sentences.en: Her eyes widened when she saw the surprise party.
sentences.zh: 她看到驚喜派對時眼睛睜得好大。

sentences.en: Can you widen the gap a little so I can get through?
sentences.zh: 你可以把縫隙弄寬一點讓我過去嗎？

sentences.en: Can reading widen your view of the world?
sentences.zh: 閱讀能拓寬你看世界的視野嗎？

sentences.en: The river begins to widen near the lake.
sentences.zh: 河流在靠近湖的地方開始變寬。

sentences.en: We had to widen the doorway to fit the new couch.
sentences.zh: 我們得把門口拓寬，新沙發才進得來。

sentences.en: Can you wipe the table after dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐後你可以擦一下桌子嗎？

sentences.en: Wipe your feet before you come in.
sentences.zh: 進來之前先把鞋底擦乾淨。

sentences.en: She wiped the tears from her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她擦掉了眼角的淚水。

sentences.en: Do you have a wipe for my hands?
sentences.zh: 你有濕紙巾讓我擦手嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter quickly wiped up the spilled juice.
sentences.zh: 服務生很快擦掉了灑出來的果汁。

sentences.en: Use a soft cloth to wipe your phone screen.
sentences.zh: 用軟布擦你的手機螢幕。

gloss_note: words of wisdom 金玉良言

sentences.en: My grandpa always shares his wisdom over dinner.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺總在晚餐時分享他的智慧。

sentences.en: Do you think wisdom comes with age?
sentences.zh: 你覺得智慧會隨著年紀增長嗎？

sentences.en: It takes wisdom to know when to stay quiet.
sentences.zh: 要有智慧才知道什麼時候該保持沉默。

sentences.en: The old teacher is known for her wisdom and kindness.
sentences.zh: 那位年長的老師以智慧和善良聞名。

sentences.en: Is there any wisdom in this old saying?
sentences.zh: 這句老話裡有什麼智慧嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for your words of wisdom.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的金玉良言。

gloss_note: wrap up 包好；也指結束

sentences.en: Can you wrap this gift for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這份禮物包起來嗎？

sentences.en: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她在脖子上圍了一條暖暖的圍巾。

sentences.en: Should I wrap the leftover pizza in foil?
sentences.zh: 我要把剩下的披薩用鋁箔紙包起來嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have a chicken wrap and a small salad.
sentences.zh: 我要一份雞肉捲餅和一份小沙拉。

sentences.en: Let's wrap the leftovers up and go home.
sentences.zh: 我們把剩菜包起來回家吧。

sentences.en: The baby was wrapped in a soft blue blanket.
sentences.zh: 寶寶被包在一條柔軟的藍色毯子裡。

sentences.en: I go to the dentist for a yearly checkup.
sentences.zh: 我每年去看牙醫做一次檢查。

sentences.en: Is there a yearly fee for this gym?
sentences.zh: 這間健身房有收年費嗎？

sentences.en: The town holds a yearly festival in the fall.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮每年秋天都會舉辦慶典。

sentences.en: We take a yearly trip to see my aunt in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我們每年都會去德州探望阿姨。

sentences.en: Our school sends out a yearly report to all parents.
sentences.zh: 我們學校每年會寄一份年度報告給所有家長。

sentences.en: Do you pay the insurance monthly or yearly?
sentences.zh: 你的保險是按月還是按年繳？

gloss_note: egg yolk 蛋黃；egg white 蛋白

sentences.en: I like my eggs with a runny yolk.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡吃蛋黃流動的蛋。

sentences.en: Separate the yolk from the white before you mix.
sentences.zh: 混合之前先把蛋黃和蛋白分開。

sentences.en: Is the yolk the yellow part of the egg?
sentences.zh: 蛋黃就是蛋裡面黃色的部分嗎？

sentences.en: The yolk broke when I dropped the egg in the pan.
sentences.zh: 我把蛋打進鍋裡時，蛋黃破了。

sentences.en: Is egg yolk rich in vitamins?
sentences.zh: 蛋黃含有豐富的維他命嗎？

sentences.en: Dad only eats the egg white and gives me the yolk.
sentences.zh: 爸爸只吃蛋白，把蛋黃給我。

gloss_note: 語氣親切稍老派，常指孩子或年輕人

sentences.en: Does the youngster next door help you carry groceries?
sentences.zh: 隔壁那個小朋友有幫你提雜貨嗎？

sentences.en: Many youngsters come to this park to play basketball.
sentences.zh: 許多年輕人來這座公園打籃球。

sentences.en: When I was a youngster, we only had one TV.
sentences.zh: 我小時候，家裡只有一台電視。

sentences.en: Is this game too hard for a youngster?
sentences.zh: 這個遊戲對小孩來說會不會太難？

sentences.en: The coach gave the youngsters some tips on hitting.
sentences.zh: 教練給那群年輕球員一些打擊的建議。

sentences.en: The library runs a reading program for local youngsters.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為當地的孩子們辦了閱讀計畫。

gloss_note: zip up 拉上拉鍊；美式 zipper，英式 zip

sentences.en: My jacket zipper is stuck again.
sentences.zh: 我外套的拉鍊又卡住了。

sentences.en: Can you pull up the zipper on my dress?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我拉上洋裝的拉鍊嗎？

sentences.en: The zipper on my backpack broke on the way to school.
sentences.zh: 我背包的拉鍊在上學途中壞掉了。

sentences.en: Is there a zipper on the side, or is it a button?
sentences.zh: 側邊是拉鍊還是釦子？

sentences.en: He closed the zipper and checked the bag again.
sentences.zh: 他拉上拉鍊，又檢查了一次包包。

sentences.en: A tiny zipper keeps the pocket safe from thieves.
sentences.zh: 一條小拉鍊讓口袋不怕被扒手偷。

sentences.en: Slow down, we're in a school zone.
sentences.zh: 慢一點，我們進入學童通行區了。

sentences.en: What time zone is New York in?
sentences.zh: 紐約在哪個時區？

sentences.en: This area is a no-parking zone.
sentences.zh: 這一區禁止停車。

sentences.en: The city has a new zone for food trucks.
sentences.zh: 市區新增了一個餐車專區。

sentences.en: Stay out of the danger zone near the construction site.
sentences.zh: 別靠近工地附近的危險區域。

sentences.en: Is this a safe zone for kids to ride bikes?
sentences.zh: 這一區讓小孩騎腳踏車安全嗎？

sentences.en: Can the company absorb the extra shipping costs?
sentences.zh: 公司能吸收額外的運費嗎？

sentences.en: Paper towels absorb water much faster than cloth.
sentences.zh: 紙巾吸水的速度比布快多了。

sentences.en: Our budget can't absorb another price increase this year.
sentences.zh: 我們的預算今年承受不了再一次漲價。

sentences.en: Do thick walls absorb noise better than thin ones?
sentences.zh: 厚牆比薄牆更能吸收噪音嗎？

sentences.en: Plants absorb sunlight and turn it into energy.
sentences.zh: 植物吸收陽光並將它轉換成能量。

sentences.en: The new owner will absorb all the debt of the shop.
sentences.zh: 新老闆會承擔這家店的所有債務。

sentences.en: Can we accelerate the project and finish by May?
sentences.zh: 我們能加快專案進度，在五月前完成嗎？

sentences.en: Prices began to accelerate after the new tax took effect.
sentences.zh: 新稅制生效後，物價開始加速上漲。

sentences.en: The manager wants to accelerate hiring this quarter.
sentences.zh: 經理想在這一季加快招募速度。

sentences.en: How can we accelerate the approval process?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼加快核准流程？

sentences.en: Can you accelerate delivery if I pay today?
sentences.zh: 如果我今天付款，你們能加快出貨嗎？

sentences.en: Warm weather will accelerate the melting of the snow.
sentences.zh: 溫暖的天氣會加速融雪。

sentences.en: Did you get your acceptance letter from the school yet?
sentences.zh: 你收到學校的錄取通知了嗎？

sentences.en: The new policy has gained wide acceptance among staff.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策已獲得員工廣泛接受。

sentences.en: Please confirm your acceptance of the offer by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前確認你接受這份聘雇條件。

sentences.en: What is the deadline for acceptance of the contract terms?
sentences.zh: 接受合約條款的期限是哪一天？

sentences.en: Her acceptance of the job surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 她接下這份工作，讓大家都很意外。

sentences.en: Public acceptance of electric cars is growing fast.
sentences.zh: 大眾對電動車的接受度正快速提高。

gloss_zh: 容易到達的；容易取得的

sentences.en: Is the office accessible by public transportation?
sentences.zh: 這間辦公室搭大眾運輸工具可以到嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel has wheelchair accessible rooms on every floor.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店每層樓都有無障礙房間。

sentences.en: Are the files accessible to everyone on the team?
sentences.zh: 團隊裡每個人都能存取這些檔案嗎？

sentences.en: Our website should be accessible to all customers.
sentences.zh: 我們的網站應該讓所有顧客都能使用。

sentences.en: The library is easily accessible from the main road.
sentences.zh: 從大馬路很容易就能到圖書館。

sentences.en: Healthy food should be accessible to every family.
sentences.zh: 每個家庭都應該買得到健康的食物。

sentences.en: Do you sell phone accessories like cases and chargers?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣手機殼和充電器之類的配件嗎？

sentences.en: That scarf is the perfect accessory for your coat.
sentences.zh: 那條圍巾是搭配你大衣的完美配件。

sentences.en: The camera comes with several useful accessories.
sentences.zh: 這台相機附有好幾樣實用的配件。

sentences.en: Which accessory goes best with this dress?
sentences.zh: 哪一件飾品最適合搭這件洋裝？

sentences.en: Car accessories are on sale at the back of the store.
sentences.zh: 汽車配件在店後面特價。

sentences.en: She bought a belt and a bag as accessories.
sentences.zh: 她買了一條皮帶和一個包包當配件。

sentences.en: Can the conference room accommodate fifty people?
sentences.zh: 這間會議室能容納五十個人嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel can accommodate large groups on short notice.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店可以在短時間內接待大型團體。

sentences.en: We will try to accommodate your schedule.
sentences.zh: 我們會盡量配合你的時間。

sentences.en: Does the restaurant accommodate guests with allergies?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳能照顧有過敏的客人嗎？

sentences.en: Our new parking lot can accommodate two hundred cars.
sentences.zh: 我們的新停車場可以停兩百輛車。

sentences.en: The school added classrooms to accommodate more students.
sentences.zh: 學校增設教室以容納更多學生。

sentences.en: What is your proudest accomplishment so far?
sentences.zh: 到目前為止，你最引以為傲的成就是什麼？

sentences.en: Finishing the marathon was a real accomplishment for him.
sentences.zh: 跑完馬拉松對他來說是真正的成就。

sentences.en: Her list of accomplishments impressed the hiring team.
sentences.zh: 她的成就清單讓招募團隊印象深刻。

sentences.en: Graduating in three years is quite an accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 三年畢業是相當了不起的成就。

sentences.en: Did the team celebrate their accomplishment?
sentences.zh: 團隊有慶祝他們的成果嗎？

sentences.en: The report highlights the company's main accomplishments this year.
sentences.zh: 這份報告強調公司今年的主要成就。

gloss_note: 常放句中或句尾；plan accordingly 依情況安排

sentences.en: Please check the new rules and act accordingly.
sentences.zh: 請看一下新規定，並據此行事。

sentences.en: The weather is changing, so dress accordingly.
sentences.zh: 天氣在變，所以要穿得合宜。

sentences.en: Did you adjust the budget accordingly?
sentences.zh: 你有據此調整預算嗎？

sentences.en: The boss was upset, and the team reacted accordingly.
sentences.zh: 老闆不高興，團隊也相應地做出反應。

sentences.en: Demand rose sharply, and prices went up accordingly.
sentences.zh: 需求大增，價格也跟著上漲。

sentences.en: If the flight is late, should we change our plans accordingly?
sentences.zh: 如果班機誤點，我們要跟著調整計畫嗎？

sentences.en: Have you sent the receipts to our accountant?
sentences.zh: 你把收據寄給我們的會計師了嗎？

sentences.en: My accountant helps me with my taxes every spring.
sentences.zh: 每年春天我的會計師都會幫我報稅。

sentences.en: She works as an accountant at a small firm.
sentences.zh: 她在一家小公司當會計。

sentences.en: Could you ask the accountant about this bill?
sentences.zh: 你可以向會計問一下這張帳單嗎？

sentences.en: The accountant found a mistake in last month's report.
sentences.zh: 會計在上個月的報表裡發現了一個錯誤。

sentences.en: He studied business so he could become an accountant.
sentences.zh: 他讀商科，好成為會計師。

sentences.en: How much interest will accrue on this loan each month?
sentences.zh: 這筆貸款每個月會累積多少利息？

sentences.en: Vacation days accrue at one per month.
sentences.zh: 休假天數每個月累積一天。

sentences.en: Late fees will accrue if the bill is not paid.
sentences.zh: 帳單沒付的話，滯納金會持續累積。

sentences.en: Does the interest accrue daily or monthly?
sentences.zh: 利息是按日還是按月累積？

sentences.en: Interest has accrued on the account since January.
sentences.zh: 這個帳戶的利息從一月起就一直累積。

sentences.en: Costs began to accrue as soon as the project started.
sentences.zh: 專案一開始，成本就開始累積。

sentences.en: Dust will accumulate quickly if you never clean.
sentences.zh: 你要是從不打掃，灰塵很快就會堆積起來。

sentences.en: How many travel points have you accumulated so far?
sentences.zh: 你到目前為止累積了多少旅遊點數？

sentences.en: She hopes to accumulate enough savings to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 她希望存夠錢買房子。

sentences.en: Snow began to accumulate on the roads overnight.
sentences.zh: 雪在夜裡開始在路上堆積起來。

sentences.en: Do your vacation days accumulate from year to year?
sentences.zh: 你的休假天數可以逐年累積嗎？

sentences.en: Debts can accumulate fast when interest rates are high.
sentences.zh: 利率高的時候，債務會迅速累積。

gloss_note: accuracy of data 資料準確性

sentences.en: How can we improve the accuracy of our sales reports?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提高銷售報表的準確度？

sentences.en: The test checks the accuracy of your spelling.
sentences.zh: 這項測驗會檢查你拼字的正確性。

sentences.en: I doubt the accuracy of this news story.
sentences.zh: 我懷疑這則新聞報導的正確性。

sentences.en: Is the accuracy of the GPS good enough for hiking?
sentences.zh: 這個定位系統的精準度夠用來健行嗎？

sentences.en: She typed with speed and accuracy.
sentences.zh: 她打字又快又準。

sentences.en: Please double-check the accuracy of these numbers.
sentences.zh: 請再核對一次這些數字的準確性。

sentences.en: Can you describe the problem more accurately?
sentences.zh: 你可以更精確地描述這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: The thermometer accurately shows the room temperature.
sentences.zh: 這支溫度計能準確顯示室溫。

sentences.en: Please fill out the form accurately.
sentences.zh: 請準確地填寫這份表格。

sentences.en: Did the reporter quote the mayor accurately?
sentences.zh: 記者有正確引用市長的話嗎？

sentences.en: The map accurately marks every exit in the building.
sentences.zh: 這張地圖精確標示了大樓的每個出口。

sentences.en: It's hard to predict the weather accurately a week ahead.
sentences.zh: 要準確預測一週後的天氣很困難。

sentences.en: It took me a month to accustom myself to the cold winters.
sentences.zh: 我花了一個月才讓自己習慣寒冷的冬天。

sentences.en: Are you accustomed to working late at night?
sentences.zh: 你習慣熬夜工作嗎？

sentences.en: She is accustomed to getting up at five every day.
sentences.zh: 她習慣每天五點起床。

sentences.en: Customers have become accustomed to fast delivery.
sentences.zh: 顧客已經習慣快速送貨了。

sentences.en: How long did it take you to get accustomed to American food?
sentences.zh: 你花了多久才習慣美國食物？

sentences.en: Give your eyes a minute to accustom themselves to the dark.
sentences.zh: 讓眼睛花一分鐘適應黑暗吧。

gloss_note: acid rain 酸雨；acidic 較常作形容詞

sentences.en: Lemon juice contains a lot of acid.
sentences.zh: 檸檬汁含有大量的酸。

sentences.en: Do tomatoes grow well in acid soil?
sentences.zh: 番茄在酸性土壤裡長得好嗎？

sentences.en: Acid rain has damaged many old stone buildings.
sentences.zh: 酸雨損壞了許多古老的石造建築。

sentences.en: Do not let the acid touch your skin.
sentences.zh: 別讓酸液碰到你的皮膚。

sentences.en: What kind of acid did you use in the experiment?
sentences.zh: 你在實驗中用了哪一種酸？

sentences.en: Stomach acid helps break down the food we eat.
sentences.zh: 胃酸幫助分解我們吃下去的食物。

sentences.en: How do I activate my new credit card?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼開通我的新信用卡？

sentences.en: Please activate your account by clicking the link in the email.
sentences.zh: 請點選電子郵件中的連結啟用你的帳號。

sentences.en: Press this button to activate the alarm.
sentences.zh: 按這個按鈕來啟動警報器。

sentences.en: Did the update activate the new feature automatically?
sentences.zh: 這次更新有自動啟用新功能嗎？

sentences.en: Heat from a fire will activate the sprinklers in the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 火災的高溫會觸動天花板上的灑水器。

sentences.en: Exercise can activate certain parts of the brain.
sentences.zh: 運動可以活化大腦的某些區域。

sentences.en: Are you actively looking for a new job?
sentences.zh: 你正在積極找新工作嗎？

sentences.en: She actively takes part in every class discussion.
sentences.zh: 她積極參與每一次課堂討論。

sentences.en: Our company is actively hiring engineers right now.
sentences.zh: 我們公司現在正積極招聘工程師。

sentences.en: Why don't you actively share your ideas in meetings?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼不在會議上主動分享想法？

sentences.en: The city is actively working to reduce air pollution.
sentences.zh: 市政府正積極努力減少空氣汙染。

sentences.en: He actively avoids talking about money.
sentences.zh: 他刻意避開不談錢的話題。

sentences.en: My sister is an environmental activist in our town.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊是我們鎮上的環保人士。

sentences.en: Activists gathered outside city hall to ask for cleaner air.
sentences.zh: 社運人士聚集在市政廳外要求更乾淨的空氣。

sentences.en: Is the speaker a well-known activist for animal rights?
sentences.zh: 這位講者是知名的動物權益倡議人士嗎？

sentences.en: He became an activist after the factory closed.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉後，他成了社運人士。

sentences.en: Several activists asked the company to protect workers.
sentences.zh: 幾位倡議人士要求公司保障員工。

sentences.en: Would you ever want to be an activist?
sentences.zh: 你會想當社運人士嗎？

sentences.en: Is the pain acute, or does it come and go?
sentences.zh: 是劇痛，還是時好時壞？

sentences.en: The city faces an acute shortage of affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 這座城市面臨嚴重的平價住宅短缺。

sentences.en: She was taken to the hospital with acute stomach pain.
sentences.zh: 她因劇烈腹痛被送到醫院。

sentences.en: Do you think the problem is acute enough to call a meeting?
sentences.zh: 你覺得問題嚴重到需要開會嗎？

sentences.en: An acute lack of water hurt farmers this summer.
sentences.zh: 嚴重缺水讓農民今年夏天受創。

sentences.en: The patient needs treatment for an acute illness.
sentences.zh: 這位病人需要接受急性疾病的治療。

sentences.en: How long does adaptation to a new country usually take?
sentences.zh: 適應一個新國家通常需要多久？

sentences.en: Plants show clever adaptation to dry weather.
sentences.zh: 植物對乾燥天氣展現巧妙的適應力。

sentences.en: Have you seen the movie adaptation of that novel?
sentences.zh: 你看過那本小說改編的電影嗎？

sentences.en: Quick adaptation to change is important in this job.
sentences.zh: 在這份工作中，快速適應變化很重要。

sentences.en: The show is an adaptation of a famous children's book.
sentences.zh: 這齣劇是改編自一本著名的童書。

sentences.en: Is the stage adaptation as good as the original story?
sentences.zh: 這部舞台劇改編和原著故事一樣好嗎？

gloss_note: adhere to 遵守（規定）；黏住

sentences.en: All employees must adhere to the safety rules.
sentences.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守安全規定。

sentences.en: Does this tape adhere to wood as well as to glass?
sentences.zh: 這種膠帶黏在木頭上和黏在玻璃上一樣牢嗎？

sentences.en: We need to adhere to the schedule if we want to finish on time.
sentences.zh: 如果想準時完成，我們就得照進度走。

sentences.en: Do all the vendors adhere to our quality standards?
sentences.zh: 所有供應商都遵守我們的品質標準嗎？

sentences.en: The sticker won't adhere to a wet surface.
sentences.zh: 貼紙黏不住潮濕的表面。

sentences.en: The company promised to adhere to the new law.
sentences.zh: 公司承諾遵守這項新法規。

gloss_note: adjacent to 緊鄰；常見於房間、土地

sentences.en: Our hotel room is adjacent to the elevator.
sentences.zh: 我們的飯店房間緊鄰電梯。

sentences.en: Is there a parking lot adjacent to the building?
sentences.zh: 大樓旁邊有停車場嗎？

sentences.en: The two offices are in adjacent buildings.
sentences.zh: 這兩間辦公室在相鄰的大樓裡。

sentences.en: A small café is adjacent to the bookstore.
sentences.zh: 書店隔壁有一家小咖啡館。

sentences.en: Could we get two adjacent seats on the plane?
sentences.zh: 我們可以在飛機上訂到兩個相鄰的座位嗎？

sentences.en: Fire spread to the adjacent houses before help arrived.
sentences.zh: 救援抵達前，火勢已蔓延到鄰近的房屋。

gloss_note: administer a program 管理計畫

sentences.en: Who will administer the new training program?
sentences.zh: 誰會負責管理這個新的訓練計畫？

sentences.en: The office administers all employee benefits.
sentences.zh: 這個部門負責辦理所有員工福利。

sentences.en: Our department administers the scholarship fund.
sentences.zh: 我們部門負責管理獎學金基金。

sentences.en: Teachers will administer the test next Monday.
sentences.zh: 老師下週一會主持這場考試。

sentences.en: Do you know who administers this website?
sentences.zh: 你知道誰在管理這個網站嗎？

sentences.en: The agency was set up to administer the new law.
sentences.zh: 這個機構是為執行新法規而設立的。

sentences.en: She works as an administrative assistant at a law firm.
sentences.zh: 她在一家律師事務所擔任行政助理。

sentences.en: Is this an administrative matter or a legal one?
sentences.zh: 這是行政事務還是法律問題？

sentences.en: Administrative costs took up a large part of the budget.
sentences.zh: 行政費用占了預算很大一部分。

sentences.en: Do you need help with the administrative work?
sentences.zh: 你需要人幫忙處理行政工作嗎？

sentences.en: The administrative office is on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 行政辦公室在二樓。

sentences.en: He left sales for an administrative job.
sentences.zh: 他離開業務部門，轉任行政職務。

sentences.en: Please contact the system administrator if you cannot log in.
sentences.zh: 如果無法登入，請聯絡系統管理員。

sentences.en: Who is the administrator of this hospital?
sentences.zh: 這家醫院的行政主管是誰？

sentences.en: The school administrator will announce the new schedule.
sentences.zh: 學校的行政人員將公布新的時間表。

sentences.en: Is the website administrator available today?
sentences.zh: 網站管理員今天在嗎？

sentences.en: She was promoted to office administrator last month.
sentences.zh: 她上個月升為辦公室行政主管。

sentences.en: Every administrator received a copy of the report.
sentences.zh: 每位行政人員都收到一份報告。

sentences.en: How much is admission to the museum?
sentences.zh: 博物館的門票要多少錢？

sentences.en: Admission is free for children under five.
sentences.zh: 五歲以下兒童免費入場。

sentences.en: Did you get your admission to the university?
sentences.zh: 你拿到大學的入學許可了嗎？

sentences.en: Please pay the admission fee at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 請到櫃檯繳交入場費。

sentences.en: Admission to the program depends on your test scores.
sentences.zh: 能否進入這個課程要看你的考試成績。

sentences.en: Is there an admission charge for the concert?
sentences.zh: 這場演唱會要收入場費嗎？

gloss_note: adj. 青春期的；常用於醫學、教育

sentences.en: Many adolescents need more sleep than adults.
sentences.zh: 許多青少年需要比成年人更多的睡眠。

sentences.en: She works as a doctor for adolescents.
sentences.zh: 她是專門看青少年的醫生。

sentences.en: What do adolescents usually worry about?
sentences.zh: 青少年通常都擔心些什麼？

sentences.en: The book is about the struggles of an adolescent.
sentences.zh: 這本書談的是一個青少年的掙扎。

sentences.en: An adolescent needs support from family and school.
sentences.zh: 青少年需要家庭和學校的支持。

sentences.en: Is it hard to raise an adolescent these days?
sentences.zh: 現在養育青少年很難嗎？

gloss_note: adoption of 採用某事物；另有「收養」之意

sentences.en: The adoption of the new software saved us a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 採用新軟體為我們省了很多時間。

sentences.en: Will the board approve the adoption of the new policy?
sentences.zh: 董事會會批准採用這項新政策嗎？

sentences.en: The adoption of electric buses is growing in many cities.
sentences.zh: 電動巴士在許多城市的使用越來越普遍。

sentences.en: What led to the quick adoption of mobile payments?
sentences.zh: 是什麼促成行動支付被迅速採用？

sentences.en: Early adoption of the system helped the team stay organized.
sentences.zh: 早期採用這套系統讓團隊井然有序。

sentences.en: Do you support the adoption of a four-day workweek?
sentences.zh: 你支持採用每週四天工作制嗎？

gloss_note: affiliate of ~ ……的子公司；也指聯盟行銷夥伴

sentences.en: The bank is an affiliate of a large insurance company.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行是一間大型保險公司的關係企業。

sentences.en: Is the local radio station an affiliate of the national network?
sentences.zh: 這家地方電台是全國廣播網的附屬台嗎？

sentences.en: Our foreign affiliate handles sales in Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們的海外關係企業負責亞洲的銷售。

sentences.en: Can an affiliate use our company logo?
sentences.zh: 附屬機構可以使用我們公司的標誌嗎？

sentences.en: She works for a hospital affiliate downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心一家醫院的附屬機構工作。

sentences.en: The firm sold its affiliate last year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司去年賣掉了它的關係企業。

sentences.en: Do you know any affordable restaurants near here?
sentences.zh: 你知道這附近有平價的餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: We are looking for an affordable apartment downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們在找市中心租金合理的公寓。

sentences.en: Is this laptop affordable for a student?
sentences.zh: 這台筆電學生買得起嗎？

sentences.en: The airline offers affordable tickets in the off-season.
sentences.zh: 這家航空公司在淡季提供平價機票。

sentences.en: Affordable health care is a major issue for many families.
sentences.zh: 平價醫療對許多家庭來說是重要議題。

sentences.en: Is there a more affordable option on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜單上有比較便宜的選擇嗎？

gloss_note: in the aggregate 總體而言

sentences.en: What is the aggregate cost of all three projects?
sentences.zh: 這三個專案的總成本是多少？

sentences.en: The aggregate sales for the year reached ten million dollars.
sentences.zh: 全年的總銷售額達到一千萬美元。

sentences.en: In the aggregate, our expenses fell by five percent.
sentences.zh: 整體而言，我們的支出下降了百分之五。

sentences.en: Did the aggregate score meet the school's target?
sentences.zh: 總分有達到學校的目標嗎？

sentences.en: Aggregate demand usually drops when prices rise sharply.
sentences.zh: 物價大幅上漲時，總需求通常會下降。

sentences.en: The report shows the aggregate profit of all our stores.
sentences.zh: 這份報告顯示我們所有分店的總利潤。

sentences.en: How much is the airfare to Chicago?
sentences.zh: 飛芝加哥的機票要多少錢？

sentences.en: The company will pay for your airfare and hotel.
sentences.zh: 公司會支付你的機票和飯店費用。

sentences.en: Airfare is cheaper if you book three months ahead.
sentences.zh: 提前三個月訂的話機票比較便宜。

sentences.en: Does the price include airfare?
sentences.zh: 這個價格有包含機票費用嗎？

sentences.en: I'm saving money on airfare by flying on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我挑星期二搭機來省機票錢。

sentences.en: Airfare went up sharply during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 假期旺季時機票價格大幅上漲。

gloss_note: alcohol-free 無酒精的；含酒精的飲品

sentences.en: Do you serve alcohol at this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你們餐廳有供應含酒精的飲料嗎？

sentences.en: You must be twenty-one to buy alcohol in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美國要滿二十一歲才能買酒。

sentences.en: This sauce has no alcohol in it.
sentences.zh: 這道醬汁裡沒有酒精。

sentences.en: Is there alcohol in the cough medicine?
sentences.zh: 這種咳嗽藥水裡有酒精嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor told him to cut back on alcohol.
sentences.zh: 醫生要他少喝酒。

sentences.en: Alcohol is not allowed on school grounds.
sentences.zh: 校園內不准攜帶酒類。

sentences.en: Stay alert when you drive at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上開車要保持警覺。

sentences.en: Are you alert enough to keep working after lunch?
sentences.zh: 你午餐後還夠清醒繼續工作嗎？

sentences.en: The guard was alert to every sound.
sentences.zh: 警衛留意著每一個聲響。

sentences.en: Coffee keeps me alert during long meetings.
sentences.zh: 咖啡讓我在冗長的會議中保持清醒。

sentences.en: Please alert me if the system goes down.
sentences.zh: 如果系統當機，請通知我。

sentences.en: Will the app alert you when your package arrives?
sentences.zh: 你的包裹到達時，應用程式會通知你嗎？

sentences.en: I have an algebra test tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 我明天早上有代數考試。

sentences.en: Can you help me with this algebra problem?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我解這道代數題嗎？

sentences.en: Algebra uses letters to stand for unknown numbers.
sentences.zh: 代數用字母來代表未知的數字。

sentences.en: Did you take algebra in high school?
sentences.zh: 你高中有修代數嗎？

sentences.en: She teaches algebra to ninth graders.
sentences.zh: 她教九年級學生代數。

sentences.en: Why do we need algebra in real life?
sentences.zh: 我們日常生活為什麼需要代數？

sentences.en: Do you know how the search algorithm ranks pages?
sentences.zh: 你知道搜尋演算法怎麼替網頁排名嗎？

sentences.en: The app uses an algorithm to suggest new songs.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式用演算法推薦新歌。

sentences.en: Our team wrote a faster algorithm for sorting data.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊寫了一個更快的資料排序演算法。

sentences.en: Did the algorithm change after the last update?
sentences.zh: 上次更新後，演算法有改變嗎？

sentences.en: An algorithm is a set of steps to solve a problem.
sentences.zh: 演算法是一組解決問題的步驟。

sentences.en: Banks use an algorithm to spot unusual charges.
sentences.zh: 銀行用演算法找出異常的刷卡消費。

sentences.en: The two companies formed an alliance to share research costs.
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司結盟以分攤研究成本。

sentences.en: Is this alliance good for small businesses?
sentences.zh: 這個聯盟對小型企業有利嗎？

sentences.en: Several airlines joined a global alliance.
sentences.zh: 幾家航空公司加入了全球聯盟。

sentences.en: We need a strong alliance with local suppliers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要和當地供應商建立穩固的合作聯盟。

sentences.en: Why did the alliance break up after five years?
sentences.zh: 這個聯盟為什麼在五年後解散了？

sentences.en: The countries formed an alliance in 1949.
sentences.zh: 這些國家在1949年結成了聯盟。

sentences.en: How should we allocate the budget among the three teams?
sentences.zh: 我們該怎麼把預算分給這三個團隊？

sentences.en: The city will allocate money for a new library.
sentences.zh: 市政府將撥款興建一座新圖書館。

sentences.en: Please allocate two hours for the training session.
sentences.zh: 請撥出兩小時給這場訓練課程。

sentences.en: Who will allocate the parking spaces this year?
sentences.zh: 今年誰來分配停車位？

sentences.en: Did the manager allocate enough time for testing?
sentences.zh: 經理有分配足夠的時間做測試嗎？

sentences.en: We allocate extra staff to the shop on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末我們會多派人手到店裡。

sentences.en: What is the allocation for marketing this year?
sentences.zh: 今年行銷費用的配額是多少？

sentences.en: The allocation of seats will be announced tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 座位的分配明天會公布。

sentences.en: Is the allocation of tasks fair to everyone?
sentences.zh: 工作分配對每個人都公平嗎？

sentences.en: The city increased its allocation for road repairs.
sentences.zh: 市政府增加了道路修繕的預算。

sentences.en: A smart allocation of resources saved the project.
sentences.zh: 善加分配資源挽救了這個專案。

sentences.en: Each department gets an equal allocation of supplies.
sentences.zh: 每個部門分到等量的用品。

sentences.en: Do you get a travel allowance for business trips?
sentences.zh: 出差時你有差旅津貼嗎？

sentences.en: My parents gave me a weekly allowance when I was ten.
sentences.zh: 我十歲時，爸媽每週給我零用錢。

sentences.en: The company offers a monthly housing allowance.
sentences.zh: 公司每月提供住宿津貼。

sentences.en: How much is the daily meal allowance?
sentences.zh: 每天的餐費補助是多少？

sentences.en: He spends his whole allowance on video games.
sentences.zh: 他把整份零用錢都花在電玩上。

sentences.en: Employees get a clothing allowance each year.
sentences.zh: 員工每年可領服裝津貼。

sentences.en: We alternate weeks working the front desk.
sentences.zh: 我們一人一週，輪流值櫃檯。

sentences.en: Do you work on alternate Saturdays?
sentences.zh: 你是隔週六上班嗎？

sentences.en: I alternate between morning and night shifts.
sentences.zh: 我早班和晚班輪流上。

sentences.en: Garbage pickup happens on alternate Fridays here.
sentences.zh: 這裡每隔一個週五收一次垃圾。

sentences.en: Can you alternate between hot and cold packs on the sore muscle?
sentences.zh: 你可以輪流用熱敷和冰敷來處理痠痛的肌肉嗎？

sentences.en: She alternates her work time with short breaks.
sentences.zh: 她把工作時間和短暫休息交替安排。

sentences.en: She is an ambitious young manager who wants to lead the company.
sentences.zh: 她是個有野心的年輕經理，想領導這家公司。

sentences.en: Is the schedule too ambitious for such a small team?
sentences.zh: 對這麼小的團隊來說，這個時程是不是太不切實際了？

sentences.en: We have an ambitious plan to open ten new stores.
sentences.zh: 我們有個宏大的計畫，要開十家新店。

sentences.en: Are you ambitious enough to start your own business?
sentences.zh: 你有足夠的雄心自己創業嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor set ambitious goals for cutting traffic.
sentences.zh: 市長訂下了減少交通壅塞的宏大目標。

sentences.en: He's very ambitious and always wants a promotion.
sentences.zh: 他很有企圖心，總是想升遷。

gloss_note: amend a contract 修訂合約；多用於條文、文件

sentences.en: We need to amend the contract before we sign it.
sentences.zh: 我們簽約前需要先修訂合約。

sentences.en: Can the rules be amended if most members agree?
sentences.zh: 如果多數成員同意，規定可以修改嗎？

sentences.en: The city council voted to amend the parking rules.
sentences.zh: 市議會投票決定修改停車規定。

sentences.en: Please amend the report to include the latest numbers.
sentences.zh: 請修訂報告，加入最新的數字。

sentences.en: Do you want to amend your order before it ships?
sentences.zh: 你想在出貨前修改訂單嗎？

sentences.en: The club decided to amend its rules last year.
sentences.zh: 這個社團去年決定修改規章。

gloss_note: amino acid 胺基酸；蛋白質的基本單位

sentences.en: Proteins are made of amino acids.
sentences.zh: 蛋白質是由胺基酸組成的。

sentences.en: Which foods contain all the essential amino acids?
sentences.zh: 哪些食物含有所有必需胺基酸？

sentences.en: The body cannot make some amino acids on its own.
sentences.zh: 人體無法自行製造某些胺基酸。

sentences.en: Do athletes take amino acid supplements after training?
sentences.zh: 運動員訓練後會服用胺基酸補充品嗎？

sentences.en: Eggs are a good source of amino acids.
sentences.zh: 蛋是胺基酸的良好來源。

sentences.en: The lab studied how amino acids join together.
sentences.zh: 實驗室研究了胺基酸如何結合在一起。

gloss_note: loan amortization 貸款攤還；常見於會計

sentences.en: The amortization schedule shows each monthly payment.
sentences.zh: 攤還表列出了每個月的還款金額。

sentences.en: How long is the amortization period for this loan?
sentences.zh: 這筆貸款的攤還期間有多長？

sentences.en: Amortization of the software cost will take five years.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體的成本要攤銷五年。

sentences.en: Did the accountant include amortization in the report?
sentences.zh: 會計有把攤銷放進報告嗎？

sentences.en: Our monthly payment covers interest and amortization.
sentences.zh: 我們每月還款包含利息和本金攤還。

sentences.en: A longer amortization lowers your monthly payment.
sentences.zh: 攤還期間越長，每月還款額越低。

gloss_note: wave amplitude 波的振幅；也指程度大小

sentences.en: The amplitude of the wave is measured in centimeters.
sentences.zh: 這個波的振幅是以公分來測量的。

sentences.en: A louder sound has a larger amplitude.
sentences.zh: 聲音越大，振幅越大。

sentences.en: What is the amplitude of this signal?
sentences.zh: 這個訊號的振幅是多少？

sentences.en: The student drew a wave with a small amplitude.
sentences.zh: 這位學生畫了一個振幅很小的波。

sentences.en: Did the amplitude change when we raised the volume?
sentences.zh: 我們調高音量時，振幅有改變嗎？

sentences.en: The earthquake's amplitude was recorded on the machine.
sentences.zh: 地震的振幅被儀器記錄了下來。

sentences.en: Today is our fifth wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 今天是我們結婚五週年紀念日。

sentences.en: What should I get my wife for our anniversary?
sentences.zh: 我該買什麼送老婆當結婚紀念日禮物？

sentences.en: The company will celebrate its tenth anniversary next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月將慶祝成立十週年。

sentences.en: Do you have a table for two for our anniversary dinner?
sentences.zh: 你們有雙人桌讓我們吃週年紀念晚餐嗎？

sentences.en: The store is having a big sale for its anniversary.
sentences.zh: 這家店為了週年慶舉辦大特賣。

sentences.en: The city held a parade on the anniversary of its founding.
sentences.zh: 城市在建城紀念日舉行了遊行。

sentences.en: The announcer said our train would be ten minutes late.
sentences.zh: 廣播員說我們的火車會晚十分鐘到。

sentences.en: Did you hear what the announcer just said?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到剛才廣播員說了什麼嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle works as a radio announcer.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是電台播音員。

sentences.en: The stadium announcer called the next player's name.
sentences.zh: 球場播報員唱名下一位球員。

sentences.en: Who is the announcer for tonight's game?
sentences.zh: 今晚比賽的播報員是誰？

sentences.en: The announcer has a deep and friendly voice.
sentences.zh: 這位播報員的聲音低沉又親切。

gloss_note: annoyed 形容人；annoying 形容事物

sentences.en: Does the noise from the street annoy you?
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音會讓你心煩嗎？

sentences.en: It annoys me when people talk during a movie.
sentences.zh: 有人在電影中說話讓我很火大。

sentences.en: Please don't annoy your sister while she studies.
sentences.zh: 你姊姊念書時別去煩她。

sentences.en: The long wait at the airport really annoyed everyone.
sentences.zh: 在機場等那麼久真的讓大家都很煩躁。

sentences.en: What annoys you most about your job?
sentences.zh: 你的工作中最讓你煩的是什麼？

sentences.en: Slow customer service can annoy even patient customers.
sentences.zh: 緩慢的客服連很有耐心的顧客也會被惹惱。

sentences.en: The conference is held annually in the spring.
sentences.zh: 這場研討會每年春天舉行。

sentences.en: Do you pay the membership fee annually or monthly?
sentences.zh: 會員費你是按年付還是按月付？

sentences.en: The company reviews its prices annually.
sentences.zh: 公司每年檢討一次價格。

sentences.en: Sales grew by ten percent annually over five years.
sentences.zh: 五年來銷售額每年成長百分之十。

sentences.en: Do you renew your car registration annually?
sentences.zh: 你的汽車行照是每年更新嗎？

sentences.en: Our family visits the beach annually in July.
sentences.zh: 我們全家每年七月都去海邊。

sentences.en: Do you have an annuity to help pay for retirement?
sentences.zh: 你有年金保險來支應退休生活嗎？

sentences.en: The annuity pays him a fixed amount every month.
sentences.zh: 這份年金每個月支付他固定的金額。

sentences.en: She bought an annuity with part of her savings.
sentences.zh: 她用一部分存款買了年金保險。

sentences.en: How does an annuity differ from a regular savings account?
sentences.zh: 年金和一般儲蓄帳戶有什麼不同？

sentences.en: An annuity can provide steady income after you stop working.
sentences.zh: 年金可以在你停止工作後提供穩定的收入。

sentences.en: The insurance company sells several kinds of annuity plans.
sentences.zh: 這家保險公司販售好幾種年金方案。

sentences.en: The body produces antibodies to fight infection.
sentences.zh: 身體會產生抗體來對抗感染。

sentences.en: Did the blood test show any antibodies?
sentences.zh: 驗血有發現任何抗體嗎？

sentences.en: A vaccine helps your body make antibodies against the virus.
sentences.zh: 疫苗能幫助你的身體製造對抗病毒的抗體。

sentences.en: What does an antibody do in the immune system?
sentences.zh: 抗體在免疫系統裡有什麼作用？

sentences.en: Researchers found a new antibody in the patient's blood.
sentences.zh: 研究人員在病人的血液中發現了一種新的抗體。

sentences.en: Each antibody matches one specific germ.
sentences.zh: 每種抗體都對應一種特定的病菌。

gloss_note: Call me anytime. 隨時打給我

sentences.en: You can call me anytime if you need help.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，隨時都可以打給我。

sentences.en: Feel free to stop by my office anytime this week.
sentences.zh: 這週隨時歡迎來我辦公室。

sentences.en: Can I cancel my reservation anytime?
sentences.zh: 我可以隨時取消訂位嗎？

sentences.en: The store accepts returns anytime within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 這家店在三十天內隨時接受退貨。

sentences.en: Is the pool open anytime during the day?
sentences.zh: 游泳池白天隨時都有開嗎？

sentences.en: Come over anytime you want to talk.
sentences.zh: 你想聊聊的時候，隨時過來。

gloss_note: accept an apology 接受道歉

sentences.en: Please accept my apology for the late reply.
sentences.zh: 對於遲覆，請接受我的歉意。

sentences.en: Did the airline offer an apology for the delay?
sentences.zh: 航空公司有為誤點道歉嗎？

sentences.en: I owe you an apology for what I said yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我為昨天說的話欠你一個道歉。

sentences.en: The manager sent a short apology to the customer.
sentences.zh: 經理寫了一封簡短的道歉信給顧客。

sentences.en: Is a simple apology enough to fix the problem?
sentences.zh: 一句簡單的道歉足以解決這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: The company made a public apology on Monday.
sentences.zh: 公司在週一公開道歉。

sentences.en: The full survey results are in the appendix.
sentences.zh: 完整的調查結果在附錄裡。

sentences.en: Can you add a list of sources to the appendix?
sentences.zh: 你可以把參考資料清單加到附錄嗎？

sentences.en: Please see Appendix B for the detailed budget.
sentences.zh: 詳細的預算請見附錄 B。

sentences.en: Is there an appendix at the back of the book?
sentences.zh: 書的最後面有附錄嗎？

sentences.en: The tables are in the appendix, so the main text stays short.
sentences.zh: 圖表放在附錄，這樣正文就不會太長。

sentences.en: My report has three appendices with extra data.
sentences.zh: 我的報告有三份附錄，附上額外的資料。

sentences.en: We need to buy a new kitchen appliance.
sentences.zh: 我們得買一件新的廚房電器。

sentences.en: Which appliance uses the most electricity at home?
sentences.zh: 家裡哪一種電器最耗電？

sentences.en: The store sells refrigerators, ovens, and other appliances.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣冰箱、烤箱和其他家電。

sentences.en: Is this appliance still under warranty?
sentences.zh: 這件家電還在保固期內嗎？

sentences.en: Unplug the appliance before you clean it.
sentences.zh: 清潔前請先拔掉電器的插頭。

sentences.en: Energy-efficient appliances can lower your monthly bill.
sentences.zh: 節能家電可以降低你每月的帳單。

sentences.en: Is this discount applicable to online orders?
sentences.zh: 這個折扣適用於網路訂單嗎？

sentences.en: Please list your degrees, if applicable.
sentences.zh: 如果適用的話，請列出你的學位。

sentences.en: The new rule is applicable to all employees.
sentences.zh: 這項新規定適用於所有員工。

sentences.en: Are any extra fees applicable to this service?
sentences.zh: 這項服務需要另外收費嗎？

sentences.en: This fee is applicable only in some states.
sentences.zh: 這項費用只在部分的州適用。

sentences.en: Check the box that is applicable to you.
sentences.zh: 請勾選適合你的那一格。

sentences.en: How many applicants did you interview today?
sentences.zh: 你今天面試了多少位應徵者？

sentences.en: Each applicant must submit a resume and a cover letter.
sentences.zh: 每位申請人都必須繳交履歷和求職信。

sentences.en: The best applicant will start next month.
sentences.zh: 最佳的應徵者下個月就會上班。

sentences.en: Is the applicant available for a second interview?
sentences.zh: 這位應徵者能來第二次面試嗎？

sentences.en: The school had over a thousand applicants this year.
sentences.zh: 學校今年有一千多名申請人。

sentences.en: We will contact every applicant by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 我們會在週末前聯絡每一位申請人。

sentences.en: When is your next performance appraisal?
sentences.zh: 你下一次績效考核是什麼時候？

sentences.en: The bank ordered an appraisal of the house.
sentences.zh: 銀行要求對這棟房子做估價。

sentences.en: My manager gave me a fair appraisal of my work.
sentences.zh: 我的主管對我的工作做了公正的評價。

sentences.en: Did you read the appraisal report before you signed?
sentences.zh: 你簽名前有讀過評估報告嗎？

sentences.en: An honest appraisal of the risks is necessary.
sentences.zh: 必須對風險做誠實的評估。

sentences.en: How long does a home appraisal usually take?
sentences.zh: 房屋估價通常要花多久時間？

gloss_note: show appreciation 表達謝意；價格升值

sentences.en: We gave her a gift to show our appreciation.
sentences.zh: 我們送她一份禮物表達謝意。

sentences.en: Please accept this card as a token of my appreciation.
sentences.zh: 請收下這張卡片，表達我的感激。

sentences.en: Do you feel the staff gets enough appreciation?
sentences.zh: 你覺得員工得到足夠的肯定嗎？

sentences.en: The house saw strong appreciation last year.
sentences.zh: 這棟房子去年大幅增值。

sentences.en: What is the yearly appreciation of homes in this area?
sentences.zh: 這一帶房價每年增值多少？

sentences.en: He expressed his deep appreciation to the whole team.
sentences.zh: 他向整個團隊表達了深深的謝意。

gloss_note: work as an apprentice 當學徒

sentences.en: He started as an apprentice in a local bakery.
sentences.zh: 他在當地一家麵包店當學徒起家。

sentences.en: Is she still an apprentice, or is she a licensed electrician now?
sentences.zh: 她還是學徒，還是已經是有執照的電工了？

sentences.en: The company hires an apprentice every summer.
sentences.zh: 公司每年夏天都會雇用一名學徒。

sentences.en: An apprentice learns the job by watching an expert.
sentences.zh: 學徒透過觀察專家來學習這份工作。

sentences.en: How long does an apprentice train before getting a license?
sentences.zh: 學徒要訓練多久才能拿到執照？

sentences.en: My uncle took on a young apprentice last month.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔上個月收了一位年輕的學徒。

gloss_note: approximate cost 概估費用；v. 近似

sentences.en: What is the approximate cost of the repair?
sentences.zh: 這次維修的大概費用是多少？

sentences.en: Can you give me an approximate arrival time?
sentences.zh: 你可以告訴我大概的抵達時間嗎？

sentences.en: The approximate size of the room is twelve feet by ten.
sentences.zh: 房間大約是十二呎乘十呎。

sentences.en: These numbers are only approximate, so please check them.
sentences.zh: 這些數字只是概數，請再核對。

sentences.en: Do you know the approximate number of guests?
sentences.zh: 你知道賓客的大概人數嗎？

sentences.en: The new model approximates real traffic quite well.
sentences.zh: 這個新模型相當接近真實的交通狀況。

gloss_note: a rough approximation 粗略估計

sentences.en: Pi is about three point one four, which is just an approximation.
sentences.zh: 圓周率約是三點一四，這只是個近似值。

sentences.en: Is this figure an exact number or an approximation?
sentences.zh: 這個數字是確切數字還是估計值？

sentences.en: That's a fair approximation of the total cost.
sentences.zh: 那是對總成本相當合理的估算。

sentences.en: Her drawing was a rough approximation of the real building.
sentences.zh: 她的畫是真實建築物的粗略描繪。

sentences.en: Can you give me a quick approximation of the time we need?
sentences.zh: 你能快速估個我們需要的時間嗎？

sentences.en: The answer is only an approximation, not the final result.
sentences.zh: 這個答案只是近似值，不是最終結果。

gloss_note: do arbitrage 進行套利；利用價差獲利

sentences.en: Traders use arbitrage to profit from small price gaps.
sentences.zh: 交易員利用套利從微小價差中獲利。

sentences.en: What is arbitrage, and how does it work?
sentences.zh: 什麼是套利？它是怎麼運作的？

sentences.en: An arbitrage deal buys low in one market and sells high in another.
sentences.zh: 套利交易是在一個市場低價買進，在另一個市場高價賣出。

sentences.en: Is arbitrage risky for a small investor?
sentences.zh: 套利對小額投資人來說風險高嗎？

sentences.en: Computers now carry out most arbitrage trades in seconds.
sentences.zh: 現在大部分套利交易由電腦在幾秒內完成。

sentences.en: The bank hired a team to look for arbitrage opportunities.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行僱了一個團隊尋找套利機會。

sentences.en: The deadline seems arbitrary to me.
sentences.zh: 這個截止日期對我來說似乎很隨意。

sentences.en: Why did the boss make such an arbitrary decision?
sentences.zh: 老闆為什麼做出這麼武斷的決定？

sentences.en: The teacher's rules felt arbitrary to the students.
sentences.zh: 學生覺得老師的規定很武斷。

sentences.en: Choose any arbitrary number between one and ten.
sentences.zh: 在一到十之間隨便挑一個數字。

sentences.en: Are these prices arbitrary, or is there a reason?
sentences.zh: 這些價格是隨便訂的，還是有原因？

sentences.en: Judges should not make arbitrary choices in court.
sentences.zh: 法官不該在法庭上做出任意的選擇。

sentences.en: She is studying archaeology at the university.
sentences.zh: 她在大學念考古學。

sentences.en: Did you visit the archaeology museum on your trip?
sentences.zh: 你旅行時有去考古博物館嗎？

sentences.en: Archaeology tells us how ancient people lived.
sentences.zh: 考古學讓我們了解古人是怎麼生活的。

sentences.en: He took an archaeology class just for fun.
sentences.zh: 他修了一門考古學的課，純粹好玩。

sentences.en: Why are you interested in archaeology?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對考古學有興趣？

sentences.en: New tools have changed archaeology in recent years.
sentences.zh: 新工具在近幾年改變了考古學。

sentences.en: The architect showed us the plans for the new library.
sentences.zh: 建築師給我們看了新圖書館的設計圖。

sentences.en: My brother wants to become an architect.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥想成為建築師。

sentences.en: Did the architect change the design of the lobby?
sentences.zh: 建築師有改大廳的設計嗎？

sentences.en: A good architect thinks about both beauty and safety.
sentences.zh: 好的建築師會同時考慮美觀與安全。

sentences.en: Who was the architect of this old train station?
sentences.zh: 這座老火車站的建築師是誰？

sentences.en: We hired an architect to redesign our kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們請了建築師來重新設計廚房。

gloss_note: an array of 一系列；多樣的

sentences.en: The store offers a wide array of cell phone cases.
sentences.zh: 這家店提供種類繁多的手機殼。

sentences.en: Does the menu have an array of vegetarian dishes?
sentences.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的素食料理嗎？

sentences.en: The company showed an impressive array of new products.
sentences.zh: 公司展示了一系列令人驚豔的新產品。

sentences.en: An array stores a list of numbers in order.
sentences.zh: 陣列依序儲存一串數字。

sentences.en: The festival has an array of food stands.
sentences.zh: 這個慶典有各式各樣的美食攤位。

sentences.en: Does your agency provide a full array of services?
sentences.zh: 你們公司提供各式各樣的服務嗎？

gloss_note: every aspect of 每個層面；一個面向

sentences.en: Which aspect of the job do you like best?
sentences.zh: 這份工作的哪個方面你最喜歡？

sentences.en: We need to look at every aspect of the plan.
sentences.zh: 我們需要檢視計畫的每個層面。

sentences.en: The cost is only one aspect of the problem.
sentences.zh: 成本只是問題的一個面向。

sentences.en: What is the most challenging aspect of your work?
sentences.zh: 你工作中最具挑戰的部分是什麼？

sentences.en: Safety is an important aspect of the design.
sentences.zh: 安全是設計中很重要的一環。

sentences.en: Another aspect of the story is the effect on families.
sentences.zh: 這件事的另一個面向是對家庭的影響。

gloss_note: assemble a team 組成團隊

sentences.en: How long does it take to assemble this bookshelf?
sentences.zh: 組裝這個書架要花多久？

sentences.en: Workers assemble the parts as they move along the conveyor belt.
sentences.zh: 零件沿著輸送帶移動時，工人一邊進行組裝。

sentences.en: Please assemble in the lobby at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 請在九點到大廳集合。

sentences.en: We need to assemble a team for the new project.
sentences.zh: 我們得為新專案組成一個團隊。

sentences.en: Did you assemble the desk by yourself?
sentences.zh: 這張桌子是你自己組裝的嗎？

sentences.en: Crowds began to assemble outside the stadium.
sentences.zh: 人群開始聚集在體育場外。

sentences.en: The assembly of this desk takes about an hour.
sentences.zh: 組裝這張書桌大約要花一個小時。

sentences.en: Workers on the assembly line wear safety glasses.
sentences.zh: 組裝線上的工人都戴著護目鏡。

sentences.en: Is there an assembly at school this morning?
sentences.zh: 學校今天早上有集會嗎？

sentences.en: The principal spoke to students at a school assembly.
sentences.zh: 校長在全校集會上對學生講話。

sentences.en: Final assembly of the cars happens in this building.
sentences.zh: 汽車的最後組裝是在這棟大樓裡進行的。

sentences.en: Do you offer free assembly when I buy furniture?
sentences.zh: 我買家具的話，你們有提供免費組裝嗎？

sentences.en: She asserted that the report was accurate.
sentences.zh: 她堅稱這份報告是正確的。

sentences.en: Do you assert that the company broke the contract?
sentences.zh: 你主張公司違反了合約嗎？

sentences.en: He tried to assert his opinion during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他試著在會議中表達自己的主張。

sentences.en: The author asserts that sleep improves memory.
sentences.zh: 作者主張睡眠能增進記憶。

sentences.en: It's important to assert yourself in a job interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時勇於表達自己很重要。

sentences.en: Why does he keep asserting that he was right?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼老是一再堅稱自己是對的？

sentences.en: When is the English assignment due?
sentences.zh: 英文作業什麼時候要交？

sentences.en: My first assignment at the company was to organize files.
sentences.zh: 我在公司的第一個任務是整理檔案。

sentences.en: The teacher gave us a long reading assignment.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們很長的閱讀作業。

sentences.en: Did you finish your assignment for tomorrow's meeting?
sentences.zh: 你完成明天會議的交辦工作了嗎？

sentences.en: She received a new assignment in the Seattle office.
sentences.zh: 她被派到西雅圖辦公室，接了新任務。

sentences.en: Can I turn in this assignment a day late?
sentences.zh: 我可以晚一天交這份作業嗎？

sentences.en: The manager gave us his assurance that the work would be done.
sentences.zh: 經理向我們保證工作會完成。

sentences.en: Can you give me some assurance that the package will arrive on time?
sentences.zh: 你能向我保證包裹會準時送到嗎？

sentences.en: We need written assurance before we sign.
sentences.zh: 簽字前我們需要書面保證。

sentences.en: Her calm voice gave me a sense of assurance.
sentences.zh: 她平靜的聲音讓我有安心的感覺。

sentences.en: Do we have any assurance that prices will stay low?
sentences.zh: 我們有任何保證價格會維持低檔嗎？

sentences.en: The company offered assurance that no jobs would be lost.
sentences.zh: 公司保證不會有人失業。

gloss_note: a relaxed atmosphere 輕鬆的氣氛

sentences.en: This café has a warm and relaxed atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館的氣氛溫暖又輕鬆。

sentences.en: Do you prefer a quiet atmosphere when you eat?
sentences.zh: 你吃飯時喜歡安靜的氣氛嗎？

sentences.en: The food was great, but the atmosphere felt rushed.
sentences.zh: 食物很棒，但整體氣氛讓人覺得很匆忙。

sentences.en: Candles gave the restaurant a romantic atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 蠟燭讓餐廳洋溢著浪漫氣氛。

sentences.en: Earth's atmosphere protects us from harmful rays.
sentences.zh: 地球的大氣層保護我們不受有害射線傷害。

sentences.en: How thick is the atmosphere around Mars?
sentences.zh: 火星周圍的大氣層有多厚？

gloss_note: an atom of hydrogen 一個氫原子

sentences.en: An atom is the smallest unit of an element.
sentences.zh: 原子是元素的最小單位。

sentences.en: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
sentences.zh: 水是由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成的。

sentences.en: Can we see an atom with a normal microscope?
sentences.zh: 我們能用一般顯微鏡看到原子嗎？

sentences.en: What is at the center of an atom?
sentences.zh: 原子的中心是什麼？

sentences.en: Scientists study how atoms join to form molecules.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究原子如何結合成分子。

sentences.en: There are countless atoms in a grain of sand.
sentences.zh: 一粒沙裡有數不清的原子。

sentences.en: The flight attendant brought us water and snacks.
sentences.zh: 空服員為我們送來水和點心。

sentences.en: Ask the parking attendant where to leave your car.
sentences.zh: 去問停車場管理員車要停在哪裡。

sentences.en: Is there an attendant at the front desk of the pool?
sentences.zh: 游泳池櫃檯有服務人員嗎？

sentences.en: A gas station attendant helped me check my tires.
sentences.zh: 加油站的服務人員幫我檢查輪胎。

sentences.en: The museum attendant told us the gallery was closing.
sentences.zh: 博物館的服務人員告訴我們展廳要關了。

sentences.en: Where is the coat check attendant in this theater?
sentences.zh: 這間劇院的衣帽間服務人員在哪裡？

sentences.en: Every attendee will receive a name badge at the door.
sentences.zh: 每位出席者都會在門口領到名牌。

sentences.en: How many attendees are coming to the workshop?
sentences.zh: 有多少位與會者要來參加工作坊？

sentences.en: The attendees were asked to sign in at the desk.
sentences.zh: 與會者被要求在櫃檯簽到。

sentences.en: Did each attendee get a copy of the schedule?
sentences.zh: 每位出席者都拿到議程表了嗎？

sentences.en: One attendee asked a question about the budget.
sentences.zh: 有一位與會者問了關於預算的問題。

sentences.en: The event had over two hundred attendees this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的活動有兩百多位出席者。

sentences.en: I have an appointment with my attorney on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我週二跟我的律師有約。

sentences.en: Should we ask an attorney to read this contract?
sentences.zh: 我們該請律師看一下這份合約嗎？

sentences.en: The defense attorney spoke for almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 辯護律師講了將近一小時。

sentences.en: Her attorney advised her not to sign the paper.
sentences.zh: 她的律師建議她不要簽那份文件。

sentences.en: Do you know a good attorney who handles real estate?
sentences.zh: 你認識處理房地產的好律師嗎？

sentences.en: He became an attorney after three years of law school.
sentences.zh: 他讀了三年法學院後成為律師。

gloss_note: at an auction 在拍賣會上；bid 出價

sentences.en: The painting will be sold at an auction next week.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫將在下週拍賣會上出售。

sentences.en: Have you ever bought anything at an auction?
sentences.zh: 你曾經在拍賣會上買過東西嗎？

sentences.en: The house went to auction after the owner moved away.
sentences.zh: 屋主搬走後，房子被送去拍賣。

sentences.en: They are holding a charity auction this Saturday.
sentences.zh: 他們這個星期六舉辦慈善拍賣會。

sentences.en: How does an online auction work?
sentences.zh: 網路拍賣是怎麼運作的？

sentences.en: My uncle found this old clock at an auction.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在拍賣會上找到這個老時鐘。

sentences.en: The tax agency will audit our records next month.
sentences.zh: 稅務機關下個月會稽核我們的帳目。

sentences.en: Did the company pass last year's audit?
sentences.zh: 公司通過去年的查帳了嗎？

sentences.en: An outside firm performs the audit every spring.
sentences.zh: 每年春天由外部事務所進行查帳。

sentences.en: Can you audit these receipts before Friday?
sentences.zh: 你能在週五前查核這些收據嗎？

sentences.en: The audit found several errors in the budget.
sentences.zh: 這次稽核在預算中發現了幾處錯誤。

sentences.en: Who will audit the safety records of the factory?
sentences.zh: 誰會稽核這座工廠的安全紀錄？

gloss_note: external auditor 外部查帳人員

sentences.en: The auditor asked to see all the receipts.
sentences.zh: 查帳員要求查看所有的收據。

sentences.en: Is the auditor coming in on Monday?
sentences.zh: 查帳員星期一會來嗎？

sentences.en: An outside auditor reviewed the company's books.
sentences.zh: 外部稽核員檢查了公司的帳冊。

sentences.en: She works as an auditor for a large accounting firm.
sentences.zh: 她在一家大型會計事務所擔任稽核員。

sentences.en: Did the auditor find any problems with our expenses?
sentences.zh: 稽核員有發現我們的費用有問題嗎？

sentences.en: Every auditor must keep client information private.
sentences.zh: 每位稽核員都必須為客戶資料保密。

sentences.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the school auditorium.
sentences.zh: 畢業典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

sentences.en: Is the auditorium big enough for five hundred people?
sentences.zh: 這個禮堂容得下五百個人嗎？

sentences.en: We met outside the auditorium before the concert.
sentences.zh: 音樂會前我們在禮堂外碰面。

sentences.en: The auditorium has comfortable seats and good lighting.
sentences.zh: 這個禮堂有舒適的座位和良好的燈光。

sentences.en: Where is the auditorium in this building?
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓的禮堂在哪裡？

sentences.en: The speaker walked onto the stage of the packed auditorium.
sentences.zh: 講者走上了座無虛席的禮堂舞台。

gloss_note: have the authority to 有權

sentences.en: Do you have the authority to approve this expense?
sentences.zh: 你有權核准這筆費用嗎？

sentences.en: Only the manager has the authority to sign contracts.
sentences.zh: 只有經理有權簽署合約。

sentences.en: Local authorities closed the road because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 地方當局因暴風雨封閉了道路。

sentences.en: Which authority should I ask about a building permit?
sentences.zh: 辦建築許可要問哪個主管機關？

sentences.en: The airport authority announced a new security rule.
sentences.zh: 機場管理局公布了新的安全規定。

sentences.en: Should I report the problem to the authorities?
sentences.zh: 我該把問題向有關單位通報嗎？

gloss_note: authorize payment 批准付款；多用於正式場合

sentences.en: Who can authorize this purchase?
sentences.zh: 誰能批准這筆採購？

sentences.en: I authorize the bank to charge my card monthly.
sentences.zh: 我授權銀行每月從我的卡上扣款。

sentences.en: Please authorize the payment before noon.
sentences.zh: 請在中午前核准這筆付款。

sentences.en: Has the manager authorized overtime this week?
sentences.zh: 經理這週有批准加班嗎？

sentences.en: Only authorized staff may enter this room.
sentences.zh: 只有獲授權的員工才能進入這個房間。

sentences.en: The city council will authorize funds for the new park.
sentences.zh: 市議會將批准興建新公園的經費。

gloss_note: automate a task 讓工作自動化

sentences.en: We plan to automate the billing process next year.
sentences.zh: 我們打算明年讓帳單流程自動化。

sentences.en: Can we automate this report instead of making it by hand?
sentences.zh: 我們能不能讓這份報告自動產生，而不是手動做？

sentences.en: The factory decided to automate its packing line.
sentences.zh: 工廠決定讓包裝線自動化。

sentences.en: How can I automate my email replies?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼讓電子郵件自動回覆？

sentences.en: Many banks automate routine questions with chatbots.
sentences.zh: 許多銀行用聊天機器人處理例行問題。

sentences.en: Will the company automate more jobs in the future?
sentences.zh: 公司未來會讓更多工作自動化嗎？

sentences.en: Employees here have a lot of autonomy in their work.
sentences.zh: 這裡的員工在工作上有很大的自主權。

sentences.en: Do you want more autonomy in your job?
sentences.zh: 你希望在工作中有更多自主權嗎？

sentences.en: Teenagers often want more autonomy from their parents.
sentences.zh: 青少年常希望脫離父母，有更多自主。

sentences.en: The branch office has full autonomy over hiring.
sentences.zh: 分公司在招聘上有完全的自主權。

sentences.en: Why does autonomy matter for a happy team?
sentences.zh: 為什麼自主性對快樂的團隊很重要？

sentences.en: The school asked for more autonomy from the district.
sentences.zh: 這所學校要求學區給予更多自主權。

gloss_note: check availability 確認有無空位／存貨

sentences.en: Can I check the availability of this item online?
sentences.zh: 我可以上網查這件商品有沒有貨嗎？

sentences.en: What is your availability next week for a meeting?
sentences.zh: 下週你什麼時候有空開會？

sentences.en: Hotel availability is limited during the holiday weekend.
sentences.zh: 假日週末飯店的空房有限。

sentences.en: Please send me your availability for an interview.
sentences.zh: 請把你可以面試的時間寄給我。

sentences.en: Is there any availability for a table at seven?
sentences.zh: 七點有空桌嗎？

sentences.en: The availability of fresh fruit changes with the season.
sentences.zh: 新鮮水果的供應量隨季節變動。

gloss_note: x-axis X 軸；axis of rotation 轉軸

sentences.en: The horizontal axis shows the years.
sentences.zh: 橫軸顯示年份。

sentences.en: Which axis shows the total sales?
sentences.zh: 哪一條軸顯示總銷售額？

sentences.en: The Earth turns on its axis once a day.
sentences.zh: 地球一天繞著地軸自轉一圈。

sentences.en: Please label the vertical axis of the chart.
sentences.zh: 請在圖表的縱軸上標示名稱。

sentences.en: Can you change the scale of the y-axis?
sentences.zh: 你可以改一下縱軸的刻度嗎？

sentences.en: The wheel spins around a central axis.
sentences.zh: 輪子繞著中心軸旋轉。

gloss_note: wear a badge 配戴識別證

sentences.en: Don't forget to wear your badge when you enter the building.
sentences.zh: 進大樓時別忘了配戴識別證。

sentences.en: Did you lose your employee badge?
sentences.zh: 你的員工識別證弄丟了嗎？

sentences.en: Visitors must show a badge at the security desk.
sentences.zh: 訪客必須在警衛櫃檯出示識別證。

sentences.en: He proudly wore the scout badge on his jacket.
sentences.zh: 他驕傲地把童軍徽章別在外套上。

sentences.en: Can I scan my badge to open this door?
sentences.zh: 我可以刷識別證開這扇門嗎？

sentences.en: The badge has my name and photo on it.
sentences.zh: 識別證上有我的名字和照片。

sentences.en: Please place your ballot in the box by noon.
sentences.zh: 請在中午前把選票投進箱子裡。

sentences.en: The club will use a secret ballot to choose a new president.
sentences.zh: 社團將以不記名投票選出新社長。

sentences.en: Did you cast your ballot at the community center?
sentences.zh: 你在社區活動中心投票了嗎？

sentences.en: The board voted by secret ballot on the merger.
sentences.zh: 董事會以不記名投票表決合併案。

sentences.en: How many ballots were counted last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚計算了多少張選票？

sentences.en: Shareholders can send in their ballots by mail.
sentences.zh: 股東可以用郵寄方式寄回選票。

sentences.en: The company went bankrupt after losing its biggest client.
sentences.zh: 公司在失去最大客戶後破產了。

sentences.en: Is the store really going bankrupt, or is it just a sale?
sentences.zh: 這家店真的要倒閉了嗎，還是只是在特賣？

sentences.en: One bad investment nearly bankrupted my uncle.
sentences.zh: 一次糟糕的投資差點讓我叔叔破產。

sentences.en: Too much debt could bankrupt a small business like ours.
sentences.zh: 過多債務可能使我們這樣的小企業破產。

sentences.en: Did you hear that the airline is bankrupt?
sentences.zh: 你有聽說那家航空公司破產了嗎？

sentences.en: The bankrupt firm sold its equipment to pay its creditors.
sentences.zh: 破產的公司變賣設備來償還債主。

gloss_note: file for bankruptcy 申請破產

sentences.en: The company filed for bankruptcy last month.
sentences.zh: 公司上個月申請破產。

sentences.en: Why did the restaurant chain file for bankruptcy so suddenly?
sentences.zh: 這家連鎖餐廳為什麼這麼突然申請破產？

sentences.en: Bankruptcy can stay on your credit report for years.
sentences.zh: 破產紀錄可能在你的信用報告上留存多年。

sentences.en: We need a plan to avoid bankruptcy this winter.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一個計畫，在今年冬天避免破產。

sentences.en: Do you think the firm can survive bankruptcy?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這家公司撐得過破產嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor lost his house after his bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居破產後失去了他的房子。

gloss_note: a banquet hall 宴會廳，較正式

sentences.en: The company will host a banquet for its top clients.
sentences.zh: 公司將為重要客戶舉辦宴會。

sentences.en: Are you coming to the retirement banquet on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你週五會來參加退休歡送宴嗎？

sentences.en: The wedding banquet lasted nearly four hours.
sentences.zh: 婚宴持續了將近四個小時。

sentences.en: We booked the hotel's banquet room for the awards dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了飯店的宴會廳來辦頒獎晚宴。

sentences.en: How many guests will attend the banquet?
sentences.zh: 會有多少賓客出席宴會？

sentences.en: The mayor gave a short speech at the banquet.
sentences.zh: 市長在宴會上簡短致詞。

gloss_note: strike a bargain 談成交易

sentences.en: This jacket was a real bargain at only twenty dollars.
sentences.zh: 這件外套只要二十美元，真的很划算。

sentences.en: Is this laptop a bargain, or is the price too good to be true?
sentences.zh: 這台筆電真的划算嗎，還是便宜得太誇張？

sentences.en: I found some great bargains at the weekend sale.
sentences.zh: 我在週末特賣會上找到幾樣超值的東西。

sentences.en: At that price, the hotel room is a bargain.
sentences.zh: 這個價錢，這間飯店房間很划算。

sentences.en: They struck a bargain with the supplier after a long talk.
sentences.zh: 長談之後，他們和供應商談成了協議。

sentences.en: Why do shoppers love to hunt for bargains?
sentences.zh: 為什麼購物者都愛找便宜貨？

gloss_note: a dead battery 沒電的電池

sentences.en: My phone battery dies before lunch every day.
sentences.zh: 我的手機電池每天午餐前就沒電了。

sentences.en: Do you have a spare battery for the camera?
sentences.zh: 你有相機的備用電池嗎？

sentences.en: The car wouldn't start because the battery was dead.
sentences.zh: 車子發不動，因為電池沒電了。

sentences.en: Please replace the batteries in the remote control.
sentences.zh: 請把遙控器裡的電池換掉。

sentences.en: How long does the battery last on a full charge?
sentences.zh: 充飽電後電池可以用多久？

sentences.en: The new battery can power the device for ten hours.
sentences.zh: 這顆新電池能讓裝置運作十小時。

gloss_note: tell me beforehand 事先告訴我

sentences.en: Please call me beforehand if you plan to be late.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算遲到，請事先打給我。

sentences.en: Why didn't you tell me beforehand?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼沒事先告訴我？

sentences.en: We reviewed the slides beforehand to avoid mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我們事先檢查了簡報，以免出錯。

sentences.en: You should book the table beforehand on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末你應該事先訂位。

sentences.en: I read the instructions beforehand, so setup was easy.
sentences.zh: 我事先讀過說明書，所以安裝很簡單。

sentences.en: Could you send me the agenda beforehand?
sentences.zh: 你可以事先把議程寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: The school hired a counselor to help with behavioral problems.
sentences.zh: 學校聘請了輔導員來協助處理行為問題。

sentences.en: Is this a behavioral issue or a learning issue?
sentences.zh: 這是行為問題還是學習問題？

sentences.en: She studies behavioral psychology at a large university.
sentences.zh: 她在一所大型大學研究行為心理學。

sentences.en: Behavioral changes in the patient were recorded daily.
sentences.zh: 病人的行為變化每天都有記錄。

sentences.en: Do these behavioral patterns start in childhood?
sentences.zh: 這些行為模式是從童年開始的嗎？

sentences.en: The study found clear behavioral differences between the two groups of kids.
sentences.zh: 研究發現這兩組孩子在行為上有明顯差異。

gloss_note: set a benchmark 設立基準

sentences.en: Last year's sales are our benchmark for this quarter.
sentences.zh: 去年的銷售額是我們這一季的基準。

sentences.en: What benchmark are we using to measure success?
sentences.zh: 我們用什麼基準來衡量成功？

sentences.en: The new store set a benchmark for customer service.
sentences.zh: 這家新店為顧客服務樹立了標竿。

sentences.en: Our team missed the benchmark by a small margin.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊以些微差距沒達到基準。

sentences.en: Is that figure a fair benchmark for the whole industry?
sentences.zh: 那個數字能公平地代表整個產業的基準嗎？

sentences.en: Analysts use the index as a benchmark for stock performance.
sentences.zh: 分析師把這個指數當作股票表現的基準。

gloss_note: name a beneficiary 指定受益人

sentences.en: Who is the beneficiary of your life insurance?
sentences.zh: 你的人壽保險受益人是誰？

sentences.en: She named her daughter as the sole beneficiary.
sentences.zh: 她指定女兒為唯一受益人。

sentences.en: The beneficiary will receive the money within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 受益人將在三十天內收到這筆錢。

sentences.en: Are students the main beneficiaries of this new program?
sentences.zh: 學生是這項新方案的主要受益者嗎？

sentences.en: You must list a beneficiary on the form.
sentences.zh: 你必須在表格上填寫受益人。

sentences.en: The charity was the beneficiary of his will.
sentences.zh: 這家慈善機構是他遺囑中的受益人。

gloss_note: 比 drink 正式，菜單常用

sentences.en: Would you like a beverage with your meal?
sentences.zh: 用餐時您想來杯飲料嗎？

sentences.en: Hot beverages are free in the hotel lobby.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的熱飲免費供應。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a wide range of beverages.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳提供各式各樣的飲料。

sentences.en: Please do not bring outside food or beverages into the theater.
sentences.zh: 請勿攜帶外食或飲料進入戲院。

sentences.en: What's your favorite cold beverage in summer?
sentences.zh: 你夏天最愛喝的冷飲是什麼？

sentences.en: Sales of sugary beverages dropped last year.
sentences.zh: 含糖飲料的銷量去年下滑。

gloss_note: bilingual 指能流利使用兩種語言

sentences.en: She grew up bilingual, speaking Mandarin and English at home.
sentences.zh: 她從小就會兩種語言，在家說中文和英文。

sentences.en: Is your daughter fully bilingual, or is she still learning?
sentences.zh: 你女兒兩種語言都很流利了嗎，還是還在學？

sentences.en: We are hiring a bilingual receptionist for the front desk.
sentences.zh: 我們要為櫃檯招聘一位雙語接待員。

sentences.en: Bilingual signs help tourists find their way.
sentences.zh: 雙語標示能幫遊客找路。

sentences.en: Many bilinguals switch languages in the middle of a sentence.
sentences.zh: 許多雙語者會在句子中途切換語言。

sentences.en: Does this clinic offer bilingual services?
sentences.zh: 這間診所有提供雙語服務嗎？

gloss_note: 小型輕鬆的餐廳，常賣簡餐

sentences.en: We had lunch at a cozy bistro near the office.
sentences.zh: 我們在公司附近一家溫馨的小餐館吃午餐。

sentences.en: Is there a good bistro around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有好吃的小餐館嗎？

sentences.en: The bistro serves a great onion soup.
sentences.zh: 這家小餐館的洋蔥湯很棒。

sentences.en: Let's meet at the bistro on Main Street at seven.
sentences.zh: 我們七點在大街上的小餐館碰面吧。

sentences.en: Do you need a reservation for the bistro tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚去那家小餐館需要訂位嗎？

sentences.en: The little bistro is always crowded on weekends.
sentences.zh: 這家小餐館週末總是擠滿人。

sentences.en: The executives are waiting in the boardroom.
sentences.zh: 主管們正在董事會議室等候。

sentences.en: Could you book the boardroom for Tuesday morning?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我預訂週二早上的董事會議室嗎？

sentences.en: The boardroom has a huge screen for presentations.
sentences.zh: 董事會議室有一面大螢幕可以做簡報。

sentences.en: Please bring the contracts to the boardroom at ten.
sentences.zh: 請十點把合約帶到董事會議室。

sentences.en: Is the boardroom free this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 董事會議室今天下午有空嗎？

sentences.en: Big decisions are usually made in the boardroom.
sentences.zh: 重大決策通常在董事會議室裡做出。

gloss_note: boast about 吹噓；boasts 擁有

sentences.en: He likes to boast about his sales numbers.
sentences.zh: 他老愛吹噓自己的業績。

sentences.en: The new hotel boasts a rooftop pool and three restaurants.
sentences.zh: 這家新飯店以擁有屋頂泳池和三間餐廳自豪。

sentences.en: Why do you always boast about your trips?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老愛吹噓你的旅行？

sentences.en: The city boasts some of the best museums in the country.
sentences.zh: 這座城市擁有全國最棒的幾間博物館。

sentences.en: Don't boast to the other team before the game starts.
sentences.zh: 比賽開始前，別對另一隊吹噓。

sentences.en: Does the new phone really boast a two-day battery life?
sentences.zh: 這支新手機真的號稱電池能撐兩天嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone received a bonus at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 年底每個人都拿到一筆獎金。

sentences.en: Will we get a bonus if we hit our target?
sentences.zh: 如果我們達標，會有獎金嗎？

sentences.en: The free shipping is a nice bonus.
sentences.zh: 免運費是個不錯的額外好處。

sentences.en: She earned a bonus for closing the biggest deal.
sentences.zh: 她因為談成最大的案子而賺到獎金。

sentences.en: Is the signing bonus paid in cash or in stock?
sentences.zh: 簽約獎金是付現金還是股票？

sentences.en: Speaking Spanish is a bonus for this job.
sentences.zh: 會說西班牙文對這份工作是加分。

gloss_note: 比 brochure 更像薄薄一本書

sentences.en: Please read the safety booklet before you start.
sentences.zh: 開始之前請先閱讀安全小冊子。

sentences.en: Where can I get a booklet about local hiking trails?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以拿到介紹當地健行步道的小冊子？

sentences.en: The hotel gave us a booklet of city maps.
sentences.zh: 飯店給了我們一本城市地圖小冊子。

sentences.en: Each employee will receive a booklet on company policy.
sentences.zh: 每位員工都會收到一本公司規定的小冊子。

sentences.en: Did you finish the training booklet yet?
sentences.zh: 你讀完訓練小冊子了嗎？

sentences.en: The booklet explains how to set up the printer.
sentences.zh: 這本小冊子說明如何設定印表機。

sentences.en: Could we sit in a booth instead of a table?
sentences.zh: 我們可以坐卡座而不是桌位嗎？

sentences.en: Our company has a booth at the trade show.
sentences.zh: 我們公司在商展上有一個攤位。

sentences.en: Come by our booth and pick up a free sample.
sentences.zh: 來我們的攤位拿一份免費試用品吧。

sentences.en: Do you want the booth by the window?
sentences.zh: 你想坐窗邊的卡座嗎？

sentences.en: She set up the booth early to greet visitors.
sentences.zh: 她提早佈置好攤位迎接訪客。

sentences.en: We found an empty booth in the back of the diner.
sentences.zh: 我們在餐館後方找到一個空的卡座。

gloss_note: bank 的 borrower 就是借款人

sentences.en: The bank checks every borrower's credit history.
sentences.zh: 銀行會檢查每位借款人的信用紀錄。

sentences.en: Is the borrower able to repay the loan on time?
sentences.zh: 借款人有能力按時還款嗎？

sentences.en: As a borrower, you have to pay interest every month.
sentences.zh: 身為借款人，你每個月都要付利息。

sentences.en: Library borrowers must return books within three weeks.
sentences.zh: 圖書館的借閱者必須在三週內還書。

sentences.en: The borrower missed two payments this year.
sentences.zh: 借款人今年漏繳了兩期還款。

sentences.en: Which borrowers qualify for a lower interest rate?
sentences.zh: 哪些借款人符合較低利率的資格？

gloss_note: be bound by 受…約束；bound to 一定

sentences.en: Both parties are bound by the terms of this contract.
sentences.zh: 雙方都受本合約條款的約束。

sentences.en: Are we legally bound to finish the project by June?
sentences.zh: 我們在法律上有義務在六月前完成這個專案嗎？

sentences.en: With prices rising, customers are bound to complain.
sentences.zh: 價格上漲，顧客一定會抱怨。

sentences.en: Employees are bound by a strict confidentiality agreement.
sentences.zh: 員工受嚴格的保密協議約束。

sentences.en: If you skip the meeting, he's bound to ask why.
sentences.zh: 如果你缺席會議，他一定會問原因。

sentences.en: Isn't the company bound to pay overtime for extra hours?
sentences.zh: 公司不是有義務支付額外工時的加班費嗎？

sentences.en: The supplier is in breach of our contract.
sentences.zh: 供應商違反了我們的合約。

sentences.en: Did hackers cause the data breach last week?
sentences.zh: 上週的資料外洩是駭客造成的嗎？

sentences.en: Leaving the vault unlocked is a breach of company rules.
sentences.zh: 沒鎖好金庫違反了公司規定。

sentences.en: The company breached its agreement by delivering late.
sentences.zh: 這家公司延遲交貨，違反了協議。

sentences.en: How did the security breach happen?
sentences.zh: 這次資安外洩事件是怎麼發生的？

sentences.en: Customers must be told quickly about any breach of their personal data.
sentences.zh: 任何個資外洩，都必須盡快通知客戶。

gloss_note: carry a briefcase 帶公事包

sentences.en: He left his briefcase on the train this morning.
sentences.zh: 他今天早上把公事包忘在火車上了。

sentences.en: Is this briefcase big enough for my laptop?
sentences.zh: 這個公事包夠大，放得下我的筆電嗎？

sentences.en: She carried a leather briefcase to every meeting.
sentences.zh: 她每次開會都帶著皮質公事包。

sentences.en: Where did you put my briefcase?
sentences.zh: 你把我的公事包放哪了？

sentences.en: Security checked my briefcase at the airport.
sentences.zh: 安檢人員在機場檢查了我的公事包。

sentences.en: The documents are in the black briefcase under the desk.
sentences.zh: 文件在桌子底下那個黑色公事包裡。

sentences.en: Broadly speaking, sales were up in every region.
sentences.zh: 大致來說，每個地區的銷售都上升了。

sentences.en: Do you broadly agree with the new plan?
sentences.zh: 你大致上同意這個新計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The policy applies broadly to all full-time staff.
sentences.zh: 這項政策廣泛適用於所有全職員工。

sentences.en: The results were broadly similar across both groups.
sentences.zh: 兩組的結果大致相似。

sentences.en: Is the idea broadly accepted in your field?
sentences.zh: 這個想法在你的領域中被廣泛接受嗎？

sentences.en: The new rules were broadly welcomed by small businesses.
sentences.zh: 新規定大致上受到小型企業歡迎。

gloss_note: 常見於旅行社、展覽、公司介紹

sentences.en: Could I take a brochure about your services?
sentences.zh: 我可以拿一份你們的服務簡介嗎？

sentences.en: The travel agent gave us a brochure for the island resort.
sentences.zh: 旅行社給了我們這座島嶼度假村的宣傳手冊。

sentences.en: We are printing new brochures for the trade show.
sentences.zh: 我們正在印商展用的新手冊。

sentences.en: Did you read the brochure before signing up?
sentences.zh: 你報名前有看過簡介嗎？

sentences.en: The brochure lists all the prices and package options.
sentences.zh: 這份手冊列出所有價格和方案。

sentences.en: Please leave a brochure on each table.
sentences.zh: 請在每張桌上放一份簡介。

sentences.en: My broker called about the stock this morning.
sentences.zh: 我的經紀人今天早上為了那支股票打電話來。

sentences.en: Do you work with a mortgage broker?
sentences.zh: 你有找房貸仲介嗎？

sentences.en: The insurance broker found us a cheaper plan.
sentences.zh: 保險經紀人幫我們找到更便宜的方案。

sentences.en: A good real estate broker knows the local market.
sentences.zh: 好的房仲了解當地市場。

sentences.en: How much does the broker charge for each trade?
sentences.zh: 經紀人每筆交易收多少費用？

sentences.en: The broker earns a commission on every sale.
sentences.zh: 經紀人每賣出一筆就賺取佣金。

sentences.en: I opened an account at an online brokerage.
sentences.zh: 我在一家網路券商開了戶。

sentences.en: Does your brokerage charge a fee for each trade?
sentences.zh: 你的券商每筆交易都收手續費嗎？

sentences.en: The brokerage sent me my tax forms in February.
sentences.zh: 券商二月寄來我的報稅表單。

sentences.en: She works for a large brokerage in New York.
sentences.zh: 她在紐約一家大型券商工作。

sentences.en: Which brokerage has the lowest fees?
sentences.zh: 哪家券商的手續費最低？

sentences.en: The brokerage fee is two percent of the sale price.
sentences.zh: 仲介手續費是成交價的百分之二。

gloss_note: in bulk 大量購買；the bulk of 大部分

sentences.en: We buy paper in bulk to save money.
sentences.zh: 我們大批購買紙張來省錢。

sentences.en: Do you offer a discount for bulk orders?
sentences.zh: 大量訂購有折扣嗎？

sentences.en: The bulk of our sales come from online orders.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分的銷售來自網路訂單。

sentences.en: Is it cheaper to buy rice in bulk?
sentences.zh: 大量買米比較便宜嗎？

sentences.en: Bulk shipments arrive every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 大宗貨物每週一早上到貨。

sentences.en: The bulk of the work is already finished.
sentences.zh: 大部分的工作已經完成了。

sentences.en: The airport posted a bulletin about the flight delays.
sentences.zh: 機場發布了一則關於班機延誤的公告。

sentences.en: Did you read the safety bulletin that HR sent?
sentences.zh: 你看過人資寄的安全公告了嗎？

sentences.en: The company publishes a weekly bulletin for all staff.
sentences.zh: 公司每週為全體員工發行一份公告通訊。

sentences.en: A news bulletin interrupted the program.
sentences.zh: 一則新聞快報打斷了節目。

sentences.en: Please check the bulletin for schedule changes.
sentences.zh: 請查看公告中的時間異動。

sentences.en: Has the weather bulletin been updated?
sentences.zh: 天氣快報更新了嗎？

gloss_note: burrito 是美式墨西哥餐點

sentences.en: I'll have a chicken burrito with extra cheese, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一份雞肉墨西哥捲餅，多加起司。

sentences.en: Do you want to share a burrito for lunch?
sentences.zh: 午餐你想分一個墨西哥捲餅來吃嗎？

sentences.en: The burrito place near campus is always packed.
sentences.zh: 校園附近那家墨西哥捲餅店總是人山人海。

sentences.en: He rolled the beans and rice into a burrito.
sentences.zh: 他把豆子和飯捲成一個墨西哥捲餅。

sentences.en: Is the burrito big enough for two people?
sentences.zh: 這個墨西哥捲餅夠兩個人吃嗎？

sentences.en: My roommate makes a great breakfast burrito.
sentences.zh: 我室友做的早餐捲餅超好吃。

sentences.en: She is a successful businessperson in the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 她是科技業一位成功的商人。

sentences.en: A good businessperson knows when to take a risk.
sentences.zh: 優秀的商人懂得何時該冒險。

sentences.en: Is the speaker a local businessperson?
sentences.zh: 這位講者是本地的商人嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel has a quiet lounge for busy businesspeople.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店有安靜的交誼廳給忙碌的商務人士。

sentences.en: As a businessperson, he travels abroad every month.
sentences.zh: 身為商人，他每個月都出國。

sentences.en: Which businessperson started this chain of stores?
sentences.zh: 哪位商人創辦了這家連鎖商店？

sentences.en: Let's take a cab to the airport.
sentences.zh: 我們搭計程車去機場吧。

sentences.en: Can you call a cab for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我叫一輛計程車嗎？

sentences.en: The cab dropped us off right at the hotel entrance.
sentences.zh: 計程車把我們載到飯店門口。

sentences.en: How much is a cab from downtown to the station?
sentences.zh: 從市中心搭計程車到車站要多少錢？

sentences.en: I got into the cab and gave the driver my address.
sentences.zh: 我上了計程車，把地址告訴司機。

sentences.en: There were no cabs outside because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，外面叫不到計程車。

sentences.en: The files are in the cabinet behind my desk.
sentences.zh: 檔案在我桌子後面的櫃子裡。

sentences.en: Can you lock the filing cabinet before you leave?
sentences.zh: 你離開前可以把檔案櫃鎖上嗎？

sentences.en: We need a new cabinet for the break room.
sentences.zh: 我們茶水間需要一個新櫃子。

sentences.en: The plates are in the kitchen cabinet above the sink.
sentences.zh: 盤子在水槽上方的廚房櫥櫃裡。

sentences.en: Where is the key to the supply cabinet?
sentences.zh: 備品櫃的鑰匙在哪裡？

sentences.en: Medicine should be kept in a locked cabinet.
sentences.zh: 藥品應該收在上鎖的櫃子裡。

sentences.en: Let's grab coffee at the cafe across the street.
sentences.zh: 我們去對街的咖啡館喝杯咖啡吧。

sentences.en: Is this cafe open on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡館週日有開嗎？

sentences.en: She works part-time at a cafe near campus.
sentences.zh: 她在校園附近一家咖啡館打工。

sentences.en: The cafe sells fresh muffins and sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡館賣現做的瑪芬和三明治。

sentences.en: We met at a small cafe to discuss the project.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家小咖啡館碰面討論專案。

sentences.en: Do you know a quiet cafe where we can study?
sentences.zh: 你知道有哪家安靜的咖啡館可以讓我們讀書嗎？

sentences.en: Milk is a good source of calcium.
sentences.zh: 牛奶是鈣質的良好來源。

sentences.en: Do you take a calcium supplement every day?
sentences.zh: 你每天都吃鈣片嗎？

sentences.en: Calcium helps keep your bones and teeth strong.
sentences.zh: 鈣能幫助維持骨骼和牙齒強健。

sentences.en: The doctor said she needed more calcium in her diet.
sentences.zh: 醫生說她的飲食中需要更多鈣。

sentences.en: Which foods are high in calcium?
sentences.zh: 哪些食物含鈣量高？

sentences.en: Too little calcium can weaken the bones over time.
sentences.zh: 長期缺鈣可能使骨骼變脆弱。

gloss_note: make a calculation 計算一下

sentences.en: My calculation shows we will break even in June.
sentences.zh: 我的計算顯示我們六月就能打平。

sentences.en: Can you double-check my calculation?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我再檢查一次我的計算嗎？

sentences.en: The calculation took longer than we expected.
sentences.zh: 這個計算花的時間比我們預期的久。

sentences.en: Based on my calculations, the project will cost fifty thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 根據我的估算，這個專案會花五萬美元。

sentences.en: Was there a mistake in the tax calculation?
sentences.zh: 稅額計算有出錯嗎？

sentences.en: He made a quick calculation in his head.
sentences.zh: 他在心裡很快算了一下。

sentences.en: May I borrow your calculator for the quiz?
sentences.zh: 小考時我可以借你的計算機嗎？

sentences.en: I used a calculator to add up the receipts.
sentences.zh: 我用計算機把收據加總。

sentences.en: Is a calculator allowed during the exam?
sentences.zh: 考試時可以用計算機嗎？

sentences.en: Her phone has a built-in calculator.
sentences.zh: 她的手機有內建的計算機。

sentences.en: The online mortgage calculator gave us a rough monthly payment.
sentences.zh: 線上房貸試算器給了我們一個大約的月付金額。

sentences.en: Where did I leave my calculator?
sentences.zh: 我把計算機放哪了？

sentences.en: She is taking calculus this semester.
sentences.zh: 她這學期在修微積分。

sentences.en: Is calculus required for an engineering degree?
sentences.zh: 工程學位一定要修微積分嗎？

sentences.en: Calculus helps us understand how things change over time.
sentences.zh: 微積分幫助我們了解事物如何隨時間變化。

sentences.en: My brother finds calculus much harder than algebra.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥覺得微積分比代數難多了。

sentences.en: The professor explained calculus with simple examples.
sentences.zh: 教授用簡單的例子解釋微積分。

sentences.en: Do you remember anything from your calculus class?
sentences.zh: 你還記得微積分課的任何內容嗎？

sentences.en: The caller asked to speak with the manager.
sentences.zh: 來電者要求和經理說話。

sentences.en: Who was the caller just now?
sentences.zh: 剛剛的來電者是誰？

sentences.en: Please tell the caller to leave a message.
sentences.zh: 請告訴來電者留言。

sentences.en: The caller sounded upset about the late delivery.
sentences.zh: 來電者聽起來對延遲送貨很不高興。

sentences.en: Do you know the name of the caller?
sentences.zh: 你知道來電者的名字嗎？

sentences.en: An unknown caller has phoned you three times today.
sentences.zh: 今天有一位不明來電者打了三次電話給你。

sentences.en: We received a cancellation from the client this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我們收到客戶的取消通知。

sentences.en: Is there a fee for late cancellation?
sentences.zh: 太晚取消要收費嗎？

sentences.en: The cancellation of the flight ruined our plans.
sentences.zh: 班機取消打亂了我們的計畫。

sentences.en: Please call us if you need to make a cancellation.
sentences.zh: 如果需要取消，請打電話通知我們。

sentences.en: Why was the cancellation announced so late?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這麼晚才宣布取消？

sentences.en: A last-minute cancellation opened up a table for two.
sentences.zh: 臨時取消讓出了一個兩人座位。

sentences.en: Capitalism is based on private ownership and competition.
sentences.zh: 資本主義建立在私人所有權與競爭之上。

sentences.en: What are the main strengths of capitalism?
sentences.zh: 資本主義的主要優點是什麼？

sentences.en: Our economics teacher compared capitalism with other systems.
sentences.zh: 我們的經濟老師把資本主義和其他制度做了比較。

sentences.en: Capitalism encourages companies to innovate.
sentences.zh: 資本主義鼓勵公司創新。

sentences.en: How did capitalism change the way factories were run?
sentences.zh: 資本主義如何改變工廠的經營方式？

sentences.en: The book traces the history of capitalism in Europe.
sentences.zh: 這本書追溯歐洲資本主義的歷史。

gloss_note: a capitalist economy 資本主義經濟

sentences.en: The capitalist invested millions in new factories.
sentences.zh: 那位資本家投資了數百萬美元興建新工廠。

sentences.en: Is the United States a capitalist country?
sentences.zh: 美國是資本主義國家嗎？

sentences.en: A wealthy capitalist funded the new research center.
sentences.zh: 一位富有的資本家資助了新的研究中心。

sentences.en: Many early capitalists made their money from trade.
sentences.zh: 許多早期的資本家靠貿易賺錢。
