sentences.en: How does a capitalist system set prices?
sentences.zh: 資本主義制度如何決定價格？

sentences.en: The capitalist economy depends on consumer spending.
sentences.zh: 資本主義經濟仰賴消費者支出。

sentences.en: The company's market capitalization passed one billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的市值突破了十億美元。

sentences.en: What is the capitalization of the startup?
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司的資本額是多少？

sentences.en: Small-cap stocks have a lower capitalization than large-cap stocks.
sentences.zh: 小型股的市值比大型股低。

sentences.en: Is the capitalization of the firm enough to fund expansion?
sentences.zh: 公司的資本額足夠支應擴張嗎？

sentences.en: Their total capitalization rose after the new share sale.
sentences.zh: 新股發行後，他們的總市值上升了。

sentences.en: Analysts track the capitalization of each company in the index.
sentences.zh: 分析師追蹤指數內每家公司的市值。

gloss_note: capitalize on 利用；另指字首大寫

sentences.en: We should capitalize on the holiday shopping season this year.
sentences.zh: 我們應該好好把握今年的年終購物季。

sentences.en: Did the company capitalize on its early success?
sentences.zh: 這家公司有利用早期的成功嗎？

sentences.en: Smart investors capitalize on market changes quickly.
sentences.zh: 聰明的投資人會迅速利用市場變化。

sentences.en: Remember to capitalize the first letter of each name.
sentences.zh: 記得把每個名字的第一個字母大寫。

sentences.en: Do we capitalize job titles in a formal letter?
sentences.zh: 正式信件裡職稱要大寫嗎？

sentences.en: Please capitalize every word in the title.
sentences.zh: 請把標題裡的每個字都大寫。

sentences.en: I'd like a caramel latte, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一杯焦糖拿鐵。

sentences.en: Do you want caramel sauce on your ice cream?
sentences.zh: 你的冰淇淋要淋焦糖醬嗎？

sentences.en: The cake has a thick layer of caramel on top.
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕上面有厚厚一層焦糖。

sentences.en: She melted sugar slowly to make caramel.
sentences.zh: 她慢慢融化砂糖來做焦糖。

sentences.en: Is the caramel popcorn made in-store?
sentences.zh: 這焦糖爆米花是店裡現做的嗎？

sentences.en: The smell of warm caramel filled the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 溫熱焦糖的香氣充滿廚房。

sentences.en: The ship carries cargo from Asia to the West Coast.
sentences.zh: 這艘船把貨物從亞洲運到西岸。

sentences.en: Is the cargo insured against damage?
sentences.zh: 這批貨有投保損壞險嗎？

sentences.en: The cargo arrived at the port on Monday.
sentences.zh: 這批貨週一抵達港口。

sentences.en: Air cargo is faster but more expensive than sea freight.
sentences.zh: 空運貨物比海運快，但更貴。

sentences.en: Workers are unloading cargo from the truck.
sentences.zh: 工人正在從卡車上卸貨。

sentences.en: How much cargo can this plane carry?
sentences.zh: 這架飛機能載多少貨物？

gloss_note: printer cartridge 印表機墨水匣

sentences.en: The printer needs a new ink cartridge.
sentences.zh: 印表機需要換新的墨水匣。

sentences.en: Do we have a spare toner cartridge in the supply room?
sentences.zh: 備品室還有碳粉匣備用嗎？

sentences.en: I replaced the cartridge, but it still won't print.
sentences.zh: 我換了墨水匣，但還是印不出來。

sentences.en: Where can I buy a cartridge for this model?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以買到這個型號的墨水匣？

sentences.en: A single cartridge prints about two hundred pages.
sentences.zh: 一個墨水匣大約能印兩百頁。

sentences.en: The empty cartridge is in the recycling box.
sentences.zh: 空的墨水匣在回收箱裡。

gloss_note: cashier 指收銀員；收銀台叫 checkout

sentences.en: The cashier gave me the wrong change.
sentences.zh: 收銀員找錯錢給我了。

sentences.en: Please pay the cashier at the front of the store.
sentences.zh: 請在店面前方向收銀員付款。

sentences.en: She works as a cashier at a grocery store.
sentences.zh: 她在一家雜貨店當收銀員。

sentences.en: Could you ask the cashier for a bag?
sentences.zh: 你可以向收銀員要個袋子嗎？

sentences.en: The cashier asked to see my ID.
sentences.zh: 收銀員要求看我的身分證件。

sentences.en: Why is the cashier taking so long with that customer?
sentences.zh: 收銀員為什麼處理那位顧客花這麼久？

gloss_note: cater to 迎合；cater 承辦餐點

sentences.en: We hired a company to cater the office party.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一家公司承辦公司派對的餐點。

sentences.en: Can you cater lunch for fifty people on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你們週五可以為五十個人承辦午餐嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel will cater our wedding reception.
sentences.zh: 飯店將負責我們婚宴的餐點。

sentences.en: The menu caters to vegetarians and meat lovers alike.
sentences.zh: 這份菜單同時迎合素食者和肉食愛好者。

sentences.en: Does the store cater to customers who want organic food?
sentences.zh: 這家店有迎合想買有機食品的顧客嗎？

sentences.en: Many shops here cater to tourists.
sentences.zh: 這裡許多商店都以觀光客為對象。

sentences.en: We chose a local caterer for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 我們為婚禮選了一家本地的外燴業者。

sentences.en: Has the caterer confirmed the menu yet?
sentences.zh: 外燴業者確認菜單了嗎？

sentences.en: The caterer will arrive two hours before the event.
sentences.zh: 外燴業者會在活動前兩小時抵達。

sentences.en: Could you recommend a good caterer for a small party?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦適合小型派對的外燴業者嗎？

sentences.en: Our caterer prepared vegetarian options for the guests.
sentences.zh: 我們的外燴業者為賓客準備了素食選擇。

sentences.en: The caterer charges by the number of guests.
sentences.zh: 外燴業者按賓客人數收費。

sentences.en: Please use caution when walking on the wet floor.
sentences.zh: 走在濕地板上請小心。

sentences.en: Do you think we should proceed with caution?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們應該謹慎行事嗎？

sentences.en: The sign cautions visitors not to feed the animals.
sentences.zh: 告示牌警告遊客不要餵食動物。

sentences.en: Investors are advised to treat the numbers with caution.
sentences.zh: 建議投資人謹慎看待這些數字。

sentences.en: The doctor cautioned him against lifting heavy boxes.
sentences.zh: 醫生告誡他不要搬重箱子。

sentences.en: Why did the manager urge caution before signing?
sentences.zh: 為什麼經理在簽約前要大家謹慎？

sentences.en: The restaurant is popular with local celebrities.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳很受本地名人歡迎。

sentences.en: Which celebrity will attend the charity event?
sentences.zh: 哪位名人會出席這場慈善活動？

sentences.en: She became a celebrity after her video went viral.
sentences.zh: 她的影片爆紅後，她成了名人。

sentences.en: Do you follow any celebrities on social media?
sentences.zh: 你有在社群媒體上追蹤任何名人嗎？

sentences.en: A celebrity endorsed our new product last week.
sentences.zh: 上週有一位名人為我們的新產品代言。

sentences.en: The hotel often hosts celebrities during the film festival.
sentences.zh: 影展期間，這家飯店常接待名人。

sentences.en: You will receive a certificate after completing the course.
sentences.zh: 完成課程後你會拿到證書。

sentences.en: Do I need a birth certificate to apply?
sentences.zh: 申請時我需要出生證明嗎？

sentences.en: She framed her certificate and hung it on the wall.
sentences.zh: 她把證書裱框掛在牆上。

sentences.en: She earned a certificate in first aid last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天取得了急救證書。

sentences.en: Could you send a copy of your certificate by email?
sentences.zh: 你可以用電子郵件寄一份證書影本嗎？

sentences.en: The certificate proves that he passed the safety test.
sentences.zh: 這張證書證明他通過了安全測驗。

sentences.en: Do you have a certification in project management?
sentences.zh: 你有專案管理的認證嗎？

sentences.en: He needs certification before he can teach yoga.
sentences.zh: 他需要先取得認證才能教瑜珈。

sentences.en: The certification exam takes about three hours.
sentences.zh: 這個認證考試大約要三個小時。

sentences.en: The product received safety certification last month.
sentences.zh: 這項產品上個月取得了安全認證。

sentences.en: How long is the certification valid?
sentences.zh: 這個認證的有效期多久？

sentences.en: Our company pays for employees' certification courses.
sentences.zh: 公司負擔員工的認證課程費用。

sentences.en: That coffee chain has opened a store on every corner.
sentences.zh: 那家連鎖咖啡店每個街角都開了分店。

sentences.en: Is this restaurant part of a big chain?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳是大型連鎖店的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: She manages a hotel chain with over two hundred locations.
sentences.zh: 她經營一家擁有兩百多個據點的連鎖飯店。

sentences.en: Small shops struggle to compete with large chains.
sentences.zh: 小商店很難和大型連鎖店競爭。

sentences.en: Which grocery chain has the best prices?
sentences.zh: 哪家連鎖超市的價格最便宜？

sentences.en: The fast-food chain is adding vegetarian items to its menu.
sentences.zh: 這家連鎖速食店正在菜單上增加素食選項。

gloss_note: 美國大學的 chancellor 即校長

sentences.en: The university chancellor spoke at the graduation ceremony.
sentences.zh: 大學校長在畢業典禮上致詞。

sentences.en: Is the chancellor visiting our campus next week?
sentences.zh: 校長下週會來我們校園嗎？

sentences.en: The chancellor announced a new scholarship program for students.
sentences.zh: 校長宣布了一項新的學生獎學金計畫。

sentences.en: The chancellor welcomed the new students on the first day.
sentences.zh: 校長在開學第一天迎接新生。

sentences.en: Did the chancellor meet with local business leaders yesterday?
sentences.zh: 校長昨天有和本地企業領袖會面嗎？

sentences.en: As chancellor, she oversees all the colleges in the system.
sentences.zh: 身為校長，她負責督導系統內所有學院。

sentences.en: The author's characterization of the hero is very detailed.
sentences.zh: 作者對主角的人物塑造非常細膩。

sentences.en: Is this characterization of the problem fair?
sentences.zh: 對這個問題的這種描述公平嗎？

sentences.en: The film's strong characterization makes every character memorable.
sentences.zh: 這部電影出色的人物塑造讓每個角色都令人難忘。

sentences.en: I disagree with his characterization of our team as lazy.
sentences.zh: 我不同意他把我們團隊形容成懶散。

sentences.en: How does the writer use dialogue for characterization?
sentences.zh: 作者如何用對話來塑造人物？

sentences.en: A clear characterization of the problem helps us find a solution.
sentences.zh: 清楚描述問題有助於我們找到解決辦法。

sentences.en: The club's charter requires an annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 俱樂部的章程規定每年要開一次會。

sentences.en: We chartered a boat for the weekend trip.
sentences.zh: 我們為週末旅行包了一艘船。

sentences.en: Is a charter flight cheaper than a regular ticket?
sentences.zh: 包機比一般機票便宜嗎？

sentences.en: The school's charter says its board must meet every month.
sentences.zh: 這所學校的章程規定董事會每個月都要開會。

sentences.en: The firm will charter a bus to take staff to the company picnic.
sentences.zh: 公司將包一輛巴士載員工去公司野餐。

sentences.en: Did the charter allow the board to change the rules?
sentences.zh: 章程允許董事會更改規則嗎？

sentences.en: The chef recommends the grilled salmon tonight.
sentences.zh: 主廚今晚推薦烤鮭魚。

sentences.en: Can I speak to the chef about my allergy?
sentences.zh: 我可以和主廚談談我的過敏嗎？

sentences.en: She trained as a pastry chef in France.
sentences.zh: 她在法國受訓成為糕點主廚。

sentences.en: The head chef checks every plate before it leaves the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 主廚在每道菜出廚房前都會檢查。

sentences.en: Do you think the chef uses fresh herbs?
sentences.zh: 你覺得主廚有用新鮮香草嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle works as a chef at a downtown hotel.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在市中心一家飯店當廚師。

gloss_note: chromosome 常與 gene 一起出現

sentences.en: Humans normally have twenty-three pairs of chromosomes.
sentences.zh: 人類通常有二十三對染色體。

sentences.en: Where are genes located on a chromosome?
sentences.zh: 基因位於染色體的哪個位置？

sentences.en: Each chromosome carries thousands of genes.
sentences.zh: 每條染色體攜帶數千個基因。

sentences.en: The students looked at a chromosome under the microscope.
sentences.zh: 學生們用顯微鏡觀察染色體。

sentences.en: Do all animals have the same number of chromosomes?
sentences.zh: 所有動物的染色體數量都一樣嗎？

sentences.en: A missing chromosome can cause serious health problems.
sentences.zh: 缺少一條染色體可能造成嚴重的健康問題。

sentences.en: My grandfather suffers from chronic back pain.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺長期受慢性背痛所苦。

sentences.en: Is chronic stress bad for your heart?
sentences.zh: 慢性壓力對心臟不好嗎？

sentences.en: She was diagnosed with a chronic illness last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年被診斷出慢性疾病。

sentences.en: The city has a chronic shortage of affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 這座城市長期缺乏平價住宅。

sentences.en: Do you have chronic allergies?
sentences.zh: 你有慢性過敏嗎？

sentences.en: Chronic lack of sleep affects your memory.
sentences.zh: 長期睡眠不足會影響記憶力。

sentences.en: Would you like cinnamon on your latte?
sentences.zh: 你的拿鐵要加肉桂粉嗎？

sentences.en: Add a teaspoon of cinnamon to the apple pie.
sentences.zh: 在蘋果派裡加一茶匙肉桂。

sentences.en: The kitchen smelled of fresh cinnamon rolls.
sentences.zh: 廚房裡瀰漫著剛出爐肉桂捲的香氣。

sentences.en: Do you know if this oatmeal has cinnamon in it?
sentences.zh: 你知道這份燕麥粥裡有沒有肉桂嗎？

sentences.en: She sprinkled cinnamon over the toast.
sentences.zh: 她在吐司上灑了肉桂粉。

sentences.en: A cinnamon stick makes hot tea taste sweeter.
sentences.zh: 一根肉桂棒能讓熱茶嚐起來更香甜。

sentences.en: Please add a citation for that statistic.
sentences.zh: 請為那項統計數字加上引用出處。

sentences.en: Do I need a citation for every quote?
sentences.zh: 每段引文都需要標註出處嗎？

sentences.en: The report includes a citation to the original study.
sentences.zh: 報告中附有原始研究的引用出處。

sentences.en: The officer gave him a citation for running a red light.
sentences.zh: 警察因他闖紅燈開了罰單。

sentences.en: Did you get a citation for parking there?
sentences.zh: 你在那裡停車被開罰單了嗎？

sentences.en: The professor checked each citation in the bibliography.
sentences.zh: 教授檢查了參考書目裡的每一條引用。

sentences.en: What is the tax classification of this expense?
sentences.zh: 這筆費用的稅務分類是什麼？

sentences.en: Her job classification changed after the reorganization.
sentences.zh: 她的職務類別在組織改組後改變了。

sentences.en: The system uses a simple classification of products by color.
sentences.zh: 這個系統用顏色對產品做簡單分類。

sentences.en: Is the classification of this document confidential?
sentences.zh: 這份文件的分級是機密嗎？

sentences.en: Biologists use a classification system to organize animals.
sentences.zh: 生物學家用分類系統來整理動物。

sentences.en: A new classification of the disease was published last year.
sentences.zh: 去年發表了這種疾病的新分類。

gloss_note: classify A as B 把A歸類為B

sentences.en: How do you classify these expenses?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼歸類這些費用？

sentences.en: We classify customers by how often they shop.
sentences.zh: 我們依顧客購物頻率來分類。

sentences.en: The tax authorities may classify him as an independent contractor.
sentences.zh: 稅務單位可能把他歸類為獨立承包人。

sentences.en: The government decided to classify the report.
sentences.zh: 政府決定將這份報告列為機密。

sentences.en: Is it okay to classify this file as urgent?
sentences.zh: 把這個檔案歸類為緊急可以嗎？

sentences.en: Librarians classify books by subject.
sentences.zh: 圖書館員依主題為書籍分類。

sentences.en: The closure of the factory put hundreds of people out of work.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉使數百人失業。

sentences.en: Is there a road closure on Main Street today?
sentences.zh: 今天大街有封路嗎？

sentences.en: We announced the closure of the downtown branch.
sentences.zh: 我們宣布了市中心分店歇業。

sentences.en: Due to the temporary closure, please use the east entrance.
sentences.zh: 由於暫時關閉，請使用東側入口。

sentences.en: How long will the bridge closure last?
sentences.zh: 這座橋的封閉會持續多久？

sentences.en: The store's closure surprised many loyal customers.
sentences.zh: 這家店歇業讓許多老顧客很驚訝。

gloss_note: cloth 是布料；衣服是 clothes

sentences.en: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
sentences.zh: 用濕布擦桌子。

sentences.en: She bought some cotton cloth to make curtains.
sentences.zh: 她買了一些棉布來做窗簾。

sentences.en: Do you have a soft cloth for cleaning glasses?
sentences.zh: 你有擦眼鏡的軟布嗎？

sentences.en: This cloth is thick enough for a winter coat.
sentences.zh: 這種布料夠厚，可以做冬季大衣。

sentences.en: The shop sells cloth by the yard.
sentences.zh: 這家店按碼賣布。

sentences.en: Where can I find a clean cloth?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以找到一塊乾淨的布？

gloss_note: form a coalition 組成聯盟

sentences.en: Several companies formed a coalition to lower shipping costs.
sentences.zh: 數家公司組成聯盟以降低運費。

sentences.en: Is your group part of the coalition?
sentences.zh: 你們的團體是這個聯盟的一員嗎？

sentences.en: A coalition of local shops asked the city for parking help.
sentences.zh: 本地商家聯盟請求市政府協助解決停車問題。

sentences.en: The coalition includes teachers, parents, and community leaders.
sentences.zh: 這個聯盟包含老師、家長和社區領袖。

sentences.en: Why did the coalition break up after only a year?
sentences.zh: 這個聯盟為什麼才一年就解散了？

sentences.en: Environmental groups joined a coalition to protect the river.
sentences.zh: 環保團體加入聯盟來保護這條河。

sentences.en: Please enter the code on the back of the card.
sentences.zh: 請輸入卡片背面的代碼。

sentences.en: What is the dress code for the dinner?
sentences.zh: 這場晚宴的服裝規定是什麼？

sentences.en: I forgot the access code to the building again.
sentences.zh: 我又忘了大樓的通行碼。

sentences.en: The restaurant has a strict code of conduct for staff.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳對員工有嚴格的行為準則。

sentences.en: Do you have a code for the discount?
sentences.zh: 你有折扣代碼嗎？

sentences.en: Our company follows a code of ethics.
sentences.zh: 我們公司遵循倫理規範。

sentences.en: The correlation coefficient is close to zero.
sentences.zh: 相關係數接近零。

sentences.en: What coefficient did you use in the formula?
sentences.zh: 你在公式裡用了什麼係數？

sentences.en: A higher coefficient means a stronger relationship.
sentences.zh: 係數越高，代表關係越強。

sentences.en: The coefficient of friction depends on the surface.
sentences.zh: 摩擦係數取決於表面。

sentences.en: Did the analyst explain the coefficient in the model?
sentences.zh: 分析師有解釋模型中的係數嗎？

sentences.en: Our risk model assigns each factor a coefficient.
sentences.zh: 我們的風險模型為每個因素指定一個係數。

sentences.en: Reading every day can improve your cognitive skills.
sentences.zh: 每天閱讀可以提升你的認知能力。

sentences.en: Is cognitive decline a normal part of aging?
sentences.zh: 認知功能衰退是老化的正常現象嗎？

sentences.en: The kids took a cognitive test at school.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在學校做了認知測驗。

sentences.en: She works on cognitive science at a university lab.
sentences.zh: 她在大學實驗室研究認知科學。

sentences.en: Do video games help children's cognitive development?
sentences.zh: 電動遊戲有助於兒童的認知發展嗎？

sentences.en: Poor sleep can hurt your cognitive performance at work.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不佳會損害你在工作上的認知表現。

sentences.en: The bank asked for collateral before approving the loan.
sentences.zh: 銀行在核准貸款前要求提供擔保品。

sentences.en: Can I use my car as collateral?
sentences.zh: 我可以用我的車當抵押品嗎？

sentences.en: Her house served as collateral for the business loan.
sentences.zh: 她的房子是這筆事業貸款的擔保品。

sentences.en: What kind of collateral do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有什麼樣的擔保品？

sentences.en: Without collateral, the interest rate will be higher.
sentences.zh: 沒有擔保品的話，利率會比較高。

sentences.en: The lender can sell the collateral if payments stop.
sentences.zh: 如果停止還款，放款人可以變賣抵押品。

sentences.en: The team made a collective decision to change the schedule.
sentences.zh: 團隊集體決定更改時程。

sentences.en: Is the collective effort enough to finish on time?
sentences.zh: 大家共同的努力足以準時完工嗎？

sentences.en: Our collective knowledge is greater than any one person's.
sentences.zh: 我們的集體知識比任何一個人的都多。

sentences.en: The union signed a collective bargaining agreement with the company.
sentences.zh: 工會與公司簽訂了團體協約。

sentences.en: What is the collective view of the staff?
sentences.zh: 員工的集體看法是什麼？

sentences.en: Collective action can change the way a company operates.
sentences.zh: 集體行動能改變公司的營運方式。

sentences.en: The town has many colonial buildings from the 1700s.
sentences.zh: 這座小鎮有許多1700年代的殖民時期建築。

sentences.en: Did the colonial government collect taxes from local farmers?
sentences.zh: 殖民政府有向當地農民徵稅嗎？

sentences.en: We studied colonial history in our social studies class.
sentences.zh: 我們在社會課學了殖民歷史。

sentences.en: Does the museum show colonial maps of the region?
sentences.zh: 博物館有展示這個地區的殖民時期地圖嗎？

sentences.en: Many countries gained independence from colonial rule after the war.
sentences.zh: 許多國家在戰後脫離殖民統治而獨立。

sentences.en: The colonial period shaped the language of the island.
sentences.zh: 殖民時期塑造了這座島的語言。

sentences.en: Online commerce has grown quickly in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年來網路商業快速成長。

sentences.en: The city is a center of commerce and finance.
sentences.zh: 這座城市是商業與金融中心。

sentences.en: Does the Chamber of Commerce meet every month?
sentences.zh: 商會每個月都開會嗎？

sentences.en: E-commerce changed how people shop.
sentences.zh: 電子商務改變了人們的購物方式。

sentences.en: The city wants to bring more commerce to downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府希望為市中心帶來更多商業活動。

sentences.en: How does a trade war affect commerce between countries?
sentences.zh: 貿易戰如何影響國與國之間的商業往來？

gloss_note: commodity prices 大宗商品價格

sentences.en: Oil is one of the world's most traded commodities.
sentences.zh: 石油是全球交易最頻繁的大宗商品之一。

sentences.en: Coffee is an important commodity for many countries.
sentences.zh: 咖啡對許多國家來說是重要的物資。

sentences.en: Do you invest in commodities like gold or wheat?
sentences.zh: 你有投資黃金或小麥之類的大宗商品嗎？

sentences.en: Clean water has become a valuable commodity here.
sentences.zh: 乾淨的水在這裡成了珍貴的商品。

sentences.en: Commodity prices rose sharply after the drought.
sentences.zh: 乾旱之後，大宗商品價格急遽上漲。

sentences.en: What commodity does your company mainly trade?
sentences.zh: 你們公司主要交易什麼商品？

sentences.en: This error is commonly seen in first drafts.
sentences.zh: 這種錯誤常見於初稿。

sentences.en: What questions are commonly asked in job interviews?
sentences.zh: 面試中通常會問哪些問題？

sentences.en: The tool is commonly used in small offices.
sentences.zh: 這個工具普遍用於小型辦公室。

sentences.en: Are these symptoms commonly found in children?
sentences.zh: 這些症狀常見於兒童嗎？

sentences.en: Tomatoes are commonly grown in this region.
sentences.zh: 這個地區普遍種植番茄。

sentences.en: The device, commonly called a hotspot, shares your phone's internet.
sentences.zh: 這種通常被稱為熱點的裝置能分享手機的網路。

gloss_zh: 共產主義的；共產主義者
gloss_note: communist 可當形容詞或名詞

sentences.en: We read about the communist movement in history class.
sentences.zh: 我們在歷史課讀到共產主義運動。

sentences.en: The museum has an exhibit on communist posters from the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一場1950年代共產主義海報的展覽。

sentences.en: Was the city under communist rule for many years?
sentences.zh: 這座城市曾受共產政權統治很多年嗎？

sentences.en: The book describes life in a communist country.
sentences.zh: 這本書描述共產主義國家的生活。

sentences.en: Which countries used communist economic systems?
sentences.zh: 哪些國家採用過共產主義經濟體制？

sentences.en: A communist leader once visited this city.
sentences.zh: 一位共產主義領袖曾造訪這座城市。

gloss_note: commute to work 通勤上班

sentences.en: I commute to the office by train every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天搭火車通勤到辦公室。

sentences.en: How long do you commute each morning?
sentences.zh: 你每天早上通勤多久？

sentences.en: She commutes from New Jersey to Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 她從紐澤西通勤到曼哈頓。

sentences.en: Many people commute by bike in this city.
sentences.zh: 這座城市有許多人騎腳踏車通勤。

sentences.en: Would you rather commute or work from home?
sentences.zh: 你比較想通勤還是在家工作？

sentences.en: We commute together to save on gas.
sentences.zh: 我們一起通勤以節省油錢。

sentences.en: The train was packed with commuters this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上火車擠滿了通勤族。

sentences.en: Are you a commuter or do you live near campus?
sentences.zh: 你是通勤生還是住在校園附近？

sentences.en: Commuters are asking for better bus service.
sentences.zh: 通勤族要求更好的公車服務。

sentences.en: The new highway lane will help commuters get home faster.
sentences.zh: 新的高速公路車道會讓通勤族更快到家。

sentences.en: Is there a parking lot for commuters at the station?
sentences.zh: 車站有通勤者用的停車場嗎？

sentences.en: Every commuter on this line knows the morning rush.
sentences.zh: 這條路線上的每位通勤者都熟悉早晨的尖峰時段。

sentences.en: Our prices are comparable to those of other stores.
sentences.zh: 我們的價格和其他店家相當。

sentences.en: Is this salary comparable to the market rate?
sentences.zh: 這份薪水和市場行情相當嗎？

sentences.en: The two phones have comparable battery life.
sentences.zh: 這兩支手機的電池續航力相近。

sentences.en: We need comparable data from last year.
sentences.zh: 我們需要去年可比較的數據。

sentences.en: Her experience is comparable to his.
sentences.zh: 她的經驗和他的相當。

sentences.en: Are the two apartments comparable in size?
sentences.zh: 這兩間公寓大小相當嗎？

sentences.en: She is writing a comparative study of two sales methods.
sentences.zh: 她正在寫兩種銷售方法的比較研究。

sentences.en: Is a comparative analysis necessary for this report?
sentences.zh: 這份報告需要做比較分析嗎？

sentences.en: We enjoyed the comparative quiet of the back office.
sentences.zh: 我們享受後面辦公室相對的安靜。

sentences.en: The report gives a comparative look at prices in both cities.
sentences.zh: 這份報告比較了兩個城市的物價。

sentences.en: He teaches comparative literature at the university.
sentences.zh: 他在大學教比較文學。

sentences.en: What is the comparative advantage of our product?
sentences.zh: 我們產品的相對優勢是什麼？

sentences.en: The company will compensate you for the damaged luggage.
sentences.zh: 公司會就受損的行李賠償你。

sentences.en: How will they compensate workers who lost their jobs?
sentences.zh: 他們會怎麼補償失業的員工？

sentences.en: Extra pay can't compensate for such long hours.
sentences.zh: 額外的薪水無法彌補這麼長的工時。

sentences.en: Did the airline compensate you for the delay?
sentences.zh: 航空公司有為延誤補償你嗎？

sentences.en: Fast delivery compensates for the higher price.
sentences.zh: 快速送貨彌補了較高的價格。

sentences.en: The insurance should compensate us for the repair costs.
sentences.zh: 保險應該補償我們的修理費用。

sentences.en: Her competence in negotiation impressed the clients.
sentences.zh: 她的談判能力讓客戶印象深刻。

sentences.en: Nobody doubts his competence as a manager.
sentences.zh: 沒人懷疑他身為經理的能力。

sentences.en: How do you test basic language competence?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼測驗基本的語言能力？

sentences.en: The interview checks both competence and attitude.
sentences.zh: 面試同時評估能力與態度。

sentences.en: Is the new hire showing enough competence?
sentences.zh: 這位新進員工展現了足夠的能力嗎？

sentences.en: Competence in math is required for this job.
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要數學方面的能力。

sentences.en: The red wine is a perfect complement to this steak.
sentences.zh: 紅酒是這份牛排的絕配。

sentences.en: Her skills complement his, so they make a good team.
sentences.zh: 她的技能與他互補，所以他們是好搭檔。

sentences.en: Does this scarf complement my jacket?
sentences.zh: 這條圍巾跟我的外套搭嗎？

sentences.en: A good salad is a nice complement to the main course.
sentences.zh: 好吃的沙拉是主餐很棒的搭配。

sentences.en: The new software complements our existing tools.
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體補足了我們現有的工具。

sentences.en: Do these two products complement each other?
sentences.zh: 這兩項產品能互相補足嗎？

sentences.en: The completion of the bridge is expected in May.
sentences.zh: 這座橋預計在五月完工。

sentences.en: Upon completion of the form, hand it to the clerk.
sentences.zh: 填完表格後，請交給櫃檯人員。

sentences.en: What is the expected completion date?
sentences.zh: 預計完成日期是什麼時候？

sentences.en: You will get a certificate upon completion of the course.
sentences.zh: 完成課程後，你會拿到證書。

sentences.en: Are we on track for completion by Friday?
sentences.zh: 我們有照進度在週五前完成嗎？

sentences.en: The builder will inspect the house before completion.
sentences.zh: 建商會在完工前檢查房子。

gloss_note: in compliance with 符合…規定

sentences.en: The company is in full compliance with safety rules.
sentences.zh: 公司完全遵守安全規定。

sentences.en: Who is responsible for compliance in your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門誰負責合規？

sentences.en: Compliance training is required for all new employees.
sentences.zh: 所有新進員工都必須接受合規訓練。

sentences.en: Failure to ensure compliance may lead to a fine.
sentences.zh: 未能確保合規可能會被罰款。

sentences.en: Does this product meet compliance standards?
sentences.zh: 這項產品符合法規標準嗎？

sentences.en: Our compliance team reviews every contract.
sentences.zh: 我們的法遵團隊會審查每份合約。

sentences.en: All employees must comply with the dress code.
sentences.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守服裝規定。

sentences.en: Did the restaurant comply with the health code?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有遵守衛生法規嗎？

sentences.en: We will comply with your request as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我們會盡快照您的要求辦理。

sentences.en: Drivers who fail to comply may face a fine.
sentences.zh: 不遵守規定的駕駛可能會被罰款。

sentences.en: Why won't the supplier comply with our request?
sentences.zh: 供應商為什麼不肯照我們的要求辦？

sentences.en: Please comply with the safety instructions on the sign.
sentences.zh: 請遵守告示牌上的安全指示。

gloss_note: film composer 電影配樂作曲家

sentences.en: The composer wrote the music in only two weeks.
sentences.zh: 作曲家只花了兩週就寫完這首曲子。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite composer?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡的作曲家是誰？

sentences.en: She wants to become a film composer someday.
sentences.zh: 她希望有一天成為電影配樂作曲家。

sentences.en: The orchestra played a piece by a famous composer.
sentences.zh: 管弦樂團演奏了一位知名作曲家的作品。

sentences.en: Was the composer still alive when it was first performed?
sentences.zh: 這首曲子首演時，作曲家還在世嗎？

sentences.en: The composer thanked the musicians after the concert.
sentences.zh: 音樂會結束後，作曲家向樂手們致謝。

sentences.en: Reading comprehension is a big part of the test.
sentences.zh: 閱讀理解是這項測驗的重要部分。

sentences.en: His comprehension of the contract was surprisingly good.
sentences.zh: 他對合約的理解出乎意料地好。

sentences.en: Does the child's comprehension improve with pictures?
sentences.zh: 孩子的理解力會因為圖片而提升嗎？

sentences.en: The comprehension questions are on the back page.
sentences.zh: 理解題在背面那一頁。

sentences.en: How can I improve my listening comprehension?
sentences.zh: 我該怎麼提升聽力理解？

sentences.en: The idea is beyond my comprehension.
sentences.zh: 這個想法我實在無法理解。

gloss_note: computation 比 calculation 偏運算

sentences.en: The computation took several hours on the old computer.
sentences.zh: 這項運算在舊電腦上花了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Can you check the computation for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我檢查這個計算嗎？

sentences.en: Complex computation requires a powerful processor.
sentences.zh: 複雜的運算需要效能強大的處理器。

sentences.en: She did the computation by hand to be safe.
sentences.zh: 為了保險起見，她用手算了一遍。

sentences.en: How much computation does the program need?
sentences.zh: 這個程式需要多少運算量？

sentences.en: The scientists used computation to predict the weather.
sentences.zh: 科學家運用運算來預測天氣。

sentences.en: Our conception of success has changed over the years.
sentences.zh: 這些年來我們對成功的概念改變了。

sentences.en: Do you have a clear conception of what the job involves?
sentences.zh: 你對這份工作的內容有清楚的概念嗎？

sentences.en: He has a strange conception of fairness.
sentences.zh: 他對公平有種奇怪的看法。

sentences.en: The film challenges our conception of family.
sentences.zh: 這部電影挑戰了我們對家庭的觀念。

sentences.en: From conception to launch, the project took three years.
sentences.zh: 從構想到上市，這個專案花了三年。

sentences.en: What was your original conception for the design?
sentences.zh: 你對這個設計原本的構想是什麼？

sentences.en: We need a conceptual design before building the model.
sentences.zh: 在做模型之前，我們需要先有概念設計。

sentences.en: Is this a conceptual problem or a technical one?
sentences.zh: 這是概念上的問題還是技術上的問題？

sentences.en: The students struggled with the conceptual part of the lesson.
sentences.zh: 學生在課程的概念部分學得吃力。

sentences.en: She explained the conceptual framework of the study.
sentences.zh: 她說明了這項研究的概念架構。

sentences.en: Do you prefer conceptual art or realistic painting?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡概念藝術還是寫實繪畫？

sentences.en: The team produced a conceptual sketch of the new logo.
sentences.zh: 團隊做出了新標誌的概念草圖。

gloss_note: make a concession 做出讓步

sentences.en: Both sides had to make a concession to close the deal.
sentences.zh: 雙方都得做出讓步，才能談成這筆交易。

sentences.en: Would you make a concession on the price if we order more?
sentences.zh: 如果我們訂多一點，你們可以在價格上讓步嗎？

sentences.en: The union refused to grant any concessions on wages.
sentences.zh: 工會拒絕在薪資上做任何讓步。

sentences.en: Is the company willing to make concessions to keep its biggest client?
sentences.zh: 公司願意做出讓步來留住最大的客戶嗎？

sentences.en: She made one small concession, and the meeting finally moved forward.
sentences.zh: 她做了一點小小的讓步，會議才終於往前推進。

sentences.en: I won't make that concession unless they offer something in return.
sentences.zh: 除非他們拿出相對的條件，否則我不會做那個讓步。

sentences.en: Their job offer is conditional on a background check.
sentences.zh: 他們的錄取通知是以通過背景調查為條件的。

sentences.en: Is the loan approval conditional on a higher credit score?
sentences.zh: 貸款核准是以更高的信用分數為條件嗎？

sentences.en: She received conditional admission, pending her final high school grades.
sentences.zh: 她拿到有條件錄取，要等高中最後的成績出來才算數。

sentences.en: Conditional approval means we still have to submit more documents.
sentences.zh: 有條件核准代表我們還得再交更多文件。

sentences.en: Is your support conditional on how the vote turns out?
sentences.zh: 你的支持是看投票結果而定的嗎？

sentences.en: The scholarship is conditional on keeping a B average.
sentences.zh: 這筆獎學金的條件是平均成績要維持在B以上。

sentences.en: The conductor raised his baton, and the orchestra went quiet.
sentences.zh: 指揮舉起指揮棒，樂團頓時安靜下來。

sentences.en: Who is the conductor of the school orchestra this year?
sentences.zh: 今年學校管弦樂團的指揮是誰？

sentences.en: The train conductor checked everyone's tickets before we left.
sentences.zh: 列車長在我們出發前檢查了大家的車票。

sentences.en: Did you see the conductor smile after the concert ended?
sentences.zh: 你有看到音樂會結束後指揮在微笑嗎？

sentences.en: She wants to become a conductor and lead a symphony someday.
sentences.zh: 她想成為指揮，有一天帶領一個交響樂團。

sentences.en: Excuse me, conductor, does this train stop in Chicago?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，列車長，這班車會停芝加哥嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep this report confidential until the announcement.
sentences.zh: 在正式公布之前，請把這份報告保密。

sentences.en: Is this email confidential, or can I forward it?
sentences.zh: 這封郵件是機密嗎，還是我可以轉寄？

sentences.en: Everything you tell the counselor stays strictly confidential.
sentences.zh: 你告訴輔導老師的一切都會嚴格保密。

sentences.en: I marked the file confidential so only managers can open it.
sentences.zh: 我把檔案標成機密，這樣只有主管能打開。

sentences.en: Why was the confidential memo sent to the whole department?
sentences.zh: 為什麼機密備忘錄會寄給整個部門？

sentences.en: The salary information is confidential, so I can't share it.
sentences.zh: 薪資資訊是機密，所以我不能透露。

sentences.en: The new office has a different configuration from the old one.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的配置和舊的不一樣。

sentences.en: Can you check the configuration before we install the software?
sentences.zh: 安裝軟體之前，你可以先檢查設定嗎？

sentences.en: The configuration of the atoms determines how the material behaves.
sentences.zh: 原子的排列配置決定了這種材料的特性。

sentences.en: What is the best seating configuration for a class of thirty?
sentences.zh: 三十人的班級，最好的座位配置是什麼？

sentences.en: A wrong configuration caused the network to crash this morning.
sentences.zh: 錯誤的設定讓網路今天早上當機了。

sentences.en: I changed the printer configuration, but it still won't connect.
sentences.zh: 我改了印表機的設定，但它還是連不上。

sentences.en: I'm still waiting for confirmation from the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我還在等飯店的確認。

sentences.en: Did you get a confirmation email after you booked the flight?
sentences.zh: 你訂機票之後有收到確認信嗎？

sentences.en: We need written confirmation before we can ship the order.
sentences.zh: 我們需要書面確認才能出貨。

sentences.en: Can you send me confirmation of the meeting time by noon?
sentences.zh: 你中午前可以把會議時間的確認通知寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: Her test results offered confirmation that the treatment was working.
sentences.zh: 她的檢驗結果證實治療有效。

sentences.en: Please print the confirmation and bring it to the front desk.
sentences.zh: 請把確認函印出來，帶到櫃檯。

gloss_note: 跨足多種行業的大公司

sentences.en: The conglomerate owns a bank, a hotel chain, and a TV station.
sentences.zh: 這個企業集團擁有一間銀行、一個連鎖飯店和一家電視台。

sentences.en: Which conglomerate bought that small software startup last year?
sentences.zh: 去年是哪個企業集團買下那家小型軟體新創公司？

sentences.en: My uncle works for a large conglomerate in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在德州一個大型企業集團工作。

sentences.en: Is it hard for a conglomerate to manage so many different businesses?
sentences.zh: 企業集團要管理這麼多不同的事業很難嗎？

sentences.en: The conglomerate plans to sell off its weakest divisions.
sentences.zh: 這個企業集團打算賣掉表現最差的部門。

sentences.en: Regulators are reviewing the merger of the two conglomerates.
sentences.zh: 主管機關正在審查這兩個企業集團的合併案。

gloss_note: congratulate sb on sth 為某事恭喜某人

sentences.en: I called to congratulate you on your promotion.
sentences.zh: 我打電話來是要恭喜你升遷。

sentences.en: Did you congratulate Maria on her new job?
sentences.zh: 你有恭喜瑪莉亞找到新工作嗎？

sentences.en: The coach congratulated the team after the big win.
sentences.zh: 大勝之後，教練向球隊道賀。

sentences.en: Let me congratulate you both on your wedding.
sentences.zh: 讓我恭喜你們兩位新婚。

sentences.en: Why don't we send him a card to congratulate him?
sentences.zh: 我們何不寄張卡片向他道賀？

sentences.en: The mayor stopped by to congratulate the winners in person.
sentences.zh: 市長親自過來向得獎者道賀。

sentences.en: He lost consciousness after hitting his head on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他頭撞到地板後失去了意識。

sentences.en: Did the patient regain consciousness this morning?
sentences.zh: 病人今天早上恢復意識了嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists still debate what consciousness really is.
sentences.zh: 科學家仍在爭論意識到底是什麼。

sentences.en: She slowly drifted back to consciousness in the hospital bed.
sentences.zh: 她在病床上慢慢恢復了意識。

sentences.en: How does anesthesia affect a person's consciousness?
sentences.zh: 麻醉如何影響一個人的意識？

sentences.en: Some animals may have a simple form of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 有些動物可能具有簡單形式的意識。

gloss_note: reach a consensus 達成共識

sentences.en: We need to reach a consensus before the end of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在會議結束前達成共識。

sentences.en: Is there a consensus among the team about the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 團隊對新的時程有共識嗎？

sentences.en: The consensus was to delay the launch until next month.
sentences.zh: 大家的共識是把上市延到下個月。

sentences.en: There is a strong consensus among doctors about the benefits of sleep.
sentences.zh: 醫生之間對睡眠的好處有很強的共識。

sentences.en: How can we build consensus when everyone disagrees?
sentences.zh: 大家都不同意的時候，我們要怎麼凝聚共識？

sentences.en: By consensus, the committee chose the first design.
sentences.zh: 經大家一致同意，委員會選了第一個設計。

sentences.en: You need written consent from a parent to join the trip.
sentences.zh: 你需要家長的書面同意才能參加這趟旅行。

sentences.en: Did your landlord consent to the repairs?
sentences.zh: 你的房東同意進行維修了嗎？

sentences.en: The patient gave her consent before the surgery.
sentences.zh: 病人在手術前表示同意。

sentences.en: Do I need their consent to share these photos?
sentences.zh: 我分享這些照片需要他們的同意嗎？

sentences.en: He finally consented to a short interview.
sentences.zh: 他終於同意接受一個簡短的訪問。

sentences.en: The contract can't change without the consent of both parties.
sentences.zh: 沒有雙方同意，合約不能更改。

gloss_note: wildlife conservation 野生動物保育

sentences.en: Wildlife conservation depends on protecting natural habitats.
sentences.zh: 野生動物保育有賴於保護自然棲地。

sentences.en: Why is water conservation so important in California?
sentences.zh: 為什麼節約用水在加州這麼重要？

sentences.en: She works for a conservation group that protects the wetlands.
sentences.zh: 她在一個保護濕地的保育團體工作。

sentences.en: Energy conservation can lower your monthly bills.
sentences.zh: 節約能源可以降低你每個月的帳單。

sentences.en: Do you support conservation efforts in national parks?
sentences.zh: 你支持國家公園的保育工作嗎？

sentences.en: Our class learned about soil conservation on a farm trip.
sentences.zh: 我們班在農場校外教學時學到了水土保持。

sentences.en: Sales rose considerably during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 假期期間的銷售量大幅上升。

sentences.en: Is the new model considerably faster than the old one?
sentences.zh: 新款比舊款快很多嗎？

sentences.en: The price has dropped considerably since last spring.
sentences.zh: 價格從去年春天以來大幅下降。

sentences.en: Her English has improved considerably this year.
sentences.zh: 她的英文今年進步很多。

sentences.en: Did traffic get considerably worse after the road closed?
sentences.zh: 那條路封閉後，交通是不是變得糟很多？

sentences.en: It's considerably colder here than in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 這裡比洛杉磯冷多了。

sentences.en: She consistently meets her sales targets every quarter.
sentences.zh: 她每一季都持續達成銷售目標。

sentences.en: Has the team consistently delivered on time?
sentences.zh: 這個團隊一直都準時交件嗎？

sentences.en: Our restaurant is consistently rated among the best in town.
sentences.zh: 我們的餐廳一直被評為全市最好的餐廳之一。

sentences.en: He consistently arrives early and stays late.
sentences.zh: 他總是很早到、很晚走。

sentences.en: Why does the app consistently crash on my phone?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個應用程式在我的手機上老是當機？

sentences.en: Consistently good service keeps customers coming back.
sentences.zh: 始終如一的好服務會讓顧客一再光臨。

sentences.en: We plan to consolidate the two offices into one.
sentences.zh: 我們打算把這兩間辦公室合併成一間。

sentences.en: Can I consolidate my credit card debts into a single loan?
sentences.zh: 我可以把信用卡債務整合成一筆貸款嗎？

sentences.en: The company consolidated its three warehouses to save money.
sentences.zh: 公司把三間倉庫合併起來以節省開銷。

sentences.en: Did the bank consolidate those accounts for you?
sentences.zh: 銀行有幫你把那些帳戶合併嗎？

sentences.en: The team worked hard to consolidate its lead in the standings.
sentences.zh: 球隊努力鞏固自己在排行榜上的領先地位。

sentences.en: Let's consolidate all the reports into one file.
sentences.zh: 我們把所有報告整合成一個檔案吧。

sentences.en: The consolidation of the two banks led to some layoffs.
sentences.zh: 兩家銀行合併後，出現了一些裁員。

sentences.en: Is debt consolidation a good idea for me?
sentences.zh: 債務整合對我來說是個好主意嗎？

sentences.en: Industry consolidation has left only three big airlines.
sentences.zh: 產業整合讓市場上只剩三家大型航空公司。

sentences.en: What does the consolidation of our departments mean for staff?
sentences.zh: 部門合併對員工來說代表什麼？

sentences.en: The plan calls for consolidation of all data centers by June.
sentences.zh: 計畫要求在六月前整合所有資料中心。

sentences.en: Analysts expect more consolidation in the retail market.
sentences.zh: 分析師預期零售市場會有更多整合。

sentences.en: The word go starts with a consonant sound.
sentences.zh: go這個字是以子音開頭的。

sentences.en: How many consonants are there in the English alphabet?
sentences.zh: 英文字母裡有幾個子音？

sentences.en: Spanish speakers often struggle with certain English consonants.
sentences.zh: 說西班牙語的人常常覺得某些英文子音很難。

sentences.en: Is the letter Y a vowel or a consonant?
sentences.zh: 字母Y是母音還是子音？

sentences.en: Her teacher explained how to pronounce the final consonant clearly.
sentences.zh: 她的老師解釋了如何把結尾的子音發清楚。

sentences.en: A consonant cluster like tr can be hard to say.
sentences.zh: 像tr這樣的子音群可能很難唸。

sentences.en: The Constitution protects the right to free speech.
sentences.zh: 憲法保障言論自由的權利。

sentences.en: Each student must read the club's constitution before joining.
sentences.zh: 每位學生加入社團前都必須先讀社團章程。

sentences.en: Who wrote the United States Constitution?
sentences.zh: 美國憲法是誰寫的？

sentences.en: Each state in the U.S. has its own constitution, too.
sentences.zh: 美國每一州也都有自己的憲法。

sentences.en: Does your country's constitution limit the president's power?
sentences.zh: 你們國家的憲法有限制總統的權力嗎？

sentences.en: We studied how the Constitution was drafted in 1787.
sentences.zh: 我們研究了憲法是如何在1787年起草的。

sentences.en: The court will decide whether the law is constitutional.
sentences.zh: 法院將裁定這項法律是否合憲。

sentences.en: Do students have a constitutional right to free speech?
sentences.zh: 學生有言論自由的憲法權利嗎？

sentences.en: Constitutional law is one of the hardest classes in law school.
sentences.zh: 憲法是法學院最難的課之一。

sentences.en: The judge said the new rule was not constitutional.
sentences.zh: 法官表示這項新規定不合憲。

sentences.en: Are there constitutional limits on what police can search?
sentences.zh: 警方能搜查的範圍有憲法上的限制嗎？

sentences.en: Our class read about the constitutional convention of 1787.
sentences.zh: 我們班讀了1787年制憲會議的資料。

sentences.en: Limited funding will constrain what we can build this year.
sentences.zh: 有限的經費會限制我們今年能蓋的東西。

sentences.en: Do strict rules constrain creativity in the classroom?
sentences.zh: 嚴格的規定會限制教室裡的創意嗎？

sentences.en: The budget constrains how many people we can hire.
sentences.zh: 預算限制了我們能僱用的人數。

sentences.en: She felt constrained by the company's old policies.
sentences.zh: 她覺得自己被公司的舊政策綁住了。

sentences.en: What factors constrain the growth of small businesses?
sentences.zh: 有哪些因素限制了小型企業的成長？

sentences.en: Tight deadlines can constrain the quality of the work.
sentences.zh: 緊迫的期限可能會限制工作的品質。

sentences.en: She left her job to start a small consultancy.
sentences.zh: 她辭掉工作，開了一間小型顧問公司。

sentences.en: Does your consultancy work with startups or big corporations?
sentences.zh: 你們的顧問公司是服務新創公司還是大企業？

sentences.en: We hired a consultancy to review our supply chain.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一家顧問公司來檢視我們的供應鏈。

sentences.en: He earns most of his income from his consultancy.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的收入來自他開的顧問公司。

sentences.en: How much does a marketing consultancy usually charge?
sentences.zh: 行銷顧問公司通常收費多少？

sentences.en: The consultancy gave us a detailed report on customer habits.
sentences.zh: 顧問公司給了我們一份關於顧客習慣的詳細報告。

sentences.en: The clinic offers a free consultation for new patients.
sentences.zh: 這間診所提供新病患免費諮詢。

sentences.en: Can I book a consultation with your tax advisor?
sentences.zh: 我可以預約你們稅務顧問的諮詢嗎？

sentences.en: After consultation with the staff, we changed the schedule.
sentences.zh: 和員工討論之後，我們更改了時程。

sentences.en: The lawyer charged a hundred dollars for the consultation.
sentences.zh: 律師收了一百美元的諮詢費。

sentences.en: Is a consultation required before I start the program?
sentences.zh: 開始這個課程之前，需要先做諮詢嗎？

sentences.en: Our first consultation with the architect lasted two hours.
sentences.zh: 我們和建築師的第一次諮詢會談持續了兩個小時。

sentences.en: Our energy consumption goes up every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們的能源消耗量每年夏天都會增加。

sentences.en: How can we reduce fuel consumption on long trips?
sentences.zh: 長途旅行時，我們要怎麼降低油耗？

sentences.en: Doctors warn against high sugar consumption.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告不要攝取過多糖分。

sentences.en: Household consumption fell slightly in the last quarter.
sentences.zh: 上一季的家庭消費略有下降。

sentences.en: Is this much electricity consumption normal for a small apartment?
sentences.zh: 一間小公寓用這麼多電正常嗎？

sentences.en: The report tracks water consumption by neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 這份報告依社區追蹤用水量。

sentences.en: Please put the leftovers in a plastic container.
sentences.zh: 請把剩菜放進塑膠容器裡。

sentences.en: The shipping container arrived at the port on Monday.
sentences.zh: 那個貨櫃週一抵達了港口。

sentences.en: Do you have a container big enough for this soup?
sentences.zh: 你有夠大的容器可以裝這鍋湯嗎？

sentences.en: Each container holds about two hundred boxes.
sentences.zh: 每個貨櫃大約裝得下兩百個箱子。

sentences.en: How long does it take to unload a container?
sentences.zh: 卸下一個貨櫃要多久？

sentences.en: Keep the container tightly closed so the food stays fresh.
sentences.zh: 容器要蓋緊，食物才能保持新鮮。

sentences.en: Our offer on the house is contingent on a satisfactory inspection.
sentences.zh: 我們對這間房子的出價，要看驗屋結果是否令人滿意而定。

sentences.en: Is the bonus contingent on meeting the sales target?
sentences.zh: 獎金是看有沒有達成銷售目標而定嗎？

sentences.en: Our plans are contingent on the weather.
sentences.zh: 我們的計畫要看天氣而定。

sentences.en: Payment is contingent upon delivery of the final report.
sentences.zh: 款項要看最終報告是否交付而定。

sentences.en: Was the promotion contingent on moving to another city?
sentences.zh: 升遷是不是以搬到別的城市為條件？

sentences.en: The sale is contingent on the buyer getting a loan.
sentences.zh: 這筆買賣要看買方能否取得貸款而定。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame

sentences.en: Good record keeping ensures continuity when staff change.
sentences.zh: 好的紀錄能確保人員更替時工作的連貫性。

sentences.en: How can we maintain continuity during the move?
sentences.zh: 搬遷期間我們要怎麼維持運作不中斷？

sentences.en: The story lacks continuity from one chapter to the next.
sentences.zh: 這個故事的章節之間缺乏連貫性。

sentences.en: A new manager brings change, but we also need continuity.
sentences.zh: 新經理會帶來改變，但我們也需要延續性。

sentences.en: Is there continuity between the old and new curriculum?
sentences.zh: 新舊課程之間有連貫性嗎？

sentences.en: The plan protects the continuity of service during repairs.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫確保維修期間服務不中斷。

sentences.en: We hired a contractor to renovate the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一位承包商來整修廚房。

sentences.en: Is she an employee or an independent contractor?
sentences.zh: 她是正職員工還是獨立承包人？

sentences.en: The contractor said the job would take three weeks.
sentences.zh: 承包商說這項工程要三個星期。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a reliable contractor in this area?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦這一帶可靠的承包商嗎？

sentences.en: Contractors are not eligible for the company's health plan.
sentences.zh: 約聘人員不能加入公司的健保方案。

sentences.en: The general contractor finished the roof before the rain.
sentences.zh: 總承包商在下雨前完成了屋頂。

sentences.en: We have a contractual obligation to finish by May.
sentences.zh: 我們有合約義務要在五月前完成。

sentences.en: Is this a contractual requirement or just a suggestion?
sentences.zh: 這是合約上的要求，還是只是建議？

sentences.en: The vendor failed to meet its contractual duties.
sentences.zh: 供應商沒有履行它的合約義務。

sentences.en: Her contractual rights include two weeks of paid leave.
sentences.zh: 她的合約權利包括兩週的有薪假。

sentences.en: Did both sides sign the contractual agreement?
sentences.zh: 雙方都簽了這份合約協議嗎？

sentences.en: Any contractual dispute goes to arbitration first.
sentences.zh: 任何合約糾紛都先交付仲裁。

sentences.en: Your story contradicts what the witness said.
sentences.zh: 你的說法和目擊者所說的互相矛盾。

sentences.en: Please don't contradict me in front of the customers.
sentences.zh: 請不要在顧客面前反駁我。

sentences.en: Does this new data contradict the earlier results?
sentences.zh: 這筆新數據和先前的結果有衝突嗎？

sentences.en: The two reports contradict each other on the budget.
sentences.zh: 這兩份報告在預算上互相矛盾。

sentences.en: Why would he contradict his own boss in the meeting?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼要在會議上反駁自己的老闆？

sentences.en: Her actions contradict everything she says about honesty.
sentences.zh: 她的行為和她說的誠實完全相反。

sentences.en: Contrary to what I expected, the exam was easy.
sentences.zh: 和我預期的相反，這次考試很簡單。

sentences.en: Is this result contrary to your earlier findings?
sentences.zh: 這個結果和你先前的發現相反嗎？

sentences.en: I have no evidence to the contrary.
sentences.zh: 我沒有相反的證據。

sentences.en: He held a contrary opinion and said so at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他持相反的意見，並且在會議上說了出來。

sentences.en: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind.
sentences.zh: 和大家以為的相反，蝙蝠並不是瞎的。

sentences.en: Why do the results run contrary to our predictions?
sentences.zh: 為什麼結果和我們的預測相反？

sentences.en: Three roads converge at the edge of the town.
sentences.zh: 三條路在小鎮邊緣交會。

sentences.en: Thousands of fans converge on the stadium before every game.
sentences.zh: 每場比賽前，成千上萬的球迷湧向體育場。

sentences.en: Do the two lines converge at some point?
sentences.zh: 這兩條線會在某個點交會嗎？

sentences.en: Our views on the plan began to converge after the long talk.
sentences.zh: 長談之後，我們對計畫的看法開始趨於一致。

sentences.en: Why do so many cultures converge on the same basic stories?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這麼多文化的基本故事都很相似？

sentences.en: Where do the two rivers converge?
sentences.zh: 這兩條河在哪裡匯流？

sentences.en: The convergence of the two rivers forms a wide, calm lake.
sentences.zh: 兩條河匯合之處形成一座寬廣平靜的湖。

sentences.en: Is there any convergence between the two theories?
sentences.zh: 這兩個理論之間有任何趨同之處嗎？

sentences.en: The convergence of phones and cameras changed photography.
sentences.zh: 手機和相機的整合改變了攝影。

sentences.en: Experts noted a convergence of opinions at the conference.
sentences.zh: 專家指出，研討會上各方意見趨於一致。

sentences.en: What explains the convergence of prices across stores?
sentences.zh: 各家商店的價格趨於一致是什麼原因？

sentences.en: The convergence of several factors caused the delay.
sentences.zh: 幾個因素同時湊在一起，造成了延誤。

sentences.en: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took a year.
sentences.zh: 把舊工廠改建成公寓花了一年。

sentences.en: Can you check the currency conversion before we pay?
sentences.zh: 付款之前你可以先確認一下貨幣換算嗎？

sentences.en: The garage conversion added a bedroom and a small office.
sentences.zh: 車庫改建後多了一間臥室和一間小書房。

sentences.en: Our website's conversion rate improved after the redesign.
sentences.zh: 網站改版之後，我們的轉換率提高了。

sentences.en: Is the file conversion going to take long?
sentences.zh: 檔案轉換會花很久嗎？

sentences.en: How much does a van conversion cost?
sentences.zh: 改裝一輛廂型車要多少錢？

sentences.en: The company issued convertible bonds to raise cash.
sentences.zh: 公司發行可轉換公司債來籌措資金。

sentences.en: Is this currency freely convertible into dollars?
sentences.zh: 這種貨幣可以自由兌換成美元嗎？

sentences.en: The sofa is convertible into a bed for guests.
sentences.zh: 這張沙發可以變成給客人睡的床。

sentences.en: Convertible notes let investors turn debt into shares later.
sentences.zh: 可轉換票據讓投資人日後能把債權換成股份。

sentences.en: Are these points convertible to cash at the register?
sentences.zh: 這些點數可以在櫃檯換成現金嗎？

sentences.en: Our convertible loan can switch to equity next year.
sentences.zh: 我們的可轉換貸款明年可以轉成股權。

sentences.en: Please cooperate with the security staff at the gate.
sentences.zh: 請在大門口配合保全人員。

sentences.en: Will the two companies cooperate on the new project?
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司會在新計畫上合作嗎？

sentences.en: If everyone cooperates, we can finish by noon.
sentences.zh: 如果大家都配合，我們中午前就能完成。

sentences.en: Why did the witness refuse to cooperate?
sentences.zh: 為什麼證人拒絕配合？

sentences.en: Our team learned to cooperate during the long trip.
sentences.zh: 在那趟長途旅行中，我們的團隊學會了合作。

sentences.en: The suppliers cooperated fully with our investigation.
sentences.zh: 供應商全力配合我們的調查。

gloss_note: coordinate with sb 與某人協調

sentences.en: Can you coordinate the schedule with the sales team?
sentences.zh: 你可以和業務團隊協調一下時程嗎？

sentences.en: I'll coordinate the trip, so just send me your flight times.
sentences.zh: 旅行由我來統籌，你把航班時間傳給我就好。

sentences.en: She coordinates volunteers at the food bank every weekend.
sentences.zh: 她每個週末都在食物銀行統籌志工。

sentences.en: How do we coordinate our work across three time zones?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼跨三個時區協調工作？

sentences.en: The manager coordinated the move to the new building.
sentences.zh: 經理統籌了搬到新大樓的事宜。

sentences.en: We need someone to coordinate all the deliveries.
sentences.zh: 我們需要有人來統籌所有的配送。

sentences.en: The event coordinator booked the hall for Saturday.
sentences.zh: 活動統籌訂下了星期六的大廳。

sentences.en: Who is the volunteer coordinator at your school?
sentences.zh: 你們學校的志工統籌人是誰？

sentences.en: She works as a project coordinator at a small firm.
sentences.zh: 她在一間小公司擔任專案協調員。

sentences.en: Please send the form to the program coordinator.
sentences.zh: 請把表格寄給課程專員。

sentences.en: Is the coordinator available for a quick call today?
sentences.zh: 專員今天有空講個電話嗎？

sentences.en: The coordinator handled all the details of the wedding.
sentences.zh: 婚禮的所有細節都由統籌人處理。

sentences.en: The copier is out of paper again.
sentences.zh: 影印機又沒紙了。

sentences.en: Can you show me how to use the copier?
sentences.zh: 你可以教我怎麼用影印機嗎？

sentences.en: Someone left an original on the copier.
sentences.zh: 有人把原稿留在影印機上。

sentences.en: Is the copier on the second floor working?
sentences.zh: 二樓的影印機能用嗎？

sentences.en: We need to call a technician to fix the copier.
sentences.zh: 我們得叫技術人員來修影印機。

sentences.en: The copier jams every time I make double-sided copies.
sentences.zh: 我每次雙面影印，影印機都會卡紙。

sentences.en: Who owns the copyright to this photo?
sentences.zh: 這張照片的著作權是誰的？

sentences.en: Using that song without permission violates copyright law.
sentences.zh: 未經許可使用那首歌違反著作權法。

sentences.en: The author kept the copyright to her novel.
sentences.zh: 作者保留了她那本小說的著作權。

sentences.en: Is it a copyright violation to copy this textbook?
sentences.zh: 影印這本教科書算侵犯著作權嗎？

sentences.en: The copyright expires seventy years after the author dies.
sentences.zh: 著作權在作者過世七十年後到期。

sentences.en: The video was removed after a copyright complaint.
sentences.zh: 這支影片在收到著作權投訴後被下架了。

sentences.en: Linguists built a corpus of ten million spoken sentences.
sentences.zh: 語言學家建立了一個包含一千萬句口語的語料庫。

sentences.en: How large is the corpus used in this study?
sentences.zh: 這項研究使用的語料庫有多大？

sentences.en: Researchers searched the corpus for examples of the word.
sentences.zh: 研究人員在語料庫中搜尋這個字的例子。

sentences.en: The corpus includes news articles, emails, and speeches.
sentences.zh: 這個語料庫包含新聞文章、電子郵件和演講。

sentences.en: Can I access the corpus online for my class project?
sentences.zh: 我可以上網使用這個語料庫來做課堂專題嗎？

sentences.en: A corpus helps us see how people really use words.
sentences.zh: 語料庫能讓我們看到人們實際上怎麼使用字詞。

sentences.en: Please fill out the form correctly.
sentences.zh: 請正確填寫這份表格。

sentences.en: Did I spell your name correctly?
sentences.zh: 我有把你的名字拼對嗎？

sentences.en: The printer hasn't been working correctly since the update.
sentences.zh: 更新之後，印表機就一直沒辦法正常運作。

sentences.en: She answered every question correctly.
sentences.zh: 她每一題都答對了。

sentences.en: Are you sure the machine is installed correctly?
sentences.zh: 你確定機器有安裝正確嗎？

sentences.en: If I remember correctly, the meeting starts at nine.
sentences.zh: 如果我沒記錯，會議是九點開始。

sentences.en: Sleep quality tends to correlate with test performance.
sentences.zh: 睡眠品質往往和考試表現有關。

sentences.en: Does income correlate with happiness?
sentences.zh: 收入和快樂有關嗎？

sentences.en: The two sets of data do not correlate at all.
sentences.zh: 這兩組數據完全沒有關聯。

sentences.en: Researchers tried to correlate sales with weather patterns.
sentences.zh: 研究人員試著找出銷售量和天氣型態的關聯。

sentences.en: How closely do these numbers correlate?
sentences.zh: 這些數字的相關程度有多高？

sentences.en: Higher prices don't always correlate with better quality.
sentences.zh: 價格越高不一定代表品質越好。

sentences.en: There is a strong correlation between exercise and mood.
sentences.zh: 運動和心情之間有很強的相關性。

sentences.en: Is there a correlation between ad spending and sales?
sentences.zh: 廣告支出和銷售額之間有相關性嗎？

sentences.en: Correlation does not mean causation.
sentences.zh: 相關不代表因果。

sentences.en: The study found no correlation between age and test scores.
sentences.zh: 這項研究發現年齡和考試成績之間沒有相關性。

sentences.en: What correlation did you see between price and demand?
sentences.zh: 你看到價格和需求之間有什麼關聯？

sentences.en: A positive correlation means both numbers rise together.
sentences.zh: 正相關表示兩個數字會一起上升。

sentences.en: Please keep all correspondence with the client in this folder.
sentences.zh: 請把所有和客戶的往來信件放在這個資料夾裡。

sentences.en: I haven't received any correspondence from them since May.
sentences.zh: 五月以後我就沒再收到他們的任何來信。

sentences.en: Is the correspondence about the contract in your inbox?
sentences.zh: 關於合約的往來信件在你的收件匣裡嗎？

sentences.en: Her correspondence with the editor lasted for years.
sentences.zh: 她和編輯的書信往來持續了好幾年。

sentences.en: How long should we keep old correspondence?
sentences.zh: 舊的往來信件我們應該保留多久？

sentences.en: The firm handles all legal correspondence by email.
sentences.zh: 這間事務所用電子郵件處理所有的法律文書往來。

sentences.en: The mayor resigned after a corruption investigation.
sentences.zh: 市長在貪腐調查後辭職了。

sentences.en: How does corruption hurt a country's economy?
sentences.zh: 貪腐如何傷害一個國家的經濟？

sentences.en: The company has a strict policy against corruption.
sentences.zh: 公司對貪腐有嚴格的規定。

sentences.en: Was there evidence of corruption in the bidding process?
sentences.zh: 招標過程中有貪腐的證據嗎？

sentences.en: Corruption makes it hard for honest firms to compete.
sentences.zh: 貪腐讓誠實的公司很難競爭。

sentences.en: The documentary exposed corruption in the construction industry.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片揭露了營建業的貪腐。

sentences.en: The visual cortex processes what we see.
sentences.zh: 視覺皮質負責處理我們所看到的東西。

sentences.en: Which part of the cortex controls movement?
sentences.zh: 皮質的哪一個部分控制動作？

sentences.en: The cortex is the outer layer of the brain.
sentences.zh: 皮質是大腦的外層。

sentences.en: Damage to the cortex can affect memory and language.
sentences.zh: 皮質受損可能影響記憶和語言。

sentences.en: Do scientists know how the cortex develops in children?
sentences.zh: 科學家知道兒童的大腦皮質是如何發育的嗎？

sentences.en: Her research focuses on how the cortex changes with age.
sentences.zh: 她的研究專注在大腦皮質如何隨年齡改變。

sentences.en: What costume are you wearing to the Halloween party?
sentences.zh: 你要穿什麼服裝去參加萬聖節派對？

sentences.en: The actors changed into their costumes before the show.
sentences.zh: 演員們在演出前換上了戲服。

sentences.en: She made her daughter's costume by hand.
sentences.zh: 她親手做了女兒的服裝。

sentences.en: Do you rent costumes for school plays?
sentences.zh: 你們有出租學校戲劇用的服裝嗎？

sentences.en: His pirate costume won first prize at the party.
sentences.zh: 他的海盜裝在派對上拿了第一名。

sentences.en: The movie won an award for best costume design.
sentences.zh: 這部電影獲得了最佳服裝設計獎。

sentences.en: I'll call my counterpart at the Tokyo office tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天會打電話給東京辦公室的對口窗口。

sentences.en: Does your counterpart in sales agree with the plan?
sentences.zh: 你在業務部的對口同事同意這個計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The president met his French counterpart for lunch.
sentences.zh: 總統和法國的同級官員共進午餐。

sentences.en: Each manager has a counterpart in the other department.
sentences.zh: 每位經理在另一個部門都有對應的人。

sentences.en: Who is the counterpart to this role in the new team?
sentences.zh: 新團隊裡，誰對應這個職位？

sentences.en: The American version costs less than its Japanese counterpart.
sentences.zh: 美國版比日本的同款產品便宜。

gloss_note: pull off a coup 做成一件大事

sentences.en: Landing that client was a real coup for our small firm.
sentences.zh: 拿下那位客戶，對我們這間小公司來說是一大成就。

sentences.en: Did she pull off another coup at the negotiating table?
sentences.zh: 她在談判桌上又漂亮地贏了一次嗎？

sentences.en: Hiring the top engineer was quite a coup for the startup.
sentences.zh: 聘到頂尖工程師，對這家新創公司來說是一大成功。

sentences.en: It was a major coup to sign the star as our spokesperson.
sentences.zh: 簽下這位明星當代言人是一大成功。

sentences.en: How did they manage such a coup on a tight budget?
sentences.zh: 他們怎麼在預算這麼緊的情況下辦成這樣的大事？

sentences.en: Winning the contract was the biggest coup of his career.
sentences.zh: 拿下這份合約是他職業生涯中最大的成就。

sentences.en: I have a coupon for ten percent off.
sentences.zh: 我有一張九折的優惠券。

sentences.en: Can I use this coupon on sale items?
sentences.zh: 這張優惠券可以用在特價商品上嗎？

sentences.en: She clips coupons from the Sunday paper every week.
sentences.zh: 她每個星期都從週日報紙上剪折價券。

sentences.en: Does this coupon expire at the end of the month?
sentences.zh: 這張優惠券月底就到期了嗎？

sentences.en: The store emailed me a coupon for a free coffee.
sentences.zh: 商店寄給我一張免費咖啡的優惠券。

sentences.en: You must show the coupon at the register.
sentences.zh: 你必須在結帳時出示優惠券。

gloss_note: send by courier 用快遞寄

sentences.en: The courier will deliver the documents by noon.
sentences.zh: 快遞員中午前會把文件送到。

sentences.en: Can you send the contract by courier?
sentences.zh: 你可以用快遞寄這份合約嗎？

sentences.en: A courier dropped off a package for you this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有快遞員送來一個給你的包裹。

sentences.en: Did the courier ask you to sign for it?
sentences.zh: 快遞員有要你簽收嗎？

sentences.en: We use a courier for urgent international shipments.
sentences.zh: 緊急的國際貨件我們都用快遞。

sentences.en: The courier service tracks every package online.
sentences.zh: 這家快遞公司會在線上追蹤每一件包裹。

sentences.en: My coworker covered my shift yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我的同事昨天幫我代班。

sentences.en: Do you get along with your coworkers?
sentences.zh: 你和同事處得來嗎？

sentences.en: A coworker brought donuts to the office today.
sentences.zh: 今天有位同事帶甜甜圈到辦公室。

sentences.en: Have you met the new coworker in accounting?
sentences.zh: 你見過會計部的新同事了嗎？

sentences.en: I'm having lunch with a coworker at noon.
sentences.zh: 我中午要和一位同事吃午餐。

sentences.en: Her coworkers threw her a surprise party.
sentences.zh: 她的同事幫她辦了一場驚喜派對。

sentences.en: Missing deadlines hurts our credibility with clients.
sentences.zh: 錯過期限會損害我們在客戶心中的可信度。

sentences.en: How can a new company build credibility quickly?
sentences.zh: 新公司要怎麼快速建立信譽？

sentences.en: The reporter's credibility was questioned after the mistake.
sentences.zh: 那位記者出錯後，他的可信度遭到質疑。

sentences.en: Does the source have enough credibility to quote?
sentences.zh: 這個消息來源的可信度夠不夠，能引用嗎？

sentences.en: A good reference adds credibility to your résumé.
sentences.zh: 一封好的推薦信會讓你的履歷更有說服力。

sentences.en: He lost all credibility after he lied to the board.
sentences.zh: 他對董事會說謊後，就完全失去了公信力。

sentences.en: The company owes money to several creditors.
sentences.zh: 這家公司欠了好幾位債權人的錢。

sentences.en: Who is the biggest creditor in the bankruptcy case?
sentences.zh: 這件破產案裡最大的債權人是誰？

sentences.en: Creditors are demanding payment before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 債權人要求月底前還款。

sentences.en: Can we negotiate a payment plan with our creditor?
sentences.zh: 我們可以和債權人協商分期還款計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The bank is the main creditor of the failing firm.
sentences.zh: 銀行是這家經營不善的公司的主要債權人。

sentences.en: The creditor agreed to wait another thirty days.
sentences.zh: 債權人同意再等三十天。

gloss_note: critique sb's work 評論某人作品

sentences.en: The professor wrote a short critique of the essay.
sentences.zh: 教授針對這篇文章寫了一段簡短的評論。

sentences.en: Can you give me a critique of my presentation?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我的簡報一些評論嗎？

sentences.en: Her critique of the movie was fair and detailed.
sentences.zh: 她對這部電影的評論公正又詳細。

sentences.en: Would you critique my design before I submit it?
sentences.zh: 在我交出去之前，你可以幫我評一下設計嗎？

sentences.en: The students had to critique each other's drafts.
sentences.zh: 學生們必須互相評論對方的草稿。

sentences.en: A good critique points out both strengths and weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 好的評論會同時指出優點和缺點。

gloss_note: take a cruise 搭郵輪旅行

sentences.en: We're taking a cruise to Alaska this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天我們要搭郵輪去阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: How long is the cruise, and what does it cost?
sentences.zh: 這趟郵輪旅行有多久？費用是多少？

sentences.en: The ship will cruise along the coast for seven days.
sentences.zh: 這艘船將沿著海岸航行七天。

sentences.en: Have you ever been on a cruise before?
sentences.zh: 你以前搭過郵輪嗎？

sentences.en: My parents booked a cruise for their anniversary.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽訂了一趟郵輪旅行慶祝結婚紀念日。

sentences.en: The plane cruises at about thirty-five thousand feet.
sentences.zh: 飛機大約在三萬五千英尺的高度巡航。

sentences.en: I like my pizza with a thin crust.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡薄餅皮的披薩。

sentences.en: Do you cut the crusts off your sandwiches?
sentences.zh: 你會把三明治的吐司邊切掉嗎？

sentences.en: The apple pie has a golden, flaky crust.
sentences.zh: 這個蘋果派有金黃酥脆的外皮。

sentences.en: Kids often leave the bread crust on their plates.
sentences.zh: 小孩常把麵包邊留在盤子上。

sentences.en: What kind of crust do you want on the quiche?
sentences.zh: 你的法式鹹派想用哪種餅皮？

sentences.en: Brush the crust with egg for a shiny finish.
sentences.zh: 在餅皮上刷一層蛋液，烤出來會亮亮的。

sentences.en: Italian cuisine is popular all over the world.
sentences.zh: 義大利料理在全世界都很受歡迎。

sentences.en: What kind of cuisine do you feel like tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想吃哪一種料理？

sentences.en: This restaurant serves modern Thai cuisine.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應現代風格的泰式料理。

sentences.en: Do you know any good places for French cuisine?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪裡有不錯的法式料理嗎？

sentences.en: The chef is famous for blending two different cuisines.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚以融合兩種不同的料理風格聞名。

sentences.en: Mexican cuisine uses a lot of corn and beans.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥料理大量使用玉米和豆子。

sentences.en: She graduated from a culinary school in New York.
sentences.zh: 她畢業於紐約的一所烹飪學校。

sentences.en: Are you interested in a culinary career?
sentences.zh: 你對廚藝相關的職業有興趣嗎？

sentences.en: The festival offers a tour of local culinary traditions.
sentences.zh: 這個節慶提供在地飲食傳統的導覽。

sentences.en: His culinary skills impressed everyone at the dinner party.
sentences.zh: 他的廚藝讓晚宴上的每個人都印象深刻。

sentences.en: Which culinary herbs grow best on a windowsill?
sentences.zh: 哪些烹飪用的香草最適合種在窗台上？

sentences.en: The magazine publishes culinary tips every month.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌每個月都刊登烹飪小技巧。

sentences.en: Your cumulative GPA is shown at the top of the transcript.
sentences.zh: 你的累計平均成績顯示在成績單最上方。

sentences.en: What is the cumulative total after three months?
sentences.zh: 三個月後的累計總數是多少？

sentences.en: The cumulative effect of small savings can be huge.
sentences.zh: 小額儲蓄的累積效果可能非常大。

sentences.en: Is the final exam cumulative, or does it cover only the last chapters?
sentences.zh: 期末考是考全部範圍，還是只考最後幾章？

sentences.en: The cumulative sales for the year reached two million dollars.
sentences.zh: 今年的累計銷售額達到兩百萬美元。

sentences.en: Cumulative stress can eventually harm your health.
sentences.zh: 長期累積的壓力最終可能損害你的健康。

sentences.en: The city is trying to curb noise at night.
sentences.zh: 市政府正努力抑制夜間的噪音。

sentences.en: How can we curb our spending this month?
sentences.zh: 這個月我們要怎麼控制開銷？

sentences.en: Drinking water can help curb your appetite.
sentences.zh: 喝水有助於抑制食慾。

sentences.en: The new rule is meant to curb cheating on exams.
sentences.zh: 這項新規定是為了遏止考試作弊。

sentences.en: Can anything curb the spread of the flu in schools?
sentences.zh: 有什麼辦法能遏止流感在學校擴散嗎？

sentences.en: Strict laws were passed to curb illegal dumping.
sentences.zh: 政府通過了嚴格的法律來遏止非法傾倒。

gloss_note: meet a deadline 趕上期限

sentences.en: We have to meet the deadline on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在週五的截止日前完成。

sentences.en: Can you extend the deadline by a few days?
sentences.zh: 你可以把截止日期延幾天嗎？

sentences.en: The deadline for applications is the end of this month.
sentences.zh: 申請截止日是這個月底。

sentences.en: What's the deadline for submitting expense reports?
sentences.zh: 費用報告的繳交期限是什麼時候？

sentences.en: She missed the deadline because of a server error.
sentences.zh: 她因為伺服器出錯而錯過了截止時間。

sentences.en: I'm working under a tight deadline this week.
sentences.zh: 我這個星期的期限很緊，一直在趕工。

sentences.en: Do you accept debit cards here?
sentences.zh: 你們這裡收簽帳金融卡嗎？

sentences.en: The debit will show up on your statement tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 這筆扣款明天會出現在你的對帳單上。

sentences.en: Please enter the debit and credit amounts in the ledger.
sentences.zh: 請把借方和貸方的金額登錄在帳簿裡。

sentences.en: Is the monthly fee a debit from my checking account?
sentences.zh: 這筆月費是從我的支票帳戶扣款嗎？

sentences.en: The bank debited the wrong account by mistake.
sentences.zh: 銀行不小心扣到錯誤的帳戶。

sentences.en: A debit of fifty dollars was made on Monday.
sentences.zh: 星期一有一筆五十美元的扣款。

sentences.en: The debtor promised to pay back the loan by June.
sentences.zh: 債務人承諾六月前還清貸款。

sentences.en: Can a debtor keep the house during bankruptcy?
sentences.zh: 破產期間，債務人可以保住房子嗎？

sentences.en: Debtors often struggle to get new credit.
sentences.zh: 債務人往往很難取得新的信用額度。

sentences.en: How does the bank contact a debtor who has moved?
sentences.zh: 銀行要怎麼聯絡搬家的債務人？

sentences.en: The court ordered the debtor to pay in monthly installments.
sentences.zh: 法院命令債務人分期按月還款。

sentences.en: He became a debtor after his business failed.
sentences.zh: 他的生意失敗後，就成了債務人。

sentences.en: The company will deduct taxes from your paycheck.
sentences.zh: 公司會從你的薪水中扣除稅金。

sentences.en: Can I deduct my home office expenses?
sentences.zh: 我可以扣除我的居家辦公開銷嗎？

sentences.en: Please deduct the deposit from the total.
sentences.zh: 請從總額中扣掉訂金。

sentences.en: Did they deduct points for the late submission?
sentences.zh: 他們有因為遲交而扣分嗎？

sentences.en: Fifty dollars was deducted from my account.
sentences.zh: 我的帳戶被扣了五十美元。

sentences.en: We deduct a small fee for each transfer.
sentences.zh: 每筆轉帳我們都會扣除一筆小額手續費。

sentences.en: You can claim a deduction for charity donations.
sentences.zh: 你可以就慈善捐款申報扣除額。

sentences.en: What deductions appear on my paycheck?
sentences.zh: 我的薪資單上有哪些扣款？

sentences.en: The deduction for health insurance is listed on the second line.
sentences.zh: 健保的扣款列在第二行。

sentences.en: Is mortgage interest a tax deduction?
sentences.zh: 房貸利息可以申報扣除嗎？

sentences.en: A small deduction was made for the damaged item.
sentences.zh: 因為商品受損，所以扣了一小筆費用。

sentences.en: The deduction reduced her taxable income by two thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 這筆扣除額讓她的應稅所得減少了兩千美元。

gloss_note: deem it necessary 認為有必要

sentences.en: The manager deemed the project too risky.
sentences.zh: 經理認為這個專案風險太高。

sentences.en: Which option does the committee deem best for us?
sentences.zh: 委員會認為哪個選項對我們最好？

sentences.en: The package will be deemed delivered once it's signed for.
sentences.zh: 包裹一經簽收，就視為已送達。

sentences.en: Do you deem it necessary to hire more staff?
sentences.zh: 你認為有必要多請一些人手嗎？

sentences.en: The committee deems her report acceptable.
sentences.zh: 委員會認為她的報告可以接受。

sentences.en: Late fees apply if the payment is deemed overdue.
sentences.zh: 若付款被視為逾期，就會收取滯納金。

sentences.en: The default language on this app is English.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式的預設語言是英文。

sentences.en: How do I reset the printer to its default settings?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼把印表機重設成預設值？

sentences.en: The borrower defaulted on the loan last spring.
sentences.zh: 借款人去年春天就違約，沒有還款。

sentences.en: Will we be in default if we pay a week late?
sentences.zh: 如果我們晚一週付款，會算違約嗎？

sentences.en: Many small firms are at risk of default this year.
sentences.zh: 今年有許多小公司有違約的風險。

sentences.en: By default, the file saves to your documents folder.
sentences.zh: 檔案預設會存到你的文件資料夾。

sentences.en: The factory found a defect in the brakes.
sentences.zh: 工廠發現煞車有瑕疵。

sentences.en: Is this a defect, or is it supposed to look like that?
sentences.zh: 這是瑕疵，還是本來就長這樣？

sentences.en: Customers can return any product with a defect.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以退回任何有瑕疵的產品。

sentences.en: How did such a serious defect pass inspection?
sentences.zh: 這麼嚴重的缺陷怎麼會通過檢驗？

sentences.en: A small defect in the glass made it cheaper.
sentences.zh: 玻璃上有一個小瑕疵，所以賣得比較便宜。

sentences.en: The company recalled the car because of a safety defect.
sentences.zh: 公司因為安全缺陷而召回這款車。

sentences.en: I'd like to return this defective blender.
sentences.zh: 我想退掉這台有問題的果汁機。

sentences.en: Is the laptop still under warranty if it's defective?
sentences.zh: 筆電如果有瑕疵，還在保固內嗎？

sentences.en: The store replaced the defective unit for free.
sentences.zh: 商店免費更換了有瑕疵的那一台。

sentences.en: How many defective items did the inspector find?
sentences.zh: 檢驗員發現了多少件瑕疵品？

sentences.en: A defective wire caused the electrical fire.
sentences.zh: 一條有缺陷的電線引發了電線走火。

sentences.en: Defective parts were sent back to the supplier.
sentences.zh: 有瑕疵的零件被退回給供應商。

sentences.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty in court.
sentences.zh: 被告在法庭上表示不認罪。

sentences.en: Where was the defendant on the night of the incident?
sentences.zh: 事發當晚，被告人在哪裡？

sentences.en: The judge asked the defendant to stand.
sentences.zh: 法官請被告站起來。

sentences.en: Did the defendant have a lawyer present?
sentences.zh: 被告有律師在場嗎？

sentences.en: The defendant agreed to pay for the damages.
sentences.zh: 被告同意賠償損失。

sentences.en: The jury listened carefully to the defendant.
sentences.zh: 陪審團仔細聆聽被告的說詞。

sentences.en: Can we defer this decision until next week?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把這個決定延到下週嗎？

sentences.en: She deferred her admission for one year.
sentences.zh: 她把入學延後了一年。

sentences.en: The bank allowed us to defer the payment.
sentences.zh: 銀行同意讓我們延後付款。

sentences.en: Why did they defer the product launch?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼延後產品上市？

sentences.en: I'd like to defer my start date until after my trip.
sentences.zh: 我想把到職日延到旅行回來之後。

sentences.en: The board deferred the vote to next month.
sentences.zh: 董事會把表決延到下個月。

sentences.en: I need a definite answer by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我需要在週五前得到明確的答覆。

sentences.en: Is the date of the meeting definite yet?
sentences.zh: 會議的日期已經確定了嗎？

sentences.en: There's a definite improvement in your writing.
sentences.zh: 你的寫作有明顯的進步。

sentences.en: We have no definite plans for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們週末沒有確定的計畫。

sentences.en: Do you have a definite time in mind?
sentences.zh: 你心中有確定的時間嗎？

sentences.en: She gave a definite no and walked away.
sentences.zh: 她斬釘截鐵地說不，然後轉身離開。

sentences.en: A good manager knows how to delegate.
sentences.zh: 好的主管懂得如何授權。

sentences.en: Can you delegate some of these tasks to the interns?
sentences.zh: 你可以把其中一些工作交給實習生嗎？

sentences.en: Each country sent a delegate to the conference.
sentences.zh: 每個國家都派了一位代表參加會議。

sentences.en: I delegated the report to my assistant.
sentences.zh: 我把報告交給助理處理。

sentences.en: Who is the delegate from your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門的代表是誰？

sentences.en: The delegates arrived at the hotel on Sunday evening.
sentences.zh: 與會代表在星期天晚上抵達飯店。

gloss_note: delete a file 刪除檔案

sentences.en: Please delete that email right away.
sentences.zh: 請馬上把那封郵件刪掉。

sentences.en: Did you accidentally delete the file?
sentences.zh: 你是不是不小心把檔案刪掉了？

sentences.en: How do I delete my account permanently?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼永久刪除我的帳號？

sentences.en: I deleted the app because it used too much storage.
sentences.zh: 我把這個應用程式刪掉了，因為它太佔儲存空間。

sentences.en: Press this key to delete the last word.
sentences.zh: 按這個鍵可以刪掉最後一個字。

sentences.en: Can you delete my name from the mailing list?
sentences.zh: 你可以把我的名字從寄送名單中刪掉嗎？

sentences.en: Do you offer free delivery on orders over twenty dollars?
sentences.zh: 訂單滿二十美元有免費外送嗎？

sentences.en: The pizza delivery took almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 披薩外送花了將近一個小時。

sentences.en: Delivery is available until ten at night.
sentences.zh: 外送服務到晚上十點。

sentences.en: Can I track my delivery on my phone?
sentences.zh: 我可以用手機追蹤我的外送嗎？

sentences.en: The delivery driver left the food at the door.
sentences.zh: 外送員把食物放在門口。

sentences.en: We ordered delivery because everyone was too tired to cook.
sentences.zh: 我們叫了外送，因為大家都累得不想煮飯。

sentences.en: Our target demographic is women between twenty-five and thirty-five.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標客群是二十五到三十五歲的女性。

sentences.en: Which demographic buys the most of this product?
sentences.zh: 哪個客群買這項產品買得最多？

sentences.en: The ad campaign reached a younger demographic.
sentences.zh: 這次廣告活動觸及了比較年輕的客群。

sentences.en: Is the demographic data in the report up to date?
sentences.zh: 報告裡的人口統計資料是最新的嗎？

sentences.en: The survey shows a shift in demographic trends.
sentences.zh: 這項調查顯示人口統計趨勢出現了轉變。

sentences.en: Teenagers are an important demographic for streaming apps.
sentences.zh: 青少年是串流應用程式的重要客群。

sentences.en: The red line on the map denotes a bus route.
sentences.zh: 地圖上的紅線代表公車路線。

sentences.en: What does this symbol denote?
sentences.zh: 這個符號代表什麼？

sentences.en: In this chart, blue dots denote last year's sales.
sentences.zh: 在這張圖表裡，藍點代表去年的銷售額。

sentences.en: Does a yellow light denote caution everywhere?
sentences.zh: 黃燈在每個地方都代表要小心嗎？

sentences.en: The letter x often denotes an unknown number.
sentences.zh: 字母x常用來代表未知數。

sentences.en: On the menu, a green leaf denotes a vegetarian dish.
sentences.zh: 菜單上的綠葉符號代表素食餐點。

sentences.en: Does your health plan cover dental care?
sentences.zh: 你的健保方案有包含牙科治療嗎？

sentences.en: I have a dental appointment at three o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我三點有牙科的預約。

sentences.en: Regular dental checkups can prevent cavities.
sentences.zh: 定期的牙科檢查可以預防蛀牙。

sentences.en: Is the dental office open on Saturdays?
sentences.zh: 牙醫診所星期六有開嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a dental assistant.
sentences.zh: 她的工作是牙科助理。

sentences.en: Poor dental hygiene can lead to gum disease.
sentences.zh: 牙齒清潔不佳可能導致牙周病。

sentences.en: Our dependence on foreign oil worries many experts.
sentences.zh: 我們對進口石油的依賴讓許多專家擔心。

sentences.en: Can people overcome their dependence on social media?
sentences.zh: 人們能擺脫對社群媒體的依賴嗎？

sentences.en: Too much dependence on one client is risky for a small firm.
sentences.zh: 過度依賴單一客戶，對小公司來說很危險。

sentences.en: Is dependence on caffeine a real problem?
sentences.zh: 對咖啡因的依賴真的是問題嗎？

sentences.en: The report warns about our growing dependence on technology.
sentences.zh: 報告警告我們對科技的依賴越來越深。

sentences.en: Her dependence on her parents ended when she got a job.
sentences.zh: 她找到工作後，就不再依賴父母了。

sentences.en: We plan to deploy the new software next Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們打算下週一部署新軟體。

sentences.en: How quickly can you deploy the update to all users?
sentences.zh: 你能多快把更新部署給所有使用者？

sentences.en: The company deployed extra staff during the holiday rush.
sentences.zh: 公司在假期的尖峰時段調派了額外的人手。

sentences.en: Did the team deploy the patch last night?
sentences.zh: 團隊昨晚有部署修補程式嗎？

sentences.en: The city deployed more buses to handle the crowds.
sentences.zh: 市政府調派了更多公車來疏運人潮。

sentences.en: Engineers deploy small updates to the app every day.
sentences.zh: 工程師每天都會部署小幅度的應用程式更新。

sentences.en: Depreciation lowers the book value of our equipment each year.
sentences.zh: 折舊讓我們的設備帳面價值每年下降。

sentences.en: How do you calculate depreciation on a new car?
sentences.zh: 新車的折舊要怎麼計算？

sentences.en: The accountant recorded the depreciation of the office computers.
sentences.zh: 會計師記錄了辦公室電腦的折舊。

sentences.en: Is depreciation included in the monthly expenses?
sentences.zh: 折舊有算在每月費用裡嗎？

sentences.en: A car's depreciation is steepest in the first year.
sentences.zh: 汽車的折舊在第一年最嚴重。

sentences.en: Currency depreciation made imports more expensive.
sentences.zh: 貨幣貶值讓進口商品變貴了。

sentences.en: The deputy manager will run the meeting today.
sentences.zh: 副理今天會主持會議。

sentences.en: Who is the deputy director of your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門的副主任是誰？

sentences.en: She was promoted from assistant to deputy last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年從助理升為副手。

sentences.en: Can my deputy sign the form while I'm away?
sentences.zh: 我不在的時候，我的副手可以簽這份表格嗎？

sentences.en: The deputy mayor spoke at the opening ceremony.
sentences.zh: 副市長在開幕典禮上致詞。

sentences.en: He acted as deputy while the principal was out sick.
sentences.zh: 校長請病假時，由他擔任代理。

gloss_note: financial derivative 金融衍生商品

sentences.en: The bank lost money trading complex derivatives.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行因為交易複雜的衍生性商品而虧損。

sentences.en: Is this song just a derivative of an older hit?
sentences.zh: 這首歌只是某首老歌的衍生作品嗎？

sentences.en: Many medicines are derivatives of natural plants.
sentences.zh: 許多藥物是天然植物的衍生物。

sentences.en: What exactly is a financial derivative?
sentences.zh: 金融衍生商品到底是什麼？

sentences.en: Futures and options are common derivatives.
sentences.zh: 期貨和選擇權是常見的衍生性商品。

sentences.en: The company sells a derivative of the original software.
sentences.zh: 這間公司販售原始軟體的衍生版本。

gloss_note: designate sb as 指定某人為

sentences.en: Please designate a representative for the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請為這場會議指派一位代表。

sentences.en: Which room is designated for the interviews?
sentences.zh: 哪個房間是指定用來面試的？

sentences.en: The city designated this area as a no-parking zone.
sentences.zh: 市政府把這一區指定為禁止停車區。

sentences.en: Can I designate my older sister as my emergency contact?
sentences.zh: 我可以指定我姊姊當緊急聯絡人嗎？

sentences.en: The manager designated Lisa to lead the project.
sentences.zh: 經理指派麗莎來帶領這個專案。

sentences.en: Smoking is allowed only in designated areas.
sentences.zh: 只有在指定區域才能吸菸。

sentences.en: I use a desktop at work and a laptop at home.
sentences.zh: 我在公司用桌上型電腦，在家用筆電。

sentences.en: Can you move that file to my desktop?
sentences.zh: 你可以把那個檔案移到我的桌面嗎？

sentences.en: Which desktop should we buy for the front office?
sentences.zh: 我們該為櫃檯買哪一台桌上型電腦？

sentences.en: My desktop is full of folders I never open.
sentences.zh: 我的桌面上滿是我從來沒打開過的資料夾。

sentences.en: The desktop in the lab crashed during the exam.
sentences.zh: 實驗室的桌上型電腦在考試期間當機了。

sentences.en: She set a photo of her dog as her desktop background.
sentences.zh: 她把狗的照片設成電腦桌布。

sentences.en: Early detection of the disease can save lives.
sentences.zh: 及早發現這種疾病可以救人一命。
