sentences.en: How does smoke detection work in this building?
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓的煙霧偵測是怎麼運作的？

sentences.en: The new software improves fraud detection.
sentences.zh: 新軟體提升了詐欺偵測的能力。

sentences.en: Is detection of small leaks possible with this sensor?
sentences.zh: 這個感應器能偵測到輕微的洩漏嗎？

sentences.en: The animal avoids detection by hiding in the grass.
sentences.zh: 這種動物藏在草叢裡，避免被發現。

sentences.en: Airport staff use metal detection at every security checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 機場人員在每個安檢口都使用金屬探測。

gloss_note: software developer 軟體開發人員

sentences.en: She works as a software developer in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 她在西雅圖擔任軟體開發人員。

sentences.en: Is the developer planning to release an update soon?
sentences.zh: 開發商打算很快推出更新嗎？

sentences.en: A real estate developer plans to build apartments here.
sentences.zh: 一家房地產開發商打算在這裡蓋公寓。

sentences.en: Our developers fixed the bug yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們的開發人員昨天修好了那個錯誤。

sentences.en: Can you ask the developer why the app keeps freezing?
sentences.zh: 你可以問問開發人員為什麼這個應用程式一直當掉嗎？

sentences.en: The game developer announced a new sequel.
sentences.zh: 這家遊戲開發商宣布要推出新的續集。

sentences.en: Children go through several developmental stages.
sentences.zh: 孩子會經歷好幾個發展階段。

sentences.en: Is this delay a normal developmental issue?
sentences.zh: 這種遲緩是正常的發展現象嗎？

sentences.en: She studies developmental psychology at the university.
sentences.zh: 她在大學主修發展心理學。

sentences.en: The program supports the developmental needs of young students.
sentences.zh: 這個課程支持年幼學生的成長需求。

sentences.en: What are the key developmental milestones for toddlers?
sentences.zh: 幼兒有哪些重要的發展里程碑？

sentences.en: Developmental research shows that play helps children learn.
sentences.zh: 發展研究顯示，遊戲有助於孩子學習。

sentences.en: Any deviation from the plan must be approved.
sentences.zh: 任何偏離計畫的做法都必須經過核准。

sentences.en: What is the standard deviation of these scores?
sentences.zh: 這些分數的標準差是多少？

sentences.en: A small deviation in temperature can ruin the batch.
sentences.zh: 溫度只要有一點偏差，整批就可能報廢。

sentences.en: Was there a deviation from the usual procedure?
sentences.zh: 有偏離平常的程序嗎？

sentences.en: The data shows little deviation from last year's results.
sentences.zh: 數據顯示與去年的結果幾乎沒有差異。

sentences.en: The pilot reported a slight deviation from the planned route.
sentences.zh: 機師回報飛行路線稍微偏離了原定航線。

gloss_note: devise a plan 擬定計畫

sentences.en: We need to devise a plan to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 我們需要想出一個降低成本的計畫。

sentences.en: Can you devise a simpler way to track orders?
sentences.zh: 你能想出更簡單的方法來追蹤訂單嗎？

sentences.en: The engineers devised a clever solution to the problem.
sentences.zh: 工程師們想出了一個聰明的辦法解決這個問題。

sentences.en: How did she devise such a smart strategy?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼想出這麼聰明的策略的？

sentences.en: Teachers devised a game to help students learn vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 老師們設計了一個遊戲來幫助學生學單字。

sentences.en: He devised a schedule that works for everyone.
sentences.zh: 他擬定了一份大家都適用的時間表。

gloss_note: make a diagnosis 做出診斷

sentences.en: The doctor gave me a diagnosis after the blood test.
sentences.zh: 醫生在驗血後告訴我診斷結果。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get a diagnosis?
sentences.zh: 要等多久才能拿到診斷結果？

sentences.en: An early diagnosis can make treatment much easier.
sentences.zh: 及早診斷能讓治療輕鬆許多。

sentences.en: Did the specialist confirm your diagnosis?
sentences.zh: 專科醫師確認你的診斷了嗎？

sentences.en: Her diagnosis surprised everyone in the family.
sentences.zh: 她的診斷結果讓全家人都很意外。

sentences.en: A wrong diagnosis can delay a patient's recovery.
sentences.zh: 誤診可能會延誤病人的康復。

sentences.en: The nurse ordered a diagnostic test for my cough.
sentences.zh: 護理師為我的咳嗽安排了診斷檢查。

sentences.en: Is there a diagnostic tool for this error?
sentences.zh: 這個錯誤有診斷工具可以用嗎？

sentences.en: The mechanic ran a diagnostic scan on my car.
sentences.zh: 技師替我的車做了診斷掃描。

sentences.en: Can you run a diagnostic check on the printer?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫印表機做個診斷檢測嗎？

sentences.en: The school uses a diagnostic exam to place new students.
sentences.zh: 學校用診斷性測驗來幫新生分班。

sentences.en: Diagnostic imaging has improved a lot in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年來診斷影像技術進步很多。

gloss_note: draw a diagram 畫示意圖

sentences.en: Could you draw a diagram of the new process?
sentences.zh: 你可以畫一張新流程的示意圖嗎？

sentences.en: The diagram on page five shows our sales steps.
sentences.zh: 第五頁的圖表呈現了我們的銷售步驟。

sentences.en: I didn't get the wiring until I saw the diagram.
sentences.zh: 我看到示意圖才搞懂線路怎麼接。

sentences.en: Is there a diagram in the instruction manual?
sentences.zh: 說明書裡有示意圖嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher drew a diagram of the water cycle.
sentences.zh: 老師畫了一張水循環的示意圖。

sentences.en: This diagram shows how the three departments work together.
sentences.zh: 這張示意圖呈現三個部門如何合作。

sentences.en: People in this town speak a different dialect.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮的人說的是另一種方言。

sentences.en: Do you understand the local dialect here?
sentences.zh: 你聽得懂這裡的方言嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother still speaks her native dialect at home.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶在家還是說她家鄉的方言。

sentences.en: Which dialect did you grow up speaking?
sentences.zh: 你從小說的是哪一種方言？

sentences.en: Linguists recorded the dialect before it disappeared.
sentences.zh: 語言學家在這種方言消失前把它錄了下來。

sentences.en: The actor learned a new dialect for the movie role.
sentences.zh: 這位演員為了電影角色學了一種新的方言。

sentences.en: The pipe is about two inches in diameter.
sentences.zh: 這條管子的直徑約兩英寸。

sentences.en: What is the diameter of this pizza?
sentences.zh: 這個披薩的直徑是多少？

sentences.en: We need a bolt with a larger diameter.
sentences.zh: 我們需要直徑更大的螺栓。

sentences.en: Can you measure the diameter of the hole?
sentences.zh: 你可以量一下這個洞的直徑嗎？

sentences.en: The diameter of Earth is about eight thousand miles.
sentences.zh: 地球的直徑大約是八千英里。

sentences.en: The tree trunk was a foot in diameter.
sentences.zh: 那棵樹的樹幹直徑有一英尺。

sentences.en: The company uses differential pricing for students and seniors.
sentences.zh: 這家公司對學生和年長者採差別訂價。

sentences.en: Is differential treatment of employees legal here?
sentences.zh: 在這裡，差別對待員工合法嗎？

sentences.en: The new tax had a differential effect on small businesses.
sentences.zh: 新稅制對小型企業的影響各不相同。

sentences.en: We offer differential rates depending on order size.
sentences.zh: 我們依訂單大小提供不同的費率。

sentences.en: Did the report explain the differential growth between regions?
sentences.zh: 報告有說明各地區成長差異的原因嗎？

sentences.en: Differential access to health care remains a serious problem.
sentences.zh: 就醫機會的不平等仍是嚴重的問題。

gloss_note: differentiate A from B 區分A與B

sentences.en: How do you differentiate our product from the competition?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼讓我們的產品有別於競爭對手？

sentences.en: Can you differentiate between these two fonts?
sentences.zh: 你分得出這兩種字型的差別嗎？

sentences.en: It is hard to differentiate the twins by their voices.
sentences.zh: 光聽聲音很難分辨這對雙胞胎。

sentences.en: Good branding helps us differentiate ourselves in the market.
sentences.zh: 好的品牌經營讓我們在市場上與眾不同。

sentences.en: Students learn to differentiate fact from opinion.
sentences.zh: 學生學習區分事實與意見。

sentences.en: Price is what differentiates this cell phone plan from the others.
sentences.zh: 價格是這個手機方案和其他方案的差別所在。

sentences.en: Product differentiation is key to our marketing plan.
sentences.zh: 產品差異化是我們行銷計畫的關鍵。

sentences.en: Do customers see any differentiation between these two brands?
sentences.zh: 顧客看得出這兩個品牌有什麼區別嗎？

sentences.en: Our price is low, but we lack differentiation.
sentences.zh: 我們的價格很低，但缺乏差異化。

sentences.en: Is there enough differentiation between the basic and premium plans?
sentences.zh: 基本方案和高級方案的區別夠明顯嗎？

sentences.en: Clear differentiation between the two roles avoids confusion.
sentences.zh: 清楚區分這兩個職務可以避免混淆。

sentences.en: Brand differentiation matters more when prices are similar.
sentences.zh: 價格相近時，品牌差異化就更重要。

gloss_note: diffusion of ideas 想法的傳播

sentences.en: Do you remember how diffusion works from science class?
sentences.zh: 你還記得科學課教的擴散是怎麼回事嗎？

sentences.en: The coffee smell spread through the room by diffusion.
sentences.zh: 咖啡香靠擴散瀰漫了整個房間。

sentences.en: The diffusion of new technology was surprisingly fast.
sentences.zh: 新科技的傳播速度快得驚人。

sentences.en: How does diffusion move oxygen into the blood?
sentences.zh: 擴散作用如何把氧氣送進血液？

sentences.en: Is the diffusion of ideas always a good thing?
sentences.zh: 想法的傳播永遠都是好事嗎？

sentences.en: Social media sped up the diffusion of the news.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體加快了這則消息的傳播。

gloss_note: diminish in value 價值減損

sentences.en: Does stress diminish your ability to focus?
sentences.zh: 壓力會削弱你的專注力嗎？

sentences.en: Our profits began to diminish last spring.
sentences.zh: 我們的利潤從去年春天開始減少。

sentences.en: Don't let one mistake diminish your confidence.
sentences.zh: 別讓一次失誤削弱你的自信。

sentences.en: The noise will diminish once the construction ends.
sentences.zh: 工程結束後，噪音就會減少。

sentences.en: Will the new tax diminish consumer spending?
sentences.zh: 新稅制會減少消費者的支出嗎？

sentences.en: Her interest in the project seemed to diminish over time.
sentences.zh: 她對這個專案的興趣似乎隨時間減退了。

gloss_note: 美式平價簡餐店，常賣早餐

sentences.en: Let's grab breakfast at the diner down the street.
sentences.zh: 我們去街上那家簡餐店吃早餐吧。

sentences.en: Is the diner near the airport open all night?
sentences.zh: 機場附近那家簡餐店整晚營業嗎？

sentences.en: The diner serves pancakes all day long.
sentences.zh: 這家簡餐店整天都供應鬆餅。

sentences.en: The waiter asked each diner about food allergies.
sentences.zh: 服務生詢問每位用餐客人有沒有食物過敏。

sentences.en: Every diner at our table ordered the special.
sentences.zh: 我們這桌的每位客人都點了今日特餐。

sentences.en: Did the other diners complain about the noise?
sentences.zh: 其他用餐的客人有抱怨噪音嗎？

sentences.en: Can you look up his number in the company directory?
sentences.zh: 你可以在公司通訊錄裡查他的號碼嗎？

sentences.en: The lobby has a directory listing every office in the building.
sentences.zh: 大廳有一份列出大樓所有辦公室的名錄。

sentences.en: I found the dentist in an online directory.
sentences.zh: 我在網路名錄上找到這位牙醫。

sentences.en: Is your name still listed in the staff directory?
sentences.zh: 你的名字還在員工通訊錄上嗎？

sentences.en: Please update your contact information in the directory.
sentences.zh: 請更新通訊錄裡的聯絡資料。

sentences.en: The phone directory used to be delivered every year.
sentences.zh: 以前每年都會送來電話簿。

gloss_note: at a disadvantage 處於劣勢

sentences.en: What is the biggest disadvantage of working from home?
sentences.zh: 在家工作最大的缺點是什麼？

sentences.en: Not speaking Spanish put him at a disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 不會說西班牙語讓他處於劣勢。

sentences.en: One disadvantage of this plan is the high cost.
sentences.zh: 這個方案的一個缺點就是成本很高。

sentences.en: Does the smaller size have any disadvantages?
sentences.zh: 小一點的尺寸有什麼缺點嗎？

sentences.en: Our team was at a disadvantage because we started late.
sentences.zh: 我們這組因為晚開始而居於劣勢。

sentences.en: Students without internet access face a clear disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 沒有網路可用的學生明顯處於劣勢。

sentences.en: I can't disclose the price until the deal is final.
sentences.zh: 在交易敲定前，我不能透露價格。

sentences.en: Did the company disclose the risks to investors?
sentences.zh: 公司有向投資人揭露風險嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't disclose my phone number to anyone.
sentences.zh: 請不要把我的電話號碼透露給任何人。

sentences.en: The doctor cannot disclose your medical records.
sentences.zh: 醫師不能公開你的病歷。

sentences.en: Do I have to disclose a past illness on this form?
sentences.zh: 我需要在這份表格上申報過去的病史嗎？

sentences.en: The firm refused to disclose where the money came from.
sentences.zh: 那家公司拒絕透露這筆錢的來源。

sentences.en: The disclosure of the data leak shocked many customers.
sentences.zh: 資料外洩的曝光讓許多客戶震驚。

sentences.en: Is full disclosure required before we sign the contract?
sentences.zh: 簽約前需要完整揭露資訊嗎？

sentences.en: The email included a disclosure about possible conflicts of interest.
sentences.zh: 這封郵件附了一則關於可能利益衝突的揭露聲明。

sentences.en: Did the seller make a disclosure about the leaky roof?
sentences.zh: 賣方有揭露屋頂漏水的問題嗎？

sentences.en: Late disclosure of the problem cost the company trust.
sentences.zh: 太晚揭露這個問題讓公司失去了信任。

sentences.en: Financial disclosure rules protect small investors.
sentences.zh: 財務揭露規定保護小額投資人。

gloss_note: discourage sb from V-ing 勸阻某人

sentences.en: Don't let one bad review discourage you.
sentences.zh: 別讓一則負評讓你氣餒。

sentences.en: Why would you discourage her from applying?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要勸她不要去應徵？

sentences.en: High prices discourage many people from buying new cars.
sentences.zh: 高價位讓許多人打消購買新車的念頭。

sentences.en: The sign is meant to discourage people from parking here.
sentences.zh: 這個告示是為了勸阻大家不要停在這裡。

sentences.en: Her parents discouraged her from moving overseas.
sentences.zh: 她的父母勸她不要搬到國外。

sentences.en: Does bad weather discourage tourists from visiting?
sentences.zh: 壞天氣會讓觀光客打消來訪的念頭嗎？

sentences.en: The tone of public discourse has become angrier lately.
sentences.zh: 近來公共論述的語氣變得更憤怒了。

sentences.en: Is online discourse really making people less polite?
sentences.zh: 網路上的言論真的讓人變得比較不禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: Teachers try to encourage civil discourse in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 老師們努力在課堂上鼓勵理性的對話。

sentences.en: What role does humor play in everyday discourse?
sentences.zh: 幽默在日常言談中扮演什麼角色？

sentences.en: Academic discourse often uses long, formal sentences.
sentences.zh: 學術論述常使用冗長而正式的句子。

sentences.en: Respectful discourse starts with listening to the other side.
sentences.zh: 互相尊重的對話從傾聽對方開始。

sentences.en: The project has three discrete stages.
sentences.zh: 這個專案有三個各自獨立的階段。

sentences.en: Are these two issues discrete or connected?
sentences.zh: 這兩個問題是各自獨立還是互相有關？

sentences.en: Please keep the files in discrete folders.
sentences.zh: 請把檔案放在各自獨立的資料夾裡。

sentences.en: Each team handles a discrete part of the work.
sentences.zh: 每個團隊負責工作中各自獨立的一部分。

sentences.en: Can we treat these as discrete categories?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把這些當作彼此獨立的類別嗎？

sentences.en: The lecture covered four discrete topics in one hour.
sentences.zh: 這堂課在一小時內講了四個各自獨立的主題。

sentences.en: Age discrimination in hiring is against the law.
sentences.zh: 招聘時的年齡歧視是違法的。

sentences.en: Has anyone reported discrimination at this workplace?
sentences.zh: 這個職場有人通報過歧視嗎？

sentences.en: She filed a complaint about workplace discrimination.
sentences.zh: 她提出了職場歧視的申訴。

sentences.en: Is the company training managers to prevent discrimination?
sentences.zh: 公司有訓練主管預防歧視嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone has the right to live free from discrimination.
sentences.zh: 每個人都有不受歧視的生活權利。

sentences.en: The landlord was sued for housing discrimination.
sentences.zh: 那位房東因居住歧視被告了。

gloss_note: at your disposal 任您使用

sentences.en: How does the office handle the disposal of old computers?
sentences.zh: 辦公室怎麼處理舊電腦的報廢？

sentences.en: Proper disposal of batteries is important for the environment.
sentences.zh: 正確處理電池對環境很重要。

sentences.en: Our staff is at your disposal if you need help.
sentences.zh: 如果需要幫忙，我們的員工隨時聽您差遣。

sentences.en: Is the company car at my disposal this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末公司車可以讓我使用嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel put a free shuttle at our disposal.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供了一輛免費接駁車供我們使用。

sentences.en: Please follow the rules for waste disposal in this building.
sentences.zh: 請遵守這棟大樓的垃圾處理規定。

sentences.en: The storm caused a major disruption to flights.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨讓航班大亂。

sentences.en: We apologize for the disruption to your service.
sentences.zh: 對於服務中斷造成的不便，我們深表歉意。

sentences.en: Will the road work cause much disruption this week?
sentences.zh: 這週的道路施工會造成很大的交通干擾嗎？

sentences.en: Any disruption in the supply chain affects our deadlines.
sentences.zh: 供應鏈只要一中斷，就會影響我們的交期。

sentences.en: Sorry for the disruption, but I need to take this call.
sentences.zh: 抱歉打擾大家，但我得接這通電話。

sentences.en: Did the power outage cause a disruption in production?
sentences.zh: 停電有造成生產中斷嗎？

gloss_note: distract sb from sth 使某人從…分心

sentences.en: Please turn off your phone so it won't distract you.
sentences.zh: 請把手機關掉，才不會讓你分心。

sentences.en: Does the music distract you while you work?
sentences.zh: 你工作時音樂會讓你分心嗎？

sentences.en: Sorry, did I distract you from your call?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我讓你講電話分心了嗎？

sentences.en: Loud construction noise can distract students during exams.
sentences.zh: 吵雜的施工噪音會讓學生在考試時分心。

sentences.en: Don't let small problems distract us from our main goal.
sentences.zh: 別讓小問題讓我們忽略了主要目標。

sentences.en: A text message distracted him, and he missed the exit.
sentences.zh: 一則簡訊讓他分了心，結果錯過了出口。

sentences.en: The distribution of free tickets starts at noon.
sentences.zh: 免費門票的發放中午開始。

sentences.en: Where is the company's main distribution center?
sentences.zh: 公司的主要配送中心在哪裡？

sentences.en: Who is in charge of distribution for the western region?
sentences.zh: 誰負責西區的配送？

sentences.en: We need a fairer distribution of the work.
sentences.zh: 我們需要更公平的工作分配。

sentences.en: Distribution delays are hurting our sales this month.
sentences.zh: 配送延誤正在拖累我們這個月的銷售。

sentences.en: How does the school handle the distribution of textbooks?
sentences.zh: 學校怎麼處理課本的發放？

sentences.en: We just signed a new distributor in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我們剛在德州簽了一家新的經銷商。

sentences.en: Who is your distributor in Canada?
sentences.zh: 你們在加拿大的經銷商是哪一家？

sentences.en: The distributor shipped the order a day late.
sentences.zh: 經銷商晚了一天出貨。

sentences.en: Can you give me the contact info for the distributor?
sentences.zh: 可以給我經銷商的聯絡資料嗎？

sentences.en: This distributor sells directly to restaurants and cafes.
sentences.zh: 這家經銷商直接供貨給餐廳和咖啡館。

sentences.en: Our products are available through an authorized distributor.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品可以透過授權經銷商購買。

gloss_note: cause a disturbance 製造騷動

sentences.en: The neighbors called about a disturbance last night.
sentences.zh: 鄰居昨晚打電話通報有人吵鬧。

sentences.en: Sorry for the disturbance, but may I come in?
sentences.zh: 抱歉打擾了，我可以進來嗎？

sentences.en: Did the disturbance wake the baby?
sentences.zh: 那陣騷動吵醒寶寶了嗎？

sentences.en: Please turn the music down to avoid any disturbance.
sentences.zh: 請把音樂關小聲，以免打擾到別人。

sentences.en: Police were called to a disturbance outside the bar.
sentences.zh: 警方接獲通報，趕往酒吧外處理一場騷動。

sentences.en: Can noise disturbance at night harm your health?
sentences.zh: 夜間的噪音干擾會損害健康嗎？

sentences.en: Our team has a diverse range of backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊的成員背景十分多元。

sentences.en: Is the menu diverse enough for vegetarians?
sentences.zh: 這份菜單的選擇夠多樣，適合素食者嗎？

sentences.en: We want a more diverse group of candidates.
sentences.zh: 我們希望應徵者的組成更多元。

sentences.en: The city has a diverse population.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的人口組成相當多元。

sentences.en: Why are their opinions so diverse?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他們的意見這麼分歧？

sentences.en: Diverse viewpoints help us make better decisions.
sentences.zh: 多元的觀點幫助我們做出更好的決定。

sentences.en: Diversification can lower the risk in your portfolio.
sentences.zh: 分散投資可以降低你投資組合的風險。

sentences.en: Is diversification part of the company's growth plan?
sentences.zh: 多角化經營是公司成長計畫的一環嗎？

sentences.en: Our advisor stressed the importance of diversification.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧問強調分散投資的重要性。

sentences.en: The firm's diversification into software paid off.
sentences.zh: 這家公司多角化跨足軟體業，成果豐碩。

sentences.en: How much diversification do we need in our product line?
sentences.zh: 我們的產品線需要多少程度的多元化？

sentences.en: Diversification protected them when oil prices fell.
sentences.zh: 油價下跌時，多角化經營保護了他們。

sentences.en: We plan to diversify into the Asian market.
sentences.zh: 我們打算多角化經營，跨入亞洲市場。

sentences.en: Should I diversify my savings across different accounts?
sentences.zh: 我應該把存款分散到不同帳戶嗎？

sentences.en: The bakery diversified by adding a coffee bar.
sentences.zh: 這間烘焙坊增設咖啡吧來擴大經營項目。

sentences.en: How can we diversify our customer base?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓客群更多元？

sentences.en: Smart investors diversify to reduce risk.
sentences.zh: 聰明的投資人會分散投資來降低風險。

sentences.en: The school wants to diversify its course offerings.
sentences.zh: 學校想讓課程選擇更多元。

gloss_note: pay a dividend 發放股息

sentences.en: The company pays a dividend every quarter.
sentences.zh: 這家公司每季發放股息。

sentences.en: Did the board approve a higher dividend this year?
sentences.zh: 董事會今年核准提高股息了嗎？

sentences.en: I use my dividends to buy more shares.
sentences.zh: 我用股息再買更多股票。

sentences.en: When is the next dividend payment due?
sentences.zh: 下一次股息何時發放？

sentences.en: A steady dividend attracts long-term investors.
sentences.zh: 穩定的股息會吸引長期投資人。

sentences.en: The firm cut its dividend after a weak year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在業績疲弱的一年之後削減了股息。

gloss_note: watch a documentary 看紀錄片

sentences.en: Have you seen the new documentary about whales?
sentences.zh: 你看過那部關於鯨魚的新紀錄片嗎？

sentences.en: We watched a documentary on the flight.
sentences.zh: 我們在飛機上看了一部紀錄片。

sentences.en: The documentary follows a family of farmers for a year.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片追蹤一個農家整整一年。

sentences.en: Is the documentary available on streaming?
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片在串流平台上看得到嗎？

sentences.en: She makes documentary films about small towns.
sentences.zh: 她拍攝關於小鎮的紀錄片。

sentences.en: Our teacher showed a short documentary in class.
sentences.zh: 老師在課堂上放了一部紀錄短片。

sentences.en: Marketing is outside my domain.
sentences.zh: 行銷不在我的專業領域內。

sentences.en: Who owns the domain for our website?
sentences.zh: 我們網站的網域是誰註冊的？

sentences.en: I need to renew the domain this month.
sentences.zh: 我這個月得幫網域續約。

sentences.en: Is this problem in your domain or mine?
sentences.zh: 這個問題是你負責的領域，還是我的？

sentences.en: Her domain is customer support.
sentences.zh: 客戶支援是她負責的領域。

sentences.en: The company registered a new domain for the campaign.
sentences.zh: 公司為這個活動註冊了新的網域。

sentences.en: Which company is dominant in this market?
sentences.zh: 哪家公司在這個市場居於主導地位？

sentences.en: Our brand is the dominant player in the region.
sentences.zh: 我們的品牌是這個地區的主導者。

sentences.en: Is English the dominant language in your office?
sentences.zh: 你們辦公室主要使用英文嗎？

sentences.en: Blue was the dominant color in the room.
sentences.zh: 藍色是這個房間的主色。

sentences.en: A dominant team usually wins most of its games.
sentences.zh: 實力強勁的球隊通常會贏下大部分比賽。

sentences.en: The dominant view among staff is that we need change.
sentences.zh: 員工之間的主流看法是我們需要改變。

sentences.en: I donate old clothes to a local charity every year.
sentences.zh: 我每年都把舊衣服捐給當地的慈善機構。

sentences.en: Would you like to donate to the school fundraiser?
sentences.zh: 你想捐錢給學校的募款活動嗎？

sentences.en: The company donated fifty laptops to the library.
sentences.zh: 這家公司捐了五十台筆電給圖書館。

sentences.en: Where can I donate used books?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡捐贈二手書？

sentences.en: She donates blood twice a year.
sentences.zh: 她一年捐血兩次。

sentences.en: Many people donated food after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，許多人捐出了食物。

sentences.en: Thank you for your generous donation.
sentences.zh: 感謝您慷慨的捐款。

sentences.en: Can I make a donation online?
sentences.zh: 我可以在網路上捐款嗎？

sentences.en: The shelter accepts clothing donations on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 收容所平日接受衣物捐贈。

sentences.en: Is my donation tax deductible?
sentences.zh: 我的捐款可以抵稅嗎？

sentences.en: The bakery made a donation of fifty cakes.
sentences.zh: 這家烘焙坊捐了五十個蛋糕。

sentences.en: Donations covered the cost of the new playground.
sentences.zh: 捐款支付了新遊樂場的費用。

sentences.en: The hospital is looking for blood donors.
sentences.zh: 醫院正在尋找捐血者。

sentences.en: Are you registered as an organ donor?
sentences.zh: 你登記成器官捐贈者了嗎？

sentences.en: A generous donor paid for the new library wing.
sentences.zh: 一位慷慨的捐款人出資興建了圖書館的新側樓。

sentences.en: The donor asked to stay anonymous.
sentences.zh: 這位捐款人要求匿名。

sentences.en: How many donors gave to the school this year?
sentences.zh: 今年有多少人捐款給學校？

sentences.en: We sent thank-you cards to every donor.
sentences.zh: 我們寄了感謝卡給每一位捐款人。

sentences.en: The economic downturn hurt small businesses.
sentences.zh: 經濟衰退重創了小型企業。

sentences.en: Did the downturn affect your sales?
sentences.zh: 景氣低迷有影響你們的銷售嗎？

sentences.en: We cut costs during the downturn.
sentences.zh: 我們在景氣低迷期間削減了成本。

sentences.en: Experts expect a downturn in the housing market.
sentences.zh: 專家預期房市會走下坡。

sentences.en: How long will this downturn last?
sentences.zh: 這波低迷會持續多久？

sentences.en: Our team stayed positive through the downturn.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在不景氣中仍保持樂觀。

gloss_note: fire drill 消防演習；power drill 電鑽

sentences.en: We have a fire drill at the office every spring.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室每年春天都會做消防演習。

sentences.en: Is the safety drill mandatory for all employees?
sentences.zh: 安全演練是所有員工都必須參加的嗎？

sentences.en: Could I borrow your drill this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末我可以借你的電鑽嗎？

sentences.en: He used a power drill to hang the shelves.
sentences.zh: 他用電鑽把層架裝上去。

sentences.en: The team ran an emergency drill last Friday.
sentences.zh: 團隊上週五進行了緊急演練。

sentences.en: Does this drill come with extra bits?
sentences.zh: 這支電鑽有附多的鑽頭嗎？

gloss_note: duplicate a file 複製檔案

sentences.en: Please duplicate this form before you send it.
sentences.zh: 寄出這份表格之前，請先複印一份。

sentences.en: Can you duplicate the file and rename it?
sentences.zh: 你可以複製這個檔案再重新命名嗎？

sentences.en: I had a duplicate of the key made for my roommate.
sentences.zh: 我請人幫室友多配了一把鑰匙。

sentences.en: Keep a duplicate of the contract in your records.
sentences.zh: 請把合約的副本留在你的紀錄裡。

sentences.en: Do we have a duplicate of this receipt?
sentences.zh: 我們有這張收據的副本嗎？

sentences.en: It's hard to duplicate the results without the same tools.
sentences.zh: 沒有相同的工具，很難複製出同樣的結果。

sentences.en: This backpack is durable enough for daily use.
sentences.zh: 這個背包夠耐用，可以天天使用。

sentences.en: Is this phone case durable enough for hiking?
sentences.zh: 這個手機殼耐用到可以帶去健行嗎？

sentences.en: We chose a durable floor for the busy lobby.
sentences.zh: 我們為人來人往的大廳選了耐用的地板。

sentences.en: Durable goods like refrigerators last for years.
sentences.zh: 冰箱這類耐久財可以用好幾年。

sentences.en: Do you have a more durable material for outdoor furniture?
sentences.zh: 你們有比較耐用的戶外家具材質嗎？

sentences.en: The company is known for making durable work boots.
sentences.zh: 這家公司以製作耐穿的工作靴聞名。

gloss_note: for the duration of 在…期間

sentences.en: What is the duration of the training course?
sentences.zh: 這門訓練課程要上多久？

sentences.en: Please keep your phone off for the duration of the flight.
sentences.zh: 飛行期間請將手機關機。

sentences.en: The duration of the meeting was only twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 這場會議只持續了二十分鐘。

sentences.en: Is the contract valid for the duration of my stay?
sentences.zh: 這份合約在我停留期間有效嗎？

sentences.en: The warranty covers the full duration of the lease.
sentences.zh: 保固涵蓋整個租賃期間。

sentences.en: He stayed silent for the duration of the dinner.
sentences.zh: 整頓晚餐期間他都沒說話。

gloss_note: dynamic team 有活力的團隊

sentences.en: She is a dynamic leader with great ideas.
sentences.zh: 她是個充滿活力、點子很多的領導者。

sentences.en: Are you looking for a dynamic team to join?
sentences.zh: 你想加入一個充滿活力的團隊嗎？

sentences.en: Is this a dynamic city for young professionals?
sentences.zh: 這座城市對年輕上班族來說夠有活力嗎？

sentences.en: The team has a dynamic way of working together.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊有種充滿活力的合作方式。

sentences.en: The company needs a more dynamic approach to marketing.
sentences.zh: 公司需要更有活力的行銷手法。

sentences.en: The schedule is dynamic, so check it daily.
sentences.zh: 時程是動態調整的，所以請每天確認。

gloss_note: read an e-book 看電子書

sentences.en: I bought the e-book instead of the paperback.
sentences.zh: 我買了電子書，沒買平裝本。

sentences.en: Is the e-book cheaper than the printed copy?
sentences.zh: 電子書比紙本書便宜嗎？

sentences.en: Can I borrow an e-book from the library?
sentences.zh: 我可以從圖書館借電子書嗎？

sentences.en: She reads an e-book on her phone during lunch.
sentences.zh: 她午餐時間用手機看電子書。

sentences.en: The company gives a free e-book to new subscribers.
sentences.zh: 這家公司送免費電子書給新訂閱者。

sentences.en: Our manual is now available as an e-book.
sentences.zh: 我們的手冊現在有電子書版本。

sentences.en: There's a small eatery around the corner.
sentences.zh: 轉角有一家小餐館。

sentences.en: Do you know a good eatery near the hotel?
sentences.zh: 你知道飯店附近有不錯的小餐館嗎？

sentences.en: That little eatery has the best sandwiches in town.
sentences.zh: 那家小餐館有全鎮最好吃的三明治。

sentences.en: We found a cozy eatery after the movie.
sentences.zh: 看完電影後，我們找到一家溫馨的小餐館。

sentences.en: Is this eatery open for lunch on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 這家小餐館週日中午有營業嗎？

sentences.en: The owner of the local eatery greeted every guest.
sentences.zh: 當地那家小餐館的老闆親自招呼每位客人。

sentences.en: This car is very economical on gas.
sentences.zh: 這輛車非常省油。

sentences.en: Is it more economical to buy in bulk?
sentences.zh: 大量購買比較划算嗎？

sentences.en: We chose the economical option for the trip.
sentences.zh: 我們為這趟旅行選了經濟實惠的方案。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers an economical lunch menu.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳提供經濟實惠的午餐菜單。

sentences.en: Cooking at home is more economical than eating out.
sentences.zh: 在家煮飯比外食更省錢。

sentences.en: Is the new printer economical to run?
sentences.zh: 這台新印表機用起來省錢嗎？

gloss_note: chief economist 首席經濟學家

sentences.en: My neighbor works as an economist at a bank.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居在銀行擔任經濟學家。

sentences.en: What does the economist expect for next year?
sentences.zh: 這位經濟學家對明年有什麼預期？

sentences.en: The economist warned that prices could keep rising.
sentences.zh: 這位經濟學家警告物價可能持續上漲。

sentences.en: Is your roommate studying to be an economist?
sentences.zh: 你的室友在準備當經濟學家嗎？

sentences.en: Several economists spoke at the conference.
sentences.zh: 好幾位經濟學家在研討會上發言。

sentences.en: An economist explained the new policy in simple words.
sentences.zh: 一位經濟學家用簡單的話解釋了這項新政策。

sentences.en: Did you read the editorial in today's paper?
sentences.zh: 你有看今天報紙的社論嗎？

sentences.en: The editorial criticized the plan to close the library.
sentences.zh: 這篇社論批評了關閉圖書館的計畫。

sentences.en: She works on the editorial team at a magazine.
sentences.zh: 她在一家雜誌社的編輯團隊工作。

sentences.en: Our editorial calendar is full through December.
sentences.zh: 我們的編輯行事曆已排滿到十二月。

sentences.en: Who wrote the editorial about school lunches?
sentences.zh: 誰寫了那篇關於學校午餐的社論？

sentences.en: The editorial staff meets every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 編輯部人員每週一早上開會。

sentences.en: How do we measure the effectiveness of this ad?
sentences.zh: 我們怎麼評估這則廣告的成效？

sentences.en: The effectiveness of the training was clear within a month.
sentences.zh: 這次培訓的成效在一個月內就很明顯。

sentences.en: Is the effectiveness of this medicine proven?
sentences.zh: 這種藥的療效已經證實了嗎？

sentences.en: We reviewed the effectiveness of our new process.
sentences.zh: 我們檢討了新流程的成效。

sentences.en: Her effectiveness as a manager impressed the director.
sentences.zh: 她身為主管的工作成效讓總監印象深刻。

sentences.en: Does the effectiveness of the program depend on funding?
sentences.zh: 這項計畫的成效取決於經費嗎？

gloss_note: work efficiently 有效率地工作

sentences.en: Can we finish this task more efficiently?
sentences.zh: 我們能更有效率地完成這項任務嗎？

sentences.en: She handles customer emails quickly and efficiently.
sentences.zh: 她處理客戶郵件又快又有效率。

sentences.en: The new software helps us work efficiently.
sentences.zh: 新軟體幫助我們有效率地工作。

sentences.en: Does this oven heat the food efficiently?
sentences.zh: 這台烤箱加熱食物有效率嗎？

sentences.en: The warehouse is organized so we can pack orders efficiently.
sentences.zh: 倉庫經過整理，讓我們能有效率地包裝訂單。

sentences.en: Use your time efficiently during the exam.
sentences.zh: 考試時要有效率地運用時間。

sentences.en: The elasticity of demand for coffee is quite low.
sentences.zh: 咖啡的需求彈性相當低。

sentences.en: Do you know what price elasticity means?
sentences.zh: 你知道價格彈性是什麼意思嗎？

sentences.en: This fabric has great elasticity, so it fits everyone.
sentences.zh: 這種布料很有彈性，所以人人都穿得下。

sentences.en: Has the manager studied the price elasticity of our best-selling products?
sentences.zh: 經理研究過我們熱銷商品的價格彈性了嗎？

sentences.en: A rubber band's elasticity lets it stretch and snap back.
sentences.zh: 橡皮筋的彈性讓它能拉長再彈回原狀。

sentences.en: The skin loses elasticity as people get older.
sentences.zh: 人老了，皮膚就會失去彈性。

sentences.en: The electoral process can take months from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 選舉程序從頭到尾可能要花好幾個月。

sentences.en: Where can I find the electoral vote totals by state?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以查到各州的選舉人票數？

sentences.en: Volunteers helped explain the electoral system to new voters.
sentences.zh: 志工協助向新選民說明選舉制度。

sentences.en: Is the electoral map available online?
sentences.zh: 選舉人票地圖有放在網路上嗎？

sentences.en: Each state has a different number of electoral votes.
sentences.zh: 每個州的選舉人票數都不一樣。

sentences.en: We learned about the electoral system in class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在課堂上學到了選舉制度。

sentences.en: We had an electrical problem in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們廚房的電路出了問題。

sentences.en: Is the electrical outlet near the window working?
sentences.zh: 窗戶旁邊的插座有電嗎？

sentences.en: Do you know a good electrical contractor?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪裡有不錯的電氣承包商嗎？

sentences.en: The fire started because of faulty electrical wiring.
sentences.zh: 這場火災起因於電線線路故障。

sentences.en: Keep electrical cords away from water.
sentences.zh: 電線要遠離水。

sentences.en: She studies electrical engineering at a state university.
sentences.zh: 她在州立大學念電機工程。

sentences.en: We need an electrician to fix the lights.
sentences.zh: 我們需要電工來修燈。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a good electrician?
sentences.zh: 你能推薦一位好的電工嗎？

sentences.en: The electrician arrives at nine tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 電工明天九點到。

sentences.en: Our landlord hired an electrician to rewire the garage.
sentences.zh: 房東請了電工幫車庫重新配線。

sentences.en: Did the electrician say it was safe to use?
sentences.zh: 電工有說這個可以安全使用嗎？

sentences.en: Becoming an electrician takes years of training.
sentences.zh: 要成為電工需要多年的訓練。

sentences.en: An electron carries a negative electric charge.
sentences.zh: 電子帶有負電荷。

sentences.en: Do you remember what an electron is?
sentences.zh: 你還記得電子是什麼嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher drew an electron on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一顆電子。

sentences.en: Electrons moving through a wire make the lamp light up.
sentences.zh: 電子在電線中移動，讓燈亮了起來。

sentences.en: Is an electron bigger than a proton?
sentences.zh: 電子比質子大嗎？

sentences.en: My son asked me what an electron looks like.
sentences.zh: 我兒子問我電子長什麼樣子。

gloss_note: an elegant solution 漂亮的解法

sentences.en: She wore an elegant black dress to the dinner.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件優雅的黑色洋裝去赴晚宴。

sentences.en: Is the hotel lobby as elegant as the photos?
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳跟照片一樣典雅嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant has an elegant, quiet atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的氣氛典雅又安靜。

sentences.en: We need an elegant solution to this problem.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一個簡潔漂亮的方法來解決這個問題。

sentences.en: His handwriting looks very elegant to me.
sentences.zh: 他的字跡在我看來非常雅緻。

sentences.en: Do you have a more elegant design for the invitation?
sentences.zh: 你們有比較雅緻的邀請卡設計嗎？

sentences.en: Are you eligible for the company's health plan?
sentences.zh: 你有資格加入公司的健保方案嗎？

sentences.en: Only full-time employees are eligible for this bonus.
sentences.zh: 只有全職員工才有資格領這筆獎金。

sentences.en: I'm eligible for a student discount.
sentences.zh: 我符合學生折扣的資格。

sentences.en: Is my order eligible for free shipping?
sentences.zh: 我的訂單符合免運資格嗎？

sentences.en: Applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.
sentences.zh: 申請人必須具備在美國工作的資格。

sentences.en: She became eligible for retirement last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年起符合退休資格。

sentences.en: Only the elite of the industry attended the event.
sentences.zh: 只有業界菁英出席了這場活動。

sentences.en: Is this an elite school for gifted kids?
sentences.zh: 這是一所專收資優生的菁英學校嗎？

sentences.en: Elite athletes train for hours every day.
sentences.zh: 頂尖運動員每天都訓練好幾個小時。

sentences.en: The hotel offers special perks to elite members.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店為頂級會員提供特別的禮遇。

sentences.en: The company wants to hire an elite team of engineers.
sentences.zh: 公司想招募一支頂尖的工程師團隊。

sentences.en: How does a player join the elite of the league?
sentences.zh: 球員要怎麼躋身聯盟的菁英之列？

gloss_note: the U.S. embassy 美國大使館

sentences.en: I need to visit the embassy to renew my passport.
sentences.zh: 我得去大使館更新護照。

sentences.en: Is the embassy open on Fridays?
sentences.zh: 大使館星期五有開嗎？

sentences.en: She works at the embassy as a translator.
sentences.zh: 她在大使館擔任翻譯。

sentences.en: The embassy sent a notice to all citizens abroad.
sentences.zh: 大使館向所有海外公民發出了通知。

sentences.en: How long does the embassy take to process a visa?
sentences.zh: 大使館處理簽證要花多久時間？

sentences.en: We stopped by the embassy before our flight.
sentences.zh: 我們在搭機前順道去了一趟大使館。

gloss_note: embed a video 嵌入影片

sentences.en: Can you embed this video in the web page?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這部影片嵌入網頁嗎？

sentences.en: You can easily embed a map on your website.
sentences.zh: 你可以輕鬆地把地圖嵌入網站。

sentences.en: The logo is embedded in the footer of the site.
sentences.zh: 標誌嵌在網站的頁尾。

sentences.en: How do I embed a chart in my slides?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼把圖表嵌入簡報？

sentences.en: Safety rules should be embedded in daily routines.
sentences.zh: 安全規定應該深植在日常作業中。

sentences.en: Respect for customers is embedded in our company culture.
sentences.zh: 尊重顧客深植在我們的公司文化裡。

sentences.en: The emergence of online shopping changed the retail industry.
sentences.zh: 網路購物的興起改變了零售業。

sentences.en: What led to the emergence of this new trend?
sentences.zh: 是什麼促成了這個新趨勢的出現？

sentences.en: We discussed the emergence of electric cars in class.
sentences.zh: 我們在課堂上討論了電動車的興起。

sentences.en: Did the emergence of new competitors worry you?
sentences.zh: 新競爭對手的出現讓你擔心嗎？

sentences.en: The emergence of the startup surprised the big banks.
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司的崛起讓大銀行很意外。

sentences.en: Scientists are tracking the emergence of a new insect species here.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在追蹤這裡一種新昆蟲物種的出現。

sentences.en: The city wants to reduce carbon emissions by half.
sentences.zh: 這座城市想把碳排放量減半。

sentences.en: Does your car pass the emissions test?
sentences.zh: 你的車通過排氣檢驗了嗎？

sentences.en: Factory emissions are a big problem here.
sentences.zh: 工廠排放的廢氣在這裡是個大問題。

sentences.en: We need to track emissions from our delivery trucks.
sentences.zh: 我們需要追蹤送貨卡車的排放量。

sentences.en: Is the company reporting its emissions honestly?
sentences.zh: 這家公司有誠實申報它的排放量嗎？

sentences.en: Electric buses produce zero emissions on the road.
sentences.zh: 電動公車在行駛時零排放。

sentences.en: We need empirical evidence before changing the policy.
sentences.zh: 修改政策之前，我們需要實證證據。

sentences.en: Is there empirical data to support this claim?
sentences.zh: 有實證資料支持這個說法嗎？

sentences.en: The study is based on empirical research, not opinion.
sentences.zh: 這項研究以實證研究為基礎，而不是意見。

sentences.en: Her empirical results matched the model's predictions.
sentences.zh: 她的實證結果和模型的預測相符。

sentences.en: Can you share the empirical findings from the pilot program?
sentences.zh: 你可以分享試辦計畫的實證結果嗎？

sentences.en: Good managers rely on empirical results, not guesses.
sentences.zh: 好的經理依靠實證結果，而不是猜測。

gloss_note: Enclosed please find 隨函附上

sentences.en: I enclosed a check with the application.
sentences.zh: 我在申請書裡附了一張支票。

sentences.en: Please find the signed contract enclosed.
sentences.zh: 隨函附上已簽署的合約，請查收。

sentences.en: Should I enclose a copy of my resume?
sentences.zh: 我該附上履歷的副本嗎？

sentences.en: A tall fence encloses the whole backyard.
sentences.zh: 一道高圍籬把整個後院圍了起來。

sentences.en: Did you enclose the receipt in the package?
sentences.zh: 你有把收據放進包裹裡嗎？

sentences.en: The garden is enclosed by a stone wall.
sentences.zh: 花園被一道石牆圍住。

sentences.en: The software will encode the video into a smaller file.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體會把影片編碼成較小的檔案。

sentences.en: How do you encode a message in binary?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼把訊息編成二進位碼？

sentences.en: Please encode the data before sending it.
sentences.zh: 傳送資料之前請先編碼。

sentences.en: The app can encode your message as a QR code.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式可以把你的訊息編碼成 QR 碼。

sentences.en: Was the file encoded the right way?
sentences.zh: 這個檔案的編碼方式正確嗎？

sentences.en: Genes encode the instructions for building proteins.
sentences.zh: 基因編碼了製造蛋白質的指令。

gloss_note: endorse a product 為產品代言

sentences.en: The famous chef endorsed our new cookware line.
sentences.zh: 這位名廚為我們的新鍋具系列代言。

sentences.en: Would the board endorse this proposal?
sentences.zh: 董事會會認可這項提案嗎？

sentences.en: She was paid to endorse a sports drink.
sentences.zh: 她受雇為一款運動飲料代言。

sentences.en: I can't endorse a product I haven't tried.
sentences.zh: 我不能為一個自己沒用過的產品背書。

sentences.en: Does the doctor endorse this treatment?
sentences.zh: 醫師認可這項治療嗎？

sentences.en: The manager endorsed the idea at the staff meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理在員工會議上表態支持這個想法。

gloss_note: enforce a rule 落實規定

sentences.en: The school strictly enforces the dress code.
sentences.zh: 學校嚴格執行服裝規定。

sentences.en: Who enforces parking rules in this building?
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓由誰來執行停車規定？

sentences.en: It's hard to enforce the policy across all offices.
sentences.zh: 要在所有辦公室落實這項政策很困難。

sentences.en: Police officers enforce traffic laws on this road.
sentences.zh: 警察在這條路上執行交通法規。

sentences.en: How will the company enforce the new safety rules?
sentences.zh: 公司要怎麼落實新的安全規定？

sentences.en: The landlord enforced the no-pets rule.
sentences.zh: 房東嚴格執行不准養寵物的規定。

sentences.en: Law enforcement officers helped direct traffic.
sentences.zh: 執法人員協助指揮交通。

sentences.en: Is enforcement of the new rule really possible?
sentences.zh: 這項新規定真的有辦法執行嗎？

sentences.en: Stricter enforcement of speed limits saved lives.
sentences.zh: 更嚴格執行速限救了許多人命。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of enforcement at the airport?
sentences.zh: 機場的執法工作由誰負責？

sentences.en: Weak enforcement lets many companies ignore the law.
sentences.zh: 執法不力讓許多公司無視法律。

sentences.en: The city increased enforcement of parking laws downtown.
sentences.zh: 市府加強了市中心的停車法規執法。

gloss_note: enroll in a course 報名課程

sentences.en: I want to enroll in a night class this fall.
sentences.zh: 我想在今年秋天報名一門夜間課程。

sentences.en: How do I enroll my daughter in kindergarten?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼幫女兒報名幼稚園？

sentences.en: Employees can enroll in the health plan until Friday.
sentences.zh: 員工可以在週五前加入健保方案。

sentences.en: Did you enroll in the yoga class yet?
sentences.zh: 你報名瑜伽課了嗎？

sentences.en: Over two hundred students enrolled in the program.
sentences.zh: 有兩百多名學生註冊了這個課程。

sentences.en: It takes ten minutes to enroll online.
sentences.zh: 線上註冊只要十分鐘。

sentences.en: Her enthusiasm made the whole team more excited.
sentences.zh: 她的熱忱讓整個團隊都興奮了起來。

sentences.en: Where does your enthusiasm for cooking come from?
sentences.zh: 你對烹飪的熱情是從哪裡來的？

sentences.en: He showed great enthusiasm during the interview.
sentences.zh: 他在面試時展現出極大的熱忱。

sentences.en: I don't share his enthusiasm for the new plan.
sentences.zh: 我不像他那樣對新計畫充滿熱情。

sentences.en: Did the news dampen your enthusiasm?
sentences.zh: 這個消息澆熄了你的熱情嗎？

sentences.en: Their enthusiasm for the project was easy to see.
sentences.zh: 他們對這個專案的熱忱顯而易見。

sentences.en: Customers were enthusiastic about the new flavor.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新口味反應熱烈。

sentences.en: Are you enthusiastic about the move to the new office?
sentences.zh: 你對搬進新辦公室感到期待嗎？

sentences.en: She gave an enthusiastic welcome to every guest.
sentences.zh: 她熱情地歡迎每一位客人。

sentences.en: We're looking for an enthusiastic person to join our team.
sentences.zh: 我們正在找一位有熱忱的人加入團隊。

sentences.en: My boss was not very enthusiastic about my idea.
sentences.zh: 我老闆對我的點子不太熱衷。

sentences.en: Why is everyone so enthusiastic about this show?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家都這麼熱愛這個節目？

sentences.en: The company is a separate legal entity from its owners.
sentences.zh: 在法律上，這家公司是獨立於業主之外的法人。

sentences.en: Is the nonprofit a separate entity from the school?
sentences.zh: 這個非營利組織和學校是各自獨立的實體嗎？

sentences.en: Each business entity must file its own tax return.
sentences.zh: 每個企業實體都必須自行報稅。

sentences.en: Which entity signed the contract?
sentences.zh: 簽這份合約的是哪個法人？

sentences.en: A government entity approved the building permit.
sentences.zh: 一個政府單位核准了建築許可。

sentences.en: The two firms operate as one entity.
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司以單一實體的方式運作。

sentences.en: My friend is a young entrepreneur in the food business.
sentences.zh: 我朋友是食品業的年輕創業家。

sentences.en: Do you want to become an entrepreneur someday?
sentences.zh: 你將來想成為創業家嗎？

sentences.en: The entrepreneur pitched her idea to investors.
sentences.zh: 這位創業家向投資人簡報了她的點子。

sentences.en: Many entrepreneurs start with very little money.
sentences.zh: 許多創業家是從很少的資金起步的。

sentences.en: What advice would an entrepreneur give to beginners?
sentences.zh: 創業家會給新手什麼建議？

sentences.en: The entrepreneur opened her second store this spring.
sentences.zh: 這位創業家今年春天開了第二家店。

sentences.en: An enzyme in saliva starts breaking down food.
sentences.zh: 唾液中的酵素開始分解食物。

sentences.en: Do you know what enzymes do in our bodies?
sentences.zh: 你知道酵素在我們體內有什麼作用嗎？

sentences.en: Some people lack the enzyme needed to digest milk.
sentences.zh: 有些人缺少消化牛奶所需的酵素。

sentences.en: This laundry detergent contains an enzyme to remove stains.
sentences.zh: 這款洗衣精含有能去除污漬的酵素。

sentences.en: Is heat bad for an enzyme?
sentences.zh: 高溫對酵素不好嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher showed how an enzyme speeds up a reaction.
sentences.zh: 老師示範了酵素如何加快反應。

sentences.en: Equality in the workplace is a goal for everyone.
sentences.zh: 職場平等是大家共同的目標。

sentences.en: Is there pay equality between men and women here?
sentences.zh: 這裡男女薪資平等嗎？

sentences.en: The school teaches equality and respect.
sentences.zh: 學校教導平等與尊重。

sentences.en: She spoke about equality at the town meeting.
sentences.zh: 她在社區大會上談到平等議題。

sentences.en: How can we promote equality in our department?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何在部門內促進平等？

sentences.en: Gender equality has improved in many countries.
sentences.zh: 許多國家的性別平等都有進步。

sentences.en: The market reached equilibrium after prices dropped.
sentences.zh: 價格下跌後，市場達到了均衡。

sentences.en: Does supply meet demand at equilibrium?
sentences.zh: 在均衡狀態下，供給等於需求嗎？

sentences.en: It took a month to find equilibrium between work and rest.
sentences.zh: 花了一個月才在工作和休息之間找到平衡。

sentences.en: A chemical reaction can reach equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 化學反應可以達到平衡。

sentences.en: How does a firm find its equilibrium price?
sentences.zh: 公司要怎麼找出均衡價格？

sentences.en: Yoga can help you restore your emotional equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽可以幫助你恢復情緒上的平衡。

sentences.en: We equipped every classroom with a projector.
sentences.zh: 我們為每間教室都配備了投影機。

sentences.en: Is the kitchen equipped with a dishwasher?
sentences.zh: 廚房有配備洗碗機嗎？

sentences.en: The company will equip you with a laptop and a phone.
sentences.zh: 公司會配給你一台筆電和一支手機。

sentences.en: How well is the gym equipped?
sentences.zh: 這間健身房的設備齊全嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel rooms are fully equipped for long stays.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間設備齊全，適合長期住宿。

sentences.en: Training will equip staff to handle emergencies.
sentences.zh: 訓練會讓員工具備處理緊急狀況的能力。

sentences.en: He owns ten percent equity in the startup.
sentences.zh: 他持有這家新創公司百分之十的股權。

sentences.en: Do employees get equity as part of the offer?
sentences.zh: 員工的聘用條件有包含股權嗎？

sentences.en: Home equity is the value of the house minus the loan.
sentences.zh: 房屋淨值就是房子的價值減去貸款。

sentences.en: We have more equity in the house than last year.
sentences.zh: 我們房子的淨值比去年增加了。

sentences.en: Is the firm looking for equity investors?
sentences.zh: 這家公司在找股權投資人嗎？

sentences.en: The investor traded debt for equity.
sentences.zh: 這位投資人把債權換成了股權。

gloss_note: essentially the same 基本上相同

sentences.en: The two plans are essentially the same.
sentences.zh: 這兩個方案基本上是一樣的。

sentences.en: Is the report essentially finished?
sentences.zh: 這份報告基本上完成了嗎？

sentences.en: Essentially, we need more time and more staff.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我們需要更多時間和更多人手。

sentences.en: He is essentially a shy person.
sentences.zh: 他本質上是個害羞的人。

sentences.en: Is the manager essentially saying we need a bigger budget?
sentences.zh: 經理基本上是在說我們需要更多預算嗎？

sentences.en: The study essentially confirms what we already knew.
sentences.zh: 這項研究基本上證實了我們早就知道的事。

gloss_note: in my estimation 依我判斷

sentences.en: In my estimation, the repair will cost about five hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 依我估計，修理大約要花五百美元。

sentences.en: Your estimation of the time was pretty accurate.
sentences.zh: 你對時間的估計相當準確。

sentences.en: Is estimation a skill they teach in math class?
sentences.zh: 數學課有教估算這項技能嗎？

sentences.en: My estimation of him went up after that meeting.
sentences.zh: 那場會議之後，我對他的評價提高了。

sentences.en: Is cost estimation part of your job?
sentences.zh: 成本估算是你工作的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: Rough estimation is fine for now.
sentences.zh: 現在先粗略估算就可以了。

sentences.en: Is it ethical to use customer data this way?
sentences.zh: 用這種方式使用客戶資料合乎道德嗎？

sentences.en: She faced an ethical dilemma at work.
sentences.zh: 她在工作上遇到了道德兩難。

sentences.en: We only buy from ethical suppliers.
sentences.zh: 我們只向合乎道德的供應商採購。

sentences.en: The company has strong ethical standards.
sentences.zh: 這家公司有嚴格的道德標準。

sentences.en: Do you think the ad was ethical?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那則廣告合乎道德嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors must follow ethical rules when treating patients.
sentences.zh: 醫師治療病人時必須遵守倫理規範。

sentences.en: Our company has a strict code of ethics.
sentences.zh: 我們公司有嚴格的倫理守則。

sentences.en: Do you teach ethics in your business class?
sentences.zh: 你們的商業課程有教倫理嗎？

sentences.en: She took a course on medical ethics last semester.
sentences.zh: 她上學期修了一門醫學倫理的課。

sentences.en: His ethics are beyond question.
sentences.zh: 他的操守無可挑剔。

sentences.en: Is that practice a violation of workplace ethics?
sentences.zh: 那種做法違反職場倫理嗎？

sentences.en: Journalists should follow professional ethics.
sentences.zh: 記者應該遵守職業道德。

gloss_note: pay in euros 用歐元付款

sentences.en: How many dollars is one euro today?
sentences.zh: 今天一歐元等於多少美元？

sentences.en: The hotel in Paris costs a hundred euros a night.
sentences.zh: 巴黎那間飯店一晚一百歐元。

sentences.en: Can I pay in euros at this shop?
sentences.zh: 我可以在這家店用歐元付款嗎？

sentences.en: The euro fell against the dollar this week.
sentences.zh: 這週歐元對美元貶值。

sentences.en: I exchanged fifty dollars for euros at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我在機場把五十美元換成了歐元。

sentences.en: Is the euro used in every European country?
sentences.zh: 每個歐洲國家都使用歐元嗎？

gloss_note: It is evident that… 很明顯…

sentences.en: It was evident that she was tired.
sentences.zh: 很明顯她累了。

sentences.en: Is the problem evident from the data?
sentences.zh: 從資料中看得出這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: His disappointment was evident to everyone.
sentences.zh: 他的失望大家都看得出來。

sentences.en: The need for change is evident.
sentences.zh: 改變的必要性很明顯。

sentences.en: It became evident that the plan wouldn't work.
sentences.zh: 事情漸漸明朗，這個計畫行不通。

sentences.en: Was it evident to you that the price had gone up?
sentences.zh: 你有明顯感覺到價格漲了嗎？

sentences.en: Evolutionary biology explains how species change over time.
sentences.zh: 演化生物學解釋物種如何隨時間改變。

sentences.en: Is this an evolutionary trait or a learned habit?
sentences.zh: 這是演化而來的特徵，還是後天養成的習慣？

sentences.en: We visited the evolutionary exhibit at the museum.
sentences.zh: 我們參觀了博物館的演化展覽。

sentences.en: The class studied the evolutionary history of birds.
sentences.zh: 這堂課研究了鳥類的演化史。

sentences.en: Do you find evolutionary science interesting?
sentences.zh: 你覺得演化科學有趣嗎？

sentences.en: Bright colors may be an evolutionary advantage for some insects.
sentences.zh: 鮮豔的顏色對某些昆蟲可能是演化上的優勢。

sentences.en: The hotel charged an excessive fee for parking.
sentences.zh: 飯店收了過高的停車費。

sentences.en: Is two hours of screen time excessive for kids?
sentences.zh: 孩子每天兩小時螢幕時間算過多嗎？

sentences.en: Excessive noise from the party kept us awake.
sentences.zh: 派對傳來的過大噪音讓我們睡不著。

sentences.en: Don't use excessive force when you open the box.
sentences.zh: 開箱子時不要用過大的力氣。

sentences.en: Did you think the delivery fee was excessive?
sentences.zh: 你覺得運費太貴了嗎？

sentences.en: Excessive heat can damage the battery.
sentences.zh: 過高的溫度會損壞電池。

sentences.en: We have exclusive rights to sell this product.
sentences.zh: 我們擁有這項產品的獨家銷售權。

sentences.en: Is this offer exclusive to members?
sentences.zh: 這個優惠是會員專屬的嗎？

sentences.en: The newspaper got an exclusive interview with the mayor.
sentences.zh: 報紙獨家採訪了市長。

sentences.en: The hotel has an exclusive lounge for guests.
sentences.zh: 飯店有一間專供住客使用的休息室。

sentences.en: Our store offers exclusive discounts for students.
sentences.zh: 我們商店提供學生專屬的折扣。

sentences.en: Does the price include exclusive use of the meeting room?
sentences.zh: 價格包含會議室的專用權嗎？

sentences.en: We took a day excursion to the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們到湖邊一日遊。

sentences.en: Is the excursion included in the tour price?
sentences.zh: 遊覽行程包含在旅費裡嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel arranges excursions to nearby farms.
sentences.zh: 飯店安排前往附近農場的遊覽行程。

sentences.en: The tour guide planned an afternoon excursion to a nearby waterfall.
sentences.zh: 導遊安排了一趟前往附近瀑布的下午遊覽行程。

sentences.en: Do you want to join the boat excursion tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天想參加搭船遊覽嗎？

sentences.en: The excursion was canceled because of rain.
sentences.zh: 這趟出遊因為下雨取消了。

gloss_note: execute a plan 執行計畫

sentences.en: We need to execute the plan carefully.
sentences.zh: 我們需要謹慎地執行這個計畫。

sentences.en: Can the team execute on this strategy?
sentences.zh: 團隊有辦法落實這個策略嗎？

sentences.en: The program failed to execute correctly.
sentences.zh: 程式沒有正確執行。

sentences.en: Both parties must execute the contract by Friday.
sentences.zh: 雙方必須在週五前簽署合約，使其生效。

sentences.en: She executed the design exactly as planned.
sentences.zh: 她完全依計畫完成了設計。

sentences.en: Who will execute the new marketing campaign?
sentences.zh: 誰來執行新的行銷活動？

sentences.en: The idea is good, but the execution was poor.
sentences.zh: 點子很好，但執行得很差。

sentences.en: Who is responsible for the execution of the project?
sentences.zh: 誰負責這個專案的執行？

sentences.en: Good execution matters more than a perfect plan.
sentences.zh: 好的執行力比完美的計畫更重要。

sentences.en: Is the execution of the contract on schedule?
sentences.zh: 合約的執行進度符合時程嗎？

sentences.en: We had some delays in the execution phase.
sentences.zh: 我們在執行階段有一些延誤。

sentences.en: The execution of the new policy begins on Monday.
sentences.zh: 新政策從週一開始執行。

sentences.en: Are nonprofit groups exempt from this tax?
sentences.zh: 非營利團體可以免繳這項稅嗎？

sentences.en: Some items are exempt from sales tax.
sentences.zh: 有些商品免徵銷售稅。

sentences.en: Many salaried employees are exempt from overtime rules.
sentences.zh: 許多領月薪的員工不適用加班費規定。

sentences.en: Is this product exempt from the new fee?
sentences.zh: 這項產品免收新的費用嗎？

sentences.en: Students are exempt from the entry fee.
sentences.zh: 學生免繳入場費。

sentences.en: Veterans are exempt from parking fees here.
sentences.zh: 退伍軍人在這裡免付停車費。

sentences.en: Do I qualify for a tax exemption?
sentences.zh: 我符合免稅資格嗎？

sentences.en: The law gives an exemption to small farms.
sentences.zh: 這項法律讓小型農場享有豁免。

sentences.en: She asked for an exemption from the late fee.
sentences.zh: 她申請免除滯納金。

sentences.en: Is there an exemption for students under eighteen?
sentences.zh: 十八歲以下的學生有豁免規定嗎？

sentences.en: The exemption saved us about two hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 這項免稅讓我們省下大約兩百美元。

sentences.en: Employers must keep records of each exemption.
sentences.zh: 雇主必須保存每一筆豁免的紀錄。

sentences.en: We hired her for her expertise in marketing.
sentences.zh: 我們是看上她在行銷方面的專業才僱用她。

sentences.en: Does anyone here have expertise in tax law?
sentences.zh: 這裡有人懂稅法嗎？

sentences.en: His expertise in design saved us a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 他在設計方面的專業幫我們省了很多時間。

sentences.en: I don't have the expertise to fix this server.
sentences.zh: 我沒有修這台伺服器的專業能力。

sentences.en: Where can we find the expertise we need?
sentences.zh: 我們去哪裡能找到需要的專業人才？

sentences.en: The firm is known for its engineering expertise.
sentences.zh: 這家公司以工程專業聞名。

sentences.en: Please check the expiration date on the milk.
sentences.zh: 請檢查一下牛奶的到期日。

sentences.en: When is the expiration date of your passport?
sentences.zh: 你的護照什麼時候到期？

sentences.en: Our contract's expiration is only two weeks away.
sentences.zh: 我們的合約再兩週就到期了。

sentences.en: Is there an expiration date on this coupon?
sentences.zh: 這張優惠券有使用期限嗎？

sentences.en: Bring the phone in for repair before the warranty's expiration.
sentences.zh: 請在保固到期前把手機送來維修。

sentences.en: The bank will send a notice before your card's expiration.
sentences.zh: 銀行會在你的卡片到期前寄出通知。

sentences.en: My passport expires next month, so I need to renew it.
sentences.zh: 我的護照下個月到期，所以我得去換新。

sentences.en: When does this coupon expire?
sentences.zh: 這張優惠券什麼時候到期？

sentences.en: Has your visa expired yet?
sentences.zh: 你的簽證已經過期了嗎？

sentences.en: The offer expires at midnight on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 這項優惠在週日午夜截止。

sentences.en: Our warranty will expire in two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我們的保固兩週後到期。

sentences.en: Don't eat that yogurt; it expired last week.
sentences.zh: 別吃那個優格，它上週就過期了。

gloss_note: explanatory note 說明註記；多用於文件與標示

sentences.en: There's an explanatory note at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 頁面底部有一則說明註記。

sentences.en: Does the manual include any explanatory diagrams?
sentences.zh: 手冊有附任何說明圖嗎？

sentences.en: Please add a short explanatory paragraph to the report.
sentences.zh: 請在報告中加上一小段說明文字。

sentences.en: The teacher handed out explanatory handouts before the quiz.
sentences.zh: 老師在小考前發了說明講義。

sentences.en: Is the explanatory text clear enough for new customers?
sentences.zh: 這段說明文字對新客戶來說夠清楚嗎？

sentences.en: The product comes with an explanatory booklet in three languages.
sentences.zh: 產品附有三種語言的說明手冊。

sentences.en: My manager gave us explicit instructions to call first.
sentences.zh: 經理明確指示我們要先打電話。

sentences.en: Were the rules explicit enough for everyone?
sentences.zh: 規則對每個人來說夠明確嗎？

sentences.en: The contract is explicit about late fees.
sentences.zh: 合約對逾期費用寫得很明確。

sentences.en: She was explicit that she wanted the report today.
sentences.zh: 她明確表示今天就要拿到報告。

sentences.en: Could you be more explicit about what went wrong?
sentences.zh: 你可以說得更明確一點，到底哪裡出錯了嗎？

sentences.en: The law has no explicit ban on night work.
sentences.zh: 法律並沒有明文禁止夜間工作。

sentences.en: I explicitly asked for a window seat.
sentences.zh: 我明確要求了靠窗的座位。

sentences.en: The sign explicitly says no parking after six.
sentences.zh: 標示清楚寫著六點後禁止停車。

sentences.en: Did she explicitly agree to the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 她有明確同意新的時程嗎？

sentences.en: The policy explicitly forbids sharing passwords.
sentences.zh: 公司政策明文禁止分享密碼。

sentences.en: Why didn't you explicitly mention the deadline?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼沒有明確提到截止日期？

sentences.en: The author explicitly states her main argument in chapter one.
sentences.zh: 作者在第一章就明確陳述了她的主要論點。

gloss_note: exploit an opportunity 把握機會

sentences.en: We should exploit this opportunity to enter the new market.
sentences.zh: 我們應該把握這個機會進入新市場。

sentences.en: How can we fully exploit our new software?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何充分利用新軟體？

sentences.en: Some factories exploit workers by paying them too little.
sentences.zh: 有些工廠壓榨工人，給的薪水太少。

sentences.en: The company exploited a loophole in the tax law.
sentences.zh: 這家公司利用了稅法中的漏洞。

sentences.en: Is it fair to exploit natural resources without a plan?
sentences.zh: 沒有計畫就開採利用天然資源，公平嗎？

sentences.en: Scammers often exploit elderly people who live alone.
sentences.zh: 詐騙集團常利用獨居的老人下手。

gloss_note: major exporter of 主要出口商或國家

sentences.en: Our company is a major exporter of auto parts.
sentences.zh: 本公司是汽車零件的主要出口商。

sentences.en: Who is the largest exporter of coffee in the world?
sentences.zh: 全世界最大的咖啡出口國是哪一國？

sentences.en: The exporter shipped the goods on Monday.
sentences.zh: 出口商週一把貨運出去了。

sentences.en: Is the exporter responsible for the customs forms?
sentences.zh: 報關文件是由出口商負責嗎？

sentences.en: Brazil is a leading exporter of sugar.
sentences.zh: 巴西是糖的主要出口國。

sentences.en: A small exporter needs a reliable shipping partner.
sentences.zh: 小型出口商需要可靠的貨運夥伴。

gloss_note: 正式用語；受詞通常是事物，不是人

sentences.en: This new software will facilitate communication between teams.
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體將促進團隊之間的溝通。

sentences.en: How can we facilitate the approval process?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何讓核准流程更順暢？

sentences.en: Clear signs facilitate travel for tourists.
sentences.zh: 清楚的標示讓觀光客旅行更方便。

sentences.en: A shared calendar will facilitate scheduling for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 共用行事曆能讓整個團隊更方便排時間。

sentences.en: Would an online form facilitate the registration?
sentences.zh: 線上表格會讓報名更方便嗎？

sentences.en: Cheap loans can facilitate small business growth.
sentences.zh: 低利貸款能促進小型企業的成長。

gloss_note: fasten your seat belt 繫好安全帶

sentences.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: Can you fasten this strap for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我繫好這條帶子嗎？

sentences.en: He fastened the bike to the rack with two straps.
sentences.zh: 他用兩條綁帶把腳踏車固定在車架上。

sentences.en: Is the lid fastened properly?
sentences.zh: 蓋子有蓋緊嗎？

sentences.en: She fastened her coat and stepped into the snow.
sentences.zh: 她扣好外套，走進雪中。

sentences.en: Fasten the shelf to the wall with these screws.
sentences.zh: 用這些螺絲把架子固定在牆上。

gloss_note: decide the fate of 決定…的命運

sentences.en: The board will decide the fate of the company tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 董事會明天會決定公司的命運。

sentences.en: Do you believe in fate?
sentences.zh: 你相信命運嗎？

sentences.en: The failed deal sealed the fate of the project.
sentences.zh: 破局的交易讓這個專案注定失敗。

sentences.en: What was the fate of the missing package?
sentences.zh: 那個遺失的包裹最後怎麼了？

sentences.en: Fate brought them together at a job fair.
sentences.zh: 命運讓他們在就業博覽會上相遇。

sentences.en: The workers waited nervously to hear their fate.
sentences.zh: 工人們緊張地等著聽自己的下場。

gloss_note: faulty wiring 有問題的線路

sentences.en: The store replaced my faulty phone charger.
sentences.zh: 店家幫我換了有瑕疵的手機充電器。

sentences.en: Is faulty wiring the reason the lights keep flickering?
sentences.zh: 是線路有問題，才害燈一直閃嗎？

sentences.en: We returned the faulty toaster for a refund.
sentences.zh: 我們把故障的烤麵包機退掉換回了錢。

sentences.en: A faulty brake can be extremely dangerous.
sentences.zh: 有缺陷的煞車可能非常危險。

sentences.en: Which part of the machine is faulty?
sentences.zh: 這台機器的哪個零件故障了？

sentences.en: The inspector found a faulty valve in the system.
sentences.zh: 檢查員在系統裡發現一個有缺陷的閥門。

sentences.en: The bank offered us favorable terms on the loan.
sentences.zh: 銀行提供我們有利的貸款條件。

sentences.en: Did the customers give favorable reviews?
sentences.zh: 顧客給了好評嗎？

sentences.en: The weather looks favorable for our outdoor event.
sentences.zh: 天氣看起來很適合我們辦戶外活動。

sentences.en: She made a favorable impression on the interviewer.
sentences.zh: 她給面試官留下了良好的印象。

sentences.en: Are the market conditions favorable for a new product?
sentences.zh: 市場條件有利於推出新產品嗎？

sentences.en: The exchange rate was favorable during our trip.
sentences.zh: 我們旅行期間的匯率對我們有利。

gloss_note: fax machine 傳真機；現在較少用

sentences.en: Could you fax me the signed form today?
sentences.zh: 你今天可以把簽好的表格傳真給我嗎？

sentences.en: Our office still has an old fax machine.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室還有一台老舊的傳真機。

sentences.en: I'll fax the contract to your lawyer right away.
sentences.zh: 我馬上把合約傳真給你的律師。

sentences.en: Did you get my fax this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上有收到我的傳真嗎？

sentences.en: The clinic asked me to send a fax instead of an email.
sentences.zh: 診所要我用傳真而不是電子郵件寄過去。

sentences.en: The fax number is at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 傳真號碼印在頁面底部。

gloss_note: give feedback on 針對…給意見；不可數

sentences.en: Thanks for your feedback on my presentation.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你對我的簡報提出意見。

sentences.en: Can I get some feedback on this draft?
sentences.zh: 我可以請你對這份草稿給點意見嗎？

sentences.en: Customer feedback has been mostly positive so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止，顧客的回饋大多是正面的。

sentences.en: Did the teacher give you any feedback on your essay?
sentences.zh: 老師有針對你的作文給意見嗎？

sentences.en: We'd love to hear your feedback about the new menu.
sentences.zh: 我們很想聽聽你對新菜單的看法。

sentences.en: Please send your feedback by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 請在本週結束前寄出你的意見。

sentences.en: We took the ferry to the island this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們今天早上搭渡輪去了那座島。

sentences.en: What time does the next ferry leave?
sentences.zh: 下一班渡輪幾點開？

sentences.en: The ferry was crowded with tourists on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 週日渡輪上擠滿了遊客。

sentences.en: Do you have to book the ferry ahead of time?
sentences.zh: 你得提前訂渡輪嗎？

sentences.en: Cars wait in line to board the ferry.
sentences.zh: 汽車排隊等著上渡輪。

sentences.en: A small boat ferries workers across the river every day.
sentences.zh: 一艘小船每天載工人過河。

sentences.en: The doctor checked the fetal heartbeat during the visit.
sentences.zh: 醫生在回診時檢查了胎兒的心跳。

sentences.en: Is fetal growth normal at this stage?
sentences.zh: 現階段的胎兒發育正常嗎？

sentences.en: Pregnant women should avoid alcohol to protect fetal health.
sentences.zh: 孕婦應避免飲酒，以保護胎兒的健康。

sentences.en: The class studied fetal development in biology.
sentences.zh: 班上在生物課學了胎兒的發育。

sentences.en: Can an ultrasound show the fetal position?
sentences.zh: 超音波能看出胎兒的位置嗎？

sentences.en: Poor nutrition can affect fetal brain development.
sentences.zh: 營養不良可能影響胎兒的腦部發育。

gloss_note: dietary fiber 膳食纖維；英式 fibre

sentences.en: Oatmeal is a good source of fiber.
sentences.zh: 燕麥片是纖維的良好來源。

sentences.en: How much fiber should I eat every day?
sentences.zh: 我每天該吃多少纖維？

sentences.en: This shirt is made of natural fiber.
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫是天然纖維做的。

sentences.en: Fruits and vegetables are full of fiber.
sentences.zh: 蔬果富含纖維。

sentences.en: Does this cereal have any fiber in it?
sentences.zh: 這款麥片有含任何纖維嗎？

sentences.en: Cotton fibers are soft and easy to wash.
sentences.zh: 棉纖維柔軟又好洗。

gloss_note: finalize the plan 敲定計畫

sentences.en: We need to finalize the budget by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們得在週五前敲定預算。

sentences.en: Have you finalized the guest list yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經確定賓客名單了嗎？

sentences.en: Let's finalize the details over the phone.
sentences.zh: 我們電話上把細節敲定吧。

sentences.en: The team will finalize the design next week.
sentences.zh: 團隊下週會完成設計定案。

sentences.en: When can we finalize the contract?
sentences.zh: 我們什麼時候可以敲定合約？

sentences.en: She finalized her travel plans last night.
sentences.zh: 她昨晚敲定了旅遊計畫。

sentences.en: Our time and money are finite, so we must choose wisely.
sentences.zh: 我們的時間和金錢都有限，所以得謹慎選擇。

sentences.en: Are the earth's natural resources finite?
sentences.zh: 地球的天然資源是有限的嗎？

sentences.en: The team has a finite budget for this project.
sentences.zh: 團隊在這個專案上的預算有限。

sentences.en: Water is a finite resource in many dry areas.
sentences.zh: 在許多乾旱地區，水是有限的資源。

sentences.en: Can a finite number of rules cover every case?
sentences.zh: 有限數量的規則能涵蓋所有情況嗎？

sentences.en: Our office has a finite amount of storage space.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室的儲藏空間有限。

gloss_note: 性別中立說法，比 fireman 常用

sentences.en: A firefighter carried the child out of the building.
sentences.zh: 一名消防員把孩子抱出了大樓。

sentences.en: My uncle works as a firefighter downtown.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在市區當消防員。

sentences.en: Did the firefighters arrive in time?
sentences.zh: 消防員有及時趕到嗎？

sentences.en: Every firefighter must pass a fitness test.
sentences.zh: 每位消防員都必須通過體能測驗。

sentences.en: The kids waved at the firefighter on the truck.
sentences.zh: 孩子們向消防車上的消防員揮手。

sentences.en: How long does it take to train as a firefighter?
sentences.zh: 訓練成為消防員要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Our fiscal year ends in June.
sentences.zh: 我們的會計年度在六月結束。

sentences.en: Is the report for this fiscal year ready?
sentences.zh: 本會計年度的報告準備好了嗎？

sentences.en: The government announced a new fiscal policy today.
sentences.zh: 政府今天宣布了新的財政政策。

sentences.en: We expect higher sales in the next fiscal quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們預期下一個會計季度的銷售會更好。

sentences.en: Did the city meet its fiscal goals this year?
sentences.zh: 市政府今年有達成財政目標嗎？

sentences.en: Fiscal discipline helps keep the budget under control.
sentences.zh: 財政紀律有助於把預算控制住。

sentences.en: She joined a fitness center near her office.
sentences.zh: 她加入了公司附近的健身中心。

sentences.en: How is your fitness level these days?
sentences.zh: 你最近的體能狀況如何？

sentences.en: Regular exercise improves your overall fitness.
sentences.zh: 規律運動能提升你整體的體能。

sentences.en: Our company offers a free fitness class on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 我們公司週五提供免費的健身課。

sentences.en: Is there a fitness room in the hotel?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有健身房嗎？

sentences.en: Students take a fitness test in gym class.
sentences.zh: 學生在體育課要做體能測驗。

gloss_note: a fatal flaw 致命的缺陷

sentences.en: The inspector found a flaw in the design.
sentences.zh: 檢查員在設計中發現一處缺陷。

sentences.en: Is there a flaw in this plan?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫有什麼漏洞嗎？

sentences.en: I noticed a small flaw in the fabric.
sentences.zh: 我注意到布料上有一處小瑕疵。

sentences.en: The biggest flaw in his argument is the lack of data.
sentences.zh: 他論點最大的缺陷是缺乏數據。

sentences.en: Can you point out any flaws in my proposal?
sentences.zh: 你能指出我的提案有哪些缺點嗎？

sentences.en: This diamond has no visible flaws.
sentences.zh: 這顆鑽石沒有肉眼可見的瑕疵。

gloss_note: flexibility in hours 工時彈性

sentences.en: Our company offers flexibility in working hours.
sentences.zh: 我們公司提供彈性的工作時間。

sentences.en: Do you have any flexibility on the price?
sentences.zh: 價格方面你有沒有彈性空間？

sentences.en: Thank you for your flexibility with the schedule.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你在時間安排上的配合。

sentences.en: Remote work gives employees more flexibility.
sentences.zh: 遠距工作讓員工更有彈性。

sentences.en: Is there any flexibility in the delivery date?
sentences.zh: 交貨日期有任何彈性嗎？

sentences.en: Flexibility is important when plans change suddenly.
sentences.zh: 計畫突然改變時，靈活應變很重要。

sentences.en: Currency fluctuations can affect our profits.
sentences.zh: 匯率波動可能影響我們的利潤。

sentences.en: What caused the fluctuation in sales last month?
sentences.zh: 上個月的銷售為什麼會起伏不定？

sentences.en: There was a sharp fluctuation in oil prices today.
sentences.zh: 今天油價出現劇烈波動。

sentences.en: Daily fluctuations in temperature are common here.
sentences.zh: 這裡氣溫每天的起伏很常見。

sentences.en: Are these fluctuations normal for this season?
sentences.zh: 這些起伏對這個季節來說正常嗎？

sentences.en: Small fluctuations in the stock market do not worry me.
sentences.zh: 股市的小幅波動不會讓我擔心。

sentences.en: Drink plenty of fluids when you have a cold.
sentences.zh: 感冒時要多喝水分。

sentences.en: Is this fluid safe to pour down the sink?
sentences.zh: 這種液體可以倒進水槽嗎？

sentences.en: The mechanic added brake fluid to the car.
sentences.zh: 技師幫車子加了煞車油。

sentences.en: What kind of fluid is leaking from the car?
sentences.zh: 車子漏出來的是什麼液體？

sentences.en: She danced with fluid, graceful movements.
sentences.zh: 她以流暢優美的動作跳舞。

sentences.en: Doctors checked the fluid around his knee.
sentences.zh: 醫生檢查了他膝蓋周圍的積液。

gloss_note: distribute flyers 發傳單；也拼 flier

sentences.en: A student handed me a flyer about the concert.
sentences.zh: 一名學生遞給我一張音樂會的傳單。

sentences.en: Can you print fifty flyers for the sale?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫特賣會印五十張傳單嗎？

sentences.en: We put a flyer under every door in the building.
sentences.zh: 我們在大樓每扇門下都塞了一張傳單。

sentences.en: Did you see the flyer on the bulletin board?
sentences.zh: 你有看到佈告欄上的傳單嗎？

sentences.en: The flyer lists all the store's weekend deals.
sentences.zh: 傳單上列出了店裡所有的週末優惠。

sentences.en: Volunteers handed out flyers at the train station.
sentences.zh: 志工在車站發傳單。

gloss_note: 電腦與紙本文件夾都叫 folder

sentences.en: Please save the file in the shared folder.
sentences.zh: 請把檔案存到共用資料夾。

sentences.en: Where did you put the client folder?
sentences.zh: 你把客戶的文件夾放在哪裡了？

sentences.en: I made a new folder for all my receipts.
sentences.zh: 我新建了一個資料夾來放所有收據。

sentences.en: Is the report in the blue folder on my desk?
sentences.zh: 報告在我桌上那個藍色文件夾裡嗎？

sentences.en: Drag the photos into the folder on your desktop.
sentences.zh: 把照片拖進桌面上的資料夾。

sentences.en: She keeps every tax document in a labeled folder.
sentences.zh: 她把每份稅務文件都放在貼了標籤的文件夾裡。

gloss_note: formulation of a plan 計畫的擬定

sentences.en: The formulation of the new policy took three months.
sentences.zh: 新政策的擬定花了三個月。

sentences.en: Did the company change the formulation of this shampoo?
sentences.zh: 這家公司改了這款洗髮精的配方嗎？

sentences.en: Careful formulation of the questions improved the survey.
sentences.zh: 仔細擬定問題，讓這份問卷更完善。

sentences.en: A new drug formulation may reduce side effects.
sentences.zh: 新的藥物配方可能減少副作用。

sentences.en: Who was involved in the formulation of the budget?
sentences.zh: 誰參與了預算的擬定？

sentences.en: The formulation of a clear strategy is our first step.
sentences.zh: 擬定明確的策略是我們的第一步。

sentences.en: The founder started the company in his garage.
sentences.zh: 創辦人在自家車庫創立了這家公司。

sentences.en: Who is the founder of this startup?
sentences.zh: 這間新創公司的創辦人是誰？

sentences.en: She is the founder and CEO of a small software firm.
sentences.zh: 她是一家小型軟體公司的創辦人兼執行長。

sentences.en: The founders raised money from local investors.
sentences.zh: 創辦人向當地投資人募資。

sentences.en: Did the founder speak at the company meeting?
sentences.zh: 創辦人有在公司會議上發言嗎？

sentences.en: Their founder still checks every product by hand.
sentences.zh: 他們的創辦人仍然親自檢查每項產品。

gloss_note: a fraction of 一小部分

sentences.en: Only a fraction of customers read the manual.
sentences.zh: 只有一小部分顧客會讀說明書。

sentences.en: What fraction of the budget goes to rent?
sentences.zh: 預算中有多少比例用在租金？

sentences.en: We finished the project in a fraction of the time.
sentences.zh: 我們只花了一小部分的時間就完成了專案。

sentences.en: In math class, we learned how to add fractions.
sentences.zh: 數學課上，我們學了怎麼做分數加法。

sentences.en: Can you turn 0.25 into a fraction?
sentences.zh: 你能把0.25換成分數嗎？

sentences.en: She paid only a fraction of the original price.
sentences.zh: 她只付了原價的一小部分。

gloss_note: open a franchise 開加盟店

sentences.en: He plans to open a coffee franchise downtown.
sentences.zh: 他打算在市區開一家咖啡加盟店。

sentences.en: How much does a franchise cost to start?
sentences.zh: 開一家加盟店要花多少錢？

sentences.en: The franchise owner pays a monthly fee to the company.
sentences.zh: 加盟主每個月要付費給總公司。

sentences.en: Is this restaurant a franchise or a family business?
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳是加盟店還是家族經營的？

sentences.en: The company sold franchises in ten new cities.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在十個新城市賣出了加盟權。

sentences.en: A franchise agreement can last for many years.
sentences.zh: 加盟合約可能長達許多年。

gloss_note: credit card fraud 信用卡詐欺

sentences.en: The bank froze my card because of suspected fraud.
sentences.zh: 銀行因疑似詐欺凍結了我的卡。

sentences.en: Did the accountant commit fraud?
sentences.zh: 那位會計師犯了詐欺罪嗎？

sentences.en: Online shopping fraud is becoming more common.
sentences.zh: 網購詐欺越來越常見。

sentences.en: He was charged with tax fraud last year.
sentences.zh: 他去年被控稅務詐欺。

sentences.en: How can I protect myself from credit card fraud?
sentences.zh: 我要如何保護自己不受信用卡詐欺所害？

sentences.en: The company lost millions in a fraud scheme.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在一場詐騙計畫中損失了數百萬元。

gloss_note: the frontier of 領域的前沿

sentences.en: Artificial intelligence is the new frontier of technology.
sentences.zh: 人工智慧是科技的新前沿。

sentences.en: In the 1800s, many families headed west to the frontier.
sentences.zh: 1800年代，許多家庭向西前往邊疆。

sentences.en: Is space the next frontier for business?
sentences.zh: 太空會是商業的下一個新領域嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists are pushing the frontiers of medicine.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在推進醫學的前沿。

sentences.en: Our company is exploring a new frontier in online learning.
sentences.zh: 我們公司正在探索線上學習的新領域。

sentences.en: Which frontier of research excites you the most?
sentences.zh: 你對哪個研究前沿最感興趣？

sentences.en: Long meetings really frustrate me.
sentences.zh: 冗長的會議真的讓我很煩躁。

sentences.en: Does slow Wi-Fi frustrate you too?
sentences.zh: 網路很慢也讓你很沮喪嗎？

sentences.en: The delay will frustrate our customers.
sentences.zh: 延誤會讓我們的顧客感到沮喪。

sentences.en: Don't let one mistake frustrate you.
sentences.zh: 別讓一個錯誤使你灰心。

sentences.en: The confusing instructions frustrated everyone in class.
sentences.zh: 令人困惑的說明讓班上每個人都很受挫。

sentences.en: What frustrates you most about your commute?
sentences.zh: 通勤時最讓你煩躁的是什麼？

sentences.en: The company will furnish all necessary equipment.
sentences.zh: 公司會提供所有必要的設備。

sentences.en: We need to furnish the new office by Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們得在週一前把新辦公室的家具配齊。

sentences.en: Can you furnish proof of your address?
sentences.zh: 你能提供住址證明嗎？

sentences.en: They furnished the apartment with a sofa and a table.
sentences.zh: 他們在公寓裡擺了沙發和桌子。

sentences.en: Is the apartment furnished or unfurnished?
sentences.zh: 這間公寓有附家具嗎？

sentences.en: The school furnished each student with a laptop.
sentences.zh: 學校提供每位學生一台筆電。

sentences.en: The restaurant serves a fusion of Asian and Italian food.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳供應亞洲與義式融合的料理。

sentences.en: This song is a fusion of jazz and rock.
sentences.zh: 這首歌是爵士與搖滾的融合。

sentences.en: Is fusion cooking popular in your city?
sentences.zh: 融合料理在你們城市受歡迎嗎？

sentences.en: The cafe is a fusion of a bakery and a bookstore.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館結合了烘焙坊與書店。

sentences.en: The design is a fusion of old and new styles.
sentences.zh: 這個設計融合了新舊風格。

sentences.en: Does the fusion of science and art interest you?
sentences.zh: 科學與藝術的結合讓你感興趣嗎？

gloss_note: a clove of garlic 一瓣蒜

sentences.en: Add two cloves of garlic to the pan.
sentences.zh: 把兩瓣大蒜加進鍋子裡。

sentences.en: Do you want garlic bread with your pasta?
sentences.zh: 你的義大利麵要搭配大蒜麵包嗎？

sentences.en: The whole kitchen smelled like garlic.
sentences.zh: 整個廚房都是大蒜味。

sentences.en: Could you chop the garlic for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把大蒜切碎嗎？

sentences.en: This soup has too much garlic for me.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯對我來說大蒜太多了。

sentences.en: Garlic is often used in Italian cooking.
sentences.zh: 大蒜常用在義式料理中。

sentences.en: This garment should be washed in cold water.
sentences.zh: 這件衣物應該用冷水洗。

sentences.en: The factory makes garments for large retailers.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠為大型零售商生產成衣。

sentences.en: Is this garment machine washable?
sentences.zh: 這件衣服可以機洗嗎？

sentences.en: Each garment is inspected before shipping.
sentences.zh: 每件成衣在出貨前都會經過檢查。

sentences.en: Where should I hang this garment?
sentences.zh: 這件衣服該掛在哪裡？

sentences.en: She works in the garment industry downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區的成衣業工作。

gloss_note: hard to generalize 難以一概而論

sentences.en: It is hard to generalize about all teenagers.
sentences.zh: 很難對所有青少年一概而論。

sentences.en: Can we generalize from such a small sample?
sentences.zh: 我們能從這麼小的樣本歸納出結論嗎？

sentences.en: Try not to generalize from one bad experience.
sentences.zh: 盡量別因為一次不好的經驗就以偏概全。

sentences.en: The researcher generalized the results to the whole city.
sentences.zh: 研究人員把結果推論到整座城市。

sentences.en: Is it fair to generalize about every customer?
sentences.zh: 對每位顧客都一概而論，這樣公平嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists generalize from many cases to form a rule.
sentences.zh: 科學家從許多案例中歸納出一個規則。

sentences.en: Do you have a generic version of this medicine?
sentences.zh: 這種藥有學名藥嗎？

sentences.en: The cover letter sounded too generic to impress anyone.
sentences.zh: 這封求職信聽起來太籠統，打動不了任何人。

sentences.en: Generic brands are usually cheaper at this store.
sentences.zh: 這家店的無品牌商品通常比較便宜。

sentences.en: Can you replace the generic greeting with the client's name?
sentences.zh: 你可以把籠統的問候語換成客戶的名字嗎？

sentences.en: I bought a generic phone charger online.
sentences.zh: 我在網路上買了一條無品牌的手機充電器。

sentences.en: Her feedback was too generic to be useful.
sentences.zh: 她的意見太籠統，沒什麼幫助。

gloss_note: 為不可數名詞，不加 a

sentences.en: Globalization has changed how companies do business.
sentences.zh: 全球化改變了企業做生意的方式。

sentences.en: What effects does globalization have on small shops?
sentences.zh: 全球化對小型商店有什麼影響？

sentences.en: Many jobs moved overseas because of globalization.
sentences.zh: 許多工作因為全球化而移往海外。

sentences.en: Is globalization good for local farmers?
sentences.zh: 全球化對當地農民有利嗎？

sentences.en: Our class discussed globalization and world trade.
sentences.zh: 我們班討論了全球化與世界貿易。

sentences.en: Globalization makes it easy to buy products from other countries.
sentences.zh: 全球化讓購買外國產品變得很容易。

gloss_note: consumer goods 消費品；常用複數

sentences.en: The store sells a wide range of household goods.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售各式各樣的家用商品。

sentences.en: How can we track the goods we ordered from the supplier?
sentences.zh: 我們向供應商訂的貨物要怎麼追蹤？

sentences.en: The truck is loaded with goods for the new store.
sentences.zh: 卡車裝滿了要運到新分店的貨物。

sentences.en: Do you offer a refund on damaged goods?
sentences.zh: 你們對受損的商品提供退款嗎？

sentences.en: Goods will be delivered within three business days.
sentences.zh: 貨物會在三個工作天內送達。

sentences.en: Customs officers checked the goods at the border.
sentences.zh: 海關人員在邊境檢查了貨物。

sentences.en: The free gift was a gesture of goodwill.
sentences.zh: 這份免費贈品是示好的表示。

sentences.en: Good service builds goodwill with customers.
sentences.zh: 好的服務能累積顧客的好感。

sentences.en: The buyer paid extra for the firm's goodwill.
sentences.zh: 買方為這家公司的商譽多付了錢。

sentences.en: Did the refund help restore customer goodwill?
sentences.zh: 退款有助於挽回顧客的好感嗎？

sentences.en: We sent flowers to show our goodwill.
sentences.zh: 我們送花表達善意。

sentences.en: How much of the company's value is goodwill?
sentences.zh: 這家公司的價值有多少是商譽？

sentences.en: Good governance protects both investors and employees.
sentences.zh: 良好的治理同時保護投資人與員工。

sentences.en: The board is reviewing our corporate governance rules.
sentences.zh: 董事會正在檢討我們的公司治理規則。

sentences.en: Is the city's governance transparent enough?
sentences.zh: 這座城市的治理夠透明嗎？

sentences.en: Poor governance led to the company's collapse.
sentences.zh: 治理不善導致這家公司垮台。

sentences.en: What does good governance look like for a nonprofit?
sentences.zh: 對非營利組織來說，良好的治理是什麼樣子？

sentences.en: She teaches a course on global governance.
sentences.zh: 她教一門全球治理的課。

gloss_note: 美式路坡多說 grade；gradient 多用於科學

sentences.en: Engineers measured the gradient of the hillside before building.
sentences.zh: 工程師在動工前測量了山坡的坡度。
