sentences.en: Her maternal grandmother lived in a small village.
sentences.zh: 她的外婆住在一個小村莊。

sentences.en: Does the study look at maternal health during pregnancy?
sentences.zh: 這項研究有探討懷孕期間母親的健康嗎？

sentences.en: She felt a strong maternal instinct the moment she held the baby.
sentences.zh: 她抱起寶寶的那一刻，湧起強烈的母性本能。

sentences.en: Are your maternal grandparents from Taiwan too?
sentences.zh: 你的外公外婆也是來自台灣嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors say maternal nutrition affects a baby's growth.
sentences.zh: 醫生說母親的營養會影響寶寶的成長。

sentences.en: We made a matrix to compare the three vendors.
sentences.zh: 我們做了一份矩陣表來比較這三家廠商。

sentences.en: Can you add a risk matrix to the slides?
sentences.zh: 你可以在簡報裡加一張風險矩陣嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher showed us how to multiply a matrix by a number.
sentences.zh: 老師教我們如何把矩陣乘上一個數字。

sentences.en: Each cell in the matrix shows one customer group.
sentences.zh: 矩陣中的每一格代表一個客群。

sentences.en: How many rows does this matrix have?
sentences.zh: 這個矩陣有幾列？

sentences.en: A priority matrix helps our team decide what to do first.
sentences.zh: 優先順序矩陣幫助我們團隊決定該先做什麼。

sentences.en: The bond reaches maturity in five years.
sentences.zh: 這檔債券五年後到期。

sentences.en: What is the maturity date on this loan?
sentences.zh: 這筆貸款的到期日是哪天？

sentences.en: He showed real maturity when he apologized first.
sentences.zh: 他先道歉，展現出真正的成熟。

sentences.en: Kids develop emotional maturity at different speeds.
sentences.zh: 孩子情緒成熟的速度各不相同。

sentences.en: Will the certificate of deposit renew automatically at maturity?
sentences.zh: 這張定存單到期時會自動續存嗎？

sentences.en: The company's growth slowed as the market reached maturity.
sentences.zh: 隨著市場趨於成熟，公司的成長放緩了。

sentences.en: We need to maximize our profit this quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們這一季得把利潤最大化。

sentences.en: How can we maximize the space in this small office?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼充分利用這間小辦公室的空間？

sentences.en: Click this button to maximize the window.
sentences.zh: 按下這個按鈕可以把視窗最大化。

sentences.en: Do you know a way to maximize my phone's battery life?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼讓我的手機電池續航力最大化嗎？

sentences.en: She maximized her study time by waking up early.
sentences.zh: 她提早起床，充分利用讀書時間。

sentences.en: The airline tries to maximize the number of passengers on each flight.
sentences.zh: 航空公司設法讓每個航班的乘客數達到最大。

gloss_note: in the meantime 在此期間

sentences.en: The manager is late. In the meantime, let's review the agenda.
sentences.zh: 經理遲到了。這段時間，我們先看一下議程。

sentences.en: Your order will arrive Friday. In the meantime, you can track it online.
sentences.zh: 你的訂單週五會到。在這之前，你可以上網追蹤。

sentences.en: What should I do in the meantime?
sentences.zh: 這段時間我該做什麼？

sentences.en: The doctor is running behind, so please have a seat in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 醫生會晚一點，請先坐著等一下。

sentences.en: I'll start the laundry. Could you set the table in the meantime?
sentences.zh: 我去洗衣服。你可以趁這時候擺好餐具嗎？

sentences.en: Dinner is almost ready; in the meantime, have some chips.
sentences.zh: 晚餐快好了，這段時間先吃點洋芋片吧。

sentences.en: The flight was delayed because of a mechanical problem.
sentences.zh: 班機因機械故障而延誤。

sentences.en: Does your son want to study mechanical engineering?
sentences.zh: 你兒子想念機械工程嗎？

sentences.en: The mechanical parts of this printer need regular cleaning.
sentences.zh: 這台印表機的機械零件需要定期清潔。

sentences.en: A mechanical clock has tiny gears inside.
sentences.zh: 機械式時鐘裡面有很小的齒輪。

sentences.en: Is it a mechanical keyboard or a regular one?
sentences.zh: 這是機械式鍵盤還是一般的？

sentences.en: A mechanical failure caused the factory line to stop.
sentences.zh: 機械故障導致工廠生產線停擺。

sentences.en: The media reported the news within minutes.
sentences.zh: 媒體在幾分鐘內就報導了這則消息。

sentences.en: Do you follow any social media accounts for work?
sentences.zh: 你有為了工作追蹤任何社群媒體帳號嗎？

sentences.en: Our marketing team manages all the company's social media.
sentences.zh: 我們的行銷團隊負責管理公司所有的社群媒體。

sentences.en: Have you seen the media coverage of our new store?
sentences.zh: 你看到媒體對我們新店的報導了嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor avoided talking to the media after the meeting.
sentences.zh: 會後市長不願對媒體發言。

sentences.en: Students should learn to question what they see in the media.
sentences.zh: 學生應該學著質疑自己在媒體上看到的內容。

gloss_note: mediate a dispute 調解糾紛

sentences.en: A neutral lawyer was hired to mediate the dispute.
sentences.zh: 有人請了一位中立的律師來調解這場糾紛。

sentences.en: Can you mediate between the two teams?
sentences.zh: 你可以在兩個團隊之間居中協調嗎？

sentences.en: Our manager often has to mediate when coworkers disagree.
sentences.zh: 同事意見不合時，我們經理常得出面調解。

sentences.en: Teachers sometimes mediate arguments between students.
sentences.zh: 老師有時要調解學生之間的爭吵。

sentences.en: Who will mediate the talks between the union and the company?
sentences.zh: 誰來居中調解工會與公司之間的談判？

sentences.en: She mediated the conflict so calmly that everyone relaxed.
sentences.zh: 她冷靜地調解衝突，讓每個人都放鬆下來。

sentences.en: Are you taking any medication right now?
sentences.zh: 你目前有在服用任何藥物嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep all medication out of children's reach.
sentences.zh: 請把所有藥物放在孩子拿不到的地方。

sentences.en: The nurse explained how to take the medication.
sentences.zh: 護理師說明了這個藥該怎麼吃。

sentences.en: Does this medication cause any side effects?
sentences.zh: 這種藥會有任何副作用嗎？

sentences.en: I forgot to bring my medication on the trip.
sentences.zh: 我旅行時忘了帶我的藥。

sentences.en: The doctor changed her medication last week.
sentences.zh: 醫生上週換了她的藥。

sentences.en: Every cell is surrounded by a thin membrane.
sentences.zh: 每個細胞都被一層薄膜包圍。

sentences.en: Water can pass through the membrane slowly.
sentences.zh: 水可以緩慢地穿過這層膜。

sentences.en: What does the cell membrane do?
sentences.zh: 細胞膜有什麼功用？

sentences.en: The membrane in this jacket keeps rain out but lets sweat escape.
sentences.zh: 這件外套裡的薄膜能擋雨，又能讓汗氣排出去。

sentences.en: Scientists use a special membrane to clean the water.
sentences.zh: 科學家用一種特殊的膜來淨化水。

sentences.en: Is the membrane damaged if it has tiny holes?
sentences.zh: 如果膜上有小洞，是不是就受損了？

gloss_note: send a memo 發內部通知

sentences.en: Did you see the memo about the new dress code?
sentences.zh: 你看到那份關於新服裝規定的內部通知了嗎？

sentences.en: The boss sent a memo to the whole staff.
sentences.zh: 老闆寄了一份備忘錄給全體員工。

sentences.en: I'll write a quick memo and email it to the team.
sentences.zh: 我會寫一份簡短的備忘錄，再用電子郵件寄給團隊。

sentences.en: Please read the memo before tomorrow's meeting.
sentences.zh: 請在明天的會議前看完這份備忘錄。

sentences.en: Who wrote this memo about parking?
sentences.zh: 誰寫了這份關於停車的備忘錄？

sentences.en: A memo went out Monday saying the office will close early Friday.
sentences.zh: 週一發出一份通知，說辦公室週五會提早關門。

gloss_note: 比 memo 正式，常見於法律商務

sentences.en: The lawyer drafted a memorandum summarizing the agreement.
sentences.zh: 律師起草了一份摘要協議內容的備忘錄。

sentences.en: Have both companies signed the memorandum of understanding?
sentences.zh: 兩家公司都簽了諒解備忘錄嗎？

sentences.en: Please file this memorandum with the other contract papers.
sentences.zh: 請把這份備忘錄和其他合約文件歸檔在一起。

sentences.en: The director issued a memorandum about the new safety rules.
sentences.zh: 主任發布了一份關於新安全規定的備忘錄。

sentences.en: Could you send me a copy of the memorandum?
sentences.zh: 你可以寄一份備忘錄給我嗎？

sentences.en: The memorandum explains why the project was delayed.
sentences.zh: 這份備忘錄說明了專案延誤的原因。

sentences.en: My first manager became a lifelong mentor to me.
sentences.zh: 我的第一任主管成了我一輩子的良師。

sentences.en: Do you have a mentor at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上有導師嗎？

sentences.en: She mentors new engineers every Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 她每週四下午都會指導新進工程師。

sentences.en: Could you be my mentor while I learn the job?
sentences.zh: 我學這份工作的期間，你可以當我的導師嗎？

sentences.en: A good mentor listens more than he talks.
sentences.zh: 好的導師聽得比說得多。

sentences.en: He considers his high school coach his mentor.
sentences.zh: 他把高中教練視為自己的良師。

sentences.en: The store is having a sale on all merchandise.
sentences.zh: 這家店所有商品都在特價。

sentences.en: Is the merchandise still under warranty?
sentences.zh: 這些商品還在保固期內嗎？

sentences.en: We check all merchandise before it goes on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 所有商品上架前我們都會檢查。

sentences.en: You can return unused merchandise within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 未使用的商品可以在三十天內退貨。

sentences.en: How much merchandise did the warehouse ship today?
sentences.zh: 倉庫今天出了多少貨？

sentences.en: Fans lined up to buy official concert merchandise.
sentences.zh: 粉絲排隊購買官方的演唱會週邊商品。

sentences.en: Local merchants are giving away free samples at the street fair.
sentences.zh: 當地商家在街頭市集發送免費試吃品。

sentences.en: Does this merchant accept credit cards?
sentences.zh: 這家商家接受信用卡嗎？

sentences.en: Merchants in the old town are worried about fewer tourists.
sentences.zh: 老城區的商家擔心遊客變少。

sentences.en: The card was declined, so I called the merchant.
sentences.zh: 那張卡被拒絕了，所以我打給了商家。

sentences.en: Many merchants offer free shipping on orders over fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 許多商家提供滿五十美元免運費。

sentences.en: Who is the merchant on this charge?
sentences.zh: 這筆消費的商家是誰？

sentences.en: The two banks plan to merge next year.
sentences.zh: 這兩家銀行打算明年合併。

sentences.en: Can you merge these two files into one?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這兩個檔案合併成一個嗎？

sentences.en: Cars must merge onto the highway carefully.
sentences.zh: 車輛必須小心地併入高速公路。

sentences.en: Did the two departments finally merge?
sentences.zh: 這兩個部門終於合併了嗎？

sentences.en: I merged the spreadsheets before the meeting started.
sentences.zh: 會議開始前，我把試算表合併了。

sentences.en: The two schools will merge into one next fall.
sentences.zh: 這兩所學校明年秋天會合併成一所。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Neoglitch assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The merger will create the largest airline in the country.
sentences.zh: 這樁合併案將造就全國最大的航空公司。

sentences.en: Will the merger lead to layoffs?
sentences.zh: 這次合併會導致裁員嗎？

sentences.en: Investors reacted well to news of the merger.
sentences.zh: 投資人對合併的消息反應良好。

sentences.en: When is the merger expected to close?
sentences.zh: 這樁合併案預計何時完成？

sentences.en: Our company announced a merger with a smaller rival today.
sentences.zh: 我們公司今天宣布與一家規模較小的對手合併。

sentences.en: After the merger, we all got new email addresses.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，我們全都換了新的電子郵件地址。

gloss_note: on its merits 就事論事

sentences.en: Both plans have merit, so let's discuss them.
sentences.zh: 兩個計畫都有可取之處，我們來討論一下。

sentences.en: What are the merits of working from home?
sentences.zh: 在家工作有哪些優點？

sentences.en: The idea has some merit, but it's too expensive.
sentences.zh: 這個點子有些價值，但太貴了。

sentences.en: Do you see any merit in changing our schedule?
sentences.zh: 你覺得改變我們的時間表有什麼好處嗎？

sentences.en: We should judge each proposal on its own merits.
sentences.zh: 我們應該就每份提案本身的優點來評斷。

sentences.en: The reviewer praised the merits of the new design.
sentences.zh: 評論者稱讚新設計的優點。

sentences.en: The study's methodology was explained in the first chapter.
sentences.zh: 這項研究的方法論在第一章中有說明。

sentences.en: Does your methodology work for small samples?
sentences.zh: 你的方法論適用於小樣本嗎？

sentences.en: We use an agile methodology for software projects.
sentences.zh: 我們的軟體專案採用敏捷開發的方法。

sentences.en: Critics questioned the methodology behind the survey.
sentences.zh: 批評者質疑這份調查背後的方法。

sentences.en: Can you describe your methodology in two sentences?
sentences.zh: 你能用兩句話描述你的研究方法嗎？

sentences.en: A clear methodology makes the results easier to trust.
sentences.zh: 清楚的研究方法能讓結果更值得信賴。

sentences.en: Which metric do we use to measure success?
sentences.zh: 我們用哪個指標來衡量成功？

sentences.en: Customer satisfaction is our most important metric.
sentences.zh: 顧客滿意度是我們最重要的指標。

sentences.en: Does this metric include online sales?
sentences.zh: 這項指標有包含網路銷售嗎？

sentences.en: We track several metrics, such as sales and returns.
sentences.zh: 我們追蹤幾項指標，像是銷售額和退貨量。

sentences.en: The team's performance metrics improved this quarter.
sentences.zh: 團隊的績效指標這一季有進步。

sentences.en: The report lacks a clear metric for quality.
sentences.zh: 這份報告缺少明確的品質衡量標準。

sentences.en: Let's get Mexican food for lunch today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天午餐吃墨西哥菜吧。

sentences.en: Is there a good Mexican restaurant around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有好吃的墨西哥餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor is Mexican, and she makes amazing tamales.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居是墨西哥人，她做的玉米粽好好吃。

sentences.en: Would you like Mexican rice or beans with that?
sentences.zh: 這份餐點你要配墨西哥飯還是豆子？

sentences.en: Mexican cuisine uses a lot of corn and chili.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥料理大量使用玉米和辣椒。

sentences.en: We celebrated her birthday at a Mexican grill downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們在市區一家墨西哥燒烤餐廳幫她慶生。

gloss_note: under the microscope 在顯微鏡下

sentences.en: We looked at onion cells under the microscope.
sentences.zh: 我們用顯微鏡觀察洋蔥細胞。

sentences.en: Can I use the microscope in the lab today?
sentences.zh: 我今天可以用實驗室的顯微鏡嗎？

sentences.en: The microscope magnifies the sample a hundred times.
sentences.zh: 這台顯微鏡可以把樣本放大一百倍。

sentences.en: Please carry the microscope with both hands.
sentences.zh: 請用雙手搬顯微鏡。

sentences.en: Where did you buy this toy microscope?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡買到這個玩具顯微鏡的？

sentences.en: Scientists used a powerful microscope to study the virus.
sentences.zh: 科學家用高倍顯微鏡研究那種病毒。

sentences.en: Bird migration begins in early fall.
sentences.zh: 鳥類的遷徙從初秋開始。

sentences.en: The migration of workers to big cities has increased.
sentences.zh: 勞工遷往大城市的現象增加了。

sentences.en: What causes the yearly migration of whales?
sentences.zh: 是什麼導致鯨魚每年的遷徙？

sentences.en: The city is studying how migration affects housing prices.
sentences.zh: 這座城市正在研究人口遷移如何影響房價。

sentences.en: Is migration from rural areas slowing down?
sentences.zh: 鄉村人口外移的情形有減緩嗎？

sentences.en: Climate change may affect the migration patterns of many animals.
sentences.zh: 氣候變遷可能影響許多動物的遷徙模式。

gloss_note: a militant union 強硬激進的工會

sentences.en: The union took a more militant stance during the talks.
sentences.zh: 工會在談判期間採取了較激進強硬的立場。

sentences.en: Is the group militant, or do they prefer peaceful protest?
sentences.zh: 這個團體很激進嗎，還是他們偏好和平抗議？

sentences.en: She is a militant campaigner for cleaner rivers.
sentences.zh: 她是為了乾淨河川而積極奔走的激進倡議者。

sentences.en: Is the new union leader more militant than the last one?
sentences.zh: 新的工會領袖比上一任更激進嗎？

sentences.en: The article describes the group's militant tactics during the strike.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章描述了該團體在罷工期間的激進手段。

sentences.en: Why did the workers turn so militant last month?
sentences.zh: 工人上個月為什麼變得那麼激進？

sentences.en: This water contains many natural minerals.
sentences.zh: 這種水含有許多天然礦物質。

sentences.en: Which minerals are found in this region?
sentences.zh: 這個地區有哪些礦物？

sentences.en: Calcium is an important mineral for strong bones.
sentences.zh: 鈣是強健骨骼的重要礦物質。

sentences.en: Do you take vitamin and mineral supplements?
sentences.zh: 你有吃維他命和礦物質補充品嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has a large collection of rocks and minerals.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有大量的岩石與礦物收藏。

sentences.en: Mining companies search for valuable minerals underground.
sentences.zh: 採礦公司在地下尋找有價值的礦物。

sentences.en: The damage to the car was minimal.
sentences.zh: 車子的損傷微乎其微。

sentences.en: We want minimal changes to the original design.
sentences.zh: 我們希望對原始設計只做最少的更動。

sentences.en: Is the risk really minimal?
sentences.zh: 這風險真的微乎其微嗎？

sentences.en: With minimal training, new staff can start right away.
sentences.zh: 只要極少量的訓練，新員工就能馬上開始工作。

sentences.en: Do you need minimal or full coverage on your insurance?
sentences.zh: 你的保險要最低限度還是完整的保障？

sentences.en: Researchers found minimal differences between the two groups.
sentences.zh: 研究人員發現兩組之間幾乎沒有差異。

sentences.en: We should minimize the risk before we launch.
sentences.zh: 我們在上市前應該把風險降到最低。

sentences.en: How can we minimize waste in the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 我們怎樣才能把廚房的浪費降到最低？

sentences.en: Can we minimize the time customers wait in line?
sentences.zh: 我們能把顧客排隊等候的時間降到最短嗎？

sentences.en: Wearing a seat belt minimizes the chance of injury.
sentences.zh: 繫安全帶能把受傷的機率降到最低。

sentences.en: Does stretching minimize muscle pain after exercise?
sentences.zh: 伸展能把運動後的肌肉痠痛降到最低嗎？

sentences.en: She minimized costs by buying in bulk.
sentences.zh: 她靠大量採購把成本降到最低。

sentences.en: The Ministry of Education announced a new school calendar.
sentences.zh: 教育部公布了新的學校行事曆。

sentences.en: Which ministry handles business licenses in your country?
sentences.zh: 在你的國家，哪個部會負責營業執照？

sentences.en: She works for the foreign ministry.
sentences.zh: 她在外交部工作。

sentences.en: A ministry official spoke to reporters this morning.
sentences.zh: 一位部會官員今天早上對記者發表談話。

sentences.en: Does the ministry plan to raise fuel prices?
sentences.zh: 該部會打算調高油價嗎？

sentences.en: The ministry released the latest unemployment figures.
sentences.zh: 該部公布了最新的失業數據。

sentences.en: I don't want to mislead our customers.
sentences.zh: 我不想誤導我們的客戶。

sentences.en: Does this label mislead shoppers about the ingredients?
sentences.zh: 這個標籤會讓購物者對成分產生誤解嗎？

sentences.en: The headline misled many readers.
sentences.zh: 這個標題誤導了許多讀者。

sentences.en: Please don't let the low price mislead you.
sentences.zh: 別讓低價誤導了你。

sentences.en: Did the salesman mislead you about the warranty?
sentences.zh: 業務員在保固的事情上誤導了你嗎？

sentences.en: Statistics can mislead if they leave out important facts.
sentences.zh: 如果遺漏重要事實，統計數據可能會誤導人。

gloss_note: misplace keys 忘了鑰匙放哪

sentences.en: I misplaced my keys again this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我又不知道把鑰匙放到哪去了。

sentences.en: Did you misplace the contract?
sentences.zh: 你把合約放到找不到了嗎？

sentences.en: We must have misplaced the receipt during the move.
sentences.zh: 搬家時我們一定是把收據放錯地方了。

sentences.en: She misplaced her passport somewhere in the hotel room.
sentences.zh: 她把護照放在飯店房間的某處，卻找不到了。

sentences.en: Could the file have been misplaced in another folder?
sentences.zh: 這個檔案會不會被放錯到別的資料夾？

sentences.en: Try not to misplace your boarding pass.
sentences.zh: 盡量別把登機證放到找不到。

sentences.en: I'll have a medium mocha, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯中杯摩卡，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Does the mocha come with whipped cream?
sentences.zh: 這杯摩卡有附鮮奶油嗎？

sentences.en: She ordered an iced mocha with extra chocolate.
sentences.zh: 她點了一杯加量巧克力的冰摩卡。

sentences.en: A hot mocha is perfect on a cold morning.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的早晨來杯熱摩卡最棒了。

sentences.en: Which do you prefer, a latte or a mocha?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡拿鐵還是摩卡？

sentences.en: Can I get my mocha without sugar?
sentences.zh: 我的摩卡可以不加糖嗎？

sentences.en: Preheat the oven to a moderate temperature, about 350 degrees.
sentences.zh: 把烤箱預熱到中等溫度，大約華氏350度。

sentences.en: Is the spice level moderate, or is it very hot?
sentences.zh: 辣度是中等，還是很辣？

sentences.en: Eat a moderate amount of rice at dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐吃適量的米飯。

sentences.en: Cook the onions over moderate heat until soft.
sentences.zh: 用中火把洋蔥煮軟。

sentences.en: Are the prices at this restaurant moderate?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的價格適中嗎？

sentences.en: Moderate exercise and a balanced diet keep you healthy.
sentences.zh: 適度的運動和均衡的飲食能讓你保持健康。

sentences.en: The company reported modest growth this quarter.
sentences.zh: 公司這一季的成長幅度不大。

sentences.en: She is very modest about her success.
sentences.zh: 她對自己的成功十分謙虛。

sentences.en: Why is he so modest about his achievements?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼對自己的成就這麼謙虛？

sentences.en: They are only asking for a modest fee.
sentences.zh: 他們只收取少許費用。

sentences.en: Can we expect more than a modest raise this year?
sentences.zh: 我們今年能期待加薪幅度不只是一點點嗎？

sentences.en: Sales showed a modest increase after the ad campaign.
sentences.zh: 廣告活動之後，銷售額小幅上升。

sentences.en: The design needs a few modifications before approval.
sentences.zh: 這份設計在核准前需要一些修改。

sentences.en: Do you have any modifications to suggest?
sentences.zh: 你有什麼修改建議嗎？

sentences.en: We made a small modification to the contract.
sentences.zh: 我們對合約做了小幅修改。

sentences.en: The modification will cost an extra two hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 這項修改要多花兩百美元。

sentences.en: Has the modification been approved yet?
sentences.zh: 這項修改核准了嗎？

sentences.en: Any modification to the schedule must be approved by the manager.
sentences.zh: 任何時程上的調整都必須經過經理核准。

sentences.en: The class studied molecular structure today.
sentences.zh: 這堂課今天學習分子結構。

sentences.en: She works in a molecular biology lab.
sentences.zh: 她在分子生物學實驗室工作。

sentences.en: Is the molecular weight of water eighteen?
sentences.zh: 水的分子量是十八嗎？

sentences.en: Molecular cooking uses science to create new textures.
sentences.zh: 分子料理運用科學創造新的口感。

sentences.en: What is the molecular formula of sugar?
sentences.zh: 糖的分子式是什麼？

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the molecular changes in the cells.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究細胞的分子變化。

sentences.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
sentences.zh: 一個水分子有兩個氫原子和一個氧原子。

sentences.en: How many molecules are in this sample?
sentences.zh: 這個樣本裡有多少分子？

sentences.en: Heat makes the molecules move faster.
sentences.zh: 熱會讓分子運動得更快。

sentences.en: The molecule is too small to see, even with a regular microscope.
sentences.zh: 這個分子太小了，就算用一般顯微鏡也看不見。

sentences.en: Can you draw the sugar molecule on the board?
sentences.zh: 你可以在黑板上畫出糖分子嗎？

sentences.en: Researchers designed a new molecule to fight the disease.
sentences.zh: 研究人員設計了一種對抗該疾病的新分子。

sentences.en: The central bank announced a new monetary policy.
sentences.zh: 中央銀行宣布了新的貨幣政策。

sentences.en: Has the monetary value of the painting been determined?
sentences.zh: 這幅畫的金錢價值已經確定了嗎？

sentences.en: The loss was not only monetary; it hurt his reputation too.
sentences.zh: 那次損失不只是金錢上的，也傷到他的名聲。

sentences.en: Does the fund offer monetary rewards to volunteers?
sentences.zh: 這個基金會有提供志工金錢獎勵嗎？

sentences.en: Monetary gifts are common at Taiwanese weddings.
sentences.zh: 在台灣的婚禮上，送禮金很普遍。

sentences.en: The company paid a monetary penalty for breaking the rule.
sentences.zh: 公司因違反規定而繳納了罰款。

gloss_note: break a monopoly 打破壟斷

sentences.en: One company held a monopoly on local internet service.
sentences.zh: 有一家公司壟斷了當地的網路服務。

sentences.en: Is the company's monopoly legal in this state?
sentences.zh: 這家公司的獨占在這個州合法嗎？

sentences.en: The government broke up the monopoly to protect consumers.
sentences.zh: 政府拆解了這個壟斷，以保護消費者。

sentences.en: Prices rise when a single seller has a monopoly.
sentences.zh: 當單一賣家壟斷市場時，價格就會上漲。

sentences.en: Why does one firm have a monopoly on this product?
sentences.zh: 為什麼單一公司能獨占這項產品？

sentences.en: Our town's water company is a natural monopoly.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上的自來水公司屬於自然壟斷。

gloss_note: in the mood for 想要…

sentences.en: I'm in the mood for pizza tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚想吃披薩。

sentences.en: What are you in the mood for, sushi or pasta?
sentences.zh: 你想吃什麼，壽司還是義大利麵？

sentences.en: Good food always puts me in a good mood.
sentences.zh: 美食總是讓我心情變好。

sentences.en: He was in a bad mood because the kitchen was out of fish.
sentences.zh: 因為廚房的魚賣完了，他心情很差。

sentences.en: Are you in the mood for something sweet?
sentences.zh: 你想吃點甜的嗎？

sentences.en: I'm not in the mood to cook after work.
sentences.zh: 下班後我沒心情下廚。

sentences.en: Linguists study the morphological structure of words.
sentences.zh: 語言學家研究字詞的構詞結構。

sentences.en: Are there morphological differences between the two species?
sentences.zh: 這兩個物種之間有形態上的差異嗎？

sentences.en: The morphological features of the fossil suggest it was a bird.
sentences.zh: 這個化石的形態特徵顯示牠是一種鳥。

sentences.en: Morphological changes in the leaf were visible after a week.
sentences.zh: 一週後，葉子的形態變化就看得出來了。

sentences.en: What morphological rules explain how plurals are formed?
sentences.zh: 哪些構詞規則解釋了複數的形成方式？

sentences.en: Her paper focuses on morphological development in children's speech.
sentences.zh: 她的論文聚焦在兒童語言中的構詞發展。

sentences.en: She is taking a course in English morphology.
sentences.zh: 她正在修一門英語構詞學的課。

sentences.en: Plant morphology is the study of a plant's shape and structure.
sentences.zh: 植物形態學研究植物的外形與構造。

sentences.en: Does the morphology of the cell change over time?
sentences.zh: 細胞的形態會隨時間改變嗎？

sentences.en: Morphology helps us understand how words are built.
sentences.zh: 構詞學幫助我們了解字是如何組成的。

sentences.en: Which book covers the morphology of Chinese words?
sentences.zh: 哪本書談到中文詞彙的構詞？

sentences.en: Scientists compared the bone morphology of the two animals.
sentences.zh: 科學家比較了這兩種動物的骨骼形態。

sentences.en: Infant mortality has dropped sharply in recent decades.
sentences.zh: 近幾十年來嬰兒死亡率大幅下降。

sentences.en: What is the mortality rate for this disease?
sentences.zh: 這種疾病的死亡率是多少？

sentences.en: Better hospitals have reduced mortality in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 更好的醫院降低了鄉村地區的死亡率。

sentences.en: The report links air pollution to higher mortality.
sentences.zh: 這份報告將空氣污染與較高的死亡率連結起來。

sentences.en: Did mortality rise during the cold winter?
sentences.zh: 在寒冷的冬季，死亡率有上升嗎？

sentences.en: Mortality figures for the region are published every year.
sentences.zh: 該地區的死亡數據每年都會公布。

sentences.en: She works for a multinational bank in New York.
sentences.zh: 她在紐約一家跨國銀行工作。

sentences.en: Is your company a multinational?
sentences.zh: 你們公司是跨國企業嗎？

sentences.en: Multinational firms often have offices in many countries.
sentences.zh: 跨國企業通常在許多國家都設有辦公室。

sentences.en: The multinational plans to open a new plant next year.
sentences.zh: 這家跨國公司計畫明年開設新工廠。

sentences.en: Working for a multinational means dealing with different time zones.
sentences.zh: 在跨國公司工作，意味著要應付不同的時區。

sentences.en: Do multinational companies pay higher salaries here?
sentences.zh: 跨國公司在這裡薪水比較高嗎？

sentences.en: Municipal workers fixed the broken streetlight.
sentences.zh: 市政人員修好了壞掉的路燈。

sentences.en: Is this a municipal park or a private one?
sentences.zh: 這是市立公園還是私人公園？

sentences.en: The municipal government plans to build a new library.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫興建一座新圖書館。

sentences.en: You need a municipal permit to open a food stand.
sentences.zh: 你需要市府許可證才能開小吃攤。

sentences.en: Does the municipal pool open in June?
sentences.zh: 市立游泳池六月開放嗎？

sentences.en: Municipal bonds help cities pay for roads and schools.
sentences.zh: 市政債券幫助城市支付道路與學校的費用。

sentences.en: A single mutation changed the color of the flower.
sentences.zh: 一個突變改變了這朵花的顏色。

sentences.en: Can a mutation be passed on to children?
sentences.zh: 突變可以遺傳給孩子嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists found a mutation in the gene linked to the disease.
sentences.zh: 科學家在與該疾病相關的基因中發現了一個突變。

sentences.en: Most mutations are harmless to the body.
sentences.zh: 大部分的突變對身體無害。

sentences.en: Why do viruses keep developing new mutations?
sentences.zh: 為什麼病毒會不斷出現新的突變？

sentences.en: The mutation rate in bacteria is surprisingly high.
sentences.zh: 細菌的突變率高得驚人。

sentences.en: Only one thing matters to me, namely my family.
sentences.zh: 對我來說只有一件事重要，那就是我的家人。

sentences.en: We need two things, namely time and money.
sentences.zh: 我們需要兩樣東西，也就是時間和金錢。

sentences.en: Two students failed, namely Jake and Lily.
sentences.zh: 有兩位學生不及格，就是傑克和莉莉。

sentences.en: The factory has a problem, namely a lack of workers.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠有個問題，那就是缺工。

sentences.en: Are you talking about my old job, namely the one at the bank?
sentences.zh: 你說的是我以前的工作，也就是在銀行的那一份嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a third option, namely waiting until next week?
sentences.zh: 有沒有第三種選擇，也就是等到下週？

gloss_zh: 民族主義者；民族主義的
gloss_note: nationalist movement 民族主義運動

sentences.en: The history book describes a famous nationalist from the nineteenth century.
sentences.zh: 這本歷史書描述了一位十九世紀著名的民族主義者。

sentences.en: Who was the leader of the nationalist movement in the film?
sentences.zh: 電影裡民族主義運動的領導人是誰？

sentences.en: The documentary explains how nationalist ideas spread across Europe.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片解釋了民族主義思想如何傳遍歐洲。

sentences.en: In class, we discussed what makes someone a nationalist.
sentences.zh: 在課堂上，我們討論了怎樣的人算是民族主義者。

sentences.en: Does the textbook explain why nationalist movements grew in the nineteenth century?
sentences.zh: 課本有解釋十九世紀民族主義運動為什麼興起嗎？

sentences.en: Nationalist feelings often grow stronger during sports events.
sentences.zh: 在體育賽事期間，民族主義的情緒常會變得更強烈。

sentences.en: The brain contains billions of neural connections.
sentences.zh: 大腦含有數十億個神經連結。

sentences.en: Does the drug affect neural activity?
sentences.zh: 這種藥會影響神經活動嗎？

sentences.en: Neural pathways grow stronger with practice.
sentences.zh: 神經通路會隨著練習變得更強。

sentences.en: Researchers recorded neural signals from the mouse's brain.
sentences.zh: 研究人員記錄了老鼠大腦的神經訊號。

sentences.en: What is a neural network in computer science?
sentences.zh: 電腦科學中的類神經網路是什麼？

sentences.en: Damage to neural tissue can be hard to repair.
sentences.zh: 神經組織受損可能很難修復。

sentences.en: The human brain has billions of neurons.
sentences.zh: 人腦有數十億個神經元。

sentences.en: How does a neuron send a signal?
sentences.zh: 神經元如何傳送訊號？

sentences.en: Each neuron connects to thousands of others.
sentences.zh: 每個神經元都與數千個其他神經元相連。

sentences.en: Neurons carry messages between the brain and the body.
sentences.zh: 神經元在大腦與身體之間傳遞訊息。

sentences.en: Do neurons grow back after an injury?
sentences.zh: 神經元受傷後會重新生長嗎？

sentences.en: The scientist studied a single neuron under the microscope.
sentences.zh: 這位科學家在顯微鏡下研究單一神經元。

sentences.en: The mediator stayed neutral during the argument.
sentences.zh: 調解人在爭執中保持中立。

sentences.en: Can we meet at a neutral location?
sentences.zh: 我們可以約在中立的地點見面嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a neutral color so it would match everything.
sentences.zh: 她穿了中性色的衣服，這樣什麼都能搭。

sentences.en: Try to keep your tone neutral in the email.
sentences.zh: 請盡量讓你的郵件語氣保持中性。

sentences.en: Is this paint beige or a neutral gray?
sentences.zh: 這款油漆是米色還是中性灰？

sentences.en: The news report was neutral and stuck to the facts.
sentences.zh: 這則新聞報導立場中立，只談事實。

gloss_note: sign up for 訂閱電子報

sentences.en: Did you subscribe to the company newsletter?
sentences.zh: 你有訂閱公司的電子報嗎？

sentences.en: Our monthly newsletter goes out on the first of each month.
sentences.zh: 我們的月刊電子報會在每月一號寄出。

sentences.en: I always delete newsletters I never asked for.
sentences.zh: 我總是刪掉那些我沒訂閱的電子報。

sentences.en: The school newsletter lists all the events this month.
sentences.zh: 學校通訊列出了這個月所有的活動。

sentences.en: Where can I sign up for your newsletter?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡訂閱你們的電子報？

sentences.en: She writes a weekly newsletter about healthy cooking.
sentences.zh: 她每週寫一份關於健康烹飪的電子報。

sentences.en: I bought a magazine at the newsstand near the station.
sentences.zh: 我在車站附近的報攤買了一本雜誌。

sentences.en: Is there a newsstand in the airport terminal?
sentences.zh: 機場航廈裡有報攤嗎？

sentences.en: The newsstand opens at six every morning.
sentences.zh: 這個報攤每天早上六點開張。

sentences.en: He picked up a newspaper from the newsstand on his way to work.
sentences.zh: 他上班途中在報攤買了份報紙。

sentences.en: Fewer newsstands survive now that people read the news online.
sentences.zh: 現在大家上網看新聞，剩下的報攤變少了。

sentences.en: Does the newsstand sell city maps and postcards?
sentences.zh: 這個報攤有賣城市地圖和明信片嗎？

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: Each node in the network connects to three others.
sentences.zh: 網路中的每個節點都與另外三個節點相連。

sentences.en: What happens if one node fails?
sentences.zh: 如果其中一個節點故障會怎樣？

sentences.en: The server is the main node of our system.
sentences.zh: 這台伺服器是我們系統的主要節點。

sentences.en: Can you add a new node to the diagram?
sentences.zh: 你可以在圖表裡加一個新節點嗎？

sentences.en: A tree has a root node and many child nodes.
sentences.zh: 樹狀結構有一個根節點和許多子節點。

sentences.en: Engineers restarted the faulty node overnight.
sentences.zh: 工程師在夜間重新啟動了故障的節點。

sentences.en: The museum charges only a nominal fee for entry.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館只收象徵性的入場費。

sentences.en: He is the nominal head of the company, but his daughter runs it.
sentences.zh: 他名義上是公司負責人，但實際由他女兒經營。

sentences.en: She is only a nominal member of the club; she never comes to meetings.
sentences.zh: 她只是這個社團名義上的成員，從來不來開會。

sentences.en: Is the delivery fee nominal or the full price?
sentences.zh: 運費是象徵性收費，還是全額？

sentences.en: Did you pay only a nominal amount for the old furniture?
sentences.zh: 你買舊家具只付了象徵性的金額嗎？

sentences.en: Tickets cost a nominal ten dollars for students.
sentences.zh: 學生票只收象徵性的十美元。

gloss_note: nominate someone for 提名某人當…

sentences.en: Who would you nominate for employee of the month?
sentences.zh: 你會提名誰當本月最佳員工？

sentences.en: I'd like to nominate Mia for class president.
sentences.zh: 我想提名米雅當班長。

sentences.en: The film was nominated for six awards.
sentences.zh: 這部電影獲得六項獎項提名。

sentences.en: Please nominate a coworker who deserves recognition.
sentences.zh: 請提名一位值得表揚的同事。

sentences.en: Has anyone nominated you for the scholarship?
sentences.zh: 有人推薦你申請獎學金嗎？

sentences.en: The committee will nominate three candidates by Friday.
sentences.zh: 委員會會在週五前提名三位候選人。

gloss_note: 口語常用 still 或 even so

sentences.en: The test was hard; nonetheless, most students passed.
sentences.zh: 考試很難，儘管如此，大部分學生還是通過了。

sentences.en: It's raining. Nonetheless, we'll go hiking.
sentences.zh: 正在下雨。儘管如此，我們還是要去健行。

sentences.en: Why did you sign the contract nonetheless?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼還是簽了合約？

sentences.en: The price is high, but it is a good deal nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 價格很高，但還是很划算。

sentences.en: Is it worth trying nonetheless?
sentences.zh: 儘管如此，還是值得一試嗎？

sentences.en: She was tired but finished the report nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 她很累，但還是把報告寫完了。

gloss_note: nonlinear equation 非線性方程式

sentences.en: The graph shows a nonlinear relationship between age and income.
sentences.zh: 圖表顯示年齡與收入之間呈非線性關係。

sentences.en: Is the growth in sales linear or nonlinear?
sentences.zh: 銷售成長是線性還是非線性？

sentences.en: Weather systems are nonlinear and hard to predict.
sentences.zh: 天氣系統是非線性的，很難預測。

sentences.en: Nonlinear equations are harder to solve by hand.
sentences.zh: 非線性方程式用手算比較難解。

sentences.en: Why does the data follow a nonlinear curve?
sentences.zh: 為什麼資料呈現非線性曲線？

sentences.en: The story has a nonlinear structure, jumping between past and present.
sentences.zh: 這個故事是非線性結構，在過去與現在之間跳躍。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: Working from home has become the norm.
sentences.zh: 在家工作已成為常態。

sentences.en: What are the cultural norms for tipping here?
sentences.zh: 這裡給小費的文化慣例是什麼？

sentences.en: Social norms vary from country to country.
sentences.zh: 社會規範因國家而異。

sentences.en: Is it the norm to bring a gift to a dinner party?
sentences.zh: 參加晚餐聚會帶禮物是慣例嗎？

sentences.en: Sales this month are well below the norm.
sentences.zh: 這個月的銷售額遠低於正常水準。

sentences.en: Employees who break company norms may be warned.
sentences.zh: 違反公司規範的員工可能會受到警告。

sentences.en: Several people helped, notably my neighbor.
sentences.zh: 好幾個人幫了忙，尤其是我的鄰居。

sentences.en: Sales rose in several regions, notably in the West.
sentences.zh: 好幾個地區的銷售都上升，尤其是西部。

sentences.en: Have prices gone up, notably for fuel and food?
sentences.zh: 物價有上漲嗎，尤其是燃料和食物？

sentences.en: The team has changed notably since last year.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊自去年以來有明顯的改變。

sentences.en: Is the new model better, notably in battery life?
sentences.zh: 新機型比較好嗎，尤其是電池續航力？

sentences.en: Several companies, notably two banks, have raised their rates.
sentences.zh: 好幾家公司，尤其是兩家銀行，調高了利率。

sentences.en: Musical notation can look confusing at first.
sentences.zh: 樂譜記號一開始看起來可能很混亂。

sentences.en: What does this notation mean in the formula?
sentences.zh: 公式裡的這個符號是什麼意思？

sentences.en: Scientific notation makes very large numbers easier to write.
sentences.zh: 科學記號法讓非常大的數字更容易書寫。

sentences.en: Do you know how to read chess notation?
sentences.zh: 你會看西洋棋的記譜法嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher wrote the notation on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師把符號寫在黑板上。

sentences.en: Different books use different notation for the same idea.
sentences.zh: 不同的書對同一個概念使用不同的記號。

gloss_note: notify sb of sth 通知某人某事

sentences.en: Please notify me as soon as the package arrives.
sentences.zh: 包裹一到請立刻通知我。

sentences.en: Will the bank notify you if there's a problem?
sentences.zh: 如果有問題，銀行會通知你嗎？

sentences.en: We'll notify all employees about the schedule change.
sentences.zh: 我們會通知所有員工時間表的變更。

sentences.en: Who should I notify if I'm going to be late?
sentences.zh: 如果我會遲到，應該通知誰？

sentences.en: The airline notified passengers that the flight was canceled.
sentences.zh: 航空公司通知乘客班機已取消。

sentences.en: The school notifies parents by text message.
sentences.zh: 學校用簡訊通知家長。

sentences.en: The nucleus controls the activities of the cell.
sentences.zh: 細胞核控制細胞的活動。

sentences.en: An atom has a nucleus made of protons and neutrons.
sentences.zh: 原子有由質子和中子組成的原子核。

sentences.en: Where is the nucleus in this diagram?
sentences.zh: 這張圖中的細胞核在哪裡？

sentences.en: The nucleus is much smaller than the whole atom.
sentences.zh: 原子核比整個原子小得多。

sentences.en: Does every cell have a nucleus?
sentences.zh: 每個細胞都有細胞核嗎？

sentences.en: Students labeled the nucleus on their cell drawings.
sentences.zh: 學生在他們畫的細胞圖上標出細胞核。

sentences.en: Please put the files in numerical order.
sentences.zh: 請把檔案依數字順序排好。

sentences.en: The spreadsheet contains only numerical data.
sentences.zh: 這份試算表只含數值資料。

sentences.en: Is the numerical value higher than last year?
sentences.zh: 這個數值比去年高嗎？

sentences.en: Enter a numerical code to unlock the door.
sentences.zh: 輸入數字密碼來開門。

sentences.en: Can you explain the numerical results in the table?
sentences.zh: 你能解釋表格中的數值結果嗎？

sentences.en: Numerical scores are easier to compare than comments.
sentences.zh: 數字評分比文字評語更容易比較。

sentences.en: The law obliges companies to report their earnings.
sentences.zh: 法律規定公司必須申報收益。

sentences.en: Did you feel obliged to help after she gave you a ride?
sentences.zh: 她載了你一程之後，你有覺得非幫忙不可嗎？

sentences.en: We would be obliged if you could reply by Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果你能在週五前回覆，我們會很感激。

sentences.en: Are employees obliged to work on holidays?
sentences.zh: 員工在假日有義務上班嗎？

sentences.en: Rain obliged us to cancel the picnic.
sentences.zh: 下雨迫使我們取消野餐。

sentences.en: Thank you, I'm much obliged for your help.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你，我非常感激你的幫忙。

sentences.en: An outside observer watched the meeting but didn't speak.
sentences.zh: 一位外部觀察員旁聽了會議，但沒有發言。

sentences.en: As a casual observer, I noticed the café was always empty.
sentences.zh: 以一個普通觀察者的角度，我發現那家咖啡店總是沒什麼人。

sentences.en: Why was an observer sent to the lab?
sentences.zh: 為什麼會派一位觀察員到實驗室？

sentences.en: Industry observers expect prices to fall next year.
sentences.zh: 業界觀察家預期明年價格會下跌。

sentences.en: The observer recorded how long each child played.
sentences.zh: 觀察者記錄了每個孩子玩了多久。

sentences.en: Are you a participant or just an observer today?
sentences.zh: 你今天是參與者還是只是觀察者？

gloss_note: overcome an obstacle 克服障礙

sentences.en: Lack of money is the biggest obstacle for our project.
sentences.zh: 缺錢是我們專案最大的障礙。

sentences.en: How can we overcome this obstacle?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼克服這個障礙？

sentences.en: A fallen tree was an obstacle on the road.
sentences.zh: 一棵倒下的樹擋在路上。

sentences.en: Language can be an obstacle when you move abroad.
sentences.zh: 搬到國外時，語言可能成為障礙。

sentences.en: Do you see any obstacles to finishing on time?
sentences.zh: 你看得出有什麼阻礙我們準時完成嗎？

sentences.en: The runners jumped over each obstacle on the track.
sentences.zh: 跑者跳過了跑道上的每個障礙物。

gloss_note: obtain a permit 取得許可證

sentences.en: You need to obtain a permit before building.
sentences.zh: 建造前你需要取得許可證。

sentences.en: Where can I obtain a copy of my birth certificate?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡取得出生證明的副本？

sentences.en: She obtained a degree in finance last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年取得了財務學位。

sentences.en: How did you obtain this information?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼取得這項資訊的？

sentences.en: Tickets can be obtained at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 票可以在櫃檯取得。

sentences.en: The company obtained approval from the city.
sentences.zh: 公司取得了市政府的核准。

gloss_note: maximum occupancy 最大容納人數

sentences.en: Hotel occupancy is high during the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏季的飯店入住率很高。

sentences.en: What is the maximum occupancy of this room?
sentences.zh: 這個房間的最大容納人數是多少？

sentences.en: The occupancy limit for this meeting room is eight people.
sentences.zh: 這間會議室的容納人數上限是八人。

sentences.en: Occupancy rates fell after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，入住率下降了。

sentences.en: Does the hotel report its occupancy every month?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店每個月都會公布入住率嗎？

sentences.en: Fire rules limit occupancy to one hundred people.
sentences.zh: 消防規定把容納人數限制在一百人。

sentences.en: Please write your name and occupation on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上填寫姓名與職業。

sentences.en: What is your current occupation, if you don't mind me asking?
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意我問的話，你目前的職業是什麼？

sentences.en: His occupation requires a lot of travel.
sentences.zh: 他的職業需要經常出差。

sentences.en: Teaching is a rewarding occupation.
sentences.zh: 教書是個很有成就感的職業。

sentences.en: Do you list your occupation on the visa application?
sentences.zh: 你有在簽證申請表上填寫職業嗎？

sentences.en: Many people in this town share the same occupation, fishing.
sentences.zh: 這個鎮上有許多人從事同一種職業：捕魚。

gloss_note: a rare occurrence 罕見的事

sentences.en: Power outages are a rare occurrence here.
sentences.zh: 停電在這裡很少發生。

sentences.en: Is this error a common occurrence?
sentences.zh: 這種錯誤很常出現嗎？

sentences.en: The occurrence of the disease is increasing.
sentences.zh: 這種疾病的發生率正在上升。

sentences.en: Please report any unusual occurrence to the front desk.
sentences.zh: 任何異常狀況請通報櫃檯。

sentences.en: Has the occurrence of flooding increased in this area?
sentences.zh: 這個地區的淹水情形增加了嗎？

sentences.en: Coffee spills are an everyday occurrence in our office.
sentences.zh: 咖啡灑出來是我們辦公室的日常。

sentences.en: Lower costs helped offset the drop in sales.
sentences.zh: 成本降低有助於抵銷銷售的下滑。

sentences.en: Can we offset the shipping fee with a discount?
sentences.zh: 我們能用折扣來抵掉運費嗎？

sentences.en: Planting trees can offset some of your carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 植樹可以抵銷你部分的碳排放。

sentences.en: Her salary increase was offset by higher rent.
sentences.zh: 她的加薪被更高的房租抵銷了。

sentences.en: The gains in Asia offset the losses in Europe.
sentences.zh: 亞洲的獲利彌補了歐洲的虧損。

sentences.en: Does the company offset its travel emissions?
sentences.zh: 這家公司有抵銷旅行產生的碳排放嗎？

gloss_note: offshore wind farm 離岸風場

sentences.en: Many companies run offshore call centers to save money.
sentences.zh: 許多公司設立海外客服中心來省錢。

sentences.en: Is that an offshore wind farm?
sentences.zh: 那是離岸風力發電場嗎？

sentences.en: Offshore drilling is a hot topic in the news.
sentences.zh: 離岸鑽油是新聞中的熱門話題。

sentences.en: Our manufacturing is offshore, mostly in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 我們的製造在海外，大部分在越南。

sentences.en: Offshore workers spend weeks away from home.
sentences.zh: 離岸作業的工人要離家好幾週。

sentences.en: Do you outsource to an offshore team?
sentences.zh: 你們有外包給海外的團隊嗎？

sentences.en: Could I have extra olives on my pizza?
sentences.zh: 我的披薩可以多加一些橄欖嗎？

sentences.en: Olive oil is common in Mediterranean cooking.
sentences.zh: 橄欖油常見於地中海料理。

sentences.en: She wore an olive jacket with white sneakers.
sentences.zh: 她穿著橄欖綠外套配白色球鞋。

sentences.en: Do you want green or black olives in your salad?
sentences.zh: 你的沙拉要綠橄欖還是黑橄欖？

sentences.en: I don't like the salty taste of olives.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡橄欖的鹹味。

sentences.en: The farm grows olive trees on the hillside.
sentences.zh: 農場在山坡上種植橄欖樹。

gloss_note: onset of winter 冬天開始

sentences.en: The onset of winter made the roads icy.
sentences.zh: 冬天一開始，道路就結冰了。

sentences.en: Early treatment can delay the onset of the disease.
sentences.zh: 及早治療可以延後疾病的發作。

sentences.en: When was the onset of your symptoms?
sentences.zh: 你的症狀是什麼時候開始的？

sentences.en: At the onset of the crisis, the company cut costs.
sentences.zh: 危機一開始，公司就削減了成本。

sentences.en: Is this the onset of a cold?
sentences.zh: 這是感冒的開端嗎？

sentences.en: The onset of the rainy season brings humid weather.
sentences.zh: 雨季開始後，天氣變得潮濕。

sentences.en: The new factory will be fully operational by June.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將在六月前全面投入運作。

sentences.en: Are all the machines operational today?
sentences.zh: 今天所有機器都能運作嗎？

sentences.en: Operational costs rose by ten percent last year.
sentences.zh: 去年營運成本上升了百分之十。

sentences.en: The elevator isn't operational right now.
sentences.zh: 電梯現在無法使用。

sentences.en: Who handles the daily operational decisions?
sentences.zh: 誰負責日常的營運決策？

sentences.en: Our operational budget doesn't include new hires.
sentences.zh: 我們的營運預算不包含新進人員。

gloss_note: opt for 選擇；opt out 退出

sentences.en: Most customers opt for the cheaper plan.
sentences.zh: 大多數顧客選擇比較便宜的方案。

sentences.en: Did you opt in to the email updates?
sentences.zh: 你有選擇加入電子郵件更新嗎？

sentences.en: I decided to opt for the vegetarian meal.
sentences.zh: 我決定選素食餐。

sentences.en: You can opt out at any time.
sentences.zh: 你隨時可以選擇退出。

sentences.en: Why did she opt to stay home?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼選擇留在家裡？

sentences.en: We opted to fly instead of drive.
sentences.zh: 我們選擇搭飛機而不是開車。

sentences.en: What is the optimal temperature for this room?
sentences.zh: 這個房間的最佳溫度是多少？

sentences.en: This plan gives the optimal result for our budget.
sentences.zh: 以我們的預算來說，這個方案帶來最理想的結果。

sentences.en: Is this the optimal time to launch the product?
sentences.zh: 現在是推出產品的最佳時機嗎？

sentences.en: Sleep is essential for optimal performance.
sentences.zh: 睡眠對於發揮最佳表現是必要的。

sentences.en: We tested several routes to find the optimal one.
sentences.zh: 我們測試了好幾條路線，找出最佳的那一條。

sentences.en: The software finds the optimal schedule automatically.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體會自動找出最佳排程。

sentences.en: The meeting is optional, but I recommend going.
sentences.zh: 這場會議是自由參加的，但我建議你去。

sentences.en: Is the tip optional here?
sentences.zh: 在這裡小費是自願給的嗎？

sentences.en: Is the homework optional this week?
sentences.zh: 這週的作業是選做的嗎？

sentences.en: The extra warranty is optional and costs fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 這個延長保固是可選的，要五十美元。

sentences.en: Fields marked optional can be left blank.
sentences.zh: 標示為選填的欄位可以留白。

sentences.en: Dessert is optional, but the cake is amazing.
sentences.zh: 甜點可點可不點，但蛋糕很棒。

sentences.en: The heart is one of the most important organs in the body.
sentences.zh: 心臟是人體最重要的器官之一。

sentences.en: Which organ cleans the blood?
sentences.zh: 哪個器官負責淨化血液？

sentences.en: Doctors need a matching donor for an organ transplant.
sentences.zh: 醫生需要找到配對的捐贈者才能進行器官移植。

sentences.en: Is the liver an organ that can repair itself?
sentences.zh: 肝臟是能自我修復的器官嗎？

sentences.en: Alcohol can damage internal organs over time.
sentences.zh: 酒精長期下來可能損害內臟器官。

sentences.en: Students labeled each organ on the diagram.
sentences.zh: 學生在圖上標出每個器官。

sentences.en: A single cell can be a complete organism.
sentences.zh: 單一細胞就可以是一個完整的生物體。

sentences.en: Which organism lives in salt water?
sentences.zh: 哪種生物生活在鹹水中？

sentences.en: Every living organism needs energy.
sentences.zh: 每個生物體都需要能量。

sentences.en: Bacteria are tiny organisms you can't see without a microscope.
sentences.zh: 細菌是沒有顯微鏡就看不見的微小生物。

sentences.en: How do organisms adapt to cold weather?
sentences.zh: 生物如何適應寒冷的天氣？

sentences.en: Scientists found a new organism deep in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 科學家在深海發現了一種新的生物。

sentences.en: The company is changing its organizational structure.
sentences.zh: 公司正在改變組織架構。

sentences.en: What is the organizational chart for your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門的組織圖長什麼樣子？

sentences.en: Organizational change can be stressful for employees.
sentences.zh: 組織變革可能讓員工感到壓力。

sentences.en: The report describes the organizational goals for next year.
sentences.zh: 報告說明了組織明年的目標。

sentences.en: Is this an organizational problem or a personal one?
sentences.zh: 這是組織層面的問題，還是個人問題？

sentences.en: She studied organizational behavior in graduate school.
sentences.zh: 她在研究所研讀組織行為學。

sentences.en: The organizer of the conference sent a welcome email.
sentences.zh: 研討會的主辦人寄了歡迎信。

sentences.en: Who is the organizer of this event?
sentences.zh: 這場活動的主辦人是誰？

sentences.en: The organizers expect about two hundred guests.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位預計約有兩百位賓客。

sentences.en: Could you ask the organizer where to park?
sentences.zh: 你可以問一下主辦人要停在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: She is a volunteer organizer for the neighborhood fair.
sentences.zh: 她是社區園遊會的志工籌辦人。

sentences.en: The event organizer apologized for the late start.
sentences.zh: 活動籌辦人為延遲開場道歉。

gloss_note: orient new hires 帶新人熟悉環境

sentences.en: We set aside one day to orient new employees.
sentences.zh: 我們留出一天讓新進員工熟悉環境。

sentences.en: Could someone orient the new interns this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 今天下午可以找個人帶新來的實習生熟悉環境嗎？

sentences.en: Our company is oriented toward customer service.
sentences.zh: 我們公司以客戶服務為導向。

sentences.en: The guide helped orient the visitors in the old town.
sentences.zh: 導遊幫遊客在老城區找到方向。

sentences.en: How do you orient yourself in a new city?
sentences.zh: 你到新城市時是怎麼辨別方向的？

sentences.en: She turned the map to orient herself.
sentences.zh: 她轉動地圖來確認自己的方位。

sentences.en: New employees attend orientation on their first day.
sentences.zh: 新進員工第一天要參加新人訓練。

sentences.en: What time does orientation start tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天新生訓練幾點開始？

sentences.en: The orientation lasted about two hours.
sentences.zh: 這場新人訓練大約進行了兩小時。

sentences.en: We got a map and schedule at orientation.
sentences.zh: 我們在新生訓練時拿到一張地圖和課表。

sentences.en: Is orientation required for all students?
sentences.zh: 所有學生都必須參加新生訓練嗎？

sentences.en: This project has a clear customer orientation.
sentences.zh: 這個專案有明確的顧客導向。

sentences.en: This software is outdated and needs an update.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體已經過時，需要更新。

sentences.en: Is the information on the website outdated?
sentences.zh: 網站上的資訊過時了嗎？

sentences.en: Her phone is so outdated that it can't run new apps.
sentences.zh: 她的手機太舊了，跑不了新的應用程式。

sentences.en: Our filing system is outdated and slows everyone down.
sentences.zh: 我們的歸檔系統已經過時，拖慢了大家的速度。

sentences.en: Why do we still use such outdated equipment?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們還在用這麼過時的設備？

sentences.en: The map was outdated, so we got lost.
sentences.zh: 地圖過時了，所以我們迷路了。

sentences.en: Is there an outlet near the window?
sentences.zh: 窗邊附近有插座嗎？

sentences.en: I need an outlet to charge my laptop.
sentences.zh: 我需要一個插座來幫筆電充電。

sentences.en: We drove to the outlet mall to buy winter coats.
sentences.zh: 我們開車去暢貨中心買冬季外套。

sentences.en: Are the prices at the outlet really lower?
sentences.zh: 暢貨中心的價格真的比較低嗎？

sentences.en: Don't plug too many devices into one outlet.
sentences.zh: 別在同一個插座插太多設備。

sentences.en: The airport café has an outlet at every table.
sentences.zh: 機場咖啡廳每張桌子都有插座。

sentences.en: The economic outlook for next year looks positive.
sentences.zh: 明年的經濟前景看起來樂觀。

sentences.en: How is the outlook for our new product?
sentences.zh: 我們新產品的前景如何？

sentences.en: The company raised its sales outlook for the year.
sentences.zh: 公司上調了今年的銷售預期。

sentences.en: Analysts have a cautious outlook for the housing market.
sentences.zh: 分析師對房市的展望持謹慎態度。

sentences.en: Is the travel industry's outlook better this year?
sentences.zh: 今年旅遊業的前景比較好嗎？

sentences.en: The job outlook for nurses is excellent.
sentences.zh: 護理師的就業前景非常好。

gloss_note: feel like an outsider 覺得格格不入

sentences.en: As an outsider, I can see problems you might miss.
sentences.zh: 身為局外人，我能看到你們可能忽略的問題。

sentences.en: Did you feel like an outsider at your new school?
sentences.zh: 你在新學校有種局外人的感覺嗎？

sentences.en: The company hired an outsider as its new manager.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請了外部人士擔任新經理。

sentences.en: Outsiders are not allowed in the lab.
sentences.zh: 外人不得進入實驗室。

sentences.en: She was an outsider in the small town for years.
sentences.zh: 多年來，她在那個小鎮都是個外人。

sentences.en: Can an outsider join the team meeting?
sentences.zh: 外人可以參加團隊會議嗎？

gloss_note: outsource work to 把工作外包給

sentences.en: We outsource our payroll to a local firm.
sentences.zh: 我們把薪資作業外包給一家本地公司。

sentences.en: Should we outsource customer service?
sentences.zh: 我們應該把客服外包嗎？

sentences.en: Many companies outsource their IT work.
sentences.zh: 許多公司把資訊科技的工作外包出去。

sentences.en: The company decided to outsource its design work.
sentences.zh: 公司決定外包設計工作。

sentences.en: Why did they outsource the cleaning?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼把清潔工作外包？

sentences.en: It costs less to outsource than to hire full-time staff.
sentences.zh: 外包比聘請全職員工便宜。

sentences.en: Everyone agreed that her work was outstanding.
sentences.zh: 大家都同意她的工作表現非常出色。

sentences.en: Is there an outstanding balance on my account?
sentences.zh: 我的帳戶還有未付清的餘額嗎？

sentences.en: We still have two outstanding payments from March.
sentences.zh: 我們還有兩筆三月的款項尚未結清。

sentences.en: He received an award for outstanding customer service.
sentences.zh: 他因為傑出的客戶服務而獲獎。

sentences.en: Who was the most outstanding player on the team?
sentences.zh: 隊上表現最突出的球員是誰？

sentences.en: Please pay the outstanding amount by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 請在月底前付清未繳的金額。

gloss_note: an oval table 橢圓形桌子

sentences.en: We sat around a large oval table in the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 我們圍坐在會議室的大橢圓形桌子旁。

sentences.en: Could you draw an oval on the whiteboard?
sentences.zh: 你可以在白板上畫一個橢圓形嗎？

sentences.en: The mirror in the hallway has an oval frame.
sentences.zh: 走廊上的鏡子有個橢圓形的框。

sentences.en: Do you prefer oval plates or round ones?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡橢圓形的盤子還是圓的？

sentences.en: The track at our school is an oval about 400 meters long.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的跑道是一個約400公尺長的橢圓形。

sentences.en: These eggs are oval, not perfectly round.
sentences.zh: 這些蛋是橢圓形的，不是正圓形。

sentences.en: Your library book is two weeks overdue.
sentences.zh: 你借的圖書館書已經逾期兩週了。

sentences.en: Is my payment overdue, or did it go through?
sentences.zh: 我的款項逾期了，還是已經入帳了？

sentences.en: The report is overdue, and my boss is getting impatient.
sentences.zh: 報告已經逾期，我老闆越來越不耐煩了。

sentences.en: This apology is long overdue.
sentences.zh: 這個道歉早就該說了。

sentences.en: I thought we paid it. Why is this invoice still overdue?
sentences.zh: 我以為我們付過了，這張請款單為什麼還逾期？

sentences.en: Repairs to the old bridge are long overdue, officials said.
sentences.zh: 官員表示，這座舊橋的整修早就該進行了。

sentences.en: Please put your bag in the overhead bin.
sentences.zh: 請把你的包包放進上方的置物櫃。

sentences.en: Is there enough room in the overhead compartment?
sentences.zh: 上方的行李櫃還有足夠的空間嗎？

sentences.en: An overhead light was flickering in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 走廊上方的燈一直閃爍。

sentences.en: Our overhead costs went up after we moved offices.
sentences.zh: 搬了辦公室之後，我們的經常費用增加了。

sentences.en: How can we cut overhead without laying anyone off?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在不裁員的情況下降低經常費用？

sentences.en: Rent is the biggest part of our overhead.
sentences.zh: 房租是我們經常費用中最大的一塊。

sentences.en: Our work schedules overlap for about two hours.
sentences.zh: 我們的工作時間大約有兩個小時重疊。

sentences.en: Do these two projects overlap in any way?
sentences.zh: 這兩個專案有任何重疊的地方嗎？

sentences.en: There is some overlap between the two courses.
sentences.zh: 這兩門課有一些內容重疊。

sentences.en: Please don't schedule meetings that overlap.
sentences.zh: 請不要安排時間重疊的會議。

sentences.en: Does your lunch break overlap with mine?
sentences.zh: 你的午休時間和我的有重疊嗎？

sentences.en: The two reports overlap in several important findings.
sentences.zh: 這兩份報告在幾個重要的發現上有重疊。

sentences.en: Can I leave my car here overnight?
sentences.zh: 我可以把車停在這裡過夜嗎？

sentences.en: We took an overnight flight to New York.
sentences.zh: 我們搭夜間班機去紐約。

sentences.en: The singer became famous overnight.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手一夜之間走紅。

sentences.en: Do you offer overnight parking at the hotel?
sentences.zh: 你們飯店有提供過夜停車嗎？

sentences.en: It snowed overnight, so the roads are icy this morning.
sentences.zh: 昨晚下了雪，所以今早路面結冰。

sentences.en: I packed an overnight bag for the trip.
sentences.zh: 我為這趟旅行收拾了一個過夜用的包包。

gloss_note: oversee a project 管理專案

sentences.en: She oversees a team of twelve engineers.
sentences.zh: 她負責管理十二位工程師組成的團隊。

sentences.en: Who will oversee the project while Tom is away?
sentences.zh: 湯姆不在的時候，誰來負責監督這個專案？

sentences.en: Our manager oversees the daily operations of the store.
sentences.zh: 我們經理負責監督店裡的日常營運。

sentences.en: A new director was hired to oversee the budget.
sentences.zh: 公司聘了一位新主管來管理預算。

sentences.en: Can you oversee the setup for tomorrow's event?
sentences.zh: 你可以負責監督明天活動的場地布置嗎？

sentences.en: Teachers oversee the students during lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐時間由老師負責看管學生。

sentences.en: I worked overtime three nights this week.
sentences.zh: 我這週有三個晚上加班。

sentences.en: Do we get paid overtime on holidays?
sentences.zh: 假日上班有加班費嗎？

sentences.en: He earns extra money from overtime.
sentences.zh: 他靠加班賺額外的錢。

sentences.en: Will I have to work overtime this weekend?
sentences.zh: 我這個週末需要加班嗎？

sentences.en: The company tries to limit overtime to ten hours a month.
sentences.zh: 公司試著把加班限制在每月十小時以內。

sentences.en: My overtime pay really helped with the rent.
sentences.zh: 我的加班費對付房租幫助很大。

sentences.en: Can you give me a quick overview of the project?
sentences.zh: 你可以簡單跟我概述一下這個專案嗎？

sentences.en: The first slide gives an overview of our sales.
sentences.zh: 第一張投影片是我們銷售狀況的總覽。

sentences.en: I read the overview before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我在開會前先讀了概要。

sentences.en: This book provides a clear overview of world history.
sentences.zh: 這本書清楚地概述了世界史。

sentences.en: Is there an overview of the new policy online?
sentences.zh: 網路上有新政策的概要說明嗎？

sentences.en: Let me start with a brief overview.
sentences.zh: 讓我先做個簡短的概述。

sentences.en: Plants release oxygen into the air.
sentences.zh: 植物會把氧氣釋放到空氣中。

sentences.en: Fish need oxygen to live in the water.
sentences.zh: 魚需要氧氣才能在水裡生存。

sentences.en: How much oxygen is in the air we breathe?
sentences.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣中有多少氧氣？

sentences.en: The nurse gave her oxygen through a small mask.
sentences.zh: 護理師用小面罩讓她吸氧氣。

sentences.en: Climbers often carry extra oxygen tanks on high mountains.
sentences.zh: 登山客在高山上常會多帶氧氣瓶。

sentences.en: Do you know that water is made of hydrogen and oxygen?
sentences.zh: 你知道水是由氫和氧組成的嗎？

gloss_note: a packet of sugar 一小包糖

sentences.en: Could I get another packet of ketchup, please?
sentences.zh: 可以再給我一小包番茄醬嗎？

sentences.en: Each new employee gets an information packet on the first day.
sentences.zh: 每位新員工第一天都會拿到一份資料袋。

sentences.en: Do you have a packet of sugar I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有一包糖可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: I left the registration packet on your desk.
sentences.zh: 我把報到資料放在你桌上了。

sentences.en: Did you read everything in the welcome packet?
sentences.zh: 歡迎資料袋裡的內容你都看過了嗎？

sentences.en: She poured a packet of sweetener into her coffee.
sentences.zh: 她把一小包代糖倒進咖啡裡。

sentences.en: I have a lot of paperwork to finish before Friday.
sentences.zh: 週五前我有一大堆文書工作要處理。

sentences.en: Do you need any paperwork from me?
sentences.zh: 你需要我提供任何文件嗎？

sentences.en: The paperwork for my visa took weeks.
sentences.zh: 我簽證的文件作業花了好幾週。

sentences.en: Filling out the paperwork was easier than I expected.
sentences.zh: 填寫這些文件比我預期的容易。

sentences.en: Please bring your paperwork to the front desk.
sentences.zh: 請把你的文件帶到櫃檯。

sentences.en: Can you help me with this insurance paperwork?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我處理這份保險文件嗎？

sentences.en: The discovery caused a paradigm shift in modern medicine.
sentences.zh: 這項發現在現代醫學中引發了典範轉移。

sentences.en: Online shopping has changed the old retail paradigm.
sentences.zh: 網路購物改變了過去的零售模式。

sentences.en: Is this a new paradigm for teaching languages?
sentences.zh: 這是一種新的語言教學模式嗎？

sentences.en: The study challenges the dominant paradigm in psychology.
sentences.zh: 這項研究挑戰了心理學的主流典範。

sentences.en: Remote work is a whole new paradigm for our company.
sentences.zh: 遠距工作對我們公司來說是全新的模式。

sentences.en: What paradigm guides your approach to design?
sentences.zh: 你的設計方式是以什麼理念為依據？

gloss_note: within the parameters 在範圍內

sentences.en: Which parameters should we change in the model?
sentences.zh: 我們該調整模型裡的哪些參數？

sentences.en: Please stay within the parameters of the budget.
sentences.zh: 請維持在預算的範圍之內。

sentences.en: We need to set the parameters before we start testing.
sentences.zh: 開始測試前，我們得先設定好參數。

sentences.en: The software lets you adjust each parameter.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體可以讓你調整每個參數。

sentences.en: What are the parameters of this project?
sentences.zh: 這個專案的範圍和限制是什麼？

sentences.en: The parameters of the study were clearly explained.
sentences.zh: 這項研究的條件範圍有清楚說明。

gloss_note: pass through parliament 國會通過

sentences.en: The parliament voted on the new law yesterday.
sentences.zh: 國會昨天針對新法案進行了表決。

sentences.en: She was elected to parliament last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天當選國會議員。

sentences.en: When does parliament return from its summer break?
sentences.zh: 國會暑假休會後什麼時候復會？

sentences.en: The prime minister spoke to parliament about the budget.
sentences.zh: 首相向國會報告了預算。

sentences.en: How many members does the parliament have?
sentences.zh: 國會有多少位議員？

sentences.en: Tourists lined up to tour the parliament building.
sentences.zh: 遊客排隊參觀國會大樓。

sentences.en: The country holds parliamentary elections every four years.
sentences.zh: 這個國家每四年舉行一次國會選舉。

sentences.en: Is a parliamentary system different from the American system?
sentences.zh: 議會制和美國的制度不一樣嗎？

sentences.en: She has served on a parliamentary committee for years.
sentences.zh: 她在國會委員會任職多年。

sentences.en: The parliamentary vote is scheduled for Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 國會的投票預定在週二進行。

sentences.en: Does the parliamentary session start this week?
sentences.zh: 國會的會期是這週開始嗎？

sentences.en: He explained the parliamentary process to the class.
sentences.zh: 他向全班說明國會的運作流程。

sentences.en: We received only a partial payment from the client.
sentences.zh: 客戶只付了我們一部分款項。

sentences.en: Is a partial refund possible?
sentences.zh: 可以退一部分的錢嗎？

sentences.en: The highway has a partial closure this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末高速公路有部分路段封閉。

sentences.en: She gave us only a partial answer.
sentences.zh: 她只給了我們一個不完整的答案。

sentences.en: Are you partial to coffee or tea?
sentences.zh: 你比較偏愛咖啡還是茶？

sentences.en: I'm partial to Italian food, especially pasta.
sentences.zh: 我偏愛義大利菜，尤其是義大利麵。

sentences.en: The store is partially open during the renovation.
sentences.zh: 整修期間，店面只有部分開放。

sentences.en: Was the package partially damaged in shipping?
sentences.zh: 包裹在運送途中有部分受損嗎？

sentences.en: The report is only partially finished.
sentences.zh: 這份報告只完成了一部分。

sentences.en: I partially agree with your idea.
sentences.zh: 我部分同意你的想法。

sentences.en: Is the problem partially my fault?
sentences.zh: 這個問題有一部分是我的錯嗎？

sentences.en: The road was partially blocked by a fallen tree.
sentences.zh: 路面被一棵倒下的樹擋住了一部分。

sentences.en: Dust particles floated in the sunlight.
sentences.zh: 灰塵微粒在陽光中飄浮。

sentences.en: Scientists study particles smaller than atoms.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究比原子還小的粒子。

sentences.en: Can a mask block tiny particles in the air?
sentences.zh: 口罩能擋住空氣中的細小微粒嗎？

sentences.en: A tiny particle of dust got stuck in my eye.
sentences.zh: 一小粒灰塵跑進我的眼睛裡了。

sentences.en: How do filters remove particles from the water?
sentences.zh: 濾水器是怎麼去除水中的微粒的？

sentences.en: Smoke contains many harmful particles.
sentences.zh: 煙霧含有許多有害的微粒。

sentences.en: A glass partition separates my desk from the hallway.
sentences.zh: 一片玻璃隔板把我的座位和走廊隔開。

sentences.en: Can we put a partition between the two rooms?
sentences.zh: 我們可以在這兩間房間之間加一道隔板嗎？

sentences.en: The office has movable partitions.
sentences.zh: 這間辦公室有可移動的隔間板。

sentences.en: She put up a partition to make a small study area.
sentences.zh: 她立了一道隔板，隔出一個小書房。

sentences.en: Is that wall a real wall or just a partition?
sentences.zh: 那面牆是真的牆，還是只是隔板？

sentences.en: The partition keeps the noise from the kitchen out.
sentences.zh: 這道隔板可以擋住廚房的噪音。

gloss_note: reset a password 重設密碼

sentences.en: I forgot my password again.
sentences.zh: 我又忘記我的密碼了。

sentences.en: Can you reset my password?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我重設密碼嗎？

sentences.en: Your password must have at least eight characters.
sentences.zh: 你的密碼至少要有八個字元。

sentences.en: Never share your password with anyone.
sentences.zh: 絕對不要把密碼告訴任何人。

sentences.en: What is the Wi-Fi password?
sentences.zh: 無線網路的密碼是什麼？

sentences.en: She wrote her password on a sticky note.
sentences.zh: 她把密碼寫在便利貼上。

sentences.en: We're having pasta for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚晚餐吃義大利麵。

sentences.en: Do you want red sauce or cream sauce on your pasta?
sentences.zh: 你的義大利麵要紅醬還是白醬？

sentences.en: How long should I boil the pasta?
sentences.zh: 義大利麵要煮多久？

sentences.en: I'd like the pasta with mushrooms, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點蘑菇義大利麵，謝謝。

sentences.en: This pasta is cooked perfectly.
sentences.zh: 這道義大利麵煮得剛剛好。

sentences.en: My dad makes fresh pasta on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸週日會自己做新鮮的義大利麵。

gloss_note: file a patent 申請專利

sentences.en: The company filed a patent for its new battery.
sentences.zh: 這間公司為它的新電池申請了專利。

sentences.en: Who holds the patent on this design?
sentences.zh: 這個設計的專利在誰手上？

sentences.en: The patent expires in five years.
sentences.zh: 這項專利五年後到期。

sentences.en: Has she patented her invention yet?
sentences.zh: 她的發明申請專利了嗎？

sentences.en: Do we need a patent lawyer for this?
sentences.zh: 這件事我們需要專利律師嗎？

sentences.en: The engineer was granted a patent last spring.
sentences.zh: 那位工程師去年春天取得了專利。

sentences.en: A narrow pathway led to the garden gate.
sentences.zh: 一條窄小的小徑通往花園大門。

sentences.en: Is there a clear pathway to promotion at this company?
sentences.zh: 這間公司有明確的升遷途徑嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep the pathway clear of boxes.
sentences.zh: 請不要在走道上堆放箱子。

sentences.en: The program offers a pathway to a nursing career.
sentences.zh: 這個課程提供通往護理職涯的途徑。

sentences.en: Scientists found a new pathway in the brain linked to memory.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現大腦中一條與記憶有關的新路徑。

sentences.en: Which pathway will take us to the lake?
sentences.zh: 哪一條小路可以帶我們到湖邊？

sentences.en: Let's eat on the patio tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚去露臺上吃飯吧。

sentences.en: Do you have any tables available on the patio?
sentences.zh: 露天座位區還有空桌嗎？

sentences.en: We had breakfast on the patio this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們今天早上在露臺上吃早餐。

sentences.en: The restaurant's patio has a great view.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳的戶外座位區視野很棒。

sentences.en: Is the patio heated in winter?
sentences.zh: 冬天的戶外座位區有暖氣嗎？

sentences.en: He's building a new patio behind the house.
sentences.zh: 他正在房子後面蓋一個新的露臺。

sentences.en: The restaurant thanked its loyal patrons with a free dessert.
sentences.zh: 餐廳送了免費甜點來感謝忠實的老主顧。

sentences.en: Do library patrons need a card to borrow books?
sentences.zh: 圖書館的讀者借書需要借書證嗎？

sentences.en: Are you a regular patron of this cafe?
sentences.zh: 你是這家咖啡廳的常客嗎？

sentences.en: The museum relies on its wealthy patrons.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館仰賴富有的贊助者。

sentences.en: Patrons are asked to turn off their phones during the show.
sentences.zh: 演出期間，請各位觀眾關閉手機。

sentences.en: She became a patron of young artists.
sentences.zh: 她成為年輕藝術家的贊助人。

sentences.en: The invoice is payable within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 這張請款單須在三十天內付款。

sentences.en: Who should I make the check payable to?
sentences.zh: 這張支票抬頭要寫給誰？

sentences.en: The accounts payable team will process this today.
sentences.zh: 應付帳款部門今天會處理這件事。

sentences.en: Is the fee payable online or only in person?
sentences.zh: 這筆費用可以線上付款，還是只能當面付？

sentences.en: The balance is payable upon delivery.
sentences.zh: 餘款在送貨時支付。

sentences.en: Make the check payable to the company.
sentences.zh: 請把支票抬頭開給公司。

gloss_note: paycheck to paycheck 薪水僅夠過活

sentences.en: I get my paycheck every other Friday.
sentences.zh: 我每隔一個週五領一次薪水。

sentences.en: Most of my paycheck goes to rent.
sentences.zh: 我的薪水大部分都拿去付房租了。

sentences.en: When does the next paycheck arrive?
sentences.zh: 下一次薪水什麼時候入帳？

sentences.en: The bank deposited my paycheck this morning.
sentences.zh: 銀行今天早上把我的薪水存進來了。

sentences.en: Do you live from paycheck to paycheck?
sentences.zh: 你是不是每個月都靠薪水勉強過日子？

sentences.en: My first paycheck felt amazing.
sentences.zh: 領到第一份薪水的感覺好棒。

sentences.en: The hard work finally had a big payoff.
sentences.zh: 辛苦的付出終於有了豐厚的回報。

sentences.en: Is the payoff worth the risk?
sentences.zh: 這份回報值得冒這個險嗎？

sentences.en: The long-term payoff of this investment is clear.
sentences.zh: 這項投資的長期回報很明確。

sentences.en: Learning a second language has a great payoff.
sentences.zh: 學第二外語的回報很大。

sentences.en: What's the payoff for spending so many hours on this?
sentences.zh: 花這麼多時間做這件事，有什麼好處？

sentences.en: After months of testing, the payoff came when sales doubled.
sentences.zh: 經過幾個月的測試，銷售額翻倍時成果就出現了。

sentences.en: The insurance company approved a large payout.
sentences.zh: 保險公司核准了一筆高額理賠。

sentences.en: How much is the payout if we win?
sentences.zh: 如果我們贏了，獎金有多少？

sentences.en: The lottery payout will be split among five people.
sentences.zh: 彩券的獎金將由五個人平分。

sentences.en: When will the payout reach my account?
sentences.zh: 這筆款項什麼時候會匯進我的帳戶？

sentences.en: Shareholders expect a higher payout this year.
sentences.zh: 股東預期今年的配息會更高。

sentences.en: The settlement included a payout of $20,000.
sentences.zh: 和解內容包括兩萬美元的賠償金。

gloss_note: on the payroll 在職領薪

sentences.en: Please send your hours to payroll by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把你的工時交給薪資部門。

sentences.en: How many people are on the payroll?
sentences.zh: 公司有多少人在領薪水？

sentences.en: The company has over 200 employees on its payroll.
sentences.zh: 這間公司有兩百多名員工在領薪。

sentences.en: Who handles payroll in your office?
sentences.zh: 你們辦公室是誰負責薪資作業？

sentences.en: Our payroll costs went up this year.
sentences.zh: 我們今年的薪資支出增加了。

sentences.en: Payroll will be late this month because of the holiday.
sentences.zh: 因為假日的關係，這個月的薪水會晚一點發。

sentences.en: A pedestrian was waiting at the crosswalk.
sentences.zh: 有一位行人正在斑馬線旁等著。

sentences.en: Cars must stop for pedestrians in the crosswalk.
sentences.zh: 車輛必須禮讓在斑馬線上的行人。

sentences.en: Is this bridge for pedestrians only?
sentences.zh: 這座橋是行人專用的嗎？

sentences.en: The city is adding more pedestrian bridges downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在市中心增建更多人行天橋。

sentences.en: Do you know if this street is pedestrian only?
sentences.zh: 你知道這條街是不是行人專用嗎？

sentences.en: Pedestrians should always use the sidewalk when it is available.
sentences.zh: 有人行道的時候，行人應該走人行道。

sentences.en: I'd like a large pepperoni pizza, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一個大的臘腸披薩，謝謝。

sentences.en: Do you want extra pepperoni on that?
sentences.zh: 你的披薩要加量臘腸嗎？

sentences.en: Pepperoni is the most popular pizza topping in America.
sentences.zh: 臘腸是美國最受歡迎的披薩配料。

sentences.en: Could you pick the pepperoni off my slice?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這片披薩上的臘腸挑掉嗎？

sentences.en: My son only eats pepperoni pizza.
sentences.zh: 我兒子只吃臘腸披薩。

sentences.en: Does the calzone come with pepperoni?
sentences.zh: 這個披薩餃有加臘腸嗎？

sentences.en: The street performer drew a big crowd.
sentences.zh: 那位街頭藝人吸引了一大群觀眾。

sentences.en: She is our top performer this quarter.
sentences.zh: 她是我們這一季表現最好的員工。

sentences.en: Which performer are you most excited to see?
sentences.zh: 你最期待看到哪位表演者？

sentences.en: The performers bowed after the final song.
sentences.zh: 最後一首歌結束後，表演者們鞠躬致意。

sentences.en: Is he a strong performer under pressure?
sentences.zh: 他在壓力下的表現穩定嗎？

sentences.en: Our best performers receive a bonus every year.
sentences.zh: 我們表現最好的員工每年都會拿到獎金。

sentences.en: The machine needs periodic maintenance.
sentences.zh: 這台機器需要定期保養。

sentences.en: We hold periodic reviews of the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們定期檢討預算。

sentences.en: Does the website send periodic updates by email?
sentences.zh: 這個網站會定期寄送最新消息的電子郵件嗎？

sentences.en: Periodic checkups can catch health problems early.
sentences.zh: 定期健康檢查可以及早發現健康問題。

sentences.en: Is the noise periodic or constant?
sentences.zh: 這個噪音是週期性出現，還是一直都在？

sentences.en: The data shows a periodic pattern every twelve months.
sentences.zh: 資料顯示每十二個月會出現一次週期性的變化。

sentences.en: She works for a large pharmaceutical company.
sentences.zh: 她在一家大型製藥公司工作。

sentences.en: The pharmaceutical industry spends billions on research.
sentences.zh: 製藥業花了數十億美元在研究上。

sentences.en: Are pharmaceuticals taxed differently from other goods?
sentences.zh: 藥品的稅率和其他商品不一樣嗎？

sentences.en: Pharmaceutical sales rose sharply last quarter.
sentences.zh: 製藥業的銷售額上一季大幅成長。

sentences.en: Did you apply for that pharmaceutical job in Boston?
sentences.zh: 你有申請波士頓那份製藥業的工作嗎？

sentences.en: He sells pharmaceutical products to hospitals.
sentences.zh: 他向醫院銷售藥品。

sentences.en: Ask the pharmacist if you can take these together.
sentences.zh: 問問藥師這些藥可不可以一起吃。

sentences.en: The pharmacist explained how to use the medicine.
sentences.zh: 藥師說明了這種藥的使用方式。

sentences.en: Is the pharmacist in right now?
sentences.zh: 藥師現在在嗎？

sentences.en: My older sister is studying to become a pharmacist.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊正在念書，準備當藥師。

sentences.en: Could you ask the pharmacist about side effects?
sentences.zh: 你可以問藥師有什麼副作用嗎？

sentences.en: The pharmacist filled my prescription in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 藥師十分鐘就把我的處方藥配好了。

gloss_note: a 24-hour pharmacy 二十四小時藥局

sentences.en: I need to stop by the pharmacy after work.
sentences.zh: 我下班後要去一趟藥局。

sentences.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有藥局嗎？

sentences.en: The pharmacy closes at nine tonight.
sentences.zh: 藥局今晚九點關門。

sentences.en: Does this pharmacy deliver medicine to your home?
sentences.zh: 這間藥局可以把藥送到你家嗎？

sentences.en: She works at the pharmacy inside the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 她在超市裡面的藥局工作。

sentences.en: The pharmacy is out of that cough syrup.
sentences.zh: 藥局那種止咳糖漿賣完了。

sentences.en: We had a philosophical discussion about happiness.
sentences.zh: 我們進行了一場關於快樂的哲學討論。

sentences.en: Is this a philosophical question or a practical one?
sentences.zh: 這是個哲學問題，還是個實際的問題？

sentences.en: She was philosophical about the bad news.
sentences.zh: 她對那個壞消息看得很開。

sentences.en: He's very philosophical about losing the game.
sentences.zh: 他對輸掉比賽很看得開。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy reading philosophical books?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡讀哲學類的書嗎？

sentences.en: The film raises deep philosophical questions.
sentences.zh: 這部電影提出了深刻的哲學問題。

sentences.en: Phonological awareness helps children learn to read.
sentences.zh: 音韻覺識能幫助孩子學習閱讀。

sentences.en: The study tested children's phonological skills.
sentences.zh: 這項研究測試了孩子的音韻能力。

sentences.en: What is a phonological rule in English?
sentences.zh: 英文裡的音韻規則是什麼？

sentences.en: My professor explained phonological rules in class today.
sentences.zh: 我的教授今天在課堂上講解了音韻規則。

sentences.en: Do you know what phonological awareness means?
sentences.zh: 你知道音韻覺識是什麼意思嗎？

sentences.en: She researches phonological development in young children.
sentences.zh: 她研究幼兒的語音發展。

gloss_note: 影印機卡紙 jammed；美國日常多說 copier

sentences.en: The photocopier is jammed again.
sentences.zh: 影印機又卡紙了。

sentences.en: Where is the photocopier on this floor?
sentences.zh: 這層樓的影印機在哪裡？

sentences.en: Can you show me how to use the photocopier?
sentences.zh: 你可以教我怎麼用影印機嗎？

sentences.en: We need to order more paper for the photocopier.
sentences.zh: 我們得幫影印機多訂一些紙。

sentences.en: Someone left their documents on the photocopier.
sentences.zh: 有人把文件忘在影印機上了。

sentences.en: Is the photocopier out of toner?
sentences.zh: 影印機的碳粉用完了嗎？

gloss_note: make a photocopy 影印一份

sentences.en: Could you photocopy this contract for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我影印這份合約嗎？

sentences.en: I made a photocopy of my passport.
sentences.zh: 我影印了一份護照。

sentences.en: Please bring a photocopy of your ID.
sentences.zh: 請帶一份身分證件的影本來。

sentences.en: How many pages do I need to photocopy?
sentences.zh: 我需要影印幾頁？

sentences.en: She photocopied the notes for the whole class.
sentences.zh: 她把筆記影印給全班同學。

sentences.en: A photocopy is fine; you don't need the original.
sentences.zh: 影本就可以了，不需要原本。

sentences.en: She studies photography at a local college.
sentences.zh: 她在當地的大學學攝影。

sentences.en: Is photography allowed inside the museum?
sentences.zh: 博物館裡面可以拍照嗎？

sentences.en: His hobby is nature photography.
sentences.zh: 他的興趣是自然攝影。

sentences.en: Are you taking a photography class this semester?
sentences.zh: 你這學期有修攝影課嗎？

sentences.en: Flash photography is not permitted during the show.
sentences.zh: 表演期間禁止使用閃光燈拍攝。

sentences.en: Her photography has been featured in several magazines.
sentences.zh: 她的攝影作品曾刊登在好幾本雜誌上。

gloss_note: primary care physician 家庭醫師

sentences.en: Please see your physician if the pain continues.
sentences.zh: 如果持續疼痛，請去看你的醫師。

sentences.en: Is she a physician or a nurse?
sentences.zh: 她是醫師還是護理師？

sentences.en: The hospital hired two new physicians this month.
sentences.zh: 醫院這個月聘了兩位新醫師。

sentences.en: My primary care physician moved to another clinic.
sentences.zh: 我的家庭醫師搬到別的診所去了。

sentences.en: Do you have a family physician here?
sentences.zh: 你在這裡有固定的家庭醫師嗎？

sentences.en: A physician must sign this form before you return to work.
sentences.zh: 你回去上班前，必須有醫師在這張表格上簽名。

sentences.en: Stress can cause physiological changes in the body.
sentences.zh: 壓力可能造成身體的生理變化。

sentences.en: Hunger is a basic physiological need.
sentences.zh: 飢餓是基本的生理需求。

sentences.en: Are the symptoms physiological or psychological?
sentences.zh: 這些症狀是生理上的，還是心理上的？

sentences.en: The study measured physiological responses like heart rate.
sentences.zh: 這項研究測量了心跳這類的生理反應。

sentences.en: Does sleep affect physiological recovery after exercise?
sentences.zh: 睡眠會影響運動後的生理恢復嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors found no physiological cause for her headaches.
sentences.zh: 醫師找不出她頭痛的生理原因。

gloss_note: pioneer in 某領域的先驅

sentences.en: She was a pioneer in women's sports.
sentences.zh: 她是女子運動的先驅。

sentences.en: The company pioneered a new way to pay online.
sentences.zh: 這間公司開創了一種新的線上付款方式。

sentences.en: Who was the pioneer of modern computing?
sentences.zh: 誰是現代電腦運算的先驅？

sentences.en: Early pioneers of aviation tested their planes in open fields.
sentences.zh: 早期的航空先驅在空曠的田野上試飛。

sentences.en: Our company is a pioneer in solar energy.
sentences.zh: 我們公司是太陽能領域的先驅。

sentences.en: Is he the man who pioneered this technique?
sentences.zh: 他就是開創這項技術的人嗎？

sentences.en: Workers repaired the oil pipeline after the leak.
sentences.zh: 工人在漏油之後修復了輸油管線。

sentences.en: We have three new products in the pipeline.
sentences.zh: 我們有三項新產品正在籌備中。

sentences.en: How strong is our sales pipeline this quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們這一季的業務案源有多充足？

sentences.en: Is anything in the pipeline for next spring?
sentences.zh: 明年春天有什麼案子在籌備嗎？

sentences.en: The company has a full pipeline of projects.
sentences.zh: 這間公司手上有滿滿的待辦專案。

sentences.en: A gas pipeline runs under this field.
sentences.zh: 這片田地底下有一條天然氣管線。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: The plaintiff asked for $50,000 in damages.
sentences.zh: 原告要求五萬美元的賠償。

sentences.en: Who is the plaintiff in this case?
sentences.zh: 這個案子的原告是誰？

sentences.en: The plaintiff's lawyer spoke first.
sentences.zh: 原告的律師先發言。

sentences.en: Did the plaintiff win the lawsuit?
sentences.zh: 原告贏了這場官司嗎？

sentences.en: The plaintiff claims the company broke the contract.
sentences.zh: 原告主張公司違反了合約。

sentences.en: The judge ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
sentences.zh: 法官判決原告勝訴。

sentences.en: She works as an event planner for a hotel.
sentences.zh: 她在一間飯店擔任活動企劃。

sentences.en: I wrote the meeting in my planner.
sentences.zh: 我把這場會議寫進我的行事曆本了。

sentences.en: Do you use a paper planner or an app?
sentences.zh: 你是用紙本行事曆還是應用程式？

sentences.en: Our city planner showed us the new park design.
sentences.zh: 我們的都市規劃師給我們看了新公園的設計。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a good wedding planner?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦一位好的婚禮企劃嗎？

sentences.en: Where did I leave my planner?
sentences.zh: 我把行事曆本放到哪裡去了？

gloss_note: a plausible excuse 合理的藉口

sentences.en: That sounds like a plausible explanation.
sentences.zh: 這聽起來是個說得通的解釋。

sentences.en: Is it plausible that the shipment was just delayed?
sentences.zh: 貨物只是延遲了，這種說法合理嗎？

sentences.en: His excuse wasn't very plausible.
sentences.zh: 他的藉口不太可信。

sentences.en: Do you think the story is plausible?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個故事可信嗎？

sentences.en: A plausible theory is that sales dropped because of the weather.
sentences.zh: 一個說得通的推測是，銷量下滑是因為天氣。

sentences.en: The detective offered a plausible reason for the delay.
sentences.zh: 偵探對延誤提出了一個合理的原因。

gloss_note: pledge to + V 承諾做某事

sentences.en: I pledge to finish the project on time.
sentences.zh: 我保證會準時完成這個專案。

sentences.en: Did the donors pledge any money this year?
sentences.zh: 今年捐款人有承諾捐款嗎？

sentences.en: The company made a pledge to cut waste.
sentences.zh: 這間公司承諾要減少浪費。

sentences.en: She pledged $500 to the school fund.
sentences.zh: 她承諾捐五百美元給學校基金。

sentences.en: Can you keep your pledge to call me every week?
sentences.zh: 你能遵守每週打電話給我的承諾嗎？

sentences.en: Leaders signed a pledge to protect the forest.
sentences.zh: 領袖們簽署了保護森林的承諾書。

gloss_note: call a plumber 找水管工

sentences.en: We called a plumber to fix the leaking sink.
sentences.zh: 我們請了水管工來修漏水的水槽。

sentences.en: Can the plumber come tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 水管工明天早上可以過來嗎？

sentences.en: The plumber charged us $150 an hour.
sentences.zh: 水管工每小時收我們一百五十美元。

sentences.en: Do you know a good plumber in this area?
sentences.zh: 你知道這附近有不錯的水管工嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor works as a plumber.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居是水管工。

sentences.en: The plumber found a crack in the pipe.
sentences.zh: 水管工發現水管上有一道裂縫。

sentences.en: Stock prices plunged after the announcement.
sentences.zh: 公告發布後，股價暴跌。

sentences.en: Did sales plunge last month?
sentences.zh: 上個月的銷售額是不是暴跌了？

sentences.en: She plunged into the cold lake.
sentences.zh: 她一頭跳進冰冷的湖裡。

sentences.en: The plunge in oil prices surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 油價的暴跌讓所有人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Temperatures plunge below freezing at night.
