sentences.zh: 夜間氣溫會驟降到冰點以下。

sentences.en: Are you ready to plunge into the water?
sentences.zh: 你準備好跳進水裡了嗎？

gloss_note: polish a speech 修飾講稿

sentences.en: I need to polish my shoes before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前我得把鞋子擦亮。

sentences.en: Can you polish this report before Friday?
sentences.zh: 你可以在週五前把這份報告潤飾一下嗎？

sentences.en: She spent the weekend polishing her presentation.
sentences.zh: 她花了整個週末修飾她的簡報。

sentences.en: He used a soft cloth to polish the table.
sentences.zh: 他用軟布把桌子擦亮。

sentences.en: How often should I polish the silverware?
sentences.zh: 銀製餐具應該多久擦亮一次？

sentences.en: Let's polish the slides one more time.
sentences.zh: 我們把投影片再修飾一次吧。

sentences.en: The issue is politically sensitive.
sentences.zh: 這個議題在政治上很敏感。

sentences.en: Is it politically smart to raise taxes now?
sentences.zh: 現在加稅在政治上是明智的做法嗎？

sentences.en: The two countries are politically stable.
sentences.zh: 這兩個國家在政治上都很穩定。

sentences.en: Many young people are politically active online.
sentences.zh: 許多年輕人在網路上積極參與政治。

sentences.en: Do you consider yourself politically active?
sentences.zh: 你覺得自己有積極參與政治嗎？

sentences.en: The decision was politically difficult for the mayor.
sentences.zh: 這個決定在政治上讓市長很為難。

gloss_note: gain popularity 越來越受歡迎

sentences.en: The app is growing in popularity every month.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式的人氣每個月都在成長。

sentences.en: Why has the show's popularity dropped?
sentences.zh: 這個節目的人氣為什麼下滑了？

sentences.en: The popularity of electric cars has increased.
sentences.zh: 電動車的受歡迎程度提高了。

sentences.en: Does popularity matter more than quality?
sentences.zh: 受歡迎比品質更重要嗎？

sentences.en: Our new product gained popularity quickly.
sentences.zh: 我們的新產品很快就受到歡迎。

sentences.en: Her popularity at school surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 她在學校的高人氣讓大家很驚訝。

sentences.en: Bring your portfolio to the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時請帶你的作品集來。

sentences.en: Her design portfolio impressed the hiring manager.
sentences.zh: 她的設計作品集讓負責招募的主管印象深刻。

sentences.en: How is your investment portfolio doing this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年的投資組合表現如何？

sentences.en: He keeps most of his portfolio in index funds.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的投資組合都放在指數型基金。

sentences.en: Can I see your portfolio before we hire you?
sentences.zh: 我們錄用你之前，可以先看你的作品集嗎？

sentences.en: I'm updating my online portfolio this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我這個週末要更新我的線上作品集。

sentences.en: How much is the postage to Canada?
sentences.zh: 寄到加拿大的郵資是多少？

sentences.en: Postage went up again this year.
sentences.zh: 今年郵資又漲價了。

sentences.en: The postage is included in the price.
sentences.zh: 價格已經包含郵資了。

sentences.en: Do I need extra postage for this package?
sentences.zh: 這個包裹需要加貼郵資嗎？

sentences.en: We spend a lot on postage every month.
sentences.zh: 我們每個月在郵資上花很多錢。

sentences.en: Please add enough postage for the heavy envelope.
sentences.zh: 這個很重的信封請貼足郵資。

gloss_note: precede the meeting 會前進行

sentences.en: A short speech will precede the dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐前會先有一段簡短的演講。

sentences.en: Which step precedes the final check?
sentences.zh: 哪一個步驟在最後檢查之前？

sentences.en: Heavy rain preceded the flood.
sentences.zh: 豪雨之後才發生淹水。

sentences.en: The warning preceded the storm by two hours.
sentences.zh: 警報比暴風雨早了兩個小時發布。

sentences.en: Does the safety video precede the main show?
sentences.zh: 安全影片是在正式表演之前播放嗎？

sentences.en: Lunch will be preceded by a brief meeting.
sentences.zh: 午餐前會先開一個簡短的會。

sentences.en: My predecessor left detailed notes for me.
sentences.zh: 我的前任幫我留了詳細的筆記。

sentences.en: How did your predecessor handle this client?
sentences.zh: 你的前任是怎麼處理這位客戶的？

sentences.en: The new phone is faster than its predecessor.
sentences.zh: 這支新手機比上一代快。

sentences.en: She thanked her predecessor for the smooth handover.
sentences.zh: 她感謝前任讓交接很順利。

sentences.en: Who was the manager's predecessor?
sentences.zh: 經理的前任是誰？

sentences.en: The company's predecessor was a small family shop.
sentences.zh: 這間公司的前身是一家小型家庭商店。

gloss_note: make a prediction 做出預測

sentences.en: Their prediction for next year's sales was wrong.
sentences.zh: 他們對明年銷售額的預測錯了。

sentences.en: What's your prediction for the game tonight?
sentences.zh: 你預測今晚的比賽結果會怎樣？

sentences.en: The app's prediction of my arrival time was exactly right.
sentences.zh: 應用程式預測的抵達時間完全正確。

sentences.en: Experts made a bold prediction about electric cars.
sentences.zh: 專家對電動車提出了大膽的預測。

sentences.en: Can anyone make an accurate prediction about the market?
sentences.zh: 有人能對市場做出準確的預測嗎？

sentences.en: My prediction about the game came true!
sentences.zh: 我對比賽的預測成真了！

sentences.en: We only have preliminary results so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止我們只有初步的結果。

sentences.en: Can I see the preliminary schedule?
sentences.zh: 我可以看一下初步的時程表嗎？

sentences.en: A preliminary report will come out next week.
sentences.zh: 初步報告下週會出來。

sentences.en: Is this just a preliminary estimate?
sentences.zh: 這只是初步的估價嗎？

sentences.en: The two teams held preliminary talks yesterday.
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊昨天進行了初步會談。

sentences.en: Please review the preliminary budget before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會前請先看過初步的預算。

sentences.en: Our health insurance premium went up again.
sentences.zh: 我們的健康保險費又漲了。

sentences.en: How much is the monthly premium?
sentences.zh: 每個月的保費是多少？

sentences.en: This store sells premium coffee beans.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣高級咖啡豆。

sentences.en: Is the premium plan worth the extra cost?
sentences.zh: 高級方案值得多付那些錢嗎？

sentences.en: Premium customers get free shipping.
sentences.zh: 高級會員可享免運費。

sentences.en: She pays her car insurance premium every month.
sentences.zh: 她每個月都繳汽車保險費。

sentences.en: I need to pick up my prescription.
sentences.zh: 我需要去領我的處方藥。

sentences.en: Can you refill my prescription?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我續領處方藥嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor wrote me a prescription for antibiotics.
sentences.zh: 醫師幫我開了抗生素的處方。

sentences.en: Do you need a prescription for this medicine?
sentences.zh: 這種藥需要處方才能買嗎？

sentences.en: Does your insurance cover prescription drugs?
sentences.zh: 你的保險有給付處方藥嗎？

sentences.en: Don't take that medicine without a prescription.
sentences.zh: 沒有處方不要吃那種藥。

sentences.en: The presenter showed three slides about sales.
sentences.zh: 報告者放了三張關於銷售額的投影片。

sentences.en: Who is the next presenter?
sentences.zh: 下一位報告者是誰？

sentences.en: The presenter answered questions after the talk.
sentences.zh: 報告結束後，主講人回答了問題。

sentences.en: Is the presenter ready to start?
sentences.zh: 主講人準備好要開始了嗎？

sentences.en: Every presenter gets fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 每位報告者有十五分鐘。

sentences.en: The presenters tested the microphones before the event.
sentences.zh: 報告者們在活動前測試了麥克風。

gloss_note: hold the presidency 擔任會長

sentences.en: He held the presidency of the company for ten years.
sentences.zh: 他擔任公司總裁十年。

sentences.en: She won the club presidency last month.
sentences.zh: 她上個月當選社團會長。

sentences.en: During his presidency, the economy grew steadily.
sentences.zh: 在他的總統任期內，經濟穩定成長。

sentences.en: Who will take over the presidency next year?
sentences.zh: 明年由誰接任會長？

sentences.en: How long does the presidency last in your country?
sentences.zh: 你們國家的總統任期有多長？

sentences.en: She was proud to accept the presidency of the student association.
sentences.zh: 她很榮幸能接下學生會會長的職位。

gloss_note: common sense prevails 常理勝出

sentences.en: In the end, common sense will prevail.
sentences.zh: 最後常理會勝出。

sentences.en: Which side do you think will prevail?
sentences.zh: 你覺得哪一邊會勝出？

sentences.en: Old customs still prevail in the small village.
sentences.zh: 古老的習俗在這個小村莊裡依然盛行。

sentences.en: Do these beliefs still prevail today?
sentences.zh: 這些觀念現在還盛行嗎？

sentences.en: Good teamwork helped us prevail over the other team.
sentences.zh: 良好的團隊合作讓我們贏過了另一隊。

sentences.en: A sense of calm prevailed after the announcement.
sentences.zh: 公告之後，現場瀰漫著一股平靜的氣氛。

gloss_note: prevalence of a disease 疾病盛行率

sentences.en: The prevalence of obesity has increased.
sentences.zh: 肥胖的盛行率上升了。

sentences.en: What is the prevalence of this disease in children?
sentences.zh: 這種疾病在孩童中的盛行率是多少？

sentences.en: The study measured the prevalence of smartphone use.
sentences.zh: 這項研究調查了智慧型手機的普及程度。

sentences.en: Experts worry about the growing prevalence of online scams.
sentences.zh: 專家擔心網路詐騙越來越普遍。

sentences.en: Do you know the prevalence of allergies in our school?
sentences.zh: 你知道我們學校過敏的盛行率有多高嗎？

sentences.en: The high prevalence of flu in winter keeps clinics busy.
sentences.zh: 冬天流感盛行，讓診所非常忙碌。

sentences.en: Did you watch the movie preview?
sentences.zh: 你看過那部電影的預告了嗎？

sentences.en: Click here for a preview of the new design.
sentences.zh: 點這裡可以預覽新的設計。

sentences.en: We got a sneak preview of next season's menu.
sentences.zh: 我們提前看到了下一季的菜單。

sentences.en: Can I preview the document before printing?
sentences.zh: 列印前我可以先預覽這份文件嗎？

sentences.en: I will send you a preview of the video before Friday.
sentences.zh: 週五前我會先寄影片的預覽給你。

sentences.en: Let me give you a quick preview of the agenda.
sentences.zh: 讓我簡單預告一下議程。

sentences.en: Can we talk privately for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我們可以私下聊一下嗎？

sentences.en: The company is privately owned.
sentences.zh: 這間公司是私人擁有的。

sentences.en: She privately admitted she was nervous.
sentences.zh: 她私下承認自己很緊張。

sentences.en: Do you want to discuss this privately?
sentences.zh: 你想私下討論這件事嗎？

sentences.en: The school is privately funded.
sentences.zh: 這所學校的經費來自私人。

sentences.en: He told me privately about his plan to quit.
sentences.zh: 他私下告訴我他打算離職。

sentences.en: The privatization of the airline took two years.
sentences.zh: 這家航空公司的民營化花了兩年。

sentences.en: Many workers worried about the privatization plan.
sentences.zh: 許多員工擔心民營化計畫。

sentences.en: Is privatization good for customers?
sentences.zh: 民營化對消費者有好處嗎？

sentences.en: The government announced the privatization of the railway.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布了鐵路的民營化。

sentences.en: What effect did privatization have on prices?
sentences.zh: 民營化對價格有什麼影響？

sentences.en: Analysts discussed the privatization during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 分析師在會議中討論了民營化。

gloss_note: launch a probe 展開調查

sentences.en: The police opened a probe into the fire.
sentences.zh: 警方對這場火災展開調查。

sentences.en: Will the probe find out what went wrong?
sentences.zh: 這項調查能查出哪裡出了問題嗎？

sentences.en: The space probe sent back new photos of Mars.
sentences.zh: 太空探測器傳回了火星的新照片。

sentences.en: A government probe is looking into the company's accounts.
sentences.zh: 政府調查正在檢視這間公司的帳目。

sentences.en: Is there a probe into the data leak?
sentences.zh: 資料外洩有在調查嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor used a small probe to check the wound.
sentences.zh: 醫師用一支小探針檢查傷口。

gloss_note: a productive day 有成效的一天

sentences.en: We had a very productive meeting today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天開了一場很有成效的會。

sentences.en: How can I be more productive at home?
sentences.zh: 我在家要怎麼提高效率？

sentences.en: She is most productive in the morning.
sentences.zh: 她早上的工作效率最高。

sentences.en: Was the call with the client productive?
sentences.zh: 和客戶的通話有成效嗎？

sentences.en: Coffee makes me productive for about two hours.
sentences.zh: 咖啡能讓我有大約兩小時的高效率。

sentences.en: A quiet office helps people stay productive.
sentences.zh: 安靜的辦公室能幫助大家保持高效率。

sentences.en: Our team's productivity went up by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊的生產力提高了百分之十。

sentences.en: How can we improve productivity without working longer hours?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在不延長工時的情況下提高生產力？

sentences.en: Noise in the office hurts productivity.
sentences.zh: 辦公室的噪音會降低工作效率。

sentences.en: This app helps you track your productivity.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式可以幫你記錄工作效率。

sentences.en: Does working from home increase productivity?
sentences.zh: 在家工作會提高生產力嗎？

sentences.en: Productivity dropped during the heat wave.
sentences.zh: 熱浪期間生產力下降了。

sentences.en: Please show proof of English proficiency.
sentences.zh: 請出示英文能力證明。

sentences.en: What is your level of proficiency in Spanish?
sentences.zh: 你的西班牙文程度如何？

sentences.en: Her proficiency in coding impressed the team.
sentences.zh: 她精通程式設計，讓團隊印象深刻。

sentences.en: Do you need a proficiency test for this job?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要語言能力測驗嗎？

sentences.en: He reached full proficiency after a year of practice.
sentences.zh: 他練習了一年後完全熟練。

sentences.en: The test measures your proficiency in speaking and writing.
sentences.zh: 這項測驗評量你的口說和寫作能力。

sentences.en: The report looks at the profitability of each product.
sentences.zh: 這份報告檢視了每項產品的獲利能力。

sentences.en: How can we improve the profitability of this store?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提高這家店的獲利能力？

sentences.en: Higher costs hurt our profitability last year.
sentences.zh: 成本增加影響了我們去年的獲利能力。

sentences.en: Profitability is our main goal this quarter.
sentences.zh: 獲利能力是我們這一季的主要目標。

sentences.en: Does the new plan increase profitability?
sentences.zh: 新計畫會提高獲利能力嗎？

sentences.en: Investors care about long-term profitability.
sentences.zh: 投資人在乎長期的獲利能力。

gloss_note: a profitable year 獲利的一年

sentences.en: The shop became profitable after two years.
sentences.zh: 這家店兩年後開始賺錢。

sentences.en: Is this business profitable yet?
sentences.zh: 這門生意已經賺錢了嗎？

sentences.en: It was a profitable deal for both sides.
sentences.zh: 這對雙方來說都是有利可圖的交易。

sentences.en: Which product line is the most profitable?
sentences.zh: 哪一條產品線最賺錢？

sentences.en: Our company has been profitable for five straight years.
sentences.zh: 我們公司已經連續五年獲利。

sentences.en: She found a profitable way to sell her crafts online.
sentences.zh: 她找到一個在網路上賣手工藝品的賺錢方法。

gloss_note: a software programmer 軟體工程師

sentences.en: My older brother works as a programmer.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥是程式設計師。

sentences.en: The programmer fixed the bug in an hour.
sentences.zh: 程式設計師一個小時就修好了這個錯誤。

sentences.en: Do we have a programmer who can fix this bug?
sentences.zh: 我們有能修這個錯誤的程式設計師嗎？

sentences.en: The programmer explained how the app works.
sentences.zh: 程式設計師說明了這個應用程式的運作方式。

sentences.en: A good programmer writes clear code.
sentences.zh: 好的程式設計師會寫出清楚易懂的程式碼。

sentences.en: Can you ask the programmer to look at this?
sentences.zh: 你可以請程式設計師看一下這個嗎？

sentences.en: The law prohibits smoking in restaurants.
sentences.zh: 法律禁止在餐廳內吸菸。

sentences.en: Company policy prohibits accepting expensive gifts.
sentences.zh: 公司規定禁止收受昂貴的禮物。

sentences.en: Does the lease prohibit pets?
sentences.zh: 租約有禁止養寵物嗎？

sentences.en: Parking is prohibited in front of the building.
sentences.zh: 大樓前面禁止停車。

sentences.en: What does the contract prohibit?
sentences.zh: 這份合約禁止哪些事情？

sentences.en: The rules prohibit students from using phones during the test.
sentences.zh: 規定禁止學生在考試時使用手機。

sentences.en: The sales projection looks too optimistic.
sentences.zh: 這份銷售預估看起來太樂觀了。

sentences.en: Can you send me your revenue projections?
sentences.zh: 你可以把你的營收預估寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: According to the projection, we'll break even next year.
sentences.zh: 根據預估，我們明年可以損益兩平。

sentences.en: How accurate are these projections?
sentences.zh: 這些預估有多準確？

sentences.en: The growth projection was revised downward.
sentences.zh: 成長預估被下修了。

sentences.en: I'm updating the budget projection this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我今天下午要更新預算預估。

gloss_note: connect the projector 連接投影機

sentences.en: The projector isn't working in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 會議室的投影機壞了。

sentences.en: Can you bring a projector to the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你可以帶一台投影機來開會嗎？

sentences.en: Where is the remote for the projector?
sentences.zh: 投影機的遙控器在哪裡？

sentences.en: The projector bulb burned out.
sentences.zh: 投影機的燈泡燒壞了。

sentences.en: Is the projector connected to your laptop?
sentences.zh: 投影機有接上你的筆電嗎？

sentences.en: We borrowed a projector from the school.
sentences.zh: 我們向學校借了一台投影機。

sentences.en: She is a prominent lawyer in the city.
sentences.zh: 她是這座城市裡知名的律師。

sentences.en: The logo is displayed in a prominent place.
sentences.zh: 標誌放在很顯眼的位置。

sentences.en: Is he a prominent figure in the industry?
sentences.zh: 他是這個產業的知名人物嗎？

sentences.en: A prominent scientist spoke at the conference.
sentences.zh: 一位知名科學家在研討會上演講。

sentences.en: Is the sign prominent enough for customers to see?
sentences.zh: 這個招牌夠顯眼，讓顧客看得到嗎？

sentences.en: The company plays a prominent role in the local market.
sentences.zh: 這間公司在當地市場扮演重要的角色。

sentences.en: We're sending out promotional emails this week.
sentences.zh: 我們這週要寄出促銷用的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Is this a promotional price or the regular price?
sentences.zh: 這是促銷價還是平常的價格？

sentences.en: The store offers promotional discounts on weekends.
sentences.zh: 這家店週末有促銷折扣。

sentences.en: Do you have any promotional items we can give away?
sentences.zh: 你們有可以送人的宣傳小禮品嗎？

sentences.en: The promotional video will go online on Monday.
sentences.zh: 宣傳影片會在週一上線。

sentences.en: She designed the promotional poster for the sale.
sentences.zh: 她設計了這次特賣的宣傳海報。

sentences.en: Please reply to the email promptly.
sentences.zh: 請儘快回覆這封電子郵件。

sentences.en: The meeting started promptly at nine.
sentences.zh: 會議九點準時開始。

sentences.en: Did the technician respond promptly?
sentences.zh: 技術人員有迅速回應嗎？

sentences.en: She promptly fixed the problem.
sentences.zh: 她很快就解決了問題。

sentences.en: Can you pay the invoice promptly this time?
sentences.zh: 這次你可以準時付清請款單嗎？

sentences.en: Customers expect orders to be shipped promptly.
sentences.zh: 顧客期望訂單能迅速出貨。

gloss_note: proofread a draft 校對草稿

sentences.en: Could you proofread my email before I send it?
sentences.zh: 我寄出前，你可以幫我校對這封電子郵件嗎？

sentences.en: I always proofread my reports twice.
sentences.zh: 我的報告一定會校對兩次。

sentences.en: She proofread the contract for typos.
sentences.zh: 她校對合約，檢查有沒有錯字。

sentences.en: Who will proofread the final draft?
sentences.zh: 誰來校對最後定稿？

sentences.en: Please proofread your essay before turning it in.
sentences.zh: 交作業前請先校對你的文章。

sentences.en: He proofread every page of the brochure.
sentences.zh: 他把這本小冊子每一頁都校對過了。

gloss_note: a business proposition 商業提案

sentences.en: That's a very interesting proposition.
sentences.zh: 這是個非常有趣的提議。

sentences.en: Her proposition was to split the cost evenly.
sentences.zh: 她的提議是平均分攤費用。

sentences.en: Is this a serious proposition or just a joke?
sentences.zh: 這是認真的提議，還是只是開玩笑？

sentences.en: The study tests the proposition that sleep improves memory.
sentences.zh: 這項研究檢驗「睡眠能改善記憶」的主張。

sentences.en: Do you think the client will accept our proposition?
sentences.zh: 你覺得客戶會接受我們的提議嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to make you a business proposition.
sentences.zh: 我想向你提出一個商業提議。

gloss_note: 美國地方檢察官稱 district attorney

sentences.en: The prosecutor presented the evidence to the jury.
sentences.zh: 檢察官向陪審團呈上證據。

sentences.en: Is the prosecutor going to appeal the decision?
sentences.zh: 檢察官會對這項判決提起上訴嗎？

sentences.en: She worked as a prosecutor for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她當了十年的檢察官。

sentences.en: The prosecutor asked the witness several questions.
sentences.zh: 檢察官問了證人好幾個問題。

sentences.en: Who is the lead prosecutor in this trial?
sentences.zh: 這場審判的首席檢察官是誰？

sentences.en: My friend wants to become a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 我朋友想當檢察官。

sentences.en: We emailed all prospective customers.
sentences.zh: 我們寄了電子郵件給所有潛在客戶。

sentences.en: Prospective students can tour the campus on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 有意就讀的學生週六可以參觀校園。

sentences.en: Do you have a list of prospective buyers?
sentences.zh: 你有潛在買家的名單嗎？

sentences.en: We're interviewing three prospective employees this week.
sentences.zh: 我們這週要面試三位可能錄用的人選。

sentences.en: Are there any prospective investors for this project?
sentences.zh: 這個專案有潛在的投資人嗎？

sentences.en: She showed the apartment to prospective tenants.
sentences.zh: 她帶有意承租的人看了這間公寓。

sentences.en: Wear protective gloves when you cut the peppers.
sentences.zh: 切辣椒的時候要戴防護手套。

sentences.en: Workers must wear protective gear on the site.
sentences.zh: 工地的工人必須穿戴防護裝備。

sentences.en: Is this case protective enough for my phone?
sentences.zh: 這個保護殼夠保護我的手機嗎？

sentences.en: She is very protective of her little brother.
sentences.zh: 她對弟弟的保護欲很強。

sentences.en: Do you sell protective glasses?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣防護眼鏡嗎？

sentences.en: A protective coating keeps the wood from getting wet.
sentences.zh: 一層保護塗料讓木頭不會被水浸濕。

sentences.en: Who is your Internet provider?
sentences.zh: 你的網路供應商是哪一家？

sentences.en: We're switching to a different service provider.
sentences.zh: 我們要換成另一家服務供應商。

sentences.en: The health care provider called me back.
sentences.zh: 醫療院所回電給我了。

sentences.en: The provider will ship the parts on Monday.
sentences.zh: 供應商週一會把零件寄出。

sentences.en: Our cable provider raised its rates again.
sentences.zh: 我們的有線電視業者又調漲費用了。

sentences.en: Is this a reliable provider of office supplies?
sentences.zh: 這是一家可靠的辦公用品供應商嗎？

gloss_note: vote by proxy 委託投票

sentences.en: I can't attend, so Maria will vote as my proxy.
sentences.zh: 我無法出席，所以瑪莉亞會當我的代理人投票。

sentences.en: Shareholders may vote by proxy.
sentences.zh: 股東可以委託他人代為投票。

sentences.en: Did you send in your proxy form?
sentences.zh: 你交了委託書嗎？

sentences.en: He acted as a proxy for the owner.
sentences.zh: 他擔任業主的代理人。

sentences.en: Who will be your proxy at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 誰會在會議上擔任你的代理人？

sentences.en: The proxy statement arrived in the mail.
sentences.zh: 委託書說明已經寄到了。

sentences.en: She works as a nurse in a psychiatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 她在精神科醫院擔任護理師。

sentences.en: Does your insurance cover psychiatric care?
sentences.zh: 你的保險涵蓋精神科治療嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor ordered a full psychiatric evaluation.
sentences.zh: 醫師要求做完整的精神科評估。

sentences.en: Is there a psychiatric unit at this hospital?
sentences.zh: 這間醫院有精神科病房嗎？

sentences.en: Some students need psychiatric care for severe anxiety during exam season.
sentences.zh: 有些學生在考試季因嚴重焦慮需要精神科治療。

sentences.en: A psychiatric study found that sleep affects mood.
sentences.zh: 一項精神醫學研究發現，睡眠會影響情緒。

sentences.en: I'm taking an intro psychology class this semester.
sentences.zh: 我這學期修心理學概論。

sentences.en: Why is the psychology of money so interesting?
sentences.zh: 為什麼金錢心理學這麼有趣？

sentences.en: She has a degree in psychology.
sentences.zh: 她擁有心理學學位。

sentences.en: Understanding customer psychology helps us price our products.
sentences.zh: 了解顧客心理有助於我們替產品訂價。

sentences.en: Did you major in psychology or sociology?
sentences.zh: 你主修的是心理學還是社會學？

sentences.en: The psychology of crowds can explain sudden market panic.
sentences.zh: 群眾心理可以解釋市場突然恐慌的現象。

sentences.en: The company will publicly announce its results on Monday.
sentences.zh: 公司將於週一公開發布業績。

sentences.en: Is it a publicly traded company?
sentences.zh: 那是一家公開上市的公司嗎？

sentences.en: He publicly apologized for the mistake.
sentences.zh: 他為這個錯誤公開道歉。

sentences.en: Please don't discuss this publicly until the deal is final.
sentences.zh: 在交易定案前，請不要公開討論這件事。

sentences.en: Why didn't they publicly admit the problem sooner?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼沒有早點公開承認這個問題？

sentences.en: The data is publicly available on the city's website.
sentences.zh: 這些資料可在市政府網站上公開取得。

gloss_note: publish a paper 發表論文

sentences.en: When will the publisher publish her new book?
sentences.zh: 出版社什麼時候會出版她的新書？

sentences.en: Our team plans to publish the results next month.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊打算下個月發表研究結果。

sentences.en: Did the magazine publish your article?
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌刊登了你的文章嗎？

sentences.en: I need to publish this article before noon.
sentences.zh: 我得在中午前發表這篇文章。

sentences.en: They publish a newsletter every Friday.
sentences.zh: 他們每週五發行一份電子報。

sentences.en: Professors must publish papers to get promoted.
sentences.zh: 教授必須發表論文才能升等。

sentences.en: The nurse checked my pulse and blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 護理師量了我的脈搏和血壓。

sentences.en: Can you feel a pulse on his wrist?
sentences.zh: 你摸得到他手腕上的脈搏嗎？

sentences.en: My pulse was racing before the big interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前我的脈搏跳得飛快。

sentences.en: What's a normal resting pulse for adults?
sentences.zh: 成人休息時的正常脈搏是多少？

sentences.en: A strong pulse is a sign of good health.
sentences.zh: 強而有力的脈搏是健康的徵象。

sentences.en: The survey will help us take the pulse of our customers.
sentences.zh: 這項調查能幫我們掌握顧客的脈動。

gloss_note: 多用於合約；日常說 buyer

sentences.en: The purchaser must pay within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 買方必須在三十天內付款。

sentences.en: Who is the purchaser listed on this receipt?
sentences.zh: 這張收據上列的購買人是誰？

sentences.en: Each purchaser will receive a free gift.
sentences.zh: 每位購買者都會收到一份免費贈品。

sentences.en: Is the purchaser responsible for shipping costs?
sentences.zh: 運費是由買方負責嗎？

sentences.en: The purchaser signed the agreement last Friday.
sentences.zh: 買方上週五簽了協議。

sentences.en: The new purchaser plans to expand the factory.
sentences.zh: 新的買家打算擴建工廠。

sentences.en: We need qualitative feedback, not just numbers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要質性回饋，而不只是數字。

sentences.en: Did you do any qualitative research before the launch?
sentences.zh: 上市前你們做過質性研究嗎？

sentences.en: Interviews are a common qualitative method.
sentences.zh: 訪談是常見的質性研究方法。

sentences.en: The report offers a qualitative analysis of customer habits.
sentences.zh: 這份報告對顧客習慣做了質性分析。

sentences.en: Is this a qualitative difference or just a small change?
sentences.zh: 這是質的差異，還是只是小小的改變？

sentences.en: Focus groups give us qualitative insights into what people want.
sentences.zh: 焦點團體提供質性的洞察，讓我們了解人們想要什麼。

sentences.en: She has a strong quantitative background.
sentences.zh: 她有扎實的量化背景。

sentences.en: Do you prefer quantitative or qualitative research?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡量化研究還是質性研究？

sentences.en: The bank hired a quantitative analyst.
sentences.zh: 銀行聘請了一位量化分析師。

sentences.en: We need quantitative data to support this claim.
sentences.zh: 我們需要量化數據來支持這個說法。

sentences.en: Is a survey of five hundred people quantitative research?
sentences.zh: 調查五百人的問卷算量化研究嗎？

sentences.en: The study used quantitative methods to measure sleep quality.
sentences.zh: 這項研究用量化方法來衡量睡眠品質。

sentences.en: Our quarterly report is due next Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們的季報下週五截止。

sentences.en: Are quarterly sales up or down this year?
sentences.zh: 今年的季銷售額是上升還是下降？

sentences.en: The board meets quarterly to review the budget.
sentences.zh: 董事會每季開會檢討預算。

sentences.en: Did you pay your quarterly taxes on time?
sentences.zh: 你有按時繳交每季稅款嗎？

sentences.en: They send customers a quarterly newsletter.
sentences.zh: 他們每季寄一份電子報給客戶。

sentences.en: Quarterly earnings beat expectations for the third time in a row.
sentences.zh: 季度獲利連續第三次優於預期。

gloss_note: 多用於書面；口語多說 question

sentences.en: Our support team answered my query about the invoice.
sentences.zh: 客服團隊回覆了我對請款單的詢問。

sentences.en: Who can answer this customer query?
sentences.zh: 誰能回答這位顧客的詢問？

sentences.en: We usually reply to every query within a day.
sentences.zh: 我們通常會在一天內回覆每一個詢問。

sentences.en: Please send any queries to the HR team.
sentences.zh: 如有疑問，請寄給人資部門。

sentences.en: Can I submit a query through your website?
sentences.zh: 我可以透過你們的網站提出詢問嗎？

sentences.en: We sent a query about the delay to the supplier.
sentences.zh: 我們向供應商發了一份關於延誤的詢問。

gloss_note: fill out a questionnaire 填問卷

sentences.en: Please fill out this questionnaire before your appointment.
sentences.zh: 請在看診前填寫這份問卷。

sentences.en: How long does the questionnaire take to complete?
sentences.zh: 這份問卷要花多久時間填完？

sentences.en: We sent a questionnaire to every employee.
sentences.zh: 我們寄了一份問卷給每位員工。

sentences.en: Did you finish the questionnaire about the course?
sentences.zh: 你填完那份課程問卷了嗎？

sentences.en: The questionnaire asks about eating and sleeping habits.
sentences.zh: 這份問卷詢問飲食和睡眠習慣。

sentences.en: Four hundred people returned the questionnaire.
sentences.zh: 有四百人交回了問卷。

gloss_note: meet the quota 達到配額

sentences.en: Our sales team hit its quota early this quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們的業務團隊這一季提早達到配額。

sentences.en: Did you meet your monthly quota?
sentences.zh: 你達到月配額了嗎？

sentences.en: The country set a quota on steel imports.
sentences.zh: 該國對鋼鐵進口設了配額。

sentences.en: What is the quota for new hires this year?
sentences.zh: 今年新進人員的名額是多少？

sentences.en: Each student gets a printing quota of 200 pages.
sentences.zh: 每位學生有兩百頁的列印額度。

sentences.en: He worked overtime to fill the quota.
sentences.zh: 他加班來完成配額。

sentences.en: Please hang your coat on the rack by the door.
sentences.zh: 請把外套掛在門邊的架子上。

sentences.en: Is there a bike rack near the entrance?
sentences.zh: 入口附近有腳踏車架嗎？

sentences.en: The shop has a rack of discounted shirts.
sentences.zh: 這家店有一整架特價襯衫。

sentences.en: Can you put the dishes on the drying rack?
sentences.zh: 你可以把盤子放到瀝水架上嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel room has a luggage rack next to the closet.
sentences.zh: 飯店客房的衣櫃旁有一個行李架。

sentences.en: She grabbed a magazine from the rack at the airport.
sentences.zh: 她在機場從雜誌架上拿了一本雜誌。

sentences.en: Too much radiation can be harmful to your health.
sentences.zh: 過量輻射可能有害健康。

sentences.en: Do X-rays expose patients to radiation?
sentences.zh: X光檢查會讓病人暴露在輻射下嗎？

sentences.en: Sunscreen protects your skin from ultraviolet radiation.
sentences.zh: 防曬乳保護皮膚免受紫外線輻射。

sentences.en: The lab workers wear special suits to block radiation.
sentences.zh: 實驗室人員穿特殊防護衣來阻擋輻射。

sentences.en: How much radiation does a smartphone give off?
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機會釋放多少輻射？

sentences.en: Radiation levels near the old plant remain low.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠附近的輻射量仍然很低。

sentences.en: Stocks rallied after the surprise rate cut.
sentences.zh: 降息出乎意料後，股市反彈上揚。

sentences.en: Will the market rally before the end of the year?
sentences.zh: 年底前市場會反彈嗎？

sentences.en: Students gathered for a pep rally before the big game.
sentences.zh: 學生們在大賽前聚集參加鼓舞士氣的集會。

sentences.en: Our stock price had a strong rally last week.
sentences.zh: 我們的股價上週大幅反彈。

sentences.en: Will fans hold a rally to keep the team from moving?
sentences.zh: 球迷會舉行集會，試圖讓球隊不要搬走嗎？

sentences.en: Shares began to rally as soon as the news came out.
sentences.zh: 消息一出，股價就開始反彈。

sentences.en: Let's make a rational decision, not an emotional one.
sentences.zh: 我們來做理性的決定，而不是情緒化的決定。

sentences.en: Is there a rational explanation for this error?
sentences.zh: 這個錯誤有合理的解釋嗎？

sentences.en: Investors don't always act in a rational way.
sentences.zh: 投資人並不總是理性行事。

sentences.en: She stayed calm and rational during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 她在危機中保持冷靜理性。

sentences.en: Can you give me one rational reason to quit?
sentences.zh: 你能給我一個合理的辭職理由嗎？

sentences.en: A rational buyer compares prices before choosing.
sentences.zh: 理性的買家會在選擇前比較價格。

sentences.en: Spare parts are readily available at the store.
sentences.zh: 店裡隨時買得到備用零件。

sentences.en: She readily agreed to help with the project.
sentences.zh: 她欣然同意協助這個專案。

sentences.en: Are these tickets readily available online?
sentences.zh: 這些票在網路上容易買到嗎？

sentences.en: Smartphones make information readily accessible to everyone.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機讓每個人都能輕易取得資訊。

sentences.en: He readily admitted that he had made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 他爽快地承認自己犯了錯。

sentences.en: Can this tool be readily installed on any laptop?
sentences.zh: 這個工具能輕易安裝在任何筆電上嗎？

gloss_note: realistic goal 切合實際的目標

sentences.en: Is that deadline realistic for such a big project?
sentences.zh: 這麼大的專案，那個期限切合實際嗎？

sentences.en: We need to set realistic goals for next year.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為明年訂定切合實際的目標。

sentences.en: The special effects in this movie look very realistic.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的特效看起來非常逼真。

sentences.en: Let's be realistic; we can't finish by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們實際一點，週五是做不完的。

sentences.en: Does the budget seem realistic to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個預算切合實際嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me a realistic picture of life abroad.
sentences.zh: 她讓我看到國外生活的真實面貌。

gloss_note: 美式用法，口語常說房仲

sentences.en: Our realtor showed us three houses on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 房仲週六帶我們看了三間房子。

sentences.en: Do you know a good realtor in this area?
sentences.zh: 你知道這一帶有好的房仲嗎？

sentences.en: The realtor put a sold sign in the yard.
sentences.zh: 房仲在院子裡插上了「已售出」的牌子。

sentences.en: How much does a realtor charge for selling a house?
sentences.zh: 房仲賣房子要收多少費用？

sentences.en: She became a realtor after working in banking.
sentences.zh: 她在銀行工作後轉行當房仲。

sentences.en: The realtor called to say the seller accepted our offer.
sentences.zh: 房仲打來說賣方接受了我們的出價。

gloss_note: rearrange the furniture 重新擺放家具

sentences.en: Can we rearrange the schedule so the meeting is on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 我們可以調整時程，把會議排在週四嗎？

sentences.en: I want to rearrange the furniture in the living room.
sentences.zh: 我想重新擺放客廳的家具。

sentences.en: We had to rearrange our travel plans because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們得重新安排行程。

sentences.en: Could you rearrange the schedule so I can leave early?
sentences.zh: 你能調整一下班表讓我早點走嗎？

sentences.en: They rearranged the shelves to make more space.
sentences.zh: 他們重新排列貨架來騰出更多空間。

sentences.en: Why did the store rearrange everything again?
sentences.zh: 這家店為什麼又把東西全部重新擺過了？

sentences.en: Teenagers often rebel against their parents' rules.
sentences.zh: 青少年常常反抗父母訂的規矩。

sentences.en: Did the staff rebel against the new dress code?
sentences.zh: 員工有反抗新的服裝規定嗎？

sentences.en: She was a rebel who never followed the rules.
sentences.zh: 她是個從不守規矩的叛逆者。

sentences.en: A few investors rebelled against the board's plan.
sentences.zh: 幾位投資人反對董事會的計畫。

sentences.en: He's a rebel in the office, but his ideas work.
sentences.zh: 他在公司裡很叛逆，但他的點子很管用。

sentences.en: Why do some workers rebel when change is announced?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些員工一宣布改變就起而反抗？

sentences.en: Accounts receivable rose sharply last quarter.
sentences.zh: 應收帳款上一季大幅增加。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of accounts receivable?
sentences.zh: 誰負責應收帳款？

sentences.en: Our receivable from this client is now thirty days overdue.
sentences.zh: 我們對這位客戶的應收款項已逾期三十天。

sentences.en: Are all the receivables listed on the balance sheet?
sentences.zh: 資產負債表上列出所有應收款項了嗎？

sentences.en: The bank offered a loan backed by our receivables.
sentences.zh: 銀行提供了一筆以我們的應收帳款為擔保的貸款。

sentences.en: We track receivable balances every week.
sentences.zh: 我們每週追蹤應收款餘額。

sentences.en: Please check in at the reception desk.
sentences.zh: 請到接待櫃檯報到。

sentences.en: Is the welcome reception at six o'clock?
sentences.zh: 歡迎會是六點開始嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel hosted a wedding reception for two hundred guests.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店舉辦了容納兩百位賓客的婚宴。

sentences.en: Leave your package at the reception desk, and I'll pick it up.
sentences.zh: 把包裹放在接待櫃檯，我會去拿。

sentences.en: Where is the reception area on this floor?
sentences.zh: 這一層的接待區在哪裡？

sentences.en: There will be a reception after the conference.
sentences.zh: 研討會結束後會有一場招待會。

gloss_note: 常見於診所、飯店、辦公室

sentences.en: The receptionist greeted us with a smile.
sentences.zh: 接待員面帶微笑地招呼我們。

sentences.en: Could you ask the receptionist to call a taxi?
sentences.zh: 你可以請櫃檯人員幫忙叫計程車嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a receptionist at a dental clinic.
sentences.zh: 她在牙醫診所擔任櫃檯接待員。

sentences.en: Did the receptionist give you a visitor pass?
sentences.zh: 接待員有給你訪客證嗎？

sentences.en: Our receptionist handles all incoming calls.
sentences.zh: 我們的接待員負責處理所有來電。

sentences.en: The receptionist said Dr. Lin would be ready soon.
sentences.zh: 接待員說林醫師很快就能看診。

sentences.en: Each receptor on the cell binds to a specific molecule.
sentences.zh: 細胞上的每個受體只會和特定分子結合。

sentences.en: How does a pain receptor send signals to the brain?
sentences.zh: 痛覺感受器如何把訊號傳到大腦？

sentences.en: Some medicines block receptors in the brain.
sentences.zh: 有些藥物會阻斷大腦中的受體。

sentences.en: The nose contains many smell receptors.
sentences.zh: 鼻子裡有許多嗅覺受體。

sentences.en: Scientists discovered a new receptor linked to sleep.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現了一種與睡眠有關的新受體。

sentences.en: Is a receptor usually a protein?
sentences.zh: 受體通常是蛋白質嗎？

gloss_note: in a recession 處於衰退期

sentences.en: Many experts fear a recession next year.
sentences.zh: 許多專家擔心明年會出現經濟衰退。

sentences.en: Are we heading into a recession?
sentences.zh: 我們是不是要進入經濟衰退了？

sentences.en: The company laid off workers during the recession.
sentences.zh: 公司在經濟衰退期間裁員了。

sentences.en: How long did the last recession last?
sentences.zh: 上一次的經濟衰退持續了多久？

sentences.en: Housing prices dropped sharply during the recession.
sentences.zh: 房價在經濟衰退期間大幅下跌。

sentences.en: We need a plan in case a recession hits.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一個萬一經濟衰退來襲時的計畫。

gloss_note: recipe for success 成功秘訣

sentences.en: Can you send me your grandmother's cake recipe?
sentences.zh: 你可以把你奶奶的蛋糕食譜寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: This recipe takes only twenty minutes to make.
sentences.zh: 照這份食譜做，只要二十分鐘就能完成。

sentences.en: I followed the recipe, but the soup tasted bland.
sentences.zh: 我照著食譜做，但湯還是很淡。

sentences.en: Where did you find this recipe?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡找到這份食譜的？

sentences.en: Hard work is the only recipe for success.
sentences.zh: 努力是成功唯一的秘訣。

sentences.en: Does the recipe call for butter or oil?
sentences.zh: 這份食譜要用奶油還是油？

sentences.en: The recipient must sign for the package.
sentences.zh: 收件人必須簽收包裹。

sentences.en: Who is the recipient of this email?
sentences.zh: 這封郵件的收件人是誰？

sentences.en: She was the recipient of a national award.
sentences.zh: 她是一項全國性獎項的得主。

sentences.en: Please enter the recipient's address here.
sentences.zh: 請在這裡填寫收件人的地址。

sentences.en: Is the recipient of the loan a small business?
sentences.zh: 這筆貸款的對象是小型企業嗎？

sentences.en: Each recipient will get a thank-you card.
sentences.zh: 每位受贈者都會收到一張感謝卡。

sentences.en: The hotel offers many recreational activities for guests.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店為房客提供許多休閒活動。

sentences.en: Is there a recreational area near the office?
sentences.zh: 辦公室附近有休閒區嗎？

sentences.en: The park has a recreational center for families.
sentences.zh: 這座公園有一座供家庭使用的休閒中心。

sentences.en: Do you use the gym for recreational purposes?
sentences.zh: 你去健身房是為了休閒嗎？

sentences.en: Recreational sports help students relax after class.
sentences.zh: 休閒運動能幫學生下課後放鬆。

sentences.en: What recreational facilities does the campus have?
sentences.zh: 校園裡有哪些休閒設施？

gloss_note: 常指企業或人力仲介的招聘者

sentences.en: A recruiter called me about a new job.
sentences.zh: 有位招募人員打電話跟我談一份新工作。

sentences.en: Did the recruiter send you the job description?
sentences.zh: 招聘專員有把職務說明寄給你嗎？

sentences.en: Our recruiter is looking for three engineers.
sentences.zh: 我們的招聘專員正在找三位工程師。

sentences.en: The recruiter asked about my salary expectations.
sentences.zh: 招聘專員問了我的期望薪資。

sentences.en: How did the recruiter find your profile?
sentences.zh: 招聘專員是怎麼找到你的個人檔案的？

sentences.en: She works as a recruiter for a staffing agency.
sentences.zh: 她在人力仲介公司擔任招募人員。

gloss_note: hold a referendum 舉辦公投

sentences.en: Voters will decide on the issue in a referendum.
sentences.zh: 選民將透過公民投票來決定這個議題。

sentences.en: When is the referendum on the new tax?
sentences.zh: 新稅制的公民投票是什麼時候？

sentences.en: The city held a referendum on building a new library.
sentences.zh: 市政府針對興建新圖書館舉辦了公民投票。

sentences.en: Turnout in the referendum was higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 公民投票的投票率比預期的高。

sentences.en: Do you know how a referendum works?
sentences.zh: 你知道公民投票是怎麼運作的嗎？

sentences.en: The referendum asked residents whether to extend the bus line.
sentences.zh: 這次公投詢問居民是否延長公車路線。

sentences.en: Refreshments will be served after the presentation.
sentences.zh: 簡報結束後會提供茶點。

sentences.en: Are refreshments included in the ticket price?
sentences.zh: 票價有包含茶點嗎？

sentences.en: We ordered coffee and snacks as refreshments for the guests.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了咖啡和點心給賓客當茶點。

sentences.en: Where can I get some light refreshments?
sentences.zh: 我可以去哪裡買點簡單的茶點？

sentences.en: The hotel lobby offers free refreshments in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳下午提供免費茶點。

sentences.en: Please help yourself to the refreshments on the table.
sentences.zh: 請自行取用桌上的茶點。

gloss_note: get a refund 拿到退款

sentences.en: I'd like a refund for this broken toaster.
sentences.zh: 我想為這台壞掉的烤麵包機退款。

sentences.en: How long does a refund take to process?
sentences.zh: 退款要花多久時間處理？

sentences.en: The airline will refund your ticket if you cancel today.
sentences.zh: 如果你今天取消，航空公司會退還你的機票款。

sentences.en: Did you get a full refund?
sentences.zh: 你拿到全額退款了嗎？

sentences.en: Keep your receipt if you want a refund.
sentences.zh: 如果想退款，請保留收據。

sentences.en: The store refunded me within three days.
sentences.zh: 店家三天內就把錢退給我了。

sentences.en: The government introduced a new tax regime this year.
sentences.zh: 政府今年推出了新的稅制。

sentences.en: Is the new regulatory regime clear to everyone?
sentences.zh: 新的監管制度大家都清楚嗎？

sentences.en: Our company operates under a strict safety regime.
sentences.zh: 我們公司在嚴格的安全制度下運作。

sentences.en: Which trade regime applies to these goods?
sentences.zh: 這批貨適用哪一種貿易制度？

sentences.en: The country moved to a flexible exchange rate regime.
sentences.zh: 該國改採彈性匯率制度。

sentences.en: How does the new pricing regime affect small shops?
sentences.zh: 新的定價制度對小商店有什麼影響？

sentences.en: We ran a regression to test the sales trend.
sentences.zh: 我們做了迴歸分析來檢驗銷售趨勢。

sentences.en: Does the regression show a strong link?
sentences.zh: 迴歸分析顯示出很強的關聯嗎？

sentences.en: A linear regression line fits the data well.
sentences.zh: 線性迴歸線與資料吻合得很好。

sentences.en: What does the regression tell us about prices?
sentences.zh: 這個迴歸結果告訴我們價格的什麼資訊？

sentences.en: The child showed regression in his reading skills.
sentences.zh: 這個孩子的閱讀能力出現退步。

sentences.en: Regression analysis is common in economics research.
sentences.zh: 迴歸分析在經濟學研究中很常見。

gloss_note: financial regulator 金融監理機構

sentences.en: The financial regulator fined the bank.
sentences.zh: 金融監理機構對那家銀行處以罰款。

sentences.en: Has the regulator approved the merger?
sentences.zh: 監管機構批准這項合併了嗎？

sentences.en: We must report the incident to the regulator.
sentences.zh: 我們必須向主管機關通報這起事件。

sentences.en: Regulators are reviewing the new safety rules.
sentences.zh: 監管機構正在審查新的安全規範。

sentences.en: Who is the regulator for the airline industry?
sentences.zh: 航空業的主管機關是誰？

sentences.en: The regulator warned companies about misleading ads.
sentences.zh: 主管機關警告各家公司不要刊登誤導性廣告。

sentences.en: We need regulatory approval before the launch.
sentences.zh: 上市前我們需要取得監管機關核准。

sentences.en: Is this product subject to regulatory review?
sentences.zh: 這項產品需要接受法規審查嗎？

sentences.en: The company faces new regulatory requirements next year.
sentences.zh: 公司明年將面臨新的法規要求。

sentences.en: Which regulatory agency handles food safety?
sentences.zh: 哪個監管機構負責食品安全？

sentences.en: Regulatory changes made our costs go up.
sentences.zh: 法規變動使我們的成本上升了。

sentences.en: Who is responsible for regulatory compliance here?
sentences.zh: 這裡誰負責法規遵循？

gloss_note: rehearse a speech 預演講稿

sentences.en: We rehearse every Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 我們每週二晚上排練。

sentences.en: Can we rehearse the presentation one more time?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把簡報再預演一次嗎？

sentences.en: She rehearsed her speech in front of the mirror.
sentences.zh: 她對著鏡子預演講稿。

sentences.en: Did the band rehearse before the concert?
sentences.zh: 樂團在演唱會前有排練嗎？

sentences.en: He rehearsed the interview questions with a friend.
sentences.zh: 他和朋友一起演練面試問題。

sentences.en: The actors rehearse for six hours a day.
sentences.zh: 演員們每天排練六小時。

gloss_note: reimburse A for B 償還 A 代墊的 B

sentences.en: Will the company reimburse me for my travel costs?
sentences.zh: 公司會給付我的差旅費嗎？

sentences.en: We'll reimburse you within two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我們會在兩週內把錢還給你。

sentences.en: Please submit your receipts so we can reimburse you.
sentences.zh: 請提交收據，我們才能幫你核銷。

sentences.en: Did the insurance reimburse the cost of your treatment?
sentences.zh: 保險有給付你的治療費用嗎？

sentences.en: The airline agreed to reimburse passengers for meals.
sentences.zh: 航空公司同意補償乘客的餐費。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get reimbursed?
sentences.zh: 要多久才能拿回代墊的錢？

gloss_note: reinforce the rules 強化規定

sentences.en: We need to reinforce the safety rules.
sentences.zh: 我們需要加強安全規定。

sentences.en: How can teachers reinforce what students learn?
sentences.zh: 老師要怎麼加強學生所學的內容？

sentences.en: Workers reinforced the old bridge with steel beams.
sentences.zh: 工人用鋼樑加固了老舊的橋。

sentences.en: These results reinforce our decision to expand.
sentences.zh: 這些結果強化了我們擴張的決定。

sentences.en: Does the new policy reinforce good habits?
sentences.zh: 這項新政策有助於強化好習慣嗎？

sentences.en: Regular practice will reinforce your English skills.
sentences.zh: 定期練習會強化你的英文能力。

sentences.en: Customers care about the reliability of our service.
sentences.zh: 顧客在意我們服務的可靠性。

sentences.en: How can we test the reliability of this data?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼檢驗這份資料的可靠度？

sentences.en: This car is famous for its reliability.
sentences.zh: 這款車以可靠性聞名。

sentences.en: Is the reliability of the network good enough?
sentences.zh: 網路的可靠性夠好嗎？

sentences.en: The study questions the reliability of online reviews.
sentences.zh: 這項研究質疑網路評論的可信度。

sentences.en: Delivery reliability is key to winning new clients.
sentences.zh: 送貨的可靠度是贏得新客戶的關鍵。

sentences.en: Our company plans to relocate to Texas next year.
sentences.zh: 我們公司打算明年搬到德州。

sentences.en: Would you be willing to relocate for this job?
sentences.zh: 你願意為這份工作搬家嗎？

sentences.en: The firm relocated its headquarters last spring.
sentences.zh: 這家公司去年春天遷移了總部。

sentences.en: Do they pay moving costs if you relocate?
sentences.zh: 如果你搬遷，他們會付搬家費嗎？

sentences.en: She had to relocate after her husband got a new job.
sentences.zh: 她先生換了新工作，所以她得搬家。

sentences.en: We're relocating our team to the new office downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們正在把團隊搬到市中心的新辦公室。

sentences.en: He was reluctant to share his opinion.
sentences.zh: 他不太願意分享自己的意見。

sentences.en: Why are you so reluctant to apply for the job?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼不願意應徵那份工作？

sentences.en: Many customers are reluctant to try new products.
sentences.zh: 許多顧客不願嘗試新產品。

sentences.en: She gave a reluctant smile and sat down.
sentences.zh: 她勉強擠出一個微笑然後坐下。

sentences.en: Are investors still reluctant to buy stocks?
sentences.zh: 投資人仍然不願買股票嗎？

sentences.en: The manager was reluctant to approve the extra budget.
sentences.zh: 經理不太願意核准額外預算。

sentences.en: I'll finish the remainder of the report tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 報告剩下的部分我明天會完成。

sentences.en: What should we do with the remainder of the budget?
sentences.zh: 剩下的預算我們該怎麼處理？

sentences.en: He spent the remainder of the week at home.
sentences.zh: 他在家度過了這星期剩下的時間。

sentences.en: Please pay the remainder within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 請在三十天內付清餘額。

sentences.en: Is the remainder of the food in the fridge?
sentences.zh: 剩下的食物都在冰箱裡嗎？

sentences.en: Only half of the tickets sold; the remainder were returned.
sentences.zh: 只賣出一半的票，其餘都退回了。

sentences.en: The company offered a quick remedy for the error.
sentences.zh: 公司針對這個錯誤提出了快速的補救辦法。

sentences.en: Is there a simple remedy for a sore throat?
sentences.zh: 喉嚨痛有簡單的療法嗎？

sentences.en: Honey and lemon is an old home remedy for coughs.
sentences.zh: 蜂蜜加檸檬是治咳嗽的老偏方。

sentences.en: What remedy do you suggest for late shipments?
sentences.zh: 針對延遲出貨，你建議什麼補救辦法？

sentences.en: We must remedy the problem before the audit.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在稽核前補救這個問題。

sentences.en: Lawmakers passed a bill to remedy the shortage.
sentences.zh: 立法者通過了一項法案來解決短缺問題。

gloss_note: 美式常用；多指改變格局或樣式的整修

sentences.en: We're going to remodel our kitchen this summer.
sentences.zh: 我們今年夏天要重新裝修廚房。

sentences.en: How much would it cost to remodel the bathroom?
sentences.zh: 重新整修浴室要花多少錢？

sentences.en: The restaurant closed to remodel the dining room.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳為了改裝用餐區而暫停營業。

sentences.en: They remodeled the old office into a modern workspace.
sentences.zh: 他們把舊辦公室改建成現代化的工作空間。

sentences.en: Did you remodel the house before you moved in?
sentences.zh: 你搬進去之前有重新裝修房子嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel will remodel all of its rooms next year.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店明年會翻修所有客房。

sentences.en: The removal of the old sign took an hour.
sentences.zh: 拆下舊招牌花了一小時。

sentences.en: Does the removal of ads cost extra?
sentences.zh: 移除廣告要額外收費嗎？

sentences.en: Stain removal is easier when the spill is fresh.
sentences.zh: 污漬在剛弄髒時比較好清除。

sentences.en: The city approved the removal of the dangerous tree.
sentences.zh: 市政府核准移除那棵危險的樹。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of snow removal here?
sentences.zh: 這裡由誰負責清雪？

sentences.en: The removal of the old files freed up space.
sentences.zh: 清除舊檔案後騰出了空間。

sentences.en: The heavy rain rendered the road unsafe to drive on.
sentences.zh: 大雨使道路無法安全行駛。

sentences.en: Please pay for the services rendered last month.
sentences.zh: 請支付上個月所提供服務的費用。

sentences.en: The new law may render the old rules useless.
sentences.zh: 新法律可能讓舊規定形同虛設。

sentences.en: The clinic rendered free care to hundreds of patients.
sentences.zh: 這家診所為數百名病患提供免費醫療。

sentences.en: Did the injury render her unable to work?
sentences.zh: 這次受傷讓她無法工作了嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the update render my phone so slow?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這次更新讓我的手機變得這麼慢？

sentences.en: I need to renew my passport soon.
sentences.zh: 我得趕快換發護照。

sentences.en: When do you have to renew your lease?
sentences.zh: 你的租約什麼時候要續約？

sentences.en: Please renew your membership before it expires.
sentences.zh: 請在會員資格到期前續約。

sentences.en: Did the company renew your contract?
sentences.zh: 公司有跟你續約嗎？

sentences.en: You can renew library books online.
sentences.zh: 你可以在網路上續借圖書館的書。

sentences.en: Can I renew my subscription for another year?
sentences.zh: 我可以再續訂一年嗎？

sentences.en: Your lease renewal is due next month.
sentences.zh: 你的租約下個月要續約。

sentences.en: When is the renewal date for the contract?
sentences.zh: 合約的續約日是什麼時候？

sentences.en: Did you get the renewal notice in the mail?
sentences.zh: 你有收到郵寄來的續約通知嗎？

sentences.en: Our insurance renewal costs more this year.
sentences.zh: 我們今年的保險續保費用比較高。

sentences.en: Passport renewal takes about six weeks.
sentences.zh: 護照換發大約要六週。

sentences.en: Is online renewal available for this license?
sentences.zh: 這張執照可以線上換發嗎？

gloss_note: renovate a house 整修房子

sentences.en: They plan to renovate the old hotel.
sentences.zh: 他們打算整修那間老飯店。

sentences.en: How long will it take to renovate the lobby?
sentences.zh: 整修大廳要花多久時間？

sentences.en: We renovated the kitchen last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們去年夏天整修了廚房。

sentences.en: Did the city renovate the train station?
sentences.zh: 市政府有翻新火車站嗎？

sentences.en: The landlord agreed to renovate the apartment before we moved in.
sentences.zh: 房東同意在我們搬進去前翻新公寓。

sentences.en: The school will renovate its gym over the break.
sentences.zh: 學校會趁假期整修體育館。

sentences.en: The renovation will take about three months.
sentences.zh: 整修大約要花三個月。

sentences.en: Is the hotel closed for renovation?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店因整修而關閉嗎？

sentences.en: Our home renovation went over budget.
sentences.zh: 我們的住家整修超出預算。

sentences.en: How much does a kitchen renovation cost?
sentences.zh: 廚房翻修要花多少錢？

sentences.en: The museum reopens after a major renovation.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館在大規模整修後重新開放。

sentences.en: Please excuse the noise from the renovation next door.
sentences.zh: 請見諒隔壁整修造成的噪音。

gloss_note: reopen a case 重啟案件

sentences.en: The restaurant will reopen on Monday.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳週一會重新開幕。

sentences.en: When does the museum reopen after the storm?
sentences.zh: 博物館在風暴後什麼時候重新開放？

sentences.en: Can we reopen this ticket if the issue comes back?
sentences.zh: 如果問題又出現，我們可以重新開啟這張服務單嗎？

sentences.en: The school will reopen once the repairs are done.
sentences.zh: 修繕完成後，學校就會重新開放。

sentences.en: Please don't reopen the debate; we already decided.
sentences.zh: 請不要再重啟討論，我們已經決定了。

sentences.en: Did the shop reopen after the fire?
sentences.zh: 那間店火災後有重新開張嗎？

sentences.en: How soon do you need to repay the loan?
sentences.zh: 你多快需要償還這筆貸款？

sentences.en: I'll repay you as soon as I get paid.
sentences.zh: 我一領到薪水就還你錢。

sentences.en: She repaid the money within a year.
sentences.zh: 她在一年內還清了那筆錢。

sentences.en: Can I repay my student loan early?
sentences.zh: 我可以提前償還學貸嗎？

sentences.en: He wanted to repay his friend's kindness.
sentences.zh: 他想回報朋友的善意。

sentences.en: The company repaid its debt ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 這家公司提前還清了債務。

sentences.en: The monthly repayment is about five hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 每月還款額約五百美元。

sentences.en: What are the repayment terms of this loan?
sentences.zh: 這筆貸款的還款條件是什麼？

sentences.en: Late repayment may lead to extra fees.
sentences.zh: 延遲還款可能會產生額外費用。

sentences.en: Can I make an early repayment without a penalty?
sentences.zh: 我可以提前還款而不被罰款嗎？

sentences.en: Repayment of the debt will take ten years.
sentences.zh: 這筆債務的償還需要十年。

sentences.en: Did you set up automatic repayment?
sentences.zh: 你有設定自動還款嗎？

sentences.en: The pianist has a huge repertoire of classical pieces.
sentences.zh: 這位鋼琴家擁有龐大的古典曲目。

sentences.en: Does the band's repertoire include new songs?
sentences.zh: 樂團的曲目包含新歌嗎？

sentences.en: Our chef has a wide repertoire of pasta dishes.
sentences.zh: 我們的主廚擅長的義大利麵菜色很多。

sentences.en: She added a few new jokes to her comedy repertoire.
sentences.zh: 她為自己的喜劇表演增添了幾則新笑話。

sentences.en: What is the usual repertoire of a jazz singer?
sentences.zh: 爵士歌手通常會唱哪些曲目？

sentences.en: Good teachers have a large repertoire of ways to explain ideas.
sentences.zh: 好老師擁有多種講解概念的方法。

gloss_note: reproduce an error 重現錯誤

sentences.en: Can you reproduce the error on your computer?
sentences.zh: 你能在你的電腦上重現這個錯誤嗎？

sentences.en: Other scientists could not reproduce the results.
sentences.zh: 其他科學家無法重現這些結果。

sentences.en: Do not reproduce this document without permission.
sentences.zh: 未經許可，請勿複製這份文件。

sentences.en: The printer can reproduce colors very accurately.
sentences.zh: 這台印表機能非常準確地重現色彩。

sentences.en: Why can't we reproduce last month's test results?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們無法重現上個月的測試結果？

sentences.en: It's hard to reproduce the flavor of this sauce at home.
sentences.zh: 這種醬汁的味道很難在家複製出來。

sentences.en: The company announced a share repurchase program.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布了一項股票回購計畫。

sentences.en: Will they repurchase more shares this year?
sentences.zh: 他們今年會回購更多股票嗎？

sentences.en: The repurchase of the building cost two million dollars.
sentences.zh: 買回那棟大樓花了兩百萬美元。

sentences.en: The firm may repurchase its bonds at a lower price.
sentences.zh: 這家公司可能以較低價格買回自家債券。

sentences.en: What is the repurchase price of the bonds?
sentences.zh: 這些債券的買回價格是多少？

sentences.en: Repurchases can raise earnings per share.
sentences.zh: 回購可以拉高每股盈餘。

sentences.en: Can we reschedule our meeting to Friday?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把會議改到週五嗎？

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but I have to reschedule.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我得改期。

sentences.en: The airline rescheduled my flight to the next morning.
sentences.zh: 航空公司把我的班機改到隔天早上。

sentences.en: Did the dentist reschedule your appointment?
sentences.zh: 牙醫有把你的預約改期嗎？

sentences.en: We had to reschedule the party because of rain.
sentences.zh: 我們因為下雨得把派對改期。

sentences.en: Please reschedule the interview for next week.
sentences.zh: 請把面試改到下週。

sentences.en: We live in a quiet residential area.
sentences.zh: 我們住在安靜的住宅區。

sentences.en: Is this building residential or commercial?
sentences.zh: 這棟建築是住宅還是商業用途？

sentences.en: The city banned loud trucks on residential streets.
sentences.zh: 市政府禁止吵鬧的卡車行駛住宅區街道。

sentences.en: Residential rents have risen sharply this year.
sentences.zh: 今年住宅租金大幅上漲。

sentences.en: Can I park a work truck in a residential neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 我可以把工作用卡車停在住宅區嗎？

sentences.en: Does your residential address match your ID?
sentences.zh: 你的居住地址和證件上的一致嗎？

sentences.en: There is residual heat in the oven.
sentences.zh: 烤箱裡還有餘熱。

sentences.en: Is there any residual value in the old equipment?
sentences.zh: 舊設備還有任何殘餘價值嗎？

sentences.en: The test found residual chemicals in the water.
sentences.zh: 檢測發現水中有殘留的化學物質。

sentences.en: He felt some residual anger after the argument.
sentences.zh: 爭吵之後，他仍感到些許殘餘的怒氣。

sentences.en: What residual risk remains after the repair?
sentences.zh: 修復後還剩下哪些殘餘風險？

sentences.en: Wipe off any residual soap with a damp cloth.
sentences.zh: 用濕布擦掉殘留的肥皂。

gloss_note: hand in a resignation 遞辭呈

sentences.en: She handed in her resignation on Monday.
sentences.zh: 她週一遞出了辭呈。

sentences.en: Did you accept his resignation?
sentences.zh: 你接受他的辭呈了嗎？

sentences.en: The CEO's resignation surprised the market.
sentences.zh: 執行長的辭職讓市場感到意外。

sentences.en: Why did she announce her resignation so suddenly?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼這麼突然宣布辭職？

sentences.en: A letter of resignation should be short and polite.
sentences.zh: 辭職信應該簡短而有禮貌。

sentences.en: His resignation takes effect at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 他的辭職將於月底生效。

sentences.en: Over sixty percent of respondents prefer remote work.
sentences.zh: 超過六成受訪者偏好遠距工作。

sentences.en: Each respondent answered ten questions.
sentences.zh: 每位受訪者回答了十個問題。

sentences.en: How many respondents completed the survey?
sentences.zh: 有多少受訪者完成了這份調查？

sentences.en: The respondent asked to remain anonymous.
sentences.zh: 那位受訪者要求匿名。

sentences.en: Were the respondents mostly young adults?
sentences.zh: 受訪者大多是年輕人嗎？

sentences.en: A typical respondent spends two hours online daily.
sentences.zh: 一般受訪者每天上網兩小時。

gloss_note: restructure a loan 重新安排貸款

sentences.en: The company plans to restructure its sales team.
sentences.zh: 公司打算重組業務團隊。

sentences.en: Do we need to restructure the department?
sentences.zh: 我們需要重組這個部門嗎？

sentences.en: They restructured the debt to lower monthly payments.
sentences.zh: 他們重整債務，以降低每月還款額。

sentences.en: Why did management restructure the project so late?
sentences.zh: 管理階層為什麼這麼晚才重組這個專案？

sentences.en: We must restructure our budget to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 我們必須重新調整預算以降低成本。

sentences.en: The bank agreed to restructure my loan.
sentences.zh: 銀行同意重新安排我的貸款。

gloss_note: 美式常寫 resume，也可加重音符號；英式說 CV

sentences.en: Please send your resume to our HR team.
sentences.zh: 請把你的履歷寄給我們的人資部門。

sentences.en: Can you look at my resume before I apply?
sentences.zh: 我投遞前你能幫我看一下履歷嗎？

sentences.en: Her resume shows five years of sales experience.
sentences.zh: 她的履歷顯示有五年業務經驗。

sentences.en: How long should a resume be?
sentences.zh: 履歷應該多長？

sentences.en: I updated my resume last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚更新了我的履歷。

sentences.en: A good resume highlights your biggest achievements.
sentences.zh: 一份好的履歷會突顯你最大的成就。

sentences.en: We buy our shoes from a large online retailer.
sentences.zh: 我們向一家大型網路零售商買鞋子。

sentences.en: Which retailer has the lowest price?
sentences.zh: 哪家零售商的價格最低？

sentences.en: The retailer offers free returns within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 這家零售商提供三十天內免費退貨。

sentences.en: Small retailers are preparing for the holiday shopping rush.
sentences.zh: 小型零售商正在為年底節慶購物旺季做準備。

sentences.en: Is the retailer responsible for damaged goods?
sentences.zh: 零售商要為受損商品負責嗎？

sentences.en: The retailer will open ten new stores this year.
sentences.zh: 這家零售商今年將開十間新店。

sentences.en: The reviewer gave the novel four stars.
sentences.zh: 評論者給這本小說四顆星。

sentences.en: Who was the reviewer for your paper?
sentences.zh: 你那篇論文的審查者是誰？

sentences.en: A reviewer noted several errors in the report.
sentences.zh: 一位審查者指出報告中有幾處錯誤。

sentences.en: Did the film reviewer like the new movie?
sentences.zh: 影評人喜歡這部新電影嗎？

sentences.en: Every reviewer must read the draft before Friday.
sentences.zh: 每位審查者都必須在週五前讀完草稿。

sentences.en: She works as a reviewer for a travel magazine.
sentences.zh: 她替一本旅遊雜誌擔任評論員。

sentences.en: Please send me the final revision by noon.
sentences.zh: 請在中午前把最終修訂版寄給我。

sentences.en: The contract needs one more revision.
sentences.zh: 合約還需要再修改一次。

sentences.en: How many revisions did your essay go through?
sentences.zh: 你的文章修改了幾次？

sentences.en: The revision of the schedule caused some confusion.
sentences.zh: 時間表的修訂造成了一些混亂。

sentences.en: Is the new revision ready for review?
sentences.zh: 新的修訂版準備好審閱了嗎？

sentences.en: Careful revision can improve your writing a lot.
sentences.zh: 仔細修改能大幅改善你的寫作。

gloss_note: revive interest 重新引起興趣

sentences.en: The new CEO hopes to revive the brand.
sentences.zh: 新任執行長希望重振這個品牌。

sentences.en: Can we revive this old project?
sentences.zh: 我們能讓這個舊專案重新啟動嗎？

sentences.en: A cup of coffee helped revive me this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上一杯咖啡讓我重新振作。

sentences.en: Tourism may revive once the weather improves.
sentences.zh: 天氣好轉後，觀光業可能會復甦。

sentences.en: Did the rescue team revive the hiker?
sentences.zh: 救援隊有把那位登山客救醒嗎？

sentences.en: The company launched a sale to revive interest in its products.
sentences.zh: 公司推出特賣，想重新喚起大家對產品的興趣。

Speaker: Naomi Persephone Amethyst
Recorder: NaomiAmethyst

gloss_note: rewrite a draft 改寫草稿

sentences.en: I need to rewrite my cover letter.
sentences.zh: 我得重寫我的求職信。

sentences.en: Could you rewrite this paragraph more clearly?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這一段改寫得更清楚嗎？

sentences.en: The editor asked me to rewrite the opening.
sentences.zh: 編輯要我重寫開頭。

sentences.en: Why did the team rewrite the whole program?
sentences.zh: 團隊為什麼重寫整個程式？

sentences.en: The story needs a complete rewrite.
sentences.zh: 這個故事需要整個重寫。

sentences.en: She rewrote her essay three times before submitting it.
sentences.zh: 她交出文章前改寫了三次。

sentences.en: Investing all your savings in one stock is risky.
sentences.zh: 把所有積蓄投入一檔股票很冒險。

sentences.en: Is it risky to drive in this snow?
sentences.zh: 在這種大雪裡開車危險嗎？

sentences.en: That was a risky decision, but it paid off.
sentences.zh: 那是個冒險的決定，但最後有回報。

sentences.en: Which loans are the riskiest for banks?
sentences.zh: 對銀行來說，哪些貸款風險最高？

sentences.en: I don't want to take any risky shortcuts.
sentences.zh: 我不想走任何有風險的捷徑。

sentences.en: How risky is this new business plan?
sentences.zh: 這個新的商業計畫風險有多高？

sentences.en: The company reported robust sales this quarter.
sentences.zh: 公司公布本季銷售表現強勁穩健。

sentences.en: We need a robust system that can handle heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 我們需要能承受大量流量的穩健系統。

sentences.en: Is the economy robust enough to keep growing?
sentences.zh: 經濟體質夠穩健，可以持續成長嗎？

sentences.en: Does she have a robust immune system?
sentences.zh: 她的免疫系統強健嗎？

sentences.en: The test results were robust across all groups.
sentences.zh: 各組的測試結果都很穩健。

sentences.en: The team built a robust plan for the busy season.
sentences.zh: 團隊為旺季擬定了一套穩健的計畫。

sentences.en: The earth's rotation causes day and night.
sentences.zh: 地球自轉造成了白天與黑夜。

sentences.en: Farmers use crop rotation to protect the soil.
sentences.zh: 農夫利用輪作來保護土壤。

sentences.en: What is the rotation speed of this wheel?
sentences.zh: 這個輪子的轉速是多少？

sentences.en: Nurses work in a weekly rotation.
sentences.zh: 護理師採每週輪班。

sentences.en: Is the tire rotation included in the service?
sentences.zh: 這項保養有包含輪胎換位嗎？

sentences.en: We use a rotation to share the cleaning duties.
sentences.zh: 我們用輪流制來分擔打掃工作。

sentences.en: Please drive safely in this weather.
sentences.zh: 這種天氣請安全駕駛。

sentences.en: Did you get home safely?
sentences.zh: 你平安到家了嗎？

sentences.en: The plane landed safely despite the strong wind.
sentences.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機仍安全降落。

sentences.en: How can we safely store these chemicals?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼安全地存放這些化學品？

sentences.en: Workers must safely shut down the equipment before leaving.
sentences.zh: 工人離開前必須安全關閉設備。

sentences.en: The package arrived safely at our warehouse.
sentences.zh: 包裹平安抵達了我們的倉庫。

sentences.en: The salesperson showed us three different laptops.
sentences.zh: 銷售人員給我們看了三款不同的筆電。

sentences.en: Could you ask a salesperson for help?
sentences.zh: 你可以請銷售人員幫忙嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a salesperson for a software company.
sentences.zh: 她在一家軟體公司擔任業務員。

sentences.en: Every salesperson has a monthly target.
sentences.zh: 每位業務員都有每月目標。

sentences.en: The salesperson called to confirm our order.
sentences.zh: 業務員打電話來確認我們的訂單。

sentences.en: What makes a great salesperson?
sentences.zh: 什麼樣的人才是優秀的業務員？

sentences.en: The satellite sends weather data every hour.
sentences.zh: 這顆衛星每小時傳送氣象資料。

sentences.en: Do you have satellite TV at home?
sentences.zh: 你家有衛星電視嗎？

sentences.en: The company will launch a new satellite next year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司明年將發射一顆新衛星。

sentences.en: How does a satellite stay in orbit?
sentences.zh: 衛星是怎麼維持在軌道上的？

sentences.en: Satellite images show the damage from the flood.
sentences.zh: 衛星影像顯示出洪水造成的災情。

sentences.en: Can a satellite phone work in the mountains?
sentences.zh: 衛星電話在山區能用嗎？

sentences.en: The scandal forced the CEO to resign.
sentences.zh: 這起醜聞迫使執行長辭職。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the accounting scandal?
sentences.zh: 你有聽說那件會計醜聞嗎？

sentences.en: The company is still dealing with the scandal.
sentences.zh: 公司仍在處理這起醜聞。

sentences.en: What caused the scandal at the bank?
sentences.zh: 那家銀行的醜聞是怎麼引起的？

sentences.en: A scandal like this can ruin a brand.
sentences.zh: 這樣的醜聞可能毀掉一個品牌。

sentences.en: The newspaper exposed the scandal last week.
sentences.zh: 報紙上週揭發了這起醜聞。

sentences.en: In the worst-case scenario, we lose the contract.
sentences.zh: 在最壞的情況下，我們會失去這份合約。

sentences.en: Can you describe a typical scenario for using this app?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一個使用這個應用程式的典型情境嗎？

sentences.en: What is the most likely scenario?
sentences.zh: 最有可能的情況是什麼？

sentences.en: The teacher gave us a role-play scenario.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們一個角色扮演的情境。

sentences.en: We ran three different scenarios for next year's budget.
sentences.zh: 我們為明年預算模擬了三種不同的情境。

sentences.en: Is that scenario realistic for a small company?
sentences.zh: 對小公司來說，那種情境符合現實嗎？

sentences.en: He sells scrap metal to a recycling center.
sentences.zh: 他把廢金屬賣給回收中心。

sentences.en: We decided to scrap the old plan.
sentences.zh: 我們決定放棄舊計畫。

sentences.en: Why did the company scrap the project?
sentences.zh: 公司為什麼把專案喊停？

sentences.en: Can the scrap be recycled?
sentences.zh: 這些廢料可以回收嗎？

sentences.en: The factory reduces scrap to save money.
sentences.zh: 工廠減少廢料以節省成本。

sentences.en: They scrapped the old car and bought a new one.
sentences.zh: 他們把舊車報廢，買了一輛新車。

sentences.en: The museum has a famous marble sculpture.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館有一件知名的大理石雕像。

sentences.en: Who made this sculpture in the lobby?
sentences.zh: 大廳裡的這件雕塑是誰做的？

sentences.en: She studies sculpture at an art school.
sentences.zh: 她在藝術學校學雕塑。

sentences.en: Is the sculpture made of bronze?
sentences.zh: 這座雕像是青銅做的嗎？

sentences.en: A large sculpture stands in front of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 一座大型雕塑矗立在飯店前面。

sentences.en: The artist spent two years on this sculpture.
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家花了兩年創作這件雕塑。

gloss_note: seasonal menu 季節限定菜單

sentences.en: We hire extra workers for seasonal demand.
sentences.zh: 我們為了季節性需求多雇用一些人手。

sentences.en: Are seasonal fruits cheaper at the market?
sentences.zh: 應季水果在市場比較便宜嗎？

sentences.en: The cafe has a seasonal menu.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店有季節限定菜單。

sentences.en: Seasonal sales usually peak in December.
sentences.zh: 季節性銷售通常在十二月達到高峰。

sentences.en: Is this a seasonal job or a full-time position?
sentences.zh: 這是季節性的工作還是全職職位？

sentences.en: Seasonal flu cases usually rise in winter.
sentences.zh: 季節性流感病例通常在冬天增加。

sentences.en: Is there outdoor seating at the restaurant?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有戶外座位嗎？

sentences.en: The seating in this theater is very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 這間劇院的座位非常舒適。

sentences.en: We need a new seating plan for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為婚禮重新安排座位表。

sentences.en: How much seating does the conference room have?
sentences.zh: 會議室有多少座位？

sentences.en: Seating is limited, so please arrive early.
sentences.zh: 座位有限，請提早抵達。

sentences.en: The host explained the seating arrangements.
sentences.zh: 主辦人說明了座位安排。

sentences.en: More job seekers are applying online.
sentences.zh: 越來越多求職者在網路上應徵。

sentences.en: Are you a thrill seeker or a homebody?
sentences.zh: 你是愛追求刺激的人，還是宅在家的人？

sentences.en: The career fair helps job seekers meet employers.
sentences.zh: 就業博覽會幫助求職者見到雇主。

sentences.en: Our website is designed for apartment seekers.
sentences.zh: 我們的網站是為找房子的人設計的。

sentences.en: Which job seeker impressed you most?
sentences.zh: 哪位求職者最讓你印象深刻？

sentences.en: He is a bargain seeker who checks every sale.
sentences.zh: 他是個愛找特價的人，每場特賣都不放過。

gloss_note: seize the chance 把握機會

sentences.en: You should seize this chance to learn.
sentences.zh: 你應該把握這個學習的機會。

sentences.en: Customs officers seized the illegal goods.
sentences.zh: 海關人員扣押了違禁品。

sentences.en: Did she seize the opportunity to speak?
sentences.zh: 她有把握住發言的機會嗎？

sentences.en: The police seized his car as evidence.
sentences.zh: 警方扣押了他的車作為證據。

sentences.en: Why did the bank seize their house?
sentences.zh: 銀行為什麼查封他們的房子？

sentences.en: He seized my arm to stop me from falling.
sentences.zh: 他抓住我的手臂，不讓我跌倒。

sentences.en: The seller agreed to lower the price.
sentences.zh: 賣方同意降價。

sentences.en: Is the seller located in the United States?
sentences.zh: 這位賣家在美國嗎？

sentences.en: Check the seller's reviews before you buy.
sentences.zh: 買之前先看看賣家的評價。

sentences.en: Who is the biggest seller of used cars in this area?
sentences.zh: 這一帶最大的二手車賣家是誰？

sentences.en: The seller must provide a clear receipt.
sentences.zh: 賣方必須提供清楚的收據。

sentences.en: Contact the seller if the item doesn't arrive.
sentences.zh: 如果商品沒送到，請聯絡賣家。

sentences.en: This is more than a semantic difference.
sentences.zh: 這不只是語意上的差別。

sentences.en: Is it a semantic issue or a real problem?
sentences.zh: 這是語意上的問題，還是真正的問題？

sentences.en: The study looks at semantic changes in modern slang.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討現代俚語的語義變化。

sentences.en: Semantic analysis helps computers understand text.
sentences.zh: 語意分析能幫助電腦理解文字。

sentences.en: Let's not argue over semantic details.
sentences.zh: 我們別為語意上的細節爭論了。

sentences.en: Do these two words have the same semantic meaning?
sentences.zh: 這兩個字的語意相同嗎？

gloss_note: attend a seminar 參加研討會

sentences.en: I'm attending a marketing seminar next week.
sentences.zh: 我下週要參加一場行銷研討會。

sentences.en: Is the seminar free for employees?
sentences.zh: 這場研討會對員工免費嗎？

sentences.en: Our professor leads a weekly seminar on economics.
sentences.zh: 我們教授每週主持一堂經濟學專題討論課。

sentences.en: The seminar starts at nine in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 研討會九點在大廳開始。

sentences.en: Who is giving the seminar on cybersecurity?
sentences.zh: 誰要主講資訊安全的研討會？

sentences.en: She signed up for a seminar on public speaking.
sentences.zh: 她報名了一場公開演說的研討會。

sentences.en: The senator will speak at the university tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 參議員明天將在大學演講。

sentences.en: Which senator introduced the bill?
sentences.zh: 哪位參議員提出了這項法案？

sentences.en: A senator visited our town last week.
sentences.zh: 上週有一位參議員造訪了我們的小鎮。

sentences.en: Did the senator answer the reporter's question?
sentences.zh: 參議員有回答記者的問題嗎？

sentences.en: Each state elects two senators.
sentences.zh: 每個州選出兩位參議員。

sentences.en: The senator's office sent us a letter.
sentences.zh: 參議員辦公室寄了一封信給我們。

gloss_note: return to sender 退回寄件人

sentences.en: Who is the sender of this package?
sentences.zh: 這個包裹的寄件人是誰？

sentences.en: The sender's address is missing.
sentences.zh: 寄件人的地址不見了。

sentences.en: Please reply to the sender directly.
sentences.zh: 請直接回覆寄件人。

sentences.en: Is the sender someone you know?
sentences.zh: 寄件者是你認識的人嗎？

sentences.en: The sender pays the shipping fee.
sentences.zh: 運費由寄件人負擔。

sentences.en: Delete any message if you don't trust the sender.
sentences.zh: 如果你不信任寄件者，就刪掉那封訊息。

sentences.en: Cultural sensitivity matters when working with global clients.
sentences.zh: 與全球客戶合作時，文化敏感度很重要。

sentences.en: She handled the issue with great sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 她非常體貼地處理這件事。

sentences.en: How does price sensitivity affect sales?
sentences.zh: 價格敏感度如何影響銷量？

sentences.en: Many young kids have a sensitivity to loud noises.
sentences.zh: 許多小孩對很大的噪音特別敏感。

sentences.en: Why is customer sensitivity to delays so high?
sentences.zh: 為什麼顧客對延遲這麼敏感？

sentences.en: A sensitivity analysis shows how profit changes.
sentences.zh: 敏感度分析顯示利潤如何變動。

sentences.en: Can we pay separately for our meals?
sentences.zh: 我們的餐點可以分開付款嗎？

sentences.en: Please pack the glasses separately.
sentences.zh: 請把玻璃杯分開包裝。

sentences.en: The two teams worked separately on the project.
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊各自獨立處理這個專案。

sentences.en: Are the taxes listed separately on the bill?
sentences.zh: 稅金有在帳單上另外列出嗎？

sentences.en: Each item is sold separately.
sentences.zh: 每件商品都是單獨販售。

sentences.en: We should handle these two issues separately.
sentences.zh: 我們應該分開處理這兩個問題。

gloss_note: 常搭 rise/fall sharply，表示急遽變化

sentences.en: Prices dropped sharply after the announcement.
sentences.zh: 公布之後價格急遽下跌。

sentences.en: Did sales rise sharply in the third quarter?
sentences.zh: 第三季的銷售額有大幅上升嗎？

sentences.en: The manager spoke sharply to the workers who were late.
sentences.zh: 經理語氣嚴厲地對遲到的員工說話。

sentences.en: Why did the stock fall so sharply this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上股價為什麼跌得這麼兇？

sentences.en: She sharply criticized the plan in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 她當著大家的面嚴厲批評那個計畫。

sentences.en: Demand for electric cars has increased sharply.
sentences.zh: 電動車的需求急遽增加。

gloss_note: a shipment of... 一批貨；可數名詞

sentences.en: The shipment should arrive on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 這批貨應該會在週一早上到。

sentences.en: Has the shipment left the warehouse yet?
sentences.zh: 這批貨已經離開倉庫了嗎？

sentences.en: A large shipment of laptops was delayed at the port.
sentences.zh: 一大批筆電在港口被延誤了。

sentences.en: Please check every box when the shipment arrives.
sentences.zh: 貨到的時候，請檢查每一個箱子。

sentences.en: Can you track my shipment online?
sentences.zh: 你可以在網路上追蹤我的貨嗎？

sentences.en: We will send you an email when your shipment goes out.
sentences.zh: 你的貨一出貨，我們就會寄電子郵件通知你。

gloss_note: 指正在逛街或網購的人

sentences.en: The mall is full of holiday shoppers today.
sentences.zh: 商場今天擠滿了過節的購物人潮。

sentences.en: Are you a careful shopper or an impulse buyer?
sentences.zh: 你是精打細算的購物者，還是衝動消費的人？

sentences.en: Smart shoppers compare prices before they buy.
sentences.zh: 聰明的購物者買東西前會先比價。

sentences.en: How many shoppers visit your store on weekends?
sentences.zh: 週末有多少顧客會來你們店裡？

sentences.en: Online shoppers often leave items in their carts.
sentences.zh: 網購的人常把商品留在購物車裡。

sentences.en: The store gave every shopper a free canvas bag.
sentences.zh: 商店送每位顧客一個免費的帆布袋。

gloss_note: a shortage of... 缺少；缺工

sentences.en: There is a shortage of nurses in many hospitals.
sentences.zh: 許多醫院都缺護理師。

sentences.en: Is the water shortage getting worse this summer?
sentences.zh: 今年夏天的缺水問題變嚴重了嗎？

sentences.en: A parts shortage slowed down our production.
sentences.zh: 零件短缺拖慢了我們的生產。

sentences.en: Why is there a shortage of eggs at the store?
sentences.zh: 為什麼商店的雞蛋缺貨？

sentences.en: We have a shortage of volunteers this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我們缺志工。

sentences.en: Will the labor shortage affect your hiring plan?
sentences.zh: 人力短缺會影響你們的招募計畫嗎？

gloss_note: flu shot 流感疫苗；take a shot 投籃

sentences.en: I got a flu shot at the pharmacy yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天在藥局打了流感疫苗。

sentences.en: Does the shot hurt very much?
sentences.zh: 這一針會很痛嗎？

sentences.en: That's a great shot of the lake! Did you take it yourself?
sentences.zh: 湖的這張照片拍得真好！是你自己拍的嗎？

sentences.en: He took a shot from the corner and missed.
sentences.zh: 他在底角出手投籃，沒投進。

sentences.en: Nice shot! Who taught you that?
sentences.zh: 投得好！誰教你的？

sentences.en: Do you think she will take the last shot?
sentences.zh: 你覺得最後一球會由她來投嗎？

gloss_note: 汽車、家具行常見；美式車行也說 dealership

sentences.en: Our car showroom opens at nine on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 我們的汽車展示間週六九點開門。

sentences.en: Is the new sofa on display in the showroom?
sentences.zh: 新沙發有陳列在展示間嗎？

sentences.en: We visited a furniture showroom before choosing a bed.
sentences.zh: 我們挑床之前先去了一間家具展示間。

sentences.en: The showroom was clean, bright, and full of customers.
sentences.zh: 展示間乾淨明亮，擠滿了顧客。

sentences.en: Can I test drive one of the cars in your showroom?
sentences.zh: 我可以試駕你們展示間裡的一輛車嗎？

sentences.en: The company will build a larger showroom downtown.
sentences.zh: 公司將在市區蓋一間更大的展示間。

gloss_note: signature dish 招牌菜；sign 簽名

sentences.en: Please put your signature at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 請在頁面底部簽名。

sentences.en: Is this your signature on the contract?
sentences.zh: 合約上的這個是你的簽名嗎？

sentences.en: I need a signature before I can hand over the package.
sentences.zh: 我要有簽名才能把包裹交給你。

sentences.en: The chef's signature dish is grilled salmon.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚的招牌菜是烤鮭魚。

sentences.en: What is the signature drink at this café?
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡廳的招牌飲料是什麼？

sentences.en: His signature smile made everyone feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 他標誌性的笑容讓大家都覺得受到歡迎。

gloss_note: simplify the process 簡化流程

sentences.en: We should simplify the sign-up process for new users.
sentences.zh: 我們應該簡化新使用者的註冊流程。

sentences.en: Can you simplify this form a little?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這份表格弄得簡單一點嗎？

sentences.en: The new app will simplify your daily work.
sentences.zh: 這個新的應用程式會簡化你的日常工作。

sentences.en: How can we simplify the instructions for beginners?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼為初學者簡化這份說明？

sentences.en: The teacher tried to simplify the idea with a drawing.
sentences.zh: 老師試著用一張圖把這個概念簡化。

sentences.en: Let me simplify things: we need more time and money.
sentences.zh: 我簡單講：我們需要更多時間和經費。

sentences.en: The pilots practiced an emergency landing in a simulation.
sentences.zh: 飛行員在模擬演練中練習緊急降落。

sentences.en: Did the simulation show any problems with the design?
sentences.zh: 模擬有顯示出這個設計的任何問題嗎？

sentences.en: We ran a computer simulation of the new traffic system.
sentences.zh: 我們對新的交通系統跑了電腦模擬。

sentences.en: Each simulation takes about two hours to finish.
sentences.zh: 每次模擬大約要花兩個小時才能跑完。

sentences.en: How accurate is this weather simulation?
sentences.zh: 這個天氣模擬有多準確？

sentences.en: Students use a simulation to learn how markets work.
sentences.zh: 學生用模擬來學習市場是如何運作的。

gloss_note: at the same time 的正式說法

sentences.en: Two flights landed simultaneously on different runways.
sentences.zh: 兩架班機同時在不同的跑道降落。

sentences.en: Can you listen and take notes simultaneously?
sentences.zh: 你可以一邊聽課一邊做筆記嗎？

sentences.en: The company launched its product in three countries simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 公司在三個國家同時推出了產品。

sentences.en: Please don't press both buttons simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 請不要同時按兩個按鈕。

sentences.en: How do you manage two projects simultaneously?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼同時處理兩個專案？

sentences.en: The two alarms went off simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 兩個警報器同時響了。

gloss_note: 信末 Sincerely, 敬上；語氣正式

sentences.en: I sincerely apologize for my late reply.
sentences.zh: 我很誠摯地為太晚回覆向你道歉。

sentences.en: Do you sincerely believe this plan will work?
sentences.zh: 你真的相信這個計畫行得通嗎？

sentences.en: She sincerely thanked everyone for their help.
sentences.zh: 她真心感謝大家的幫忙。

sentences.en: We sincerely hope you enjoy your stay.
sentences.zh: 我們誠摯希望您住得愉快。

sentences.en: He sincerely wants to learn, so I will help him.
sentences.zh: 他是真心想學，所以我會幫他。

sentences.en: Are you sincerely interested in this job?
sentences.zh: 你是真的對這份工作有興趣嗎？

gloss_note: 文法用語，相對於 plural 複數的

sentences.en: Is the verb singular or plural in this sentence?
sentences.zh: 這個句子裡的動詞是單數還是複數？

sentences.en: Use a singular verb with a singular subject.
sentences.zh: 主詞是單數時，要用單數動詞。

sentences.en: In English, a singular noun often needs a or the.
sentences.zh: 在英文裡，單數名詞前面常要加冠詞。

sentences.en: Add an s to change most singular nouns into plurals.
sentences.zh: 大多數單數名詞加上字尾 s 就變成複數。

sentences.en: Did you use the singular form of the word here?
sentences.zh: 你這裡用的是這個字的單數形嗎？

sentences.en: A collective noun like team is usually singular in American English.
sentences.zh: 在美式英文裡，「團隊」這類集合名詞通常當單數。

gloss_note: skim through 快速翻閱；skim fat 撇油

sentences.en: Let me skim the report before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會前讓我先快速看過這份報告。

sentences.en: Did you skim the email or read it carefully?
sentences.zh: 你是大略瀏覽那封電子郵件，還是仔細讀過？

sentences.en: I only had time to skim the headlines.
sentences.zh: 我只有時間瀏覽標題而已。

sentences.en: Skim the first page to find the main idea.
sentences.zh: 先略讀第一頁，找出主旨。

sentences.en: Skim the foam off the soup with a spoon.
sentences.zh: 用湯匙把湯上的浮沫撇掉。

sentences.en: Should I skim the fat from the top of the broth?
sentences.zh: 我該把高湯上面的油脂撇掉嗎？

gloss_note: in a slump 處於低迷；比單純下跌更持久

sentences.en: Sales went into a slump after the holidays.
sentences.zh: 假期過後，銷售陷入了低迷。

sentences.en: Why did the housing market slump so suddenly?
sentences.zh: 房市為什麼突然低迷？

sentences.en: Is the economy still in a slump?
sentences.zh: 經濟還處在低迷期嗎？

sentences.en: Stock prices slumped after the weak report.
sentences.zh: 疲弱的報告公布後，股價大跌。

sentences.en: Our team is in a slump, so we need new ideas.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊正處於低潮，所以需要新點子。

sentences.en: Profits slumped by nearly twenty percent last quarter.
sentences.zh: 上一季利潤暴跌了將近兩成。

gloss_note: soar to 飆升至；過去式 soared

sentences.en: Home prices have soared in the past two years.
sentences.zh: 過去兩年房價暴漲。

sentences.en: Will gas prices soar again this summer?
sentences.zh: 今年夏天油價又會飆漲嗎？

sentences.en: Our profits soared after we launched the app.
sentences.zh: 我們推出應用程式後，利潤暴增。

sentences.en: An eagle soared above the mountain.
sentences.zh: 一隻老鷹在山上高高翱翔。

sentences.en: Why did the temperature soar so quickly today?
sentences.zh: 今天氣溫為什麼升得這麼快？

sentences.en: Ticket sales soared after the show got great reviews.
sentences.zh: 節目獲得好評後，票房暴增。

gloss_note: the sole + 名詞；sole right 獨家權利

sentences.en: She is the sole owner of the company.
sentences.zh: 她是這家公司唯一的老闆。

sentences.en: Who is the sole survivor of the accident?
sentences.zh: 誰是這場意外唯一的生還者？

sentences.en: My sole goal this year is to save money.
sentences.zh: 我今年唯一的目標是存錢。
