sentences.zh: 這家餐廳在違反衛生規定後被勒令停業。

sentences.en: Any violation of the rules will be reported.
sentences.zh: 任何違規行為都會被通報。

sentences.en: How serious is the safety violation?
sentences.zh: 這項安全違規有多嚴重？

sentences.en: He paid a fine for a traffic violation.
sentences.zh: 他為一項交通違規繳了罰款。

sentences.en: We're holding a virtual meeting this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們今天下午要開線上會議。

sentences.en: Can you join the virtual tour of the museum?
sentences.zh: 你可以參加博物館的虛擬導覽嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a virtual assistant from home.
sentences.zh: 她在家擔任虛擬助理。

sentences.en: Do you offer virtual classes for beginners?
sentences.zh: 你們有開給初學者的線上課程嗎？

sentences.en: The company runs a virtual office with no building.
sentences.zh: 這家公司採虛擬辦公室，沒有實體大樓。

sentences.en: Virtual reality headsets are popular this season.
sentences.zh: 虛擬實境頭戴裝置這一季很熱門。

sentences.en: Patience is a virtue, especially in customer service.
sentences.zh: 耐心是一種美德，在客服工作中尤其如此。

sentences.en: What is the greatest virtue of this plan?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫最大的優點是什麼？

sentences.en: Honesty is a virtue that every leader needs.
sentences.zh: 誠實是每位領導者都需要的美德。

sentences.en: Do you think hard work is still a virtue?
sentences.zh: 你認為努力工作還是一種美德嗎？

sentences.en: The main virtue of this phone is its battery life.
sentences.zh: 這支手機最大的優點是電池續航力。

sentences.en: She was praised for the virtue of humility.
sentences.zh: 她因為謙虛的美德而受到稱讚。

gloss_note: volatile market 波動劇烈的市場

sentences.en: Oil prices have been extremely volatile this year.
sentences.zh: 今年油價極度波動。

sentences.en: Is the stock market too volatile for retirees?
sentences.zh: 股市對退休人士來說是否太不穩定？

sentences.en: The situation in the region is still volatile.
sentences.zh: 該地區的局勢仍然不穩定。

sentences.en: Volatile markets make it hard to plan ahead.
sentences.zh: 波動劇烈的市場讓人很難提前規劃。

sentences.en: Why is the exchange rate so volatile right now?
sentences.zh: 為什麼匯率現在這麼不穩定？

sentences.en: He has a volatile temper and changes moods quickly.
sentences.zh: 他脾氣善變，情緒轉換很快。

sentences.en: Market volatility has made investors nervous.
sentences.zh: 市場波動讓投資人緊張。

sentences.en: How do you measure the volatility of a stock?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼衡量一支股票的波動性？

sentences.en: Currency volatility can hurt exporters.
sentences.zh: 匯率波動可能傷害出口商。

sentences.en: Is the recent volatility a sign of a bigger problem?
sentences.zh: 最近的波動是更大問題的徵兆嗎？

sentences.en: High volatility means prices can swing sharply.
sentences.zh: 高波動性代表價格可能劇烈震盪。

sentences.en: The fund aims to reduce volatility in returns.
sentences.zh: 這檔基金的目標是降低報酬的波動。

gloss_note: meal voucher 餐券；禮券多說 gift card

sentences.en: Show this voucher at the front desk for a free drink.
sentences.zh: 在櫃檯出示這張抵用券可免費換一杯飲料。

sentences.en: Can I use this voucher on my next visit?
sentences.zh: 我下次來可以用這張抵用券嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel gave us a dinner voucher for the delay.
sentences.zh: 飯店因為延誤給了我們一張晚餐抵用券。

sentences.en: Does the voucher expire at the end of the month?
sentences.zh: 這張抵用券月底會到期嗎？

sentences.en: The airline gave us a travel voucher after canceling our flight.
sentences.zh: 航空公司取消我們的班機後，給了我們一張旅行抵用券。

sentences.en: She redeemed the voucher for a free ticket.
sentences.zh: 她用抵用券兌換了一張免費門票。

sentences.en: This word begins with a vowel sound.
sentences.zh: 這個字以母音開頭。

sentences.en: How many vowels are there in English?
sentences.zh: 英文有幾個母音？

sentences.en: Can you pronounce this long vowel correctly?
sentences.zh: 你能正確發出這個長母音嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher drew a chart of vowel sounds.
sentences.zh: 老師畫了一張母音發音表。

sentences.en: A short vowel sounds different from a long one.
sentences.zh: 短母音和長母音聽起來不一樣。

sentences.en: Vowel sounds change in different accents.
sentences.zh: 不同口音的母音發音會有變化。

sentences.en: Small businesses are vulnerable to economic changes.
sentences.zh: 小型企業容易受到經濟變動的影響。

sentences.en: Is our network vulnerable to cyber attacks?
sentences.zh: 我們的網路容易受到網路攻擊嗎？

sentences.en: Young children are vulnerable to the flu.
sentences.zh: 年幼的孩子很容易得流感。

sentences.en: She felt vulnerable after losing her job.
sentences.zh: 失業後，她覺得很脆弱無助。

sentences.en: Why is this system so vulnerable to errors?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個系統這麼容易出錯？

sentences.en: Older adults are more vulnerable during heat waves.
sentences.zh: 長者在熱浪期間更容易受到傷害。

sentences.en: The goods are stored in a warehouse near the port.
sentences.zh: 貨物存放在港口附近的倉庫裡。

sentences.en: How many workers does the warehouse employ?
sentences.zh: 這座倉庫僱用了多少工人？

sentences.en: Our online orders ship from a large warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我們的線上訂單是從一座大型倉庫出貨的。

sentences.en: Is the warehouse open on weekends?
sentences.zh: 倉庫週末有開嗎？

sentences.en: A fire damaged the warehouse last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一場火災損毀了倉庫。

sentences.en: The manager asked me to check the warehouse inventory.
sentences.zh: 經理要我清點倉庫的庫存。

sentences.en: The police need a warrant to search the house.
sentences.zh: 警方需要搜索令才能搜查這間房子。

sentences.en: Did the judge issue an arrest warrant?
sentences.zh: 法官有核發逮捕令嗎？

sentences.en: The investor exercised a warrant to buy more shares.
sentences.zh: 這位投資人行使認股權證來買進更多股票。

sentences.en: Without a warrant, the agents could not enter the office.
sentences.zh: 沒有搜索令，探員無法進入辦公室。

sentences.en: Does the company offer warrants along with its bonds?
sentences.zh: 這家公司發行債券時有附認股權證嗎？

sentences.en: A warrant was issued after the suspect missed court.
sentences.zh: 嫌犯缺席開庭後，法院核發了拘票。

sentences.en: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
sentences.zh: 這台筆電附有兩年保固。

sentences.en: Is the repair covered under warranty?
sentences.zh: 這次維修在保固範圍內嗎？

sentences.en: The warranty expires at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 保固在月底到期。

sentences.en: Do I need to keep the receipt for the warranty?
sentences.zh: 保固需要留著收據嗎？

sentences.en: Our extended warranty covers parts and labor.
sentences.zh: 我們的延長保固涵蓋零件和人工費。

sentences.en: The warranty doesn't cover accidental damage.
sentences.zh: 保固不涵蓋意外損壞。

sentences.en: There is widespread support for the new policy.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策獲得廣泛支持。

sentences.en: Is internet access widespread in rural areas?
sentences.zh: 偏遠地區的網路普及嗎？

sentences.en: Widespread flooding closed many roads yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天大範圍的淹水讓許多道路封閉。

sentences.en: Why is the use of mobile payments so widespread?
sentences.zh: 為什麼行動支付的使用這麼普遍？

sentences.en: The news caused widespread concern among customers.
sentences.zh: 這則消息引起顧客普遍的擔憂。

sentences.en: Food shortages were widespread during the war.
sentences.zh: 戰爭期間糧食短缺的情況十分普遍。

sentences.en: This national park is famous for its wildlife.
sentences.zh: 這座國家公園以野生動物聞名。

sentences.en: Do you often see wildlife near your house?
sentences.zh: 你家附近常看到野生動物嗎？

sentences.en: Please do not feed the wildlife.
sentences.zh: 請不要餵食野生動物。

sentences.en: The group works to protect local wildlife.
sentences.zh: 這個團體致力於保護當地的野生動物。

sentences.en: Where can we watch wildlife on this trip?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅程我們可以在哪裡觀察野生動物？

sentences.en: Pollution is a serious threat to wildlife.
sentences.zh: 汙染對野生動物是嚴重的威脅。

gloss_note: willingness to help 樂於幫忙

sentences.en: Her willingness to help impressed the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她樂於幫忙的態度讓整個團隊印象深刻。

sentences.en: Do you doubt his willingness to cooperate?
sentences.zh: 你懷疑他合作的意願嗎？

sentences.en: We value your willingness to work on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我們很感謝你願意週末上班。

sentences.en: What shows a candidate's willingness to learn?
sentences.zh: 什麼能顯示應徵者願意學習？

sentences.en: Their willingness to compromise saved the deal.
sentences.zh: 他們願意妥協的態度挽救了這筆交易。

sentences.en: The survey measured customers' willingness to pay more.
sentences.zh: 這項調查衡量了顧客願意多付錢的意願。

gloss_note: a glass of wine 一杯葡萄酒

sentences.en: Would you like red or white wine with dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐你想配紅酒還是白酒？

sentences.en: This restaurant has a great wine list.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的酒單很棒。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a wine for the fish?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦一款搭配魚的葡萄酒嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a bottle of wine for our host.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一瓶葡萄酒送給主人。

sentences.en: The sauce is made with white wine and butter.
sentences.zh: 這道醬汁是用白酒和奶油做的。

sentences.en: She took a small sip of wine.
sentences.zh: 她小啜了一口葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Is there a wireless network in the conference room?
sentences.zh: 會議室有無線網路嗎？

sentences.en: I bought wireless headphones for the flight.
sentences.zh: 我為這趟飛行買了無線耳機。

sentences.en: The hotel offers free wireless internet.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店提供免費的無線網路。

sentences.en: Does this printer support wireless printing?
sentences.zh: 這台印表機支援無線列印嗎？

sentences.en: Our wireless network was down all morning.
sentences.zh: 我們的無線網路整個早上都中斷了。

sentences.en: A wireless mouse keeps my desk neat.
sentences.zh: 無線滑鼠讓我的桌面保持整齊。

sentences.en: I made a cash withdrawal at the ATM.
sentences.zh: 我在自動提款機領了現金。

sentences.en: Is there a fee for each withdrawal?
sentences.zh: 每次提款都要收手續費嗎？

sentences.en: The bank limits daily withdrawals to five hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 銀行把每日提款額度限制在五百美元。

sentences.en: Her withdrawal from the project surprised the team.
sentences.zh: 她退出這個專案讓團隊很意外。

sentences.en: Can I cancel my withdrawal request?
sentences.zh: 我可以取消我的提款申請嗎？

sentences.en: The company announced its withdrawal from the market.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布撤出這個市場。

gloss_note: aging workforce 高齡化勞動力

sentences.en: The company has a workforce of about two thousand.
sentences.zh: 這家公司約有兩千名員工。

sentences.en: How is the aging population changing the workforce?
sentences.zh: 人口高齡化如何改變勞動力？

sentences.en: A skilled workforce attracts new investment.
sentences.zh: 技術純熟的勞動力能吸引新的投資。

sentences.en: Is the factory planning to expand its workforce?
sentences.zh: 這座工廠打算擴編人力嗎？

sentences.en: Women now make up nearly half of the workforce.
sentences.zh: 女性現在占勞動人口的近一半。

sentences.en: The new policy affects the entire workforce.
sentences.zh: 新政策影響全體員工。

sentences.en: Safety is the top priority in our workplace.
sentences.zh: 在我們的工作場所，安全是第一優先。

sentences.en: Do you feel respected in your workplace?
sentences.zh: 你在職場上覺得受到尊重嗎？

sentences.en: Remote work has changed the modern workplace.
sentences.zh: 遠距工作改變了現代職場。

sentences.en: Our workplace offers free coffee and snacks.
sentences.zh: 我們的辦公室提供免費咖啡和點心。

sentences.en: How can we make the workplace more inclusive?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓職場更包容？

sentences.en: Bullying has no place in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 職場上容不下霸凌。

gloss_note: attend a workshop 參加研習

sentences.en: I'm attending a leadership workshop next Friday.
sentences.zh: 我下週五要參加領導力工作坊。

sentences.en: Who is running the workshop this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 今天下午是誰主持這場研習會？

sentences.en: The workshop covers basic data skills.
sentences.zh: 這場工作坊涵蓋基本的資料技能。

sentences.en: Do I need to register for the workshop in advance?
sentences.zh: 我需要事先報名這場研習會嗎？

sentences.en: We hold a safety workshop every year.
sentences.zh: 我們每年都會舉辦安全研習會。

sentences.en: She learned a lot at the writing workshop.
sentences.zh: 她在寫作工作坊學到很多。

sentences.en: The company has customers worldwide.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的客戶遍及全世界。

sentences.en: Do you offer worldwide shipping?
sentences.zh: 你們提供全球配送嗎？

sentences.en: The movie became a worldwide hit.
sentences.zh: 這部電影成為全球熱賣的作品。

sentences.en: Is the problem affecting users worldwide?
sentences.zh: 這個問題影響到全球的用戶嗎？

sentences.en: Sales rose by ten percent worldwide last year.
sentences.zh: 去年全球銷售額成長了百分之十。

sentences.en: Their brand is known worldwide.
sentences.zh: 他們的品牌在全世界都很有名。

sentences.en: The yen weakened against the dollar this week.
sentences.zh: 本週日圓對美元貶值。

sentences.en: How many yen can I get for one hundred dollars?
sentences.zh: 一百美元可以換多少日圓？

sentences.en: Prices in Japan are usually listed in yen.
sentences.zh: 日本的物價通常以日圓標示。

sentences.en: A weak yen makes Japan cheaper for tourists.
sentences.zh: 日圓走貶讓日本對觀光客來說更便宜。

sentences.en: Do you accept yen, or only credit cards?
sentences.zh: 你們收日圓，還是只收信用卡？

sentences.en: The shop priced the souvenir at five hundred yen.
sentences.zh: 店家把這個紀念品定價為五百日圓。

gloss_note: abandon a plan 放棄計畫

sentences.en: We had to abandon the picnic because it started to rain.
sentences.zh: 因為開始下雨，我們不得不放棄野餐。

sentences.en: Did you abandon your plan to move to Texas?
sentences.zh: 你放棄搬到德州的計畫了嗎？

sentences.en: Someone abandoned a car on our street last week.
sentences.zh: 上週有人把一輛車遺棄在我們這條街上。

sentences.en: Please don't abandon the project now; we're almost done.
sentences.zh: 現在請不要放棄這個專案，我們快完成了。

sentences.en: How could anyone abandon a puppy like this?
sentences.zh: 怎麼會有人這樣遺棄一隻小狗？

sentences.en: The crew abandoned the ship as it began to sink.
sentences.zh: 船開始下沉時，船員們棄船了。

gloss_note: abolish a rule 廢除規定

sentences.en: The company decided to abolish the old dress code.
sentences.zh: 公司決定廢除舊的服裝規定。

sentences.en: Why did they abolish the late fee?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼取消了逾期費？

sentences.en: Many states abolished that tax decades ago.
sentences.zh: 許多州在數十年前就廢除了那項稅。

sentences.en: Will the new manager abolish our Friday meetings?
sentences.zh: 新來的經理會取消我們週五的會議嗎？

sentences.en: Slavery was abolished in the United States in 1865.
sentences.zh: 美國在1865年廢除了奴隸制度。

sentences.en: We should abolish this form; nobody reads it.
sentences.zh: 我們應該廢除這張表格，根本沒有人會看。

sentences.en: I have absolute trust in my team.
sentences.zh: 我絕對信任我的團隊。

sentences.en: It was an absolute disaster from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 這從頭到尾完全是一場災難。

sentences.en: Is that an absolute rule, or can we make an exception?
sentences.zh: 那是絕對的規定，還是我們可以破例？

sentences.en: The room was in absolute silence during the test.
sentences.zh: 考試期間，房間裡完全鴉雀無聲。

sentences.en: Do you believe there's an absolute truth?
sentences.zh: 你相信有絕對的真理嗎？

sentences.en: He's an absolute beginner, so please be patient.
sentences.zh: 他是個徹底的新手，所以請有點耐心。

gloss_note: absorption of water 水分的吸收

sentences.en: Plant roots help with the absorption of water.
sentences.zh: 植物的根有助於水分的吸收。

sentences.en: Does coffee affect the absorption of iron?
sentences.zh: 咖啡會影響鐵質的吸收嗎？

sentences.en: Sunscreen reduces the skin's absorption of harmful rays.
sentences.zh: 防曬乳能減少皮膚對有害光線的吸收。

sentences.en: Fiber slows the absorption of sugar into the blood.
sentences.zh: 纖維會減緩糖分被血液吸收的速度。

sentences.en: What affects the absorption of sound in a room?
sentences.zh: 什麼會影響房間裡聲音的吸收？

sentences.en: The soft carpet helps with sound absorption in our living room.
sentences.zh: 柔軟的地毯有助於我們客廳的吸音效果。

sentences.en: She likes abstract art with bold colors.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡色彩大膽的抽象藝術。

sentences.en: Love is an abstract idea that's hard to define.
sentences.zh: 愛是一個很難定義的抽象概念。

sentences.en: Is "freedom" an abstract word or a concrete one?
sentences.zh: 「自由」是抽象的詞還是具體的詞？

sentences.en: The design looks too abstract for our customers.
sentences.zh: 這個設計對我們的顧客來說看起來太抽象了。

sentences.en: This is too abstract for me. Can you give an example?
sentences.zh: 這對我來說太抽象了。你可以舉個例子嗎？

sentences.en: My son prefers abstract paintings to realistic ones.
sentences.zh: 我兒子喜歡抽象畫勝過寫實畫。

sentences.en: Her academic record is excellent.
sentences.zh: 她的學業成績非常優秀。

sentences.en: How was your first academic year in college?
sentences.zh: 你大學第一學年過得如何？

sentences.en: He wrote an academic paper on climate change.
sentences.zh: 他寫了一篇關於氣候變遷的學術論文。

sentences.en: Do you need any academic help this semester?
sentences.zh: 這學期你需要任何課業上的協助嗎？

sentences.en: Our school offers academic advising for all students.
sentences.zh: 我們學校為所有學生提供學業諮詢。

sentences.en: The academic calendar starts in late August here.
sentences.zh: 這裡的校曆是從八月下旬開始。

sentences.en: This car has great acceleration on the highway.
sentences.zh: 這輛車在高速公路上的加速性能很好。

sentences.en: What is the acceleration of an object in free fall?
sentences.zh: 物體在自由落下時的加速度是多少？

sentences.en: The acceleration of the company's growth surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 公司成長速度加快，讓所有人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Passengers feel pressure in their seats during acceleration.
sentences.zh: 加速時，乘客會感覺到座椅傳來的壓力。

sentences.en: Does this bike have enough acceleration for steep hills?
sentences.zh: 這輛腳踏車的加速夠應付陡坡嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists measured the acceleration of the falling ball.
sentences.zh: 科學家測量了落下的球的加速度。

gloss_note: a Southern accent 南方口音

sentences.en: She speaks English with a slight French accent.
sentences.zh: 她說英文帶有一點法國口音。

sentences.en: Do I have a strong accent?
sentences.zh: 我的口音很重嗎？

sentences.en: My coworker has a Southern accent, and I love it.
sentences.zh: 我的同事有南方口音，我很喜歡。

sentences.en: Where does your accent come from?
sentences.zh: 你的口音是哪個地方的？

sentences.en: It took me years to lose my accent.
sentences.zh: 我花了好幾年才改掉我的口音。

sentences.en: He tried a British accent, but it sounded fake.
sentences.zh: 他試著學英國口音，但聽起來很假。

sentences.en: Do you have access to the shared folder?
sentences.zh: 你有權限使用共用資料夾嗎？

sentences.en: I can't access my email from this computer.
sentences.zh: 我在這台電腦上無法存取我的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Students have free access to the library.
sentences.zh: 學生可以免費使用圖書館。

sentences.en: How do I access the Wi-Fi in this hotel?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼連上這間飯店的無線網路？

sentences.en: Everyone on the team has access to the report.
sentences.zh: 團隊裡每個人都能取得這份報告。

sentences.en: Only managers can access the payroll files.
sentences.zh: 只有經理才能存取薪資檔案。

sentences.en: The fire was accidental, according to the report.
sentences.zh: 根據報告，這場火災是意外造成的。

sentences.en: Was the mistake accidental, or did he do it on purpose?
sentences.zh: 那個錯誤是無心之過，還是他故意的？

sentences.en: Sorry, that was an accidental click.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，那是不小心點到的。

sentences.en: Their meeting was purely accidental.
sentences.zh: 他們的見面純屬偶然。

sentences.en: Does your insurance cover accidental damage to the phone?
sentences.zh: 你的保險有涵蓋手機的意外損壞嗎？

sentences.en: The discovery was accidental, but it changed everything.
sentences.zh: 這項發現是偶然的，卻改變了一切。

gloss_note: accompany sb to 陪某人去

sentences.en: Can I accompany you to the airport?
sentences.zh: 我可以陪你去機場嗎？

sentences.en: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
sentences.zh: 兒童必須由成人陪同。

sentences.en: A fever may accompany the flu.
sentences.zh: 發燒可能伴隨流感出現。

sentences.en: My manager will accompany us to the client meeting.
sentences.zh: 我的經理會陪我們去參加客戶會議。

sentences.en: Who will accompany you on the trip?
sentences.zh: 誰會陪你去這趟旅行？

sentences.en: His dog accompanies him everywhere he goes.
sentences.zh: 他走到哪，他的狗就陪到哪。

gloss_note: accomplish a goal 達成目標

sentences.en: We accomplished a lot this week.
sentences.zh: 我們這週完成了很多事。

sentences.en: What do you hope to accomplish this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年希望達成什麼？

sentences.en: She accomplished her goal of running a marathon.
sentences.zh: 她達成了跑完馬拉松的目標。

sentences.en: Did you accomplish everything on your list today?
sentences.zh: 你今天把清單上的事都完成了嗎？

sentences.en: It's hard to accomplish anything with all this noise.
sentences.zh: 有這麼多噪音，很難完成任何事。

sentences.en: The team accomplished the task ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 團隊提前完成了這項任務。

sentences.en: This team needs more accountability.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊需要更明確的責任歸屬。

sentences.en: Who takes accountability when a project fails?
sentences.zh: 專案失敗時，誰要負起責任？

sentences.en: Good leaders show accountability by admitting their mistakes.
sentences.zh: 好的領導者會承認自己的錯誤，展現責任感。

sentences.en: How do we build accountability into our weekly meetings?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何在每週的會議中建立問責機制？

sentences.en: Customers expect accountability when something goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 出了問題時，顧客期待有人負責。

sentences.en: There's no accountability if nobody tracks the results.
sentences.zh: 如果沒人追蹤結果，就沒有問責可言。

sentences.en: Managers are accountable for their team's results.
sentences.zh: 經理要對團隊的成果負責。

sentences.en: Who is accountable if the shipment is late?
sentences.zh: 如果貨物延遲，誰要負責？

sentences.en: I hold myself accountable for every deadline.
sentences.zh: 我對每個截止日期都要求自己負起責任。

sentences.en: We are accountable to our customers first.
sentences.zh: 我們首先要對顧客負責。

sentences.en: Are you accountable to the board or the CEO?
sentences.zh: 你是要對董事會負責，還是對執行長負責？

sentences.en: Nobody was held accountable for the error.
sentences.zh: 沒有人因為那個錯誤被追究責任。

gloss_note: accrual of interest 利息累計

sentences.en: The accrual of interest starts on the first day of the month.
sentences.zh: 利息的累計從每個月的第一天開始。

sentences.en: How is vacation accrual calculated here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的休假累計是怎麼計算的？

sentences.en: The accountant explained the accrual of unpaid wages.
sentences.zh: 會計師解釋了未付薪資的應計。

sentences.en: Does the accrual stop while I'm on leave?
sentences.zh: 我請假期間，累計會停止嗎？

sentences.en: Our sick-leave accrual is one day per month.
sentences.zh: 我們的病假累計是每個月一天。

sentences.en: Monthly accrual of interest makes the balance grow quickly.
sentences.zh: 每月累計的利息讓餘額成長得很快。

sentences.en: The accumulation of snow closed several roads.
sentences.zh: 積雪使幾條道路封閉了。

sentences.en: Wealth accumulation takes time and discipline.
sentences.zh: 財富累積需要時間和自律。

sentences.en: Is the accumulation of dust making you sneeze?
sentences.zh: 灰塵堆積讓你一直打噴嚏嗎？

sentences.en: Experts warn about the accumulation of plastic in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 專家警告海洋中塑膠的累積。

sentences.en: How does the accumulation of interest work on this account?
sentences.zh: 這個帳戶的利息累積是怎麼算的？

sentences.en: The accumulation of stress can affect your health.
sentences.zh: 壓力的累積會影響你的健康。

gloss_note: accuse sb of sth 指控某人…

sentences.en: Are you accusing me of lying?
sentences.zh: 你是在指責我說謊嗎？

sentences.en: The driver was accused of ignoring a stop sign.
sentences.zh: 那名駕駛被指控無視停車標誌。

sentences.en: Don't accuse people without proof.
sentences.zh: 不要在沒有證據的情況下指責別人。

sentences.en: She accused her brother of eating her cake.
sentences.zh: 她指責她弟弟吃了她的蛋糕。

sentences.en: Why would they accuse us of cheating?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼要指控我們作弊？

sentences.en: The company accused its rival of copying its design.
sentences.zh: 該公司指控競爭對手抄襲它的設計。

gloss_note: a casual acquaintance 點頭之交

sentences.en: He's just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
sentences.zh: 他只是個熟人，不是密友。

sentences.en: I met an old acquaintance at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我在超市遇到了一位舊識。

sentences.en: Is she a friend or just an acquaintance?
sentences.zh: 她是朋友，還是只是認識的人？

sentences.en: A mutual acquaintance introduced us at a party.
sentences.zh: 一位共同的熟人在派對上把我們介紹給彼此。

sentences.en: Do you have any acquaintances in Seattle?
sentences.zh: 你在西雅圖有認識的人嗎？

sentences.en: We're acquaintances from work, nothing more.
sentences.zh: 我們是工作上認識的熟人，僅此而已。

gloss_note: acquire a skill 學得技能

sentences.en: How did you acquire so many books?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼得到這麼多書的？

sentences.en: Children acquire new languages faster than adults.
sentences.zh: 孩子學會新語言的速度比成人快。

sentences.en: The museum just acquired a rare painting.
sentences.zh: 博物館剛剛購得一幅珍貴的畫作。

sentences.en: It takes time to acquire good habits.
sentences.zh: 養成好習慣需要時間。

sentences.en: Where did you acquire that skill?
sentences.zh: 你是在哪裡學會那項技能的？

sentences.en: Our firm plans to acquire a smaller competitor.
sentences.zh: 我們公司計畫收購一家規模較小的競爭對手。

sentences.en: They bought five acres of farmland by the lake.
sentences.zh: 他們在湖邊買了五英畝的農地。

sentences.en: How many acres does the park cover?
sentences.zh: 這座公園佔地多少英畝？

sentences.en: The house sits on two acres of land.
sentences.zh: 那棟房子坐落在兩英畝的土地上。

sentences.en: We're looking for land, maybe an acre or two.
sentences.zh: 我們在找土地，大概一、兩英畝。

sentences.en: Is the property more than ten acres?
sentences.zh: 那塊地超過十英畝嗎？

sentences.en: A big fire burned thousands of acres of forest.
sentences.zh: 一場大火燒毀了數千英畝的森林。

sentences.en: It took me a month to adapt to the new schedule.
sentences.zh: 我花了一個月才適應新的時程。

sentences.en: How quickly can you adapt to a new team?
sentences.zh: 你能多快適應新的團隊？

sentences.en: Plants must adapt to the dry climate.
sentences.zh: 植物必須適應乾燥的氣候。

sentences.en: We had to adapt our plan after the budget cut.
sentences.zh: 預算被刪減後，我們必須調整計畫。

sentences.en: Kids usually adapt well to a new school.
sentences.zh: 孩子通常能很好地適應新學校。

sentences.en: Can you adapt this recipe for people with allergies?
sentences.zh: 你能為有過敏的人調整這份食譜嗎？

sentences.en: Humans are highly adaptive creatures.
sentences.zh: 人類是適應力很強的生物。

sentences.en: Is adaptive learning software worth the cost?
sentences.zh: 適性學習軟體值得花這筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: Adaptive behavior helps animals survive in cold climates.
sentences.zh: 適應性的行為幫助動物在寒冷的氣候中生存。

sentences.en: The school uses an adaptive test that changes with your answers.
sentences.zh: 學校使用會隨你的答案而改變的適性測驗。

sentences.en: How adaptive is your team when plans suddenly change?
sentences.zh: 計畫突然改變時，你的團隊適應力有多強？

sentences.en: Adaptive thinking is a useful skill in a changing job market.
sentences.zh: 適應性的思考在不斷變化的就業市場中是很實用的能力。

sentences.en: My brother is a total coffee addict.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟是個不折不扣的咖啡成癮者。

sentences.en: Is she addicted to her phone?
sentences.zh: 她對手機上癮了嗎？

sentences.en: Many people are addicted to sugar without knowing it.
sentences.zh: 很多人在不知不覺中對糖上癮了。

sentences.en: Why do some kids get addicted to video games so easily?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些孩子那麼容易沉迷於電子遊戲？

sentences.en: These apps are designed to addict users.
sentences.zh: 這些應用程式的設計就是要讓使用者上癮。

sentences.en: The clinic offers support to addicts and their families.
sentences.zh: 這間診所為成癮者及其家人提供支持。

sentences.en: Do you get adequate sleep at night?
sentences.zh: 你晚上有足夠的睡眠嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel room was small but adequate.
sentences.zh: 那間飯店房間很小，但還算夠用。

sentences.en: We don't have adequate staff for the holiday rush.
sentences.zh: 假日人潮期間，我們沒有足夠的人手。

sentences.en: Is this amount of food adequate for ten people?
sentences.zh: 這個份量的食物夠十個人吃嗎？

sentences.en: Her English is adequate for the job.
sentences.zh: 她的英文足以勝任這份工作。

sentences.en: The pay is adequate, but the hours are long.
sentences.zh: 薪水還過得去，但工時很長。

sentences.en: It's freezing in here. Can you adjust the heat?
sentences.zh: 這裡好冷。你可以調整一下暖氣嗎？

sentences.en: I need to adjust my seat before driving.
sentences.zh: 我開車前得先調整座椅。

sentences.en: He's still adjusting to life in a big city.
sentences.zh: 他還在適應大城市的生活。

sentences.en: We'll adjust the schedule if the client needs more time.
sentences.zh: 如果客戶需要更多時間，我們會調整時程。

sentences.en: How long did it take you to adjust to the time difference?
sentences.zh: 你花了多久時間適應時差？

sentences.en: You can adjust the font size in settings.
sentences.zh: 你可以在設定裡調整字體大小。

sentences.en: A small adjustment fixed the problem.
sentences.zh: 一個小小的調整就解決了問題。

sentences.en: Do we need to make an adjustment to the budget?
sentences.zh: 我們需要調整預算嗎？

sentences.en: Moving abroad requires a big adjustment.
sentences.zh: 搬到國外需要很大的調適。

sentences.en: Is this a temporary adjustment or a permanent one?
sentences.zh: 這是暫時的調整還是永久的調整？

sentences.en: The mechanic made an adjustment to the brakes.
sentences.zh: 技師對煞車做了調整。

sentences.en: Her adjustment to the new school went smoothly.
sentences.zh: 她適應新學校的過程很順利。

gloss_note: admirable effort 令人佩服的努力

sentences.en: Your patience with the kids is admirable.
sentences.zh: 你對孩子們的耐心令人欽佩。

sentences.en: That was an admirable effort, even though we lost.
sentences.zh: 雖然我們輸了，那仍是令人欽佩的努力。

sentences.en: Is it admirable to work 80 hours a week?
sentences.zh: 每週工作八十小時值得欽佩嗎？

sentences.en: She has many admirable qualities.
sentences.zh: 她有許多令人欽佩的特質。

sentences.en: His performance leading the team was admirable.
sentences.zh: 他帶領團隊的表現令人欽佩。

sentences.en: What's the most admirable thing a friend has done for you?
sentences.zh: 朋友為你做過最令人欽佩的事是什麼？

sentences.en: I have great admiration for nurses.
sentences.zh: 我非常欽佩護理師。

sentences.en: She looked at the painting with admiration.
sentences.zh: 她帶著讚賞的眼神看著那幅畫。

sentences.en: Do you feel admiration for your boss?
sentences.zh: 你欽佩你的老闆嗎？

sentences.en: His hard work earned the admiration of his coworkers.
sentences.zh: 他的努力贏得了同事的欽佩。

sentences.en: The kids watched the pilot in admiration.
sentences.zh: 孩子們滿懷敬佩地看著那位機師。

sentences.en: What do you think earns people's admiration these days?
sentences.zh: 你覺得現在什麼能贏得人們的欽佩？

gloss_note: adopt a plan 採用計畫

sentences.en: We adopted a dog from the shelter last month.
sentences.zh: 我們上個月從收容所領養了一隻狗。

sentences.en: Our company will adopt the new software in May.
sentences.zh: 我們公司將在五月採用新的軟體。

sentences.en: Have you ever thought about adopting a child?
sentences.zh: 你曾經想過收養孩子嗎？

sentences.en: The school board adopted a new policy on phones.
sentences.zh: 學校董事會採行了關於手機的新政策。

sentences.en: Why did they adopt such a strict dress code?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼要採用這麼嚴格的服裝規定？

sentences.en: Let's adopt a simpler method for tracking orders.
sentences.zh: 我們採用比較簡單的方法來追蹤訂單吧。

sentences.en: There are good opportunities for advancement here.
sentences.zh: 這裡有很好的晉升機會。

sentences.en: Does the company support career advancement?
sentences.zh: 公司支持職涯晉升嗎？

sentences.en: Her hard work led to quick advancement.
sentences.zh: 她的努力讓她很快就獲得晉升。

sentences.en: Technological advancement has changed how we work.
sentences.zh: 科技的進步改變了我們的工作方式。

sentences.en: What's the path to advancement in this department?
sentences.zh: 在這個部門裡，晉升的途徑是什麼？

sentences.en: Training programs help employees prepare for advancement.
sentences.zh: 培訓計畫幫助員工為晉升做準備。

gloss_note: adverse effect on 對…的不良影響

sentences.en: Adverse weather delayed our flight.
sentences.zh: 惡劣的天氣延誤了我們的班機。

sentences.en: Could the new tax have an adverse effect on small shops?
sentences.zh: 新稅制會對小商店造成不良影響嗎？

sentences.en: The medicine can cause adverse reactions in some people.
sentences.zh: 這種藥對某些人可能引起不良反應。

sentences.en: Adverse market conditions hurt our sales this quarter.
sentences.zh: 不利的市場狀況傷害了我們這一季的銷售。

sentences.en: Did the bad review have an adverse impact on business?
sentences.zh: 那則負評對生意有不利的影響嗎？

sentences.en: We should plan for adverse conditions like heavy snow.
sentences.zh: 我們應該為大雪這類不利的狀況做準備。

sentences.en: Our biggest advertiser just canceled its contract.
sentences.zh: 我們最大的廣告主剛剛取消了合約。

sentences.en: Which advertisers sponsor this show?
sentences.zh: 哪些廣告主贊助這個節目？

sentences.en: Advertisers pay more for prime-time slots.
sentences.zh: 廣告主會為黃金時段付更多錢。

sentences.en: Do advertisers care about how many people watch?
sentences.zh: 廣告主在乎有多少人在看嗎？

sentences.en: The advertiser wants to see the final design today.
sentences.zh: 廣告主今天想看最終的設計。

sentences.en: We're meeting with an advertiser about a summer campaign.
sentences.zh: 我們要跟一位廣告主談夏季的宣傳活動。

sentences.en: She joined the advisory board last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天加入了顧問委員會。

sentences.en: Is this an advisory role or a full-time job?
sentences.zh: 這是顧問性質的職務還是全職工作？

sentences.en: He works in an advisory capacity for two startups.
sentences.zh: 他以顧問身分為兩家新創公司工作。

sentences.en: Our advisory team can review your plan for free.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧問團隊可以免費審閱你的計畫。

sentences.en: Will the advisory committee meet before the vote?
sentences.zh: 顧問委員會會在投票前開會嗎？

sentences.en: The committee's role is advisory, not final.
sentences.zh: 委員會的角色是諮詢性質，不是最終決定。

sentences.en: I like the aesthetic appeal of old brick buildings.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡老磚造建築的美感。

sentences.en: Does the aesthetic value of a building matter more than its cost?
sentences.zh: 建築物的美學價值比成本更重要嗎？

sentences.en: The designers focused on aesthetic details like color and shape.
sentences.zh: 設計師把重點放在色彩和形狀這類美感的細節上。

sentences.en: Aesthetic judgments often differ from person to person.
sentences.zh: 審美的判斷往往因人而異。

sentences.en: Are you taking an aesthetic approach or a practical one?
sentences.zh: 你採取的是美學的角度，還是實用的角度？

sentences.en: She studies aesthetic theory at a small college.
sentences.zh: 她在一所小型大學研讀美學理論。

sentences.en: We hired an ad agency to design our logo.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一間廣告代理商來設計我們的標誌。

sentences.en: Which travel agency did you book the tour through?
sentences.zh: 你是透過哪家旅行社訂這個行程的？

sentences.en: She works for a government agency in Washington.
sentences.zh: 她在華盛頓的一個政府機構工作。

sentences.en: Is it better to hire through an employment agency?
sentences.zh: 透過人力仲介公司找人會比較好嗎？

sentences.en: The agency sent us three candidates for the job.
sentences.zh: 仲介公司為這個職缺推薦了三位應徵者給我們。

sentences.en: A federal agency issued a recall on the baby car seats.
sentences.zh: 一個聯邦機構針對那款嬰兒汽車座椅發布了召回。

gloss_note: real estate agent 房地產經紀人

sentences.en: Our real estate agent showed us five houses.
sentences.zh: 我們的房地產經紀人帶我們看了五間房子。

sentences.en: Can I speak to a customer service agent?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟客服人員談談嗎？

sentences.en: The travel agent found us a cheap flight.
sentences.zh: 旅行社人員為我們找到便宜的機票。

sentences.en: Is your agent handling the contract?
sentences.zh: 你的經紀人在處理這份合約嗎？

sentences.en: An insurance agent called me about my policy.
sentences.zh: 一位保險業務員打電話給我談我的保單。

sentences.en: The airline agent checked my passport at the counter.
sentences.zh: 航空公司的地勤人員在櫃檯檢查了我的護照。

gloss_note: aggressive driver 開車很衝的人

sentences.en: Some drivers get aggressive when they're in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 有些駕駛趕時間時會變得很具攻擊性。

sentences.en: Our company has an aggressive growth plan this year.
sentences.zh: 我們公司今年有一個積極進取的成長計畫。

sentences.en: Why is your dog so aggressive toward strangers?
sentences.zh: 你的狗為什麼對陌生人那麼有攻擊性？

sentences.en: Is it smart to be this aggressive in a negotiation?
sentences.zh: 在談判中這麼強勢是明智的嗎？

sentences.en: The coach wants us to play a more aggressive game.
sentences.zh: 教練要我們打得更積極進取一點。

sentences.en: Don't be so aggressive; he's only asking a question.
sentences.zh: 別這麼咄咄逼人，他只是問個問題。

sentences.en: My roommate is easygoing and very agreeable.
sentences.zh: 我的室友個性隨和，很好說話。

sentences.en: Are you agreeable to meeting at nine?
sentences.zh: 你願意九點見面嗎？

sentences.en: If the price is agreeable, we'll sign today.
sentences.zh: 如果價格可以接受，我們今天就簽約。

sentences.en: He was agreeable to changing the date.
sentences.zh: 他同意更改日期。

sentences.en: Is everyone agreeable to this plan?
sentences.zh: 大家都同意這個計畫嗎？

sentences.en: She's a pleasant, agreeable person to work with.
sentences.zh: 她是個很好共事、很隨和的人。

sentences.en: We need to align our goals with the company's plans.
sentences.zh: 我們需要讓我們的目標與公司的計畫一致。

sentences.en: Can you align the text to the left?
sentences.zh: 你可以把文字向左對齊嗎？

sentences.en: Our schedules don't align this week.
sentences.zh: 我們這週的行程對不上。

sentences.en: How do we align sales and marketing?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何讓銷售和行銷步調一致？

sentences.en: The two teams met to align on next steps.
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊開會，就下一步取得共識。

sentences.en: Please align the boxes so they look neat.
sentences.zh: 請把盒子對齊，這樣看起來才整齊。

gloss_note: make an allegation 提出指控

sentences.en: The company denied the allegation of unfair pricing.
sentences.zh: 該公司否認了定價不公的指控。

sentences.en: Is there any proof behind this allegation?
sentences.zh: 這項指控背後有任何證據嗎？

sentences.en: He made a serious allegation against his former boss.
sentences.zh: 他對前老闆提出了嚴重的指控。

sentences.en: The allegations turned out to be false.
sentences.zh: 事實證明那些指控是假的。

sentences.en: How should HR handle an allegation like that?
sentences.zh: 人資部門該如何處理這樣的指控？

sentences.en: Reporters are looking into the allegations right now.
sentences.zh: 記者目前正在調查那些指控。

gloss_note: an alternative to 替代…的選擇

sentences.en: Do you have an alternative plan?
sentences.zh: 你有替代方案嗎？

sentences.en: Is there an alternative to driving downtown?
sentences.zh: 除了開車到市中心，還有別的選擇嗎？

sentences.en: We need an alternative route; this road is closed.
sentences.zh: 我們需要另一條替代路線，這條路封閉了。

sentences.en: Tofu is a good alternative to meat.
sentences.zh: 豆腐是肉類的良好替代品。

sentences.en: The airline offered us an alternative flight.
sentences.zh: 航空公司提供了替代班機給我們。

sentences.en: She chose the cheaper alternative and saved money.
sentences.zh: 她選了比較便宜的替代方案，因此省了錢。

gloss_note: 用在提出另一個選擇時

sentences.en: We can drive there. Alternatively, we could take the train.
sentences.zh: 我們可以開車去。或者，我們也可以搭火車。

sentences.en: You can pay online or, alternatively, at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 你可以線上付款，或者改在櫃檯付款。

sentences.en: Alternatively, should we just order pizza?
sentences.zh: 或者，我們乾脆叫披薩？

sentences.en: I'll call him tonight. Alternatively, I could send a text.
sentences.zh: 我今晚會打電話給他。或者，我也可以傳簡訊。

sentences.en: We could wait for a table. Alternatively, we could eat at the bar.
sentences.zh: 我們可以等位子。或者，我們可以在吧台吃。

sentences.en: Alternatively, could we move the meeting to Friday?
sentences.zh: 或者，我們可以把會議改到週五嗎？

sentences.en: My dad is an amateur photographer.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是業餘攝影師。

sentences.en: Are you a professional or an amateur?
sentences.zh: 你是專業人士還是業餘愛好者？

sentences.en: She joined an amateur soccer league last fall.
sentences.zh: 她去年秋天加入了一個業餘足球聯盟。

sentences.en: For an amateur, he plays the piano really well.
sentences.zh: 以業餘者來說，他鋼琴彈得真的很好。

sentences.en: Can an amateur really compete at this level?
sentences.zh: 業餘選手真的能在這個水準上競爭嗎？

sentences.en: We're just amateurs, so please be gentle.
sentences.zh: 我們只是業餘愛好者，所以請多包涵。

sentences.en: His answer was ambiguous, so I asked again.
sentences.zh: 他的回答很含糊，所以我又問了一次。

sentences.en: Is this sentence ambiguous to you?
sentences.zh: 這個句子對你來說模稜兩可嗎？

sentences.en: The contract has an ambiguous clause about payment.
sentences.zh: 合約裡有一條關於付款的條款含糊不清。

sentences.en: The ending of the movie is ambiguous on purpose.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的結局是刻意模稜兩可的。

sentences.en: Why did you give such an ambiguous reply?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼給出這麼含糊的回覆？

sentences.en: Ambiguous instructions can lead to costly mistakes.
sentences.zh: 含糊的指示可能導致代價高昂的錯誤。

sentences.en: Does the hotel offer amenities like a pool?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有提供泳池這類的設施嗎？

sentences.en: The apartment has great amenities, including a gym.
sentences.zh: 這間公寓設施很棒，包括一間健身房。

sentences.en: Free Wi-Fi is a basic amenity these days.
sentences.zh: 免費無線網路現在是基本的便利設施。

sentences.en: What amenities are included in the rent?
sentences.zh: 租金包含哪些便利設施？

sentences.en: The building's best amenity is its rooftop garden.
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓最棒的設施是屋頂花園。

sentences.en: Guests can use all the amenities at no extra charge.
sentences.zh: 房客可以免費使用所有的設施。

gloss_note: amortize over five years 分五年攤銷

sentences.en: We will amortize the setup fee over five years.
sentences.zh: 我們會把建置費用分五年攤銷。

sentences.en: How many years can we amortize this software?
sentences.zh: 這套軟體我們可以攤銷幾年？

sentences.en: The bank lets you amortize the loan over 30 years.
sentences.zh: 銀行讓你把貸款分三十年攤還。

sentences.en: Our accountant amortized the license fee last quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們的會計師上一季把授權費做了攤銷。

sentences.en: Can we amortize the cost of the renovation?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把整修的費用做攤銷嗎？

sentences.en: Companies often amortize patents over their useful life.
sentences.zh: 公司通常會在專利的使用年限內攤銷專利。

sentences.en: We have ample time before the flight.
sentences.zh: 在起飛前我們有充裕的時間。

sentences.en: Is there ample parking near the office?
sentences.zh: 辦公室附近有充足的停車位嗎？

sentences.en: The new apartment has ample storage space.
sentences.zh: 新公寓有充足的收納空間。

sentences.en: Please give me ample notice before you travel.
sentences.zh: 你出發旅行前，請提早充分通知我。

sentences.en: Do we have ample supplies for the weekend sale?
sentences.zh: 我們有足夠的貨品應付週末特賣嗎？

sentences.en: The living room has ample space for twelve guests.
sentences.zh: 客廳有充足的空間容納十二位客人。

sentences.en: Your jokes always amuse the kids at dinner.
sentences.zh: 你的笑話總是能在晚餐時逗樂孩子們。

sentences.en: Does this old cartoon still amuse you?
sentences.zh: 這部老卡通還能逗你開心嗎？

sentences.en: She tried not to look amused when her boss tripped.
sentences.zh: 老闆絆了一跤時，她努力不露出覺得好笑的表情。

sentences.en: The magician amused everyone with a simple card trick.
sentences.zh: 魔術師用一個簡單的紙牌戲法逗樂了大家。

sentences.en: What amuses you most about living in the States?
sentences.zh: 住在美國，什麼事最讓你覺得有趣？

sentences.en: We were amused by how seriously the cat watched TV.
sentences.zh: 看到貓咪那麼認真地看電視，我們覺得很好笑。

sentences.en: He watched the puppy chase its tail with amusement.
sentences.zh: 他饒富興味地看著小狗追著自己的尾巴跑。

sentences.en: Do you need some amusement on this long flight?
sentences.zh: 這趟長途飛行你需要點消遣嗎？

sentences.en: To my amusement, my dad learned to use emoji.
sentences.zh: 讓我覺得好笑的是，我爸學會了用表情符號。

sentences.en: Reading is her favorite amusement after a long day at work.
sentences.zh: 閱讀是她結束一天漫長工作後最愛的消遣。

sentences.en: What do you do for amusement on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末都做什麼消遣？

sentences.en: Her brother's dance gave the whole family great amusement.
sentences.zh: 她弟弟跳的舞讓全家人覺得非常好玩。

sentences.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
sentences.zh: 老師用類比來解釋心臟如何運作。

sentences.en: Can you give me an analogy to make this clearer?
sentences.zh: 你可以舉個類比讓這件事更清楚嗎？

sentences.en: The author draws an analogy between the internet and a highway.
sentences.zh: 作者將網際網路與高速公路作類比。

sentences.en: Is that a fair analogy, or is it too simple?
sentences.zh: 那是個恰當的類比，還是太過簡單了？

sentences.en: In that analogy, a company is like a ship that needs a captain.
sentences.zh: 照那個類比，公司就像一艘需要船長的船。

sentences.en: His analogy with a car engine made the lecture easy to follow.
sentences.zh: 他拿汽車引擎做的類比，讓這堂課很容易聽懂。

gloss_note: 複數 analyses；do an analysis 做分析

sentences.en: The analysis shows that sales dropped in March.
sentences.zh: 分析顯示三月的銷售額下降了。

sentences.en: Could you send me the full analysis by noon?
sentences.zh: 你可以在中午前把完整的分析寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: We need a closer analysis of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我們需要對這個問題做更仔細的分析。

sentences.en: What does your analysis say about the new store?
sentences.zh: 你的分析對這家新店有什麼看法？

sentences.en: After careful analysis, the doctor found the cause.
sentences.zh: 經過仔細分析，醫生找出了原因。

sentences.en: The class began with an analysis of the poem.
sentences.zh: 這堂課一開始先分析了那首詩。

sentences.en: We are looking for someone with strong analytical skills.
sentences.zh: 我們在找分析能力很強的人。

sentences.en: Is she more creative or more analytical?
sentences.zh: 她比較有創意，還是比較善於分析？

sentences.en: He takes an analytical approach to every budget problem.
sentences.zh: 他用分析的方式來處理每個預算問題。

sentences.en: Do you have any analytical tools for tracking sales?
sentences.zh: 你有任何追蹤銷售的分析工具嗎？

sentences.en: The report is very analytical, with charts on every page.
sentences.zh: 這份報告非常偏重分析，每一頁都有圖表。

sentences.en: Her analytical mind spots errors very quickly.
sentences.zh: 她善於分析的頭腦很快就能發現錯誤。

gloss_note: 名詞 analysis；英式拼法 analyse

sentences.en: Let's analyze last quarter's numbers before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會前，我們先來分析上一季的數字吧。

sentences.en: How do you analyze customer feedback?
sentences.zh: 你都怎麼分析客戶的意見回饋？

sentences.en: Scientists analyzed the water samples from the lake.
sentences.zh: 科學家分析了從湖裡採集的水樣。

sentences.en: I need time to analyze this contract.
sentences.zh: 我需要時間來分析這份合約。

sentences.en: Can you analyze what went wrong with the plan?
sentences.zh: 你能分析一下計畫哪裡出了問題嗎？

sentences.en: The students analyzed the speech in small groups.
sentences.zh: 學生們分小組分析了那場演說。

sentences.en: My ancestors came to this country over a hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 我的祖先在一百多年前來到這個國家。

sentences.en: Do you know where your ancestors are from?
sentences.zh: 你知道你的祖先來自哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: She is researching her family's ancestors online.
sentences.zh: 她正在網路上查她家族的祖先。

sentences.en: Birds share a common ancestor with dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 鳥類與恐龍有共同的祖先。

sentences.en: Who was the first ancestor in your family to move here?
sentences.zh: 你們家第一個搬來這裡的祖先是誰？

sentences.en: Every spring, we show respect to our ancestors.
sentences.zh: 每年春天，我們都會向祖先表達敬意。

sentences.en: Our annual meeting is next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我們的年度會議在下週二。

sentences.en: What is the annual fee for this credit card?
sentences.zh: 這張信用卡的年費是多少？

sentences.en: The annual report will come out in March.
sentences.zh: 年度報告會在三月出爐。

sentences.en: Do you get an annual bonus at your company?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有年度獎金嗎？

sentences.en: She gets her annual checkup every June.
sentences.zh: 她每年六月都會做年度健康檢查。

sentences.en: The town holds an annual art fair downtown.
sentences.zh: 這個鎮每年都會在市中心舉辦藝術市集。

sentences.en: She majored in anthropology in college.
sentences.zh: 她大學時主修人類學。

sentences.en: Is anthropology the study of people and cultures?
sentences.zh: 人類學是研究人類與文化的學問嗎？

sentences.en: Our anthropology professor lived with a farming community for a year.
sentences.zh: 我們的人類學教授和一個農耕社群一起生活了一年。

sentences.en: What can anthropology teach us about ancient societies?
sentences.zh: 人類學能教我們哪些關於古代社會的事？

sentences.en: He took an anthropology class to learn about different cultures.
sentences.zh: 他修了一門人類學課，想了解不同的文化。

sentences.en: Anthropology uses interviews and field notes to understand daily life.
sentences.zh: 人類學利用訪談與田野筆記來了解日常生活。

sentences.en: I bought this antique desk at a yard sale.
sentences.zh: 我在庭院拍賣會買了這張古董書桌。

sentences.en: Do you sell antiques in your shop?
sentences.zh: 你們店裡有賣古董嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother collects antique clocks.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶收集古董鐘。

sentences.en: How much is this antique mirror?
sentences.zh: 這面古董鏡子多少錢？

sentences.en: The antique vase on the shelf is very fragile.
sentences.zh: 架子上的古董花瓶非常易碎。

sentences.en: They run a small antique store on Main Street.
sentences.zh: 他們在大街上經營一家小古董店。

sentences.en: The company is facing an antitrust investigation.
sentences.zh: 那家公司正面臨反托拉斯調查。

sentences.en: Do antitrust laws apply to small businesses?
sentences.zh: 反托拉斯法適用於小型企業嗎？

sentences.en: Regulators filed an antitrust lawsuit against the tech giant.
sentences.zh: 主管機關對那家科技巨頭提起了反托拉斯訴訟。

sentences.en: Will the merger pass the antitrust review?
sentences.zh: 這項合併案能通過反托拉斯審查嗎？

sentences.en: Our lawyer is an expert in antitrust cases.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師是反托拉斯案件的專家。

sentences.en: The antitrust rules keep large firms from fixing prices.
sentences.zh: 反托拉斯規定防止大公司操縱價格。

sentences.en: She felt a lot of anxiety before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前，她感到非常焦慮。

sentences.en: Do you ever have anxiety about flying?
sentences.zh: 你會對搭飛機感到焦慮嗎？

sentences.en: A little anxiety is normal before a test.
sentences.zh: 考試前有一點焦慮是正常的。

sentences.en: Is there anything I can do to ease your anxiety?
sentences.zh: 我能做些什麼來減輕你的焦慮嗎？

sentences.en: His anxiety about money kept him awake at night.
sentences.zh: 他對錢的焦慮讓他夜裡睡不著。

sentences.en: Deep breathing helps me manage my anxiety.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸能幫助我控制焦慮。

gloss_note: apparent to sb. 對某人而言很明顯

sentences.en: It was apparent that he hadn't read the report.
sentences.zh: 很明顯，他沒有看過那份報告。

sentences.en: Is the cause of the delay apparent yet?
sentences.zh: 延誤的原因已經很明顯了嗎？

sentences.en: For no apparent reason, the printer stopped working.
sentences.zh: 印表機毫無明顯的原因就停止運作了。

sentences.en: The problem became apparent after the first week.
sentences.zh: 第一週過後，問題就變得很明顯了。

sentences.en: Was her disappointment apparent to everyone?
sentences.zh: 大家都看得出她很失望嗎？

sentences.en: There's no apparent damage to the car.
sentences.zh: 這輛車沒有明顯的損傷。

gloss_note: appetite for risk 風險偏好

sentences.en: Investors have little appetite for risk right now.
sentences.zh: 投資人現在對風險的承受意願很低。

sentences.en: Do consumers still have an appetite for luxury goods?
sentences.zh: 消費者還有購買精品的意願嗎？

sentences.en: The kids lost their appetite after eating too many snacks.
sentences.zh: 孩子們吃了太多零食後就沒胃口了。

sentences.en: Does the board have an appetite for another acquisition?
sentences.zh: 董事會有再收購一家公司的意願嗎？

sentences.en: I have a big appetite after my morning workout.
sentences.zh: 晨間運動後，我的胃口很大。

sentences.en: Our competitor has no appetite for a price war.
sentences.zh: 我們的競爭對手無意打價格戰。

gloss_note: 美式說法；英式常用 starter

sentences.en: For an appetizer, I'll have the fried calamari.
sentences.zh: 開胃菜我要點炸花枝圈。

sentences.en: Would you like to order an appetizer first?
sentences.zh: 您要先點一份開胃菜嗎？

sentences.en: Can we share one appetizer before the main course?
sentences.zh: 我們可以在主餐前分食一份開胃菜嗎？

sentences.en: The appetizers at the party were gone in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 派對上的開胃菜十分鐘就被吃光了。

sentences.en: This soup makes a great appetizer.
sentences.zh: 這道湯當開胃菜很棒。

sentences.en: The waiter brought a small appetizer on the house.
sentences.zh: 服務生送來一小份免費的開胃菜。

sentences.en: Did you send in your job application yet?
sentences.zh: 你寄出求職申請了嗎？

sentences.en: The application form takes about ten minutes to fill out.
sentences.zh: 這份申請表大約要花十分鐘填寫。

sentences.en: Her application for a visa was approved.
sentences.zh: 她的簽證申請獲得核准。

sentences.en: What is the practical application of this theory?
sentences.zh: 這個理論有什麼實際應用？

sentences.en: The college application is due on January first.
sentences.zh: 大學申請的截止日是1月1日。

sentences.en: This tool has many applications in medicine.
sentences.zh: 這項工具在醫學上有許多應用。

gloss_note: appoint sb. as/to 任命某人為

sentences.en: The board will appoint a new manager next week.
sentences.zh: 董事會下週會任命一位新經理。

sentences.en: Who did they appoint to lead the project?
sentences.zh: 他們指派了誰來帶領這項計畫？

sentences.en: She was appointed head of the department last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年被任命為部門主管。

sentences.en: Should we appoint someone to take notes?
sentences.zh: 我們該指派一個人做紀錄嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor appointed a committee to study the problem.
sentences.zh: 市長任命了一個委員會來研究這個問題。

sentences.en: They appointed him as the team captain.
sentences.zh: 他們指派他擔任隊長。

sentences.en: I have a dentist appointment at three o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我三點有一個牙醫的預約。

sentences.en: Can I make an appointment for next Monday?
sentences.zh: 我可以預約下週一嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have an appointment with Dr. Lee?
sentences.zh: 你有預約李醫師嗎？

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I have to cancel my appointment.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，我必須取消我的預約。

sentences.en: Walk-ins are fine, but an appointment is faster.
sentences.zh: 不預約直接來也可以，但預約會比較快。

sentences.en: I have an appointment with a client at ten.
sentences.zh: 我十點跟一位客戶有約。

sentences.en: Is this jacket appropriate for a job interview?
sentences.zh: 這件夾克適合穿去面試嗎？

sentences.en: Please wear appropriate clothes to the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 請穿著合宜的服裝出席典禮。

sentences.en: That joke wasn't appropriate for the meeting.
sentences.zh: 那個笑話不適合在會議上說。

sentences.en: What is the appropriate way to thank a client?
sentences.zh: 向客戶道謝的適當方式是什麼？

sentences.en: We'll take appropriate action once we know more.
sentences.zh: 等我們了解更多後，會採取適當的行動。

sentences.en: The movie isn't appropriate for young children.
sentences.zh: 這部電影不適合幼童觀看。

sentences.en: I need my manager's approval before I order this.
sentences.zh: 我下單之前需要經理的批准。

sentences.en: Did the city give final approval for the building?
sentences.zh: 市政府對那棟建築給出最終核准了嗎？

sentences.en: The plan is still waiting for approval.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫仍在等待核准。

sentences.en: She nodded in approval and smiled at me.
sentences.zh: 她點頭表示同意，並對我微笑。

sentences.en: Do I need parental approval to join the trip?
sentences.zh: 我參加這趟旅行需要家長的同意嗎？

sentences.en: The new medicine received approval last month.
sentences.zh: 這款新藥上個月獲得核准。

sentences.en: We took the kids to the aquarium on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 星期六我們帶孩子去了水族館。

sentences.en: How often do you clean your aquarium?
sentences.zh: 你多久清一次你的魚缸？

sentences.en: The aquarium has a huge tank full of sharks.
sentences.zh: 水族館有一個養滿鯊魚的大水槽。

sentences.en: She keeps a small aquarium in her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 她在臥室裡放了一個小魚缸。

sentences.en: Is the aquarium open on Mondays?
sentences.zh: 水族館星期一有開嗎？

sentences.en: My son loves watching the jellyfish at the aquarium.
sentences.zh: 我兒子很愛在水族館看水母。

gloss_note: 名詞指拱形結構；動詞指彎成弧形

sentences.en: Walk through the stone arch and turn left.
sentences.zh: 穿過那座石拱門後左轉。

sentences.en: The bridge has three large arches.
sentences.zh: 這座橋有三個大型拱形橋孔。

sentences.en: Do you see the arch over the entrance?
sentences.zh: 你看到入口上方的拱門了嗎？

sentences.en: The cat arched its back and hissed.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓拱起背並發出嘶聲。

sentences.en: Can you arch your back like this?
sentences.zh: 你可以像這樣拱起背嗎？

sentences.en: Our wedding photos were taken under a flower arch.
sentences.zh: 我們的婚禮照片是在一座花拱門下拍的。

sentences.en: The architectural plans are ready for review.
sentences.zh: 建築圖已經準備好供審閱了。

sentences.en: Do you have any architectural drawings of the office?
sentences.zh: 你有這間辦公室的任何建築圖嗎？

sentences.en: The city is famous for its architectural beauty.
sentences.zh: 這座城市以建築之美聞名。

sentences.en: She works for an architectural firm downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心的一家建築事務所工作。

sentences.en: Who made the architectural design for the new library?
sentences.zh: 新圖書館的建築設計是誰做的？

sentences.en: We took an architectural tour of the old downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們參加了舊市區的建築導覽。

gloss_note: 常置於 best/most 等最高級前

sentences.en: She is arguably the best manager we have.
sentences.zh: 她可以說是我們最優秀的經理。

sentences.en: Wasn't last year arguably our strongest year in sales?
sentences.zh: 去年不就可以說是我們業績最好的一年嗎？

sentences.en: Arguably, the cheaper option is the better choice.
sentences.zh: 可以說，比較便宜的選項是比較好的選擇。

sentences.en: That was arguably the worst meeting I've ever sat through.
sentences.zh: 那可以說是我參加過最糟的會議。

sentences.en: Isn't this arguably the best time to expand?
sentences.zh: 這難道不能說是擴張的最好時機嗎？

sentences.en: Their product is arguably easier to use than ours.
sentences.zh: 他們的產品可以說比我們的更好用。

gloss_note: arise from 起因於；過去式 arose

sentences.en: If any problems arise, call me right away.
sentences.zh: 如果出現任何問題，立刻打電話給我。

sentences.en: What should we do if a conflict arises?
sentences.zh: 如果發生衝突，我們該怎麼辦？

sentences.en: A new question arose during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 會議期間出現了一個新的問題。

sentences.en: Do these issues often arise at your workplace?
sentences.zh: 你的職場常出現這些問題嗎？

sentences.en: Several new opportunities have arisen this year.
sentences.zh: 今年出現了好幾個新機會。

sentences.en: The trouble arose from a simple misunderstanding.
sentences.zh: 這場麻煩源自一個簡單的誤會。

sentences.en: Follow the arrow on the sign to the exit.
sentences.zh: 跟著標誌上的箭頭走到出口。

sentences.en: The archer pulled back the string and shot an arrow.
sentences.zh: 弓箭手拉開弓弦，射出一支箭。

sentences.en: Which way does that arrow point?
sentences.zh: 那個箭頭指向哪個方向？

sentences.en: Press the up arrow key to scroll up.
sentences.zh: 按向上的箭頭鍵往上捲動。

sentences.en: The arrow missed the target by a few inches.
sentences.zh: 這支箭差了幾英吋沒射中靶。

sentences.en: Do you see the red arrow on the map?
sentences.zh: 你看到地圖上的紅色箭頭了嗎？

sentences.en: It's hard to articulate how I feel right now.
sentences.zh: 我很難說清楚自己現在的感受。

sentences.en: Can you articulate your main idea in one sentence?
sentences.zh: 你能用一句話清楚表達你的主要想法嗎？

sentences.en: She is an articulate speaker who connects with the audience.
sentences.zh: 她是個口才很好的講者，能和聽眾產生共鳴。

sentences.en: The candidate was calm and articulate during the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時，那位應徵者冷靜而且口才很好。

sentences.en: He struggled to articulate his concerns to the board.
sentences.zh: 他很難向董事會清楚表達他的疑慮。

sentences.en: Why can't I articulate what I want?
sentences.zh: 我為什麼說不清楚我想要什麼？

sentences.en: The museum displays artifacts from an ancient city.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示了來自一座古城的文物。

sentences.en: Archaeologists found a clay artifact near the river.
sentences.zh: 考古學家在河邊發現了一件陶製文物。

sentences.en: Is this tool an artifact from the Stone Age?
sentences.zh: 這件工具是石器時代的文物嗎？

sentences.en: What can artifacts tell us about daily life long ago?
sentences.zh: 文物能告訴我們哪些古代日常生活的事？

sentences.en: Visitors may not touch the artifacts.
sentences.zh: 參觀者不得觸摸這些文物。

sentences.en: The students drew sketches of each artifact.
sentences.zh: 學生們為每件文物畫了素描。

sentences.en: This juice has no artificial colors.
sentences.zh: 這款果汁不含人工色素。

sentences.en: Is that plant real or artificial?
sentences.zh: 那株植物是真的還是人造的？

sentences.en: The company uses artificial intelligence to sort emails.
sentences.zh: 那家公司用人工智慧來分類電子郵件。

sentences.en: We have an artificial lake behind the hotel.
sentences.zh: 飯店後面有一座人工湖。

sentences.en: Do you prefer real flowers or artificial ones?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡真花還是人造花？

sentences.en: Artificial light can affect how well you sleep.
sentences.zh: 人造光線會影響睡眠品質。

sentences.en: She has a very artistic eye for color.
sentences.zh: 她對色彩有很敏銳的藝術眼光。

sentences.en: Is your daughter artistic at all?
sentences.zh: 你女兒有什麼藝術天分嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant has an artistic design with hand-painted walls.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳設計很有藝術感，牆壁都是手繪的。

sentences.en: I'm not very artistic, but I love to try.
sentences.zh: 我不太有藝術細胞，但我很愛嘗試。

sentences.en: Which artistic style do you like best?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪種藝術風格？

sentences.en: The school offers many artistic activities after class.
sentences.zh: 學校在課後提供許多藝術活動。

sentences.en: I'm ashamed of how I acted yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我對昨天自己的行為感到羞愧。

sentences.en: Why would you be ashamed of your accent?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要為自己的口音感到羞愧？

sentences.en: He felt ashamed after he lied to his boss.
sentences.zh: 他對老闆說謊後感到羞愧。

sentences.en: Are you ashamed to ask for help?
sentences.zh: 你羞於開口求助嗎？

sentences.en: She was too ashamed to tell her parents about the grade.
sentences.zh: 她羞愧得不敢告訴爸媽那個成績。

sentences.en: You should never be ashamed of making a mistake.
sentences.zh: 你絕不該為犯錯而羞愧。

sentences.en: Do you have any aspirin in your bag?
sentences.zh: 你包包裡有阿斯匹靈嗎？

sentences.en: I took an aspirin for my headache.
sentences.zh: 我吃了一顆阿斯匹靈來緩解頭痛。

sentences.en: Should I take aspirin with food?
sentences.zh: 我應該配著食物吃阿斯匹靈嗎？

sentences.en: The pharmacy near the hotel sells aspirin.
sentences.zh: 飯店附近的藥局有賣阿斯匹靈。

sentences.en: Aspirin is in the first aid kit under the sink.
sentences.zh: 阿斯匹靈放在水槽下方的急救箱裡。

sentences.en: Read the label before you take aspirin.
sentences.zh: 吃阿斯匹靈前，請先看標籤。

gloss_note: assault on 對…的襲擊（新聞用語）

sentences.en: Did you see the news about the assault downtown?
sentences.zh: 你看到市中心那起襲擊案的新聞了嗎？

sentences.en: I just watched a movie about an assault on a castle.
sentences.zh: 我剛看了一部關於攻擊城堡的電影。

sentences.en: Were there any witnesses to the assault?
sentences.zh: 那起襲擊案有目擊者嗎？

sentences.en: Police arrested a man for assault last night.
sentences.zh: 警方昨晚因攻擊案逮捕了一名男子。

sentences.en: Why did the army launch an assault at dawn?
sentences.zh: 軍隊為什麼要在黎明發動攻擊？

sentences.en: The mayor condemned the assault and asked everyone to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 市長譴責了這起襲擊，並呼籲大家保持冷靜。

gloss_note: assign sb. to 指派某人去

sentences.en: My boss assigned me to the new project.
sentences.zh: 老闆指派我加入新計畫。

sentences.en: Who assigned you this task?
sentences.zh: 誰指派這項任務給你？

sentences.en: The teacher assigned two chapters for homework.
sentences.zh: 老師指定了兩章作為回家作業。

sentences.en: Can you assign someone to cover the front desk?
sentences.zh: 你能指派一個人去顧櫃檯嗎？

sentences.en: We assigned each person a seat number.
sentences.zh: 我們給每個人分配了座位號碼。

sentences.en: They assigned the biggest room to the new manager.
sentences.zh: 他們把最大的房間分配給新來的經理。

sentences.en: Thank you for your assistance with the project.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你對這項計畫的協助。

sentences.en: Do you need any assistance with your bags?
sentences.zh: 你的行李需要協助嗎？

sentences.en: Financial assistance is available for students.
sentences.zh: 學生可以申請經濟協助。

sentences.en: Call this number if you need assistance.
sentences.zh: 如果需要協助，請打這支電話。

sentences.en: May I ask for your assistance for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以請你幫忙一下嗎？

sentences.en: She walked without assistance after the surgery.
sentences.zh: 手術後，她不需要別人協助就能走路。

gloss_note: associate A with B 把A聯想到B

sentences.en: Most people associate the color red with luck.
sentences.zh: 大多數人會把紅色和好運聯想在一起。

sentences.en: What do you associate with summer?
sentences.zh: 說到夏天，你會聯想到什麼？

sentences.en: Do you associate this song with a special memory?
sentences.zh: 你會把這首歌和某段特別的回憶聯想在一起嗎？

sentences.en: He introduced me to a business associate from Texas.
sentences.zh: 他把我介紹給一位德州來的生意夥伴。

sentences.en: My associate will meet you in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 我的夥伴會在大廳跟你碰面。

sentences.en: Our associate in Chicago will handle the shipment.
sentences.zh: 我們在芝加哥的夥伴會處理這批出貨。

sentences.en: She is a member of the local teachers' association.
sentences.zh: 她是當地教師協會的會員。

sentences.en: Is there an association between sleep and stress?
sentences.zh: 睡眠和壓力之間有關聯嗎？

sentences.en: The neighborhood association meets on the first Monday.
sentences.zh: 社區協會在每月第一個星期一開會。

sentences.en: The smell of pine has a strong association with Christmas.
sentences.zh: 松木的味道讓人強烈聯想到聖誕節。

sentences.en: Scientists found a strong association between exercise and good mood.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現運動與好心情之間有很強的關聯。

sentences.en: How do I join the parent-teacher association at school?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼加入學校的家長會？

gloss_note: assure sb. that… 向某人保證

sentences.en: I assure you the package will arrive tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我向你保證包裹明天會到。

sentences.en: Can you assure me that this is safe?
sentences.zh: 你能向我保證這樣是安全的嗎？

sentences.en: She assured her guests that dinner was almost ready.
sentences.zh: 她向客人保證晚餐快好了。

sentences.en: Let me assure you, we take every complaint seriously.
sentences.zh: 讓我向你保證，我們很認真看待每一則客訴。

sentences.en: The manager assured the team their jobs were safe.
sentences.zh: 經理向團隊保證他們的工作很安全。

sentences.en: Who can assure us that the deadline will be met?
sentences.zh: 誰能向我們保證能趕上期限？

sentences.en: He wears athletic shoes to work every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天都穿運動鞋上班。

sentences.en: Are you an athletic person?
sentences.zh: 你是個愛運動的人嗎？

sentences.en: She got an athletic scholarship to college.
sentences.zh: 她拿到了體育獎學金上大學。

sentences.en: Our school has a new athletic field.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有一座新的運動場。

sentences.en: Do you have athletic socks in a larger size?
sentences.zh: 你們有更大尺寸的運動襪嗎？

sentences.en: My son is tall and athletic.
sentences.zh: 我兒子又高又擅長運動。

sentences.en: The teacher drew an atomic model on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個原子模型。

sentences.en: What is the atomic number of oxygen?
sentences.zh: 氧的原子序是多少？

sentences.en: Atomic clocks are extremely accurate.
sentences.zh: 原子鐘極為準確。

sentences.en: Who first came up with atomic theory?
sentences.zh: 誰最先提出原子理論？

sentences.en: We learned about atomic structure in science class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在自然課學到了原子結構。

sentences.en: The atomic weight of carbon is about twelve.
sentences.zh: 碳的原子量大約是十二。

gloss_note: attach A to B 把 A 附在 B 上

sentences.en: I'll attach the file to this email.
sentences.zh: 我會把檔案附在這封電子郵件上。

sentences.en: Did you attach the receipt to the form?
sentences.zh: 你有把收據附在表格上嗎？

sentences.en: Please attach a photo to your application.
sentences.zh: 請在申請書上附一張照片。

sentences.en: How do I attach a document in this app?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼在這個應用程式裡附加文件？

sentences.en: Attach the label to the box with tape.
sentences.zh: 用膠帶把標籤貼在箱子上。

sentences.en: She attached a note to the gift.
sentences.zh: 她在禮物上附了一張紙條。

sentences.en: I can't open the attachment you sent.
sentences.zh: 我打不開你寄來的附件。

sentences.en: Did you see the attachment in my last email?
sentences.zh: 你有看到我上一封郵件裡的附件嗎？

sentences.en: Please check the attachment for the schedule.
sentences.zh: 請看附件裡的時程表。

sentences.en: The message was too big to send with that attachment.
sentences.zh: 加上那個附件後，訊息太大寄不出去。

sentences.en: The little girl has a strong attachment to her teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 小女孩對她的泰迪熊有很深的依戀。

sentences.en: Why do we form an attachment to certain places?
sentences.zh: 我們為什麼會對某些地方產生依戀？

gloss_note: attain a goal 達成目標

sentences.en: She worked hard to attain her goal.
sentences.zh: 她努力工作以達成她的目標。

sentences.en: How can we attain this sales target by June?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在六月前達成這個銷售目標？

sentences.en: He attained a master's degree in 2020.
sentences.zh: 他在2020年取得碩士學位。

sentences.en: Do you think we can attain the same quality at a lower cost?
sentences.zh: 你認為我們能以較低的成本達到相同的品質嗎？

sentences.en: It takes years to attain this level of skill.
sentences.zh: 要達到這種技術水準得花好幾年。

sentences.en: The team attained its goal of finishing in the top three.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍達成了名列前三名的目標。

sentences.en: The drop in sales is attributable to the weather.
sentences.zh: 銷售下滑可歸因於天氣。

sentences.en: Is the delay attributable to a supplier problem?
sentences.zh: 這次延誤是否可歸因於供應商的問題？

sentences.en: Most of the profit growth is attributable to online orders.
sentences.zh: 大部分的獲利成長可歸因於網路訂單。

sentences.en: Which part of the cost is attributable to shipping?
sentences.zh: 哪一部分的成本可歸因於運費？

sentences.en: None of the errors were attributable to the staff.
sentences.zh: 沒有任何一項錯誤可歸因於員工。

sentences.en: The increase is largely attributable to higher prices.
sentences.zh: 這次的成長大部分可歸因於價格上漲。

sentences.en: Can you hear the audio on your end?
sentences.zh: 你那邊聽得到聲音嗎？

sentences.en: The audio quality on this call is terrible.
sentences.zh: 這通電話的音訊品質很糟。

sentences.en: Please send me the audio file after the meeting.
sentences.zh: 會議結束後請把音訊檔寄給我。

sentences.en: The museum offers an audio guide in five languages.
sentences.zh: 博物館提供五種語言的語音導覽。

sentences.en: Is there an audio version of this book?
sentences.zh: 這本書有有聲版本嗎？

sentences.en: The audio and the video are out of sync.
sentences.zh: 聲音和影片不同步。

gloss_note: authentic Mexican food 道地墨西哥菜

sentences.en: This restaurant serves authentic Italian pizza.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳賣道地的義大利披薩。

sentences.en: How can I tell if this bag is authentic?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼分辨這個包包是不是真品？

sentences.en: The shop sells authentic handmade pottery.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣的是真正的手工陶器。

sentences.en: Is this sauce authentic, or from a jar?
sentences.zh: 這個醬是道地的做法，還是罐裝的？

sentences.en: I want an authentic experience, not a tourist trap.
sentences.zh: 我想要道地的體驗，不是觀光陷阱。

sentences.en: The museum has an authentic letter from the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一封1800年代的真跡信件。

sentences.en: Do you have authorization to approve this purchase?
sentences.zh: 你有核准這筆採購的授權嗎？

sentences.en: I need written authorization from my manager first.
sentences.zh: 我需要先取得主管的書面授權。

sentences.en: Travel expenses over $500 require authorization from the director.
sentences.zh: 超過500美元的差旅費需要主任的批准。

sentences.en: Who gave you authorization to enter the server room?
sentences.zh: 是誰授權你進入伺服器機房的？

sentences.en: Without proper authorization, employees cannot open these files.
sentences.zh: 沒有適當的授權，員工就無法開啟這些檔案。

sentences.en: She signed the authorization form and handed it back.
sentences.zh: 她簽好授權書，然後把它交了回去。

sentences.en: Have you read his autobiography yet?
sentences.zh: 你讀過他的自傳了嗎？

sentences.en: Our English teacher asked us to write a short autobiography.
sentences.zh: 英文老師要我們寫一篇簡短的自傳。

sentences.en: Her autobiography tells the story of growing up on a farm.
sentences.zh: 她的自傳講述了在農場長大的故事。

sentences.en: Did she write her autobiography by herself?
sentences.zh: 她的自傳是自己寫的嗎？

sentences.en: I borrowed an autobiography from the library last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我上週末從圖書館借了一本自傳。

sentences.en: The autobiography became a bestseller within a month.
sentences.zh: 這本自傳在一個月內成了暢銷書。

gloss_note: ask for an autograph 要簽名

sentences.en: Can I get your autograph for my daughter?
sentences.zh: 我可以為我女兒要一個你的親筆簽名嗎？

sentences.en: The singer signed autographs after the show.
sentences.zh: 歌手在表演結束後為大家簽名。

sentences.en: He autographed the baseball and gave it to the boy.
sentences.zh: 他在棒球上簽了名，然後送給那個男孩。

sentences.en: Did the author autograph your copy of the book?
sentences.zh: 作者有在你那本書上簽名嗎？

sentences.en: I kept the autograph in a frame on my wall.
sentences.zh: 我把那個簽名裱了框，掛在牆上。

sentences.en: Fans waited in line for hours to get an autograph.
sentences.zh: 粉絲們排了好幾個小時的隊，只為了要一個簽名。

sentences.en: Many investors have an aversion to losses.
sentences.zh: 許多投資人厭惡虧損。

sentences.en: Does your boss have an aversion to change?
sentences.zh: 你的老闆是不是很厭惡改變？

sentences.en: The owner's aversion to debt kept the company stable.
sentences.zh: 老闆對負債的反感讓公司維持穩定。

sentences.en: Why do some customers show an aversion to online payments?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些顧客對線上付款感到反感？

sentences.en: She has a strong aversion to public speaking.
sentences.zh: 她對公開演講有很強的反感。

sentences.en: His aversion to risk made him reject the deal.
sentences.zh: 他對風險的厭惡讓他拒絕了這筆交易。

gloss_note: 較正式；日常多說 wait for

sentences.en: We are awaiting your reply to our email.
sentences.zh: 我們正在等候您回覆我們的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Passengers must await further instructions at the gate.
sentences.zh: 乘客必須在登機門等候進一步的指示。

sentences.en: Are you still awaiting the test results?
sentences.zh: 你還在等檢驗結果嗎？

sentences.en: The company awaits approval from the city council.
sentences.zh: 公司正在等候市議會的核准。

sentences.en: I'm awaiting a call from the hiring manager.
sentences.zh: 我正在等用人主管的來電。

sentences.en: Is the team still awaiting a decision from headquarters?
sentences.zh: 團隊還在等總部的決定嗎？

sentences.en: Antibiotics treat bacterial infections, not viral ones.
sentences.zh: 抗生素能治療細菌感染，但不能治療病毒感染。

sentences.en: Is this sore throat bacterial or viral?
sentences.zh: 這次喉嚨痛是細菌性的還是病毒性的？

sentences.en: Bacterial growth slows down in cold temperatures.
sentences.zh: 細菌的生長在低溫下會減緩。

sentences.en: The lab found bacterial contamination in the water sample.
sentences.zh: 實驗室在水樣本中發現了細菌污染。

sentences.en: Can bacterial cells survive in extreme heat?
sentences.zh: 細菌的細胞能在極高溫下存活嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors confirmed that the boy had a bacterial infection.
sentences.zh: 醫師確認那個男孩得了細菌感染。

gloss_note: bail out a company 替公司紓困

sentences.en: The government bailed out the bank last year.
sentences.zh: 政府去年對那家銀行進行了紓困。

sentences.en: Will the city bail out the failing airline?
sentences.zh: 市政府會對經營不善的航空公司紓困嗎？

sentences.en: Our parent company bailed us out when sales dropped.
sentences.zh: 銷售下滑時，母公司出手紓困了我們。

sentences.en: Why should taxpayers bail out big companies?
sentences.zh: 為什麼要由納稅人替大公司紓困？

sentences.en: Nobody wanted to bail out the struggling startup.
sentences.zh: 沒有人願意替這家苦苦掙扎的新創公司紓困。

sentences.en: Could the investors bail us out one more time?
sentences.zh: 投資人能再救我們一次嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like the baked potato with sour cream, please.
sentences.zh: 我想點烤馬鈴薯，加酸奶油，謝謝。

sentences.en: Do you have any freshly baked bread today?
sentences.zh: 你們今天有現烤的麵包嗎？

sentences.en: The baked salmon comes with rice and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 烤鮭魚附有飯和蔬菜。

sentences.en: Is the baked chicken healthier than the fried one?
sentences.zh: 烤雞比炸的更健康嗎？

sentences.en: My grandma's baked apples smell like cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 奶奶烤的蘋果聞起來有肉桂的香味。

sentences.en: We sell baked goods every morning at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我們每天早上在農夫市集賣烘焙食品。

sentences.en: My dad started going bald in his thirties.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸三十幾歲就開始禿頭了。

sentences.en: Is that bald man at the front desk your boss?
sentences.zh: 櫃檯那個禿頭的男人是你的老闆嗎？

sentences.en: He shaved his head and looked completely bald.
sentences.zh: 他把頭剃光，看起來完全禿了。

sentences.en: The baby was almost bald at birth.
sentences.zh: 這個寶寶出生時幾乎是光頭。

sentences.en: Do you think I'd look good if I went bald?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我如果禿頭了會好看嗎？

sentences.en: The bald spot on his head got bigger every year.
sentences.zh: 他頭上禿的那一塊一年比一年大。

sentences.en: My niece takes ballet lessons every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我的姪女每週六上芭蕾舞課。

sentences.en: Would you like to see the ballet this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末想去看芭蕾舞表演嗎？

sentences.en: The ballet tells the story of a lonely swan.
sentences.zh: 這齣芭蕾舞劇講述一隻孤單天鵝的故事。

sentences.en: How long have you studied ballet?
sentences.zh: 你學芭蕾舞多久了？

sentences.en: She wore pink ballet shoes to class.
sentences.zh: 她穿著粉紅色的芭蕾舞鞋去上課。

sentences.en: The school is putting on a ballet this spring.
sentences.zh: 學校今年春天要演出一齣芭蕾舞劇。

sentences.en: Do we have any bandages in the first aid kit?
sentences.zh: 急救箱裡有繃帶嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse put a clean bandage on my knee.
sentences.zh: 護理師在我的膝蓋上貼了乾淨的繃帶。

sentences.en: Can you help me bandage my ankle before the game?
sentences.zh: 比賽前你可以幫我把腳踝包紮起來嗎？

sentences.en: Change the bandage every day until the cut heals.
sentences.zh: 在傷口癒合前，每天都要換繃帶。

sentences.en: He bandaged his sore wrist and kept playing.
sentences.zh: 他把痠痛的手腕包紮起來，繼續打球。

sentences.en: She wrapped a bandage around the dog's paw.
sentences.zh: 她用繃帶包住狗的腳掌。

sentences.en: Language can be a barrier when you move abroad.
sentences.zh: 搬到國外時，語言可能會成為一道障礙。

sentences.en: Is the language barrier a problem at your new job?
sentences.zh: 語言障礙在你的新工作上是個問題嗎？

sentences.en: A concrete barrier blocked the road near the bridge.
sentences.zh: 橋邊的路被一道水泥障礙物擋住了。

sentences.en: What is the biggest barrier to learning a new skill?
sentences.zh: 學習新技能最大的障礙是什麼？

sentences.en: Fear of failure is a barrier for many young people.
sentences.zh: 對失敗的恐懼是許多年輕人的障礙。

sentences.en: The workers set up a barrier around the hole.
sentences.zh: 工人在洞口周圍設了障礙物。

sentences.en: Farmers in the Mississippi River basin grow corn and soybeans.
sentences.zh: 密西西比河流域的農民種植玉米和黃豆。

sentences.en: Which river basin is the largest in the world?
sentences.zh: 世界上最大的河川流域是哪一個？

sentences.en: The city sits in a basin surrounded by mountains.
sentences.zh: 這座城市位於群山環繞的盆地裡。

sentences.en: Does fog collect in the basin every morning?
sentences.zh: 霧每天早上都會聚集在盆地裡嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy rain flooded the whole basin last spring.
sentences.zh: 去年春天的大雨淹沒了整個流域。

sentences.en: Scientists measure water quality across the entire basin.
sentences.zh: 科學家測量整個流域的水質。

gloss_note: a batch of cookies 一批餅乾

sentences.en: The first batch of products ships on Monday.
sentences.zh: 第一批產品週一出貨。

sentences.en: Did the lab test every batch before shipping?
sentences.zh: 實驗室在出貨前有檢驗每一批產品嗎？

sentences.en: We found a defect in this batch of parts.
sentences.zh: 我們在這批零件中發現了瑕疵。

sentences.en: Can you process the next batch of invoices?
sentences.zh: 你可以處理下一批請款單嗎？

sentences.en: She baked a large batch of cookies for the party.
sentences.zh: 她為派對烤了一大批餅乾。

sentences.en: A new batch of orders arrived this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上來了一批新訂單。

gloss_note: 美語多說 panhandler；beggar 較書面

sentences.en: A beggar sat outside the train station with a paper cup.
sentences.zh: 一名乞丐拿著紙杯坐在火車站外面。

sentences.en: Have you ever given money to a beggar?
sentences.zh: 你有給過乞丐錢嗎？

sentences.en: In the story, a kind beggar helps the young prince.
sentences.zh: 故事中，一名善良的乞丐幫助了年輕的王子。

sentences.en: The old beggar smiled and thanked her for the sandwich.
sentences.zh: 年老的乞丐微笑著謝謝她給的三明治。

sentences.en: Why did the king dress up as a beggar?
sentences.zh: 國王為什麼要打扮成乞丐？

sentences.en: The city has fewer beggars on the streets than before.
sentences.zh: 這座城市街上的乞丐比以前少了。

sentences.en: Her behavior at the meeting surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 她在會議上的舉止讓大家都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Is this kind of behavior normal for a puppy?
sentences.zh: 這種行為對小狗來說正常嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher praised the students for their good behavior.
sentences.zh: 老師稱讚學生們良好的行為。

sentences.en: We study animal behavior in biology class.
sentences.zh: 我們在生物課研究動物的行為。

sentences.en: Why is your son's behavior so different at home?
sentences.zh: 你兒子在家裡的行為為什麼這麼不一樣？

sentences.en: Rude behavior will not be tolerated here.
sentences.zh: 這裡不容許無禮的行為。

sentences.en: This deal is beneficial to both companies.
sentences.zh: 這筆交易對兩家公司都有益。

sentences.en: Would a flexible schedule be beneficial to our staff?
sentences.zh: 彈性工時對我們的員工會有益嗎？

sentences.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health.
sentences.zh: 規律運動對你的健康有益。

sentences.en: We are looking for a mutually beneficial agreement.
sentences.zh: 我們正在尋求一份互惠的協議。

sentences.en: How is the new software beneficial to our customers?
sentences.zh: 新軟體對我們的客戶有什麼益處？

sentences.en: Sleep is beneficial to growing teenagers.
sentences.zh: 睡眠對成長中的青少年有益。

sentences.en: The lowest bidder usually wins the construction contract.
sentences.zh: 通常出價最低的競標者會得到營建合約。

sentences.en: Who was the winning bidder for the old building?
sentences.zh: 那棟舊大樓的得標者是誰？

sentences.en: We have five bidders for this project.
sentences.zh: 這個專案有五位競標者。

sentences.en: Will the highest bidder pay in cash?
sentences.zh: 出價最高的人會付現金嗎？

sentences.en: Each bidder must submit a sealed bid.
sentences.zh: 每位競標者都必須提交密封標單。

sentences.en: The bidder withdrew from the auction at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 那位出價人在最後一刻退出了拍賣。

sentences.en: Put the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
sentences.zh: 把空瓶子放進回收桶。

sentences.en: Do you keep the toys in that plastic bin?
sentences.zh: 你把玩具放在那個塑膠收納箱裡嗎？

sentences.en: The bin by the door is for paper only.
sentences.zh: 門邊的那個回收桶只放紙類。

sentences.en: I found my old photos in a bin in the garage.
sentences.zh: 我在車庫的一個收納箱裡找到了我的舊照片。

sentences.en: Which bin should I use for plastic bags?
sentences.zh: 塑膠袋該丟進哪一個回收桶？

sentences.en: The store keeps the apples in a big wooden bin.
sentences.zh: 店裡把蘋果放在一個大木箱裡。

sentences.en: Computers store information in binary code.
sentences.zh: 電腦用二進位碼儲存資訊。

sentences.en: Why do computers use a binary system?
sentences.zh: 電腦為什麼使用二進位系統？

sentences.en: Binary numbers use only zeros and ones.
sentences.zh: 二進位數字只使用零和一。

sentences.en: Can you write this number in binary form?
sentences.zh: 你可以用二進位的形式寫出這個數字嗎？

sentences.en: A binary choice leaves only two possible answers.
sentences.zh: 二元選擇只留下兩個可能的答案。

sentences.en: The survey has a binary question with only yes or no answers.
sentences.zh: 這份問卷有一個只能回答「是」或「否」的二元問題。

sentences.en: I'm reading a biography of a famous inventor.
sentences.zh: 我正在讀一本著名發明家的傳記。

sentences.en: Have you seen the movie based on his biography?
sentences.zh: 你看過根據他的傳記改編的電影嗎？

sentences.en: The biography covers her whole life, from childhood to retirement.
sentences.zh: 這本傳記涵蓋了她的一生，從童年到退休。

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short biography of a hero.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫一位英雄的簡短傳記。

sentences.en: Is there a biography of a famous scientist in the library?
sentences.zh: 圖書館裡有著名科學家的傳記嗎？

sentences.en: The author spent five years researching the biography.
sentences.zh: 作者花了五年時間研究這本傳記。

gloss_note: a blend of A and B A與B的混合

sentences.en: Blend the flour and butter until smooth.
sentences.zh: 把麵粉和奶油攪拌混合到滑順。

sentences.en: Can you blend these two colors to make green?
sentences.zh: 你能把這兩種顏色混合調出綠色嗎？

sentences.en: The singer blends rock and jazz in her songs.
sentences.zh: 這位歌手在她的歌曲中混合了搖滾和爵士。

sentences.en: This coffee is a blend of beans from three countries.
sentences.zh: 這款咖啡是用三個國家的咖啡豆調和而成的。

sentences.en: Do you want me to blend the fruit into a smoothie?
sentences.zh: 你要我把水果打成果昔嗎？

sentences.en: The city is a blend of old and new buildings.
sentences.zh: 這座城市是新舊建築的混合。

gloss_note: give one's blessing 給予祝福

sentences.en: Her parents gave their blessing to the marriage.
sentences.zh: 她的父母祝福了這門婚事。

sentences.en: Good health is a blessing we often forget.
sentences.zh: 健康是我們常常忘記的福氣。

sentences.en: Do you have your parents' blessing to move abroad?
sentences.zh: 你搬到國外有得到父母的祝福嗎？

sentences.en: Having a good neighbor is a real blessing.
sentences.zh: 有個好鄰居真是一種福氣。

sentences.en: The rain was a blessing for the dry farms.
sentences.zh: 這場雨對乾旱的農田來說是一大福音。

sentences.en: Was the new job a blessing for your family?
sentences.zh: 這份新工作對你的家人來說是一種福氣嗎？

sentences.en: Try not to blink while I take the photo.
sentences.zh: 我拍照的時候盡量不要眨眼。

sentences.en: Did you see that? I blinked and missed it.
sentences.zh: 你看到了嗎？我一眨眼就錯過了。

sentences.en: The bright light made me blink several times.
sentences.zh: 刺眼的光線讓我眨了好幾次眼。

sentences.en: Our eyes blink automatically to stay moist.
sentences.zh: 我們的眼睛會自動眨動以保持濕潤。

sentences.en: Is it normal to blink this much when I wear contacts?
sentences.zh: 戴隱形眼鏡時眨這麼多次眼睛正常嗎？

sentences.en: Does a slow blink mean the cat is relaxed?
sentences.zh: 貓慢慢眨眼代表牠很放鬆嗎？

sentences.en: The cherry trees bloom in early spring.
sentences.zh: 櫻花樹在早春開花。

sentences.en: When do the roses bloom in your garden?
sentences.zh: 你花園裡的玫瑰什麼時候開花？

sentences.en: The tulips are in full bloom this week.
sentences.zh: 鬱金香這週正值盛開。

sentences.en: This orchid produces a new bloom every winter.
sentences.zh: 這株蘭花每年冬天都會開一朵新花。

sentences.en: Do these flowers bloom all summer long?
sentences.zh: 這些花整個夏天都會開嗎？

sentences.en: Rain in April helps the garden bloom in May.
sentences.zh: 四月的雨有助於花園在五月開花。

sentences.en: The apple trees are covered in white blossoms.
sentences.zh: 蘋果樹開滿了白色的花。

sentences.en: When do the peach trees blossom here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的桃樹什麼時候開花？

sentences.en: We went to see the cherry blossoms in April.
sentences.zh: 我們四月去賞櫻花。

sentences.en: The orange blossoms smell sweet in the evening.
sentences.zh: 橘子花在傍晚聞起來很香甜。

sentences.en: Do plum trees blossom before the weather warms up?
sentences.zh: 梅樹會在天氣變暖之前開花嗎？

sentences.en: Spring blossoms fell onto the sidewalk after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，春天的花落在人行道上。

gloss_note: approve a blueprint 核准設計圖

sentences.en: The architect showed us the blueprint for the new office.
sentences.zh: 建築師向我們展示了新辦公室的設計圖。

sentences.en: Can I see the blueprint before construction begins?
sentences.zh: 動工前我可以看一下設計圖嗎？

sentences.en: The builders followed the blueprint carefully.
sentences.zh: 營造工人仔細地按照設計圖施工。

sentences.en: Who approved the blueprint for the parking garage?
sentences.zh: 是誰核准了停車場的設計圖？

sentences.en: We need a revised blueprint before we apply for the permit.
sentences.zh: 申請許可證之前，我們需要一份修改過的設計圖。

sentences.en: A blueprint of the factory hangs on the wall.
sentences.zh: 一張工廠的設計圖掛在牆上。

sentences.en: The museum has an old bomber from World War II.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有一架第二次世界大戰時期的老轟炸機。

sentences.en: Did a bomber really fly over this town in 1944?
sentences.zh: 1944年真的有轟炸機飛越這座城鎮嗎？

sentences.en: The pilot trained to fly a heavy bomber.
sentences.zh: 這位飛行員受訓駕駛重型轟炸機。

sentences.en: Is the old bomber still on display at the air show?
sentences.zh: 那架老轟炸機還在航空展上展出嗎？

sentences.en: The documentary shows how a bomber was built in 1942.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片介紹了1942年一架轟炸機是如何製造的。
