sentences.en: The cat purred in contentment on the warm sofa.
sentences.zh: 貓咪窩在溫暖的沙發上，滿足地呼嚕叫。

sentences.en: How can people find contentment in a busy city?
sentences.zh: 在忙碌的城市裡，人們要怎麼找到知足的心境？

sentences.en: Grandpa sat in the garden with a look of contentment.
sentences.zh: 爺爺坐在花園裡，一臉心滿意足。

gloss_note: enter a contest 參加比賽

sentences.en: She won first place in the school speech contest.
sentences.zh: 她在學校的演講比賽中拿到第一名。

sentences.en: Are you going to enter the baking contest?
sentences.zh: 你要報名烘焙比賽嗎？

sentences.en: The contest ends on Friday at noon.
sentences.zh: 比賽在週五中午結束。

sentences.en: How many people entered the photo contest this year?
sentences.zh: 今年有多少人參加攝影比賽？

sentences.en: My classmate lost the spelling contest by one point.
sentences.zh: 我同學在拼字比賽中以一分之差落敗。

sentences.en: The town holds a pie-eating contest every summer.
sentences.zh: 小鎮每年夏天都會舉辦吃派比賽。

gloss_note: out of context 斷章取義

sentences.en: You can often guess the meaning from the context.
sentences.zh: 你常常可以從上下文猜出意思。

sentences.en: What was the context of his comment?
sentences.zh: 他那句話是在什麼情況下說的？

sentences.en: Without context, her joke sounded rude.
sentences.zh: 少了前後的情境，她的玩笑聽起來很沒禮貌。

sentences.en: Can you give me more context about the project?
sentences.zh: 關於這個專案，你可以多給我一些背景資訊嗎？

sentences.en: Historical context helps us understand old stories.
sentences.zh: 歷史背景能幫助我們了解古老的故事。

sentences.en: Please read the whole paragraph to understand the context.
sentences.zh: 請把整段讀完，才能理解上下文。

sentences.en: We need a contingency plan in case the supplier is late.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一套應變計畫，以防供應商延遲交貨。

sentences.en: Is there money in the budget for contingencies?
sentences.zh: 預算裡有為突發狀況預留的錢嗎？

sentences.en: The manager prepared for every possible contingency before the event.
sentences.zh: 活動前，經理為每一種可能的突發狀況都做了準備。

sentences.en: What is our contingency plan if the power goes out?
sentences.zh: 萬一停電，我們的應變計畫是什麼？

sentences.en: Good travelers always keep some cash for contingencies.
sentences.zh: 經驗老到的旅人總會留一些現金應付突發狀況。

sentences.en: A contingency fund covers unexpected repair costs.
sentences.zh: 應變基金可以支應意外的維修費用。

gloss_note: continual 斷斷續續，continuous 不間斷

sentences.en: The continual noise from the street kept waking me up.
sentences.zh: 街上不斷傳來的噪音一直把我吵醒。

sentences.en: Why do you make continual changes to the schedule?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是更動時程表？

sentences.en: Continual interruptions made it hard to finish my work.
sentences.zh: 不斷的打擾讓我很難完成工作。

sentences.en: Are the continual delays caused by the weather?
sentences.zh: 一再的延誤是天氣造成的嗎？

sentences.en: She apologized for the continual mistakes in her report.
sentences.zh: 她為報告裡一再出現的錯誤道歉。

sentences.en: The customer's continual complaints wore out the staff.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客一再的抱怨讓員工疲於應付。

sentences.en: Our costs are continually rising.
sentences.zh: 我們的成本不斷上漲。

sentences.en: Why does the printer continually jam?
sentences.zh: 這台印表機為什麼老是卡紙？

sentences.en: The phone rang continually all through the morning.
sentences.zh: 整個早上電話響個不停。

sentences.en: Is the system continually updated with new data?
sentences.zh: 這個系統會不斷用新資料更新嗎？

sentences.en: She continually checks her email during meetings.
sentences.zh: 她開會時老是在看電子郵件。

sentences.en: We continually improve our service based on customer feedback.
sentences.zh: 我們根據顧客的意見不斷改善服務。

gloss_note: continuous 指中間完全沒有停

sentences.en: We heard continuous thunder all night.
sentences.zh: 我們整晚都聽到不間斷的雷聲。

sentences.en: The hospital provides continuous care for patients day and night.
sentences.zh: 這家醫院日夜為病患提供不間斷的照護。

sentences.en: Do you get a continuous signal in the basement?
sentences.zh: 你在地下室的訊號會一直不中斷嗎？

sentences.en: Continuous practice is the key to learning a language.
sentences.zh: 持續不斷的練習是學好語言的關鍵。

sentences.en: After a continuous ten-hour drive, we finally reached the hotel.
sentences.zh: 連續開了十個小時的車，我們終於抵達飯店。

sentences.en: Why is there a continuous beeping from the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 為什麼廚房一直傳來嗶嗶聲？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. TheDaveRoss assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The machine ran continuously for forty-eight hours.
sentences.zh: 這台機器連續運轉了四十八小時。

sentences.en: Has the server been working continuously since Monday?
sentences.zh: 伺服器從週一起就一直不間斷地運作嗎？

sentences.en: It snowed continuously from morning until night.
sentences.zh: 雪從早到晚下個不停。

sentences.en: Our team works continuously to keep the website online.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊持續不斷地努力讓網站維持上線。

sentences.en: How long can you work continuously without a break?
sentences.zh: 你不休息可以連續工作多久？

sentences.en: The shop has been open continuously for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 這家店已經不間斷地營業三十年了。

sentences.en: The map shows the contours of the hills near our camp.
sentences.zh: 這張地圖標示出我們營地附近山丘的等高線。

sentences.en: She traced the contour of the lake with her finger.
sentences.zh: 她用手指描出湖的輪廓。

sentences.en: Can you see the contour of the mountains in the fog?
sentences.zh: 你看得到霧中群山的輪廓嗎？

sentences.en: How does the road follow the contour of the coast?
sentences.zh: 這條路是怎麼順著海岸的輪廓延伸的？

sentences.en: The contours of the coastline change after every big storm.
sentences.zh: 每次大風暴過後，海岸線的輪廓都會改變。

sentences.en: The artist drew the contour of a face in one line.
sentences.zh: 畫家一筆就勾勒出臉的輪廓。

sentences.en: There is a clear contradiction in his story.
sentences.zh: 他的說法有明顯的矛盾。

sentences.en: Do you see the contradiction between these two reports?
sentences.zh: 你有看出這兩份報告之間的矛盾嗎？

sentences.en: Saying you're busy while watching TV is a contradiction.
sentences.zh: 說你很忙卻在看電視，這根本是自相矛盾。

sentences.en: The data was full of contradictions, so we checked it again.
sentences.zh: 這些資料充滿矛盾，所以我們又重新核對了一遍。

sentences.en: Isn't it a contradiction to ask for quiet and play loud music?
sentences.zh: 要求安靜卻又大聲放音樂，這不是很矛盾嗎？

sentences.en: The manager noticed a contradiction between the two invoices.
sentences.zh: 經理發現這兩張請款單互相矛盾。

sentences.en: There is a big contrast between summer and winter here.
sentences.zh: 這裡夏天和冬天的差別很大。

sentences.en: In contrast, our new model is much quieter.
sentences.zh: 相較之下，我們的新機型安靜多了。

sentences.en: Is the contrast between the two designs clear enough?
sentences.zh: 這兩種設計之間的對比夠明顯嗎？

sentences.en: The black text creates a strong contrast against the white page.
sentences.zh: 黑色文字在白紙上形成強烈的對比。

sentences.en: How does your life in America contrast with life in Taiwan?
sentences.zh: 你在美國的生活和在台灣的生活有什麼不同？

sentences.en: The bright red door contrasts with the gray wall.
sentences.zh: 鮮紅色的門和灰色的牆形成對比。

sentences.en: Everyone should contribute ideas during the group meeting.
sentences.zh: 在小組會議中，每個人都應該貢獻想法。

sentences.en: Would you like to contribute to the class gift?
sentences.zh: 你想不想為班上的禮物出一份錢？

sentences.en: Lack of sleep contributed to my mistakes at work.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足是我工作出錯的原因之一。

sentences.en: How much did each person contribute to the project?
sentences.zh: 每個人對這個專案各貢獻了多少？

sentences.en: Neighbors contributed food and blankets after the flood.
sentences.zh: 水災過後，鄰居們捐出了食物和毯子。

sentences.en: Does sugar contribute to health problems?
sentences.zh: 糖會導致健康問題嗎？

gloss_note: make a contribution 做出貢獻；捐款

sentences.en: Her contribution to the team was very important.
sentences.zh: 她對團隊的貢獻非常重要。

sentences.en: Thank you for your generous contribution to our school.
sentences.zh: 感謝你對我們學校慷慨捐款。

sentences.en: What was his biggest contribution to the company?
sentences.zh: 他對公司最大的貢獻是什麼？

sentences.en: Can I make a small contribution to the fund?
sentences.zh: 我可以為這個基金捐一小筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: Every contribution helps, no matter how small.
sentences.zh: 每一份心意都有幫助，不論多小。

sentences.en: The teacher thanked each student for their contribution to the discussion.
sentences.zh: 老師感謝每位學生在討論中的貢獻。

sentences.en: The new policy caused a lot of controversy at work.
sentences.zh: 這項新規定在公司內引起了不少爭議。

sentences.en: Is there any controversy about the company's new logo?
sentences.zh: 公司的新商標有引起什麼爭議嗎？

sentences.en: The article stirred up controversy among readers.
sentences.zh: 那篇文章在讀者之間引起了爭議。

sentences.en: Why did the ad lead to such controversy?
sentences.zh: 那支廣告為什麼會引發這麼大的爭議？

sentences.en: The controversy over the project finally ended last week.
sentences.zh: 圍繞著這個專案的爭議上週終於落幕了。

sentences.en: There is some controversy over whether homework helps students.
sentences.zh: 關於回家作業到底有沒有幫助學生，還有些爭議。

sentences.en: The hotel is conveniently located near the airport.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店位在機場附近，交通很方便。

sentences.en: Is the office conveniently close to the train station?
sentences.zh: 辦公室離火車站是不是很近、很方便？

sentences.en: You can conveniently pay with your phone at the register.
sentences.zh: 你可以在櫃檯用手機付款，非常方便。

sentences.en: The store is conveniently open until midnight.
sentences.zh: 這家店營業到午夜，非常方便。

sentences.en: Our supplies are conveniently stored in the room next door.
sentences.zh: 我們的物資就放在隔壁房間，拿取很方便。

sentences.en: Where can I conveniently park near the conference center?
sentences.zh: 在會議中心附近，我可以停在哪裡比較方便？

sentences.en: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet.
sentences.zh: 見面時握手是一種慣例。

sentences.en: Will you attend the teachers' convention in Denver?
sentences.zh: 你會參加在丹佛舉辦的教師大會嗎？

sentences.en: Many hotels fill up when a big convention comes to town.
sentences.zh: 有大型會議來到市區時，許多飯店都會客滿。

sentences.en: Social conventions differ from country to country.
sentences.zh: 社交慣例因國家而異。

sentences.en: Why do Americans follow the convention of tipping at restaurants?
sentences.zh: 為什麼美國人在餐廳有給小費的慣例？

sentences.en: The convention lasts three days and starts on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 這場大會為期三天，週四開始。

gloss_note: conventional 指大家習慣的做法

sentences.en: Her ideas are not very conventional, but they work.
sentences.zh: 她的想法不太傳統，但很管用。

sentences.en: Most people still use conventional ovens for baking.
sentences.zh: 大多數人烘焙時仍然使用傳統烤箱。

sentences.en: Do you prefer conventional teaching or online classes?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡傳統教學還是線上課程？

sentences.en: The artist avoided conventional methods and tried something new.
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家避開傳統的方法，嘗試了新的東西。

sentences.en: It's conventional to wear a suit to a job interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時穿西裝是慣例。

sentences.en: Why did the company drop conventional advertising?
sentences.zh: 公司為什麼放棄傳統的廣告方式？

sentences.en: They conversed quietly in the back of the room.
sentences.zh: 他們在房間後方低聲交談。

sentences.en: Can you converse with customers in English?
sentences.zh: 你能用英文和顧客交談嗎？

sentences.en: We conversed for an hour over coffee.
sentences.zh: 我們邊喝咖啡邊聊了一個小時。

sentences.en: I love to converse with older neighbors about local history.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡和年長的鄰居聊當地的歷史。

sentences.en: Did you converse with anyone during the long flight?
sentences.zh: 漫長的飛行途中，你有和任何人交談嗎？

sentences.en: Students should practice conversing in simple sentences first.
sentences.zh: 學生應該先練習用簡單的句子交談。

gloss_note: convey a message 傳達訊息；較正式

sentences.en: I'm not sure how to convey this news to my boss.
sentences.zh: 我不知道該怎麼向老闆傳達這個消息。

sentences.en: Her smile conveyed more than words ever could.
sentences.zh: 她的微笑傳達的比任何言語都多。

sentences.en: How can I convey my thanks to everyone?
sentences.zh: 我該怎麼向大家表達我的感謝？

sentences.en: Could you convey my apology to the customer?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我向客人轉達歉意嗎？

sentences.en: The speaker conveys her ideas clearly and simply.
sentences.zh: 這位講者把她的想法表達得清楚又簡單。

sentences.en: The poster is meant to convey a sense of hope.
sentences.zh: 這張海報是想傳達一種希望的感覺。

gloss_note: be convicted of 被判…罪；名詞指「囚犯」

sentences.en: The jury convicted him after a two-week trial.
sentences.zh: 陪審團在為期兩週的審判後判他有罪。

sentences.en: Can they convict someone without any real evidence?
sentences.zh: 沒有真正的證據，能判人有罪嗎？

sentences.en: He was convicted of fraud last spring.
sentences.zh: 他去年春天被判詐欺罪。

sentences.en: Did the court convict the driver in the end?
sentences.zh: 法院最後有判那位司機有罪嗎？

sentences.en: The lawyer said the evidence was too weak to convict.
sentences.zh: 律師說證據太薄弱，無法定罪。

sentences.en: In the movie, an innocent man gets convicted of theft.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一名無辜的男子被判竊盜罪。

gloss_note: strong conviction 堅定信念；定罪

sentences.en: His conviction for theft shocked the whole town.
sentences.zh: 他被判竊盜罪的消息震驚了全鎮。

sentences.en: Was the conviction a surprise to his family?
sentences.zh: 這次定罪讓他的家人很意外嗎？

sentences.en: She spoke with such conviction that everyone listened.
sentences.zh: 她說話的信念如此堅定，大家都專心聽。

sentences.en: Do you have the conviction to follow your dream?
sentences.zh: 你有堅定的信念去追求夢想嗎？

sentences.en: He has a strong conviction that honesty pays off.
sentences.zh: 他堅信誠實終究會有回報。

sentences.en: The judge overturned the conviction last week.
sentences.zh: 法官上週撤銷了原本的有罪判決。

gloss_note: convince sb to do 說服某人做

sentences.en: I couldn't convince my roommate to join the trip.
sentences.zh: 我說服不了室友參加這趟旅行。

sentences.en: Can you convince him to try the new menu?
sentences.zh: 你能說服他試試新菜單嗎？

sentences.en: She convinced me that the plan would work.
sentences.zh: 她讓我相信這個計畫行得通。

sentences.en: I'm convinced that we made the right choice.
sentences.zh: 我深信我們做了正確的決定。

sentences.en: What convinced you to change your major?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓你決定換主修？

sentences.en: It took one phone call to convince the manager.
sentences.zh: 只打了一通電話就說服了經理。

gloss_note: 美式用語；picnic cooler 野餐保冷箱

sentences.en: Please put the drinks in the cooler.
sentences.zh: 請把飲料放進保冷箱。

sentences.en: Do you sell coolers big enough for a camping trip?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣大到可以帶去露營的保冷箱嗎？

sentences.en: We packed sandwiches and ice in a cooler.
sentences.zh: 我們把三明治和冰塊裝進保冷箱。

sentences.en: Who is bringing the cooler to the company picnic?
sentences.zh: 誰要把保冷箱帶去公司野餐？

sentences.en: The cooler kept the fish fresh during the long drive.
sentences.zh: 保冷箱讓魚在漫長的車程中保持新鮮。

sentences.en: I bought a cheap cooler at the hardware store.
sentences.zh: 我在五金行買了一個便宜的保冷箱。

sentences.en: Thank you for your cooperation.
sentences.zh: 感謝您的配合。

sentences.en: Their cooperation made the project finish early.
sentences.zh: 他們的合作讓專案提早完成。

sentences.en: How can we get more cooperation from the other team?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓另一組更願意配合？

sentences.en: The school runs the program in cooperation with local shops.
sentences.zh: 這所學校與當地商店合作舉辦這個計畫。

sentences.en: Is cooperation between the two countries improving?
sentences.zh: 兩國之間的合作有進步嗎？

sentences.en: Good teamwork needs trust and cooperation.
sentences.zh: 好的團隊需要信任與合作。

gloss_note: cooperative with 對…配合；名詞為合作社

sentences.en: Our manager was very cooperative during the audit.
sentences.zh: 審計期間我們的經理非常配合。

sentences.en: Was the patient cooperative during the check-up?
sentences.zh: 病人在檢查時有配合嗎？

sentences.en: The farmers sell their milk through a cooperative.
sentences.zh: 農夫們透過合作社賣牛奶。

sentences.en: Have you ever bought anything from a farmers' cooperative?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有在農民合作社買過東西？

sentences.en: The suspect was calm and cooperative with the police.
sentences.zh: 嫌犯很冷靜，也很配合警方。

sentences.en: If you stay cooperative, we can finish by noon.
sentences.zh: 只要你肯配合，我們中午前就能做完。

sentences.en: Good coordination between departments saves a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 各部門之間良好的協調能省下很多時間。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of coordination for the event?
sentences.zh: 這場活動由誰負責統籌協調？

sentences.en: Poor coordination caused the shipment to arrive late.
sentences.zh: 協調不良導致貨物延遲抵達。

sentences.en: How do you handle coordination with overseas teams?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼處理與海外團隊的協調？

sentences.en: Thanks to careful coordination, the launch went smoothly.
sentences.zh: 多虧周到的協調，上市活動很順利。

sentences.en: Our weekly meeting is mainly for coordination.
sentences.zh: 我們的週會主要是為了協調工作。

gloss_note: cope with 應付（壓力、困難）

sentences.en: How do you cope with so much stress?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼應付這麼大的壓力？

sentences.en: I can't cope with this much homework.
sentences.zh: 我應付不了這麼多功課。

sentences.en: She coped well when the power went out.
sentences.zh: 停電時她處理得很好。

sentences.en: Can the small store cope with the weekend rush?
sentences.zh: 這家小店應付得了週末的人潮嗎？

sentences.en: Nurses cope with long shifts every day.
sentences.zh: 護理師每天都要應付長時間的輪班。

sentences.en: Grandma is coping fine on her own.
sentences.zh: 奶奶一個人也應付得來。

gloss_note: copper wire 銅線；copper pipe 銅管

sentences.en: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
sentences.zh: 銅是良好的導電體。

sentences.en: The pipes in our old house are made of copper.
sentences.zh: 我們老房子的水管是銅做的。

sentences.en: Do you know why copper turns green over time?
sentences.zh: 你知道銅為什麼久了會變綠嗎？

sentences.en: She hung copper pots above the kitchen stove.
sentences.zh: 她把銅鍋掛在廚房爐子上方。

sentences.en: Is the copper wire thick enough for this lamp?
sentences.zh: 這條銅線夠粗，可以用在這盞燈上嗎？

sentences.en: The price of copper rose sharply this year.
sentences.zh: 今年銅價大漲。

sentences.en: Don't trip over the cord.
sentences.zh: 小心別被電線絆倒。

sentences.en: Do you have a longer extension cord?
sentences.zh: 你有比較長的延長線嗎？

sentences.en: He tied the box with a strong cord.
sentences.zh: 他用一條結實的細繩把箱子綁好。

sentences.en: The cord on my phone charger is broken.
sentences.zh: 我手機充電器的線壞了。

sentences.en: Can you cut this cord in half for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這條繩子剪成兩半嗎？

sentences.en: She pulled the cord and the blinds went up.
sentences.zh: 她拉了拉繩子，百葉窗就升起來了。

sentences.en: Coronary heart disease is a major cause of death in many countries.
sentences.zh: 冠心病是許多國家的主要死因之一。

sentences.en: The doctor checked my father's coronary arteries.
sentences.zh: 醫生檢查了我爸爸的冠狀動脈。

sentences.en: What are the main risk factors for coronary disease?
sentences.zh: 冠狀動脈疾病的主要風險因子有哪些？

sentences.en: Regular exercise lowers the risk of coronary problems.
sentences.zh: 規律運動能降低冠狀動脈出問題的風險。

sentences.en: Did he have surgery on a coronary artery?
sentences.zh: 他的冠狀動脈有動過手術嗎？

sentences.en: Smoking damages the coronary arteries over time.
sentences.zh: 吸菸會逐漸損害冠狀動脈。

sentences.en: Please make the correction before you send the report.
sentences.zh: 請在寄出報告前先做好修正。

sentences.en: Thanks for the correction; I got the date wrong.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的更正，我把日期弄錯了。

sentences.en: Did the teacher mark any corrections on your essay?
sentences.zh: 老師有在你的作文上標出需要修改的地方嗎？

sentences.en: The newspaper printed a correction the next day.
sentences.zh: 報紙隔天刊登了更正啟事。

sentences.en: Is there a correction I should make to the invoice?
sentences.zh: 請款單上有什麼需要我更正的地方嗎？

sentences.en: A small correction to the schedule saved us an hour.
sentences.zh: 行程表上一個小小的修正替我們省了一小時。

gloss_note: correspond with/to 與…相符；與…通信

sentences.en: Your answer doesn't correspond with the data.
sentences.zh: 你的答案和數據不相符。

sentences.en: Does this name correspond to the one on your passport?
sentences.zh: 這個名字和你護照上的相符嗎？

sentences.en: We corresponded by email for several months.
sentences.zh: 我們用電子郵件通信了好幾個月。

sentences.en: The numbers on the map correspond to the photos.
sentences.zh: 地圖上的數字和照片是對應的。

sentences.en: Do you still correspond with your old teacher?
sentences.zh: 你還有和以前的老師通信嗎？

sentences.en: Each color corresponds to a different bus route.
sentences.zh: 每種顏色對應一條不同的公車路線。

gloss_note: corrupt officials 貪腐官員；常指金錢或權力

sentences.en: Police arrested several corrupt officials in the city.
sentences.zh: 警方逮捕了市內幾名貪腐官員。

sentences.en: Why did the board ignore the corrupt accountant?
sentences.zh: 董事會為什麼對那名貪腐的會計視而不見？

sentences.en: Power can corrupt even honest people.
sentences.zh: 權力可以使連誠實的人也腐化。

sentences.en: Do you think money corrupts people?
sentences.zh: 你覺得金錢會使人墮落嗎？

sentences.en: The film is about a corrupt cop in a small town.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是小鎮上一名貪腐的警察。

sentences.en: A corrupt boss can ruin a good company.
sentences.zh: 貪腐的老闆能毀掉一家好公司。

sentences.en: The store sells cosmetic products from many countries.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售來自許多國家的美妝產品。

sentences.en: Does your clinic offer cosmetic procedures?
sentences.zh: 你們診所有提供美容療程嗎？

sentences.en: We only made a few cosmetic changes to the website.
sentences.zh: 我們只對網站做了幾處表面上的修改。

sentences.en: Is the damage only cosmetic, or is the engine hurt?
sentences.zh: 損傷只是外觀上的，還是引擎也壞了？

sentences.en: She is saving money for cosmetic surgery.
sentences.zh: 她正在存錢準備做整形手術。

sentences.en: Is this cream for cosmetic use or medical use?
sentences.zh: 這款乳霜是美容用還是醫療用？

gloss_note: a lake cottage 湖邊小屋；多為度假或鄉下住所

sentences.en: We rented a cottage by the lake for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們週末租了一間湖邊小屋。

sentences.en: Does the cottage have a fireplace?
sentences.zh: 那間小屋有壁爐嗎？

sentences.en: My grandparents live in a tiny cottage in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母住在鄉下一間小小的鄉間小屋。

sentences.en: The cottage was cold, so we lit a fire.
sentences.zh: 小屋很冷，所以我們生了火。

sentences.en: How far is the cottage from the nearest town?
sentences.zh: 小屋離最近的鎮上有多遠？

sentences.en: She painted the cottage door bright yellow.
sentences.zh: 她把小屋的門漆成亮黃色。

sentences.en: The city council voted on the new park yesterday.
sentences.zh: 市議會昨天針對新公園進行表決。

sentences.en: Who sits on the student council at your school?
sentences.zh: 你們學校的學生會有哪些成員？

sentences.en: The council meets every second Tuesday of the month.
sentences.zh: 理事會每個月第二個週二開會。

sentences.en: Did the council approve the budget for the library?
sentences.zh: 議會有通過圖書館的預算嗎？

sentences.en: I spoke to the town council about the noise.
sentences.zh: 我向鎮議會反映了噪音問題。

sentences.en: She was elected to the city council last fall.
sentences.zh: 她去年秋天當選市議員。

gloss_note: pay at the counter 到櫃檯付款

sentences.en: Please pay at the counter near the door.
sentences.zh: 請到門邊的櫃檯付款。

sentences.en: Leave the dishes on the counter; I'll wash them later.
sentences.zh: 把碗盤放在流理台上，我晚點再洗。

sentences.en: Is your kitchen counter made of marble or wood?
sentences.zh: 你家的流理台是大理石還是木頭做的？

sentences.en: The woman behind the counter smiled and said hello.
sentences.zh: 櫃檯後面的女士微笑著打了招呼。

sentences.en: Could you ask the person at the counter about a refund?
sentences.zh: 你可以去櫃檯問一下退費的事嗎？

sentences.en: I left my receipt on the counter at the bakery.
sentences.zh: 我把收據留在麵包店的櫃檯上了。

gloss_note: a courageous decision 勇敢的決定

sentences.en: It was courageous of her to speak up.
sentences.zh: 她挺身發言真的很勇敢。

sentences.en: The firefighters made a courageous rescue during the storm.
sentences.zh: 消防員在暴風雨中展開了勇敢的救援。

sentences.en: Was it a courageous choice to quit his job?
sentences.zh: 他辭職是個勇敢的決定嗎？

sentences.en: The courageous boy saved his little brother from the water.
sentences.zh: 那個勇敢的男孩把弟弟從水裡救了出來。

sentences.en: What makes a person truly courageous?
sentences.zh: 怎樣才算真正勇敢的人？

sentences.en: Our coach said we were courageous in the final game.
sentences.zh: 教練說我們在決賽中表現得很勇敢。

sentences.en: Thank you for your courtesy during my visit.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您在我拜訪期間的禮遇。

sentences.en: It's common courtesy to say thank you.
sentences.zh: 說聲謝謝是基本的禮貌。

sentences.en: Did the clerk treat you with courtesy?
sentences.zh: 店員有禮貌地對待你嗎？

sentences.en: As a courtesy, we'll call you before the delivery.
sentences.zh: 出於好意，我們會在送貨前先打電話給你。

sentences.en: Why don't people show more courtesy on the road?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家在路上不多一點禮貌？

sentences.en: Showing courtesy to coworkers makes the office a nicer place.
sentences.zh: 對同事以禮相待，會讓辦公室變成更舒服的地方。

gloss_note: 統計與財務用語，衡量兩變數連動程度

sentences.en: The covariance of the two stocks is positive.
sentences.zh: 這兩檔股票的共變異數是正的。

sentences.en: How do you calculate covariance in a spreadsheet?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼在試算表裡算共變異數？

sentences.en: Analysts use covariance to see how two assets move together.
sentences.zh: 分析師用共變異數來看兩種資產如何連動。

sentences.en: A negative covariance means the prices tend to move opposite ways.
sentences.zh: 共變異數為負，表示價格傾向反向變動。

sentences.en: Why is covariance important when building a portfolio?
sentences.zh: 建立投資組合時，共變異數為什麼很重要？

sentences.en: Our professor showed us a covariance matrix in class.
sentences.zh: 教授在課堂上給我們看了一個共變異數矩陣。

gloss_note: loan covenant 貸款條款；常指契約中的限制條件

sentences.en: The loan has a covenant limiting additional debt.
sentences.zh: 這筆貸款有一項限制額外負債的條款。

sentences.en: Did the company break a covenant in its loan agreement?
sentences.zh: 這家公司有違反貸款合約裡的條款嗎？

sentences.en: Lenders often add a covenant that requires regular reports.
sentences.zh: 貸款人常加入要求定期提交報告的條款。

sentences.en: What does this financial covenant mean for our budget?
sentences.zh: 這項財務條款對我們的預算有什麼影響？

sentences.en: The bank waived the covenant after talks with the owner.
sentences.zh: 銀行與業主協商後，免除了這項條款。

sentences.en: The lease contains a covenant against subletting.
sentences.zh: 租約裡有禁止轉租的條款。

gloss_note: 常帶貶意；不要隨便當面說

sentences.en: Don't call him a coward just because he was scared.
sentences.zh: 別只因為他會害怕就說他是懦夫。

sentences.en: Am I a coward for not speaking up?
sentences.zh: 我沒開口發言，算是懦夫嗎？

sentences.en: In the story, the coward runs away at the first sign of danger.
sentences.zh: 故事裡的懦夫一看到危險的跡象就逃跑了。

sentences.en: She felt like a coward after she lied to her friend.
sentences.zh: 她對朋友說謊後，覺得自己像個懦夫。

sentences.en: Why does the movie make the hero look like a coward?
sentences.zh: 這部電影為什麼把英雄演得像個懦夫？

sentences.en: Only a coward would hide behind a fake name online.
sentences.zh: 只有懦夫才會躲在網路假名後面。

gloss_note: 美式拼法 cozy，英式 cosy；形容空間或氣氛

sentences.en: This café is small but really cozy.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡館雖小，卻很溫馨舒適。

sentences.en: Do you want a cozy table by the window?
sentences.zh: 你想要靠窗那個舒適的位子嗎？

sentences.en: We stayed in a cozy cabin during the snowstorm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雪期間我們住在一間溫暖舒適的小木屋。

sentences.en: The soup and warm bread made the night feel cozy.
sentences.zh: 湯和熱麵包讓這個夜晚感覺很溫暖愜意。

sentences.en: Is there a cozy place nearby for brunch?
sentences.zh: 附近有舒服的地方可以吃早午餐嗎？

sentences.en: I love getting cozy on the couch with hot cocoa.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡窩在沙發上喝熱可可。

gloss_note: a crack in 某物上的裂縫；crack 也可作動詞

sentences.en: There's a crack in the bathroom mirror.
sentences.zh: 浴室的鏡子有一道裂痕。

sentences.en: Did your phone screen crack when you dropped it?
sentences.zh: 你的手機螢幕掉到地上有裂開嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, or you'll crack the plate.
sentences.zh: 小心點，不然你會把盤子弄裂。

sentences.en: How did the wall get such a big crack?
sentences.zh: 這面牆的裂縫怎麼這麼大？

sentences.en: Water leaked through a crack in the pipe.
sentences.zh: 水從水管的裂縫漏出來。

sentences.en: The old paint began to crack in the heat.
sentences.zh: 舊油漆在高溫下開始龜裂。

sentences.en: Pottery is a craft that takes years to learn.
sentences.zh: 製陶是一門要學好幾年的手工藝。

sentences.en: Do you sell local crafts at your shop?
sentences.zh: 你們店裡有賣當地的手工藝品嗎？

sentences.en: She taught me the craft of bread making.
sentences.zh: 她教了我製作麵包的技藝。

sentences.en: The town holds a craft fair every fall.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮每年秋天都會舉辦手工藝市集。

sentences.en: Is writing a craft or a natural talent?
sentences.zh: 寫作是一門技藝，還是天生的才能？

sentences.en: My daughter loves making crafts out of old boxes.
sentences.zh: 我女兒喜歡用舊盒子做手工藝品。

gloss_note: crave sth 很想要某樣東西，常指食物

sentences.en: I'm craving something sweet after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我好想吃點甜的。

sentences.en: Do you ever crave pizza at midnight?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有半夜突然很想吃披薩？

sentences.en: Pregnant women sometimes crave strange foods.
sentences.zh: 孕婦有時會特別想吃一些奇怪的食物。

sentences.en: What are you craving for lunch today?
sentences.zh: 你今天午餐想吃什麼？

sentences.en: She craved a hot bowl of noodle soup on the cold day.
sentences.zh: 那天好冷，她好想喝一碗熱湯麵。

sentences.en: Kids crave attention when their parents are busy.
sentences.zh: 爸媽忙的時候，孩子會渴望被關注。

sentences.en: The creation of the new logo took only two days.
sentences.zh: 新標誌的設計只花了兩天。

sentences.en: This painting is my favorite creation so far.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫是我目前最滿意的作品。

sentences.en: Will the new factory lead to the creation of jobs?
sentences.zh: 新工廠會帶來就業機會嗎？

sentences.en: The chef's newest creation is a spicy peach pie.
sentences.zh: 主廚最新的創作是辣味水蜜桃派。

sentences.en: How long did the creation of the website take?
sentences.zh: 製作這個網站花了多久？

sentences.en: She is proud of her creation, a tiny robot.
sentences.zh: 她對自己的作品，一個小機器人，感到驕傲。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: show creativity 展現創意；不可數名詞

sentences.en: Her creativity helped us solve the problem fast.
sentences.zh: 她的創意幫我們很快解決了問題。

sentences.en: How do you keep your creativity alive at work?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼在工作中保持創意？

sentences.en: This job gives me plenty of room for creativity.
sentences.zh: 這份工作給我很大的創意空間。

sentences.en: Does too much screen time hurt a child's creativity?
sentences.zh: 看螢幕太久會傷害孩子的創造力嗎？

sentences.en: The ad campaign shows real creativity.
sentences.zh: 這個廣告活動展現了真正的創意。

sentences.en: Teachers should encourage creativity in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 老師應該在課堂上鼓勵創造力。

gloss_note: creep up 慢慢上升；過去式 crept

sentences.en: I crept down the stairs so I wouldn't wake anyone.
sentences.zh: 我躡手躡腳地下樓，免得吵醒別人。

sentences.en: Did something just creep across the floor?
sentences.zh: 剛剛是不是有東西爬過地板？

sentences.en: Traffic crept along the highway in the rain.
sentences.zh: 下雨天，車流在高速公路上緩緩移動。

sentences.en: The cat crept toward the bird.
sentences.zh: 貓悄悄地靠近那隻鳥。

sentences.en: Why do prices keep creeping up every year?
sentences.zh: 為什麼物價每年都一直慢慢上漲？

sentences.en: Vines were creeping up the old wall.
sentences.zh: 藤蔓正沿著舊牆往上爬。

sentences.en: The film critic gave the movie four stars.
sentences.zh: 這位影評人給了這部電影四顆星。

sentences.en: Did the food critic like the new restaurant?
sentences.zh: 美食評論家喜歡這家新餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: Critics say the plan costs too much.
sentences.zh: 批評者說這項計畫花費太高。

sentences.en: She's her own harshest critic.
sentences.zh: 她對自己最嚴苛。

sentences.en: Do critics usually agree with the audience?
sentences.zh: 評論家通常和觀眾的看法一致嗎？

sentences.en: The art critic praised the young painter's style.
sentences.zh: 藝評家稱讚這位年輕畫家的風格。

gloss_note: critical of 批評；critical to 關鍵

sentences.en: It is critical that we finish before Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們一定要在週五前完成，這很關鍵。

sentences.en: Why is he always so critical of my cooking?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼老是批評我煮的菜？

sentences.en: The review was very critical of the new phone.
sentences.zh: 這篇評論對新手機的批評很嚴厲。

sentences.en: Is this step critical to the whole process?
sentences.zh: 這個步驟對整個流程很關鍵嗎？

sentences.en: Teamwork is critical in a busy restaurant kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在忙碌的餐廳廚房裡，團隊合作很關鍵。

sentences.en: Don't be so critical of yourself.
sentences.zh: 別對自己那麼苛責。

sentences.en: How do you take criticism from your boss?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼面對老闆的批評？

sentences.en: Her criticism was fair, but it still hurt.
sentences.zh: 她的批評很公平，但還是讓人難過。

sentences.en: The company faced heavy criticism for its slow response.
sentences.zh: 這家公司因反應遲緩而遭受嚴厲批評。

sentences.en: Constructive criticism can help you improve.
sentences.zh: 建設性的批評能幫你進步。

sentences.en: Is the criticism of the film fair?
sentences.zh: 大家對這部電影的批評公平嗎？

sentences.en: I welcome criticism as long as it's polite.
sentences.zh: 只要有禮貌，我歡迎批評。

gloss_note: criticize sb for sth 因…批評

sentences.en: Please don't criticize me in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 請不要在大家面前批評我。

sentences.en: Why do people criticize others so quickly online?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家在網路上這麼快就批評別人？

sentences.en: The coach criticized the team for being late.
sentences.zh: 教練批評球隊遲到。

sentences.en: He criticized the report for missing key facts.
sentences.zh: 他批評那份報告漏掉了重要事實。

sentences.en: Is it fair to criticize a beginner?
sentences.zh: 批評一個初學者公平嗎？

sentences.en: My mom never criticizes my cooking.
sentences.zh: 我媽從來不批評我煮的菜。

gloss_note: crude oil 原油；crude 作形容詞指粗糙、粗俗

sentences.en: Crude oil prices fell for the third week in a row.
sentences.zh: 原油價格連續第三週下跌。

sentences.en: How much crude oil does the country import?
sentences.zh: 這個國家進口多少原油？

sentences.en: The refinery turns crude oil into gasoline.
sentences.zh: 煉油廠把原油加工成汽油。

sentences.en: His first design was crude, but the idea was good.
sentences.zh: 他最初的設計很粗糙，但點子不錯。

sentences.en: Is this crude sketch all you have for the pitch?
sentences.zh: 你的提案就只有這張粗略的草圖嗎？

sentences.en: Airlines get nervous when crude prices jump suddenly.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在原油價格突然飆漲時會很緊張。

gloss_note: cruelty to animals 虐待動物

sentences.en: I was shocked by the cruelty of his joke.
sentences.zh: 他那個玩笑的殘酷讓我很震驚。

sentences.en: Is cruelty to animals illegal in your state?
sentences.zh: 在你們那一州，虐待動物違法嗎？

sentences.en: The book teaches kids that cruelty is never funny.
sentences.zh: 這本書告訴孩子：殘忍一點也不好笑。

sentences.en: Why do some bullies enjoy cruelty?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些霸凌者以殘忍為樂？

sentences.en: Teachers must report cruelty to children right away.
sentences.zh: 老師必須立刻通報對孩童的虐待行為。

sentences.en: She could not understand the cruelty of his words.
sentences.zh: 她無法理解他的話為何這麼殘酷。

sentences.en: The company is facing a cash crunch this quarter.
sentences.zh: 公司這一季資金吃緊。

sentences.en: Are you in a time crunch before the deadline?
sentences.zh: 截止日前你的時間很緊迫嗎？

sentences.en: A credit crunch made it hard to get a loan.
sentences.zh: 信貸緊縮讓人很難貸到款。

sentences.en: Because of the budget crunch, we can't hire anyone.
sentences.zh: 因為預算吃緊，我們沒辦法再請人。

sentences.en: What can we do about the staffing crunch in December?
sentences.zh: 我們能怎麼解決十二月的人手吃緊問題？

sentences.en: Many small shops feel the crunch when rent goes up.
sentences.zh: 租金上漲時，許多小店都會感到吃緊。

gloss_note: 形容食物咬起來脆；crispy 偏薄脆

sentences.en: I like my toast warm and crunchy.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡吐司熱熱脆脆的。

sentences.en: Are these carrots fresh and crunchy?
sentences.zh: 這些紅蘿蔔新鮮又脆嗎？

sentences.en: The fried chicken has a crunchy crust.
sentences.zh: 這炸雞有酥脆的外皮。

sentences.en: Do you prefer crunchy apples or soft ones?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡脆的蘋果還是軟的？

sentences.en: The salad needs something crunchy, like nuts.
sentences.zh: 這道沙拉需要一點脆脆的東西，像是堅果。

sentences.en: Dry leaves felt crunchy under our feet.
sentences.zh: 乾枯的落葉踩起來脆脆的。

gloss_note: have a crush on sb 暗戀某人

sentences.en: Crush the garlic with the side of your knife.
sentences.zh: 用刀面把大蒜壓碎。

sentences.en: Don't stack heavy books on top or they'll crush the box.
sentences.zh: 別把重書疊在上面，不然會把盒子壓壞。

sentences.en: Did you crush the crackers for the pie crust?
sentences.zh: 你有把餅乾壓碎來做派皮嗎？

sentences.en: I had a crush on a classmate in high school.
sentences.zh: 高中時我暗戀過一個同學。

sentences.en: Does she have a crush on Jake?
sentences.zh: 她是不是暗戀傑克？

sentences.en: Everyone knew he had a crush on her.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道他暗戀她。

sentences.en: Salt forms crystals when the water dries up.
sentences.zh: 水分蒸發後，鹽會形成結晶。

sentences.en: Scientists studied the crystal under a microscope.
sentences.zh: 科學家用顯微鏡觀察那顆晶體。

sentences.en: Is this glass vase made of real crystal?
sentences.zh: 這個玻璃花瓶是真的水晶做的嗎？

sentences.en: How do ice crystals form inside clouds?
sentences.zh: 冰晶是怎麼在雲裡形成的？

sentences.en: Sugar crystals slowly dissolved in the hot tea.
sentences.zh: 糖的結晶慢慢在熱茶裡溶化了。

sentences.en: The crystal glasses sparkled on the dining table.
sentences.zh: 水晶杯在餐桌上閃閃發亮。

gloss_note: ice cube 冰塊；the cube of 2 指三次方

sentences.en: Add two ice cubes to my drink, please.
sentences.zh: 請在我的飲料裡加兩顆冰塊。

sentences.en: A cube has six equal faces.
sentences.zh: 立方體有六個相等的面。

sentences.en: What is the volume of a cube with sides of three inches?
sentences.zh: 邊長三英寸的立方體，體積是多少？

sentences.en: Can you cut the potatoes into small cubes?
sentences.zh: 你可以把馬鈴薯切成小方塊嗎？

sentences.en: The cube of two is eight.
sentences.zh: 二的立方是八。

sentences.en: My classmate can solve a puzzle cube in one minute.
sentences.zh: 我同學一分鐘就能解開益智方塊。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: I took that as my cue to leave.
sentences.zh: 我把那當成該離開的暗示。

sentences.en: Did you miss your cue on stage?
sentences.zh: 你在舞台上有錯過出場的提示嗎？

sentences.en: The actor waited for his cue behind the curtain.
sentences.zh: 演員在布幕後面等他的出場提示。

sentences.en: She gave me a cue when it was time to speak.
sentences.zh: 輪到我發言時，她給了我一個暗示。

sentences.en: Do babies learn language from visual cues?
sentences.zh: 寶寶是從視覺線索學會語言的嗎？

sentences.en: The red light is the cue for everyone to stop.
sentences.zh: 紅燈是要大家停下來的信號。

gloss_note: cunning plan 巧妙的計畫；常帶貶意

sentences.en: The fox in the story is very cunning.
sentences.zh: 故事裡的狐狸非常狡猾。

sentences.en: Is the new manager as cunning as people say?
sentences.zh: 新經理真的像大家說的那麼精明狡詐嗎？

sentences.en: He used a cunning trick to win the game.
sentences.zh: 他用一招狡猾的小把戲贏了比賽。

sentences.en: The cat is cunning enough to open the door.
sentences.zh: 這隻貓機靈到會自己開門。

sentences.en: What a cunning way to hide the surprise party!
sentences.zh: 用這種方式藏住驚喜派對，真是機靈！

sentences.en: Did the cunning thief fool everyone in the shop?
sentences.zh: 那個狡猾的小偷騙過店裡所有人了嗎？

gloss_note: out of curiosity 出於好奇

sentences.en: Curiosity got the better of me, so I looked.
sentences.zh: 我敵不過好奇心，所以看了一眼。

sentences.en: Do you have any curiosity about other cultures?
sentences.zh: 你對其他文化有好奇心嗎？

sentences.en: Kids ask questions because of natural curiosity.
sentences.zh: 孩子問問題是出於天生的好奇。

sentences.en: Out of curiosity, how much did the car cost?
sentences.zh: 出於好奇，那輛車多少錢？

sentences.en: Teachers should feed students' curiosity instead of killing it.
sentences.zh: 老師應該滿足學生的好奇心，而不是扼殺它。

sentences.en: The strange box aroused her curiosity.
sentences.zh: 那個奇怪的盒子勾起了她的好奇心。

gloss_note: curl up 蜷縮；curls 指一綹綹捲髮

sentences.en: She has long, dark curls.
sentences.zh: 她有一頭又長又黑的捲髮。

sentences.en: Do you curl your hair every morning?
sentences.zh: 你每天早上都會捲頭髮嗎？

sentences.en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 貓蜷縮在沙發上睡著了。

sentences.en: Smoke began to curl from the chimney.
sentences.zh: 煙開始從煙囪裊裊升起。

sentences.en: How do you get your hair to curl so nicely?
sentences.zh: 你的頭髮怎麼捲得這麼漂亮？

sentences.en: The edges of the old photo had started to curl.
sentences.zh: 那張舊照片的邊角已經開始捲曲了。

sentences.en: The school updated its curriculum this year.
sentences.zh: 這所學校今年更新了課程。

sentences.en: Does the curriculum include a lab course?
sentences.zh: 這份課程裡有實驗課嗎？

sentences.en: Teachers helped design the new math curriculum.
sentences.zh: 老師們協助設計了新的數學課程。

sentences.en: What subjects are in the school curriculum?
sentences.zh: 學校課程裡有哪些科目？

sentences.en: Art should be part of every school curriculum.
sentences.zh: 藝術應該是每個學校課程的一部分。

sentences.en: Our curriculum is too crowded to add anything new.
sentences.zh: 我們的課程太滿，沒辦法再加新東西。

gloss_note: chicken curry 咖哩雞；常配白飯

sentences.en: Do you want your curry mild or spicy?
sentences.zh: 你的咖哩要點小辣還是大辣？

sentences.en: My mom makes a great chicken curry on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽每個星期天都會煮很好吃的咖哩雞。

sentences.en: What kind of curry does this place serve?
sentences.zh: 這家店賣哪一種咖哩？

sentences.en: I spilled curry on my white shirt at lunch.
sentences.zh: 我午餐時把咖哩灑到白襯衫上了。

sentences.en: The curry needs more salt and a little lemon juice.
sentences.zh: 這鍋咖哩需要再加點鹽和一些檸檬汁。

sentences.en: We ordered curry with rice and some warm bread.
sentences.zh: 我們點了咖哩配飯和一些溫熱的麵包。

gloss_note: curse at sb 對某人咒罵

sentences.en: Do you believe an old curse can follow a family?
sentences.zh: 你相信古老的詛咒會纏著一個家族嗎？

sentences.en: In the story, a witch put a curse on the village.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一個女巫對村莊下了詛咒。

sentences.en: Dad cursed under his breath when the car wouldn't start.
sentences.zh: 車子發不動時，爸爸低聲咒罵了幾句。

sentences.en: Why did the driver curse at everyone on the road?
sentences.zh: 那位駕駛為什麼對路上的每個人咒罵？

sentences.en: The teacher told us never to curse at classmates.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們絕對不要咒罵同學。

sentences.en: The movie is about a prince who breaks an ancient curse.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一位王子打破古老詛咒的故事。

sentences.en: Can you pass me that cushion from the couch?
sentences.zh: 你可以把沙發上那個靠墊遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: My office chair needs a cushion to support my back.
sentences.zh: 我的辦公椅需要一個軟墊來支撐背部。

sentences.en: The dog fell asleep on a cushion by the window.
sentences.zh: 小狗在窗邊的軟墊上睡著了。

sentences.en: How much does a cushion like this cost?
sentences.zh: 像這樣的軟墊要多少錢？

sentences.en: The hotel put a small cushion on every bed.
sentences.zh: 飯店在每張床上都放了一個小靠墊。

sentences.en: The yoga teacher asked us to bring a cushion to class.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽老師請我們帶一個軟墊來上課。

gloss_note: customize an order 客製化訂單

sentences.en: Can we customize the report for each client?
sentences.zh: 我們可以為每位客戶客製化這份報告嗎？

sentences.en: You can add cheese to customize your sandwich.
sentences.zh: 你可以加起司，把三明治客製成自己喜歡的口味。

sentences.en: This app lets you customize your home screen.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式可以讓你自訂主畫面。

sentences.en: How long does it take to customize a desk?
sentences.zh: 訂製一張書桌要花多久時間？

sentences.en: We customized the packaging for our biggest customer.
sentences.zh: 我們為最大的客戶客製了包裝。

sentences.en: Will the company customize the training for new hires?
sentences.zh: 公司會為新進員工客製化訓練課程嗎？

gloss_note: cyclical industry 景氣循環產業

sentences.en: Is the travel business as cyclical as people say?
sentences.zh: 旅遊業真的像大家說的那麼具週期性嗎？

sentences.en: Housing is a cyclical industry with good and bad years.
sentences.zh: 房地產是個有週期性的產業，有好年也有壞年。

sentences.en: Our sales are cyclical, with a peak every December.
sentences.zh: 我們的銷售有週期性，每年十二月都會達到高峰。

sentences.en: Analysts expect cyclical stocks to recover next year.
sentences.zh: 分析師預期景氣循環股明年會回升。

sentences.en: How do you plan for a cyclical market?
sentences.zh: 面對週期性的市場，你們怎麼規劃？

sentences.en: The slowdown looks cyclical rather than permanent.
sentences.zh: 這次的放緩看起來是週期性的，並非長期現象。

sentences.en: A can is shaped like a cylinder.
sentences.zh: 罐頭的形狀像一個圓柱。

sentences.en: How do you find the volume of a cylinder?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼求圓柱的體積？

sentences.en: The students filled a glass cylinder with water.
sentences.zh: 學生們在玻璃圓筒裡裝滿了水。

sentences.en: The architect designed a tall tower shaped like a cylinder.
sentences.zh: 建築師設計了一棟圓柱形的高塔。

sentences.en: This vase is a perfect cylinder, plain and tall.
sentences.zh: 這個花瓶是完美的圓柱形，簡單又高挑。

sentences.en: Can you roll the paper into a cylinder for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把紙捲成圓筒嗎？

gloss_note: damp towel 微濕的毛巾；比 wet 輕

sentences.en: The basement smells damp after all the rain.
sentences.zh: 下了這麼多雨，地下室聞起來很潮濕。

sentences.en: Why is my towel still damp?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的毛巾還是濕濕的？

sentences.en: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
sentences.zh: 用微濕的布擦桌子。

sentences.en: Don't put damp clothes in the drawer.
sentences.zh: 不要把潮濕的衣服放進抽屜裡。

sentences.en: Is the ground too damp for a picnic?
sentences.zh: 地面會不會太潮濕，不適合野餐？

sentences.en: The damp weather made mold grow on the walls.
sentences.zh: 潮濕的天氣讓牆壁發霉了。

gloss_note: car dealership 汽車展售中心

sentences.en: I'm taking my car to the dealership for service.
sentences.zh: 我要把車開去經銷商那裡做保養。

sentences.en: Does the dealership offer a free test drive?
sentences.zh: 這家經銷商有提供免費試駕嗎？

sentences.en: She works at a local dealership as a sales manager.
sentences.zh: 她在當地一家經銷商擔任業務經理。

sentences.en: The dealership stays open until eight on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 這家經銷商每週五營業到八點。

sentences.en: How far is the nearest dealership from here?
sentences.zh: 離這裡最近的經銷商有多遠？

sentences.en: The dealership called to say my new truck arrived.
sentences.zh: 經銷商打電話來說我訂的新卡車到了。

gloss_note: convertible debenture 可轉換公司債

sentences.en: The company issued a debenture to raise cash.
sentences.zh: 公司發行了一檔無擔保公司債來籌措資金。

sentences.en: What interest rate does the debenture pay?
sentences.zh: 這檔無擔保公司債的利率是多少？

sentences.en: A debenture is not backed by any specific property.
sentences.zh: 無擔保公司債沒有任何特定資產作擔保。

sentences.en: Our broker recommended a five-year debenture.
sentences.zh: 我們的經紀人推薦了一檔五年期的公司債。

sentences.en: Did investors buy the debenture at par?
sentences.zh: 投資人是以面額買進這檔公司債的嗎？

sentences.en: The debenture matures in 2032, and investors get their money back.
sentences.zh: 這檔公司債在2032年到期，投資人屆時可以拿回本金。

gloss_note: tooth decay 蛀牙；腐敗、衰敗

sentences.en: Fallen leaves decay and feed the soil.
sentences.zh: 落葉腐爛後會滋養土壤。

sentences.en: Why do some fruits decay faster than others?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些水果比其他水果腐爛得更快？

sentences.en: Sugary snacks can cause teeth to decay.
sentences.zh: 含糖零食可能讓牙齒蛀掉。

sentences.en: Can the city stop the decay of its old downtown?
sentences.zh: 這座城市能阻止舊市區的衰敗嗎？

sentences.en: The report describes the slow decay of rural villages.
sentences.zh: 這份報告描述了鄉村緩慢衰退的過程。

sentences.en: Wood left in the rain will start to decay.
sentences.zh: 木頭放在雨中就會開始腐爛。

sentences.en: The job offers a decent salary and good benefits.
sentences.zh: 這份工作薪水還不錯，福利也好。

sentences.en: Can we find a decent hotel near the airport?
sentences.zh: 我們能在機場附近找到一間像樣的飯店嗎？

sentences.en: Her presentation was decent, but it needed more data.
sentences.zh: 她的簡報還不錯，但需要更多數據。

sentences.en: Is this a decent price for a used laptop?
sentences.zh: 二手筆電這個價格算合理嗎？

sentences.en: We need a decent plan before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會前，我們需要一個像樣的計畫。

sentences.en: I finally got a decent night's sleep.
sentences.zh: 我終於好好睡了一覺。

sentences.en: Did you fill out the customs declaration form?
sentences.zh: 你填好海關申報單了嗎？

sentences.en: The company issued a declaration about the product recall.
sentences.zh: 公司針對產品回收發表了聲明。

sentences.en: Where do I hand in this declaration?
sentences.zh: 這份申報書要交到哪裡？

sentences.en: Every applicant must sign a declaration that the information is true.
sentences.zh: 每位申請人都必須簽署聲明，保證資料屬實。

sentences.en: Please sign the declaration at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 請在頁面底部的聲明書上簽名。

sentences.en: A false declaration at the border can lead to a fine.
sentences.zh: 在邊境做不實申報可能會被罰款。

sentences.en: We put up holiday decorations last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末布置了節慶裝飾。

sentences.en: What kind of decoration do you want on the cake?
sentences.zh: 你想在蛋糕上放什麼樣的裝飾？

sentences.en: The restaurant's decorations are simple but warm.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的裝飾簡單卻溫馨。

sentences.en: Students made paper decorations for the party.
sentences.zh: 學生們為派對做了紙製裝飾。

sentences.en: Where can I buy cheap decorations for the office?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以買到便宜的辦公室裝飾品？

sentences.en: The decoration of the hall took three days to finish.
sentences.zh: 禮堂的布置花了三天才完成。

gloss_note: show dedication to 對…全心投入

sentences.en: Thank you for your dedication to this project.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你對這個專案的付出。

sentences.en: Her dedication to the team impressed everyone.
sentences.zh: 她對團隊的投入讓每個人都印象深刻。

sentences.en: Does this job require a lot of dedication?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要很多投入嗎？

sentences.en: Years of dedication helped him become a top nurse.
sentences.zh: 多年的投入讓他成為頂尖的護理師。

sentences.en: How can I show my dedication to the company?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼表現出我對公司的付出？

sentences.en: The award recognizes her dedication to teaching.
sentences.zh: 這個獎項表彰她對教學的奉獻。

gloss_note: meet your deductible 付滿自付額

sentences.en: What is the deductible on my car insurance?
sentences.zh: 我的汽車保險自付額是多少？

sentences.en: Our health plan has a thousand-dollar deductible.
sentences.zh: 我們的醫療保險方案有一千美元的自付額。

sentences.en: I paid the deductible before the insurance covered anything.
sentences.zh: 我先付了自付額，保險才開始理賠。

sentences.en: A higher deductible usually means a lower monthly premium.
sentences.zh: 自付額越高，每月保費通常越低。

sentences.en: Will I have to pay a deductible for this repair?
sentences.zh: 這次維修我需要付自付額嗎？

sentences.en: Have you met your deductible for this year yet?
sentences.zh: 你今年的自付額已經付滿了嗎？

gloss_note: defeat an opponent 擊敗對手

sentences.en: Our team hopes to defeat the champions tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們隊希望今晚能擊敗冠軍隊。

sentences.en: How did she defeat the best chess players in town?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼擊敗鎮上最強的棋手的？

sentences.en: The loss was a bitter defeat for the school.
sentences.zh: 這場輸球對學校來說是慘痛的失敗。

sentences.en: Don't let one defeat discourage you.
sentences.zh: 別讓一次失敗打擊你。

sentences.en: Can a small company defeat a giant rival?
sentences.zh: 小公司能擊敗龐大的對手嗎？

sentences.en: The army suffered a major defeat in 1815.
sentences.zh: 這支軍隊在1815年遭遇了一次重大的失敗。

sentences.en: The goalkeeper must defend the net all game.
sentences.zh: 守門員整場比賽都必須守住球門。

sentences.en: How will you defend your idea at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你會在會議上如何為你的想法辯護？

sentences.en: Lawyers defend their clients in court.
sentences.zh: 律師在法庭上為當事人辯護。

sentences.en: Why did the coach defend his decision to the reporters?
sentences.zh: 教練為什麼要向記者為他的決定辯護？

sentences.en: Soldiers once defended this castle for months.
sentences.zh: 士兵們曾經守衛這座城堡長達數月。

sentences.en: I'll always defend my friends when they're wrongly blamed.
sentences.zh: 朋友被冤枉時，我一定會替他們辯護。

sentences.en: Our defense played great in the second half.
sentences.zh: 我們的防守在下半場表現很棒。

sentences.en: Is a firewall enough defense against online attacks?
sentences.zh: 防火牆足以防禦網路攻擊嗎？

sentences.en: Washing your hands is a simple defense against colds.
sentences.zh: 洗手是預防感冒的簡單防禦方式。

sentences.en: Who plays defense on your school team?
sentences.zh: 你們學校隊上誰負責防守？

sentences.en: A tall fence was the farm's only defense against deer.
sentences.zh: 一道高圍籬是農場唯一用來擋住鹿群的防禦。

sentences.en: The coach spent the whole week working on defense.
sentences.zh: 教練整個星期都在練習防守。

gloss_note: a defensible position 站得住腳的立場

sentences.en: Is your decision defensible if someone challenges it?
sentences.zh: 如果有人質疑，你的決定站得住腳嗎？

sentences.en: The manager's explanation sounded perfectly defensible.
sentences.zh: 經理的解釋聽起來完全站得住腳。

sentences.en: That price increase is defensible given higher costs.
sentences.zh: 考慮到成本上升，這次漲價是站得住腳的。

sentences.en: We need a defensible reason for missing the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一個站得住腳的理由來解釋為何錯過期限。

sentences.en: Do you think his argument is defensible?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他的論點站得住腳嗎？

sentences.en: The judge said the policy was legally defensible.
sentences.zh: 法官說這項政策在法律上站得住腳。

gloss_note: get defensive 變得有防衛心

sentences.en: Why are you so defensive about my question?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對我的問題這麼有防衛心？

sentences.en: Our team played a defensive game today.
sentences.zh: 我們隊今天打了一場防守型的比賽。

sentences.en: Don't get defensive; I'm only offering advice.
sentences.zh: 別這麼有防衛心，我只是在給建議。

sentences.en: Defensive driving can help you avoid accidents.
sentences.zh: 防禦性駕駛能幫你避免事故。

sentences.en: He became defensive when the boss asked about the mistake.
sentences.zh: 老闆問起那個錯誤時，他變得很有防衛心。

sentences.en: Is a defensive strategy smarter in a weak market?
sentences.zh: 在疲軟的市場中，採取防禦性策略比較聰明嗎？

sentences.en: A vitamin D deficiency can make you feel tired.
sentences.zh: 缺乏維他命D可能讓人覺得疲倦。

sentences.en: How do doctors test for iron deficiency?
sentences.zh: 醫生如何檢測缺鐵？

sentences.en: The study found a protein deficiency in many young children.
sentences.zh: 研究發現許多幼童有蛋白質缺乏的問題。

sentences.en: Does a calcium deficiency affect bone health?
sentences.zh: 缺鈣會影響骨骼健康嗎？

sentences.en: Eating more greens may fix a mild deficiency.
sentences.zh: 多吃蔬菜或許能改善輕微的缺乏。

sentences.en: Sleep deficiency hurts how well students learn.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足會影響學生的學習效果。

sentences.en: Deflation means prices keep falling over time.
sentences.zh: 通貨緊縮代表物價長期持續下跌。

sentences.en: Why do economists worry about deflation?
sentences.zh: 經濟學家為什麼擔心通貨緊縮？

sentences.en: The country has struggled with deflation for years.
sentences.zh: 這個國家多年來一直深受通貨緊縮所苦。

sentences.en: Can deflation hurt small businesses?
sentences.zh: 通貨緊縮會傷害小型企業嗎？

sentences.en: During deflation, shoppers often wait for lower prices.
sentences.zh: 通貨緊縮期間，消費者常會等待更低的價格。

sentences.en: Our boss explained how deflation could affect next year's budget.
sentences.zh: 老闆說明了通貨緊縮可能會怎麼影響明年的預算。

gloss_note: delegation of work 工作授權

sentences.en: A delegation from Japan will visit our factory.
sentences.zh: 一個來自日本的代表團將參訪我們的工廠。

sentences.en: Who will lead the delegation to the trade show?
sentences.zh: 誰會帶領代表團去參加貿易展？

sentences.en: The delegation arrived at the airport this morning.
sentences.zh: 代表團今天早上抵達機場。

sentences.en: Good managers are skilled at delegation.
sentences.zh: 好的主管擅長授權。

sentences.en: Is delegation hard for you when you're busy?
sentences.zh: 忙的時候，要放手授權對你來說很難嗎？

sentences.en: Delegation saves time when the team is overloaded.
sentences.zh: 團隊負荷過重時，授權能節省時間。

gloss_note: 美式熟食店賣三明治、冷盤

sentences.en: I'll grab a sandwich from the deli downstairs.
sentences.zh: 我去樓下的熟食店買個三明治。

sentences.en: Does the deli open early on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店星期天會早點開門嗎？

sentences.en: This deli makes the best turkey sandwich in town.
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店做的火雞肉三明治是全城最好吃的。

sentences.en: Can you pick up some sliced ham at the deli?
sentences.zh: 你可以去熟食店買些火腿片嗎？

sentences.en: The deli counter at the supermarket sells fresh salads.
sentences.zh: 超市的熟食櫃檯賣新鮮的沙拉。

sentences.en: We ate dinner at a small deli near the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我們在飯店附近的一家小熟食店吃了晚餐。

gloss_note: do sth deliberately 故意做某事

sentences.en: Did he deliberately delete the file?
sentences.zh: 他是故意刪掉那個檔案的嗎？

sentences.en: The company deliberately kept the price low.
sentences.zh: 公司刻意把價格維持在低檔。

sentences.en: She deliberately arrived early to meet the client.
sentences.zh: 她刻意提早到，好和客戶碰面。

sentences.en: I didn't deliberately ignore your email.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意不回你的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Why would anyone deliberately break the rules?
sentences.zh: 為什麼會有人故意違反規定？

sentences.en: The writer deliberately left the ending unclear.
sentences.zh: 作者刻意把結局寫得模糊不清。

sentences.en: Be careful; these glasses are very delicate.
sentences.zh: 小心，這些玻璃杯非常脆弱。

sentences.en: The baby's skin is soft and delicate.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒的皮膚柔軟又脆弱。

sentences.en: Do you have a detergent for delicate fabrics?
sentences.zh: 你們有適合洗細緻衣物的洗衣精嗎？

sentences.en: She painted delicate flowers on the teacups.
sentences.zh: 她在茶杯上畫了精緻的花朵。

sentences.en: Is this lace too delicate to wash by machine?
sentences.zh: 這種蕾絲是不是太脆弱，不能用洗衣機洗？

sentences.en: The soup has a delicate flavor, not too strong.
sentences.zh: 這道湯的味道細緻，不會太重。

gloss_note: to my delight 令我高興的是

sentences.en: The children squealed with delight at the gift.
sentences.zh: 孩子們收到禮物，開心得尖叫起來。

sentences.en: Did the gift delight your kids?
sentences.zh: 那份禮物讓你的孩子們很開心嗎？

sentences.en: Her speech will delight the whole audience.
sentences.zh: 她的演講會讓全場觀眾都很開心。

sentences.en: To my delight, the train arrived on time.
sentences.zh: 令我高興的是，火車準時到站。

sentences.en: What delights you most about living here?
sentences.zh: 住在這裡最讓你開心的是什麼？

sentences.en: The chef's dessert was a delight to taste.
sentences.zh: 主廚的甜點吃起來是一種享受。

sentences.en: We had a delightful dinner at my aunt's house.
sentences.zh: 我們在阿姨家吃了一頓很愉快的晚餐。

sentences.en: Is the weather always this delightful in May?
sentences.zh: 五月的天氣一向這麼宜人嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel has a delightful garden by the pool.
sentences.zh: 飯店在泳池旁有座迷人的花園。

sentences.en: What a delightful surprise to see you here!
sentences.zh: 在這裡見到你，真是個愉快的驚喜！

sentences.en: Was the concert as delightful as you expected?
sentences.zh: 這場音樂會有像你預期的那麼精彩愉快嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher found the story delightful and funny.
sentences.zh: 老師覺得這個故事既迷人又有趣。

gloss_note: project deliverable 專案交付項目

sentences.en: What are the deliverables for this project?
sentences.zh: 這個專案要交付哪些成果？

sentences.en: The first deliverable is due on Friday.
sentences.zh: 第一項交付成果星期五到期。

sentences.en: Can we agree on the deliverables before we start?
sentences.zh: 我們開工前可以先談定交付項目嗎？

sentences.en: Our client rejected the final deliverable.
sentences.zh: 我們的客戶退回了最終的交付成果。

sentences.en: Each deliverable needs a manager's signature.
sentences.zh: 每項交付成果都需要主管簽名。

sentences.en: Please list every deliverable in the contract.
sentences.zh: 請把合約裡的每個交付項目都列出來。

sentences.en: Customers demand fast service at lunchtime.
sentences.zh: 午餐時段，顧客都要求快速的服務。

sentences.en: Is there much demand for this phone?
sentences.zh: 這支手機的需求量大嗎？

sentences.en: The tenants demand that the landlord fix the heater.
sentences.zh: 房客要求房東修好暖氣。

sentences.en: Demand for electric cars keeps growing.
sentences.zh: 電動車的需求持續成長。

sentences.en: What do you demand from a good manager?
sentences.zh: 你對好主管有什麼要求？

sentences.en: The store ordered more bread because demand was high.
sentences.zh: 因為需求量大，店家多訂了一些麵包。

gloss_note: demonstrate how to… 示範如何…

sentences.en: Could you demonstrate how this machine works?
sentences.zh: 你可以示範這台機器怎麼運作嗎？

sentences.en: The salesperson demonstrated the vacuum cleaner.
sentences.zh: 業務員示範了吸塵器的使用方式。

sentences.en: This experiment demonstrates that plants need light.
sentences.zh: 這個實驗證明了植物需要光線。

sentences.en: Can you demonstrate that your product saves time?
sentences.zh: 你能證明你們的產品能節省時間嗎？

sentences.en: Let me demonstrate the new app on my phone.
sentences.zh: 讓我在手機上示範這個新的應用程式。

sentences.en: Her grades demonstrate how hard she has worked.
sentences.zh: 她的成績顯示出她有多努力。

sentences.en: The chef gave a cooking demonstration yesterday.
sentences.zh: 主廚昨天做了一場料理示範。

sentences.en: Would you like a demonstration of the new printer?
sentences.zh: 你想看看新印表機的示範嗎？

sentences.en: Can I see a quick demonstration before I buy it?
sentences.zh: 買之前，我可以先看一下簡單的示範嗎？

sentences.en: The science teacher's demonstration amazed the students.
sentences.zh: 自然科老師的實驗展示讓學生們驚嘆不已。

sentences.en: A live demonstration is better than a long speech.
sentences.zh: 現場示範比冗長的演講更有效。

sentences.en: She watched the demonstration and then tried it herself.
sentences.zh: 她看完示範後，自己也試了一次。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. TheDaveRoss assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: denounce sb as… 指責某人是…

sentences.en: Many experts denounce the new advertising practice.
sentences.zh: 許多專家公開譴責這種新的廣告手法。

sentences.en: Why did the company denounce its former partner?
sentences.zh: 這家公司為什麼公開指責前合作夥伴？

sentences.en: Investors denounced the plan as careless.
sentences.zh: 投資人批評這項計畫太草率。

sentences.en: Will the board publicly denounce the false claims?
sentences.zh: 董事會會公開譴責這些不實的說法嗎？

sentences.en: The newspaper denounced the factory for dumping waste.
sentences.zh: 報紙譴責這間工廠傾倒廢棄物。

sentences.en: Leaders should denounce cheating in business.
sentences.zh: 領導者應該公開譴責商場上的欺騙行為。

gloss_note: dense fog 濃霧；人口稠密

sentences.en: A dense fog covered the highway this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上濃霧籠罩了公路。

sentences.en: Is the forest too dense to walk through?
sentences.zh: 這座森林是不是太茂密，無法穿越？

sentences.en: This city has a very dense population.
sentences.zh: 這座城市人口非常稠密。

sentences.en: The dense crowd made it hard to find my friends.
sentences.zh: 擁擠的人群讓我很難找到朋友。

sentences.en: Why is the smoke so dense downtown?
sentences.zh: 為什麼市區的煙這麼濃？

sentences.en: Plants grew in dense clusters along the river.
sentences.zh: 河邊的植物長成了濃密的一叢叢。

gloss_note: a dependable worker 可靠的員工

sentences.en: We need a dependable driver for the airport trip.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一位可靠的司機載我們去機場。

sentences.en: Is this car dependable in the winter?
sentences.zh: 這輛車在冬天可靠嗎？

sentences.en: She's a dependable coworker who always meets deadlines.
sentences.zh: 她是個可靠的同事，總是準時交件。

sentences.en: Do you know a dependable plumber?
sentences.zh: 你認識可靠的水管工人嗎？

sentences.en: A dependable internet connection matters for remote work.
sentences.zh: 穩定可靠的網路連線對遠距工作很重要。

sentences.en: My old truck is cheap but dependable.
sentences.zh: 我那輛舊卡車很便宜，但很可靠。

sentences.en: Our plans are dependent on the weather this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們的計畫要看這個週末的天氣。

sentences.en: Are you dependent on coffee to wake up?
sentences.zh: 你需要靠咖啡才能清醒嗎？

sentences.en: Young children are dependent on their parents.
sentences.zh: 年幼的孩子依賴父母。

sentences.en: The price is dependent on how many you order.
sentences.zh: 價格取決於你訂購的數量。

sentences.en: Is your income dependent on tips?
sentences.zh: 你的收入要看小費嗎？

sentences.en: Many farms are dependent on rain in this region.
sentences.zh: 這個地區的許多農場都依賴雨水。

gloss_note: depict sb/sth as… 把…描繪成…

sentences.en: The painting depicts a quiet fishing village.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一個寧靜的漁村。

sentences.en: How does the movie depict life in the 1920s?
sentences.zh: 這部電影如何描寫1920年代的生活？

sentences.en: The chart depicts our sales for the past year.
sentences.zh: 這張圖表呈現了我們過去一年的銷售狀況。

sentences.en: Does the ad depict the product honestly?
sentences.zh: 這則廣告有如實描繪產品嗎？

sentences.en: The author depicts her hometown with great warmth.
sentences.zh: 作者以滿滿的溫情描寫她的家鄉。

sentences.en: Students were asked to depict a scene from the book.
sentences.zh: 學生被要求描繪書中的一個場景。

sentences.en: New cars depreciate quickly in the first year.
sentences.zh: 新車在第一年貶值得很快。

sentences.en: How fast will this laptop depreciate?
sentences.zh: 這台筆電會貶值多快？

sentences.en: The company depreciates its equipment over five years.
sentences.zh: 公司把設備分五年折舊。

sentences.en: Why does a house sometimes depreciate in value?
sentences.zh: 為什麼房子有時候會貶值？

sentences.en: Our accountant said the trucks will depreciate by ten percent a year.
sentences.zh: 會計師說這些卡車每年會折舊百分之十。

sentences.en: Phones depreciate faster than most other gadgets.
sentences.zh: 手機比大多數其他電子產品貶值得更快。

gloss_note: the Great Depression 經濟大蕭條

sentences.en: Depression is a common illness, and it can be treated.
sentences.zh: 憂鬱症是常見的疾病，而且可以治療。

sentences.en: Can regular exercise help with depression?
sentences.zh: 規律運動對改善憂鬱有幫助嗎？

sentences.en: My friend talked to a counselor about her depression.
sentences.zh: 我朋友找諮商師談了她的憂鬱問題。

sentences.en: What are the early signs of depression?
sentences.zh: 憂鬱症的早期徵兆有哪些？

sentences.en: My grandfather grew up during the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是在經濟大蕭條時期長大的。

sentences.en: Many banks closed during the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 許多銀行在經濟大蕭條期間倒閉了。

sentences.en: Please write a descriptive title for the file.
sentences.zh: 請為這個檔案取一個具說明性的標題。

sentences.en: The menu has descriptive names for every dish.
sentences.zh: 菜單上每道菜的名稱都有說明。

sentences.en: Is the product label descriptive enough?
sentences.zh: 產品標籤的說明夠詳細嗎？

sentences.en: Her descriptive essay about the beach won first prize.
sentences.zh: 她那篇描寫海灘的描述文獲得了第一名。

sentences.en: Add a short descriptive note under each photo.
sentences.zh: 在每張照片下面加一段簡短的說明文字。

sentences.en: Can you give me a more descriptive answer?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我一個描述得更詳細的回答嗎？

sentences.en: We're desperate for a new sales manager.
sentences.zh: 我們迫切需要一位新的業務經理。

sentences.en: Are you so desperate that you'd take any job?
sentences.zh: 你有急到什麼工作都肯接嗎？

sentences.en: The desperate hikers shouted for help.
sentences.zh: 絕望的登山客大聲呼救。

sentences.en: Why is the team so desperate for a win?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這支球隊這麼渴望贏一場？

sentences.en: She made a desperate phone call to the bank.
sentences.zh: 她急迫地打了通電話給銀行。

sentences.en: I'm desperate for a glass of water.
sentences.zh: 我渴得急需一杯水。

sentences.en: The storm caused widespread destruction along the coast.
sentences.zh: 風暴在海岸沿線造成大範圍的破壞。

sentences.en: How much destruction did the fire cause?
sentences.zh: 這場火災造成多大的損毀？

sentences.en: Pollution leads to the destruction of wildlife habitats.
sentences.zh: 汙染導致野生動物的棲地遭到破壞。

sentences.en: Can anything stop the destruction of the rain forest?
sentences.zh: 有什麼辦法能阻止雨林被破壞嗎？

sentences.en: The destruction of old records worried the librarian.
sentences.zh: 舊紀錄被銷毀讓圖書館員很擔心。

sentences.en: The flood caused the destruction of the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 洪水沖毀了那座舊橋。

gloss_note: detach A from B 把A從B拆下

sentences.en: Detach the form along the dotted line.
sentences.zh: 沿著虛線把表格撕下來。

sentences.en: Can you detach the hose from the sink?
sentences.zh: 你可以把水管從水槽上拆下來嗎？

sentences.en: The straps detach easily for washing.
sentences.zh: 肩帶很容易拆下來清洗。

sentences.en: Please detach your ticket and keep the stub.
sentences.zh: 請撕下你的票，並保留票根。

sentences.en: How do I detach the camera from the stand?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼把相機從腳架上拆下來？

sentences.en: He detached the trailer from the truck.
sentences.zh: 他把拖車從卡車上拆了下來。

sentences.en: The detective studied the footprints near the window.
sentences.zh: 偵探仔細察看窗邊的腳印。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite detective in movies?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡電影裡的哪一位偵探？

sentences.en: My friend Tom wants to become a detective someday.
sentences.zh: 我朋友湯姆有一天想當偵探。

sentences.en: Did the detective find the missing necklace?
sentences.zh: 偵探找到那條失蹤的項鍊了嗎？

sentences.en: The detective asked everyone where they were at nine.
sentences.zh: 偵探問每個人九點時人在哪裡。

sentences.en: We're reading a detective story in English class.
sentences.zh: 我們在英文課上讀一篇偵探故事。

gloss_note: deter sb from doing 阻止某人做

sentences.en: High fees may deter new customers from signing up.
sentences.zh: 高額費用可能讓新客戶不敢註冊。

sentences.en: Will cameras deter people from stealing?
sentences.zh: 攝影機能嚇阻人們偷東西嗎？

sentences.en: Bad weather didn't deter the fans from coming.
sentences.zh: 壞天氣並沒有阻止球迷前來。

sentences.en: What would deter you from buying this product?
sentences.zh: 什麼因素會讓你不想買這項產品？

sentences.en: A strong lock can deter most burglars.
sentences.zh: 堅固的門鎖能嚇阻大多數的竊賊。

sentences.en: The company raised the price to deter small orders.
sentences.zh: 公司調漲價格，以阻止小額訂單。

sentences.en: His health began to deteriorate last winter.
sentences.zh: 他的健康從去年冬天開始惡化。

sentences.en: Will the weather deteriorate by the weekend?
sentences.zh: 到週末天氣會變差嗎？

sentences.en: Customer service deteriorated after the company grew.
sentences.zh: 公司成長之後，客戶服務品質變差了。

sentences.en: Why are the roads deteriorating so fast?
sentences.zh: 為什麼路面惡化得這麼快？

sentences.en: Relations between the two firms began to deteriorate.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司的關係開始惡化。

sentences.en: Food will deteriorate quickly if you leave it in the sun.
sentences.zh: 食物放在太陽下，很快就會變質。

gloss_note: a determinant of 的決定因素

sentences.en: Price is the key determinant of demand for our product.
sentences.zh: 價格是我們產品需求的關鍵決定因素。

sentences.en: What is the main determinant of employee satisfaction here?
sentences.zh: 這裡員工滿意度的主要決定因素是什麼？

sentences.en: Customer service was a major determinant of her decision to switch banks.
sentences.zh: 客戶服務是她決定換銀行的一大決定因素。

sentences.en: Is location the biggest determinant of a store's success?
sentences.zh: 地點是一家店成功與否最大的決定因素嗎？

sentences.en: Interest rates remain a major determinant of home prices.
sentences.zh: 利率仍是房價的主要決定因素。

sentences.en: Our boss says trust is the real determinant of good teamwork.
sentences.zh: 我們老闆說，信任才是良好團隊合作真正的決定因素。

sentences.en: She showed great determination during the marathon.
sentences.zh: 她在馬拉松比賽中展現了極大的決心。

sentences.en: Your determination to learn English really impresses me.
sentences.zh: 你學英文的決心真的讓我佩服。

sentences.en: Do you have the determination to finish this project?
sentences.zh: 你有決心把這個專案完成嗎？

sentences.en: With enough determination, he passed the exam on his third try.
sentences.zh: 憑著足夠的毅力，他第三次終於通過了考試。

sentences.en: What gives you the determination to get up at five every day?
sentences.zh: 是什麼給了你每天五點起床的毅力？

sentences.en: The team won the game through pure determination.
sentences.zh: 球隊單憑決心就贏得了比賽。

sentences.en: Please turn off all electronic devices before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛前請關閉所有電子裝置。

sentences.en: Is this device compatible with my phone?
sentences.zh: 這個裝置和我的手機相容嗎？

sentences.en: I bought a small device that tracks my sleep.
sentences.zh: 我買了一個可以追蹤睡眠的小裝置。

sentences.en: My dad invented a handy device for opening jars.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸發明了一個方便開罐子的小裝置。

sentences.en: Which device do you use to read e-books?
sentences.zh: 你用哪種裝置看電子書？

sentences.en: The device stopped working after I dropped it.
sentences.zh: 我把這個裝置摔到地上之後，它就不能用了。

gloss_note: devote A to B 把A投入B

sentences.en: She devotes every Sunday to her family.
sentences.zh: 她把每個星期天都留給家人。

sentences.en: How much time do you devote to studying each night?
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上花多少時間讀書？

sentences.en: He devoted his whole life to teaching children.
sentences.zh: 他一生都投入在教導孩子上。

sentences.en: We should devote more money to public schools.
sentences.zh: 我們應該把更多經費投入公立學校。

sentences.en: Would you devote a weekend to volunteering with us?
sentences.zh: 你願意花一個週末跟我們一起當志工嗎？

sentences.en: I plan to devote this summer to learning Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我打算把這個夏天投入在學西班牙文上。

sentences.en: The grass was wet with dew this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上草地上都是露水。

sentences.en: Do you see the dew on that spider web?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那張蜘蛛網上的露水嗎？

sentences.en: We walked barefoot through the morning dew.
sentences.zh: 我們赤腳走過晨間的露水。

sentences.en: Why does dew form on the car windows at night?
sentences.zh: 為什麼夜裡車窗上會凝結露水？

sentences.en: My shoes got soaked from the dew.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋子被露水弄得濕透了。

sentences.en: Drops of dew sparkled on the leaves in the sunlight.
sentences.zh: 葉子上的露珠在陽光下閃閃發亮。

gloss_note: diagnose a problem 診斷問題

sentences.en: The technician diagnosed the problem in about ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 技術人員大約十分鐘就診斷出了問題。

sentences.en: Can you diagnose why the printer keeps jamming?
sentences.zh: 你能診斷出印表機為什麼一直卡紙嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors diagnosed him with the flu last week.
sentences.zh: 醫生上週診斷他得了流感。

sentences.en: It's hard to diagnose the issue without seeing the error message.
sentences.zh: 沒看到錯誤訊息，很難診斷出問題。

sentences.en: How long will it take to diagnose the engine trouble?
sentences.zh: 診斷引擎故障要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Regular checkups help doctors diagnose illnesses sooner.
sentences.zh: 定期檢查能幫助醫生更早診斷出疾病。

gloss_note: dictate a letter 口述信件

sentences.en: She dictated the letter to her assistant.
sentences.zh: 她把這封信口述給助理。

sentences.en: Do you dictate your emails, or do you type them?
sentences.zh: 你的電子郵件是用口述的，還是用打字的？

sentences.en: Company policy dictates how we handle returns.
sentences.zh: 公司政策規定了我們如何處理退貨。

sentences.en: The contract dictates that payment is due within 30 days.
sentences.zh: 合約規定款項必須在30天內付清。

sentences.en: What does the law dictate about overtime pay?
sentences.zh: 法律對加班費有什麼規定？

sentences.en: Can I dictate a quick note for you to type?
sentences.zh: 我可以口述一則簡短的備忘讓你打字嗎？

sentences.en: My roommate and I differ on almost everything.
sentences.zh: 我和室友幾乎每件事的看法都不同。

sentences.en: How does this phone differ from the older model?
sentences.zh: 這支手機和舊款有什麼不同？

sentences.en: Prices differ from store to store.
sentences.zh: 每家店的價格都不一樣。

sentences.en: Do you and your boss ever differ on how to handle clients?
sentences.zh: 你和你老闆在如何應對客戶上有過意見不合嗎？

sentences.en: Tastes differ, so I'll order both flavors.
sentences.zh: 每個人口味不同，所以我兩種口味都點。

sentences.en: Experts differ on whether the new law will help.
sentences.zh: 專家對這項新法律是否有幫助看法不一。

sentences.en: Spicy food is hard for me to digest.
sentences.zh: 辛辣的食物我很難消化。

sentences.en: Give me a minute to digest the news.
sentences.zh: 讓我花點時間消化一下這個消息。

sentences.en: How long does it take to digest a big meal?
sentences.zh: 消化一頓大餐要花多久時間？

sentences.en: There was too much information to digest in one meeting.
sentences.zh: 一場會議裡要消化的資訊太多了。

sentences.en: Don't lie down right after dinner; let your food digest.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後別馬上躺下，讓食物先消化一下。

sentences.en: Did you digest everything the teacher explained today?
sentences.zh: 老師今天講解的內容，你全都消化了嗎？

sentences.en: Our sales grew by double digits last quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們上一季的銷售額成長了兩位數。

sentences.en: Please enter the last four digits of your card.
sentences.zh: 請輸入您卡片的最後四碼。

sentences.en: How many digits are in your account number?
sentences.zh: 你的帳號有幾位數？

sentences.en: Inflation fell to single digits this year.
sentences.zh: 今年通貨膨脹降到了個位數。

sentences.en: Which digit did you type wrong?
sentences.zh: 你打錯的是哪一個數字？

sentences.en: In the US, a ZIP code has five digits.
sentences.zh: 在美國，郵遞區號有五位數。

sentences.en: Can you send me a digital copy of the contract?
sentences.zh: 你可以寄一份合約的數位檔給我嗎？

sentences.en: Do you still use a digital camera, or just your phone?
sentences.zh: 你還在用數位相機，還是只用手機？

sentences.en: The store sells digital cameras and printers.
sentences.zh: 那家店賣數位相機和印表機。

sentences.en: Everything in our office is going digital.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室的一切都在走向數位化。

sentences.en: Digital payments are common in many stores now.
sentences.zh: 現在許多商店都很常見數位支付。

sentences.en: The digital clock on the wall is five minutes fast.
sentences.zh: 牆上的電子鐘快了五分鐘。

sentences.en: Everyone deserves to be treated with dignity.
sentences.zh: 每個人都應該受到有尊嚴的對待。

sentences.en: He lost his job but kept his dignity.
sentences.zh: 他丟了工作，但保住了尊嚴。

sentences.en: How can we help older people live with dignity?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何幫助年長者有尊嚴地生活？

sentences.en: She walked out of the meeting with her dignity intact.
sentences.zh: 她保有尊嚴地走出了會議室。

sentences.en: Does asking for help take away a person's dignity?
sentences.zh: 尋求幫助會讓人失去尊嚴嗎？

sentences.en: Teachers should protect a student's dignity, even when correcting mistakes.
sentences.zh: 老師就算在糾正錯誤時，也應該維護學生的尊嚴。

gloss_note: in a dilemma 進退兩難

sentences.en: I'm in a dilemma about whether to accept the offer.
sentences.zh: 對於要不要接受這份工作邀約，我陷入了兩難。

sentences.en: What would you do if you faced this dilemma?
sentences.zh: 如果你面臨這種兩難，你會怎麼做？

sentences.en: The company faces a dilemma: raise prices or lose customers.
sentences.zh: 公司面臨兩難：要漲價，還是失去客戶。

sentences.en: Her dilemma was whether to tell her boss the truth.
sentences.zh: 她的兩難在於該不該對老闆說實話。

sentences.en: Isn't that a dilemma every small business owner faces?
sentences.zh: 這不是每個小企業老闆都會面臨的兩難嗎？

sentences.en: Moving for the job created a dilemma for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 為了工作搬家，讓全家人陷入了兩難。

sentences.en: Her diligence earned her a promotion.
sentences.zh: 她的勤奮為她贏得了升遷。

sentences.en: Success usually comes from diligence, not luck.
sentences.zh: 成功通常來自勤奮，而不是運氣。

sentences.en: Do you think diligence matters more than talent?
sentences.zh: 你覺得勤奮比天分更重要嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher praised the students for their diligence.
sentences.zh: 老師稱讚學生們的用功。

sentences.en: He studied with great diligence every night before the exam.
sentences.zh: 考試前，他每天晚上都非常用功地讀書。

sentences.en: How did you develop such diligence at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上這麼勤奮，是怎麼培養出來的？

sentences.en: A cube is a three-dimensional shape.
sentences.zh: 立方體是三維的形狀。

sentences.en: Can you build a three-dimensional model of the building?
sentences.zh: 你能做出這棟建築的立體模型嗎？

sentences.en: A flat drawing is two-dimensional, but a statue is not.
sentences.zh: 平面的圖畫是二維的，但雕像不是。

sentences.en: The museum has a three-dimensional map of the city.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一張這座城市的立體地圖。

sentences.en: Is this printer able to make three-dimensional objects?
sentences.zh: 這台印表機能做出立體的物件嗎？

sentences.en: Movies today often use three-dimensional effects.
sentences.zh: 現在的電影常使用立體特效。

gloss_note: high school diploma 高中文憑

sentences.en: He got his high school diploma two years ago.
sentences.zh: 他兩年前拿到了高中畢業證書。

sentences.en: Do I need a college diploma for this job?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要大學文憑嗎？

sentences.en: The diploma is hanging on the wall of her office.
sentences.zh: 她的畢業證書掛在辦公室的牆上。

sentences.en: Please bring a copy of your diploma to the interview.
sentences.zh: 請帶一份你的文憑影本來面試。

sentences.en: Where did you put your diploma after graduation?
sentences.zh: 你畢業後把畢業證書放哪裡了？

sentences.en: She studied at night to earn her diploma.
sentences.zh: 她為了拿到文憑，晚上都在讀書。

sentences.en: The two countries solved the problem through diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 兩國透過外交解決了這個問題。

sentences.en: It took some diplomacy to calm the angry customer.
sentences.zh: 要安撫那位生氣的客人需要一點手腕。

sentences.en: Do you have the diplomacy to handle this negotiation?
sentences.zh: 你有足夠的手腕處理這場談判嗎？

sentences.en: She handled the disagreement with tact and diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 她以機智與手腕處理了這場意見分歧。

sentences.en: Diplomacy is important when you work with a large team.
sentences.zh: 與大型團隊共事時，交際手腕很重要。

sentences.en: Is diplomacy better than being blunt with a client?
sentences.zh: 跟客戶打交道時，講究手腕會比直話直說好嗎？

sentences.en: The two countries restored diplomatic relations this year.
sentences.zh: 兩國今年恢復了外交關係。

sentences.en: That was a diplomatic way to say no.
sentences.zh: 那是個委婉說不的圓滑方式。

sentences.en: Can you be more diplomatic when you talk to clients?
sentences.zh: 你跟客戶說話時能再圓滑一點嗎？

sentences.en: She gave a diplomatic answer to avoid an argument.
sentences.zh: 她給了圓滑的回答，以避免爭吵。

sentences.en: Is it diplomatic to criticize your boss in front of everyone?
sentences.zh: 在大家面前批評老闆，算得上圓滑得體嗎？

sentences.en: He was diplomatic and never took sides in the argument.
sentences.zh: 他很圓滑，從不在爭論中選邊站。

gloss_note: issue a directive 發出指示

sentences.en: The manager sent out a new directive about travel expenses.
sentences.zh: 經理發出了一項關於差旅費用的新指示。

sentences.en: Did you read the directive from headquarters?
sentences.zh: 你看過總公司的指示了嗎？

sentences.en: Under the new directive, all staff must wear ID badges.
sentences.zh: 依據新的指令，所有員工都必須佩戴識別證。

sentences.en: What was the main directive of that memo?
sentences.zh: 那份備忘錄的主要指示是什麼？

sentences.en: The CEO's directive caught everyone by surprise.
sentences.zh: 執行長的指示讓大家都很意外。

sentences.en: We followed the safety directive and left the building.
sentences.zh: 我們遵照安全指示離開了大樓。

gloss_note: people with disabilities 身心障礙者

sentences.en: The building has ramps for people with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 這棟建築設有供身心障礙者使用的坡道。

sentences.en: Does the office have access for employees with disabilities?
sentences.zh: 辦公室有為身心障礙員工提供無障礙設施嗎？

sentences.en: He has a learning disability, but he does well in school.
sentences.zh: 他有學習障礙，但在學校表現不錯。

sentences.en: The law protects workers with a disability from unfair treatment.
sentences.zh: 這項法律保護身心障礙的勞工免受不公平待遇。

sentences.en: Is the new movie theater accessible to people with disabilities?
sentences.zh: 新的電影院對身心障礙者來說方便進出嗎？

sentences.en: Her disability never stopped her from becoming a teacher.
sentences.zh: 她的身心障礙從未阻止她成為老師。

gloss_note: have a disagreement 意見不合

sentences.en: We had a disagreement about the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們對預算有意見分歧。

sentences.en: How do you usually resolve a disagreement with a coworker?
sentences.zh: 你通常怎麼化解和同事之間的意見不合？

sentences.en: The disagreement between the two managers slowed the project.
sentences.zh: 兩位經理之間的意見不合拖慢了專案進度。

sentences.en: Was there any disagreement about the meeting time?
sentences.zh: 對開會時間有任何異議嗎？

sentences.en: Our disagreement was minor, so we settled it quickly.
sentences.zh: 我們的歧見很小，所以很快就解決了。

sentences.en: There's still some disagreement over who should lead the team.
sentences.zh: 對於誰該領導團隊，仍有一些意見不合。

sentences.en: I don't want to disappoint my parents.
sentences.zh: 我不想讓我的父母失望。

sentences.en: Sorry to disappoint you, but the store is closed.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉讓你失望了，但這家店關門了。

sentences.en: Did the movie disappoint you?
sentences.zh: 這部電影讓你失望了嗎？

sentences.en: I hate to disappoint the kids, but we can't go today.
sentences.zh: 我不想讓孩子們失望，但我們今天不能去。

sentences.en: Why did the team's performance disappoint so many fans?
sentences.zh: 為什麼球隊的表現讓這麼多球迷失望？

sentences.en: Her low test score disappointed her parents.
sentences.zh: 她考試考低分，讓父母很失望。

gloss_note: a big disappointment 大失所望

sentences.en: Her face showed her disappointment.
sentences.zh: 她的臉上流露出失望。

sentences.en: The trip was a big disappointment because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，這趟旅行讓人大失所望。

sentences.en: How did you handle the disappointment of losing the deal?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼面對失去那筆交易的失望？

sentences.en: To my disappointment, the concert was canceled.
sentences.zh: 讓我失望的是，演唱會被取消了。

sentences.en: Was the hotel a disappointment for you?
sentences.zh: 這家飯店讓你失望嗎？

sentences.en: He tried to hide his disappointment when he didn't get the job.
sentences.zh: 他沒得到那份工作時，試著掩飾自己的失望。

sentences.en: The flood was the worst disaster in the town's history.
sentences.zh: 那場洪水是小鎮歷史上最嚴重的災難。

sentences.en: Our first date was a total disaster.
sentences.zh: 我們第一次約會簡直是一場災難。

sentences.en: Is your town ready for a natural disaster?
sentences.zh: 你們的城鎮為天然災害做好準備了嗎？

sentences.en: The company's new product launch was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 公司的新產品上市是一場慘敗。

sentences.en: What should we keep in the car in case of a disaster?
sentences.zh: 為了以防災難發生，我們車上該備些什麼？

sentences.en: Volunteers rushed to help after the disaster.
sentences.zh: 災難發生後，志工們趕去幫忙。

sentences.en: The company discharged him for repeated lateness.
sentences.zh: 公司因他一再遲到而將他解僱。

sentences.en: Employees can't be discharged without a valid reason.
sentences.zh: 沒有正當理由，員工不得被解僱。

sentences.en: Was she discharged, or did she resign?
sentences.zh: 她是被解僱的，還是自己辭職的？

sentences.en: The manager discharged two workers for safety violations.
sentences.zh: 經理因違反安全規定解僱了兩名員工。

sentences.en: Why was the new hire discharged after only a week?
sentences.zh: 那位新進員工為什麼才一週就被解僱？

sentences.en: Several workers were discharged after the factory closed.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉後，有幾名員工被解僱。

sentences.en: Good study habits take discipline.
sentences.zh: 養成好的讀書習慣需要自律。

sentences.en: The coach demands strict discipline from the team.
sentences.zh: 教練要求球隊嚴格遵守紀律。

sentences.en: Do you have the discipline to save money every month?
sentences.zh: 你有自律能力每個月存錢嗎？

sentences.en: Discipline in the classroom isn't easy for new teachers.
sentences.zh: 對新老師來說，維持班級紀律並不容易。

sentences.en: How do you keep your discipline when you work from home?
sentences.zh: 你在家工作時，怎麼保持自律？

sentences.en: He has the discipline to run every morning, even in winter.
sentences.zh: 他很自律，連冬天也每天早上跑步。

sentences.en: Please disconnect the power cord before cleaning.
sentences.zh: 清潔前請先拔掉電源線。

sentences.en: My call got disconnected twice during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我的通話在會議中斷線了兩次。

sentences.en: Why does the Wi-Fi keep disconnecting?
sentences.zh: 為什麼無線網路一直斷線？

sentences.en: Could you disconnect the printer from the network?
sentences.zh: 你可以把印表機從網路上斷開嗎？

sentences.en: The phone company will disconnect your service if you don't pay.
sentences.zh: 如果你不付款，電話公司會中斷你的服務。

sentences.en: Did the storm disconnect your internet?
