sentences.zh: 暴風雨讓你的網路中斷了嗎？

sentences.en: The company will discontinue this model next year.
sentences.zh: 公司明年將停產這個型號。

sentences.en: Why did they discontinue my favorite shampoo?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼停產了我最愛的洗髮精？

sentences.en: We discontinued the service because few people used it.
sentences.zh: 因為使用的人很少，我們終止了這項服務。

sentences.en: Is this color still available, or was it discontinued?
sentences.zh: 這個顏色還有貨，還是已經停產了？

sentences.en: The store plans to discontinue its loyalty card program.
sentences.zh: 這家店打算終止它的會員卡方案。

sentences.en: Customers were upset when the airline discontinued that route.
sentences.zh: 航空公司停飛那條航線時，顧客都很不高興。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: She felt deep discouragement after failing the exam.
sentences.zh: 她考試不及格後深感氣餒。

sentences.en: Don't let a little discouragement stop you.
sentences.zh: 別讓一點小小的氣餒阻止你。

sentences.en: How do you deal with discouragement at work?
sentences.zh: 工作上感到氣餒時，你都怎麼調適？

sentences.en: Words of discouragement from friends made her doubt herself.
sentences.zh: 朋友們的洩氣話讓她開始懷疑自己。

sentences.en: Despite the discouragement, they kept practicing every day.
sentences.zh: 儘管感到氣餒，他們仍每天持續練習。

sentences.en: Is discouragement a normal part of learning a language?
sentences.zh: 氣餒是學語言過程中的正常現象嗎？

gloss_note: at one's discretion 由某人斟酌

sentences.en: Use your own discretion when handling customer data.
sentences.zh: 處理客戶資料時，請自行斟酌判斷。

sentences.en: Refunds are given at the manager's discretion.
sentences.zh: 退款由經理酌情決定。

sentences.en: Can I trust you to use discretion with this information?
sentences.zh: 我能相信你會謹慎處理這項資訊嗎？

sentences.en: The team has full discretion over how to spend the budget.
sentences.zh: 團隊對如何使用預算擁有完全的裁量權。

sentences.en: Discretion is important when you work in human resources.
sentences.zh: 在人資部門工作，保持謹慎很重要。

sentences.en: Do employees have the discretion to give discounts?
sentences.zh: 員工有權自行決定給折扣嗎？

sentences.en: Discretionary spending dropped during the recession.
sentences.zh: 經濟衰退期間，可自由支配的支出減少了。

sentences.en: How much of your income is discretionary?
sentences.zh: 你的收入有多少是可以自由支配的？

sentences.en: The manager has a discretionary budget for team events.
sentences.zh: 經理有一筆可自由支配的預算，用於團隊活動。

sentences.en: Bonuses are discretionary, so they aren't guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 獎金是酌情發放的，所以並不保證有。

sentences.en: Is this fee discretionary, or do we have to pay it?
sentences.zh: 這筆費用是可付可不付的，還是我們非付不可？

sentences.en: Families with more discretionary income spend more on dining out.
sentences.zh: 可自由支配所得較多的家庭，外出用餐花得更多。

sentences.en: The actor wore a clever disguise in the movie.
sentences.zh: 那位演員在電影裡做了巧妙的偽裝。

sentences.en: She tried to disguise her nervousness with a smile.
sentences.zh: 她試著用微笑掩飾自己的緊張。

sentences.en: Can you disguise the taste of the medicine in juice?
sentences.zh: 你能用果汁掩蓋藥的味道嗎？

sentences.en: The kids disguised themselves as pirates for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在萬聖節假扮成海盜。

sentences.en: There's no disguising the fact that sales are down.
sentences.zh: 銷售下滑是掩飾不了的事實。

sentences.en: Do you think this hat is enough of a disguise?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這頂帽子足以當作偽裝嗎？

sentences.en: She looked at the moldy bread with disgust.
sentences.zh: 她厭惡地看著那塊發霉的麵包。

sentences.en: The smell of the trash disgusted me.
sentences.zh: 垃圾的味道讓我覺得噁心。

sentences.en: Does the sight of bugs fill you with disgust?
sentences.zh: 看到蟲子會讓你滿心厭惡嗎？

sentences.en: He left the meeting in disgust.
sentences.zh: 他厭惡地離開了會議。

sentences.en: Dirty restrooms disgust a lot of travelers.
sentences.zh: 髒亂的廁所讓許多旅客覺得噁心。

sentences.en: Why does cooked liver disgust you so much?
sentences.zh: 為什麼煮熟的肝臟讓你覺得這麼噁心？

gloss_note: load the dishwasher 把碗盤放進洗碗機

sentences.en: Please put your plates in the dishwasher.
sentences.zh: 請把你的盤子放進洗碗機。

sentences.en: Is this bowl safe to put in the dishwasher?
sentences.zh: 這個碗可以放進洗碗機嗎？

sentences.en: The dishwasher stopped working this morning.
sentences.zh: 洗碗機今天早上壞了。

sentences.en: He got a job as a dishwasher at a small restaurant.
sentences.zh: 他在一家小餐廳找到了洗碗工的工作。

sentences.en: Can you unload the dishwasher before dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐前你可以把洗碗機裡的碗盤拿出來嗎？

sentences.en: We need a new dishwasher because the old one leaks.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一台新的洗碗機，因為舊的會漏水。

gloss_note: dismiss an idea 否定想法

sentences.en: Don't dismiss his idea before you hear it.
sentences.zh: 在聽完之前，別不把他的想法當一回事。

sentences.en: My boss dismissed my plan without even reading it.
sentences.zh: 我老闆連看都沒看就否決了我的計畫。

sentences.en: Why did she dismiss my concerns so quickly?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼這麼快就不把我的擔憂當一回事？

sentences.en: Many people dismissed the rumor as a joke.
sentences.zh: 許多人把那則謠言當成玩笑，不予理會。

sentences.en: Why did the court dismiss the lawsuit so quickly?
sentences.zh: 法院為什麼這麼快就駁回了這起訴訟？

sentences.en: Please don't dismiss the warning signs.
sentences.zh: 請不要忽視這些警訊。

sentences.en: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
sentences.zh: 派對結束後，房間一片混亂。

sentences.en: He takes medicine for a stomach disorder.
sentences.zh: 他服藥治療腸胃失調。

sentences.en: Doctors say a sleep disorder can affect your mood.
sentences.zh: 醫生說睡眠失調會影響你的情緒。

sentences.en: The storm threw the airport into disorder.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨使機場陷入一片混亂。

sentences.en: Why is your desk always in such disorder?
sentences.zh: 你的書桌為什麼總是這麼亂？

sentences.en: Is this kind of stomach disorder serious?
sentences.zh: 這種腸胃失調嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: Automation has led to the displacement of many factory workers.
sentences.zh: 自動化導致許多工廠工人被取代。

sentences.en: The flood caused the displacement of thousands of families.
sentences.zh: 洪水造成數千個家庭被迫遷離家園。

sentences.en: Is displacement a problem in your neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你們社區有居民被迫搬離的問題嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle worries about the displacement of workers by robots.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔擔心工人會被機器人取代。

sentences.en: Rising rents are causing displacement in our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 租金上漲正在造成我們社區的居民被迫搬離。

sentences.en: Do you think the displacement of workers by machines will continue?
sentences.zh: 你覺得工人被機器取代的情況會持續下去嗎？

sentences.en: Please dispose of the old batteries properly.
sentences.zh: 請妥善處理舊電池。

sentences.en: How should we dispose of these broken computers?
sentences.zh: 我們該如何處理這些壞掉的電腦？

sentences.en: Where can I dispose of used cooking oil?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡丟棄用過的食用油？

sentences.en: The company disposed of its old inventory at a discount.
sentences.zh: 公司以折扣價把舊庫存處理掉了。

sentences.en: You should dispose of confidential documents in the shredder.
sentences.zh: 你應該把機密文件丟進碎紙機處理掉。

sentences.en: We disposed of the old couch last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末把舊沙發處理掉了。

gloss_note: settle a dispute 解決爭議

sentences.en: The two neighbors had a dispute over the fence.
sentences.zh: 兩位鄰居為了圍籬起了爭執。

sentences.en: We finally settled the dispute about the bill.
sentences.zh: 我們終於解決了帳單上的爭議。

sentences.en: How do you resolve a dispute with a coworker?
sentences.zh: 你如何解決與同事之間的爭執？

sentences.en: Nobody disputes that she worked hard.
sentences.zh: 沒有人質疑她工作很努力。

sentences.en: I'd like to dispute this charge on my credit card.
sentences.zh: 我想對信用卡上的這筆費用提出異議。

sentences.en: Is the dispute between the two companies over?
sentences.zh: 兩家公司之間的糾紛結束了嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy snow disrupted flights across the Midwest.
sentences.zh: 大雪擾亂了中西部各地的班機。

sentences.en: Sorry to disrupt your meeting, but it's urgent.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉打斷你們開會，但事情很緊急。

sentences.en: Will the construction disrupt our work schedule?
sentences.zh: 這項施工會干擾我們的工作時程嗎？

sentences.en: Loud music from the street disrupted my sleep.
sentences.zh: 街上的大聲音樂干擾了我的睡眠。

sentences.en: Why do you keep disrupting the class?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼一直擾亂上課？

sentences.en: A power outage disrupted service at the hotel for hours.
sentences.zh: 停電讓這家飯店的服務中斷了好幾個小時。

gloss_note: 多用 dissatisfied with 對…不滿

sentences.en: Slow delivery may dissatisfy customers.
sentences.zh: 配送太慢可能會讓顧客不滿意。

sentences.en: What part of our service left you most dissatisfied?
sentences.zh: 我們的服務哪個部分最讓你不滿意？

sentences.en: Many customers are dissatisfied with the long wait times.
sentences.zh: 許多顧客對漫長的等待時間感到不滿。

sentences.en: We never want a loyal customer to leave dissatisfied.
sentences.zh: 我們絕不希望忠實顧客帶著不滿離開。

sentences.en: Were you dissatisfied with the late shipment?
sentences.zh: 你對貨運延遲感到不滿意嗎？

sentences.en: Employees were dissatisfied when the policy changed again.
sentences.zh: 政策又改了一次，員工們很不滿。

gloss_note: defend a dissertation 答辯博士論文

sentences.en: My friend is writing her dissertation on ocean currents.
sentences.zh: 我朋友正在寫一篇關於洋流的博士論文。

sentences.en: How long did it take you to finish your dissertation?
sentences.zh: 你花了多久時間完成博士論文？

sentences.en: He defended his dissertation in front of five professors.
sentences.zh: 他在五位教授面前進行了博士論文答辯。

sentences.en: Her dissertation took four years of research.
sentences.zh: 她的博士論文花了四年的研究。

sentences.en: Have you chosen a topic for your dissertation yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經選好博士論文的題目了嗎？

sentences.en: The library keeps a copy of every dissertation.
sentences.zh: 圖書館保存每一篇博士論文的複本。

gloss_note: dissolution of a company 公司解散

sentences.en: The partners agreed to the dissolution of the company.
sentences.zh: 合夥人同意解散公司。

sentences.en: What led to the dissolution of your partnership?
sentences.zh: 是什麼導致你們的合夥關係終止？

sentences.en: The dissolution of the band surprised their fans.
sentences.zh: 樂團的解散讓歌迷很驚訝。

sentences.en: A lawyer will explain the dissolution process.
sentences.zh: 律師會說明解散的程序。

sentences.en: The dissolution of a small business takes a lot of paperwork.
sentences.zh: 解散一家小公司需要大量的文書作業。

sentences.en: Did the dissolution of the contract cost you money?
sentences.zh: 合約的終止讓你損失了錢嗎？

gloss_note: dissolve a partnership 解散合夥

sentences.en: Stir the sugar until it dissolves in the water.
sentences.zh: 攪拌到糖在水中溶解為止。

sentences.en: Does this tablet dissolve in cold water?
sentences.zh: 這種錠劑能溶於冷水嗎？

sentences.en: The two owners decided to dissolve the partnership.
sentences.zh: 兩位老闆決定解散合夥關係。

sentences.en: The board voted to dissolve the company last year.
sentences.zh: 董事會去年投票決議解散公司。

sentences.en: Salt dissolves faster in warm water.
sentences.zh: 鹽在溫水中溶解得更快。

sentences.en: Why would they dissolve a business that makes money?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼要解散一家賺錢的公司？

sentences.en: The two sisters have distinct personalities.
sentences.zh: 這兩姊妹有截然不同的個性。

sentences.en: I heard a distinct knock at the door.
sentences.zh: 我清楚聽到了敲門聲。

sentences.en: Is there a distinct difference between these two products?
sentences.zh: 這兩項產品有明顯的差別嗎？

sentences.en: Spanish and Portuguese are distinct languages.
sentences.zh: 西班牙文和葡萄牙文是不同的語言。

sentences.en: I have a distinct memory of our first meeting.
sentences.zh: 我對我們第一次見面有清楚的記憶。

sentences.en: Can you taste a distinct flavor of lemon in this cake?
sentences.zh: 你能在這個蛋糕裡嚐到明顯的檸檬味嗎？

gloss_note: a distinctive style 獨特風格

sentences.en: The brand has a distinctive logo that everyone recognizes.
sentences.zh: 這個品牌有個大家都認得的獨特標誌。

sentences.en: What makes your product distinctive?
sentences.zh: 你們的產品有什麼獨特之處？

sentences.en: She has a distinctive laugh you can hear across the room.
sentences.zh: 她有獨特的笑聲，隔著整個房間都聽得到。

sentences.en: Our company wants a distinctive style for its packaging.
sentences.zh: 我們公司想為包裝打造獨特的風格。

sentences.en: Is that distinctive smell coming from the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 那股獨特的味道是從廚房傳來的嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant is known for its distinctive sauce.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以其獨特的醬汁聞名。

gloss_note: distinguish A from B 分辨A和B

sentences.en: Can you distinguish butter from margarine by taste?
sentences.zh: 你能靠味道分辨奶油和人造奶油嗎？

sentences.en: It's hard to distinguish the twins from each other.
sentences.zh: 很難把那對雙胞胎彼此區分開來。

sentences.en: Children learn to distinguish right from wrong.
sentences.zh: 孩子們學著分辨是非對錯。

sentences.en: How do you distinguish real leather from fake?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼分辨真皮和假皮？

sentences.en: I can't distinguish these two colors in dim light.
sentences.zh: 在昏暗的光線下，我分辨不出這兩種顏色。

sentences.en: A small tag helps distinguish my luggage from others.
sentences.zh: 一個小吊牌幫助我把行李和別人的區分開來。

gloss_note: a distinguished career 輝煌的事業

sentences.en: She is a distinguished professor of chemistry.
sentences.zh: 她是一位傑出的化學教授。

sentences.en: Who is the distinguished guest at the front table?
sentences.zh: 坐在前排桌子的那位貴賓是誰？

sentences.en: My grandfather had a long and distinguished career in the navy.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺在海軍有著漫長而傑出的職業生涯。

sentences.en: Was he a distinguished scientist before he retired?
sentences.zh: 他退休前是一位傑出的科學家嗎？

sentences.en: The school invited several distinguished speakers to the event.
sentences.zh: 學校邀請了幾位傑出的講者參加這場活動。

sentences.en: You look very distinguished in that gray suit.
sentences.zh: 你穿那套灰色西裝看起來氣度不凡。

gloss_note: distort the facts 扭曲事實

sentences.en: Some companies distort their earnings to look more profitable.
sentences.zh: 有些公司扭曲獲利數字，讓自己看起來更賺錢。

sentences.en: Does this chart distort the sales numbers?
sentences.zh: 這張圖表有扭曲銷售數字嗎？

sentences.en: High tariffs can distort prices in the market.
sentences.zh: 高關稅會扭曲市場價格。

sentences.en: Please don't distort what I said in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請不要曲解我在會議上說的話。

sentences.en: Could a poorly written survey distort our results?
sentences.zh: 一份寫得不好的問卷會扭曲我們的結果嗎？

sentences.en: The reporter distorted the facts to make the story more exciting.
sentences.zh: 那位記者扭曲事實，好讓報導更刺激。

sentences.en: Subsidies can cause serious distortion in the housing market.
sentences.zh: 補貼可能造成住宅市場嚴重扭曲。

sentences.en: Is there any distortion in these financial figures?
sentences.zh: 這些財務數字有失真的地方嗎？

sentences.en: The audit found a major distortion in the quarterly report.
sentences.zh: 稽核發現季報中有嚴重的失真。

sentences.en: Their ad was a distortion of the truth.
sentences.zh: 他們的廣告是對事實的扭曲。

sentences.en: Can you hear the distortion when the volume is up?
sentences.zh: 音量開大時，你聽得到失真嗎？

sentences.en: Exchange rate distortion makes it hard to compare prices.
sentences.zh: 匯率扭曲讓價格很難比較。

sentences.en: The company is in serious financial distress.
sentences.zh: 這家公司陷入嚴重的財務困境。

sentences.en: Is the firm still in financial distress?
sentences.zh: 那家公司還在財務困境中嗎？

sentences.en: The delay caused a lot of distress for our customers.
sentences.zh: 這次延誤讓我們的客戶非常苦惱。

sentences.en: The bad news distressed everyone in the office.
sentences.zh: 壞消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都很苦惱。

sentences.en: Did the sudden layoffs distress the staff?
sentences.zh: 突然裁員有讓員工感到苦惱嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter was in distress when she lost her phone.
sentences.zh: 我女兒弄丟手機時非常苦惱。

gloss_note: distribute A to B 把A分發給B

sentences.en: The teacher distributed the test papers to the class.
sentences.zh: 老師把考卷發給全班。

sentences.en: Could you distribute these flyers at the door?
sentences.zh: 你可以在門口發這些傳單嗎？

sentences.en: Does anyone in your neighborhood distribute free food on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你們社區有人在週末發放免費食物嗎？

sentences.en: Please distribute the snacks evenly among the kids.
sentences.zh: 請把點心平均分給孩子們。

sentences.en: The nurse distributes the medicine at nine every morning.
sentences.zh: 護理師每天早上九點分發藥物。

sentences.en: The volunteers distributed water bottles after the race.
sentences.zh: 志工在賽後發放瓶裝水。

sentences.en: She lives in the downtown business district.
sentences.zh: 她住在市中心的商業區。

sentences.en: Which district of the city do you work in?
sentences.zh: 你在這座城市的哪一區上班？

sentences.en: The restaurant is in the historic district.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳位在歷史街區。

sentences.en: Our school district is closing two schools next year.
sentences.zh: 我們的學區明年要關閉兩所學校。

sentences.en: Is this district safe to walk around at night?
sentences.zh: 這一區晚上在外面走路安全嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans to build a new park in this district.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算在這一區蓋一座新公園。

gloss_note: Do not disturb 請勿打擾

sentences.en: Sorry to disturb you, but you have a call.
sentences.zh: 抱歉打擾你，你有一通電話。

sentences.en: Please don't disturb me while I'm studying.
sentences.zh: 我讀書的時候請不要打擾我。

sentences.en: Did the noise from the street disturb your sleep?
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音有吵到你睡覺嗎？

sentences.en: Would it disturb you if I turned on the TV?
sentences.zh: 我如果開電視，會打擾到你嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel guest hung a Do Not Disturb sign on the door.
sentences.zh: 飯店房客在門上掛了「請勿打擾」的牌子。

sentences.en: Loud construction work disturbs the whole neighborhood every morning.
sentences.zh: 吵鬧的施工每天早上都擾亂整個社區的安寧。

sentences.en: Our school celebrates cultural diversity with a food festival.
sentences.zh: 我們學校用美食節來慶祝文化多樣性。

sentences.en: Does your team value diversity in hiring?
sentences.zh: 你們團隊在招募時重視多元性嗎？

sentences.en: The diversity of plants in this forest is amazing.
sentences.zh: 這座森林的植物多樣性令人驚嘆。

sentences.en: There is a lot of diversity in this neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 這個社區非常多元。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy the diversity of food in this city?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡這座城市豐富多樣的食物嗎？

sentences.en: The manager wants more diversity on the hiring committee.
sentences.zh: 經理希望招募委員會能更多元。

sentences.en: We had to divert funds from marketing to repairs.
sentences.zh: 我們得把行銷的資金挪去做維修。

sentences.en: Why would they divert money from the training budget?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼要把訓練預算的錢挪走？

sentences.en: Road work will divert traffic onto side streets.
sentences.zh: 道路施工會把車流導向小街道。

sentences.en: The airline diverted our flight to another city.
sentences.zh: 航空公司把我們的班機改飛到另一座城市。

sentences.en: Can we divert some staff to the new project?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把一些員工調去新專案嗎？

sentences.en: Don't let small problems divert your attention from the goal.
sentences.zh: 別讓小問題轉移你對目標的注意力。

sentences.en: This chocolate cake is absolutely divine.
sentences.zh: 這個巧克力蛋糕美妙極了。

sentences.en: Is the soup at that place really divine?
sentences.zh: 那家店的湯真的那麼絕妙嗎？

sentences.en: We had a divine dinner by the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊吃了一頓絕妙的晚餐。

sentences.en: In Greek myths, divine beings lived on a tall mountain.
sentences.zh: 在希臘神話裡，神明住在一座高山上。

sentences.en: Did the ancient Egyptians think their kings had divine power?
sentences.zh: 古埃及人認為他們的國王擁有神的力量嗎？

sentences.en: The view from the hotel balcony was simply divine.
sentences.zh: 從飯店陽台看出去的景色美妙極了。

sentences.en: My neighbors got a divorce last year.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居去年離婚了。

sentences.en: Why did they decide to get a divorce?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼決定離婚？

sentences.en: She divorced him after ten years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 她在結婚十年後和他離婚了。

sentences.en: The divorce rate has dropped in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年來離婚率下降了。

sentences.en: Is it hard for children to go through a divorce?
sentences.zh: 孩子經歷父母離婚會很難受嗎？

sentences.en: They divorced and moved to different cities.
sentences.zh: 他們離婚後搬到了不同的城市。

sentences.en: Courts have long followed the doctrine of freedom of contract.
sentences.zh: 法院長期遵循契約自由原則。

sentences.en: Lawyers often cite the fair use doctrine in copyright cases.
sentences.zh: 律師在著作權案件中常引用合理使用原則。

sentences.en: Is this doctrine still useful in modern business?
sentences.zh: 這個原則在現代商業中還有用嗎？

sentences.en: The new director dropped the old doctrine of cutting costs first.
sentences.zh: 新任主管捨棄了「先削減成本」的舊原則。

sentences.en: Does the first sale doctrine let me resell this textbook?
sentences.zh: 依照首次銷售原則，我可以轉賣這本教科書嗎？

sentences.en: Our legal team explained the doctrine of limited liability.
sentences.zh: 我們的法務團隊說明了有限責任原則。

sentences.en: Please send the required documentation by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前寄出所需的文件資料。

sentences.en: Do you have the proper documentation for customs?
sentences.zh: 你有海關需要的正確文件嗎？

sentences.en: The user documentation is clear and easy to follow.
sentences.zh: 使用說明文件清楚又好懂。

sentences.en: I need more documentation before approving this expense.
sentences.zh: 在核准這筆費用之前，我需要更多文件資料。

sentences.en: Who is responsible for updating the project documentation?
sentences.zh: 誰負責更新專案的文件？

sentences.en: The auditor asked for documentation of every purchase.
sentences.zh: 稽核員要求提供每筆採購的文件資料。

gloss_note: market dominance 市場主導地位

sentences.en: The firm's dominance of the market has lasted for decades.
sentences.zh: 這家公司對市場的支配地位已持續了數十年。

sentences.en: What explains the dominance of English in science?
sentences.zh: 英語在科學領域的主導地位要如何解釋？

sentences.en: Is the dominance of big tech companies good for consumers?
sentences.zh: 大型科技公司的主導地位對消費者有利嗎？

sentences.en: One rival's dominance makes it hard for small shops to compete.
sentences.zh: 一個對手的強勢地位，讓小店很難競爭。

sentences.en: Their dominance on the basketball court lasted ten years.
sentences.zh: 他們在籃球場上的稱霸持續了十年。

sentences.en: Our dog shows dominance by always taking the best seat.
sentences.zh: 我家的狗總是搶走最好的位子，藉此展現支配地位。

gloss_note: dominate the market 主導市場

sentences.en: Two big banks dominate the local market.
sentences.zh: 兩家大銀行主導著當地市場。

sentences.en: Don't let one person dominate the discussion.
sentences.zh: 別讓一個人主導整場討論。

sentences.en: Does one player always dominate the game in your league?
sentences.zh: 你們聯盟裡是不是總有一位球員主導整場比賽？

sentences.en: Tall buildings dominate the skyline of the city.
sentences.zh: 高樓主宰著這座城市的天際線。

sentences.en: She dominated the conversation at dinner last night.
sentences.zh: 她昨晚在晚餐上主導了整場談話。

sentences.en: Can a small team dominate this industry?
sentences.zh: 小團隊有辦法稱霸這個產業嗎？

sentences.en: Grandpa taught me how to play dominoes at the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 爺爺在廚房的餐桌上教我玩骨牌。

sentences.en: Do you want to play dominoes after dinner?
sentences.zh: 你晚餐後想玩骨牌嗎？

sentences.en: Can you line up the dominoes in a long row?
sentences.zh: 你可以把骨牌排成長長一排嗎？

sentences.en: One broken oven caused a domino effect in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 一台壞掉的烤箱在廚房裡引發了骨牌效應。

sentences.en: A late delivery can start a domino effect at a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 送貨延遲可能在餐廳裡引發骨牌效應。

sentences.en: Did you see that long chain of falling dominoes online?
sentences.zh: 你在網路上看過那一長串倒下的骨牌嗎？

gloss_note: a downward trend 下降趨勢

sentences.en: Sales have been on a downward trend since spring.
sentences.zh: 銷售額從春天以來一直呈下降趨勢。

sentences.en: Is the downward trend in prices going to continue?
sentences.zh: 價格的下降趨勢會持續下去嗎？

sentences.en: Rising rent put downward pressure on our profits.
sentences.zh: 租金上漲對我們的利潤造成了下行壓力。

sentences.en: Did you notice the downward turn in customer interest?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到客戶興趣出現下滑嗎？

sentences.en: The trail has a steep downward slope near the end.
sentences.zh: 這條步道接近盡頭處有陡峭的下坡。

sentences.en: The graph shows a clear downward curve after July.
sentences.zh: 圖表顯示七月之後有明顯向下的曲線。

gloss_note: a rough draft 草稿；draft a plan

sentences.en: Can you read my first draft of the report?
sentences.zh: 你可以看一下我這份報告的初稿嗎？

sentences.en: I'll draft the email and send it to you.
sentences.zh: 我來起草這封電子郵件，再寄給你。

sentences.en: She is drafting a letter to her landlord.
sentences.zh: 她正在起草一封給房東的信。

sentences.en: Have you finished the draft of the proposal yet?
sentences.zh: 你完成提案的草稿了嗎？

sentences.en: This is only a rough draft, so please be kind.
sentences.zh: 這只是粗略的草稿，請手下留情。

sentences.en: We drafted a new schedule for the team.
sentences.zh: 我們為團隊擬了一份新的時程表。

sentences.en: I dread going to the dentist.
sentences.zh: 我很怕去看牙醫。

sentences.en: Do you dread Monday mornings as much as I do?
sentences.zh: 你也像我一樣害怕週一早上嗎？

sentences.en: She felt a deep dread before the results came out.
sentences.zh: 成績公布前，她心裡充滿憂懼。

sentences.en: He dreaded telling his boss about the mistake.
sentences.zh: 他很怕把這個錯誤告訴老闆。

sentences.en: What do you dread most about moving?
sentences.zh: 你搬家時最怕什麼？

sentences.en: We waited in dread as the storm came closer.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨逼近時，我們懷著恐懼等待著。

sentences.en: The boat slowly drifted away from the dock.
sentences.zh: 小船慢慢從碼頭漂走了。

sentences.en: Clouds drifted slowly across the sky.
sentences.zh: 雲朵緩緩飄過天空。

sentences.en: Our conversation drifted away from the main topic.
sentences.zh: 我們的對話漸漸偏離了主題。

sentences.en: Has the project drifted away from its original goal?
sentences.zh: 這個專案是不是漸漸偏離了原本的目標？

sentences.en: Why did you two drift apart after college?
sentences.zh: 你們兩個為什麼大學畢業後就漸行漸遠？

sentences.en: Prices have drifted lower over the past month.
sentences.zh: 價格在過去一個月裡緩慢走低。

gloss_note: a severe drought 嚴重乾旱

sentences.en: The drought has hurt farmers across the region.
sentences.zh: 乾旱傷害了整個地區的農民。

sentences.en: Will the drought raise grocery prices this year?
sentences.zh: 乾旱會讓今年的生鮮雜貨價格上漲嗎？

sentences.en: Our supplier delayed shipments because of the drought.
sentences.zh: 因為乾旱，我們的供應商延後了出貨。

sentences.en: The state asked residents to save water during the drought.
sentences.zh: 州政府在乾旱期間要求居民節約用水。

sentences.en: How long has the drought lasted in your area?
sentences.zh: 你們那一帶的乾旱持續多久了？

sentences.en: It was the worst drought in fifty years.
sentences.zh: 那是五十年來最嚴重的乾旱。

gloss_note: feel drowsy 覺得昏昏欲睡

sentences.en: This cold medicine makes me drowsy.
sentences.zh: 這種感冒藥會讓我昏昏欲睡。

sentences.en: Do you feel drowsy after lunch every day?
sentences.zh: 你每天午餐後都覺得昏昏欲睡嗎？

sentences.en: Don't drive if you're feeling drowsy.
sentences.zh: 如果你覺得昏昏欲睡，就不要開車。

sentences.en: The warm room made the students drowsy.
sentences.zh: 溫暖的教室讓學生們昏昏欲睡。

sentences.en: Are you too drowsy to finish the report?
sentences.zh: 你睏到沒辦法完成這份報告了嗎？

sentences.en: The baby grew drowsy in my arms.
sentences.zh: 寶寶在我懷裡漸漸昏昏欲睡。

gloss_note: a dusty road 塵土飛揚的路

sentences.en: The attic was dusty, so I started sneezing.
sentences.zh: 閣樓滿是灰塵，我就開始打噴嚏了。

sentences.en: Why is everything in this room so dusty?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個房間裡的東西都這麼多灰塵？

sentences.en: Could you wipe the dusty shelves for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我擦一下積滿灰塵的架子嗎？

sentences.en: He pulled a dusty box out of the closet.
sentences.zh: 他從衣櫃裡拿出一個積滿灰塵的盒子。

sentences.en: The road was dusty after weeks without rain.
sentences.zh: 好幾週沒下雨，路上塵土飛揚。

sentences.en: My car gets dusty quickly in the summer.
sentences.zh: 我的車在夏天很快就會蒙上灰塵。

sentences.en: She dyed her hair dark brown last weekend.
sentences.zh: 她上週末把頭髮染成了深棕色。

sentences.en: Are you going to dye your hair again?
sentences.zh: 你又要染頭髮了嗎？

sentences.en: The shirt was colored with natural dye from plants.
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫是用植物的天然染料上色的。

sentences.en: Can you dye this white dress blue for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這件白洋裝染成藍色嗎？

sentences.en: The students dyed cloth in art class.
sentences.zh: 學生們在美術課上染布。

sentences.en: Does this dye wash out easily?
sentences.zh: 這種染料容易洗掉嗎？

gloss_note: a family dynasty 家族世家

sentences.en: Which dynasty built this old stone bridge?
sentences.zh: 這座古老的石橋是哪個朝代建造的？

sentences.en: The Tang dynasty lasted for nearly three hundred years.
sentences.zh: 唐朝持續了將近三百年。

sentences.en: Our history teacher loves talking about the Han dynasty.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史老師很愛談漢朝。

sentences.en: The family built a restaurant dynasty over three generations.
sentences.zh: 這個家族花了三代的時間建立起餐飲王朝。

sentences.en: Is it hard for a family dynasty to last three generations?
sentences.zh: 家族世家要延續三代很難嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has a vase from the Song dynasty.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有一只宋朝的花瓶。

sentences.en: He made an earnest effort to learn Spanish.
sentences.zh: 他很認真地努力學習西班牙文。

sentences.en: She gave an earnest apology to the customer.
sentences.zh: 她誠摯地向顧客道歉。

sentences.en: Is she an earnest worker, or just trying to impress us?
sentences.zh: 她是個認真的員工，還是只是想給我們留下好印象？

sentences.en: The young intern is earnest and always on time.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的實習生很認真，而且總是準時。

sentences.en: Did he make an earnest attempt to fix the problem?
sentences.zh: 他有認真設法解決這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: We began working on the project in earnest this week.
sentences.zh: 我們這週開始認真著手這個專案。

sentences.en: I forgot my earphones, so I can't listen to music.
sentences.zh: 我忘了帶耳機，所以沒辦法聽音樂。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your earphones for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你借一下耳機嗎？

sentences.en: These earphones hurt my ears after an hour.
sentences.zh: 這副耳機戴一個小時後我的耳朵會痛。

sentences.en: Please use earphones on the train.
sentences.zh: 請在火車上使用耳機。

sentences.en: Where did you buy those wireless earphones?
sentences.zh: 你那副無線耳機是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: She wore earphones to block out the noise.
sentences.zh: 她戴著耳機來隔絕噪音。

sentences.en: The oil spill caused an ecological disaster along the coast.
sentences.zh: 漏油事件在海岸沿線造成了生態災難。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the ecological effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究氣候變遷對生態的影響。

sentences.en: Is this new highway an ecological risk for the wetlands?
sentences.zh: 這條新公路對濕地來說是生態風險嗎？

sentences.en: Our class visited an ecological reserve last week.
sentences.zh: 我們班上週參觀了一處生態保護區。

sentences.en: Why is the ecological balance of the lake changing?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這座湖的生態平衡正在改變？

sentences.en: My company wants to reduce its ecological footprint.
sentences.zh: 我的公司想減少它的生態足跡。

gloss_note: the ecology of a lake 湖泊生態

sentences.en: She is studying ecology at the state university.
sentences.zh: 她在州立大學讀生態學。

sentences.en: Pollution has harmed the ecology of this lake.
sentences.zh: 汙染損害了這座湖的生態。

sentences.en: Did you take an ecology class in college?
sentences.zh: 你大學時有修過生態學的課嗎？

sentences.en: My roommate loves ecology and spends weekends in the woods.
sentences.zh: 我室友熱愛生態學，週末都待在森林裡。

sentences.en: How does a new dam change the local ecology?
sentences.zh: 一座新水壩會如何改變當地的生態？

sentences.en: The ecology of the desert is more complex than people think.
sentences.zh: 沙漠的生態比人們想的更複雜。

sentences.en: The country is facing an economic crisis.
sentences.zh: 這個國家正面臨經濟危機。

sentences.en: What is the economic situation like in your town?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上的經濟狀況如何？

sentences.en: Rent is a big economic burden for young families.
sentences.zh: 房租對年輕家庭來說是很大的經濟負擔。

sentences.en: The new factory will bring economic growth to our city.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將為我們的城市帶來經濟成長。

sentences.en: Do you think economic problems affect people's happiness?
sentences.zh: 你覺得經濟問題會影響人們的快樂嗎？

sentences.en: My dad always reads the economic news at breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸早餐時總是看經濟新聞。

sentences.en: The plan is economically sound for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫在經濟上對小型企業來說是穩健的。

sentences.en: Can we run this office more economically?
sentences.zh: 我們可以更節省地經營這間辦公室嗎？

sentences.en: She shops economically by buying in bulk.
sentences.zh: 她靠大量購買來精打細算地購物。

sentences.en: Is it economically possible to open a second store?
sentences.zh: 開第二間分店在經濟上可行嗎？

sentences.en: The new engine uses fuel economically.
sentences.zh: 新引擎用油很節省。

sentences.en: Many small towns are struggling economically.
sentences.zh: 許多小鎮在經濟上都很掙扎。

sentences.en: She majored in economics at a state university.
sentences.zh: 她在州立大學主修經濟學。

sentences.en: Did you like your economics class?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡你的經濟學課嗎？

sentences.en: Economics explains why prices go up when supplies are low.
sentences.zh: 經濟學解釋了為什麼供應量低時價格會上漲。

sentences.en: A friend of mine wants to study economics next year.
sentences.zh: 我有個朋友明年想念經濟學。

sentences.en: Is economics harder than math for you?
sentences.zh: 對你來說，經濟學比數學難嗎？

sentences.en: The economics of running a small cafe are tough.
sentences.zh: 經營一間小咖啡館在經濟層面上很不容易。

sentences.en: We need to economize on travel costs this year.
sentences.zh: 我們今年得節省差旅費用。

sentences.en: How can our department economize without cutting jobs?
sentences.zh: 我們部門要怎麼節省開支又不裁員？

sentences.en: Many families economize by cooking at home.
sentences.zh: 許多家庭靠在家煮飯來省錢。

sentences.en: Did the company economize on office supplies last quarter?
sentences.zh: 公司上一季有在辦公用品上節省開支嗎？

sentences.en: She economized for a year to buy a car.
sentences.zh: 她省吃儉用了一年，就為了買一輛車。

sentences.en: Let's economize by sharing a rental car.
sentences.zh: 我們合租一輛車來省錢吧。

sentences.en: The new software improved our efficiency a lot.
sentences.zh: 新軟體大幅提升了我們的效率。

sentences.en: Is energy efficiency important when you buy appliances?
sentences.zh: 買家電時，能源效率重要嗎？

sentences.en: I admire the efficiency of this restaurant's staff.
sentences.zh: 我很佩服這間餐廳員工的效率。

sentences.en: How can we increase efficiency in the warehouse?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提升倉庫的效率？

sentences.en: Efficiency matters more than speed in this job.
sentences.zh: 在這份工作中，效率比速度更重要。

sentences.en: The car's fuel efficiency is great for long trips.
sentences.zh: 這輛車的燃油效率很適合長途旅行。

sentences.en: They planned an elaborate surprise party for her.
sentences.zh: 他們為她策畫了一場精心安排的驚喜派對。

sentences.en: Could you elaborate on your budget idea?
sentences.zh: 你可以詳細說明一下你的預算想法嗎？

sentences.en: The chef made an elaborate dessert for the guests.
sentences.zh: 主廚為賓客做了一道精緻複雜的甜點。

sentences.en: She didn't elaborate on why she quit.
sentences.zh: 她沒有詳述自己為何辭職。

sentences.en: Why is the wedding plan so elaborate?
sentences.zh: 這場婚禮的計畫為什麼這麼講究複雜？

sentences.en: The professor elaborated on the main points after class.
sentences.zh: 教授下課後進一步闡述了重點。

sentences.en: These pants have an elastic waistband.
sentences.zh: 這條褲子有鬆緊腰帶。

sentences.en: Is this fabric elastic enough for exercise?
sentences.zh: 這種布料的彈性足夠拿來運動嗎？

sentences.en: Is demand for this product elastic?
sentences.zh: 這項產品的需求有彈性嗎？

sentences.en: The strap is elastic, so it fits every size.
sentences.zh: 這條帶子有彈性，所以每種尺寸都合用。

sentences.en: I need to sew new elastic into these shorts.
sentences.zh: 我得在這條短褲裡縫上新的鬆緊帶。

sentences.en: Young skin is more elastic than older skin.
sentences.zh: 年輕的皮膚比年長的皮膚更有彈性。

sentences.en: This store sells electronics and kitchen appliances.
sentences.zh: 這間店販售電子產品和廚房家電。

sentences.en: Where is the electronics section in this store?
sentences.zh: 這間店的電子產品區在哪裡？

sentences.en: A friend of mine works in the electronics industry.
sentences.zh: 我有個朋友在電子業工作。

sentences.en: Do you recycle your old electronics?
sentences.zh: 你會回收舊的電子產品嗎？

sentences.en: Please turn off all electronics during takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛期間請關閉所有電子產品。

sentences.en: She studied electronics before becoming an engineer.
sentences.zh: 她在成為工程師之前學的是電子學。

gloss_note: elevate one's mood 提振心情

sentences.en: Regular exercise can elevate your mood.
sentences.zh: 規律運動可以提振你的心情。

sentences.en: The company hopes to elevate its image with a new logo.
sentences.zh: 公司希望靠新標誌來提升形象。

sentences.en: Can a better menu elevate the restaurant's reputation?
sentences.zh: 更好的菜單能提升這間餐廳的名聲嗎？

sentences.en: Please elevate your foot to reduce the swelling.
sentences.zh: 請把腳抬高以減輕腫脹。

sentences.en: Good teachers elevate the entire school.
sentences.zh: 好老師能提升整所學校的水準。

sentences.en: How can we elevate customer service at our stores?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提升各分店的客戶服務？

gloss_note: at high elevation 在高海拔處

sentences.en: This town sits at an elevation of 2,000 feet.
sentences.zh: 這座小鎮海拔2,000英尺。

sentences.en: What is the elevation of the airport?
sentences.zh: 這座機場的海拔高度是多少？

sentences.en: The air feels thinner at a higher elevation.
sentences.zh: 在海拔較高的地方，空氣感覺比較稀薄。

sentences.en: Do you get headaches at high elevation?
sentences.zh: 你在高海拔地區會頭痛嗎？

sentences.en: Our hotel is at a low elevation, so it's warm.
sentences.zh: 我們的飯店海拔很低，所以很溫暖。

sentences.en: The map shows the elevation of each hill.
sentences.zh: 這張地圖標示出每座山丘的海拔。

sentences.en: We need to eliminate waste in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們得消除廚房裡的浪費。

sentences.en: How can we eliminate mistakes in the report?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼消除報告裡的錯誤？

sentences.en: Their team was eliminated in the first round.
sentences.zh: 他們的隊伍在第一輪就被淘汰了。

sentences.en: The company eliminated fifty jobs last year.
sentences.zh: 公司去年裁撤了五十個職缺。

sentences.en: Did the doctor tell you to eliminate sugar from your diet?
sentences.zh: 醫生有叫你把糖從飲食中剔除嗎？

sentences.en: Good planning can eliminate most of the stress.
sentences.zh: 良好的規劃可以消除大部分的壓力。

gloss_note: the elimination of waste 消除浪費

sentences.en: The elimination of waste saved us thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 消除浪費為我們省下了好幾千美元。

sentences.en: Is the elimination of plastic bags realistic?
sentences.zh: 全面淘汰塑膠袋實際可行嗎？

sentences.en: She was shocked by her team's elimination from the tournament.
sentences.zh: 她對自己的隊伍在錦標賽中遭到淘汰感到震驚。

sentences.en: The doctor recommended the elimination of salt from his diet.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議他把鹽從飲食中剔除。

sentences.en: What led to the elimination of that old rule?
sentences.zh: 是什麼原因讓那條舊規定被廢除？

sentences.en: Fans were upset about the elimination of the home team.
sentences.zh: 球迷對地主隊遭到淘汰感到難過。

sentences.en: If we're full, we can eat elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 如果客滿，我們可以去別的地方吃。

sentences.en: Is there a better price elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 別的地方有更便宜的價格嗎？

sentences.en: She looked for a job elsewhere after the layoff.
sentences.zh: 裁員之後，她到別處找工作。

sentences.en: I couldn't find parking here, so I parked elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 這裡找不到停車位，所以我停在別處。

sentences.en: Do you want to take this conversation elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 你想換個地方談這件事嗎？

sentences.en: The rest of the family lives elsewhere in the state.
sentences.zh: 其餘的家人住在州內的其他地方。

gloss_note: blush with embarrassment 尷尬臉紅

sentences.en: He turned red with embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 他尷尬得臉都紅了。

sentences.en: Was it an embarrassment to lose the first game?
sentences.zh: 輸掉第一場比賽很丟臉嗎？

sentences.en: After tripping on stage, she wanted to hide from embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 在舞台上絆倒後，她尷尬得想躲起來。

sentences.en: To avoid embarrassment, check your spelling before you send it.
sentences.zh: 為了避免尷尬，寄出前請檢查拼字。

sentences.en: Did you feel any embarrassment when you forgot his name?
sentences.zh: 你忘記他的名字時有覺得尷尬嗎？

sentences.en: The failed demo was an embarrassment for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 這次失敗的展示對整個團隊來說很丟臉。

sentences.en: A rabbit emerged from behind the bushes.
sentences.zh: 一隻兔子從灌木叢後面出現。

sentences.en: When did the new problem emerge?
sentences.zh: 這個新問題是什麼時候出現的？

sentences.en: The sun emerged after a week of rain.
sentences.zh: 連下一週的雨之後，太陽露臉了。

sentences.en: New facts may emerge during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 會議期間可能會有新的事實浮現。

sentences.en: Did a clear winner emerge from the contest?
sentences.zh: 比賽中有出現明顯的贏家嗎？

sentences.en: She emerged from the store with three bags.
sentences.zh: 她提著三個袋子從店裡走出來。

sentences.en: Our school puts great emphasis on reading.
sentences.zh: 我們學校非常重視閱讀。

sentences.en: What is the main emphasis of this training?
sentences.zh: 這次訓練的重點是什麼？

sentences.en: The teacher placed emphasis on clear writing.
sentences.zh: 老師強調清楚的寫作。

sentences.en: Is there too much emphasis on test scores?
sentences.zh: 是不是太強調考試分數了？

sentences.en: She spoke with emphasis to make her point clear.
sentences.zh: 她加重語氣說話，好讓重點更清楚。

sentences.en: The company shifted its emphasis to online sales.
sentences.zh: 公司把重心轉移到網路銷售。

gloss_note: a food empire 食品王國

sentences.en: The Roman Empire once ruled much of Europe.
sentences.zh: 羅馬帝國曾統治歐洲的大部分地區。

sentences.en: How did the empire grow so large?
sentences.zh: 這個帝國是怎麼變得這麼大的？

sentences.en: He built a food empire from one small cart.
sentences.zh: 他從一輛小推車起家，打造出一個食品王國。

sentences.en: Did the old empire fall because of money problems?
sentences.zh: 這個古老的帝國是因為財政問題而滅亡的嗎？

sentences.en: She runs a small media empire from her home office.
sentences.zh: 她在家裡的辦公室經營一個小型媒體王國。

sentences.en: The museum shows how the empire traded with distant lands.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館展示了這個帝國如何與遙遠的地方貿易。

gloss_note: enact a law 制定法律；正式用語

sentences.en: The city council will enact the new parking rules in June.
sentences.zh: 市議會將在六月頒布新的停車規定。

sentences.en: Will the board enact the new travel policy this month?
sentences.zh: 董事會這個月會制定新的差旅政策嗎？

sentences.en: Lawmakers enacted a law to protect workers' wages last year.
sentences.zh: 議員們去年制定了一項保護勞工薪資的法律。

sentences.en: When was the privacy law enacted?
sentences.zh: 這項隱私法是什麼時候頒布的？

sentences.en: Our company cannot enact a new dress code without a vote.
sentences.zh: 沒有經過投票，我們公司不能制定新的服裝規定。

sentences.en: Is the state ready to enact stricter safety rules for factories?
sentences.zh: 州政府準備好要制定更嚴格的工廠安全規定了嗎？

gloss_note: encounter a problem 遇到問題

sentences.en: Did you encounter any problems during the trip?
sentences.zh: 你旅途中有遇到什麼問題嗎？

sentences.en: I encountered my old teacher at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我在雜貨店遇到了以前的老師。

sentences.en: Hikers may encounter bears on this trail.
sentences.zh: 健行者在這條步道上可能會遇到熊。

sentences.en: How often do you encounter rude customers?
sentences.zh: 你多常遇到無禮的顧客？

sentences.en: We encounter many new words when we read novels.
sentences.zh: 讀小說的時候，我們會碰到很多生字。

sentences.en: Their brief encounter at the airport changed everything.
sentences.zh: 他們在機場短暫的相遇改變了一切。

gloss_note: online encyclopedia 線上百科全書

sentences.en: Our library still keeps a set of old encyclopedias.
sentences.zh: 我們的圖書館還保留著一套舊的百科全書。

sentences.en: Do you know which online encyclopedia is free to use?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪個線上百科全書可以免費使用嗎？

sentences.en: The company sells encyclopedias to schools across the country.
sentences.zh: 這家公司把百科全書賣給全國各地的學校。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your encyclopedia for my report?
sentences.zh: 我的報告可以跟你借百科全書用嗎？

sentences.en: She wrote an article for a medical encyclopedia.
sentences.zh: 她替一本醫學百科全書寫了一篇文章。

sentences.en: An encyclopedia entry is a good place to start your research.
sentences.zh: 百科全書的條目是開始做研究的好起點。

sentences.en: Texting while driving can endanger everyone on the road.
sentences.zh: 開車時傳訊息會危及路上所有人的安全。

sentences.en: Does this chemical endanger the workers in the factory?
sentences.zh: 這種化學物質會危害工廠裡的工人嗎？

sentences.en: Pollution may endanger many species of fish.
sentences.zh: 汙染可能使許多種魚類瀕臨絕種。

sentences.en: Why would you endanger your health for a deadline?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要為了趕截止日期而危害自己的健康？

sentences.en: Please don't endanger the children by leaving the gate open.
sentences.zh: 請不要把門開著，讓孩子們陷入危險。

sentences.en: The oil spill endangered the local fishing business.
sentences.zh: 漏油事件危及了當地的漁業。

sentences.en: The university's endowment grew by eight percent last year.
sentences.zh: 這所大學的捐贈基金去年成長了百分之八。

sentences.en: How large is your school's endowment?
sentences.zh: 你們學校的捐贈基金有多少？

sentences.en: A generous endowment will pay for new scholarships.
sentences.zh: 一筆慷慨的捐款將用來支付新的獎學金。

sentences.en: The museum lives on income from its endowment.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館靠捐贈基金的收益維持運作。

sentences.en: Did the family set up an endowment for the hospital?
sentences.zh: 這個家族有為醫院設立捐贈基金嗎？

sentences.en: Our finance team manages the endowment very carefully.
sentences.zh: 我們的財務團隊非常謹慎地管理這筆基金。

sentences.en: I can't endure this noise any longer.
sentences.zh: 我再也無法忍受這種噪音了。

sentences.en: How long did the workers endure the heat?
sentences.zh: 工人們忍受了多久的高溫？

sentences.en: Their friendship has endured for over thirty years.
sentences.zh: 他們的友誼已經持續超過三十年了。

sentences.en: Can small shops endure a long economic slowdown?
sentences.zh: 小商店撐得過長期的景氣低迷嗎？

sentences.en: She endured months of pain before the surgery.
sentences.zh: 手術前，她忍受了好幾個月的疼痛。

sentences.en: Good design endures even when styles change.
sentences.zh: 即使流行改變，好的設計依然長存。

sentences.en: He studies engineering at a state university.
sentences.zh: 他在一所州立大學主修工程。

sentences.en: Is engineering a hard major for beginners?
sentences.zh: 工程對初學者來說是很難的科系嗎？

sentences.en: The engineering team fixed the software bug overnight.
sentences.zh: 工程團隊連夜修好了軟體的錯誤。

sentences.en: Mina works in civil engineering.
sentences.zh: 米娜從事土木工程的工作。

sentences.en: What kind of engineering does your company do?
sentences.zh: 你們公司做哪一類的工程？

sentences.en: The bridge is a great piece of engineering.
sentences.zh: 這座橋是一項了不起的工程傑作。

gloss_note: enlarge a photo 放大照片

sentences.en: Can you enlarge this photo to fit the frame?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這張照片放大到剛好放進相框嗎？

sentences.en: The company plans to enlarge its main office next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫明年擴大總辦公室的空間。

sentences.en: Please enlarge the text so I can read it.
sentences.zh: 請把文字放大，這樣我才看得到。

sentences.en: Would it cost much to enlarge the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 把廚房擴大要花很多錢嗎？

sentences.en: Click here to enlarge the map.
sentences.zh: 點這裡就能放大地圖。

sentences.en: The city will enlarge the airport to handle more flights.
sentences.zh: 市政府將擴建機場，以容納更多航班。

sentences.en: This enlargement of the photo is too blurry.
sentences.zh: 這張放大後的照片太模糊了。

sentences.en: How much is a poster-size enlargement?
sentences.zh: 海報大小的放大照要多少錢？

sentences.en: The enlargement of the parking lot took three months.
sentences.zh: 停車場的擴建花了三個月。

sentences.en: Do you offer free enlargement of digital pictures?
sentences.zh: 你們有提供數位照片免費放大的服務嗎？

sentences.en: The school board voted for the enlargement of the library.
sentences.zh: 學校董事會投票通過了擴建圖書館。

sentences.en: Each page allows quick enlargement of small text.
sentences.zh: 每一頁都能快速放大小字。

gloss_note: an enormous amount 極大的量

sentences.en: The stadium was enormous, and we got lost.
sentences.zh: 那座體育場大得不得了，我們還迷路了。

sentences.en: Did the new factory cost an enormous amount of money?
sentences.zh: 新工廠花了一大筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: She has an enormous pile of homework this weekend.
sentences.zh: 她這個週末有一大堆作業要寫。

sentences.en: What is that enormous truck doing in front of our house?
sentences.zh: 那輛巨大的卡車停在我們家前面做什麼？

sentences.en: The storm caused enormous damage along the coast.
sentences.zh: 這場風暴對沿岸造成了龐大的損失。

sentences.en: His speech had an enormous effect on the team.
sentences.zh: 他的演說對團隊產生了極大的影響。

gloss_note: ensure that + 子句 確保…

sentences.en: Please ensure that all the doors are locked before you leave.
sentences.zh: 離開前請確保所有的門都已上鎖。

sentences.en: How can we ensure the package arrives on time?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼確保包裹準時送到？

sentences.en: The new rule ensures fair treatment for everyone.
sentences.zh: 這項新規定確保每個人都受到公平對待。

sentences.en: Will the teacher ensure that every student gets a chance to speak?
sentences.zh: 老師會確保每位學生都有機會發言嗎？

sentences.en: Regular checkups ensure that small problems are found early.
sentences.zh: 定期健康檢查能確保小毛病及早被發現。

sentences.en: The airline ensured our bags would reach the hotel.
sentences.zh: 航空公司保證我們的行李會送到飯店。

gloss_note: entail + 名詞 需要、牽涉到…

sentences.en: What does this job entail?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要做些什麼？

sentences.en: Opening a new store entails a lot of paperwork.
sentences.zh: 開一家新店需要處理大量的文書作業。

sentences.en: The merger will entail some layoffs.
sentences.zh: 這次合併勢必牽涉到一些裁員。

sentences.en: Does the promotion entail moving to another city?
sentences.zh: 這次升遷需要搬到別的城市嗎？

sentences.en: Moving into a bigger office would entail higher rent.
sentences.zh: 搬進更大的辦公室會讓租金變高。

sentences.en: Learning to fly a plane entailed years of training.
sentences.zh: 學習駕駛飛機需要好幾年的訓練。

sentences.en: The clown entertained the kids at the birthday party.
sentences.zh: 小丑在生日派對上逗孩子們開心。

sentences.en: Do you often entertain guests at your house?
sentences.zh: 你常在家裡招待客人嗎？

sentences.en: We need a way to entertain the kids on the long flight.
sentences.zh: 我們得想辦法讓孩子們在長途飛行中有事做。

sentences.en: She entertains clients with dinner and a show.
sentences.zh: 她用晚餐和表演來款待客戶。

sentences.en: Can this movie entertain both adults and children?
sentences.zh: 這部電影能讓大人小孩都看得開心嗎？

sentences.en: Our boss will entertain visitors from Japan tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 老闆明天要接待來自日本的訪客。

sentences.en: What do you do for entertainment on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末都做什麼消遣？

sentences.en: The hotel offers live entertainment every night.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店每晚都有現場表演。

sentences.en: Online entertainment is a huge business now.
sentences.zh: 線上娛樂現在是一門龐大的生意。

sentences.en: This magazine covers news about movies and entertainment.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌報導電影和娛樂方面的消息。

sentences.en: Is there any entertainment on the flight to Denver?
sentences.zh: 飛往丹佛的班機上有什麼娛樂節目嗎？

sentences.en: The mall has restaurants, shops, and entertainment for families.
sentences.zh: 這間購物中心有餐廳、商店，還有適合家庭的娛樂設施。

sentences.en: The crowd cheered enthusiastically when the band came out.
sentences.zh: 樂團一出場，群眾就熱烈歡呼。

sentences.en: She answered the interviewer's questions enthusiastically.
sentences.zh: 她熱情地回答了面試官的問題。

sentences.en: Did the staff respond enthusiastically to the new plan?
sentences.zh: 員工對新計畫的反應熱烈嗎？

sentences.en: How enthusiastically did customers welcome the new product?
sentences.zh: 顧客對這項新產品的歡迎程度有多熱烈？

sentences.en: He enthusiastically shook hands with every guest.
sentences.zh: 他熱情地和每一位來賓握手。

sentences.en: Our neighbors enthusiastically joined the cleanup day.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居熱烈參加了社區清掃日。

sentences.en: We choose environmentally friendly cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 我們選用環保的清潔用品。

sentences.en: Is this packaging environmentally safe?
sentences.zh: 這種包裝對環境無害嗎？

sentences.en: Environmentally aware shoppers prefer cloth bags.
sentences.zh: 有環保意識的購物者偏好使用布袋。

sentences.en: Is it environmentally smart to buy bottled water?
sentences.zh: 買瓶裝水對環境來說是明智的嗎？

sentences.en: The plant is run in an environmentally responsible way.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠以對環境負責的方式營運。

sentences.en: Many travelers now choose environmentally conscious hotels.
sentences.zh: 現在有許多旅客會選擇重視環保的飯店。

sentences.en: All the office equipment needs to be checked.
sentences.zh: 所有的辦公設備都需要檢查。

sentences.en: Where do you keep the camping equipment?
sentences.zh: 你把露營用具放在哪裡？

sentences.en: The gym bought new equipment last month.
sentences.zh: 健身房上個月買了新器材。

sentences.en: Is this equipment safe for young children?
sentences.zh: 這項器材對年幼的孩子安全嗎？

sentences.en: Workers must wear safety equipment on the site.
sentences.zh: 工人在工地必須穿戴安全裝備。

sentences.en: We rent sports equipment at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 我們在櫃檯出租運動器材。

gloss_note: equivalence of A and B 等值

sentences.en: Is there any equivalence between these two degrees?
sentences.zh: 這兩個學位之間有等值的關係嗎？

sentences.en: Does the school recognize the equivalence of foreign diplomas?
sentences.zh: 學校承認外國文憑的同等效力嗎？

sentences.en: The equivalence of the two results surprised the research team.
sentences.zh: 兩項結果相等，讓研究團隊很驚訝。

sentences.en: This table shows the equivalence between miles and kilometers.
sentences.zh: 這張表格列出英里與公里之間的對等換算。

sentences.en: Students noticed the equivalence of the two fractions.
sentences.zh: 學生們發現這兩個分數是相等的。

sentences.en: The study found no equivalence between the old and new methods.
sentences.zh: 這項研究發現新舊方法之間並不等值。

sentences.en: We live in an era of fast change.
sentences.zh: 我們生活在一個快速變遷的時代。

sentences.en: What was life like in the era before cell phones?
sentences.zh: 在還沒有手機的年代，生活是什麼樣子？

sentences.en: This factory belongs to a different era.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠屬於另一個年代。

sentences.en: That song reminds me of the era of my childhood.
sentences.zh: 那首歌讓我想起我童年的那個年代。

sentences.en: The new CEO promises a fresh era for the company.
sentences.zh: 新任執行長承諾公司將迎來新的時代。

sentences.en: Did the invention mark the start of a new era?
sentences.zh: 這項發明是否標誌著一個新時代的開始？

gloss_note: take the escalator 搭電扶梯

sentences.en: Take the escalator to the second floor.
sentences.zh: 搭電扶梯到二樓。

sentences.en: Where is the escalator in this mall?
sentences.zh: 這間購物中心的電扶梯在哪裡？

sentences.en: The escalator is broken, so we need to use the stairs.
sentences.zh: 電扶梯壞了，所以我們得走樓梯。

sentences.en: Please hold the handrail on the escalator.
sentences.zh: 搭乘電扶梯時請扶好扶手。

sentences.en: Do you want to take the escalator or the elevator?
sentences.zh: 你想搭電扶梯還是電梯？

sentences.en: Is the escalator going up or down?
sentences.zh: 這部電扶梯是往上還是往下？

sentences.en: I'll have a double espresso, please.
sentences.zh: 麻煩給我一杯雙份濃縮咖啡。

sentences.en: Does this machine make real espresso?
sentences.zh: 這台機器能做出真正的義式濃縮咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: She drinks an espresso after every lunch.
sentences.zh: 她每次吃完午餐都會喝一杯濃縮咖啡。

sentences.en: Espresso is the base of most coffee drinks.
sentences.zh: 濃縮咖啡是大多數咖啡飲品的基底。

sentences.en: Would you like an espresso or a regular coffee?
sentences.zh: 你想要濃縮咖啡還是一般的咖啡？

sentences.en: The cafe's espresso tastes rich and a little bitter.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店的濃縮咖啡味道濃郁，帶一點苦味。

sentences.en: The essence of good service is listening.
sentences.zh: 好服務的精髓在於傾聽。

sentences.en: Can you explain the essence of the plan in one sentence?
sentences.zh: 你能用一句話說明這項計畫的核心嗎？

sentences.en: What is the essence of our company's culture?
sentences.zh: 我們公司文化的本質是什麼？

sentences.en: The essence of her argument is simple.
sentences.zh: 她論點的核心很簡單。

sentences.en: The report captures the essence of the debate.
sentences.zh: 這份報告抓住了這場辯論的精髓。

sentences.en: This film shows the essence of small-town life.
sentences.zh: 這部電影呈現出小鎮生活的本質。

sentences.en: Water is essential for all living things.
sentences.zh: 水對所有生物來說都是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: Is a college degree essential for this job?
sentences.zh: 這份工作一定要有大學學歷嗎？

sentences.en: Please bring only the essential items.
sentences.zh: 請只帶必要的物品。

sentences.en: What are the essential skills for a nurse?
sentences.zh: 護理師必備的技能有哪些？

sentences.en: Good communication is essential to teamwork.
sentences.zh: 良好的溝通對團隊合作是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: The essential ingredient in this soup is fresh ginger.
sentences.zh: 這道湯最關鍵的食材是新鮮的薑。

gloss_note: establish a company 成立公司

sentences.en: The company was established in 1998.
sentences.zh: 這家公司成立於1998年。

sentences.en: How do we establish trust with new clients?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼和新客戶建立信任？

sentences.en: The school plans to establish a new art program.
sentences.zh: 學校打算設立一個新的藝術課程。

sentences.en: When did your family establish this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你們家是什麼時候創立這間餐廳的？

sentences.en: Our teacher helped us establish good study habits.
sentences.zh: 老師幫助我們建立良好的讀書習慣。

sentences.en: Let's establish clear rules before the trip starts.
sentences.zh: 我們在旅行開始前先訂好明確的規則吧。

sentences.en: This establishment does not accept personal checks.
sentences.zh: 本店不接受個人支票。

sentences.en: Is that restaurant a family-owned establishment?
sentences.zh: 那間餐廳是家族經營的店嗎？

sentences.en: The bakery is a well-known establishment in the city.
sentences.zh: 這間麵包店是市內知名的店家。

sentences.en: The establishment of the new branch took six months.
sentences.zh: 新分公司的設立花了六個月。

sentences.en: Who paid for the establishment of the village library?
sentences.zh: 是誰出錢設立了這座村子的圖書館？

sentences.en: The establishment closes at ten on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 這家店平日晚上十點打烊。

gloss_note: a rough estimate 粗略估計

sentences.en: Can you estimate how long the repair will take?
sentences.zh: 你能估計修理要花多久時間嗎？

sentences.en: The mechanic gave me a written estimate for the repairs.
sentences.zh: 技師給了我一份書面的維修估價單。

sentences.en: We estimate that sales will grow by five percent.
sentences.zh: 我們估計銷售額會成長百分之五。

sentences.en: Could I get a free estimate for painting the house?
sentences.zh: 我可以拿到粉刷房子的免費估價嗎？

sentences.en: Experts estimated the crowd at about ten thousand.
sentences.zh: 專家估計群眾約有一萬人。

sentences.en: My rough estimate is about two hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 我粗略的估計大約是兩百美元。

sentences.en: The city is home to many ethnic groups.
sentences.zh: 這座城市住著許多不同的族群。

sentences.en: The festival celebrates the ethnic traditions of the area.
sentences.zh: 這個節慶慶祝當地的民族傳統。

sentences.en: Students from every ethnic background study here.
sentences.zh: 來自各種族裔背景的學生都在這裡就讀。

sentences.en: What ethnic groups live in your neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你們社區裡住著哪些族群？

sentences.en: Does the survey ask about your ethnic background?
sentences.zh: 這份問卷有問你的族裔背景嗎？

sentences.en: The report shows how ethnic communities shaped the town.
sentences.zh: 這份報告說明了各族群社區如何塑造這座小鎮。

sentences.en: We will evaluate each candidate after the interviews.
sentences.zh: 面試結束後，我們會評估每位應徵者。

sentences.en: How do you evaluate a new employee's progress?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼評估新進員工的進步情況？

sentences.en: Teachers evaluate students with tests and projects.
sentences.zh: 老師用考試和專題來評量學生。

sentences.en: Can an outside expert evaluate our safety system?
sentences.zh: 外部專家可以評估我們的安全系統嗎？

sentences.en: The committee will evaluate the proposal next week.
sentences.zh: 委員會下週會審核這份提案。

sentences.en: Customers evaluated the hotel on its cleanliness and comfort.
sentences.zh: 顧客就清潔度和舒適度來評價這間飯店。

sentences.en: My annual evaluation is scheduled for Friday.
sentences.zh: 我的年度考核排在星期五。

sentences.en: How did your performance evaluation go?
sentences.zh: 你的績效考核進行得怎麼樣？

sentences.en: The evaluation of the new software will take a month.
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體的評估要花一個月。

sentences.en: Did the teacher give you a fair evaluation?
sentences.zh: 老師給你的評價公平嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor ordered a full evaluation of her hearing.
sentences.zh: 醫生安排了完整的聽力評估。

sentences.en: Students can fill out an evaluation form after the class.
sentences.zh: 學生可以在課程結束後填寫評量表。

gloss_note: eventual 指最終的，非可能的

sentences.en: The eventual winner was a small company from Ohio.
sentences.zh: 最後的贏家是一家來自俄亥俄州的小公司。

sentences.en: What was the eventual outcome of the meeting?
sentences.zh: 那場會議的最終結果是什麼？

sentences.en: Her hard work led to her eventual promotion.
sentences.zh: 她的努力讓她最終獲得升遷。

sentences.en: Do you know the eventual cost of the repairs?
sentences.zh: 你知道這次維修最後的費用是多少嗎？

sentences.en: The eventual goal is to open stores in ten cities.
sentences.zh: 最終的目標是在十座城市開設分店。

sentences.en: Their eventual success surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 他們最終的成功讓大家都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Do you have any evidence to support your idea?
sentences.zh: 你有任何證據可以支持你的想法嗎？

sentences.en: The police found no evidence of a break-in.
sentences.zh: 警方沒有找到闖入的證據。

sentences.en: Evidence shows that sleep helps memory.
sentences.zh: 證據顯示睡眠有助於記憶。

sentences.en: The lawyer showed new evidence to the jury.
sentences.zh: 律師向陪審團出示了新的證據。

sentences.en: Is there enough evidence to prove the claim?
sentences.zh: 有足夠的證據證明這項說法嗎？

sentences.en: The report offers clear evidence of rising costs.
sentences.zh: 這份報告提供了成本上升的明確證據。

gloss_note: exaggerate a story 誇大故事

sentences.en: Don't exaggerate; it wasn't that bad.
sentences.zh: 別誇張了，沒那麼糟啦。

sentences.en: Do you think the ad exaggerates the benefits?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這支廣告有誇大好處嗎？

sentences.en: He tends to exaggerate when he tells stories.
sentences.zh: 他講故事的時候常會誇大其詞。

sentences.en: The news report exaggerated the size of the storm.
sentences.zh: 這則新聞報導誇大了風暴的規模。

sentences.en: I'm not exaggerating when I say the line was an hour long.
sentences.zh: 我說排隊排了一個小時，一點也沒誇張。

sentences.en: Am I exaggerating, or is the food here the best in town?
sentences.zh: 是我太誇張，還是這裡的食物真的是全城最好吃的？

sentences.en: Everyone has to pay; there are no exceptions.
sentences.zh: 每個人都要付費，沒有例外。

sentences.en: Can you make an exception for me this time?
sentences.zh: 這次你可以為我破例嗎？

sentences.en: With the exception of Monday, we're open daily.
sentences.zh: 除了星期一以外，我們每天都營業。

sentences.en: Most students passed, but Tom was an exception.
sentences.zh: 大多數學生都及格了，但湯姆是個例外。

sentences.en: Is there an exception to this rule?
sentences.zh: 這條規定有例外嗎？

sentences.en: Our boss made an exception and let us leave early.
sentences.zh: 老闆破例讓我們提早下班。

sentences.en: She received an award for exceptional service.
sentences.zh: 她因傑出的服務而獲獎。

sentences.en: Is the quality of this product exceptional?
sentences.zh: 這項產品的品質很出色嗎？

sentences.en: His exceptional memory helped him win the quiz.
sentences.zh: 他過人的記憶力幫他贏得了問答比賽。

sentences.en: Do you give discounts only in exceptional cases?
sentences.zh: 你們只在特殊情況下才給折扣嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel staff were exceptional during our stay.
sentences.zh: 我們住宿期間，飯店員工的表現非常傑出。

sentences.en: Her exceptional talent impressed the judges.
sentences.zh: 她傑出的才華讓評審印象深刻。

gloss_note: exclusion from 被排除在…之外

sentences.en: The exclusion of small stores from the plan upset many owners.
sentences.zh: 小商店被排除在計畫之外，讓許多老闆很不高興。

sentences.en: Does the policy list any exclusions?
sentences.zh: 這份保單有列出任何除外項目嗎？

sentences.en: The contract has an exclusion for damage caused by floods.
sentences.zh: 合約中有一項針對洪水造成損害的除外條款。

sentences.en: Why was her exclusion from the meeting never explained?
sentences.zh: 為什麼她被排除在會議之外卻始終沒有說明原因？

sentences.en: Exclusion from the team made him feel lonely.
sentences.zh: 被排除在球隊之外，讓他覺得很孤單。

sentences.en: Check the exclusions before you buy this insurance plan.
sentences.zh: 買這份保險方案之前，先確認一下除外項目。

sentences.en: This lounge is exclusively for members.
sentences.zh: 這間休息室僅供會員使用。

sentences.en: The store sells exclusively organic products.
sentences.zh: 這家店只賣有機產品。

sentences.en: Do you work exclusively with one client?
sentences.zh: 你只替單一客戶工作嗎？

sentences.en: The offer is available exclusively online.
sentences.zh: 這項優惠僅限線上提供。

sentences.en: Is this parking lot exclusively for employees?
sentences.zh: 這個停車場是員工專用的嗎？

sentences.en: Her company focuses exclusively on children's furniture.
sentences.zh: 她的公司專門做兒童家具。

sentences.en: The long meeting exhausted everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 這場冗長的會議讓房裡每個人都累壞了。

sentences.en: We will exhaust our budget by June.
sentences.zh: 我們到六月就會把預算用完。

sentences.en: Do long flights exhaust you too?
sentences.zh: 長途飛行也會讓你累壞嗎？

sentences.en: Don't exhaust yourself; take a break.
sentences.zh: 別把自己累壞了，休息一下吧。

sentences.en: Will the town exhaust its water supply this summer?
sentences.zh: 這座城鎮今年夏天的供水會用光嗎？

sentences.en: The heat and the noise exhausted us.
sentences.zh: 酷熱和噪音讓我們精疲力竭。

gloss_note: exhibit at a fair 在展覽中展出

sentences.en: The museum will exhibit her paintings this fall.
sentences.zh: 博物館今年秋天會展出她的畫作。

sentences.en: Which exhibit did you like most?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪一項展覽品？

sentences.en: Our company will exhibit new phones at the trade show.
sentences.zh: 我們公司將在商展上展出新手機。

sentences.en: The art exhibit opens on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 這場藝術展在星期六早上開幕。

sentences.en: Do they exhibit local artists' work in the lobby?
sentences.zh: 他們會在大廳展出當地藝術家的作品嗎？

sentences.en: The children loved the dinosaur exhibit.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很喜歡恐龍展。

sentences.en: The writer spent ten years in exile.
sentences.zh: 這位作家流亡了十年。

sentences.en: The king was sent into exile after the war.
sentences.zh: 戰爭結束後，國王被放逐流亡。

sentences.en: Why was the artist forced into exile?
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家為什麼被迫流亡？

sentences.en: Do you know when the poet returned from exile?
sentences.zh: 你知道這位詩人是什麼時候結束流亡回國的嗎？

sentences.en: In the story, the prince was exiled from his kingdom.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，王子被放逐，離開了他的王國。

sentences.en: She wrote her best book while living in exile abroad.
sentences.zh: 她在國外流亡期間寫出了她最好的一本書。

sentences.en: The menu has several exotic fruits.
sentences.zh: 菜單上有好幾種異國水果。

sentences.en: Have you ever traveled to an exotic place?
sentences.zh: 你去過異國風情的地方旅行嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel sells exotic souvenirs in its gift shop.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店的禮品店賣具異國風情的紀念品。

sentences.en: The store imports exotic spices from Asia.
sentences.zh: 這家店從亞洲進口外來的香料。

sentences.en: Is that exotic bird common in this area?
sentences.zh: 那種外來的鳥在這個地區常見嗎？

sentences.en: We're planning an exotic vacation in Bali.
sentences.zh: 我們正計畫去峇里島度過一個充滿異國風情的假期。

gloss_note: expand into 拓展到（新市場）

sentences.en: The company plans to expand into Asian markets.
sentences.zh: 這家公司打算拓展到亞洲市場。

sentences.en: Our school expanded its library last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們學校去年夏天擴建了圖書館。

sentences.en: Are you going to expand your restaurant next year?
sentences.zh: 你明年會擴大你的餐廳規模嗎？

sentences.en: We need to expand our team before the busy season.
sentences.zh: 旺季之前，我們得擴編團隊。

sentences.en: The city is expanding its bus network.
sentences.zh: 這座城市正在擴大公車路網。

sentences.en: Will the store expand its hours during the holidays?
sentences.zh: 這家店在假日期間會延長營業時間嗎？

sentences.en: The expansion of the airport will create new jobs.
sentences.zh: 機場的擴建將創造新的工作機會。

sentences.en: How fast is your company's expansion overseas?
sentences.zh: 貴公司在海外的擴張速度有多快？

sentences.en: The bakery announced an expansion into three new cities.
sentences.zh: 這家麵包店宣布將擴展到三座新城市。

sentences.en: Is the expansion of the highway worth the cost?
sentences.zh: 擴建高速公路值得花這筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: Rapid expansion caused cash problems for the store.
sentences.zh: 快速擴張讓這家店出現資金問題。

sentences.en: The museum's expansion will add two new galleries.
sentences.zh: 博物館的擴建將增加兩間新展覽室。

sentences.en: The lab is testing an experimental drug.
sentences.zh: 實驗室正在測試一種實驗性藥物。

sentences.en: Is this experimental program open to all students?
sentences.zh: 這個實驗性的課程開放給所有學生嗎？

sentences.en: The chef served an experimental dish with fruit and cheese.
sentences.zh: 主廚端出一道搭配水果和起司的創意實驗料理。

sentences.en: The experimental results will be published next month.
sentences.zh: 實驗的結果下個月會公布。

sentences.en: Are the new buses still in the experimental stage?
sentences.zh: 這些新公車還在實驗階段嗎？

sentences.en: The band's experimental music isn't for everyone.
sentences.zh: 這個樂團的實驗性音樂不是人人都能接受。

gloss_note: give an explanation 做出解釋

sentences.en: Can you give me a simple explanation?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我一個簡單的說明嗎？

sentences.en: The manager owes us an explanation for the delay.
sentences.zh: 經理得為這次延誤給我們一個交代。

sentences.en: Her explanation made the math problem easy.
sentences.zh: 她的解釋讓這道數學題變得很容易。

sentences.en: What is the explanation for this error?
sentences.zh: 這個錯誤的原因該怎麼解釋？

sentences.en: The teacher's explanation was clear and short.
sentences.zh: 老師的說明既清楚又簡短。

sentences.en: There is no easy explanation for the price jump.
sentences.zh: 價格大漲並沒有簡單的解釋。

sentences.en: Space exploration costs billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 太空探索要花上數十億美元。

sentences.en: The company started oil exploration off the coast.
sentences.zh: 這家公司開始在近海探勘石油。

sentences.en: Is deep sea exploration safe for divers?
sentences.zh: 深海探索對潛水員來說安全嗎？

sentences.en: The exploration of the old cave took two days.
sentences.zh: 探索那座古老洞穴花了兩天。

sentences.en: Our trip was a week of exploration through the old town.
sentences.zh: 我們的旅行是花一週在老城區四處探索。

sentences.en: Does your team have time for exploration of new ideas?
sentences.zh: 你的團隊有時間探索新點子嗎？

gloss_note: an explosion in sales 銷量激增

sentences.en: A loud explosion shook the building last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一聲巨大的爆炸震動了這棟大樓。

sentences.en: What caused the explosion at the factory?
sentences.zh: 工廠的爆炸是什麼原因造成的？

sentences.en: There has been an explosion in online shopping.
sentences.zh: 網路購物出現了爆炸性的成長。

sentences.en: Was the explosion heard from far away?
sentences.zh: 遠處也聽得到這次爆炸聲嗎？

sentences.en: The city saw an explosion of tourists after the festival.
sentences.zh: 節慶過後，這座城市的遊客數量暴增。

sentences.en: The movie ends with a huge explosion on a bridge.
sentences.zh: 這部電影以橋上的一場大爆炸作結。

sentences.en: Gas is highly explosive, so keep it away from fire.
sentences.zh: 瓦斯非常容易爆炸，所以要遠離火源。

sentences.en: Is this chemical explosive when it gets hot?
sentences.zh: 這種化學物質受熱時會爆炸嗎？

sentences.en: The company reported explosive growth in sales.
sentences.zh: 這家公司公布銷售額出現爆炸性成長。

sentences.en: Fireworks are explosive, so children must stay back.
sentences.zh: 煙火是易爆物，所以孩子們必須退後。

sentences.en: Why are these materials so explosive?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這些材料這麼容易爆炸？

sentences.en: Workers must handle the explosive liquid with great care.
sentences.zh: 工人必須非常小心地處理這種易爆的液體。

sentences.en: The company saw exponential growth in its first three years.
sentences.zh: 公司創立頭三年呈現指數成長。

sentences.en: Is the growth of online sales exponential or just steady?
sentences.zh: 網路銷售的成長是呈指數型，還是只是穩定成長？

sentences.en: Why did the number of users rise at an exponential rate?
sentences.zh: 為什麼使用者人數會以指數速度成長？

sentences.en: The graph shows an exponential increase in solar energy use.
sentences.zh: 這張圖顯示太陽能的使用量呈指數增加。

sentences.en: Our costs have gone up at an exponential pace since January.
sentences.zh: 我們的成本從一月起以指數速度上升。

sentences.en: Exponential growth cannot continue forever on a planet with limited resources.
sentences.zh: 在資源有限的地球上，指數型成長不可能永遠持續下去。

gloss_note: expose A to B 使A暴露於B

sentences.en: Don't expose your skin to the sun for too long.
sentences.zh: 不要讓皮膚曝曬在太陽下太久。

sentences.en: Does this job expose workers to loud noise?
sentences.zh: 這份工作會讓工人暴露在很大的噪音中嗎？

sentences.en: The report exposed serious problems at the factory.
sentences.zh: 這份報告揭露了工廠的嚴重問題。

sentences.en: Museum visits expose children to different cultures.
sentences.zh: 參觀博物館能讓孩子接觸不同的文化。

sentences.en: When the paint is exposed to air, it dries quickly.
sentences.zh: 油漆接觸到空氣時，很快就會乾。

sentences.en: Who exposed the hotel's hidden fees?
sentences.zh: 是誰揭發了這家飯店的隱藏費用？

gloss_note: exposure to 暴露於、接觸到

sentences.en: Long exposure to loud music can damage your hearing.
sentences.zh: 長時間暴露在大音量的音樂中可能傷害聽力。

sentences.en: Does your child get enough exposure to English at home?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子在家有足夠的機會接觸英文嗎？

sentences.en: Exposure to cold weather killed many of the plants.
sentences.zh: 受到寒冷天氣的影響，許多植物都死了。

sentences.en: Studying abroad gave me great exposure to other cultures.
sentences.zh: 出國讀書讓我有很多機會接觸其他文化。

sentences.en: Workers must limit their exposure to these chemicals.
sentences.zh: 工人必須限制自己接觸這些化學藥品的程度。

sentences.en: How much exposure to sunlight is safe each day?
sentences.zh: 每天曬多少太陽才算安全？

gloss_note: extend a deadline 延長期限

sentences.en: Can we extend the deadline until next Monday?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把截止日期延到下週一嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel let us extend our stay by one night.
sentences.zh: 飯店讓我們多住了一晚。

sentences.en: The road extends all the way to the lake.
sentences.zh: 這條路一路延伸到湖邊。

sentences.en: Can I extend my visa for six more months?
sentences.zh: 我的簽證可以再延六個月嗎？

sentences.en: The park extends along the river for miles.
sentences.zh: 這座公園沿著河岸延伸好幾英里。

sentences.en: The store will extend its hours during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 商店在假期旺季會延長營業時間。

gloss_note: to some extent 在某種程度上

sentences.en: To some extent, I agree with your idea.
sentences.zh: 在某種程度上，我同意你的想法。

sentences.en: Do you know the full extent of the damage?
sentences.zh: 你知道損害的全部範圍嗎？

sentences.en: To what extent can we trust this survey?
sentences.zh: 這份調查我們能相信到什麼程度？

sentences.en: Nobody knew the extent of the company's debt.
sentences.zh: 沒有人知道公司的債務有多嚴重。

sentences.en: To a large extent, her success comes from hard work.
sentences.zh: 她的成功在很大程度上來自努力。

sentences.en: The extent of the garden surprised all of us.
sentences.zh: 花園的大小讓我們所有人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: This fabric feels soft and doesn't wrinkle easily.
sentences.zh: 這塊布料摸起來很柔軟，也不容易起皺。

sentences.en: Do you have this fabric in blue?
sentences.zh: 這種布料有藍色的嗎？

sentences.en: Cotton fabric is cooler to wear in summer.
sentences.zh: 棉布料夏天穿比較涼爽。

sentences.en: How much fabric do I need for two curtains?
sentences.zh: 做兩片窗簾我需要多少布料？

sentences.en: The store sells fabric by the yard.
sentences.zh: 這家店的布料是論碼賣的。

sentences.en: Wash this fabric in cold water to keep its color.
sentences.zh: 這種布料要用冷水洗才能保持顏色。

sentences.en: Her facial expression showed that she was nervous.
sentences.zh: 她臉上的表情顯示她很緊張。

sentences.en: Do you use a facial cleanser every night?
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都用洗面乳嗎？

sentences.en: The camera can recognize facial features in low light.
sentences.zh: 這台相機在光線不足時也能辨識臉部特徵。

sentences.en: Can you tell his mood from his facial expression?
sentences.zh: 你能從他的臉部表情看出他的心情嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor checked for facial swelling after the fall.
sentences.zh: 醫生在跌倒後檢查了臉部是否腫脹。

sentences.en: Facial muscles help us smile and frown.
sentences.zh: 臉部肌肉讓我們能微笑和皺眉。

gloss_note: 常用複數 facilities 設施

sentences.en: The hotel has a gym and other facilities.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有健身房和其他設施。

sentences.en: Does the new building have a child care facility?
sentences.zh: 這棟新大樓有托兒設施嗎？

sentences.en: Our school's sports facilities are open until nine.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的運動設施開放到九點。

sentences.en: Where is the nearest medical facility?
sentences.zh: 最近的醫療設施在哪裡？

sentences.en: The company built a new research facility near the city.
sentences.zh: 公司在市郊蓋了一座新的研究設施。

sentences.en: The facility will close for repairs next week.
sentences.zh: 這個設施下週會關閉維修。

gloss_note: faction within a group 團體內的派系

sentences.en: A small faction in the company opposed the merger.
sentences.zh: 公司內有一個小派系反對這項合併。

sentences.en: Which faction of the board supports the plan?
sentences.zh: 董事會中哪一派支持這項計畫？

sentences.en: The club split into two factions over the budget.
sentences.zh: 俱樂部因預算問題分裂成兩派。

sentences.en: Is there a faction that wants to change the rules?
sentences.zh: 有沒有一派人想要修改規則？

sentences.en: Rival factions inside the team slowed every decision.
sentences.zh: 團隊內互相對立的派系拖慢了每一項決定。

sentences.en: Our manager tried to keep peace between the two factions.
sentences.zh: 我們的經理努力讓兩派人馬和平相處。

gloss_note: a faculty member 一位教職員

sentences.en: The faculty meets every Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 全體教職員每週二早上開會。

sentences.en: Several faculty members attended the opening ceremony.
sentences.zh: 有幾位教職員參加了開幕典禮。

sentences.en: Will the faculty vote on the new schedule today?
sentences.zh: 教職員今天會對新課表進行表決嗎？

sentences.en: The school hired two new faculty members this fall.
sentences.zh: 學校今年秋天新聘了兩位教職員。

sentences.en: How many faculty work in the science department?
sentences.zh: 理科系有多少位教職員？

sentences.en: The faculty and students share one cafeteria.
sentences.zh: 教職員和學生共用一間餐廳。

sentences.en: Our dog stayed faithful to his owner for years.
sentences.zh: 我們家的狗多年來一直對主人忠心耿耿。

sentences.en: Is the movie faithful to the original book?
sentences.zh: 這部電影忠於原著嗎？

sentences.en: She has been a faithful customer of this bakery for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她是這家麵包店的忠實顧客，已經十年了。

sentences.en: The translation is faithful to the author's words.
sentences.zh: 這份譯文忠實呈現了作者的原意。

sentences.en: Have you stayed faithful to your diet plan?
sentences.zh: 你一直有確實遵守你的飲食計畫嗎？

sentences.en: He remained faithful to his friends even in hard times.
sentences.zh: 即使在困難的時候，他仍然對朋友忠誠。

gloss_note: rise to fame 一舉成名

sentences.en: The young singer gained fame almost overnight.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕歌手幾乎一夜成名。

sentences.en: Does fame really make people happy?
sentences.zh: 名氣真的能讓人快樂嗎？

sentences.en: She never wanted fame or money.
sentences.zh: 她從來不想要名氣或金錢。

sentences.en: The small town's fame comes from its hot springs.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮的名氣來自它的溫泉。

sentences.en: Would you want fame if it cost you your privacy?
sentences.zh: 如果要犧牲隱私，你還想要成名嗎？

sentences.en: His fame spread quickly after the video went online.
sentences.zh: 影片上網後，他的名氣迅速傳開。

sentences.en: Please familiarize yourself with the safety rules.
sentences.zh: 請先熟悉一下安全規定。

sentences.en: Can you familiarize the new staff with our system?
sentences.zh: 你可以讓新進員工熟悉我們的系統嗎？

sentences.en: I need time to familiarize myself with this software.
sentences.zh: 我需要一點時間來熟悉這套軟體。

sentences.en: The tour helped us familiarize ourselves with the campus.
sentences.zh: 這趟導覽讓我們熟悉了校園環境。

sentences.en: How can I familiarize my team with the new process?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼讓團隊熟悉新的流程？

sentences.en: She spent a week familiarizing herself with the new office.
sentences.zh: 她花了一週時間熟悉新的辦公室。

sentences.en: She loves reading fantasy novels about dragons.
sentences.zh: 她很愛看有關龍的奇幻小說。

sentences.en: Living on a beach is just a fantasy for me.
sentences.zh: 住在海邊對我來說只是幻想。

sentences.en: Do you prefer fantasy or science fiction?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡奇幻還是科幻？

sentences.en: His idea of getting rich quickly is pure fantasy.
sentences.zh: 他想快速致富的念頭純屬幻想。

sentences.en: The child lived in a fantasy world of talking animals.
sentences.zh: 那個孩子活在一個動物會說話的幻想世界裡。

sentences.en: Is that a real plan or just a fantasy?
sentences.zh: 那是真正的計畫，還是只是幻想？

sentences.en: We held a farewell party for our manager.
sentences.zh: 我們為經理辦了一場歡送會。

sentences.zh: 她在機場向朋友揮手道別。

sentences.zh: 週五是傑克的送別晚餐嗎？

sentences.zh: 團隊給了林小姐一場溫馨的送別。

sentences.en: Why was his farewell speech so short?
sentences.zh: 他的告別演說為什麼這麼短？

sentences.en: It was hard to say farewell to my hometown.
sentences.zh: 要向家鄉告別真的很不容易。

sentences.en: The car accident was fatal for the driver.
sentences.zh: 那場車禍對駕駛來說是致命的。

sentences.en: One fatal mistake cost the company its biggest client.
sentences.zh: 一個致命的錯誤讓公司失去了最大的客戶。

sentences.en: Can a small error be fatal in this job?
sentences.zh: 在這份工作中，小錯誤也可能是致命的嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor said the illness is not fatal.
sentences.zh: 醫生說這種病不會致命。

sentences.en: Can a bee sting be fatal for some people?
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂叮咬對某些人可能致命嗎？

sentences.en: The storm caused several fatal accidents on the highway.
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨在高速公路上造成數起致命的事故。

sentences.en: Is it feasible to finish the work by Friday?
sentences.zh: 在週五前完成這份工作可行嗎？

sentences.zh: 團隊找到了一個可行的方法來降低成本。

sentences.zh: 可行的計畫必須符合我們的預算。

sentences.en: Do you think the new schedule is feasible?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個新時程可行嗎？

sentences.en: It's not feasible to hire ten people this year.
sentences.zh: 今年要僱用十個人是不可行的。

sentences.zh: 這項研究指出，太陽能對小型農場來說是可行的。

sentences.en: Our family prepared a big feast for the New Year.
sentences.zh: 我們全家為新年準備了一桌豐盛的大餐。

sentences.en: Are you ready for the Thanksgiving feast?
sentences.zh: 你準備好迎接感恩節大餐了嗎？

sentences.en: We feasted on fresh seafood by the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我們在海邊盡情享用新鮮海鮮。

sentences.en: The wedding feast lasted for three hours.
sentences.zh: 婚宴持續了三個小時。

sentences.en: Who cooked this wonderful feast?
sentences.zh: 這桌豐盛的菜是誰煮的？

sentences.en: Kids feast on cake at every birthday party.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在每場生日派對上都大吃蛋糕。

sentences.en: The valley has fertile soil for growing rice.
sentences.zh: 這個山谷有肥沃的土壤可以種稻。

sentences.en: Is this land fertile enough for vegetables?
sentences.zh: 這塊地肥沃到足以種蔬菜嗎？

sentences.zh: 肥沃的土地讓這座農場有了大豐收。

sentences.en: What makes farm soil so fertile?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓農地的土壤這麼肥沃？

sentences.zh: 農民搬到河口三角洲，因為那裡土地肥沃。

sentences.zh: 加入堆肥能讓你的花園土壤更肥沃。

sentences.zh: 這個國家的生育率已經大幅下降。

sentences.zh: 有哪些因素會影響現代社會的生育力？

sentences.zh: 許多夫妻會去診所諮詢生育方面的問題。

sentences.zh: 壓力有時會降低男女雙方的生育力。

sentences.en: Farmers use natural methods to restore soil fertility.
sentences.zh: 農民用自然的方法來恢復土壤肥力。

sentences.en: Does the fertility of this field change every year?
sentences.zh: 這塊田的土壤肥力每年都會改變嗎？

sentences.zh: 你可以幫我拿杯水來嗎？

sentences.zh: 我去我房間把車鑰匙拿來。

sentences.zh: 這隻狗很愛去把球撿回來。

sentences.zh: 你可以去儲藏室把檔案拿來嗎？

sentences.zh: 請去浴室拿一條毛巾來。

sentences.en: Who will fetch the package from the front desk?
sentences.zh: 誰要去櫃檯把包裹拿來？

gloss_note: fiction 與 nonfiction（非小說）相對

sentences.en: She reads a lot of fiction before bed.
sentences.zh: 她睡前會看很多小說。

sentences.en: Is this story fact or fiction?
sentences.zh: 這個故事是事實還是虛構的？

sentences.en: The library has a large fiction section.
sentences.zh: 圖書館有很大的小說區。

sentences.en: What kind of fiction do you like best?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪一種小說？

sentences.en: Her first work of fiction won a small prize.
sentences.zh: 她的第一部小說得到了一個小獎。

sentences.en: The news report turned out to be pure fiction.
sentences.zh: 那則新聞報導結果完全是捏造的。

sentences.en: Competition in the phone market is fierce.
sentences.zh: 手機市場的競爭非常激烈。

sentences.en: Is that dog as fierce as it looks?
sentences.zh: 那隻狗真的像看起來那麼兇猛嗎？

sentences.en: The two companies are in fierce competition for the contract.
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司為了這份合約展開激烈的競爭。

sentences.en: A fierce wind blew across the field all night.
sentences.zh: 猛烈的風整晚吹過田野。

sentences.en: Why is the debate over the new rule so fierce?
sentences.zh: 為什麼針對新規定的辯論這麼激烈？

sentences.en: The team faced fierce opposition from local shops.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊遭到當地商家的強烈反對。

sentences.en: She works in the finance department of a small firm.
sentences.zh: 她在一家小公司的財務部門工作。

sentences.en: Does the bank finance small businesses?
sentences.zh: 這家銀行會為小型企業提供資金嗎？

sentences.en: How will you finance your new car?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎麼籌錢買新車？

sentences.en: My brother studies finance at college.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟在大學念財務金融。

sentences.en: The city will finance the new bridge with a special fund.
sentences.zh: 市政府將以專款出資興建這座新橋。

sentences.en: Good personal finance starts with a monthly budget.
sentences.zh: 良好的個人理財從每月預算開始。

sentences.en: The company is in serious financial trouble.
sentences.zh: 這家公司陷入嚴重的財務困難。

sentences.en: Can you give me some financial advice?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我一些理財建議嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have a financial plan for retirement?
sentences.zh: 你有退休後的理財計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The financial report is due at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 財務報告在月底之前要交。

sentences.en: Students can apply for financial aid at the school office.
sentences.zh: 學生可以到學校辦公室申請助學金。

sentences.en: What caused the financial crisis ten years ago?
sentences.zh: 十年前的金融危機是什麼造成的？

sentences.en: Is the company financially stable this year?
sentences.zh: 這家公司今年的財務穩健嗎？

sentences.en: We can't afford it financially right now.
sentences.zh: 我們現在在經濟上負擔不起。

sentences.en: She is financially independent now.
sentences.zh: 她現在經濟上已經獨立了。

sentences.en: Is this plan financially feasible for our team?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫在財務上對我們團隊來說可行嗎？

sentences.en: The shop is doing well financially.
sentences.zh: 這家店的財務狀況很好。

sentences.en: The merger was financially risky, but it was worth it.
sentences.zh: 這次合併在財務上有風險，但很值得。

gloss_note: a cozy fireplace 溫馨的壁爐

sentences.en: We sat by the fireplace and drank hot chocolate.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在壁爐旁喝熱可可。

sentences.en: Does the cabin have a fireplace?
sentences.zh: 這間小木屋有壁爐嗎？

sentences.en: There is a family photo above the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 壁爐上方掛著一張全家福。

sentences.en: The fireplace keeps the whole living room warm.
sentences.zh: 壁爐讓整個客廳都很暖和。

sentences.en: Could you put more wood in the fireplace?
sentences.zh: 你可以多放一些木柴到壁爐裡嗎？

sentences.en: A cat was sleeping in front of the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 一隻貓正在壁爐前睡覺。

gloss_note: flatter sb 對某人灌迷湯

sentences.en: Don't flatter me; just tell me the truth.
sentences.zh: 別奉承我，告訴我實話就好。

sentences.en: He flatters his boss to get a promotion.
sentences.zh: 他為了升遷而奉承老闆。

sentences.en: Are you trying to flatter me with those words?
sentences.zh: 你是想用那些話來恭維我嗎？
