sentences.en: Salespeople often flatter customers to close a deal.
sentences.zh: 業務員常常為了成交而奉承客人。

sentences.en: Why do people flatter those with power?
sentences.zh: 為什麼人們會奉承有權力的人？

sentences.en: I'm not flattering you; your idea is really good.
sentences.zh: 我不是在奉承你，你的點子真的很好。

gloss_note: flea 指寄生在動物身上的小蟲

sentences.en: Our dog scratches a lot because of fleas.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗因為跳蚤一直抓癢。

sentences.en: Do you see any fleas on the cat?
sentences.zh: 你有看到貓身上有跳蚤嗎？

sentences.en: A flea can jump very high for its size.
sentences.zh: 以體型來說，跳蚤可以跳得非常高。

sentences.en: The vet gave us medicine to kill fleas.
sentences.zh: 獸醫給了我們殺跳蚤的藥。

sentences.en: Fleas often live in carpets and on pets.
sentences.zh: 跳蚤常常住在地毯裡和寵物身上。

sentences.en: How did the fleas get into our house?
sentences.zh: 跳蚤是怎麼跑進我們家的？

sentences.en: Thousands of people fled the city before the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，數千人逃離了這座城市。

sentences.en: The thief fled when he heard the alarm.
sentences.zh: 小偷一聽到警報聲就逃走了。

sentences.en: Why did so many customers flee to our competitor?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有這麼多客戶轉投我們的競爭對手？

sentences.en: Did the animals flee from the fire?
sentences.zh: 動物們有從火場逃走嗎？

sentences.en: Residents were forced to flee their homes after the flood.
sentences.zh: 水災過後，居民被迫逃離家園。

sentences.en: Investors tend to flee when the market gets unstable.
sentences.zh: 市場不穩時，投資人往往會抽身逃離。

gloss_note: a fleet of trucks 一支卡車車隊

sentences.en: The company owns a fleet of delivery trucks.
sentences.zh: 這家公司擁有一支送貨卡車車隊。

sentences.en: How many vehicles are in the delivery fleet?
sentences.zh: 這支送貨車隊有多少輛車？

sentences.en: The delivery company plans to expand its fleet of vans.
sentences.zh: 這家快遞公司打算擴充它的廂型車車隊。

sentences.en: A fishing fleet left the harbor at dawn.
sentences.zh: 一支漁船隊在黎明時離開了港口。

sentences.en: Our fleet manager checks every van each month.
sentences.zh: 我們的車隊經理每個月都會檢查每一輛廂型車。

sentences.en: Will the city's bus fleet switch to electric power?
sentences.zh: 市內的公車車隊會改用電力嗎？

sentences.en: Is your schedule flexible next week?
sentences.zh: 你下週的時間有彈性嗎？

sentences.en: We offer flexible work hours.
sentences.zh: 我們提供彈性的上班時間。

sentences.en: Yoga makes your body more flexible.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽能讓你的身體更柔軟靈活。

sentences.en: Can you be flexible about the meeting time?
sentences.zh: 開會時間你可以彈性一點嗎？

sentences.en: Plastic pipes are flexible and easy to bend.
sentences.zh: 塑膠管很有彈性，很容易彎曲。

sentences.en: A flexible plan can handle sudden changes.
sentences.zh: 有彈性的計畫能應付突如其來的變動。

sentences.en: Gas prices fluctuate from week to week.
sentences.zh: 汽油價格每週都在波動。

sentences.en: Does your income fluctuate a lot during the year?
sentences.zh: 你的收入一年之中波動很大嗎？

sentences.en: The exchange rate fluctuated all day yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天匯率整天都在波動。

sentences.en: Why does the temperature fluctuate so much in spring?
sentences.zh: 為什麼春天的氣溫起伏這麼大？

sentences.en: Sales tend to fluctuate with the seasons.
sentences.zh: 銷售量往往隨季節而波動。

sentences.en: Stock prices fluctuate whenever big news breaks.
sentences.zh: 只要有重大消息傳出，股價就會上下波動。

gloss_note: be fluent in 精通（語言）

sentences.en: She is fluent in English and Spanish.
sentences.zh: 她的英文和西班牙文都很流利。

sentences.en: Are you fluent in any other language?
sentences.zh: 你有其他說得很流利的語言嗎？

sentences.en: His fluent speech impressed the interviewers.
sentences.zh: 他流暢的談吐讓面試官印象深刻。

sentences.en: It takes years to become fluent in a new language.
sentences.zh: 要精通一種新語言需要好幾年。

sentences.en: How long did it take you to speak fluent English?
sentences.zh: 你花了多久才能說一口流利的英文？

sentences.en: The new employee is fluent in Japanese.
sentences.zh: 這位新員工的日文很流利。

sentences.en: Please flush the toilet after you use it.
sentences.zh: 使用完馬桶後請沖水。

sentences.en: Why won't the toilet flush properly?
sentences.zh: 為什麼馬桶沖不乾淨？

sentences.en: Don't flush paper towels down the toilet.
sentences.zh: 不要把紙巾沖進馬桶裡。

sentences.en: Could you show me how to flush this toilet?
sentences.zh: 你可以教我怎麼沖這個馬桶嗎？

sentences.en: The flush is too weak, so we should call a plumber.
sentences.zh: 這個馬桶的沖水力道太弱，我們該請水電工來看看。

sentences.en: Did you flush before leaving the restroom?
sentences.zh: 你離開洗手間前有沖水嗎？

gloss_note: in flux 處於變動之中

sentences.en: The housing market is in a state of flux.
sentences.zh: 房市正處於不斷變動的狀態。

sentences.en: Are the rules still in flux, or are they final?
sentences.zh: 規則還在變動，還是已經確定了？

sentences.en: Language is always in flux as new words appear.
sentences.zh: 隨著新字不斷出現，語言總是在變動。

sentences.en: After the merger, everyone's role was in flux.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，每個人的職務都還在變動中。

sentences.en: Why is the job market in such constant flux?
sentences.zh: 為什麼就業市場一直變動得這麼厲害？

sentences.en: Fashion trends are in constant flux.
sentences.zh: 流行趨勢一直在變動。

sentences.en: Do you like extra foam on your cappuccino?
sentences.zh: 你的卡布奇諾喜歡多加一些奶泡嗎？

sentences.en: The waves left white foam on the sand.
sentences.zh: 海浪在沙灘上留下白色的泡沫。

sentences.en: This soap makes a lot of foam.
sentences.zh: 這種肥皂會產生很多泡沫。

sentences.en: Pour the milk slowly to keep the foam on top.
sentences.zh: 慢慢倒牛奶，才能讓奶泡留在上面。

sentences.en: The soap foams quickly when you add water.
sentences.zh: 加水後，這塊肥皂很快就會起泡。

sentences.en: Why does the soda have so much foam?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這杯汽水的泡沫這麼多？

gloss_note: forbid sb to V 禁止某人做…

sentences.en: The rules forbid students from using phones in class.
sentences.zh: 校規禁止學生在課堂上使用手機。

sentences.en: My parents forbade me to stay out late.
sentences.zh: 我父母不准我在外面待到很晚。

sentences.en: Does the contract forbid us from sharing the data?
sentences.zh: 合約是否禁止我們分享這些資料？

sentences.en: Company policy forbids accepting gifts from clients.
sentences.zh: 公司政策禁止收受客戶的禮物。

sentences.en: Is it forbidden to take photos inside the museum?
sentences.zh: 在博物館裡面禁止拍照嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the school forbid hats in the classroom?
sentences.zh: 學校為什麼禁止在教室裡戴帽子？

sentences.en: What's the weather forecast for tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天的天氣預報怎麼說？

sentences.en: Sales forecasts look good for the next quarter.
sentences.zh: 下一季的銷售預測看起來不錯。

sentences.en: Experts forecast that prices will rise next year.
sentences.zh: 專家預測明年物價會上漲。

sentences.en: The forecast says it will rain all weekend.
sentences.zh: 預報說整個週末都會下雨。

sentences.en: Did anyone forecast such a big drop in sales?
sentences.zh: 有人預測到銷售量會下降這麼多嗎？

sentences.en: Our forecast for the coming year is cautious.
sentences.zh: 我們對來年的預測很保守。

sentences.en: The foreman checks the site every morning at seven.
sentences.zh: 工頭每天早上七點巡視工地。

sentences.en: Please ask the foreman about the schedule.
sentences.zh: 請向工頭詢問工作時程。

sentences.en: Is the foreman on site today?
sentences.zh: 工頭今天在工地嗎？

sentences.en: The foreman told the crew to wear safety helmets.
sentences.zh: 工頭要工人們戴上安全帽。

sentences.en: She became a foreman after ten years on the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 她在工廠現場做了十年後，成為領班。

sentences.en: Who is the foreman of this construction crew?
sentences.zh: 這個施工隊的工頭是誰？

gloss_note: forge a partnership 建立合作關係

sentences.en: The two firms forged a strong partnership last year.
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司去年建立了穩固的合作關係。

sentences.en: How can we forge closer ties with our clients?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼跟客戶建立更緊密的關係？

sentences.en: We hope to forge a long-term relationship with this supplier.
sentences.zh: 我們希望和這家供應商建立長期的合作關係。

sentences.en: The school hopes to forge links with local businesses.
sentences.zh: 學校希望與當地企業建立聯繫。

sentences.en: Did the two teams forge an agreement during the talks?
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊在會談中達成協議了嗎？

sentences.en: It takes years to forge trust between partners.
sentences.zh: 要在合作夥伴之間建立信任需要好幾年。

gloss_note: formally 與 formerly 拼字相近

sentences.en: The company will formally announce the deal on Monday.
sentences.zh: 公司將在週一正式宣布這筆交易。

sentences.en: Have you been formally introduced to the CEO?
sentences.zh: 你有被正式介紹給執行長嗎？

sentences.en: The contract was formally signed in March.
sentences.zh: 合約在三月正式簽署。

sentences.en: Do I need to formally apply for the job?
sentences.zh: 我需要正式申請這份工作嗎？

sentences.en: She was formally welcomed to the team this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，她正式受到團隊的歡迎。

sentences.en: When will the new policy formally take effect?
sentences.zh: 新政策什麼時候會正式生效？

sentences.en: The formation of a new habit takes time.
sentences.zh: 養成新習慣需要時間。

sentences.en: Scientists study the formation of mountains.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究山脈的形成。

sentences.en: What led to the formation of the new club?
sentences.zh: 是什麼促成了這個新社團的成立？

sentences.en: Cloud formation depends on temperature and wind.
sentences.zh: 雲的形成取決於溫度和風。

sentences.en: The formation of the team took only two weeks.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊只花了兩週就組成了。

sentences.en: Can you explain the formation of a rainbow?
sentences.zh: 你可以解釋彩虹是怎麼形成的嗎？

sentences.en: This building was formerly a bank.
sentences.zh: 這棟建築以前是一間銀行。

sentences.en: The restaurant, formerly a bookstore, opened last week.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以前是書店，上週開幕了。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen, formerly of our Boston office, joined the team.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐之前在我們波士頓辦公室，現在加入了這個團隊。

sentences.en: Was your company formerly known by a different name?
sentences.zh: 你們公司以前用過別的名字嗎？

sentences.en: Mr. Wang, formerly our sales director, now runs his own firm.
sentences.zh: 王先生以前是我們的業務總監，現在自己經營公司。

sentences.en: Wasn't this cafe formerly a post office?
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡店以前不是郵局嗎？

sentences.en: What is the formula for the area of a circle?
sentences.zh: 圓面積的公式是什麼？

sentences.en: The teacher wrote the formula on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師把公式寫在黑板上。

sentences.en: Do you remember the formula for speed?
sentences.zh: 你還記得速度的公式嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant keeps its sauce formula a secret.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳把醬汁的配方當作祕密。

sentences.en: There is no magic formula for success.
sentences.zh: 成功沒有什麼神奇的公式。

sentences.en: Each cleaning product has its own formula.
sentences.zh: 每一種清潔用品都有自己的配方。

gloss_note: formulate a plan 擬訂計畫

sentences.en: We need to formulate a plan before the launch.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在上市前擬訂一個計畫。

sentences.en: Can you help me formulate a reply to this email?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我擬一封回覆這封電子郵件的信嗎？

sentences.en: The team formulated a new strategy for the Asian market.
sentences.zh: 團隊為亞洲市場擬定了新的策略。

sentences.en: How did the engineers formulate this solution?
sentences.zh: 工程師是怎麼想出這個解決方案的？

sentences.en: It took weeks to formulate the budget proposal.
sentences.zh: 擬訂這份預算提案花了好幾週。

sentences.en: She tried to formulate her ideas clearly before the interview.
sentences.zh: 她在面試前努力把自己的想法整理清楚。

gloss_note: 歷史、軍事情境常見；地名常寫 Fort

sentences.en: The old fort sits on a hill above the town.
sentences.zh: 那座古老的堡壘坐落在小鎮上方的山丘上。

sentences.en: Did the soldiers build the fort out of stone?
sentences.zh: 士兵們是用石頭建造這座要塞的嗎？

sentences.en: We toured an old fort on our trip to Texas.
sentences.zh: 我們去德州旅行時參觀了一座古老的要塞。

sentences.en: How long did it take to build this fort?
sentences.zh: 蓋這座堡壘花了多久？

sentences.en: The fort protected the village from attacks for years.
sentences.zh: 這座堡壘多年來保護村莊不受攻擊。

sentences.en: Our teacher showed us a map of the fort.
sentences.zh: 老師給我們看了這座堡壘的地圖。

gloss_zh: 即將到來的；即將出版的

sentences.en: We'll announce the forthcoming product launch next week.
sentences.zh: 我們下週會宣布即將推出的新產品上市活動。

sentences.en: What's in the forthcoming issue of the magazine?
sentences.zh: 雜誌即將發行的那一期有什麼內容？

sentences.en: The CEO will discuss the forthcoming merger at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 執行長會在會議上談即將進行的合併案。

sentences.en: Are you ready for the forthcoming audit?
sentences.zh: 你為即將到來的查帳做好準備了嗎？

sentences.en: Details about the forthcoming changes will be sent by email.
sentences.zh: 有關即將實施的調整，細節會用電子郵件寄出。

sentences.en: Her forthcoming book comes out in March.
sentences.zh: 她即將出版的新書三月上市。

sentences.en: We're fortunate to have such a great team.
sentences.zh: 我們很幸運能有這麼棒的團隊。

sentences.en: Were you fortunate enough to get a seat?
sentences.zh: 你運氣好，有搶到位子嗎？

sentences.en: It was fortunate that nobody got hurt in the accident.
sentences.zh: 幸好沒有人在意外中受傷。

sentences.en: He was fortunate to find a job right after graduation.
sentences.zh: 他很幸運，一畢業就找到工作。

sentences.en: Isn't it fortunate that the rain stopped before the game?
sentences.zh: 比賽前雨停了，不是很幸運嗎？

sentences.en: Those of us who are fortunate should help others.
sentences.zh: 我們這些幸運的人應該幫助別人。

sentences.en: Have you posted your question on the online forum?
sentences.zh: 你把問題貼到線上論壇了嗎？

sentences.en: The company is hosting a forum on customer service next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月要舉辦一場客戶服務論壇。

sentences.en: Who's speaking at the industry forum on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 週四的產業論壇誰要演講？

sentences.en: I found the answer in a user forum.
sentences.zh: 我在一個使用者論壇裡找到了答案。

sentences.en: The city held a public forum about the new park.
sentences.zh: 市政府針對新公園舉辦了一場公開論壇。

sentences.en: Come to the open forum if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何問題，歡迎來參加開放討論會。

sentences.en: The students found a fossil near the river.
sentences.zh: 學生們在河邊發現了一塊化石。

sentences.en: How old is this fossil?
sentences.zh: 這塊化石有多老？

sentences.en: Scientists dug up a dinosaur fossil in the desert.
sentences.zh: 科學家在沙漠裡挖出了一塊恐龍化石。

sentences.en: Did you see the fish fossil at the museum?
sentences.zh: 你有看到博物館裡那塊魚化石嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor collects fossils and keeps them on a shelf.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居喜歡收集化石，都放在架子上。

sentences.en: Fossils show us how life on Earth has changed.
sentences.zh: 化石讓我們看到地球上的生命如何演變。

sentences.en: We want to foster a culture of open communication.
sentences.zh: 我們想要培養一種開放溝通的文化。

sentences.en: How can managers foster teamwork on remote teams?
sentences.zh: 主管要怎麼在遠距團隊中促進團隊合作？

sentences.en: The program helps foster innovation among young engineers.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫有助於促進年輕工程師之間的創新。

sentences.en: Good leaders foster trust by being honest.
sentences.zh: 好的領導者靠誠實來培養信任。

sentences.en: Does the new policy foster growth in small businesses?
sentences.zh: 這項新政策有助於促進小型企業的成長嗎？

sentences.en: I try to foster good relationships with our clients.
sentences.zh: 我努力和客戶培養良好的關係。

gloss_note: a foundation for/of 某事的基礎

sentences.en: Good study habits are the foundation of success.
sentences.zh: 好的讀書習慣是成功的基礎。

sentences.en: Do you have a solid foundation in math?
sentences.zh: 你的數學基礎紮實嗎？

sentences.en: The foundation gave money to local schools.
sentences.zh: 那個基金會捐錢給當地的學校。

sentences.en: She works for a foundation that helps homeless families.
sentences.zh: 她在一個幫助無家可歸家庭的基金會工作。

sentences.en: Basic grammar lays the foundation for learning a new language.
sentences.zh: 基本文法為學習新語言打下基礎。

sentences.en: Which foundation is organizing the charity concert?
sentences.zh: 哪個基金會在籌辦這場慈善音樂會？

gloss_note: fragile 標籤＝易碎品，小心輕放

sentences.en: Be careful with that box. It's fragile.
sentences.zh: 那個箱子小心點，它很易碎。

sentences.en: Please mark the package as fragile.
sentences.zh: 請在包裹上標示為易碎品。

sentences.en: Is this vase too fragile to ship?
sentences.zh: 這個花瓶會不會太容易碎、沒辦法寄？

sentences.en: The economy is still fragile after the crisis.
sentences.zh: 經濟在那場危機後仍然很脆弱。

sentences.en: Why are glass ornaments so fragile?
sentences.zh: 為什麼玻璃飾品這麼容易碎？

sentences.en: Newborn babies have fragile skin.
sentences.zh: 新生兒的皮膚很脆弱。

sentences.en: I need a bigger frame for this photo.
sentences.zh: 這張照片我需要一個比較大的相框。

sentences.en: Can you frame this poster for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這張海報裱框嗎？

sentences.en: The bed has a sturdy wood frame.
sentences.zh: 這張床有個堅固的木框架。

sentences.en: She wants to frame her diploma and hang it up.
sentences.zh: 她想把畢業證書裝框掛起來。

sentences.en: Did you see the frame around that mirror?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那面鏡子的邊框嗎？

sentences.en: The bike's frame is made of lightweight aluminum.
sentences.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是輕量鋁製的。

gloss_note: 名詞 freelancer 指自由工作者

sentences.en: I work as a freelance designer.
sentences.zh: 我是自由接案的設計師。

sentences.en: Does your company hire freelance writers?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有聘請自由接案的撰稿人嗎？

sentences.en: She quit her job to freelance full time.
sentences.zh: 她辭掉工作，全職自由接案。

sentences.en: Would you be willing to freelance for us this summer?
sentences.zh: 你今年夏天願意幫我們接案嗎？

sentences.en: He does freelance work on weekends.
sentences.zh: 他週末會接案子。

sentences.en: Our freelance photographer is on assignment today.
sentences.zh: 我們的自由接案攝影師今天出外勤。

sentences.en: Employees can speak freely in these meetings.
sentences.zh: 員工在這些會議中可以暢所欲言。

sentences.en: Can customers move freely around the store?
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在店裡自由走動嗎？

sentences.en: Information should flow freely between departments.
sentences.zh: 資訊應該在各部門之間自由流通。

sentences.en: She freely admitted that she made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 她坦率承認自己犯了錯。

sentences.en: Do goods move freely across the border?
sentences.zh: 貨物能在邊境自由流通嗎？

sentences.en: The new rules let people travel freely in the region.
sentences.zh: 新規定讓人們能在該地區自由旅行。

sentences.en: How much does freight cost to the West Coast?
sentences.zh: 運到西岸的貨運費是多少？

sentences.en: We ship most of our freight by train.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分的貨物是用火車運送。

sentences.en: The freight train blocked the road for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 那列貨運列車擋住道路十分鐘。

sentences.en: Air freight is faster but more expensive.
sentences.zh: 空運比較快，但比較貴。

sentences.en: Has the freight arrived at the warehouse yet?
sentences.zh: 那批貨運到倉庫了嗎？

sentences.en: The company handles freight for several large retailers.
sentences.zh: 這家公司為好幾家大型零售商處理貨運。

sentences.en: What's the frequency of your team meetings?
sentences.zh: 你們團隊開會的頻率是多久一次？

sentences.en: The frequency of earthquakes in this area is low.
sentences.zh: 這個地區的地震頻率很低。

sentences.en: We reduced the frequency of our deliveries to save money.
sentences.zh: 我們為了省錢，減少了送貨的頻率。

sentences.en: Tune the radio to a different frequency.
sentences.zh: 把收音機調到不同的頻率。

sentences.en: Does the bus run with greater frequency during rush hour?
sentences.zh: 尖峰時段公車的班次會更頻繁嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor asked about the frequency of my headaches.
sentences.zh: 醫生問了我頭痛的頻率。

gloss_note: 美式用法；freshman year 第一年

sentences.en: My daughter is a freshman in high school.
sentences.zh: 我女兒是高一新生。

sentences.en: Are you a freshman or a sophomore?
sentences.zh: 你是一年級新生還是二年級生？

sentences.en: Freshmen have to attend orientation on Monday.
sentences.zh: 新生週一必須參加新生訓練。

sentences.en: I got lost a lot during my freshman year.
sentences.zh: 我大一那年常常迷路。

sentences.en: Do freshmen get to choose their own roommates?
sentences.zh: 新生可以自己選室友嗎？

sentences.en: He was a shy freshman who rarely spoke in class.
sentences.zh: 他是個很害羞的新生，上課很少發言。

gloss_note: fried rice 炒飯；fried chicken 炸雞

sentences.en: I'd like a plate of fried rice, please.
sentences.zh: 請給我一盤炒飯。

sentences.en: Do you want fried chicken or grilled chicken?
sentences.zh: 你要炸雞還是烤雞？

sentences.en: Would you like your eggs fried or scrambled?
sentences.zh: 你的蛋要煎的還是炒的？

sentences.en: We ordered fried calamari as an appetizer.
sentences.zh: 我們點了炸花枝當開胃菜。

sentences.en: The fried fish at that restaurant is always crispy.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的炸魚總是很酥脆。

sentences.en: Fried foods taste great but aren't very healthy.
sentences.zh: 油炸食物很好吃，但不太健康。

gloss_note: on the fringe(s) of 在…的邊緣

sentences.en: Small startups often work on the fringe of the market.
sentences.zh: 小型新創公司常常在市場邊緣經營。

sentences.en: Many artists live on the fringe of the city.
sentences.zh: 許多藝術家住在城市的外圍。

sentences.en: That theory was once on the fringe of mainstream science.
sentences.zh: 那個理論曾經處於主流科學的邊緣。

sentences.en: Is the new store on the fringe of downtown?
sentences.zh: 新店是在市中心的外圍嗎？

sentences.en: Why do some groups feel pushed to the fringe of society?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些族群覺得自己被推到社會邊緣？

sentences.en: He sat on the fringe of the crowd and watched.
sentences.zh: 他坐在人群外圍看著。

gloss_note: frost 不可數；first frost 初霜

sentences.en: There was frost on the windshield this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上擋風玻璃上結了霜。

sentences.en: Did the frost kill your tomato plants?
sentences.zh: 霜把你的番茄植株凍死了嗎？

sentences.en: Frost covered the grass after the cold night.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的夜晚過後，草地上覆了一層霜。

sentences.en: Is it cold enough for frost tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚夠冷會下霜嗎？

sentences.en: Farmers worry that the frost will damage the crops.
sentences.zh: 農夫擔心霜會損害作物。

sentences.en: The windows frost over every winter morning.
sentences.zh: 每個冬天的早晨，窗戶都會結霜。

sentences.en: Why are you frowning at your phone?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼盯著手機皺眉頭？

sentences.en: She frowned when she read the email.
sentences.zh: 她讀到那封電子郵件時皺起了眉頭。

sentences.en: My boss gave me a frown after I arrived late.
sentences.zh: 我遲到之後，老闆對我皺了眉頭。

sentences.en: Did you see the frown on his face?
sentences.zh: 你有看到他臉上皺眉的表情嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher frowned at the noisy students.
sentences.zh: 老師對吵鬧的學生皺起眉頭。

sentences.en: Don't frown; it's just a small mistake.
sentences.zh: 別皺眉，只是個小錯誤而已。

gloss_note: a sense of frustration 挫折感

sentences.en: I could hear the frustration in her voice.
sentences.zh: 我聽得出她語氣中的挫折感。

sentences.en: Long delays at the airport caused a lot of frustration.
sentences.zh: 在機場久候讓許多人感到很挫折。

sentences.en: How do you deal with frustration at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上怎麼處理挫折感？

sentences.en: He threw up his hands in frustration.
sentences.zh: 他沮喪地兩手一攤。

sentences.en: Slow Wi-Fi is a common source of frustration for remote workers.
sentences.zh: 網路太慢是遠距工作者常見的挫折來源。

sentences.en: Do you ever feel frustration when learning English?
sentences.zh: 學英文的時候，你會感到挫折嗎？

gloss_note: fulfill a dream 實現夢想；英式 fulfil

sentences.en: She finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a nurse.
sentences.zh: 她終於實現了當護士的夢想。

sentences.en: Does this laptop fulfill your travel needs?
sentences.zh: 這台筆電能滿足你旅行時的需求嗎？

sentences.en: You must fulfill all the course requirements to graduate.
sentences.zh: 你必須滿足所有課程要求才能畢業。

sentences.en: He promised to help, and he fulfilled that promise.
sentences.zh: 他答應要幫忙，也確實實現了這個承諾。

sentences.en: Our team fulfilled its sales goal this quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊這一季達成了銷售目標。

sentences.en: What would it take to fulfill your goal of running a marathon?
sentences.zh: 要怎樣才能實現你跑馬拉松的目標？

gloss_note: a sense of fulfillment 成就感

sentences.en: She finds great fulfillment in teaching kids.
sentences.zh: 她從教孩子中得到極大的滿足感。

sentences.en: Does your job give you a sense of fulfillment?
sentences.zh: 你的工作有帶給你滿足感嗎？

sentences.en: The fulfillment of this dream took ten years.
sentences.zh: 實現這個夢想花了十年。

sentences.en: Money alone can't bring real fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 光靠金錢無法帶來真正的滿足感。

sentences.en: What kind of work brings you the most fulfillment?
sentences.zh: 什麼樣的工作最能帶給你滿足感？

sentences.en: Volunteering gave him a deep sense of fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 當志工讓他感到深深的滿足。

sentences.en: The kitchen is small but very functional.
sentences.zh: 這間廚房雖小但很實用。

sentences.en: Is the elevator functional again after the repair?
sentences.zh: 電梯修好後又能運作了嗎？

sentences.en: I prefer furniture that's functional rather than fancy.
sentences.zh: 我偏好實用而非華麗的家具。

sentences.en: The new website is fully functional now.
sentences.zh: 新網站現在完全能正常運作了。

sentences.en: Is this old printer still functional?
sentences.zh: 這台舊印表機還能用嗎？

sentences.en: She wore functional shoes for the long hike.
sentences.zh: 她穿了實用的鞋子去長途健行。

sentences.en: Honesty is fundamental to any good friendship.
sentences.zh: 誠實是任何好友誼的根本。

sentences.en: What's the fundamental problem with this design?
sentences.zh: 這個設計的根本問題是什麼？

sentences.en: We need to make a fundamental change to our schedule.
sentences.zh: 我們得對行程做根本的改變。

sentences.en: Do you understand the fundamental rules of the game?
sentences.zh: 你懂這個遊戲的基本規則嗎？

sentences.en: Reading is a fundamental skill for every student.
sentences.zh: 閱讀是每個學生的基本能力。

sentences.en: There's a fundamental difference between the two plans.
sentences.zh: 這兩個計畫有根本上的差異。

gloss_note: 名詞 fundraiser 指募款活動或募款人

sentences.en: Our club is fundraising for the new school band.
sentences.zh: 我們社團正在為學校的新樂團募款。

sentences.en: Are you going to fundraise for the trip?
sentences.zh: 你們要為這趟旅行募款嗎？

sentences.en: We need to fundraise before the season starts.
sentences.zh: 我們得在球季開始前募款。

sentences.en: How did your team fundraise so quickly?
sentences.zh: 你們團隊怎麼這麼快就募到款？

sentences.en: The staff started to fundraise after the storm damaged the gym.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨損壞體育館後，工作人員開始募款。

sentences.en: She volunteered to help fundraise for the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她自願協助為醫院募款。

gloss_note: attend a funeral 參加葬禮

sentences.en: I have to attend a funeral on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我週六得去參加一場葬禮。

sentences.en: What should I wear to a funeral?
sentences.zh: 去葬禮該穿什麼？

sentences.en: Did you send flowers to the funeral?
sentences.zh: 你有送花去葬禮嗎？

sentences.en: The funeral was small and quiet.
sentences.zh: 葬禮辦得簡單而安靜。

sentences.en: He took three days off to plan the funeral.
sentences.zh: 他請了三天假籌辦葬禮。

sentences.en: The whole town came to the funeral.
sentences.zh: 全鎮的人都來參加了葬禮。

gloss_note: furious with 人 / at 事

sentences.en: My boss was furious when the shipment arrived late.
sentences.zh: 貨物晚到時，我老闆氣炸了。

sentences.en: Why is she so furious with me?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼這麼氣我？

sentences.en: I was furious when I saw the bill.
sentences.zh: 我看到帳單時氣炸了。

sentences.en: Are you still furious about the parking ticket?
sentences.zh: 你還在為那張停車罰單氣得要命嗎？

sentences.en: He sent a furious email to customer service.
sentences.zh: 他寄了一封怒氣沖沖的電子郵件給客服。

sentences.en: The fans were furious about the canceled game.
sentences.zh: 球迷對取消的比賽非常憤怒。

sentences.en: The apartment is cheap, and furthermore, it's close to work.
sentences.zh: 這間公寓很便宜，而且離公司很近。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the data shows that sales are rising.
sentences.zh: 此外，數據顯示銷量正在上升。

sentences.en: The hotel is clean; furthermore, the staff is very friendly.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店很乾淨，此外，員工也很親切。

sentences.en: Furthermore, students must submit the form by Friday.
sentences.zh: 此外，學生必須在週五前繳交表格。

sentences.en: The repairs are expensive, and furthermore, who will pay for them?
sentences.zh: 修理費很貴，而且誰要來付這筆錢？

sentences.en: The price is high, and furthermore, does it come with a warranty?
sentences.zh: 價格很高，而且它有附保固嗎？

sentences.en: There's a new art gallery downtown.
sentences.zh: 市中心新開了一家畫廊。

sentences.en: Did you visit the photo gallery on the second floor?
sentences.zh: 你有去二樓的攝影展覽廳嗎？

sentences.en: Her paintings are on display at the gallery this month.
sentences.zh: 她的畫作這個月在畫廊展出。

sentences.en: We spent the afternoon walking through the gallery.
sentences.zh: 我們整個下午都在畫廊裡逛。

sentences.en: Who owns that gallery on Main Street?
sentences.zh: 主街上那間畫廊是誰開的？

sentences.en: The gallery is free on the first Sunday of the month.
sentences.zh: 這間畫廊每個月第一個週日免費入場。

sentences.en: The gardener waters the flowers every morning.
sentences.zh: 園丁每天早上幫花澆水。

sentences.en: We hired a gardener to take care of the lawn.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一位園丁來照顧草坪。

sentences.en: Does the hotel have its own gardener?
sentences.zh: 這家飯店有自己的園丁嗎？

sentences.en: The gardener asked us to stay off the grass.
sentences.zh: 園丁請我們不要踩草地。

sentences.en: How often does the gardener come to trim the hedges?
sentences.zh: 園丁多久來修剪一次樹籬？

sentences.en: The company's gardener planted new tulips near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 公司的園丁在入口附近種了新的鬱金香。

gloss_note: a gauge of 某事的指標

sentences.en: The fuel gauge shows the tank is almost empty.
sentences.zh: 油量表顯示油箱快空了。

sentences.en: Sales are a good gauge of customer interest.
sentences.zh: 銷售量是衡量顧客興趣的好指標。

sentences.en: Can you check the tire pressure gauge?
sentences.zh: 你能看一下胎壓計嗎？

sentences.en: The survey is a useful gauge of employee morale.
sentences.zh: 這份調查是衡量員工士氣的實用指標。

sentences.en: What's the best gauge of a company's health?
sentences.zh: 衡量公司體質最好的指標是什麼？

sentences.en: The temperature gauge on the oven isn't working.
sentences.zh: 烤箱上的溫度表壞了。

gloss_note: gaze at 凝視（持久而專注）

sentences.en: She gazed out the window at the falling snow.
sentences.zh: 她望著窗外飄落的雪。

sentences.en: What are you gazing at?
sentences.zh: 你在盯著什麼看？

sentences.en: The kids gazed at the fireworks in wonder.
sentences.zh: 孩子們驚奇地望著煙火。

sentences.en: His gaze stayed on the screen the whole meeting.
sentences.zh: 整場會議他的視線都停在螢幕上。

sentences.en: Why do cats gaze at the wall for so long?
sentences.zh: 為什麼貓會盯著牆壁看那麼久？

sentences.en: The tourists gazed up at the tall building.
sentences.zh: 遊客們抬頭仰望那棟高樓。

gloss_note: gear 不可數；camping gear 露營裝備

sentences.en: Did you pack all your camping gear?
sentences.zh: 你把露營裝備都收好了嗎？

sentences.en: He shifted into second gear and sped up.
sentences.zh: 他換到二檔並加速。

sentences.en: Where do you keep your fishing gear?
sentences.zh: 你的釣魚裝備放在哪裡？

sentences.en: My car is stuck in first gear.
sentences.zh: 我的車卡在一檔。

sentences.en: The store sells good outdoor gear at fair prices.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣品質不錯的戶外裝備，價格公道。

sentences.en: Check that all your safety gear fits before you start.
sentences.zh: 開始之前，先檢查所有安全裝備是否合身。

gloss_note: 與 sex 不同，gender 偏社會性別

sentences.en: Please select your gender on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上選擇你的性別。

sentences.en: Is the survey open to people of any gender?
sentences.zh: 這份問卷開放給任何性別的人嗎？

sentences.en: Gender should not affect how much someone earns.
sentences.zh: 性別不該影響一個人賺多少錢。

sentences.en: What's the gender ratio in your class?
sentences.zh: 你們班的性別比例是多少？

sentences.en: The teacher treats students equally, regardless of gender.
sentences.zh: 老師對所有學生一視同仁，不分性別。

sentences.en: The study compared test scores by age and gender.
sentences.zh: 這項研究依年齡和性別比較測驗成績。

sentences.en: Scientists found a gene linked to heart disease.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現了一個與心臟病有關的基因。

sentences.en: Do you think curly hair is in your genes?
sentences.zh: 你覺得捲髮是你的基因決定的嗎？

sentences.en: Each gene carries instructions for building a protein.
sentences.zh: 每個基因都帶有製造蛋白質的指令。

sentences.en: My eyes are blue because of a gene from my mother.
sentences.zh: 我的眼睛是藍色的，是因為母親的一個基因。

sentences.en: Which gene controls the color of the flower?
sentences.zh: 哪個基因控制花的顏色？

sentences.en: Good genes help, but exercise matters too.
sentences.zh: 好基因有幫助，但運動也很重要。

gloss_note: make a generalization 做概括；常帶貶意

sentences.en: That's a broad generalization, and it isn't always true.
sentences.zh: 那是個太籠統的說法，並不總是對的。

sentences.en: Is it fair to make a generalization from one example?
sentences.zh: 光憑一個例子就下籠統的結論，公平嗎？

sentences.en: Avoid making generalizations about people from one country.
sentences.zh: 避免對來自同一個國家的人做籠統的概括。

sentences.en: The report makes some sweeping generalizations about young workers.
sentences.zh: 這份報告對年輕員工做了一些過度籠統的概括。

sentences.en: Can you support your generalization with real data?
sentences.zh: 你能用真實數據支持你的概括性說法嗎？

sentences.en: A generalization based on three customers is not reliable.
sentences.zh: 只憑三位顧客做出的概括並不可靠。

sentences.en: My grandparents' generation grew up without computers.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母那一代是在沒有電腦的環境下長大的。

sentences.en: Each generation faces different challenges.
sentences.zh: 每一代人都面臨不同的挑戰。

sentences.en: Which generation do you think spends the most time online?
sentences.zh: 你覺得哪個世代花最多時間上網？

sentences.en: Three generations of my family live in this house.
sentences.zh: 我們家三代人住在這棟房子裡。

sentences.en: Is the younger generation really that different?
sentences.zh: 年輕一代真的那麼不一樣嗎？

sentences.en: The company wants to appeal to the next generation of customers.
sentences.zh: 公司想吸引下一代的顧客。

sentences.en: Thank you for your generosity.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的慷慨。

sentences.en: I was amazed by the generosity of our neighbors.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們的慷慨讓我驚訝不已。

sentences.en: Her generosity helped dozens of families last winter.
sentences.zh: 她的慷慨去年冬天幫助了數十個家庭。

sentences.en: How can we repay your generosity?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼回報你的慷慨？

sentences.en: The school thanked the donors for their generosity.
sentences.zh: 學校感謝捐款者的慷慨。

sentences.en: Did his generosity surprise you?
sentences.zh: 他的慷慨讓你意外嗎？

sentences.en: She is studying genetics at the university.
sentences.zh: 她在大學念遺傳學。

sentences.en: Does genetics play a role in height?
sentences.zh: 遺傳因素對身高有影響嗎？

sentences.en: Genetics explains why children look like their parents.
sentences.zh: 遺傳學解釋了孩子為什麼長得像父母。

sentences.en: The professor teaches a course in plant genetics.
sentences.zh: 那位教授開了一門植物遺傳學的課。

sentences.en: Is intelligence mostly a matter of genetics?
sentences.zh: 智力主要是遺傳因素造成的嗎？

sentences.en: Advances in genetics are changing modern medicine.
sentences.zh: 遺傳學的進步正在改變現代醫學。

sentences.en: Is this bag made of genuine leather?
sentences.zh: 這個包包是真皮做的嗎？

sentences.en: She showed genuine interest in my work.
sentences.zh: 她對我的工作表現出真正的興趣。

sentences.en: I appreciate your genuine concern.
sentences.zh: 我很感謝你真誠的關心。

sentences.en: Can you tell if this painting is genuine?
sentences.zh: 你分辨得出這幅畫是不是真品嗎？

sentences.en: He seems like a genuine person.
sentences.zh: 他看起來是個真誠的人。

sentences.en: We want genuine feedback from our customers.
sentences.zh: 我們想要顧客真實的意見回饋。

sentences.en: The company is expanding into new geographic markets.
sentences.zh: 公司正在拓展到新的地區市場。

sentences.en: Which geographic regions have the highest sales?
sentences.zh: 哪些地理區域的銷售最高？

sentences.en: Our customers are spread across a wide geographic area.
sentences.zh: 我們的客戶分布在很廣的地理區域。

sentences.en: Is the store's geographic location convenient for customers?
sentences.zh: 這家店的地理位置對顧客來說方便嗎？

sentences.en: Geographic barriers like mountains can slow down delivery.
sentences.zh: 像山脈這樣的地理阻隔會拖慢送貨速度。

sentences.en: Geographic differences affect how we price products.
sentences.zh: 地區差異會影響我們產品的定價。

gloss_note: germs 常指會致病的細菌

sentences.en: Wash your hands to get rid of germs.
sentences.zh: 洗手可以去除細菌。

sentences.en: Kids pass germs to each other at school.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在學校會互相傳染病菌。

sentences.en: Do hand sanitizers really kill germs?
sentences.zh: 乾洗手真的能殺死細菌嗎？

sentences.en: There are germs on every doorknob.
sentences.zh: 每個門把上都有細菌。

sentences.en: Cover your mouth when you cough to stop spreading germs.
sentences.zh: 咳嗽時要摀住嘴巴，避免散播病菌。

sentences.en: Are the germs that cause the flu the same every year?
sentences.zh: 引起流感的病菌每年都一樣嗎？

sentences.en: She is a gifted pianist.
sentences.zh: 她是位有天分的鋼琴家。

sentences.en: Our school has a program for gifted students.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有針對資優生的課程。

sentences.en: Is your son gifted in math?
sentences.zh: 你兒子有數學天分嗎？

sentences.en: He's gifted with a great sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 他天生就很有幽默感。

sentences.en: Do you think gifted children need special classes?
sentences.zh: 你覺得資優兒童需要特殊班級嗎？

sentences.en: The gifted young artist won first prize.
sentences.zh: 那位有天賦的年輕藝術家贏得了首獎。

gloss_note: 語氣比 huge 更誇張

sentences.en: A gigantic wave hit the shore.
sentences.zh: 一道巨浪打上了岸邊。

sentences.en: Did you see that gigantic truck?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那輛超大的卡車嗎？

sentences.en: The gigantic screen takes up an entire wall.
sentences.zh: 那面巨大的螢幕占滿整面牆。

sentences.en: Why did they build such a gigantic stadium?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼蓋這麼大的體育場？

sentences.en: We made a gigantic mistake on the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們在預算上犯了一個大得離譜的錯。

sentences.en: She ordered a gigantic pizza for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她為整個團隊訂了一個超大的披薩。

gloss_note: giggle 多指忍不住的輕笑

sentences.en: The kids giggled when the teacher sneezed.
sentences.zh: 老師打噴嚏時，孩子們咯咯笑了起來。

sentences.en: Why are you giggling over there?
sentences.zh: 你在那邊傻笑什麼？

sentences.en: I couldn't stop giggling during the movie.
sentences.zh: 我看電影時一直忍不住咯咯笑。

sentences.en: Her giggle made everyone in the room smile.
sentences.zh: 她的咯咯笑聲讓房間裡每個人都笑了。

sentences.en: Did the baby giggle when you made that face?
sentences.zh: 你做那個鬼臉時，寶寶有咯咯笑嗎？

sentences.en: She tried not to giggle during the speech.
sentences.zh: 她在演講時努力忍著不笑出聲。

gloss_note: 不可數；ginger ale 薑汁汽水

sentences.en: Add a little ginger to the soup.
sentences.zh: 在湯裡加一點薑。

sentences.en: Do you want ginger in your tea?
sentences.zh: 你的茶要加薑嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh ginger gives the dish a spicy kick.
sentences.zh: 新鮮的薑讓這道菜帶有辛辣的衝勁。

sentences.en: Can you peel the ginger for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我削薑皮嗎？

sentences.en: I drink ginger tea when I have a cold.
sentences.zh: 感冒時我會喝薑茶。

sentences.en: This stir-fry needs garlic, green onions, and ginger.
sentences.zh: 這道炒菜需要蒜頭、青蔥和薑。

gloss_note: catch a glimpse of 瞥見

sentences.en: I caught a glimpse of the actor at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我在機場瞥見了那位演員。

sentences.en: Did you get a glimpse of the driver?
sentences.zh: 你有瞄到司機嗎？

sentences.en: She glimpsed her old friend across the street.
sentences.zh: 她瞥見馬路對面的老朋友。

sentences.en: The tour gives visitors a glimpse of local life.
sentences.zh: 這趟導覽讓遊客得以一窺當地生活。

sentences.en: We only had a glimpse of the sunset before the clouds came.
sentences.zh: 雲飄來之前，我們只匆匆瞥見夕陽。

sentences.en: Can you give me a glimpse of the new design?
sentences.zh: 可以讓我先瞄一眼新設計嗎？

gloss_note: around the globe 全球各地

sentences.en: We have offices all around the globe.
sentences.zh: 我們在世界各地都有辦公室。

sentences.en: Can you find Taiwan on the globe?
sentences.zh: 你能在地球儀上找到台灣嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher spun the globe and pointed to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 老師轉動地球儀，指向巴西。

sentences.en: Customers from across the globe buy our products.
sentences.zh: 來自全球各地的顧客購買我們的產品。

sentences.en: Have you ever traveled halfway around the globe?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有去過地球另一端那麼遠的地方？

sentences.en: A small globe sits on his desk.
sentences.zh: 他的桌上放著一個小地球儀。

sentences.en: We had glorious weather all weekend.
sentences.zh: 整個週末天氣好極了。

sentences.en: It was a glorious day for a picnic.
sentences.zh: 那是個適合野餐的絕佳日子。

sentences.en: The team celebrated its glorious victory.
sentences.zh: 球隊慶祝它輝煌的勝利。

sentences.en: Isn't the sunrise glorious this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上的日出不是美極了嗎？

sentences.en: Did you see the glorious view from the top?
sentences.zh: 你有看到山頂那絕佳的景色嗎？

sentences.en: The museum shows the glorious history of the old empire.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示了古老帝國輝煌的歷史。

sentences.en: Is this bread gluten-free?
sentences.zh: 這款麵包是無麩質的嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have to avoid gluten?
sentences.zh: 你必須避開麩質嗎？

sentences.en: Gluten is what makes pizza dough stretchy.
sentences.zh: 麩質讓披薩麵團有彈性。

sentences.en: My roommate can't eat gluten, so we ordered rice bowls.
sentences.zh: 我室友不能吃麩質，所以我們點了蓋飯。

sentences.en: The menu marks every gluten-free dish with a small leaf.
sentences.zh: 菜單用小葉子標示每道無麩質的菜。

sentences.en: Bread flour has more gluten than cake flour.
sentences.zh: 高筋麵粉的麩質比低筋麵粉多。

gloss_note: gourmet burger 精緻漢堡；也可當名詞指美食家

sentences.en: We had a gourmet burger with truffle fries.
sentences.zh: 我們吃了精緻漢堡，配松露薯條。

sentences.en: Is that gourmet shop on Main Street still open?
sentences.zh: 主街上那家精緻美食店還開著嗎？

sentences.en: Did you see the gourmet cheese at the farmers market?
sentences.zh: 你有看到農夫市集的精緻起司嗎？

sentences.en: He cooks gourmet meals every weekend just for fun.
sentences.zh: 他每個週末都做精緻料理，純粹好玩。

sentences.en: The hotel's gourmet breakfast costs extra.
sentences.zh: 飯店的精緻早餐要另外收費。

sentences.en: Gourmet coffee is getting more expensive every year.
sentences.zh: 精緻咖啡每年都越來越貴。

gloss_note: 較正式；常說 government agency 政府機關

sentences.en: Do you need governmental approval to open a bank?
sentences.zh: 開銀行需要政府核准嗎？

sentences.en: Which governmental agency handles business licenses here?
sentences.zh: 這裡由哪個政府機關負責營業執照？

sentences.en: The company works closely with several governmental agencies.
sentences.zh: 這家公司與幾個政府機關密切合作。

sentences.en: Our biggest client is a governmental organization.
sentences.zh: 我們最大的客戶是政府單位。

sentences.en: Governmental regulations changed again last quarter.
sentences.zh: 上一季政府法規又改了。

sentences.en: Are there any governmental grants for small businesses?
sentences.zh: 有針對小型企業的政府補助嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a long red gown to the wedding.
sentences.zh: 她穿一件紅色長禮服去參加婚禮。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that beautiful gown?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡買到那件漂亮的禮服？

sentences.en: The graduates put on their caps and gowns.
sentences.zh: 畢業生戴上學士帽、穿上畢業袍。

sentences.en: Do I have to return the gown after graduation?
sentences.zh: 畢業典禮後我得歸還這件長袍嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse handed me a hospital gown.
sentences.zh: 護理師遞給我一件病人袍。

sentences.en: Her wedding gown was made by her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 她的結婚禮服是外婆做的。

gloss_note: grace us with 賞光蒞臨

sentences.en: Did you see how she moved with such grace?
sentences.zh: 你有看到她的動作多麼優雅嗎？

sentences.en: How does he handle pressure with such grace?
sentences.zh: 他怎麼能那麼優雅地面對壓力？

sentences.en: He accepted the loss with grace.
sentences.zh: 他很有風度地接受了落敗。

sentences.en: Ballet takes strength as well as grace.
sentences.zh: 芭蕾除了力量，也需要優雅。

sentences.en: Her photo graced the cover of the magazine this month.
sentences.zh: 她的照片為本月雜誌封面增色不少。

sentences.en: Will the mayor grace us with a speech tonight?
sentences.zh: 市長今晚會賞光為我們致詞嗎？

sentences.en: The dancer's movements were smooth and graceful.
sentences.zh: 舞者的動作流暢又優美。

sentences.en: Have you seen how graceful she is on skates?
sentences.zh: 你有看到她溜冰時多優美嗎？

sentences.en: Cats are graceful, even when they fall.
sentences.zh: 貓即使跌落也很優雅。

sentences.en: He made a graceful exit after the argument.
sentences.zh: 吵完之後他得體地退場了。

sentences.en: Could you give me a graceful way to say no?
sentences.zh: 你能教我一個得體的拒絕方式嗎？

sentences.en: The bridge has a graceful curve over the river.
sentences.zh: 那座橋在河上有一道優美的弧線。

sentences.en: Thank you for being such a gracious host.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你當這麼親切的主人。

sentences.en: Was the winner gracious when she accepted the award?
sentences.zh: 得獎者領獎時態度有風度嗎？

sentences.en: It was gracious of you to invite my parents too.
sentences.zh: 你連我爸媽也邀請，真是周到體貼。

sentences.en: Our neighbors were gracious about the noise.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居對噪音很寬容。

sentences.en: Why is the manager always so gracious to everyone?
sentences.zh: 為什麼經理對每個人都那麼和氣有禮？

sentences.en: He gave a gracious reply to the harsh criticism.
sentences.zh: 他對嚴厲的批評給了寬厚的回應。

sentences.en: Her English grammar is better than mine.
sentences.zh: 她的英文文法比我好。

sentences.en: Can you check my grammar in this email?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我檢查這封電子郵件的文法嗎？

sentences.en: Did we cover this grammar rule in class?
sentences.zh: 這個文法規則我們上課教過嗎？

sentences.en: Grammar is easier when you read a lot.
sentences.zh: 多閱讀的話，文法就比較容易學。

sentences.en: There are two grammar mistakes in your first paragraph.
sentences.zh: 你的第一段有兩個文法錯誤。

sentences.en: The teacher explained the grammar of this sentence.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了這個句子的文法。

gloss_note: grateful to sb for sth 感激某人某事

sentences.en: I'm so grateful for your help today.
sentences.zh: 我非常感謝你今天的幫忙。

sentences.en: How can I show my parents I'm grateful?
sentences.zh: 我該怎麼讓爸媽知道我很感激？

sentences.en: We'd be grateful if you could reply by Monday.
sentences.zh: 如果你能在週一前回覆，我們會很感激。

sentences.en: Are you grateful to the neighbors who helped you move?
sentences.zh: 你感激那些幫你搬家的鄰居嗎？

sentences.en: I'm grateful to have a job I like.
sentences.zh: 我很感恩能有一份自己喜歡的工作。

sentences.en: She was grateful for the ride home.
sentences.zh: 她很感激有人載她回家。

sentences.en: She sent flowers to show her gratitude.
sentences.zh: 她送花表達感激。

sentences.en: How can we show our gratitude to the volunteers?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼向志工表達感謝？

sentences.en: He wrote a card to express his gratitude.
sentences.zh: 他寫了張卡片表達謝意。

sentences.en: Do you ever feel gratitude for the small things?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有對小事心懷感激過？

sentences.en: I have endless gratitude for everything you did.
sentences.zh: 我對你所做的一切有說不盡的感激。

sentences.en: Our class gave the teacher a gift out of gratitude.
sentences.zh: 我們班送老師一份禮物表示感激。

sentences.en: The company is in grave danger of going bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 這家公司面臨破產的重大危機。

sentences.en: Do you think this is a grave mistake?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這是個嚴重的錯誤嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors have grave concerns about the new drug.
sentences.zh: 醫師們對這種新藥有嚴重的疑慮。

sentences.en: Is the situation as grave as the news says?
sentences.zh: 情況真的像新聞說的那麼嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: Visitors left flowers at the soldier's grave.
sentences.zh: 訪客在那位士兵的墳前放了花。

sentences.en: Where is your grandfather's grave?
sentences.zh: 你爺爺的墳墓在哪裡？

gloss_note: gravity of 事態的嚴重性

sentences.en: Gravity pulls everything toward the center of the Earth.
sentences.zh: 重力把萬物拉向地球中心。

sentences.en: Why does gravity feel weaker on the Moon?
sentences.zh: 為什麼月球上的重力感覺比較小？

sentences.en: Astronauts train for weeks to handle zero gravity.
sentences.zh: 太空人受訓數週來適應無重力環境。

sentences.en: Do you understand the gravity of this decision?
sentences.zh: 你了解這個決定的嚴重性嗎？

sentences.en: The gravity of the situation became clear after the flood.
sentences.zh: 洪水過後，情勢的嚴重性才變得明顯。

sentences.en: Scientists have studied gravity for centuries.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究重力已經好幾個世紀。

sentences.en: Greasy food always upsets my stomach.
sentences.zh: 油膩的食物總是讓我胃不舒服。

sentences.en: Is the pizza too greasy for you?
sentences.zh: 這披薩對你來說會太油嗎？

sentences.en: Why are the fries so greasy today?
sentences.zh: 今天的薯條怎麼這麼油？

sentences.en: My hands got greasy from the burger.
sentences.zh: 漢堡弄得我手上都是油。

sentences.en: The diner's breakfast was good but a little greasy.
sentences.zh: 那家小餐館的早餐好吃，但有點油膩。

sentences.en: Wipe the greasy pan with a paper towel first.
sentences.zh: 先用紙巾把油膩的平底鍋擦一擦。

sentences.en: I'll have a Greek salad with extra feta.
sentences.zh: 我要一份希臘沙拉，多加羊奶起司。

sentences.en: Do you want Greek yogurt or regular yogurt?
sentences.zh: 你要希臘優格還是一般優格？

sentences.en: Is there a good Greek restaurant near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有好吃的希臘餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: I put Greek yogurt on my pancakes.
sentences.zh: 我把希臘優格放在鬆餅上。

sentences.en: My favorite Greek dish is lamb with lemon potatoes.
sentences.zh: 我最愛的希臘菜是羊肉配檸檬馬鈴薯。

sentences.en: The Greek olives here are salty but delicious.
sentences.zh: 這裡的希臘橄欖有點鹹，但很好吃。

sentences.en: A simple greeting makes customers feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 簡單的問候就能讓顧客感到受歡迎。

sentences.en: What's a polite greeting for a first meeting?
sentences.zh: 初次見面有什麼有禮貌的招呼用語？

sentences.en: She waved in greeting from across the street.
sentences.zh: 她在對街揮手打招呼。

sentences.en: Did you get my birthday greeting?
sentences.zh: 你有收到我的生日問候嗎？

sentences.en: The most common English greeting is a simple hello.
sentences.zh: 英文最常見的問候語就是一聲簡單的哈囉。

sentences.en: He gave the guests a warm greeting at the door.
sentences.zh: 他在門口熱情地招呼賓客。

sentences.en: The data is arranged in a grid of rows and columns.
sentences.zh: 資料以行列組成的網格排列。

sentences.en: Can you add a grid to the chart?
sentences.zh: 你可以在圖表上加格線嗎？

sentences.en: A storm knocked out the power grid for hours.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨使電力網癱瘓了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Is the city's power grid ready for summer?
sentences.zh: 這座城市的電力網準備好迎接夏天了嗎？

sentences.en: We use a grid to line up the photos on each page.
sentences.zh: 我們用網格來排每頁的照片位置。

sentences.en: Our designer built the web page on a twelve-column grid.
sentences.zh: 設計師用十二欄網格做出了這個網頁。

gloss_note: deal with grief 面對悲痛
other_senses: 麻煩；刁難（give sb grief，口語）

sentences.en: He felt deep grief after losing his grandfather.
sentences.zh: 失去爺爺後，他深感悲痛。

sentences.en: How do people deal with grief?
sentences.zh: 人們要怎麼面對悲痛？

sentences.en: Time doesn't erase grief, but it helps.
sentences.zh: 時間不會抹去悲痛，但會有幫助。

sentences.en: The whole town shared the family's grief.
sentences.zh: 全鎮的人都分擔了那家人的悲痛。

sentences.en: Is there a support group for people in grief?
sentences.zh: 有為悲痛中的人設的支持團體嗎？

sentences.en: Grief can make it hard to sleep or eat.
sentences.zh: 悲痛會讓人難以入睡或進食。

gloss_note: the daily grind 日復一日的苦差事

sentences.en: Do you grind your own coffee beans?
sentences.zh: 你自己磨咖啡豆嗎？

sentences.en: Grind some fresh pepper over the pasta, please.
sentences.zh: 請在義大利麵上磨一點新鮮胡椒。

sentences.en: Can you grind these nuts into a fine powder?
sentences.zh: 你能把這些堅果磨成細粉嗎？

sentences.en: This old machine can grind wheat into flour.
sentences.zh: 這台老機器可以把小麥磨成麵粉。

sentences.en: Working two jobs is a real grind.
sentences.zh: 同時打兩份工真是苦差事。

sentences.en: I'm tired of the daily grind at the office.
sentences.zh: 我厭倦了辦公室日復一日的苦差事。

gloss_note: bride and groom 新娘新郎

sentences.en: The groom wore a dark blue suit.
sentences.zh: 新郎穿著深藍色西裝。

sentences.en: Who is the groom's best man?
sentences.zh: 新郎的伴郎是誰？

sentences.en: The bride and groom cut the cake together.
sentences.zh: 新娘和新郎一起切蛋糕。

sentences.en: Did the groom cry during the vows?
sentences.zh: 新郎在宣讀誓詞時有哭嗎？

sentences.en: The groom's parents hosted the rehearsal dinner.
sentences.zh: 新郎的父母主辦了婚禮彩排晚宴。

sentences.en: My brother is the groom, so I'm nervous too.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥是新郎，所以我也很緊張。

gloss_note: 電器保固美式多說 warranty

sentences.en: This laptop comes with a satisfaction guarantee.
sentences.zh: 這台筆電附有滿意保證。

sentences.en: Can you guarantee it will arrive by Friday?
sentences.zh: 你能保證週五前送到嗎？

sentences.en: I can't guarantee we'll finish on time.
sentences.zh: 我不能保證我們會準時完成。

sentences.en: Does the store offer a money-back guarantee?
sentences.zh: 這家店有提供退款保證嗎？

sentences.en: Hard work doesn't guarantee success.
sentences.zh: 努力工作並不保證會成功。

sentences.en: The coach guaranteed that every player would get a chance.
sentences.zh: 教練保證每位球員都有機會上場。

sentences.en: Students under eighteen need a parent or guardian's signature.
sentences.zh: 未滿十八歲的學生需要家長或監護人簽名。

sentences.en: Are you the legal guardian of this child?
sentences.zh: 你是這個孩子的法定監護人嗎？

sentences.en: Her aunt became her guardian after the accident.
sentences.zh: 意外之後，她的阿姨成了她的監護人。

sentences.en: Please have your guardian sign this form.
sentences.zh: 請讓你的監護人在這張表格上簽名。

sentences.en: In the story, a stone lion is the guardian of the village.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，石獅是村子的守護者。

sentences.en: Why do some people see themselves as guardians of tradition?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人把自己當成傳統的守護者？

gloss_note: guilt trip 讓人內疚的說法（口語）

sentences.en: I felt a lot of guilt about missing her birthday.
sentences.zh: 錯過她的生日讓我很愧疚。

sentences.en: Why do you carry so much guilt?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼背負那麼多罪惡感？

sentences.en: Do you feel any guilt about leaving early?
sentences.zh: 提早離開你會覺得有罪惡感嗎？

sentences.en: The jury must decide on his guilt or innocence.
sentences.zh: 陪審團必須決定他有罪還是無罪。

sentences.en: Guilt kept him awake all night.
sentences.zh: 罪惡感讓他整晚睡不著。

sentences.en: The evidence proves her guilt beyond doubt.
sentences.zh: 證據毫無疑問地證明了她有罪。

gloss_note: guilty pleasure 讓人有點內疚的小享受

sentences.en: I feel guilty about eating the last cookie.
sentences.zh: 我吃掉最後一片餅乾覺得很內疚。

sentences.en: Do you feel guilty when you skip the gym?
sentences.zh: 沒去健身房你會覺得內疚嗎？

sentences.en: The jury found him guilty of theft.
sentences.zh: 陪審團認定他犯了竊盜罪。

sentences.en: What's your guilty pleasure on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末有什麼讓人有點愧疚的小享受？

sentences.en: He pleaded guilty to the charge in court.
sentences.zh: 他在法庭上對指控認罪。

sentences.en: She gave me a guilty look when I asked about the cake.
sentences.zh: 我問起蛋糕時，她露出心虛的表情。

sentences.en: Ships cross the gulf in about two days.
sentences.zh: 船隻大約兩天就能橫越海灣。

sentences.en: Is the gulf warm enough to swim in?
sentences.zh: 這片海灣的水夠暖，可以游泳嗎？

sentences.en: A hurricane formed over the gulf last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚海灣上空形成了颶風。

sentences.en: There's a wide gulf between rich and poor in some cities.
sentences.zh: 在某些城市，貧富之間有很大的鴻溝。

sentences.en: Can we close the gulf between our two teams?
sentences.zh: 我們能縮小兩個團隊之間的鴻溝嗎？

sentences.en: Fishermen leave early to work in the gulf.
sentences.zh: 漁夫們一早就出發到海灣捕魚。

gloss_note: 美式常唸 YEER-oh；皮塔餅包烤肉

sentences.en: I'll have a lamb gyro with extra sauce.
sentences.zh: 我要一份羊肉希臘烤肉捲，醬多加一點。

sentences.en: Does the gyro come with fries?
sentences.zh: 希臘烤肉捲有附薯條嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want chicken or lamb in your gyro?
sentences.zh: 你的希臘烤肉捲要雞肉還是羊肉？

sentences.en: The food truck sells a great gyro for eight dollars.
sentences.zh: 那輛餐車賣的希臘烤肉捲很好吃，一份八美元。

sentences.en: A gyro is meat, onions, and sauce wrapped in pita.
sentences.zh: 希臘烤肉捲是用皮塔餅包著肉、洋蔥和醬料。

sentences.en: He ate a gyro in the car on the way home.
sentences.zh: 他在回家的車上吃了一個希臘烤肉捲。

sentences.en: Pandas lose habitat when forests are cut down.
sentences.zh: 森林被砍伐時，貓熊會失去棲息地。

sentences.en: Why is habitat loss such a big problem?
sentences.zh: 為什麼棲息地消失是這麼大的問題？

sentences.en: The zoo tries to copy each animal's natural habitat.
sentences.zh: 動物園努力模擬每種動物的自然棲息地。

sentences.en: Wetlands are an important habitat for birds.
sentences.zh: 濕地是鳥類重要的棲息地。

sentences.en: Can fish survive if their habitat gets warmer?
sentences.zh: 如果棲息地變暖，魚還能存活嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists are working to protect the turtle's habitat.
sentences.zh: 科學家正努力保護海龜的棲息地。

gloss_note: habitual liar 習慣性說謊者

sentences.en: He's a habitual liar, so nobody trusts him.
sentences.zh: 他習慣性說謊，所以沒人相信他。

sentences.en: Is his complaining habitual, or is he just stressed?
sentences.zh: 他愛抱怨是習慣性的，還是只是壓力大？

sentences.en: Habitual lateness can cost you your job.
sentences.zh: 習慣性遲到可能會讓你丟掉工作。

sentences.en: Are you a habitual coffee drinker?
sentences.zh: 你是習慣每天喝咖啡的人嗎？

sentences.en: Habitual late payments can hurt your credit score.
sentences.zh: 習慣性延遲付款會傷害你的信用分數。

sentences.en: She gave her habitual shrug and walked away.
sentences.zh: 她照例聳了聳肩，轉身走開。

gloss_note: come to a halt 停下來

sentences.en: The factory had to halt production after the fire.
sentences.zh: 火災後工廠不得不停止生產。

sentences.en: The truck came to a halt at the red light.
sentences.zh: 卡車在紅燈前停了下來。

sentences.en: Can anything halt the rise in prices?
sentences.zh: 有什麼能阻止物價上漲嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the board halt the project?
sentences.zh: 董事會為什麼中止這個專案？

sentences.en: Traffic ground to a halt near the bridge.
sentences.zh: 橋附近的車流完全停住了。

sentences.en: Officials may halt the game if the rain gets worse.
sentences.zh: 如果雨更大，裁判可能會暫停比賽。

sentences.en: Please put the handset back on its base.
sentences.zh: 請把聽筒放回底座上。

sentences.en: Did you charge the cordless handset last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有幫無線話機充電嗎？

sentences.en: The company sold two million handsets last quarter.
sentences.zh: 公司上一季賣出了兩百萬支手機。

sentences.en: Which handsets come with this phone plan?
sentences.zh: 這個資費方案有搭配哪些手機？

sentences.en: I dropped the handset, and now there's static.
sentences.zh: 我把話機摔到地上，現在有雜音。

sentences.en: The new handset has a bigger screen and a longer battery life.
sentences.zh: 新手機螢幕更大，電池也更耐用。

sentences.en: Your handwriting is so neat!
sentences.zh: 你的字好工整！

sentences.en: Can you read the doctor's handwriting on this prescription?
sentences.zh: 你看得懂醫師在這張處方上的字跡嗎？

sentences.en: My handwriting gets worse when I'm in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 我一趕時間，字就會變得更醜。

sentences.en: Does your school still teach handwriting?
sentences.zh: 你們學校還教手寫嗎？

sentences.en: I recognized her handwriting on the envelope right away.
sentences.zh: 我一眼就認出信封上是她的筆跡。

sentences.en: Handwriting helps me remember things better than typing does.
sentences.zh: 手寫比打字更能幫我記住東西。

sentences.en: Many families faced hardship during the recession.
sentences.zh: 許多家庭在經濟衰退期間面臨困苦。

sentences.en: She grew up in hardship but never gave up.
sentences.zh: 她在困苦中長大，卻從不放棄。

sentences.en: Does the company help workers in financial hardship?
sentences.zh: 公司會幫助經濟困難的員工嗎？

sentences.en: What was the biggest hardship of your first year abroad?
sentences.zh: 你出國第一年最大的困難是什麼？

sentences.en: They endured years of hardship to save for a house.
sentences.zh: 他們忍受多年的艱苦，只為了存錢買房。

sentences.en: The long drought brought hardship to local farmers.
sentences.zh: 長期的乾旱給當地農民帶來了困苦。

gloss_note: in harmony 和睦；三部和聲

sentences.en: The neighbors live together in harmony.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們和睦相處。

sentences.en: How do you keep harmony in a big family?
sentences.zh: 大家庭裡要怎麼維持和諧？

sentences.en: Our choir is practicing a song in three-part harmony.
sentences.zh: 我們的合唱團在練習三部和聲的歌。

sentences.en: Can you sing the harmony while I sing the melody?
sentences.zh: 我唱旋律時，你可以唱和聲嗎？

sentences.en: The colors in the room are in perfect harmony.
sentences.zh: 房間裡的色彩搭配得非常和諧。

sentences.en: Good teamwork depends on harmony between coworkers.
sentences.zh: 良好的團隊合作要靠同事之間的和諧。

sentences.en: Her harsh words made everyone in the room go quiet.
sentences.zh: 她嚴厲的話讓房裡所有人都安靜下來。

sentences.en: Don't you think the penalty was too harsh?
sentences.zh: 你不覺得這處罰太嚴厲了嗎？

sentences.en: My boss was harsh with me in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 老闆在會議上對我很嚴厲。

sentences.en: Can plants survive in such harsh conditions?
sentences.zh: 植物能在這麼惡劣的條件下存活嗎？

sentences.en: The CEO received harsh criticism for the layoffs.
sentences.zh: 執行長因裁員遭到嚴厲批評。

sentences.en: Harsh weather delayed our flight for two hours.
sentences.zh: 惡劣的天氣讓我們的班機延誤了兩小時。

sentences.en: In my haste, I forgot my keys.
sentences.zh: 我一匆忙就忘了帶鑰匙。

sentences.en: Why did you leave in such haste?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼匆忙地離開？

sentences.en: Haste makes waste, so check your work.
sentences.zh: 欲速則不達，所以要檢查你的作業。

sentences.en: The report was written in haste and full of errors.
sentences.zh: 這份報告寫得匆促，錯誤百出。

sentences.en: Is there any need for such haste?
sentences.zh: 有必要這麼倉促嗎？

sentences.en: She packed her bag in haste and ran for the train.
sentences.zh: 她匆忙收拾包包，跑去趕火車。

gloss_note: hasten to add 趕緊補充；較正式

sentences.en: Cold weather may hasten the spread of the flu.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的天氣可能加速流感的傳播。

sentences.en: Will the new system hasten the approval process?
sentences.zh: 新系統會加快核准流程嗎？

sentences.en: I hasten to add that no one was hurt.
sentences.zh: 我要趕緊補充一句，沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: Stress can hasten the aging process.
sentences.zh: 壓力會加速老化。

sentences.en: Did the delay hasten the company's decline?
sentences.zh: 這次延誤加速了公司的衰退嗎？

sentences.en: We hastened back to the hotel when it started to rain.
sentences.zh: 下雨時我們急忙趕回飯店。

sentences.en: He felt deep hatred for the people who lied to him.
sentences.zh: 他對欺騙他的人懷有深深的恨意。

sentences.en: Why does hatred spread so quickly online?
sentences.zh: 為什麼仇恨在網路上散播得這麼快？

sentences.en: Can hatred ever lead to anything good?
sentences.zh: 憎恨能帶來任何好處嗎？

sentences.en: Her hatred of spiders keeps her out of the garage.
sentences.zh: 她對蜘蛛的憎恨讓她不敢進車庫。

sentences.en: The film shows how hatred can destroy a family.
sentences.zh: 這部電影呈現了憎恨如何摧毀一個家庭。

sentences.en: Love is stronger than hatred, the old saying goes.
sentences.zh: 俗話說，愛比恨更強大。

sentences.en: Our trucks haul goods from the port to the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我們的卡車把貨物從港口運到倉庫。

sentences.en: How much can this truck haul at once?
sentences.zh: 這輛卡車一次能拖運多少？

sentences.en: We hired movers to haul the old couch away.
sentences.zh: 我們請搬家工人把舊沙發拖走。

sentences.en: Can you haul these boxes to the loading dock?
sentences.zh: 你能把這些箱子拖到裝貨碼頭嗎？

sentences.en: It's a long haul from Los Angeles to Seattle by truck.
sentences.zh: 開卡車從洛杉磯到西雅圖是一段長途。

sentences.en: Fuel costs add up on a long haul.
sentences.zh: 跑長途運輸時，油錢會越加越多。

gloss_zh: 夏威夷的；夏威夷風味的
other_senses: 夏威夷人；夏威夷語（名詞）

sentences.en: Do you want Hawaiian pizza with pineapple?
sentences.zh: 你想要加鳳梨的夏威夷披薩嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have the Hawaiian poke bowl, please.
sentences.zh: 我要夏威夷生魚丼，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Does this café serve Hawaiian coffee?
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店有賣夏威夷咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: My favorite Hawaiian dish is kalua pork.
sentences.zh: 我最愛的夏威夷菜是夏威夷烤豬肉。

sentences.en: The Hawaiian barbecue place near work is always crowded.
sentences.zh: 公司附近那家夏威夷烤肉店總是人很多。

sentences.en: These Hawaiian rolls are soft and a little sweet.
sentences.zh: 這些夏威夷麵包捲又軟又帶點甜味。

sentences.en: A hawk was circling over the field.
sentences.zh: 一隻老鷹在田野上空盤旋。

sentences.en: Did you see that hawk on the power line?
sentences.zh: 你有看到電線上那隻老鷹嗎？

sentences.en: Hawks have very sharp eyesight.
sentences.zh: 老鷹的視力非常敏銳。

sentences.en: The hawk dove down and caught a mouse.
sentences.zh: 老鷹俯衝而下，抓走了一隻老鼠。

sentences.en: How high can a hawk fly?
sentences.zh: 老鷹能飛多高？

sentences.en: A hawk built its nest in the old oak tree.
sentences.zh: 一隻老鷹在那棵老橡樹上築了巢。

sentences.en: Wet floors are a safety hazard.
sentences.zh: 濕滑的地板是安全隱患。

sentences.en: Is this wiring a fire hazard?
sentences.zh: 這些線路會有火災危險嗎？

sentences.en: Please report any hazard you see in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 請通報你在倉庫看到的任何危險。

sentences.en: The company trains workers to spot health hazards.
sentences.zh: 公司訓練員工辨識健康危害。

sentences.en: Smoking is a serious health hazard.
sentences.zh: 吸菸是嚴重的健康危害。

sentences.en: What hazards should we plan for on the construction site?
sentences.zh: 我們在工地應該預防哪些危險？

sentences.en: Hazardous waste must be thrown away properly.
sentences.zh: 有害廢棄物必須妥善處理。

sentences.en: Is it hazardous to mix these cleaning products?
sentences.zh: 混用這些清潔劑有危險嗎？

sentences.en: The road is hazardous when it's icy.
sentences.zh: 路面結冰時很危險。

sentences.en: Workers wear masks in hazardous areas.
sentences.zh: 工人在危險區域會戴口罩。

sentences.en: Why is this chemical labeled hazardous?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這種化學品被標示為有害？

sentences.en: Shipping hazardous materials requires special forms.
sentences.zh: 運送危險物品需要特殊表格。

sentences.en: Does the company offer good healthcare benefits?
sentences.zh: 公司提供的醫療保健福利好嗎？

sentences.en: Healthcare costs are rising faster than wages.
sentences.zh: 醫療保健費用上漲得比薪資快。

sentences.en: My roommate works in healthcare as a nurse.
sentences.zh: 我室友在醫療保健業當護理師。

sentences.en: How much do you pay for healthcare each month?
sentences.zh: 你每個月花多少錢在醫療保健上？

sentences.en: Many small businesses can't afford to provide healthcare.
sentences.zh: 許多小企業負擔不起提供醫療保健。

sentences.en: She has ten years of experience in healthcare sales.
sentences.zh: 她有十年的醫療保健業銷售經驗。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame

gloss_note: a herd of cattle 一群牛

sentences.en: A herd of cattle blocked the country road.
sentences.zh: 一群牛擋住了鄉間道路。

sentences.en: How many cows are in that herd?
sentences.zh: 那群牛有多少頭？

sentences.en: We watched a herd of elephants cross the river.
sentences.zh: 我們看著一群大象過河。

sentences.en: The farmer herded the sheep into the barn.
sentences.zh: 農夫把羊群趕進穀倉。

sentences.en: Can a dog herd sheep without training?
sentences.zh: 狗沒受過訓練也能趕羊嗎？

sentences.en: The guide herded us onto the bus after lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐後導遊把我們趕上遊覽車。

gloss_note: be hesitant to do 不願貿然做

sentences.en: I was hesitant to sign the contract.
sentences.zh: 我對簽這份合約有些猶豫。

sentences.en: Why are you so hesitant to ask for a raise?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼不敢開口要求加薪？

sentences.en: The customer seemed hesitant about the price.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客對價格似乎有些猶豫。

sentences.en: Are you hesitant about taking the new job?
sentences.zh: 你對接下新工作有所猶豫嗎？

sentences.en: She gave a hesitant smile and stepped inside.
sentences.zh: 她帶著遲疑的微笑走了進去。

sentences.en: Many investors are hesitant to buy right now.
sentences.zh: 許多投資人現在都不敢貿然買進。

sentences.en: After a brief hesitation, she said yes to the offer.
sentences.zh: 稍微猶豫了一下，她答應了這份邀約。

sentences.en: What's behind your hesitation about moving to Texas?
sentences.zh: 你對搬到德州有所猶豫，是為什麼？

sentences.en: I noticed a slight hesitation in his voice.
sentences.zh: 我注意到他的聲音裡有一絲遲疑。

sentences.en: Do you have any hesitation about the plan?
sentences.zh: 你對這個計畫有任何猶豫嗎？

sentences.en: A moment of hesitation can cost you the game.
sentences.zh: 一時的猶豫可能讓你輸掉比賽。

sentences.en: Please call me without hesitation if you need help.
sentences.zh: 如果需要幫忙，請不要猶豫，儘管打給我。

sentences.en: The waiter highly recommended the grilled salmon.
sentences.zh: 服務生極力推薦烤鮭魚。

sentences.en: Is the chef highly rated around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近的主廚評價很高嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighbors highly recommend that new Thai place.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居極力推薦那家新開的泰式餐廳。

sentences.en: Which dish would you highly recommend here?
sentences.zh: 這裡你最推薦哪一道菜？

sentences.en: This is a highly popular bakery on weekends.
sentences.zh: 這家烘焙坊週末非常受歡迎。

sentences.en: The soup was highly seasoned, so I drank a lot of water.
sentences.zh: 那碗湯調味非常重，所以我喝了很多水。

gloss_note: 常置句首；historically low 歷史新低

sentences.en: Historically, interest rates have been lower in this region.
sentences.zh: 歷來這個地區的利率都比較低。

sentences.en: Has our company historically done well in the winter?
sentences.zh: 我們公司過去在冬季的表現一向不錯嗎？

sentences.en: Historically, the town depended on its fishing industry.
sentences.zh: 歷史上，這個小鎮靠漁業維生。

sentences.en: Do sales historically drop in the summer months?
sentences.zh: 夏季那幾個月的銷售量歷來都會下滑嗎？

sentences.en: Historically, we've never missed a payment.
sentences.zh: 一直以來，我們從來沒有漏繳過任何一筆款項。

sentences.en: Our budget is historically tight in the first quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們的預算在第一季向來吃緊。

other_senses: 熱鬧忙碌的地方（a hive of activity）

sentences.en: The bees returned to the hive before the rain started.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂在下雨前飛回了蜂巢。

sentences.en: Did you see the hive hanging from that tree?
sentences.zh: 你有看到掛在那棵樹上的蜂巢嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle keeps three hives in his backyard.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在後院放了三個蜂箱。

sentences.en: How many bees can live in one hive?
sentences.zh: 一個蜂巢裡可以住多少隻蜜蜂？

sentences.en: Don't touch the hive, or the bees will get angry.
sentences.zh: 別碰蜂巢，不然蜜蜂會生氣。

sentences.en: The beekeeper opened the hive to collect some honey.
sentences.zh: 養蜂人打開蜂箱來採一些蜂蜜。

gloss_note: 指出生或祖先所在的國家

sentences.en: Many people miss their homeland during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 很多人在節日期間會想念自己的故鄉。

sentences.en: When was the last time you visited your homeland?
sentences.zh: 你上一次回到故鄉是什麼時候？

sentences.en: She sends money to her family in her homeland every month.
sentences.zh: 她每個月都寄錢給在故鄉的家人。

sentences.en: Do you still cook food from your homeland?
sentences.zh: 你還會煮來自家鄉的料理嗎？

sentences.en: His homeland is known for its beautiful mountains.
sentences.zh: 他的祖國以美麗的山岳聞名。

sentences.en: They moved here, but their homeland always stays in their hearts.
sentences.zh: 他們搬來了這裡，但故鄉永遠留在他們心中。

gloss_note: 動詞用法：honeymoon in 在某地度蜜月

sentences.en: Where are you going for your honeymoon?
sentences.zh: 你們蜜月旅行要去哪裡？

sentences.en: They honeymooned in Hawaii two years ago.
sentences.zh: 他們兩年前去夏威夷度蜜月。

sentences.en: We're saving up for our honeymoon right now.
sentences.zh: 我們現在正在為蜜月旅行存錢。

sentences.en: Did you enjoy your honeymoon in Italy?
sentences.zh: 你們在義大利的蜜月旅行玩得開心嗎？

sentences.en: My parents still talk about their honeymoon at the lake.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽還是常常聊起他們在湖邊度蜜月的事。

sentences.en: After the wedding, the couple will honeymoon in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 婚禮結束後，這對新人會到墨西哥度蜜月。

gloss_note: hook A to B 把 A 鉤在 B 上

sentences.en: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
sentences.zh: 把你的外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

sentences.en: Could you hook the trailer to the truck?
sentences.zh: 你可以把拖車鉤到卡車上嗎？

sentences.en: There's a hook on the back of the bathroom door.
sentences.zh: 浴室門後面有一個掛鉤。

sentences.en: Where's the hook for the towels?
sentences.zh: 掛毛巾的掛鉤在哪裡？

sentences.en: He hooked the rope onto the rail and pulled hard.
sentences.zh: 他把繩子鉤在欄杆上，然後用力一拉。

sentences.en: We need a stronger hook to hold this heavy mirror.
sentences.zh: 我們需要更牢固的掛鉤來掛這面很重的鏡子。

gloss_note: 生物與醫學常見字；hormone level 荷爾蒙濃度

sentences.en: Insulin is a hormone that controls blood sugar.
sentences.zh: 胰島素是一種控制血糖的荷爾蒙。

sentences.en: Which hormone makes people feel sleepy at night?
sentences.zh: 哪一種荷爾蒙會讓人在夜裡覺得想睡？

sentences.en: Stress can change the level of hormones in your body.
sentences.zh: 壓力會改變你體內的荷爾蒙濃度。

sentences.en: Does exercise affect hormone levels in teenagers?
sentences.zh: 運動會影響青少年的荷爾蒙濃度嗎？

sentences.en: My doctor said my hormones were completely normal.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生說我的荷爾蒙完全正常。

sentences.en: Researchers measured the growth hormone in each patient's blood.
sentences.zh: 研究人員測量了每位患者血液中的生長激素。

gloss_note: 常用被動：be horrified at/by 對…感到驚駭

sentences.en: The loud crash horrified everyone in the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 那聲巨響嚇壞了餐廳裡的每一個人。

sentences.en: Were you horrified when you saw the bill?
sentences.zh: 你看到帳單的時候是不是嚇傻了？

sentences.en: The news about the fire horrified the whole town.
sentences.zh: 這則火災的消息讓全鎮的人震驚不已。

sentences.en: I was horrified to find mold in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 我發現冰箱裡長了霉，嚇了一大跳。

sentences.en: Doesn't it horrify you how fast prices are rising?
sentences.zh: 物價漲得這麼快，難道你不覺得震驚嗎？

sentences.en: Her rude comments horrified her parents at dinner.
sentences.zh: 她無禮的言論讓她的父母在晚餐時大吃一驚。

sentences.en: Please roll up the hose after you water the lawn.
sentences.zh: 澆完草坪後，請把水管捲起來。

sentences.en: Can you hose off the patio before the guests arrive?
sentences.zh: 客人到之前，你可以用水管把露台沖一沖嗎？

sentences.en: The garden hose is too short to reach the fence.
sentences.zh: 園藝水管太短，搆不到圍籬。

sentences.en: Where did you leave the hose this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上把水管放在哪裡了？

sentences.en: My son hosed down the muddy dog in the yard.
sentences.zh: 我兒子在院子裡用水管把滿身泥巴的狗沖乾淨。

sentences.en: A small hole in the hose was leaking water.
sentences.zh: 水管上有個小洞在漏水。

sentences.en: There was open hostility between the two managers.
sentences.zh: 兩位經理之間有著明顯的敵意。

sentences.en: Why do I sense hostility whenever he joins the call?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每次他加入通話，我都感覺得到敵意？

sentences.en: Customers showed hostility toward the new pricing policy.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新的訂價政策表現出敵意。

sentences.en: Did you notice the hostility in her email?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有注意到她那封電子郵件裡的敵意？

sentences.en: Hostility between the teams slowed down the whole project.
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊之間的敵對讓整個專案進度變慢。

sentences.en: We tried to ease the hostility before the meeting started.
sentences.zh: 我們在會議開始前試著化解雙方的敵意。

gloss_note: customer service hotline 客服專線

sentences.en: Call the customer service hotline if you need help.
sentences.zh: 需要協助的話，請撥打客服專線。

sentences.en: What's the number for the support hotline?
sentences.zh: 技術支援專線的號碼是多少？

sentences.en: The hotline is open twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 這支專線全天二十四小時開放。

sentences.en: I waited on the hotline for almost thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 我在專線上等了將近三十分鐘。

sentences.en: Did you try the hotline printed on the receipt?
sentences.zh: 你有試過收據上印的服務專線嗎？

sentences.en: The bank set up a hotline for lost cards.
sentences.zh: 銀行設立了一條遺失信用卡的通報專線。

gloss_note: 指同住的一家人；every household 每一戶

sentences.en: Every household in our building received a notice.
sentences.zh: 我們大樓的每一戶都收到了通知。

sentences.en: How many people live in your household?
sentences.zh: 你們家有幾個人住在一起？

sentences.en: The average household spends a lot on groceries.
sentences.zh: 一般家庭在食品雜貨上花很多錢。

sentences.en: Chores are shared among everyone in our household.
sentences.zh: 我們家的家事由每個人一起分攤。

sentences.en: Is there a smoke alarm in every household?
sentences.zh: 每個家庭都有裝煙霧警報器嗎？

sentences.en: Her household runs on a very tight budget.
sentences.zh: 她家的開銷抓得非常緊。

sentences.en: Chicago is a major hub for air travel.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥是重要的航空運輸樞紐。

sentences.en: Our new office will be the hub of the company.
sentences.zh: 我們的新辦公室將成為公司的中心。

sentences.en: Is this airport a hub for any big airline?
sentences.zh: 這座機場是哪家大型航空公司的樞紐嗎？

sentences.en: The city has become a hub for tech startups.
sentences.zh: 這座城市已經成為新創科技公司的聚集中心。

sentences.en: Where is the hub of your delivery network?
sentences.zh: 你們配送網路的樞紐在哪裡？

sentences.en: We'll send every package through the Dallas hub.
sentences.zh: 我們會把所有包裹都送到達拉斯的轉運中心。

sentences.en: Pollution is a serious threat to humanity.
sentences.zh: 汙染對人類是一大威脅。

sentences.en: Do you think humanity will ever live on Mars?
sentences.zh: 你覺得人類有一天會住在火星上嗎？

sentences.en: War movies often show the best and worst of humanity.
sentences.zh: 戰爭片常常呈現人性最好與最壞的一面。

sentences.en: What is the biggest challenge facing humanity today?
sentences.zh: 現今人類面臨的最大挑戰是什麼？

sentences.en: Her speech reminded us of our shared humanity.
sentences.zh: 她的演講讓我們想起彼此共有的人性。

sentences.en: Thanks to science, humanity has made huge progress.
sentences.zh: 多虧了科學，人類有了很大的進步。

sentences.en: The humidity here is unbearable in August.
sentences.zh: 這裡八月的濕度讓人受不了。

sentences.en: What's the humidity like in your area today?
sentences.zh: 你們那一帶今天的濕度怎麼樣？

sentences.en: High humidity makes the heat feel even worse.
sentences.zh: 高濕度讓暑熱感覺更難受。

sentences.en: Does the humidity bother you when you run?
sentences.zh: 你跑步的時候會被濕度困擾嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a machine to lower the humidity downstairs.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一台機器，來降低樓下的濕度。

sentences.en: Humidity in the rainforest stays above ninety percent.
sentences.zh: 雨林裡的濕度一直維持在百分之九十以上。

sentences.en: The hurricane is expected to hit the coast tonight.
sentences.zh: 預計颶風今晚會侵襲海岸。

sentences.en: Did you evacuate before the hurricane arrived?
sentences.zh: 颶風來襲之前，你們有撤離嗎？

sentences.en: Our school closed for two days because of the hurricane.
sentences.zh: 因為颶風，我們學校停課兩天。

sentences.en: Do you have enough water in case of a hurricane?
sentences.zh: 萬一遇上颶風，你們有準備足夠的水嗎？

sentences.en: The hurricane knocked down several trees on our street.
sentences.zh: 颶風吹倒了我們那條街上的好幾棵樹。

sentences.en: Forecasters are tracking a hurricane over the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 氣象預報人員正在追蹤大西洋上的一個颶風。

gloss_note: hybrid work 混合辦公（部分在家）

sentences.en: We're using a hybrid schedule with two days in the office.
sentences.zh: 我們採混合式上班制，每週進辦公室兩天。

sentences.en: Is your new car a hybrid?
sentences.zh: 你的新車是油電混合車嗎？

sentences.en: The company offers hybrid meetings for remote staff.
sentences.zh: 公司為遠距的員工提供混合式會議。

sentences.en: I bought a hybrid because gas prices keep going up.
sentences.zh: 因為油價一直漲，我買了一輛油電混合車。

sentences.en: Would a hybrid model work better for your team?
sentences.zh: 混合式的做法對你們團隊會比較適合嗎？

sentences.en: This hybrid course mixes online lessons with in-person classes.
sentences.zh: 這門混合式課程把線上課程和實體課堂結合在一起。

gloss_note: 化學符號 H；hydrogen fuel 氫燃料

sentences.en: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
sentences.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的。

sentences.en: Which gas is lighter, hydrogen or helium?
sentences.zh: 氫氣和氦氣，哪一種比較輕？

sentences.en: Did you know that hydrogen is the most common element?
sentences.zh: 你知道氫是最常見的元素嗎？

sentences.en: Some buses now run on hydrogen instead of gasoline.
sentences.zh: 有些公車現在用氫氣取代汽油來運轉。

sentences.en: Is hydrogen safe to use as a fuel?
sentences.zh: 用氫氣當燃料安全嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher filled a balloon with hydrogen for the demo.
sentences.zh: 老師在示範時，把一顆氣球充滿氫氣。

gloss_zh: 圖示；代表性人物或事物
gloss_note: app icon 應用程式圖示

sentences.en: Click the icon in the top corner of the screen.
sentences.zh: 點一下螢幕上方角落的那個圖示。

sentences.en: Where's the icon for the shared folder?
sentences.zh: 共用資料夾的圖示在哪裡？

sentences.en: I can't find the printer icon on my laptop.
sentences.zh: 我在筆電上找不到印表機的圖示。

sentences.en: He became a fashion icon in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 他在1980年代成為時尚界的代表人物。

sentences.en: Was she really an icon of her generation?
sentences.zh: 她真的是她那個世代的代表人物嗎？

sentences.en: That old theater is an icon of our small town.
sentences.zh: 那座老戲院是我們小鎮的象徵。

gloss_note: 常置句首，表示最理想的情況

sentences.en: Ideally, we'd finish the report by noon.
sentences.zh: 理想上，我們中午前就能完成報告。

sentences.en: Ideally, how many people should attend the meeting?
sentences.zh: 理想上，這場會議應該有多少人出席？

sentences.en: Ideally, I'd like to start on Monday.
sentences.zh: 最好是我週一就能開始。

sentences.en: Where would you ideally want to open a second store?
sentences.zh: 你理想中會想把第二家店開在哪裡？

sentences.en: Ideally, the package should arrive before the weekend.
sentences.zh: 理想上，包裹應該在週末前送到。

sentences.en: Ideally, a good manager listens before making a decision.
sentences.zh: 理想上，好的主管會先聽意見再做決定。

gloss_note: identify A as B 認出 A 是 B

sentences.en: Can you identify the man in this photo?
sentences.zh: 你認得出這張照片裡的男人嗎？

sentences.en: We need to identify the cause of the delay.
sentences.zh: 我們得找出造成延誤的原因。

sentences.en: The witness couldn't identify the driver of the car.
sentences.zh: 目擊者無法辨認出那輛車的駕駛。

sentences.en: Can you identify this bird by its song?
sentences.zh: 你能從叫聲辨認出這種鳥嗎？

sentences.en: Do you know how to identify a fake bill?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼辨認假鈔嗎？

sentences.en: The test helps doctors identify the problem early.
sentences.zh: 這項檢查能幫助醫生及早找出問題。

gloss_note: 字面意思和實際意思不同的說法

sentences.en: Do you know what this idiom means?
sentences.zh: 你知道這個慣用語是什麼意思嗎？

sentences.en: That idiom is hard to translate into Chinese.
sentences.zh: 那個慣用語很難翻成中文。

sentences.en: My teacher taught us a new idiom every Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們老師每週五都會教我們一個新的慣用語。

sentences.en: Is that idiom used in everyday conversation?
sentences.zh: 那個慣用語會用在日常對話裡嗎？

sentences.en: Using an idiom correctly makes your English sound natural.
sentences.zh: 正確使用慣用語，會讓你的英文聽起來更自然。

sentences.en: He used a funny idiom, and nobody understood it.
sentences.zh: 他用了一句有趣的慣用語，結果沒人聽得懂。

gloss_note: idle money 閒置資金；idle time 閒置時間

sentences.en: The factory machines sat idle during the holiday week.
sentences.zh: 工廠的機器在假期那一週一直閒置著。

sentences.en: Why is this computer idle all day?
sentences.zh: 這台電腦為什麼整天都閒置著？

sentences.en: Don't leave the car idling in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 不要讓車子在車道上一直空轉。

sentences.en: Is the engine still idling outside?
sentences.zh: 引擎還在外面空轉嗎？

sentences.en: Money sitting idle in a bank earns very little.
sentences.zh: 閒置在銀行裡的錢賺不了多少。

sentences.en: A lot of idle land in this area could become a park.
sentences.zh: 這一帶有許多閒置的土地，可以改建成公園。

gloss_note: pop idol 流行偶像；idolize 崇拜

sentences.en: Who was your idol when you were a teenager?
sentences.zh: 你青少年時期的偶像是誰？

sentences.en: My little sister is crazy about her pop idol.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹迷她的流行偶像迷得不得了。

sentences.en: Her father has always been her idol.
sentences.zh: 她的父親一直都是她的偶像。

sentences.en: Did you meet your idol at the concert?
sentences.zh: 你在演唱會上見到你的偶像了嗎？

sentences.en: Fans waited outside the hotel to see their idol.
sentences.zh: 粉絲們在飯店外面等著看他們的偶像。

sentences.en: A good teacher can become an idol to young students.
sentences.zh: 好老師可以成為年輕學生心中的偶像。

sentences.en: Ignorance of the law is no excuse.
sentences.zh: 不知道法律並不能當作藉口。

sentences.en: Is ignorance really bliss, or just an excuse?
sentences.zh: 無知真的是一種福氣，還是只是個藉口？

sentences.en: His ignorance about money cost him a lot.
sentences.zh: 他對金錢的無知讓他付出了很大的代價。

sentences.en: I apologize for my ignorance on this topic.
sentences.zh: 我為自己對這個話題的無知向你道歉。

sentences.en: How can we fight ignorance about mental health?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何對抗大眾對心理健康的無知？

sentences.en: She spoke out of ignorance, not out of anger.
sentences.zh: 她那樣說是因為不知情，不是因為生氣。

gloss_note: be ignorant of/about 對…一無所知

sentences.en: I was completely ignorant of the new rules.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道有新的規定。

sentences.en: Don't stay ignorant about your own health.
sentences.zh: 不要對自己的健康一無所知。

sentences.en: Are you ignorant of how the system works?
sentences.zh: 你不知道這個系統是怎麼運作的嗎？

sentences.en: He felt ignorant when everyone else knew the answer.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道答案時，他覺得自己很無知。

sentences.en: Why are so many people ignorant of basic first aid?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這麼多人不懂基本的急救？

sentences.en: It's not fair to call someone ignorant for asking questions.
sentences.zh: 別人問問題就說他無知，這樣並不公平。

gloss_note: illustrate a point 舉例說明論點

sentences.en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
sentences.zh: 讓我舉個例子來說明我的意思。

sentences.en: Can you illustrate how this machine works?
sentences.zh: 你可以示範說明這台機器怎麼運作嗎？

sentences.en: This chart illustrates the rise in sales.
sentences.zh: 這張圖表說明了銷售額的成長。

sentences.en: Who is going to illustrate the children's book?
sentences.zh: 誰要為這本童書畫插圖？

sentences.en: A short story can illustrate a complex idea.
sentences.zh: 一個短故事可以把複雜的概念說明清楚。

sentences.en: Could you illustrate that with a quick sketch?
sentences.zh: 你可以畫張簡單的草圖來說明一下嗎？

gloss_note: a good illustration of 是…的好例子

sentences.en: The book has a beautiful illustration on every page.
sentences.zh: 這本書每一頁都有漂亮的插圖。

sentences.en: Can you give me an illustration of what you mean?
sentences.zh: 你可以舉個例子說明你的意思嗎？

sentences.en: She makes a living drawing illustrations for magazines.
sentences.zh: 她靠為雜誌畫插圖維生。

sentences.en: This story is a good illustration of teamwork.
sentences.zh: 這個故事是團隊合作的好例子。

sentences.en: Which illustration do you like best in this report?
sentences.zh: 這份報告裡的插圖，你最喜歡哪一張？

sentences.en: The teacher used an illustration to explain the idea.
sentences.zh: 老師用了一個實例來解釋這個概念。

sentences.en: My daughter has an imaginary friend named Max.
sentences.zh: 我女兒有一個叫麥克斯的假想朋友。

sentences.en: Is the town in the movie real or imaginary?
sentences.zh: 電影裡的那座小鎮是真的，還是虛構的？

sentences.en: Some kids play with imaginary spaceships in the yard.
sentences.zh: 有些孩子在院子裡玩想像出來的太空船。

sentences.en: The danger was only imaginary, not real.
sentences.zh: 那個危險只存在於想像中，並不是真的。

sentences.en: Do you talk to an imaginary audience when you practice?
sentences.zh: 你練習的時候，會對著想像中的觀眾講話嗎？

sentences.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the earth.
sentences.zh: 赤道是一條環繞地球的假想線。

sentences.en: She's a very imaginative designer.
sentences.zh: 她是個很有想像力的設計師。

sentences.en: Was the director's idea imaginative or just strange?
sentences.zh: 導演的點子是有創意，還是只是很奇怪？

sentences.en: The kids came up with an imaginative solution.
sentences.zh: 孩子們想出了一個很有創意的解決辦法。

sentences.en: We need an imaginative way to attract customers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一個有創意的方法來吸引顧客。

sentences.en: Do you think young children are more imaginative than adults?
sentences.zh: 你覺得小孩子比大人更有想像力嗎？

sentences.en: His imaginative stories kept the class laughing.
sentences.zh: 他充滿想像力的故事讓全班笑個不停。

sentences.en: Kids often imitate what their parents do.
sentences.zh: 小孩常常模仿父母做的事。

sentences.en: Can you imitate a cat's meow?
sentences.zh: 你會模仿貓叫聲嗎？

sentences.en: He can imitate his boss's voice perfectly.
sentences.zh: 他能把老闆的聲音模仿得維妙維肖。

sentences.en: Why do toddlers imitate everything they see?
sentences.zh: 為什麼學步的幼兒會模仿他們看到的一切？

sentences.en: The comedian loves to imitate famous singers.
sentences.zh: 這位喜劇演員很愛模仿知名的歌手。
