sentences.en: I tried to imitate her accent, but I failed.
sentences.zh: 我試著模仿她的口音，但失敗了。

sentences.en: This purse is just a cheap imitation.
sentences.zh: 這個包包只是廉價的仿製品。

sentences.en: Is the leather real, or is it imitation?
sentences.zh: 這是真皮，還是仿製的？

sentences.en: His imitation of the principal made everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 他模仿校長的樣子，把大家都逗笑了。

sentences.en: Imitation is a natural way for babies to learn.
sentences.zh: 模仿是嬰兒學習的一種自然方式。

sentences.en: Do you sell any imitation pearls here?
sentences.zh: 你們這裡有賣仿製的珍珠嗎？

sentences.en: She does a great imitation of a robot.
sentences.zh: 她把機器人模仿得很棒。

gloss_note: 指移入某國的人；移出者為 emigrant

sentences.en: My grandfather was an immigrant from Italy.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是從義大利來的移民。

sentences.en: Many immigrants start small businesses in this neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 許多移民在這個社區開設小型商店。

sentences.en: Are you a recent immigrant, or were you born here?
sentences.zh: 你是新移民，還是在這裡出生的？

sentences.en: The immigrant family opened a small bakery downtown.
sentences.zh: 那個移民家庭在市區開了一家小烘焙坊。

sentences.en: How long has your family lived here as immigrants?
sentences.zh: 你們家以移民的身分在這裡住多久了？

sentences.en: The school offers English classes for new immigrants.
sentences.zh: 這所學校為新移民開設英文課程。

sentences.en: My parents immigrated to the U.S. in 1995.
sentences.zh: 我父母在1995年移民到美國。

sentences.en: When did your family immigrate to Canada?
sentences.zh: 你們家是什麼時候移民到加拿大的？

sentences.en: Many people immigrate to find better jobs.
sentences.zh: 很多人為了找更好的工作而移民。

sentences.en: Why did you decide to immigrate here?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼決定移民到這裡來？

sentences.en: She plans to immigrate next spring with her kids.
sentences.zh: 她打算明年春天帶著孩子們移民。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of paperwork to immigrate legally.
sentences.zh: 要合法移民，需要辦理很多文件。

sentences.en: The company recorded a large impairment on its old factory.
sentences.zh: 公司針對舊工廠認列了一筆鉅額減損。

sentences.en: Did the auditors find any impairment of our assets?
sentences.zh: 稽核人員有發現我們的資產減損嗎？

sentences.en: An impairment charge lowered our profit this quarter.
sentences.zh: 一筆減損費用拉低了我們本季的獲利。

sentences.en: How much impairment should we expect next year?
sentences.zh: 我們明年預期會有多少減損？

sentences.en: The report explains the impairment on the new store's equipment.
sentences.zh: 報告說明了新店設備的減損情形。

sentences.en: Our accountant explained why the impairment was necessary.
sentences.zh: 我們的會計師解釋了為什麼必須認列這筆減損。

sentences.en: Are you implying that I made a mistake?
sentences.zh: 你是在暗示我犯了錯嗎？

sentences.en: His silence seemed to imply he disagreed.
sentences.zh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他並不同意。

sentences.en: Does a higher price always imply better quality?
sentences.zh: 價格比較高，就一定代表品質比較好嗎？

sentences.en: I didn't mean to imply anything by that.
sentences.zh: 我那樣說並沒有想暗示什麼。

sentences.en: The report implies that sales will keep falling.
sentences.zh: 這份報告暗示銷售額還會繼續下滑。

sentences.en: Her smile implied she already knew the answer.
sentences.zh: 她的微笑暗示著她早就知道答案了。

sentences.en: More importantly, the client agreed to our price.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，客戶同意了我們開的價格。

sentences.en: Importantly, no one was hurt in the accident.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，這場意外沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: More importantly, what do our customers actually want?
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，我們的顧客到底想要什麼？

sentences.en: The plan is cheap and, importantly, easy to use.
sentences.zh: 這個方案很便宜，而且重要的是，很容易使用。

sentences.en: Did you bring the contract and, more importantly, a pen?
sentences.zh: 你有帶合約嗎？更重要的是，有帶筆嗎？

sentences.en: Importantly, the study included people of all ages.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，這項研究涵蓋了各個年齡層的人。

gloss_note: impose A on B 把 A 強加於 B

sentences.en: I don't want to impose my opinion on you.
sentences.zh: 我不想把我的意見強加在你身上。

sentences.en: The city plans to impose a new tax on soda.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算對汽水課徵一項新稅。

sentences.en: Why do parents impose so many rules on teenagers?
sentences.zh: 為什麼父母要對青少年訂下這麼多規矩？

sentences.en: The school imposed a strict dress code last year.
sentences.zh: 學校去年開始實施嚴格的服裝規定。

sentences.en: Can employers impose limits on break time?
sentences.zh: 雇主可以限制休息時間嗎？

sentences.en: The judge may impose a fine on the company.
sentences.zh: 法官可能會對這家公司處以罰款。

gloss_note: make a good impression 留下好印象

sentences.en: You made a great impression on my boss.
sentences.zh: 你給我老闆留下了很好的印象。

sentences.en: What was your first impression of the city?
sentences.zh: 你對這座城市的第一印象是什麼？

sentences.en: First impressions matter in a job interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時，第一印象很重要。

sentences.en: I got the impression that she was upset.
sentences.zh: 我覺得她好像不太高興。

sentences.en: Did he make a good impression at the dinner?
sentences.zh: 他在晚餐上有給人留下好印象嗎？

sentences.en: My impression is that the project is going well.
sentences.zh: 我的印象是這個專案進行得很順利。

sentences.en: I bought these shoes on impulse.
sentences.zh: 我是一時衝動才買了這雙鞋。

sentences.en: Try to resist the impulse to check your phone.
sentences.zh: 試著克制想看手機的衝動。

sentences.en: Do you ever feel an impulse to quit everything?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有過想把一切都放下的衝動？

sentences.en: She had a sudden impulse to call her old friend.
sentences.zh: 她突然有股衝動，想打電話給老朋友。

sentences.en: Was it a planned trip, or just an impulse?
sentences.zh: 這是計畫好的旅行，還是一時的衝動？

sentences.en: Stores put candy near the register to trigger impulse buying.
sentences.zh: 商店把糖果放在收銀台旁，來刺激衝動購物。

sentences.en: Our current staff is inadequate for this workload.
sentences.zh: 我們現有的人力不足以應付這樣的工作量。

sentences.en: Is the training we offer inadequate?
sentences.zh: 我們提供的訓練是不是不夠充分？

sentences.en: The funding was inadequate to cover all the costs.
sentences.zh: 這筆資金不足以支付所有的成本。

sentences.en: Many customers said the parking was inadequate.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客說停車位不夠。

sentences.en: Why are the safety measures so inadequate?
sentences.zh: 為什麼安全措施這麼不充分？

sentences.en: The company's response to the complaint was inadequate.
sentences.zh: 公司對這項客訴的處理並不充分。

gloss_note: report an incident 通報事故

sentences.en: There was a small incident at the store this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上店裡發生了一件小事故。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the incident downtown?
sentences.zh: 你有聽說市區發生的那起事件嗎？

sentences.en: The police are investigating the incident.
sentences.zh: 警方正在調查這起事件。

sentences.en: Please report any incident to your supervisor right away.
sentences.zh: 發生任何事故，請立刻向你的主管報告。

sentences.en: How did the incident happen?
sentences.zh: 這起事件是怎麼發生的？

sentences.en: It was a minor incident, and nobody got hurt.
sentences.zh: 那只是一起小事故，沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: Is the price inclusive of tax?
sentences.zh: 這個價格有含稅嗎？

sentences.en: The room rate is inclusive of breakfast and Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 房價包含早餐和無線網路。

sentences.en: Our monthly fee is all-inclusive.
sentences.zh: 我們的月費是全包式的。

sentences.en: Is the ticket price inclusive of meals?
sentences.zh: 票價有包含餐點嗎？

sentences.en: The total is inclusive of delivery and installation.
sentences.zh: 總額包含運送和安裝的費用。

sentences.en: Dates are inclusive, from June 1 to June 5.
sentences.zh: 日期包含頭尾，從6月1日到6月5日。

gloss_note: articles of incorporation 公司章程

sentences.en: We filed the incorporation papers last week.
sentences.zh: 我們上週遞交了公司設立登記的文件。

sentences.en: Where did you file for incorporation?
sentences.zh: 你們是在哪裡辦理公司設立登記的？

sentences.en: The incorporation of the startup took only two days.
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司的設立登記只花了兩天。

sentences.en: How long does incorporation usually take?
sentences.zh: 公司設立登記通常要花多久？

sentences.en: Our lawyer is handling the incorporation of the new company.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師正在處理新公司的設立登記。

sentences.en: The articles of incorporation list the company's goals.
sentences.zh: 公司章程列出了公司的目標。

gloss_note: 口語常用來稱讚，語氣很強

sentences.en: The view from the top was incredible.
sentences.zh: 山頂上的景色美得令人難以置信。

sentences.en: Is that incredible story really true?
sentences.zh: 那個難以置信的故事是真的嗎？

sentences.en: You did an incredible job on the presentation.
sentences.zh: 你的簡報做得太棒了。

sentences.en: How did he finish the race in such an incredible time?
sentences.zh: 他怎麼能用這麼驚人的時間跑完比賽？

sentences.en: The food at that place is incredible.
sentences.zh: 那家店的食物好吃得不得了。

sentences.en: It's incredible how fast the kids grow.
sentences.zh: 孩子們長得這麼快，真是不可思議。

sentences.en: The incumbent will train her replacement next month.
sentences.zh: 現任者下個月會訓練接替她的人。

sentences.en: Who is the incumbent in this role right now?
sentences.zh: 目前擔任這個職位的現任者是誰？

sentences.en: As the incumbent, he knows the clients well.
sentences.zh: 身為現任者，他很了解這些客戶。

sentences.en: Can a new hire compete with the incumbent?
sentences.zh: 新進人員有辦法跟現任者競爭嗎？

sentences.en: The incumbent has held this position for ten years.
sentences.zh: 現任者已經在這個職位上待了十年。

sentences.en: The incumbent usually has an advantage over new candidates.
sentences.zh: 現任者通常比新的候選人更有優勢。

sentences.en: There's no indication that sales will improve soon.
sentences.zh: 沒有跡象顯示銷售很快就會好轉。

sentences.en: Is there any indication of what caused the delay?
sentences.zh: 有任何跡象顯示是什麼造成了延誤嗎？

sentences.en: A red light is a clear indication that something is wrong.
sentences.zh: 亮紅燈明顯是出了問題的跡象。

sentences.en: Did she give any indication that she was leaving?
sentences.zh: 她有沒有流露出要離開的跡象？

sentences.en: Early indications show the new plan is working.
sentences.zh: 初步跡象顯示新計畫行得通。

sentences.en: His smile was the first indication that he was pleased.
sentences.zh: 他的微笑是他很滿意的第一個跡象。

sentences.en: The new tax rule will indirectly affect our prices.
sentences.zh: 新的稅法會間接影響我們的價格。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the layoffs indirectly or from your manager?
sentences.zh: 你是間接聽說裁員的事，還是主管告訴你的？

sentences.en: Our team is indirectly responsible for the shipping delay.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊對出貨延誤負有間接責任。

sentences.en: How does a weak dollar indirectly hurt small businesses?
sentences.zh: 美元走弱會如何間接傷害小型企業？

sentences.en: I only know him indirectly, through my older sister's coworker.
sentences.zh: 我只是間接認識他，是透過我姊姊的同事。

sentences.en: Customers indirectly pay for these costs through higher fees.
sentences.zh: 客戶是透過較高的費用間接負擔這些成本。

sentences.en: Please wrap the gifts individually so they look nice.
sentences.zh: 請把禮物一個一個分開包裝，這樣比較好看。

sentences.en: Can I talk to each of you individually this week?
sentences.zh: 這週我可以跟你們每個人單獨談談嗎？

sentences.en: The tickets are sold individually, not as a package.
sentences.zh: 這些票是單張販售，不是套票。

sentences.en: Each student was tested individually after the lesson.
sentences.zh: 課後每位學生都接受個別測驗。

sentences.en: Do you want the cookies packed individually or together?
sentences.zh: 餅乾你要分開包還是包在一起？

sentences.en: The parts are cheap individually, but the full kit costs a lot.
sentences.zh: 零件單買都很便宜，但整組很貴。

gloss_note: inefficient process 沒效率的流程

sentences.en: Our old filing system is slow and inefficient.
sentences.zh: 我們舊的歸檔系統又慢又沒效率。

sentences.en: Why is this process so inefficient?
sentences.zh: 這個流程為什麼這麼沒效率？

sentences.en: Is it inefficient to hold three meetings a day?
sentences.zh: 一天開三場會是不是很沒效率？

sentences.en: Heating the whole house all day is inefficient.
sentences.zh: 整天幫整間房子開暖氣很浪費。

sentences.en: The inefficient machine wastes both time and energy.
sentences.zh: 那台效率差的機器既浪費時間又浪費能源。

sentences.en: I found my old route to work really inefficient.
sentences.zh: 我發現我以前上班走的路線真的很沒效率。

gloss_note: 常置於動詞前；勢必、難免

sentences.en: Prices will inevitably go up next year.
sentences.zh: 明年物價勢必會上漲。

sentences.en: When you grow fast, mistakes inevitably happen.
sentences.zh: 成長得快，難免就會出錯。

sentences.en: Will the project inevitably run over budget?
sentences.zh: 這個專案會不可避免地超出預算嗎？

sentences.en: We inevitably get more calls after a big sale.
sentences.zh: 大型促銷之後，我們難免會接到更多電話。

sentences.en: Why does traffic inevitably get worse on Fridays?
sentences.zh: 為什麼週五的交通總是難免變得更糟？

sentences.en: The old factory inevitably closed when demand dropped.
sentences.zh: 需求下滑時，那間老工廠終究不得不關門。

sentences.en: The infant slept through the whole flight.
sentences.zh: 那個嬰兒整趟飛行都在睡。

sentences.en: Do you have a car seat for an infant?
sentences.zh: 你們有嬰兒用的安全座椅嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor's infant cries every night around two.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居家的嬰兒每天半夜兩點左右都會哭。

sentences.en: How often should an infant eat at night?
sentences.zh: 嬰兒晚上應該多久吃一次？

sentences.en: These infant clothes are so tiny and cute!
sentences.zh: 這些嬰兒衣服好小好可愛！

sentences.en: The hospital offers a class for infant care.
sentences.zh: 醫院開了一堂嬰兒照護課。

sentences.en: The doctor said I have an ear infection.
sentences.zh: 醫生說我耳朵感染了。

sentences.en: How can I avoid getting an infection from a cut?
sentences.zh: 傷口要怎麼處理才不會感染？

sentences.en: Wash your hands to stop the spread of infection.
sentences.zh: 洗手可以防止感染擴散。

sentences.en: Is the infection getting better with the medicine?
sentences.zh: 吃了藥之後，感染有好轉嗎？

sentences.en: A small infection kept him home for three days.
sentences.zh: 一個小感染讓他在家待了三天。

sentences.en: The nurse cleaned the wound to prevent infection.
sentences.zh: 護理師清理傷口以預防感染。

sentences.en: Can you help me inflate this bike tire?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這個腳踏車輪胎打氣嗎？

sentences.en: Stores sometimes inflate prices before a big holiday.
sentences.zh: 商店有時會在大節日前哄抬價格。

sentences.en: Use this pump to inflate the air mattress.
sentences.zh: 用這個打氣機幫充氣床墊打氣。

sentences.en: Why did the seller inflate the price so much?
sentences.zh: 賣家為什麼把價格抬得這麼高？

sentences.en: We need to inflate the raft before we leave.
sentences.zh: 出發前我們得先把橡皮艇充好氣。

sentences.en: Does the hotel inflate its rates during big events?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店在大型活動期間會哄抬房價嗎？

sentences.en: Because of inflation, groceries cost more every year.
sentences.zh: 因為通貨膨脹，日用品每年都越來越貴。

sentences.en: Is inflation the reason rent went up again?
sentences.zh: 通膨是房租又漲的原因嗎？

sentences.en: My salary hasn't kept up with inflation.
sentences.zh: 我的薪水沒有跟上通貨膨脹。

sentences.en: How high is inflation in your country right now?
sentences.zh: 你的國家現在通膨有多高？

sentences.en: The news says inflation slowed down last month.
sentences.zh: 新聞說上個月通膨趨緩了。

sentences.en: We talked about inflation in economics class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在經濟學課上討論了通貨膨脹。

sentences.en: Printing too much money can be inflationary.
sentences.zh: 印太多鈔票可能會引發通膨。

sentences.en: Is it true that lower interest rates are inflationary?
sentences.zh: 利率降低真的會引發通膨嗎？

sentences.en: Experts warned of inflationary pressure on housing costs.
sentences.zh: 專家警告居住成本面臨通膨壓力。

sentences.en: Are rising wages always inflationary, or only sometimes?
sentences.zh: 薪資上漲一定會引發通膨，還是只有有時候？

sentences.en: Rising oil costs have an inflationary effect on shipping.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲對運輸費用有推升通膨的效果。

sentences.en: My professor says cheap credit can be inflationary.
sentences.zh: 我的教授說寬鬆的信貸可能會引發通膨。

gloss_note: an influential figure 有影響力的人物

sentences.en: She is one of the most influential people in our company.
sentences.zh: 她是我們公司最有影響力的人之一。

sentences.en: Who was the most influential teacher you ever had?
sentences.zh: 你遇過最有影響力的老師是誰？

sentences.en: That book was influential in my career choice.
sentences.zh: 那本書對我的職涯選擇影響很大。

sentences.en: Is he influential enough to change the board's mind?
sentences.zh: 他的影響力夠大到能改變董事會的想法嗎？

sentences.en: An influential critic gave the film great reviews.
sentences.zh: 一位很有影響力的評論家給了這部電影極高的評價。

sentences.en: My older brother was very influential when I was young.
sentences.zh: 我小時候，哥哥對我的影響很大。

sentences.en: Every investment has some inherent risk.
sentences.zh: 每項投資都有其固有的風險。

sentences.en: Is that problem inherent in the design?
sentences.zh: 那個問題是設計本身就有的嗎？

sentences.en: Long hours are inherent in this kind of job.
sentences.zh: 這類工作本來就免不了長時間工作。

sentences.en: What are the inherent limits of this software?
sentences.zh: 這套軟體本身有哪些限制？

sentences.en: There is an inherent conflict between speed and quality.
sentences.zh: 速度與品質之間本來就存在衝突。

sentences.en: Our product has an inherent advantage over cheaper ones.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品相較於便宜的同類產品，有與生俱來的優勢。

gloss_note: inherit a business 繼承事業

sentences.en: She will inherit her father's small shop someday.
sentences.zh: 她有一天會繼承她爸爸的小店。

sentences.en: Did you inherit any money from your grandmother?
sentences.zh: 你有從祖母那裡繼承到錢嗎？

sentences.en: The new manager inherited a lot of old problems.
sentences.zh: 新經理接手了許多舊問題。

sentences.en: When I inherit the house, I want to fix the roof.
sentences.zh: 等我繼承這棟房子，我想把屋頂修一修。

sentences.en: Who inherits the company when the owner retires?
sentences.zh: 老闆退休後，誰會接手公司？

sentences.en: We inherited this old system from the previous team.
sentences.zh: 這套舊系統是我們從前一個團隊那裡接手的。

gloss_note: 常用複數 inhibitions；放下顧忌

sentences.en: Children often lose their inhibitions when they play with friends.
sentences.zh: 孩子跟朋友玩的時候，常常會放下顧忌。

sentences.en: Do you have any inhibitions about speaking English?
sentences.zh: 你說英文時會不會放不開？

sentences.en: The study looked at the inhibition of cell growth.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討的是細胞生長的抑制。

sentences.en: Dancing helped her overcome her inhibitions.
sentences.zh: 跳舞幫助她克服了心中的顧忌。

sentences.en: Is a lack of inhibition always a good thing?
sentences.zh: 毫無顧忌一定是好事嗎？

sentences.en: Some actors seem to have no inhibitions on stage.
sentences.zh: 有些演員在台上似乎毫無顧忌。

sentences.en: My initial reaction was surprise.
sentences.zh: 我最初的反應是驚訝。

sentences.en: What was your initial impression of the new boss?
sentences.zh: 你對新老闆的第一印象是什麼？

sentences.en: The initial cost is high, but it saves money later.
sentences.zh: 前期成本很高，但之後會省錢。

sentences.en: Is the initial offer negotiable?
sentences.zh: 最初的報價可以談嗎？

sentences.en: Please check the initial draft and send me your notes.
sentences.zh: 請看一下初稿，再把你的意見寄給我。

sentences.en: After the initial shock, everyone started to laugh.
sentences.zh: 一開始的震驚過後，大家都笑了起來。

gloss_note: the initiation of 某事的啟動

sentences.en: The initiation of the new project is set for May.
sentences.zh: 新專案預定五月啟動。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of the initiation of the program?
sentences.zh: 誰負責這個計畫的啟動？

sentences.en: The report describes the initiation of a new reading program in schools.
sentences.zh: 報告描述了學校開始實施新閱讀計畫的過程。

sentences.en: Is early initiation of treatment important for this illness?
sentences.zh: 這種疾病，及早開始治療重要嗎？

sentences.en: Her initiation of the talks surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 她主動展開談判，讓所有人都很意外。

sentences.en: Delays in the initiation of construction raised the costs.
sentences.zh: 工程延後動工，使成本增加。

gloss_note: inject money into 投入資金

sentences.en: The nurse will inject the vaccine into your arm.
sentences.zh: 護理師會把疫苗注射到你的手臂。

sentences.en: Did the doctor inject anything near the wound?
sentences.zh: 醫生有在傷口附近注射什麼嗎？

sentences.en: The company plans to inject more money into the project.
sentences.zh: 公司打算再投入更多資金到這個專案。

sentences.en: How do you inject a little humor into a serious speech?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼在嚴肅的演講裡加一點幽默？

sentences.en: Cooks sometimes inject marinade into the meat.
sentences.zh: 廚師有時會把醃料注入肉裡。

sentences.en: The new manager tried to inject some energy into the team.
sentences.zh: 新經理努力替團隊注入一些活力。

sentences.en: Be careful not to injure your back when you lift that.
sentences.zh: 搬那個的時候，小心別傷到背。

sentences.en: How did he injure his knee?
sentences.zh: 他的膝蓋是怎麼受傷的？

sentences.en: Two players were injured during the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽中有兩名球員受傷。

sentences.en: Did you injure yourself when you fell?
sentences.zh: 你跌倒時有受傷嗎？

sentences.en: Wear a helmet so you don't injure your head.
sentences.zh: 戴上安全帽，才不會傷到頭。

sentences.en: The crash injured a few passengers, but all of them are fine now.
sentences.zh: 這起事故有幾名乘客受傷，但現在都沒事了。

gloss_note: prove one's innocence 證明清白

sentences.en: The lawyer fought to prove her client's innocence.
sentences.zh: 律師努力證明當事人的清白。

sentences.en: Do you believe in his innocence?
sentences.zh: 你相信他是清白的嗎？

sentences.en: I miss the innocence of being a kid.
sentences.zh: 我懷念小時候的天真無邪。

sentences.en: How can he prove his innocence without any witnesses?
sentences.zh: 沒有任何目擊者，他要怎麼證明自己的清白？

sentences.en: Her face showed complete innocence when I asked about the cake.
sentences.zh: 我問起蛋糕時，她一臉天真無辜。

sentences.en: The movie is about the loss of innocence in a small town.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是小鎮裡純真的消逝。

sentences.en: We'd love your input on the new design.
sentences.zh: 我們很想聽聽你對新設計的意見。

sentences.en: Can I get your input before Friday?
sentences.zh: 週五前我可以先聽聽你的意見嗎？

sentences.en: The program won't accept this input.
sentences.zh: 程式不接受這個輸入的內容。

sentences.en: Do you need any input from the sales team?
sentences.zh: 你需要業務團隊提供任何意見嗎？

sentences.en: His input helped us fix the problem quickly.
sentences.zh: 他的意見幫助我們很快解決了問題。

sentences.en: Check your input again if the form shows an error.
sentences.zh: 如果表單顯示錯誤，請再檢查一次你輸入的內容。

gloss_note: insert a card 插入卡片

sentences.en: Please insert your card and enter your PIN.
sentences.zh: 請插入卡片並輸入密碼。

sentences.en: Where do I insert the batteries?
sentences.zh: 電池要裝在哪裡？

sentences.en: Can you insert a page break after this paragraph?
sentences.zh: 你可以在這段後面插入分頁符號嗎？

sentences.en: She tried to insert the key, but it wouldn't fit.
sentences.zh: 她試著把鑰匙插進去，但插不進去。

sentences.en: I need to insert a table in my slides.
sentences.zh: 我需要在簡報裡插入一個表格。

sentences.en: Do not insert coins until the light turns green.
sentences.zh: 在燈號轉綠之前，請不要投入硬幣。

gloss_note: draw inspiration from 從……汲取靈感

sentences.en: Where do you get your inspiration for new recipes?
sentences.zh: 你的新食譜靈感都是從哪裡來的？

sentences.en: I need some inspiration for my presentation.
sentences.zh: 我的簡報需要一點靈感。

sentences.en: Her story was an inspiration to the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她的故事給了整個團隊啟發。

sentences.en: The trip to Japan gave me a lot of inspiration.
sentences.zh: 那趟日本之行給了我很多靈感。

sentences.en: Do you ever lose inspiration in the middle of a project?
sentences.zh: 做專案做到一半，你會不會失去靈感？

sentences.en: My grandfather is my biggest inspiration.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是我最大的啟發來源。

sentences.en: Can you help me install this app on my phone?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這個應用程式安裝到手機上嗎？

sentences.en: The technician will install the new router tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 技術人員明天會來安裝新的路由器。

sentences.en: How long does it take to install the update?
sentences.zh: 安裝這個更新要花多久？

sentences.en: We installed a smoke alarm in every bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我們在每間臥室都裝了煙霧警報器。

sentences.en: Please install the printer before the meeting starts.
sentences.zh: 請在會議開始前把印表機裝好。

sentences.en: Did they install the new windows yet?
sentences.zh: 他們裝好新窗戶了嗎？

gloss_note: trust your instincts 相信直覺

sentences.en: My instinct told me something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的直覺告訴我有地方不對勁。

sentences.en: Do you trust your first instinct on tests?
sentences.zh: 考試時你會相信自己的第一直覺嗎？

sentences.en: Birds know when to fly south by instinct.
sentences.zh: 鳥類憑本能知道什麼時候該往南飛。

sentences.en: A good salesperson has a strong instinct for what people want.
sentences.zh: 好的業務對客人想要什麼有很強的直覺。

sentences.en: Is it instinct, or did you learn it?
sentences.zh: 這是本能，還是你學來的？

sentences.en: Her first instinct was to call her mom.
sentences.zh: 她的第一直覺是打給她媽媽。

sentences.en: The budget is insufficient for a project this big.
sentences.zh: 預算不足以應付這麼大的專案。

sentences.en: Is the evidence insufficient to make a decision?
sentences.zh: 證據不足以做出決定嗎？

sentences.en: We have insufficient staff on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我們週末的人手不足。

sentences.en: Why were the funds insufficient this quarter?
sentences.zh: 這一季的資金為什麼不夠？

sentences.en: The package was returned due to insufficient postage.
sentences.zh: 包裹因為郵資不足被退回了。

sentences.en: Our supply of paper is insufficient for the whole month.
sentences.zh: 我們的紙張存量不夠撐一整個月。

sentences.en: I didn't mean to insult you.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要冒犯你。

sentences.en: Did he really insult the waiter in front of everyone?
sentences.zh: 他真的在大家面前侮辱了服務生嗎？

sentences.en: That low offer is an insult to our hard work.
sentences.zh: 那麼低的報價是對我們辛苦付出的侮辱。

sentences.en: Is it an insult to ask for a receipt?
sentences.zh: 要收據算是一種冒犯嗎？

sentences.en: She felt insulted when they ignored her idea.
sentences.zh: 當他們忽視她的想法時，她覺得受到了冒犯。

sentences.en: The player was fined for shouting an insult at the referee.
sentences.zh: 那名球員因對裁判口出惡言而被罰款。

gloss_note: a person of integrity 正直的人

sentences.en: A good manager leads with integrity.
sentences.zh: 好的主管以誠信來帶領團隊。

sentences.en: Do you think honesty and integrity matter at work?
sentences.zh: 你覺得誠實與正直在職場上重要嗎？

sentences.en: He lost his job but kept his integrity.
sentences.zh: 他丟了工作，卻保住了自己的正直。

sentences.en: Our company is known for its integrity.
sentences.zh: 我們公司以誠信聞名。

sentences.en: How do you protect your integrity under pressure?
sentences.zh: 在壓力之下，你怎麼守住自己的原則？

sentences.en: The reporter's integrity made readers trust her articles.
sentences.zh: 那位記者的正直讓讀者信任她的文章。

sentences.en: Reading is good intellectual exercise for the brain.
sentences.zh: 閱讀是很好的腦力訓練。

sentences.en: Is chess more of an intellectual game than a sport?
sentences.zh: 西洋棋比較像智力遊戲而不是運動嗎？

sentences.en: She loves intellectual conversations about history.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡聊歷史這類有深度的話題。

sentences.en: My uncle is an intellectual who reads three books a week.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是個知識分子，一週讀三本書。

sentences.en: Do you find that class an intellectual challenge?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那堂課在智識上有挑戰性嗎？

sentences.en: Many intellectuals attended the book talk.
sentences.zh: 許多知識分子出席了那場新書座談。

sentences.en: She has great intelligence and a warm heart.
sentences.zh: 她既聰明又心地善良。

sentences.en: Do you think intelligence is something you're born with?
sentences.zh: 你覺得智力是天生的嗎？

sentences.en: The test measures intelligence, not just memory.
sentences.zh: 這項測驗測的是智力，而不只是記憶力。

sentences.en: His intelligence helped him solve the puzzle fast.
sentences.zh: 他的聰明才智讓他很快解開了謎題。

sentences.en: How do scientists define intelligence in animals?
sentences.zh: 科學家如何定義動物的智力？

sentences.en: It's an insult to my intelligence to say that.
sentences.zh: 說那種話根本是看輕我的智商。

sentences.en: I intend to finish this report today.
sentences.zh: 我打算今天完成這份報告。

sentences.en: What do you intend to do after graduation?
sentences.zh: 你畢業後打算做什麼？

sentences.en: We never intended to cause any trouble.
sentences.zh: 我們從沒打算惹麻煩。

sentences.en: Did you intend to call me, or was it a mistake?
sentences.zh: 你本來是打算打給我，還是撥錯了？

sentences.en: She intends to apply for the job next week.
sentences.zh: 她打算下週去應徵那份工作。

sentences.en: The comment wasn't intended as a joke.
sentences.zh: 那句話並不是說來開玩笑的。

sentences.en: The heat was intense at noon.
sentences.zh: 中午熱得受不了。

sentences.en: Is this class too intense for beginners?
sentences.zh: 這堂課對初學者來說強度會不會太高？

sentences.en: She felt intense pressure before the exam.
sentences.zh: 考試前她感受到強烈的壓力。

sentences.en: The two teams had an intense game last night.
sentences.zh: 兩支球隊昨晚打了一場激烈的比賽。

sentences.en: Why is the competition so intense this year?
sentences.zh: 今年的競爭為什麼這麼激烈？

sentences.en: The sunlight is too intense for my eyes.
sentences.zh: 陽光對我的眼睛來說太強烈了。

sentences.en: I have no intention of quitting my job.
sentences.zh: 我完全沒打算辭職。

sentences.en: What was your intention when you sent that message?
sentences.zh: 你傳那則訊息的用意是什麼？

sentences.en: She had good intentions, but things went wrong.
sentences.zh: 她出於好意，但事情出了差錯。

sentences.en: Is it your intention to move out this year?
sentences.zh: 你打算今年搬出去嗎？

sentences.en: His intention was to surprise his wife with dinner.
sentences.zh: 他原本想給太太一個晚餐驚喜。

sentences.en: The company announced its intention to open a new store.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布打算開一間新分店。

sentences.en: Face-to-face interaction is important for kids.
sentences.zh: 面對面的互動對孩子很重要。

sentences.en: How much interaction do you have with customers?
sentences.zh: 你平常和客人有多少互動？

sentences.en: The app encourages interaction between students.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式鼓勵學生之間互動。

sentences.en: Is there enough interaction in your online class?
sentences.zh: 你的線上課有足夠的互動嗎？

sentences.en: Social interaction can lift your mood.
sentences.zh: 社交互動可以讓心情變好。

sentences.en: My interaction with the new coworker was brief but friendly.
sentences.zh: 我和新同事的互動雖然短暫，但很愉快。

gloss_note: 多置於句首或句中，引出意外事實

sentences.en: The results, interestingly, were the opposite of what we expected.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，結果和我們預期的正好相反。

sentences.en: Most students, interestingly, still preferred paper books.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，大多數學生仍然偏好紙本書。

sentences.en: Did you know that, interestingly, sales go up when it rains?
sentences.zh: 你知道嗎？有趣的是，一下雨銷量反而會上升。

sentences.en: My brother, interestingly, hates pizza even though he works at a pizza place.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥在披薩店工作，有趣的是他卻討厭披薩。

sentences.en: Have you noticed that, interestingly, no one complained?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有注意到，有趣的是沒有人抱怨？

sentences.en: The author interestingly compares the city to a living body.
sentences.zh: 作者很有意思地把城市比作一個活的身體。

gloss_note: interfere in 干涉；with 妨礙

sentences.en: I don't want to interfere, but can I give some advice?
sentences.zh: 我不想干涉，但可以給你一點建議嗎？

sentences.en: Loud music can interfere with your sleep.
sentences.zh: 大聲的音樂會妨礙睡眠。

sentences.en: Does your phone interfere with your work?
sentences.zh: 你的手機會妨礙你工作嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't let personal problems interfere with the project.
sentences.zh: 請別讓私人問題影響到專案。

sentences.en: Why do my parents always interfere in my personal life?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我爸媽老是干涉我的私生活？

sentences.en: Bad weather may interfere with our travel plans.
sentences.zh: 壞天氣可能會打亂我們的旅行計畫。

sentences.en: Our brand is sold internationally.
sentences.zh: 我們的品牌在國際上都有販售。

sentences.en: Is this certificate recognized internationally?
sentences.zh: 這張證書在國際上受到認可嗎？

sentences.en: She travels internationally for work every month.
sentences.zh: 她每個月都要到國外出差。

sentences.en: The company wants to expand internationally next year.
sentences.zh: 公司明年想拓展到國際市場。

sentences.en: Do you ship internationally, or only within the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 你們有寄送到國外嗎？還是只寄美國境內？

sentences.en: The singer became famous internationally after that song.
sentences.zh: 那首歌之後，這位歌手在國際上走紅。

sentences.en: How do you interpret this chart?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼解讀這張圖表？

sentences.en: Different people may interpret the rule differently.
sentences.zh: 不同的人可能對這條規定有不同的解讀。

sentences.en: Can you interpret for me at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你可以在會議上幫我口譯嗎？

sentences.en: I interpreted his silence as a yes.
sentences.zh: 我把他的沉默解讀成答應了。

sentences.en: Doctors need to interpret the test results carefully.
sentences.zh: 醫生必須謹慎解讀檢驗結果。

sentences.en: My cousin interpreted for the tourists at the museum.
sentences.zh: 我的表親在博物館替遊客做口譯。

sentences.en: Sorry for the interruption, but you have a call.
sentences.zh: 抱歉打斷一下，你有電話。

sentences.en: Can we finish this meeting without more interruptions?
sentences.zh: 這場會議我們可以不要再被打斷、順利結束嗎？

sentences.en: I get too many interruptions at my desk.
sentences.zh: 我在座位上老是被打擾。

sentences.en: The storm caused an interruption in internet service.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成網路服務中斷。

sentences.en: Do you mind a quick interruption?
sentences.zh: 你介意我打斷一下嗎？

sentences.en: Her speech continued without interruption.
sentences.zh: 她的演說持續進行，沒有被打斷。

sentences.en: Managers should intervene when employees can't agree.
sentences.zh: 員工意見不合時，主管應該出面介入。

sentences.en: Should I intervene or let them work it out?
sentences.zh: 我該介入，還是讓他們自己解決？

sentences.en: The teacher had to intervene in the argument.
sentences.zh: 老師得介入那場爭執。

sentences.en: When should a bank intervene in a failing business?
sentences.zh: 銀行該在什麼時候介入經營不善的企業？

sentences.en: Luckily, a neighbor intervened before things got worse.
sentences.zh: 幸好鄰居在情況惡化前出面介入。

sentences.en: Did the boss intervene in the hiring decision?
sentences.zh: 老闆有介入這項聘雇決定嗎？

sentences.en: They have an intimate friendship that began in college.
sentences.zh: 他們從大學就建立了親密的友誼。

sentences.en: Do you have an intimate friend you can tell everything to?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有可以無話不談的知心好友？

sentences.en: Is it okay to ask such an intimate question?
sentences.zh: 問這麼私人的問題可以嗎？

sentences.en: The magazine printed intimate details about the actor's life.
sentences.zh: 雜誌刊出了這位演員生活中的私密細節。

sentences.en: They had an intimate conversation on the porch late at night.
sentences.zh: 他們深夜在門廊上進行了一場很私密的談話。

sentences.en: The two sisters have an intimate bond that nothing can break.
sentences.zh: 這對姊妹有著任何事物都無法打破的親密情誼。

sentences.en: Her intonation makes every sentence sound friendly.
sentences.zh: 她的語調讓每句話聽起來都很親切。

sentences.en: Does my intonation sound natural to you?
sentences.zh: 我的語調聽起來自然嗎？

sentences.en: In English, rising intonation often shows a question.
sentences.zh: 在英文裡，語調上揚通常表示疑問。

sentences.en: How can I improve my intonation when I speak?
sentences.zh: 我說話時要怎麼改善語調？

sentences.en: The teacher practiced intonation with us for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 老師帶我們練習語調練了十分鐘。

sentences.en: You can tell he's upset from his intonation.
sentences.zh: 從他的語調就聽得出來他很不高興。

sentences.en: Money isn't the only reward; there's also intrinsic motivation.
sentences.zh: 金錢不是唯一的回報，還有內在動機。

sentences.en: What is the intrinsic value of an old coin?
sentences.zh: 一枚舊硬幣的內在價值是多少？

sentences.en: Is curiosity intrinsic to human nature?
sentences.zh: 好奇心是人性本質中就有的嗎？

sentences.en: Good design has an intrinsic beauty.
sentences.zh: 好的設計本身就有一種美。

sentences.en: The stock's price is far above its intrinsic value.
sentences.zh: 這檔股票的價格遠高於它的內在價值。

sentences.en: I want a job with intrinsic rewards, not just a paycheck.
sentences.zh: 我想要的工作，要有內在的成就感，而不只是薪水。

sentences.en: We offer an introductory price for new customers.
sentences.zh: 我們為新客戶提供優惠的入門價。

sentences.en: Is there an introductory class for beginners?
sentences.zh: 有給初學者的入門課嗎？

sentences.en: The introductory video is only two minutes long.
sentences.zh: 開場介紹的影片只有兩分鐘。

sentences.en: Did you read the introductory chapter before class?
sentences.zh: 你上課前有讀導論那一章嗎？

sentences.en: She gave a short introductory speech before the main talk.
sentences.zh: 她在主講之前先做了一段簡短的開場致詞。

sentences.en: The book includes an introductory note from the author.
sentences.zh: 這本書收錄了作者寫的前言。

gloss_note: follow one's intuition 跟著直覺走

sentences.en: My intuition says this deal is too good to be true.
sentences.zh: 我的直覺告訴我，這筆交易好得不像真的。

sentences.en: Do you rely on intuition or data when you decide?
sentences.zh: 做決定時，你是靠直覺還是靠資料？

sentences.en: She followed her intuition and left early.
sentences.zh: 她跟著直覺提早離開了。

sentences.en: Can intuition be trained over time?
sentences.zh: 直覺可以靠時間培養嗎？

sentences.en: Good doctors often use both knowledge and intuition.
sentences.zh: 好醫生通常同時運用知識與直覺。

sentences.en: I had no proof, just intuition.
sentences.zh: 我沒有證據，只有直覺。

gloss_note: invade one's privacy 侵犯隱私

sentences.en: Apps shouldn't invade your privacy.
sentences.zh: 應用程式不該侵犯你的隱私。

sentences.en: Does this camera invade the neighbors' privacy?
sentences.zh: 這個攝影機會侵犯鄰居的隱私嗎？

sentences.en: Ants invade my kitchen every spring.
sentences.zh: 每年春天螞蟻都會入侵我的廚房。

sentences.en: In the movie, aliens invade a small farming town.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，外星人入侵一個小農村。

sentences.en: The history class covered how Rome tried to invade Britain.
sentences.zh: 歷史課講到羅馬人如何試圖入侵不列顛。

sentences.en: How do I stop weeds from invading my garden?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼不讓雜草入侵我的花園？

gloss_note: invaluable 不是沒價值，而是價值極高

sentences.en: Your advice was invaluable to me.
sentences.zh: 你的建議對我來說非常寶貴。

sentences.en: Is this training invaluable for new hires?
sentences.zh: 這個訓練對新進員工來說是不是極為重要？

sentences.en: Good coworkers are invaluable when a deadline is tight.
sentences.zh: 趕截止日期的時候，好同事是無價之寶。

sentences.en: This map turned out to be invaluable on our trip.
sentences.zh: 這張地圖在我們旅途中派上了大用場。

sentences.en: Can you imagine how invaluable a good mentor is?
sentences.zh: 你能想像一位好導師有多重要嗎？

sentences.en: The old photos are invaluable to my family.
sentences.zh: 這些老照片對我們家來說是無價之寶。

gloss_note: invasion of privacy 侵犯隱私

sentences.en: Reading my diary is an invasion of my privacy.
sentences.zh: 偷看我的日記是侵犯我的隱私。

sentences.en: Is a camera in the hallway an invasion of privacy?
sentences.zh: 走廊裝攝影機算侵犯隱私嗎？

sentences.en: The movie shows an alien invasion of Earth.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描寫外星人入侵地球。

sentences.en: We had an invasion of ants in the kitchen last week.
sentences.zh: 上週我們廚房遭螞蟻入侵。

sentences.en: How do farmers protect crops from an invasion of insects?
sentences.zh: 農夫要怎麼保護農作物不受昆蟲入侵？

sentences.en: Constant sales calls feel like an invasion of my personal life.
sentences.zh: 不停的推銷電話讓我覺得私生活被侵擾了。

sentences.en: Who is responsible for the invention of the telephone?
sentences.zh: 誰發明了電話？

sentences.en: The invention of the light bulb changed how people live.
sentences.zh: 燈泡的發明改變了人們的生活方式。

sentences.en: My uncle has a new invention that peels apples in seconds.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔有個新發明，幾秒鐘就能削好蘋果。

sentences.en: Is this gadget your own invention?
sentences.zh: 這個小玩意是你自己發明的嗎？

sentences.en: Our engineers filed a patent for their latest invention.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師為他們最新的發明申請了專利。

sentences.en: We saw some strange inventions at the science fair today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在科學展上看到一些奇特的發明。

gloss_note: invest in 投資於；投入時間心力

sentences.en: She decided to invest her savings in a small bakery.
sentences.zh: 她決定把存款投資在一間小烘焙坊。

sentences.en: Should I invest in a better laptop for school?
sentences.zh: 我該為了上學投資一台更好的筆電嗎？

sentences.en: My dad invests a little money every month.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每個月都會投資一點錢。

sentences.en: Why did you invest so much time in that game?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼在那個遊戲上投入這麼多時間？

sentences.en: The city invested millions in the new highway project.
sentences.zh: 市政府在新的公路計畫上投入了數百萬。

sentences.en: Teachers invest a lot of energy in their students.
sentences.zh: 老師為學生投入了許多心力。

sentences.en: The police opened an investigation into the break-in.
sentences.zh: 警方針對這起闖空門案展開了調查。

sentences.en: How long will the investigation take?
sentences.zh: 這項調查要花多久？

sentences.en: The fire is still under investigation.
sentences.zh: 這場火災仍在調查中。

sentences.en: Did the investigation find any new evidence?
sentences.zh: 調查有找到新的證據嗎？

sentences.en: After a careful investigation, the teacher found out who broke the window.
sentences.zh: 經過仔細調查，老師查出是誰打破了窗戶。

sentences.en: The company ordered an internal investigation last month.
sentences.zh: 公司上個月下令進行內部調查。

gloss_note: a good investment 值得的投資

sentences.en: Buying a house is a big investment.
sentences.zh: 買房子是一大筆投資。

sentences.en: Do you think this car is a good investment?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這輛車是個划算的投資嗎？

sentences.en: The company made a large investment in new equipment.
sentences.zh: 公司在新設備上做了一大筆投資。

sentences.en: What kind of investment is safest for a beginner?
sentences.zh: 對新手來說，哪種投資最安全？

sentences.en: A college education is an investment in your future.
sentences.zh: 大學教育是對你未來的投資。

sentences.en: My brother lost money on a risky investment last year.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥去年在一項高風險的投資上虧了錢。

sentences.en: Parents' involvement in school activities is very helpful.
sentences.zh: 家長參與學校活動很有幫助。

sentences.en: What was his involvement in the project?
sentences.zh: 他在這個計畫中參與了哪些部分？

sentences.en: She denied any involvement in the accident.
sentences.zh: 她否認與那起事故有任何牽連。

sentences.en: Thanks to your involvement, the event ran smoothly.
sentences.zh: 多虧你的參與，活動進行得很順利。

sentences.en: Would you like more involvement in the decision?
sentences.zh: 你想更多地參與這項決定嗎？

sentences.en: Her involvement with the charity began ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 她參與那個慈善團體是從十年前開始的。

sentences.en: That comment is irrelevant to today's meeting.
sentences.zh: 那則意見和今天的會議無關。

sentences.en: Is this information irrelevant to our client?
sentences.zh: 這項資訊跟我們的客戶無關嗎？

sentences.en: Please skip the irrelevant details in your report.
sentences.zh: 報告裡不相關的細節請省略。

sentences.en: Why are you bringing up something so irrelevant?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要提這種不相干的事？

sentences.en: Her age is irrelevant when we choose a candidate.
sentences.zh: 我們挑選人選時，她的年齡無關緊要。

sentences.en: The old figures are irrelevant to this quarter's budget.
sentences.zh: 舊的數字與本季預算無關。

sentences.en: Loud typing in the office really irritates me.
sentences.zh: 辦公室裡很大聲的打字聲真的讓我很煩。

sentences.en: Does it irritate you when people interrupt?
sentences.zh: 別人打斷你說話時，你會覺得煩嗎？

sentences.en: His constant complaints began to irritate his coworkers.
sentences.zh: 他不斷的抱怨開始惹惱同事了。

sentences.en: Don't let one rude customer irritate you.
sentences.zh: 別讓一位無禮的客人惹惱你。

sentences.en: What irritates you most about working from home?
sentences.zh: 在家工作，最讓你煩躁的是什麼？

sentences.en: The long wait at the airport irritated everyone.
sentences.zh: 在機場久候讓每個人都很煩躁。

sentences.en: Farmers isolate sick animals to protect the rest of the herd.
sentences.zh: 農夫會把生病的動物隔離，以保護其他牲畜。

sentences.en: Why do you isolate yourself from your friends?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把自己和朋友隔絕開來？

sentences.en: Bad weather can isolate small mountain towns.
sentences.zh: 惡劣的天氣可能把山區小鎮孤立起來。

sentences.en: Did the school isolate the students who had the flu?
sentences.zh: 學校有把得流感的學生隔離嗎？

sentences.en: I don't want to isolate him from the group.
sentences.zh: 我不想孤立他，讓他脫離團體。

sentences.en: The nurse asked us to isolate the sick child in a separate room.
sentences.zh: 護理師要求我們把生病的孩子隔離在另一個房間。

gloss_note: in isolation 孤立地；單獨地

sentences.en: Many elderly people suffer from isolation.
sentences.zh: 許多年長者飽受孤立之苦。

sentences.en: How do you cope with isolation when you work alone?
sentences.zh: 當你獨自工作時，你如何應付與人隔絕的感覺？

sentences.en: The patient was kept in isolation for a week.
sentences.zh: 那位病人被隔離了一週。

sentences.en: Living in isolation on the farm made her lonely.
sentences.zh: 住在與世隔絕的農場讓她覺得孤單。

sentences.en: Is social isolation a problem for new students?
sentences.zh: 社交孤立對新生來說是個問題嗎？

sentences.en: The island's isolation protects its rare birds.
sentences.zh: 這座島與世隔絕，保護了稀有的鳥類。

gloss_note: raise an issue 提出問題

sentences.en: Climate change is an important issue for young people.
sentences.zh: 氣候變遷對年輕人來說是個重要的議題。

sentences.en: Is there an issue with my order?
sentences.zh: 我的訂單有問題嗎？

sentences.en: We need to discuss a few issues before Friday.
sentences.zh: 週五前我們得討論幾個問題。

sentences.en: What's the main issue you're facing at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上遇到的主要問題是什麼？

sentences.en: The issue of school lunch prices came up at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 學校午餐價格的議題在會議上被提了出來。

sentences.en: My phone has a battery issue again.
sentences.zh: 我的手機電池又出問題了。

gloss_note: 辣度中等，常切片或醃漬

sentences.en: Can I get extra jalapenos on my nachos?
sentences.zh: 我的玉米片可以多加一些墨西哥辣椒嗎？

sentences.en: I sliced a jalapeno and added it to the salsa.
sentences.zh: 我切了一根墨西哥辣椒，加進莎莎醬裡。

sentences.en: Are the jalapenos in this burger very spicy?
sentences.zh: 這個漢堡裡的墨西哥辣椒很辣嗎？

sentences.en: She likes pickled jalapenos on her sandwich.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡在三明治上放醃漬的墨西哥辣椒。

sentences.en: Remove the seeds from the jalapeno if you want less heat.
sentences.zh: 想要不那麼辣，就把墨西哥辣椒的籽去掉。

sentences.en: Dad grows jalapenos in the backyard every summer.
sentences.zh: 爸爸每年夏天都在後院種墨西哥辣椒。

gloss_note: out of jealousy 出於嫉妒

sentences.en: Jealousy can ruin a friendship.
sentences.zh: 嫉妒可能毀掉一段友誼。

sentences.en: Is it jealousy, or are you just worried about her?
sentences.zh: 那是嫉妒，還是你只是在擔心她？

sentences.en: He felt strong jealousy when his friend won the prize.
sentences.zh: 朋友得獎時，他感到強烈的嫉妒。

sentences.en: She spoke out of jealousy, not because it was true.
sentences.zh: 她是出於嫉妒才這麼說，並不是因為那是事實。

sentences.en: How do you deal with jealousy at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上怎麼處理嫉妒的情緒？

sentences.en: There was a hint of jealousy in her voice.
sentences.zh: 她的聲音裡帶著一絲嫉妒。

sentences.en: Let's grab lunch at that new burger joint.
sentences.zh: 我們去那家新開的漢堡店吃午餐吧。

sentences.en: Is there a good pizza joint near your hotel?
sentences.zh: 你的飯店附近有沒有好吃的披薩店？

sentences.en: This little taco joint has the best salsa in town.
sentences.zh: 這間小小的塔可店有全鎮最好吃的莎莎醬。

sentences.en: We found a cheap noodle joint after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，我們找到一間便宜的麵店。

sentences.en: What's the name of that breakfast joint you love?
sentences.zh: 你很愛的那家早餐小店叫什麼名字？

sentences.en: My grandfather ran a barbecue joint for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺經營一家燒烤小店三十年。

sentences.en: The two companies jointly developed the new software.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司共同開發了這套新軟體。

sentences.en: Did you and your partner jointly sign the contract?
sentences.zh: 你和你的合夥人有一起簽這份合約嗎？

sentences.en: They jointly own a small restaurant downtown.
sentences.zh: 他們共同擁有一間位於市中心的小餐廳。

sentences.en: The report was jointly written by three managers.
sentences.zh: 這份報告由三位經理共同撰寫。

sentences.en: Can we jointly apply for the loan?
sentences.zh: 我們可以一起聯名申請這筆貸款嗎？

sentences.en: The city and the school jointly paid for the new library.
sentences.zh: 市府和學校共同出資興建了新圖書館。

sentences.en: The judicial system must treat everyone fairly.
sentences.zh: 司法體系必須公平對待每一個人。

sentences.en: Who appoints judges in the judicial branch?
sentences.zh: 司法部門的法官是由誰任命的？

sentences.en: The company asked for a judicial review of the decision.
sentences.zh: 公司要求對這項決定進行司法審查。

sentences.en: Is the judicial process in this state very slow?
sentences.zh: 這個州的司法程序很慢嗎？

sentences.en: Judicial decisions must follow the law.
sentences.zh: 司法判決必須依法而行。

sentences.en: A judicial hearing is scheduled for next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 一場法院聽證會安排在下週二。

gloss_note: justification for 做…的正當理由

sentences.en: What's the justification for this extra expense?
sentences.zh: 這筆額外開銷的正當理由是什麼？

sentences.en: You need a strong justification to change the schedule.
sentences.zh: 你需要很有力的理由才能更動時程。

sentences.en: There is no justification for treating customers rudely.
sentences.zh: 沒有任何理由可以對客人無禮。

sentences.en: Did your manager accept your justification for the delay?
sentences.zh: 你的經理接受你對延誤的說明了嗎？

sentences.en: Please provide a written justification with your budget request.
sentences.zh: 預算申請請附上書面的理由說明。

sentences.en: The company offered no justification for raising prices.
sentences.zh: 公司沒有為漲價提出任何正當理由。

gloss_note: a keen interest 濃厚興趣

sentences.en: She has a keen interest in space science.
sentences.zh: 她對太空科學有濃厚的興趣。

sentences.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
sentences.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常敏銳。

sentences.en: Is the competition for this job very keen?
sentences.zh: 這份工作的競爭很激烈嗎？

sentences.en: His keen eye caught the mistake right away.
sentences.zh: 他敏銳的眼睛立刻發現了錯誤。

sentences.en: Do you have a keen ear for music?
sentences.zh: 你對音樂的聽覺敏銳嗎？

sentences.en: The coach showed a keen understanding of the game.
sentences.zh: 教練對比賽有敏銳而透徹的理解。

gloss_note: 燒水用，爐上或電熱皆可

sentences.en: Mom filled the kettle and turned on the stove.
sentences.zh: 媽媽把水壺裝滿水，打開了爐火。

sentences.en: Is the water in the kettle hot yet?
sentences.zh: 水壺裡的水燒開了嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, the kettle is still very hot.
sentences.zh: 小心，水壺還很燙。

sentences.en: Can you fill the kettle for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把水壺裝滿水嗎？

sentences.en: The kettle started whistling in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 水壺在廚房裡開始發出哨音。

sentences.en: We bought an electric kettle for our dorm room.
sentences.zh: 我們為宿舍房間買了一個電熱水壺。

gloss_note: kneel down 跪下；過去式 knelt

sentences.en: She knelt down to tie her son's shoes.
sentences.zh: 她跪下來幫兒子綁鞋帶。

sentences.en: Do you have to kneel to reach the bottom shelf?
sentences.zh: 你得跪下來才拿得到最下層的架子嗎？

sentences.en: The farmer knelt in the garden to plant the seeds.
sentences.zh: 農夫跪在園子裡播種。

sentences.en: Why did the knight kneel before the queen?
sentences.zh: 騎士為什麼要在女王面前下跪？

sentences.en: My knees hurt when I kneel on the hard floor.
sentences.zh: 我跪在硬地板上時膝蓋會痛。

sentences.en: She is kneeling by the pond to wash her hands.
sentences.zh: 她跪在池塘邊洗手。

sentences.en: Turn the knob to the right to raise the volume.
sentences.zh: 把旋鈕往右轉來調大音量。

sentences.en: The knob came off the door in my hand.
sentences.zh: 門把在我手裡掉了下來。

sentences.en: Which knob controls the oven temperature?
sentences.zh: 哪個旋鈕控制烤箱的溫度？

sentences.en: Can you twist this knob to open the cabinet?
sentences.zh: 你可以轉這個圓把手來打開櫃子嗎？

sentences.en: She grabbed the knob, but the door was locked.
sentences.zh: 她握住門把，但門鎖住了。

sentences.en: Why is the radio knob so loose?
sentences.zh: 這個收音機的旋鈕為什麼這麼鬆？

sentences.en: Hard labor in the hot sun made him exhausted.
sentences.zh: 在大太陽下做粗重的勞動讓他筋疲力盡。

sentences.en: Labor costs have gone up in our industry.
sentences.zh: 我們這一行的人力成本上升了。

sentences.en: Is there a labor shortage in your area?
sentences.zh: 你們那一帶缺工嗎？

sentences.en: The labor union met with the factory owner yesterday.
sentences.zh: 工會昨天和工廠老闆會面。

sentences.en: How much labor does it take to build a house?
sentences.zh: 蓋一棟房子需要多少人力？

sentences.en: Most of the labor on the farm is done by hand.
sentences.zh: 農場上大部分的勞動都是靠雙手完成的。

sentences.en: Students must wear safety glasses in the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 學生在實驗室裡必須戴上護目鏡。

sentences.en: Where is the chemistry laboratory?
sentences.zh: 化學實驗室在哪裡？

sentences.en: She works in a medical laboratory downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區的一間醫學檢驗室工作。

sentences.en: Did you finish the laboratory report for class?
sentences.zh: 你完成這堂課的實驗報告了嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists tested the new medicine in the laboratory first.
sentences.zh: 科學家先在實驗室裡測試這種新藥。

sentences.en: The school built a new science laboratory last year.
sentences.zh: 學校去年蓋了一間新的科學實驗室。

sentences.en: The mountain landscape looked beautiful at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 日出時的山景美極了。

sentences.en: Do you like painting landscapes?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡畫風景畫嗎？

sentences.en: The landscape changes a lot as you drive north.
sentences.zh: 往北開時，沿途的景觀變化很大。

sentences.en: We stopped to take photos of the desert landscape.
sentences.zh: 我們停下來拍沙漠風景的照片。

sentences.en: What is the best landscape you've ever seen?
sentences.zh: 你看過最美的風景是什麼？

sentences.en: New buildings are changing the landscape of our small town.
sentences.zh: 新建築正在改變我們小鎮的面貌。

gloss_note: largely due to 主要是因為

sentences.en: Her success was largely due to hard work.
sentences.zh: 她的成功主要是靠努力。

sentences.en: The town is largely quiet at night.
sentences.zh: 這座小鎮夜晚大致上很安靜。

sentences.en: Is the problem largely about money?
sentences.zh: 這個問題主要跟錢有關嗎？

sentences.en: The rumors are largely untrue.
sentences.zh: 這些傳言大部分都不是真的。

sentences.en: Are your classmates largely happy with the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 你的同學大致上都滿意新的課表嗎？

sentences.en: The sales team largely ignored the new rule.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊大多無視這項新規定。

gloss_note: launch a product 推出產品

sentences.en: The company will launch its new phone next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月將推出新手機。

sentences.en: When did they launch the rocket?
sentences.zh: 他們是什麼時候發射火箭的？

sentences.en: Our school plans to launch a recycling program.
sentences.zh: 我們學校計畫推出一項資源回收計畫。

sentences.en: Are you going to launch your website soon?
sentences.zh: 你的網站快要上線了嗎？

sentences.en: The scientists launched a weather satellite into orbit.
sentences.zh: 科學家把一顆氣象衛星送入軌道。

sentences.en: Our team will launch the new app at noon.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊中午會推出新的應用程式。

gloss_note: lawful 較正式，日常多說 legal

sentences.en: Is it lawful to park here overnight?
sentences.zh: 在這裡過夜停車合法嗎？

sentences.en: Fishing without a permit is not lawful in this lake.
sentences.zh: 在這座湖未持許可證釣魚是不合法的。

sentences.en: The police need a lawful reason to search a car.
sentences.zh: 警方需要合法的理由才能搜查車輛。

sentences.en: Was the contract lawful, or did it break any rules?
sentences.zh: 那份合約合法嗎，還是違反了任何規定？

sentences.en: He earned a lawful income from his small shop.
sentences.zh: 他靠小店賺取合法的收入。

sentences.en: Are these fireworks lawful in your state?
sentences.zh: 這些煙火在你們州合法嗎？

gloss_note: lean on 倚靠；lean forward 前傾

sentences.en: Don't lean against the wall; the paint is still wet.
sentences.zh: 別靠在牆上，油漆還沒乾。

sentences.en: She leaned over and whispered something to me.
sentences.zh: 她傾身靠過來對我小聲說了句話。

sentences.en: Can I lean on you for a second?
sentences.zh: 我可以靠你一下嗎？

sentences.en: Why do you always lean back in your chair?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼總是把身體往後靠在椅背上？

sentences.en: The ladder is leaning against the garage wall.
sentences.zh: 梯子斜靠在車庫的牆上。

sentences.en: He leaned forward to hear the speaker better.
sentences.zh: 他身體前傾，想把講者聽得更清楚。

gloss_note: give a lecture 演講；也可指說教

sentences.en: The professor gave a lecture on ocean life.
sentences.zh: 教授發表了一場關於海洋生物的演講。

sentences.en: Did you take notes during today's lecture?
sentences.zh: 你有在今天的課堂上記筆記嗎？

sentences.en: We found seats in the back of the lecture hall.
sentences.zh: 我們在階梯教室的後排找到了位子。

sentences.en: Will the guest lecture be recorded?
sentences.zh: 那場客座演講會錄影嗎？

sentences.en: A famous author will lecture at our school next week.
sentences.zh: 一位知名作家下週要來我們學校演講。

sentences.en: I missed the lecture because my bus was late.
sentences.zh: 我因為公車誤點而錯過了那堂課。

sentences.en: Our lecturer is also a famous writer.
sentences.zh: 我們的講師同時也是知名作家。

sentences.en: Who is the guest lecturer for tomorrow's class?
sentences.zh: 明天的課，客座講師是誰？

sentences.en: The lecturer used slides to explain the idea.
sentences.zh: 講師用投影片來說明這個概念。

sentences.en: Is she a lecturer at the local college?
sentences.zh: 她是當地大學的講師嗎？

sentences.en: Our lecturer answers emails within a few hours.
sentences.zh: 我們的講師會在幾小時內回覆電子郵件。

sentences.en: The lecturer asked us to read two chapters before class.
sentences.zh: 講師要求我們上課前讀完兩個章節。

gloss_note: leave a legacy 留下遺產／影響

sentences.en: Her grandmother left her a small legacy.
sentences.zh: 她祖母留給她一小筆遺產。

sentences.en: What legacy do you want to leave behind?
sentences.zh: 你想留下什麼樣的傳承？

sentences.en: The founder's legacy still guides our company today.
sentences.zh: 創辦人留下的精神至今仍指引著我們公司。

sentences.en: Did the old mayor leave a lasting legacy?
sentences.zh: 那位老市長有留下長遠的影響嗎？

sentences.en: The war left a painful legacy in the region.
sentences.zh: 那場戰爭在這個地區留下了痛苦的影響。

sentences.en: Honesty is the legacy my parents gave me.
sentences.zh: 誠實是我父母留給我的傳承。

sentences.en: The legend says a dragon lives in the lake.
sentences.zh: 傳說湖裡住著一條龍。

sentences.en: Have you heard the legend about this old castle?
sentences.zh: 你聽過這座古堡的傳說嗎？

sentences.en: He became a legend in the world of basketball.
sentences.zh: 他成為籃球界的傳奇人物。

sentences.en: Is that story true, or is it just a legend?
sentences.zh: 那個故事是真的，還是只是個傳說？

sentences.en: My grandfather is a legend in our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是我們社區的傳奇人物。

sentences.en: Our teacher told us a local legend about hidden treasure.
sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們一個關於寶藏的當地傳說。

sentences.en: The legislative branch writes the laws of a country.
sentences.zh: 立法部門負責制定國家的法律。

sentences.en: Is the bill still in the legislative process?
sentences.zh: 這項法案還在立法程序中嗎？

sentences.en: The company hired a lawyer to follow legislative changes.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請律師追蹤立法上的變動。

sentences.en: What does the legislative committee do?
sentences.zh: 立法委員會做些什麼？

sentences.en: The legislative session starts in January.
sentences.zh: 立法會期從一月開始。

sentences.en: Business owners worry about new legislative requirements.
sentences.zh: 企業主擔心新的立法規定。

sentences.en: The state legislature passed a new education law.
sentences.zh: 州議會通過了一項新的教育法。

sentences.en: When does the legislature meet next?
sentences.zh: 立法機關下次什麼時候開會？

sentences.en: Our company talks with the legislature about trade rules.
sentences.zh: 我們公司就貿易規定與立法機關溝通。

sentences.en: Is the legislature planning to change the tax law?
sentences.zh: 立法機關打算修改稅法嗎？

sentences.en: The legislature voted on the budget yesterday.
sentences.zh: 立法機關昨天針對預算進行了表決。

sentences.en: Each state has its own legislature.
sentences.zh: 每個州都有自己的議會。

gloss_note: a legitimate reason 正當理由

sentences.en: Is this a legitimate business or a scam?
sentences.zh: 這是正當的生意，還是詐騙？

sentences.en: She had a legitimate reason for being late.
sentences.zh: 她遲到有正當的理由。

sentences.en: The company needs legitimate receipts for every expense.
sentences.zh: 公司要求每筆開銷都要有合法的收據。

sentences.en: Do you think his complaint is legitimate?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他的抱怨是正當的嗎？

sentences.en: Only legitimate users can enter the system.
sentences.zh: 只有合法的使用者才能進入系統。

sentences.en: Check that the website is legitimate before you pay.
sentences.zh: 付款前先確認網站是正當合法的。

gloss_note: a leisurely walk 悠閒的散步

sentences.en: We took a leisurely walk along the river.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。

sentences.en: Do you prefer a leisurely breakfast on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末喜歡悠閒地吃頓早餐嗎？

sentences.en: She set a leisurely pace for the hike.
sentences.zh: 她把健行的步調放得很悠閒。

sentences.en: We had a leisurely lunch before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會前我們從容地吃了午餐。

sentences.en: Why not take a leisurely drive through the countryside?
sentences.zh: 何不悠閒地開車穿越鄉間兜風？

sentences.en: Grandpa strolled leisurely through the park.
sentences.zh: 爺爺在公園裡悠閒地漫步。

gloss_note: lengthen a skirt 把裙子放長

sentences.en: Can you lengthen these pants by two inches?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這條褲子放長兩吋嗎？

sentences.en: The tailor will lengthen the sleeves for you.
sentences.zh: 裁縫師會幫你把袖子放長。

sentences.en: The city plans to lengthen the runway at the airport.
sentences.zh: 市府計畫延長機場的跑道。

sentences.en: Exercise can lengthen your life, doctors say.
sentences.zh: 醫生說運動可以延長壽命。

sentences.en: Does a long meeting really lengthen your workday?
sentences.zh: 開長會真的會拉長你的工作天嗎？

sentences.en: In spring, the days begin to lengthen.
sentences.zh: 春天時，白晝開始變長。

sentences.en: The city will levy a new tax on soda.
sentences.zh: 市府將對汽水課徵新稅。

sentences.en: Why did the government levy a fee on plastic bags?
sentences.zh: 政府為什麼對塑膠袋徵收費用？

sentences.en: The new levy will raise money for the schools.
sentences.zh: 這項新的稅費會為學校籌措經費。

sentences.en: Companies must pay the levy by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 公司必須在月底前繳納這筆稅費。

sentences.en: Will they levy extra charges on imported goods?
sentences.zh: 他們會對進口商品加徵額外費用嗎？

sentences.en: A small levy was added to each hotel bill.
sentences.zh: 每張飯店帳單都加收了一筆小額稅費。

gloss_note: 口氣直接，帶有指責意味

sentences.en: Nobody trusts a liar for very long.
sentences.zh: 沒有人會長久相信一個愛說謊的人。

sentences.en: Are you calling me a liar?
sentences.zh: 你是在說我說謊嗎？

sentences.en: He is a terrible liar, so his face always gives it away.
sentences.zh: 他很不會說謊，所以什麼都寫在臉上。

sentences.en: How can you tell if someone is a liar?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼分辨一個人是不是在說謊？

sentences.en: The little boy was called a liar by his classmates.
sentences.zh: 那個小男孩被同學說是愛說謊的人。

sentences.en: My brother is a liar, but I love him anyway.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟愛說謊，但我還是愛他。

sentences.en: Trade liberalization opened new markets for local farmers.
sentences.zh: 貿易自由化為當地農民開拓了新的市場。

sentences.en: What effect did liberalization have on prices?
sentences.zh: 自由化對物價有什麼影響？

sentences.en: The liberalization of the airline industry lowered ticket prices.
sentences.zh: 航空業的自由化降低了機票價格。

sentences.en: Did the liberalization of rules help small businesses?
sentences.zh: 規定的放寬有幫助到小型企業嗎？

sentences.en: Economists disagree about financial liberalization.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家對金融自由化有不同的看法。

sentences.en: Our company benefited from the liberalization of energy markets.
sentences.zh: 我們公司受惠於能源市場的自由化。

sentences.en: I need to renew my driver's license this month.
sentences.zh: 我這個月得更新我的駕照。

sentences.en: Do you have a license to sell food here?
sentences.zh: 你有在這裡賣食物的執照嗎？

sentences.en: She got her fishing license at the hardware store.
sentences.zh: 她在五金行辦了釣魚許可證。

sentences.en: How long is the license valid?
sentences.zh: 這張執照的有效期限有多久？

sentences.en: The restaurant lost its license after the inspection.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳在檢查後被吊銷了執照。

sentences.en: Where can I apply for a marriage license?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡申請結婚許可證？

sentences.en: The lifeguard blew her whistle and cleared the pool.
sentences.zh: 救生員吹響哨子，請大家離開泳池。

sentences.en: Is there a lifeguard on duty at this beach?
sentences.zh: 這個海灘有救生員值勤嗎？

sentences.en: My cousin works as a lifeguard every summer.
sentences.zh: 我的表親每年夏天都當救生員。

sentences.en: A lifeguard pulled the tired swimmer out of the water.
sentences.zh: 一名救生員把筋疲力盡的游泳者拉出水面。

sentences.en: How do you become a certified lifeguard?
sentences.zh: 怎麼樣才能成為合格的救生員？

sentences.en: The lifeguard told the kids to stay in the shallow end.
sentences.zh: 救生員叫孩子們待在淺水區。

gloss_note: a healthy lifestyle 健康的生活方式

sentences.en: A healthy lifestyle starts with good sleep.
sentences.zh: 健康的生活方式從充足的睡眠開始。

sentences.en: Has your lifestyle changed since you moved to the city?
sentences.zh: 搬到城市後，你的生活方式有改變嗎？

sentences.en: This hotel is perfect for a relaxed beach lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店很適合悠閒的海灘生活。

sentences.en: What kind of lifestyle do your customers have?
sentences.zh: 你們的客人過著什麼樣的生活方式？

sentences.en: Working from home has changed our lifestyle a lot.
sentences.zh: 在家工作大大改變了我們的生活方式。

sentences.en: The magazine writes about food, travel, and lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌介紹美食、旅遊和生活風格。

gloss_note: 回應客套話時可單獨說

sentences.en: "Nice to meet you," she said. "Likewise," I answered.
sentences.zh: 「很高興認識你。」她說。「我也是。」我回答。

sentences.en: I cleaned my desk, and my coworker did likewise.
sentences.zh: 我整理了我的桌子，同事也照著做。

sentences.en: Please turn off your phones, and ask your guests to do likewise.
sentences.zh: 請關掉手機，也請你們的客人照做。

sentences.en: Everyone else stood up; should I do likewise?
sentences.zh: 其他人都站起來了，我也要這樣做嗎？

sentences.en: You're bringing a gift, so should I do likewise?
sentences.zh: 你要帶禮物，那我也該這麼做嗎？

sentences.en: Treat people with respect, and they will do likewise.
sentences.zh: 以尊重對待別人，他們也會這樣對你。

gloss_note: know your limitations 認清極限

sentences.en: Every study has some limitations.
sentences.zh: 每項研究都有些侷限。

sentences.en: What are the limitations of this phone plan?
sentences.zh: 這個手機方案有哪些限制？

sentences.en: There is a limitation on how many guests can come.
sentences.zh: 能來的賓客人數有限制。

sentences.en: She knows her limitations and asks for help.
sentences.zh: 她了解自己的極限，也會開口求助。

sentences.en: Do you see any limitations in this design?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個設計有任何侷限嗎？

sentences.en: Age should not be a limitation for learning.
sentences.zh: 年齡不該成為學習的限制。

gloss_note: linens 指床單桌巾等家用織品

sentences.en: I bought a linen shirt for the summer.
sentences.zh: 我為夏天買了一件亞麻襯衫。

sentences.en: Is this tablecloth made of linen?
sentences.zh: 這條桌巾是亞麻做的嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh linens were on the bed when we arrived.
sentences.zh: 我們抵達時，床上已鋪好乾淨的寢具。

sentences.en: The hotel changes the linen every day.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店每天更換床單與布巾。

sentences.en: Is the linen on your bed soft or rough?
sentences.zh: 你床上的亞麻寢具是柔軟還是粗糙的？

sentences.en: The restaurant uses white linen napkins at every table.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳每張桌子都使用白色亞麻餐巾。

sentences.en: She is majoring in linguistics at college.
sentences.zh: 她在大學主修語言學。

sentences.en: What does linguistics teach us about language?
sentences.zh: 語言學教了我們哪些關於語言的事？

sentences.en: Linguistics studies how languages sound, change, and work.
sentences.zh: 語言學研究語言如何發音、演變與運作。

sentences.en: Did you take a linguistics class last semester?
sentences.zh: 你上學期有修語言學的課嗎？

sentences.en: Her interest in linguistics began when she learned a second language.
sentences.zh: 她對語言學的興趣始於學習第二外語的時候。

sentences.en: The linguistics department is holding a talk on accents tonight.
sentences.zh: 語言學系今晚舉辦一場關於口音的講座。

sentences.en: She put on red lipstick before the party.
sentences.zh: 她在派對前擦上了紅色口紅。

sentences.en: Do you have an extra lipstick in your bag?
sentences.zh: 你包包裡有多的口紅嗎？

sentences.en: That lipstick looks great on you.
sentences.zh: 那支口紅很適合你。

sentences.en: The lipstick left a mark on the coffee cup.
sentences.zh: 口紅在咖啡杯上留下了印子。

sentences.en: Which shade of lipstick should I buy?
sentences.zh: 我該買哪個色號的口紅？

sentences.en: Mom keeps her lipstick in the bathroom drawer.
sentences.zh: 媽媽把口紅放在浴室的抽屜裡。

sentences.en: The company had to liquidate its assets to pay its debts.
sentences.zh: 公司必須變賣資產來還債。

sentences.en: Why did the owners decide to liquidate the business?
sentences.zh: 老闆們為什麼決定結束營業並清算公司？

sentences.en: We plan to liquidate our old inventory before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 我們打算在年底前把舊庫存清倉變現。

sentences.en: Will the board liquidate the company if sales keep falling?
sentences.zh: 如果銷售持續下滑，董事會會清算公司嗎？

sentences.en: The investor liquidated his shares to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 這位投資人變賣了手中的股票來買房子。

sentences.en: After the lawsuit, the firm was liquidated and the workers lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 官司之後，公司被清算，員工都失業了。

gloss_note: go into liquidation 進入清算

sentences.en: The company went into liquidation last spring.
sentences.zh: 這家公司去年春天進入了清算程序。

sentences.en: Who will handle the liquidation of the factory?
sentences.zh: 誰會負責處理這間工廠的清算事宜？

sentences.en: Liquidation usually means selling everything the business owns.
sentences.zh: 清算通常是指把公司擁有的一切都賣掉。

sentences.en: Is the store having a liquidation sale, or is it just a discount?
sentences.zh: 這家店是在做結束營業大拍賣，還是只是打折？

sentences.en: The judge ordered the liquidation of the failed bank.
sentences.zh: 法官下令清算這家倒閉的銀行。

sentences.en: Their debts were paid from the money raised in the liquidation.
sentences.zh: 他們的債務是用清算所得的款項還清的。

sentences.en: Lisa wants to study literary history in college.
sentences.zh: 麗莎想在大學研讀文學史。

sentences.en: Have you ever read any literary magazines?
sentences.zh: 你有讀過任何文學雜誌嗎？

sentences.en: This novel won a famous literary prize last year.
sentences.zh: 這本小說去年得了一個知名的文學獎。

sentences.en: What is your favorite literary work from high school?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡高中時讀過的哪一部文學作品？

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to write a literary analysis of the poem.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們為這首詩寫一篇文學分析。

sentences.en: The town holds a literary festival every fall.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮每年秋天都會舉辦文學節。

sentences.en: We're reading American literature in English class.
sentences.zh: 我們在英文課上讀美國文學。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy classic literature?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡經典文學嗎？

sentences.en: She got a degree in English literature.
sentences.zh: 她拿到了英國文學學位。

sentences.en: What kind of literature does your book club read?
sentences.zh: 你們的讀書會都讀哪一類的文學作品？

sentences.en: Before writing the paper, he reviewed the literature on sleep.
sentences.zh: 寫論文之前，他先回顧了關於睡眠的文獻。

sentences.en: Children's literature can teach big ideas in simple words.
sentences.zh: 兒童文學能用簡單的字句傳達大道理。

gloss_note: in litigation 在訴訟中；不可數

sentences.en: The company is facing litigation over its old contracts.
sentences.zh: 這家公司因為舊合約而面臨訴訟。

sentences.en: Litigation can cost a small business a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 訴訟可能讓小企業花掉一大筆錢。

sentences.en: Is the firm still involved in litigation with its supplier?
sentences.zh: 這家公司還在和供應商打官司嗎？

sentences.en: Our lawyer says we should avoid litigation if possible.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師說，可以的話應該避免訴訟。

sentences.en: How long does patent litigation usually take?
sentences.zh: 專利訴訟通常要花多久時間？

sentences.en: The litigation ended when both sides agreed to settle.
sentences.zh: 雙方同意和解後，訴訟就結束了。

gloss_note: liver disease 肝病；複數 livers

sentences.en: The liver helps the body break down harmful substances.
sentences.zh: 肝臟幫助身體分解有害物質。

sentences.en: Where exactly is the liver located in the body?
sentences.zh: 肝臟究竟位於身體的哪個部位？

sentences.en: Too much alcohol can damage the liver over time.
sentences.zh: 長期飲酒過量會損害肝臟。

sentences.en: Doctors checked his liver after the blood test showed a problem.
sentences.zh: 血液檢查發現異常後，醫生檢查了他的肝臟。

sentences.en: Can a person live with only part of a liver?
sentences.zh: 一個人只靠部分肝臟能存活嗎？

sentences.en: The liver stores energy and makes a fluid that helps digestion.
sentences.zh: 肝臟儲存能量，並製造幫助消化的液體。

gloss_note: take out a loan 申請貸款

sentences.en: I took out a loan to buy my first car.
sentences.zh: 我貸款買了我的第一輛車。

sentences.en: Could you loan me twenty dollars until Friday?
sentences.zh: 你可以借我二十美元到週五嗎？

sentences.en: How long will it take to pay off the loan?
sentences.zh: 還清這筆貸款要花多久？

sentences.en: The bank approved their loan for a new house.
sentences.zh: 銀行核准了他們買新房子的貸款。

sentences.en: My neighbor loaned me his truck for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居週末把他的卡車借給我。

sentences.en: Did you get a student loan for college?
sentences.zh: 你上大學有申請學生貸款嗎？

gloss_note: lobster roll 龍蝦堡（美東名物）

sentences.en: We had grilled lobster at the seafood restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳吃了烤龍蝦。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried lobster?
sentences.zh: 你吃過龍蝦嗎？

sentences.en: Lobster is expensive, so we only eat it on special days.
sentences.zh: 龍蝦很貴，所以我們只在特別的日子才吃。

sentences.en: Maine is famous for its fresh lobster.
sentences.zh: 緬因州以新鮮龍蝦聞名。

sentences.en: How much is the lobster special tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚的龍蝦特餐多少錢？

sentences.en: The fisherman pulled a huge lobster out of the trap.
sentences.zh: 漁夫從籠子裡拉出一隻巨大的龍蝦。

gloss_note: 不可數；follow logic 合乎邏輯

sentences.en: I don't see the logic in this rule.
sentences.zh: 我看不出這條規定有什麼道理。

sentences.en: Math class teaches us to use logic to solve problems.
sentences.zh: 數學課教我們用邏輯來解題。

sentences.en: Does his argument follow any kind of logic?
sentences.zh: 他的論點有任何邏輯可言嗎？

sentences.en: There's no logic to the way they organize the files.
sentences.zh: 他們整理檔案的方式毫無條理。

sentences.en: What is the logic behind this decision?
sentences.zh: 這個決定背後的道理是什麼？

sentences.en: She explained her plan with clear logic.
sentences.zh: 她用清楚的邏輯說明她的計畫。

gloss_note: 單複數動詞皆可；logistics company 物流公司

sentences.en: She manages logistics for a large shipping company.
sentences.zh: 她在一家大型貨運公司負責物流管理。

sentences.en: Logistics became harder when the port closed.
sentences.zh: 港口關閉後，物流變得更困難。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of logistics for the sales conference?
sentences.zh: 誰負責這次銷售會議的後勤安排？

sentences.en: Good logistics keep products moving from the factory to the stores.
sentences.zh: 良好的物流讓產品能從工廠順利送到商店。

sentences.en: Can we talk about the logistics of the trip tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 我們明天可以談談這趟行程的相關安排嗎？

sentences.en: Our logistics team tracks every package in real time.
sentences.zh: 我們的物流團隊即時追蹤每一個包裹。

gloss_note: loom large 顯得迫在眉睫

sentences.en: A price increase looms over the whole industry.
sentences.zh: 漲價的陰影籠罩著整個產業。

sentences.en: Is another budget cut looming?
sentences.zh: 又一輪預算削減要來了嗎？

sentences.en: Dark clouds loomed over the city as we left work.
sentences.zh: 我們下班時，烏雲籠罩在城市上空。

sentences.en: With the deadline looming, the team worked all weekend.
sentences.zh: 截止期限逼近，團隊整個週末都在加班。

sentences.en: Why does a layoff always seem to loom at year end?
sentences.zh: 為什麼年底好像總是有裁員的陰影？

sentences.en: A huge tax bill loomed ahead, and we had no savings.
sentences.zh: 一大筆稅單即將到來，而我們沒有存款。

gloss_note: loosen a tie/rule 鬆領帶／放寬規定

sentences.en: Loosen your tie if you feel hot.
sentences.zh: 覺得熱的話就把領帶鬆開吧。

sentences.en: Can you loosen this bolt with a wrench?
sentences.zh: 你可以用扳手把這顆螺栓鬆開嗎？

sentences.en: The school may loosen its dress code next year.
sentences.zh: 學校明年可能會放寬服裝規定。

sentences.en: He loosened his grip on the rope.
sentences.zh: 他鬆開了握著繩子的手。

sentences.en: Why did the screw loosen after only a week?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那顆螺絲才一週就鬆掉了？

sentences.en: Stretching can loosen tight muscles after a long drive.
sentences.zh: 長途開車後，伸展可以讓緊繃的肌肉放鬆。

gloss_note: 口語；feel lousy 覺得很不舒服

sentences.en: I got lousy sleep last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚睡得很糟。

sentences.en: The service at that diner was lousy.
sentences.zh: 那家小餐館的服務很糟。

sentences.en: Why is the weather so lousy this weekend?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個週末的天氣這麼糟？

sentences.en: I feel lousy, so I'm going home early.
sentences.zh: 我覺得很不舒服，所以要早點回家。

sentences.en: Was the movie really that lousy?
sentences.zh: 那部電影真的有那麼爛嗎？

sentences.en: He's a lousy cook, but he tries hard.
sentences.zh: 他廚藝很差，但是很努力。

sentences.en: She left teaching for a more lucrative job in sales.
sentences.zh: 她離開教職，改做收入更高的業務工作。

sentences.en: Is exporting coffee a lucrative business?
sentences.zh: 出口咖啡是個賺錢的生意嗎？

sentences.en: The company signed a lucrative contract with a large retailer.
sentences.zh: 公司和一家大型零售商簽了一份利潤豐厚的合約。

sentences.en: Online advertising has become very lucrative.
sentences.zh: 網路廣告已變得非常賺錢。

sentences.en: That sounds like a lucrative offer. Are you going to take it?
sentences.zh: 聽起來是很優渥的條件，你要接受嗎？

sentences.en: Selling handmade furniture turned out to be lucrative for him.
sentences.zh: 事實證明，賣手工家具對他來說很賺錢。

gloss_note: lump sum 一次付清的款項

sentences.en: She took her pension as a lump sum.
sentences.zh: 她把退休金一次領取。

sentences.en: Do you want the money in a lump sum or monthly payments?
sentences.zh: 你想一次領完這筆錢，還是分月領取？

sentences.en: Put a lump of butter in the pan.
sentences.zh: 在平底鍋裡放一塊奶油。

sentences.en: The company paid the bonus in one lump sum.
sentences.zh: 公司一次付清了整筆獎金。

sentences.en: Can you roll this lump of clay into a ball?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這塊黏土搓成球嗎？

sentences.en: Mix the batter well so there are no lumps.
sentences.zh: 把麵糊攪拌均勻，才不會有結塊。

gloss_note: lure A into B 誘使A陷入B

sentences.en: The store uses big discounts to lure new customers.
sentences.zh: 這家店用大折扣來吸引新顧客。

sentences.en: Can a high salary lure top engineers away from other firms?
sentences.zh: 高薪能把頂尖工程師從其他公司挖角過來嗎？

sentences.en: Free samples can lure hungry shoppers into the store.
sentences.zh: 免費試吃品能把飢餓的顧客吸引進店裡。

sentences.en: Don't let the promise of quick money lure you into a bad deal.
sentences.zh: 別讓賺快錢的承諾把你誘入糟糕的交易。

sentences.en: What lured you to this company in the first place?
sentences.zh: 你當初是被這家公司的什麼吸引來的？

sentences.en: The city lured the factory with lower taxes.
sentences.zh: 這座城市以較低的稅率吸引工廠進駐。

sentences.en: We stayed in a luxurious hotel by the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們住在海邊一間豪華的飯店。

sentences.en: Is that luxurious car worth the price?
sentences.zh: 那輛豪華車值那個價錢嗎？

sentences.en: Her apartment is small but luxurious.
sentences.zh: 她的公寓雖小卻很奢華。

sentences.en: The spa offers a luxurious massage after a long week.
sentences.zh: 這間水療中心在漫長的一週之後提供豪華按摩。

sentences.en: Have you ever had a luxurious dinner like that?
sentences.zh: 你有吃過那樣奢華的晚餐嗎？

sentences.en: The thick towels felt soft and luxurious.
sentences.zh: 厚厚的毛巾摸起來柔軟又高級。

gloss_note: a luxury 奢侈享受；不可數亦可數

sentences.en: A big house is a luxury for most young people.
sentences.zh: 對大多數年輕人來說，大房子是奢侈品。

sentences.en: Do you think a vacation is a luxury or a need?
sentences.zh: 你覺得度假是奢侈還是必需？

sentences.en: They live in luxury on a quiet island.
sentences.zh: 他們在一座寧靜的小島上過著奢華的生活。

sentences.en: Sleeping late on a weekday is a rare luxury.
sentences.zh: 平日能睡晚一點是難得的奢侈享受。

sentences.en: Can we afford the luxury of a new car this year?
sentences.zh: 我們今年負擔得起買新車這種奢侈嗎？

sentences.en: This luxury hotel charges extra for everything.
sentences.zh: 這家豪華飯店什麼都要另外收費。

gloss_note: 禮貌稱呼女性，美式服務業常用

sentences.en: Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your wallet.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，女士，您的皮夾掉了。

sentences.en: Can I help you with those bags, ma'am?
sentences.zh: 女士，需要我幫您拿那些袋子嗎？

sentences.en: Yes, ma'am, I'll check on your order right away.
sentences.zh: 好的，女士，我馬上幫您查訂單。

sentences.en: Would you like a window seat, ma'am?
sentences.zh: 女士，您想要靠窗的座位嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for waiting, ma'am. Your table is ready.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您的等候，女士。您的位子準備好了。

sentences.en: The clerk said, "No, ma'am, that size is sold out."
sentences.zh: 店員說：「沒有了，女士，那個尺寸賣完了。」

gloss_note: 對比 microeconomics 個體經濟學

sentences.en: She teaches macroeconomics at a community college.
sentences.zh: 她在社區大學教總體經濟學。

sentences.en: Macroeconomics looks at inflation, jobs, and national growth.
sentences.zh: 總體經濟學研究通貨膨脹、就業和國家的成長。

sentences.en: Did you take macroeconomics in college?
sentences.zh: 你大學有修總體經濟學嗎？

sentences.en: What does macroeconomics say about rising prices?
sentences.zh: 總體經濟學對物價上漲有什麼看法？

sentences.en: Our macroeconomics exam covers interest rates and unemployment.
sentences.zh: 我們的總體經濟學考試範圍包括利率和失業。

sentences.en: The macroeconomics professor predicted slower growth next year.
sentences.zh: 總體經濟學教授預測明年成長會放緩。

gloss_note: 語氣強烈，比 great 更正式

sentences.en: The view from the mountain was magnificent.
sentences.zh: 山上的景色壯麗極了。

sentences.en: Have you seen the magnificent old theater downtown?
sentences.zh: 你看過市區那間宏偉的老戲院嗎？

sentences.en: What a magnificent dinner! Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好豐盛的一頓晚餐！非常謝謝你。

sentences.en: She wore a magnificent red dress to the party.
sentences.zh: 她穿著一件華麗的紅色洋裝去參加派對。

sentences.en: Isn't that bridge magnificent at sunset?
sentences.zh: 那座橋在日落時不是很壯觀嗎？

sentences.en: You did a magnificent job on the science project.
sentences.zh: 你的科學專題做得太棒了。

gloss_note: 常與 island 對比；the mainland

sentences.en: Shipping goods from the island to the mainland costs extra.
sentences.zh: 從島上把貨物運到本土要多收費用。

sentences.en: Does the ferry to the mainland run on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 開往本土的渡輪星期天有開嗎？

sentences.en: Many islanders commute to jobs on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 許多島民通勤到本土工作。

sentences.en: The resort buys most of its food from the mainland.
sentences.zh: 這間度假村大部分的食材都向本土採購。

sentences.en: How far is the mainland from here?
sentences.zh: 本土離這裡有多遠？

sentences.en: Prices on the island are higher than on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 島上的物價比本土高。

gloss_note: enter the mainstream 成為主流

sentences.en: Electric cars are finally entering the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 電動車終於進入主流市場。

sentences.en: Is this product too strange for the mainstream?
sentences.zh: 這項產品對主流大眾來說是不是太奇特了？

sentences.en: The brand wants to move from niche to mainstream.
sentences.zh: 這個品牌想從小眾走向主流。

sentences.en: Her ideas were far from the mainstream at that time.
sentences.zh: 她的想法在當時遠離主流。

sentences.en: Will online learning become part of the mainstream?
sentences.zh: 線上學習會成為主流的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: Most mainstream banks now offer mobile payments.
sentences.zh: 現在大多數主流銀行都提供行動支付。

gloss_note: 不可數；makeup artist 化妝師

sentences.en: She doesn't wear much makeup to work.
sentences.zh: 她上班不太化妝。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that makeup?
sentences.zh: 你那款彩妝是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: I need to take off my makeup before bed.
sentences.zh: 我睡前得先卸妝。

sentences.en: Do you have any makeup I could borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有化妝品可以借我用嗎？

sentences.en: The actor sat still while the makeup artist worked.
sentences.zh: 化妝師工作時，演員一動也不動地坐著。

sentences.en: Her makeup bag was full of lipsticks and brushes.
sentences.zh: 她的化妝包裡裝滿口紅和刷具。

sentences.en: Some companies manipulate prices to hurt competitors.
sentences.zh: 有些公司操縱價格來打擊競爭對手。

sentences.en: Did he manipulate the numbers to look better?
sentences.zh: 他是不是為了讓數字好看而動手腳？

sentences.en: Advertisers sometimes manipulate our feelings.
sentences.zh: 廣告商有時會操控我們的情緒。

sentences.en: She felt that her boss was trying to manipulate her.
sentences.zh: 她覺得老闆在設法擺布她。

sentences.en: How do you stop people from manipulating the data?
sentences.zh: 要怎麼防止有人竄改資料？

sentences.en: The report says traders manipulated the stock market.
sentences.zh: 報告指出交易員操縱了股市。

sentences.en: The study examined emotional manipulation in advertising.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討廣告中的情緒操弄。

sentences.en: Is price manipulation common in this industry?
sentences.zh: 這個產業常有價格操縱嗎？

sentences.en: Manipulation of data can lead to false conclusions.
sentences.zh: 操弄數據可能導致錯誤的結論。

sentences.en: Children can learn to recognize online manipulation.
sentences.zh: 孩子可以學會辨識網路上的操弄。

sentences.en: Why do some people use emotional manipulation to get what they want?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人用情緒操控來達成目的？

sentences.en: Investigators found evidence of stock market manipulation.
sentences.zh: 調查人員發現了操縱股市的證據。

sentences.en: The factory manufactures car parts for several companies.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠為好幾家公司製造汽車零件。

sentences.en: Where is this phone manufactured?
sentences.zh: 這支手機是在哪裡製造的？

sentences.en: The manufacture of steel requires a lot of energy.
sentences.zh: 鋼鐵的製造需要大量能源。

sentences.en: Do they manufacture their own furniture?
sentences.zh: 他們自己製造家具嗎？

sentences.en: Many toys are manufactured overseas.
sentences.zh: 許多玩具是在海外製造的。

sentences.en: The company stopped manufacturing the old model last year.
sentences.zh: 公司去年停止生產舊款了。

sentences.en: Our company is a leading car manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 我們公司是一家領先的汽車製造商。

sentences.en: Contact the manufacturer if the product breaks.
sentences.zh: 如果產品壞了，就聯絡製造商。

sentences.en: Who is the manufacturer of this laptop?
sentences.zh: 這台筆記型電腦的製造商是誰？

sentences.en: The manufacturer offers a two-year warranty.
sentences.zh: 製造商提供兩年保固。

sentences.en: Did the manufacturer recall the toy?
sentences.zh: 製造商有召回那款玩具嗎？

sentences.en: Small manufacturers often struggle with rising material costs.
sentences.zh: 小型製造商常為上漲的原料成本所苦。

gloss_note: run a marathon 跑馬拉松

sentences.en: My dad runs a marathon every spring.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每年春天都跑一場馬拉松。

sentences.en: Have you ever finished a marathon?
sentences.zh: 你跑完過馬拉松嗎？

sentences.en: She trained for six months before the marathon.
sentences.zh: 她為了馬拉松訓練了六個月。

sentences.en: How long does it take to run a marathon?
sentences.zh: 跑完一場馬拉松要花多久？

sentences.en: Thousands of people lined the streets to watch the marathon.
sentences.zh: 成千上萬的人站在街邊觀看馬拉松。

sentences.en: A marathon is about twenty-six miles long.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松全程大約是二十六英里。

gloss_note: margin of error 誤差範圍

sentences.en: Please write your notes in the margin.
sentences.zh: 請把筆記寫在頁邊空白處。

sentences.en: Leave a wide margin on each side of the page.
sentences.zh: 每一頁左右兩邊要留寬一點的邊界。

sentences.en: Did she win by a large margin?
sentences.zh: 她是以很大的差距獲勝的嗎？

sentences.en: The team lost by a narrow margin.
sentences.zh: 這隊以些微差距落敗。

sentences.en: What is the margin of error in this survey?
sentences.zh: 這項調查的誤差範圍是多少？

sentences.en: Why are there notes in the margin of this book?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這本書的頁邊有筆記？

gloss_note: materially affect 實質影響；偏正式
