sentences.en: The new policy did not materially change our costs.
sentences.zh: 新政策並未實質改變我們的成本。

sentences.en: Has the deal materially affected your sales?
sentences.zh: 這筆交易有對你們的銷售造成實質影響嗎？

sentences.en: The two plans differ materially in price.
sentences.zh: 這兩項計畫在價格上有很大的不同。

sentences.en: Nothing has materially changed since last quarter.
sentences.zh: 自上一季以來沒有任何實質的改變。

sentences.en: Would a delay materially hurt the project?
sentences.zh: 延誤會對專案造成嚴重損害嗎？

sentences.en: The contract can end if either side materially breaks its terms.
sentences.zh: 只要任何一方嚴重違反條款，合約就可以終止。

sentences.en: The company focuses on profit maximization.
sentences.zh: 這家公司專注於利潤最大化。

sentences.en: Is revenue maximization your only goal?
sentences.zh: 營收最大化是你唯一的目標嗎？

sentences.en: Maximization of efficiency saved the factory thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 效率最大化為工廠省下了好幾千美元。

sentences.en: Why is profit maximization sometimes harmful to workers?
sentences.zh: 為什麼利潤最大化有時會對員工有害？

sentences.en: The class discussed the maximization of shareholder value.
sentences.zh: 課堂上討論了股東價值最大化。

sentences.en: Our goal is the maximization of customer satisfaction, not just sales.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是讓顧客滿意度最大化，而不只是銷售。

gloss_note: measurable goals 可衡量的目標

sentences.en: We saw measurable progress after just one month.
sentences.zh: 才一個月，我們就看到了明顯的進步。

sentences.en: Set measurable goals so you can track your results.
sentences.zh: 設定可衡量的目標，這樣才能追蹤成果。

sentences.en: Is there a measurable difference between the two products?
sentences.zh: 這兩種產品之間有明顯的差別嗎？

sentences.en: The medicine had no measurable effect on his cough.
sentences.zh: 這種藥對他的咳嗽沒有明顯的效果。

sentences.en: Are these results measurable in any way?
sentences.zh: 這些成果能以任何方式量化嗎？

sentences.en: The lake level has risen by a measurable amount.
sentences.zh: 湖水水位上升了可測量到的幅度。

gloss_note: spaghetti and meatballs 肉丸義大利麵

sentences.en: I'll have the spaghetti and meatballs, please.
sentences.zh: 我要義大利肉丸麵，麻煩你了。

sentences.en: Do these meatballs have pork in them?
sentences.zh: 這些肉丸裡有豬肉嗎？

sentences.en: Dad makes the best meatball sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 爸爸做的肉丸三明治最好吃。

sentences.en: Would you like a meatball sub for lunch?
sentences.zh: 午餐你想吃肉丸潛艇堡嗎？

sentences.en: Roll the meat into small meatballs and bake them.
sentences.zh: 把肉搓成小肉丸，然後拿去烤。

sentences.en: The kids ate every meatball on the plate.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把盤子裡的每顆肉丸都吃光了。

sentences.en: The median salary in this field is about sixty thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 這個領域的薪資中位數大約是六萬美元。

sentences.en: Is the median income higher than last year?
sentences.zh: 收入中位數比去年高嗎？

sentences.en: The median age of our customers is thirty-five.
sentences.zh: 我們顧客的年齡中位數是三十五歲。

sentences.en: What is the median price of a home in this area?
sentences.zh: 這一帶房子價格的中位數是多少？

sentences.en: Half the workers earn more than the median wage.
sentences.zh: 有一半的員工賺得比薪資中位數多。

sentences.en: The median of three, five, and nine is five.
sentences.zh: 三、五、九的中位數是五。

gloss_note: a memorable trip 難忘的旅行

sentences.en: It was a memorable trip for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 對全家人來說，那是一趟難忘的旅行。

sentences.en: What was the most memorable day of your life?
sentences.zh: 你這輩子最難忘的一天是哪一天？

sentences.en: The teacher gave a memorable speech at graduation.
sentences.zh: 老師在畢業典禮上發表了一場令人難忘的演講。

sentences.en: Her smile made the evening truly memorable.
sentences.zh: 她的笑容讓那天晚上真正難忘。

sentences.en: Do you have a memorable meal from your travels?
sentences.zh: 你旅行時有哪一餐令你難忘嗎？

sentences.en: That song has a very memorable tune.
sentences.zh: 那首歌的旋律非常好記。

sentences.en: We visited the memorial in the park last weekend.
sentences.zh: 上週末我們去參觀了公園裡的紀念碑。

sentences.en: Is there a memorial for the firefighters in your town?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上有為消防員設立的紀念碑嗎？

sentences.en: The family held a memorial service for their friend.
sentences.zh: 這家人為朋友舉辦了追思會。

sentences.en: Many people leave flowers at the memorial every year.
sentences.zh: 每年都有許多人在紀念碑前獻花。

sentences.en: What does the memorial in the center of town honor?
sentences.zh: 市中心的那座紀念碑是在紀念什麼？

sentences.en: The school planted a tree as a memorial to the late principal.
sentences.zh: 學校種了一棵樹來紀念已故的校長。

sentences.en: I need to memorize twenty new words tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚得背二十個新單字。

sentences.en: How do you memorize so many phone numbers?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼記住這麼多電話號碼的？

sentences.en: The actors had to memorize their lines in a week.
sentences.zh: 演員們必須在一週內把台詞背起來。

sentences.en: Can you memorize the whole poem by tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天以前能把整首詩背起來嗎？

sentences.en: She memorized the route before she started driving.
sentences.zh: 她開車之前先把路線記熟了。

sentences.en: Don't just memorize the formula; try to understand it.
sentences.zh: 不要只是死背公式，要試著理解它。

gloss_note: show mercy 手下留情；不可數

sentences.en: The judge showed mercy because it was his first mistake.
sentences.zh: 因為這是他第一次犯錯，法官從輕發落。

sentences.en: Please have mercy and give me one more day.
sentences.zh: 求你發發慈悲，再給我一天。

sentences.en: Did the king show any mercy to the thieves in the story?
sentences.zh: 故事裡的國王對小偷有手下留情嗎？

sentences.en: The storm showed no mercy to the small town.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨毫不留情地襲擊這個小鎮。

sentences.en: Is mercy more important than punishment?
sentences.zh: 憐憫比懲罰更重要嗎？

sentences.en: The student asked the teacher for mercy after missing the deadline.
sentences.zh: 學生錯過期限後，向老師求情。

sentences.en: It cost a mere five dollars.
sentences.zh: 那只要區區五美元。

sentences.en: She is a mere child, so be patient.
sentences.zh: 她只是個孩子，所以要有耐心。

sentences.en: Is a mere apology enough after what happened?
sentences.zh: 發生了那些事之後，光是道歉就夠了嗎？

sentences.en: The mere thought of snakes scares me.
sentences.zh: 光是想到蛇我就害怕。

sentences.en: Why worry over a mere scratch?
sentences.zh: 為什麼要為一道小擦傷操心？

sentences.en: He won the race by a mere second.
sentences.zh: 他以區區一秒之差贏得比賽。

gloss_note: bike messenger 腳踏車快遞員

sentences.en: A messenger delivered the package to our office.
sentences.zh: 一位信差把包裹送到我們辦公室。

sentences.en: The king sent a messenger to the next town.
sentences.zh: 國王派了一位信差去下一個鎮。

sentences.en: Can you send a messenger to pick up the documents?
sentences.zh: 你能派個送件員來拿文件嗎？

sentences.en: He worked as a bike messenger in the city.
sentences.zh: 他在市區當腳踏車快遞員。

sentences.en: Who was the messenger who brought the news?
sentences.zh: 帶來消息的信差是誰？

sentences.en: Don't blame the messenger; he only repeated what he heard.
sentences.zh: 別怪傳話的人，他只是轉述聽到的話。

sentences.en: My room is messy because I haven't cleaned in a week.
sentences.zh: 我的房間很亂，因為我一個星期沒打掃了。

sentences.en: Why is your desk always so messy?
sentences.zh: 你的書桌為什麼總是這麼亂？

sentences.en: Eating spaghetti can get messy.
sentences.zh: 吃義大利麵可能會弄得一團髒亂。

sentences.en: It's a messy situation, and nobody knows what to do.
sentences.zh: 這情況很棘手，沒有人知道該怎麼辦。

sentences.en: Do you mind if the kitchen is a little messy?
sentences.zh: 廚房有點亂你介意嗎？

sentences.en: Kids love messy art projects with paint and glue.
sentences.zh: 孩子們喜歡用顏料和膠水做髒兮兮的美勞作品。

sentences.en: Exercise can speed up your metabolism.
sentences.zh: 運動可以加快你的新陳代謝。

sentences.en: Does age affect a person's metabolism?
sentences.zh: 年齡會影響一個人的新陳代謝嗎？

sentences.en: Some people have a faster metabolism than others.
sentences.zh: 有些人的新陳代謝比別人快。

sentences.en: The study measured how sleep changes metabolism.
sentences.zh: 這項研究測量睡眠如何改變新陳代謝。

sentences.en: How does the body's metabolism turn food into energy?
sentences.zh: 身體的新陳代謝是如何把食物轉換成能量的？

sentences.en: A slow metabolism can make weight loss harder.
sentences.zh: 新陳代謝緩慢會讓減重更困難。

sentences.en: The poet uses the ocean as a metaphor for time.
sentences.zh: 詩人用海洋來比喻時間。

sentences.en: What does the writer mean by this metaphor?
sentences.zh: 作者用這個隱喻是什麼意思？

sentences.en: "Time is money" is a common metaphor.
sentences.zh: 「時間就是金錢」是常見的隱喻。

sentences.en: Can you think of a metaphor for friendship?
sentences.zh: 你能想到一個形容友誼的比喻嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher explained the difference between a metaphor and a simile.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了隱喻和明喻的差別。

sentences.en: She described the project as a sinking ship, a powerful metaphor.
sentences.zh: 她把這項專案形容成一艘正在下沉的船，是個有力的比喻。

sentences.en: Many migrant workers pick fruit on large farms.
sentences.zh: 許多移工在大農場採收水果。

sentences.en: The migrant population in this city has grown.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的移居人口增加了。

sentences.en: Are migrant workers protected by the same labor laws?
sentences.zh: 移工受到相同勞動法律的保護嗎？

sentences.en: The company hires migrant labor during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 公司在旺季雇用外來勞工。

sentences.en: Many migrants send money back to their families.
sentences.zh: 許多移工把錢寄回給家人。

sentences.en: How many migrants arrive in the area each year?
sentences.zh: 每年有多少移居者來到這個地區？

sentences.en: The weather is mild in San Diego all year.
sentences.zh: 聖地牙哥全年氣候溫和。

sentences.en: Do you like mild salsa or spicy salsa?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡溫和的莎莎醬還是辣的？

sentences.en: He had a mild cold and stayed home.
sentences.zh: 他得了輕微感冒，所以待在家裡。

sentences.en: Is this soap mild enough for babies?
sentences.zh: 這種肥皂對嬰兒來說夠溫和嗎？

sentences.en: My boss has a mild manner, but she's firm.
sentences.zh: 我的主管態度溫和，但立場堅定。

sentences.en: We had a mild winter this year, with almost no snow.
sentences.zh: 我們今年的冬天很溫和，幾乎沒下雪。

gloss_note: gas mileage 油耗；里程報銷

sentences.en: What's the mileage on this rental car?
sentences.zh: 這輛租來的車跑了多少里程？

sentences.en: The company pays me for mileage when I drive to clients.
sentences.zh: 我開車去見客戶時，公司會給我里程補貼。

sentences.en: Did you write down your mileage for the trip?
sentences.zh: 你有記下這趟出差的里程數嗎？

sentences.en: This used truck has low mileage for its age.
sentences.zh: 這輛二手卡車以車齡來說里程數很低。

sentences.en: I need to submit my mileage report by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我週五前得交里程報表。

sentences.en: How much mileage can we claim for the sales trip?
sentences.zh: 這次業務出差我們可以報多少里程補貼？

gloss_note: 多指由平民組成的非正規武裝

sentences.en: My history teacher said a militia helped defend the town.
sentences.zh: 我的歷史老師說有一支民兵幫忙保衛這座城鎮。

sentences.en: Was the militia made up of farmers and shopkeepers?
sentences.zh: 這支民兵是由農夫和店主組成的嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather joined the local militia when he was young.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺年輕時加入過當地的民兵組織。

sentences.en: The news says the militia has left the area.
sentences.zh: 新聞說那支民兵已經離開這個地區了。

sentences.en: Why did the colonists form a militia in the first place?
sentences.zh: 殖民者當初為什麼要組成民兵？

sentences.en: We watched a documentary about a small-town militia last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部關於小鎮民兵的紀錄片。

gloss_note: paper mill 造紙廠；flour mill 麵粉廠

sentences.en: My uncle works at a paper mill near the river.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在河邊附近的一間造紙廠工作。

sentences.en: Does the old flour mill still work?
sentences.zh: 那座老磨坊還能運作嗎？

sentences.en: The steel mill laid off fifty workers last month.
sentences.zh: 那家鋼鐵廠上個月裁掉了五十名員工。

sentences.en: How long has the textile mill been closed?
sentences.zh: 這家紡織廠關閉多久了？

sentences.en: We visited a historic mill on our field trip.
sentences.zh: 我們校外教學時參觀了一座歷史悠久的磨坊。

sentences.en: The lumber mill ships boards to stores across the state.
sentences.zh: 這家木材廠把木板運到全州各地的商店。

sentences.en: He became a millionaire before he turned thirty.
sentences.zh: 他三十歲前就成了百萬富翁。

sentences.en: Do you think you could ever be a millionaire?
sentences.zh: 你覺得你有可能成為百萬富翁嗎？

sentences.en: A millionaire donated money to our school library.
sentences.zh: 一位百萬富翁捐錢給我們學校的圖書館。

sentences.en: How did she become a millionaire so young?
sentences.zh: 她怎麼這麼年輕就成了百萬富翁？

sentences.en: My neighbor looks like a normal guy, but he's a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居看起來像個普通人，其實是個百萬富翁。

sentences.en: The movie is about a millionaire who loses everything.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一個失去一切的百萬富翁。

sentences.en: The miner put on his helmet and went underground.
sentences.zh: 礦工戴上安全帽，下到地底。

sentences.en: My great-grandfather was a coal miner.
sentences.zh: 我曾祖父是煤礦礦工。

sentences.en: Is it dangerous to work as a miner?
sentences.zh: 當礦工危險嗎？

sentences.en: Rescue teams are searching for the missing miners.
sentences.zh: 救援隊正在搜尋失蹤的礦工。

sentences.en: How much does a gold miner make in a year?
sentences.zh: 一名金礦礦工一年能賺多少錢？

sentences.en: The miners went on strike for better pay.
sentences.zh: 礦工們為了爭取更高的薪水而罷工。

sentences.en: What's the minimum order for free shipping?
sentences.zh: 免運費的最低訂購金額是多少？

sentences.en: You need a minimum of two years of experience.
sentences.zh: 你至少需要兩年的經驗。

sentences.en: The minimum wage went up again this year.
sentences.zh: 今年基本工資又調漲了。

sentences.en: Could you keep the noise to a minimum, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把噪音降到最低嗎？

sentences.en: I only studied the bare minimum for the quiz.
sentences.zh: 我為了小考只讀了最低限度的內容。

sentences.en: Is there a minimum age to enter the park?
sentences.zh: 進入這座公園有最低年齡限制嗎？

sentences.en: The minister of education visited our school today.
sentences.zh: 教育部長今天來參觀我們學校。

sentences.en: Did the transportation minister say anything about the new bridge?
sentences.zh: 交通部長有提到那座新橋嗎？

sentences.en: The foreign minister arrived at the airport this morning.
sentences.zh: 外交部長今天早上抵達機場。

sentences.en: My aunt works as an assistant to a cabinet minister.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在一位內閣部長手下當助理。

sentences.en: Why did the finance minister visit the factory?
sentences.zh: 財政部長為什麼去參觀那間工廠？

sentences.en: In civics class, we learned what a government minister does.
sentences.zh: 在公民課上，我們學到了政府部長的職責。

gloss_note: mint tea 薄荷茶；mint leaves 薄荷葉

sentences.en: Could I get some fresh mint in my iced tea?
sentences.zh: 我的冰茶裡可以加一些新鮮薄荷嗎？

sentences.en: The chef sprinkled chopped mint over the salad.
sentences.zh: 主廚在沙拉上撒了切碎的薄荷。

sentences.en: I grow mint in a pot on my balcony.
sentences.zh: 我在陽台的盆子裡種薄荷。

sentences.en: Does this chocolate ice cream have mint in it?
sentences.zh: 這個巧克力冰淇淋裡有薄荷嗎？

sentences.en: Add a few mint leaves to the lemonade.
sentences.zh: 在檸檬汁裡加幾片薄荷葉。

sentences.en: This toothpaste tastes like mint.
sentences.zh: 這牙膏嚐起來有薄荷味。

sentences.en: The kids are quiet, so they must be up to mischief.
sentences.zh: 孩子們這麼安靜，一定在搗蛋。

sentences.en: What kind of mischief did your puppy get into today?
sentences.zh: 你的小狗今天又闖了什麼禍？

sentences.en: There was a spark of mischief in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她眼中閃著淘氣的光芒。

sentences.en: He grinned with mischief and hid my keys.
sentences.zh: 他淘氣地咧嘴一笑，把我的鑰匙藏了起來。

sentences.en: Our teacher keeps the boys apart to avoid mischief.
sentences.zh: 老師把男生們分開坐，以免他們搗蛋。

sentences.en: Is April Fools' Day just an excuse for mischief?
sentences.zh: 愚人節只是讓人惡作劇的藉口嗎？

sentences.en: I felt miserable when I caught a cold on vacation.
sentences.zh: 我度假時感冒了，覺得好難受。

sentences.en: Why do you look so miserable today?
sentences.zh: 你今天怎麼看起來這麼難過？

sentences.en: The weather was cold, wet, and miserable all weekend.
sentences.zh: 整個週末天氣又冷又濕，糟透了。

sentences.en: Waiting in a long line was miserable for everyone.
sentences.zh: 排很長的隊對大家來說都很難受。

sentences.en: Is he still miserable about losing the game?
sentences.zh: 他還在為輸掉比賽難過嗎？

sentences.en: She had a miserable week at work.
sentences.zh: 她這週上班過得很悲慘。

gloss_note: 較正式；口語常說 bad luck

sentences.en: Losing his job was just the start of his misfortune.
sentences.zh: 失去工作只是他不幸的開始。

sentences.en: Have you ever had a streak of misfortune?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有遇過一連串的不幸？

sentences.en: She never complains about her misfortune.
sentences.zh: 她從不抱怨自己的不幸。

sentences.en: By some misfortune, the package never arrived.
sentences.zh: 運氣不好，那個包裹一直沒送到。

sentences.en: Why do some people laugh at other people's misfortune?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人會嘲笑別人的不幸？

sentences.en: The town slowly recovered from its misfortune after the flood.
sentences.zh: 水災過後，這座小鎮慢慢從厄運中恢復過來。

sentences.en: I think you misunderstand what I'm asking.
sentences.zh: 我想你誤會我的意思了。

sentences.en: Please don't misunderstand me; I'm not angry.
sentences.zh: 請別誤會，我沒有生氣。

sentences.en: How could the client misunderstand the instructions?
sentences.zh: 客戶怎麼會誤解這些說明呢？

sentences.en: Sorry, I misunderstood your email.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我誤解了你的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Did the customer misunderstand our return policy?
sentences.zh: 顧客是不是誤解了我們的退貨規定？

sentences.en: Teenagers often feel that adults misunderstand them.
sentences.zh: 青少年常覺得大人誤解他們。

sentences.en: Education can improve social mobility for low-income families.
sentences.zh: 教育可以提升低收入家庭的社會流動性。

sentences.en: After the surgery, her mobility got better every week.
sentences.zh: 手術後，她的行動能力一週比一週好。

sentences.en: Is mobility a problem for elderly residents in your town?
sentences.zh: 在你們鎮上，年長居民有行動上的困難嗎？

sentences.en: How does a good bus system affect people's mobility?
sentences.zh: 良好的公車系統對人們的行動便利有什麼影響？

sentences.en: The study found little upward mobility in the region.
sentences.zh: 研究發現這個地區幾乎沒有向上流動的機會。

sentences.en: My grandfather has limited mobility, so we installed a ramp.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺行動不便，所以我們裝了斜坡。

sentences.en: Her modesty made everyone like her even more.
sentences.zh: 她的謙虛讓大家更喜歡她。

sentences.en: Is it modesty, or does he just dislike attention?
sentences.zh: 那是謙虛，還是他只是不喜歡受人注目？

sentences.en: He accepted the award with great modesty.
sentences.zh: 他非常謙遜地接受了這個獎。

sentences.en: Don't show false modesty; you did a great job.
sentences.zh: 別假裝謙虛，你做得很好。

sentences.en: Why does modesty matter so much in some workplaces?
sentences.zh: 為什麼在某些職場中，謙虛這麼重要？

sentences.en: With typical modesty, the coach thanked his players.
sentences.zh: 教練一如往常地謙虛，感謝他的球員。

sentences.en: We have good momentum, so let's not slow down now.
sentences.zh: 我們現在氣勢正旺，別在這時候慢下來。

sentences.en: How can we keep the momentum going after the launch?
sentences.zh: 產品上市後，我們要怎麼保持這股氣勢？

sentences.en: Sales gained momentum in the second quarter.
sentences.zh: 第二季的銷售成長動力增強了。

sentences.en: The project lost momentum when two key people left.
sentences.zh: 兩位關鍵人員離開後，這個專案就失去了動力。

sentences.en: Did the new ad campaign give us any momentum?
sentences.zh: 新的廣告活動有為我們帶來任何氣勢嗎？

sentences.en: The team needs momentum before the big presentation.
sentences.zh: 在重要簡報之前，團隊需要先衝出一股氣勢。

sentences.en: Could you buy a bigger monitor for my desk?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我的桌子買一個更大的螢幕嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse will monitor his heart rate overnight.
sentences.zh: 護理師整晚會監測他的心跳。

sentences.en: My monitor keeps flickering; can you ask the help desk?
sentences.zh: 我的螢幕一直閃爍，你可以問一下服務台嗎？

sentences.en: How do you monitor the quality of your products?
sentences.zh: 你們怎麼監控產品的品質？

sentences.en: Parents should monitor how much time kids spend online.
sentences.zh: 家長應該監督孩子花多少時間上網。

sentences.en: Is the second monitor working with your laptop?
sentences.zh: 你的筆電能用第二個螢幕嗎？

sentences.en: We took pictures in front of the monument.
sentences.zh: 我們在紀念碑前拍了照。

sentences.en: Is that monument open to visitors on weekends?
sentences.zh: 那座紀念碑週末開放參觀嗎？

sentences.en: The city built a monument to honor the firefighters.
sentences.zh: 市政府蓋了一座紀念碑來紀念消防員。

sentences.en: Which monument did you like best on the tour?
sentences.zh: 導覽行程中你最喜歡哪座古蹟？

sentences.en: This ancient monument is more than two thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 這座古蹟已有兩千多年歷史。

sentences.en: My class visited a stone monument in the park last spring.
sentences.zh: 去年春天我們班去參觀了公園裡的一座石造紀念碑。

sentences.en: Morale is low since the layoffs were announced.
sentences.zh: 自從宣布裁員後，士氣一直很低落。

sentences.en: How can we boost morale on the sales team?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提振業務團隊的士氣？

sentences.en: A free lunch can really lift morale.
sentences.zh: 一頓免費午餐真的能提振士氣。

sentences.en: The manager held a party to raise morale.
sentences.zh: 經理辦了派對來提高士氣。

sentences.en: Did morale improve after the new schedule started?
sentences.zh: 新的排班開始後，士氣有改善嗎？

sentences.en: Poor morale is hurting our customer service.
sentences.zh: 低落的士氣正在影響我們的客戶服務。

gloss_note: moral 為形容詞；moral values 道德價值

sentences.en: Many philosophers study the morality of lying.
sentences.zh: 許多哲學家研究說謊的道德問題。

sentences.en: Does morality change from one culture to another?
sentences.zh: 道德觀會隨文化不同而改變嗎？

sentences.en: The film asks tough questions about morality and justice.
sentences.zh: 這部電影對道德與正義提出了尖銳的問題。

sentences.en: My parents taught me a strong sense of morality.
sentences.zh: 我父母教我要有強烈的道德觀。

sentences.en: How do children learn morality?
sentences.zh: 孩子是怎麼學會道德的？

sentences.en: We debated the morality of animal testing in class.
sentences.zh: 我們在課堂上辯論了動物實驗是否合乎道德。

sentences.en: The apartment is cheap. Moreover, it's close to the subway.
sentences.zh: 這間公寓很便宜，而且離地鐵很近。

sentences.en: Moreover, our team finished the work two days early.
sentences.zh: 此外，我們團隊提前兩天完成了工作。

sentences.en: She is smart and, moreover, very kind.
sentences.zh: 她很聰明，而且人又很善良。

sentences.en: The soup was delicious; moreover, it was only five dollars.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯很好喝，而且只要五美元。

sentences.en: She has experience. Moreover, she speaks Spanish. Shouldn't we hire her?
sentences.zh: 她有經驗，而且會說西班牙語。我們不是該錄取她嗎？

sentences.en: The job pays well. Moreover, it offers health insurance. Why not apply?
sentences.zh: 這份工作薪水不錯，而且有健康保險。何不去應徵？

gloss_note: a recurring motif 反覆出現的主題

sentences.en: The wallpaper has a flower motif.
sentences.zh: 這壁紙有花朵圖案。

sentences.en: Water is a recurring motif in this novel.
sentences.zh: 水是這部小說中反覆出現的主題。

sentences.en: Can you spot the leaf motif on the curtains?
sentences.zh: 你找得到窗簾上的樹葉圖案嗎？

sentences.en: What motif does the artist repeat in his paintings?
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家在畫作中反覆使用什麼圖案？

sentences.en: The same motif appears throughout the symphony.
sentences.zh: 同一個主題貫穿整首交響曲。

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to find a motif in the poem.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們找出這首詩中的一個主題。

gloss_note: motivate sb to do 激勵某人做某事

sentences.en: How do you motivate your team on busy days?
sentences.zh: 在忙碌的日子裡，你怎麼激勵團隊？

sentences.en: A good coach knows how to motivate players.
sentences.zh: 好教練懂得如何激勵球員。

sentences.en: Money alone can't motivate everyone.
sentences.zh: 光靠錢無法激勵每個人。

sentences.en: What motivates you to get up so early?
sentences.zh: 是什麼促使你這麼早起床？

sentences.en: I need something to motivate me to exercise.
sentences.zh: 我需要點什麼來激勵自己去運動。

sentences.en: Praise from the teacher helped motivate the students.
sentences.zh: 老師的稱讚有助於激勵學生。

sentences.en: I've lost my motivation to study lately.
sentences.zh: 我最近失去了念書的動力。

sentences.en: What's your motivation for learning English?
sentences.zh: 你學英文的動機是什麼？

sentences.en: The boss's speech gave everyone new motivation.
sentences.zh: 老闆的演講讓大家有了新的幹勁。

sentences.en: Does she have enough motivation to finish the course?
sentences.zh: 她有足夠的動力完成這門課嗎？

sentences.en: Good grades can be a strong motivation for students.
sentences.zh: 好成績可以成為學生強大的動力。

sentences.en: His motivation for moving here was a better job.
sentences.zh: 他搬來這裡的動機是為了更好的工作。

sentences.en: What was the motive behind the price change?
sentences.zh: 這次調價背後的動機是什麼？

sentences.en: The profit motive drives many small businesses.
sentences.zh: 營利動機驅動著許多小型企業。

sentences.en: I don't understand his motive for quitting.
sentences.zh: 我不明白他辭職的理由。

sentences.en: Does the company have a hidden motive?
sentences.zh: 這家公司有什麼隱藏的動機嗎？

sentences.en: The reporter asked about the motive for the merger.
sentences.zh: 記者詢問了合併的動機。

sentences.en: Her motive for calling was simply to say thanks.
sentences.zh: 她打電話的理由只是想說聲謝謝。

gloss_note: a mountainous region 多山地區

sentences.en: This part of the country is very mountainous.
sentences.zh: 這個國家的這個地區山很多。

sentences.en: Is the area around the lake mountainous?
sentences.zh: 湖周圍的地區多山嗎？

sentences.en: Driving through mountainous terrain made me nervous.
sentences.zh: 開車穿過多山的地形讓我很緊張。

sentences.en: Mountainous regions get more snow in winter.
sentences.zh: 多山地區冬天雪下得比較多。

sentences.en: We hiked in a mountainous area last weekend.
sentences.zh: 上週末我們在一個多山的地區健行。

sentences.en: Why is farming so hard in mountainous countries?
sentences.zh: 為什麼在多山的國家務農這麼困難？

gloss_note: 披薩和番茄起司沙拉常用

sentences.en: Can I get extra mozzarella on my pizza?
sentences.zh: 我的披薩可以多加莫札瑞拉起司嗎？

sentences.en: We bought fresh mozzarella at the market.
sentences.zh: 我們在市場買了新鮮的莫札瑞拉起司。

sentences.en: Fresh mozzarella is soft, white, and mild.
sentences.zh: 新鮮的莫札瑞拉起司又軟又白，味道溫和。

sentences.en: Does the sandwich come with mozzarella and tomato?
sentences.zh: 這份三明治有附莫札瑞拉起司和番茄嗎？

sentences.en: Sprinkle shredded mozzarella over the pasta before baking.
sentences.zh: 烘烤前，把莫札瑞拉起司絲撒在義大利麵上。

sentences.en: The lasagna has three kinds of cheese, including mozzarella.
sentences.zh: 這道千層麵用了三種起司，包括莫札瑞拉。

gloss_note: muddy boots 沾滿泥巴的靴子

sentences.en: Please take off your muddy shoes before coming in.
sentences.zh: 進來之前請把沾滿泥巴的鞋子脫掉。

sentences.en: The trail was too muddy after the rain.
sentences.zh: 下雨後那條步道泥濘不堪。

sentences.en: Why are your pants so muddy?
sentences.zh: 你的褲子怎麼沾滿了泥巴？

sentences.en: Is the soccer field still muddy from last night's rain?
sentences.zh: 足球場還因為昨晚的雨而泥濘嗎？

sentences.en: The dog ran through the yard and got muddy.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗跑過院子，弄得一身泥。

sentences.en: We drove down a muddy road to the campsite.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著一條泥濘的路開到露營地。

gloss_note: stubborn as a mule 像騾子一樣固執

sentences.en: The old farmer still uses a mule to pull his cart.
sentences.zh: 老農夫還是用一頭騾子來拉他的板車。

sentences.en: Is a mule a cross between a horse and a donkey?
sentences.zh: 騾子是馬和驢雜交的後代嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists rode a mule down the canyon trail.
sentences.zh: 觀光客騎著騾子沿著峽谷步道往下走。

sentences.en: My brother is as stubborn as a mule.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥像騾子一樣固執。

sentences.en: How much weight can a mule carry up a mountain?
sentences.zh: 一頭騾子能背多重的東西上山？

sentences.en: We saw a mule standing by the barn.
sentences.zh: 我們看到一頭騾子站在穀倉旁。

sentences.en: I've called him multiple times, but he never answers.
sentences.zh: 我打給他好幾次了，他都沒接。

sentences.en: The package came in multiple boxes.
sentences.zh: 包裹分成好幾個箱子送來。

sentences.en: Can I pay with multiple credit cards?
sentences.zh: 我可以用好幾張信用卡付款嗎？

sentences.en: She has multiple job offers to think about.
sentences.zh: 她有好幾個工作機會要考慮。

sentences.en: Does this software support multiple languages?
sentences.zh: 這個軟體支援多種語言嗎？

sentences.en: The storm caused multiple delays at the airport.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成機場多次延誤。

sentences.en: A new factory can have a multiplier effect on local jobs.
sentences.zh: 一間新工廠可能對當地就業產生乘數效應。

sentences.en: We use a multiplier of two to set retail prices.
sentences.zh: 我們用兩倍的倍數來訂定零售價。

sentences.en: How big is the multiplier effect of tourism in this town?
sentences.zh: 觀光在這個小鎮的乘數效應有多大？

sentences.en: A higher multiplier means each dollar creates more income.
sentences.zh: 乘數越大，每一美元創造的收入越多。

sentences.en: Can you explain the multiplier in simple terms?
sentences.zh: 你可以用簡單的方式解釋乘數嗎？

sentences.en: Investors apply a multiplier to annual profit to value the company.
sentences.zh: 投資人用年度獲利乘上一個倍數來評估公司價值。

gloss_note: 常見於推理小說、電影與新聞

sentences.en: In the novel, the murderer is the last person you'd expect.
sentences.zh: 在這本小說裡，兇手是你最意想不到的人。

sentences.en: Who do you think the murderer is in this movie?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這部電影裡的兇手是誰？

sentences.en: The detective finally figured out who the murderer was.
sentences.zh: 偵探終於查出誰是兇手。

sentences.en: The news said the murderer was sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 新聞說那名殺人犯被判無期徒刑。

sentences.en: Did you guess the murderer before the ending?
sentences.zh: 你在結局前就猜到兇手是誰了嗎？

sentences.en: My book club is reading a mystery about a clever murderer.
sentences.zh: 我的讀書會正在讀一本關於聰明兇手的推理小說。

gloss_note: a murmur of voices 低聲交談聲

sentences.en: I heard a soft murmur coming from the next room.
sentences.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來輕輕的低語聲。

sentences.en: She murmured something and went back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 她喃喃說了些話，又睡著了。

sentences.en: A murmur ran through the audience when he walked in.
sentences.zh: 他走進來時，觀眾間響起一陣低語。

sentences.en: Did you hear him murmur my name?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到他低聲叫我的名字嗎？

sentences.en: What are those two murmuring about in the back row?
sentences.zh: 後排那兩個人在低聲說些什麼？

sentences.en: The teacher's voice dropped to a murmur.
sentences.zh: 老師的聲音降成了低語。

sentences.en: Would you like mustard or ketchup on your hot dog?
sentences.zh: 你的熱狗要加黃芥末醬還是番茄醬？

sentences.en: Can I get honey mustard for my chicken strips?
sentences.zh: 我的雞柳條可以附蜂蜜芥末醬嗎？

sentences.en: I spread a little mustard on the sandwich.
sentences.zh: 我在三明治上抹了一點黃芥末醬。

sentences.en: This pretzel tastes better with spicy mustard.
sentences.zh: 這個椒鹽脆餅配辛辣的芥末醬更好吃。

sentences.en: We're out of mustard, so please buy some.
sentences.zh: 我們的黃芥末醬用完了，請買一些。

sentences.en: The dressing has mustard, olive oil, and lemon juice.
sentences.zh: 這個醬汁用了黃芥末醬、橄欖油和檸檬汁。

sentences.en: We have a mutual friend named Sam.
sentences.zh: 我們有個共同的朋友叫山姆。

sentences.en: You enjoy working with me? The feeling is mutual.
sentences.zh: 你喜歡跟我共事？我也有同感。

sentences.en: Good teamwork starts with mutual respect.
sentences.zh: 好的團隊合作始於相互尊重。

sentences.en: Is the decision mutual, or did one side push for it?
sentences.zh: 這是雙方共同的決定，還是有一方在推動？

sentences.en: They ended the contract by mutual agreement.
sentences.zh: 他們經雙方同意終止了合約。

sentences.en: Do you and Jake have any mutual interests?
sentences.zh: 你和傑克有什麼共同的興趣嗎？

sentences.en: We're looking for a mutually beneficial deal.
sentences.zh: 我們正在尋求互惠的交易。

sentences.en: Are these two goals mutually exclusive?
sentences.zh: 這兩個目標是互相排斥的嗎？

sentences.en: The two companies mutually agreed to end the partnership.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司雙方同意終止合作關係。

sentences.en: Can we find a solution that's mutually acceptable?
sentences.zh: 我們能找到雙方都能接受的解決方案嗎？

sentences.en: We mutually decided to move the meeting to Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們雙方決定把會議改到週一。

sentences.en: Mutually agreed deadlines keep projects on track.
sentences.zh: 雙方約定的期限能讓專案按進度進行。

gloss_note: a mysterious stranger 神祕的陌生人

sentences.en: A mysterious package was sitting at my door.
sentences.zh: 我家門口放著一個神祕的包裹。

sentences.en: Why was he so mysterious about his weekend plans?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼對週末的計畫這麼神祕？

sentences.en: The old house has a mysterious past.
sentences.zh: 這棟老房子有段神祕的過去。

sentences.en: Who left this mysterious note on my desk?
sentences.zh: 誰把這張神祕的紙條放在我桌上？

sentences.en: Scientists are studying a mysterious light in the sky.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究天空中一道神祕的光。

sentences.en: Her smile looked mysterious in the photo.
sentences.zh: 她在照片裡的笑容看起來很神祕。

sentences.en: Many people believe the myth that we use only ten percent of our brains.
sentences.zh: 很多人相信我們只用了大腦百分之十的迷思。

sentences.en: Is it a myth that cold weather gives you a cold?
sentences.zh: 天氣冷會讓人感冒是個迷思嗎？

sentences.en: We read a Greek myth about a flying boy in class.
sentences.zh: 我們在課堂上讀了一則關於會飛男孩的希臘神話。

sentences.en: That's a myth; goldfish remember much longer than three seconds.
sentences.zh: 那是迷思；金魚記得的時間遠超過三秒。

sentences.en: Does your culture have a myth about the moon?
sentences.zh: 你們的文化裡有關於月亮的神話嗎？

sentences.en: The report tries to clear up myths about healthy eating.
sentences.zh: 這份報告試圖澄清關於健康飲食的迷思。

sentences.en: There's a nasty smell coming from the fridge.
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡傳出一股難聞的味道。

sentences.en: Why was he so nasty to the waiter?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼對服務生那麼惡劣？

sentences.en: We had nasty weather on our trip.
sentences.zh: 我們旅行時遇到惡劣的天氣。

sentences.en: She sent me a nasty text after the argument.
sentences.zh: 吵架後她傳了一則很難聽的簡訊給我。

sentences.en: Did you hear the nasty rumor about the new manager?
sentences.zh: 你有聽說關於新經理的那個難聽謠言嗎？

sentences.en: That's a nasty cough; you should see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 這咳嗽很糟糕，你該去看醫生。

gloss_note: 常見於歷史與社會課題

sentences.en: The textbook explains how nationalism grew in the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 課本解釋了民族主義在1800年代如何興起。

sentences.en: Does sport increase nationalism or just friendly pride?
sentences.zh: 運動會增強民族主義，還是只是友善的自豪感？

sentences.en: My roommate is writing a paper on nationalism.
sentences.zh: 我室友正在寫一篇關於民族主義的報告。

sentences.en: What role did nationalism play in European history?
sentences.zh: 民族主義在歐洲史上扮演了什麼角色？

sentences.en: We talked about nationalism in history class today.
sentences.zh: 今天歷史課我們討論了民族主義。

sentences.en: The documentary looks at nationalism in the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片探討二十世紀的民族主義。

sentences.en: Please write your name and nationality on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上寫下你的姓名和國籍。

sentences.en: Does this form ask for your nationality?
sentences.zh: 這張表格有要填國籍嗎？

sentences.en: There are students of many nationalities in my class.
sentences.zh: 我班上有許多不同國籍的學生。

sentences.en: He holds dual nationality because his mother was born abroad.
sentences.zh: 他因為母親出生在國外而擁有雙重國籍。

sentences.en: What nationality is the new exchange student?
sentences.zh: 新來的交換學生是什麼國籍？

sentences.en: The airline asked for each passenger's nationality at check-in.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在報到時詢問每位乘客的國籍。

gloss_note: a nationwide sale 全國性特賣

sentences.en: The company plans a nationwide sale next month.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫下個月舉辦全國性的特賣。

sentences.en: Is the new service available nationwide?
sentences.zh: 這項新服務全國都有嗎？

sentences.en: Our products are sold in stores nationwide.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品在全國各地的商店都有販售。

sentences.en: The airline began a nationwide hiring campaign.
sentences.zh: 這家航空公司展開了全國性的徵才活動。

sentences.en: Did the snowstorm cause nationwide flight delays?
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雪有造成全國性的航班延誤嗎？

sentences.en: We ship orders nationwide within three days.
sentences.zh: 我們三天內把訂單寄送到全國各地。

sentences.en: Our school collects coats for needy families.
sentences.zh: 我們學校為貧困家庭募集外套。

sentences.en: The charity helps needy children get school supplies.
sentences.zh: 這個慈善機構幫助貧困的孩子取得學用品。

sentences.en: How can we support needy students in our community?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼幫助社區裡有需要的學生？

sentences.en: Do you know any needy families who could use this food?
sentences.zh: 你認識哪些貧困家庭可以用到這些食物嗎？

sentences.en: Many volunteers cook meals for the needy on weekends.
sentences.zh: 許多志工週末為窮困的人煮飯。

sentences.en: A local bakery gives free bread to needy neighbors every Friday.
sentences.zh: 當地一家麵包店每週五免費送麵包給貧困的鄰居。

sentences.en: Don't neglect your health when work gets busy.
sentences.zh: 工作忙的時候別忽略了健康。

sentences.en: The pipes burst because of neglect.
sentences.zh: 水管因為疏於維護而爆裂。

sentences.en: Did I neglect to mention the deadline changed?
sentences.zh: 我是不是忘了說截止日期改了？

sentences.en: She felt that her boss neglected her ideas.
sentences.zh: 她覺得老闆忽視她的想法。

sentences.en: Why has the city neglected this park for so long?
sentences.zh: 市政府為什麼這麼久都不管這座公園？

sentences.en: Years of neglect had left the garden full of weeds.
sentences.zh: 多年的疏於照顧讓花園長滿雜草。

sentences.en: The company was sued for negligence.
sentences.zh: 這家公司因過失被告。

sentences.en: Was the accident caused by negligence?
sentences.zh: 這起意外是疏忽造成的嗎？

sentences.en: The manager admitted the delay was caused by his negligence.
sentences.zh: 經理承認延誤是他的疏忽造成的。

sentences.en: Medical negligence cases can take years to settle.
sentences.zh: 醫療疏失案件可能要花好幾年才能和解。

sentences.en: Can the landlord be held responsible for negligence?
sentences.zh: 房東要為疏失負責嗎？

sentences.en: Negligence in following safety rules costs businesses millions.
sentences.zh: 不遵守安全規定的疏忽讓企業損失數百萬美元。

sentences.en: Can we negotiate the price a little?
sentences.zh: 我們可以稍微談一下價格嗎？

sentences.en: I plan to negotiate a higher salary.
sentences.zh: 我打算爭取更高的薪水。

sentences.en: The two sides will negotiate again on Monday.
sentences.zh: 雙方週一會再次協商。

sentences.en: How do you negotiate with a difficult client?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼跟難搞的客戶談判？

sentences.en: She negotiated a better deal on the lease.
sentences.zh: 她談成了更好的租約條件。

sentences.en: Our team is negotiating a new contract with the supplier.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊正與供應商協商新合約。

sentences.en: The test was hard. Nevertheless, I passed.
sentences.zh: 考試很難，儘管如此，我還是通過了。

sentences.en: It was raining; we went hiking nevertheless.
sentences.zh: 下著雨，我們還是去健行了。

sentences.en: The room was small. Nevertheless, it felt cozy.
sentences.zh: 房間很小，但還是覺得很溫馨。

sentences.en: He was tired. He helped us move nevertheless.
sentences.zh: 他很累，但還是幫我們搬家。

sentences.en: She had a fever. Why did she go to work nevertheless?
sentences.zh: 她發燒了，為什麼還是去上班？

sentences.en: The plan has some flaws. Should we go ahead nevertheless?
sentences.zh: 這計畫有些缺點，我們還是要繼續嗎？

gloss_note: find a niche 找到利基；niche market

sentences.en: Our startup found a niche in organic pet food.
sentences.zh: 我們的新創公司在有機寵物食品上找到了利基市場。

sentences.en: Can a small shop survive in such a niche?
sentences.zh: 小店能在這麼小眾的市場裡生存嗎？

sentences.en: We should target a niche instead of the whole market.
sentences.zh: 我們應該鎖定利基市場，而不是整個市場。

sentences.en: How did she find a profitable niche so quickly?
sentences.zh: 她怎麼這麼快就找到有利可圖的利基市場？

sentences.en: The brand fills a niche that big companies ignore.
sentences.zh: 這個品牌填補了大公司忽略的利基市場。

sentences.en: Handmade leather goods are a growing niche.
sentences.zh: 手工皮件是一個正在成長的利基市場。

sentences.en: I had a nightmare about missing the final exam.
sentences.zh: 我做了一場惡夢，夢到自己錯過期末考。

sentences.en: Did you have a nightmare last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有做惡夢嗎？

sentences.en: Parking downtown on weekends is a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 週末在市區停車簡直是場惡夢。

sentences.en: Why is the traffic always such a nightmare here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的交通為什麼老是像場惡夢？

sentences.en: The movie gave my little brother nightmares for a week.
sentences.zh: 那部電影害我弟弟連續一週做惡夢。

sentences.en: Moving to a new city with no job would be a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 沒有工作就搬到新城市，那會是場惡夢。

gloss_note: 元素符號 N，空氣的主要成分

sentences.en: Air is about 78 percent nitrogen.
sentences.zh: 空氣中大約有78%是氮。

sentences.en: Plants need nitrogen to grow healthy leaves.
sentences.zh: 植物需要氮才能長出健康的葉子。

sentences.en: Why do farmers add nitrogen to the soil?
sentences.zh: 農夫為什麼要在土壤中加入氮？

sentences.en: Too much nitrogen from fertilizer can pollute rivers.
sentences.zh: 肥料中過多的氮可能汙染河川。

sentences.en: Does liquid nitrogen really freeze food instantly?
sentences.zh: 液態氮真的能瞬間冷凍食物嗎？

sentences.en: The students measured the nitrogen level in the water sample.
sentences.zh: 學生測量了水樣本中的氮含量。

gloss_note: a noble cause 崇高的理念

sentences.en: Returning a lost wallet is a noble thing to do.
sentences.zh: 歸還遺失的錢包是很高尚的舉動。

sentences.en: Is helping others a noble goal for a career?
sentences.zh: 幫助別人是個高尚的職業目標嗎？

sentences.en: She comes from a noble family that owned land for centuries.
sentences.zh: 她出身貴族世家，家族擁有土地好幾百年。

sentences.en: Did noble families in medieval Europe pay taxes?
sentences.zh: 中世紀歐洲的貴族家族要繳稅嗎？

sentences.en: His noble effort to help the team earned everyone's respect.
sentences.zh: 他幫助球隊的高尚努力贏得了大家的尊敬。

sentences.en: In the story, a noble knight protects the village.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一位高尚的騎士守護著村莊。

sentences.en: Don't talk nonsense; you know that isn't true.
sentences.zh: 別胡說，你知道那不是真的。

sentences.en: Is it true, or is it just nonsense?
sentences.zh: 這是真的，還是只是胡說八道？

sentences.en: I read the email twice, but it was complete nonsense.
sentences.zh: 我把那封電子郵件讀了兩遍，但完全是一派胡言。

sentences.en: Why do people believe this kind of nonsense online?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家會相信網路上這種胡說八道？

sentences.en: The teacher said the answer was nonsense because the numbers didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 老師說這個答案毫無意義，因為數字根本對不起來。

sentences.en: I have no time for nonsense, so let's get to the point.
sentences.zh: 我沒時間聽廢話，直接說重點吧。

gloss_note: 多放句首，常與現在式連用

sentences.en: Nowadays, most people pay with their phones.
sentences.zh: 現在大多數人都用手機付款。

sentences.en: What do young people do for fun nowadays?
sentences.zh: 現在的年輕人都做什麼消遣？

sentences.en: Nowadays, it's hard to find a store that only takes cash.
sentences.zh: 如今很難找到只收現金的店了。

sentences.en: Do you still write letters nowadays?
sentences.zh: 你現在還會寫信嗎？

sentences.en: We rarely see old telephone booths nowadays.
sentences.zh: 現今我們很少看到老舊的電話亭了。

sentences.en: Nowadays, many students take notes on tablets instead of paper.
sentences.zh: 現在許多學生用平板電腦而不是紙張做筆記。

sentences.en: The country plans to build a new nuclear power plant.
sentences.zh: 該國計畫興建一座新的核能發電廠。

sentences.en: Is nuclear energy safe enough to replace coal?
sentences.zh: 核能夠安全到足以取代煤炭嗎？

sentences.en: Nuclear power provides a large share of the electricity here.
sentences.zh: 核能提供了這裡很大一部分的電力。

sentences.en: Do you think nuclear power is a clean source of energy?
sentences.zh: 你覺得核能是乾淨的能源嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle works as an engineer at a nuclear plant.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在核能電廠擔任工程師。

sentences.en: The class watched a video about how nuclear reactors work.
sentences.zh: 全班看了一部介紹核子反應爐如何運作的影片。

gloss_note: null and void 無效、作廢

sentences.en: The contract is null and void if either side breaks the terms.
sentences.zh: 如果任何一方違反條款，這份合約即屬無效。

sentences.en: Is the agreement still valid, or is it null and void?
sentences.zh: 這份協議還有效，還是已經作廢了？

sentences.en: Without a witness, the document could be declared null and void.
sentences.zh: 沒有見證人的話，這份文件可能被宣告無效。

sentences.en: Our lawyer said the old lease became null and void after the sale.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師說，出售之後那份舊租約就失效了。

sentences.en: Is this coupon null and void if I use it after the expiration date?
sentences.zh: 如果我過了到期日才使用，這張優惠券會失效嗎？

sentences.en: The court ruled the deal null and void because nobody had signed it.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定這筆交易無效，因為沒有人簽署過。

sentences.en: Numerous customers have asked about the new menu.
sentences.zh: 許多顧客詢問過新菜單。

sentences.en: Have you had numerous problems with this printer?
sentences.zh: 你用這台印表機遇過很多問題嗎？

sentences.en: She has won numerous awards for her teaching.
sentences.zh: 她因教學獲得過許多獎項。

sentences.en: There are numerous ways to save money on groceries.
sentences.zh: 買菜省錢的方法有很多。

sentences.en: Why did numerous students miss the deadline?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這麼多學生都錯過了截止期限？

sentences.en: I called the office numerous times, but nobody answered.
sentences.zh: 我打了很多次電話到辦公室，但都沒人接。

gloss_note: 美式多指嬰兒房；托兒所說 daycare

sentences.en: They painted the nursery yellow before the baby arrived.
sentences.zh: 寶寶出生前，他們把嬰兒房漆成了黃色。

sentences.en: Where did you put the crib in the nursery?
sentences.zh: 你把嬰兒床放在嬰兒房的哪裡？

sentences.en: Is the nursery ready for the baby yet?
sentences.zh: 嬰兒房準備好迎接寶寶了嗎？

sentences.en: The hospital nursery is just down the hall from her room.
sentences.zh: 醫院的育嬰室就在她病房的走廊那頭。

sentences.en: The nursery has soft toys and a rocking chair.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒房裡有柔軟的玩偶和一張搖椅。

sentences.en: Should we put a night-light in the nursery?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要在嬰兒房放一盞小夜燈？

sentences.en: Plants take nutrients from the soil through their roots.
sentences.zh: 植物透過根部從土壤吸收養分。

sentences.en: Which nutrients does your body need every day?
sentences.zh: 你的身體每天需要哪些營養素？

sentences.en: Vegetables are a rich source of important nutrients.
sentences.zh: 蔬菜是重要營養素的豐富來源。

sentences.en: Does cooking destroy the nutrients in broccoli?
sentences.zh: 烹煮會破壞花椰菜裡的營養素嗎？

sentences.en: The soil in this region lacks the nutrients crops need.
sentences.zh: 這個地區的土壤缺乏農作物所需的養分。

sentences.en: Researchers studied how algae absorb nutrients from the water.
sentences.zh: 研究人員探討藻類如何從水中吸收養分。

gloss_note: a nutritious meal 有營養的一餐

sentences.en: This soup is both tasty and nutritious.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯既美味又有營養。

sentences.en: Is a bowl of oatmeal a nutritious breakfast?
sentences.zh: 一碗燕麥粥算是有營養的早餐嗎？

sentences.en: Our school lunches are cheap but nutritious.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的午餐便宜但營養豐富。

sentences.en: What's the most nutritious fruit you can buy in winter?
sentences.zh: 冬天買得到的水果裡，哪一種最有營養？

sentences.en: She packs nutritious snacks for her kids every morning.
sentences.zh: 她每天早上都幫孩子準備有營養的點心。

sentences.en: Beans are a nutritious food that's easy to cook.
sentences.zh: 豆類是容易烹調的營養食物。

sentences.en: Dogs learn obedience through patient training.
sentences.zh: 狗透過耐心的訓練學會服從。

sentences.en: Do you think strict obedience is good for children?
sentences.zh: 你認為嚴格要求服從對孩子有好處嗎？

sentences.en: Obedience to the rules keeps the school safe.
sentences.zh: 服從規則能讓學校保持安全。

sentences.en: Why does the company expect total obedience from its workers?
sentences.zh: 這家公司為什麼要求員工完全服從？

sentences.en: My dog class focuses on obedience, not tricks.
sentences.zh: 我的狗狗課程重視服從訓練，而不是表演把戲。

sentences.en: In many families, obedience to parents is an important value.
sentences.zh: 在許多家庭裡，服從父母是很重要的價值觀。

sentences.en: The puppy is very obedient and sits when I say so.
sentences.zh: 這隻小狗很聽話，我一說就會坐下。

sentences.en: Is your daughter always this obedient at school?
sentences.zh: 你女兒在學校總是這麼聽話嗎？

sentences.en: He was an obedient child who never argued with his parents.
sentences.zh: 他是個聽話的孩子，從不跟父母頂嘴。

sentences.en: Why aren't the kids more obedient at bedtime?
sentences.zh: 為什麼孩子們到了睡覺時間還不聽話？

sentences.en: A good guide dog must be calm and obedient.
sentences.zh: 好的導盲犬必須冷靜而聽話。

sentences.en: The students stayed obedient and lined up quietly.
sentences.zh: 學生們很聽話，安靜地排好隊。

gloss_note: raise an objection 提出異議

sentences.en: Does anyone have an objection to the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 有人對新的時程表有異議嗎？

sentences.en: I have no objection if you want to leave early.
sentences.zh: 如果你想早點走，我不反對。

sentences.en: Her main objection to the plan is the cost.
sentences.zh: 她對這項計畫的主要反對理由是成本。

sentences.en: What was your objection to moving the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你對更改會議時間有什麼異議？

sentences.en: The neighbors raised an objection to the loud music.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們對吵鬧的音樂提出了異議。

sentences.en: Despite his parents' objection, he joined the band.
sentences.zh: 儘管父母反對，他還是加入了樂團。

gloss_note: achieve an objective 達成目標

sentences.en: Our main objective this year is to improve customer service.
sentences.zh: 我們今年的主要目標是改善客戶服務。

sentences.en: What is the objective of today's lesson?
sentences.zh: 今天這堂課的目標是什麼？

sentences.en: A good judge must stay objective and fair.
sentences.zh: 好的法官必須保持客觀公正。

sentences.en: Can you give me an objective opinion about my essay?
sentences.zh: 你可以客觀地評論一下我的作文嗎？

sentences.en: The reporter tried to give an objective view of the issue.
sentences.zh: 記者試圖對這個議題提出客觀的看法。

sentences.en: We reached our objective ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 我們提前達成了目標。

gloss_note: obscure language 晦澀難懂的語言

sentences.en: The meaning of the poem is obscure to most readers.
sentences.zh: 這首詩的意思對大多數讀者來說很晦澀。

sentences.en: Why is the author's argument so obscure?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這位作者的論點這麼晦澀難懂？

sentences.en: He was an obscure artist until a museum bought his work.
sentences.zh: 在博物館買下他的作品之前，他只是個不出名的藝術家。

sentences.en: Which obscure artist should we study for the paper?
sentences.zh: 我們的報告該研究哪位不出名的藝術家？

sentences.en: Legal documents are often written in obscure language.
sentences.zh: 法律文件常用晦澀難懂的語言寫成。

sentences.en: Her explanation was too obscure for me to follow.
sentences.zh: 她的解釋太晦澀了，我聽不懂。

sentences.en: The students recorded their observations in a notebook.
sentences.zh: 學生們把觀察結果記在筆記本裡。

sentences.en: Do you have any observations about the test results?
sentences.zh: 你對測驗結果有什麼觀察嗎？

sentences.en: Careful observation helped her notice the small mistake.
sentences.zh: 仔細的觀察讓她注意到那個小錯誤。

sentences.en: What was the main observation from your experiment?
sentences.zh: 你的實驗最主要的觀察結果是什麼？

sentences.en: The doctor kept him in the hospital for observation.
sentences.zh: 醫生讓他留在醫院觀察。

sentences.en: That's a good observation; I hadn't thought of that.
sentences.zh: 這個觀察很敏銳，我之前沒想到。

sentences.en: We grab the occasional lunch together when we're both free.
sentences.zh: 我們兩個都有空時，偶爾會一起吃個午餐。

sentences.en: Are you an occasional or a regular customer here?
sentences.zh: 你是偶爾才來的客人，還是這裡的常客？

sentences.en: Expect occasional showers in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午預計會有零星陣雨。

sentences.en: Do you get an occasional headache from looking at screens?
sentences.zh: 你會因為看螢幕而偶爾頭痛嗎？

sentences.en: He makes occasional mistakes, but he learns fast.
sentences.zh: 他偶爾會犯錯，但學得很快。

sentences.en: She sends me an occasional email to say hello.
sentences.zh: 她偶爾會寄封電子郵件向我問好。

sentences.en: The bookshelf occupies half of my room.
sentences.zh: 那個書架佔了我房間的一半。

sentences.en: Excuse me, is this seat occupied?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，這個座位有人坐嗎？

sentences.en: The meeting will occupy most of my afternoon.
sentences.zh: 這場會議會佔掉我大半個下午。

sentences.en: What occupies your time after school?
sentences.zh: 放學後你的時間都花在什麼事上？

sentences.en: Reading keeps the kids occupied on long flights.
sentences.zh: 閱讀讓孩子們在長途飛行中有事可做。

sentences.en: The tourists occupied every table in the café.
sentences.zh: 遊客佔滿了咖啡館裡的每張桌子。

gloss_note: the odds are good 機率很高

sentences.en: What are the odds that the deal will close this month?
sentences.zh: 這筆交易在這個月成交的機率有多大？

sentences.en: The odds of winning the contract are pretty good.
sentences.zh: 拿下這份合約的機率相當高。

sentences.en: Our odds of finishing on time look slim.
sentences.zh: 我們準時完成的機率看起來很渺茫。

sentences.en: Do you think the odds are in our favor?
sentences.zh: 你覺得機率對我們有利嗎？

sentences.en: Against all odds, the small shop survived the recession.
sentences.zh: 儘管機率渺茫，這家小店還是撐過了不景氣。

sentences.en: Experts say the odds of a rate cut are about fifty percent.
sentences.zh: 專家說降息的可能性約為五成。

sentences.en: I didn't mean to offend you.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要冒犯你。

sentences.en: Did my joke offend anyone at the party?
sentences.zh: 我的笑話有冒犯到派對上的任何人嗎？

sentences.en: Some jokes can offend people from other cultures.
sentences.zh: 有些玩笑可能冒犯到來自其他文化的人。

sentences.en: Would it offend them if we left early?
sentences.zh: 如果我們提早離開，會不會得罪他們？

sentences.en: Her rude comment offended the whole class.
sentences.zh: 她無禮的評論冒犯了全班同學。

sentences.en: He was careful not to offend the customer.
sentences.zh: 他很小心，不去得罪那位客人。

sentences.en: I meant no offense by that comment.
sentences.zh: 我說那句話並無冒犯之意。

sentences.en: Please don't take offense at his honest answer.
sentences.zh: 請別因為他誠實的回答而覺得被冒犯。

sentences.en: Is parking here a traffic offense?
sentences.zh: 在這裡停車算交通違規嗎？

sentences.en: Why did she take offense at such a small joke?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼會因為這麼小的玩笑而覺得被冒犯？

sentences.en: A first offense usually gets only a warning.
sentences.zh: 初次違規通常只會被警告。

sentences.en: No offense, but I think your idea needs work.
sentences.zh: 無意冒犯，但我覺得你的點子還需要改進。

gloss_note: offensive language 冒犯人的言詞

sentences.en: Some people find that joke offensive.
sentences.zh: 有些人覺得那個笑話很冒犯人。

sentences.en: Is it offensive to ask someone's age?
sentences.zh: 問別人的年齡算冒犯嗎？

sentences.en: The company removed the offensive ad after complaints.
sentences.zh: 接到客訴後，公司撤下了那則冒犯人的廣告。

sentences.en: Please don't use offensive language in the office.
sentences.zh: 請不要在辦公室說冒犯別人的話。

sentences.en: Would that nickname be offensive to him?
sentences.zh: 那個綽號會讓他覺得被冒犯嗎？

sentences.en: I thought his comment was rude and offensive.
sentences.zh: 我覺得他的評論既無禮又冒犯人。

sentences.en: The new store officially opens next Monday.
sentences.zh: 新店下週一正式開幕。

sentences.en: Has the company officially announced the merger?
sentences.zh: 公司已經正式宣布合併了嗎？

sentences.en: When will the results be officially released?
sentences.zh: 結果何時會正式公布？

sentences.en: I'm officially on vacation starting tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 從明天起，我正式開始休假了。

sentences.en: The contract was officially signed this morning.
sentences.zh: 合約今天早上正式簽署了。

sentences.en: The airline has not officially confirmed the delay.
sentences.zh: 航空公司尚未正式證實延誤。

sentences.en: Many animals protect their offspring from danger.
sentences.zh: 許多動物會保護牠們的後代免於危險。

sentences.en: How many offspring does a female sea turtle produce each year?
sentences.zh: 母海龜每年會生下多少後代？

sentences.en: The offspring of the two plants grew taller than either parent.
sentences.zh: 這兩株植物的後代長得比任何一株親代都高。

sentences.en: Do the offspring inherit the color of their parents' fur?
sentences.zh: 後代會遺傳父母毛皮的顏色嗎？

sentences.en: Researchers compared the offspring of both groups.
sentences.zh: 研究人員比較了兩組動物的後代。

sentences.en: Parents often work hard to give their offspring a better life.
sentences.zh: 父母常努力工作，讓子女過更好的生活。

sentences.en: We're going to see an opera on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 我們週六晚上要去看歌劇。

sentences.en: Have you ever listened to an opera in Italian?
sentences.zh: 你聽過義大利語的歌劇嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother loves opera and sings along.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶很愛歌劇，還會跟著唱。

sentences.en: How long is the opera tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚的歌劇要演多久？

sentences.en: The opera singer's voice filled the whole hall.
sentences.zh: 那位歌劇演唱家的歌聲響徹整個大廳。

sentences.en: The city built a new opera house by the river.
sentences.zh: 這座城市在河邊蓋了一座新的歌劇院。

sentences.en: The new policy becomes operative on January 1.
sentences.zh: 新政策將於1月1日生效。

sentences.en: Is the backup system fully operative yet?
sentences.zh: 備用系統已經完全運作了嗎？

sentences.en: Only one of the three elevators is operative today.
sentences.zh: 今天三部電梯只有一部在運作。

sentences.en: When does the new rule become operative?
sentences.zh: 這項新規定何時開始生效？

sentences.en: The security cameras are operative around the clock.
sentences.zh: 監視器全天候運作中。

sentences.en: Our contract remains operative until the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 我們的合約到明年底前都有效。

gloss_note: oppose a plan 反對計畫

sentences.en: Many residents oppose the plan to build a new highway.
sentences.zh: 許多居民反對興建新高速公路的計畫。

sentences.en: Why do you oppose changing the school uniform?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼反對更改制服？

sentences.en: My parents strongly oppose my idea of moving abroad.
sentences.zh: 我父母強烈反對我搬到國外的想法。

sentences.en: Would anyone oppose moving the meeting to Thursday?
sentences.zh: 有沒有人反對把會議改到週四？

sentences.en: Our coach opposed the idea of practicing on weekends.
sentences.zh: 教練反對週末練習的想法。

sentences.en: Several teachers opposed the new class schedule.
sentences.zh: 幾位老師反對新的課表。

sentences.en: An optical illusion can trick your brain.
sentences.zh: 視覺錯覺可以欺騙你的大腦。

sentences.en: Does this camera have an optical zoom?
sentences.zh: 這台相機有光學變焦嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists use optical instruments to study distant stars.
sentences.zh: 科學家使用光學儀器研究遙遠的星星。

sentences.en: How does an optical fiber carry light over long distances?
sentences.zh: 光纖如何將光線傳送到很遠的地方？

sentences.en: Cameras rely on optical lenses to focus light.
sentences.zh: 相機仰賴光學鏡片來聚焦光線。

sentences.en: The lab developed a new optical sensor that detects small changes in light.
sentences.zh: 實驗室開發出一種新的光學感測器，可以偵測光線的微小變化。

sentences.en: There is a lot of optimism about next quarter's sales.
sentences.zh: 大家對下一季的銷售非常樂觀。

sentences.en: Her optimism helped the team stay positive.
sentences.zh: 她的樂觀讓團隊保持正面。

sentences.en: Why is there so much optimism in the market today?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今天市場上的氣氛這麼樂觀？

sentences.en: Do you share my optimism about the project?
sentences.zh: 你跟我一樣對這個專案很樂觀嗎？

sentences.en: He spoke with optimism about finding a new job.
sentences.zh: 他樂觀地談到找新工作的事。

sentences.en: Their optimism faded when the sales numbers came in.
sentences.zh: 銷售數字出爐後，他們的樂觀情緒消退了。

sentences.en: Website optimization can bring in more customers.
sentences.zh: 網站最佳化可以帶來更多顧客。

sentences.en: Who is responsible for the optimization of our delivery routes?
sentences.zh: 誰負責我們配送路線的最佳化？

sentences.en: The optimization of our schedule saved us two hours a day.
sentences.zh: 我們的排程最佳化後，每天省下了兩小時。

sentences.en: Is search engine optimization worth the cost?
sentences.zh: 搜尋引擎最佳化值得花這筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: Cost optimization is our main goal this quarter.
sentences.zh: 成本最佳化是我們這一季的主要目標。

sentences.en: Does this software help with the optimization of battery use?
sentences.zh: 這個軟體有助於電池使用的最佳化嗎？

sentences.en: We need to optimize our website for cell phones.
sentences.zh: 我們需要針對手機將網站最佳化。

sentences.en: How can we optimize the use of our warehouse space?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何充分利用倉庫空間？

sentences.en: This app helps users optimize their daily schedules.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式幫助使用者最佳化他們的每日行程。

sentences.en: Can you optimize the photos so the page loads faster?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這些照片最佳化，讓網頁載入得更快嗎？

sentences.en: The team worked to optimize the production line.
sentences.zh: 團隊努力讓生產線達到最佳化。

sentences.en: Let's optimize our budget before the year ends.
sentences.zh: 我們在年底前把預算最佳化吧。

sentences.en: The moon orbits the Earth about every 27 days.
sentences.zh: 月球大約每27天繞地球一圈。

sentences.en: The satellite stays in orbit about 500 miles above the Earth.
sentences.zh: 這顆衛星在地表上方約500英里的軌道上運行。

sentences.en: How long does it take Mars to orbit the sun?
sentences.zh: 火星繞太陽一圈要多久？

sentences.en: Why do planets stay in orbit around the sun?
sentences.zh: 為什麼行星會留在繞太陽的軌道上？

sentences.en: Astronauts orbit the Earth about sixteen times a day.
sentences.zh: 太空人每天繞地球約十六圈。

sentences.en: The rocket carried a weather satellite into orbit.
sentences.zh: 火箭把一顆氣象衛星送進了軌道。

sentences.en: My daughter plays the violin in the school orchestra.
sentences.zh: 我女兒在學校管弦樂團拉小提琴。

sentences.en: The orchestra will perform at the city hall tonight.
sentences.zh: 管弦樂團今晚將在市政廳演出。

sentences.en: Have you ever heard a live orchestra?
sentences.zh: 你聽過現場的管弦樂團演奏嗎？

sentences.en: How many musicians are in the orchestra?
sentences.zh: 管弦樂團裡有多少位樂手？

sentences.en: The conductor asked the orchestra to play more softly.
sentences.zh: 指揮要求管弦樂團演奏得輕柔一些。

sentences.en: Tickets for the orchestra concert sell out fast.
sentences.zh: 管弦樂團音樂會的票很快就賣完了。

gloss_note: 縱軸上的值；橫座標是 abscissa

sentences.en: The ordinate of this point on the chart is 40.
sentences.zh: 圖上這個點的縱座標是40。

sentences.en: What is the ordinate of the highest point on the graph?
sentences.zh: 圖表上最高點的縱座標是多少？

sentences.en: Does a higher ordinate on this chart mean higher revenue?
sentences.zh: 在這張圖表上，縱座標越高是否代表營收越高？

sentences.en: Which point has the largest ordinate on this sales chart?
sentences.zh: 這張銷售圖表上哪個點的縱座標最大？

sentences.en: Each point's ordinate on the graph is that month's sales total.
sentences.zh: 圖上每個點的縱座標就是該月的銷售總額。

sentences.en: The analyst checked the ordinates to find the peak.
sentences.zh: 分析師查看縱座標的數值，找出高峰。

gloss_note: orphan 也可作動詞，指使成為孤兒

sentences.en: The story is about an orphan who finds a new family.
sentences.zh: 這個故事講的是一個孤兒找到新家人的經歷。

sentences.en: Did the orphan in the novel find a home in the end?
sentences.zh: 小說裡的孤兒最後找到歸宿了嗎？

sentences.en: Our class donated books to a group that helps orphans.
sentences.zh: 我們班把書捐給一個協助孤兒的團體。

sentences.en: The little orphan was adopted by a loving couple.
sentences.zh: 那個小孤兒被一對充滿愛心的夫婦收養了。

sentences.en: Many classic stories begin with an orphan on a journey.
sentences.zh: 許多經典故事都是從一個踏上旅程的孤兒開始的。

sentences.en: How does a story about an orphan teach us about hope?
sentences.zh: 一個孤兒的故事如何讓我們認識希望？

sentences.en: The oscillation of the pendulum slows over time.
sentences.zh: 鐘擺的振盪會隨時間變慢。

sentences.en: Scientists measured the oscillation of the bridge during the storm.
sentences.zh: 科學家測量了暴風雨期間橋梁的振盪。

sentences.en: Why does a guitar string produce a regular oscillation?
sentences.zh: 吉他弦為什麼會產生規律的振盪？

sentences.en: Is the oscillation in prices caused by the seasons?
sentences.zh: 價格的波動是季節造成的嗎？

sentences.en: The graph shows a small oscillation in temperature each day.
sentences.zh: 圖表顯示每天氣溫都有小幅波動。

sentences.en: How fast is the oscillation of this sound wave?
sentences.zh: 這個聲波的振盪速度有多快？

gloss_note: 否則＝or else；其餘＝apart from that

sentences.en: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.
sentences.zh: 快一點，不然我們會趕不上火車。

sentences.en: I'm glad I left early; otherwise I would have missed my flight.
sentences.zh: 我很慶幸提早出門，不然就趕不上班機了。

sentences.en: We'd better leave now, otherwise we'll be late, right?
sentences.zh: 我們最好現在出發，不然會遲到，對吧？

sentences.en: The room was small but otherwise very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 房間雖然小，但除此之外非常舒適。

sentences.en: Aside from the morning meeting, is your schedule otherwise open on Friday?
sentences.zh: 除了早上的會議之外，你週五的行程還是空的嗎？

sentences.en: Set an alarm; otherwise you might oversleep.
sentences.zh: 設個鬧鐘，不然你可能會睡過頭。

sentences.en: Are you happy with the outcome of the game?
sentences.zh: 你對比賽結果滿意嗎？

sentences.en: The outcome of our class vote surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 我們班投票的結果讓大家都很意外。

sentences.en: Hard work usually leads to a good outcome.
sentences.zh: 努力通常會帶來好結果。

sentences.en: What outcome do you expect from the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你期待這場會議有什麼結果？

sentences.en: Doctors were pleased with the outcome of the surgery.
sentences.zh: 醫生們對手術結果感到滿意。

sentences.en: Whatever the outcome is, we'll accept it.
sentences.zh: 不管結果如何，我們都會接受。

gloss_note: a new outfit 一套新衣服

sentences.en: I need a new outfit for the job interview.
sentences.zh: 我需要一套新衣服去面試。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that outfit?
sentences.zh: 你那套衣服是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: She wore a bright outfit to the company party.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一套亮色的服裝參加公司派對。

sentences.en: What kind of outfit is right for a business meeting?
sentences.zh: 什麼樣的服裝適合商務會議？

sentences.en: His outfit matched his tie perfectly.
sentences.zh: 他的整套服裝和領帶完美搭配。

sentences.en: The store sells complete outfits for work.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售上班穿的整套服裝。

sentences.en: The company is worried about the cash outflow this year.
sentences.zh: 公司擔心今年的現金流出。

sentences.en: What caused the outflow of money from the fund?
sentences.zh: 是什麼造成資金從基金流出？

sentences.en: A large outflow of workers hurt the local economy.
sentences.zh: 大量勞工外流傷害了當地經濟。

sentences.en: Can we reduce the monthly outflow of cash?
sentences.zh: 我們能減少每個月的現金流出嗎？

sentences.en: The report shows a steady outflow of investment.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示投資持續外流。

sentences.en: Is the outflow bigger than the inflow this quarter?
sentences.zh: 這一季的流出比流入還多嗎？

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: outperform the market 表現優於大盤

sentences.en: Our new model outperformed last year's version in every test.
sentences.zh: 我們的新型號在每項測試中都勝過去年的版本。

sentences.en: Can our team outperform the competition this quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們團隊這一季能勝過競爭對手嗎？

sentences.en: Smaller firms sometimes outperform larger ones.
sentences.zh: 小型公司有時表現會勝過大型公司。

sentences.en: Why did this stock outperform the market last year?
sentences.zh: 這支股票去年為什麼表現優於大盤？

sentences.en: She outperformed everyone else on the sales team.
sentences.zh: 她的業績勝過業務團隊裡的每一個人。

sentences.en: We aim to outperform our rivals by offering better service.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是靠更好的服務勝過對手。

gloss_note: outright lie 徹頭徹尾的謊言

sentences.en: That claim is an outright lie.
sentences.zh: 那個說法根本是徹頭徹尾的謊言。

sentences.en: He refused the offer outright.
sentences.zh: 他直接拒絕了這項提議。

sentences.en: Did the manager reject the idea outright?
sentences.zh: 經理是直接否決了這個點子嗎？

sentences.en: Was the project an outright failure, or just a delay?
sentences.zh: 這個專案是徹底失敗，還是只是延誤？

sentences.en: She told me outright that she didn't like the design.
sentences.zh: 她直接告訴我她不喜歡這個設計。

sentences.en: The report called the practice an outright violation of company rules.
sentences.zh: 報告稱這種做法完全違反公司規定。

sentences.en: It's freezing, so you'd better wear your overcoat.
sentences.zh: 天氣冷得要命，你最好穿上大衣。

sentences.en: Where did you leave your overcoat?
sentences.zh: 你把大衣放在哪裡了？

sentences.en: He bought a long gray overcoat for the winter.
sentences.zh: 他為冬天買了一件灰色長大衣。

sentences.en: Is this overcoat warm enough for a snowy day?
sentences.zh: 這件大衣夠暖，適合下雪天穿嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter took my overcoat and hung it up.
sentences.zh: 服務生接過我的大衣，把它掛了起來。

sentences.en: She buttoned her overcoat and stepped out into the wind.
sentences.zh: 她扣上大衣，走進風中。

gloss_note: 過去式 overcame，過去分詞同原形

sentences.en: She overcame her fear of speaking in public.
sentences.zh: 她克服了在大眾面前說話的恐懼。

sentences.en: How did you overcome the language barrier abroad?
sentences.zh: 你在國外是怎麼克服語言障礙的？

sentences.en: It took him years to overcome the injury.
sentences.zh: 他花了好幾年才克服傷勢。

sentences.en: Can we overcome this problem before the deadline?
sentences.zh: 我們能在截止期限前克服這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: Students must overcome many challenges to learn a new language.
sentences.zh: 學生必須克服許多挑戰才能學會一種新語言。

sentences.en: Hard work helped the team overcome the early setbacks.
sentences.zh: 努力讓團隊克服了早期的挫折。

gloss_note: 易忽略的細節 overlook details

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I overlooked that detail in your email.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我漏看了你信裡的那個細節。

sentences.en: Did we overlook any errors in the report?
sentences.zh: 我們有漏掉報告裡的任何錯誤嗎？

sentences.en: Don't overlook the small details when you check the contract.
sentences.zh: 檢查合約時別忽略小細節。

sentences.en: How could the editor overlook such an obvious typo?
sentences.zh: 編輯怎麼會漏掉這麼明顯的錯字？

sentences.en: It's easy to overlook the shipping cost when shopping online.
sentences.zh: 網路購物時，很容易忽略運費。

sentences.en: Many people overlook the importance of sleep.
sentences.zh: 很多人忽略了睡眠的重要性。

gloss_note: overthrow a government 推翻政府

sentences.en: The rebels planned to overthrow the government.
sentences.zh: 反抗軍計畫推翻政府。

sentences.en: Why did the people want to overthrow their ruler?
sentences.zh: 人民為什麼想推翻他們的統治者？

sentences.en: In history class, we learned how the king was overthrown.
sentences.zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到國王是如何被推翻的。

sentences.en: Do you think a peaceful protest can overthrow a dictator?
sentences.zh: 你覺得和平抗議能推翻獨裁者嗎？

sentences.en: The movie is about a group trying to overthrow an evil queen.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一群人想推翻邪惡的女王。

sentences.en: Soldiers overthrew the leader after months of unrest.
sentences.zh: 在動盪了好幾個月後，士兵推翻了那位領導人。

gloss_note: be overwhelmed by 被…壓得喘不過氣

sentences.en: The sudden flood of orders began to overwhelm our small team.
sentences.zh: 突然湧入的訂單開始讓我們的小團隊應接不暇。

sentences.en: Don't let the workload overwhelm you; take it one task at a time.
sentences.zh: 別讓工作量壓垮你，一次處理一件事就好。

sentences.en: Does all this paperwork overwhelm you?
sentences.zh: 這一大堆文件會讓你喘不過氣嗎？

sentences.en: Will our servers be overwhelmed if everyone logs in at once?
sentences.zh: 如果大家同時登入，我們的伺服器會不會負荷不了？

sentences.en: The new tax rules may overwhelm small business owners.
sentences.zh: 新的稅務規定可能讓小型企業主難以招架。

sentences.en: She was overwhelmed by all the emails after her vacation.
sentences.zh: 她休假回來後，被一大堆電子郵件壓得喘不過氣。

sentences.en: She walks at a fast pace every morning.
sentences.zh: 她每天早上都快步走路。

sentences.en: Can you slow down? I can't keep pace with you.
sentences.zh: 你可以慢一點嗎？我跟不上你的步調。

sentences.en: The team is working at a steady pace.
sentences.zh: 團隊正以穩定的步調工作。

sentences.en: Is this pace too fast for the beginners?
sentences.zh: 這個速度對初學者來說會不會太快？

sentences.en: Prices are rising at a faster pace than wages.
sentences.zh: 物價上漲的速度比薪資還快。

sentences.en: Why is the project moving at such a slow pace?
sentences.zh: 這個專案為什麼進展得這麼慢？

gloss_note: sign a pact 簽訂協定

sentences.en: The two companies signed a pact to share research.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司簽了協定，要共享研究成果。

sentences.en: Did the countries agree to the trade pact?
sentences.zh: 這些國家同意貿易協定了嗎？

sentences.en: We made a pact never to talk about work at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們約定晚餐時絕不談工作。

sentences.en: Will the new pact protect small farmers?
sentences.zh: 這項新協定能保護小農嗎？

sentences.en: The leaders announced a peace pact on Monday.
sentences.zh: 領導人週一宣布了和平協定。

sentences.en: The pact between the two firms ends next year.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司之間的協定明年到期。

sentences.en: The control panel is on the left side of the machine.
sentences.zh: 控制面板在機器的左側。

sentences.en: Is the solar panel on the roof still working?
sentences.zh: 屋頂上的太陽能板還能用嗎？

sentences.en: A panel of judges will pick the winner.
sentences.zh: 一組評審將選出優勝者。

sentences.en: Who is on the panel for tomorrow's discussion?
sentences.zh: 誰是明天座談會的小組成員？

sentences.en: Please press the button on the panel to start.
sentences.zh: 請按面板上的按鈕開始。

sentences.en: Our teacher invited a panel of doctors to speak to the class.
sentences.zh: 我們老師請來一組醫師，到班上為同學演講。

sentences.en: I bought a paperback at the airport for the flight.
sentences.zh: 我在機場買了一本平裝書，準備在飛機上看。

sentences.en: Is the book available in paperback?
sentences.zh: 這本書有平裝版嗎？

sentences.en: The paperback costs ten dollars less than the hardcover.
sentences.zh: 平裝本比精裝本便宜十美元。

sentences.en: Do you have any paperbacks for sale?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣平裝書嗎？

sentences.en: She keeps a paperback in her purse for the commute.
sentences.zh: 她在包包裡放了一本平裝書，通勤時看。

sentences.en: The store sells used paperbacks for two dollars each.
sentences.zh: 這家店的二手平裝書一本賣兩美元。

gloss_note: open a parachute 打開降落傘

sentences.en: The pilot jumped out of the plane and opened his parachute.
sentences.zh: 飛行員跳出飛機，打開了他的降落傘。

sentences.en: Would you ever jump out of a plane with a parachute?
sentences.zh: 你敢背著降落傘從飛機上跳下去嗎？

sentences.en: The parachute opened just in time.
sentences.zh: 降落傘剛好及時打開了。

sentences.en: How does a parachute slow down a falling person?
sentences.zh: 降落傘如何讓下墜的人減速？

sentences.en: Each skydiver checks his parachute before the jump.
sentences.zh: 每位跳傘員在跳之前都會檢查自己的降落傘。

sentences.en: A small red parachute carried the box safely to the ground.
sentences.zh: 一個紅色的小降落傘把箱子安全地送到地面。

sentences.en: Please read the first paragraph aloud.
sentences.zh: 請大聲朗讀第一段。

sentences.en: Can you add a paragraph about the budget?
sentences.zh: 你可以加一段關於預算的內容嗎？

sentences.en: Each paragraph should have one main idea.
sentences.zh: 每一段都應該有一個主旨。

sentences.en: Which paragraph did you find confusing?
sentences.zh: 你覺得哪一段令人困惑？

sentences.en: I only had time to read one paragraph of the report.
sentences.zh: 我只來得及讀報告裡的一段。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to write a short paragraph about our weekend.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫一小段關於週末的文字。

gloss_note: in your own words 用自己的話

sentences.en: Could you paraphrase that so everyone understands?
sentences.zh: 你能換個說法，讓大家都聽得懂嗎？

sentences.en: Please paraphrase the customer's complaint in your own words.
sentences.zh: 請用你自己的話改述客戶的抱怨。

sentences.en: Let me paraphrase what you just said to make sure I got it.
sentences.zh: 讓我換句話說你剛才的意思，確認我沒聽錯。

sentences.en: Did she paraphrase the article correctly?
sentences.zh: 她有正確地改述這篇文章嗎？

sentences.en: Students must paraphrase the source instead of copying it.
sentences.zh: 學生必須改述資料來源，而不是照抄。

sentences.en: It's hard to paraphrase legal language without changing the meaning.
sentences.zh: 要在不改變意思的情況下改述法律用語很難。

sentences.en: Students under eighteen need parental permission to join the trip.
sentences.zh: 十八歲以下的學生需要家長同意才能參加這趟旅行。

sentences.en: Does your company offer paid parental leave?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有提供有薪育嬰假嗎？

sentences.en: Parental involvement can improve children's grades.
sentences.zh: 父母的參與能提升孩子的成績。

sentences.en: How much parental control should teens have over their phones?
sentences.zh: 青少年的手機應該由父母管控到什麼程度？

sentences.en: The report links parental income to children's success in school.
sentences.zh: 這份報告把父母的收入和孩子在學校的成就連結起來。

sentences.en: Do you need parental consent before the school shares the photos?
sentences.zh: 學校分享這些照片之前，需要家長同意嗎？

gloss_note: pay parity 薪資平等；at parity 等值

sentences.en: Women are demanding pay parity with men in the industry.
sentences.zh: 這個產業的女性要求與男性薪資平等。

sentences.en: Do the two currencies still trade at parity?
sentences.zh: 這兩種貨幣的匯率還是一比一嗎？

sentences.en: The union wants wage parity across all offices.
sentences.zh: 工會希望所有辦公室的薪資都一致。

sentences.en: How can we achieve parity between full-time and part-time benefits?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何讓全職與兼職員工的福利達到同等？

sentences.en: Our prices have reached parity with those of our competitors.
sentences.zh: 我們的價格已經和競爭對手持平了。

sentences.en: Is there parity in how the two teams are funded?
sentences.zh: 這兩個團隊的經費分配是否對等？

sentences.en: Class participation counts for twenty percent of your grade.
sentences.zh: 課堂參與占你成績的百分之二十。

sentences.en: Thank you for your participation in the survey.
sentences.zh: 感謝你參與這次問卷調查。

sentences.en: Is participation in the training required?
sentences.zh: 一定要參加這次訓練嗎？

sentences.en: Active participation from everyone will make the meeting better.
sentences.zh: 大家積極參與會讓會議更有成效。

sentences.en: How can we encourage more participation from students?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼鼓勵學生多參與？

sentences.en: Participation in the school marathon is free.
sentences.zh: 參加學校馬拉松是免費的。

sentences.en: The two companies announced a new partnership today.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司今天宣布了一項新的合作關係。

sentences.en: Do you think our partnership with that supplier is working?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們和那家供應商的合作關係行得通嗎？

sentences.en: They opened a law firm as a partnership.
sentences.zh: 他們以合夥的方式開了一家法律事務所。

sentences.en: A good partnership depends on trust.
sentences.zh: 良好的合作關係取決於信任。

sentences.en: How long has your company been in partnership with the city?
sentences.zh: 你們公司和市政府合作多久了？

sentences.en: The library works in partnership with local schools.
sentences.zh: 圖書館與當地學校合作。

sentences.en: He is too passive in meetings; he never shares his ideas.
sentences.zh: 他在會議中太被動，從來不分享自己的想法。

sentences.en: Don't be passive; speak up if you disagree.
sentences.zh: 別那麼消極，不同意就說出來。

sentences.en: Is this sentence written in the passive voice?
sentences.zh: 這個句子是用被動語態寫的嗎？

sentences.en: Why do you take such a passive role in the group?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼在小組裡扮演這麼被動的角色？

sentences.en: A passive attitude won't help you find a job.
sentences.zh: 消極的態度無法幫你找到工作。

sentences.en: Can a manager be too passive during a crisis?
sentences.zh: 主管在危機時會不會太過被動？

gloss_note: 指貓、狗等動物帶肉墊的腳掌

sentences.en: The dog put its paw on my knee.
sentences.zh: 狗把爪子放在我的膝蓋上。

sentences.en: Why does the cat keep licking its paw?
sentences.zh: 那隻貓為什麼一直舔牠的爪子？

sentences.en: Look at the muddy paw prints on the floor!
sentences.zh: 看看地板上那些泥濘的爪印！

sentences.en: Does your dog give you its paw when you ask?
sentences.zh: 你叫你的狗握手時，牠會伸出爪子嗎？

sentences.en: A bear's paw is bigger than my hand.
sentences.zh: 熊的爪子比我的手還大。

sentences.en: The vet checked the puppy's sore paw.
sentences.zh: 獸醫檢查了小狗受傷的爪子。

sentences.en: The payback period for the new machine is two years.
sentences.zh: 這台新機器的投資回收期是兩年。

sentences.en: How long until we see a payback on this investment?
sentences.zh: 這筆投資要多久才能回本？

sentences.en: We expect a quick payback from the ad campaign.
sentences.zh: 我們預期這次廣告活動能很快回本。

sentences.en: Is the payback worth the risk?
sentences.zh: 這樣的回報值得冒這個險嗎？

sentences.en: Solar panels can offer a payback within five years.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板五年內就能回本。

sentences.en: Investors want a faster payback on the project.
sentences.zh: 投資人希望這個專案能更快回收資金。

gloss_note: 多指舊時或貧窮地區的小農

sentences.en: Most peasants in the village could not read or write.
sentences.zh: 村裡大多數農民都不識字。

sentences.en: Did medieval peasants pay taxes to the lord?
sentences.zh: 中世紀的農民需要向領主繳稅嗎？

sentences.en: The novel describes the hard life of a peasant family.
sentences.zh: 這本小說描寫一個農民家庭的艱苦生活。

sentences.en: Why did the peasants rise up against the landowners?
sentences.zh: 為什麼農民要起身反抗地主？

sentences.en: A peasant worked the land from sunrise to sunset.
sentences.zh: 農民從日出忙到日落。

sentences.en: In the museum, we saw a peasant's tools from five hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 在博物館裡，我們看到五百年前農民使用的工具。

sentences.en: There's a peculiar smell coming from the basement.
sentences.zh: 地下室傳來一股奇怪的味道。

sentences.en: Isn't it peculiar that he left without saying goodbye?
sentences.zh: 他沒說再見就走了，不覺得很奇怪嗎？

sentences.en: That customer asked a peculiar question about our return policy.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客問了一個關於退貨規定的奇怪問題。

sentences.en: This habit is peculiar to people in that region.
sentences.zh: 這個習慣是那個地區的人所特有的。

sentences.en: Did you notice the peculiar sound the car made?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到那輛車發出的奇怪聲音嗎？

sentences.en: My grandpa has a peculiar way of telling jokes.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺講笑話的方式很特別。

gloss_note: peep at 偷看；美式口語較常用 peek

sentences.en: The kids peeped into the room to see the presents.
sentences.zh: 孩子們偷看房間裡的禮物。

sentences.en: Don't peep! It's a surprise.
sentences.zh: 別偷看！這是個驚喜。

sentences.en: Did you peep at my cards?
sentences.zh: 你剛才是不是偷看了我的牌？

sentences.en: She peeped out the window to see who was there.
sentences.zh: 她從窗戶偷瞄外面是誰。

sentences.en: Why is he peeping around the corner?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼從轉角探頭偷看？

sentences.en: I'll just peep inside to see if the baby is asleep.
sentences.zh: 我只是偷看一下裡面，看寶寶睡了沒。

sentences.en: Teenagers are often influenced by their peers.
sentences.zh: 青少年常受到同儕的影響。

sentences.en: Do you feel pressure from your peers at school?
sentences.zh: 你在學校會感受到來自同儕的壓力嗎？

sentences.en: She gets along well with her peers at work.
sentences.zh: 她和工作上的同輩相處得很好。

sentences.en: How do your peers usually spend their weekends?
sentences.zh: 你的同儕週末通常都做些什麼？

sentences.en: Researchers asked the students to rate their peers.
sentences.zh: 研究人員請學生替他們的同儕評分。

sentences.en: He is respected by his peers in the industry.
sentences.zh: 他受到業界同行的尊敬。

sentences.en: The penalty for parking here is fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 在這裡停車的罰款是五十美元。

sentences.en: What is the penalty for turning in homework late?
sentences.zh: 遲交作業會受到什麼處罰？

sentences.en: There is a penalty if you cancel within twenty-four hours.
sentences.zh: 如果你在二十四小時內取消，會被收取罰款。

sentences.en: Will I pay a penalty for paying off my loan early?
sentences.zh: 我提前還清貸款會被罰款嗎？

sentences.en: The company faces a heavy penalty for breaking the rules.
sentences.zh: 這家公司因違反規定而面臨重罰。

sentences.en: Students who cheat will face a severe penalty.
sentences.zh: 作弊的學生會受到嚴厲的處罰。

sentences.en: About sixty percent of the students walk to school.
sentences.zh: 大約百分之六十的學生走路上學。

sentences.en: Is this shirt really thirty percent off?
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫真的打七折嗎？

sentences.en: Our sales grew by ten percent last quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們上一季的銷售成長了百分之十。

sentences.en: What percent of the class passed the test?
sentences.zh: 全班有百分之幾的人通過考試？

sentences.en: I left a twenty percent tip at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我在餐廳留了百分之二十的小費。

sentences.en: Only five percent of the cake was left.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕只剩下百分之五。

gloss_note: a large percentage of 很大比例的

sentences.en: What percentage of your income goes to rent?
sentences.zh: 你的收入有百分之幾拿去付房租？

sentences.en: A large percentage of our customers shop online.
sentences.zh: 我們有很大比例的顧客在網路上購物。

sentences.en: Can you show the percentage for each color in a chart?
sentences.zh: 你可以用圖表顯示每種顏色的百分比嗎？

sentences.en: The store takes a small percentage of every sale.
sentences.zh: 這家店從每筆銷售中抽取一小部分。

sentences.en: Please write your answer as a percentage.
sentences.zh: 請用百分比寫出你的答案。

sentences.en: Is the percentage of people who work from home still rising?
sentences.zh: 在家工作的人口比例還在上升嗎？

sentences.en: The steak was cooked to perfection.
sentences.zh: 這塊牛排煎得恰到好處。

sentences.en: Nobody expects perfection on the first day.
sentences.zh: 沒有人期待你第一天就做到完美。

sentences.en: Is perfection really possible in art?
sentences.zh: 藝術真的有可能達到完美嗎？

sentences.en: She practiced the song until she reached perfection.
sentences.zh: 她反覆練習那首歌，直到完美為止。

sentences.en: Why do you always demand perfection from yourself?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼總是要求自己做到完美？

sentences.en: Perfection takes time and patience.
sentences.zh: 要做到完美需要時間和耐心。

gloss_note: a bottle of perfume 一瓶香水

sentences.en: She wears a light perfume to work.
sentences.zh: 她上班時會擦淡淡的香水。

sentences.en: Is that your perfume? It smells great.
sentences.zh: 那是你的香水嗎？味道好香。

sentences.en: I bought a bottle of perfume for my mom's birthday.
sentences.zh: 我買了一瓶香水當媽媽的生日禮物。

sentences.en: Can you smell the perfume of the roses?
sentences.zh: 你聞得到玫瑰的香氣嗎？

sentences.en: Too much perfume can bother people sitting nearby.
sentences.zh: 香水擦太多可能會打擾到旁邊的人。

sentences.en: Does this store carry any other perfumes?
sentences.zh: 這家店還有賣其他香水嗎？

sentences.en: The library keeps recent periodicals on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 圖書館把最新的期刊放在二樓。

sentences.en: Does our office subscribe to any business periodicals?
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室有訂閱任何商業期刊嗎？

sentences.en: She published her research in a medical periodical.
sentences.zh: 她把研究發表在一份醫學期刊上。

sentences.en: Can I borrow that periodical when you're done?
sentences.zh: 你看完後，我可以借那本期刊嗎？

sentences.en: Periodicals cannot be checked out of the library.
sentences.zh: 期刊不能借出圖書館。

sentences.en: He reads several periodicals about design every month.
sentences.zh: 他每個月都會讀好幾份設計類的期刊。

gloss_note: 比 regularly 間隔較不固定

sentences.en: Please check the printer periodically.
sentences.zh: 請定期檢查印表機。

sentences.en: Do you back up your files periodically?
sentences.zh: 你有定期備份檔案嗎？

sentences.en: The software periodically asks you to update your password.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體會定期要求你更新密碼。

sentences.en: We meet periodically to review our goals.
sentences.zh: 我們每隔一段時間開會檢視目標。

sentences.en: The river floods periodically in the spring.
sentences.zh: 這條河在春天會不時氾濫。

sentences.en: Should we periodically check the smoke alarms at home?
sentences.zh: 我們是不是該定期檢查家裡的煙霧警報器？

sentences.en: Peripheral vision helps drivers notice cars beside them.
sentences.zh: 周邊視野能幫助駕駛注意到旁邊的車。

sentences.en: That issue is peripheral to our main goal.
sentences.zh: 那個問題對我們的主要目標來說是次要的。

sentences.en: Are peripheral devices like the mouse included in the price?
sentences.zh: 像滑鼠這類周邊設備有包含在價格裡嗎？

sentences.en: Her role in the project was peripheral.
sentences.zh: 她在這個專案中的角色是次要的。

sentences.en: Why is this peripheral detail in the report?
sentences.zh: 這個次要的細節為什麼會出現在報告裡？

sentences.en: The study ignored peripheral factors.
sentences.zh: 這項研究忽略了次要的因素。

sentences.en: He finally got a permanent job at the company.
sentences.zh: 他終於在這家公司找到一份正職工作。

sentences.en: Is this a permanent address or a temporary one?
sentences.zh: 這是永久地址還是臨時地址？

sentences.en: Is this a permanent marker, or will it wash off?
sentences.zh: 這是油性筆嗎？還是洗得掉？

sentences.en: The accident caused permanent damage to his knee.
