sentences.zh: 那場意外對他的膝蓋造成了永久性的傷害。

sentences.en: She applied for permanent residency in the United States.
sentences.zh: 她申請了美國的永久居留權。

sentences.en: Are the changes to the schedule permanent?
sentences.zh: 這次的時程更動是固定的嗎？

sentences.en: If the cough persists, see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 如果咳嗽持續不退，就去看醫生。

sentences.en: Why do these problems persist after every update?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每次更新之後這些問題還是持續出現？

sentences.en: She persisted until the manager agreed to listen.
sentences.zh: 她堅持到經理同意聽她說為止。

sentences.en: Will the high prices persist through next year?
sentences.zh: 高物價會持續到明年嗎？

sentences.en: Despite many failures, he persisted in his plan.
sentences.zh: 儘管失敗了很多次，他仍堅持自己的計畫。

sentences.en: The heavy rain is expected to persist until Friday.
sentences.zh: 預計大雨會持續到星期五。

sentences.en: It took some persuasion to get her to come.
sentences.zh: 費了好一番口舌，才說服她來。

sentences.en: With a little persuasion, he agreed to help.
sentences.zh: 稍微勸了一下，他就答應幫忙了。

sentences.en: Is persuasion more effective than pressure?
sentences.zh: 說服比施壓更有效嗎？

sentences.en: The art of persuasion is useful in sales.
sentences.zh: 說服的技巧在銷售上很有用。

sentences.en: Did it take much persuasion to convince your boss?
sentences.zh: 要說服你的老闆，是不是費了很多功夫？

sentences.en: Her skill at persuasion helped her win the debate.
sentences.zh: 她的說服力幫助她贏得了辯論。

gloss_note: a persuasive argument 有力的論點

sentences.en: She gave a persuasive speech about recycling.
sentences.zh: 她發表了一場關於資源回收、很有說服力的演講。

sentences.en: Was his argument persuasive to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他的論點有說服力嗎？

sentences.en: Their sales pitch was very persuasive.
sentences.zh: 他們的銷售簡報很有說服力。

sentences.en: What makes an essay persuasive?
sentences.zh: 一篇文章怎樣才算有說服力？

sentences.en: You need persuasive evidence to change my mind.
sentences.zh: 你得拿出有說服力的證據才能改變我的想法。

sentences.en: Do you find the author's reasoning persuasive?
sentences.zh: 你覺得作者的推論有說服力嗎？

sentences.en: Don't be so pessimistic; things will get better.
sentences.zh: 別那麼悲觀，事情會好轉的。

sentences.en: Why are you so pessimistic about the interview?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對這次面試這麼悲觀？

sentences.en: Experts are pessimistic about the economy next year.
sentences.zh: 專家對明年的經濟感到悲觀。

sentences.en: My older brother is pessimistic about winning the game.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥對贏得這場比賽很悲觀。

sentences.en: Are you pessimistic about the weather this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你對這個週末的天氣感到悲觀嗎？

sentences.en: A pessimistic person often expects the worst.
sentences.zh: 悲觀的人常預期最壞的結果。

sentences.en: Farmers use special sprays to control pests.
sentences.zh: 農夫用特殊的噴劑來控制害蟲。

sentences.en: Which pest is eating the leaves of my tomato plants?
sentences.zh: 是哪種害蟲在吃我番茄的葉子？

sentences.en: Rats are a common pest in big cities.
sentences.zh: 老鼠是大城市裡常見的害蟲。

sentences.en: Do you have a pest control service for your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你的公寓有請除蟲服務嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother is such a pest when I'm studying.
sentences.zh: 我讀書的時候，我弟弟真是個討厭鬼。

sentences.en: Ants are a pest in our kitchen every summer.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，螞蟻都是我們廚房裡的害蟲。

sentences.en: Over five hundred people signed the petition against the new fee.
sentences.zh: 超過五百人在反對新收費的請願書上連署。

sentences.en: Can I add my name to the petition?
sentences.zh: 我可以在請願書上加上我的名字嗎？

sentences.en: The residents started a petition to build a crosswalk.
sentences.zh: 居民發起連署，要求設置行人穿越道。

sentences.en: Who will deliver the petition to the city council?
sentences.zh: 誰要把請願書送到市議會？

sentences.en: The petition asks the school to start classes later.
sentences.zh: 這份請願書要求學校晚一點開始上課。

sentences.en: Did the company respond to the petition?
sentences.zh: 公司有回應這份請願書嗎？

sentences.en: Rainbows are a natural phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 彩虹是一種自然現象。

sentences.en: Is this phenomenon common in your country?
sentences.zh: 這種現象在你的國家很常見嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the strange phenomenon in the sky.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究天空中的奇特現象。

sentences.en: Online shopping is a global phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 網路購物是一種全球現象。

sentences.en: Can you explain why this phenomenon happens?
sentences.zh: 你能解釋這個現象為什麼會發生嗎？

sentences.en: The class watched a video about the phenomenon of tides.
sentences.zh: 全班看了一段關於潮汐現象的影片。

sentences.en: The philosopher believed that happiness comes from within.
sentences.zh: 那位哲學家相信快樂來自內心。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite philosopher?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡的哲學家是誰？

sentences.en: Did the ancient philosophers ask the same questions we do today?
sentences.zh: 古代的哲學家問的問題跟我們現在一樣嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle studied to become a philosopher.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔以前讀書是想成為哲學家。

sentences.en: A philosopher once said that we should question everything.
sentences.zh: 有位哲學家曾說，我們應該質疑一切。

sentences.en: Philosophers have debated this question for centuries.
sentences.zh: 哲學家針對這個問題已經爭論了好幾個世紀。

gloss_note: philosophy of life 人生哲學

sentences.en: She is studying philosophy at college.
sentences.zh: 她在大學主修哲學。

sentences.en: What is your philosophy of life?
sentences.zh: 你的人生哲學是什麼？

sentences.en: Our company's philosophy is to put customers first.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的理念是客戶至上。

sentences.en: Did you take a philosophy class last semester?
sentences.zh: 你上學期有修哲學課嗎？

sentences.en: His philosophy is simple: work hard and be kind.
sentences.zh: 他的理念很簡單：努力工作、待人和善。

sentences.en: The professor gave an interesting lecture on ancient philosophy.
sentences.zh: 教授做了一場關於古代哲學的有趣演講。

sentences.en: Farmers add phosphate to the soil to help crops grow.
sentences.zh: 農夫在土壤中加入磷酸鹽來幫助作物生長。

sentences.en: Why do some detergents contain phosphate?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些清潔劑含有磷酸鹽？

sentences.en: Too much phosphate can harm rivers and lakes.
sentences.zh: 磷酸鹽過多會危害河流與湖泊。

sentences.en: Is phosphate used in the fertilizer you bought?
sentences.zh: 你買的肥料裡有用到磷酸鹽嗎？

sentences.en: The report measured phosphate levels in the lake water.
sentences.zh: 這份報告測量了湖水中的磷酸鹽濃度。

sentences.en: Phosphate is found in rocks and mined for fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 磷酸鹽存在於岩石中，被開採來製作肥料。

gloss_note: physically demanding 體力上吃重的

sentences.en: The job is physically demanding.
sentences.zh: 這份工作在體力上很吃重。

sentences.en: Are you physically able to lift this box?
sentences.zh: 你的身體狀況能搬得動這個箱子嗎？

sentences.en: Do I need to be physically in the office on Fridays?
sentences.zh: 星期五我需要人實際到辦公室嗎？

sentences.en: Exercise keeps you healthy both physically and mentally.
sentences.zh: 運動讓你在身體和心理上都保持健康。

sentences.en: He was physically exhausted after the long hike.
sentences.zh: 長途健行之後，他累得全身無力。

sentences.en: Is it physically possible to finish this by tonight?
sentences.zh: 要在今晚前完成這件事，實際上有可能嗎？

sentences.en: The physicist explained how light travels.
sentences.zh: 那位物理學家解釋了光是如何傳播的。

sentences.en: Does your older brother work as a physicist?
sentences.zh: 你哥哥是物理學家嗎？

sentences.en: A young physicist won the science award.
sentences.zh: 一位年輕的物理學家贏得了科學獎。

sentences.en: My dream is to become a physicist.
sentences.zh: 我的夢想是成為一名物理學家。

sentences.en: What does a physicist do all day?
sentences.zh: 物理學家一整天都在做些什麼？

sentences.en: The physicist gave a talk at our school last week.
sentences.zh: 上週有位物理學家來我們學校演講。

sentences.en: Can I get extra pickles on my burger?
sentences.zh: 我的漢堡可以多加一些醃黃瓜嗎？

sentences.en: I like a pickle with my sandwich.
sentences.zh: 我吃三明治時喜歡配一根醃黃瓜。

sentences.en: Is that pickle sour or sweet?
sentences.zh: 那根醃黃瓜是酸的還是甜的？

sentences.en: My grandmother makes her own pickles every summer.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年夏天都會自己醃黃瓜。

sentences.en: Pickles are cucumbers kept in salt water or vinegar.
sentences.zh: 醃黃瓜是用鹽水或醋泡過的小黃瓜。

sentences.en: Please hold the pickle on my sandwich.
sentences.zh: 我的三明治請不要放醃黃瓜。

gloss_note: 賣披薩的餐廳；美式也說 pizza place

sentences.en: Let's grab dinner at the pizzeria down the street.
sentences.zh: 我們去街上那家披薩店吃晚餐吧。

sentences.en: Is the pizzeria open on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 那家披薩店星期天有營業嗎？

sentences.en: The pizzeria on Main Street makes its dough fresh every day.
sentences.zh: 大街上那家披薩店每天現做麵團。

sentences.en: Do you know a good pizzeria near here?
sentences.zh: 你知道這附近有不錯的披薩店嗎？

sentences.en: My younger brother works at a pizzeria after school.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟放學後在披薩店打工。

sentences.en: The pizzeria delivers within thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 這家披薩店三十分鐘內會送到。

sentences.en: The placement of the sign makes it hard to see.
sentences.zh: 招牌擺放的位置讓人很難看到。

sentences.en: How does shelf placement affect sales?
sentences.zh: 貨架上的擺放位置如何影響銷售？

sentences.en: The agency helps with job placement for new graduates.
sentences.zh: 這家機構協助應屆畢業生的就業安置。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of student placement at the school?
sentences.zh: 學校裡誰負責學生的安置？

sentences.en: Product placement near the register boosts sales.
sentences.zh: 把商品擺在收銀台附近能提高銷售。

sentences.en: Do you like the placement of the new furniture?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡新家具擺放的位置嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh fruit is plentiful in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天的新鮮水果很充足。

sentences.en: Are parking spaces plentiful near the stadium?
sentences.zh: 球場附近的停車位充足嗎？

sentences.en: The region has plentiful rain every spring.
sentences.zh: 這個地區每年春天都有充沛的雨量。

sentences.en: Water was plentiful along the hiking trail.
sentences.zh: 健行步道沿途的水源很充足。

sentences.en: Jobs are plentiful in the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 科技業的工作機會很多。

sentences.en: Is the supply of fresh water plentiful in your town?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上的淡水供應充足嗎？

sentences.en: The plot of the movie was easy to follow.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的劇情很容易看懂。

sentences.en: Can you tell me the plot without spoiling the ending?
sentences.zh: 你可以告訴我劇情，但不要爆雷結局嗎？

sentences.en: I couldn't follow the plot of that mystery novel.
sentences.zh: 我看不懂那本推理小說的情節。

sentences.en: What is the main plot of this book?
sentences.zh: 這本書的主要情節是什麼？

sentences.en: The writer spent a month working out the plot.
sentences.zh: 作者花了一個月的時間構思情節。

sentences.en: The plot twist at the end surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 結尾的劇情轉折讓大家都嚇了一跳。

gloss_note: 李子乾是 prune；梅酒常稱 plum wine

sentences.en: Plums are ripe in late summer.
sentences.zh: 李子在夏末成熟。

sentences.en: Would you like a plum for a snack?
sentences.zh: 你想吃顆李子當點心嗎？

sentences.en: This plum is sweet and juicy.
sentences.zh: 這顆李子又甜又多汁。

sentences.en: My mom made plum jam last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽上週末做了李子果醬。

sentences.en: Do plums grow well in this climate?
sentences.zh: 李子在這種氣候下長得好嗎？

sentences.en: There is a plum tree in our backyard.
sentences.zh: 我們的後院有一棵李子樹。

sentences.en: Is the plural form of this noun regular or irregular?
sentences.zh: 這個名詞的複數形是規則變化還是不規則變化？

sentences.en: Most English nouns add an -s to make the plural.
sentences.zh: 大多數英文名詞加 -s 就變成複數。

sentences.en: Please circle every plural noun in the first paragraph.
sentences.zh: 請把第一段裡每個複數名詞圈起來。

sentences.en: Does a plural subject need a plural verb?
sentences.zh: 複數主詞需要搭配複數動詞嗎？

sentences.en: My students often forget the plural ending on nouns.
sentences.zh: 我的學生常常忘記在名詞後面加複數字尾。

sentences.en: The report uses plural pronouns to refer to the whole team.
sentences.zh: 這份報告用複數代名詞來指整個團隊。

sentences.en: Are these wild mushrooms poisonous?
sentences.zh: 這些野生菇類有毒嗎？

sentences.en: Some poisonous plants grow in this desert.
sentences.zh: 這片沙漠裡長著一些有毒植物。

sentences.en: Keep poisonous cleaning products out of children's reach.
sentences.zh: 把有毒的清潔用品放在小孩拿不到的地方。

sentences.en: Is this plant poisonous to dogs?
sentences.zh: 這種植物對狗有毒嗎？

sentences.en: The lab warned workers about the poisonous fumes.
sentences.zh: 實驗室警告工作人員注意有毒煙霧。

sentences.en: Many brightly colored frogs are poisonous.
sentences.zh: 許多顏色鮮豔的青蛙有毒。

sentences.en: Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt seals.
sentences.zh: 北極熊依靠海冰來獵捕海豹。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying how the polar ice is changing.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究極地冰層如何變化。

sentences.en: Would you ever travel to the polar regions?
sentences.zh: 你會想去極地旅行嗎？

sentences.en: This jacket is warm enough for polar weather.
sentences.zh: 這件外套的保暖度足以應付極地天氣。

sentences.en: How cold does it get in the polar winter?
sentences.zh: 極地的冬天會冷到什麼程度？

sentences.en: The documentary follows a team on a polar expedition.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片跟拍一支極地探險隊。

sentences.en: A policeman stopped me for driving too fast.
sentences.zh: 一名警察攔下我，因為我開太快。

sentences.en: Could you ask that policeman for directions?
sentences.zh: 你可以向那位警察問路嗎？

sentences.en: The policeman helped the lost child find her mother.
sentences.zh: 警察幫迷路的小女孩找到媽媽。

sentences.en: Did the policeman at the door ask to see your ID?
sentences.zh: 門口的警察有要求看你的身分證嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle worked as a policeman for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔當了三十年的警察。

sentences.en: A policeman directed traffic outside the stadium after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，一名警察在球場外指揮交通。

sentences.en: Sales performed poorly during the first quarter.
sentences.zh: 第一季的銷售表現不佳。

sentences.en: Why did the product launch go so poorly?
sentences.zh: 這次產品上市為什麼這麼不順利？

sentences.en: The website is poorly designed and hard to use.
sentences.zh: 這個網站設計不良，很難使用。

sentences.en: Our team was poorly prepared for the client's questions.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊對客戶的提問準備不足。

sentences.en: Did the new manager handle the complaint poorly?
sentences.zh: 新經理處理這項客訴的方式很差嗎？

sentences.en: The room was poorly lit, so I could barely read the menu.
sentences.zh: 房間光線不足，我幾乎看不清菜單。

gloss_note: 描述風格，不表立場；多見新聞

sentences.en: The history book describes him as a populist leader of the 1890s.
sentences.zh: 這本歷史書把他描述為1890年代的民粹派領袖。

sentences.en: Does the mayor's speech sound too populist to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得市長的演說聽起來太民粹了嗎？

sentences.en: What makes a speech sound populist to voters?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓一場演說在選民聽來帶有民粹色彩？

sentences.en: The analyst said the populist movement was growing across the country.
sentences.zh: 分析師表示，民粹運動正在全國各地擴大。

sentences.en: Investors are watching how populist policies could affect trade.
sentences.zh: 投資人正在關注民粹式政策可能對貿易造成什麼影響。

sentences.en: Our professor asked us to define a populist in one sentence.
sentences.zh: 教授要我們用一句話定義什麼是民粹主義者。

sentences.en: Is this speaker portable enough to bring to the beach?
sentences.zh: 這個喇叭夠輕便，可以帶去海邊嗎？

sentences.en: I bought a portable charger for my trip.
sentences.zh: 我買了一個行動電源帶去旅行。

sentences.en: Do you have a portable fan I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有可以借我的攜帶式電風扇嗎？

sentences.en: The company sells a portable heater for small offices.
sentences.zh: 這家公司販售適合小辦公室的可攜式暖爐。

sentences.en: Her laptop is thin, light, and easily portable.
sentences.zh: 她的筆電又薄又輕，很方便攜帶。

sentences.en: We need a portable screen for the outdoor presentation.
sentences.zh: 我們戶外簡報需要一面可攜式螢幕。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: portray A as B 把 A 描繪成 B

sentences.en: The movie portrays the life of a young nurse.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描繪一位年輕護理師的生活。

sentences.en: Who portrays the villain in the new film?
sentences.zh: 新電影裡由誰飾演反派？

sentences.en: The news report portrayed the town as safe and friendly.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導把這個小鎮描繪成安全又友善的地方。

sentences.en: How does the author portray the main character's father?
sentences.zh: 作者如何刻畫主角的父親？

sentences.en: The ad portrays a family enjoying breakfast together.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告描繪一家人一起享用早餐的畫面。

sentences.en: He portrayed a doctor in a popular TV drama.
sentences.zh: 他在一部熱門電視劇裡飾演醫師。

sentences.en: Customers responded positively to the new design.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新設計的反應很正面。

sentences.en: Did the board respond positively to your proposal?
sentences.zh: 董事會對你的提案反應正面嗎？

sentences.en: She always thinks positively, even when things go wrong.
sentences.zh: 即使事情不順，她總是積極正面地思考。

sentences.en: How can we talk positively about the change with staff?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼向員工正面地談這項改變？

sentences.en: The reviews describe our service positively.
sentences.zh: 這些評論對我們的服務給予正面評價。

sentences.en: The test results were positively received by the whole committee.
sentences.zh: 全體委員會對這些測試結果的看法很正面。

sentences.en: Does she possess the skills this job requires?
sentences.zh: 她具備這份工作所需的技能嗎？

sentences.en: Few people possess a rare coin like this one.
sentences.zh: 很少人擁有像這樣的稀有硬幣。

sentences.en: The family possesses a large farm near the river.
sentences.zh: 這個家族在河邊擁有一大片農場。

sentences.en: He doesn't possess a driver's license yet.
sentences.zh: 他還沒有駕照。

sentences.en: Do you possess a valid passport for international travel?
sentences.zh: 你有出國旅行用的有效護照嗎？

sentences.en: Companies must possess the proper permits before they open.
sentences.zh: 公司在開業前必須持有適當的許可證。

sentences.en: Please keep your personal possessions with you at all times.
sentences.zh: 請隨時把個人物品帶在身邊。

sentences.en: Did you leave any of your possessions in the hotel room?
sentences.zh: 你有把任何私人物品留在飯店房間嗎？

sentences.en: The fire destroyed most of the family's possessions.
sentences.zh: 這場火災燒毀了這家人大部分的財物。

sentences.en: Which possession would you save first in an emergency?
sentences.zh: 緊急情況下，你會先搶救哪一件財物？

sentences.en: He was arrested for possession of stolen goods.
sentences.zh: 他因持有贓物而被逮捕。

sentences.en: My most valued possession is my grandfather's old watch.
sentences.zh: 我最珍貴的東西是爺爺的舊手錶。

sentences.en: Please write your postal address on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的郵寄地址。

sentences.en: Postal rates will go up next month.
sentences.zh: 郵資下個月將調漲。

sentences.en: A friend of mine works for the postal service.
sentences.zh: 我有個朋友在郵政單位工作。

sentences.en: Does the postal service deliver on holidays?
sentences.zh: 郵政服務在假日會送信嗎？

sentences.en: Do you accept a postal money order as payment?
sentences.zh: 你們接受郵政匯票付款嗎？

sentences.en: A postal worker left a notice on our door.
sentences.zh: 郵務人員在我們門上留了一張通知單。

sentences.en: We met with a potential client this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們今天早上和一位潛在客戶見了面。

sentences.en: Do you think this young player has real potential?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這位年輕球員真的有潛力嗎？

sentences.en: The potential risks of the project worry me.
sentences.zh: 這項專案的潛在風險讓我很擔心。

sentences.en: She has the potential to become a great leader.
sentences.zh: 她有成為優秀領導者的潛力。

sentences.en: What is the biggest potential problem with this plan?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫最大的潛在問題是什麼？

sentences.en: This area has great potential for growth.
sentences.zh: 這個地區有很大的成長潛力。

sentences.en: Our clinic hires only licensed practitioners.
sentences.zh: 我們診所只聘用有執照的從業人員。

sentences.en: Is she a practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine?
sentences.zh: 她是中醫執業者嗎？

sentences.en: The book is written for practitioners, not students.
sentences.zh: 這本書是寫給實務工作者，不是給學生看的。

sentences.en: Many legal practitioners attended the conference.
sentences.zh: 許多法律界的從業人員參加了這場研討會。

sentences.en: Which practitioner should I see for back pain?
sentences.zh: 背痛的話我該看哪一類的專業人員？

sentences.en: As a practitioner, he knows how the theory works in real life.
sentences.zh: 身為實務工作者，他知道理論在現實中如何運作。

sentences.en: Let's take a pragmatic approach to this problem.
sentences.zh: 我們用務實的方式來處理這個問題吧。

sentences.en: Is renting a bigger office a pragmatic choice right now?
sentences.zh: 現在租更大的辦公室是務實的選擇嗎？

sentences.en: She is a pragmatic person who focuses on results.
sentences.zh: 她是個務實的人，著重成果。

sentences.en: The mayor chose a pragmatic solution over an ideal one.
sentences.zh: 市長選擇了務實的解決辦法，而不是理想的方案。

sentences.en: Why did the council take such a pragmatic view of the budget?
sentences.zh: 為什麼議會對預算抱持這麼務實的看法？

sentences.en: A pragmatic investor looks at costs before dreams.
sentences.zh: 務實的投資人先看成本，再談夢想。

sentences.en: Can you give me the precise time of the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你可以告訴我會議的確切時間嗎？

sentences.en: The recipe needs precise measurements.
sentences.zh: 這份食譜需要精確的份量。

sentences.en: Please be more precise about what went wrong.
sentences.zh: 請更精確地說明哪裡出了問題。

sentences.en: Do you have the precise address of the hotel?
sentences.zh: 你有飯店的確切地址嗎？

sentences.en: The scale gives a very precise reading.
sentences.zh: 這個秤的讀數非常精準。

sentences.en: At that precise moment, the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，燈全滅了。

gloss_note: 常用被動：predetermined 預先訂好的

sentences.en: Our budget was predetermined before we joined the project.
sentences.zh: 我們加入專案前，預算就已經預先訂好了。

sentences.en: Did the committee predetermine the outcome of the vote?
sentences.zh: 委員會是否預先決定了投票結果？

sentences.en: The price is predetermined, so we can't negotiate.
sentences.zh: 價格是事先定好的，所以我們無法議價。

sentences.en: Don't let your fears predetermine what you can do.
sentences.zh: 別讓你的恐懼預先限定了你能做什麼。

sentences.en: The contract predetermines how profits will be shared.
sentences.zh: 合約已事先規定利潤要怎麼分配。

sentences.en: Who predetermined the order of the speakers?
sentences.zh: 誰事先排定了講者的順序？

gloss_note: predict the future 預測未來

sentences.en: Can anyone predict what the market will do next year?
sentences.zh: 有人能預測明年的市場走向嗎？

sentences.en: Experts predict heavy rain this weekend.
sentences.zh: 專家預測這個週末會下大雨。

sentences.en: I predict that our team will win tonight.
sentences.zh: 我預測我們隊今晚會贏。

sentences.en: Who predicted that prices would rise so fast?
sentences.zh: 誰曾預料到物價會漲得這麼快？

sentences.en: It's hard to predict how customers will react.
sentences.zh: 很難預測顧客會有什麼反應。

sentences.en: The forecast predicts clear skies for the game.
sentences.zh: 天氣預報預測比賽時會是晴天。

sentences.en: The ending of the movie was too predictable.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的結局太好猜了。

sentences.en: Is the demand for winter coats predictable?
sentences.zh: 冬季外套的需求量可以預測嗎？

sentences.en: Her reaction was perfectly predictable.
sentences.zh: 她的反應完全在意料之中。

sentences.en: Predictable schedules help workers plan their lives.
sentences.zh: 固定可預期的排班讓員工能規劃生活。

sentences.en: Why are the results so predictable every year?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每年的結果都這麼容易預料？

sentences.en: Customers like a predictable, reliable delivery time.
sentences.zh: 顧客喜歡可預期、可靠的送貨時間。

sentences.en: The audience was predominantly young adults.
sentences.zh: 觀眾絕大部分是年輕人。

sentences.en: Is your customer base predominantly local?
sentences.zh: 你們的客群主要是本地人嗎？

sentences.en: The region is predominantly rural.
sentences.zh: 這個地區以農村為主。

sentences.en: The report says sales came predominantly from online orders.
sentences.zh: 報告指出銷售主要來自網路訂單。

sentences.en: Is the class predominantly made up of first-year students?
sentences.zh: 這個班級大多是一年級學生嗎？

sentences.en: The weather there is predominantly dry in summer.
sentences.zh: 那裡夏天的天氣大多乾燥。

sentences.en: She felt tired during the first months of her pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 她懷孕的前幾個月都覺得很累。

sentences.en: Is it safe to travel late in pregnancy?
sentences.zh: 懷孕後期旅行安全嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor gave us advice about a healthy pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 醫師給了我們健康孕期的建議。

sentences.en: How long does a normal pregnancy last?
sentences.zh: 正常的懷孕期有多久？

sentences.en: Pregnancy brings many changes to a woman's body.
sentences.zh: 懷孕會讓女性的身體產生許多變化。

sentences.en: They announced the pregnancy to their families last weekend.
sentences.zh: 他們上週末向家人宣布了懷孕的消息。

sentences.en: My coworker is six months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我的同事懷孕六個月了。

sentences.en: Is it OK for a pregnant woman to drink coffee?
sentences.zh: 孕婦可以喝咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: She found out she was pregnant last week.
sentences.zh: 她上週發現自己懷孕了。

sentences.en: Pregnant passengers may board first.
sentences.zh: 孕婦乘客可以優先登機。

sentences.en: When did you learn your wife was pregnant?
sentences.zh: 你是什麼時候得知太太懷孕的？

sentences.en: The pregnant cat hid under the bed.
sentences.zh: 那隻懷孕的貓躲到了床底下。

sentences.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my throat infection.
sentences.zh: 醫師開了抗生素給我治療喉嚨感染。

sentences.en: Can a nurse practitioner prescribe medicine?
sentences.zh: 執業護理師可以開藥嗎？

sentences.en: What did the doctor prescribe for your cough?
sentences.zh: 醫師開了什麼藥給你治咳嗽？

sentences.en: She was prescribed a stronger painkiller after surgery.
sentences.zh: 她手術後被開了藥效更強的止痛藥。

sentences.en: Only licensed doctors can prescribe this drug.
sentences.zh: 只有有執照的醫師才能開這種藥。

sentences.en: My dentist prescribed a special mouthwash.
sentences.zh: 我的牙醫開了一種特殊的漱口水。

sentences.en: I have a presentation to give to the board on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我星期一要向董事會做簡報。

sentences.en: Could you send me your presentation slides?
sentences.zh: 你可以把簡報投影片寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: How long should the presentation be?
sentences.zh: 這份簡報應該多長？

sentences.en: Her presentation about solar energy impressed the class.
sentences.zh: 她關於太陽能的報告讓全班印象深刻。

sentences.en: We practiced our presentation three times last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚把簡報練習了三次。

sentences.en: The presentation starts at ten in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 簡報十點在會議室開始。

gloss_note: wildlife preservation 野生動物保育

sentences.en: The museum is dedicated to the preservation of old photographs.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館致力於保存舊照片。

sentences.en: Is the preservation of this old building worth the cost?
sentences.zh: 保存這棟老建築值得花這筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: Proper storage helps with food preservation.
sentences.zh: 妥善的儲存方式有助於食物保存。

sentences.en: Many groups work for wildlife preservation in this area.
sentences.zh: 許多團體在這個地區致力於野生動物保育。

sentences.en: What methods are used for the preservation of ancient books?
sentences.zh: 保存古書用的是什麼方法？

sentences.en: The city passed a law for historic preservation.
sentences.zh: 這座城市通過了一項歷史建築保存的法律。

sentences.en: How can we preserve fresh herbs for winter?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼保存新鮮香草過冬？

sentences.en: The park was created to preserve the forest.
sentences.zh: 這座公園是為了保護森林而設立的。

sentences.en: Grandma preserves peaches in jars every summer.
sentences.zh: 奶奶每年夏天都把桃子裝罐保存起來。

sentences.en: Do you know how to preserve old photos?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼保存老照片嗎？

sentences.en: We must preserve our culture for the next generation.
sentences.zh: 我們必須為下一代保存我們的文化。

sentences.en: The cold air helped preserve the fish.
sentences.zh: 冷空氣幫助保存了這些魚。

sentences.en: I presume you've already read the contract.
sentences.zh: 我想你已經看過合約了。

sentences.en: Should we presume the shipment will arrive on time?
sentences.zh: 我們該假定貨物會準時送達嗎？

sentences.en: Don't presume that everyone agrees with you.
sentences.zh: 別以為每個人都同意你。

sentences.en: Since the lights were off, we presumed nobody was home.
sentences.zh: 因為燈都關著，我們推測家裡沒人。

sentences.en: Why do you presume the test will be easy?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼認為這次考試會很簡單？

sentences.en: The judge must presume the defendant is innocent.
sentences.zh: 法官必須假定被告無罪。

sentences.en: Prevention is better than treatment.
sentences.zh: 預防勝於治療。

sentences.en: Good hand washing is key to disease prevention.
sentences.zh: 勤洗手是預防疾病的關鍵。

sentences.en: What steps does your company take for fire prevention?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有哪些防火措施？

sentences.en: The clinic offers free classes on injury prevention.
sentences.zh: 診所開設免費的傷害預防課程。

sentences.en: Is crime prevention a priority in this neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 這個社區把預防犯罪列為優先事項嗎？

sentences.en: Accident prevention training is required for all new hires.
sentences.zh: 所有新進員工都必須接受事故預防訓練。

sentences.en: That restaurant looks nice, but it's pretty pricey.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳看起來不錯，但價格相當貴。

sentences.en: Is the steak at this place too pricey for lunch?
sentences.zh: 這家店的牛排當午餐會不會太貴？

sentences.en: The wine list was a little pricey for us.
sentences.zh: 那份酒單對我們來說有點貴。

sentences.en: Don't order the seafood tower; it's way too pricey.
sentences.zh: 別點海鮮塔，實在太貴了。

sentences.en: Why are organic eggs so pricey?
sentences.zh: 有機雞蛋為什麼這麼貴？

sentences.en: We found a pricey but delicious dessert shop downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們在市區找到一家貴但好吃的甜點店。

gloss_note: in one's prime 正值巔峰

sentences.en: Our prime concern is the safety of the passengers.
sentences.zh: 我們最關心的是乘客的安全。

sentences.en: Is he still in his prime as an athlete?
sentences.zh: 他身為運動員還在全盛期嗎？

sentences.en: The police named him as the prime suspect.
sentences.zh: 警方指認他為頭號嫌疑人。

sentences.en: This story is a prime example of good reporting.
sentences.zh: 這篇報導是優良新聞報導的最佳範例。

sentences.en: What is the prime reason you want to move?
sentences.zh: 你想搬家的首要原因是什麼？

sentences.en: She was in her prime when she won the championship.
sentences.zh: 她奪冠時正值巔峰。

gloss_note: a primer on 某主題的入門書

sentences.en: This book is a good primer on personal finance.
sentences.zh: 這本書是個人理財的好入門書。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a primer on climate science?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦一本氣候科學的入門書嗎？

sentences.en: The professor handed out a short primer on research methods.
sentences.zh: 教授發了一份簡短的研究方法入門讀本。

sentences.en: I read a primer on the basics of economics last week.
sentences.zh: 我上週讀了一本經濟學基礎入門書。

sentences.en: Is there a primer for beginners who want to learn photography?
sentences.zh: 有沒有給想學攝影的初學者看的入門書？

sentences.en: The guide serves as a primer for new employees.
sentences.zh: 這份指南是給新進員工的入門讀本。

sentences.en: Early humans used primitive tools made of stone.
sentences.zh: 早期人類使用石頭做的原始工具。

sentences.en: The cabin was primitive, with no electricity.
sentences.zh: 那間小木屋很簡陋，沒有電。

sentences.en: Are these primitive methods still used today?
sentences.zh: 這些原始的方法現在還在使用嗎？

sentences.en: The museum displays primitive weapons from long ago.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出很久以前的原始武器。

sentences.en: Our first computer was slow and primitive.
sentences.zh: 我們的第一部電腦又慢又原始。

sentences.en: How did people cook with such primitive equipment?
sentences.zh: 人們是怎麼用這麼簡陋的設備煮飯的？

sentences.en: Customer safety is our top priority.
sentences.zh: 顧客安全是我們的首要之務。

sentences.en: What are your priorities for this week?
sentences.zh: 你這週的優先事項是什麼？

sentences.en: Let's set priorities before we start the project.
sentences.zh: 我們在開始專案前先排好優先順序。

sentences.en: Which task should be the highest priority?
sentences.zh: 哪項任務應該列為最優先？

sentences.en: Families with small children get priority when boarding.
sentences.zh: 帶小孩的家庭登機時享有優先權。

sentences.en: Fixing the bug is a high priority for the team.
sentences.zh: 修正這個程式錯誤是團隊的高優先任務。

sentences.en: I value my privacy, so I keep my account private.
sentences.zh: 我很重視隱私，所以把帳號設為私人。

sentences.en: Does this app protect users' privacy?
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式有保護使用者隱私嗎？

sentences.en: Hotel rooms should offer guests some privacy.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間應該讓住客享有一些隱私。

sentences.en: Please respect my privacy and knock first.
sentences.zh: 請尊重我的隱私，先敲門。

sentences.en: The company updated its privacy policy last month.
sentences.zh: 公司上個月更新了隱私權政策。

sentences.en: Can we talk somewhere with more privacy?
sentences.zh: 我們可以找個比較有隱私的地方談嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans to privatize its parking system.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算把停車系統民營化。

sentences.en: Why did the state decide to privatize the water service?
sentences.zh: 州政府為什麼決定把供水服務民營化？

sentences.en: Some countries privatize their airlines to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 有些國家把航空公司民營化以降低成本。

sentences.en: Would it save money to privatize garbage collection?
sentences.zh: 垃圾清運民營化能省錢嗎？

sentences.en: The government privatized the phone company in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 政府在1990年代把電話公司民營化。

sentences.en: Analysts say the plan to privatize the airport could take years.
sentences.zh: 分析師說，機場民營化的計畫可能要花上好幾年。

gloss_note: It's a privilege to… 能…是我的榮幸

sentences.en: It's a privilege to work with such a talented team.
sentences.zh: 能和這麼有才華的團隊共事是我的榮幸。

sentences.en: Do senior members get special privileges here?
sentences.zh: 資深會員在這裡有特殊待遇嗎？

sentences.en: Having a car is a privilege, not a right.
sentences.zh: 有車是一種特權，不是理所當然的權利。

sentences.en: Members enjoy extra privileges, like free parking.
sentences.zh: 會員享有額外的特權，例如免費停車。

sentences.en: May I have the privilege of introducing our guest speaker?
sentences.zh: 我能榮幸地介紹我們的演講貴賓嗎？

sentences.en: Library cards give you borrowing privileges at all branches.
sentences.zh: 圖書證讓你在所有分館都有借書的權限。

gloss_note: problematic for sb 對某人而言有困難

sentences.en: The new software has a few problematic features.
sentences.zh: 新軟體有幾個有問題的功能。

sentences.en: Is the schedule problematic for anyone on the team?
sentences.zh: 這個時程對團隊裡的任何人有困難嗎？

sentences.en: Moving the deadline would be problematic for us.
sentences.zh: 延後截止日期對我們來說會很棘手。

sentences.en: Several problematic results appeared in the study.
sentences.zh: 這項研究中出現了幾個有疑慮的結果。

sentences.en: What makes this contract problematic?
sentences.zh: 這份合約有哪裡不妥？

sentences.en: Parking is problematic downtown on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末市區的停車很麻煩。

gloss_note: follow the procedure 照程序走

sentences.en: What is the procedure for requesting time off?
sentences.zh: 請假的程序是什麼？

sentences.en: Please follow the safety procedure exactly.
sentences.zh: 請嚴格遵守安全程序。

sentences.en: The check-in procedure takes only a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 報到手續只需要幾分鐘。

sentences.en: Is there a standard procedure for returning items?
sentences.zh: 退貨有標準流程嗎？

sentences.en: The lab changed its procedure after the test failed.
sentences.zh: 測試失敗後，實驗室更改了作業程序。

sentences.en: New hires learn the company's procedures in the first week.
sentences.zh: 新進員工在第一週學習公司的作業程序。

sentences.en: Please proceed to Gate 12 for boarding.
sentences.zh: 請前往12號登機門登機。

sentences.en: May we proceed with the meeting now?
sentences.zh: 我們現在可以繼續進行會議了嗎？

sentences.en: After the break, the speaker proceeded to the next topic.
sentences.zh: 休息後，講者接著進入下一個主題。

sentences.en: Should we proceed with the plan despite the delay?
sentences.zh: 儘管延誤，我們還要照原計畫進行嗎？

sentences.en: Drivers should proceed with caution on icy roads.
sentences.zh: 駕駛人在結冰的路面上應小心前進。

sentences.en: Once the payment clears, we'll proceed with the order.
sentences.zh: 款項入帳後，我們就會繼續處理訂單。

gloss_note: payment processor 支付處理業者

sentences.en: This laptop has a fast processor.
sentences.zh: 這台筆電的處理器很快。

sentences.en: Which processor does your new phone use?
sentences.zh: 你的新手機用的是哪一種處理器？

sentences.en: Our payment processor charges a small fee per sale.
sentences.zh: 我們的支付處理業者每筆交易收取少許手續費。

sentences.en: Is the processor powerful enough for video editing?
sentences.zh: 這個處理器的效能夠不夠剪輯影片？

sentences.en: The meat processor recalled several products last week.
sentences.zh: 這家肉品加工業者上週召回了幾項產品。

sentences.en: The chip maker unveiled a faster processor for tablets.
sentences.zh: 晶片製造商發表了適用於平板電腦的更快處理器。

sentences.en: Our procurement team negotiates with suppliers.
sentences.zh: 我們的採購團隊負責與供應商議價。

sentences.en: Who handles procurement for office supplies?
sentences.zh: 辦公用品的採購由誰負責？

sentences.en: The procurement process takes about two weeks.
sentences.zh: 採購流程大約要兩週。

sentences.en: Does procurement need approval from the finance department?
sentences.zh: 採購需要財務部門核准嗎？

sentences.en: She works in procurement at a large hospital.
sentences.zh: 她在一家大型醫院的採購部門工作。

sentences.en: The company cut costs by improving its procurement system.
sentences.zh: 公司改善採購系統，因而降低了成本。

sentences.en: Teaching is a demanding profession.
sentences.zh: 教書是一份要求很高的職業。

sentences.en: What profession would you like to work in?
sentences.zh: 你想從事什麼行業？

sentences.en: He chose the medical profession because he wanted to help people.
sentences.zh: 他選擇投入醫療行業，因為他想幫助別人。

sentences.en: Why did you choose such a stressful profession?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼選了壓力這麼大的行業？

sentences.en: By profession, she is an architect.
sentences.zh: 她的職業是建築師。

sentences.en: Nursing is a respected profession in this country.
sentences.zh: 護理在這個國家是受人尊敬的行業。

sentences.en: She always looks professional at client meetings.
sentences.zh: 她在客戶會議上總是顯得很專業。

sentences.en: Should we hire a professional to fix the roof?
sentences.zh: 我們該請專業人員來修屋頂嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep your emails short and professional.
sentences.zh: 請讓你的電子郵件簡短又專業。

sentences.en: He is a professional photographer.
sentences.zh: 他是專業攝影師。

sentences.en: Is that behavior professional in the workplace?
sentences.zh: 那種行為在職場上算專業嗎？

sentences.en: Many young professionals live in this neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 許多年輕的專業人士住在這個社區。

sentences.en: The book had a profound effect on my life.
sentences.zh: 這本書對我的人生有深遠的影響。

sentences.en: Did the trip leave a profound impression on you?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅程給你留下深刻的印象嗎？

sentences.en: He felt a profound sadness after the news.
sentences.zh: 聽到消息後，他感到深深的悲傷。

sentences.en: The new law will have a profound impact on small businesses.
sentences.zh: 這項新法律將對小型企業產生深遠的影響。

sentences.en: What is the most profound lesson you have learned?
sentences.zh: 你學到最深刻的一課是什麼？

sentences.en: There has been a profound change in how people shop.
sentences.zh: 人們購物的方式發生了深刻的轉變。

sentences.en: The doctor tracks the progression of the disease.
sentences.zh: 醫師追蹤這種疾病的發展情形。

sentences.en: What is the natural progression of a career in this field?
sentences.zh: 這個領域的職涯一般會怎麼一步步發展？

sentences.en: The chart shows the progression of sales over five years.
sentences.zh: 這張圖顯示五年來銷售的演變。

sentences.en: Is there a clear progression from beginner to advanced lessons?
sentences.zh: 從初級到進階課程有明確的銜接順序嗎？

sentences.en: The film shows the progression of a friendship over many years.
sentences.zh: 這部電影呈現一段友誼多年來的發展。

sentences.en: Students can see their progression from week to week.
sentences.zh: 學生可以看到自己每週的進展。

sentences.en: Does your company have a progressive approach to training?
sentences.zh: 你們公司的培訓方式夠進步嗎？

sentences.en: Is the damage to my hearing progressive?
sentences.zh: 我的聽力損傷是漸進惡化的嗎？

sentences.en: The disease causes progressive loss of memory.
sentences.zh: 這種疾病會造成記憶力逐漸喪失。

sentences.en: Which progressive teaching methods does this school use?
sentences.zh: 這所學校採用哪些先進的教學方法？

sentences.en: The patient showed progressive improvement after each session.
sentences.zh: 病人每次療程後都有逐步的進步。

sentences.en: A progressive change is easier to accept than a sudden one.
sentences.zh: 漸進式的改變比突然的改變更容易接受。

gloss_note: a promising start 好的開始

sentences.en: She is a promising young engineer at our firm.
sentences.zh: 她是我們公司一位很有前途的年輕工程師。

sentences.en: Does the new plan look promising to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個新計畫看起來有希望嗎？

sentences.en: The test results were promising, so we kept going.
sentences.zh: 測試結果很有希望，所以我們繼續做下去。

sentences.en: Is he a promising player on the school team?
sentences.zh: 他是校隊裡很有前途的球員嗎？

sentences.en: The weather forecast doesn't look very promising for the picnic.
sentences.zh: 這次野餐的天氣預報看起來不太樂觀。

sentences.en: Scientists reported promising results from the early trial.
sentences.zh: 科學家報告了初期試驗中令人看好的結果。

gloss_note: get a promotion 獲得升遷

sentences.en: Congratulations on your promotion to team leader!
sentences.zh: 恭喜你升任組長！

sentences.en: Did you hear about Mia's promotion?
sentences.zh: 你聽說米雅升職的事了嗎？

sentences.en: The store is running a big promotion this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這家店這個週末有大型促銷活動。

sentences.en: How long did it take you to get a promotion?
sentences.zh: 你花了多久才得到升遷？

sentences.en: A promotion usually comes with a higher salary.
sentences.zh: 升遷通常會伴隨更高的薪水。

sentences.en: The promotion ends on Sunday, so buy now.
sentences.zh: 促銷活動週日結束，所以現在就買吧。

gloss_note: a prompt reply 即時回覆

sentences.en: Thank you for your prompt reply.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你迅速回覆。

sentences.en: Is the delivery service usually prompt?
sentences.zh: 這家快遞服務通常很迅速嗎？

sentences.en: We need prompt action before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在截止日前立刻採取行動。

sentences.en: The waiter was friendly and prompt.
sentences.zh: 服務生親切又迅速。

sentences.en: Could you give me a prompt answer by noon?
sentences.zh: 你可以在中午前給我即時的答覆嗎？

sentences.en: Prompt payment will save you a late fee.
sentences.zh: 及時付款可以讓你省下滯納金。

sentences.en: Your pronunciation is getting better every week.
sentences.zh: 你的發音每週都在進步。

sentences.en: How do you check the pronunciation of a new word?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼確認新單字的發音？

sentences.en: Can you help me with the pronunciation of this name?
sentences.zh: 你可以教我這個名字怎麼發音嗎？

sentences.en: The pronunciation of this word is hard for me.
sentences.zh: 這個字的發音對我來說很難。

sentences.en: Did the teacher correct your pronunciation?
sentences.zh: 老師有糾正你的發音嗎？

sentences.en: Clear pronunciation helps people understand you on the phone.
sentences.zh: 清楚的發音能幫助別人在電話中聽懂你。

gloss_note: submit a proposal 提交提案

sentences.en: Did the client accept our proposal?
sentences.zh: 客戶接受我們的提案了嗎？

sentences.en: I'll send you the proposal by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我週五前會把企劃書寄給你。

sentences.en: Her proposal to start a recycling program got approved.
sentences.zh: 她開辦回收計畫的提案獲得通過。

sentences.en: What did you think of the budget proposal?
sentences.zh: 你覺得預算提案如何？

sentences.en: We need to write a research proposal for class.
sentences.zh: 我們得為這堂課寫一份研究計畫書。

sentences.en: The city council rejected the proposal last night.
sentences.zh: 市議會昨晚否決了這項提案。

sentences.en: That software is proprietary, so we can't share the code.
sentences.zh: 那套軟體是專有的，所以我們不能分享程式碼。

sentences.en: Is this recipe proprietary or open to the public?
sentences.zh: 這個食譜是專有的，還是對外公開的？

sentences.en: Never share proprietary information with outside companies.
sentences.zh: 絕對不要與外部公司分享專有資訊。

sentences.en: The firm owns a proprietary method for testing batteries.
sentences.zh: 這家公司擁有專有的電池測試方法。

sentences.en: Do we have a proprietary format for these files?
sentences.zh: 這些檔案我們有專有格式嗎？

sentences.en: They kept the proprietary design secret from competitors.
sentences.zh: 他們對競爭對手保密專有設計。

gloss_note: prosecute a case 起訴案件

sentences.en: The state decided to prosecute the company for fraud.
sentences.zh: 州政府決定以詐欺罪起訴這家公司。

sentences.en: Will they prosecute the man who stole the bikes?
sentences.zh: 他們會起訴偷腳踏車的那個人嗎？

sentences.en: Shoplifters can be prosecuted in this state.
sentences.zh: 在這個州，順手牽羊的人可能被起訴。

sentences.en: Our lawyer says it's hard to prosecute such a case.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師說這種案子很難起訴。

sentences.en: Why did the district attorney refuse to prosecute?
sentences.zh: 地方檢察官為什麼拒絕起訴？

sentences.en: In the movie, a young lawyer must prosecute a powerful boss.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一位年輕律師必須起訴一位有權勢的老闆。

sentences.en: The prosecution showed the jury a video.
sentences.zh: 檢方向陪審團播放了一段影片。

sentences.en: Will the prosecution call another witness today?
sentences.zh: 檢方今天還會傳喚另一位證人嗎？

sentences.en: Companies that break the law risk prosecution.
sentences.zh: 違法的公司有被起訴的風險。

sentences.en: He was afraid of prosecution, so he told the truth.
sentences.zh: 他怕被起訴，所以說了實話。

sentences.en: A lawyer for the prosecution spoke at our school today.
sentences.zh: 檢方的一位律師今天來我們學校演講。

sentences.en: Does the prosecution have enough evidence to go to trial?
sentences.zh: 檢方有足夠的證據進入審判嗎？

gloss_note: read the prospectus 閱讀說明書

sentences.en: Please read the fund prospectus before you invest.
sentences.zh: 投資前請先閱讀基金公開說明書。

sentences.en: Where can I find the prospectus for this new stock?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以找到這檔新股票的招股說明書？

sentences.en: The company released its prospectus ahead of the public offering.
sentences.zh: 公司在公開發行前發布了招股說明書。

sentences.en: Did you check the risks listed in the prospectus?
sentences.zh: 你有看過說明書裡列出的風險嗎？

sentences.en: Our lawyers spent weeks preparing the prospectus.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師花了好幾週準備公開說明書。

sentences.en: The prospectus says the fees are very low.
sentences.zh: 公開說明書上說手續費很低。

gloss_note: prosper in business 事業興旺

sentences.en: Small shops can prosper if they know their customers.
sentences.zh: 小商店只要了解顧客就能興旺。

sentences.en: I hope your new restaurant will prosper.
sentences.zh: 我希望你的新餐廳生意興隆。

sentences.en: Will the town prosper after the factory opens?
sentences.zh: 工廠開張後，這個小鎮會繁榮起來嗎？

sentences.en: Can any business prosper without good customer service?
sentences.zh: 沒有良好的客戶服務，企業還有可能興旺嗎？

sentences.en: Their family prospered after moving to a bigger city.
sentences.zh: 他們搬到大城市後，家境逐漸富裕起來。

sentences.en: Cities prosper when people feel safe and have jobs.
sentences.zh: 當人們感到安全又有工作時，城市就會繁榮。

sentences.en: We wish you health and prosperity in the new year.
sentences.zh: 祝你新的一年健康又富足。

sentences.en: What brings prosperity to a small town?
sentences.zh: 什麼能為小鎮帶來繁榮？

sentences.en: Trade has brought prosperity to this region.
sentences.zh: 貿易為這個地區帶來了繁榮。

sentences.en: Does education lead to greater prosperity?
sentences.zh: 教育會帶來更大的富足嗎？

sentences.en: My grandparents enjoyed years of prosperity after opening their shop.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母在開店後享受了多年的富足生活。

sentences.en: The new factory is a sign of the town's growing prosperity.
sentences.zh: 新工廠象徵著小鎮日益增長的繁榮。

gloss_note: a prosperous town 繁榮的城鎮

sentences.en: This used to be a poor village, but now it's prosperous.
sentences.zh: 這裡以前是個貧窮的村子，現在卻很繁榮。

sentences.en: Is the city still as prosperous as it was?
sentences.zh: 這座城市還像以前一樣繁榮嗎？

sentences.en: He comes from a prosperous farming family.
sentences.zh: 他來自一個富裕的農家。

sentences.en: We hope to build a prosperous business together.
sentences.zh: 我們希望一起打造一家興旺的事業。

sentences.en: What makes some countries more prosperous than others?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些國家比其他國家更富裕？

sentences.en: The shop owner looks quite prosperous these days.
sentences.zh: 這位店主最近看起來相當富裕。

gloss_note: high in protein 富含蛋白質

sentences.en: Eggs and beans are good sources of protein.
sentences.zh: 蛋和豆類是很好的蛋白質來源。

sentences.en: How much protein do I need each day?
sentences.zh: 我每天需要多少蛋白質？

sentences.en: This yogurt has twice as much protein as that one.
sentences.zh: 這種優格的蛋白質是那種的兩倍。

sentences.en: I try to eat some protein at every meal.
sentences.zh: 我盡量每餐都吃一些蛋白質。

sentences.en: Is there enough protein in a vegetarian diet?
sentences.zh: 素食飲食裡有足夠的蛋白質嗎？

sentences.en: Muscles need protein to grow and repair themselves.
sentences.zh: 肌肉需要蛋白質來生長和修復。

sentences.en: Thousands of people joined the protest downtown.
sentences.zh: 數千人參加了市中心的抗議活動。

sentences.en: Why did the workers protest against the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 工人為什麼抗議新的排班表？

sentences.en: I must protest. I never agreed to this.
sentences.zh: 我必須表示反對，我從來沒有同意過這件事。

sentences.en: Did the students protest the new parking rules?
sentences.zh: 學生有抗議新的停車規定嗎？

sentences.en: The neighbors held a protest over the noise from the construction site.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們為了工地的噪音發起抗議。

sentences.en: Despite his protests, they changed the plan.
sentences.zh: 儘管他提出反對，他們還是改了計畫。

gloss_note: a peaceful protester 和平的抗議者

sentences.en: Traffic was slow because protesters blocked the main road.
sentences.zh: 因為抗議者擋住主要道路，車流很慢。

sentences.en: Were the protesters allowed to enter the building?
sentences.zh: 抗議民眾獲准進入大樓嗎？

sentences.en: A few protesters held signs outside our office today.
sentences.zh: 今天有幾位抗議者在我們辦公室外舉著標語牌。

sentences.en: Did you see the protesters near the bus stop this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上有看到公車站附近的抗議者嗎？

sentences.en: The protester next to me gave me a bottle of water.
sentences.zh: 我旁邊的抗議者給了我一瓶水。

sentences.en: The police asked the protesters to move back.
sentences.zh: 警方請抗議者往後退。

gloss_note: follow protocol 遵守流程規範

sentences.en: We have a strict protocol for handling customer complaints.
sentences.zh: 我們處理客訴有嚴格的流程。

sentences.en: Is there a safety protocol for the lab?
sentences.zh: 實驗室有安全流程規範嗎？

sentences.en: Please follow the protocol when you enter the clean room.
sentences.zh: 進入無塵室時，請遵守流程規範。

sentences.en: What's the protocol if the fire alarm goes off?
sentences.zh: 如果火警警報響了，標準流程是什麼？

sentences.en: The two computers talk through a standard protocol.
sentences.zh: 這兩台電腦透過標準協定彼此溝通。

sentences.en: Doctors followed a new protocol to treat the patients.
sentences.zh: 醫師依循新的流程來治療病患。

gloss_note: protons and neutrons 質子與中子

sentences.en: A proton has a positive electric charge.
sentences.zh: 質子帶有正電荷。

sentences.en: Which particle is heavier, a proton or an electron?
sentences.zh: 哪個粒子比較重，質子還是電子？

sentences.en: Every hydrogen atom has one proton in its nucleus.
sentences.zh: 每個氫原子的原子核裡都有一個質子。

sentences.en: Our teacher drew a proton as a small red circle.
sentences.zh: 老師把質子畫成一個紅色的小圓圈。

sentences.en: Do you remember how many protons carbon has?
sentences.zh: 你記得碳有幾個質子嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists use machines to make protons move very fast.
sentences.zh: 科學家用機器讓質子高速移動。

sentences.en: Each Canadian province has its own provincial laws.
sentences.zh: 加拿大每個省都有自己的省級法律。

sentences.en: Do you know the provincial capital of that area?
sentences.zh: 你知道那個地區的省會是哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: We visited a provincial park on our road trip.
sentences.zh: 我們公路旅行時去了一座省立公園。

sentences.en: The provincial election results came out last night.
sentences.zh: 省級選舉的結果昨晚公布了。

sentences.en: Is the provincial office open on Saturdays?
sentences.zh: 省級辦事處週六有開嗎？

sentences.en: The provincial hospital serves thousands of rural families.
sentences.zh: 省立醫院服務數千個鄉村家庭。

gloss_note: provoke a reaction 引起反應

sentences.en: Her comment provoked a lot of laughter in the room.
sentences.zh: 她的評論讓現場笑聲不斷。

sentences.en: Please don't provoke the dog; it might bite.
sentences.zh: 請不要激怒那隻狗，牠可能會咬人。

sentences.en: What provoked such a strong reaction from customers?
sentences.zh: 是什麼引發了顧客這麼強烈的反應？

sentences.en: The new rule may provoke complaints from workers.
sentences.zh: 新規定可能會引發員工的抱怨。

sentences.en: Why do you always try to provoke your little brother?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是想惹你弟弟生氣？

sentences.en: The article provoked a debate among students.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章在學生之間引發了辯論。

sentences.en: Moving to a new country can cause psychological stress.
sentences.zh: 搬到新國家可能造成心理壓力。

sentences.en: Is it a physical problem or a psychological one?
sentences.zh: 這是生理問題還是心理問題？

sentences.en: The psychological effects of the move lasted for months.
sentences.zh: 這次搬遷的心理影響持續了好幾個月。

sentences.en: He needs some psychological support after the accident.
sentences.zh: 他在這次意外後需要一些心理支持。

sentences.en: Do you think sleep affects psychological health?
sentences.zh: 你覺得睡眠會影響心理健康嗎？

sentences.en: Winning the game gave us a big psychological boost.
sentences.zh: 贏得比賽給了我們很大的心理鼓舞。

gloss_note: see a psychologist 看心理師

sentences.en: My friend wants to become a child psychologist.
sentences.zh: 我朋友想成為兒童心理學家。

sentences.en: Is the school psychologist available this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 學校心理師今天下午有空嗎？

sentences.en: A psychologist explained why people feel nervous before tests.
sentences.zh: 一位心理學家解釋了人們為何在考試前會緊張。

sentences.en: I made an appointment to see a psychologist next week.
sentences.zh: 我預約了下週去看心理師。

sentences.en: Did the psychologist say anything about your sleep habits?
sentences.zh: 心理師有提到你的睡眠習慣嗎？

sentences.en: Our professor is a psychologist who studies how children learn.
sentences.zh: 我們的教授是研究孩子如何學習的心理學家。

gloss_note: date of publication 出版日期

sentences.en: The book's publication is set for next spring.
sentences.zh: 這本書預計明年春天出版。

sentences.en: Which publication did your article appear in?
sentences.zh: 你的文章刊登在哪一份出版刊物上？

sentences.en: This magazine is a monthly publication for gardeners.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌是給園藝愛好者的月刊。

sentences.en: When is the publication date of her new novel?
sentences.zh: 她的新小說出版日期是什麼時候？

sentences.en: The study is waiting for publication in a science journal.
sentences.zh: 這項研究正等待在科學期刊上發表。

sentences.en: Check the publication year before you cite the book.
sentences.zh: 引用這本書之前，先確認出版年份。

sentences.en: The festival got great publicity on local TV.
sentences.zh: 這個慶典在地方電視台獲得了很好的宣傳。

sentences.en: Do we have a budget for publicity this quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們這一季有宣傳預算嗎？

sentences.en: The scandal brought the company a lot of bad publicity.
sentences.zh: 這起醜聞給公司帶來許多負面報導。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of publicity for the new store?
sentences.zh: 誰負責新店的宣傳？

sentences.en: A free concert is a good way to get publicity.
sentences.zh: 免費音樂會是獲得曝光的好方法。

sentences.en: The singer avoids publicity and lives quietly.
sentences.zh: 這位歌手避免曝光，過著安靜的生活。

sentences.en: The publisher wants the final draft by March.
sentences.zh: 出版社希望三月前拿到定稿。

sentences.en: Which publisher printed this cookbook?
sentences.zh: 這本食譜是哪家出版社印的？

sentences.en: She works as an editor at a small publisher.
sentences.zh: 她在一家小出版社擔任編輯。

sentences.en: Has the publisher sent you the contract yet?
sentences.zh: 出版商寄合約給你了嗎？

sentences.en: A newspaper publisher spoke at our school today.
sentences.zh: 一位報社發行人今天來我們學校演講。

sentences.en: My friend's first book found a publisher last month.
sentences.zh: 我朋友的第一本書上個月找到了出版商。

sentences.en: Our manager is always punctual for meetings.
sentences.zh: 我們經理開會總是很準時。

sentences.en: Please be punctual; the train won't wait.
sentences.zh: 請準時，火車不會等人。

sentences.en: Is the bus in this town usually punctual?
sentences.zh: 這個鎮上的公車通常準時嗎？

sentences.en: She is a punctual worker who never misses a deadline.
sentences.zh: 她是個守時的員工，從不錯過截止日。

sentences.en: Why are you never punctual for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼吃晚餐從來不準時？

sentences.en: Customers really appreciate punctual delivery of their orders.
sentences.zh: 顧客非常重視訂單準時送達。

sentences.en: What is the punishment for being late to class?
sentences.zh: 上課遲到的處罰是什麼？

sentences.en: The punishment for cheating on the exam is severe.
sentences.zh: 考試作弊的處罰很嚴重。

sentences.en: Is there a punishment for breaking the safety rules here?
sentences.zh: 這裡違反安全規定有什麼處罰嗎？

sentences.en: Punishment alone rarely teaches children good behavior.
sentences.zh: 光靠處罰很少能教會孩子好行為。

sentences.en: A heavy fine is a common punishment for littering.
sentences.zh: 高額罰款是亂丟垃圾的常見處罰。

sentences.en: He accepted his punishment without complaining.
sentences.zh: 他毫無怨言地接受處罰。

gloss_note: purely by chance 純屬巧合

sentences.en: We met purely by chance at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我們在機場純屬巧合地遇見了。

sentences.en: Is this decision purely about money?
sentences.zh: 這個決定純粹是為了錢嗎？

sentences.en: I'm asking purely out of curiosity.
sentences.zh: 我純粹是出於好奇才問。

sentences.en: The test was purely optional, so many students skipped it.
sentences.zh: 這個測驗純屬自願，所以很多學生沒參加。

sentences.en: Did he take the job purely for the salary?
sentences.zh: 他接這份工作純粹是為了薪水嗎？

sentences.en: The report is purely based on public data.
sentences.zh: 這份報告純粹以公開資料為基礎。

gloss_note: pursue a goal 追求目標

sentences.en: She plans to pursue a master's degree in biology.
sentences.zh: 她打算攻讀生物學碩士學位。

sentences.en: Why did you decide to pursue a career in sales?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼決定從事業務工作？

sentences.en: We should pursue this new market before our rivals do.
sentences.zh: 我們應該趕在對手之前開拓這個新市場。

sentences.en: Do you still want to pursue this deal with them?
sentences.zh: 你還想繼續爭取和他們的這筆交易嗎？

sentences.en: He left his job to pursue his dream of painting.
sentences.zh: 他辭掉工作，去追求繪畫的夢想。

sentences.en: Many students pursue their interests after school.
sentences.zh: 許多學生放學後會追求自己的興趣。

gloss_note: pursuit of happiness 追求幸福

sentences.en: The pursuit of happiness is different for everyone.
sentences.zh: 每個人追求幸福的方式都不同。

sentences.en: Is the pursuit of wealth worth all that stress?
sentences.zh: 追求財富值得承受那麼多壓力嗎？

sentences.en: He left the country in pursuit of a better job.
sentences.zh: 他離開了那個國家，為了尋求更好的工作。

sentences.en: Her pursuit of a degree took six years.
sentences.zh: 她攻讀學位花了六年。

sentences.en: Was the police pursuit shown on the news last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的新聞有播出警方追逐的畫面嗎？

sentences.en: The cat ran into the yard in pursuit of a squirrel.
sentences.zh: 貓衝進院子裡追松鼠。

gloss_note: hard to quantify 難以量化

sentences.en: How can we quantify the benefits of the training?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何量化這項培訓的效益？

sentences.en: It's hard to quantify how much time we saved.
sentences.zh: 很難量化我們省了多少時間。

sentences.en: Can you quantify the risk for the board?
sentences.zh: 你能為董事會把風險量化嗎？

sentences.en: Researchers tried to quantify the damage after the storm.
sentences.zh: 研究人員試著量化風暴後的損失。

sentences.en: We need numbers to quantify customer satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 我們需要數字來量化顧客滿意度。

sentences.en: Not everything we value can be quantified.
sentences.zh: 我們重視的事物並非都能被量化。

sentences.en: Quantum physics explains how tiny particles behave.
sentences.zh: 量子物理解釋了微小粒子的行為。

sentences.en: Have you ever read a book about quantum computers?
sentences.zh: 你讀過關於量子電腦的書嗎？

sentences.en: The professor gave a talk on quantum theory.
sentences.zh: 教授做了一場關於量子理論的演講。

sentences.en: Is quantum mechanics hard to learn?
sentences.zh: 量子力學難學嗎？

sentences.en: A quantum computer could solve some problems very quickly.
sentences.zh: 量子電腦或許能很快解決某些問題。

sentences.en: Each packet of light energy is called a quantum.
sentences.zh: 每一份光能量稱為一個量子。

sentences.en: My parents rarely quarrel about money.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽很少為了錢吵架。

sentences.en: What did you two quarrel about last night?
sentences.zh: 你們兩個昨晚在吵什麼？

sentences.en: They had a small quarrel over who would drive.
sentences.zh: 他們為了誰開車起了點小爭執。

sentences.en: Let's not quarrel in front of the guests.
sentences.zh: 我們別在客人面前吵架。

sentences.en: The quarrel between the neighbors ended with an apology.
sentences.zh: 鄰居之間的爭吵以道歉收場。

sentences.en: Did the coworkers make up after their quarrel?
sentences.zh: 那兩位同事吵架後和好了嗎？

gloss_note: support queue 客服佇列；日常多說line

sentences.en: You are number five in the queue, please hold.
sentences.zh: 您目前排在第五位，請在線上稍候。

sentences.en: The support queue is full of billing questions today.
sentences.zh: 客服佇列今天塞滿了帳單問題。

sentences.en: How long is the queue for technical help?
sentences.zh: 技術支援的等候佇列有多長？

sentences.en: Please queue the file for printing, and I'll pick it up.
sentences.zh: 請把檔案排入列印佇列，我再去拿。

sentences.en: Is your ticket still in the queue?
sentences.zh: 你的服務單還在佇列裡嗎？

sentences.en: New orders go into the queue and ship in order.
sentences.zh: 新訂單會進入佇列，並依序出貨。

gloss_note: a warm quilt 暖和的被子

sentences.en: Grandma made this quilt by hand.
sentences.zh: 奶奶親手縫了這條拼布被。

sentences.en: I'm cold, so can you pull the quilt over me?
sentences.zh: 我好冷，你可以把被子拉上來蓋住我嗎？

sentences.en: This quilt is soft but not too heavy.
sentences.zh: 這條被子柔軟但不會太重。

sentences.en: Do you wash the quilt every month?
sentences.zh: 你每個月都洗被子嗎？

sentences.en: The town fair has a contest for the best quilt.
sentences.zh: 鎮上的園遊會有最佳拼布被的比賽。

sentences.en: We bought a new quilt for the guest room.
sentences.zh: 我們為客房買了一條新被子。

gloss_note: get a quotation 取得報價

sentences.en: Could you send me a quotation for fifty chairs?
sentences.zh: 你可以寄給我五十張椅子的報價單嗎？

sentences.en: We received three quotations from different suppliers.
sentences.zh: 我們收到了三家不同供應商的報價。

sentences.en: Is this quotation valid for thirty days?
sentences.zh: 這份報價的有效期是三十天嗎？

sentences.en: The essay begins with a quotation from a famous poem.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章以一首名詩的引文開頭。

sentences.en: Where did you find that quotation?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡找到那句引文的？

sentences.en: Put quotation marks around the quotation and name the author.
sentences.zh: 把引文用引號框起來，並註明作者。

sentences.en: The airport radar showed a storm moving closer.
sentences.zh: 機場雷達顯示暴風雨正在逼近。

sentences.en: Does this car have radar to detect other cars?
sentences.zh: 這輛車有偵測其他車輛的雷達嗎？

sentences.en: Ships use radar to find their way in thick fog.
sentences.zh: 船隻在濃霧中利用雷達找路。

sentences.en: The weather radar shows rain coming at noon.
sentences.zh: 氣象雷達顯示中午會下雨。

sentences.en: Can the police radar catch cars going too fast?
sentences.zh: 警用雷達能抓到超速的車嗎？

sentences.en: Planes appear as small dots on the radar screen.
sentences.zh: 飛機在雷達螢幕上看起來像小點。

gloss_note: within a 5-mile radius 半徑5英里內

sentences.en: The circle has a radius of five centimeters.
sentences.zh: 這個圓的半徑是五公分。

sentences.en: Is there a pharmacy within a one-mile radius?
sentences.zh: 一英里範圍內有藥局嗎？

sentences.en: How do you find the radius of a circle?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼求圓的半徑？

sentences.en: We deliver food within a three-mile radius.
sentences.zh: 我們在三英里範圍內送餐。

sentences.en: The storm affected homes within a ten-mile radius.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨影響了十英里範圍內的住家。

sentences.en: Double the radius, and the area becomes four times bigger.
sentences.zh: 半徑加倍，面積就會變成四倍。

gloss_note: fly into a rage 勃然大怒

sentences.en: He shouted in rage when the printer jammed again.
sentences.zh: 印表機又卡紙時，他氣得大吼。

sentences.en: Road rage is a serious problem on busy highways.
sentences.zh: 路怒是繁忙高速公路上的嚴重問題。

sentences.en: Why was she in such a rage this morning?
sentences.zh: 她今天早上為什麼那麼生氣？

sentences.en: His rage faded after a long walk.
sentences.zh: 他的怒氣在散了很久的步後消退了。

sentences.en: Do you ever rage at your computer when it freezes?
sentences.zh: 電腦當機時你會對它大發雷霆嗎？

sentences.en: The customer was red with rage over the late delivery.
sentences.zh: 顧客因為延遲送貨氣得滿臉通紅。

sentences.en: Police made a raid on the warehouse early this morning.
sentences.zh: 警方今天一大早突襲搜查了那間倉庫。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the raid downtown last night?
sentences.zh: 你有聽說昨晚市中心的突襲搜查嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor told me the raid began at dawn.
sentences.zh: 鄰居告訴我突襲是在黎明展開的。

sentences.en: In the movie, soldiers raid a hidden camp.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，士兵突襲了一個隱蔽的營地。

sentences.en: Why did officers raid the office yesterday?
sentences.zh: 警官昨天為什麼突襲搜查那間辦公室？

sentences.en: We watched a movie about a raid on a castle last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部關於突襲城堡的電影。

sentences.en: The average rainfall here is about forty inches a year.
sentences.zh: 這裡的平均年降雨量約四十英寸。

sentences.en: How much rainfall did we get last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的降雨量有多少？

sentences.en: Heavy rainfall closed several roads this morning.
sentences.zh: 豪雨使今早好幾條道路封閉。

sentences.en: Is it normal to get this much rainfall in April?
sentences.zh: 四月下這麼多雨正常嗎？

sentences.en: My garden grows well when the rainfall is steady.
sentences.zh: 降雨穩定時，我的花園長得很好。

sentences.en: We had way more rainfall than usual this spring.
sentences.zh: 今年春天的降雨量比平常多很多。

sentences.en: Do you want raisins in your oatmeal?
sentences.zh: 你的燕麥粥要加葡萄乾嗎？

sentences.en: I don't like raisin bread.
sentences.zh: 我不愛葡萄乾麵包。

sentences.en: A handful of raisins makes a quick snack.
sentences.zh: 一把葡萄乾就是一份快速的點心。

sentences.en: Raisins are just dried grapes.
sentences.zh: 葡萄乾其實就是曬乾的葡萄。

sentences.en: Could you add some raisins to the cookie dough?
sentences.zh: 你可以在餅乾麵團裡加一些葡萄乾嗎？

sentences.en: My son picks the raisins out of his cereal.
sentences.zh: 我兒子會把葡萄乾從麥片裡挑出來。

sentences.en: Can I get ranch dressing on the side?
sentences.zh: 可以把田園沙拉醬另外附上嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want ranch or Italian on your salad?
sentences.zh: 你的沙拉要田園醬還是義式醬？

sentences.en: He dips his pizza in ranch.
sentences.zh: 他習慣把披薩沾田園醬吃。

sentences.en: Ranch is the most popular dressing in our school cafeteria.
sentences.zh: 田園醬是我們學校餐廳最受歡迎的沙拉醬。

sentences.en: My friend's family runs a cattle ranch in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我朋友的家人在德州經營一座牧場。

sentences.en: Did you ever stay on a ranch when you were a kid?
sentences.zh: 你小時候住過牧場嗎？

gloss_note: randomize the order 隨機排序

sentences.en: Let's randomize the order of the questions.
sentences.zh: 我們把題目的順序隨機打亂吧。

sentences.en: The app can randomize your music playlist.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式可以隨機排列你的歌單。

sentences.en: Researchers randomize the groups to avoid bias.
sentences.zh: 研究人員會隨機分組以避免偏差。

sentences.en: Why do we need to randomize the test questions?
sentences.zh: 我們為什麼需要把測驗題目隨機排列？

sentences.en: I use a tool to randomize who goes first.
sentences.zh: 我用一個工具隨機決定誰先開始。

sentences.en: Did you randomize the order of the speakers?
sentences.zh: 你有把講者的順序隨機排列嗎？

sentences.en: Winners will be randomly chosen from all entries.
sentences.zh: 得獎者將從所有參賽者中隨機抽出。

sentences.en: The survey randomly asked people on the street.
sentences.zh: 這項調查在街上隨機詢問路人。

sentences.en: Did she randomly pick that seat?
sentences.zh: 她是隨便挑了那個座位嗎？

sentences.en: My phone randomly turns off during the day.
sentences.zh: 我的手機白天會毫無預警地自己關機。

sentences.en: Students were randomly assigned to two groups.
sentences.zh: 學生被隨機分配到兩個組別。

sentences.en: Why did the system randomly delete my files?
sentences.zh: 系統為什麼莫名其妙地刪掉我的檔案？

gloss_note: the rationale for… 做…的理由

sentences.en: What is the rationale behind this price change?
sentences.zh: 這次價格調整背後的理由是什麼？

sentences.en: Could you explain your rationale for choosing this supplier?
sentences.zh: 你可以說明選擇這家供應商的理由嗎？

sentences.en: The rationale for the new rule is simple: safety.
sentences.zh: 新規定的理由很簡單：安全。

sentences.en: I don't understand the rationale for working on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 我不懂星期六上班的理由是什麼。

sentences.en: The report gives a clear rationale for the budget cut.
sentences.zh: 報告清楚說明了削減預算的理由。

sentences.en: Does the rationale make sense to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個理由說得通嗎？

sentences.en: Philosophers have long debated human rationality.
sentences.zh: 哲學家長期以來一直在爭論人類的理性。

sentences.en: Does rationality always win over emotion?
sentences.zh: 理性總是勝過情感嗎？

sentences.en: In a crisis, rationality is easy to lose.
sentences.zh: 在危機中，理性很容易喪失。

sentences.en: I admire her calm and rationality in tough meetings.
sentences.zh: 我很佩服她在艱難會議中的冷靜與理性。

sentences.en: Why do people doubt the rationality of that choice?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家質疑那個選擇的合理性？

sentences.en: Anger can get in the way of rationality.
sentences.zh: 憤怒可能會妨礙理性。

sentences.en: The nuclear reactor supplies power to the whole region.
sentences.zh: 這座核反應爐為整個地區供電。

sentences.en: Is the nuclear reactor near your town safe?
sentences.zh: 你家附近的核反應爐安全嗎？

sentences.en: Engineers shut down the reactor for routine checks.
sentences.zh: 工程師為了例行檢查而關閉反應爐。

sentences.en: We toured a research reactor on a school trip.
sentences.zh: 我們校外教學時參觀了一座研究用反應爐。

sentences.en: How does a reactor turn heat into electricity?
sentences.zh: 反應爐如何把熱轉換成電力？

sentences.en: The company designs reactors for power plants.
sentences.zh: 這家公司為發電廠設計反應爐。

gloss_note: the realm of science 科學領域

sentences.en: Cooking is outside my realm of experience.
sentences.zh: 烹飪不在我的經驗範圍內。

sentences.en: Is this question in the realm of law or business?
sentences.zh: 這個問題屬於法律還是商業領域？

sentences.en: Time travel belongs to the realm of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 時光旅行屬於科幻的領域。

sentences.en: Do you work in the realm of finance?
sentences.zh: 你是在金融領域工作嗎？

sentences.en: This is outside my realm of expertise, so I'll ask Dana.
sentences.zh: 這不在我的專業領域內，我去問黛娜。

sentences.en: Winning every game is not within the realm of possibility.
sentences.zh: 每場比賽都贏，根本不在可能的範圍內。

sentences.en: Can you reassure the client that the order is safe?
sentences.zh: 你能向客戶保證訂單沒問題嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse reassured the little boy before the shot.
sentences.zh: 護理師在打針前安撫了小男孩。

sentences.en: Her kind words reassured me before the interview.
sentences.zh: 她親切的話讓我在面試前安心不少。

sentences.en: How can we reassure customers after the data problem?
sentences.zh: 資料出問題後，我們要怎麼讓顧客安心？

sentences.en: I called to reassure my mom that I arrived safely.
sentences.zh: 我打電話讓媽媽放心，告訴她我平安抵達。

sentences.en: The bank reassured investors that their money was safe.
sentences.zh: 銀行向投資人保證他們的錢很安全。

gloss_note: mail-in rebate 郵寄申請退款

sentences.en: Did you mail in the form for the rebate?
sentences.zh: 你把退款申請表寄出去了嗎？

sentences.en: The store offers a $50 rebate on every new TV.
sentences.zh: 這家店每買一台新電視，就提供50美元的現金回饋。

sentences.en: How long does it take to receive the rebate?
sentences.zh: 收到退款要多久？

sentences.en: I'm still waiting for my rebate check in the mail.
sentences.zh: 我還在等郵寄的退款支票寄到。

sentences.en: Customers can apply for a rebate on our website.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們的網站上申請退款。

sentences.en: Do I get the rebate at checkout or later?
sentences.zh: 我是在結帳時拿到退款，還是之後才拿到？

sentences.en: They plan to rebuild the bridge next spring.
sentences.zh: 他們計畫明年春天重建這座橋。

sentences.en: It took years to rebuild trust with our customers.
sentences.zh: 花了好幾年才重新建立與客戶之間的信任。

sentences.en: Can we rebuild the website before the sale starts?
sentences.zh: 我們能在特價開始前重做網站嗎？

sentences.en: After the fire, the family had to rebuild their home.
sentences.zh: 火災之後，這家人必須重建家園。

sentences.en: Why did the team rebuild the whole system?
sentences.zh: 團隊為什麼要把整個系統重建？

sentences.en: I want to rebuild my savings after the trip.
sentences.zh: 旅行之後我想重新把積蓄存起來。

gloss_note: recall a name 想起名字

sentences.en: I can't recall where I put my keys.
sentences.zh: 我想不起來把鑰匙放在哪裡。

sentences.en: Do you recall the name of that restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你還記得那間餐廳的名字嗎？

sentences.en: The company had to recall thousands of faulty toasters.
sentences.zh: 公司必須召回數千台有瑕疵的烤麵包機。

sentences.en: Can you recall what the teacher said about the test?
sentences.zh: 你想得起來老師說了什麼關於考試的事嗎？

sentences.en: As far as I recall, the meeting starts at ten.
sentences.zh: 就我記得，會議是十點開始。

sentences.en: Why did the maker recall its baby strollers?
sentences.zh: 廠商為什麼要召回嬰兒推車？

sentences.en: She received recognition for her hard work.
sentences.zh: 她的努力獲得了肯定。

sentences.en: Did your manager give you any recognition for the project?
sentences.zh: 這個專案，主管有給你任何肯定嗎？

sentences.en: The old teacher smiled in recognition when she saw me.
sentences.zh: 老師一看到我就認出我，露出了微笑。

sentences.en: Our team wants more recognition for its good work.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊希望自己的優秀表現得到更多肯定。

sentences.en: Why did the club give him an award in recognition of his service?
sentences.zh: 俱樂部為什麼要頒獎表揚他的付出？

sentences.en: Without recognition, workers can lose their motivation.
sentences.zh: 沒有肯定，員工可能會失去動力。

sentences.en: Can you reconcile the bank statement with our records?
sentences.zh: 你能把銀行對帳單和我們的紀錄核對一下嗎？

sentences.en: The two brothers finally reconciled after years apart.
sentences.zh: 兩兄弟分開多年後終於和好了。

sentences.en: I need to reconcile my accounts before tax season.
sentences.zh: 報稅季前我得先核對我的帳目。

sentences.en: How do we reconcile these two sets of numbers?
sentences.zh: 這兩組數字要怎麼核對才會吻合？

sentences.en: She tried to reconcile with her old friend.
sentences.zh: 她試著和老朋友和好。

sentences.en: The accountant will reconcile the invoices on Monday.
sentences.zh: 會計週一會核對這些請款單。

sentences.en: The monthly bank reconciliation is due on Friday.
sentences.zh: 每月的銀行對帳在週五截止。

sentences.en: Is there any hope of reconciliation between them?
sentences.zh: 他們之間還有和解的希望嗎？

sentences.en: The two companies sought reconciliation after the long dispute.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司在長期爭議後尋求和解。

sentences.en: Did you finish the reconciliation of last month's sales figures?
sentences.zh: 你把上個月銷售數字的對帳做完了嗎？

sentences.en: Their reconciliation made the whole family happy.
sentences.zh: 他們和好讓全家人都很開心。

sentences.en: Who handles account reconciliation in your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門是誰負責帳目核對？

gloss_note: reconstruct events 重現事件經過

sentences.en: Police tried to reconstruct the events of that night.
sentences.zh: 警方試著重現那晚事情的經過。

sentences.en: Scientists reconstructed the ancient city from old maps.
sentences.zh: 科學家根據舊地圖重建了這座古城。

sentences.en: Can you reconstruct what happened before the power went out?
sentences.zh: 你能還原停電之前發生了什麼事嗎？

sentences.en: How did researchers reconstruct the dinosaur's skeleton?
sentences.zh: 研究人員是如何重組這隻恐龍的骨架的？

sentences.en: After the earthquake, engineers reconstructed the old train station.
sentences.zh: 地震後，工程師重建了那座老火車站。

sentences.en: I tried to reconstruct the story from my notes.
sentences.zh: 我試著根據筆記把整件事重新拼湊出來。

gloss_note: make a full recovery 完全康復

sentences.en: I wish you a quick recovery after your surgery.
sentences.zh: 祝你手術後快點康復。

sentences.en: The economy is showing signs of recovery.
sentences.zh: 經濟出現復甦的跡象。

sentences.en: How long is the recovery time for a broken arm?
sentences.zh: 手臂骨折的恢復期要多久？

sentences.en: My dad made a full recovery from the flu.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸從流感中完全康復了。

sentences.en: Is data recovery possible after the hard drive crashed?
sentences.zh: 硬碟壞掉之後還能復原資料嗎？

sentences.en: Rest is the key to a faster recovery.
sentences.zh: 休息是加快恢復的關鍵。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Neskaya assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The park offers free recreation for families.
sentences.zh: 這座公園提供家庭免費的休閒活動。

sentences.en: What do you do for recreation on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末都做什麼休閒活動？

sentences.en: Our hotel has a pool and a recreation room.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店有游泳池和娛樂室。

sentences.en: Does your office have a recreation area for workers?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有供員工使用的休閒區嗎？

sentences.en: Hiking is my favorite form of recreation.
sentences.zh: 健行是我最愛的休閒方式。

sentences.en: The city opened a new recreation center last month.
sentences.zh: 市政府上個月開了一座新的休閒中心。

sentences.en: Recruitment for the summer jobs starts next week.
sentences.zh: 暑期工作的招募下週開始。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of recruitment in your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門是誰負責招募？

sentences.en: Our recruitment process takes about three weeks.
sentences.zh: 我們的徵才流程大約要三週。

sentences.en: Is the recruitment event open to all students?
sentences.zh: 這場徵才活動開放給所有學生嗎？

sentences.en: The company increased its recruitment budget this year.
sentences.zh: 公司今年增加了招募預算。

sentences.en: Recruitment of new teachers is a priority for the school.
sentences.zh: 招募新老師是學校的首要任務。

gloss_note: recur 偏正式；口語常說 happen again

sentences.en: The same error keeps recurring on my computer.
sentences.zh: 我的電腦一直反覆出現同樣的錯誤。

sentences.en: How can we stop this problem from recurring?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼避免這個問題再次發生？

sentences.en: If the pain recurs, call your doctor.
sentences.zh: 如果疼痛再次出現，請打電話給醫生。

sentences.en: Will this charge recur every month?
sentences.zh: 這筆費用每個月都會再出現嗎？

sentences.en: Similar mistakes tend to recur when we rush.
sentences.zh: 趕工時，類似的錯誤很容易再次發生。

sentences.en: The dream recurred several times last year.
sentences.zh: 這個夢去年出現了好幾次。

gloss_note: redeem a coupon 兌換優惠券

sentences.en: How do I redeem this coupon at checkout?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼在結帳時兌換這張優惠券？

sentences.en: You can redeem your points for a free coffee.
sentences.zh: 你可以用點數兌換一杯免費咖啡。

sentences.en: Did you redeem the gift card yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經兌換那張禮物卡了嗎？

sentences.en: Customers must redeem the voucher before March.
sentences.zh: 顧客必須在三月前兌換這張抵用券。

sentences.en: The bank will redeem the bonds after five years.
sentences.zh: 銀行會在五年後贖回這些債券。

sentences.en: Can I redeem my miles for a plane ticket?
sentences.zh: 我可以用里程數兌換機票嗎？

sentences.en: Point redemption is easy on our mobile app.
sentences.zh: 在我們的行動應用程式上兌換點數很簡單。

sentences.en: Is there a deadline for coupon redemption?
sentences.zh: 優惠券兌換有期限嗎？

sentences.en: The bond redemption date is in June.
sentences.zh: 債券的贖回日是在六月。

sentences.en: Where do I go for prize redemption?
sentences.zh: 我要去哪裡兌換獎品？

sentences.en: Online redemption of gift cards starts today.
sentences.zh: 禮物卡的線上兌換從今天開始。

sentences.en: Each customer is limited to one redemption per day.
sentences.zh: 每位顧客每天限兌換一次。

sentences.en: The store announced a big price reduction.
sentences.zh: 這家店宣布大幅降價。

sentences.en: Is there a price reduction on last year's models?
sentences.zh: 去年的款式有降價嗎？

sentences.en: We saw a ten percent reduction in sales.
sentences.zh: 我們的銷售額減少了百分之十。

sentences.en: The city wants a reduction in traffic downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府希望市中心的車流量減少。

sentences.en: What caused the sudden reduction in noise?
sentences.zh: 噪音突然減少是什麼原因？

sentences.en: Staff reduction made everyone's workload heavier.
sentences.zh: 人員縮減讓每個人的工作量更重了。

sentences.en: Who are you referring to?
sentences.zh: 你指的是誰？

sentences.en: Please refer to page ten for the answer.
sentences.zh: 請參考第十頁的答案。

sentences.en: He often refers to his notes during the talk.
sentences.zh: 他演講時常常參考他的筆記。

sentences.en: Did she refer to me in her email?
sentences.zh: 她在電子郵件裡有提到我嗎？

sentences.en: Students can refer to the dictionary during the test.
sentences.zh: 學生考試時可以參考字典。

sentences.en: What does this sign refer to?
sentences.zh: 這個標誌指的是什麼？

gloss_note: 求職推薦人美式說 reference

sentences.en: The referee blew the whistle at the end of the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束時裁判吹了哨子。

sentences.en: Did the referee check the video replay before his call?
sentences.zh: 裁判做出判決前有看回放影片嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the referee stop the match?
sentences.zh: 裁判為什麼讓比賽暫停？

sentences.en: The referee gave the player a yellow card.
sentences.zh: 裁判給了那位球員一張黃牌。

sentences.en: The referee made a bad call, and the fans booed.
sentences.zh: 裁判做了錯誤的判決，球迷發出噓聲。

sentences.en: Does a youth soccer game need more than one referee?
sentences.zh: 青少年足球賽需要不只一位裁判嗎？

sentences.en: Keep this guide as a reference for later.
sentences.zh: 留著這份指南日後參考。

sentences.en: Can you give me a reference for my new job?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我寫一封新工作的推薦信嗎？

sentences.en: Please use the dictionary as a reference.
sentences.zh: 請拿字典當參考。

sentences.en: Do you have a reference book on birds?
sentences.zh: 你有關於鳥類的參考書嗎？

sentences.en: The manager called my last boss for a reference.
sentences.zh: 經理打電話給我前任老闆，請他為我做推薦。

sentences.en: Is this website a good reference for the report?
sentences.zh: 這個網站適合當報告的參考資料嗎？

gloss_note: referral from a doctor 醫生轉診

sentences.en: I need a referral to see a heart specialist.
sentences.zh: 我需要轉介單才能看心臟科醫師。

sentences.en: Does your company pay a bonus for employee referrals?
sentences.zh: 公司對員工推薦有發獎金嗎？

sentences.en: Most of our new customers come from referrals.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分的新客戶都是靠別人推薦來的。

sentences.en: Who gave you the referral for this plumber?
sentences.zh: 是誰把這位水電工介紹給你的？

sentences.en: Thanks for the referral; I got the job.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的推薦，我得到這份工作了。

sentences.en: Do I need a referral from my doctor first?
sentences.zh: 我需要先拿到醫生的轉介嗎？

gloss_note: refine a plan 改進計畫

sentences.en: We need to refine our sales pitch.
sentences.zh: 我們得改進我們的銷售說詞。

sentences.en: Can you refine the design before Friday's meeting?
sentences.zh: 你可以在週五開會前把設計再改進一下嗎？

sentences.en: The factory refines sugar from sugar cane.
sentences.zh: 這間工廠從甘蔗中精製出糖。

sentences.en: She keeps refining her speech until it sounds perfect.
sentences.zh: 她不斷修潤講稿，直到聽起來完美為止。

sentences.en: How can we refine the process to save time?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼改進流程以節省時間？

sentences.en: Do they refine oil near the coast?
sentences.zh: 他們在海岸附近煉油嗎？

audio.artist:
Speaker: Naomi Persephone Amethyst
Recorder: NaomiAmethyst

gloss_note: reflect on 另有「反省」之意

sentences.en: The lake reflects the mountains like a mirror.
sentences.zh: 湖面像鏡子一樣映出群山。

sentences.en: These numbers reflect how hard the team worked.
sentences.zh: 這些數字反映出團隊有多努力。

sentences.en: Does this price reflect the quality of the product?
sentences.zh: 這個價格反映了產品的品質嗎？

sentences.en: White walls reflect more light than dark ones.
sentences.zh: 白牆反射的光比深色牆多。

sentences.en: Her smile reflected how happy she was.
sentences.zh: 她的笑容反映出她有多開心。

sentences.en: Why does the moon reflect so much light?
sentences.zh: 月亮為什麼能反射這麼多光？

gloss_note: a reflection of 是…的反映

sentences.en: I saw my reflection in the store window.
sentences.zh: 我在商店櫥窗裡看見自己的倒影。

sentences.en: The test result is a reflection of your effort.
sentences.zh: 考試結果反映了你的努力。

sentences.en: Can you see your reflection in the water?
sentences.zh: 你看得到自己在水中的倒影嗎？

sentences.en: Is this report a fair reflection of our sales?
sentences.zh: 這份報告能如實反映我們的銷售狀況嗎？

sentences.en: There was a bright reflection on the screen.
sentences.zh: 螢幕上有一道刺眼的反光。

sentences.en: The mirror gave a clear reflection of the room.
sentences.zh: 鏡子清楚映出整個房間。

sentences.en: My reflexive reaction was to jump back.
sentences.zh: 我的反射反應是往後一跳。

sentences.en: Blinking is a reflexive action.
sentences.zh: 眨眼是一種反射動作。

sentences.en: Is this word a reflexive pronoun?
sentences.zh: 這個字是反身代名詞嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor tested my reflexive response with a small hammer.
sentences.zh: 醫生用小槌子測試我的反射反應。

sentences.en: Why is a reflexive reaction faster than a planned one?
sentences.zh: 為什麼反射性反應比經過思考的反應快？

sentences.en: Do you think her reflexive smile was real?
sentences.zh: 你覺得她那個不自覺的微笑是真心的嗎？

sentences.en: The school plans to reform its lunch program.
sentences.zh: 學校計畫改革午餐方案。

sentences.en: The company announced a big reform of its hiring rules.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布大幅改革招聘規則。

sentences.en: Does the city plan to reform its bus system?
sentences.zh: 市政府打算改革公車系統嗎？

sentences.en: The coach wants to reform the way we practice.
sentences.zh: 教練想改革我們的練習方式。

sentences.en: What reforms has the manager made this year?
sentences.zh: 經理今年做了哪些改革？

sentences.en: Our team leader wants to reform the review process.
sentences.zh: 我們組長想改革審核流程。

sentences.en: The family came to the U.S. as refugees.
sentences.zh: 這家人是以難民身分來到美國的。

sentences.en: A volunteer group helps refugee families find housing.
sentences.zh: 一個志工團體協助難民家庭找房子。

sentences.en: How many refugees does the camp hold?
sentences.zh: 這個營區收容了多少難民？

sentences.en: My neighbor was a refugee before he moved here.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居搬來這裡之前是難民。

sentences.en: Did the city open a shelter for refugees?
sentences.zh: 這座城市有為難民開設庇護所嗎？

sentences.en: The movie tells the story of a young refugee.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講述一位年輕難民的故事。

gloss_note: refusal to do 拒絕做某事

sentences.en: His refusal to help surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 他拒絕幫忙，讓大家很驚訝。

sentences.en: Did you get a refusal from the bank?
sentences.zh: 你被銀行拒絕了嗎？

sentences.en: I got a refusal letter from the landlord yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天收到房東的拒絕信。

sentences.en: What was the reason for their refusal?
sentences.zh: 他們拒絕的理由是什麼？

sentences.en: The customer's refusal to pay caused a delay.
sentences.zh: 客戶拒絕付款造成了延誤。

sentences.en: Try to give a kind refusal, not an angry one.
sentences.zh: 試著客氣地拒絕，不要生氣。

gloss_note: register for a class 報名課程

sentences.en: Did you register for the class yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經報名那堂課了嗎？

sentences.en: You must register your car within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 你必須在三十天內登記你的車。

sentences.en: Please register at the front desk when you arrive.
sentences.zh: 抵達時請在櫃檯登記。

sentences.en: How do I register for the free workshop?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼報名這場免費的工作坊？

sentences.en: New students register on the first day of school.
sentences.zh: 新生在開學第一天註冊。

sentences.en: We register all guests before the event begins.
sentences.zh: 活動開始前我們會替所有賓客登記。

sentences.en: Registration for fall classes opens Monday.
sentences.zh: 秋季課程的註冊週一開放。
