sentences.en: Where do I pick up my registration form?
sentences.zh: 我要去哪裡拿報名表？

sentences.en: The car registration expires next month.
sentences.zh: 這輛車的行照下個月到期。

sentences.en: Is there a fee for online registration?
sentences.zh: 線上報名要收費嗎？

sentences.en: Please bring your registration card to the exam.
sentences.zh: 請帶你的報名卡來參加考試。

sentences.en: Registration takes only five minutes at the desk.
sentences.zh: 在櫃檯登記只要五分鐘。

sentences.en: The government regulates how food is labeled.
sentences.zh: 政府規範食品的標示方式。

sentences.en: This knob helps regulate the room temperature.
sentences.zh: 這個旋鈕可以調節室溫。

sentences.en: Who regulates the price of gas?
sentences.zh: 誰在管制汽油的價格？

sentences.en: Your body can regulate its own temperature.
sentences.zh: 你的身體能自行調節體溫。

sentences.en: How do you regulate the heat on this stove?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼調節這個爐子的火力？

sentences.en: The town tries to regulate noise after ten at night.
sentences.zh: 鎮上試著管制晚上十點後的噪音。

sentences.en: Safety regulations require everyone to wear helmets.
sentences.zh: 安全規定要求每個人都戴安全帽。

sentences.en: Is this move against company regulations?
sentences.zh: 這樣做違反公司規定嗎？

sentences.en: The new regulation takes effect on July first.
sentences.zh: 新規定七月一日生效。

sentences.en: What are the regulations for carry-on bags?
sentences.zh: 隨身行李有什麼規定？

sentences.en: Our school has strict regulations about cell phones.
sentences.zh: 我們學校對手機有嚴格的規定。

sentences.en: Do these rules count as official regulations?
sentences.zh: 這些規則算是正式的法規嗎？

sentences.en: I submitted my travel reimbursement form yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天交了差旅費報帳單。

sentences.en: How long does reimbursement usually take?
sentences.zh: 報帳通常要多久？

sentences.en: Will the company provide reimbursement for hotel costs?
sentences.zh: 公司會補助住宿費嗎？

sentences.en: Please attach receipts to your reimbursement request.
sentences.zh: 請把收據附在你的報帳申請上。

sentences.en: Did you get your reimbursement for the taxi?
sentences.zh: 計程車費退給你了嗎？

sentences.en: The reimbursement arrived in my account today.
sentences.zh: 報帳的款項今天進到我的帳戶了。

gloss_note: reinvest profits 將獲利再投資

sentences.en: We plan to reinvest the profits in new equipment.
sentences.zh: 我們打算把利潤再投資在新設備上。

sentences.en: Should we reinvest the money or save it?
sentences.zh: 我們該把錢拿去再投資還是存起來？

sentences.en: She reinvested her bonus in the stock market.
sentences.zh: 她把獎金再投資到股市。

sentences.en: Do you reinvest your dividends every year?
sentences.zh: 你每年都把股息再投資嗎？

sentences.en: The owner will reinvest in the shop next spring.
sentences.zh: 老闆明年春天會再對這家店投入資金。

sentences.en: Many small firms reinvest their earnings to grow.
sentences.zh: 許多小公司把收益再投資以求成長。

sentences.en: I got a rejection email from the company.
sentences.zh: 我收到那家公司寄來的拒絕信。

sentences.en: How do you handle job rejection?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼面對求職被拒絕？

sentences.en: The rejection of his idea made him sad.
sentences.zh: 他的點子被拒絕讓他很難過。

sentences.en: Does a rejection always mean you did something wrong?
sentences.zh: 被拒絕一定代表你做錯了什麼嗎？

sentences.en: Her rejection of the offer surprised the team.
sentences.zh: 她拒絕了這項提議，讓團隊很驚訝。

sentences.en: Fear of rejection stops many people from trying.
sentences.zh: 害怕被拒絕讓許多人不敢嘗試。

gloss_note: form of relaxation 放鬆方式

sentences.en: Reading is my favorite form of relaxation.
sentences.zh: 閱讀是我最愛的放鬆方式。

sentences.en: Do you do yoga for relaxation?
sentences.zh: 你做瑜伽來放鬆嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel offers a spa for relaxation.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有提供水療讓人放鬆。

sentences.en: A short walk after work is good for relaxation.
sentences.zh: 下班後散個短步有助於放鬆。

sentences.en: Is there a quiet room for relaxation here?
sentences.zh: 這裡有安靜的放鬆空間嗎？

sentences.en: Experts say relaxation lowers stress.
sentences.zh: 專家說放鬆能降低壓力。

sentences.en: Is this email relevant to my department?
sentences.zh: 這封電子郵件跟我的部門有關嗎？

sentences.en: Please bring only relevant documents to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請只帶相關文件來開會。

sentences.en: That comment isn't relevant to our topic.
sentences.zh: 那個意見和我們的主題無關。

sentences.en: What experience do you have that's relevant to this job?
sentences.zh: 你有哪些和這份工作相關的經驗？

sentences.en: Only relevant questions will be answered today.
sentences.zh: 今天只回答切題的問題。

sentences.en: Her advice was very relevant to my situation.
sentences.zh: 她的建議跟我的狀況很相關。

sentences.en: Our reliance on one supplier is risky.
sentences.zh: 我們依賴單一供應商是有風險的。

sentences.en: Is your reliance on coffee getting worse?
sentences.zh: 你對咖啡的依賴是不是越來越嚴重了？

sentences.en: The country's reliance on oil is slowly falling.
sentences.zh: 這個國家對石油的依賴正慢慢下降。

sentences.en: Too much reliance on your phone can hurt sleep.
sentences.zh: 太依賴手機可能會影響睡眠。

sentences.en: How can we reduce our reliance on paper?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼減少對紙張的依賴？

sentences.en: The firm's reliance on one big client worries me.
sentences.zh: 公司對一個大客戶的依賴讓我擔心。

sentences.en: This medicine will relieve your headache.
sentences.zh: 這個藥可以緩解你的頭痛。

sentences.en: A hot shower can relieve muscle pain.
sentences.zh: 熱水澡能緩解肌肉痠痛。

sentences.en: How do you relieve stress after work?
sentences.zh: 你下班後怎麼紓解壓力？

sentences.en: Hiring two more people will relieve the pressure on our team.
sentences.zh: 多請兩個人可以減輕團隊的壓力。

sentences.en: Can this cream relieve the itching?
sentences.zh: 這個藥膏能止癢嗎？

sentences.en: Taking a short break can relieve eye strain.
sentences.zh: 休息一下可以緩解眼睛疲勞。

gloss_note: make a remark 發表意見

sentences.en: That was a rude remark, and you should apologize.
sentences.zh: 那句話很無禮，你應該道歉。

sentences.en: Did you hear his remark about the schedule?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到他對時程的評論嗎？

sentences.en: She remarked that the soup needed more salt.
sentences.zh: 她說湯需要再加點鹽。

sentences.en: Can I make one quick remark before we vote?
sentences.zh: 投票前我可以簡短說句話嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher remarked on how much I improved.
sentences.zh: 老師特別提到我進步了多少。

sentences.en: What did he remark about the new rules?
sentences.zh: 他對新規定說了什麼？

sentences.en: She made a remarkable recovery after the accident.
sentences.zh: 她在意外後奇蹟般地復原了。

sentences.en: Your progress this semester is remarkable.
sentences.zh: 你這學期的進步很驚人。

sentences.en: Isn't this view absolutely remarkable?
sentences.zh: 這景色不是真的很了不起嗎？

sentences.en: The team did a remarkable job on the launch.
sentences.zh: 團隊在產品上市時表現得非常出色。

sentences.en: What is so remarkable about this old house?
sentences.zh: 這間老房子有什麼了不起的地方？

sentences.en: The city has seen remarkable growth in ten years.
sentences.zh: 這座城市十年來有顯著的成長。

sentences.en: Sales were remarkably strong last quarter.
sentences.zh: 上一季的銷售額異常強勁。

sentences.en: The new software runs remarkably fast.
sentences.zh: 新軟體跑得出奇地快。

sentences.en: Why is the office remarkably quiet today?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今天辦公室特別安靜？

sentences.en: She stayed remarkably calm during the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時她出奇地冷靜。

sentences.en: Was the test remarkably easy for you too?
sentences.zh: 這次考試對你來說也出奇地簡單嗎？

sentences.en: The company grew remarkably fast in two years.
sentences.zh: 這家公司兩年內成長得驚人地快。

gloss_note: set a reminder 設定提醒

sentences.en: Thanks for the reminder about the meeting.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你提醒我開會的事。

sentences.en: I set a reminder on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我在手機上設了提醒。

sentences.en: Did you get my reminder email?
sentences.zh: 你有收到我的提醒信嗎？

sentences.en: This is a friendly reminder that rent is due Friday.
sentences.zh: 這是友善的提醒，房租週五到期。

sentences.en: Can you send me a reminder tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 你明天早上可以提醒我一下嗎？

sentences.en: The photo was a sweet reminder of our trip.
sentences.zh: 這張照片讓我想起我們的旅行，好溫馨。

gloss_note: of great renown 享有盛名；偏正式

sentences.en: That restaurant gained renown for its fresh pasta.
sentences.zh: 那間餐廳以新鮮義大利麵聞名。

sentences.en: Did the writer win renown for her first book?
sentences.zh: 這位作家的第一本書讓她聲名大噪了嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor is a person of great renown.
sentences.zh: 這位醫師享有極高的名聲。

sentences.en: Does this school have international renown?
sentences.zh: 這所學校有國際知名度嗎？

sentences.en: He moved to the city to gain renown as a singer.
sentences.zh: 他搬到這座城市，想成為有名的歌手。

sentences.en: A bakery of such renown always has a long line.
sentences.zh: 這麼有名的麵包店總是大排長龍。

gloss_note: renter 美式常用；英式多說 tenant

sentences.en: As a renter, I can't paint the walls.
sentences.zh: 身為租客，我不能粉刷牆壁。

sentences.en: Is the renter responsible for fixing the sink?
sentences.zh: 修水槽是租客的責任嗎？

sentences.en: The landlord called the renter about the late payment.
sentences.zh: 房東為了遲繳的事打電話給租客。

sentences.en: Does the car renter have to show a license?
sentences.zh: 租車的人必須出示駕照嗎？

sentences.en: Every renter must sign the lease by Friday.
sentences.zh: 每位租客都必須在週五前簽好租約。

sentences.en: A new renter moves into the apartment next door tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天有一位新租客搬進隔壁公寓。

sentences.en: The repairperson will arrive between ten and noon.
sentences.zh: 維修人員會在十點到中午之間抵達。

sentences.en: Can you call a repairperson for the washing machine?
sentences.zh: 你能叫維修人員來修洗衣機嗎？

sentences.en: Did the repairperson fix the air conditioner?
sentences.zh: 維修人員把冷氣修好了嗎？

sentences.en: Our repairperson is very friendly and fast.
sentences.zh: 我們的維修人員人很親切，動作也快。

sentences.en: The repairperson said the part must be replaced.
sentences.zh: 維修人員說這個零件必須更換。

sentences.en: I'm waiting at home for the repairperson.
sentences.zh: 我在家等維修人員。

sentences.en: I called the shop repeatedly, but no one answered.
sentences.zh: 我一再打電話給那家店，卻沒人接。

sentences.en: The printer has failed repeatedly this week.
sentences.zh: 印表機這週一再故障。

sentences.en: Why did the system crash repeatedly last night?
sentences.zh: 為什麼系統昨晚一再當機？

sentences.en: The teacher repeatedly told us to be on time.
sentences.zh: 老師一再告訴我們要準時。

sentences.en: Have you tried to reset your password repeatedly?
sentences.zh: 你有反覆嘗試重設密碼嗎？

sentences.en: He repeatedly said sorry for being late.
sentences.zh: 他一再為遲到道歉。

gloss_note: repetition of 某事的重複；不可數

sentences.en: Repetition is the best way to memorize new words.
sentences.zh: 重複是記新單字最好的方法。

sentences.en: Why does the teacher use so much repetition in class?
sentences.zh: 老師為什麼在課堂上用這麼多重複練習？

sentences.en: I'm tired of the repetition in this job.
sentences.zh: 我厭倦了這份工作裡一成不變的重複。

sentences.en: Does repetition really help you learn a song faster?
sentences.zh: 反覆練習真的能讓你更快學會一首歌嗎？

sentences.en: The repetition of the same mistake cost us a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 同樣的錯誤一再重複，讓我們損失了很多錢。

sentences.en: Constant repetition can make a speech boring.
sentences.zh: 不斷的重複會讓演講變得很無聊。

gloss_note: replicate the results 重現結果

sentences.en: Other labs could not replicate the results of the study.
sentences.zh: 其他實驗室無法重現這項研究的結果。

sentences.en: Can you replicate the problem on your computer?
sentences.zh: 你能在你的電腦上重現這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: She tried to replicate her grandmother's recipe, but it tasted different.
sentences.zh: 她試著複製外婆的食譜，但味道不一樣。

sentences.en: Scientists want to replicate the experiment before they trust it.
sentences.zh: 科學家想先重現這個實驗，才願意相信結果。

sentences.en: Would it be easy to replicate this design in another store?
sentences.zh: 要把這個設計複製到另一家店容易嗎？

sentences.en: The team replicated the survey last spring and got the same results.
sentences.zh: 團隊去年春天重現了那項調查，得到相同的結果。

gloss_note: replication study 重複驗證的研究

sentences.en: Replication is important because one study is not enough.
sentences.zh: 重現驗證很重要，因為只靠一項研究是不夠的。

sentences.en: Has anyone attempted a replication of her findings?
sentences.zh: 有人嘗試重現她的研究發現嗎？

sentences.en: My sister does replication work at a lab downtown.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊在市區的實驗室做重現驗證的工作。

sentences.en: Our professor asked us to do a replication of an old study.
sentences.zh: 教授要我們重做一項舊研究來驗證。

sentences.en: Without replication, we can't be sure the result is real.
sentences.zh: 沒有重現驗證，我們無法確定結果是真的。

sentences.en: Why did the replication fail to match the first results?
sentences.zh: 為什麼重現驗證的結果跟最初的結果對不上？

gloss_note: a fair representation of 公正呈現

sentences.en: This painting is a representation of a quiet village.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪的是一個寧靜的村莊。

sentences.en: Does the map give an accurate representation of the town?
sentences.zh: 這張地圖有準確描繪這座小鎮嗎？

sentences.en: Many students felt the ad was a false representation of our school.
sentences.zh: 許多學生覺得那則廣告錯誤呈現了我們學校的樣貌。

sentences.en: The graph is a simple representation of our sales.
sentences.zh: 這張圖表簡單描繪了我們的銷售狀況。

sentences.en: Is this model a good representation of the real bridge?
sentences.zh: 這個模型能好好呈現真正的橋嗎？

sentences.en: That movie gives a fair representation of life in the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 那部電影公正地描繪了1950年代的生活。

gloss_note: plant reproduction 植物繁殖；不可數

sentences.en: Reproduction in plants often depends on bees and wind.
sentences.zh: 植物的繁殖常常要靠蜜蜂和風。

sentences.en: How does reproduction work in fish?
sentences.zh: 魚類是怎麼繁殖的？

sentences.en: Our biology class studied cell reproduction today.
sentences.zh: 我們的生物課今天學了細胞繁殖。

sentences.en: Do all animals use the same method of reproduction?
sentences.zh: 所有動物都用同一種方式繁殖嗎？

sentences.en: Warm water speeds up the reproduction of algae.
sentences.zh: 溫暖的水會加快藻類的繁殖。

sentences.en: My kid asked me how reproduction works in frogs.
sentences.zh: 我孩子問我青蛙是怎麼繁殖的。

gloss_note: have a good reputation 名聲好

sentences.en: This restaurant has a great reputation for fresh seafood.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以新鮮海鮮聞名，聲譽很好。

sentences.en: Will one mistake ruin your reputation at work?
sentences.zh: 一次失誤會毀掉你在公司的名聲嗎？

sentences.en: He worked hard to build a good reputation.
sentences.zh: 他努力建立良好的名聲。

sentences.en: Her reputation as a fair boss spread quickly.
sentences.zh: 她公正老闆的名聲很快就傳開了。

sentences.en: What kind of reputation does that car dealer have?
sentences.zh: 那家汽車經銷商的聲譽怎麼樣？

sentences.en: I don't want to damage my reputation by lying.
sentences.zh: 我不想因為說謊而毀了自己的名聲。

gloss_note: rescue sb from… 把某人從…救出

sentences.en: Firefighters rescued a cat from a tall tree.
sentences.zh: 消防員把一隻貓從高高的樹上救了下來。

sentences.en: Did the rescue team find everyone safely?
sentences.zh: 救援隊把大家都平安找到了嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for coming to my rescue.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你來救我。

sentences.en: A helicopter rescued two hikers from the mountain last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一架直升機把兩名登山客從山上救了出來。

sentences.en: Who rescued you when your car broke down?
sentences.zh: 你的車拋錨時，是誰來救你的？

sentences.en: I rescued my phone from the water just in time.
sentences.zh: 我及時把手機從水裡搶救了出來。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: do research 做研究；不可數

sentences.en: I did some research before buying this laptop.
sentences.zh: 買這台筆電之前，我做了一些調查。

sentences.en: What does the latest research say about sleep?
sentences.zh: 關於睡眠，最新的研究怎麼說？

sentences.en: She researches ocean wildlife at a university.
sentences.zh: 她在一所大學研究海洋野生動物。

sentences.en: Have you researched hotels near the airport yet?
sentences.zh: 你調查過機場附近的飯店了嗎？

sentences.en: Our research shows customers prefer shorter forms.
sentences.zh: 我們的研究顯示，顧客比較喜歡簡短的表格。

sentences.en: The students spent an hour on research in the library.
sentences.zh: 學生們在圖書館花了一小時做研究。

sentences.en: My neighbor is a researcher at a medical lab.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居是一家醫學實驗室的研究員。

sentences.en: The researcher explained her findings to the class.
sentences.zh: 那位研究員向全班說明她的發現。

sentences.en: Are you a researcher or a teacher?
sentences.zh: 你是研究員還是老師？

sentences.en: Several researchers are working on a new battery.
sentences.zh: 好幾位研究人員正在研發一種新電池。

sentences.en: Which researcher wrote this report?
sentences.zh: 這份報告是哪位研究員寫的？

sentences.en: He wants to become a researcher after graduation.
sentences.zh: 他畢業後想當研究員。

sentences.en: You really resemble your father when you laugh.
sentences.zh: 你笑起來真的很像你爸爸。

sentences.en: Does this dish resemble the one your mom makes?
sentences.zh: 這道菜跟你媽媽做的很像嗎？

sentences.en: The twins resemble each other so much.
sentences.zh: 這對雙胞胎長得非常像。

sentences.en: Her handwriting closely resembles mine.
sentences.zh: 她的字跡跟我的非常像。

sentences.en: Which animal does this cloud resemble?
sentences.zh: 這朵雲像哪一種動物？

sentences.en: The new office resembles a small library.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室看起來像一間小圖書館。

sentences.en: Wash the fruit to remove any pesticide residue.
sentences.zh: 把水果洗一洗，去除農藥殘留。

sentences.en: What is this sticky residue on the pan?
sentences.zh: 鍋子上這層黏黏的殘留物是什麼？

sentences.en: Scientists found a thin residue of salt on the rocks.
sentences.zh: 科學家在岩石上發現一層薄薄的鹽分殘留物。

sentences.en: There was a white residue at the bottom of the cup.
sentences.zh: 杯底有一層白色的殘渣。

sentences.en: Do you know how to clean soap residue off the tiles?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼清掉磁磚上的肥皂殘留嗎？

sentences.en: This soap leaves no residue on dishes.
sentences.zh: 這款肥皂不會在碗盤上留下殘留物。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee will resign at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 李先生將在月底辭職。

sentences.en: Why did she resign so suddenly?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼這麼突然就辭職了？

sentences.en: I'm thinking of resigning from my job.
sentences.zh: 我在考慮辭掉工作。

sentences.en: The manager resigned after the project failed.
sentences.zh: 專案失敗後，經理辭職了。

sentences.en: Did you hear that our coach resigned?
sentences.zh: 你聽說我們教練辭職了嗎？

sentences.en: He resigned from the club board last week.
sentences.zh: 他上週辭去了社團幹部的職務。

gloss_note: resistance to change 抗拒改變

sentences.en: I met a lot of resistance when I changed the menu.
sentences.zh: 我更改菜單時遇到很多抗拒。

sentences.en: Is there any resistance to the new policy?
sentences.zh: 有人抗拒這項新規定嗎？

sentences.en: Why do kids show resistance to going to bed?
sentences.zh: 為什麼孩子都抗拒上床睡覺？

sentences.en: Her resistance to change slowed the whole team down.
sentences.zh: 她對改變的抗拒拖慢了整個團隊。

sentences.en: Little resistance came from the staff at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 會議上員工幾乎沒有表現出抗拒。

sentences.en: Local residents offered strong resistance to the new road.
sentences.zh: 當地居民強烈抗拒這條新道路。

sentences.en: This jacket is resistant to water.
sentences.zh: 這件外套能抗水。

sentences.en: Some bacteria are resistant to common medicine.
sentences.zh: 有些細菌對常見藥物有抗藥性。

sentences.en: Are you resistant to change at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上會抗拒改變嗎？

sentences.en: The oven mitt is made of heat-resistant fabric.
sentences.zh: 這隻烤箱手套是耐熱布料做的。

sentences.en: Is this phone case resistant to scratches?
sentences.zh: 這個手機殼耐刮嗎？

sentences.en: These tomatoes are resistant to many plant diseases.
sentences.zh: 這些番茄能抗多種植物病害。

gloss_note: New Year's resolution 新年新希望

sentences.en: My New Year's resolution is to exercise more.
sentences.zh: 我的新年新希望是多運動。

sentences.en: Did you make a resolution this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年有立下什麼決心嗎？

sentences.en: She kept her resolution and avoided sugar for a month.
sentences.zh: 她堅守自己的決心，一個月不碰糖。

sentences.en: The club passed a resolution to meet every Friday.
sentences.zh: 社團通過決議，每週五聚會。

sentences.en: What resolution did the board pass yesterday?
sentences.zh: 董事會昨天通過了什麼決議？

sentences.en: His resolution to study abroad never changed.
sentences.zh: 他出國讀書的決心從未動搖。

gloss_note: resolve a problem 解決問題

sentences.en: We need to resolve this problem before Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們得在週一前解決這個問題。

sentences.en: Did you resolve the issue with your landlord?
sentences.zh: 你跟房東的問題解決了嗎？

sentences.en: The two sisters finally resolved their argument.
sentences.zh: 兩姊妹終於化解了爭執。

sentences.en: Did the update resolve your login problem?
sentences.zh: 這次更新有解決你的登入問題嗎？

sentences.en: How can we resolve the conflict peacefully?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼和平解決這場衝突？

sentences.en: The support team resolved my complaint within an hour.
sentences.zh: 客服團隊一小時內就解決了我的客訴。

sentences.en: He comes from a respectable family.
sentences.zh: 他出身於體面的家庭。

sentences.en: Is this shirt respectable enough for an interview?
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫穿去面試夠體面嗎？

sentences.en: She earns a respectable salary as a nurse.
sentences.zh: 她當護理師，薪水相當體面。

sentences.en: Wear something respectable to the dinner.
sentences.zh: 去晚宴請穿得體面一點。

sentences.en: Does that look respectable to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那樣看起來體面嗎？

sentences.en: He is a respectable man in our town.
sentences.zh: 他在我們鎮上是個受人尊敬的人。

sentences.en: Be respectful when you talk to your elders.
sentences.zh: 跟長輩說話要有禮貌。

sentences.en: Is that a respectful way to speak to a customer?
sentences.zh: 那樣跟客人說話算有禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: The students were quiet and respectful during the speech.
sentences.zh: 演講期間，學生們安靜又守禮。

sentences.en: She is always respectful of other people's time.
sentences.zh: 她總是很尊重別人的時間。

sentences.en: The kids stood in respectful silence.
sentences.zh: 孩子們肅穆地靜靜站著。

sentences.en: How can we be more respectful in emails?
sentences.zh: 寫電子郵件時，我們要怎麼更有禮貌？

sentences.en: The two managers returned to their respective offices.
sentences.zh: 兩位經理各自回到自己的辦公室。

sentences.en: Please send the files to your respective teams.
sentences.zh: 請把檔案寄給你們各自的團隊。

sentences.en: What are the respective roles of sales and marketing?
sentences.zh: 業務部和行銷部各自的角色是什麼？

sentences.en: The partners explained their respective duties.
sentences.zh: 合夥人說明了各自的職責。

sentences.en: Can each person describe their respective goals for next quarter?
sentences.zh: 每個人可以說明自己下一季各自的目標嗎？

sentences.en: Both firms will announce the deal at their respective events.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司將在各自的活動上宣布這筆交易。

sentences.en: Smoke can cause respiratory problems.
sentences.zh: 煙霧可能引起呼吸方面的問題。

sentences.en: My son has a respiratory infection.
sentences.zh: 我兒子呼吸道感染了。

sentences.en: Do you have any respiratory problems?
sentences.zh: 你有任何呼吸方面的問題嗎？

sentences.en: Cold air can irritate the respiratory system.
sentences.zh: 冷空氣會刺激呼吸系統。

sentences.en: What are the signs of a respiratory infection?
sentences.zh: 呼吸道感染有哪些徵兆？

sentences.en: She works as a respiratory therapist at a hospital.
sentences.zh: 她在醫院擔任呼吸治療師。

sentences.en: The power was restored after two hours.
sentences.zh: 兩小時後就恢復供電了。

sentences.en: Can you restore the deleted files?
sentences.zh: 你能恢復被刪除的檔案嗎？

sentences.en: They restored the old theater downtown.
sentences.zh: 他們修復了市中心的老戲院。

sentences.en: How long will it take to restore our internet?
sentences.zh: 我們的網路要多久才能恢復？

sentences.en: A good night's sleep will restore your energy.
sentences.zh: 好好睡一覺就能恢復你的精力。

sentences.en: He restored an old truck with his dad.
sentences.zh: 他和爸爸一起修復了一輛舊卡車。

sentences.en: The company showed restraint in its spending this year.
sentences.zh: 公司今年的支出相當克制。

sentences.en: Spending restraint this year forced us to cancel the party.
sentences.zh: 今年緊縮開支，讓我們不得不取消派對。

sentences.en: Please show some restraint when you talk to the press.
sentences.zh: 跟媒體說話時請克制一點。

sentences.en: Should we show more restraint with the office budget?
sentences.zh: 我們在辦公室預算上是否該更克制一點？

sentences.en: She showed great restraint and didn't answer the angry email.
sentences.zh: 她非常克制，沒有回覆那封憤怒的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Why did management ask for restraint on travel costs?
sentences.zh: 管理階層為什麼要求克制差旅費用？

sentences.en: Is there a weight restriction on carry-on bags?
sentences.zh: 隨身行李有重量限制嗎？

sentences.en: The city put new restrictions on parking downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府對市中心的停車訂了新的管制。

sentences.en: Do you have any dietary restrictions?
sentences.zh: 你有任何飲食限制嗎？

sentences.en: There is no age restriction for this class.
sentences.zh: 這門課沒有年齡限制。

sentences.en: Speed restrictions apply in school zones.
sentences.zh: 學校區域有速度管制。

sentences.en: Travel restrictions made our trip harder to plan.
sentences.zh: 旅行管制讓我們的行程更難安排。

sentences.en: This jacket retains heat very well.
sentences.zh: 這件外套很能留住熱度。

sentences.en: How can we retain our best employees?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼留住最優秀的員工？

sentences.en: Please retain your receipt in case you need to return it.
sentences.zh: 請保留收據，以免需要退貨。

sentences.en: She retained her title for three years.
sentences.zh: 她連續三年保住了頭銜。

sentences.en: Can you retain all that information after one reading?
sentences.zh: 你讀一次就能把這些資訊留在腦子裡嗎？

sentences.en: The old house retained its charm after the repairs.
sentences.zh: 老房子修繕後仍保留著原有的魅力。

sentences.en: Employee retention is a big concern for our company.
sentences.zh: 留住員工是我們公司很大的課題。

sentences.en: How do we improve customer retention?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提高客戶留存率？

sentences.en: Our retention rate went up after the raise.
sentences.zh: 加薪之後，我們的留任率上升了。

sentences.en: What causes poor retention in your department?
sentences.zh: 你們部門留不住人，原因是什麼？

sentences.en: Good benefits help with staff retention.
sentences.zh: 良好的福利有助於留住員工。

sentences.en: The store offers discounts to boost customer retention.
sentences.zh: 這家店提供折扣，以提高顧客的留存率。

sentences.en: My uncle will retire next spring.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔明年春天退休。

sentences.en: When do you plan to retire?
sentences.zh: 你打算什麼時候退休？

sentences.en: She retired at sixty and moved to Florida.
sentences.zh: 她六十歲退休，搬到佛羅里達。

sentences.en: Did the coach retire after that season?
sentences.zh: 教練在那個球季後退休了嗎？

sentences.en: Many workers retire earlier than they expected.
sentences.zh: 許多人比預期更早退休。

sentences.en: He retired from teaching and opened a small bakery.
sentences.zh: 他從教職退休，開了一家小麵包店。

sentences.en: What are your plans for retirement?
sentences.zh: 你退休後有什麼計畫？

sentences.en: My grandfather enjoys his retirement by gardening.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺靠種花草享受退休生活。

sentences.en: She announced her retirement at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她在會議上宣布退休。

sentences.en: Are you saving enough for retirement?
sentences.zh: 你為退休存的錢夠嗎？

sentences.en: The party is for Mr. Chen's retirement.
sentences.zh: 這場派對是為陳先生的退休辦的。

sentences.en: After retirement, he started painting.
sentences.zh: 退休後，他開始畫畫。

sentences.en: The hikers decided to retreat when the storm got worse.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨變強時，登山客決定撤退。

sentences.en: Don't retreat just because it's hard.
sentences.zh: 別因為困難就退縮。

sentences.en: Why did the company retreat from the market so fast?
sentences.zh: 這家公司為什麼這麼快就從市場撤退？

sentences.en: The history book describes the army's retreat in winter.
sentences.zh: 歷史課本描述了軍隊在冬天的撤退。

sentences.en: When the dog barked, the child made a quick retreat.
sentences.zh: 狗一叫，小孩就趕緊往後退。

sentences.en: Should we retreat and try again tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要先撤退，明天再試一次？

sentences.en: Can you retrieve the file I deleted yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你能找回我昨天刪掉的檔案嗎？

sentences.en: I need to retrieve my luggage from baggage claim.
sentences.zh: 我得去行李提領處取回我的行李。

sentences.en: The system can retrieve customer data in seconds.
sentences.zh: 這個系統幾秒內就能檢索客戶資料。

sentences.en: How do I retrieve my password?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼取回我的密碼？

sentences.en: She retrieved her keys from the car.
sentences.zh: 她從車上把鑰匙拿了回來。

sentences.en: The dog retrieved the ball and ran back.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗把球撿了回來，又跑回來。

sentences.en: We have a family reunion every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們每年夏天都有家族團聚。

sentences.en: Are you going to the class reunion this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末要去同學會嗎？

sentences.en: Their reunion at the airport made everyone smile.
sentences.zh: 他們在機場重聚的畫面讓大家都笑了。

sentences.en: It was a happy reunion after five years.
sentences.zh: 相隔五年的重聚，大家都很開心。

sentences.en: Who is organizing the reunion?
sentences.zh: 誰在籌辦這次的同學會？

sentences.en: Our college friends planned a reunion in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我們的大學朋友計畫在芝加哥辦一次重聚。

sentences.en: Revenge is never the answer, my mom always says.
sentences.zh: 我媽總是說，報復從來不是解決之道。

sentences.en: Do you think revenge ever makes people feel better?
sentences.zh: 你覺得報復真的能讓人好過一點嗎？

sentences.en: She didn't want revenge, just an apology.
sentences.zh: 她不想報復，只想要一句道歉。

sentences.en: My little brother hid my socks as revenge.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟藏起我的襪子來報復我。

sentences.en: Why does the hero in this movie want revenge?
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡的主角為什麼想報復？

sentences.en: In the old tale, the fox takes revenge on the crow.
sentences.zh: 在古老的故事裡，狐狸向烏鴉報復。

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution changed how people worked.
sentences.zh: 工業革命改變了人們的工作方式。

sentences.en: Did the internet cause a revolution in shopping?
sentences.zh: 網路是否為購物帶來了重大變革？

sentences.en: We studied the French Revolution in history class.
sentences.zh: 我們在歷史課上學了法國大革命。

sentences.en: Smartphones started a revolution in how we take photos.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機掀起了拍照方式的重大變革。

sentences.en: Which revolution do you find most interesting?
sentences.zh: 你覺得哪一場革命最有趣？

sentences.en: The revolution in electric cars is happening fast.
sentences.zh: 電動車的變革正在快速進行。

gloss_note: a revolutionary idea 劃時代的點子

sentences.en: The company launched a revolutionary new phone.
sentences.zh: 公司推出了一款劃時代的新手機。

sentences.en: Is this a revolutionary idea or just a trick?
sentences.zh: 這是劃時代的創意，還是只是噱頭？

sentences.en: Her revolutionary design changed how we build bikes.
sentences.zh: 她革命性的設計改變了我們製造自行車的方式。

sentences.en: What makes this product so revolutionary?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓這項產品如此具有革命性？

sentences.en: Scientists announced a revolutionary battery that charges in minutes.
sentences.zh: 科學家宣布了一種幾分鐘就能充飽電的革命性電池。

sentences.en: That software was revolutionary when it first came out.
sentences.zh: 那套軟體剛推出時是革命性的創新。

sentences.en: He got a reward for returning the lost wallet.
sentences.zh: 他因為歸還遺失的皮夾而得到獎賞。

sentences.en: What reward do you want for finishing early?
sentences.zh: 提早完成的話，你想要什麼獎勵？

sentences.en: Hard work will be rewarded.
sentences.zh: 努力工作會得到獎賞。

sentences.en: I'll reward myself with ice cream after the exam.
sentences.zh: 考完試後，我要請自己吃冰淇淋當獎勵。

sentences.en: Is the reward worth the risk?
sentences.zh: 這樣的獎賞值得冒險嗎？

sentences.en: The boss rewarded the team with a free lunch.
sentences.zh: 老闆請團隊吃免費午餐作為獎勵。

sentences.en: The speech was full of beautiful rhetoric but few facts.
sentences.zh: 這場演講充滿漂亮的修辭，卻沒什麼事實。

sentences.en: Do you study rhetoric in your writing class?
sentences.zh: 你的寫作課有學修辭嗎？

sentences.en: Good rhetoric can make a weak idea sound strong.
sentences.zh: 好的修辭能讓薄弱的想法聽起來很有力。

sentences.en: I'm tired of empty rhetoric from advertisements.
sentences.zh: 我受夠了廣告裡的空洞言詞。

sentences.en: Is it just rhetoric, or will they really act?
sentences.zh: 這只是空洞的言詞，還是他們真的會行動？

sentences.en: Our professor teaches rhetoric and public speaking.
sentences.zh: 我們教授教修辭學和公開演說。

sentences.en: Does this poem have a rhyme in every line?
sentences.zh: 這首詩每一行都有押韻嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter loves songs that rhyme.
sentences.zh: 我女兒喜歡押韻的歌。

sentences.en: Can you think of a word that rhymes with 'go'?
sentences.zh: 你想得到跟「go」押韻的字嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher read a funny rhyme to the class.
sentences.zh: 老師對全班唸了一首好笑的押韻小詩。

sentences.en: Rap lyrics often use rhyme at the end of lines.
sentences.zh: 饒舌歌詞常在句尾使用押韻。

sentences.en: Kids learn new words faster with rhyme.
sentences.zh: 孩子透過押韻學新單字比較快。

sentences.en: I love the rhythm of this song.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這首歌的節奏。

sentences.en: Can you clap to the rhythm?
sentences.zh: 你可以跟著節奏拍手嗎？

sentences.en: It took me a month to get into the rhythm of my new job.
sentences.zh: 我花了一個月才進入新工作的節奏。

sentences.en: Our daily rhythm changed after the baby arrived.
sentences.zh: 寶寶出生後，我們的生活節奏改變了。

sentences.en: Do you work better with a steady rhythm?
sentences.zh: 你在穩定的節奏下工作比較好嗎？

sentences.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm all night.
sentences.zh: 鼓手整晚都維持穩定的節奏。

sentences.en: Can you solve this riddle?
sentences.zh: 你能解開這個謎語嗎？

sentences.en: My grandpa tells us a riddle every night.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺每晚都出一個謎語給我們猜。

sentences.en: What's the answer to the riddle on the card?
sentences.zh: 卡片上那個謎語的答案是什麼？

sentences.en: The riddle was too hard for the kids.
sentences.zh: 這個謎語對孩子來說太難了。

sentences.en: She loves riddles and word games.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡猜謎和文字遊戲。

sentences.en: The book begins with a riddle about a lost key.
sentences.zh: 這本書以一個關於失落鑰匙的謎語開頭。

gloss_note: rig a vote 操縱投票

sentences.en: Some people say the contest was rigged.
sentences.zh: 有些人說這場比賽被人操縱了。

sentences.en: Did someone rig the vote at the club meeting?
sentences.zh: 有人在社團會議上操縱投票嗎？

sentences.en: The company was caught rigging bids on city contracts.
sentences.zh: 這家公司被抓到操縱市府合約的投標。

sentences.en: How could anyone rig a lottery drawing?
sentences.zh: 怎麼會有人能操縱抽獎？

sentences.en: Stores were accused of rigging prices.
sentences.zh: 商店被指控操縱價格。

sentences.en: I think the game was rigged against us.
sentences.zh: 我覺得這場遊戲被動了手腳，對我們不利。

sentences.en: The news reported a riot outside the stadium after the game.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導比賽結束後，體育場外發生了騷亂。

sentences.en: Police closed the road after a small riot downtown.
sentences.zh: 市中心發生小規模暴動後，警方封閉了那條路。

sentences.en: What caused the riot at the concert?
sentences.zh: 是什麼引發了演唱會上的騷亂？

sentences.en: My history teacher explained why the riot began.
sentences.zh: 我的歷史老師解釋了暴動為什麼爆發。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the riot on the news?
sentences.zh: 你有在新聞上看到那場暴動嗎？

sentences.en: Fans started a riot when the show was canceled.
sentences.zh: 演出取消時，歌迷引發了騷亂。

gloss_note: morning ritual 晨間固定習慣

sentences.en: My morning coffee is a daily ritual.
sentences.zh: 我的早晨咖啡是每天的固定儀式。

sentences.en: What is your bedtime ritual?
sentences.zh: 你睡前有什麼固定的習慣？

sentences.en: The tea ceremony is an important cultural ritual in Japan.
sentences.zh: 茶道是日本重要的文化儀式。

sentences.en: Our family has a ritual of eating dumplings on Lunar New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 我們家有除夕吃水餃的慣例。

sentences.en: Do you have any rituals before a big game?
sentences.zh: 大賽前你有什麼固定的慣例嗎？

sentences.en: The wedding included several traditional rituals.
sentences.zh: 婚禮包含了幾項傳統儀式。

sentences.en: Police are looking for the robber who hit a store last night.
sentences.zh: 警方正在尋找昨晚搶劫商店的搶匪。

sentences.en: In the movie, the robber wears a funny mask.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的搶匪戴著一個滑稽的面具。

sentences.en: Did the robber get away?
sentences.zh: 搶匪逃走了嗎？

sentences.en: A security camera recorded the robber's face.
sentences.zh: 監視器拍下了搶匪的臉。

sentences.en: Who played the robber in that old film?
sentences.zh: 那部老電影裡的搶匪是誰演的？

sentences.en: My kids like the story of the clever robber.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子們喜歡那個聰明搶匪的故事。

sentences.en: Their romance began at a small coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 他們的戀情始於一家小咖啡店。

sentences.en: Is there still romance in modern dating?
sentences.zh: 現代人約會還有浪漫嗎？

sentences.en: He added some romance to the evening with candles.
sentences.zh: 他點上蠟燭，為夜晚增添了一些浪漫。

sentences.en: The movie's romance felt sweet and real.
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡的戀情甜蜜又真實。

sentences.en: Did their office romance end well?
sentences.zh: 他們的辦公室戀情有好結局嗎？

sentences.en: My grandparents still keep the romance alive.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母仍讓浪漫持續著。

sentences.en: The Earth rotates once every twenty-four hours.
sentences.zh: 地球每二十四小時自轉一圈。

sentences.en: We rotate shifts every two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我們每兩週輪一次班。

sentences.en: How often should I rotate my tires?
sentences.zh: 我的輪胎應該多久換位一次？

sentences.en: Rotate the photo so it faces the right way.
sentences.zh: 把照片旋轉一下，讓它朝向正確的方向。

sentences.en: Does your team rotate who runs the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你們團隊會輪流主持會議嗎？

sentences.en: The wheel rotated slowly in the wind.
sentences.zh: 輪子在風中緩緩旋轉。

sentences.en: What route do you take to work?
sentences.zh: 你上班走哪條路線？

sentences.en: I'll send you the route by text.
sentences.zh: 我會用簡訊把路線傳給你。

sentences.en: Is there a faster route to the airport?
sentences.zh: 去機場有比較快的路線嗎？

sentences.en: We took the scenic route home.
sentences.zh: 我們走風景優美的路線回家。

sentences.en: The bus route changed last month.
sentences.zh: 公車路線上個月改了。

sentences.en: Traffic forced us to change our route.
sentences.zh: 塞車逼得我們改變路線。

sentences.en: The runner crossed the finish line first.
sentences.zh: 那位跑者第一個衝過終點線。

sentences.en: Are you a runner or a swimmer?
sentences.zh: 你平常是跑者還是游泳選手？

sentences.en: Our company sponsors a local runner.
sentences.zh: 我們公司贊助一位當地的跑者。

sentences.en: Many runners stop at this water station.
sentences.zh: 許多跑者會在這個補給站停下來。

sentences.en: Which runner won the marathon this year?
sentences.zh: 今年馬拉松是哪位跑者獲勝？

sentences.en: My coworker is a serious runner and joins races on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我同事是認真的跑者，週末會參加路跑。

gloss_note: rural area 鄉村地區；反義 urban

sentences.en: She grew up in a rural area.
sentences.zh: 她在鄉村地區長大。

sentences.en: Is internet service good in rural towns?
sentences.zh: 鄉村小鎮的網路服務好嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle runs a small rural clinic.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔經營一間小小的鄉村診所。

sentences.en: Rural roads can be dark at night.
sentences.zh: 鄉村的道路晚上可能很暗。

sentences.en: Would you rather live in a rural or urban place?
sentences.zh: 你比較想住在鄉村還是都市？

sentences.en: Many rural families depend on farming.
sentences.zh: 許多鄉村家庭靠務農維生。

sentences.en: The old bike chain is rusty, so it squeaks.
sentences.zh: 舊腳踏車的鏈條生鏽了，所以會吱吱作響。

sentences.en: Is that hammer too rusty to use?
sentences.zh: 那把鐵鎚是不是鏽得不能用了？

sentences.en: My Spanish is rusty because I haven't practiced in years.
sentences.zh: 我好幾年沒練習，西班牙文都生疏了。

sentences.en: Her piano skills got rusty after a long break.
sentences.zh: 休息很久之後，她的鋼琴技巧變得生疏了。

sentences.en: Do you feel rusty after a month away from work?
sentences.zh: 離開工作一個月後，你會覺得生疏嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful with that rusty ladder in the garage.
sentences.zh: 小心車庫裡那座生鏽的梯子。

gloss_note: make a sacrifice 做出犧牲

sentences.en: My parents made many sacrifices so I could go to college.
sentences.zh: 我父母做了許多犧牲，讓我能上大學。

sentences.en: Would you sacrifice your weekend to finish the project?
sentences.zh: 你願意犧牲週末來完成這個專案嗎？

sentences.en: He refused to sacrifice quality just to save money.
sentences.zh: 他不肯為了省錢而犧牲品質。

sentences.en: What are you willing to sacrifice to reach your goal?
sentences.zh: 為了達成目標，你願意捨棄什麼？

sentences.en: Some athletes sacrifice sleep to train before dawn.
sentences.zh: 有些運動員為了在黎明前訓練而犧牲睡眠。

sentences.en: It was a big sacrifice to give up our trip.
sentences.zh: 放棄我們的旅行是很大的犧牲。

sentences.en: We need to safeguard customer data from hackers.
sentences.zh: 我們必須保護客戶資料不被駭客入侵。

sentences.en: How can small businesses safeguard their cash flow?
sentences.zh: 小型企業要如何保障自己的現金流？

sentences.en: A good contract is a safeguard against late payments.
sentences.zh: 一份好的合約能保障我們不被拖欠款項。

sentences.en: The new rules safeguard workers from unsafe conditions.
sentences.zh: 新規定保護員工免於不安全的工作環境。

sentences.en: Does this policy safeguard us if the supplier closes down?
sentences.zh: 如果供應商倒閉，這份保單能保障我們嗎？

sentences.en: Banks use strong passwords to safeguard your accounts.
sentences.zh: 銀行用高強度密碼來保護你的帳戶。

sentences.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
sentences.zh: 顧客滿意是我們的首要任務。

sentences.en: How would you rate your satisfaction with the service?
sentences.zh: 你對這次服務的滿意程度打幾分？

sentences.en: She felt great satisfaction after finishing her first painting.
sentences.zh: 完成第一幅畫後，她感到非常滿足。

sentences.en: Did you get any satisfaction from finishing the marathon?
sentences.zh: 跑完馬拉松，你有感到滿足嗎？

sentences.en: He smiled with satisfaction when he saw his grades.
sentences.zh: 他看到成績時滿意地笑了。

sentences.en: There is a lot of satisfaction in helping others.
sentences.zh: 幫助別人能帶來很大的滿足感。

sentences.en: The hotel has a sauna and a pool on the third floor.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店三樓有三溫暖和游泳池。

sentences.en: Is the sauna open after ten at night?
sentences.zh: 三溫暖晚上十點過後還有開嗎？

sentences.en: I like to sit in the sauna after my workout.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡運動後去三溫暖坐一坐。

sentences.en: Guests should not stay in the sauna for more than twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 客人在三溫暖裡不要待超過二十分鐘。

sentences.en: Could you tell me where the sauna is?
sentences.zh: 可以告訴我三溫暖在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: The sauna was too hot, so she left after five minutes.
sentences.zh: 三溫暖太熱了，所以她五分鐘後就離開了。

sentences.en: I could scarcely believe the price was so low.
sentences.zh: 我簡直不敢相信價格這麼低。

sentences.en: There was scarcely any food left in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡幾乎沒剩什麼食物了。

sentences.en: Why do we scarcely see each other anymore?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們現在幾乎都見不到面了？

sentences.en: Why did scarcely anyone come to the meeting?
sentences.zh: 為什麼幾乎沒有人來開會？

sentences.en: We scarcely noticed the time during the movie.
sentences.zh: 看電影時，我們幾乎沒注意到時間。

sentences.en: The shop had scarcely any customers on Monday.
sentences.zh: 這家店週一幾乎沒有客人。

gloss_note: scold sb for sth 因某事責罵

sentences.en: My mother scolded me for coming home late.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽罵我太晚回家。

sentences.en: Did the teacher scold the whole class?
sentences.zh: 老師有罵全班嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't scold the kids; they already said sorry.
sentences.zh: 請別罵孩子們，他們已經道歉了。

sentences.en: Why did your boss scold you in front of everyone?
sentences.zh: 你老闆為什麼當著大家的面罵你？

sentences.en: Dad scolded the dog for chewing his shoes.
sentences.zh: 爸爸罵狗咬壞他的鞋子。

sentences.en: Nobody likes being scolded in public.
sentences.zh: 沒有人喜歡在大庭廣眾下被罵。

gloss_note: a scoop of ice cream 一球冰淇淋

sentences.en: I'd like two scoops of vanilla ice cream, please.
sentences.zh: 我要兩球香草冰淇淋，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Could you scoop the rice into the bowls?
sentences.zh: 你可以把飯舀到碗裡嗎？

sentences.en: She added a scoop of protein powder to her smoothie.
sentences.zh: 她在果昔裡加了一勺蛋白粉。

sentences.en: How many scoops of coffee do I need for four cups?
sentences.zh: 煮四杯咖啡需要幾勺咖啡粉？

sentences.en: He used a spoon to scoop the seeds out of the pumpkin.
sentences.zh: 他用湯匙把南瓜籽挖出來。

sentences.en: Scoop the dough onto a baking sheet with a spoon.
sentences.zh: 用湯匙把麵糰舀到烤盤上。

sentences.en: Stop scratching your arm; it will only get worse.
sentences.zh: 別再抓你的手臂了，只會更嚴重。

sentences.en: My cat scratched the new sofa again.
sentences.zh: 我的貓又把新沙發抓壞了。

sentences.en: Did you scratch the car when you parked?
sentences.zh: 你停車的時候有刮到車嗎？

sentences.en: There is a deep scratch on my phone screen.
sentences.zh: 我的手機螢幕上有一道很深的刮痕。

sentences.en: How did you get that scratch on your knee?
sentences.zh: 你膝蓋上的擦傷是怎麼來的？

sentences.en: The dog scratched at the door to go outside.
sentences.zh: 狗在門上抓，想要出去。

gloss_note: under scrutiny 受到嚴格審查

sentences.en: The company's accounts are under close scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的帳目正受到嚴格審查。

sentences.en: Will the new budget survive scrutiny from the board?
sentences.zh: 新預算經得起董事會的仔細審查嗎？

sentences.en: His work didn't hold up under scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 他的工作成果經不起仔細檢視。

sentences.en: Why did the deal face so much scrutiny?
sentences.zh: 這筆交易為什麼受到這麼多審查？

sentences.en: Public scrutiny of the bank has grown since the report.
sentences.zh: 自從那份報告出爐，大眾對這家銀行的檢視越來越嚴格。

sentences.en: Every contract goes through careful scrutiny before we sign it.
sentences.zh: 每份合約簽署前都要經過仔細審查。

gloss_note: seaside town 海邊小鎮；美式較常說 beach

sentences.en: We booked a hotel in a small seaside town.
sentences.zh: 我們在一個海邊小鎮訂了飯店。

sentences.en: Is the seaside restaurant open for lunch?
sentences.zh: 那家海邊餐廳中午有營業嗎？

sentences.en: The seaside resort is quiet in winter.
sentences.zh: 這座海濱度假村冬天很安靜。

sentences.en: How far is the seaside hotel from the airport?
sentences.zh: 那間海邊的飯店離機場有多遠？

sentences.en: Our company picnic was at a seaside park this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我們公司的野餐辦在一座海邊公園。

sentences.en: A seaside cafe near the pier serves fresh seafood.
sentences.zh: 碼頭附近的一家海邊咖啡館供應新鮮海鮮。

gloss_note: secular trend 長期趨勢；正式

sentences.en: Economists see a secular decline in print advertising.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家認為平面廣告正出現長期衰退。

sentences.en: Is this a secular trend or just a short-term dip?
sentences.zh: 這是長期趨勢，還是只是短期下滑？

sentences.en: The report points to secular growth in online shopping.
sentences.zh: 報告指出網路購物呈現長期成長。

sentences.en: Why do analysts expect secular growth in the health care market?
sentences.zh: 分析師為什麼預期醫療保健市場會長期成長？

sentences.en: Our fund focuses on secular trends, not quarterly noise.
sentences.zh: 我們的基金著眼長期趨勢，而不是每季的短期波動。

sentences.en: Does the data show a secular change in how people shop?
sentences.zh: 這份數據顯示人們的購物方式出現長期改變了嗎？

sentences.en: Make sure your password is long and secure.
sentences.zh: 請確保你的密碼又長又安全。

sentences.en: Is this connection secure enough for online banking?
sentences.zh: 這個連線夠安全，可以用來做網路銀行嗎？

sentences.en: She finally found a secure job with good benefits.
sentences.zh: 她終於找到一份福利好又穩定的工作。

sentences.en: Check that the ladder is secure before you climb it.
sentences.zh: 爬上去之前，先確認梯子是穩固的。

sentences.en: Do you feel secure about your future at the company?
sentences.zh: 你對自己在公司的未來有安全感嗎？

sentences.en: The door was locked, so we felt secure.
sentences.zh: 門鎖好了，所以我們覺得很安心。

gloss_note: 不可數為主；river sediment 河川沉積物

sentences.en: Rivers carry sediment down to the sea.
sentences.zh: 河流把沉積物帶往大海。

sentences.en: Layers of sediment formed these rocks over millions of years.
sentences.zh: 這些岩石是由沉積物層層堆疊數百萬年形成的。

sentences.en: What happens to the sediment at the bottom of a lake?
sentences.zh: 湖底的沉積物會發生什麼變化？

sentences.en: Scientists studied the sediment to learn about past climates.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究沉積物，以了解過去的氣候。

sentences.en: Why is there sediment at the bottom of my water tank?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的水塔底部有沉積物？

sentences.en: Heavy rain washed sediment into the bay.
sentences.zh: 大雨把沉積物沖進了海灣。

gloss_note: a wide selection of 種類繁多的

sentences.en: The restaurant has a wide selection of desserts.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的甜點種類很多。

sentences.en: Do you have a good selection of cheeses?
sentences.zh: 你們有多樣的起司可以選嗎？

sentences.en: The wine selection here is small but excellent.
sentences.zh: 這裡的酒款不多，但都很精選。

sentences.en: How large is the selection of vegetarian dishes?
sentences.zh: 素食料理有多少種可以選？

sentences.en: The bakery's selection changes with every season.
sentences.zh: 這家麵包店的商品會隨季節更換。

sentences.en: I couldn't decide from the huge selection of ice cream flavors.
sentences.zh: 冰淇淋口味太多，我不知道該選哪個。

sentences.en: The university is highly selective about who it admits.
sentences.zh: 這所大學對錄取的學生非常嚴格篩選。

sentences.en: Be selective when you choose sources for your essay.
sentences.zh: 為論文挑選資料來源時要有所取捨。

sentences.en: Are you always so selective about what you eat?
sentences.zh: 你吃東西總是這麼挑嗎？

sentences.en: Selective memory can change how people recall events.
sentences.zh: 選擇性記憶會改變人們回想事件的方式。

sentences.en: How selective is the company when it hires new staff?
sentences.zh: 這家公司聘用新員工時有多嚴格篩選？

sentences.en: The survey used a selective sample of schools, so its results may be biased.
sentences.zh: 這項調查只挑選特定學校作為樣本，結果可能有偏差。

sentences.en: Babies learn through sensory experiences like touch and sound.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒透過觸覺和聲音等感官經驗來學習。

sentences.en: Some museums offer sensory rooms for young children.
sentences.zh: 有些博物館為幼童設有感官體驗室。

sentences.en: Can too much sensory input make you feel tired?
sentences.zh: 過多的感官刺激會讓人覺得累嗎？

sentences.en: Sensory nerves send signals from the skin to the brain.
sentences.zh: 感覺神經把訊號從皮膚傳到大腦。

sentences.en: What sensory details did the writer use in this paragraph?
sentences.zh: 作者在這一段用了哪些感官細節？

sentences.en: The sensory test measured how well she could smell and taste.
sentences.zh: 這項感官測試評估她的嗅覺和味覺有多靈敏。

sentences.en: Consumer sentiment dropped for the third month in a row.
sentences.zh: 消費者信心已連續三個月下滑。

sentences.en: Is investor sentiment turning positive this quarter?
sentences.zh: 本季投資人的情緒轉為樂觀了嗎？

sentences.en: Public sentiment turned against the price increase.
sentences.zh: 大眾的看法轉為反對漲價。

sentences.en: What does the survey say about customer sentiment?
sentences.zh: 這份調查對顧客的看法有什麼說法？

sentences.en: The report shows strong sentiment in favor of remote work.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示大家普遍贊成遠距工作。

sentences.en: How did market sentiment change after the earnings call?
sentences.zh: 財報電話會議後，市場情緒有什麼變化？

sentences.en: Early settlers built small farms near the river.
sentences.zh: 早期的拓荒者在河邊蓋了小農場。

sentences.en: The museum shows how the first settlers lived.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館展示第一批移民如何生活。

sentences.en: Why did so many settlers move west in the 1800s?
sentences.zh: 為什麼1800年代有那麼多移民往西遷移？

sentences.en: Many settlers faced harsh winters in the new land.
sentences.zh: 許多拓荒者在新土地上面對嚴酷的冬天。

sentences.en: Did the settlers bring seeds and tools with them?
sentences.zh: 拓荒者有帶著種子和工具來嗎？

sentences.en: The town was founded by a small group of settlers in 1850.
sentences.zh: 這座小鎮是由一小群移民在1850年建立的。

sentences.en: The storm caused severe damage to the roof.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了屋頂。

sentences.en: Is the pain severe enough to see a doctor?
sentences.zh: 疼痛嚴重到需要看醫生了嗎？

sentences.en: Severe weather is expected tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚預計會有惡劣的天氣。

sentences.en: How severe were the delays on the highway?
sentences.zh: 高速公路上的延誤有多嚴重？

sentences.en: She has a severe allergy to peanuts.
sentences.zh: 她對花生有嚴重的過敏。

sentences.en: A severe drought has hurt farmers across the region.
sentences.zh: 嚴重的乾旱重創了整個地區的農民。

gloss_note: sew on a button 縫上鈕釦

sentences.en: Can you sew a button back on my shirt?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把鈕釦縫回襯衫上嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother sews all her own curtains.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶的窗簾都是自己縫的。

sentences.en: I sewed the hole in my jeans last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚把牛仔褲上的破洞縫好了。

sentences.en: Where did you learn to sew?
sentences.zh: 你是在哪裡學會縫紉的？

sentences.en: She has sewn dozens of costumes for the school play.
sentences.zh: 她為學校的話劇縫製了幾十套戲服。

sentences.en: He is sewing a patch onto his backpack.
sentences.zh: 他正在把一塊補丁縫到背包上。

gloss_note: in the shade 在陰涼處

sentences.en: Let's sit in the shade; it's too hot out here.
sentences.zh: 我們去陰涼處坐吧，這裡太熱了。

sentences.en: Do you want to park the car in the shade?
sentences.zh: 你要把車停在陰涼的地方嗎？

sentences.en: The big oak tree gives shade to the whole yard.
sentences.zh: 那棵大橡樹為整個院子遮蔭。

sentences.en: Is there any shade at the playground?
sentences.zh: 遊樂場有任何遮蔭的地方嗎？

sentences.en: Tall buildings shade the street in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 高樓在下午會遮住這條街的陽光。

sentences.en: We planted two trees to shade the patio.
sentences.zh: 我們種了兩棵樹來為露臺遮蔭。

sentences.en: We found a shady spot under the trees for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們在樹下找到一處陰涼的地方吃午餐。

sentences.en: Is there a shady place to wait near the bus stop?
sentences.zh: 公車站附近有陰涼的地方可以等嗎？

sentences.en: The patio is nice and shady in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 露臺下午很涼爽，有遮蔭。

sentences.en: Let's walk on the shady side of the street.
sentences.zh: 我們走街道有遮蔭的那一邊吧。

sentences.en: Are the picnic tables shady at noon?
sentences.zh: 野餐桌在中午有遮蔭嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather loves to nap on the shady porch.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺喜歡在陰涼的門廊上小睡。

sentences.en: It is shameful to waste so much food.
sentences.zh: 浪費這麼多食物真是可恥。

sentences.en: Do you think his behavior at the party was shameful?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他在派對上的行為很丟臉嗎？

sentences.en: The company's treatment of its workers was shameful.
sentences.zh: 這家公司對待員工的方式令人不齒。

sentences.en: She felt it was shameful to lie to her parents.
sentences.zh: 她覺得對父母說謊是件丟臉的事。

sentences.en: Isn't it shameful that nobody helped him?
sentences.zh: 沒有人幫他，不是很可恥嗎？

sentences.en: The coach said the team's effort was shameful.
sentences.zh: 教練說這支球隊的表現很丟臉。

sentences.en: My dad shaves every morning before work.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每天早上上班前都會刮鬍子。

sentences.en: Did you shave before the job interview?
sentences.zh: 你面試前有刮鬍子嗎？

sentences.en: I need a new razor; this one doesn't shave well.
sentences.zh: 我需要一把新刮鬍刀，這把刮不乾淨。

sentences.en: He shaved his head for the summer.
sentences.zh: 他為了過夏天把頭髮剃光了。

sentences.en: How often do you shave?
sentences.zh: 你多久刮一次鬍子？

sentences.en: She cut her chin while shaving.
sentences.zh: 她刮鬍子時割傷了下巴。

gloss_note: shed jobs 裁員；shed costs 削減成本

sentences.en: The company plans to shed 500 jobs this year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司計畫今年裁減500個職位。

sentences.en: Will the retailer shed its unprofitable stores?
sentences.zh: 這家零售商會裁撤不賺錢的店面嗎？

sentences.en: We need to shed costs without hurting quality.
sentences.zh: 我們需要削減成本，但又不能傷害品質。

sentences.en: How many pounds did he shed before the wedding?
sentences.zh: 婚禮前他甩掉了多少磅體重？

sentences.en: The airline shed thousands of jobs during the downturn.
sentences.zh: 景氣低迷期間，這家航空公司裁減了數千個職位。

sentences.en: Shedding old debt helped the firm recover.
sentences.zh: 擺脫舊債務幫助這家公司恢復元氣。

sentences.en: We took shelter in a store when the storm hit.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來襲時，我們躲進了一家商店。

sentences.en: Where is the nearest shelter during a tornado?
sentences.zh: 龍捲風來時，最近的避難處在哪裡？

sentences.en: Volunteers set up a shelter after the flood.
sentences.zh: 洪水過後，志工搭建了一處避難所。

sentences.en: We ran into a cafe to shelter from the rain.
sentences.zh: 我們跑進一家咖啡館躲雨。

sentences.en: Does the bus stop offer any shelter from the wind?
sentences.zh: 這個公車站能擋風嗎？

sentences.en: The hikers built a simple shelter out of branches.
sentences.zh: 登山客用樹枝搭了一個簡單的遮蔽處。

gloss_note: shield sb from risk 使免於風險

sentences.en: The law shields small investors from fraud.
sentences.zh: 這項法律保護小額投資人免受詐騙。

sentences.en: Can insurance fully shield us from lawsuits?
sentences.zh: 保險能完全保護我們免於訴訟嗎？

sentences.en: A strong contract shields the company from risk.
sentences.zh: 一份嚴謹的合約能讓公司免於風險。

sentences.en: How do you shield your savings from inflation?
sentences.zh: 你如何保護自己的存款不受通貨膨脹影響？

sentences.en: A cash reserve helps shield the business from sudden losses.
sentences.zh: 現金儲備能保護公司免於突如其來的虧損。

sentences.en: Good planning can shield workers from sudden layoffs.
sentences.zh: 周全的規劃可以讓員工免於突然被裁員。

gloss_note: a shift in 在…上的轉變

sentences.en: There has been a big shift in how people shop.
sentences.zh: 人們購物的方式出現了很大的轉變。

sentences.en: Did the company shift its customer service to another city?
sentences.zh: 公司把客服轉移到別的城市了嗎？

sentences.en: Our focus will shift from sales to service next year.
sentences.zh: 明年我們的重心會從銷售轉向服務。

sentences.en: Why did public opinion shift so quickly?
sentences.zh: 為什麼民意轉變得這麼快？

sentences.en: The shift to remote work changed our office.
sentences.zh: 轉為遠距工作改變了我們的辦公室。

sentences.en: Shift your weight to your left foot.
sentences.zh: 把重心移到你的左腳上。

gloss_note: of great significance 非常重要

sentences.en: Do you understand the significance of this date?
sentences.zh: 你了解這個日期的重要意義嗎？

sentences.en: The significance of the discovery was clear to everyone.
sentences.zh: 這項發現的重要性對每個人來說都很明顯。

sentences.en: This test result has little significance for your health.
sentences.zh: 這項檢驗結果對你的健康影響不大。

sentences.en: What is the significance of the red door in the story?
sentences.zh: 故事裡那扇紅門有什麼意義？

sentences.en: Our teacher explained the historical significance of the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了這座老橋的歷史意義。

sentences.en: Does the price change have any significance for our budget?
sentences.zh: 這次價格調整對我們的預算有影響嗎？

sentences.en: The staff silently cleared the tables after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後，員工靜靜地收拾桌子。

sentences.en: Why did he sit silently through the whole meeting?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼整場會議都默不作聲？

sentences.en: Please close the door silently; the baby is asleep.
sentences.zh: 請輕輕把門關上，寶寶睡著了。

sentences.en: Everyone read the instructions silently before the test.
sentences.zh: 考試前，大家都默默地讀完說明。

sentences.en: She silently handed me the keys and left.
sentences.zh: 她默默地把鑰匙交給我就離開了。

sentences.en: Can you leave silently so you don't wake anyone?
sentences.zh: 你可以安靜地離開，以免吵醒別人嗎？

sentences.en: The software can simulate how a building handles an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體可以模擬建築物如何承受地震。

sentences.en: Pilots use machines that simulate real flights.
sentences.zh: 飛行員使用能模擬真實飛行的機器。

sentences.en: Can this program simulate traffic in a large city?
sentences.zh: 這個程式能模擬大城市的交通嗎？

sentences.en: Researchers simulated climate change with a computer model.
sentences.zh: 研究人員用電腦模型模擬氣候變遷。

sentences.en: How do engineers simulate a car crash safely?
sentences.zh: 工程師如何安全地模擬車禍？

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to simulate a job interview in pairs.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們兩人一組模擬求職面試。

sentences.en: I could hear the sincerity in her apology.
sentences.zh: 我聽得出她道歉時的真誠。

sentences.en: Do you doubt his sincerity?
sentences.zh: 你懷疑他的誠意嗎？

sentences.en: He thanked us with great sincerity.
sentences.zh: 他非常真誠地向我們道謝。

sentences.en: Sincerity matters more than fancy words in a speech.
sentences.zh: 演講中，真誠比華麗的詞藻更重要。

sentences.en: How can I show sincerity in a thank-you note?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼在感謝卡裡表達誠意？

sentences.en: Nobody questioned the sincerity of her promise.
sentences.zh: 沒有人質疑她承諾的誠意。

sentences.en: The construction site is closed on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 這個建築工地週日休工。

sentences.en: Where is the site of the new school?
sentences.zh: 新學校蓋在哪裡？

sentences.en: The site of the old factory will become a park.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠的所在地將會變成公園。

sentences.en: Did you visit the site before signing the lease?
sentences.zh: 簽租約前你有去看過場地嗎？

sentences.en: Workers must wear hard hats on the site.
sentences.zh: 工人在現場必須戴安全帽。

sentences.en: Is this a good site for our picnic?
sentences.zh: 這裡適合我們野餐嗎？

sentences.en: I'm skeptical about promises that sound too good.
sentences.zh: 對聽起來太好的承諾，我都抱持懷疑。

sentences.en: Are investors skeptical of the new plan?
sentences.zh: 投資人對新計畫抱持懷疑嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me a skeptical look when I said it was free.
sentences.zh: 我說這是免費的，她投來懷疑的眼神。

sentences.en: Why are you so skeptical about the results?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對這些結果這麼存疑？

sentences.en: Many customers remain skeptical about the new pricing.
sentences.zh: 許多顧客對新的定價仍然存疑。

sentences.en: Be skeptical of emails asking for your password.
sentences.zh: 對要求提供密碼的電子郵件要保持懷疑。

sentences.en: Could you make a quick sketch of the layout?
sentences.zh: 你可以快速畫一張配置草圖嗎？

sentences.en: She sketched the mountain from the car window.
sentences.zh: 她從車窗畫下了那座山的素描。

sentences.en: The architect showed us a rough sketch of the house.
sentences.zh: 建築師給我們看了房子的草圖。

sentences.en: Do you sketch when you're bored in class?
sentences.zh: 你在課堂上無聊時會畫素描嗎？

sentences.en: I made a sketch of the garden before planting.
sentences.zh: 種植前，我先畫了庭院的草圖。

sentences.en: He sketched a map on a napkin for us.
sentences.zh: 他在餐巾紙上為我們畫了一張簡圖。

gloss_note: tall skyscraper 高聳的摩天大樓

sentences.en: The new skyscraper will be the tallest building in the city.
sentences.zh: 這棟新的摩天大樓將是全市最高的建築。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to the top of a skyscraper?
sentences.zh: 你上過摩天大樓的頂樓嗎？

sentences.en: Our office is on the 40th floor of a skyscraper.
sentences.zh: 我們的辦公室在一棟摩天大樓的40樓。

sentences.en: Workers built the skyscraper in just three years.
sentences.zh: 工人只花三年就蓋好了這棟摩天大樓。

sentences.en: How many floors does that skyscraper have?
sentences.zh: 那棟摩天大樓有幾層樓？

sentences.en: From the hotel window we could see skyscrapers glowing at night.
sentences.zh: 從飯店窗戶可以看到摩天大樓在夜裡閃著光。

sentences.en: Demand has been slack since the holidays ended.
sentences.zh: 假期結束後，需求一直很疲軟。

sentences.en: Why are sales so slack this month?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個月的銷售這麼疲軟？

sentences.en: Business is always slack in January.
sentences.zh: 一月的生意總是很冷清。

sentences.en: Is hiring still slack in the construction industry?
sentences.zh: 營建業的招聘仍然冷清嗎？

sentences.en: Slack demand forced the factory to reduce output.
sentences.zh: 需求疲軟迫使工廠減少產量。

sentences.en: Business at the restaurant is slack on weekday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳平日下午生意很冷清。

sentences.en: The store slashed prices by half for the sale.
sentences.zh: 這家店為了促銷把價格砍到半價。

sentences.en: Will the company slash its marketing budget?
sentences.zh: 公司會大幅削減行銷預算嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans to slash spending on road repairs.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算大幅削減道路維修的支出。

sentences.en: How much did they slash the price of the old model?
sentences.zh: 他們把舊款的價格砍了多少？

sentences.en: The new manager wants to slash costs by 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 新經理想把成本大幅削減兩成。

sentences.en: Slashing prices too far can hurt profits.
sentences.zh: 價格砍得太低會傷害利潤。

gloss_note: 不可數；abolish slavery 廢除奴隸制

sentences.en: Slavery was practiced in many parts of the world for centuries.
sentences.zh: 奴隸制度在世界許多地方存在了好幾個世紀。

sentences.en: Our history class studied how slavery ended in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史課探討了美國奴隸制度如何結束。

sentences.en: When did slavery end in your country?
sentences.zh: 你的國家是什麼時候廢除奴隸制度的？

sentences.en: Museums teach visitors about the history of slavery.
sentences.zh: 博物館向參觀者介紹奴隸制度的歷史。

sentences.en: How did slavery shape the economy of the 1700s?
sentences.zh: 奴隸制度如何影響1700年代的經濟？

sentences.en: The novel describes a family's escape from slavery.
sentences.zh: 這本小說描寫一個家庭逃離奴隸制度的經過。

gloss_note: a slight chance 一點點機會

sentences.en: There was a slight delay at the airport.
sentences.zh: 機場有一點輕微的延誤。

sentences.en: Do you feel any slight pain when you walk?
sentences.zh: 你走路時有感覺到輕微的疼痛嗎？

sentences.en: I have a slight cold, but I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 我有點小感冒，但沒事。

sentences.en: Is there a slight chance of rain tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天有一點下雨的機率嗎？

sentences.en: The two prices show only a slight difference.
sentences.zh: 這兩個價格只有些微的差別。

sentences.en: She spoke with a slight accent.
sentences.zh: 她說話帶有一點點口音。

sentences.en: The shop's slogan is easy to remember.
sentences.zh: 這家店的標語很好記。

sentences.en: Can you think of a good slogan for our campaign?
sentences.zh: 你能為我們的宣傳活動想出好標語嗎？

sentences.en: The students painted a slogan on a big banner.
sentences.zh: 學生們把一句口號畫在大布條上。

sentences.en: Whose idea was this catchy slogan?
sentences.zh: 這句朗朗上口的標語是誰的點子？

sentences.en: A short slogan can stick in customers' minds.
sentences.zh: 簡短的標語能讓顧客印象深刻。

sentences.en: The team's slogan appeared on every T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 球隊的口號印在每一件T恤上。

sentences.en: Economists warn of a global economic slowdown.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家警告全球經濟將會放緩。

sentences.en: Is the slowdown in sales only temporary?
sentences.zh: 銷售放緩只是暫時的嗎？

sentences.en: The slowdown hit the housing market hardest.
sentences.zh: 這波放緩對房市衝擊最大。

sentences.en: What caused the slowdown in factory orders?
sentences.zh: 是什麼導致工廠接單速度放緩？

sentences.en: A slowdown in hiring worried many graduates.
sentences.zh: 招聘放緩讓許多應屆畢業生感到憂心。

sentences.en: The company froze spending during the slowdown.
sentences.zh: 在景氣放緩期間，公司凍結了支出。

sentences.en: The meeting went smoothly from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 會議從頭到尾都進行得很順利。

sentences.en: Did the flight land smoothly despite the wind?
sentences.zh: 儘管有風，班機降落還平穩嗎？

sentences.en: I hope the move goes smoothly next week.
sentences.zh: 我希望下週搬家一切順利。

sentences.en: How can we make the process run more smoothly?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎樣才能讓流程運作得更順暢？

sentences.en: The new system is working smoothly so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止，新系統運作得很順暢。

sentences.en: The engine runs smoothly after the repair.
sentences.zh: 修理之後，引擎運轉得很平順。

gloss_note: 作形容詞指「社會主義的」

sentences.en: In class, we learned that a socialist favors public ownership of industry.
sentences.zh: 課堂上我們學到，社會主義者主張產業公有。

sentences.en: Historians describe him as a socialist who wrote about labor.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家形容他是一位書寫勞工議題的社會主義者。

sentences.en: Was she a socialist when she was young?
sentences.zh: 她年輕時是社會主義者嗎？

sentences.en: The documentary profiles a socialist who organized factory workers in 1910.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片介紹一位在1910年組織工廠工人的社會主義者。

sentences.en: How did early socialists describe the factory system in the 1800s?
sentences.zh: 早期的社會主義者如何描述1800年代的工廠制度？

sentences.en: The book follows a young socialist in Europe.
sentences.zh: 這本書追隨一位歐洲年輕社會主義者的故事。

gloss_note: socially responsible 對社會負責的

sentences.en: Socially, remote work has changed how coworkers connect.
sentences.zh: 在社交層面，遠距工作改變了同事之間的聯繫方式。

sentences.en: Is it socially acceptable to text during a meeting?
sentences.zh: 在會議中傳訊息，社會上能接受嗎？

sentences.en: Our company wants to be socially responsible.
sentences.zh: 我們公司希望對社會負責。

sentences.en: He is shy and feels awkward socially.
sentences.zh: 他很害羞，在社交場合覺得很不自在。

sentences.en: Do you see your coworkers socially outside the office?
sentences.zh: 你下班後會和同事私下社交往來嗎？

sentences.en: The policy is economically sound but socially risky.
sentences.zh: 這項政策在經濟上合理，但在社會上有風險。

gloss_note: a pair of socks 一雙襪子

sentences.en: Do you sell wool socks for hiking?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣健行穿的羊毛襪嗎？

sentences.en: I packed two pairs of socks for the three-day trip.
sentences.zh: 我為這趟三天的旅程帶了兩雙襪子。

sentences.en: Why is there always one sock missing after laundry?
sentences.zh: 為什麼洗完衣服總是少一隻襪子？

sentences.en: He wore one black sock and one blue sock to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他開會時一隻腳穿黑襪、一隻腳穿藍襪。

sentences.en: The sign says shoes off, but socks are fine.
sentences.zh: 告示上寫要脫鞋，但穿襪子就可以。

sentences.en: The airline gave each passenger a pair of socks and an eye mask.
sentences.zh: 航空公司給每位乘客一雙襪子和一個眼罩。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: wall socket 牆上插座；美式多說 outlet

sentences.en: Is there a socket near the window for my laptop?
sentences.zh: 靠窗的地方有插座可以給我的筆電用嗎？

sentences.en: The socket in the kitchen stopped working.
sentences.zh: 廚房的插座壞了。

sentences.en: Don't plug too many things into one socket.
sentences.zh: 別在同一個插座插太多東西。

sentences.en: Could you check whether the wall socket has power?
sentences.zh: 你可以檢查一下牆上的插座有沒有電嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel room had only one socket by the bed.
sentences.zh: 那間飯店房間床邊只有一個插座。

sentences.en: You'll need an adapter to fit a European socket.
sentences.zh: 你需要轉接頭才能插進歐洲的插座。

sentences.en: Sodium is a soft metal that reacts strongly with water.
sentences.zh: 鈉是一種會與水劇烈反應的軟金屬。

sentences.en: Too much sodium in your diet can raise blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 飲食中鈉太多會使血壓升高。

sentences.en: How much sodium is in one serving of this soup?
sentences.zh: 這種湯一份含有多少鈉？

sentences.en: Why do sports drinks contain sodium?
sentences.zh: 運動飲料為什麼含有鈉？

sentences.en: The label says this snack is low in sodium.
sentences.zh: 標籤上說這種零食的鈉含量低。

sentences.en: My doctor told me to cut down on sodium.
sentences.zh: 醫生要我減少鈉的攝取。

gloss_note: 不可數；install software 安裝軟體

sentences.en: Do we have the software to open this file?
sentences.zh: 我們有能開這個檔案的軟體嗎？

sentences.en: The new accounting software saves us hours every week.
sentences.zh: 新的會計軟體每週替我們省下好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Make sure your antivirus software is up to date.
sentences.zh: 記得讓你的防毒軟體保持在最新版本。

sentences.en: Which software do you use to edit photos?
sentences.zh: 你用哪個軟體修照片？

sentences.en: Students in this class will learn how to test software.
sentences.zh: 這堂課的學生會學習如何測試軟體。

sentences.en: The report warns that pirated software often contains viruses.
sentences.zh: 報告警告，盜版軟體常帶有病毒。

sentences.en: Solar panels cover the roof of our school.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板覆蓋了我們學校的屋頂。

sentences.en: Is solar energy cheaper than electricity from coal?
sentences.zh: 太陽能比煤炭發的電便宜嗎？

sentences.en: We're thinking about installing a solar water heater at home.
sentences.zh: 我們正考慮在家裡裝太陽能熱水器。

sentences.en: The city plans to build a large solar farm next year.
sentences.zh: 這座城市計畫明年蓋一座大型太陽能發電場。

sentences.en: Do these solar lights turn on by themselves at night?
sentences.zh: 這些太陽能燈晚上會自己亮起來嗎？

sentences.en: The company sells solar equipment to local farmers.
sentences.zh: 這家公司向當地農民銷售太陽能設備。

sentences.en: Can a sovereign wealth fund buy shares in private companies?
sentences.zh: 主權財富基金可以購買民營公司的股票嗎？

sentences.en: Why do sovereign bonds pay less interest than corporate bonds?
sentences.zh: 為什麼主權債券的利息比公司債券低？

sentences.en: My analyst says sovereign debt is risky in some countries.
sentences.zh: 我的分析師說，某些國家的主權債務風險很高。

sentences.en: Each sovereign state can make its own laws.
sentences.zh: 每個主權國家都能制定自己的法律。

sentences.en: Several sovereign nations signed the trade agreement today.
sentences.zh: 幾個主權國家今天簽署了這項貿易協定。

sentences.en: Our client only buys sovereign bonds because they feel safe.
sentences.zh: 我們的客戶只買主權債券，因為覺得很安全。

sentences.en: The hotel has a spa on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 飯店二樓有一間水療中心。

sentences.en: I'd like to book a facial at your spa for Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我想預約星期六在你們水療中心做臉。

sentences.en: Does the spa close at nine tonight?
sentences.zh: 水療會館今晚九點打烊嗎？

sentences.en: My team spent a relaxing afternoon at a spa after the conference.
sentences.zh: 開完研討會後，我們團隊在水療會館度過了放鬆的下午。

sentences.en: Is the spa included in the room price?
sentences.zh: 房價有包含水療中心嗎？

sentences.en: She gave her mother a spa gift card for her birthday.
sentences.zh: 她送媽媽水療禮券當生日禮物。

sentences.en: Hand me the spade, please.
sentences.zh: 請把鏟子遞給我。

sentences.en: Dig the hole with a spade, not with your hands.
sentences.zh: 用鏟子挖洞，不要用手。

sentences.en: Do we still have a spade in the garage?
sentences.zh: 車庫裡還有鏟子嗎？

sentences.en: My grandpa sharpened his spade before planting the roses.
sentences.zh: 爺爺種玫瑰前先把鏟子磨利了。

sentences.en: Does this hardware store sell garden spades?
sentences.zh: 這家五金行有賣園藝鏟嗎？

sentences.en: The farmer used a spade to turn over the soil.
sentences.zh: 農夫用鏟子翻土。

gloss_note: spam filter 垃圾郵件過濾器

sentences.en: My inbox is full of spam again.
sentences.zh: 我的收件匣又塞滿了垃圾郵件。

sentences.en: Is this message spam or a real request?
sentences.zh: 這封信是垃圾郵件，還是真的請求？

sentences.en: The spam filter blocked the email from our client.
sentences.zh: 垃圾郵件過濾器擋掉了客戶寄來的信。

sentences.en: Please don't open attachments in spam.
sentences.zh: 請不要開啟垃圾郵件裡的附件。

sentences.en: How do I stop spam from reaching my work account?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼讓垃圾郵件不要寄到我的工作信箱？

sentences.en: Most spam tries to get you to click a link.
sentences.zh: 大部分垃圾郵件都想騙你點連結。

gloss_note: spare tire 備胎；spare key 備用鑰匙

sentences.en: Do you have a spare key to the office?
sentences.zh: 你有辦公室的備用鑰匙嗎？

sentences.en: I always keep a spare charger in my bag.
sentences.zh: 我包包裡總是放著一條備用充電器。

sentences.en: Is there a spare room for guests in your house?
sentences.zh: 你家有多出來的房間可以給客人住嗎？

sentences.en: We don't have any spare chairs for the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們沒有多餘的椅子可以給會議用。

sentences.en: The driver replaced the flat tire with the spare tire.
sentences.zh: 司機用備胎換掉了爆掉的輪胎。

sentences.en: Take a spare shirt in case the airline loses your bag.
sentences.zh: 帶一件備用襯衫，以防航空公司弄丟你的行李。

sentences.en: A spark from the campfire landed on the dry grass.
sentences.zh: 營火的火星掉在乾草上。

sentences.en: Can a new logo spark interest in our brand?
sentences.zh: 新標誌能引起大家對我們品牌的興趣嗎？

sentences.en: The speech sparked a long debate among the staff.
sentences.zh: 這場演說在員工之間引發了一場長時間的辯論。

sentences.en: Did a loose wire spark and start the fire?
sentences.zh: 是電線鬆脫產生火花，才引起火災的嗎？

sentences.en: I saw a spark when I plugged in the old heater.
sentences.zh: 我把舊電暖器插上電時看到了火花。

sentences.en: The price cut could spark a wave of new orders.
sentences.zh: 降價可能引發一波新訂單。

sentences.en: The museum has an old spear from the Stone Age.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一支石器時代的舊長矛。

sentences.en: Did early hunters really use a spear to catch fish?
sentences.zh: 早期的獵人真的用魚叉捕魚嗎？

sentences.en: Hunters in the film carry a wooden spear.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的獵人帶著木製長矛。

sentences.en: The guide showed us how villagers used a spear to fish.
sentences.zh: 嚮導示範了村民如何用魚叉捕魚。

sentences.en: Is that a real spear or just a prop?
sentences.zh: 那是真的長矛還是只是道具？

sentences.en: The boy made a toy spear from a tree branch.
sentences.zh: 那個男孩用樹枝做了一支玩具長矛。

sentences.en: This cake was specially made for your birthday.
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕是特地為你的生日做的。

sentences.en: Is this bag specially designed for laptops?
sentences.zh: 這個包包是專門為筆電設計的嗎？

sentences.en: The room was specially cleaned for our important guests.
sentences.zh: 這個房間是特別為我們的貴賓打掃的。

sentences.en: We ordered a specially printed banner for the event.
sentences.zh: 我們為這場活動訂了一條特別印製的布條。

sentences.en: Our drivers are specially trained to handle large trucks.
sentences.zh: 我們的司機受過專門訓練，能駕駛大型卡車。

sentences.en: Was the menu specially prepared for people with allergies?
sentences.zh: 這份菜單是專為有過敏的人準備的嗎？

gloss_note: 單複數同形：one species, two species

sentences.en: Is this plant a protected species?
sentences.zh: 這種植物是保育物種嗎？

sentences.en: How many species of frogs live in this park?
sentences.zh: 這座公園裡住著多少種青蛙？

sentences.en: Many species are disappearing because of pollution.
sentences.zh: 許多物種正因污染而消失。

sentences.en: Scientists found a new species of ant last year.
sentences.zh: 科學家去年發現了一種新的螞蟻物種。

sentences.en: My daughter is studying an endangered species for her science project.
sentences.zh: 我女兒正為自然科學作業研究一種瀕臨絕種的物種。

sentences.en: The zoo is home to over fifty species of birds.
sentences.zh: 動物園裡有超過五十種鳥類。

sentences.en: Buying that stock is too speculative for me.
sentences.zh: 買那檔股票對我來說太投機了。

sentences.en: Is it speculative to invest in a startup this early?
sentences.zh: 這麼早投資新創公司算投機嗎？

sentences.en: The reporter's story is purely speculative.
sentences.zh: 那名記者的報導純屬推測。

sentences.en: Many speculative buyers pushed up housing prices.
sentences.zh: 許多投機買家推高了房價。

sentences.en: I don't want to make speculative claims without data.
sentences.zh: 沒有數據的話，我不想做出推測性的說法。

sentences.en: Are those numbers real, or just speculative?
sentences.zh: 那些數字是真的，還是只是推測？

gloss_note: spicy food 辣的食物；mild 不辣

sentences.en: Is the soup spicy, or can kids eat it?
sentences.zh: 這道湯辣嗎？小孩可以吃嗎？

sentences.en: Can you make the noodles less spicy, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把麵做得不那麼辣嗎？

sentences.en: My mother cooks really spicy beef noodles on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽週末會煮非常辣的牛肉麵。

sentences.en: Spicy food can upset your stomach if you eat too much.
sentences.zh: 辣的食物吃太多會讓你胃不舒服。

sentences.en: This spicy sauce goes well with fried rice.
sentences.zh: 這種辣醬跟炒飯很搭。

sentences.en: Customers love our spicy wings, so we make extra every Friday.
sentences.zh: 客人很愛我們的辣雞翅，所以每週五我們都多做一些。

sentences.en: Does music give you spiritual comfort?
sentences.zh: 音樂能帶給你心靈上的慰藉嗎？

sentences.en: Taking a quiet walk is good for my spiritual health.
sentences.zh: 安靜散步對我的心靈健康有益。

sentences.en: Many people travel to the mountains for spiritual peace.
sentences.zh: 許多人到山上尋求心靈的平靜。

sentences.en: Reading can support a child's spiritual growth.
sentences.zh: 閱讀有助於孩子的心靈成長。

sentences.en: Is spiritual happiness more important than money?
sentences.zh: 精神上的快樂比金錢更重要嗎？

sentences.en: After the long illness, he found spiritual strength in his family.
sentences.zh: 久病之後，他從家人身上找到了精神力量。

gloss_note: 語氣老派稍正式，美式口語常說 great

sentences.en: We had a splendid view of the lake from our room.
sentences.zh: 我們從房間裡可以看到壯麗的湖景。

sentences.en: Did you see the splendid fireworks last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有看到那場壯麗的煙火嗎？

sentences.en: That's a splendid idea for the new campaign.
sentences.zh: 那是個很棒的新宣傳活動點子。

sentences.en: The chef prepared a splendid dinner for the guests.
sentences.zh: 主廚為客人準備了一頓極棒的晚餐。

sentences.en: Is the new library as splendid as people say?
sentences.zh: 新圖書館真的像大家說的那麼壯麗嗎？

sentences.en: The orchestra gave a splendid performance on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 管弦樂團週六晚上的演出極為精采。

gloss_note: split the bill 平分帳單

sentences.en: Can we split the bill four ways?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把帳單分成四份各付嗎？

sentences.en: Let's split the work between the two teams.
sentences.zh: 我們把工作分給兩個團隊分擔吧。

sentences.en: The two roommates split the rent equally.
sentences.zh: 兩位室友平均分攤房租。

sentences.en: Do you want to split this dessert with me?
sentences.zh: 你想跟我一起分著吃這份甜點嗎？

sentences.en: The class split into small groups for the project.
sentences.zh: 全班分成小組來做這項專題。

sentences.en: The company decided to split the profit with its workers.
sentences.zh: 公司決定把利潤分給員工。

sentences.en: The company spokesman will answer your questions at noon.
sentences.zh: 公司發言人將於中午回答你們的問題。

sentences.en: Who will be the spokesman at tomorrow's press event?
sentences.zh: 明天的記者會誰要擔任發言人？

sentences.en: A hotel spokesman said the guests were safe.
sentences.zh: 一位飯店發言人表示，房客們都很安全。

sentences.en: Could you send the spokesman a copy of this statement?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這份聲明的副本寄給發言人嗎？

sentences.en: Has our spokesman called the reporters back yet?
sentences.zh: 我們的發言人回電給記者了嗎？

sentences.en: The team chose Mark as its spokesman for the client meeting.
sentences.zh: 團隊選了馬克在客戶會議上擔任發言人。

gloss_note: spontaneous decision 臨時起意的決定

sentences.en: It was a spontaneous trip, so we booked nothing.
sentences.zh: 那是一趟臨時起意的旅行，所以我們什麼都沒訂。

sentences.en: The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer when the team arrived.
sentences.zh: 球隊抵達時，群眾自發地歡呼了起來。

sentences.en: I love spontaneous dinners with friends after work.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡下班後和朋友臨時起意聚餐。

sentences.en: Was the decision planned, or was it spontaneous?
sentences.zh: 這個決定是事先規劃的，還是臨時起意的？

sentences.en: Are you the spontaneous type, or do you plan everything?
sentences.zh: 你是隨興的人，還是凡事都要計畫？

sentences.en: Researchers found that spontaneous laughter helps students relax.
sentences.zh: 研究人員發現，自發的笑聲能幫助學生放鬆。

gloss_note: 夫妻其中一方，男女通用，較正式

sentences.en: Please write your spouse's name on this form.
sentences.zh: 請在這張表格上填寫你配偶的姓名。

sentences.en: Is your spouse coming to the company dinner?
sentences.zh: 你的配偶會來參加公司聚餐嗎？

sentences.en: Employees can add a spouse to their health plan.
sentences.zh: 員工可以把配偶加入自己的健康保險方案。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a discount if your spouse joins you.
sentences.zh: 如果配偶與你同行，飯店提供折扣。

sentences.en: Would you and your spouse like a table by the window?
sentences.zh: 你和你的配偶想坐窗邊的位子嗎？

sentences.en: My spouse picked up the kids while I worked late.
sentences.zh: 我加班的時候，我的配偶去接了孩子。

gloss_note: sprinkle sugar on 在上面撒糖

sentences.en: Sprinkle some cheese on top of the pasta.
sentences.zh: 在義大利麵上面撒些起司。

sentences.en: Could you sprinkle extra sugar on my pancakes?
sentences.zh: 你能在我的鬆餅上多撒一點糖嗎？

sentences.en: Do I sprinkle the salt before or after cooking?
sentences.zh: 我該在烹調前還是烹調後撒鹽？

sentences.en: She sprinkled water on the plants before leaving.
sentences.zh: 她出門前往植物上灑了些水。

sentences.en: The baker sprinkled sugar on every cookie.
sentences.zh: 烘焙師傅在每塊餅乾上都撒了糖。

sentences.en: Please sprinkle salt on the icy steps.
sentences.zh: 請在結冰的台階上撒些鹽。

sentences.en: Lower interest rates may spur spending.
sentences.zh: 較低的利率可能刺激消費。

sentences.en: What could spur sales during the slow season?
sentences.zh: 淡季時有什麼能刺激買氣？

sentences.en: The bonus plan was meant to spur the sales team.
sentences.zh: 這個獎金計畫的目的是激勵業務團隊。

sentences.en: Do you think a price cut will spur demand?
sentences.zh: 你覺得降價會刺激需求嗎？

sentences.en: Competition can spur companies to improve their products.
sentences.zh: 競爭能促使公司改進他們的產品。

sentences.en: A good discount might spur customers to buy more.
sentences.zh: 優惠的折扣或許能刺激顧客多買一些。

gloss_note: stab A with B 用 B 戳 A

sentences.en: She stabbed a piece of fruit with her fork.
sentences.zh: 她用叉子叉起一塊水果。

sentences.en: Stab the potato with a fork a few times before baking.
sentences.zh: 烤馬鈴薯之前，先用叉子戳幾下。

sentences.en: Why did you stab the box with a pen?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼拿筆戳那個箱子？

sentences.en: The report says one man was stabbed in the arm.
sentences.zh: 報導說有一名男子手臂被刺傷。

sentences.en: Did you stab the cake with a toothpick to see if it's done?
sentences.zh: 你有用牙籤戳蛋糕，看熟了沒嗎？

sentences.en: The child stabbed the clay with a stick to make holes.
sentences.zh: 小孩用棍子戳黏土做出洞來。

sentences.en: The central bank acted to stabilize prices.
sentences.zh: 中央銀行採取行動穩定物價。

sentences.en: Will the market stabilize after the holidays?
sentences.zh: 假期過後市場會趨穩嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor said his condition should stabilize soon.
sentences.zh: 醫生說他的狀況應該很快就會穩定下來。

sentences.en: Use a tripod to stabilize your camera.
sentences.zh: 用三腳架讓你的相機保持穩定。

sentences.en: How can we stabilize sales during the winter months?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在冬季月份穩定銷售？

sentences.en: Her breathing finally stabilized after she rested.
sentences.zh: 休息之後，她的呼吸終於穩定下來。

sentences.en: Negotiations stalled over the price.
sentences.zh: 談判因價格問題陷入停滯。

sentences.en: Why did the deal stall at the last minute?
sentences.zh: 這筆交易為什麼在最後一刻卡住了？

sentences.en: Stop stalling and tell me the truth.
sentences.zh: 別再拖延了，告訴我實話。

sentences.en: Sales stalled in the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 第三季的銷售陷入停滯。

sentences.en: Is he trying to stall until the deadline passes?
sentences.zh: 他是不是想拖到期限過去？

sentences.en: The supplier keeps stalling, so we can't ship the order.
sentences.zh: 供應商一直拖延，所以我們無法出貨。

gloss_note: take a stance 表明立場

sentences.en: What is the company's stance on remote work?
sentences.zh: 公司對遠距工作的立場是什麼？

sentences.en: Our manager took a firm stance on late reports.
sentences.zh: 我們經理對遲交報告採取強硬立場。

sentences.en: I understand your stance, but I disagree.
sentences.zh: 我了解你的立場，但我不同意。

sentences.en: Has the airline changed its stance on refunds?
sentences.zh: 航空公司對退款的立場改變了嗎？

sentences.en: The school's stance on cell phones is very clear.
sentences.zh: 學校對手機的立場很明確。

sentences.en: The writer's stance on school uniforms is easy to see in this essay.
sentences.zh: 從這篇文章很容易看出作者對校服的立場。

sentences.en: We ran out of staples, so please order more.
sentences.zh: 我們的釘書針用完了，所以請再訂購一些。

sentences.en: Could you staple these pages together for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這幾頁釘在一起嗎？

sentences.en: Please staple your receipt to the form.
sentences.zh: 請把收據釘在表格上。

sentences.en: Is there a staple stuck in the copy machine?
sentences.zh: 影印機裡是不是卡了一根釘書針？

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to staple the quiz to our homework.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們把小考卷釘在作業上。

sentences.en: A box of staples costs only two dollars.
sentences.zh: 一盒釘書針只要兩美元。

sentences.en: Where did you put the stapler?
sentences.zh: 你把釘書機放哪了？

sentences.en: Could I borrow your stapler for a minute?
sentences.zh: 可以跟你借釘書機用一下嗎？

sentences.en: This stapler jams almost every time I use it.
sentences.zh: 我幾乎每次用這台釘書機都會卡針。

sentences.en: That store sells a big stapler for thick reports.
sentences.zh: 那家店賣可以釘厚報告的大型釘書機。

sentences.en: The teacher keeps a red stapler on her desk.
sentences.zh: 老師的桌上放著一台紅色釘書機。

sentences.en: My son wants a stapler for his school project.
sentences.zh: 我兒子想要一台釘書機來做學校專題。

gloss_note: static 也可作名詞：靜電、雜訊

sentences.en: The company cannot stay static in a fast-changing market.
