sentences.zh: 公司在快速變動的市場中不能一成不變。

sentences.en: Is the population of this town static or growing?
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮的人口是維持不變，還是在成長？

sentences.en: Wages stayed static for the last five years.
sentences.zh: 薪資在過去五年一直停滯不變。

sentences.en: Do you prefer static pictures or moving videos?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡靜態圖片還是動態影片？

sentences.en: Sales have been static since January.
sentences.zh: 銷售量從一月以來一直沒有變動。

sentences.en: Culture is not static; it changes over time.
sentences.zh: 文化不是一成不變的，它會隨時間改變。

gloss_note: 常用複數；statistics 也指統計學

sentences.en: That statistic surprised everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 那個統計數字讓房裡的每個人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Where did you find that statistic?
sentences.zh: 你是在哪裡找到那個統計數字的？

sentences.en: One statistic in the report looks wrong to me.
sentences.zh: 報告裡有一個統計數字我覺得不對。

sentences.en: The teacher shared a surprising statistic about sleep.
sentences.zh: 老師分享了一個關於睡眠的驚人統計數字。

sentences.en: Is this statistic from this year or last year?
sentences.zh: 這個統計數字是今年的還是去年的？

sentences.en: Every statistic in the presentation came from a reliable source.
sentences.zh: 簡報中的每個統計數字都來自可靠的來源。

sentences.en: The difference is statistically significant.
sentences.zh: 這個差異在統計上具有顯著性。

sentences.en: Statistically, flying is safer than driving.
sentences.zh: 就統計而言，搭飛機比開車安全。

sentences.en: Are these survey results statistically reliable?
sentences.zh: 這些調查結果在統計上可靠嗎？

sentences.en: Statistically speaking, most customers buy within a week.
sentences.zh: 就統計而言，大多數客人在一週內就會購買。

sentences.en: Why are the two groups so different statistically?
sentences.zh: 這兩組為什麼在統計上差這麼多？

sentences.en: Statistically, our team finishes more projects than other teams.
sentences.zh: 就統計而言，我們團隊完成的專案比其他團隊多。

sentences.en: Can you check the status of my order?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我查一下我的訂單狀態嗎？

sentences.en: Please update your status in the system.
sentences.zh: 請在系統中更新你的狀態。

sentences.en: Please write your marital status on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的婚姻狀況。

sentences.en: The flight status changed to delayed.
sentences.zh: 班機狀態變成了延誤。

sentences.en: What is the status of the new project?
sentences.zh: 新專案目前的狀況如何？

sentences.en: Some people care too much about social status.
sentences.zh: 有些人太在意社會地位。

sentences.en: Could you steer the conversation back to the budget?
sentences.zh: 你可以把話題引導回預算上嗎？

sentences.en: The new CEO will steer the company through a hard year.
sentences.zh: 新任執行長會帶領公司度過艱困的一年。

sentences.en: It's hard to steer a big truck in a small parking lot.
sentences.zh: 在小停車場裡駕駛大卡車很困難。

sentences.en: My dad taught me how to steer a boat.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸教過我怎麼駕駛小船。

sentences.en: Can you steer me toward a good Italian restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我指點一家好吃的義大利餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: Her advice helped steer me toward a better career.
sentences.zh: 她的建議引導我走向更好的職涯。

sentences.en: Cut the stem at an angle before putting the flowers in water.
sentences.zh: 把花莖斜剪，再把花插進水裡。

sentences.en: Her fear of flying stems from a bad experience.
sentences.zh: 她對搭飛機的恐懼源自一次不好的經驗。

sentences.en: Most of the complaints stem from late deliveries.
sentences.zh: 大部分的客訴都源自於延遲交貨。

sentences.en: Does the problem stem from the software or the hardware?
sentences.zh: 這個問題是源自軟體還是硬體？

sentences.en: Pull the leaves off the stems and chop them.
sentences.zh: 把葉子從莖上摘下來切碎。

sentences.en: Do these health problems stem from poor diet?
sentences.zh: 這些健康問題是源自不良飲食嗎？

sentences.en: Turn down the stereo, please. The baby is sleeping.
sentences.zh: 請把音響關小聲一點，寶寶在睡覺。

sentences.en: Did you buy a new stereo for the living room?
sentences.zh: 你有買新音響放客廳嗎？

sentences.en: Our car's stereo stopped working yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們車子的音響昨天壞了。

sentences.en: Can you hear the stereo from the next room?
sentences.zh: 你在隔壁房間聽得到音響的聲音嗎？

sentences.en: This old stereo still sounds great.
sentences.zh: 這台老音響聽起來還是很棒。

sentences.en: The band recorded the album in stereo in 1975.
sentences.zh: 樂團在1975年以立體聲錄製了這張專輯。

gloss_note: gender stereotype 性別刻板印象

sentences.en: Many stereotypes about teenagers are simply wrong.
sentences.zh: 許多關於青少年的刻板印象根本是錯的。

sentences.en: Do you think this ad reinforces a stereotype?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這則廣告強化了刻板印象嗎？

sentences.en: Try not to judge candidates by a stereotype.
sentences.zh: 別用刻板印象去評斷應徵者。

sentences.en: The movie breaks the stereotype that scientists are boring.
sentences.zh: 這部電影打破了科學家很無趣的刻板印象。

sentences.en: Where does the stereotype about older workers come from?
sentences.zh: 對年長員工的刻板印象是從哪裡來的？

sentences.en: Teachers should help students challenge stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 老師應該幫助學生挑戰刻板印象。

sentences.en: Visitors must wear a name sticker at all times.
sentences.zh: 訪客必須隨時貼著名牌貼紙。

sentences.en: Where can I buy stickers for my notebook?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以買到貼我筆記本用的貼紙？

sentences.en: The price sticker is still on the gift box.
sentences.zh: 價格貼紙還貼在禮物盒上。

sentences.en: Do you have any stickers for kids?
sentences.zh: 你們有給小孩的貼紙嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter covered her water bottle with stickers.
sentences.zh: 我女兒把她的水壺貼滿了貼紙。

sentences.en: The inspection sticker on the car expires next month.
sentences.zh: 車子上的檢驗貼紙下個月到期。

sentences.en: She wore black stockings with her dress.
sentences.zh: 她穿著黑色長襪搭配洋裝。

sentences.en: Do you sell wool stockings for winter?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣冬天穿的羊毛長襪嗎？

sentences.en: I found a hole in my stocking this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上發現我的長襪破了一個洞。

sentences.en: The kids hung their Christmas stockings by the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把聖誕襪掛在壁爐旁。

sentences.en: Are these stockings long enough to cover my knees?
sentences.zh: 這雙長襪夠長，能蓋住我的膝蓋嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother knits warm wool stockings every winter.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年冬天都織保暖的羊毛長襪。

sentences.en: The application process is pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 申請流程相當簡單明瞭。

sentences.en: Can you give me a straightforward answer?
sentences.zh: 你能給我一個坦率的答案嗎？

sentences.en: Her instructions were clear and straightforward.
sentences.zh: 她的說明既清楚又簡單明瞭。

sentences.en: I like how straightforward our new manager is.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡我們新主管的坦率。

sentences.en: Is the refund policy straightforward, or full of exceptions?
sentences.zh: 退款政策是簡單明瞭，還是有一堆例外？

sentences.en: The test was straightforward if you studied the notes.
sentences.zh: 如果你有讀筆記，這場考試就很簡單。

gloss_note: a strand of hair 一縷頭髮

sentences.en: Why is there a strand of hair in my soup?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的湯裡有一縷頭髮？

sentences.en: She tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear.
sentences.zh: 她把一縷鬆脫的頭髮塞到耳後。

sentences.en: Rope is made by twisting many strands together.
sentences.zh: 繩子是把許多股纖維擰在一起做成的。

sentences.en: Each strand of the spider web was covered in dew.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛網的每一條絲上都沾滿了露水。

sentences.en: Can you cut one strand of the wire and test it?
sentences.zh: 你能剪下一股電線來測試嗎？

sentences.en: The scarf is made from several strands of wool.
sentences.zh: 這條圍巾是用好幾股羊毛線織成的。

gloss_note: streamline the process 簡化流程

sentences.en: We need to streamline our hiring process.
sentences.zh: 我們需要精簡招募流程。

sentences.en: How can we streamline the approval steps?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼簡化核准的步驟？

sentences.en: The new system will streamline billing for all departments.
sentences.zh: 新系統會簡化所有部門的請款作業。

sentences.en: Can this software streamline our inventory reports?
sentences.zh: 這個軟體能簡化我們的庫存報告作業嗎？

sentences.en: The airline streamlined check-in to shorten the lines.
sentences.zh: 航空公司簡化了報到流程，以縮短排隊人龍。

sentences.en: Streamlining the menu helped the restaurant save money.
sentences.zh: 精簡菜單幫餐廳省下了錢。

sentences.en: Exercise can strengthen your bones and muscles.
sentences.zh: 運動可以強化你的骨骼和肌肉。

sentences.en: How can we strengthen our team's communication?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼加強團隊的溝通？

sentences.en: The city will strengthen the old bridge before winter.
sentences.zh: 市政府會在冬天前加固這座舊橋。

sentences.en: Do these exercises really strengthen your back?
sentences.zh: 這些運動真的能強化你的背部嗎？

sentences.en: Working on the project together strengthened our friendship.
sentences.zh: 一起做這個專題強化了我們的友誼。

sentences.en: We should strengthen the lock on the back door.
sentences.zh: 我們應該加強後門的鎖。

sentences.en: I like the shirt with the blue stripes.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡那件藍色條紋的襯衫。

sentences.en: Do you have this tie with thinner stripes?
sentences.zh: 這條領帶有條紋比較細的款式嗎？

sentences.en: A zebra has black and white stripes.
sentences.zh: 斑馬有黑白相間的條紋。

sentences.en: The road sign has a white stripe across the middle.
sentences.zh: 路標中間有一道白色條紋。

sentences.en: Why do tigers have stripes?
sentences.zh: 老虎為什麼有條紋？

sentences.en: The painter added a yellow stripe along the wall.
sentences.zh: 油漆工在牆上加了一道黃色條紋。

gloss_note: strive to V 努力做到；strive for 爭取

sentences.en: We strive to answer every email within a day.
sentences.zh: 我們努力在一天內回覆每封電子郵件。

sentences.en: Why do you strive for perfection in everything?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼凡事都力求完美？

sentences.en: The company strives to treat customers fairly.
sentences.zh: 公司努力公平對待客戶。

sentences.en: Students should strive to do their best on the exam.
sentences.zh: 學生應該在考試中盡力而為。

sentences.en: Do you strive to read for thirty minutes every day?
sentences.zh: 你會努力每天閱讀三十分鐘嗎？

sentences.en: Our hotel strives to make every guest comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店致力於讓每位客人都感到舒適。

sentences.en: My grandfather had a stroke last year.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺去年中風了。

sentences.en: Can high blood pressure cause a stroke?
sentences.zh: 高血壓會導致中風嗎？

sentences.en: A stroke can happen suddenly, without any warning.
sentences.zh: 中風可能毫無預警地突然發生。

sentences.en: Does your family have a history of stroke?
sentences.zh: 你的家族有中風病史嗎？

sentences.en: She recovered well after the stroke and returned to work.
sentences.zh: 她中風後恢復得很好，已經回去上班了。

sentences.en: Doctors say regular exercise lowers your risk of stroke.
sentences.zh: 醫生說規律運動可以降低中風的風險。

sentences.en: Is that review fair, or is it just subjective?
sentences.zh: 那則評論公平嗎，還是只是主觀的？

sentences.en: Beauty is subjective, so people will never fully agree.
sentences.zh: 美是主觀的，所以大家永遠無法完全達成共識。

sentences.en: Her view of the meeting was very subjective.
sentences.zh: 她對那場會議的看法非常主觀。

sentences.en: Teachers try not to be subjective when they grade essays.
sentences.zh: 老師批改作文時會盡量不要太主觀。

sentences.en: How subjective is the manager's performance review?
sentences.zh: 經理的績效考核有多主觀？

sentences.en: Taste in music is subjective, so I won't argue.
sentences.zh: 音樂品味很主觀，所以我不跟你爭。

gloss_note: 簡稱 sub；submarine sandwich 潛艇堡

sentences.en: The museum has a real submarine you can tour.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有一艘可以參觀的真潛水艇。

sentences.en: How long can a submarine stay under water?
sentences.zh: 潛水艇可以在水下待多久？

sentences.en: My brother wants to build a toy submarine.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟想做一艘玩具潛水艇。

sentences.en: In the movie, the submarine sank to the ocean floor.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，那艘潛水艇沉到了海底。

sentences.en: Did you see the old submarine at the harbor?
sentences.zh: 你有看到港口那艘老潛水艇嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists used a small submarine to study deep-sea fish.
sentences.zh: 科學家用一艘小型潛水艇研究深海魚類。

sentences.en: Many banks lost money on subprime mortgages in 2008.
sentences.zh: 2008年，許多銀行在次級房貸上虧了錢。

sentences.en: What exactly is a subprime loan?
sentences.zh: 次級貸款到底是什麼？

sentences.en: Subprime borrowers usually pay higher interest rates.
sentences.zh: 次級借款人通常要付較高的利率。

sentences.en: Did the bank stop offering subprime car loans?
sentences.zh: 那家銀行停止提供次級汽車貸款了嗎？

sentences.en: Our professor explained how subprime lending caused the crisis.
sentences.zh: 我們教授說明了次級放貸如何引發那場危機。

sentences.en: He couldn't get a regular loan, so he took a subprime one.
sentences.zh: 他申請不到一般貸款，所以辦了次級貸款。

gloss_note: 常用於生物、化學、材料學

sentences.en: Moss grows best on a damp rock substrate.
sentences.zh: 苔蘚在潮濕的岩石基質上長得最好。

sentences.en: What kind of substrate do these plants need?
sentences.zh: 這些植物需要哪一種基質？

sentences.en: The thin film is placed on a glass substrate.
sentences.zh: 這層薄膜鋪在玻璃底層上。

sentences.en: Fungi feed on the substrate they grow on.
sentences.zh: 真菌以所生長的基質為食。

sentences.en: Does the coating stick well to the plastic substrate?
sentences.zh: 這層塗料能牢牢附著在塑膠底層上嗎？

sentences.en: The students tested three substrates for growing bean seeds.
sentences.zh: 學生測試了三種種豆子的基質。

gloss_note: a subtle difference 細微差異

sentences.en: There is a subtle difference between these two colors.
sentences.zh: 這兩種顏色之間有細微的差異。

sentences.en: Can you taste the subtle flavor of ginger?
sentences.zh: 你嚐得出薑那股細微的風味嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me a subtle hint about the surprise party.
sentences.zh: 她對驚喜派對給了我一個微妙的暗示。

sentences.en: The company made only subtle changes to the logo.
sentences.zh: 公司只對標誌做了些細微的更動。

sentences.en: Is the sarcasm in his email too subtle?
sentences.zh: 他電子郵件裡的諷刺是不是太微妙了？

sentences.en: A subtle shift in the market surprised the analysts.
sentences.zh: 市場出現細微的轉變，讓分析師很意外。

gloss_note: make a suggestion 提出建議

sentences.en: Do you have any suggestions for dinner tonight?
sentences.zh: 你對今晚的晚餐有什麼建議嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for the suggestion; I'll try the soup.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的建議，我會試試那道湯。

sentences.en: She made a suggestion at the end of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她在會議結束時提了一個建議。

sentences.en: May I offer a suggestion about the schedule?
sentences.zh: 我可以對時間表提個建議嗎？

sentences.en: Your suggestion saved us two hours of work.
sentences.zh: 你的建議替我們省下了兩小時的工作。

sentences.en: Our teacher welcomes suggestions from students.
sentences.zh: 我們老師歡迎學生提出建議。

gloss_note: summarize in a few words 簡短總結

sentences.en: Can you summarize the movie plot for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我概述一下這部電影的劇情嗎？

sentences.en: Let me summarize what we decided today.
sentences.zh: 讓我總結一下我們今天的決定。

sentences.en: The report summarizes the results of the survey.
sentences.zh: 這份報告概述了調查的結果。

sentences.en: She summarized the article for the whole class.
sentences.zh: 她為全班概述了那篇文章。

sentences.en: Who will summarize the key points for our manager?
sentences.zh: 誰要為我們經理總結重點？

sentences.en: I'm summarizing the notes from the call now.
sentences.zh: 我正在總結電話會議的筆記。

gloss_note: plenty of sunshine 充足的陽光

sentences.en: We enjoyed warm sunshine all weekend at the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們整個週末在海邊享受溫暖的陽光。

sentences.en: Does this room get enough sunshine in the morning?
sentences.zh: 這個房間早上的陽光夠多嗎？

sentences.en: The plants need plenty of sunshine to grow.
sentences.zh: 這些植物需要充足的陽光才能生長。

sentences.en: Let's eat lunch outside in the sunshine.
sentences.zh: 我們到外面的陽光下吃午餐吧。

sentences.en: How much sunshine does this city get in winter?
sentences.zh: 這個城市冬天有多少日照？

sentences.en: The hotel room gets lots of sunshine every morning.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間每天早上都有充足的陽光。

sentences.en: New employees work under close supervision at first.
sentences.zh: 新進員工一開始會在密切的監督下工作。

sentences.en: Do the interns need constant supervision?
sentences.zh: 實習生需要隨時的監督嗎？

sentences.en: Children must swim under adult supervision.
sentences.zh: 孩子必須在大人的監督下游泳。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of supervision on the night shift?
sentences.zh: 晚班的督導工作由誰負責？

sentences.en: The factory was fined for poor supervision of workers.
sentences.zh: 這家工廠因為對員工監督不周而被罰款。

sentences.en: Lack of supervision led to several mistakes in the report.
sentences.zh: 缺乏監督導致報告出現好幾個錯誤。

sentences.en: This shop is supposedly the best in town.
sentences.zh: 據說這家店是城裡最好的。

sentences.en: He's supposedly in a meeting right now.
sentences.zh: 聽說他現在在開會。

sentences.en: Where is the package that was supposedly delivered yesterday?
sentences.zh: 那個據說昨天就送到的包裹在哪裡？

sentences.en: The new phone is supposedly waterproof, but mine broke.
sentences.zh: 這支新手機據說防水，但我的壞掉了。

sentences.en: She supposedly quit last week. Is that true?
sentences.zh: 聽說她上週辭職了。是真的嗎？

sentences.en: The company supposedly saves money, yet costs keep rising.
sentences.zh: 這家公司據說在省錢，成本卻不斷上升。

sentences.en: I'd like a large supreme pizza, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一個大的綜合披薩，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Does the supreme pizza come with olives?
sentences.zh: 綜合披薩有加橄欖嗎？

sentences.en: The supreme pizza has peppers, sausage, and onions.
sentences.zh: 綜合披薩有青椒、香腸和洋蔥。

sentences.en: Our team ordered two supreme pizzas for Friday lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊為週五午餐訂了兩個綜合披薩。

sentences.en: Which is better, the supreme or the plain cheese?
sentences.zh: 綜合口味和單純起司口味，哪個比較好？

sentences.en: The supreme nachos come with beans, cheese, and peppers.
sentences.zh: 綜合配料玉米片附豆子、起司和辣椒。

gloss_note: heart surgeon 心臟外科醫師

sentences.en: My uncle is a surgeon at the city hospital.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是市立醫院的外科醫師。

sentences.en: Will the surgeon call us after the operation?
sentences.zh: 外科醫師會在手術後打電話給我們嗎？

sentences.en: The surgeon spent six hours in the operating room.
sentences.zh: 這位外科醫師在手術室待了六個小時。

sentences.en: The surgeon explained the risks to the patient's family.
sentences.zh: 外科醫師向病患家屬說明了風險。

sentences.en: How many years does it take to become a surgeon?
sentences.zh: 要花幾年才能成為外科醫師？

sentences.en: A famous surgeon spoke at the medical conference.
sentences.zh: 一位知名外科醫師在醫學研討會上發言。

sentences.en: My grandfather needs surgery on his knee.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺的膝蓋需要動手術。

sentences.en: How long will the surgery take?
sentences.zh: 這場手術要多久？

sentences.en: She had surgery last week and is resting at home.
sentences.zh: 她上週動了手術，正在家休養。

sentences.en: Is the surgery covered by my insurance?
sentences.zh: 我的保險有給付這項手術嗎？

sentences.en: The doctors decided that surgery was the best option.
sentences.zh: 醫師們判斷手術是最好的選擇。

sentences.en: After surgery, patients should avoid heavy lifting.
sentences.zh: 手術後，病患應避免提重物。

sentences.en: The surgical team was ready before the patient arrived.
sentences.zh: 手術團隊在病患抵達之前就準備好了。

sentences.en: Where do we keep the surgical gloves?
sentences.zh: 手術手套放在哪裡？

sentences.en: Surgical tools must be cleaned after every use.
sentences.zh: 手術器械每次使用後都必須清洗。

sentences.en: The hospital bought new surgical equipment this year.
sentences.zh: 這家醫院今年買了新的手術設備。

sentences.en: Is a surgical mask better than a cloth one?
sentences.zh: 外科口罩比布口罩更好嗎？

sentences.en: The study compared surgical and non-surgical treatments for back pain.
sentences.zh: 這項研究比較了手術與非手術的背痛治療方式。

sentences.en: The army surrendered, and the long war finally ended.
sentences.zh: 軍隊投降了，漫長的戰爭終於結束。

sentences.en: Why did the team surrender the lead so easily?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那支隊伍這麼輕易就交出領先優勢？

sentences.en: You must surrender your passport at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 你必須在櫃檯交出護照。

sentences.en: I surrender; you win this argument.
sentences.zh: 我投降，這場爭論你贏了。

sentences.en: Will the company surrender its license next month?
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會交出執照嗎？

sentences.en: Her quick surrender surprised everyone in the debate club.
sentences.zh: 她這麼快就投降，讓辯論社的每個人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: The hotel has beautiful surroundings and a quiet garden.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店周遭環境優美，還有一座安靜的花園。

sentences.en: Animals change color to match their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 有些動物會改變顏色來配合周遭環境。

sentences.en: Are you comfortable in your new surroundings?
sentences.zh: 你適應新環境了嗎？

sentences.en: It took me a week to get used to my surroundings.
sentences.zh: 我花了一週才習慣周遭環境。

sentences.en: Always be aware of your surroundings when you walk at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上走路時，要隨時留意四周環境。

sentences.en: How do the surroundings affect how well students learn?
sentences.zh: 周遭環境如何影響學生的學習成效？

sentences.en: Young children are susceptible to colds in winter.
sentences.zh: 小孩子在冬天容易感冒。

sentences.en: Are older trees more susceptible to this disease?
sentences.zh: 較老的樹更容易得這種病嗎？

sentences.en: The old computer system is susceptible to attacks.
sentences.zh: 那套老舊電腦系統容易受到攻擊。

sentences.en: Some people are more susceptible to stress than others.
sentences.zh: 有些人比別人更容易受壓力影響。

sentences.en: Is your skin susceptible to sunburn?
sentences.zh: 你的皮膚容易曬傷嗎？

sentences.en: Crops are susceptible to damage during heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 農作物在大雨期間容易受損。

sentences.en: Did you notice anything suspicious in the parking lot?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有注意到停車場有什麼可疑的地方？

sentences.en: I got a suspicious email asking for my password.
sentences.zh: 我收到一封索取密碼的可疑電子郵件。

sentences.en: She was suspicious of the sudden discount.
sentences.zh: 她對這突然的折扣起了疑心。

sentences.en: Why are you so suspicious of my plan?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼懷疑我的計畫？

sentences.en: The guard reported a suspicious bag near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 警衛通報入口附近有個可疑的袋子。

sentences.en: His story sounded suspicious to the teacher.
sentences.zh: 他的說詞在老師聽來很可疑。

sentences.en: The trees sway gently in the evening breeze.
sentences.zh: 樹木在傍晚的微風中輕輕搖擺。

sentences.en: Can ads really sway what people buy?
sentences.zh: 廣告真的能左右人們買什麼嗎？

sentences.en: The boat began to sway in the strong wind.
sentences.zh: 小船在強風中開始搖晃。

sentences.en: Don't let other people sway your decision.
sentences.zh: 別讓其他人左右你的決定。

sentences.en: Did the music make the whole crowd sway together?
sentences.zh: 音樂有讓整群觀眾一起搖擺嗎？

sentences.en: One strong speech swayed the whole committee.
sentences.zh: 一場有力的演說影響了整個委員會。

gloss_note: a sympathetic ear 願意傾聽的人

sentences.en: My boss was sympathetic when I missed work.
sentences.zh: 我缺勤時，老闆很體諒。

sentences.en: Was the agent sympathetic when you called about the delay?
sentences.zh: 你為延誤來電時，客服人員有表示體諒嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me a sympathetic smile after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，她對我投以同情的微笑。

sentences.en: Everyone was sympathetic to the family after the fire.
sentences.zh: 火災後，大家都很同情那一家人。

sentences.en: Do you have a sympathetic friend you can talk to?
sentences.zh: 你有一位可以聊聊、能體諒你的朋友嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher was not sympathetic to his excuse for being late.
sentences.zh: 老師並不體諒他遲到的藉口。

sentences.en: I feel great sympathy for the families affected.
sentences.zh: 我對受影響的家庭深感同情。

sentences.en: Please accept our sympathy for your loss.
sentences.zh: 請接受我們對你失去親人的慰問。

sentences.en: Do you have any sympathy for people who cheat?
sentences.zh: 你對作弊的人有任何同情嗎？

sentences.en: She sent a card to show her sympathy.
sentences.zh: 她寄了一張卡片表達慰問。

sentences.en: He got no sympathy from his coworkers.
sentences.zh: 他沒有得到同事的同情。

sentences.en: Why should I have sympathy for someone who never helps?
sentences.zh: 我為什麼要同情一個從不幫忙的人？

sentences.en: Would you like maple syrup on your pancakes?
sentences.zh: 你的鬆餅要不要淋楓糖漿？

sentences.en: Pour the syrup slowly over the warm waffles.
sentences.zh: 把糖漿慢慢淋在熱鬆餅上。

sentences.en: The chef made a simple syrup with sugar and water.
sentences.zh: 主廚用糖和水做了簡易糖漿。

sentences.en: Can I get extra syrup on the side?
sentences.zh: 我可以另外多要一些糖漿放旁邊嗎？

sentences.en: The fruit was stored in sweet syrup.
sentences.zh: 這些水果泡在甜糖漿裡保存。

sentences.en: Too much syrup makes the cake too sweet.
sentences.zh: 糖漿太多會讓蛋糕太甜。

sentences.en: We need tangible results, not just promises.
sentences.zh: 我們需要實質的成果，而不只是承諾。

sentences.en: Does the new software offer tangible benefits?
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體有帶來實質好處嗎？

sentences.en: Land and equipment count as tangible assets.
sentences.zh: 土地和設備都算有形資產。

sentences.en: Can you show me any tangible proof of the savings?
sentences.zh: 你能給我看省下這些錢的實質證據嗎？

sentences.en: The investors want a tangible return this year.
sentences.zh: 投資人希望今年有實質的回報。

sentences.en: A tangible product is easier to sell than an idea.
sentences.zh: 有形的產品比點子更容易賣。

gloss_note: teen 為 teenager 的口語簡稱

sentences.en: The store sells clothes for teens and young adults.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售青少年和年輕成人的服飾。

sentences.en: Our new phone plan is popular with teens.
sentences.zh: 我們的新手機方案很受青少年歡迎。

sentences.en: How many teens attended the job fair?
sentences.zh: 有多少青少年參加了就業博覽會？

sentences.en: She teaches a coding class for teens on weekends.
sentences.zh: 她週末開一堂給青少年的程式設計課。

sentences.en: Do you offer a discount for teens?
sentences.zh: 你們有提供青少年折扣嗎？

sentences.en: The library started a book club for teens last month.
sentences.zh: 圖書館上個月開了一個青少年讀書會。

sentences.en: My neighbor works for a telecommunications company.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居在一家電信公司工作。

sentences.en: The telecommunications industry is growing fast.
sentences.zh: 電信業正在快速成長。

sentences.en: Which telecommunications provider has the best coverage?
sentences.zh: 哪家電信業者的涵蓋範圍最好？

sentences.en: Our firm invested in new telecommunications equipment.
sentences.zh: 我們公司投資了新的電信設備。

sentences.en: Did the storm damage the telecommunications network?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨有破壞電信網路嗎？

sentences.en: She is studying telecommunications engineering at the university.
sentences.zh: 她在大學裡主修電信工程。

gloss_note: 舊式通訊，現多用於歷史情境

sentences.en: The telegraph let people send messages across the country.
sentences.zh: 電報讓人們能把訊息傳到全國各地。

sentences.en: Who invented the telegraph, and when?
sentences.zh: 誰發明了電報，又是什麼時候？

sentences.en: Before phones, people used the telegraph for urgent news.
sentences.zh: 在有電話之前，人們用電報傳遞緊急消息。

sentences.en: We saw an old telegraph machine at the museum.
sentences.zh: 我們在博物館看到一台舊電報機。

sentences.en: How fast was the telegraph compared with the mail?
sentences.zh: 電報比郵寄快多少？

sentences.en: He telegraphed his parents that he had arrived safely.
sentences.zh: 他發電報告訴父母自己平安抵達。

gloss_note: through a telescope 透過望遠鏡

sentences.en: I got a small telescope for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 我生日收到一台小望遠鏡。

sentences.en: Can we see Saturn through this telescope?
sentences.zh: 我們用這台望遠鏡看得到土星嗎？

sentences.en: The telescope is set up on the roof tonight.
sentences.zh: 望遠鏡今晚架在屋頂上。

sentences.en: Scientists use a powerful telescope to study distant stars.
sentences.zh: 科學家用高倍望遠鏡研究遙遠的恆星。

sentences.en: How much does a good telescope cost?
sentences.zh: 一台好的望遠鏡要多少錢？

sentences.en: Our class visited an observatory with a giant telescope.
sentences.zh: 我們班參觀了一座有巨型望遠鏡的天文台。

sentences.en: The teller asked to see my ID.
sentences.zh: 櫃員要求看我的身分證。

sentences.en: Excuse me, is there a teller available?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，有櫃員可以服務嗎？

sentences.en: I gave the teller my deposit slip.
sentences.zh: 我把存款單交給了櫃員。

sentences.en: The bank is hiring two new tellers this month.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行這個月要聘兩名新櫃員。

sentences.en: Should I use the ATM or talk to a teller?
sentences.zh: 我該用提款機，還是找櫃員？

sentences.en: The teller counted the cash twice before handing it over.
sentences.zh: 櫃員把現金點了兩次才交出去。

gloss_note: have a tendency to 有…的傾向

sentences.en: My dad has a tendency to worry too much.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸有過度擔心的傾向。

sentences.en: Is there a tendency for prices to rise in summer?
sentences.zh: 夏天的物價有上漲的趨勢嗎？

sentences.en: Cats have a natural tendency to hide when scared.
sentences.zh: 貓受到驚嚇時，天生有躲起來的傾向。

sentences.en: Young people show a tendency to shop online.
sentences.zh: 年輕人有網路購物的傾向。

sentences.en: Do you have a tendency to forget names?
sentences.zh: 你是不是有容易忘記名字的傾向？

sentences.en: There is a tendency among students to put things off.
sentences.zh: 學生之間有把事情往後拖的傾向。

sentences.en: The mood in the meeting room was tense.
sentences.zh: 會議室裡的氣氛很緊張。

sentences.en: Why are you so tense before the interview?
sentences.zh: 面試前你為什麼這麼緊張？

sentences.en: My shoulders feel tense after a long day.
sentences.zh: 忙了一整天後，我的肩膀覺得很緊繃。

sentences.en: Things got tense when the two teams argued.
sentences.zh: 兩隊爭論起來時，場面變得很緊張。

sentences.en: Are you tense about the final exam?
sentences.zh: 你對期末考感到緊張嗎？

sentences.en: The final minutes of the game were very tense.
sentences.zh: 比賽最後幾分鐘非常緊張。

sentences.en: There was a lot of tension in the room.
sentences.zh: 房間裡瀰漫著緊張的氣氛。

sentences.en: How can we reduce the tension between them?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼緩和他們之間的緊張？

sentences.en: A joke helped ease the tension at dinner.
sentences.zh: 一個笑話緩和了晚餐時的緊張氣氛。

sentences.en: Tension between the two countries is growing.
sentences.zh: 兩國之間的緊張情勢正在升高。

sentences.en: I feel tension in my neck after typing all day.
sentences.zh: 打了一整天字後，我覺得脖子很緊繃。

sentences.en: Have you felt any tension at work lately?
sentences.zh: 你最近在工作上有感覺到任何緊張氣氛嗎？

sentences.en: The termination of the contract takes effect on June 1.
sentences.zh: 合約自六月一日起終止。

sentences.en: What is the notice period for termination?
sentences.zh: 終止合約需要提前多久通知？

sentences.en: She received a letter about her termination.
sentences.zh: 她收到一封通知她被終止雇用的信。

sentences.en: Early termination of the lease costs a fee.
sentences.zh: 提前終止租約要付費用。

sentences.en: Why did the company announce the termination of the project?
sentences.zh: 公司為什麼宣布終止這項計畫？

sentences.en: Can I request termination of my phone plan online?
sentences.zh: 我可以在網路上申請終止我的手機方案嗎？

sentences.en: Medical terminology can be hard for beginners.
sentences.zh: 醫學術語對初學者來說可能很難。

sentences.en: Do you know the legal terminology in this contract?
sentences.zh: 你懂這份合約裡的法律術語嗎？

sentences.en: The textbook explains the key terminology in each chapter.
sentences.zh: 課本在每一章都解釋了重要術語。

sentences.en: We should use consistent terminology in the report.
sentences.zh: 我們在報告中應該使用一致的術語。

sentences.en: Where can I find a list of computer terminology?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以找到電腦術語表？

sentences.en: Scientists created new terminology to describe the finding.
sentences.zh: 科學家創造了新術語來描述這項發現。

sentences.en: The country exports textiles to many markets.
sentences.zh: 這個國家把紡織品出口到許多市場。

sentences.en: Does your factory make textile products?
sentences.zh: 你們工廠生產紡織產品嗎？

sentences.en: Cotton is the main material in the textile industry.
sentences.zh: 棉花是紡織業的主要原料。

sentences.en: She runs a small textile business with her husband.
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫經營一家小型紡織事業。

sentences.en: Which textiles are best for summer clothing?
sentences.zh: 哪些紡織品最適合做夏季衣物？

sentences.en: The museum has a collection of antique textiles.
sentences.zh: 博物館收藏了一批古老的紡織品。

sentences.en: The store reported a theft last night.
sentences.zh: 這家商店通報昨晚發生了竊案。

sentences.en: How can we prevent employee theft?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何防止員工偷竊？

sentences.en: Theft costs retailers billions of dollars every year.
sentences.zh: 竊盜每年讓零售業者損失數十億美元。

sentences.en: Did you file a police report about the theft?
sentences.zh: 你有針對這起竊案報警備案嗎？

sentences.en: Car theft rates dropped in our city last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我們市的汽車竊盜率下降了。

sentences.en: The security cameras caught the theft on video.
sentences.zh: 監視器把竊盜過程拍了下來。

sentences.en: What is the main theme of this story?
sentences.zh: 這個故事的主要主題是什麼？

sentences.en: Our party has a beach theme this year.
sentences.zh: 我們的派對今年以海灘為主題。

sentences.en: She chose a space theme for her son's birthday.
sentences.zh: 她替兒子的生日選了太空主題。

sentences.en: Friendship is a common theme in children's books.
sentences.zh: 友誼是兒童書籍中常見的主題。

sentences.en: Can you stick to the theme of the presentation?
sentences.zh: 你可以緊扣簡報的主題嗎？

sentences.en: The theme of today's class is climate change.
sentences.zh: 今天這堂課的主題是氣候變遷。

sentences.en: The theorist explained his idea in a short lecture.
sentences.zh: 這位理論家在一場短講中說明了他的想法。

sentences.en: Who was the first theorist to study this problem?
sentences.zh: 誰是第一位研究這個問題的理論家？

sentences.en: Many theorists disagree about how children learn language.
sentences.zh: 許多理論家對孩子如何學習語言意見不一。

sentences.en: Is she a theorist or a practical engineer?
sentences.zh: 她是理論家，還是實務工程師？

sentences.en: Economic theorists often disagree about inflation.
sentences.zh: 經濟理論家對通貨膨脹常有不同意見。

sentences.en: The famous theorist wrote a book on social change.
sentences.zh: 這位知名理論家寫了一本談社會變遷的書。

sentences.en: I bought thermal socks for the cold winter.
sentences.zh: 我為寒冷的冬天買了保暖襪。

sentences.en: Is this thermal jacket warm enough for snow?
sentences.zh: 這件保暖外套夠暖，能在雪地穿嗎？

sentences.en: Thermal energy moves from hot objects to cold ones.
sentences.zh: 熱能會從熱的物體傳到冷的物體。

sentences.en: Do you wear thermal underwear when you go skiing?
sentences.zh: 你去滑雪時會穿保暖內衣嗎？

sentences.en: Thermal imaging shows where a house loses heat.
sentences.zh: 熱影像能顯示房子哪裡散失熱量。

sentences.en: The thermal blanket kept the hikers warm overnight.
sentences.zh: 保暖毯讓健行者整晚都很溫暖。

sentences.en: What is the thickness of this wall?
sentences.zh: 這面牆的厚度是多少？

sentences.en: The ice thickness must be at least four inches.
sentences.zh: 冰的厚度至少要有四英吋。

sentences.en: Measure the thickness of the paper with a ruler.
sentences.zh: 用尺量一下這張紙的厚度。

sentences.en: Does the thickness of the glass affect the price?
sentences.zh: 玻璃的厚度會影響價格嗎？

sentences.en: Cut the bread to the same thickness each time.
sentences.zh: 每次都把麵包切成同樣的厚度。

sentences.en: The thickness of this sweater makes it great for winter.
sentences.zh: 這件毛衣的厚度很適合冬天穿。

gloss_note: a thoughtful gift 貼心的禮物

sentences.en: Thank you for the thoughtful gift.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你這份貼心的禮物。

sentences.en: It was thoughtful of you to call.
sentences.zh: 你打電話來真貼心。

sentences.en: Is your coworker always this thoughtful?
sentences.zh: 你的同事一直都這麼體貼嗎？

sentences.en: She wrote a thoughtful reply to every customer.
sentences.zh: 她對每位客戶都寫了一封周到的回覆。

sentences.en: He's a thoughtful boy who helps his neighbors.
sentences.zh: 他是個體貼的男孩，會幫助鄰居。

sentences.en: Can you give me a thoughtful answer instead of a quick one?
sentences.zh: 你能給我深思熟慮的答案，而不是倉促的回答嗎？

gloss_note: thrive on 以…為養分、樂在其中

sentences.en: Small businesses thrive when the local economy is strong.
sentences.zh: 當地方經濟強勁時，小型企業就會興盛。

sentences.en: Will this plant thrive in low light?
sentences.zh: 這種植物在光線不足的地方能長得好嗎？

sentences.en: The company has thrived since it moved online.
sentences.zh: 這家公司自從轉到網路上後就蒸蒸日上。

sentences.en: Children thrive when they feel safe at home.
sentences.zh: 孩子在家裡覺得安全時，會茁壯成長。

sentences.en: How can our restaurant thrive during the slow season?
sentences.zh: 我們餐廳要如何在淡季中蓬勃發展？

sentences.en: Local farms thrive in this warm, wet climate.
sentences.zh: 當地農場在這種溫暖潮濕的氣候中蓬勃發展。

sentences.en: Why are you trying to tickle me?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼想搔我癢？

sentences.en: The feather tickled my nose.
sentences.zh: 羽毛搔得我的鼻子好癢。

sentences.en: Does it tickle when I touch your foot?
sentences.zh: 我碰你的腳時會癢嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother loves to tickle our dog's belly.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟喜歡搔我們家狗狗的肚子。

sentences.en: A tickle in my throat kept me awake.
sentences.zh: 喉嚨一陣發癢讓我睡不著。

sentences.en: Her hair tickled his face in the wind.
sentences.zh: 風吹著，她的頭髮搔得他臉上發癢。

sentences.en: Which pricing tier includes free shipping?
sentences.zh: 哪一個價格級距包含免運費？

sentences.en: The premium tier costs ten dollars more per month.
sentences.zh: 高級方案每月貴十美元。

sentences.en: Our company offers three tiers of membership.
sentences.zh: 我們公司提供三種會員等級。

sentences.en: Can I upgrade to a higher tier later?
sentences.zh: 我之後可以升級到更高的等級嗎？

sentences.en: Customers in the top tier get free repairs.
sentences.zh: 最高等級的客戶可享免費維修。

sentences.en: What does the lowest tier of service include?
sentences.zh: 最低等級的服務包含什麼？

gloss_note: in a timely manner 及時地

sentences.en: Thank you for your timely reply.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你及時的回覆。

sentences.en: Please submit the form in a timely manner.
sentences.zh: 請及時提交這份表格。

sentences.en: Was the delivery timely, or did it arrive late?
sentences.zh: 這次送貨及時嗎，還是晚到了？

sentences.en: Her timely warning saved us a lot of trouble.
sentences.zh: 她及時的警告替我們省了很多麻煩。

sentences.en: The airline sent a timely update about the delay.
sentences.zh: 航空公司就延誤發出了及時的更新通知。

sentences.en: Is this article timely enough for the newsletter?
sentences.zh: 這篇文章夠切合時事，適合放進電子報嗎？

gloss_note: set a timer 設定計時器

sentences.en: Set the timer for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 把計時器設定為十分鐘。

sentences.en: Where is the kitchen timer?
sentences.zh: 廚房計時器在哪裡？

sentences.en: The timer went off, so the cookies are ready.
sentences.zh: 計時器響了，所以餅乾烤好了。

sentences.en: Do you have a timer for the presentation?
sentences.zh: 你有簡報用的計時器嗎？

sentences.en: The gym uses a big timer for its workouts.
sentences.zh: 健身房的訓練用一個大型計時器。

sentences.en: I use a timer to limit my phone time.
sentences.zh: 我用計時器限制自己的手機使用時間。

sentences.en: Can you check the train timetable for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我查一下火車時刻表嗎？

sentences.en: The project timetable gives us only two weeks for testing.
sentences.zh: 專案時程表只給我們兩週做測試。

sentences.en: The ferry timetable is posted at the dock.
sentences.zh: 渡輪時刻表張貼在碼頭。

sentences.en: Is the new shuttle timetable on the hotel website?
sentences.zh: 新的接駁車時刻表有放在飯店網站上嗎？

sentences.en: The airline posted its new winter timetable online.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在網路上公布了新的冬季時刻表。

sentences.en: Will the new bus timetable start in March?
sentences.zh: 新的公車時刻表三月開始實施嗎？

gloss_note: a timid smile 羞怯的微笑

sentences.en: My little brother is too timid to talk to strangers.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟太膽小，不敢跟陌生人說話。

sentences.en: Why are you so timid about asking questions in class?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼不敢在課堂上發問？

sentences.en: The timid puppy hid behind the couch during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨時，那隻膽小的小狗躲在沙發後面。

sentences.en: She gave a timid smile and walked into the room.
sentences.zh: 她羞怯地笑了笑，走進房間。

sentences.en: Don't be timid; just tell the manager what you think.
sentences.zh: 別害羞，直接告訴經理你的想法吧。

sentences.en: Was he always this timid when he was a kid?
sentences.zh: 他小時候也一直這麼膽小嗎？

gloss_zh: 勉強可忍受的；過得去的

sentences.en: The heat was tolerable in the shade.
sentences.zh: 在樹蔭下，這種炎熱還勉強可以忍受。

sentences.en: Is the noise from the street tolerable at night?
sentences.zh: 晚上街上的噪音還受得了嗎？

sentences.en: The food at the cafeteria is tolerable, but nothing special.
sentences.zh: 學校餐廳的食物還過得去，但沒什麼特別。

sentences.en: Her pain was tolerable after she took the medicine.
sentences.zh: 她吃了藥之後，疼痛就可以忍受了。

sentences.en: Would a ten-minute wait be tolerable for you?
sentences.zh: 等十分鐘你可以接受嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel room was small, but the price was tolerable.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間很小，但價格還算可以接受。

sentences.en: Our teacher is tolerant of mistakes when we try our best.
sentences.zh: 只要我們盡力，老師對錯誤很包容。

sentences.en: Are you tolerant of people who think differently from you?
sentences.zh: 你能包容和你想法不同的人嗎？

sentences.en: My manager is tolerant when someone arrives a few minutes late.
sentences.zh: 有人晚到幾分鐘，我的經理都很寬容。

sentences.en: We live in a tolerant city where everyone feels welcome.
sentences.zh: 我們住在一座包容的城市，每個人都覺得受到歡迎。

sentences.en: How can parents be more tolerant of their teenagers?
sentences.zh: 父母要怎麼對青少年子女更寬容？

sentences.en: Grandma is very tolerant of our noisy games.
sentences.zh: 奶奶對我們吵鬧的遊戲非常包容。

sentences.en: I can't tolerate the smell of fish.
sentences.zh: 我受不了魚腥味。

sentences.en: Our company will not tolerate cheating of any kind.
sentences.zh: 我們公司不容許任何形式的作弊。

sentences.en: How long can you tolerate this noise?
sentences.zh: 你還能忍受這種噪音多久？

sentences.en: The school does not tolerate bullying.
sentences.zh: 學校不容許霸凌行為。

sentences.en: Could you tolerate a long flight with a crying baby nearby?
sentences.zh: 旁邊有嬰兒哭鬧，你還能忍受長途飛行嗎？

sentences.en: He tolerated his roommate's mess for months before saying anything.
sentences.zh: 他忍了室友的髒亂好幾個月才開口。

gloss_note: take a toll on 對…造成損害

sentences.en: How much is the toll on this bridge?
sentences.zh: 這座橋的過路費是多少？

sentences.en: We took the toll road to save time.
sentences.zh: 我們走收費公路來節省時間。

sentences.en: Stress at work is taking a toll on my health.
sentences.zh: 工作壓力正在損害我的健康。

sentences.en: Do you have enough change for the toll?
sentences.zh: 你有足夠的零錢付過路費嗎？

sentences.en: The long drive took a toll on everyone in the car.
sentences.zh: 長途開車讓車上每個人都累壞了。

sentences.en: The company pays our tolls when we travel for work.
sentences.zh: 出差時，公司會支付我們的過路費。

sentences.en: Scientists discovered an ancient tomb under the desert.
sentences.zh: 科學家在沙漠底下發現了一座古墓。

sentences.en: Have you ever visited a royal tomb in Egypt?
sentences.zh: 你去過埃及的王室陵墓嗎？

sentences.en: The tour guide said the tomb is over three thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 導遊說這座陵墓已有三千多年的歷史。

sentences.en: Visitors can't take photos inside the tomb.
sentences.zh: 遊客不能在墓室裡拍照。

sentences.en: What did the workers find inside the tomb?
sentences.zh: 工人在墓裡發現了什麼？

sentences.en: My class wrote a report about a famous tomb in China.
sentences.zh: 我們班寫了一份關於中國一座著名陵墓的報告。

sentences.en: The printer is out of toner again.
sentences.zh: 印表機的碳粉又用完了。

sentences.en: Where do we keep the extra toner?
sentences.zh: 備用的碳粉放在哪裡？

sentences.en: Hello, I'd like to order two toner cartridges for our office.
sentences.zh: 你好，我想幫我們辦公室訂兩個碳粉匣。

sentences.en: The copies look faint because the toner is low.
sentences.zh: 影印出來的字很淡，因為碳粉快沒了。

sentences.en: Please send me a message if the toner runs out.
sentences.zh: 如果碳粉用完了，請傳訊息給我。

sentences.en: How often do you have to change the toner in this machine?
sentences.zh: 這台機器多久要換一次碳粉？

sentences.en: A tort is a wrong that one person does to another.
sentences.zh: 侵權行為是指某人對另一人造成的不法損害。

sentences.en: What is the difference between a tort and a crime?
sentences.zh: 侵權行為和犯罪有什麼不同？

sentences.en: She studied tort law before becoming a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 她在當律師之前讀過侵權行為法。

sentences.en: Could a slip on a wet floor become a tort case?
sentences.zh: 在濕滑的地板上滑倒，可能成為侵權案件嗎？

sentences.en: The company's lawyer explained that the claim was a tort, not a contract issue.
sentences.zh: 公司的律師說明這項求償屬於侵權行為，而非合約問題。

sentences.en: The news report described the case as a tort claim.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導把這起案件稱為侵權求償案。

gloss_note: tortoise 陸龜；turtle 多指水龜

sentences.en: The tortoise moved slowly across the garden.
sentences.zh: 那隻陸龜慢慢爬過花園。

sentences.en: Did you know a tortoise can live over a hundred years?
sentences.zh: 你知道陸龜可以活超過一百年嗎？

sentences.en: We saw a giant tortoise at the zoo yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們昨天在動物園看到一隻巨型陸龜。

sentences.en: In the story, the tortoise beats the rabbit in a race.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，烏龜在賽跑中打敗了兔子。

sentences.en: What does a tortoise eat besides grass?
sentences.zh: 陸龜除了草之外還吃什麼？

sentences.en: My daughter wants a pet tortoise for her birthday.
sentences.zh: 我女兒生日想要一隻寵物陸龜。

sentences.en: Waiting for the test results was pure torture.
sentences.zh: 等待考試成績簡直是折磨。

sentences.en: Is sitting through a three-hour meeting torture for you too?
sentences.zh: 坐著開完三小時的會，對你來說也是種折磨嗎？

sentences.en: This hot weather is torture for people without air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 這種炎熱的天氣對沒有冷氣的人來說簡直是折磨。

sentences.en: The history book explains why many countries banned torture.
sentences.zh: 歷史課本說明了許多國家為什麼禁止酷刑。

sentences.en: Why do you torture yourself by watching that sad movie again?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼又要看那部悲傷的電影來折磨自己？

sentences.en: The long, slow line at the airport felt like torture.
sentences.zh: 機場裡又長又慢的隊伍簡直像在受折磨。

gloss_note: a tract of land 一大片土地

sentences.en: A large tract of forest was cleared for farming.
sentences.zh: 一大片森林被開墾成農地。

sentences.en: Who owns that huge tract of farmland by the highway?
sentences.zh: 公路旁那一大片農地是誰的？

sentences.en: Why did the city buy a large tract near the airport?
sentences.zh: 市政府為什麼買下機場附近的一大片土地？

sentences.en: The company bought a tract of land near the river.
sentences.zh: 這家公司買下了河邊的一大片土地。

sentences.en: How many families live on this tract of land?
sentences.zh: 有多少家庭住在這片土地上？

sentences.en: Scientists studied a wide tract of wetland for ten years.
sentences.zh: 科學家對一大片溼地進行了十年的研究。

gloss_note: avoid a tragedy 避免悲劇

sentences.en: The accident was a tragedy for the whole town.
sentences.zh: 這場意外對整個小鎮來說是一場悲劇。

sentences.en: Did you read a Greek tragedy in literature class?
sentences.zh: 你在文學課讀過希臘悲劇嗎？

sentences.en: What a tragedy that the old theater had to close!
sentences.zh: 老戲院非關門不可，真是一大憾事！

sentences.en: How can we prevent another tragedy like this?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼避免再發生這樣的悲劇？

sentences.en: The movie turns from comedy to tragedy in the last hour.
sentences.zh: 這部電影在最後一個小時從喜劇轉為悲劇。

sentences.en: Losing the small farm was a family tragedy.
sentences.zh: 失去那座小農場，對整個家庭來說是一場悲劇。

gloss_note: a tragic ending 悲慘的結局

sentences.en: It was a tragic accident, and everyone was shocked.
sentences.zh: 那是一場悲慘的意外，大家都很震驚。

sentences.en: Why does the story have such a tragic ending?
sentences.zh: 這個故事為什麼有這麼悲慘的結局？

sentences.en: Isn't it tragic that so many young people can't find jobs?
sentences.zh: 這麼多年輕人找不到工作，不是很令人痛心嗎？

sentences.en: The tragic news reached the village late at night.
sentences.zh: 這則令人悲痛的消息深夜才傳到村裡。

sentences.en: He told us a tragic story about his childhood.
sentences.zh: 他跟我們說了一個關於他童年的悲慘故事。

sentences.en: The tragic fire destroyed three homes on our street.
sentences.zh: 那場不幸的火災燒毀了我們這條街上的三棟房子。

sentences.en: I need a transcription of today's interview.
sentences.zh: 我需要今天訪談的逐字稿。

sentences.en: How long does the transcription of a one-hour recording take?
sentences.zh: 轉錄一小時的錄音要花多久？

sentences.en: The transcription had a few spelling mistakes.
sentences.zh: 這份謄寫稿有幾個拼字錯誤。

sentences.en: Students can use the lecture transcription to review for the exam.
sentences.zh: 學生可以用課堂逐字稿來準備考試。

sentences.en: Could you check the transcription against the original audio?
sentences.zh: 你可以把逐字稿和原始錄音對照檢查一下嗎？

sentences.en: The researcher made a careful transcription of each interview.
sentences.zh: 研究人員把每一場訪談都仔細整理成逐字稿。

gloss_note: transform A into B 把A轉變成B

sentences.en: The new park will transform this empty lot.
sentences.zh: 新公園將讓這塊空地煥然一新。

sentences.en: How did the internet transform the way we shop?
sentences.zh: 網路如何改變了我們的購物方式？

sentences.en: Heat can transform water into steam.
sentences.zh: 熱能把水轉變成水蒸氣。

sentences.en: She transformed her small kitchen into a bright, cozy space.
sentences.zh: 她把狹小的廚房改造成明亮舒適的空間。

sentences.en: Can a good coach transform a weak team in one season?
sentences.zh: 好教練能在一個球季內讓弱隊脫胎換骨嗎？

sentences.en: The company hopes to transform its image with a new logo.
sentences.zh: 公司希望藉由新標誌改變形象。

gloss_note: translate A into B 把A翻成B

sentences.en: Can you translate this sentence into English for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這個句子翻成英文嗎？

sentences.en: I used an app to translate the menu.
sentences.zh: 我用應用程式翻譯了菜單。

sentences.en: She translated the letter from Spanish to English.
sentences.zh: 她把這封信從西班牙文翻成英文。

sentences.en: How do you translate this word into Chinese?
sentences.zh: 這個字用中文要怎麼翻？

sentences.en: The author's books have been translated into many languages.
sentences.zh: 這位作者的書已被翻譯成多國語言。

sentences.en: He translated for the visitors during the tour.
sentences.zh: 導覽期間，他為訪客擔任翻譯。

gloss_note: hire a translator 聘請翻譯

sentences.en: My friend works as a translator for a travel company.
sentences.zh: 我朋友在旅行社擔任翻譯。

sentences.en: We need a translator for tomorrow's meeting with the Japanese clients.
sentences.zh: 明天和日本客戶開會，我們需要一位翻譯。

sentences.en: Does the hotel have a translator for guests who speak little English?
sentences.zh: 飯店有為不太會說英文的客人準備翻譯人員嗎？

sentences.en: The translator did a great job with the novel.
sentences.zh: 譯者把這部小說翻得非常出色。

sentences.en: How much does a professional translator charge per page?
sentences.zh: 專業譯者每頁收費多少？

sentences.en: The translator finished the Spanish version of the report.
sentences.zh: 譯者完成了這份報告的西班牙文版。

sentences.en: Customers want more transparency about how prices are set.
sentences.zh: 顧客希望價格是怎麼訂的能更透明。

sentences.en: How can the company improve transparency in its reports?
sentences.zh: 公司要如何提高報告的透明度？

sentences.en: Transparency builds trust between managers and employees.
sentences.zh: 公開透明能建立主管與員工之間的信任。

sentences.en: The city promised more transparency in how it spends tax money.
sentences.zh: 市政府承諾在稅金用途上更公開透明。

sentences.en: Do you think the new policy offers enough transparency?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這項新政策夠公開透明嗎？

sentences.en: The glass has a high level of transparency.
sentences.zh: 這種玻璃的透明度很高。

sentences.en: The doctor explained how trauma can affect a child's sleep.
sentences.zh: 醫生說明創傷如何影響孩子的睡眠。

sentences.en: Psychologists study how people recover from trauma.
sentences.zh: 心理學家研究人們如何從創傷中復原。

sentences.en: Can a stressful move cause emotional trauma for kids?
sentences.zh: 搬家的壓力會對孩子造成心理創傷嗎？

sentences.en: She talked with a counselor to deal with the trauma.
sentences.zh: 她找輔導員談話，來面對那個創傷。

sentences.en: How long does it take to heal from trauma?
sentences.zh: 要從創傷中痊癒需要多久？

sentences.en: Head trauma is common in some contact sports.
sentences.zh: 頭部外傷在某些碰撞型運動中很常見。

gloss_note: tremble with fear 嚇得發抖

sentences.en: Her hands began to tremble before the speech.
sentences.zh: 演講前，她的雙手開始發抖。

sentences.en: Why is your voice trembling? Are you nervous?
sentences.zh: 你的聲音為什麼在顫抖？你緊張嗎？

sentences.en: The ground started to tremble when the truck passed.
sentences.zh: 卡車經過時，地面開始震動。

sentences.en: The little girl trembled with cold in the snow.
sentences.zh: 小女孩在雪地裡冷得發抖。

sentences.en: Did the windows tremble during the storm last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚暴風雨時，窗戶有震動嗎？

sentences.en: My knees trembled when I looked down from the bridge.
sentences.zh: 從橋上往下看時，我的膝蓋直打顫。

sentences.en: The new store has been a tremendous success.
sentences.zh: 這家新店大獲成功。

sentences.en: Thank you for your tremendous help this week.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你這個星期的大力幫忙。

sentences.en: Did the team make a tremendous effort on this project?
sentences.zh: 團隊在這個專案上投入了極大的心力嗎？

sentences.en: There was a tremendous crowd outside the stadium.
sentences.zh: 體育場外聚集了大批人潮。

sentences.en: A tremendous storm hit the coast last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨襲擊了海岸。

sentences.en: Do you have a tremendous amount of homework this week?
sentences.zh: 你這個星期的功課多得驚人嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has an exhibit on tribal art.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一場部落藝術的展覽。

sentences.en: Tribal leaders met to talk about protecting the forest.
sentences.zh: 部落領袖聚在一起討論如何保護森林。

sentences.en: Do you know the meaning of this tribal dance?
sentences.zh: 你知道這支部落舞蹈的意義嗎？

sentences.en: She is writing a paper about tribal customs in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 她正在寫一篇關於山區部落習俗的報告。

sentences.en: Tribal music often uses drums and simple instruments.
sentences.zh: 部落音樂常使用鼓和簡單的樂器。

sentences.en: Have you ever visited a tribal village on a trip?
sentences.zh: 你旅行時去過部落村莊嗎？

sentences.en: The tribunal ruled in favor of the smaller company.
sentences.zh: 仲裁庭作出有利於規模較小那家公司的裁決。

sentences.en: How long does a tribunal usually take to reach a decision?
sentences.zh: 仲裁庭通常要多久才會做出決定？

sentences.en: The tribunal will hear both sides next Monday, so we must be ready.
sentences.zh: 仲裁庭下週一會聽取雙方說詞，所以我們得做好準備。

sentences.en: Our lawyer says we should bring the dispute to a tribunal.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師說應該把這項爭議提交仲裁庭。

sentences.en: Is a tribunal the same as a regular court?
sentences.zh: 仲裁庭和一般法院一樣嗎？

sentences.en: In the film, a special tribunal decides the old king's fate.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一個特別法庭決定了老國王的命運。

sentences.en: The company plans to trim costs by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 公司打算把成本削減百分之十。

sentences.en: Can you trim the budget without cutting any jobs?
sentences.zh: 你能在不裁員的情況下縮減預算嗎？

sentences.en: I need to trim my hedge this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我得修剪樹籬。

sentences.en: Could you trim a little off the sides, please?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩你把兩側稍微修短一點嗎？

sentences.en: He trimmed the fat from the steak before cooking.
sentences.zh: 他下鍋前先把牛排的肥肉修掉。

sentences.en: We trimmed the report to fit on one page.
sentences.zh: 我們把報告刪減到只剩一頁。

gloss_note: triple in size 大小成為三倍

sentences.en: Our sales tripled after we launched the new app.
sentences.zh: 新應用程式推出後，我們的銷售額成長為三倍。

sentences.en: Did rent really triple in five years?
sentences.zh: 房租真的在五年內漲了三倍嗎？

sentences.en: The company hopes to triple its profits next year.
sentences.zh: 公司希望明年的利潤能成長為三倍。

sentences.en: I'd like a triple scoop of chocolate ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我想要三球巧克力冰淇淋。

sentences.en: Is it true that the cost will triple next month?
sentences.zh: 費用下個月真的會漲到三倍嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant serves a triple burger for big appetites.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳為食量大的人提供三層漢堡。

sentences.en: Winning the national contest was a triumph for our school.
sentences.zh: 贏得全國比賽，是我們學校的一大勝利。

sentences.en: The new phone was a triumph for the design team.
sentences.zh: 這支新手機是設計團隊的一大成就。

sentences.en: How did the small team triumph over its larger rivals?
sentences.zh: 這支小團隊如何戰勝規模較大的對手？

sentences.en: She smiled in triumph as she crossed the finish line.
sentences.zh: 她衝過終點線時，得意地笑了。

sentences.en: Was the concert a triumph or a failure?
sentences.zh: 那場演唱會是大獲成功還是徹底失敗？

sentences.en: He triumphed over every difficulty and finished college.
sentences.zh: 他戰勝了所有困難，完成了大學學業。

gloss_note: a trivial matter 芝麻小事

sentences.en: Don't worry about such a trivial mistake.
sentences.zh: 別為這麼小的錯誤擔心。

sentences.en: Are these trivial details really worth discussing?
sentences.zh: 這些瑣碎的細節真的值得討論嗎？

sentences.en: They argued over a trivial matter for an hour.
sentences.zh: 他們為了一件芝麻小事吵了一個小時。

sentences.en: The cost of a cup of coffee is trivial to him.
sentences.zh: 一杯咖啡的錢對他來說微不足道。

sentences.en: Why do you care about such trivial things?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼在意這種小事？

sentences.en: The researchers found only a trivial difference between the two groups.
sentences.zh: 研究人員發現兩組之間只有微不足道的差異。

gloss_note: a troublesome problem 棘手的問題

sentences.en: My old car has been troublesome lately.
sentences.zh: 我的舊車最近很讓人頭痛。

sentences.en: Is the new system troublesome to install?
sentences.zh: 新系統安裝起來很麻煩嗎？

sentences.en: The troublesome customer called three times today.
sentences.zh: 那位難纏的客人今天打了三通電話。

sentences.en: Her troublesome cough lasted all winter.
sentences.zh: 她那惱人的咳嗽整個冬天都沒好。

sentences.en: Do you find the new rules troublesome?
sentences.zh: 你覺得新規定很麻煩嗎？

sentences.en: Weeds are troublesome in a vegetable garden.
sentences.zh: 雜草在菜園裡很惱人。

sentences.en: College tuition goes up almost every year.
sentences.zh: 大學學費幾乎年年調漲。

sentences.en: How much is the tuition at that school?
sentences.zh: 那所學校的學費是多少？

sentences.en: My company will pay part of my tuition.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔我一部分的學費。

sentences.en: Did she get a scholarship to cover her tuition?
sentences.zh: 她拿到獎學金來支付學費了嗎？

sentences.en: Tuition is due at the start of each semester.
sentences.zh: 學費要在每學期開始時繳清。

sentences.en: I work part-time to help pay for my tuition.
sentences.zh: 我打工來幫忙付學費。

sentences.en: The little boy tumbled down the hill and laughed.
sentences.zh: 小男孩從山坡上滾下去，還哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: Stock prices tumbled after the bad news.
sentences.zh: 壞消息傳出後，股價暴跌。

sentences.en: Why did the company's shares tumble yesterday?
sentences.zh: 這家公司的股價昨天為什麼暴跌？

sentences.en: Watch out, or you'll tumble off that chair!
sentences.zh: 小心，不然你會從那張椅子上摔下來！

sentences.en: Did she tumble on the ice this morning?
sentences.zh: 她今天早上在冰上摔倒了嗎？

sentences.en: Our sales tumbled last month because of the weather.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣的關係，我們上個月的銷售額大跌。

gloss_note: turbulent air 不穩定的氣流

sentences.en: The country went through a turbulent period in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 這個國家在1970年代經歷了一段動盪時期。

sentences.en: The plane hit turbulent air over the mountains.
sentences.zh: 飛機在山區上空遇到了不穩定的氣流。

sentences.en: Why is the stock market so turbulent this year?
sentences.zh: 股市今年為什麼這麼動盪？

sentences.en: The turbulent river was too dangerous to cross.
sentences.zh: 那條水流湍急的河太危險，不能涉水渡過。

sentences.en: Teenage years can be a turbulent time for families.
sentences.zh: 青少年時期對家庭來說可能是個動盪的時期。

sentences.en: How did the company survive such a turbulent year?
sentences.zh: 公司是怎麼度過這麼動盪的一年？

sentences.en: A bird built its nest from twigs and grass.
sentences.zh: 一隻鳥用細枝和草築巢。

sentences.en: The dog brought me a twig and wanted to play.
sentences.zh: 狗叼來一根小樹枝，想跟我玩。

sentences.en: Can you pick up the twigs in the yard?
sentences.zh: 你可以把院子裡的細樹枝撿起來嗎？

sentences.en: We used dry twigs to start the campfire.
sentences.zh: 我們用乾樹枝生起營火。

sentences.en: What is that small green twig in the vase?
sentences.zh: 花瓶裡那根綠色的小樹枝是什麼？

sentences.en: The twig snapped under his boot.
sentences.zh: 那根細樹枝在他的靴子底下啪地折斷了。

gloss_note: currently unavailable 目前無法提供

sentences.en: I'm sorry, Mr. Lee is unavailable right now.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，李先生現在沒空。

sentences.en: Why is this jacket unavailable in medium?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這件外套的中號缺貨？

sentences.en: She will be unavailable all day Friday because of training.
sentences.zh: 她星期五整天都要受訓，沒有空。

sentences.en: That dish is unavailable today because we ran out of fish.
sentences.zh: 那道菜今天沒有供應，因為我們的魚賣完了。

sentences.en: Will you be unavailable on Tuesday afternoon?
sentences.zh: 你星期二下午會沒空嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel said the room was unavailable for those dates.
sentences.zh: 飯店說那幾天沒有空房。

sentences.en: The interest rate remained unchanged this quarter.
sentences.zh: 利率本季維持不變。

sentences.en: Is the meeting time unchanged?
sentences.zh: 開會時間沒有變動嗎？

sentences.en: Our prices will stay unchanged through the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 我們的價格到年底都不會調整。

sentences.en: After ten years, the old town looks almost unchanged.
sentences.zh: 十年過去，這座老城看起來幾乎沒變。

sentences.en: Her opinion of the plan stayed unchanged.
sentences.zh: 她對這項計畫的看法沒有改變。

sentences.en: Why is the schedule unchanged even after the complaints?
sentences.zh: 即使有人抱怨，時間表為什麼還是沒改？

sentences.en: This chair is uncomfortable after an hour.
sentences.zh: 這張椅子坐了一個小時就很不舒服。

sentences.en: Are the seats on this flight uncomfortable?
sentences.zh: 這班飛機的座位不舒服嗎？

sentences.en: I feel uncomfortable when everyone looks at me.
sentences.zh: 大家都看著我的時候，我會覺得不自在。

sentences.en: The hotel bed was too hard and uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 飯店的床太硬，睡起來很不舒服。

sentences.en: Did the comments make you uncomfortable at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 那些評論讓你在會議上感到不自在嗎？

sentences.en: It's uncomfortable to wear a heavy coat indoors.
sentences.zh: 在室內穿厚外套很不舒服。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortybot assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: He has been unemployed since last spring.
sentences.zh: 他從去年春天起就失業了。

sentences.en: How many people are unemployed in this city?
sentences.zh: 這座城市有多少人失業？

sentences.en: The unemployed workers attended a free job fair.
sentences.zh: 失業的人參加了免費的就業博覽會。

sentences.en: Are you still unemployed, or did you find a new job?
sentences.zh: 你還在失業，還是已經找到新工作了？

sentences.en: My neighbor was unemployed for six months before he found work.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居失業了六個月才找到工作。

sentences.en: The government offers help to the unemployed.
sentences.zh: 政府對失業者提供協助。

Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: unify A and B 整合A與B

sentences.en: The new coach hopes to unify the team.
sentences.zh: 新教練希望能讓球隊團結一心。

sentences.en: How can we unify the two departments?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何整合這兩個部門？

sentences.en: A shared language helped unify the country.
sentences.zh: 共同的語言有助於統一這個國家。

sentences.en: The company wants to unify its websites under one design.
sentences.zh: 公司想把旗下的網站統一成同一種設計。

sentences.en: Can music unify people from different backgrounds?
sentences.zh: 音樂能讓不同背景的人團結起來嗎？

sentences.en: The king unified the small states into one nation.
sentences.zh: 國王把幾個小國統一成一個國家。

gloss_note: universal language 世界共通語言

sentences.en: Music is a universal language.
sentences.zh: 音樂是一種世界共通的語言。

sentences.en: Is a smile universal, or does its meaning change by culture?
sentences.zh: 微笑是普世皆然，還是意義會因文化而異？

sentences.en: This charger is universal and works with most phones.
sentences.zh: 這款充電器是通用型的，適用於大多數手機。

sentences.en: There is universal agreement that safety comes first.
sentences.zh: 大家一致認為安全第一。

sentences.en: Does this universal remote work with our TV?
sentences.zh: 這個通用遙控器可以用在我們的電視上嗎？

sentences.en: The film's message of hope is universal.
sentences.zh: 這部電影傳達的希望是人人共通的。

gloss_note: unload a truck 卸下卡車的貨

sentences.en: The workers will unload the truck this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 工人今天下午會卸下卡車上的貨。

sentences.en: Could you help me unload these boxes?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我卸下這些箱子嗎？

sentences.en: How long does it take to unload a cargo ship?
sentences.zh: 卸完一艘貨輪要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Please unload the groceries before the ice cream melts.
sentences.zh: 請趁冰淇淋融化前，把買回來的東西從車上搬下來。

sentences.en: The driver stopped at the loading dock to unload.
sentences.zh: 司機在卸貨區停車卸貨。

sentences.en: We need to unload the van before noon.
sentences.zh: 我們中午前得把廂型車上的貨卸下來。

gloss_note: an unpopular decision 不受歡迎的決定

sentences.en: The new policy is unpopular with employees.
sentences.zh: 新政策不受員工歡迎。

sentences.en: Why is this product so unpopular with young buyers?
sentences.zh: 這項產品為什麼不受年輕買家歡迎？

sentences.en: Making an unpopular decision is part of a manager's job.
sentences.zh: 做出不受歡迎的決定是主管工作的一部分。

sentences.en: The unpopular flavor was removed from the menu.
sentences.zh: 這個不受歡迎的口味已從菜單上撤掉。

sentences.en: Is the mayor really that unpopular?
sentences.zh: 市長真的那麼不受歡迎嗎？

sentences.en: He felt unpopular at his new school.
sentences.zh: 他在新學校覺得自己不受歡迎。

sentences.en: The company reported unprecedented growth this year.
sentences.zh: 公司公布今年的成長史無前例。

sentences.en: Is this level of demand unprecedented?
sentences.zh: 這樣的需求量是前所未見的嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists called the heat wave unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 科學家稱這波熱浪為前所未見。

sentences.en: We're facing an unprecedented challenge in this market.
sentences.zh: 我們正面臨這個市場前所未有的挑戰。

sentences.en: Did anyone expect such unprecedented sales on the first day?
sentences.zh: 有人料到開賣第一天就創下前所未有的銷量嗎？

sentences.en: Our school gave out an unprecedented number of awards this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我們學校頒發的獎項數量前所未有。

gloss_note: unstable economy 不穩定的經濟

sentences.en: This ladder feels unstable, so please hold it.
sentences.zh: 這把梯子感覺不穩，請幫我扶著。

sentences.en: Why is the internet connection so unstable today?
sentences.zh: 今天網路連線為什麼這麼不穩？

sentences.en: An unstable economy makes people afraid to spend money.
sentences.zh: 不穩定的經濟讓人不敢花錢。

sentences.en: The patient's condition is still unstable.
sentences.zh: 病人的狀況仍不穩定。

sentences.en: Is the old bridge too unstable for trucks?
sentences.zh: 這座舊橋對卡車來說是不是太不穩了？

sentences.en: Prices stay unstable when the weather keeps changing.
sentences.zh: 天氣一直變來變去，價格就一直不穩定。

sentences.en: It's unusually warm for November.
sentences.zh: 以十一月來說，天氣異常溫暖。

sentences.en: The office was unusually quiet this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上辦公室格外安靜。

sentences.en: Why was the airport unusually crowded today?
sentences.zh: 機場今天為什麼特別擁擠？

sentences.en: Sales were unusually high during the first week.
sentences.zh: 第一週的銷售額異常地高。

sentences.en: Is he unusually tall for his age?
sentences.zh: 以他的年齡來說，他是不是特別高？

sentences.en: Our manager arrived unusually late for the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們經理開會時罕見地晚到。

gloss_note: unveil a plan 公布計畫

sentences.en: The company will unveil its new phone next week.
sentences.zh: 公司下週將發表新手機。

sentences.en: When will they unveil the statue in the park?
sentences.zh: 公園裡的雕像什麼時候揭幕？

sentences.en: Our team will unveil the new design at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊會在會議上公布新設計。

sentences.en: The artist unveiled her latest painting at the gallery.
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家在畫廊揭開了她的最新畫作。

sentences.en: Are you ready to unveil the plan to the staff?
sentences.zh: 你準備好向員工公布這項計畫了嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor unveiled a plan to build more bike lanes.
sentences.zh: 市長公布了興建更多自行車道的計畫。

sentences.en: Uranium is used as fuel in some power plants.
sentences.zh: 鈾被用作某些發電廠的燃料。

sentences.en: The company mines uranium in a remote desert area.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在偏遠的沙漠地區開採鈾礦。

sentences.en: Where is most of the world's uranium mined?
sentences.zh: 世界上大部分的鈾是在哪裡開採的？

sentences.en: The price of uranium rose sharply last year.
sentences.zh: 鈾的價格去年大幅上漲。

sentences.en: Why do investors care about uranium?
sentences.zh: 投資人為什麼關注鈾？

sentences.en: Uranium is a heavy metal found in rocks and soil.
sentences.zh: 鈾是一種存在於岩石和土壤中的重金屬。

gloss_note: resist the urge 抵抗衝動

sentences.en: Doctors urge people to get enough sleep.
sentences.zh: 醫生極力呼籲大家要睡眠充足。

sentences.en: I felt a sudden urge to call my mom.
sentences.zh: 我突然很想打電話給媽媽。

sentences.en: Did he urge you to apply for the scholarship?
sentences.zh: 他有力勸你去申請那筆獎學金嗎？

sentences.en: The manager urged everyone to finish before Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理催促大家在星期五前完成。

sentences.en: Can you resist the urge to check your phone?
sentences.zh: 你能忍住想看手機的衝動嗎？

sentences.en: She urged the driver to slow down in the rain.
sentences.zh: 她極力勸司機在雨中開慢一點。

sentences.en: We urgently need a replacement for the broken printer.
sentences.zh: 我們急需一台新印表機來替換壞掉的那台。

sentences.en: Why did the client call so urgently this morning?
sentences.zh: 客戶今天早上為什麼這麼急著打電話來？

sentences.en: Is the manager urgently looking for someone to cover tonight's shift?
sentences.zh: 經理是不是急著找人頂今晚的班？

sentences.en: I need to speak with you urgently about the shipment.
sentences.zh: 關於那批貨，我有急事要跟你談。

sentences.en: The hotel staff urgently called a plumber about the leak.
sentences.zh: 飯店人員因為漏水緊急找來水電工。

sentences.en: The store is urgently hiring more cashiers for Saturday's sale.
sentences.zh: 商店急著多找幾位收銀員來應付週六的特賣。

sentences.en: Is this recipe website easy for a new user to follow?
sentences.zh: 對新使用者來說，這個食譜網站容易上手嗎？

sentences.en: As a first-time user, how do I order dinner through this app?
sentences.zh: 我是第一次使用，要怎麼用這個應用程式訂晚餐？

sentences.en: The ordering app asks every user to pick a pickup time.
sentences.zh: 這個點餐應用程式會要求每位使用者選擇取餐時間。

sentences.en: This blender is designed for the average home user.
sentences.zh: 這台果汁機是為一般家庭使用者設計的。

sentences.en: Each user can save up to fifty favorite recipes.
sentences.zh: 每位使用者最多可以收藏五十道喜愛的食譜。

sentences.en: Does the oven warn the user when the door is open?
sentences.zh: 烤箱在門沒關好時會提醒使用者嗎？

gloss_note: vacate the room 退房；較正式

sentences.en: Guests must vacate their rooms by eleven a.m.
sentences.zh: 房客必須在上午十一點前退房。

sentences.en: When do we have to vacate the old office?
sentences.zh: 我們什麼時候得搬出舊辦公室？

sentences.en: Would you mind vacating this seat for an elderly passenger?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把這個座位讓給一位年長的乘客嗎？

sentences.en: The tenants agreed to vacate the apartment before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 房客同意在月底前搬離這間公寓。

sentences.en: Please vacate the meeting room so the next team can use it.
sentences.zh: 請把會議室空出來，讓下一組人使用。

sentences.en: The store will vacate this space when the lease ends.
sentences.zh: 租約到期時，這家店會搬離這個店面。

sentences.en: The company is investing millions in a new flu vaccine.
sentences.zh: 這家公司投入數百萬資金研發新的流感疫苗。

sentences.en: Did the drug company finish testing the vaccine?
sentences.zh: 這家藥廠完成疫苗測試了嗎？

sentences.en: Which vaccine should children get before starting school?
sentences.zh: 孩子上學前應該接種哪些疫苗？

sentences.en: Doctors say the vaccine is safe and works well.
sentences.zh: 醫生說這種疫苗很安全，效果也很好。

sentences.en: The clinic ran out of the vaccine by noon.
sentences.zh: 診所中午前就把疫苗用完了。

sentences.en: Shares rose after the lab announced a promising vaccine.
sentences.zh: 實驗室宣布研發出一款很有希望的疫苗後，股價上漲了。

sentences.en: She made a vain attempt to fix the old radio.
sentences.zh: 她試著修理那台舊收音機，卻徒勞無功。

sentences.en: Why is he so vain about his looks?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼對自己的外表這麼自戀？

sentences.en: Our efforts to save the old tree were vain.
sentences.zh: 我們想保住那棵老樹的努力白費了。

sentences.en: Is it vain to spend an hour on my hair?
sentences.zh: 花一個小時整理頭髮，會不會太愛漂亮了？

sentences.en: After a vain search, we found the keys in my coat.
sentences.zh: 找了半天都找不到，結果鑰匙就在我的外套裡。

sentences.en: The actor was too vain to wear glasses on stage.
sentences.zh: 那位演員太愛面子，不肯戴眼鏡上台。

sentences.en: Turn the valve to shut off the water.
sentences.zh: 轉動閥門把水關掉。

sentences.en: Can you check whether the gas valve is closed?
sentences.zh: 你可以檢查一下瓦斯閥門有沒有關好嗎？

sentences.en: The engineer replaced a faulty valve in the pipe.
sentences.zh: 工程師換掉了管線中有問題的閥門。

sentences.en: How does a valve control the flow of liquid?
sentences.zh: 閥門是如何控制液體流動的？

sentences.en: The heart has valves that keep blood flowing in one direction.
sentences.zh: 心臟有瓣膜，讓血液只往單一方向流動。

sentences.en: Why did the doctor say the heart valve needed repair?
sentences.zh: 醫生為什麼說那個心臟瓣膜需要修復？

gloss_note: a vast amount of 大量的

sentences.en: The desert stretches across a vast area.
sentences.zh: 沙漠綿延在一大片廣闊的區域上。

sentences.en: Have you seen how vast the ocean looks from the plane?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有看過從飛機上俯瞰，海洋看起來有多遼闊？

sentences.en: A vast crowd gathered in the park for the concert.
sentences.zh: 一大群人聚集在公園裡看演唱會。

sentences.en: The library holds a vast collection of old maps.
sentences.zh: 這間圖書館收藏了大量的古地圖。

sentences.en: Why did the company spend such a vast sum on ads?
sentences.zh: 公司為什麼花這麼龐大的金額做廣告？

sentences.en: We drove through vast fields of corn all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們整個下午都開車穿過一望無際的玉米田。

gloss_note: vegan 不吃任何動物製品

sentences.en: Do you have any vegan desserts on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜單上有沒有純素的甜點？

sentences.en: My roommate has been vegan for three years.
sentences.zh: 我室友吃純素已經三年了。

sentences.en: Is this soup vegan, or does it have chicken broth?
sentences.zh: 這道湯是純素的嗎？還是有用雞高湯？

sentences.en: The café offers a vegan burger made with beans.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡館提供用豆子做的純素漢堡。

sentences.en: I'm cooking a vegan dinner for six friends tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚要煮純素晚餐給六位朋友。

sentences.en: Many vegans avoid honey as well as meat and eggs.
sentences.zh: 許多純素者除了肉和蛋之外，也不吃蜂蜜。

sentences.en: Thick vegetation covers the hills after the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 雨季過後，山丘上覆蓋著茂密的植被。

sentences.en: What kind of vegetation grows in a desert?
sentences.zh: 沙漠裡長的是哪一類植被？

sentences.en: Heavy rain washed away much of the vegetation on the slope.
sentences.zh: 豪雨沖走了斜坡上大部分的植被。

sentences.en: The trail was hard to follow through the dense vegetation.
sentences.zh: 茂密的草木讓人很難沿著小徑前進。

sentences.en: Does the local vegetation change with the altitude?
sentences.zh: 當地的植被會隨海拔高度而改變嗎？

sentences.en: The researchers measured how much vegetation the island had lost.
sentences.zh: 研究人員測量了這座島失去了多少植被。

sentences.en: Eat your veggies before you have dessert.
sentences.zh: 先把蔬菜吃完，再吃甜點。

sentences.en: Can I get extra veggies on my pizza?
sentences.zh: 我的披薩可以多加一些蔬菜嗎？

sentences.en: Which veggies go best in a stir-fry?
sentences.zh: 哪些蔬菜最適合拿來炒？

sentences.en: We roasted some veggies with olive oil and garlic.
sentences.zh: 我們用橄欖油和大蒜烤了一些蔬菜。

sentences.en: The kids picked fresh veggies from the garden.
sentences.zh: 孩子們從菜園裡摘了新鮮的蔬菜。

sentences.en: This farmers market sells the best local veggies in town.
sentences.zh: 這個農夫市集賣的是鎮上最棒的當地蔬菜。

sentences.en: Blood flows through a vein back to the heart.
sentences.zh: 血液經由靜脈流回心臟。

sentences.en: Why did the nurse have trouble finding a vein?
sentences.zh: 護理師為什麼很難找到靜脈？

sentences.en: Veins carry blood toward the heart, not away from it.
sentences.zh: 靜脈把血液送回心臟，而不是送離心臟。

sentences.en: Can you see the blue veins under your skin?
sentences.zh: 你看得到皮膚底下的藍色血管嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse drew blood from a vein in my arm.
sentences.zh: 護理師從我手臂的靜脈抽血。

sentences.en: A swollen vein in his leg made it hard to walk.
sentences.zh: 他腿上有一條靜脈腫起來，走路很不方便。

sentences.en: Machines in the lobby vend snacks and cold drinks.
sentences.zh: 大廳裡的機器販售點心和冷飲。

sentences.en: Does this machine vend hot coffee?
sentences.zh: 這台機器有賣熱咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: Street sellers vend fresh fruit near the station.
sentences.zh: 小販在車站附近擺攤賣新鮮水果。

sentences.en: The city allows people to vend food at the night market.
sentences.zh: 市政府允許民眾在夜市販售食物。

sentences.en: Who is allowed to vend food outside the stadium?
sentences.zh: 誰可以在體育場外面販賣食物？

sentences.en: You need a city permit to vend snacks on this street.
sentences.zh: 在這條街上賣點心需要市政府的許可。

gloss_note: reach a verdict 做出裁決

sentences.en: The jury reached a verdict after two days.
sentences.zh: 陪審團討論兩天後做出了裁決。

sentences.en: When will the court announce its verdict?
sentences.zh: 法院什麼時候會宣布裁決？

sentences.en: What's your verdict on the new restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這家新餐廳到底怎麼樣？

sentences.en: The critics' verdict on the movie was mostly positive.
sentences.zh: 影評人對這部電影的評價大多是正面的。

sentences.en: We're waiting for the board's verdict on the merger plan.
sentences.zh: 我們正在等董事會對合併案的裁決。

sentences.en: The judge said the verdict must be unanimous.
sentences.zh: 法官說裁決必須全體一致。

gloss_note: vessel 較正式；blood vessel 血管

sentences.en: A large vessel entered the harbor at dawn.
sentences.zh: 一艘大船在黎明時駛入港口。

sentences.en: What kind of vessel carries cargo across the ocean?
sentences.zh: 什麼樣的船能運貨橫越海洋？

sentences.en: The museum displays a clay vessel more than two thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一件兩千多年前的陶製容器。

sentences.en: Scientists heated the water in a glass vessel.
sentences.zh: 科學家在玻璃容器裡把水加熱。

sentences.en: Is the vessel carrying fuel or fruit?
sentences.zh: 這艘船載的是燃料還是水果？

sentences.en: Sailors secured the vessel before the storm arrived.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，水手們把船固定好了。

gloss_note: veto a plan 否決計畫

sentences.en: The mayor threatened to veto the new budget.
sentences.zh: 市長威脅要否決新預算。

sentences.en: Can the board veto the CEO's plan?
sentences.zh: 董事會可以否決執行長的計畫嗎？

sentences.en: Did the governor veto the road bill?
sentences.zh: 州長否決了那項道路法案嗎？

sentences.en: My manager used her veto to stop the hiring.
sentences.zh: 我的經理動用否決權，擋下了這次招聘。

sentences.en: Each member of the committee has the power to veto.
sentences.zh: 委員會的每位成員都有否決的權力。

sentences.en: We had to drop the idea after our boss vetoed it.
sentences.zh: 老闆否決之後，我們只好放棄這個點子。

sentences.en: Is this a viable plan for a small business?
sentences.zh: 這對小型企業來說是可行的計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The startup needs a viable way to make money.
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司需要一個可行的獲利方式。

sentences.en: Our team found a viable option under the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在預算內找到了一個可行的方案。

sentences.en: Is the new store financially viable?
sentences.zh: 這家新店在財務上撐得下去嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists say the seeds are still viable after ten years.
sentences.zh: 科學家說這些種子過了十年仍然具有生命力，可以發芽。

sentences.en: Which of these two ideas is more viable?
sentences.zh: 這兩個點子哪一個比較可行？

sentences.en: The show lost many viewers after the new season began.
sentences.zh: 新一季開播後，這個節目流失了許多觀眾。

sentences.en: How many viewers watched the final episode?
sentences.zh: 有多少觀眾收看了最後一集？

sentences.en: Advertisers want to reach younger viewers.
sentences.zh: 廣告商想接觸更年輕的觀眾。

sentences.en: Each viewer can pause the video and replay it.
sentences.zh: 每位觀眾都可以暫停影片並重新播放。

sentences.en: Do you know how many viewers the ad campaign reached?
sentences.zh: 你知道這波廣告活動觸及了多少觀眾嗎？

sentences.en: The station thanked its loyal viewers with a short video.
sentences.zh: 電視台用一段短片感謝忠實的觀眾。

sentences.en: A virus causes the common cold.
sentences.zh: 感冒是由病毒引起的。

sentences.en: Did you catch a virus on the trip?
sentences.zh: 你這趟旅行是不是感染了病毒？

sentences.en: The flu virus spreads easily in winter.
sentences.zh: 流感病毒在冬天很容易傳播。

sentences.en: Washing your hands helps stop a virus from spreading.
sentences.zh: 洗手有助於防止病毒擴散。

sentences.en: My laptop slowed down because of a virus.
sentences.zh: 我的筆電因為中了電腦病毒而變慢了。

sentences.en: How does a virus get into a cell?
sentences.zh: 病毒是怎麼進入細胞的？

gloss_note: visual aid 視覺輔助教具

sentences.en: Some students learn better with visual aids.
sentences.zh: 有些學生借助視覺輔助工具學得更好。

sentences.en: Is the poster's visual design clear to you?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這張海報的視覺設計夠清楚嗎？

sentences.en: The artist's visual style is easy to recognize.
sentences.zh: 這位藝術家的視覺風格很容易辨認。

sentences.en: Do you think visual memory is stronger than sound memory?
sentences.zh: 你覺得視覺記憶比聽覺記憶更強嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher used a visual timeline to explain the war.
sentences.zh: 老師用視覺化的時間軸來講解那場戰爭。

sentences.en: The movie's visual effects were amazing.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的視覺特效太驚人了。

sentences.en: Sleep is vital for your health.
sentences.zh: 睡眠對你的健康極為重要。

sentences.en: Is it vital to finish this today?
sentences.zh: 這件事非得今天做完不可嗎？

sentences.en: Water is vital to all living things.
sentences.zh: 水對所有生物都是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: Teamwork played a vital role in our success.
sentences.zh: 團隊合作在我們的成功中扮演了極重要的角色。

sentences.en: Why is it vital to check your tire pressure?
sentences.zh: 為什麼檢查胎壓這麼重要？

sentences.en: The doctor checked my vital signs first.
sentences.zh: 醫生先檢查了我的生命徵象。

sentences.en: Joining the cleanup is voluntary, not required.
sentences.zh: 參加清掃活動是自願的，不是強制的。

sentences.en: Is the fitness class voluntary or required?
sentences.zh: 這堂健身課是自願參加還是必修？

sentences.en: Her work at the animal shelter is entirely voluntary.
sentences.zh: 她在動物收容所的工作完全是出於自願。

sentences.en: The company asked for voluntary donations.
sentences.zh: 公司徵求自願捐款。

sentences.en: Are voluntary overtime hours paid here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的自願加班有給薪嗎？

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet is voluntary on this trail.
sentences.zh: 在這條步道上，戴安全帽是自願的。

gloss_note: volunteer to do 自願去做

sentences.en: We need a volunteer to help set up the chairs.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一位志工來幫忙擺椅子。

sentences.en: Who wants to volunteer for the bake sale?
sentences.zh: 誰想自願幫忙烘焙義賣？

sentences.en: She volunteers at the library every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 她每個星期六都在圖書館當志工。

sentences.en: Thanks to every volunteer who cleaned the beach.
sentences.zh: 感謝每一位清理海灘的志工。

sentences.en: I'll volunteer to take notes in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我自願在會議中做記錄。

sentences.en: Can you volunteer a few hours this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末可以抽出幾個小時當志工嗎？

sentences.en: The voyage across the ocean took two weeks.
sentences.zh: 橫越海洋的航行花了兩個星期。

sentences.en: How long was your voyage to the island?
sentences.zh: 你去那座島的航程有多久？

sentences.en: Early sailors began their voyage with little food.
sentences.zh: 早期的水手出航時只帶了很少的食物。

sentences.en: Did you enjoy the voyage on the cruise ship?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡搭郵輪的那趟旅程嗎？

sentences.en: The captain wished us a safe voyage.
sentences.zh: 船長祝我們一路平安。

sentences.en: The film follows a family's voyage around the world.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描述一個家庭環遊世界的旅程。

gloss_note: 較文學；日常多用 wake up

sentences.en: The noise from the street wakened the baby.
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音吵醒了寶寶。

sentences.en: Please don't waken your father; he's very tired.
sentences.zh: 請別吵醒你爸爸，他很累。

sentences.en: Will the alarm waken you in time for the flight?
sentences.zh: 鬧鐘會及時把你叫醒，讓你趕上班機嗎？

sentences.en: She wakened slowly to the smell of coffee.
sentences.zh: 她在咖啡香中慢慢醒來。

sentences.en: The thunder wakened me at three in the morning.
sentences.zh: 雷聲在凌晨三點把我驚醒。

sentences.en: How can we waken students' interest in science?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼喚起學生對科學的興趣？

sentences.en: The walkway between the two buildings is covered.
sentences.zh: 兩棟大樓之間的人行通道是有遮蔽的。

sentences.en: Please keep the walkway clear of boxes.
sentences.zh: 請保持走道暢通，不要堆放箱子。

sentences.en: Is there a walkway from the parking garage to the mall?
sentences.zh: 從停車場到購物中心有人行通道嗎？

sentences.en: Workers are repairing the walkway outside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 工人正在修理飯店外面的步道。

sentences.en: Where does this walkway lead?
sentences.zh: 這條通道通往哪裡？

sentences.en: Snow made the walkway slippery this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上下雪，讓走道變得很滑。

gloss_note: on the same wavelength 想法相近

sentences.en: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue light.
sentences.zh: 紅光的波長比藍光長。

sentences.en: How do scientists measure the wavelength of a sound wave?
sentences.zh: 科學家如何測量聲波的波長？

sentences.en: Radio waves have a very long wavelength.
sentences.zh: 無線電波的波長很長。

sentences.en: What happens to the wavelength when the frequency goes up?
sentences.zh: 頻率增加時，波長會怎麼變化？

sentences.en: The lab used a laser with a specific wavelength.
sentences.zh: 實驗室使用了特定波長的雷射。

sentences.en: Each color we see has its own wavelength.
sentences.zh: 我們看到的每種顏色都有各自的波長。

gloss_note: load a webpage 載入網頁

sentences.en: Our team is redesigning the company webpage.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊正在重新設計公司的網頁。

sentences.en: Can you send me the link to that webpage?
sentences.zh: 你可以把那個網頁的連結寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: The webpage takes too long to load.
sentences.zh: 這個網頁載入的時間太久了。

sentences.en: Why does the webpage show an error message?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個網頁會顯示錯誤訊息？

sentences.en: I saved the webpage so I could read it on the plane.
sentences.zh: 我把網頁存起來，這樣在飛機上也能看。

sentences.en: Each product has its own webpage with photos.
sentences.zh: 每項產品都有自己的網頁，上面有照片。

gloss_note: visit a website 瀏覽網站

sentences.en: Our school launched a new website last week.
sentences.zh: 我們學校上週推出了新網站。

sentences.en: Which website did you use to book the tickets?
sentences.zh: 你是用哪個網站訂票的？

sentences.en: This website has free videos for learning English.
sentences.zh: 這個網站有免費的英語學習影片。

sentences.en: Is the website down again?
sentences.zh: 這個網站又掛了嗎？

sentences.en: He built a small website for his bakery.
sentences.zh: 他為自己的烘焙坊做了一個小網站。

sentences.en: I read the news on a website every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都在網站上看新聞。

sentences.en: The school cares about students' welfare.
sentences.zh: 學校很關心學生的福祉。

sentences.en: Some families receive welfare when they lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 有些家庭失業時會領取福利補助。

sentences.en: Does the city do enough for child welfare?
sentences.zh: 市政府在兒童福利方面做得夠多嗎？

sentences.en: Good care is important for the welfare of farm animals.
sentences.zh: 良好的照顧對農場動物的福祉很重要。

sentences.en: Our company set up a fund for employee welfare.
sentences.zh: 我們公司設立了員工福利基金。

sentences.en: How can we protect the welfare of the elderly?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼保障長者的福祉？

sentences.en: The contract sets out a system whereby both sides share the costs.
sentences.zh: 合約訂定了一套制度，讓雙方藉此分攤費用。

sentences.en: Is there a process whereby customers can return items without a receipt?
sentences.zh: 有沒有一套流程，可以讓顧客不用收據也能退貨？

sentences.en: The report describes a method whereby waste is turned into energy.
sentences.zh: 報告描述了一種方法，可藉此把廢棄物轉為能源。

sentences.en: They created a plan whereby each employee works four days a week.
sentences.zh: 他們擬定了一項方案，讓每位員工每週只上四天班。

sentences.en: Can you explain the agreement whereby the two firms share profits?
sentences.zh: 你能說明讓兩家公司分享利潤的那份協議嗎？

sentences.en: The school adopted a policy whereby late work loses points.
