sentences.en: Can you carry the canvas to my car?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把畫布拿到我車上嗎？

sentences.en: Canvas shoes are cheap and comfortable in summer.
sentences.zh: 帆布鞋既便宜，夏天穿起來又舒服。

gloss_note: capability to do 做…的能力

sentences.en: The new software has impressive security capabilities.
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體有令人印象深刻的安全功能。

sentences.en: Does our team have the capability to finish this on time?
sentences.zh: 我們團隊有能力準時完成這件事嗎？

sentences.en: The factory doubled its production capability last year.
sentences.zh: 工廠去年把產能提高了一倍。

sentences.en: I doubt her capability to lead such a large team.
sentences.zh: 我懷疑她是否有能力帶領這麼大的團隊。

sentences.en: What are the main capabilities of this machine?
sentences.zh: 這台機器的主要性能有哪些？

sentences.en: The company is building its capability in data analysis.
sentences.zh: 公司正在培養資料分析的能力。

sentences.en: Oxygen passes through the thin wall of a capillary.
sentences.zh: 氧氣會穿過微血管的薄壁。

sentences.en: What is the job of a capillary in the body?
sentences.zh: 微血管在人體內的作用是什麼？

sentences.en: Capillaries connect the smallest arteries to the smallest veins.
sentences.zh: 微血管連接著最細的動脈與最細的靜脈。

sentences.en: Cold weather makes the capillaries near the skin narrow.
sentences.zh: 天冷會讓皮膚附近的微血管收縮。

sentences.en: Can you see a capillary under the microscope?
sentences.zh: 你在顯微鏡下看得到微血管嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher drew a capillary network on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上畫出微血管網。

sentences.en: Paris is the capital of France.
sentences.zh: 巴黎是法國的首都。

sentences.en: Do you know the capital of Canada?
sentences.zh: 你知道加拿大的首都是哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: Sacramento is the capital of California.
sentences.zh: 沙加緬度是加州的首府。

sentences.en: We took a train to the capital for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們搭火車去首都過週末。

sentences.en: Which state capital is closest to your hometown?
sentences.zh: 哪個州首府離你的家鄉最近？

sentences.en: The capital has restaurants from every part of the country.
sentences.zh: 首都有來自全國各地的餐廳。

sentences.en: Carbon is found in all living things.
sentences.zh: 所有生物體內都含有碳。

sentences.en: How can we reduce our carbon emissions at home?
sentences.zh: 我們在家要怎麼減少碳排放？

sentences.en: Burning coal puts a lot of carbon into the air.
sentences.zh: 燃燒煤炭會把大量的碳釋放到空氣中。

sentences.en: Does flying increase your carbon footprint a lot?
sentences.zh: 搭飛機會大幅增加你的碳足跡嗎？

sentences.en: Diamonds are made of pure carbon.
sentences.zh: 鑽石是由純碳構成的。

sentences.en: The company promised to cut its carbon output by half.
sentences.zh: 公司承諾把碳排放量減半。

sentences.en: Our town holds a carnival every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上每年夏天都會舉辦嘉年華。

sentences.en: Are you going to the school carnival on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你週五會去學校的園遊會嗎？

sentences.en: The kids rode the Ferris wheel at the carnival.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在嘉年華上玩了摩天輪。

sentences.en: We won a giant teddy bear at the carnival.
sentences.zh: 我們在園遊會上贏了一隻超大的泰迪熊。

sentences.en: Is there a parking lot near the carnival?
sentences.zh: 嘉年華附近有停車場嗎？

sentences.en: The carnival brings thousands of tourists to the city each year.
sentences.zh: 這場嘉年華每年為這座城市帶來數千名遊客。

sentences.en: The new casino created hundreds of jobs in town.
sentences.zh: 新賭場為鎮上創造了數百個工作機會。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to a casino in Las Vegas?
sentences.zh: 你去過拉斯維加斯的賭場嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a dealer at a casino downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心的一家賭場當荷官。

sentences.en: The hotel has a casino on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店一樓有一間賭場。

sentences.en: Is the casino open all night?
sentences.zh: 賭場整晚都有營業嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists spend a lot of money in the casino every weekend.
sentences.zh: 觀光客每個週末都在賭場花很多錢。

sentences.en: The failed launch was a financial catastrophe for the firm.
sentences.zh: 這次失敗的產品上市，對公司來說是一場財務災難。

sentences.en: How can we avoid another catastrophe like last year's?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼避免再發生像去年那樣的慘事？

sentences.en: A single mistake in the contract could mean catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 合約裡一個失誤就可能釀成大災難。

sentences.en: Did the flood turn into a real catastrophe for the town?
sentences.zh: 這場水災對小鎮來說真的變成大災難了嗎？

sentences.en: The bank's collapse was a catastrophe for many families.
sentences.zh: 銀行倒閉對許多家庭來說是場浩劫。

sentences.en: Forgetting the passports would be a catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 忘了帶護照可就慘了。

sentences.en: We toured the old cathedral on our trip to Europe.
sentences.zh: 我們去歐洲旅行時參觀了那座古老的大教堂。

sentences.en: How tall is the cathedral in the center of town?
sentences.zh: 市中心那座大教堂有多高？

sentences.en: The cathedral has beautiful stained glass windows.
sentences.zh: 這座大教堂有美麗的彩繪玻璃窗。

sentences.en: Did it take over a hundred years to build the cathedral?
sentences.zh: 這座大教堂花了一百多年才蓋好嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists line up outside the cathedral every morning.
sentences.zh: 觀光客每天早上都在大教堂外排隊。

sentences.en: The architect studied the cathedral's famous stone arches.
sentences.zh: 建築師研究了這座大教堂那些有名的石拱。

sentences.en: The cemetery is quiet and full of old trees.
sentences.zh: 這座墓園很安靜，園裡有許多老樹。

sentences.en: Is the cemetery open to visitors on weekends?
sentences.zh: 墓園週末有開放給民眾參觀嗎？

sentences.en: We walked past the cemetery on the way home.
sentences.zh: 我們回家的路上經過了那座墓園。

sentences.en: The town plans to build a new cemetery near the hill.
sentences.zh: 小鎮計畫在山丘旁蓋一座新的墓園。

sentences.en: Where is the nearest cemetery to your grandparents' house?
sentences.zh: 離你祖父母家最近的墓園在哪裡？

sentences.en: Old gravestones in the cemetery show names from the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 墓園裡的老墓碑上刻著1800年代的人名。

gloss_note: censor a film 審查電影

sentences.en: The TV station may censor some words in the movie.
sentences.zh: 電視台可能會刪掉這部電影裡的某些字眼。

sentences.en: Does the platform censor rude comments automatically?
sentences.zh: 這個平台會自動審查不雅的留言嗎？

sentences.en: The station decided to censor the scene before it aired.
sentences.zh: 電視台決定在播出前刪剪那一幕。

sentences.en: The school paper does not censor student articles.
sentences.zh: 校刊不會審查學生寫的文章。

sentences.en: Many music apps censor swear words in songs.
sentences.zh: 許多音樂應用程式會把歌曲裡的髒話消音。

sentences.en: Why did they censor the ending of the old film?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼要刪剪那部老電影的結局？

gloss_note: take a census 進行人口普查

sentences.en: The census is taken every ten years.
sentences.zh: 人口普查每十年進行一次。

sentences.en: According to the census, the town has 5,000 residents.
sentences.zh: 根據人口普查，這個小鎮有5,000名居民。

sentences.en: Did you fill out the census form this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年有填人口普查表嗎？

sentences.en: The city used census data to plan new schools.
sentences.zh: 市政府利用人口普查的資料來規劃新學校。

sentences.en: When will the next census start in your state?
sentences.zh: 你們州的下一次人口普查何時開始？

sentences.en: Census workers visited homes to ask a few questions.
sentences.zh: 人口普查員挨家挨戶拜訪，詢問幾個問題。

sentences.en: The graduation ceremony starts at ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 畢業典禮十點開始。

sentences.en: Are you going to the award ceremony tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚會去頒獎典禮嗎？

sentences.en: The opening ceremony included music and fireworks.
sentences.zh: 開幕典禮有音樂和煙火表演。

sentences.en: They held a small wedding ceremony in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 他們在後院舉行了一場小型婚禮。

sentences.en: Is there a ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new library?
sentences.zh: 新圖書館有剪綵儀式嗎？

sentences.en: The tea ceremony took almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 這場茶道儀式花了將近一個小時。

sentences.en: They got married in a small chapel by the lake.
sentences.zh: 他們在湖邊的一座小教堂結婚。

sentences.en: The hospital has a quiet chapel on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 醫院一樓有一間安靜的小教堂。

sentences.en: Is the campus chapel open to visitors?
sentences.zh: 校園裡的小教堂開放給訪客參觀嗎？

sentences.en: The chapel was built from local stone in 1920.
sentences.zh: 這座小教堂是1920年用當地石材蓋的。

sentences.en: Can we rent the chapel for a family event?
sentences.zh: 我們可以租這間小教堂辦家族活動嗎？

sentences.en: A student choir practices in the chapel every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 學生合唱團每週二都在小教堂練唱。

gloss_note: characterize A as B 把A形容成B

sentences.en: Critics characterize the film as slow but beautiful.
sentences.zh: 影評人把這部電影形容為節奏慢但很美。

sentences.en: How would you characterize your management style?
sentences.zh: 你會怎麼形容自己的管理風格？

sentences.en: Hot summers and mild winters characterize this region.
sentences.zh: 炎熱的夏天與溫和的冬天是這個地區的特色。

sentences.en: The report characterizes the new program as a success.
sentences.zh: 報告把這項新計畫描述為成功。

sentences.en: Would your friends characterize you as calm and funny?
sentences.zh: 你的朋友會把你形容成冷靜又風趣的人嗎？

sentences.en: A strong team spirit characterizes our department.
sentences.zh: 強烈的團隊精神是我們部門的特色。

sentences.en: How cheaply can a small team build a website?
sentences.zh: 一個小團隊能用多低的成本做出一個網站？

sentences.en: I got this couch very cheaply. Do you like it?
sentences.zh: 我很便宜就買到這張沙發。你喜歡嗎？

sentences.en: You can eat cheaply near campus. Want to join us?
sentences.zh: 學校附近可以吃得很便宜，要不要跟我們一起去？

sentences.en: The company produces its goods cheaply by using local materials.
sentences.zh: 這家公司使用在地材料，以低成本生產商品。

sentences.en: The house was built cheaply, so it needs many repairs.
sentences.zh: 這棟房子蓋得很廉價，所以需要大量整修。

sentences.en: We traveled cheaply across Europe by staying in hostels.
sentences.zh: 我們住青年旅館，花很少的錢玩遍歐洲。

sentences.en: I'll have a cheeseburger with fries, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一個起司漢堡加薯條，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Do you want onions on your cheeseburger?
sentences.zh: 你的起司漢堡要加洋蔥嗎？

sentences.en: He ate two cheeseburgers after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，他吃了兩個起司漢堡。

sentences.en: This cheeseburger is juicy, but it's too salty.
sentences.zh: 這個起司漢堡很多汁，但太鹹了。

sentences.en: Is the cheeseburger special still available?
sentences.zh: 起司漢堡的特餐還有嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter orders a cheeseburger every time we eat out.
sentences.zh: 我女兒每次外食都點起司漢堡。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: a slice of cheesecake 一塊起司蛋糕

sentences.en: We shared a slice of cheesecake for dessert.
sentences.zh: 我們分食了一塊起司蛋糕當甜點。

sentences.en: Does the cheesecake come with strawberry sauce?
sentences.zh: 這個起司蛋糕附草莓醬嗎？

sentences.en: She baked a cheesecake for her dad's birthday.
sentences.zh: 她烤了一個起司蛋糕幫爸爸慶生。

sentences.en: The cheesecake needs to chill overnight in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 起司蛋糕需要在冰箱裡冰一整晚。

sentences.en: Which do you like better, cheesecake or chocolate cake?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡起司蛋糕還是巧克力蛋糕？

sentences.en: This cheesecake is creamy and not too sweet.
sentences.zh: 這個起司蛋糕口感綿密，也不會太甜。

sentences.en: She finished her last round of chemotherapy in May.
sentences.zh: 她在五月完成了最後一個療程的化療。

sentences.en: Does chemotherapy always cause hair loss?
sentences.zh: 化療一定會掉頭髮嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors use chemotherapy to help treat many kinds of cancer.
sentences.zh: 醫生會用化療來幫助治療多種癌症。

sentences.en: My aunt is doing well during her chemotherapy.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在化療期間狀況不錯。

sentences.en: How long does each chemotherapy treatment take?
sentences.zh: 每次化療要花多久時間？

sentences.en: New medicines have made chemotherapy easier on patients.
sentences.zh: 新藥讓化療對病患來說比較不那麼辛苦。

gloss_note: 美國常指辣豆肉醬這道菜

sentences.en: We made a big pot of chili on game day.
sentences.zh: 比賽日那天我們煮了一大鍋辣肉醬。

sentences.en: Do you want cheese on your chili?
sentences.zh: 你的辣肉醬要加起司嗎？

sentences.en: Add one chili pepper to the sauce if you like it spicy.
sentences.zh: 喜歡吃辣的話，就在醬裡加一根辣椒。

sentences.en: My dad's chili has beans, beef, and lots of spices.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸煮的辣肉醬有豆子、牛肉和很多香料。

sentences.en: Is this chili too spicy for kids?
sentences.zh: 這道辣肉醬對小朋友來說會太辣嗎？

sentences.en: She chopped a red chili pepper and tossed it in the pan.
sentences.zh: 她切了一根紅辣椒丟進鍋裡。

sentences.en: Table salt is sodium chloride.
sentences.zh: 食鹽就是氯化鈉。

sentences.en: What happens when sodium chloride dissolves in water?
sentences.zh: 氯化鈉溶於水時會發生什麼事？

sentences.en: The lab tested the water for chloride.
sentences.zh: 實驗室檢驗了水中的氯化物含量。

sentences.en: Too much chloride can damage the pipes.
sentences.zh: 氯化物過多可能會損壞水管。

sentences.en: Does this sports drink contain potassium chloride?
sentences.zh: 這款運動飲料含有氯化鉀嗎？

sentences.en: Students measured the chloride in a salt solution.
sentences.zh: 學生測量了鹽溶液中的氯化物含量。

sentences.en: I sing in the school choir every Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我每週四都會參加學校合唱團練唱。

sentences.en: Does your community choir need more singers?
sentences.zh: 你們社區的合唱團還需要更多團員嗎？

sentences.en: The choir will perform at the winter concert.
sentences.zh: 合唱團將在冬季音樂會上演出。

sentences.en: She joined the choir in middle school.
sentences.zh: 她國中時加入了合唱團。

sentences.en: How long has the choir been rehearsing this song?
sentences.zh: 合唱團練這首歌練多久了？

sentences.en: The choir sounded wonderful in the big hall.
sentences.zh: 合唱團在大廳裡唱起來好聽極了。

gloss_note: play a chord 彈一個和弦

sentences.en: Can you play this chord on the guitar?
sentences.zh: 你可以用吉他彈這個和弦嗎？

sentences.en: A major chord usually sounds bright and happy.
sentences.zh: 大和弦聽起來通常明亮又愉快。

sentences.en: He learned three chords and wrote his first song.
sentences.zh: 他學了三個和弦，就寫出了第一首歌。

sentences.en: The pianist played a soft chord to start the piece.
sentences.zh: 鋼琴家彈了一個輕柔的和弦，為這首曲子開場。

sentences.en: Which chord comes next in this song?
sentences.zh: 這首歌接下來是哪個和弦？

sentences.en: Is it hard to change from one chord to the next?
sentences.zh: 從一個和弦換到下一個很難嗎？

sentences.en: It's my turn to do the chores today.
sentences.zh: 今天輪到我做家務。

sentences.en: Do your kids help with chores around the house?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子會幫忙做家事嗎？

sentences.en: Washing dishes is my least favorite chore.
sentences.zh: 洗碗是我最不喜歡的家務。

sentences.en: I have a few chores to finish before dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐前我還有幾件雜事要做完。

sentences.en: Which chore do you hate the most?
sentences.zh: 你最討厭哪一項家務？

sentences.en: We split the weekend chores between the three of us.
sentences.zh: 週末的家務由我們三個人分著做。

sentences.en: The house was built circa 1920, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 這棟房子大約是1920年蓋的，對不對？

sentences.en: The castle dates from circa 1600. Have you seen it?
sentences.zh: 那座城堡大約建於1600年。你去看過嗎？

sentences.en: The museum owns a clay jar made circa 500 BC.
sentences.zh: 博物館收藏了一只約西元前500年製作的陶罐。

sentences.en: This map is from circa 1850, according to the label.
sentences.zh: 根據標籤，這張地圖大約是1850年的。

sentences.en: The painting is dated circa 1890. Is it worth much?
sentences.zh: 這幅畫的年代約為1890年。它很值錢嗎？

sentences.en: Historians say the town was founded circa 1700.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家說，這個小鎮大約建於1700年。

gloss_note: cite a source 引用資料來源

sentences.en: Remember to cite your sources in the essay.
sentences.zh: 記得在文章中引用你的資料來源。

sentences.en: Can you cite an example to support your point?
sentences.zh: 你能舉個例子來支持你的論點嗎？

sentences.en: The report cites several studies on sleep and memory.
sentences.zh: 這份報告引用了幾項關於睡眠與記憶的研究。

sentences.en: Did the lawyer cite any earlier cases in court?
sentences.zh: 律師在法庭上有引用任何先前的案例嗎？

sentences.en: She cited heavy traffic as the reason she was late.
sentences.zh: 她舉塞車當作自己遲到的理由。

sentences.en: Our professor always cites recent research in his lectures.
sentences.zh: 我們教授上課時總是引用最新的研究。

sentences.en: She applied for U.S. citizenship last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天申請了美國公民身分。

sentences.en: Does your child have dual citizenship?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子有雙重國籍嗎？

sentences.en: He received his citizenship at a small ceremony.
sentences.zh: 他在一場小型儀式中取得了公民身分。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get citizenship?
sentences.zh: 取得公民身分要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Citizenship is required for some government jobs.
sentences.zh: 有些政府職位要求具備公民身分。

sentences.en: The class prepares immigrants for the citizenship test.
sentences.zh: 這堂課幫移民準備公民身分考試。

sentences.en: Voting is an important civic duty.
sentences.zh: 投票是重要的公民責任。

sentences.en: The civic center hosts a farmers market every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 市民活動中心每週日都舉辦農夫市集。

sentences.en: Are you active in any civic groups in your town?
sentences.zh: 你在鎮上有積極參與任何市民團體嗎？

sentences.en: Our class learned about civic responsibility today.
sentences.zh: 我們班今天學了公民責任。

sentences.en: What civic projects is your club planning this year?
sentences.zh: 你們社團今年規劃了哪些公益計畫？

sentences.en: Residents showed great civic pride after the park reopened.
sentences.zh: 公園重新開放後，居民展現了高度的市民榮譽感。

gloss_note: clam chowder 蛤蜊巧達濃湯

sentences.en: I'd like a bowl of clam chowder, please.
sentences.zh: 請給我一碗蛤蜊巧達濃湯。

sentences.en: Do you want to dig for clams at the beach?
sentences.zh: 你想去海灘挖蛤蜊嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh clams are cooked with garlic and white wine.
sentences.zh: 新鮮蛤蜊用大蒜和白酒烹煮。

sentences.en: The clam shells opened as soon as the pot got hot.
sentences.zh: 鍋子一燒熱，蛤蜊殼就打開了。

sentences.en: Are the clams in this soup fresh or frozen?
sentences.zh: 這道湯裡的蛤蜊是新鮮的還是冷凍的？

sentences.en: We ate fried clams at a little seafood place.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家小海鮮餐館吃了炸蛤蜊。

sentences.en: I need more clarity on what the client wants.
sentences.zh: 我需要更清楚了解客戶想要什麼。

sentences.en: The photo has amazing clarity, even when zoomed in.
sentences.zh: 這張照片就算放大也非常清晰。

sentences.en: Could you give me some clarity on the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我釐清一下新的時程嗎？

sentences.en: The new rules brought clarity to the whole team.
sentences.zh: 新規定讓整個團隊都清楚了方向。

sentences.en: Does the contract lack clarity about payment dates?
sentences.zh: 合約對付款日期的說明是否不夠明確？

sentences.en: She explained the plan with great clarity.
sentences.zh: 她把計畫解釋得非常清楚。

sentences.en: This restaurant looks classy, so let's dress up.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳看起來很高級，我們穿正式一點吧。

sentences.en: Is the new wine bar as classy as people say?
sentences.zh: 這家新開的酒吧真的像大家說的那麼有品味嗎？

sentences.en: She picked a classy black dress for the dinner.
sentences.zh: 她為晚宴挑了一件有質感的黑色洋裝。

sentences.en: The hotel lobby has a classy, quiet feel.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店的大廳有種高雅沉靜的氣氛。

sentences.en: Is it classy to wear sneakers to a nice restaurant?
sentences.zh: 穿球鞋去高級餐廳，這樣有品味嗎？

sentences.en: Their classy dessert menu includes a lemon tart.
sentences.zh: 他們高級的甜點菜單上有檸檬塔。

gloss_note: a clause in a contract 合約條款

sentences.en: Please read the cancellation clause before you sign.
sentences.zh: 簽名前請先讀過取消條款。

sentences.en: Does the lease have a clause about pets?
sentences.zh: 這份租約有關於寵物的條款嗎？

sentences.en: The contract includes a clause that protects the buyer.
sentences.zh: 合約中有一項保護買方的條款。

sentences.en: Our lawyer added a new clause to the agreement.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師在協議中加了一項新條款。

sentences.en: Which clause says we must give thirty days' notice?
sentences.zh: 哪一條寫著我們必須提前三十天通知？

sentences.en: A clause in the deal lets either side leave early.
sentences.zh: 協議中有一項條款允許任何一方提前退出。

sentences.en: The cleric spoke at the opening of the new library.
sentences.zh: 一位神職人員在新圖書館的開幕典禮上致詞。

sentences.en: Our history teacher showed a painting of a medieval cleric.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史老師展示了一幅中世紀神職人員的畫。

sentences.en: Did the local cleric attend the community dinner?
sentences.zh: 當地的神職人員有出席社區聚餐嗎？

sentences.en: A cleric helped organize the food drive last winter.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天有一位神職人員協助籌辦食物捐贈活動。

sentences.en: The news said a cleric will lead the charity walk.
sentences.zh: 新聞說一位神職人員將帶領慈善健走。

sentences.en: Which cleric wrote this old book in the museum?
sentences.zh: 博物館裡這本古書是哪位神職人員寫的？

sentences.en: The baby clung to her mother's coat at the door.
sentences.zh: 寶寶在門口緊抓著媽媽的外套。

sentences.en: Wet clothes cling to your skin on a rainy day.
sentences.zh: 下雨天濕衣服會黏在皮膚上。

sentences.en: Why does plastic wrap always cling to my fingers?
sentences.zh: 為什麼保鮮膜總是黏在我的手指上？

sentences.en: He clung to the railing as the boat rocked.
sentences.zh: 船搖晃時，他緊抓著欄杆。

sentences.en: Does this window film cling to glass without any glue?
sentences.zh: 這種窗貼不用膠水也能黏在玻璃上嗎？

sentences.en: Small drops of water clung to the window.
sentences.zh: 小水珠附著在窗戶上。

sentences.en: The company is running a clinical trial for a new drug.
sentences.zh: 這家公司正在進行新藥的臨床試驗。

sentences.en: Is she doing her clinical training at the hospital?
sentences.zh: 她正在醫院做臨床實習嗎？

sentences.en: Clinical studies show the treatment works well for most patients.
sentences.zh: 臨床研究顯示這種療法對多數病人很有效。

sentences.en: She is a clinical psychologist with an office downtown.
sentences.zh: 她是臨床心理師，辦公室在市區。

sentences.en: Nursing students get clinical experience in their last year.
sentences.zh: 護理系學生在最後一年累積臨床經驗。

sentences.en: Did the clinical results match what the doctors expected?
sentences.zh: 臨床結果和醫生的預期相符嗎？

gloss_note: 多用於商業或政壇，口語

sentences.en: She has a lot of clout in the industry.
sentences.zh: 她在業界很有影響力。

sentences.en: Does our department have enough clout to change the policy?
sentences.zh: 我們部門有足夠的影響力改變政策嗎？

sentences.en: A reference letter from him carries real clout.
sentences.zh: 他寫的推薦信很有影響力。

sentences.en: The big supplier uses its clout to set prices.
sentences.zh: 那家大供應商憑藉其勢力來訂價。

sentences.en: Small shops lack the clout to negotiate with the landlord.
sentences.zh: 小商家沒有足夠的影響力和房東談判。

sentences.en: How much clout does a new manager really have?
sentences.zh: 新上任的經理究竟有多少影響力？

gloss_note: a cluster of ~ 一群／一串

sentences.en: A cluster of grapes hung from the vine.
sentences.zh: 一串葡萄掛在藤上。

sentences.en: Tourists cluster around the fountain every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 遊客每天下午都聚集在噴泉周圍。

sentences.en: Why do all the new cafes cluster on this street?
sentences.zh: 為什麼新開的咖啡館都聚集在這條街上？

sentences.en: Astronomers found a cluster of stars near the center of our galaxy.
sentences.zh: 天文學家在銀河系中心附近發現了一個星團。

sentences.en: A small cluster of houses sits by the lake.
sentences.zh: 湖邊有一小群房子。

sentences.en: Did you see the cluster of balloons at the entrance?
sentences.zh: 你有看到入口那一束氣球嗎？

sentences.en: The coffin was made of plain pine wood.
sentences.zh: 這口棺材是用素面的松木做的。

sentences.en: The museum has an ancient stone coffin on display.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一口古代石棺。

sentences.en: Did the family choose a simple coffin for the service?
sentences.zh: 家屬為喪禮選了簡單的棺木嗎？

sentences.en: Flowers covered the coffin during the quiet ceremony.
sentences.zh: 在肅穆的儀式中，鮮花覆蓋著棺木。

sentences.en: In the movie, a hidden coffin leads to a secret room.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一口隱藏的棺材通往一間密室。

sentences.en: How much does a basic coffin cost these days?
sentences.zh: 現在一口基本款的棺材要多少錢？

sentences.en: My vacation will coincide with the school break.
sentences.zh: 我的假期會和學校放假的時間重疊。

sentences.en: Do our lunch breaks coincide on Fridays?
sentences.zh: 我們週五的午休時間有重疊嗎？

sentences.en: The sale happens to coincide with the holiday weekend.
sentences.zh: 特價剛好和連假週末同時舉行。

sentences.en: Their visit coincided with our office move.
sentences.zh: 他們來訪的時間正好跟我們搬辦公室撞期。

sentences.en: Why do the two meetings always coincide?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這兩場會議老是撞期？

sentences.en: The product launch should coincide with the trade show.
sentences.zh: 產品上市應該配合展覽同時進行。

sentences.en: What a coincidence to meet you here!
sentences.zh: 在這裡遇到你，真是巧！

sentences.en: It was just a coincidence that we chose the same shirt.
sentences.zh: 我們挑了同一件襯衫，純屬巧合。

sentences.en: Is it a coincidence that both stores closed this week?
sentences.zh: 兩家店這週都關門，是巧合嗎？

sentences.en: By coincidence, my neighbor works at the same company.
sentences.zh: 湊巧的是，我鄰居和我在同一家公司上班。

sentences.en: The detective in the show doesn't believe in coincidence.
sentences.zh: 影集裡的偵探不相信巧合。

sentences.en: Do you think that was a coincidence or a plan?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那是巧合還是計畫？

gloss_note: 偏正式；多用於書面或會議

sentences.en: The team collectively agreed to work late on Friday.
sentences.zh: 全隊一致同意週五加班。

sentences.en: The five stores collectively earned more than last year.
sentences.zh: 五家店合計賺得比去年多。

sentences.en: The neighbors collectively paid for the new fence.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們共同出錢蓋了新圍籬。

sentences.en: The students collectively wrote a letter to the principal. Did you read it?
sentences.zh: 學生們共同寫了一封信給校長。你看過了嗎？

sentences.en: The tenants collectively asked for repairs. Has the landlord replied?
sentences.zh: 房客們共同要求修繕。房東回覆了嗎？

sentences.en: Collectively, the three of us speak four languages.
sentences.zh: 我們三個人合起來會說四種語言。

gloss_note: food columnist 美食專欄作家

sentences.en: My dad reads his favorite columnist every morning.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每天早上都會讀他最喜歡的專欄作家的文章。

sentences.en: The columnist wrote about rising rent in the city.
sentences.zh: 這位專欄作家寫了城裡租金上漲的事。

sentences.en: Is she a food columnist for the local paper?
sentences.zh: 她是地方報紙的美食專欄作家嗎？

sentences.en: The columnist answers readers' questions about money.
sentences.zh: 這位專欄作家回答讀者有關理財的問題。

sentences.en: Did you read what the sports columnist said today?
sentences.zh: 你有看今天體育專欄作家寫的東西嗎？

sentences.en: He became a columnist after ten years as a reporter.
sentences.zh: 他當了十年記者後成為專欄作家。

gloss_note: stand-up comedian 單口喜劇演員

sentences.en: The comedian had the whole room laughing.
sentences.zh: 這位喜劇演員讓全場笑聲不斷。

sentences.en: Do you want to see a comedian at the club tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想去俱樂部看喜劇演員表演嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle wanted to be a comedian when he was young.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔年輕時想當喜劇演員。

sentences.en: Which comedian is hosting the awards show?
sentences.zh: 哪位喜劇演員主持頒獎典禮？

sentences.en: The comedian told jokes about airport food.
sentences.zh: 這位喜劇演員講了關於機場餐點的笑話。

sentences.en: She works as a comedian and teaches classes on weekends.
sentences.zh: 她是喜劇演員，週末還教課。

sentences.en: This sofa seats four people comfortably.
sentences.zh: 這張沙發可以讓四個人舒適地坐下。

sentences.en: The chairs are new and wide. Can you sit comfortably in one?
sentences.zh: 椅子是新的，也很寬。你坐起來舒服嗎？

sentences.en: She won the race comfortably, finishing well ahead.
sentences.zh: 她輕鬆贏得比賽，遙遙領先。

sentences.en: We can comfortably finish the report by noon.
sentences.zh: 我們可以輕鬆在中午前完成報告。

sentences.en: Does your salary let you live comfortably in this city?
sentences.zh: 你的薪水能讓你在這座城市過得舒適嗎？

sentences.en: The tent is big enough to sleep three people comfortably.
sentences.zh: 這頂帳篷大到可以讓三個人舒適地睡。

gloss_note: 正式用語，日常多說 start

sentences.en: The ceremony will commence at ten o'clock sharp.
sentences.zh: 典禮將於十點整開始。

sentences.en: The doors open at noon. When will the show commence?
sentences.zh: 大門中午開啟。表演何時開始？

sentences.en: Construction on the new bridge will commence in March.
sentences.zh: 新橋的工程將於三月動工。

sentences.en: The company will commence hiring next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月將開始招募人員。

sentences.en: Classes commence the first Monday of September.
sentences.zh: 課程在九月的第一個星期一開始。

sentences.en: The meeting should commence as soon as everyone arrives. Is Tom here yet?
sentences.zh: 會議等大家到齊就該開始了。湯姆到了嗎？

sentences.en: The sports commentator got excited during the final minute.
sentences.zh: 球評在最後一分鐘變得很興奮。

sentences.en: Who is the commentator for tonight's game?
sentences.zh: 今晚這場比賽的球評是誰？

sentences.en: A news commentator explained the new tax rules.
sentences.zh: 一位新聞評論員解說了新的稅制。

sentences.en: Do you like the commentator on that baseball broadcast?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡那場棒球轉播的球評嗎？

sentences.en: She worked as a radio commentator for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她當了十年的廣播評論員。

sentences.en: The commentator said the home team played well.
sentences.zh: 球評說主場球隊表現得很好。

sentences.en: She earns a ten percent commission on every sale.
sentences.zh: 她每筆銷售可賺百分之十的佣金。

sentences.en: Do you work on commission or get a fixed salary?
sentences.zh: 你是領佣金還是領固定薪水？

sentences.en: The agent's commission is paid after the deal closes.
sentences.zh: 仲介的佣金在交易完成後支付。

sentences.en: How much commission do you get per sale?
sentences.zh: 你每筆交易可以拿多少佣金？

sentences.en: He sells cars and makes most of his money from commission.
sentences.zh: 他賣車，大部分收入來自佣金。

sentences.en: Our sales team gets a bonus on top of the commission.
sentences.zh: 我們的業務團隊除了佣金還有獎金。

gloss_note: make a commitment 做出承諾

sentences.en: Thank you for your commitment to the project.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你對這個專案的投入。

sentences.en: Do you have time for another commitment this month?
sentences.zh: 你這個月還有時間再答應一件事嗎？

sentences.en: The coach praised the team's commitment to training.
sentences.zh: 教練稱讚球隊對訓練的投入。

sentences.en: Making a commitment to exercise takes real effort.
sentences.zh: 下定決心要運動需要真正的努力。

sentences.en: She made a commitment to visit her grandma weekly.
sentences.zh: 她承諾每週去看外婆。

sentences.en: Is the company's commitment to quality clear to customers?
sentences.zh: 公司對品質的承諾，顧客看得出來嗎？

gloss_note: 多見於歷史課與教科書

sentences.en: Our history class studied the rise of communism in the 1900s.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史課探討了1900年代共產主義的興起。

sentences.en: The textbook describes communism as a system of shared property.
sentences.zh: 課本把共產主義描述為一種財產共有的制度。

sentences.en: Does this chapter explain how communism began?
sentences.zh: 這一章有解釋共產主義是如何開始的嗎？

sentences.en: The museum exhibit shows daily life in the era of communism.
sentences.zh: 博物館的展覽呈現共產主義時期的日常生活。

sentences.en: What did the teacher say about communism today?
sentences.zh: 老師今天談了哪些關於共產主義的內容？

sentences.en: Our essay topic is the history of communism in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我們的作文題目是歐洲共產主義的歷史。

sentences.en: The nurse treated every patient with compassion.
sentences.zh: 護理師以同情心對待每一位病人。

sentences.en: Do you feel compassion for people who lose their jobs?
sentences.zh: 你會同情那些失業的人嗎？

sentences.en: He showed great compassion when his friend was sick.
sentences.zh: 朋友生病時，他展現了很大的同情心。

sentences.en: Teachers need patience and compassion.
sentences.zh: 老師需要耐心和同情心。

sentences.en: Her compassion for stray animals led her to volunteer.
sentences.zh: 她對流浪動物的憐憫之心促使她去當志工。

sentences.en: Where does her compassion for strangers come from?
sentences.zh: 她對陌生人的同情心是從哪裡來的？

sentences.en: She is a compassionate doctor who listens carefully.
sentences.zh: 她是一位體貼的醫師，會仔細傾聽。

sentences.en: Is your manager compassionate when someone is ill?
sentences.zh: 有人生病時，你的主管有同情心嗎？

sentences.en: The compassionate neighbor brought soup to the family.
sentences.zh: 那位體貼的鄰居帶了湯給那家人。

sentences.en: We need a more compassionate approach to customer complaints.
sentences.zh: 我們處理客訴需要更體貼的做法。

sentences.en: He was kind and compassionate to every student.
sentences.zh: 他對每位學生都親切又有同情心。

sentences.en: Why are some people more compassionate than others?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人比別人更有同情心？

sentences.en: The airline offered compensation for the delayed flight.
sentences.zh: 航空公司為延誤的班機提供賠償。

sentences.en: What kind of compensation comes with this job?
sentences.zh: 這份工作的薪酬待遇是什麼？

sentences.en: Her compensation includes a salary and a yearly bonus.
sentences.zh: 她的薪酬包括薪水和年終獎金。

sentences.en: Did the driver pay compensation for the damaged fence?
sentences.zh: 那位駕駛有賠償被撞壞的圍籬嗎？

sentences.en: Workers asked for fair compensation for overtime.
sentences.zh: 員工要求為加班給予合理的報酬。

sentences.en: The store gave me a free item as compensation.
sentences.zh: 商店送我一件免費商品作為補償。

sentences.en: She is a competent manager who solves problems quickly.
sentences.zh: 她是個能幹的經理，解決問題很迅速。

sentences.en: Is the new assistant competent enough to handle the phones?
sentences.zh: 新來的助理夠稱職，能負責接電話嗎？

sentences.en: We need a competent mechanic to fix the brakes.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一位稱職的技師來修煞車。

sentences.en: He is competent in math but nervous about speaking.
sentences.zh: 他的數學能力足夠，但一說話就緊張。

sentences.en: A competent teacher explains hard ideas in simple words.
sentences.zh: 稱職的老師會用簡單的話解釋困難的概念。

sentences.en: How do you tell if a contractor is competent?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼判斷承包商稱不稱職？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The complexity of the tax form confused me.
sentences.zh: 這份稅表的複雜程度讓我很困惑。

sentences.en: Did you expect this much complexity in the project?
sentences.zh: 你有料到這個專案會這麼複雜嗎？

sentences.en: The report explains the complexity of the housing market.
sentences.zh: 這份報告說明了房市的複雜性。

sentences.en: We tried to reduce the complexity of the menu.
sentences.zh: 我們試著降低菜單的複雜度。

sentences.en: Her essay shows the complexity of family relationships.
sentences.zh: 她的文章呈現了家庭關係的複雜性。

sentences.en: Why does the complexity of software keep growing?
sentences.zh: 為什麼軟體的複雜度一直在增加？

sentences.en: Thank you for the compliment. That's very kind.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的稱讚，你人真好。

sentences.en: My boss complimented me on the presentation.
sentences.zh: 老闆稱讚了我的簡報。

sentences.en: Did anyone compliment your new haircut?
sentences.zh: 有人稱讚你的新髮型嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me a nice compliment about my cooking.
sentences.zh: 她誇獎了我的廚藝。

sentences.en: He complimented the chef on the soup.
sentences.zh: 他稱讚主廚的湯很好喝。

sentences.en: How do you respond when someone pays you a compliment?
sentences.zh: 別人稱讚你的時候，你怎麼回應？

sentences.en: Each component is tested before it leaves the factory.
sentences.zh: 每個零件在出廠前都會經過測試。

sentences.en: Which component of the engine needs replacing?
sentences.zh: 引擎的哪個零件需要更換？

sentences.en: Trust is a key component of any good team.
sentences.zh: 信任是任何好團隊的關鍵要素。

sentences.en: The main components of the dish are rice and beans.
sentences.zh: 這道菜的主要成分是米飯和豆子。

sentences.en: Do you sell individual components, or only the full set?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣單獨的零件，還是只賣整組？

sentences.en: Exercise is an important component of a healthy life.
sentences.zh: 運動是健康生活的重要組成部分。

sentences.en: Skipping meetings will only compound the problem.
sentences.zh: 缺席會議只會讓問題更嚴重。

sentences.en: Bad weather compounded the delays at the airport.
sentences.zh: 惡劣天氣使機場的延誤更加嚴重。

sentences.en: Don't compound your mistake by lying about it.
sentences.zh: 別用說謊來加重你的錯誤。

sentences.en: Will a price increase compound our financial troubles?
sentences.zh: 漲價會讓我們的財務困難更嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: Her illness was compounded by a lack of sleep.
sentences.zh: 她的病情因睡眠不足而加重。

sentences.en: How did the new rule compound the confusion?
sentences.zh: 新規定是怎麼讓混亂更嚴重的？

sentences.en: I can't comprehend why the system keeps crashing.
sentences.zh: 我無法理解為什麼系統一直當機。

sentences.en: Young children can't comprehend complex rules yet.
sentences.zh: 年幼的孩子還無法理解複雜的規則。

sentences.en: Did you comprehend everything in the contract?
sentences.zh: 合約裡的每一點你都理解了嗎？

sentences.en: She struggled to comprehend the long science article.
sentences.zh: 她很吃力才讀懂那篇長長的科學文章。

sentences.en: It's hard to comprehend how big the universe is.
sentences.zh: 很難理解宇宙到底有多大。

sentences.en: Can students comprehend this text without a dictionary?
sentences.zh: 學生不查字典能看懂這篇文章嗎？

sentences.en: The committee comprises five members from different departments.
sentences.zh: 委員會由來自不同部門的五位成員組成。

sentences.en: The course comprises twelve short lessons.
sentences.zh: 這門課包含十二堂短課。

sentences.en: Is the package comprised of three separate parts?
sentences.zh: 這組商品是由三個獨立的部分組成的嗎？

sentences.en: The campus comprises six buildings and a large park.
sentences.zh: 校園包含六棟建築和一座大公園。

sentences.en: The team is comprised of ten people from three countries.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊由來自三個國家的十個人組成。

sentences.en: Does the collection comprise more than a hundred paintings?
sentences.zh: 這批收藏包含一百多幅畫作嗎？

gloss_note: reach a compromise 達成妥協

sentences.en: We reached a compromise on the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們在預算上達成了折衷方案。

sentences.en: Neither side wanted to compromise at first.
sentences.zh: 起初雙方都不想妥協。

sentences.en: Can we compromise and meet at six instead?
sentences.zh: 我們可以各退一步，改成六點碰面嗎？

sentences.en: Good relationships need a bit of compromise.
sentences.zh: 好的關係需要一點妥協。

sentences.en: Is there a compromise that works for everyone?
sentences.zh: 有沒有對大家都行得通的折衷辦法？

sentences.en: She refused to compromise on quality.
sentences.zh: 她不願在品質上妥協。

sentences.en: Is a foreign language compulsory at your high school?
sentences.zh: 你們高中的外語是必修的嗎？

sentences.en: Is it compulsory to wear a helmet here?
sentences.zh: 在這裡一定要戴安全帽嗎？

sentences.en: Attendance at the safety training is compulsory.
sentences.zh: 必須參加安全訓練。

sentences.en: Seat belts are compulsory for all passengers.
sentences.zh: 所有乘客都必須繫安全帶。

sentences.en: Are the team meetings compulsory, or can I skip them?
sentences.zh: 團隊會議是強制參加的，還是我可以不去？

sentences.en: Compulsory education ends at age sixteen in some states.
sentences.zh: 在某些州，義務教育到十六歲結束。

sentences.en: The clinic plans to computerize its patient records.
sentences.zh: 診所計畫將病歷電腦化。

sentences.en: We computerized the whole inventory system last year.
sentences.zh: 我們去年把整個庫存系統電腦化了。

sentences.en: Did the library computerize its catalog yet?
sentences.zh: 圖書館已經把目錄電腦化了嗎？

sentences.en: It cost a lot to computerize the old factory.
sentences.zh: 把舊工廠電腦化花了很多錢。

sentences.en: Why did the bank computerize its loan process?
sentences.zh: 銀行為什麼要把貸款流程電腦化？

sentences.en: Many offices computerized their filing in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 許多辦公室在1990年代把檔案作業電腦化。

sentences.en: He tried to conceal his surprise.
sentences.zh: 他試圖掩飾自己的驚訝。

sentences.en: Did the company conceal the problem from customers?
sentences.zh: 公司有對顧客隱瞞這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: She used a scarf to conceal the stain on her shirt.
sentences.zh: 她用絲巾遮住襯衫上的污漬。

sentences.en: The thick fog concealed the road ahead.
sentences.zh: 濃霧遮住了前方的路。

sentences.en: Why would anyone conceal a mistake like that?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人會隱瞞那樣的錯誤？

sentences.en: The report concealed the real cost of the project.
sentences.zh: 這份報告隱瞞了專案的實際成本。

gloss_note: 常簡稱 condo；各戶有獨立產權

sentences.en: They bought a condominium near the beach last spring.
sentences.zh: 他們去年春天在海邊附近買了一戶公寓。

sentences.en: How much is the monthly fee at your condominium?
sentences.zh: 你們那棟公寓大樓的每月管理費是多少？

sentences.en: The condominium has a pool and a small gym.
sentences.zh: 這棟公寓大樓有游泳池和小型健身房。

sentences.en: Many retirees prefer a condominium to a big house.
sentences.zh: 許多退休人士比較喜歡住公寓大樓，而不是大房子。

sentences.en: Is the condominium close to public transportation?
sentences.zh: 這棟公寓大樓離大眾運輸近嗎？

sentences.en: The condominium board voted to repaint the building.
sentences.zh: 公寓大樓管理委員會投票決定重新粉刷大樓。

gloss_note: conduct a survey 進行問卷調查

sentences.en: We will conduct a survey of our customers next week.
sentences.zh: 我們下週將對顧客進行問卷調查。

sentences.en: Who will conduct the interview this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 今天下午誰來進行面試？

sentences.en: The scientists conducted the experiment three times.
sentences.zh: 科學家們把實驗進行了三次。

sentences.en: Teachers conduct a short quiz every Friday.
sentences.zh: 老師每週五都會進行一次小考。

sentences.en: The bank is conducting a review of its fees.
sentences.zh: 銀行正在對手續費進行檢討。

sentences.en: Do you conduct business over the phone or online?
sentences.zh: 你們是透過電話還是線上做生意？

sentences.en: Heat travels through metal by conduction.
sentences.zh: 熱透過傳導在金屬中傳遞。

sentences.en: A spoon in hot soup warms up through conduction.
sentences.zh: 熱湯裡的湯匙會透過傳導變燙。

sentences.en: What is the difference between conduction and convection?
sentences.zh: 傳導和對流有什麼不同？

sentences.en: Copper pans heat evenly because of fast heat conduction.
sentences.zh: 銅鍋因為熱傳導快，所以受熱均勻。

sentences.en: Our science teacher showed us electrical conduction with a battery.
sentences.zh: 我們的自然老師用電池示範了電的傳導。

sentences.en: Is conduction in wood as fast as it is in metal?
sentences.zh: 木頭的傳導和金屬一樣快嗎？

sentences.en: I need to confer with my lawyer before I sign.
sentences.zh: 我簽名前需要先和律師商量。

sentences.en: The doctors conferred for an hour about the treatment.
sentences.zh: 醫生們針對治療方式商議了一個小時。

sentences.en: Can we confer with the team before we decide?
sentences.zh: 我們決定前可以先和團隊商量一下嗎？

sentences.en: The judges stepped out to confer privately.
sentences.zh: 評審們走到一旁私下討論。

sentences.en: She conferred with her manager about the schedule.
sentences.zh: 她和經理商議了時程。

sentences.en: Would you like to confer with your partner first?
sentences.zh: 你要不要先和你的合夥人商量一下？

sentences.en: I have a confession to make. I ate your cake.
sentences.zh: 我得坦白一件事：我吃了你的蛋糕。

sentences.en: The suspect's confession surprised the whole town.
sentences.zh: 嫌犯的招認讓全鎮都很驚訝。

sentences.en: In the movie, the detective finally gets a confession.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，偵探終於讓嫌犯招供了。

sentences.en: Was his confession honest or just an excuse?
sentences.zh: 他的坦白是出於誠實，還是只是藉口？

sentences.en: Her confession made me like her even more.
sentences.zh: 她的坦白讓我更喜歡她了。

sentences.en: Do you have a confession to make about the missing pie?
sentences.zh: 關於不見的那塊派，你有什麼要坦白的嗎？

sentences.en: The strange test question confounded the whole class.
sentences.zh: 那道奇怪的考題難倒了全班。

sentences.en: The results confounded the researchers.
sentences.zh: 研究結果讓研究人員一頭霧水。

sentences.en: Does this puzzle confound you, too?
sentences.zh: 這個謎題也難倒你了嗎？

sentences.en: The complex rules confound many new players.
sentences.zh: 複雜的規則讓許多新手玩家搞不懂。

sentences.en: What could confound an expert like her?
sentences.zh: 什麼事能難倒像她這樣的專家？

sentences.en: His sudden silence confounded his friends.
sentences.zh: 他突然沉默，讓朋友們摸不著頭腦。

sentences.en: The two drivers had a heated confrontation over the parking spot.
sentences.zh: 兩位駕駛為了停車位起了激烈衝突。

sentences.en: Many people avoid confrontation at work.
sentences.zh: 很多人在工作上會避免衝突。

sentences.en: Is a face-to-face confrontation really necessary?
sentences.zh: 真的有必要當面對峙嗎？

sentences.en: The video shows a confrontation between fans after the game.
sentences.zh: 影片拍到比賽結束後球迷之間的衝突。

sentences.en: She hates confrontation, so she sent an email.
sentences.zh: 她討厭正面衝突，所以寄了電子郵件。

sentences.en: How can we settle this without a confrontation?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在不起衝突的情況下解決這件事？

sentences.en: Our congressman visited the high school today.
sentences.zh: 我們選區的眾議員今天到高中參訪。

sentences.en: The congressman gave a speech about road repairs.
sentences.zh: 這位眾議員針對道路修繕發表了演說。

sentences.en: Did you write a letter to your congressman?
sentences.zh: 你有寫信給你的眾議員嗎？

sentences.en: A local congressman opened the new community library.
sentences.zh: 當地一位眾議員為新的社區圖書館主持開幕。

sentences.en: Who is the congressman for this district?
sentences.zh: 這個選區的眾議員是誰？

sentences.en: The congressman toured the factory and met the workers.
sentences.zh: 這位眾議員參觀了工廠並和員工見面。

sentences.en: Her actions are congruent with her words.
sentences.zh: 她的行動和她說的話一致。

sentences.en: Are these two sets of data congruent?
sentences.zh: 這兩組資料相符嗎？

sentences.en: The results were congruent with our earlier findings.
sentences.zh: 結果與我們先前的發現一致。

sentences.en: His story is not congruent with the camera footage.
sentences.zh: 他的說法與監視器畫面不一致。

sentences.en: Is the company's mission congruent with its daily practices?
sentences.zh: 公司的使命和日常做法是否一致？

sentences.en: A good plan should be congruent with your goals.
sentences.zh: 好的計畫應該與你的目標一致。

gloss_note: in conjunction with 與…配合（正式）

sentences.en: The ad runs in conjunction with the sale. Did you see it?
sentences.zh: 這則廣告配合特賣活動一起推出。你看到了嗎？

sentences.en: The event is held in conjunction with the city fair.
sentences.zh: 這場活動與市集同期舉辦。

sentences.en: Use this cream in conjunction with a daily sunscreen.
sentences.zh: 這款乳霜請搭配每日防曬一起使用。

sentences.en: We worked in conjunction with the design team.
sentences.zh: 我們與設計團隊配合進行。

sentences.en: The new policy, in conjunction with lower prices, boosted sales.
sentences.zh: 新政策再加上降價，帶動了銷售成長。

sentences.en: Can the app work in conjunction with my calendar?
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式可以搭配我的行事曆一起使用嗎？

gloss_note: USB connector 接頭；多指電子零件

sentences.en: Do you have a connector that fits this cable?
sentences.zh: 你有適合這條線的接頭嗎？

sentences.en: The connector on my charger is loose.
sentences.zh: 我充電器的接頭鬆掉了。

sentences.en: Which connector do I need for the projector?
sentences.zh: 投影機要用哪一種連接器？

sentences.en: He plugged the connector into the back of the monitor.
sentences.zh: 他把接頭插進螢幕背面。

sentences.en: A faulty connector can cause the signal to drop.
sentences.zh: 有瑕疵的連接器可能讓訊號中斷。

sentences.en: Please check that each connector is firmly attached.
sentences.zh: 請確認每個接頭都接牢了。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: That word has a negative connotation in English.
sentences.zh: 這個字在英文裡帶有負面的隱含意義。

sentences.en: Does this phrase have a different connotation in your language?
sentences.zh: 這個說法在你的語言裡有不同的言外之意嗎？

sentences.en: Sorry, I didn't mean for that word to have a bad connotation.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我沒有要讓那個詞聽起來有不好的言外之意。

sentences.en: Marketers choose names with a positive connotation.
sentences.zh: 行銷人員會選擇帶有正面意涵的名稱。

sentences.en: Why does the color red carry a connotation of luck in some cultures?
sentences.zh: 為什麼紅色在某些文化裡帶有幸運的意涵？

sentences.en: The writer chose each word for its subtle connotation.
sentences.zh: 作者挑選每個字，都是看中它細微的言外之意。

sentences.en: It has rained for five consecutive days.
sentences.zh: 已經連續下了五天的雨。

sentences.en: Did you work two consecutive weekends again?
sentences.zh: 你又連續兩個週末都上班嗎？

sentences.en: Our team won three consecutive games.
sentences.zh: 我們隊連贏了三場比賽。

sentences.en: How many consecutive nights can I stay at this hotel?
sentences.zh: 我最多可以連續住這間飯店幾晚？

sentences.en: She missed two consecutive payments on her credit card.
sentences.zh: 她的信用卡連續兩期都沒繳款。

sentences.en: Sales have grown for six consecutive quarters.
sentences.zh: 銷售額已經連續六季成長。

gloss_note: 共謀詐欺 conspiracy to defraud

sentences.en: The movie is about a conspiracy inside a large bank.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一家大銀行內部的陰謀。

sentences.en: Do you think the detective will uncover the conspiracy?
sentences.zh: 你覺得偵探會揭穿這場陰謀嗎？

sentences.en: Prosecutors charged three men with conspiracy to commit fraud.
sentences.zh: 檢方以共謀詐欺罪起訴了三名男子。

sentences.en: Historians found letters that revealed a conspiracy against the king.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家找到信件，揭露了一場針對國王的陰謀。

sentences.en: Was the conspiracy ever proven in court?
sentences.zh: 這起共謀後來在法庭上被證實了嗎？

sentences.en: That show has a great twist about a secret conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 那部影集有個關於秘密陰謀的精彩轉折。

sentences.en: Water is the main constituent of the human body.
sentences.zh: 水是人體的主要成分。

sentences.en: What are the key constituents of this herbal tea?
sentences.zh: 這款花草茶的主要成分有哪些？

sentences.en: Each constituent of the plan needs its own budget.
sentences.zh: 計畫的每個組成部分都需要各自的預算。

sentences.en: Which constituent of the soil helps plants grow best?
sentences.zh: 土壤中的哪種成分最有助於植物生長？

sentences.en: Iron is a key constituent of steel.
sentences.zh: 鐵是鋼的重要成分。

sentences.en: Hydrogen and oxygen are the two constituents of water.
sentences.zh: 氫和氧是水的兩種組成成分。

sentences.en: Our biggest constraint on this project is time.
sentences.zh: 這個專案最大的限制是時間。

sentences.en: Do we have any budget constraints I should know about?
sentences.zh: 我需要知道有什麼預算上的限制嗎？

sentences.en: Due to space constraints, we can't add another desk.
sentences.zh: 由於空間有限，我們沒辦法再多放一張桌子。

sentences.en: Is there a time constraint on this quiz?
sentences.zh: 這次小考有時間限制嗎？

sentences.en: She works well under tight constraints.
sentences.zh: 她在嚴格的限制下也能表現得很好。

sentences.en: The study was limited by financial constraints.
sentences.zh: 這項研究受限於經費。

sentences.en: Is the flu still contagious after three days?
sentences.zh: 流感過了三天還會傳染嗎？

sentences.en: That virus is contagious, so wash your hands often.
sentences.zh: 那種病毒會傳染，所以要常洗手。

sentences.en: Stay home until you're no longer contagious.
sentences.zh: 在不再具有傳染力之前，請待在家裡。

sentences.en: Chickenpox is highly contagious among young children.
sentences.zh: 水痘在幼童之間的傳染力很強。

sentences.en: Is smiling really contagious, or is that a myth?
sentences.zh: 微笑真的會傳染，還是只是迷思？

sentences.en: His excitement was contagious, and the whole team felt it.
sentences.zh: 他的興奮很有感染力，整個團隊都感受到了。

sentences.en: Don't use the same knife, or you'll contaminate the salad.
sentences.zh: 別用同一把刀，不然會汙染沙拉。

sentences.en: How did the chemicals contaminate the river?
sentences.zh: 這些化學物質是怎麼汙染河川的？

sentences.en: Wash your hands so you don't contaminate the food.
sentences.zh: 要洗手，才不會汙染食物。

sentences.en: Could the dirty water contaminate our drinking water?
sentences.zh: 髒水會不會汙染我們的飲用水？

sentences.en: Oil spills can contaminate the soil for many years.
sentences.zh: 漏油可能讓土壤受汙染好幾年。

sentences.en: The lab uses gloves to avoid contaminating the samples.
sentences.zh: 實驗室戴手套以避免汙染樣本。

sentences.en: I prefer contemporary art to classical paintings.
sentences.zh: 比起古典繪畫，我比較喜歡當代藝術。

sentences.en: Is this a contemporary design or an older style?
sentences.zh: 這是現代設計，還是比較舊的款式？

sentences.en: She writes contemporary fiction about modern city life.
sentences.zh: 她寫的是描寫現代都市生活的當代小說。

sentences.en: Do you listen to contemporary music or old songs?
sentences.zh: 你聽的是當代音樂，還是老歌？

sentences.en: The hotel has a bright, contemporary look.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有明亮的現代風格。

sentences.en: Our English class reads contemporary American authors.
sentences.zh: 我們的英文課讀的是當代美國作家的作品。

sentences.en: He looked at the cheater with contempt.
sentences.zh: 他用輕蔑的眼神看著作弊的人。

sentences.en: Why do you treat your coworkers with such contempt?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這樣輕蔑地對待同事？

sentences.en: She dismissed the idea with open contempt.
sentences.zh: 她毫不掩飾輕蔑，否決了那個點子。

sentences.en: I have nothing but contempt for people who lie.
sentences.zh: 我對說謊的人只有鄙視。

sentences.en: Do you really feel contempt for him, or are you just angry?
sentences.zh: 你真的鄙視他，還是只是在生氣？

sentences.en: His voice was full of contempt as he answered.
sentences.zh: 他回答時語氣充滿輕蔑。

sentences.en: Will the storm hit the continental United States?
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨會襲擊美國本土嗎？

sentences.en: Does this phone plan cover the whole continental U.S.?
sentences.zh: 這個手機方案涵蓋整個美國本土嗎？

sentences.en: Inland areas often have a continental climate with cold winters.
sentences.zh: 內陸地區常屬大陸性氣候，冬天很冷。

sentences.en: Fish are plentiful on the continental shelf.
sentences.zh: 大陸棚上的魚類很豐富。

sentences.en: Shipping costs are higher outside the continental U.S.
sentences.zh: 美國本土以外的運費比較高。

sentences.en: Continental drift moves the continents slowly over millions of years.
sentences.zh: 大陸漂移讓各大陸在數百萬年間緩慢移動。

sentences.en: The economy saw a sharp contraction last quarter.
sentences.zh: 經濟在上一季大幅萎縮。

sentences.en: Will the contraction in the housing market continue?
sentences.zh: 房市的緊縮會持續下去嗎？

sentences.en: A contraction in demand forced the factory to cut hours.
sentences.zh: 需求萎縮，迫使工廠縮減工時。

sentences.en: Analysts expect a contraction in sales this year.
sentences.zh: 分析師預期今年銷售會萎縮。

sentences.en: What caused the contraction in our retail business?
sentences.zh: 是什麼造成我們零售業務萎縮？

sentences.en: The report shows a three percent contraction in exports.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示出口萎縮了百分之三。

sentences.en: The two witnesses gave contradictory statements.
sentences.zh: 兩名目擊者的說詞互相矛盾。

sentences.en: Why are these instructions so contradictory?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這些說明這麼前後矛盾？

sentences.en: I got contradictory advice from two different doctors.
sentences.zh: 我從兩位醫生那裡得到互相矛盾的建議。

sentences.en: Are these two reports contradictory, or am I missing something?
sentences.zh: 這兩份報告互相矛盾嗎，還是我漏看了什麼？

sentences.en: Her words and her actions are completely contradictory.
sentences.zh: 她的言行完全互相矛盾。

sentences.en: The study produced contradictory results in the second trial.
sentences.zh: 這項研究在第二次試驗中出現了互相牴觸的結果。

gloss_note: a contributor to 某事的貢獻者

sentences.en: She is a regular contributor to the local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 她是地方報紙的固定撰稿人。

sentences.en: Who is the biggest contributor to this project?
sentences.zh: 這個專案貢獻最多的人是誰？

sentences.en: Thanks to every contributor who shared ideas this week.
sentences.zh: 感謝這週分享點子的每一位貢獻者。

sentences.en: Is he a paid writer or just a contributor?
sentences.zh: 他是領薪水的作者，還是只是撰稿人？

sentences.en: Our magazine is always looking for new contributors.
sentences.zh: 我們的雜誌一直在找新的撰稿人。

sentences.en: She was named the top contributor to the fundraiser.
sentences.zh: 她被選為募款活動的最大貢獻者。

sentences.en: The new school dress code is quite controversial.
sentences.zh: 新的學校服裝規定很有爭議。

sentences.en: Why was that ad so controversial?
sentences.zh: 那支廣告為什麼這麼有爭議？

sentences.en: That film was controversial when it first came out.
sentences.zh: 那部電影剛上映時引發了爭議。

sentences.en: Is it controversial to require overtime on weekends?
sentences.zh: 要求週末加班有爭議嗎？

sentences.en: I don't want to say anything controversial in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我不想在會議上說任何有爭議的話。

sentences.en: The city made a controversial decision to close the old library.
sentences.zh: 市政府做出關閉舊圖書館這個有爭議的決定。

gloss_note: convert A into B 把A轉成B

sentences.en: Can you convert this file to another format?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這個檔案轉成別的格式嗎？

sentences.en: We plan to convert the garage into a home office.
sentences.zh: 我們打算把車庫改裝成家庭辦公室。

sentences.en: How do I convert miles to kilometers?
sentences.zh: 英里要怎麼換算成公里？

sentences.en: The factory was converted into apartments last year.
sentences.zh: 那間工廠去年被改建成公寓。

sentences.en: This sofa converts into a bed in seconds.
sentences.zh: 這張沙發幾秒鐘就能變成一張床。

sentences.en: Please convert the price to U.S. dollars.
sentences.zh: 請把價格換算成美元。

sentences.en: My mom gave me her old cookbook.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽把她的舊食譜書送給了我。

sentences.en: Do you have a good cookbook for beginners?
sentences.zh: 你有適合新手的食譜書嗎？

sentences.en: I found this recipe in a cookbook at the library.
sentences.zh: 我在圖書館的一本食譜書裡找到這道料理的做法。

sentences.en: Which cookbook did you use for this cake?
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕你是照哪一本食譜書做的？

sentences.en: She is writing a cookbook about easy weeknight dinners.
sentences.zh: 她正在寫一本關於簡易平日晚餐的食譜書。

sentences.en: The cookbook has pictures for every dish.
sentences.zh: 這本食譜書的每道菜都有照片。

gloss_note: cordless phone/drill 無線電話／電鑽

sentences.en: I need to charge my cordless drill.
sentences.zh: 我得幫無線電鑽充電。

sentences.en: Did you see where I left the cordless phone?
sentences.zh: 你有看到我把無線電話放哪了嗎？

sentences.en: A cordless vacuum is easier to use on the stairs.
sentences.zh: 無線吸塵器在樓梯上比較好用。

sentences.en: Do you carry cordless screwdrivers in this store?
sentences.zh: 這間店有賣無線螺絲起子嗎？

sentences.en: The cordless model costs twenty dollars more.
sentences.zh: 無線款貴了二十美元。

sentences.en: She bought a cordless hair dryer for traveling.
sentences.zh: 她買了一支旅行用的無線吹風機。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame

sentences.en: What is the core of the problem?
sentences.zh: 問題的核心是什麼？

sentences.en: Quality is one of our core values.
sentences.zh: 品質是我們的核心價值之一。

sentences.en: Strong core muscles help prevent back pain.
sentences.zh: 核心肌群強健有助於預防背痛。

sentences.en: Is trust at the core of a good team?
sentences.zh: 信任是一個好團隊的核心嗎？

sentences.en: Let's focus on the core issues first.
sentences.zh: 我們先專注在核心議題上吧。

sentences.en: The core of the earth is extremely hot.
sentences.zh: 地球的核心溫度極高。

sentences.en: She works in the corporate office downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區的公司總部上班。

sentences.en: Does the corporate policy allow working from home?
sentences.zh: 公司政策允許在家工作嗎？

sentences.en: He left a corporate job to start his own business.
sentences.zh: 他辭去企業的工作，自己創業。

sentences.en: We have a corporate discount at this hotel.
sentences.zh: 我們在這間飯店有企業折扣。

sentences.en: Corporate profits rose for the third year in a row.
sentences.zh: 企業獲利連續第三年成長。

sentences.en: What kind of corporate culture does your company have?
sentences.zh: 你們公司是什麼樣的企業文化？

gloss_note: 指大型或股份有限公司

sentences.en: My uncle works for a large corporation.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在一家大企業工作。

sentences.en: Is your company a small shop or a corporation?
sentences.zh: 你的公司是小店，還是大企業？

sentences.en: The corporation announced record profits this morning.
sentences.zh: 該公司今天早上宣布創紀錄的獲利。

sentences.en: She started a corporation with two friends.
sentences.zh: 她和兩位朋友成立了一家公司。

sentences.en: Which corporation made this software?
sentences.zh: 這套軟體是哪家公司做的？

sentences.en: Every large corporation needs a good legal team.
sentences.zh: 每家大企業都需要優秀的法務團隊。

sentences.en: We need to take corrective action right away.
sentences.zh: 我們必須立刻採取改正措施。

sentences.en: What corrective steps has the team already taken?
sentences.zh: 團隊已經採取了哪些改正措施？

sentences.en: The manager asked for a corrective plan by Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理要求週五前提出改善計畫。

sentences.en: Did the corrective measures actually fix the problem?
sentences.zh: 這些改正措施真的解決問題了嗎？

sentences.en: Her knee needed corrective surgery after the injury.
sentences.zh: 她膝蓋受傷後需要做矯正手術。

sentences.en: She wears corrective lenses for reading.
sentences.zh: 她閱讀時需要戴矯正鏡片。

sentences.en: She is a foreign correspondent for a national newspaper.
sentences.zh: 她是全國性報紙的駐外特派員。

sentences.en: Our correspondent in Paris filed this report.
sentences.zh: 我們駐巴黎的特派員發回了這則報導。

sentences.en: Do you know the correspondent reporting from the scene?
sentences.zh: 你認識那位在現場報導的記者嗎？

sentences.en: He has been a sports correspondent for ten years.
sentences.zh: 他當了十年的體育記者。

sentences.en: Which correspondent will cover the storm tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天是哪位特派記者要報導這場暴風雨？

sentences.en: The network sent a correspondent to the airport.
sentences.zh: 電視網派了一名記者到機場。

sentences.en: The restroom is at the end of the corridor.
sentences.zh: 洗手間在走廊的盡頭。

sentences.en: Is this corridor the way to the conference room?
sentences.zh: 這條走廊是通往會議室的路嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't leave boxes in the corridor.
sentences.zh: 請不要把箱子放在走廊上。

sentences.en: The students walked quietly down the corridor.
sentences.zh: 學生們安靜地沿著走廊走。

sentences.en: A long corridor connects the two buildings.
sentences.zh: 一條長長的通道連接著兩棟大樓。

sentences.en: Which corridor leads to the emergency exit?
sentences.zh: 哪一條走廊通往緊急出口？

gloss_note: give counsel 給予建議；較正式

sentences.en: My grandfather always gave me wise counsel.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺總是給我睿智的勸告。

sentences.en: She counsels students who are worried about college.
sentences.zh: 她為擔心上大學的學生提供諮詢。

sentences.en: Can I ask for your counsel on a personal matter?
sentences.zh: 我能就一件私事請你給我些建議嗎？

sentences.en: Who counsels new parents at this clinic?
sentences.zh: 這間診所是誰在為新手父母提供諮詢？

sentences.en: He took his mother's counsel and saved some money.
sentences.zh: 他聽從母親的勸告，存了一些錢。

sentences.en: Doctors often counsel patients to get more sleep.
sentences.zh: 醫生常勸病人多睡一點。

gloss_note: school counselor 學校輔導老師

sentences.en: I have an appointment with the school counselor tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天跟學校輔導老師有約。

sentences.en: Is your counselor helping you pick a college?
sentences.zh: 你的輔導老師有幫你選大學嗎？

sentences.en: She became a counselor because she likes helping people.
sentences.zh: 她因為喜歡幫助別人而當了諮商師。

sentences.en: The camp counselor taught the kids how to swim.
sentences.zh: 營隊輔導員教孩子們游泳。

sentences.en: Would you like to talk to a counselor about it?
sentences.zh: 你想跟諮商師聊聊這件事嗎？

sentences.en: The company hired a counselor to support its staff.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請了一位諮商師來支持員工。

sentences.en: We drove through the beautiful countryside on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我們週日開車穿過美麗的鄉間。

sentences.en: Do you prefer the city or the countryside?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡城市還是鄉下？

sentences.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母住在鄉下。

sentences.en: The hotel offers tours of the surrounding countryside.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供周邊鄉間的導覽行程。

sentences.en: Is there a good restaurant in the countryside near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近的鄉下有好吃的餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: The countryside here is green after the spring rain.
sentences.zh: 春雨過後，這裡的鄉間一片翠綠。

gloss_note: 比 polite 稍正式，常用於服務

sentences.en: The hotel staff were friendly and courteous.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工親切又有禮貌。

sentences.en: Was the waiter courteous to you?
sentences.zh: 服務生對你有禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: Please be courteous to other passengers.
sentences.zh: 請對其他乘客有禮貌。

sentences.en: He gave a courteous reply to the angry customer.
sentences.zh: 他對生氣的顧客給了有禮貌的回覆。

sentences.en: Is it courteous to take a phone call during dinner?
sentences.zh: 用餐時接電話有禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: A courteous driver always lets others merge.
sentences.zh: 有禮貌的駕駛總是會讓其他車輛併入車道。

sentences.en: The news station gave full coverage of the game.
sentences.zh: 新聞台對這場比賽做了完整的報導。

sentences.en: Does my insurance include coverage for dental work?
sentences.zh: 我的保險有包含牙科治療的保障嗎？

sentences.en: The coverage of the festival was on every channel.
sentences.zh: 這場慶典的報導出現在每個頻道。

sentences.en: What does this health plan's coverage include?
sentences.zh: 這個健康保險方案的保障範圍包含哪些項目？

sentences.en: My car insurance coverage ends next month.
sentences.zh: 我的汽車保險保障下個月就到期了。

sentences.en: Critics praised the magazine's coverage of local issues.
sentences.zh: 評論者稱讚這本雜誌對地方議題的報導。

sentences.en: Do you have the credentials to teach here?
sentences.zh: 你有在這裡任教的資格證明嗎？

sentences.en: Please show your credentials at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 請在櫃台出示你的資格證件。

sentences.en: She has strong credentials in nursing.
sentences.zh: 她擁有紮實的護理專業證照。

sentences.en: What credentials do I need to become an accountant?
sentences.zh: 要當會計師需要什麼證照？

sentences.en: The new hire's credentials were checked before day one.
sentences.zh: 新進員工的資格證明在到職前就已查驗過。

sentences.en: He lost his credentials, so the guard stopped him.
sentences.zh: 他弄丟了證件，所以警衛攔住了他。

gloss_note: a credible source 可信的來源

sentences.en: Is that website a credible source of news?
sentences.zh: 那個網站是可信的新聞來源嗎？

sentences.en: Her story sounds credible to me.
sentences.zh: 她的說法在我聽來是可信的。

sentences.en: We need a credible plan before we ask for money.
sentences.zh: 在要求資金之前，我們需要一個可信的計畫。

sentences.en: The police found no credible evidence.
sentences.zh: 警方沒有找到可信的證據。

sentences.en: Do you think he is a credible witness?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他是個可信的證人嗎？

sentences.en: Our supplier gave us a credible explanation for the delay.
sentences.zh: 供應商對延誤提出了可信的解釋。

gloss_note: 美式常指小河，比 stream 口語

sentences.en: The kids were catching frogs in the creek.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在小溪裡抓青蛙。

sentences.en: There is a small creek behind our house.
sentences.zh: 我們家後面有一條小溪。

sentences.en: Is it safe to drink the water from this creek?
sentences.zh: 這條小溪的水可以安心喝嗎？

sentences.en: We followed the creek up to a waterfall.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著小溪走到一座瀑布。

sentences.en: How deep is the creek after the rain?
sentences.zh: 下過雨後這條小溪有多深？

sentences.en: The creek froze over during the cold winter.
sentences.zh: 小溪在寒冷的冬天結冰了。

audio.artist: Dvortygirl, revised by EncycloPetey to remove static

gloss_note: 甜鹹口味皆有，點餐時常說 crepe

sentences.en: I'll have a crepe with strawberries, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一份草莓可麗餅，謝謝。

sentences.en: Do you sell sweet crepes or only savory ones?
sentences.zh: 你們賣甜的可麗餅，還是只賣鹹的？

sentences.en: She flipped the crepe in the pan.
sentences.zh: 她在平底鍋裡把可麗餅翻面。

sentences.en: The crepe is thin, so it cooks in a minute.
sentences.zh: 可麗餅很薄，所以一分鐘就煎好了。

sentences.en: Can I get my crepe with chocolate and bananas?
sentences.zh: 我的可麗餅可以加巧克力和香蕉嗎？

sentences.en: We shared a crepe for dessert after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們分著吃了一份可麗餅當甜點。

gloss_note: 用於系統、經濟等；勿用來稱呼人

sentences.en: The snowstorm crippled traffic across the whole city.
sentences.zh: 暴風雪使全市的交通陷入癱瘓。

sentences.en: Could a strike cripple the shipping industry?
sentences.zh: 罷工會讓航運業嚴重受創嗎？

sentences.en: A computer virus crippled our network yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天一種電腦病毒讓我們的網路癱瘓了。

sentences.en: Heavy debt can cripple a small business.
sentences.zh: 沉重的債務可能讓小公司嚴重受損。

sentences.en: Did the outage cripple your website for long?
sentences.zh: 這次服務中斷讓你的網站癱瘓很久嗎？

sentences.en: The drought crippled farms in the valley.
sentences.zh: 乾旱重創了山谷裡的農場。

sentences.en: Price is our main criterion for choosing a supplier.
sentences.zh: 價格是我們挑選供應商的主要標準。

sentences.en: What criterion do you use to rank the applicants?
sentences.zh: 你用什麼標準替應徵者排名？

sentences.en: Honesty is the first criterion for this job.
sentences.zh: 誠實是這份工作的首要條件。

sentences.en: Does this essay meet every criterion on the list?
sentences.zh: 這篇文章符合清單上的每一項標準嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher explained each criterion for the grade.
sentences.zh: 老師說明了評分的每一項標準。

sentences.en: Another criterion is how fast you can learn.
sentences.zh: 另一個標準是你學習的速度有多快。

sentences.en: We need to think critically about this offer.
sentences.zh: 我們需要嚴謹地思考這個提議。

sentences.en: Do you read the news critically, or do you just believe it?
sentences.zh: 你讀新聞會用批判的眼光，還是照單全收？

sentences.en: Students should learn to think critically about what they read.
sentences.zh: 學生應該學會對所讀的內容進行批判性思考。

sentences.en: Let's look critically at last month's sales numbers.
sentences.zh: 我們來嚴謹地檢視上個月的銷售數字。

sentences.en: Can you review my draft critically and tell me the truth?
sentences.zh: 你能用批判的角度看我的草稿，並跟我說實話嗎？

sentences.en: The professor asked us to read the article critically.
sentences.zh: 教授要我們以批判性的眼光閱讀這篇文章。

gloss_note: a crucial role 關鍵角色

sentences.en: It's crucial that we finish this before Friday.
sentences.zh: 在週五前完成這件事至關重要。

sentences.en: Is this step really crucial to the process?
sentences.zh: 這個步驟對整個流程真的很關鍵嗎？

sentences.en: Sleep is crucial for teenagers.
sentences.zh: 睡眠對青少年極為重要。

sentences.en: A good first impression is crucial in an interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時，好的第一印象至關重要。

sentences.en: What is the most crucial skill for this position?
sentences.zh: 這個職位最關鍵的技能是什麼？

sentences.en: Her advice played a crucial role in our success.
sentences.zh: 她的建議對我們的成功扮演了關鍵角色。

sentences.en: The long custody case finally ended last week.
sentences.zh: 漫長的監護權官司上週終於結束了。

sentences.en: Who has custody of the kids on weekends?
sentences.zh: 週末孩子們由誰監護？

sentences.en: The suspect is in police custody tonight.
sentences.zh: 嫌犯今晚遭警方拘留。

sentences.en: Was he taken into custody at the airport?
sentences.zh: 他是在機場被拘留的嗎？

sentences.en: The couple agreed on joint custody of their son.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻同意共同監護兒子。

sentences.en: She fought hard for custody of her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她為了女兒的監護權努力奮戰。

sentences.en: Many plants go through cyclic periods of growth and rest.
sentences.zh: 許多植物會經歷生長與休眠的週期性循環。

sentences.en: Is the weather pattern here cyclic or random?
sentences.zh: 這裡的天氣型態是週期性的，還是隨機的？

sentences.en: The moon's phases follow a cyclic pattern.
sentences.zh: 月亮的盈虧遵循週期性的模式。

sentences.en: The scientist studied the cyclic changes in ocean temperature.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究海水溫度的週期性變化。

sentences.en: Do sleep and waking follow a cyclic rhythm?
sentences.zh: 睡眠和清醒是否遵循週期性的節律？

sentences.en: The water cycle is a cyclic process that never stops.
sentences.zh: 水循環是永不停止的循環過程。

gloss_note: a deadly weapon 致命武器

sentences.en: This snake is deadly, so please keep your distance.
sentences.zh: 這種蛇很致命，所以請保持距離。

sentences.en: Is this mushroom deadly if you eat it raw?
sentences.zh: 這種蘑菇生吃會致命嗎？

sentences.en: The storm caused a deadly crash on the highway.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成公路上一起致命的車禍。

sentences.en: Texting while driving can be deadly.
sentences.zh: 邊開車邊傳訊息可能會致命。

sentences.en: How deadly is this virus compared to the flu?
sentences.zh: 這種病毒跟流感比起來有多致命？

sentences.en: The movie's hero faces a deadly trap.
sentences.zh: 電影的主角面臨一個致命的陷阱。

sentences.en: Workers are cleaning up the debris after the storm.
sentences.zh: 工人正在清理暴風雨後的殘骸。

sentences.en: Watch out for the debris on the road.
sentences.zh: 小心路上的碎片。

sentences.en: Is there still any debris in the garage?
sentences.zh: 車庫裡還有碎片殘留嗎？

sentences.en: Flying debris broke the window during the wind.
sentences.zh: 強風中飛散的碎片打破了窗戶。

sentences.en: Where should we put all this debris?
sentences.zh: 這些殘骸我們要放哪裡？

sentences.en: Divers found debris from the sunken boat.
sentences.zh: 潛水員發現了沉船的殘骸。

gloss_note: make one's debut 初次登場

sentences.en: The singer made her debut at age sixteen.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手十六歲就初次登台。

sentences.en: When is the debut of our new product?
sentences.zh: 我們的新產品什麼時候首次亮相？

sentences.en: His debut as a coach was a big win.
sentences.zh: 他的教練初登場就大獲全勝。

sentences.en: Did you see the actor's debut in that movie?
sentences.zh: 你有看過那位演員在那部電影的初登場嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant will make its debut next Monday.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳下週一正式亮相。

sentences.en: The band's debut album sold out in a week.
sentences.zh: 那個樂團的首張專輯一週就賣光了。

gloss_note: deceive sb. into 騙某人去做

sentences.en: Don't let the low price deceive you.
sentences.zh: 別被低價給騙了。

sentences.en: Why would he deceive his own friends?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼要欺騙自己的朋友？

sentences.en: The ad tried to deceive customers about the real cost.
sentences.zh: 那則廣告想在真實價格上欺騙消費者。

sentences.en: I never meant to deceive you.
sentences.zh: 我從來沒打算欺騙你。

sentences.en: Do you think the scammer deceived many people?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那個詐騙的人騙了很多人嗎？

sentences.en: Appearances can deceive, so check the facts first.
sentences.zh: 外表可能騙人，所以先查證事實。

sentences.en: The company decided to decentralize its decision making.
sentences.zh: 公司決定把決策權下放。

sentences.en: Will it help to decentralize our purchasing process?
sentences.zh: 把我們的採購流程分權會有幫助嗎？

sentences.en: Many firms decentralize authority to respond faster.
sentences.zh: 許多公司把權限下放，好更快做出回應。

sentences.en: We want to decentralize control of the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們想把預算的控制權下放。

sentences.en: Did the school decentralize its management last year?
sentences.zh: 學校去年有把管理權下放嗎？

sentences.en: To decentralize the network, each office will run its own server.
sentences.zh: 為了讓網路去中心化，每間辦公室會各自架設一台伺服器。

sentences.en: Round the answer to one decimal place.
sentences.zh: 答案請四捨五入到小數點後一位。

sentences.en: Can you write one fourth as a decimal?
sentences.zh: 你可以把四分之一寫成小數嗎？

sentences.en: You put the decimal in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: 你把小數點放錯位置了。

sentences.en: Where should I put the decimal point in this price?
sentences.zh: 這個價格的小數點要放在哪裡？

sentences.en: My little sister is learning to add decimals in math class.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹正在數學課學小數加法。

sentences.en: The spreadsheet rounds every decimal to two places.
sentences.zh: 試算表把每個小數都四捨五入到兩位。

gloss_note: decline in sales 銷售下滑

sentences.en: Sales began to decline after the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 假期旺季過後，銷售開始下滑。

sentences.en: Why did the number of customers decline so quickly?
sentences.zh: 顧客人數為什麼下滑得這麼快？

sentences.en: There has been a steady decline in newspaper readers.
sentences.zh: 報紙讀者持續衰退。

sentences.en: Do you think the decline in prices will continue?
sentences.zh: 你覺得價格下跌的趨勢會持續嗎？

sentences.en: The town's population is in decline.
sentences.zh: 這座小鎮的人口正在減少。

sentences.en: Test scores declined slightly this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的考試成績略微下降。

sentences.en: I love the decor in this restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這間餐廳的裝潢。

sentences.en: Have they changed the decor since our last visit?
sentences.zh: 自從我們上次來，他們改過裝潢嗎？

sentences.en: The cafe's decor feels warm and cozy.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館的布置給人溫暖舒適的感覺。

sentences.en: The owner chose rustic decor for the new bakery.
sentences.zh: 老闆為新的麵包店選了鄉村風的裝潢。

sentences.en: What do you think of the holiday decor?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這些節慶布置怎麼樣？

sentences.en: Simple decor makes the dining room feel bigger.
sentences.zh: 簡約的裝潢讓用餐空間看起來更大。

gloss_note: issue a decree 頒布法令

sentences.en: The king issued a decree about new taxes.
sentences.zh: 國王頒布了一道有關新稅的法令。

sentences.en: Who signed the decree that closed the factory?
sentences.zh: 是誰簽署了關閉工廠的命令？

sentences.en: The new queen's first decree lowered taxes on bread.
sentences.zh: 新女王的第一道法令降低了麵包稅。

sentences.en: By decree of the board, all staff must attend.
sentences.zh: 依董事會的命令，全體員工都必須出席。

sentences.en: Do you know when the decree takes effect?
sentences.zh: 你知道這項法令什麼時候生效嗎？

sentences.en: Historians study how the old decree changed daily life.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家研究這道古老的法令如何改變了日常生活。

gloss_note: dedicate A to B 把A獻給／投入B

sentences.en: She dedicated her life to helping children.
sentences.zh: 她畢生致力於幫助孩子。

sentences.en: Are you willing to dedicate your weekends to this project?
sentences.zh: 你願意把週末都投入這個專案嗎？

sentences.en: I want to dedicate this song to my mother.
sentences.zh: 我想把這首歌獻給我媽媽。

sentences.en: How much time can you dedicate to studying each day?
sentences.zh: 你每天能投入多少時間念書？

sentences.en: The team dedicated the whole month to testing.
sentences.zh: 團隊整整一個月都投入在測試上。

sentences.en: He dedicated his book to his teacher.
sentences.zh: 他把他的書獻給了他的老師。

gloss_note: budget/trade deficit 預算／貿易赤字

sentences.en: The company ran a deficit for the third year in a row.
sentences.zh: 公司連續第三年出現赤字。

sentences.en: How can we cut the budget deficit without laying anyone off?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在不裁員的情況下減少預算赤字？

sentences.en: We're facing a deficit of about two thousand dollars this month.
sentences.zh: 我們這個月大約短缺兩千美元。

sentences.en: In economics class, we learned why a trade deficit isn't always bad.
sentences.zh: 在經濟課上，我們學到為什麼貿易赤字不一定是壞事。

sentences.en: Did the deficit shrink after you raised your prices?
sentences.zh: 你們漲價之後，赤字有縮小嗎？

sentences.en: The school fundraiser barely covered the deficit in the music budget.
sentences.zh: 學校的募款活動勉強補上音樂經費的不足。

gloss_note: deflect 是動詞；話題、責任被轉開也用

sentences.en: The deflection of the ball off the post surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 球打到門柱後偏轉，讓大家都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Was that a real answer, or just a deflection?
sentences.zh: 那是真正的回答，還是只是在轉移話題？

sentences.en: The scientist measured the deflection of the light beam.
sentences.zh: 科學家測量了光束的偏轉。

sentences.en: His joke was a clever deflection from the real problem.
sentences.zh: 他的玩笑巧妙地把話題從真正的問題上轉開。

sentences.en: The goalie's quick deflection kept the score tied.
sentences.zh: 守門員迅速把球擋偏，保住了平手的比分。

sentences.en: Why does the compass needle show a slight deflection near the magnet?
sentences.zh: 為什麼靠近磁鐵時，羅盤指針會輕微偏轉？

gloss_note: defy the odds 突破萬難

sentences.en: Teenagers sometimes defy their parents just to prove a point.
sentences.zh: 青少年有時為了表明立場而違抗父母。

sentences.en: How did she defy the odds and win the race?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼突破萬難贏得比賽的？

sentences.en: Would you defy a direct order from your boss?
sentences.zh: 你會違抗老闆的直接命令嗎？

sentences.en: The skater's jump seemed to defy gravity.
sentences.zh: 滑冰選手的跳躍彷彿違抗了地心引力。

sentences.en: The new rule was so unfair that many students chose to defy it.
sentences.zh: 這條新規定太不公平，許多學生選擇不理會它。

sentences.en: He defied the doctor's advice and went back to work.
sentences.zh: 他不聽醫生的勸告，又回去上班了。

gloss_note: degrade 偏學術、環境、材料用語

sentences.en: Heat and sunlight can degrade plastic over time.
sentences.zh: 高溫和日照會使塑膠逐漸劣化。

sentences.en: Does constant noise degrade the quality of our sleep?
sentences.zh: 持續的噪音會降低我們的睡眠品質嗎？

sentences.en: Pollution has degraded the soil in this farming area.
sentences.zh: 汙染使這個農業區的土壤退化。

sentences.en: Why did the video quality degrade after we compressed the file?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們壓縮檔案後，影片品質變差了？

sentences.en: Poor storage will degrade the paint within a few months.
sentences.zh: 儲存不當會讓油漆在幾個月內變質。

sentences.en: Researchers study how fast the material degrades in seawater.
sentences.zh: 研究人員研究這種材料在海水中劣化的速度。

sentences.en: I think the delay was deliberate, not an accident.
sentences.zh: 我覺得這次拖延是故意的，不是意外。

sentences.en: Was that mistake deliberate, or did he just forget?
sentences.zh: 那個錯誤是故意的，還是他只是忘了？

sentences.en: She made a deliberate choice to leave the city.
sentences.zh: 她經過深思熟慮，決定離開這座城市。

sentences.en: The manager took a slow, deliberate approach to the problem.
sentences.zh: 經理以緩慢而審慎的方式處理這個問題。

sentences.en: Do you think the company's silence is deliberate?
sentences.zh: 你覺得公司的沉默是有意的嗎？

sentences.en: He walked up to the stage with slow, deliberate steps.
sentences.zh: 他以緩慢而沉穩的腳步走上舞台。

sentences.en: We bought sandwiches at the delicatessen near the office.
sentences.zh: 我們在辦公室附近的熟食店買了三明治。

sentences.en: Does the delicatessen on Fifth Street open on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 第五街那家熟食店週日有開嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle owns a small delicatessen that sells pickles and smoked fish.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔開了一家小熟食店，賣醃黃瓜和煙燻魚。

sentences.en: What's the best thing to order at this delicatessen?
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店點什麼最好吃？

sentences.en: The delicatessen slices turkey fresh while you wait.
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店會在你等的時候現切火雞肉片。

sentences.en: I grabbed some cheese and olives from the delicatessen counter.
sentences.zh: 我從熟食店的櫃檯買了一些起司和橄欖。

gloss_note: What's the delta? 差多少？商業口語

sentences.en: What's the delta between our forecast and the actual sales?
sentences.zh: 我們的預測和實際銷售額之間差多少？

sentences.en: The delta in price between the two plans is small.
sentences.zh: 兩種方案的價差不大。

sentences.en: Can you explain the delta in last month's numbers?
sentences.zh: 你可以解釋一下上個月數字的差額嗎？

sentences.en: We need to close the delta before the quarter ends.
sentences.zh: 我們得在季末前補上這個差距。

sentences.en: Our team lead wants a report that shows the delta by region.
sentences.zh: 組長想要一份依地區列出差額的報告。

sentences.en: Why is there such a big delta in delivery times?
sentences.zh: 為什麼送貨時間的差距這麼大？

sentences.en: We upgraded to a deluxe room with an ocean view.
sentences.zh: 我們升級到有海景的豪華客房。

sentences.en: Does the deluxe package include breakfast?
sentences.zh: 豪華方案有含早餐嗎？

sentences.en: The deluxe burger comes with bacon and a fried egg.
sentences.zh: 豪華漢堡附有培根和一顆煎蛋。

sentences.en: Is the deluxe model worth the extra two hundred dollars?
sentences.zh: 豪華款值得多花兩百美元嗎？

sentences.en: She treated her mother to a deluxe spa day.
sentences.zh: 她請媽媽享受了一整天的豪華水療。

sentences.en: The deluxe edition of the game has extra levels.
sentences.zh: 這款遊戲的豪華版有額外的關卡。

gloss_note: 多指企業、制度或事物的終結

sentences.en: Poor management led to the demise of the family business.
sentences.zh: 管理不善導致這家家族企業倒閉。

sentences.en: What caused the demise of the local bookstore?
sentences.zh: 當地那家書店為什麼會倒閉？

sentences.en: Analysts predicted the demise of the old software years ago.
sentences.zh: 分析師多年前就預言這套舊軟體會走入歷史。

sentences.en: Many people blame online shopping for the demise of small stores.
sentences.zh: 許多人把小商店的沒落歸咎於網路購物。

sentences.en: Do you think cheap imports will cause the demise of our industry?
sentences.zh: 你覺得廉價進口品會讓我們的產業消亡嗎？

sentences.en: The company's demise surprised everyone, including its own employees.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的倒閉讓所有人大吃一驚，包括它自己的員工。

gloss_note: 大寫 Democrat 指美國民主黨員

sentences.en: The textbook describes him as a democrat who trusted ordinary citizens.
sentences.zh: 課本把他描述為相信一般公民的民主主義者。

sentences.en: What does it mean to be a democrat in today's world?
sentences.zh: 在今日世界，身為民主主義者代表什麼？

sentences.en: In ancient Athens, a democrat supported rule by the people.
sentences.zh: 在古雅典，民主主義者支持由人民統治。

sentences.en: Not every Greek thinker was a democrat.
sentences.zh: 並不是每位希臘思想家都是民主主義者。

sentences.en: Was the early reformer really a democrat, or just a popular speaker?
sentences.zh: 那位早期的改革者真的是民主主義者，還是只是個受歡迎的演說家？

sentences.en: In civics class, we debated what makes someone a democrat.
sentences.zh: 在公民課上，我們討論了什麼樣的人才算民主主義者。

gloss_note: product demonstrator 則是商品示範員

sentences.en: The demonstrators marched peacefully through the city center.
sentences.zh: 示威者和平地走過市中心。

sentences.en: Police asked the demonstrators to stay on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 警方請示威者留在人行道上。

sentences.en: How many demonstrators joined the rally downtown yesterday?
sentences.zh: 昨天有多少示威者參加市區的集會？

sentences.en: Photos from 1965 show demonstrators carrying large signs.
sentences.zh: 1965年的照片顯示示威者舉著大型標語。

sentences.en: Did the demonstrators have a permit for the march?
sentences.zh: 示威者有取得遊行的許可嗎？

sentences.en: Several demonstrators sat down in the street and sang.
sentences.zh: 幾名示威者坐在街上唱歌。

gloss_note: in denial 拒絕面對現實

sentences.en: The company issued a flat denial of the rumors.
sentences.zh: 公司斷然否認這些傳聞。

sentences.en: His denial didn't sound honest to me.
sentences.zh: 他的否認聽起來並不誠實。

sentences.en: Did you get a denial letter from the insurance company?
sentences.zh: 你有收到保險公司的拒絕信函嗎？

sentences.en: What was the reason for the denial of my request?
sentences.zh: 我的申請被拒絕的原因是什麼？

sentences.en: Being in denial about a problem won't make it go away.
sentences.zh: 對問題視而不見，並不會讓它消失。

sentences.en: The mayor's denial was reported on the evening news.
sentences.zh: 市長的否認在晚間新聞中被報導。

sentences.en: The contract is denominated in U.S. dollars, not euros.
sentences.zh: 這份合約以美元計價，不是歐元。

sentences.en: Are the bonds denominated in dollars or yen?
sentences.zh: 這些債券是以美元還是日圓計價？

sentences.en: Our invoices are denominated in the buyer's local currency.
sentences.zh: 我們的請款單以買方當地的貨幣計價。

sentences.en: Should we denominate the loan in local currency to reduce risk?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要以當地貨幣計價這筆貸款，以降低風險？

sentences.en: Oil is usually denominated in dollars on world markets.
sentences.zh: 在全球市場上，石油通常以美元計價。

sentences.en: Why was the debt denominated in a foreign currency?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這筆債務是以外幣計價？

sentences.en: In the fraction three fourths, four is the denominator.
sentences.zh: 在四分之三這個分數中，四是分母。

sentences.en: What is the denominator of this fraction?
sentences.zh: 這個分數的分母是什麼？

sentences.en: To add fractions, you first need a common denominator.
sentences.zh: 要做分數加法，首先需要有共同分母。

sentences.en: Which number goes in the denominator here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的分母要放哪個數字？

sentences.en: The teacher circled the denominator in red ink.
sentences.zh: 老師用紅筆圈起分母。

sentences.en: If the denominator gets bigger, the fraction gets smaller.
sentences.zh: 分母變大，分數就變小。

sentences.en: Lead has a much higher density than wood.
sentences.zh: 鉛的密度比木頭高得多。

sentences.en: What is the density of water at room temperature?
sentences.zh: 水在室溫下的密度是多少？

sentences.en: This city has a very high population density.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的人口密度非常高。

sentences.en: How do you calculate the density of an object?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼計算物體的密度？

sentences.en: Oil floats on water because it has a lower density.
sentences.zh: 油會浮在水上，因為它的密度較低。

sentences.en: The teacher showed us how the density of salt water changes.
sentences.zh: 老師示範了鹽水的密度如何變化。

gloss_note: make a dent in 稍微減少；有些進展

sentences.en: There's a big dent in the side of my car.
sentences.zh: 我的車側面有一個很大的凹痕。

sentences.en: Who put this dent in the rental car?
sentences.zh: 這輛租來的車上的凹痕是誰弄的？

sentences.en: The new tax won't make much of a dent in the deficit.
sentences.zh: 這項新稅對縮減赤字不會有太大的效果。

sentences.en: Can we make a dent in this backlog before Friday?
