sentences.zh: 我們能在週五前消化掉一部分積壓的工作嗎？

sentences.en: The recall barely put a dent in the company's profits.
sentences.zh: 這次召回幾乎沒有減損公司的獲利。

sentences.en: Did the delivery driver cause the dent in this package?
sentences.zh: 這個包裹上的凹痕是送貨員弄的嗎？

sentences.en: Our heavy dependency on one supplier is a real risk.
sentences.zh: 我們對單一供應商的高度依賴是個實際的風險。

sentences.en: How can we reduce our dependency on imported parts?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何降低對進口零件的依賴？

sentences.en: The project has a dependency on the design team's schedule.
sentences.zh: 這個專案的進度取決於設計團隊的時程。

sentences.en: Does this task have a dependency on the payment update?
sentences.zh: 這項工作和付款更新之間有依存關係嗎？

sentences.en: Economists warn about the region's dependency on tourism.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家對該地區依賴觀光業提出警告。

sentences.en: The program failed to start because of a missing dependency.
sentences.zh: 程式因為缺少相依項目而無法啟動。

sentences.en: The deployment of the new software is scheduled for Monday.
sentences.zh: 新軟體預定週一部署。

sentences.en: Did the deployment go smoothly last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的部署順利嗎？

sentences.en: We need faster deployment of staff to the new store.
sentences.zh: 我們需要更快把人員調派到新分店。

sentences.en: What's the timeline for the deployment of the new scanners?
sentences.zh: 新掃描器的部署時程是什麼？

sentences.en: A delay in deployment cost us two weeks.
sentences.zh: 部署的延誤讓我們損失了兩週。

sentences.en: News reports praised the quick deployment of emergency crews.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導稱讚緊急救援人員迅速調度到位。

sentences.en: Every depositor is insured up to a certain amount.
sentences.zh: 每位存款人在一定金額內都受到保障。

sentences.en: The bank sent a letter to each depositor about the new fees.
sentences.zh: 銀行寄信通知每位存款人新的手續費。

sentences.en: Are depositors allowed to withdraw cash without a fee?
sentences.zh: 存款人提領現金不用手續費嗎？

sentences.en: As a depositor, you earn interest on your savings.
sentences.zh: 身為存款人，你的儲蓄可以賺取利息。

sentences.en: Why were depositors waiting outside the branch this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上為什麼有存款人在分行外面等？

sentences.en: The bank promised to protect its depositors during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 銀行承諾在危機期間保護它的存款人。

gloss_note: depressed 可指心情低落或價格低迷

sentences.en: Rainy days always depress my brother.
sentences.zh: 下雨天總是讓我弟弟情緒低落。

sentences.en: Does the news ever depress you?
sentences.zh: 新聞有時候會讓你沮喪嗎？

sentences.en: High interest rates can depress housing prices.
sentences.zh: 高利率可能壓低房價。

sentences.en: Will the new tax depress car sales this year?
sentences.zh: 新稅會壓低今年的汽車銷量嗎？

sentences.en: Don't let one bad grade depress you too much.
sentences.zh: 別讓一次成績不好讓你太沮喪。

sentences.en: The gloomy music began to depress everyone at the party.
sentences.zh: 陰沉的音樂開始讓派對上的每個人都意志消沉。

gloss_note: deprive A of B 剝奪 A 的 B

sentences.en: Lack of sleep can deprive your brain of the rest it needs.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足會讓大腦得不到所需的休息。

sentences.en: Don't deprive the kids of their playtime.
sentences.zh: 別剝奪孩子們玩耍的時間。

sentences.en: Would the new policy deprive workers of their overtime pay?
sentences.zh: 新政策會剝奪員工的加班費嗎？

sentences.en: The storm deprived the town of power for three days.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨使小鎮三天沒電可用。

sentences.en: Why would anyone deprive a student of a fair chance?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人要剝奪學生公平的機會？

sentences.en: Some companies deprive employees of breaks during busy seasons.
sentences.zh: 有些公司在旺季剝奪員工的休息時間。

sentences.en: Deregulation of the airline industry lowered ticket prices.
sentences.zh: 航空業解除管制後，機票價格下降了。

sentences.en: Did deregulation really help small businesses?
sentences.zh: 解除管制真的幫助了小型企業嗎？

sentences.en: Supporters say deregulation encourages competition and innovation.
sentences.zh: 支持者說鬆綁能促進競爭與創新。

sentences.en: Critics worry that deregulation could hurt consumers.
sentences.zh: 批評者擔心解除管制可能傷害消費者。

sentences.en: What were the effects of energy deregulation in the 1990s?
sentences.zh: 1990年代能源解除管制有什麼影響？

sentences.en: The professor explained how deregulation changed the phone market.
sentences.zh: 教授解釋了解除管制如何改變電信市場。

gloss_note: derive from 源自；derive A from B

sentences.en: Many English words derive from Latin.
sentences.zh: 許多英文單字源自拉丁文。

sentences.en: Where does this word derive from?
sentences.zh: 這個字源自哪裡？

sentences.en: She derives great joy from teaching young children.
sentences.zh: 她從教導幼童中得到很大的快樂。

sentences.en: Do you derive any benefit from your gym membership?
sentences.zh: 你從健身房會員資格中得到什麼好處嗎？

sentences.en: The company derives most of its income from online sales.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的大部分收入來自網路銷售。

sentences.en: Scientists derive the formula from the data they collected.
sentences.zh: 科學家從蒐集到的資料推導出這個公式。

sentences.en: The plane began to descend toward the airport.
sentences.zh: 飛機開始朝機場下降。

sentences.en: Careful when you descend the stairs; they're slippery.
sentences.zh: 下樓梯要小心，台階很滑。

sentences.en: Did the elevator descend to the basement level?
sentences.zh: 電梯有降到地下室那一層嗎？

sentences.en: The hikers descended the mountain before dark.
sentences.zh: 登山客在天黑前下了山。

sentences.en: How long does it take to descend to the valley floor?
sentences.zh: 走到谷底要多久？

sentences.en: A thick fog descended on the road as we drove home.
sentences.zh: 我們開車回家時，濃霧籠罩了道路。

gloss_note: 反義詞是 ancestor 祖先

sentences.en: She is a descendant of early settlers in this region.
sentences.zh: 她是這個地區早期拓荒者的後代。

sentences.en: Are you a descendant of the famous painter?
sentences.zh: 你是那位著名畫家的後代嗎？

sentences.en: Birds are the living descendants of some ancient dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 鳥類是某些遠古恐龍存活至今的後裔。

sentences.en: My grandmother wants her descendants to keep the family recipes.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶希望子孫能保存家傳食譜。

sentences.en: How many descendants does the old farmer have?
sentences.zh: 那位老農夫有多少後代？

sentences.en: The museum invited a descendant of the inventor to speak.
sentences.zh: 博物館邀請發明家的後代來演講。

gloss_note: band descriptor 評分等級描述

sentences.en: A descriptor like cozy appears in many hotel reviews.
sentences.zh: 像「溫馨」這樣的描述詞常出現在許多旅館評論中。

sentences.en: Which descriptor best fits this essay, clear or vague?
sentences.zh: 哪個描述詞最適合這篇文章，清楚還是模糊？

sentences.en: Each product page needs a short descriptor under the title.
sentences.zh: 每個產品頁面在標題下方都需要簡短的描述。

sentences.en: A good descriptor tells readers exactly what the chart shows.
sentences.zh: 好的描述能讓讀者確切知道圖表呈現什麼。

sentences.en: Can you suggest a better descriptor for this data field?
sentences.zh: 你能為這個資料欄位建議一個更好的描述嗎？

sentences.en: Examiners compare your answer with the band descriptors.
sentences.zh: 評分者會把你的答案與等級描述做比對。

sentences.en: She sank into despair when the results were announced.
sentences.zh: 成績公布時，她陷入絕望。

sentences.en: Don't despair; you can retake the test next month.
sentences.zh: 別絕望，你下個月可以重考。

sentences.en: What drove the villagers to despair after the flood?
sentences.zh: 洪水過後，是什麼讓村民陷入絕望？

sentences.en: He looked at the broken car in despair.
sentences.zh: 他絕望地看著那輛壞掉的車。

sentences.en: Do you ever despair of finding a good apartment here?
sentences.zh: 你有時會對在這裡找到好公寓感到絕望嗎？

sentences.en: Many fans gave up in despair when the team fell behind.
sentences.zh: 球隊落後時，許多球迷絕望地放棄了。

gloss_note: 命中注定；比 fate 更帶正面意味

sentences.en: She believed it was her destiny to become a doctor.
sentences.zh: 她相信成為醫生是她的命運。

sentences.en: Do you think we control our own destiny?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們能掌握自己的命運嗎？

sentences.en: He took charge of his destiny and started his own company.
sentences.zh: 他掌握了自己的命運，創辦了自己的公司。

sentences.en: Some people say meeting you was destiny.
sentences.zh: 有人說遇見你是命中注定。

sentences.en: In the movie, a young farmer discovers his destiny.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一名年輕農夫發現了自己的命運。

sentences.en: Is it destiny or just luck that we met again?
sentences.zh: 我們再次相遇，是命運還是只是運氣？

sentences.en: The storm was the most destructive one in years.
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨是多年來破壞力最強的一場。

sentences.en: Is this software destructive to my existing files?
sentences.zh: 這個軟體會破壞我現有的檔案嗎？

sentences.en: Smoking is a destructive habit that harms your lungs.
sentences.zh: 吸菸是會傷害肺部的破壞性習慣。

sentences.en: Constant criticism can be very destructive to a team.
sentences.zh: 不斷的批評對團隊可能極具破壞性。

sentences.en: Why are some puppies so destructive when left alone?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些小狗獨處時破壞力這麼強？

sentences.en: The report describes the destructive effects of overfishing.
sentences.zh: 報告描述了過度捕撈的破壞性影響。

sentences.en: The sudden devaluation of the currency shocked investors.
sentences.zh: 貨幣突然貶值，讓投資人震驚。

sentences.en: How will the devaluation affect our import costs?
sentences.zh: 貶值會如何影響我們的進口成本？

sentences.en: The central bank announced a ten percent devaluation.
sentences.zh: 央行宣布貶值百分之十。

sentences.en: Did the devaluation make our exports cheaper overseas?
sentences.zh: 貶值讓我們的出口品在海外變便宜了嗎？

sentences.en: Devaluation made travel abroad much more expensive for locals.
sentences.zh: 貶值讓當地人出國旅遊貴了許多。

sentences.en: Economists blame years of inflation for the devaluation.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家把這次貶值歸咎於多年的通貨膨脹。

gloss_note: 常用被動 be devastated 崩潰、心碎

sentences.en: The hurricane devastated several coastal towns.
sentences.zh: 颶風摧毀了好幾個沿海城鎮。

sentences.en: The news of the layoffs devastated everyone on the team.
sentences.zh: 裁員的消息讓團隊裡的每個人都深受打擊。

sentences.en: Would a loss of that size devastate your business?
sentences.zh: 那麼大的損失會摧毀你的事業嗎？

sentences.en: I was devastated when my flight was canceled.
sentences.zh: 我的班機被取消時，我整個人都崩潰了。

sentences.en: A wildfire can devastate a whole forest in days.
sentences.zh: 野火幾天內就能摧毀整片森林。

sentences.en: How badly did the flood devastate local farmers?
sentences.zh: 這場洪水對當地農民造成多大的毀滅性打擊？

sentences.en: Her devotion to her patients impressed everyone at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她對病患的奉獻讓醫院裡的每個人印象深刻。

sentences.en: What explains his devotion to the company after so many years?
sentences.zh: 經過這麼多年，他對公司的忠誠是怎麼來的？

sentences.en: The coach is known for her devotion to young players.
sentences.zh: 這位教練以她對年輕球員的付出而聞名。

sentences.en: Their devotion to music began when they were children.
sentences.zh: 他們對音樂的熱愛從小就開始了。

sentences.en: Do you admire his devotion to his work?
sentences.zh: 你欽佩他對工作的投入嗎？

sentences.en: Fans showed their devotion by waiting in line all night.
sentences.zh: 粉絲整晚排隊，表達自己的熱愛。

sentences.en: Could you change the baby's diaper, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你幫寶寶換尿布嗎？

sentences.en: We're out of diapers; I'll stop at the store.
sentences.zh: 我們的尿布用完了，我順路去店裡買。

sentences.en: Do these diapers come in a bigger size?
sentences.zh: 這種尿布有大一點的尺寸嗎？

sentences.en: The restroom has a table for changing a diaper.
sentences.zh: 洗手間有可以換尿布的台子。

sentences.en: I always keep a spare diaper in my bag.
sentences.zh: 我包包裡總是放一片備用的尿布。

sentences.en: He cried because his diaper was wet.
sentences.zh: 他因為尿布濕了而哭。

gloss_note: 用於歷史、電影；也可比喻專橫的人

sentences.en: The film tells the story of a cruel dictator.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講述一名殘酷獨裁者的故事。

sentences.en: In history class, we studied how a dictator takes power.
sentences.zh: 歷史課上，我們研究了獨裁者如何掌權。

sentences.en: Why did people eventually turn against the dictator?
sentences.zh: 人們為什麼最後起而反對那名獨裁者？

sentences.en: My boss runs the office like a dictator.
sentences.zh: 我老闆管理辦公室像個獨裁者。

sentences.en: The museum exhibit shows how one dictator controlled the news.
sentences.zh: 展覽呈現一名獨裁者如何控制新聞。

sentences.en: Do you think a dictator can ever be a good leader?
sentences.zh: 你覺得獨裁者有可能成為好的領導者嗎？

sentences.en: The country lived under a dictatorship for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 這個國家在獨裁政權下生活了三十年。

sentences.en: How did the dictatorship finally come to an end?
sentences.zh: 這個獨裁政權最後是怎麼結束的？

sentences.en: Our teacher compared a dictatorship with a democracy.
sentences.zh: 老師比較了獨裁政權和民主制度。

sentences.en: Books were banned during the dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 獨裁政權時期，書籍遭到查禁。

sentences.en: What was daily life like under the dictatorship?
sentences.zh: 獨裁政權之下的日常生活是什麼樣子？

sentences.en: The documentary describes the rise of a military dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片描述了軍事獨裁政權的興起。

sentences.en: A short walk after dinner helps digestion.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後散個步有助消化。

sentences.en: Does fiber really improve digestion?
sentences.zh: 纖維真的能改善消化嗎？

sentences.en: Poor digestion can make you feel tired and bloated.
sentences.zh: 消化不良會讓你覺得疲倦又脹氣。

sentences.en: The doctor asked whether I had any problems with digestion.
sentences.zh: 醫生問我有沒有消化方面的問題。

sentences.en: Chewing slowly makes digestion easier.
sentences.zh: 慢慢咀嚼能讓消化更輕鬆。

sentences.en: How long does digestion take after a big meal?
sentences.zh: 吃了大餐後，消化要花多久時間？

gloss_note: dilute with water 用水稀釋

sentences.en: Dilute the juice with water before giving it to the kids.
sentences.zh: 給孩子喝之前，先用水把果汁稀釋。

sentences.en: How much water should I add to dilute the cleaner?
sentences.zh: 我要加多少水來稀釋這個清潔劑？

sentences.en: Adding more investors will dilute each person's share of the company.
sentences.zh: 增加投資人會稀釋每個人在公司的持股。

sentences.en: Too many changes could dilute the message of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 太多更動可能削弱這次活動的訊息。

sentences.en: Does the coffee taste weak because the ice dilutes it?
sentences.zh: 咖啡嚐起來比較淡，是因為冰塊把它稀釋了嗎？

sentences.en: Chemists dilute the acid slowly to keep the mixture safe.
sentences.zh: 化學家慢慢稀釋酸液，以確保混合物安全。

sentences.en: Culture adds another dimension to the problem.
sentences.zh: 文化為這個問題增添了另一個面向。

sentences.en: What are the dimensions of this table?
sentences.zh: 這張桌子的尺寸是多少？

sentences.en: Please check the dimensions of the box before shipping.
sentences.zh: 寄送前請確認箱子的尺寸。

sentences.en: Money is only one dimension of a happy life.
sentences.zh: 金錢只是快樂生活的其中一個面向。

sentences.en: Can you tell me the dimensions of the room before I buy a rug?
sentences.zh: 在我買地毯之前，你能告訴我房間的尺寸嗎？

sentences.en: The new teacher brought a fresh dimension to our class.
sentences.zh: 新老師為我們的班級帶來全新的面向。

sentences.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.
sentences.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳並釋出氧氣。

sentences.en: How much carbon dioxide does a car produce each year?
sentences.zh: 一輛車每年會排放多少二氧化碳？

sentences.en: Factories must reduce their carbon dioxide emissions by next year.
sentences.zh: 工廠必須在明年之前減少二氧化碳排放。

sentences.en: Sulfur dioxide from the plant caused heavy smog.
sentences.zh: 工廠排放的二氧化硫造成嚴重空汙。

sentences.en: Why is carbon dioxide called a greenhouse gas?
sentences.zh: 為什麼二氧化碳被稱為溫室氣體？

sentences.en: The soda fizzes because it contains dissolved carbon dioxide.
sentences.zh: 汽水會冒泡，是因為含有溶解的二氧化碳。

gloss_note: disable 的反義詞是 enable 啟用

sentences.en: How do I disable notifications on my phone?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼關閉手機的通知？

sentences.en: IT will disable your old account at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 資訊部門會在月底停用你的舊帳號。

sentences.en: Someone disabled the fire alarm during the test.
sentences.zh: 測試期間有人把火警警報器停用了。

sentences.en: Please disable the pop-up blocker to view this page.
sentences.zh: 請停用彈出視窗阻擋功能，才能檢視此頁面。

sentences.en: Can you disable the alarm before the staff arrives?
sentences.zh: 你可以在員工抵達前先解除警報嗎？

sentences.en: A software bug disabled the self-checkout machines for an hour.
sentences.zh: 軟體錯誤讓自助結帳機停擺了一小時。

sentences.en: My parents disapprove of staying out late.
sentences.zh: 我父母不贊成在外面待到很晚。

sentences.en: Do you disapprove of the new dress code?
sentences.zh: 你不贊成新的服裝規定嗎？

sentences.en: She frowned to show she disapproved.
sentences.zh: 她皺起眉頭，表示不贊成。

sentences.en: Why would the manager disapprove of the plan?
sentences.zh: 經理為什麼會不贊成這項計畫？

sentences.en: Many teachers disapprove of using phones during class.
sentences.zh: 許多老師不贊成上課時使用手機。

sentences.en: I disapprove of how he treated the new intern.
sentences.zh: 我不贊成他對待新實習生的方式。

sentences.en: The first date was disastrous from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 第一次約會從頭到尾都糟透了。

sentences.en: A disastrous quarter forced the company to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 一個慘不忍睹的季度，迫使公司削減成本。

sentences.en: Was the launch really as disastrous as people say?
sentences.zh: 這次上市真的像大家說的那麼慘嗎？

sentences.en: Skipping the safety check could have disastrous results.
sentences.zh: 略過安全檢查可能造成災難性的後果。

sentences.en: The storm had disastrous effects on the local economy.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨對當地經濟造成災難性的影響。

sentences.en: How could one small error be so disastrous?
sentences.zh: 一個小小的錯誤怎麼會造成這麼嚴重的後果？

sentences.en: I found a discrepancy between the invoice and the receipt.
sentences.zh: 我發現請款單和收據之間有出入。

sentences.en: Can you explain this discrepancy in the sales figures?
sentences.zh: 你可以解釋銷售數字中的這個差異嗎？

sentences.en: The accountant noticed a small discrepancy in the totals.
sentences.zh: 會計師注意到總額有小小的差異。

sentences.en: Please report any discrepancy in your bill to the front desk.
sentences.zh: 帳單如有任何不符，請向櫃檯反映。

sentences.en: Why is there a discrepancy between the two reports?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這兩份報告有出入？

sentences.en: A discrepancy in the inventory count delayed the audit.
sentences.zh: 庫存盤點的差異拖延了查核作業。

sentences.en: It is illegal to discriminate against job applicants because of age.
sentences.zh: 因年齡而歧視求職者是違法的。

sentences.en: Company policy forbids us to discriminate against anyone.
sentences.zh: 公司規定禁止我們歧視任何人。

sentences.en: Do you think the hiring test discriminates against older workers?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個徵才測驗會歧視年長員工嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher told us never to discriminate against classmates.
sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們絕不能歧視同學。

sentences.en: How can managers make sure they don't discriminate during interviews?
sentences.zh: 主管要如何確保自己在面試時不歧視任何人？

sentences.en: Courts ruled that the landlord had discriminated against a family.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定房東歧視了一個家庭。

sentences.en: The team's dismal performance disappointed all the fans.
sentences.zh: 球隊慘淡的表現讓所有球迷失望。

sentences.en: Sales figures for the quarter were dismal.
sentences.zh: 本季的銷售數字慘淡。

sentences.en: Why is the weather so dismal this week?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這星期的天氣這麼陰沉？

sentences.en: The company posted dismal profits for the third year.
sentences.zh: 公司連續第三年獲利慘淡。

sentences.en: Do you think the job market looks dismal for new graduates?
sentences.zh: 你覺得就業市場對應屆畢業生來說很慘淡嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel room was small, dark, and dismal.
sentences.zh: 這間旅館房間又小又暗，令人沮喪。

gloss_note: dismantle 把東西拆開，反義 assemble

sentences.en: The workers will dismantle the stage tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 工人明天早上會拆除舞台。

sentences.en: Can you help me dismantle this old bookshelf?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我拆這個舊書架嗎？

sentences.en: The company plans to dismantle its old production line.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫拆除舊的生產線。

sentences.en: It took two hours to dismantle the tent.
sentences.zh: 拆掉帳篷花了兩個小時。

sentences.en: How do you dismantle the crib without losing screws?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼拆嬰兒床才不會弄丟螺絲？

sentences.en: Mechanics dismantled the engine to find the problem.
sentences.zh: 技師拆開引擎找問題。

sentences.en: His dismissal came as a shock to the whole department.
sentences.zh: 他被解僱，讓整個部門都很震驚。

sentences.en: Did she receive written notice of her dismissal?
sentences.zh: 她有收到書面的解僱通知嗎？

sentences.en: The employee sued for wrongful dismissal.
sentences.zh: 這名員工以不當解僱為由提告。

sentences.en: The judge's dismissal of the case surprised the lawyers.
sentences.zh: 法官駁回此案，讓律師們很意外。

sentences.en: What was the reason for the dismissal of the manager?
sentences.zh: 這位經理被解僱的原因是什麼？

sentences.en: Can he appeal his dismissal within thirty days?
sentences.zh: 他可以在三十天內對解僱提出申訴嗎？

gloss_note: dispatch an order 發出訂單

sentences.en: We will dispatch your order within one business day.
sentences.zh: 我們會在一個工作天內出貨。

sentences.en: Dispatch a technician to the second floor right away.
sentences.zh: 立刻派一名技師到二樓。

sentences.en: How quickly can you dispatch a driver to the airport?
sentences.zh: 你多快能派司機到機場？

sentences.en: The dispatch of the package was delayed by the storm.
sentences.zh: 包裹的寄出因暴風雨而延誤。

sentences.en: Did the warehouse dispatch the shipment yesterday?
sentences.zh: 倉庫昨天有把貨物發出嗎？

sentences.en: The dispatch team assigns trucks to each delivery route.
sentences.zh: 調度團隊把卡車分配給每條配送路線。

sentences.en: Cheap imports could displace local manufacturers within a few years.
sentences.zh: 廉價進口品幾年內可能會把本地製造商擠出市場。

sentences.en: Will the new software displace any of our current staff?
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體會取代我們現有的任何員工嗎？

sentences.en: Robots have displaced hundreds of workers at the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 倉庫裡的機器人已經取代了數百名工人。

sentences.en: I don't want the reorganization to displace our best sales reps.
sentences.zh: 我不希望這次重組把我們最優秀的業務擠掉。

sentences.en: Online shopping is slowly displacing small stores downtown.
sentences.zh: 網路購物正逐漸取代市區的小商店。

sentences.en: Do you think electric cars will displace gas cars by 2040?
sentences.zh: 你覺得電動車到2040年會取代汽油車嗎？

sentences.en: We use disposable cups at the office party.
sentences.zh: 我們在公司派對上用免洗杯。

sentences.en: After rent and bills, how much disposable income do you have?
sentences.zh: 付完房租和帳單後，你有多少可支配所得？

sentences.en: Rising prices have cut into families' disposable income.
sentences.zh: 物價上漲侵蝕了家庭的可支配所得。

sentences.en: Are these gloves disposable, or can we wash them?
sentences.zh: 這些手套是用完即丟的，還是可以洗？

sentences.en: Our customers have less disposable income this year, so sales dropped.
sentences.zh: 今年我們的客戶可支配所得變少，所以銷售下滑了。

sentences.en: The clinic switched to disposable towels last month.
sentences.zh: 診所上個月改用了一次性毛巾。

gloss_note: disposition of assets 資產處分

sentences.en: The board approved the disposition of the old factory.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准處分舊工廠。

sentences.en: How will the company handle the disposition of unsold inventory?
sentences.zh: 公司要如何處理未售出的庫存？

sentences.en: Who approves the disposition of damaged goods at your warehouse?
sentences.zh: 你們倉庫的受損貨品要由誰核准處置？

sentences.en: The disposition of surplus equipment is handled by the finance team.
sentences.zh: 剩餘設備的處分由財務部負責。

sentences.en: Proceeds from the disposition of assets will pay off our debt.
sentences.zh: 處分資產的收益將用來還清我們的債務。

sentences.en: The lawyer reviewed the disposition of the company's property.
sentences.zh: 律師審閱了公司財產的處分情形。

sentences.en: Students performed the dissection of a frog in biology class.
sentences.zh: 學生們在生物課解剖了一隻青蛙。

sentences.en: Did you enjoy the dissection lab, or was it too messy?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡解剖實驗課嗎，還是覺得太凌亂？

sentences.en: The article offers a careful dissection of the company's failed strategy.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章對公司失敗的策略做了仔細的剖析。

sentences.en: Her dissection of the poem's meaning impressed the whole class.
sentences.zh: 她對這首詩涵義的剖析讓全班都印象深刻。

sentences.en: Would you be able to watch a dissection without feeling sick?
sentences.zh: 你看得了解剖過程而不覺得噁心嗎？

sentences.en: A close dissection of the data revealed several hidden errors.
sentences.zh: 對資料的仔細剖析發現了好幾個隱藏的錯誤。

sentences.en: There was little dissent when the board voted on the merger.
sentences.zh: 董事會表決合併案時幾乎沒有異議。

sentences.en: Why does the manager discourage any dissent in meetings?
sentences.zh: 為什麼經理在會議中不鼓勵任何異議？

sentences.en: Two committee members voiced dissent over the budget plan.
sentences.zh: 兩位委員對預算計畫表示異議。

sentences.en: Is it safe to express dissent in front of the boss?
sentences.zh: 在老闆面前表達不同意見安全嗎？

sentences.en: Widespread dissent among employees forced the company to rethink the new policy.
sentences.zh: 員工之間普遍的反對聲浪迫使公司重新考慮新政策。

sentences.en: Her dissent was noted in the meeting minutes.
sentences.zh: 她的異議被記錄在會議紀錄裡。

sentences.en: A dissident shareholder demanded changes to the board.
sentences.zh: 一位持異議的股東要求改組董事會。

sentences.en: Are the dissident directors planning to vote against the deal?
sentences.zh: 持異議的董事們打算投票反對這筆交易嗎？

sentences.en: The company tried to win over a few dissidents before the vote.
sentences.zh: 公司在表決前試圖爭取幾位持異議者。

sentences.en: Several dissident members refused to sign the agreement.
sentences.zh: 幾位持異議的成員拒絕在協議上簽名。

sentences.en: Is she the dissident who keeps challenging every new proposal?
sentences.zh: 她就是那個老是質疑每個新提案的異議者嗎？

sentences.en: The dissident group asked for an independent review of the accounts.
sentences.zh: 異議團體要求對帳目進行獨立審查。

gloss_note: draw a distinction 做出區分

sentences.en: Can you explain the distinction between a virus and a bacterium?
sentences.zh: 你能解釋病毒和細菌的差別嗎？

sentences.en: There is a clear distinction between being confident and being rude.
sentences.zh: 有自信和無禮之間有明顯的差別。

sentences.en: She earned the distinction of being the school's youngest champion.
sentences.zh: 她獲得了成為學校最年輕冠軍的殊榮。

sentences.en: Do you see any distinction between these two phone plans?
sentences.zh: 你看得出這兩種手機方案有什麼不同嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher doesn't make a distinction between boys and girls.
sentences.zh: 老師不會區別對待男生和女生。

sentences.en: This small town has the distinction of having the oldest library in the state.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮有擁有全州最古老圖書館的殊榮。

sentences.en: My phone is a constant distraction during meetings.
sentences.zh: 我的手機在開會時老是讓我分心。

sentences.en: Could we move to a quiet room? The noise is a distraction.
sentences.zh: 我們可以換到安靜的房間嗎？這些噪音會讓人分心。

sentences.en: Does it feel like a distraction when coworkers stop by your desk?
sentences.zh: 同事順道來你座位找你，會讓你分心嗎？

sentences.en: Please turn off notifications to avoid distractions while you work.
sentences.zh: 工作時請關掉通知，以免分心。

sentences.en: Is the open office too full of distractions for deep work?
sentences.zh: 開放式辦公室是不是干擾太多，沒辦法專心工作？

sentences.en: Her kids were a welcome distraction from the stress of the project.
sentences.zh: 孩子們是讓她暫時擺脫專案壓力的好消遣。

gloss_note: document 當動詞指詳細記錄

sentences.en: Please document every change you make to the file.
sentences.zh: 請把你對檔案做的每項修改都記錄下來。

sentences.en: Where can I find the document I need to sign?
sentences.zh: 我要簽的文件在哪裡找得到？

sentences.en: Can you email me the signed document by noon?
sentences.zh: 你可以在中午前把簽好的文件用電子郵件寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: She documented the whole trip with her camera.
sentences.zh: 她用相機記錄了整趟旅程。

sentences.en: You'll need an official document to prove your age.
sentences.zh: 你需要一份官方文件來證明你的年齡。

sentences.en: Reporters documented the damage after the storm.
sentences.zh: 記者在暴風雨後記錄了災情。

sentences.en: The old library has a beautiful glass dome.
sentences.zh: 那座老圖書館有個美麗的玻璃圓頂。

sentences.en: Can you see the dome of the observatory from your window?
sentences.zh: 你從窗戶看得到天文台的圓頂嗎？

sentences.en: We sat under the dome and watched a show about stars.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在穹頂下看了一場關於星星的表演。

sentences.en: A golden dome rises above the city hall.
sentences.zh: 市政廳上方矗立著一座金色圓頂。

sentences.en: Is this a dome tent, or does it have a flat roof?
sentences.zh: 這是圓頂帳篷，還是平頂的？

sentences.en: Workers repaired the leaking dome last spring.
sentences.zh: 工人們去年春天修好了漏水的圓頂。

sentences.en: Poor planning doomed the project from the start.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的規劃讓這個專案一開始就注定失敗。

sentences.en: Is the company doomed if it loses this big client?
sentences.zh: 如果失去這個大客戶，公司就完蛋了嗎？

sentences.en: Many analysts predict doom for the retail chain.
sentences.zh: 許多分析師預測這家零售連鎖店將面臨厄運。

sentences.en: Their weak sales figures seemed to doom the product launch.
sentences.zh: 他們疲弱的銷售數字似乎讓新品上市注定失敗。

sentences.en: Are we doomed to repeat the same mistakes every quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們注定每一季都重複同樣的錯誤嗎？

sentences.en: A sudden lawsuit sealed the startup's doom.
sentences.zh: 一場突如其來的訴訟讓這家新創公司在劫難逃。

sentences.en: She stood in the doorway and waved goodbye.
sentences.zh: 她站在門口揮手道別。

sentences.en: Could you please not block the doorway?
sentences.zh: 你可以不要擋住門口嗎？

sentences.en: Who is that man standing in the doorway?
sentences.zh: 站在門口的那個男人是誰？

sentences.en: The cat sat in the doorway all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓整個下午都坐在門口。

sentences.en: Rain poured down while we waited in the doorway of the shop.
sentences.zh: 我們在店門口等著，雨傾盆而下。

sentences.en: The doorway is too narrow for this couch.
sentences.zh: 這個門口太窄，這張沙發進不去。

sentences.en: Knead the dough for about ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 把麵團揉大約十分鐘。

sentences.en: How long should the dough rest before baking?
sentences.zh: 麵團烘烤前要靜置多久？

sentences.en: My grandma made the dough by hand every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每個星期天都親手揉麵團。

sentences.en: Is the dough supposed to be this sticky?
sentences.zh: 這個麵團應該這麼黏嗎？

sentences.en: The dough doubled in size after an hour.
sentences.zh: 一個小時後，麵團膨脹成兩倍大。

sentences.en: Roll out the dough on a floured surface.
sentences.zh: 把麵團放在撒了麵粉的檯面上，壓成薄片。

gloss_note: downgrade A to B 把A降為B

sentences.en: The agency downgraded the company's credit rating last week.
sentences.zh: 評等機構上週調降了該公司的信用評等。

sentences.en: Did the airline downgrade your seat without telling you?
sentences.zh: 航空公司沒告訴你就把你的座位降等了嗎？

sentences.en: Analysts may downgrade the stock if earnings keep falling.
sentences.zh: 如果獲利持續下滑，分析師可能會調降這檔股票的評等。

sentences.en: We had to downgrade our growth forecast for next year.
sentences.zh: 我們不得不下修明年的成長預測。

sentences.en: Would a downgrade to the basic plan save us money?
sentences.zh: 降級到基本方案能幫我們省錢嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel downgraded us to a smaller room because of a booking error.
sentences.zh: 因為訂房出錯，飯店把我們降到較小的房間。

sentences.en: The main downside of this plan is the cost.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫的主要缺點是成本。

sentences.en: What's the downside of working from home?
sentences.zh: 在家工作的缺點是什麼？

sentences.en: There's a downside to every new strategy.
sentences.zh: 每項新策略都有不利之處。

sentences.en: Is there any downside to signing the contract early?
sentences.zh: 提早簽約有什麼不利的地方嗎？

sentences.en: The downside is that we'd lose some flexibility.
sentences.zh: 缺點是我們會失去一些彈性。

sentences.en: On the downside, the new laptop is heavier.
sentences.zh: 缺點是，這台新筆電比較重。

sentences.en: The company plans to downsize its regional office next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫明年縮編地區辦公室。

sentences.en: Are they downsizing again after such a bad quarter?
sentences.zh: 業績這麼差的一季之後，他們又要裁員縮編了嗎？

sentences.en: Many firms downsized during the economic slowdown.
sentences.zh: 許多公司在經濟衰退期間裁員縮編。

sentences.en: Why did the store downsize its staff before the holidays?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這家店在假期前縮減人力？

sentences.en: We had to downsize our department to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 為了節省成本，我們部門不得不縮編。

sentences.en: After the kids moved out, they decided to downsize to a smaller home.
sentences.zh: 孩子搬出去後，他們決定換到小一點的房子。

sentences.en: The only drawback of this hotel is the noise.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店唯一的缺點是噪音。

sentences.en: Does the cheaper model have any drawbacks?
sentences.zh: 比較便宜的型號有什麼缺點嗎？

sentences.en: One major drawback is the long delivery time.
sentences.zh: 一個主要的缺點是交貨時間很長。

sentences.en: What's the biggest drawback of using this software?
sentences.zh: 使用這套軟體最大的缺點是什麼？

sentences.en: Despite its drawbacks, the plan got approval from the manager.
sentences.zh: 儘管有缺點，這個計畫還是獲得經理核准。

sentences.en: The drawback to a remote job is feeling isolated.
sentences.zh: 遠端工作的缺點是會覺得孤單。

sentences.en: The weather was dreadful, so we stayed in all weekend.
sentences.zh: 天氣糟透了，所以我們整個週末都待在家。

sentences.en: I feel dreadful about missing your party.
sentences.zh: 沒能參加你的派對，我覺得很糟糕。

sentences.en: Why is the food at this cafeteria so dreadful?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這間自助餐廳的食物這麼難吃？

sentences.en: That was a dreadful movie; I want my money back.
sentences.zh: 那部電影爛透了，我想要退錢。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the dreadful accident on the highway?
sentences.zh: 你聽說高速公路上那起可怕的意外了嗎？

sentences.en: The traffic this morning was dreadful, so I was late.
sentences.zh: 今天早上的車況糟透了，所以我遲到了。

sentences.en: Please don't park in front of the driveway.
sentences.zh: 請不要把車停在車道前面。

sentences.en: Our driveway is covered in snow again.
sentences.zh: 我們家的車道又被雪蓋住了。

sentences.en: Can you pull into the driveway so I can unload?
sentences.zh: 你可以把車開進車道讓我卸貨嗎？

sentences.en: The kids drew pictures with chalk on the driveway.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用粉筆在車道上畫畫。

sentences.en: Is that your car parked at the end of the driveway?
sentences.zh: 停在車道盡頭的那輛是你的車嗎？

sentences.en: He shoveled the driveway before heading to work.
sentences.zh: 他上班前先把車道的雪鏟乾淨。

gloss_note: drizzle A over B 把A淋在B上

sentences.en: Drizzle a little olive oil over the salad.
sentences.zh: 在沙拉上淋一點橄欖油。

sentences.en: Should I drizzle the honey on the pancakes now?
sentences.zh: 我現在要把蜂蜜淋在鬆餅上嗎？

sentences.en: She drizzled chocolate sauce over the ice cream.
sentences.zh: 她把巧克力醬淋在冰淇淋上。

sentences.en: Could you drizzle the sauce over the chicken, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把醬汁淋在雞肉上嗎？

sentences.en: The chef drizzled lemon juice on the fish before serving.
sentences.zh: 主廚上菜前在魚上淋了檸檬汁。

sentences.en: Drizzle the glaze on the cake once it cools.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕涼了之後再淋上糖霜。

sentences.en: She holds dual citizenship in two countries.
sentences.zh: 她擁有兩個國家的雙重國籍。

sentences.en: Does this sofa serve a dual purpose, as a seat and a bed?
sentences.zh: 這張沙發可以兼具座位和床的雙重用途嗎？

sentences.en: He plays a dual role as sales manager and trainer.
sentences.zh: 他同時擔任業務經理和訓練師的雙重角色。

sentences.en: The phone has dual cameras on the back.
sentences.zh: 這支手機背面有雙鏡頭。

sentences.en: Does this laptop support dual monitors?
sentences.zh: 這台筆電支援雙螢幕嗎？

sentences.en: The company has a dual focus on growth and customer service.
sentences.zh: 公司同時著重成長與客戶服務。

sentences.en: The press dubbed the merger the deal of the year.
sentences.zh: 媒體把這樁合併案稱為年度大交易。

sentences.en: Coworkers dubbed him the spreadsheet king.
sentences.zh: 同事給他取了「試算表之王」的綽號。

sentences.en: Why did they dub the new product line the Green Series?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼把新產品線稱為綠色系列？

sentences.en: Reporters dubbed the CEO's speech a turning point.
sentences.zh: 記者把執行長的演講稱為一個轉捩點。

sentences.en: Critics have dubbed this startup the next big thing.
sentences.zh: 評論家把這家新創公司稱為下一個熱門新星。

sentences.en: Who dubbed our quarterly meeting Pizza Friday?
sentences.zh: 是誰把我們的季會戲稱為披薩星期五？

sentences.en: The presentation was so dull that half the room fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 簡報太無聊，房間裡有一半的人都睡著了。

sentences.en: Sales have been dull since the new year started.
sentences.zh: 新年一開始，業績就一直不太好。

sentences.en: Is the market always this dull in January?
sentences.zh: 一月的市場總是這麼冷清嗎？

sentences.en: Why are these training videos so dull?
sentences.zh: 這些訓練影片為什麼這麼乏味？

sentences.en: It was a dull meeting with nothing new to discuss.
sentences.zh: 那是一場沒有新鮮事可討論的乏味會議。

sentences.en: Business remains dull in the winter months.
sentences.zh: 冬季那幾個月生意依然清淡。

gloss_note: 正式；duly signed 依規定簽署

sentences.en: The form was duly signed, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 表格有依規定簽名了，不是嗎？

sentences.en: He duly paid the fee. Did you?
sentences.zh: 他按規定繳了費用。你繳了嗎？

sentences.en: All visitors must be duly registered at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 所有訪客都必須在櫃檯依規定登記。

sentences.en: The package arrived, duly stamped and signed.
sentences.zh: 包裹送達了，並且依規定蓋了章、簽了名。

sentences.en: We duly informed the customer of the delay.
sentences.zh: 我們已依規定通知客戶延遲一事。

sentences.en: The invoice was duly submitted before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 請款單已在截止日前如期送出。

sentences.en: A healthy ecosystem needs both plants and animals.
sentences.zh: 健康的生態系需要植物也需要動物。

sentences.en: How does pollution affect the ocean ecosystem?
sentences.zh: 汙染如何影響海洋生態系？

sentences.en: The wetland ecosystem supports many kinds of birds.
sentences.zh: 這片濕地生態系養活了許多種鳥類。

sentences.en: Did your class visit a forest ecosystem on the field trip?
sentences.zh: 你們班在校外教學時參觀了森林生態系嗎？

sentences.en: Removing one species can upset the whole ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 移除一個物種可能打亂整個生態系。

sentences.en: The lake's ecosystem has slowly recovered since the cleanup.
sentences.zh: 自從整治之後，這座湖的生態系已慢慢恢復。

sentences.en: He has a huge ego, but he's a good leader.
sentences.zh: 他很自負，不過是個好領導者。

sentences.en: Don't let your ego get in the way of teamwork.
sentences.zh: 別讓你的自負妨礙團隊合作。

sentences.en: Does it hurt your ego when people correct you?
sentences.zh: 別人糾正你時，你的自尊心會受傷嗎？

sentences.en: Her ego was bruised after losing the debate.
sentences.zh: 她辯論輸了之後，自尊心受了傷。

sentences.en: Why do some people have such big egos?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人這麼自大？

sentences.en: A little praise can boost anyone's ego.
sentences.zh: 一點稱讚就能提升任何人的自尊心。

gloss_note: 指有投票權的全體民眾

sentences.en: The electorate will vote on the new library budget in November.
sentences.zh: 全體選民將在十一月就新圖書館預算投票。

sentences.en: Is the electorate paying attention to this local race?
sentences.zh: 選民們有在關注這場地方選舉嗎？

sentences.en: A large part of the electorate stayed home on election day.
sentences.zh: 有很大一部分選民在投票日待在家裡。

sentences.en: The mayor said the electorate deserves honest answers.
sentences.zh: 市長說選民值得得到誠實的答案。

sentences.en: How can candidates reach younger members of the electorate?
sentences.zh: 候選人要如何接觸較年輕的選民？

sentences.en: The new voting rules affect the entire electorate.
sentences.zh: 新的投票規定會影響所有選民。

sentences.en: She gave an eloquent speech at the wedding.
sentences.zh: 她在婚禮上發表了一場動人的演說。

sentences.en: Is he always this eloquent when he talks about his work?
sentences.zh: 他談到工作時總是這麼口才流利嗎？

sentences.en: The lawyer made an eloquent case for the client.
sentences.zh: 律師為客戶做了有力的辯護。

sentences.en: Her eloquent reply silenced the critics.
sentences.zh: 她雄辯的回答讓批評者啞口無言。

sentences.en: Who is the most eloquent speaker in your class?
sentences.zh: 你們班上口才最好的人是誰？

sentences.en: He wasn't eloquent, but everyone understood his point.
sentences.zh: 他口才不算好，但大家都懂他的意思。

sentences.en: This brand embodies quality and trust.
sentences.zh: 這個品牌體現了品質與信賴。

sentences.en: Does the new logo embody our company values?
sentences.zh: 新標誌有體現我們公司的價值觀嗎？

sentences.en: She embodies the team spirit we want everyone to have.
sentences.zh: 她體現了我們希望每個人都有的團隊精神。

sentences.en: The CEO embodied leadership during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 執行長在危機中是領導力的最佳典範。

sentences.en: How can we embody these ideas in the final design?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何把這些想法具體呈現在最終設計裡？

sentences.en: His work ethic embodies what this company stands for.
sentences.zh: 他的工作態度體現了這家公司所代表的價值。

sentences.en: They embraced at the airport after two years apart.
sentences.zh: 分開兩年後，他們在機場擁抱。

sentences.en: Our company needs to embrace new technology.
sentences.zh: 我們公司需要欣然接受新科技。

sentences.en: Why do some people refuse to embrace change?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人拒絕擁抱改變？

sentences.en: She welcomed him with a warm embrace.
sentences.zh: 她以溫暖的擁抱迎接他。

sentences.en: Would you embrace a move abroad for the right job?
sentences.zh: 如果是理想的工作，你會欣然接受搬到國外嗎？

sentences.en: The students embraced the new schedule quickly.
sentences.zh: 學生們很快就接受了新的課表。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Commander Keane
Recorder: Commander Keane

sentences.en: Factories must limit the gases they emit into the air.
sentences.zh: 工廠必須限制排放到空氣中的氣體。

sentences.en: Does this heater emit any harmful fumes?
sentences.zh: 這台暖爐會排放任何有害氣體嗎？

sentences.en: The device emits a loud beep when the battery is low.
sentences.zh: 電池電量低時，這個裝置會發出很大的嗶聲。

sentences.en: Cars emitting less carbon are becoming more popular.
sentences.zh: 排放較少碳的汽車越來越受歡迎。

sentences.en: How much light does a firefly emit?
sentences.zh: 螢火蟲會發出多少光？

sentences.en: The sun emits both light and heat.
sentences.zh: 太陽會放出光和熱。

gloss_note: empower sb to do 授權某人做

sentences.en: The training program empowers women to start their own businesses.
sentences.zh: 這個訓練計畫賦予女性創業的能力。

sentences.en: Our manager empowers us to make decisions on our own.
sentences.zh: 我們的經理授權我們自己做決定。

sentences.en: Can this new tool empower small shops to compete online?
sentences.zh: 這個新工具能讓小商店有能力在網路上競爭嗎？

sentences.en: I felt empowered after the leadership workshop.
sentences.zh: 參加完領導力工作坊後，我覺得更有信心、有能力了。

sentences.en: Are we empowered to approve refunds without asking you?
sentences.zh: 我們有權限不經你同意就核准退款嗎？

sentences.en: The company wants to empower employees through better training.
sentences.zh: 公司想透過更好的訓練來賦予員工能力。

sentences.en: Employee empowerment improves morale and productivity.
sentences.zh: 員工賦權能提升士氣與生產力。

sentences.en: How does the company encourage empowerment among its staff?
sentences.zh: 公司如何增強員工的自主權？

sentences.en: The workshop focuses on women's economic empowerment.
sentences.zh: 這場工作坊聚焦於女性的經濟賦權。

sentences.en: Is empowerment just a buzzword, or does it change anything?
sentences.zh: 賦權只是流行語，還是真的有改變？

sentences.en: Giving teams more control leads to a sense of empowerment.
sentences.zh: 給團隊更多掌控權，會帶來被賦權的感覺。

sentences.en: Her book is about personal empowerment and confidence.
sentences.zh: 她的書談的是個人的自我賦權與自信。

sentences.en: The training course encompasses sales, marketing, and customer service.
sentences.zh: 這門訓練課程涵蓋業務、行銷和客戶服務。

sentences.en: Does the contract encompass maintenance costs?
sentences.zh: 這份合約包含維修費用嗎？

sentences.en: Our product line encompasses everything from phones to speakers.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品線涵蓋從手機到喇叭的各種產品。

sentences.en: What does the term customer service encompass in your company?
sentences.zh: 在你們公司，客戶服務這個詞涵蓋哪些範圍？

sentences.en: The survey encompassed more than five thousand households.
sentences.zh: 這項調查涵蓋了五千多戶家庭。

sentences.en: The project's scope encompasses three departments.
sentences.zh: 這項專案的範圍涵蓋三個部門。

gloss_note: endless meetings 沒完沒了的會議

sentences.en: These endless meetings are eating up my whole week.
sentences.zh: 這些沒完沒了的會議占掉了我整個星期。

sentences.en: Is there an endless supply of paper in the supply room?
sentences.zh: 備品室的紙是無限供應的嗎？

sentences.en: The report is full of endless details that nobody reads.
sentences.zh: 那份報告滿是沒人會看的冗長細節。

sentences.en: Why does this paperwork feel endless?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這些文書作業感覺沒完沒了？

sentences.en: The new market offers endless opportunities for growth.
sentences.zh: 新市場提供無盡的成長機會。

sentences.en: We waited in an endless line at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我們在機場排了一條看不到盡頭的隊伍。

gloss_note: get an endorsement 獲得背書

sentences.en: We need the manager's endorsement before we can order.
sentences.zh: 我們得先取得經理的認可才能下訂單。

sentences.en: Did the committee give its endorsement to the new budget?
sentences.zh: 委員會有認可新預算嗎？

sentences.en: A strong endorsement from a customer can boost sales.
sentences.zh: 顧客的強力背書能提升銷售。

sentences.en: The product received an endorsement from several experts.
sentences.zh: 這項產品獲得數位專家的背書。

sentences.en: Is the plan ready for final endorsement?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫準備好接受最後核可了嗎？

sentences.en: She asked for his endorsement of her proposal.
sentences.zh: 她請他對她的提案表示認可。

gloss_note: legally enforceable 法律上可執行

sentences.en: Is this verbal agreement legally enforceable?
sentences.zh: 這個口頭協議在法律上有強制執行力嗎？

sentences.en: The contract is only enforceable if both sides sign it.
sentences.zh: 這份合約必須雙方簽字才具有強制執行力。

sentences.en: We need rules that are clear and enforceable.
sentences.zh: 我們需要明確而且可執行的規定。

sentences.en: Our lawyer says the noncompete clause isn't enforceable.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師說競業禁止條款沒有強制執行力。

sentences.en: Are these terms enforceable in every state?
sentences.zh: 這些條款在每個州都具有強制執行力嗎？

sentences.en: An enforceable policy needs penalties for breaking it.
sentences.zh: 可執行的政策需要有違規的處罰。

sentences.en: The latest update includes several performance enhancements.
sentences.zh: 最新的更新包含好幾項效能提升。

sentences.en: What kind of enhancement are you hoping for in the next version?
sentences.zh: 你希望下一個版本有哪些強化？

sentences.en: Photo enhancement tools can fix dark pictures.
sentences.zh: 照片強化工具可以修正偏暗的照片。

sentences.en: Is the new feature a real enhancement or just a change?
sentences.zh: 這個新功能是真的改善，還是只是改變？

sentences.en: We budgeted money for security enhancements this year.
sentences.zh: 我們今年編列了資安強化的預算。

sentences.en: The enhancement of customer service raised our ratings.
sentences.zh: 客戶服務的提升拉高了我們的評價。

gloss_note: 修飾動詞或形容詞，語氣強

sentences.en: The new policy has helped us enormously.
sentences.zh: 新政策對我們幫助極大。

sentences.en: Prices have varied enormously from store to store.
sentences.zh: 各家店的價格差異極大。

sentences.en: Rents have risen enormously in this city, haven't they?
sentences.zh: 這座城市的房租漲了非常多，對吧？

sentences.en: Her book influenced readers enormously.
sentences.zh: 她的書對讀者影響極大。

sentences.en: Why has the population here increased enormously since 2010?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這裡的人口從2010年以來大幅增加？

sentences.en: I enjoyed the concert enormously.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜歡那場演唱會。

sentences.en: Travel can enrich your view of the world.
sentences.zh: 旅行能豐富你對世界的看法。

sentences.en: How does music enrich a child's education?
sentences.zh: 音樂如何豐富孩子的教育？

sentences.en: The new partnership will enrich our product line.
sentences.zh: 新的合作關係將豐富我們的產品線。

sentences.en: Does this course enrich students' understanding of business?
sentences.zh: 這門課能讓學生對商業的理解更豐富嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh ingredients enrich the flavor of the soup.
sentences.zh: 新鮮食材讓湯的風味更豐富。

sentences.en: Volunteering enriched her life in many ways.
sentences.zh: 當志工在許多方面豐富了她的生活。

sentences.en: She started a small enterprise selling handmade soap.
sentences.zh: 她創辦了一家販售手工肥皂的小企業。

sentences.en: Is your parents' small enterprise doing well this year?
sentences.zh: 你爸媽的小事業今年經營得好嗎？

sentences.en: Small enterprises create many jobs in this town.
sentences.zh: 小型企業在這個鎮上創造了許多工作機會。

sentences.en: The government offered loans to new enterprises.
sentences.zh: 政府提供貸款給新創事業。

sentences.en: What kind of enterprise would you like to run someday?
sentences.zh: 你有一天想經營什麼樣的事業？

sentences.en: Running a free school lunch program is a worthwhile enterprise.
sentences.zh: 辦免費營養午餐是件有價值的事業。

sentences.en: He's a camera enthusiast who owns six lenses.
sentences.zh: 他是個相機愛好者，擁有六顆鏡頭。

sentences.en: Are you a fitness enthusiast or just a casual jogger?
sentences.zh: 你是健身狂熱者，還是只是偶爾慢跑？

sentences.en: The store caters to coffee enthusiasts.
sentences.zh: 這家店的客群是咖啡愛好者。

sentences.en: Many car enthusiasts attend the annual show.
sentences.zh: 許多汽車迷會參加年度車展。

sentences.en: Do you know any wine enthusiasts we could invite?
sentences.zh: 你認識我們可以邀請的葡萄酒愛好者嗎？

sentences.en: As a hiking enthusiast, she packed her boots first.
sentences.zh: 身為健行愛好者，她最先打包的就是登山靴。

gloss_note: be entitled to 有權享有

sentences.en: This ticket entitles you to a free drink.
sentences.zh: 這張票讓你有資格免費領一杯飲料。

sentences.en: Are employees entitled to paid sick leave?
sentences.zh: 員工有權享有有薪病假嗎？

sentences.en: You're entitled to a full refund within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 你有權在三十天內全額退費。

sentences.en: Being the boss doesn't entitle you to be rude.
sentences.zh: 當老闆並不代表你有資格無禮。

sentences.en: Does a student ID entitle me to a discount?
sentences.zh: 學生證能讓我享有折扣嗎？

sentences.en: Members are entitled to use the gym after work.
sentences.zh: 會員有權在下班後使用健身房。

sentences.en: A new entrant in the market can disrupt big companies.
sentences.zh: 市場上的新進入者可能會打亂大公司。

sentences.en: How many entrants joined the cooking contest this year?
sentences.zh: 今年有多少參賽者參加了烹飪比賽？

sentences.en: The company worries about new entrants offering lower prices.
sentences.zh: 公司擔心新進入者提供更低的價格。

sentences.en: Each entrant must submit a form before Friday.
sentences.zh: 每位參賽者都必須在星期五前交一份表格。

sentences.en: Are you a new entrant to the job market?
sentences.zh: 你是剛進入就業市場的新人嗎？

sentences.en: Entrants to the program must be at least eighteen.
sentences.zh: 參加這個計畫的人必須年滿十八歲。

gloss_note: 美式指主餐；英式指前菜

sentences.en: For my entree, I'll have the grilled salmon.
sentences.zh: 我的主菜要點烤鮭魚。

sentences.en: Does the entree come with a side salad?
sentences.zh: 主菜有附配菜沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: The entree was huge, so we shared one.
sentences.zh: 主菜份量好大，所以我們合點一份。

sentences.en: What's your favorite entree at this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳你最喜歡哪道主菜？

sentences.en: She ordered a pasta entree and a glass of water.
sentences.zh: 她點了一份義大利麵主菜和一杯水。

sentences.en: Our entrees come with soup or salad.
sentences.zh: 我們的主菜附湯或沙拉。

sentences.en: She has an entrepreneurial spirit and loves taking risks.
sentences.zh: 她有創業精神，也喜歡冒險。

sentences.en: Is your son entrepreneurial, or does he prefer a steady job?
sentences.zh: 你兒子有創業精神，還是比較喜歡穩定的工作？

sentences.en: The school offers an entrepreneurial program for high school students.
sentences.zh: 學校為高中生開設了創業培訓課程。

sentences.en: We're looking for entrepreneurial people to join our startup.
sentences.zh: 我們正在找有創業精神的人加入我們的新創公司。

sentences.en: Her entrepreneurial skills helped the family shop grow.
sentences.zh: 她的創業能力幫助家裡的小店成長。

sentences.en: What makes a city more entrepreneurial?
sentences.zh: 什麼因素讓一座城市更有創業活力？

sentences.en: I'm envious of your long vacation.
sentences.zh: 我好羨慕你的長假。

sentences.en: Are you envious of her new job?
sentences.zh: 你羨慕她的新工作嗎？

sentences.en: He felt envious when his friend bought a sports car.
sentences.zh: 看到朋友買了跑車，他覺得很羨慕。

sentences.en: Don't be envious; you'll get your turn soon.
sentences.zh: 別嫉妒，很快就輪到你了。

sentences.en: Why do you look so envious of that couple?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼看起來這麼羨慕那對情侶？

sentences.en: She gave an envious glance at my dessert.
sentences.zh: 她羨慕地瞥了我的甜點一眼。

sentences.en: I can't envision myself working in an office all day.
sentences.zh: 我無法想像自己整天在辦公室工作。

sentences.en: How do you envision the future of your company?
sentences.zh: 你如何設想公司的未來？

sentences.en: The architect envisioned a park in the empty lot.
sentences.zh: 建築師設想在那塊空地蓋一座公園。

sentences.en: Can you envision living in another country?
sentences.zh: 你能想像住在另一個國家嗎？

sentences.en: We envision a world where everyone can read.
sentences.zh: 我們設想一個人人都能讀書識字的世界。

sentences.en: She envisioned a bright future for her kids.
sentences.zh: 她為孩子們設想了光明的未來。

gloss_note: epidemic proportions 大流行的規模

sentences.en: Flu cases have reached epidemic levels in the region.
sentences.zh: 流感病例在這個地區已達到流行的程度。

sentences.en: Doctors fear the disease may reach epidemic proportions.
sentences.zh: 醫生擔心這種疾病可能蔓延成大規模流行。

sentences.en: Is the epidemic outbreak under control now?
sentences.zh: 這次流行性疫情現在控制住了嗎？

sentences.en: The school closed during the flu epidemic.
sentences.zh: 流感流行期間學校停課了。

sentences.en: How did the town handle the epidemic?
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮是怎麼應對疫情的？

sentences.en: Doctors are working hard to stop the epidemic.
sentences.zh: 醫生們正努力阻止疫情。

gloss_note: 研究疾病如何傳播的學科

sentences.en: She studied epidemiology because she wanted to understand how diseases spread.
sentences.zh: 她學流行病學，是因為想了解疾病如何傳播。

sentences.en: What does epidemiology tell us about the spread of the flu?
sentences.zh: 流行病學能告訴我們哪些關於流感傳播的事？

sentences.en: Our professor teaches an introductory epidemiology course every fall.
sentences.zh: 我們教授每年秋季都開流行病學入門課。

sentences.en: Is epidemiology a required class for public health majors?
sentences.zh: 流行病學是公共衛生系學生的必修課嗎？

sentences.en: Advances in epidemiology have helped cities respond to outbreaks faster.
sentences.zh: 流行病學的進步，讓各城市能更快應對疫情爆發。

sentences.en: I'm reading a book on epidemiology for my research paper.
sentences.zh: 我正在讀一本流行病學的書，要寫研究報告。

sentences.en: Did you watch the latest episode of that cooking show?
sentences.zh: 你看了那個料理節目的最新一集嗎？

sentences.en: The final episode ends with a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 最後一集以一個大驚喜作結。

sentences.en: We binge-watched six episodes last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末一口氣追了六集。

sentences.en: That embarrassing episode at the party still makes me laugh.
sentences.zh: 派對上那段尷尬的插曲，我想到還是會笑。

sentences.en: Which episode has the scene at the airport?
sentences.zh: 哪一集有機場那一幕？

sentences.en: The radio show posts a new episode every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 這個廣播節目每週二都會上傳新的一集。

gloss_note: equate A with B 把A等同於B

sentences.en: Many people equate high prices with good quality.
sentences.zh: 很多人把高價和好品質畫上等號。

sentences.en: Don't equate being busy with being productive.
sentences.zh: 別把忙碌和有效率劃上等號。

sentences.en: Do you really equate success with making a lot of money?
sentences.zh: 你真的把成功和賺大錢劃上等號嗎？

sentences.en: The manager refused to equate seniority with skill.
sentences.zh: 經理不肯把年資和能力視為同一回事。

sentences.en: Why do customers equate a famous name with reliability?
sentences.zh: 為什麼顧客會把知名度和可靠劃上等號？

sentences.en: The study equates a large following with real influence.
sentences.zh: 這項研究把大量追蹤者等同於真正的影響力。

gloss_note: solve an equation 解方程式

sentences.en: Can you help me solve this equation for my homework?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我解這道方程式的作業嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher wrote a long equation on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上寫了一道很長的方程式。

sentences.en: What happens if you move x to the other side of the equation?
sentences.zh: 如果把 x 移到等號另一邊，會怎麼樣？

sentences.en: I got the answer wrong because I copied the equation incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 我答錯了，因為我把方程式抄錯了。

sentences.en: This equation shows how distance, speed, and time are related.
sentences.zh: 這個等式說明了距離、速度和時間的關係。

sentences.en: Please check each equation before you turn in the test.
sentences.zh: 交卷前請檢查每一道算式。

sentences.en: One cup of this juice is equivalent to two oranges.
sentences.zh: 一杯這種果汁相當於兩顆柳橙。

sentences.en: Is a high school diploma here equivalent to one in Taiwan?
sentences.zh: 這裡的高中文憑和台灣的高中文憑是同等的嗎？

sentences.en: The two jobs pay about the same, so they're roughly equivalent.
sentences.zh: 這兩份工作薪水差不多，所以大致相當。

sentences.en: What's the equivalent of ten dollars in euros today?
sentences.zh: 今天十美元相當於多少歐元？

sentences.en: Her degree is equivalent to a master's in the United States.
sentences.zh: 她的學位相當於美國的碩士學位。

sentences.en: Is there an English equivalent for this Chinese saying?
sentences.zh: 這句中文成語在英文裡有對應的說法嗎？

gloss_note: erect a fence 架起圍欄

sentences.en: Workers will erect a stage in the park this weekend.
sentences.zh: 工人這週末會在公園搭起一座舞台。

sentences.en: The city plans to erect a new statue downtown.
sentences.zh: 市府計畫在市中心豎立一座新雕像。

sentences.en: How long does it take to erect a tent?
sentences.zh: 搭一頂帳篷要花多久？

sentences.en: She stood erect and waited for her turn to speak.
sentences.zh: 她站得筆直，等著輪到自己發言。

sentences.en: Why do dancers always hold their backs so erect?
sentences.zh: 為什麼舞者的背總是挺得那麼直？

sentences.en: The neighbors erected a fence around their backyard.
sentences.zh: 鄰居在後院周圍架起了一道圍欄。

sentences.en: Rising costs will erode our profit margin this year.
sentences.zh: 成本上升會侵蝕我們今年的利潤率。

sentences.en: Constant delays can erode customer trust over time.
sentences.zh: 一再延誤會逐漸削弱顧客的信任。

sentences.en: How quickly will inflation erode the value of our savings?
sentences.zh: 通貨膨脹會多快侵蝕我們存款的價值？

sentences.en: Ocean waves slowly eroded the cliff near the hotel.
sentences.zh: 海浪慢慢侵蝕了飯店附近的懸崖。

sentences.en: Do discounts erode a brand's image in the long run?
sentences.zh: 長期下來，打折會削弱品牌形象嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy rain has eroded the soil along the riverbank.
sentences.zh: 豪雨沖蝕了河岸邊的土壤。

sentences.en: I have a few errands to run after work.
sentences.zh: 下班後我還有幾件雜事要跑。

sentences.en: Can you run an errand for me on your way home?
sentences.zh: 你回家路上可以幫我跑個腿嗎？

sentences.en: Saturday mornings are usually for errands and laundry.
sentences.zh: 週六早上通常用來辦雜事和洗衣服。

sentences.en: She sent her son on an errand to the corner store.
sentences.zh: 她叫兒子去街角的商店跑腿。

sentences.en: Did you finish all your errands at the post office?
sentences.zh: 你在郵局的事都辦完了嗎？

sentences.en: I'm running errands today, so I'll answer emails later.
sentences.zh: 我今天要出去辦事，所以晚點再回信。

gloss_note: erupt in applause 爆出掌聲

sentences.en: The volcano erupted without any warning last night.
sentences.zh: 那座火山昨晚毫無預警地噴發了。

sentences.en: Cheers erupted when the team scored in the last minute.
sentences.zh: 球隊在最後一分鐘得分時，歡呼聲爆發了出來。

sentences.en: Do you think the volcano will erupt again soon?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那座火山很快會再噴發嗎？

sentences.en: Laughter erupted across the room after his joke.
sentences.zh: 他說完笑話，整個房間爆出笑聲。

sentences.en: What made the crowd erupt in applause?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓觀眾爆出掌聲？

sentences.en: A fire erupted in the kitchen, but everyone got out safely.
sentences.zh: 廚房突然起火，不過大家都安全逃出來了。

gloss_note: leave an estate 留下遺產

sentences.en: They spent their honeymoon at a country estate in Italy.
sentences.zh: 他們在義大利的一座鄉間莊園度蜜月。

sentences.en: The old estate has a huge garden and a lake.
sentences.zh: 那座老莊園有一個大花園和一座湖。

sentences.en: Who will inherit the family's estate?
sentences.zh: 誰會繼承這個家族的遺產？

sentences.en: He left his entire estate to his two daughters.
sentences.zh: 他把全部遺產留給了兩個女兒。

sentences.en: How big is the estate your grandparents lived on?
sentences.zh: 你祖父母住的那座莊園有多大？

sentences.en: A lawyer is helping the family settle the estate.
sentences.zh: 一位律師正在協助家人處理遺產。

sentences.en: They promised each other eternal friendship.
sentences.zh: 他們互相許下永恆的友誼。

sentences.en: Do you believe in eternal love?
sentences.zh: 你相信永恆的愛嗎？

sentences.en: The poem is about the eternal beauty of nature.
sentences.zh: 這首詩談的是大自然永恆的美。

sentences.en: It felt like the wait at the airport was eternal.
sentences.zh: 在機場等待的那段時間感覺永無止境。

sentences.en: Is anything in this world truly eternal?
sentences.zh: 這個世界上有什麼東西真的是永恆的嗎？

sentences.en: The museum displays art that explores eternal questions about life.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出探討生命永恆課題的藝術品。

gloss_note: 多指玉米等製成的燃料酒精

sentences.en: Most gas in this state contains ten percent ethanol.
sentences.zh: 這個州的大多數汽油含有百分之十的乙醇。

sentences.en: The company plans to build a new ethanol plant in the Midwest.
sentences.zh: 這家公司計畫在中西部興建一座新的乙醇工廠。

sentences.en: How much does it cost to produce a gallon of ethanol?
sentences.zh: 生產一加侖的乙醇要花多少錢？

sentences.en: Corn prices affect the cost of making ethanol.
sentences.zh: 玉米價格會影響製造乙醇的成本。

sentences.en: Is ethanol really better for the environment than regular gasoline?
sentences.zh: 乙醇真的比一般汽油更環保嗎？

sentences.en: Our investors are interested in ethanol and other renewable fuels.
sentences.zh: 我們的投資人對乙醇和其他再生燃料有興趣。

gloss_note: work ethic 工作倫理；ethics 多用複數

sentences.en: She has a strong work ethic and never misses a deadline.
sentences.zh: 她的工作倫理很強，從不錯過截止期限。

sentences.en: Does your company have a clear code of ethics?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有明確的道德規範嗎？

sentences.en: Students in my ethics class discuss real-life dilemmas.
sentences.zh: 我的倫理學課上，學生會討論現實生活中的兩難問題。

sentences.en: I admire his work ethic; he's always the first one in.
sentences.zh: 我很佩服他的工作倫理，他總是第一個到。

sentences.en: Is it a question of ethics, or just company policy?
sentences.zh: 這是道德問題，還是只是公司政策？

sentences.en: The reporter lost his job for breaking basic journalism ethics.
sentences.zh: 那位記者因違反基本的新聞倫理而丟了工作。

gloss_note: evacuate a building 疏散大樓

sentences.en: Everyone must evacuate the building when the alarm sounds.
sentences.zh: 警報響起時，所有人都必須撤離大樓。

sentences.en: The hotel staff evacuated the guests within ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工在十分鐘內疏散了所有房客。

sentences.en: Do you know where to go if we have to evacuate?
sentences.zh: 如果我們得撤離，你知道要去哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: Residents were told to evacuate before the storm hit.
sentences.zh: 居民被告知要在暴風雨來襲前撤離。

sentences.en: How quickly can the theater evacuate a full audience?
sentences.zh: 戲院要多快才能疏散坐滿的觀眾？

sentences.en: The school practices how to evacuate during fire drills.
sentences.zh: 學校會在消防演習中練習如何疏散。

sentences.en: The workload should be divided evenly among the team members.
sentences.zh: 工作量應該平均分配給團隊成員。

sentences.en: Could you split the bill evenly among the four of us?
sentences.zh: 帳單可以由我們四個人平分嗎？

sentences.en: Make sure the paint covers the wall evenly.
sentences.zh: 要確保油漆均勻地塗滿整面牆。

sentences.en: Sales were spread evenly across all four quarters.
sentences.zh: 銷售額均勻分布在四個季度。

sentences.en: Are the tasks shared evenly between the two departments?
sentences.zh: 這些任務有平均分配給兩個部門嗎？

sentences.en: The boxes are packed evenly so they won't tip over.
sentences.zh: 這些箱子裝得很平均，才不會翻倒。

sentences.en: We learned about the evolution of birds in biology class.
sentences.zh: 我們在生物課學到鳥類的演化。

sentences.en: The evolution of the smartphone has been amazing.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機的演變令人驚嘆。

sentences.en: How did the evolution of language begin?
sentences.zh: 語言的演化是怎麼開始的？

sentences.en: Can you describe the evolution of our company's logo?
sentences.zh: 你能說明一下我們公司標誌的演變嗎？

sentences.en: Fashion goes through constant evolution every year.
sentences.zh: 時尚每年都在不斷演變。

sentences.en: The documentary traces the evolution of jazz over a century.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片追溯了爵士樂一百年來的演變。

sentences.en: Animals evolve to survive in their environment.
sentences.zh: 動物會演化以適應環境。

sentences.en: Our team's strategy has evolved a lot since last year.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊的策略自去年以來已有很大的演變。

sentences.en: How did this tiny shop evolve into a big chain?
sentences.zh: 這家小店是怎麼發展成大型連鎖店的？

sentences.en: Do you think technology will evolve even faster in the next decade?
sentences.zh: 你覺得科技在未來十年會發展得更快嗎？

sentences.en: Her interests evolved as she got older.
sentences.zh: 隨著年紀增長，她的興趣也逐漸改變。

sentences.en: The story evolves into something much darker in the second season.
sentences.zh: 這個故事在第二季演變得黑暗許多。

sentences.en: Saying he's the best player ever is a bit of an exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 說他是史上最強球員有點誇張。

sentences.en: Is it an exaggeration to say the line took two hours?
sentences.zh: 說排隊花了兩個小時，算誇張嗎？

sentences.en: That's not an exaggeration; the food was really that bad.
sentences.zh: 這一點也不誇張，食物真的就是那麼難吃。

sentences.en: The ad's claims were a clear exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告的說法明顯是誇大。

sentences.en: Without exaggeration, it was the best trip of my life.
sentences.zh: 毫不誇張地說，那是我這輩子最棒的旅行。

sentences.en: Was his story true, or just an exaggeration?
sentences.zh: 他說的是真的，還是只是誇大？

gloss_note: exceed the limit 超過限制

sentences.en: Costs must not exceed the budget we approved.
sentences.zh: 成本不能超過我們核准的預算。

sentences.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit may get a ticket.
sentences.zh: 超速的駕駛可能會被開罰單。

sentences.en: Did the final bill exceed what the hotel quoted?
sentences.zh: 最後的帳單有超過飯店報的價錢嗎？

sentences.en: Sales exceeded our expectations this quarter.
sentences.zh: 本季銷售額超出我們的預期。

sentences.en: Does your carry-on bag exceed the weight limit?
sentences.zh: 你的隨身行李有超過重量限制嗎？

sentences.en: The temperature exceeded ninety degrees all week.
sentences.zh: 整個星期的氣溫都超過華氏九十度。

sentences.en: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed.
sentences.zh: 「多美的景色啊！」她驚呼道。

sentences.en: The kids exclaimed with joy when they saw the snow.
sentences.zh: 孩子們看到雪時開心地大叫。

sentences.en: Why did he exclaim like that when he opened the envelope?
sentences.zh: 他打開信封時，為什麼那樣驚呼？

sentences.en: "We won!" the coach exclaimed, hugging the players.
sentences.zh: 「我們贏了！」教練喊道，一邊擁抱著球員。

sentences.en: Did anyone exclaim in surprise when the lights went out?
sentences.zh: 燈熄滅的時候，有人驚呼出聲嗎？

sentences.en: Customers exclaimed that the prices were surprisingly low.
sentences.zh: 顧客驚呼價格低得出乎意料。

gloss_note: price excludes tax 價格不含稅

sentences.en: Does the price exclude tax and shipping?
sentences.zh: 這個價格不含稅和運費嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't exclude anyone from the group chat.
sentences.zh: 請不要把任何人排除在群組聊天之外。

sentences.en: The survey excludes people under eighteen.
sentences.zh: 這份調查不包含十八歲以下的人。

sentences.en: Why did they exclude him from the team photo?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼把他排除在團體照之外？

sentences.en: The warranty excludes damage caused by water.
sentences.zh: 保固不涵蓋因進水造成的損壞。

sentences.en: I try to exclude sugar from my diet.
sentences.zh: 我盡量讓飲食中不含糖。

gloss_note: executive team 高階管理團隊

sentences.en: She became a senior executive at the age of thirty-five.
sentences.zh: 她三十五歲就成為高階主管。

sentences.en: The executive team meets every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 高階管理團隊每週一早上開會。

sentences.en: Is the new executive in charge of marketing?
sentences.zh: 新來的主管負責行銷嗎？

sentences.en: Our executive assistant booked the flights for the trip.
sentences.zh: 我們的行政助理訂好了這趟旅程的機票。

sentences.en: Which executive approved this project?
sentences.zh: 哪位主管核准了這個計畫？

sentences.en: Several executives from the company attended the conference.
sentences.zh: 公司有幾位高階主管出席了研討會。

sentences.en: Big retailers exert a lot of pressure on small suppliers.
sentences.zh: 大型零售商對小型供應商施加很大的壓力。

sentences.en: She exerts a strong influence on the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她對整個團隊有很大的影響力。

sentences.en: How much effort should I exert on this one task?
sentences.zh: 這件事我該花多少力氣？

sentences.en: Don't exert yourself too much on your first day at the gym.
sentences.zh: 第一天去健身房，別太賣力過頭。

sentences.en: Gravity exerts a force on every object on Earth.
sentences.zh: 重力會對地球上的每個物體施加一股力量。

sentences.en: Can a small shareholder exert any influence on big decisions?
sentences.zh: 小股東對重大決策能發揮任何影響力嗎？

gloss_note: life expectancy 預期壽命（人或設備）

sentences.en: Life expectancy has risen steadily over the past century.
sentences.zh: 過去一個世紀以來，預期壽命穩定上升。

sentences.en: Insurance companies use life expectancy to set their rates.
sentences.zh: 保險公司用預期壽命來訂定費率。

sentences.en: What is the average life expectancy of this machine?
sentences.zh: 這台機器的平均預期使用壽命是多久？

sentences.en: Does a healthy lifestyle really increase life expectancy?
sentences.zh: 健康的生活方式真的能延長預期壽命嗎？

sentences.en: The retirement plan assumes a life expectancy of ninety years.
sentences.zh: 這個退休計畫假設預期壽命為九十歲。

sentences.en: Life expectancy differs a lot from one country to another.
sentences.zh: 預期壽命在各國之間差異很大。

gloss_note: expedite an order 加快處理訂單

sentences.en: Can you expedite my refund request, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你加快處理我的退款申請嗎？

sentences.en: We paid extra to expedite the shipment.
sentences.zh: 我們多付了錢，好加快這批貨的出貨。

sentences.en: The manager promised to expedite the approval process.
sentences.zh: 經理答應加快核准流程。

sentences.en: Is there any way to expedite the visa application?
sentences.zh: 有沒有辦法加快簽證申請？

sentences.en: A new system will expedite orders during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 新系統會在年底旺季加快訂單處理。

sentences.en: Please expedite this invoice since the vendor is waiting.
sentences.zh: 供應商在等，請加緊處理這張請款單。

gloss_note: go on an expedition 去探險

sentences.en: A team of scientists left on an expedition to Antarctica.
sentences.zh: 一組科學家出發前往南極探險。

sentences.en: Have you ever joined an expedition into the jungle?
sentences.zh: 你曾參加過叢林探險嗎？

sentences.en: The expedition took two months and cost a fortune.
sentences.zh: 這趟探險花了兩個月，也花了一大筆錢。

sentences.en: He wrote a book about his expedition across the desert.
sentences.zh: 他寫了一本書，記錄他橫越沙漠的探險。

sentences.en: What supplies do you need for a month-long expedition?
sentences.zh: 一趟為期一個月的探險需要帶哪些物資？

sentences.en: The documentary follows a deep-sea expedition off the coast.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片追蹤一趟近海的深海探險。

gloss_note: ask for an extension 申請延期

sentences.en: Could I get an extension on the essay deadline?
sentences.zh: 我的報告繳交期限可以延期嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher gave us a two-day extension.
sentences.zh: 老師讓我們延期兩天。

sentences.en: We applied for an extension of our lease.
sentences.zh: 我們申請了租約展延。

sentences.en: Did the company approve the extension of the project?
sentences.zh: 公司核准這個計畫的延期了嗎？

sentences.en: The extension on my visa lets me stay three more months.
sentences.zh: 簽證延期讓我可以多待三個月。

sentences.en: The city announced an extension of library hours during finals.
sentences.zh: 市政府宣布期末考期間延長圖書館的開放時間。

gloss_note: extensive menu 菜色種類繁多

sentences.en: The restaurant has an extensive menu with over a hundred dishes.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的菜單種類繁多，有一百多道菜。

sentences.en: She has extensive experience in customer service.
sentences.zh: 她在客戶服務方面有廣泛的經驗。

sentences.en: Is the wine list as extensive as the food menu?
sentences.zh: 酒單和菜單一樣種類繁多嗎？

sentences.en: The storm caused extensive damage along the coast.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨在沿海地區造成大範圍的損害。

sentences.en: Did you do extensive research before buying the car?
sentences.zh: 你買車之前有做過大量研究嗎？

sentences.en: The school conducted an extensive survey of student lunch habits.
sentences.zh: 學校針對學生的午餐習慣做了大規模調查。

sentences.en: The exterior of the house needs a new coat of paint.
sentences.zh: 這棟房子的外觀需要重新上漆。

sentences.en: Do you like the exterior design of this car?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡這輛車的外觀設計嗎？

sentences.en: Use exterior paint on the fence so it lasts longer.
sentences.zh: 圍欄要用室外專用漆，才會比較耐用。

sentences.en: The building's exterior walls are made of brick.
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓的外牆是用磚砌成的。

sentences.en: What color should we paint the exterior?
sentences.zh: 外牆要漆什麼顏色？

sentences.en: He looks tough on the exterior, but he's really very kind.
sentences.zh: 他外表看起來很兇，其實人很好。

sentences.en: I bought an external hard drive to back up my photos.
sentences.zh: 我買了一顆外接硬碟來備份照片。

sentences.en: Are external factors hurting our sales?
sentences.zh: 外部因素有影響到我們的銷售嗎？

sentences.en: The company hired an external auditor this year.
sentences.zh: 公司今年聘請了外部稽核人員。

sentences.en: This job is open to both internal and external candidates.
sentences.zh: 這個職缺同時開放給內部和外部的應徵者。

sentences.en: Can I plug an external monitor into this laptop?
sentences.zh: 我可以把外接螢幕接到這台筆電上嗎？

sentences.en: External pressure from customers forced the store to change its policy.
sentences.zh: 來自顧客的外部壓力，迫使這家店改變政策。

gloss_note: 經濟學：成本或好處外溢給第三方

sentences.en: Pollution is a classic negative externality of manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 汙染是製造業典型的負面外部效應。

sentences.en: A well-kept park creates a positive externality for local shops.
sentences.zh: 維護良好的公園為周邊商店帶來正面的外部效應。

sentences.en: Does traffic congestion count as an externality?
sentences.zh: 交通壅塞算是外部效應嗎？

sentences.en: Companies rarely pay for the externalities they create.
sentences.zh: 企業很少為自己造成的外部效應買單。

sentences.en: How can the government put a price on an externality like carbon emissions?
sentences.zh: 政府要如何為碳排放這類外部效應定價？

sentences.en: Our analyst explained the externality in simple terms.
sentences.zh: 我們的分析師用簡單易懂的話解釋了外部效應。

sentences.en: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
sentences.zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前絕種了。

sentences.en: Many animals will go extinct if we destroy their habitat.
sentences.zh: 如果我們破壞棲地，許多動物將會絕種。

sentences.en: Is that bird species already extinct?
sentences.zh: 那種鳥類已經絕種了嗎？

sentences.en: Some old traditions are almost extinct in big cities.
sentences.zh: 有些老傳統在大城市幾乎消失了。

sentences.en: Why did the woolly mammoth go extinct?
sentences.zh: 長毛象為什麼會絕種？

sentences.en: Video rental stores are nearly extinct these days.
sentences.zh: 影片出租店現在幾乎絕跡了。

sentences.en: Where is the nearest fire extinguisher?
sentences.zh: 最近的滅火器在哪裡？

sentences.en: Every floor must have a fire extinguisher by the stairs.
sentences.zh: 每一層樓的樓梯旁都必須放一支滅火器。

sentences.en: Someone checks the extinguishers in our building every month.
sentences.zh: 有人每個月檢查我們大樓裡的滅火器。

sentences.en: I keep a small extinguisher in the kitchen just in case.
sentences.zh: 我在廚房放了一支小滅火器以防萬一。

sentences.en: Do you know how to use a fire extinguisher?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼使用滅火器嗎？

sentences.en: The inspector said the extinguisher had expired.
sentences.zh: 檢查員說那支滅火器已經過期了。

sentences.en: She has an extraordinary talent for painting.
sentences.zh: 她有非凡的繪畫天分。

sentences.en: The chef prepared an extraordinary dinner for us.
sentences.zh: 主廚為我們準備了一頓非凡的晚餐。

sentences.en: Was it an extraordinary game, or just a lucky win?
sentences.zh: 那是一場非凡的比賽，還是只是運氣好贏的？

sentences.en: The team made an extraordinary effort to finish on time.
sentences.zh: 團隊付出了非凡的努力，準時完成。

sentences.en: Has anything extraordinary happened at work lately?
sentences.zh: 最近工作上有發生什麼特別的事嗎？

sentences.en: It takes extraordinary courage to speak up in front of a crowd.
sentences.zh: 在大批群眾面前發言需要非凡的勇氣。

sentences.en: The news report warned about extremists spreading false claims online.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導警告有極端分子在網路上散播假消息。

sentences.en: Why do a few extremists often get most of the attention online?
sentences.zh: 為什麼少數極端分子常常得到最多的網路關注？

sentences.en: Our moderation team removes posts written by extremists.
sentences.zh: 我們的管理團隊會移除極端分子發表的貼文。

sentences.en: Is he an extremist, or just very passionate about recycling?
sentences.zh: 他是偏激的人，還是只是對資源回收很熱衷？

sentences.en: A small group of extremists disrupted the town festival.
sentences.zh: 一小群極端分子擾亂了鎮上的慶典活動。

sentences.en: Some diet extremists refuse to eat anything with sugar.
sentences.zh: 有些飲食很極端的人，連含糖的東西都不肯吃。

sentences.en: You look fabulous in that jacket!
sentences.zh: 你穿那件外套好好看！

sentences.en: We had a fabulous time at the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海灘玩得超開心。

sentences.en: Did you try the fabulous cheesecake at that bakery?
sentences.zh: 你吃過那家烘焙坊超讚的起司蛋糕了嗎？

sentences.en: What a fabulous idea for the party!
sentences.zh: 這個派對的點子太棒了！

sentences.en: Is the new hotel as fabulous as it looks in the photos?
sentences.zh: 這間新飯店真的跟照片裡一樣漂亮嗎？

sentences.en: The singer gave a fabulous performance last night.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手昨晚的表演精采絕倫。

gloss_note: facet of a problem 問題的某一面

sentences.en: Cost is only one facet of the problem.
sentences.zh: 成本只是這個問題的其中一個層面。

sentences.en: This study looks at another facet of teenage behavior.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討青少年行為的另一個面向。

sentences.en: Which facet of the city's history interests you most?
sentences.zh: 這座城市歷史的哪個面向最讓你感興趣？

sentences.en: Every facet of daily life has been changed by technology.
sentences.zh: 日常生活的每個層面都被科技改變了。

sentences.en: Can we discuss each facet of the plan one by one?
sentences.zh: 我們可以逐一討論這項計畫的每個層面嗎？

sentences.en: Her job has many facets, from writing to training new staff.
sentences.zh: 她的工作有很多面向，從寫作到訓練新員工都有。

sentences.en: The researchers used a factorial design to test two variables at once.
sentences.zh: 研究人員採用因子設計，同時測試兩個變數。

sentences.en: What is the advantage of a factorial experiment over a simple one?
sentences.zh: 因子實驗比單純的實驗有什麼優點？

sentences.en: Our professor asked us to use a factorial design in our experiment.
sentences.zh: 我們教授要求我們的實驗採用因子設計。

sentences.en: Is a factorial study the best way to compare these two teaching methods?
sentences.zh: 因子研究是比較這兩種教學方法的最佳方式嗎？

sentences.en: In a factorial trial, each factor is tested at several levels.
sentences.zh: 在因子試驗中，每個因子都會用幾個水準來測試。

sentences.en: My thesis compares the results of two factorial experiments.
sentences.zh: 我的論文比較了兩個因子實驗的結果。

gloss_note: fairness in hiring 招聘的公平性

sentences.en: Employees care a lot about fairness in pay.
sentences.zh: 員工非常在意薪資的公平性。

sentences.en: How can we ensure fairness in the hiring process?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何確保招聘過程的公平？

sentences.en: The manager treats everyone with fairness and respect.
sentences.zh: 經理公平且尊重地對待每一個人。

sentences.en: Customers questioned the fairness of the new fee.
sentences.zh: 顧客質疑這項新收費是否公平。

sentences.en: Is fairness more important than speed in a review process?
sentences.zh: 在審核過程中，公平比速度更重要嗎？

sentences.en: Fairness matters when you split bonuses among team members.
sentences.zh: 在團隊成員之間分配獎金時，公平很重要。

sentences.en: Familiarity with spreadsheet software is required for this job.
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要熟悉試算表軟體。

sentences.en: Do you have much familiarity with our products?
sentences.zh: 你對我們的產品很熟悉嗎？

sentences.en: Her familiarity with the city made the trip easy.
sentences.zh: 她對這座城市很熟悉，讓這趟旅程輕鬆許多。

sentences.en: Do you have any familiarity with this type of contract?
sentences.zh: 你對這類合約有任何了解嗎？

sentences.en: Familiarity with the neighborhood helped me find a good apartment.
sentences.zh: 熟悉這個社區，幫我找到了不錯的公寓。

sentences.en: There was a strange familiarity about the old hotel lobby.
sentences.zh: 那間舊飯店的大廳有種奇妙的熟悉感。

sentences.en: Space has always fascinated me.
sentences.zh: 太空一直讓我很著迷。

sentences.en: What fascinates you most about ancient history?
sentences.zh: 古代史最吸引你的地方是什麼？

sentences.en: The magic show fascinated the children for an hour.
sentences.zh: 魔術表演讓孩子們著迷了一個小時。

sentences.en: I'm fascinated by how birds find their way home.
sentences.zh: 我對鳥類如何找到回家的路深深著迷。

sentences.en: Do these old maps fascinate you as much as they do me?
sentences.zh: 這些老地圖也像吸引我一樣吸引你嗎？

sentences.en: Her stories about traveling alone fascinate everyone at work.
sentences.zh: 她獨自旅行的故事讓公司的每個人都聽得入迷。

sentences.en: Driver fatigue causes many accidents on long highways.
sentences.zh: 駕駛疲勞是長途公路上許多事故的原因。

sentences.en: I felt fatigue setting in after the long flight.
sentences.zh: 搭完長途班機後，我覺得疲倦感漸漸湧上來。

sentences.en: Do you often feel fatigue in the afternoon?
sentences.zh: 你下午常常覺得疲倦嗎？

sentences.en: The study links poor sleep to chronic fatigue.
sentences.zh: 這項研究把睡眠不足和慢性疲勞連在一起。

sentences.en: What are the common causes of fatigue among office workers?
sentences.zh: 上班族疲勞的常見原因有哪些？

sentences.en: Fatigue made it hard for her to focus during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 疲勞讓她在會議中很難專心。

sentences.en: Is Monday a federal holiday this year?
sentences.zh: 今年的週一是聯邦假日嗎？

sentences.en: Federal taxes are due in April.
sentences.zh: 聯邦稅款要在四月繳交。

sentences.en: She works for a federal agency in Washington.
sentences.zh: 她在華盛頓的一個聯邦機構工作。

sentences.en: The bank is regulated by federal law.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行受聯邦法律規範。

sentences.en: Do federal employees get extra days off in December?
sentences.zh: 聯邦公務員十二月有額外的休假嗎？

sentences.en: The federal court postponed the hearing until next week.
sentences.zh: 聯邦法院把聽證會延到下週。

gloss_note: 希臘羊奶起司，鹹、易碎，常配沙拉

sentences.en: Can I get extra feta on my Greek salad?
sentences.zh: 我的希臘沙拉可以多加一點菲達起司嗎？

sentences.en: She crumbled feta over the roasted vegetables.
sentences.zh: 她把菲達起司捏碎，撒在烤蔬菜上。

sentences.en: Feta tastes salty and a little sour.
sentences.zh: 菲達起司吃起來又鹹又帶點酸。

sentences.en: Do you want spinach and feta in your omelet?
sentences.zh: 你的歐姆蛋要加菠菜和菲達起司嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a block of feta at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我們在農夫市集買了一塊菲達起司。

sentences.en: The pastry is filled with spinach and feta.
sentences.zh: 這個酥皮點心裡包了菠菜和菲達起司。

sentences.en: A financial advisor has a fiduciary duty to put clients first.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問有受託責任，必須把客戶放在第一位。

sentences.en: As a fiduciary, she must manage the trust fund honestly.
sentences.zh: 身為受託人，她必須誠實管理這筆信託基金。

sentences.en: Is your investment advisor a fiduciary?
sentences.zh: 你的投資顧問是受託人嗎？

sentences.en: Board members owe a fiduciary responsibility to the shareholders.
sentences.zh: 董事對股東負有受託責任。

sentences.en: Does the fiduciary have to report to the court every year?
sentences.zh: 受託人每年都必須向法院報告嗎？

sentences.en: The bank acts as a fiduciary for many retirement accounts.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行是許多退休帳戶的受託人。

sentences.en: Please replace the water filter every six months.
sentences.zh: 請每六個月更換一次濾水器。

sentences.en: My email filter keeps sending important messages to the spam folder.
sentences.zh: 我的郵件過濾器老是把重要信件丟進垃圾郵件匣。

sentences.en: Can you filter out the old customers from this list?
sentences.zh: 你可以把舊客戶從這份名單中篩掉嗎？

sentences.en: We need a new coffee filter for the machine.
sentences.zh: 咖啡機需要換新的濾紙。

sentences.en: Does this pitcher filter chlorine out of the water?
sentences.zh: 這個水壺能把水裡的氯濾掉嗎？

sentences.en: The mask filters out most of the dust in the air.
sentences.zh: 這個口罩可以濾掉空氣中大部分的灰塵。

sentences.en: A fish uses its fins to steer through the water.
sentences.zh: 魚用魚鰭在水中轉向。

sentences.en: What is the fin on a shark's back used for?
sentences.zh: 鯊魚背上的鰭是做什麼用的？

sentences.en: The aquarium guide pointed to a fish with a bright orange fin.
sentences.zh: 水族館導覽員指著一條有鮮橘色魚鰭的魚。

sentences.en: Did you see the fin sticking out of the water?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那片從水面冒出來的魚鰭嗎？

sentences.en: This fish lost part of its fin in a fishing net.
sentences.zh: 這條魚的一部分魚鰭在漁網裡弄斷了。

sentences.en: Scientists measured the length of each fin on the fish.
sentences.zh: 科學家測量了這條魚每一片鰭的長度。

sentences.en: Our company offers flextime, so I start work at ten.
sentences.zh: 我們公司有彈性工時，所以我十點才上班。

sentences.en: Do you work flextime or a regular schedule?
sentences.zh: 你是彈性工時，還是固定班表？

sentences.en: Flextime helps parents pick up their kids from school.
sentences.zh: 彈性工時能讓家長去學校接小孩。

sentences.en: Is flextime available for new employees?
sentences.zh: 新進員工可以申請彈性工時嗎？

sentences.en: She asked her boss about switching to flextime.
sentences.zh: 她問老闆能不能改成彈性工時。

sentences.en: Many workers prefer flextime to a strict nine-to-five job.
sentences.zh: 許多員工比較喜歡彈性工時，而不是嚴格的朝九晚五。

sentences.en: Can you flip the pancakes before they burn?
sentences.zh: 你可以在鬆餅燒焦前把它們翻面嗎？

sentences.en: Let's flip a coin to decide who pays.
sentences.zh: 我們擲硬幣來決定誰付錢吧。

sentences.en: Be careful, or the canoe will flip over.
sentences.zh: 小心，不然獨木舟會翻過去。

sentences.en: Did you flip the mattress like the manual says?
sentences.zh: 你有照說明書把床墊翻面嗎？

sentences.en: Please flip the card over and read the back.
sentences.zh: 請把卡片翻過來，看一下背面。

sentences.en: Strong winds flipped the food truck's sign upside down.
sentences.zh: 強風把餐車的招牌吹得整個翻過來。

gloss_note: 偏英式；美式多說 IPO、go public

sentences.en: The company announced its flotation on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 公司在週一早上宣布股票上市。

sentences.en: When is the flotation of the software firm planned?
sentences.zh: 這家軟體公司預計什麼時候上市？

sentences.en: Will the flotation raise enough money for new factories?
sentences.zh: 這次上市募到的資金夠蓋新工廠嗎？

sentences.en: My broker called about the flotation of a small bank.
sentences.zh: 我的經紀人打電話來談一家小銀行的上市。

sentences.en: After the flotation last spring, the founder became very rich.
sentences.zh: 去年春天上市之後，創辦人變得非常有錢。

sentences.en: How did the flotation change life for the staff?
sentences.zh: 上市對員工的生活帶來了什麼改變？

sentences.en: Small businesses flourish when taxes stay low.
sentences.zh: 稅負維持低檔時，小型企業就會蓬勃發展。

sentences.en: Will our online shop still flourish after the sale ends?
sentences.zh: 特賣結束後，我們的網路商店還能興旺嗎？

sentences.en: The coffee shop began to flourish after it added lunch.
sentences.zh: 咖啡店加了午餐之後開始興旺起來。

sentences.en: Which industries are likely to flourish in the next decade?
sentences.zh: 哪些產業在未來十年有可能蓬勃發展？

sentences.en: Her catering business has flourished since she moved downtown.
sentences.zh: 她搬到市中心後，外燴生意一直很興旺。

sentences.en: Our team can flourish if managers give us more freedom.
sentences.zh: 如果主管給我們更多自由，我們的團隊就能蓬勃發展。

gloss_note: fluency in Spanish 西班牙文流利

sentences.en: Her fluency in Spanish helped her get the job.
sentences.zh: 她流利的西班牙文幫她得到了這份工作。

sentences.en: How can I improve my fluency in English?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼提升自己的英文流利度？
