sentences.en: Fluency matters more than perfect grammar in daily talk.
sentences.zh: 日常對話中，流利比文法完美更重要。

sentences.en: Do you need fluency in Chinese for this position?
sentences.zh: 這個職位需要流利的中文嗎？

sentences.en: He speaks with surprising fluency after only one year.
sentences.zh: 他才學了一年，說話就出乎意料地流利。

sentences.en: The teacher praised the fluency of my reading.
sentences.zh: 老師稱讚我朗讀得很流暢。

sentences.en: Please check the footnote at the bottom of page five.
sentences.zh: 請看第五頁下方的註腳。

sentences.en: Where is the footnote that explains this number?
sentences.zh: 解釋這個數字的註腳在哪裡？

sentences.en: The author added a footnote to explain the old word.
sentences.zh: 作者加了一則註腳來解釋這個古字。

sentences.en: Did you read the footnote under the chart?
sentences.zh: 你有看圖表下面的註腳嗎？

sentences.en: Each footnote must include the source of the idea.
sentences.zh: 每則註腳都必須註明這個想法的出處。

sentences.en: The tiny footnote said the offer ended in May.
sentences.zh: 那行小小的註腳寫著優惠在五月結束。

gloss_note: economic forecaster 經濟預測專家

sentences.en: Most forecasters expect sales to rise next quarter.
sentences.zh: 大多數預測專家預期下一季的銷售會成長。

sentences.en: The economic forecaster warned that prices could climb.
sentences.zh: 經濟預測專家警告物價可能會上漲。

sentences.en: Is our sales forecaster using last year's numbers?
sentences.zh: 我們的銷售預測專家用的是去年的數字嗎？

sentences.en: Which forecaster predicted the drop in oil prices?
sentences.zh: 哪位預測專家預測到了油價下跌？

sentences.en: Forecasters at the bank lowered their growth estimate.
sentences.zh: 銀行的預測專家調降了他們的成長預估。

sentences.en: My uncle works as a forecaster for a shipping company.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在一家貨運公司擔任預測專家。

sentences.en: What format should I use for the report?
sentences.zh: 這份報告我該用什麼格式？

sentences.en: Please save the file in a different format.
sentences.zh: 請把檔案存成別的格式。

sentences.en: Do I need to format this flash drive first?
sentences.zh: 我需要先把這個隨身碟格式化嗎？

sentences.en: The format of the test changed this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的考試格式改了。

sentences.en: The professor wants all essays in the same format.
sentences.zh: 教授要求所有論文都用同樣的格式。

sentences.en: Can you format the table so it fits one page?
sentences.zh: 你可以調整表格格式，讓它剛好一頁嗎？

sentences.en: Fortunately, the rain stopped before the outdoor event began.
sentences.zh: 幸好雨在戶外活動開始前就停了。

sentences.en: Fortunately, my suitcase arrived. Did yours make it too?
sentences.zh: 幸好我的行李箱到了。你的也到了嗎？

sentences.en: We left late, but fortunately, traffic was light.
sentences.zh: 我們很晚才出發，但幸好路上車不多。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the printer was fixed. Can you print these now?
sentences.zh: 幸好印表機修好了。你現在可以印這些嗎？

sentences.en: Fortunately for us, the hotel had one room left.
sentences.zh: 對我們來說幸運的是，飯店還剩一間房。

sentences.en: The storm was bad, but fortunately, the power stayed on.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨很大，但幸好沒有停電。

gloss_note: foul smell 臭味；foul mood 壞心情

sentences.en: What is that foul smell coming from the fridge?
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡傳出來的那股臭味是什麼？

sentences.en: The foul weather forced us to cancel the picnic.
sentences.zh: 惡劣的天氣害我們不得不取消野餐。

sentences.en: He has been in a foul mood all morning.
sentences.zh: 他一整個早上心情都很差。

sentences.en: Why does the water from this old pipe taste so foul?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這條舊水管流出來的水這麼難喝？

sentences.en: The foul air in the basement made me cough.
sentences.zh: 地下室難聞的空氣讓我咳了起來。

sentences.en: Do you smell something foul in the hallway?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有聞到走廊有股臭味？

gloss_note: a fracture of the arm 手臂骨折

sentences.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his wrist.
sentences.zh: X光顯示他的手腕有一處輕微骨折。

sentences.en: How long does a leg fracture take to heal?
sentences.zh: 腿部骨折要多久才會好？

sentences.en: She suffered a hip fracture when she slipped on ice.
sentences.zh: 她在冰上滑倒，造成髖部骨折。

sentences.en: Can a doctor tell if it's a fracture without a scan?
sentences.zh: 醫生不做掃描也能判斷是不是骨折嗎？

sentences.en: A thin fracture in the glass worried the engineers.
sentences.zh: 玻璃上的一道細裂痕讓工程師很擔心。

sentences.en: The study looked at fracture rates among older adults.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討了老年人的骨折發生率。

sentences.en: Be careful not to step on the glass fragments.
sentences.zh: 小心別踩到玻璃碎片。

sentences.en: Can you pick up the fragments of that plate?
sentences.zh: 你可以把那個盤子的碎片撿起來嗎？

sentences.en: I only heard a fragment of their conversation.
sentences.zh: 我只聽到他們談話的片段。

sentences.en: Archaeologists found a fragment of an ancient bowl.
sentences.zh: 考古學家發現了一塊古代碗的碎片。

sentences.en: She remembered only a fragment of the dream.
sentences.zh: 她只記得夢裡的一小段。

sentences.en: Is this fragment of text part of the original letter?
sentences.zh: 這段文字是原本那封信的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: We need a clear framework for the new project.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為新計畫建立清楚的架構。

sentences.en: Does this framework apply to small companies too?
sentences.zh: 這個架構也適用於小公司嗎？

sentences.en: The city created a legal framework for ride sharing.
sentences.zh: 市政府為共乘服務訂立了法律框架。

sentences.en: Our teacher gave us a framework for writing essays.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們一個寫作文的架構。

sentences.en: Can you explain the framework behind your plan?
sentences.zh: 你可以說明一下你這項計畫背後的架構嗎？

sentences.en: The report offers a framework for understanding poverty.
sentences.zh: 這份報告提供了一個理解貧窮問題的框架。

sentences.en: The Swiss franc is a very stable currency.
sentences.zh: 瑞士法郎是非常穩定的貨幣。

sentences.en: How many francs did the hotel charge per night?
sentences.zh: 那間飯店一晚收多少法郎？

sentences.en: I paid fifty francs for the train ticket in Zurich.
sentences.zh: 我在蘇黎世買火車票花了五十法郎。

sentences.en: Do you take euros, or only Swiss francs?
sentences.zh: 你們收歐元，還是只收瑞士法郎？

sentences.en: The exporter was worried about the rising franc.
sentences.zh: 出口商很擔心法郎持續升值。

sentences.en: She exchanged her dollars for francs at the airport.
sentences.zh: 她在機場把美金換成了法郎。

sentences.en: I found fraudulent charges on my credit card bill.
sentences.zh: 我在信用卡帳單上發現了盜刷的款項。

sentences.en: How did the bank discover the fraudulent claim?
sentences.zh: 銀行是怎麼發現這筆不實申請的？

sentences.en: The film is about a man selling fraudulent paintings.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一個販賣假畫的男人。

sentences.en: Did you report the fraudulent check to your bank?
sentences.zh: 你有向銀行通報那張詐騙支票嗎？

sentences.en: Investigators reviewed hundreds of fraudulent insurance claims.
sentences.zh: 調查人員審查了數百件不實的保險理賠申請。

sentences.en: She was fired for submitting fraudulent receipts.
sentences.zh: 她因為提交不實的收據而被開除。

sentences.en: The freighter arrived at the port early this morning.
sentences.zh: 那艘貨輪今天一早就抵達港口。

sentences.en: How long will the freighter take to cross the ocean?
sentences.zh: 這艘貨輪橫渡海洋要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Workers unloaded steel from the freighter all night.
sentences.zh: 工人整晚都在從貨輪上卸下鋼材。

sentences.en: Is our order on the freighter that left Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 我們訂的貨在週二出發的那艘貨輪上嗎？

sentences.en: The company chartered a freighter to ship its furniture overseas.
sentences.zh: 這家公司包了一艘貨輪，把家具運到海外。

sentences.en: A huge freighter was stuck near the harbor entrance.
sentences.zh: 一艘巨大的貨輪卡在港口入口附近。

sentences.en: Don't fret over small mistakes in the report.
sentences.zh: 別為報告裡的小錯誤發愁了。

sentences.en: Why do you fret about the quarterly numbers?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼擔心每季的數字？

sentences.en: She fretted all night before the big presentation.
sentences.zh: 她在重要簡報前整晚都在煩惱。

sentences.en: Managers often fret over rising costs.
sentences.zh: 主管常常為成本上漲而煩惱。

sentences.en: Is he still fretting about the missed deadline?
sentences.zh: 他還在為錯過截止日期的事煩惱嗎？

sentences.en: There's no need to fret; the client already agreed.
sentences.zh: 不用擔心，客戶已經同意了。

sentences.en: Friction between the two surfaces produces heat.
sentences.zh: 兩個表面之間的摩擦會產生熱。

sentences.en: Is there any friction between you and your roommate?
sentences.zh: 你跟室友之間有什麼摩擦嗎？

sentences.en: Wet floors reduce the friction under our shoes.
sentences.zh: 濕地板會減少鞋底的摩擦力。

sentences.en: Their different working styles caused friction in the team.
sentences.zh: 他們不同的工作方式在團隊裡造成了摩擦。

sentences.en: How can managers reduce friction among coworkers?
sentences.zh: 主管要怎麼減少同事之間的摩擦？

sentences.en: Money often causes friction in families.
sentences.zh: 金錢常常造成家人之間的不和。

sentences.en: The two plans are fundamentally different.
sentences.zh: 這兩項計畫在根本上就不一樣。

sentences.en: Do you think people are fundamentally good?
sentences.zh: 你覺得人本質上是善良的嗎？

sentences.en: The new law fundamentally changed how we work.
sentences.zh: 新法律從根本上改變了我們的工作方式。

sentences.en: Fundamentally, this is a question of trust.
sentences.zh: 基本上，這是信任的問題。

sentences.en: Is the design fundamentally flawed, or just unfinished?
sentences.zh: 這個設計是根本上有缺陷，還是只是還沒完成？

sentences.en: She fundamentally disagrees with the plan.
sentences.zh: 她從根本上不同意這項計畫。

sentences.en: A fungus is growing on the bathroom wall.
sentences.zh: 浴室牆上長了黴菌。

sentences.en: Is this white spot on the bread a fungus?
sentences.zh: 麵包上這個白點是黴菌嗎？

sentences.en: Mushrooms are a kind of fungus, not a plant.
sentences.zh: 蘑菇是一種真菌，不是植物。

sentences.en: The fungus spread quickly in the damp basement.
sentences.zh: 黴菌在潮濕的地下室裡迅速蔓延。

sentences.en: Some types of fungus are used to make cheese.
sentences.zh: 有些種類的真菌被用來製作起司。

sentences.en: How does a fungus get its food?
sentences.zh: 真菌是怎麼取得養分的？

sentences.en: Our galaxy contains billions of stars.
sentences.zh: 我們的銀河系包含了數十億顆恆星。

sentences.en: How many galaxies can we see with this telescope?
sentences.zh: 用這支望遠鏡我們能看到多少個星系？

sentences.en: The teacher showed us a picture of a distant galaxy.
sentences.zh: 老師給我們看了一張遙遠星系的照片。

sentences.en: Is there life in another galaxy?
sentences.zh: 別的星系裡有生命嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists found a new galaxy far from Earth.
sentences.zh: 科學家在離地球很遠的地方發現了一個新星系。

sentences.en: My son loves books about space and the galaxy.
sentences.zh: 我兒子很愛看有關太空和銀河的書。

sentences.en: The crowd gasped when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 燈一熄滅，群眾都倒抽了一口氣。

sentences.en: Why did everyone gasp at the news?
sentences.zh: 大家聽到那個消息為什麼都倒抽一口氣？

sentences.en: She gasped for air after climbing the stairs.
sentences.zh: 她爬完樓梯後喘得上氣不接下氣。

sentences.en: I let out a gasp when I saw the bill.
sentences.zh: 我看到帳單時倒抽了一口氣。

sentences.en: Did you gasp when the magician disappeared?
sentences.zh: 魔術師消失的時候，你有嚇得倒抽一口氣嗎？

sentences.en: He gave a gasp of surprise at the gift.
sentences.zh: 他看到禮物，驚訝地倒抽了一口氣。

sentences.en: The new store should generate more revenue.
sentences.zh: 這家新店應該會創造更多營收。

sentences.en: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板利用陽光發電。

sentences.en: How can we generate new ideas for the campaign?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼為這次活動想出新點子？

sentences.en: This program can generate a report in seconds.
sentences.zh: 這個程式幾秒內就能產生一份報告。

sentences.en: Will the festival generate enough jobs for the town?
sentences.zh: 這個慶典能為小鎮創造足夠的工作機會嗎？

sentences.en: Can a small app generate steady income?
sentences.zh: 一個小型應用程式能帶來穩定的收入嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a generator in case of power outages.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一台發電機，以防停電。

sentences.en: Does the hospital have a backup generator?
sentences.zh: 這家醫院有備用發電機嗎？

sentences.en: The generator ran all night during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間，發電機整晚都在運轉。

sentences.en: Where do you keep the fuel for the generator?
sentences.zh: 你把發電機的燃料放在哪裡？

sentences.en: A small generator powered the lights at the food truck.
sentences.zh: 一台小型發電機供應餐車的燈光用電。

sentences.en: The noisy generator at the site bothered the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 工地那台吵鬧的發電機打擾了鄰居。

sentences.en: Doctors tested her for a genetic disease.
sentences.zh: 醫生替她檢測是否有遺傳疾病。

sentences.en: Is height mostly genetic in your family?
sentences.zh: 在你們家，身高主要是遺傳的嗎？

sentences.en: The lab studies genetic differences between plants.
sentences.zh: 這間實驗室研究植物之間的基因差異。

sentences.en: Genetic tests can show your risk of heart disease.
sentences.zh: 基因檢測可以看出你罹患心臟病的風險。

sentences.en: Is your allergy genetic, or did it start later?
sentences.zh: 你的過敏是遺傳的，還是後來才出現的？

sentences.en: Scientists found a genetic link to the illness.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現這種疾病與基因有關。

sentences.en: Are these tomatoes genetically modified?
sentences.zh: 這些番茄是基因改造的嗎？

sentences.en: The twins are genetically identical.
sentences.zh: 這對雙胞胎的基因完全相同。

sentences.en: Some people are genetically prone to allergies.
sentences.zh: 有些人在遺傳上就容易過敏。

sentences.en: Genetically modified corn grows well in dry soil.
sentences.zh: 基因改造玉米在乾燥的土壤裡長得很好。

sentences.en: Is this trait genetically passed down in families?
sentences.zh: 這種特徵會在家族中遺傳下去嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists genetically modified the mice to study the illness.
sentences.zh: 科學家以基因改造小鼠來研究這種疾病。

sentences.en: What genre of music do you like best?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪種類型的音樂？

sentences.en: Mystery is my favorite genre of books.
sentences.zh: 推理是我最愛的書籍類型。

sentences.en: The store sorts its movies by genre.
sentences.zh: 這家店把電影依類型分類。

sentences.en: Which genre does this new show belong to?
sentences.zh: 這部新節目屬於哪一種類型？

sentences.en: Her songs mix several genres into one style.
sentences.zh: 她的歌把好幾種類型融合成一種風格。

sentences.en: The festival features bands from every genre.
sentences.zh: 這場音樂祭有來自各種類型的樂團。

sentences.en: I genuinely appreciate your help with the budget.
sentences.zh: 我由衷感謝你幫忙處理預算。

sentences.en: Are you genuinely interested in this job?
sentences.zh: 你真的對這份工作有興趣嗎？

sentences.en: The manager was genuinely sorry for the mistake.
sentences.zh: 經理對這個錯誤真心感到抱歉。

sentences.en: Do customers genuinely like the new design?
sentences.zh: 顧客真的喜歡這個新設計嗎？

sentences.en: She genuinely cares about her clients.
sentences.zh: 她真心關心她的客戶。

sentences.en: This is a genuinely good deal. Do you want it?
sentences.zh: 這真的是很划算的交易。你要嗎？

sentences.en: He glared at me when I was late.
sentences.zh: 我遲到的時候，他瞪了我一眼。

sentences.en: Why is she glaring at the waiter?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼瞪著那位服務生？

sentences.en: The boss gave the team a cold glare.
sentences.zh: 老闆冷冷地瞪了團隊一眼。

sentences.en: Don't glare at your sister like that.
sentences.zh: 別那樣瞪你妹妹。

sentences.en: Did the driver glare at you after you honked?
sentences.zh: 你按喇叭之後，那個司機有瞪你嗎？

sentences.en: The student glared at the noisy kids behind him.
sentences.zh: 那個學生瞪著後面吵鬧的孩子們。

sentences.en: Our company sells its products globally.
sentences.zh: 我們公司在全球銷售產品。

sentences.en: Is the problem happening globally or just here?
sentences.zh: 這個問題是全球性的，還是只有這裡有？

sentences.en: Prices are rising globally because of high fuel costs.
sentences.zh: 由於燃料成本很高，全球物價都在上漲。

sentences.en: We want to think globally and act locally.
sentences.zh: 我們想放眼全球，從在地做起。

sentences.en: How many people use this service globally?
sentences.zh: 全球有多少人使用這項服務？

sentences.en: The brand grew globally within five years.
sentences.zh: 這個品牌在五年內擴展到了全球。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: a gloomy day 陰沉的一天

sentences.en: It was a gloomy day, so we stayed home.
sentences.zh: 那天天色陰沉，所以我們待在家裡。

sentences.en: Why is everyone so gloomy this morning?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家今天早上都這麼悶悶不樂？

sentences.en: The movie's gloomy ending made me cry.
sentences.zh: 那部電影沉重的結局讓我哭了。

sentences.en: Do you feel gloomy when it rains all week?
sentences.zh: 整個星期都下雨的時候，你會覺得心情低落嗎？

sentences.en: The room looked gloomy without any windows.
sentences.zh: 這個房間沒有窗戶，看起來很陰暗。

sentences.en: Experts have a gloomy view of next year's sales.
sentences.zh: 專家對明年的銷售看法悲觀。

sentences.en: You look gorgeous in that blue dress.
sentences.zh: 你穿那件藍色洋裝好漂亮。

sentences.en: Is the weather going to stay gorgeous this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末天氣會一直都這麼好嗎？

sentences.en: We had gorgeous weather for the whole trip.
sentences.zh: 整趟旅行我們都遇到極好的天氣。

sentences.en: Their new house has a gorgeous garden.
sentences.zh: 他們的新家有個非常漂亮的花園。

sentences.en: Did you see her gorgeous wedding photos?
sentences.zh: 你有看到她那些超美的婚紗照嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel room has a gorgeous view of the lake.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店房間可以看到湖面的絕美景色。

sentences.en: The school will grant us permission to use the gym.
sentences.zh: 學校會准許我們使用體育館。

sentences.en: Did the city grant your request for a permit?
sentences.zh: 市政府有批准你的許可證申請嗎？

sentences.en: She won a grant to study marine life.
sentences.zh: 她拿到一筆補助金來研究海洋生物。

sentences.en: How can a small business apply for a grant?
sentences.zh: 小型企業要怎麼申請補助金？

sentences.en: The manager granted me an extra day off.
sentences.zh: 經理准了我多放一天假。

sentences.en: The grant covered most of the lab's equipment costs.
sentences.zh: 這筆補助金支付了實驗室大部分的設備費用。

sentences.en: The graphics in your slides look professional.
sentences.zh: 你簡報裡的圖像看起來很專業。

sentences.en: Can you add some graphics to the sales report?
sentences.zh: 你可以在銷售報告裡加一些圖像嗎？

sentences.en: Does this computer have good graphics for design work?
sentences.zh: 這台電腦的繪圖效能夠做設計工作嗎？

sentences.en: The new brochure has bright, clear graphics.
sentences.zh: 新的宣傳手冊有明亮清晰的圖像。

sentences.en: Colorful graphics make complex data easier to read.
sentences.zh: 色彩豐富的圖像讓複雜的資料更容易看懂。

sentences.en: Our website needs better graphics on the home page.
sentences.zh: 我們的網站首頁需要更好的圖像。

sentences.en: Greed made him take more than his share.
sentences.zh: 貪婪讓他拿了超過自己應得的份。

sentences.en: Was greed the reason the company failed?
sentences.zh: 公司倒閉是因為貪婪嗎？

sentences.en: The movie shows how greed can destroy a family.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描寫貪婪如何毀掉一個家庭。

sentences.en: Some people think greed drives the economy.
sentences.zh: 有些人認為貪婪推動了經濟。

sentences.en: Do you think greed is part of human nature?
sentences.zh: 你覺得貪婪是人性的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: Her greed for money surprised her old friends.
sentences.zh: 她對金錢的貪婪讓老朋友們很驚訝。

gloss_note: grieve for sb 為某人哀悼

sentences.en: The whole town grieved after the sudden loss of its mayor.
sentences.zh: 市長突然過世後，全鎮的人都在哀悼。

sentences.en: It takes time to grieve for someone you love.
sentences.zh: 為所愛的人哀悼需要時間。

sentences.en: How long should we let her grieve in peace?
sentences.zh: 我們該讓她靜靜哀悼多久？

sentences.en: He still grieves for his grandfather.
sentences.zh: 他仍在為他的祖父悲痛。

sentences.en: Can friends help you grieve after a loss?
sentences.zh: 失去親人後，朋友能幫你走過悲痛嗎？

sentences.en: Families grieve in different ways, the counselor said.
sentences.zh: 輔導員說，每個家庭哀悼的方式都不同。

gloss_note: grille 是格柵；grill 才是烤架

sentences.en: The metal grille on the window kept the birds out.
sentences.zh: 窗戶上的金屬格柵把鳥擋在外面。

sentences.en: Dust stuck to the grille of the air conditioner.
sentences.zh: 灰塵黏在冷氣的出風格柵上。

sentences.en: The old church had an iron grille on the door.
sentences.zh: 那座老教堂的門上裝有鐵格柵。

sentences.en: Why is there a grille in front of the ticket window?
sentences.zh: 售票窗口前為什麼有格柵？

sentences.en: Is the grille on the car's front damaged?
sentences.zh: 車子前面的護網壞了嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant covered its kitchen vent with a steel grille.
sentences.zh: 餐廳用鋼製格柵蓋住了廚房的排風口。

sentences.en: I'll have the grilled chicken salad, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點烤雞肉沙拉，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Is the grilled fish fresh today?
sentences.zh: 今天的烤魚新鮮嗎？

sentences.en: He ordered a grilled cheese sandwich with tomato soup.
sentences.zh: 他點了烤起司三明治配番茄湯。

sentences.en: Grilled vegetables taste great with a little olive oil.
sentences.zh: 烤蔬菜淋一點橄欖油就很好吃。

sentences.en: Do you want your corn grilled or boiled?
sentences.zh: 你的玉米要烤的還是煮的？

sentences.en: We ate grilled shrimp on the patio.
sentences.zh: 我們在露台上吃烤蝦。

sentences.en: The report brought grim news about job losses.
sentences.zh: 這份報告帶來了有關失業的壞消息。

sentences.en: Is the outlook for the housing market still grim?
sentences.zh: 房市的前景依然嚴峻嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone looked grim after hearing about the layoffs.
sentences.zh: 聽到裁員消息後，每個人的表情都很沉重。

sentences.en: Why is your face so grim today?
sentences.zh: 你今天的臉色怎麼這麼陰沉？

sentences.en: The grim weather matched the mood of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 陰沉的天氣和會議的氣氛很搭。

sentences.en: Experts predict a grim year for local farmers.
sentences.zh: 專家預測今年對當地農民來說會很艱難。

sentences.en: Let's get some grub after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後我們去找點吃的吧。

sentences.en: Is the grub at this place any good?
sentences.zh: 這地方的東西好吃嗎？

sentences.en: The campfire grub was simple but tasty.
sentences.zh: 營火邊的食物雖然簡單，卻很好吃。

sentences.en: Who's bringing the grub for the party?
sentences.zh: 誰要帶派對的食物？

sentences.en: We need some cheap grub before the movie.
sentences.zh: 看電影前我們得先吃點便宜的東西。

sentences.en: Dad cooked up some good grub for us.
sentences.zh: 爸爸煮了一些好吃的東西給我們。

sentences.en: Can I get extra guacamole on my burrito?
sentences.zh: 我的墨西哥捲餅可以多加酪梨醬嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh guacamole is easy to make at home.
sentences.zh: 新鮮的酪梨醬在家很容易做。

sentences.en: Do you like guacamole with chips?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡用玉米片沾酪梨醬吃嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter brought guacamole and salsa to our table.
sentences.zh: 服務生把酪梨醬和莎莎醬送到我們桌上。

sentences.en: She mashed avocados to make guacamole for the party.
sentences.zh: 她把酪梨壓成泥，為派對做酪梨醬。

sentences.en: This guacamole needs a little more lime juice.
sentences.zh: 這份酪梨醬還需要多加一點萊姆汁。

sentences.en: Please follow the safety guidelines at all times.
sentences.zh: 請隨時遵守安全準則。

sentences.en: Where can I find the new travel guidelines?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以找到新的差旅準則？

sentences.en: The school set strict guidelines for online tests.
sentences.zh: 學校為線上考試訂了嚴格的準則。

sentences.en: Do these guidelines apply to part-time workers?
sentences.zh: 這些準則也適用於兼職員工嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor gave me simple guidelines for healthy eating.
sentences.zh: 醫生給了我一些簡單的健康飲食原則。

sentences.en: A clear guideline helps everyone work faster.
sentences.zh: 一份清楚的準則能讓大家工作更快。

sentences.en: Trust your gut when something feels wrong.
sentences.zh: 覺得哪裡不對勁的時候，要相信自己的直覺。

sentences.en: My gut told me not to sign the deal.
sentences.zh: 我的直覺告訴我不要簽這份合約。

sentences.en: Do you go with your gut or the data?
sentences.zh: 你是憑直覺，還是看數據做決定？

sentences.en: Spicy food always gives me a pain in my gut.
sentences.zh: 辛辣的食物總是讓我肚子痛。

sentences.en: Her gut feeling about the new hire was right.
sentences.zh: 她對新進員工的直覺是對的。

sentences.en: Is yogurt good for your gut?
sentences.zh: 優格對腸胃好嗎？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Stephanie~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: We were halfway to the airport when it started raining.
sentences.zh: 我們開到機場的半路上，天就下起雨了。

sentences.en: Are we halfway through the movie yet?
sentences.zh: 電影演到一半了嗎？

sentences.en: She quit halfway through the semester.
sentences.zh: 她在學期進行到一半時就放棄了。

sentences.en: Halfway through his speech, the microphone stopped working.
sentences.zh: 他演講到一半，麥克風就壞了。

sentences.en: How do you feel halfway through the program?
sentences.zh: 課程進行到一半，你覺得怎麼樣？

sentences.en: I stopped halfway up the stairs to catch my breath.
sentences.zh: 我爬到樓梯一半就停下來喘口氣。

sentences.en: Check the employee handbook for the vacation policy.
sentences.zh: 請查看員工手冊裡的休假規定。

sentences.en: Where is the safety handbook kept?
sentences.zh: 安全手冊放在哪裡？

sentences.en: Every new hire gets a handbook on the first day.
sentences.zh: 每位新進員工第一天都會拿到一本手冊。

sentences.en: Does the handbook explain how to request time off?
sentences.zh: 手冊裡有說明怎麼請假嗎？

sentences.en: The handbook lists the rules for using the lab.
sentences.zh: 手冊列出了使用實驗室的規定。

sentences.en: I keep a repair handbook in my car's glove box.
sentences.zh: 我在車子的置物箱裡放了一本維修手冊。

sentences.en: Please pick up a handout on your way in.
sentences.zh: 進場時請拿一份講義。

sentences.en: Did you get the handout from today's lecture?
sentences.zh: 你有拿到今天上課的講義嗎？

sentences.en: The professor passed out a handout with practice questions.
sentences.zh: 教授發了一份附練習題的講義。

sentences.en: Can I have an extra handout for my friend?
sentences.zh: 我可以多拿一份講義給我朋友嗎？

sentences.en: I left my handout on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我把講義忘在公車上了。

sentences.en: The handout summarizes the main points of the talk.
sentences.zh: 這份講義整理了演講的重點。

sentences.en: I'd like a hazelnut latte, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一杯榛果拿鐵，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Do these cookies contain hazelnuts?
sentences.zh: 這些餅乾裡有榛果嗎？

sentences.en: She put hazelnut spread on warm toast.
sentences.zh: 她在熱吐司上抹了榛果醬。

sentences.en: Hazelnut trees grow well in cool climates.
sentences.zh: 榛樹在涼爽的氣候中長得很好。

sentences.en: Is this cake made with hazelnut or almond?
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕是用榛果還是杏仁做的？

sentences.en: My mom puts crushed hazelnuts on top of her cake.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽在她的蛋糕上撒碎榛果。

gloss_note: heir to the throne 王位繼承人

sentences.en: The king's eldest son is the heir to the throne.
sentences.zh: 國王的長子是王位繼承人。

sentences.en: Who is the heir to the family business?
sentences.zh: 誰是這家家族企業的繼承人？

sentences.en: As the only heir, she inherited the whole farm.
sentences.zh: 身為唯一的繼承人，她繼承了整座農場。

sentences.en: Does the old man have an heir?
sentences.zh: 那位老先生有繼承人嗎？

sentences.en: The company had no heir to take over after he retired.
sentences.zh: 他退休後，公司沒有繼承人可以接手。

sentences.en: The heir sold the house soon after the funeral.
sentences.zh: 繼承人在葬禮後不久就把房子賣了。

sentences.en: Our teacher drew a double helix on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個雙螺旋。

sentences.en: Can you draw a helix on this graph?
sentences.zh: 你可以在這張圖上畫一條螺旋線嗎？

sentences.en: A spiral staircase forms a helix around its center.
sentences.zh: 螺旋梯繞著中心形成一個螺旋形。

sentences.en: Is a screw shaped like a helix?
sentences.zh: 螺絲的形狀像螺旋嗎？

sentences.en: The helix of this metal spring is very tight.
sentences.zh: 這個金屬彈簧的螺旋圈非常緊密。

sentences.en: Scientists first described the double helix in 1953.
sentences.zh: 科學家在1953年首次描述了雙螺旋結構。

gloss_note: 書面用語，常接名詞片語

sentences.en: The store closed early, hence the empty parking lot. Did you hear why?
sentences.zh: 那家店提早打烊，所以停車場才空空的。你聽說原因了嗎？

sentences.en: Fuel costs rose, hence the higher ticket prices.
sentences.zh: 燃料成本上漲，因此票價變高了。

sentences.en: I have a meeting at nine, hence this early call. Are you free?
sentences.zh: 我九點要開會，所以才這麼早打給你。你有空嗎？

sentences.en: The road is icy, hence the slow traffic. Did you drive today?
sentences.zh: 路面結冰，所以車流很慢。你今天有開車嗎？

sentences.en: She missed the bus, hence her late arrival.
sentences.zh: 她錯過了公車，所以才會遲到。

sentences.en: Sales dropped sharply, hence the need for a new plan.
sentences.zh: 銷售大幅下滑，因此需要一項新計畫。

gloss_note: hepatitis B vaccine B型肝炎疫苗

sentences.en: Do you need a hepatitis vaccine before the trip?
sentences.zh: 你出發前需要打肝炎疫苗嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse said the hepatitis test results come back Friday.
sentences.zh: 護理師說肝炎檢驗的結果週五會出來。

sentences.en: Hepatitis can damage the liver if it is not treated.
sentences.zh: 肝炎如果沒有治療，可能會傷害肝臟。

sentences.en: Is hepatitis spread through dirty food or water?
sentences.zh: 肝炎會經由不乾淨的食物或水傳染嗎？

sentences.en: Many people don't know they have hepatitis until a checkup.
sentences.zh: 許多人直到健康檢查才發現自己得了肝炎。

sentences.en: Our school offers a free hepatitis shot to all students.
sentences.zh: 我們學校提供所有學生免費的肝炎疫苗。

gloss_note: 美式 herb 的 h 不發音，唸 erb

sentences.en: Do you grow any herbs on your balcony?
sentences.zh: 你陽台上有種香草嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh herb sauce goes well with grilled fish.
sentences.zh: 新鮮香草醬和烤魚很搭。

sentences.en: Add a handful of herbs just before serving.
sentences.zh: 上菜前再加一把香草。

sentences.en: Which herbs help you sleep better?
sentences.zh: 哪些藥草能幫助你睡得比較好？

sentences.en: My grandmother uses herbs to treat a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶用藥草來治療喉嚨痛。

sentences.en: Basil is an easy herb for beginners to grow.
sentences.zh: 羅勒是新手容易栽種的香草。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Stuart H assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: Please wear gloves when you spray herbicide.
sentences.zh: 噴除草劑時請戴上手套。

sentences.en: Does this herbicide really work on dandelions?
sentences.zh: 這款除草劑對蒲公英真的有效嗎？

sentences.en: Farmers used herbicide to protect their corn crop.
sentences.zh: 農夫用除草劑來保護他們的玉米田。

sentences.en: Too much herbicide can pollute nearby streams.
sentences.zh: 過量的除草劑可能汙染附近的溪流。

sentences.en: We keep the herbicide on a high shelf in the garage.
sentences.zh: 我們把除草劑放在車庫的高架子上。

sentences.en: Is organic herbicide as strong as the regular kind?
sentences.zh: 有機除草劑和一般的一樣有效嗎？

sentences.en: Our town celebrates its Italian heritage every October.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上每年十月都會慶祝義大利裔的文化傳承。

sentences.en: Do you know much about your family's heritage?
sentences.zh: 你對自己家族的傳統了解多少？

sentences.en: The old bridge is part of our national heritage.
sentences.zh: 這座老橋是我們國家文化遺產的一部分。

sentences.en: Why is it important to protect cultural heritage?
sentences.zh: 為什麼保護文化遺產這麼重要？

sentences.en: She shares her Mexican heritage by cooking traditional dishes.
sentences.zh: 她用烹煮傳統菜餚的方式，分享她的墨西哥裔文化。

sentences.en: The festival keeps our local heritage alive for kids.
sentences.zh: 這個慶典讓孩子們認識我們在地的傳統。

gloss_note: highlight key points 標出重點

sentences.en: Please highlight the key points in yellow.
sentences.zh: 請用黃色螢光筆標出重點。

sentences.en: Can you highlight the main risks in your email?
sentences.zh: 你能在電子郵件裡強調主要的風險嗎？

sentences.en: The manager highlighted the need for better training.
sentences.zh: 經理強調了加強訓練的必要性。

sentences.en: Why did the article highlight only the good news?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這篇文章只強調好消息？

sentences.en: I always highlight important dates on my calendar.
sentences.zh: 我總是把行事曆上的重要日期標示出來。

sentences.en: The new report highlights a gap in our customer service.
sentences.zh: 新報告點出了我們客戶服務上的缺口。

gloss_note: trail 步道；day hiker 單日健行者

sentences.en: Every hiker should carry water and a map.
sentences.zh: 每位健行者都應該帶水和地圖。

sentences.en: Are you an experienced hiker or a beginner?
sentences.zh: 你是經驗豐富的登山客，還是新手？

sentences.en: A friendly hiker offered us some trail mix.
sentences.zh: 一位友善的健行者請我們吃綜合堅果。

sentences.en: The park ranger warned hikers about the afternoon storm.
sentences.zh: 公園管理員警告健行者下午會有暴風雨。

sentences.en: Where can hikers leave their cars overnight?
sentences.zh: 健行者可以把車停在哪裡過夜？

sentences.en: My brother became a serious hiker after college.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥大學畢業後變成了熱衷的登山客。

gloss_note: bar chart 是長條圖，兩者不同

sentences.en: Can you add a histogram to the sales report?
sentences.zh: 你可以在銷售報告裡加一張直方圖嗎？

sentences.en: The histogram shows how many customers waited too long.
sentences.zh: 直方圖顯示有多少顧客等太久。

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to draw a histogram by hand.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們用手畫一張直方圖。

sentences.en: What does the tall bar on this histogram mean?
sentences.zh: 這張直方圖上那根高高的長條代表什麼？

sentences.en: A histogram makes it easy to spot unusual prices.
sentences.zh: 直方圖讓人很容易看出不尋常的價格。

sentences.en: I made a histogram of last month's website visits.
sentences.zh: 我把上個月的網站訪客數做成了直方圖。

gloss_note: 非常正式；日常多說 until now、so far

sentences.en: Hitherto, the company has avoided layoffs. Will that change?
sentences.zh: 迄今公司一直避免裁員。這種情況會改變嗎？

sentences.en: Costs have hitherto stayed low. Can we keep it that way?
sentences.zh: 成本迄今都維持在低點。我們能繼續維持嗎？

sentences.en: The hitherto unknown writer won a major award.
sentences.zh: 這位迄今默默無名的作家贏得了一項大獎。

sentences.en: Hitherto, our software has been free. Why change now?
sentences.zh: 迄今我們的軟體一直是免費的。為什麼現在要改？

sentences.en: Hitherto, staff could park anywhere. Now spaces are assigned.
sentences.zh: 迄今員工都能隨處停車，現在改成指定車位。

sentences.en: Prices have hitherto been stable. Did you expect this jump?
sentences.zh: 價格迄今一直很穩定。你有預料到這次大漲嗎？

gloss_note: 美國日常說 hockey 多指冰球（ice hockey）

sentences.en: Do you want to watch the hockey game tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想看冰球比賽嗎？

sentences.en: My son practices hockey every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 我兒子每週六早上都練習冰球。

sentences.en: Hockey season starts as soon as the lake freezes.
sentences.zh: 湖面一結冰，冰球季就開始了。

sentences.en: Is hockey popular where you grew up?
sentences.zh: 你長大的地方流行冰球嗎？

sentences.en: She bought new hockey sticks for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她替整個球隊買了新的冰球桿。

sentences.en: Our school added a hockey club this year.
sentences.zh: 我們學校今年新增了一個冰球社。

gloss_note: the homeless 指遊民；shelter 收容所

sentences.en: Our school collects coats for homeless families every winter.
sentences.zh: 我們學校每年冬天都為無家可歸的家庭募集外套。

sentences.en: How many people in this city are homeless?
sentences.zh: 這座城市有多少人無家可歸？

sentences.en: A fire left the family homeless overnight.
sentences.zh: 一場火災讓這家人一夜之間無家可歸。

sentences.en: Do you volunteer at the shelter for the homeless?
sentences.zh: 你有在遊民收容所當志工嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans to build housing for the homeless.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫為遊民興建住宅。

sentences.en: I gave a homeless man my extra sandwich.
sentences.zh: 我把多的三明治給了一位無家可歸的男子。

sentences.en: Most homeowners pay property tax every year.
sentences.zh: 大多數屋主每年都要繳房地產稅。

sentences.en: Are you a homeowner, or are you renting?
sentences.zh: 你是屋主，還是租房子？

sentences.en: The homeowner called us about a leaking roof.
sentences.zh: 屋主打電話來說屋頂漏水。

sentences.en: Does homeowners insurance cover water damage?
sentences.zh: 屋主保險有包含水災損失嗎？

sentences.en: New homeowners often underestimate repair costs.
sentences.zh: 新屋主常常低估修繕費用。

sentences.en: As a homeowner, I now fix my own faucet.
sentences.zh: 當了屋主以後，我現在自己修水龍頭。

gloss_note: 句首 Honestly, 表示坦白語氣

sentences.en: Honestly, the meeting could have been an email.
sentences.zh: 老實說，這場會議用一封電子郵件就能解決了。

sentences.en: I honestly don't remember where I put the keys. Did you see them?
sentences.zh: 我真的不記得鑰匙放哪了。你有看到嗎？

sentences.en: Honestly, I liked the first version better. What do you think?
sentences.zh: 老實說，我比較喜歡第一版。你覺得呢？

sentences.en: He spoke honestly about the mistake in the interview.
sentences.zh: 他在面試中坦白談到那個失誤。

sentences.en: Please tell me honestly. Was the soup too salty?
sentences.zh: 請老實告訴我，湯會不會太鹹？

sentences.en: Honestly, I'd rather take the train than drive.
sentences.zh: 說真的，我寧願搭火車也不想開車。

sentences.en: The mayor made an honorable choice and returned the gift.
sentences.zh: 市長做了值得尊敬的決定，把禮物退了回去。

sentences.en: Do you think quitting was the honorable thing to do?
sentences.zh: 你覺得辭職是值得尊敬的做法嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather had an honorable career in the army.
sentences.zh: 我祖父在軍中有過光榮的職業生涯。

sentences.en: They found an honorable way to settle the dispute.
sentences.zh: 他們找到了體面的方式來解決爭執。

sentences.en: Teachers should set an honorable example for students.
sentences.zh: 老師應該為學生樹立值得尊敬的榜樣。

sentences.en: Was it honorable of him to take the blame?
sentences.zh: 他主動扛下責任，算是值得尊敬的行為嗎？

gloss_note: take someone hostage 挾持某人為人質

sentences.en: In the movie, a pilot is taken hostage on a flight.
sentences.zh: 片中一名機師在航班上被挾持為人質。

sentences.en: Did the news say all the hostages are safe?
sentences.zh: 新聞有說所有人質都平安嗎？

sentences.en: Negotiators worked all night to free the hostages.
sentences.zh: 談判人員整晚努力要讓人質獲釋。

sentences.en: Have the hostages been released yet?
sentences.zh: 人質已經獲釋了嗎？

sentences.en: Our drama class is reading a play about a hostage.
sentences.zh: 我們的戲劇課正在讀一齣關於人質的劇本。

sentences.en: The writer's new novel features a hostage and a detective.
sentences.zh: 這位作家的新小說以一名人質和一位偵探為主角。

sentences.en: Housing prices keep rising in many big cities.
sentences.zh: 許多大城市的房價持續上漲。

sentences.en: Does the university provide housing for new students?
sentences.zh: 大學有提供新生住宿嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans to build more affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫興建更多可負擔住宅。

sentences.en: How much of your income goes to housing?
sentences.zh: 你的收入有多少花在居住上？

sentences.en: Our company offers a housing allowance for new hires.
sentences.zh: 我們公司提供新進員工住宿津貼。

sentences.en: Student housing near campus fills up quickly each fall.
sentences.zh: 校園附近的學生住宅每年秋天都很快就客滿。

gloss_note: wolves howl 狼嚎；wind howls 風呼嘯

sentences.en: We heard wolves howl across the valley last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我們聽到狼群的嚎叫聲迴盪在山谷。

sentences.en: Why does your dog howl when you leave?
sentences.zh: 你出門時，你的狗為什麼會嚎叫？

sentences.en: The wind began to howl around the old cabin.
sentences.zh: 風開始在老木屋四周呼嘯。

sentences.en: Did you hear that long howl outside the tent?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到帳篷外那一聲長長的嚎叫嗎？

sentences.en: The neighbor's puppy starts to howl at every siren.
sentences.zh: 鄰居的小狗一聽到警笛就會嚎叫。

sentences.en: A low howl echoed through the forest in the movie.
sentences.zh: 電影裡一聲低沉的嚎叫在森林中迴盪。

sentences.en: The new product has been hugely popular with customers.
sentences.zh: 這項新產品深受顧客歡迎，人氣極高。

sentences.en: Was last quarter's launch hugely successful?
sentences.zh: 上一季的產品上市非常成功嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks, your advice was hugely helpful to us.
sentences.zh: 謝謝，你的建議對我們幫助極大。

sentences.en: Is this restaurant hugely popular or just well advertised?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳是真的極受歡迎，還是只是廣告打得好？

sentences.en: The film was hugely expensive to make but earned little.
sentences.zh: 這部片的拍攝成本極其高昂，卻賺得很少。

sentences.en: Customer needs vary hugely from region to region.
sentences.zh: 各地區顧客的需求差異極大。

gloss_note: clear a hurdle 跨過難關

sentences.en: Funding is the biggest hurdle for our new project.
sentences.zh: 資金是我們新計畫最大的難關。

sentences.en: How did you clear that hurdle with the client?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼和客戶一起跨過那道難關的？

sentences.en: Passing the license exam was a major hurdle for me.
sentences.zh: 通過執照考試對我來說是一大難關。

sentences.en: Is the language barrier a hurdle for new employees?
sentences.zh: 語言隔閡對新進員工來說是障礙嗎？

sentences.en: The bill faces one more hurdle before it becomes law.
sentences.zh: 這項法案在成為法律之前還有一道關卡。

sentences.en: Saving for a down payment is our next hurdle.
sentences.zh: 存頭期款是我們下一道難關。

sentences.en: Good hygiene is very important in a restaurant kitchen.
sentences.zh: 餐廳廚房裡，良好的衛生非常重要。

sentences.en: Did the nurse teach you about hand hygiene?
sentences.zh: 護理師有教你們手部衛生嗎？

sentences.en: My dentist says dental hygiene starts with daily flossing.
sentences.zh: 我的牙醫說口腔衛生要從每天使用牙線開始。

sentences.en: Who checks the hygiene standards in the staff cafeteria?
sentences.zh: 誰負責檢查員工餐廳的衛生標準？

sentences.en: Poor hygiene was the main reason for the food poisoning.
sentences.zh: 衛生不良是這次食物中毒的主因。

sentences.en: Pack extra hygiene items for the long camping trip.
sentences.zh: 長途露營請多帶一些衛生用品。

sentences.en: Our hypothesis is that plants grow faster in blue light.
sentences.zh: 我們的假設是植物在藍光下長得比較快。

sentences.en: What was your hypothesis before you ran the experiment?
sentences.zh: 你在做實驗之前的假設是什麼？

sentences.en: The experiment did not support the scientists' hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 這項實驗並未支持科學家的假設。

sentences.en: Can we test this hypothesis with a simple survey?
sentences.zh: 我們能用簡單的問卷來檢驗這個假設嗎？

sentences.en: Write a clear hypothesis before you start the project.
sentences.zh: 開始專題之前，先寫下清楚的假設。

sentences.en: The marketing team's hypothesis turned out to be wrong.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊的假設最後證明是錯的。

sentences.en: That's a purely hypothetical question; we have no plans yet.
sentences.zh: 那純粹是個假設性的問題，我們目前還沒有計畫。

sentences.en: How would you handle this hypothetical situation with a customer?
sentences.zh: 面對這個假設性的客戶情境，你會怎麼處理？

sentences.en: Let's use a hypothetical example to explain the rule.
sentences.zh: 我們用個假設的例子來說明這條規則。

sentences.en: Is that discount hypothetical, or is it already approved?
sentences.zh: 那個折扣只是假設，還是已經核准了？

sentences.en: The report includes a hypothetical budget for next year.
sentences.zh: 報告中包含一份明年的假設預算。

sentences.en: My brother loves hypothetical debates about space travel.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥很愛辯論太空旅行之類的假設性話題。

gloss_note: ideological differences 意識形態差異

sentences.en: Experts say the debate is more ideological than practical.
sentences.zh: 專家說這場辯論與其說務實，不如說是意識形態之爭。

sentences.en: Do ideological differences make teamwork harder?
sentences.zh: 意識形態的差異會讓團隊合作更困難嗎？

sentences.en: The founders split over an ideological disagreement about company values.
sentences.zh: 創辦人因為對公司價值觀的意識形態分歧而分道揚鑣。

sentences.en: Our professor explained the ideological roots of the movement.
sentences.zh: 教授解釋了這場運動在意識形態上的根源。

sentences.en: Is the magazine's ideological slant easy to spot?
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌的意識形態立場很容易看出來嗎？

sentences.en: We avoid ideological arguments at family dinners.
sentences.zh: 我們在家庭聚餐時避免意識形態的爭論。

sentences.en: This picture is a famous optical illusion.
sentences.zh: 這張圖是一個著名的視覺錯覺。

sentences.en: Are the lines really moving, or is it an illusion?
sentences.zh: 這些線條真的在動，還是只是錯覺？

sentences.en: He is under the illusion that success comes overnight.
sentences.zh: 他幻想成功可以一夜之間到手。

sentences.en: Why do mirrors create the illusion of more space?
sentences.zh: 為什麼鏡子會讓空間看起來更大？

sentences.en: Don't give them the illusion that the job will be easy.
sentences.zh: 別讓他們以為這份工作會很輕鬆。

sentences.en: Many tourists lose their illusions about the city after a week.
sentences.zh: 許多遊客待了一週就對這座城市不再抱有幻想。

sentences.en: The trade imbalance grew again last quarter.
sentences.zh: 貿易失衡在上一季再度擴大。

sentences.en: Is there an imbalance in how we share the workload?
sentences.zh: 我們分攤工作量的方式有不平衡嗎？

sentences.en: Work-life imbalance can lead to burnout.
sentences.zh: 工作與生活失衡可能導致身心耗竭。

sentences.en: Could a hormonal imbalance explain her tiredness?
sentences.zh: 荷爾蒙失衡能解釋她為什麼這麼累嗎？

sentences.en: The gender imbalance in the class surprised the teacher.
sentences.zh: 班上的性別比例失衡讓老師很驚訝。

sentences.en: The imbalance in our household chores bothers me.
sentences.zh: 我們家務分配不均，讓我很困擾。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: The new stadium looks immense from the highway.
sentences.zh: 從高速公路看過去，新球場顯得巨大無比。

sentences.en: How did you handle such immense pressure at work?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼應付工作上這麼大的壓力的？

sentences.en: We owe immense gratitude to all our volunteers.
sentences.zh: 我們對所有志工懷有極大的感激。

sentences.en: Is the immense old tree in the park protected?
sentences.zh: 公園裡那棵巨大的老樹受到保護嗎？

sentences.en: Winning the scholarship was an immense relief for my family.
sentences.zh: 拿到獎學金讓我的家人大大鬆了一口氣。

sentences.en: The storm caused immense damage to the coastal town.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨對這個沿海小鎮造成了極大的損害。

sentences.en: Weather officials warn that a snowstorm is imminent.
sentences.zh: 氣象人員警告暴風雪即將來臨。

sentences.en: Is the product launch imminent, or still months away?
sentences.zh: 產品上市是即將到來，還是還要好幾個月？

sentences.en: With the deadline imminent, the team worked late.
sentences.zh: 截止日迫在眉睫，團隊加班到很晚。

sentences.en: Do you think a decision is imminent?
sentences.zh: 你覺得很快就會有決定了嗎？

sentences.en: Grandma's visit is imminent, so let's clean the house.
sentences.zh: 奶奶就快到了，我們來打掃家裡吧。

sentences.en: The company's collapse seemed imminent last year.
sentences.zh: 去年那家公司看起來快要倒閉了。

sentences.en: Lack of sleep can impair your judgment.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足會削弱你的判斷力。

sentences.en: Does noise from the street impair your concentration?
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音會影響你的專注力嗎？

sentences.en: Poor lighting may impair vision over time.
sentences.zh: 光線不佳久了可能會損害視力。

sentences.en: Could this software bug impair our sales system?
sentences.zh: 這個軟體錯誤會損害我們的銷售系統嗎？

sentences.en: A bad cold can impair your sense of taste.
sentences.zh: 嚴重感冒可能削弱你的味覺。

sentences.en: Long delays impaired the team's ability to deliver on time.
sentences.zh: 長時間的延誤削弱了團隊準時交貨的能力。

gloss_note: imperative that 後接原形動詞（美式）

sentences.en: It is imperative that everyone arrive on time tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天每個人都務必準時到。

sentences.en: Is it imperative that we finish before Friday?
sentences.zh: 我們一定要在週五前完成嗎？

sentences.en: It's imperative to back up your files regularly.
sentences.zh: 定期備份檔案非常重要。

sentences.en: Why is it imperative that the doors stay locked?
sentences.zh: 為什麼門一定要保持鎖上？

sentences.en: Safety checks are imperative before every flight.
sentences.zh: 每次飛行前，安全檢查都是必要的。

sentences.en: A quick reply is imperative, since the offer ends today.
sentences.zh: 必須盡快回覆，因為優惠今天就結束。

gloss_note: implement a plan 執行計畫

sentences.en: We plan to implement the new system next month.
sentences.zh: 我們打算下個月實施新系統。

sentences.en: Who will implement the changes in the billing process?
sentences.zh: 誰會負責執行帳務流程的變更？

sentences.en: The school implemented a no-phone rule in classrooms.
sentences.zh: 學校在教室裡實施了禁用手機的規定。

sentences.en: Can your team implement this plan by June?
sentences.zh: 你的團隊能在六月前執行這個計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The city will implement a new recycling program soon.
sentences.zh: 市政府即將實施新的資源回收計畫。

sentences.en: It took six months to implement the software fully.
sentences.zh: 把這套軟體全面導入花了六個月。

gloss_note: have implications for 對…有影響

sentences.en: The new law has serious implications for small shops.
sentences.zh: 這項新法對小商店有嚴重的影響。

sentences.en: What are the implications of raising our prices?
sentences.zh: 提高我們的價格會有什麼影響？

sentences.en: I don't like the implication in your question.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡你問題裡的言外之意。

sentences.en: Did you notice the implication behind her comment?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到她那句話背後的含意嗎？

sentences.en: The study's implications go beyond this one school.
sentences.zh: 這項研究的影響不只限於這所學校。

sentences.en: The doctor explained the implications of the test results.
sentences.zh: 醫生解釋了檢驗結果可能帶來的影響。

gloss_note: importer and exporter 進口商與出口商

sentences.en: Our importer ships olive oil to stores across the country.
sentences.zh: 我們的進口商把橄欖油運往全國各地的商店。

sentences.en: Do you know a reliable importer of Italian wine?
sentences.zh: 你認識可靠的義大利葡萄酒進口商嗎？

sentences.en: The importer must pay the customs duty first.
sentences.zh: 進口商必須先繳納關稅。

sentences.en: Is the importer responsible for the damaged goods?
sentences.zh: 進口商要為受損的貨物負責嗎？

sentences.en: As an importer, she travels to Asia every spring.
sentences.zh: 身為進口商，她每年春天都去亞洲出差。

sentences.en: A local importer called about our tea order.
sentences.zh: 一家本地進口商打電話來詢問我們的茶葉訂單。

gloss_note: inability to + V 無法做某事

sentences.en: His inability to say no caused many problems.
sentences.zh: 他無法拒絕別人，造成了許多問題。

sentences.en: Is your inability to log in a new problem?
sentences.zh: 你無法登入是新出現的問題嗎？

sentences.en: The inability to find parking made us late.
sentences.zh: 找不到停車位害我們遲到了。

sentences.en: Did the inability to hear the speaker bother you?
sentences.zh: 聽不到講者說話有困擾到你嗎？

sentences.en: We regret our inability to ship your order this week.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，我們這週無法出貨您的訂單。

sentences.en: A fear of failure can lead to an inability to decide.
sentences.zh: 害怕失敗可能導致無法做決定。

sentences.en: Free shipping is a good incentive to order more.
sentences.zh: 免運費是促使顧客多下單的好誘因。

sentences.en: What incentive do workers have to stay longer?
sentences.zh: 員工有什麼誘因願意待久一點？

sentences.en: The government offers a tax incentive for solar panels.
sentences.zh: 政府提供裝設太陽能板的租稅優惠。

sentences.en: Do small bonuses work as an incentive?
sentences.zh: 小額獎金能當作激勵嗎？

sentences.en: Our sales team gets a cash incentive each quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們的業務團隊每一季都會領到現金獎勵。

sentences.en: My parents gave me a new phone as an incentive.
sentences.zh: 爸媽送我一支新手機當作獎勵。

gloss_note: be inclined to + V 傾向於做…

sentences.en: I'm inclined to accept the lower offer.
sentences.zh: 我傾向接受比較低的報價。

sentences.en: Are you inclined to take the job in Denver?
sentences.zh: 你有意願接受丹佛那份工作嗎？

sentences.en: Her honesty inclines me to trust her.
sentences.zh: 她的誠實讓我傾向於相信她。

sentences.en: Why are customers inclined to pay in cash here?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這裡的顧客傾向用現金付款？

sentences.en: Most students are inclined to study late before exams.
sentences.zh: 大多數學生考前傾向熬夜讀書。

sentences.en: He seemed inclined to agree with our plan.
sentences.zh: 他似乎傾向同意我們的計畫。

sentences.en: The two reports give inconsistent numbers for May.
sentences.zh: 這兩份報告給的五月數字不一致。

sentences.en: Why are your answers so inconsistent today?
sentences.zh: 你今天的答案為什麼這麼前後矛盾？

sentences.en: Her story was inconsistent with the video.
sentences.zh: 她的說法和影片內容不一致。

sentences.en: Is the quality of this product inconsistent?
sentences.zh: 這項產品的品質是否不一致？

sentences.en: Inconsistent rules confuse new employees.
sentences.zh: 前後不一致的規定會讓新進員工感到困惑。

sentences.en: Mom says my excuses are inconsistent with what I told Dad.
sentences.zh: 媽媽說我的藉口跟我對爸爸說的不一致。

gloss_note: incorporate A into B 把 A 納入 B

sentences.en: We will incorporate your feedback into the final design.
sentences.zh: 我們會把你的意見納入最後的設計。

sentences.en: Can you incorporate these notes into the report?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這些筆記併入報告嗎？

sentences.en: The chef likes to incorporate local vegetables into every dish.
sentences.zh: 主廚喜歡把當地蔬菜融入每一道菜。

sentences.en: How can teachers incorporate games into daily lessons?
sentences.zh: 老師要如何把遊戲納入日常教學？

sentences.en: Our gym will incorporate yoga classes next month.
sentences.zh: 我們健身房下個月會加入瑜伽課。

sentences.en: The new software incorporates a translation tool.
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體加入了翻譯工具。

sentences.en: The address on this package is incorrect.
sentences.zh: 這個包裹上的地址不正確。

sentences.en: Is this answer incorrect, or did I misread it?
sentences.zh: 這個答案是錯的，還是我看錯了？

sentences.en: The check shows an incorrect total.
sentences.zh: 帳單上的總額有誤。

sentences.en: Why does my phone show the incorrect time?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的手機顯示的時間不對？

sentences.en: The newspaper printed an incorrect date for the event.
sentences.zh: 報紙刊登了錯誤的活動日期。

sentences.en: It's incorrect to say the project was a failure.
sentences.zh: 說這個計畫失敗是不正確的。

sentences.en: The view from the top was incredibly beautiful.
sentences.zh: 山頂的景色美得令人難以置信。

sentences.en: Why was the line at the airport incredibly long?
sentences.zh: 為什麼機場的隊伍長得這麼誇張？

sentences.en: Scientists found an incredibly small insect in the cave.
sentences.zh: 科學家在洞穴裡發現了一種小得難以置信的昆蟲。

sentences.en: Are you incredibly tired, or just bored?
sentences.zh: 你是累得不得了，還是只是無聊？

sentences.en: This soup is incredibly good for such a low price.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯以這麼低的價格來說，好喝得驚人。

sentences.en: Our team worked incredibly hard on this report.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊為這份報告非常努力。

sentences.en: Look it up in the index at the back.
sentences.zh: 到書後面的索引查查看。

sentences.en: Did the consumer price index go up again?
sentences.zh: 消費者物價指數又上升了嗎？

sentences.en: Our manager checks the customer satisfaction index every month.
sentences.zh: 經理每個月都會查看顧客滿意度指數。

sentences.en: Does this textbook have an index of names?
sentences.zh: 這本課本有人名索引嗎？

sentences.en: The stock index closed higher on Monday.
sentences.zh: 股價指數週一收盤走高。

sentences.en: My mom made an index of all her recipe cards.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽幫她所有的食譜卡做了一份索引。

sentences.en: His indifference to the customer's complaint was obvious.
sentences.zh: 他對顧客的抱怨顯然漠不關心。

sentences.en: Why is there such indifference to the new rule?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家對新規定這麼冷淡？

sentences.en: The mayor's indifference to the problem upset residents.
sentences.zh: 市長對這個問題的漠不關心讓居民很不滿。

sentences.en: Did you mistake her quiet indifference for shyness?
sentences.zh: 你是不是把她冷淡的態度誤認為害羞？

sentences.en: She answered with a shrug and complete indifference.
sentences.zh: 她聳聳肩，一臉完全不在乎地回答。

sentences.en: Teachers worry about student indifference toward reading.
sentences.zh: 老師擔心學生對閱讀漠不關心。

sentences.en: He seemed indifferent to the final score.
sentences.zh: 他似乎對最後的比數漠不關心。

sentences.en: Why are you so indifferent to my advice?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對我的建議這麼冷淡？

sentences.en: The waiter was rude and indifferent to our requests.
sentences.zh: 服務生態度無禮，對我們的要求漠不關心。

sentences.en: Are young people becoming indifferent to the news?
sentences.zh: 年輕人對新聞越來越漠不關心了嗎？

sentences.en: Our boss stayed indifferent during the long meeting.
sentences.zh: 老闆在冗長的會議中顯得興趣缺缺。

sentences.en: Don't be indifferent when a neighbor needs help.
sentences.zh: 鄰居需要幫忙時，不要漠不關心。

sentences.en: A good map is indispensable on this hike.
sentences.zh: 在這趟健行中，一張好地圖不可或缺。

sentences.en: Is a car indispensable in your city?
sentences.zh: 在你的城市裡，車子是不可或缺的嗎？

sentences.en: She is an indispensable member of our team.
sentences.zh: 她是我們團隊不可或缺的一員。

sentences.en: Is a smartphone indispensable for students now?
sentences.zh: 現在的學生一定要有智慧型手機嗎？

sentences.en: Water is indispensable for all living things.
sentences.zh: 水對所有生物來說都不可或缺。

sentences.en: My coffee maker has become indispensable in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我的咖啡機已經成了早晨不可或缺的東西。

gloss_note: indulge in 盡情享受；縱容自己

sentences.en: Let's indulge a little and order dessert.
sentences.zh: 我們就放縱一下，點個甜點吧。

sentences.en: Do you ever indulge yourself with a day at the spa?
sentences.zh: 你會偶爾犒賞自己，去做一整天的水療嗎？

sentences.en: Grandparents often indulge their grandchildren with sweets.
sentences.zh: 祖父母常常用甜食來寵溺孫子孫女。

sentences.en: Why do parents indulge their kids at the store?
sentences.zh: 為什麼父母在商店裡總是縱容孩子？

sentences.en: I plan to indulge in a long nap this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我打算這個週末盡情睡個長長的午覺。

sentences.en: We indulged in a huge breakfast on vacation.
sentences.zh: 度假時，我們盡情享用了豐盛的早餐。

sentences.en: Industrialization changed how people lived and worked.
sentences.zh: 工業化改變了人們的生活與工作方式。

sentences.en: How did industrialization affect air quality in cities?
sentences.zh: 工業化如何影響城市的空氣品質？

sentences.en: Rapid industrialization has helped many families escape poverty.
sentences.zh: 快速的工業化幫助許多家庭脫離了貧窮。

sentences.en: Did industrialization begin earlier in Britain than elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 工業化在英國是不是比其他地方更早開始？

sentences.en: Industrialization brought new jobs and crowded cities to the region.
sentences.zh: 工業化為這個地區帶來新的工作，也帶來擁擠的城市。

sentences.en: My grandfather remembers the industrialization of his hometown.
sentences.zh: 我祖父記得他家鄉工業化的過程。

sentences.en: Many countries began to industrialize in the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 許多國家在1800年代開始工業化。

sentences.en: Why did Japan industrialize so quickly?
sentences.zh: 日本為什麼工業化得這麼快？

sentences.en: The region is trying to industrialize without hurting nature.
sentences.zh: 這個地區想在不破壞自然的情況下推動工業化。

sentences.en: Is your country fully industrialized yet?
sentences.zh: 你的國家已經完全工業化了嗎？

sentences.en: Most industrialized countries use more energy per person.
sentences.zh: 大多數工業化國家的人均耗能比較高。

sentences.en: Our small town industrialized quickly after the railroad arrived.
sentences.zh: 我們的小鎮在鐵路通車後快速工業化了。

sentences.en: The new ad campaign was completely ineffective.
sentences.zh: 這次新的廣告活動完全沒有效果。

sentences.en: Why is this cleaner so ineffective on grease?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這款清潔劑對油汙這麼沒效？

sentences.en: Our old training method proved ineffective.
sentences.zh: 我們舊的訓練方法被證明效果不佳。

sentences.en: Is this pain medicine ineffective once it expires?
sentences.zh: 這種止痛藥過期後就沒效了嗎？

sentences.en: Long emails are often ineffective for urgent messages.
sentences.zh: 冗長的電子郵件用來傳達緊急訊息，往往效果不佳。

sentences.en: The fence was ineffective at keeping the dog in.
sentences.zh: 這道圍籬擋不住狗。

sentences.en: We need to fix the inefficiency in our ordering process.
sentences.zh: 我們得解決訂購流程效率低落的問題。

sentences.en: Where do you see the biggest inefficiency in our workflow?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們的工作流程哪裡最沒效率？

sentences.en: Waste and inefficiency cost the company millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 浪費與低效率讓公司損失了數百萬美元。

sentences.en: Could automation reduce inefficiency in the warehouse?
sentences.zh: 自動化能減少倉庫的低效率嗎？

sentences.en: Slow elevators are a daily inefficiency in this building.
sentences.zh: 電梯太慢是這棟大樓每天都有的低效率問題。

sentences.en: The audit found several inefficiencies in the billing system.
sentences.zh: 稽核發現帳務系統有好幾處效率不彰的地方。

gloss_note: infectious laugh 有感染力的笑聲

sentences.en: The flu is highly infectious in crowded classrooms.
sentences.zh: 流感在擁擠的教室裡傳染性很高。

sentences.en: Is a cold still infectious after the fever goes away?
sentences.zh: 感冒退燒後還會傳染嗎？

sentences.en: Her laugh is so infectious that everyone joins in.
sentences.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，大家都跟著笑了起來。

sentences.en: Which infectious diseases can vaccines prevent?
sentences.zh: 疫苗能預防哪些傳染病？

sentences.en: The coach's enthusiasm was infectious during practice.
sentences.zh: 教練的熱情在練習時很有感染力。

sentences.en: Doctors warn that this virus is extremely infectious.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告這種病毒的傳染力極強。

sentences.en: What happens when a number goes to infinity?
sentences.zh: 當一個數字趨近無窮大時會怎樣？

sentences.en: Is there a largest number, or does it go on to infinity?
sentences.zh: 有最大的數嗎，還是會一直延伸到無限大？

sentences.en: The symbol for infinity looks like a sideways number eight.
sentences.zh: 無窮大的符號看起來像橫放的數字8。

sentences.en: The line on this graph stretches out toward infinity.
sentences.zh: 這張圖上的線朝無限遠處延伸。

sentences.en: My nephew said he could count to infinity, but he fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 我外甥說他可以數到無限大，結果睡著了。

sentences.en: The universe seems to stretch out to infinity.
sentences.zh: 宇宙看起來一直延伸到無限遠。

gloss_note: take the initiative 採取主動

sentences.en: She took the initiative and organized the whole team lunch.
sentences.zh: 她主動出面，把全組的午餐都安排好了。

sentences.en: Do you think he shows enough initiative for this job?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他夠主動，適合這份工作嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor announced a new initiative to clean up the river.
sentences.zh: 市長宣布了一項整治河川的新計畫。

sentences.en: Our manager likes people who show initiative.
sentences.zh: 我們經理喜歡有主動性的人。

sentences.en: Can we launch this initiative before the end of the quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們能在本季結束前推動這項新計畫嗎？

sentences.en: Nobody told me to do it. I did it on my own initiative.
sentences.zh: 沒人叫我做，是我自己主動做的。

sentences.en: Some people believe musical talent is innate.
sentences.zh: 有些人認為音樂才華是天生的。

sentences.en: Is the fear of heights innate, or do we learn it?
sentences.zh: 懼高是天生的，還是後天學來的？

sentences.en: Babies seem to have an innate ability to learn language.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒似乎天生就有學習語言的能力。

sentences.en: Do you think good leadership is innate?
sentences.zh: 你覺得領導能力是天生的嗎？

sentences.en: My dog has an innate sense of direction.
sentences.zh: 我的狗天生就有很好的方向感。

sentences.en: Researchers are studying which language skills are innate.
sentences.zh: 研究人員正在研究哪些語言能力是天生的。

sentences.en: Who's pitching in the ninth inning?
sentences.zh: 第九局是誰上場投球？

sentences.en: We were down by two runs in the last inning.
sentences.zh: 最後一局我們落後兩分。

sentences.en: Are we staying for the whole game or leaving after the seventh inning?
sentences.zh: 我們要看完整場比賽，還是第七局後就走？

sentences.en: He hit a home run in the third inning.
sentences.zh: 他在第三局打出一支全壘打。

sentences.en: The game went into extra innings.
sentences.zh: 比賽打進了延長賽。

sentences.en: Kids get tired by the fifth inning and ask for snacks.
sentences.zh: 孩子們到第五局就累了，吵著要吃點心。

sentences.en: Our company encourages innovation at every level.
sentences.zh: 我們公司鼓勵各個層級創新。

sentences.en: What was the biggest innovation in phones this year?
sentences.zh: 今年手機最大的創新是什麼？

sentences.en: Is this new design a real innovation or just a new look?
sentences.zh: 這個新設計是真正的創新，還是只是換個外觀？

sentences.en: Many innovations come from small startups.
sentences.zh: 許多創新都來自小型新創公司。

sentences.en: She won an award for her innovation in teaching math.
sentences.zh: 她因在數學教學上的創新而獲獎。

sentences.en: Innovation takes time, and it often takes many failed tries.
sentences.zh: 創新需要時間，往往得經過很多次失敗的嘗試。

sentences.en: I'm writing in response to your inquiry about our prices.
sentences.zh: 我是來回覆您詢問我們價格的來信。

sentences.en: Did you get an inquiry from that customer yet?
sentences.zh: 那位客戶的詢問你收到了嗎？

sentences.en: How many customer inquiries do we get each day?
sentences.zh: 我們每天會收到多少客戶詢問？

sentences.en: Thank you for your inquiry. We will reply within two days.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您的詢問，我們會在兩天內回覆。

sentences.en: All inquiries should go through the front desk.
sentences.zh: 所有詢問都應該透過櫃檯處理。

sentences.en: He made an inquiry at the bank about a small loan.
sentences.zh: 他到銀行詢問小額貸款的事。

gloss_note: 口語：insane traffic 離譜的車流

sentences.en: The traffic on the freeway was insane this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上高速公路的車流多得離譜。

sentences.en: That price is way too high. Are you insane?
sentences.zh: 這價格也太高了吧，你瘋了嗎？

sentences.en: Did you see that insane catch in the game last night?
sentences.zh: 你有看到昨晚比賽那個瘋狂的接殺嗎？

sentences.en: He works insane hours during tax season.
sentences.zh: 報稅季期間，他的工時多得離譜。

sentences.en: That roller coaster looks insane.
sentences.zh: 那座雲霄飛車看起來太瘋狂了。

sentences.en: It's insane how fast the rent keeps going up.
sentences.zh: 房租漲得這麼快，真是離譜。

gloss_note: gain insight into 深入了解

sentences.en: Her report gave us real insight into customer habits.
sentences.zh: 她的報告讓我們深入了解顧客的習慣。

sentences.en: Can you give me some insight into how this process works?
sentences.zh: 你能讓我深入了解這個流程是怎麼運作的嗎？

sentences.en: That's a great insight. I never thought of it that way.
sentences.zh: 這見解很棒，我從沒那樣想過。

sentences.en: What insights did you get from the survey results?
sentences.zh: 你從問卷結果中得到了什麼見解？

sentences.en: Reading old letters gave the author insight into her grandmother's life.
sentences.zh: 讀那些舊信件，讓作者深入了解她祖母的生活。

sentences.en: He has a lot of insight for someone so young.
sentences.zh: 以他這麼年輕來說，他很有洞察力。

sentences.en: Which financial institution do you use for your savings?
sentences.zh: 你的存款放在哪一家金融機構？

sentences.en: The university is one of the oldest institutions in the state.
sentences.zh: 這所大學是該州最古老的機構之一。

sentences.en: Is your bank a large institution or a small local one?
sentences.zh: 你的銀行是大型機構，還是小型的在地銀行？

sentences.en: Schools and hospitals are important public institutions.
sentences.zh: 學校和醫院都是重要的公共機構。

sentences.en: Our town has several educational institutions, including two colleges.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上有好幾所教育機構，包括兩所學院。

sentences.en: After 2008, many people lost trust in large financial institutions.
sentences.zh: 2008年後，許多人對大型金融機構失去了信任。

gloss_note: 新聞用語，指有組織的武裝叛亂

sentences.en: The news reported a growing insurgency in the northern region.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導北部地區的叛亂正在擴大。

sentences.en: How did the government respond to the insurgency?
sentences.zh: 政府如何回應這場叛亂？

sentences.en: Did you watch that documentary about the insurgency last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有看那部關於叛亂的紀錄片嗎？

sentences.en: Historians still debate why the insurgency lasted so long.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家仍在爭論這場叛亂為何持續那麼久。

sentences.en: The novel describes a village caught in the middle of an insurgency.
sentences.zh: 這本小說描寫一個被捲入叛亂中的村莊。

sentences.en: The film is about a soldier sent to fight an insurgency.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講述一名士兵被派去對抗叛亂的故事。

gloss_note: 新聞用語；亦可作形容詞

sentences.en: The report said insurgents had taken control of two towns.
sentences.zh: 報導說叛軍已控制兩座城鎮。

sentences.en: In the movie, the insurgent leader hides in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，叛軍領袖躲在山裡。

sentences.en: Who was the insurgent leader in that war movie?
sentences.zh: 那部戰爭電影裡的叛軍領袖是誰？

sentences.en: My history teacher explained how insurgents fought in small groups.
sentences.zh: 我的歷史老師解釋了叛軍如何以小股部隊作戰。

sentences.en: How did the insurgents get their supplies?
sentences.zh: 叛軍是怎麼取得補給的？

sentences.en: Talks began between the government and the insurgents.
sentences.zh: 政府與叛軍展開了談判。

sentences.en: The package arrived with everything intact.
sentences.zh: 包裹送到時，裡面的東西都完好無缺。

sentences.en: Is the box still intact, or did the movers damage it?
sentences.zh: 這個箱子還完好嗎，還是被搬家工人弄壞了？

sentences.en: Amazingly, the old bridge stayed intact after the storm.
sentences.zh: 說來神奇，那座老橋在暴風雨後仍完好無損。

sentences.en: Was the seal intact when you opened the jar?
sentences.zh: 你打開罐子時，封條是完好的嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep the label intact so we can process your return.
sentences.zh: 請保持標籤完整，我們才能處理您的退貨。

sentences.en: Most of the ancient pottery was found intact.
sentences.zh: 大部分古代陶器出土時都完好無缺。

gloss_note: integrate A into B 把A整合進B

sentences.en: We need to integrate the new software with our old system.
sentences.zh: 我們需要把新軟體和舊系統整合起來。

sentences.en: How long will it take to integrate the two teams?
sentences.zh: 整合這兩個團隊要花多久？

sentences.en: Does this program integrate with our email?
sentences.zh: 這個程式能和我們的電子郵件整合嗎？

sentences.en: She is working hard to integrate into her new school.
sentences.zh: 她正努力融入新學校。

sentences.en: Our goal is to integrate art into every subject.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是把藝術融入每一門科目。

sentences.en: Let's integrate the customer feedback into the final design.
sentences.zh: 我們把客戶意見整合進最終設計吧。

sentences.en: Police said they would intensify patrols near the school.
sentences.zh: 警方表示會加強學校附近的巡邏。

sentences.en: The storm is expected to intensify overnight.
sentences.zh: 預計暴風雨會在夜間增強。

sentences.en: Will the pressure on sales intensify next quarter?
sentences.zh: 下一季的銷售壓力會加劇嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the competition intensify so quickly this year?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今年競爭加劇得這麼快？

sentences.en: We must intensify our efforts to finish before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我們必須加緊努力，在截止日前完成。

sentences.en: The pain began to intensify, so he called the doctor.
sentences.zh: 疼痛開始加劇，所以他打電話給醫生。

sentences.en: The museum has an interactive map of the old city.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一張舊城區的互動式地圖。

sentences.en: Is the training session interactive, or just a lecture?
sentences.zh: 這場培訓是互動式的，還是只有演講？

sentences.en: Kids learn faster with interactive games.
sentences.zh: 孩子用互動式遊戲學得更快。

sentences.en: Our website now has an interactive chart for sales data.
sentences.zh: 我們的網站現在有銷售資料的互動式圖表。

sentences.en: Can we make the presentation more interactive?
sentences.zh: 我們能讓簡報更有互動性嗎？

sentences.en: I like interactive classes where I can ask questions.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡可以提問的互動式課程。

gloss_note: intercept a pass 攔截傳球

sentences.en: The defender intercepted the pass and ran the other way.
sentences.zh: 防守球員攔截了傳球，往反方向跑。

sentences.en: Can anyone intercept messages sent over this network?
sentences.zh: 有人能攔截經由這個網路傳送的訊息嗎？

sentences.en: Security guards intercepted the man before he reached the stage.
sentences.zh: 警衛在那名男子走上舞台前攔住了他。

sentences.en: Customs officers intercepted a shipment of fake watches at the airport.
sentences.zh: 海關人員在機場攔截了一批假手錶。

sentences.en: Did you see that player intercept the ball?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那名球員攔截到球嗎？

sentences.en: Hackers tried to intercept the company's emails.
sentences.zh: 駭客試圖截取公司的電子郵件。

sentences.en: There's a lot of interference on this phone line.
sentences.zh: 這條電話線的雜音干擾很多。

sentences.en: Is something causing interference with the Wi-Fi signal?
sentences.zh: 是不是有什麼東西在干擾無線網路訊號？

sentences.en: My boss hates interference from other departments.
sentences.zh: 我老闆討厭其他部門的干涉。

sentences.en: Did the manager's interference slow down the project?
sentences.zh: 經理的干涉讓這個計畫變慢了嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep your phone away from the speaker to avoid interference.
sentences.zh: 請把手機拿離喇叭，以免產生干擾。

sentences.en: The team finished without any interference from management.
sentences.zh: 團隊在沒有管理層干涉的情況下完成了工作。

sentences.en: The interior of the car smells like fresh leather.
sentences.zh: 車子內部聞起來有新皮革的味道。

sentences.en: Who designed the interior of this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的室內裝潢是誰設計的？

sentences.en: Paint the interior walls a light color to brighten the room.
sentences.zh: 把室內牆壁漆成淺色，讓房間更明亮。

sentences.en: Cook until the interior of the chicken reaches 165 degrees.
sentences.zh: 把雞肉煮到內部達到華氏165度。

sentences.en: Can we see the interior of the house before we decide?
sentences.zh: 我們決定之前能先看看房子的內部嗎？

sentences.en: The interior of the cave stays cool even in summer.
sentences.zh: 洞穴內部即使在夏天也很涼爽。

sentences.en: We'll handle this issue internally before telling the client.
sentences.zh: 我們會先在公司內部處理這個問題，再告訴客戶。

sentences.en: Did you share the report internally or send it out?
sentences.zh: 你是在內部分享了這份報告，還是寄出去了？

sentences.en: The new policy was announced internally on Monday.
sentences.zh: 新政策週一已在公司內部公布。

sentences.en: Do you promote people internally or hire from outside?
sentences.zh: 你們是內部升遷，還是對外聘人？

sentences.en: The company decided to investigate the matter internally.
sentences.zh: 公司決定在內部調查這件事。

sentences.en: Let's discuss the price internally and call you back.
sentences.zh: 讓我們先內部討論價格，再回電給您。

sentences.en: What's your interpretation of the poem's last line?
sentences.zh: 你對這首詩最後一行的解讀是什麼？

sentences.en: The two judges had different interpretations of the rule.
sentences.zh: 兩位裁判對這條規則有不同的解讀。

sentences.en: Is that the only possible interpretation of these numbers?
sentences.zh: 這些數字只能有那一種解讀嗎？

sentences.en: Her interpretation of the song made the audience cry.
sentences.zh: 她對這首歌的詮釋讓觀眾落淚。

sentences.en: The contract is open to interpretation, so let's ask a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 這份合約有解讀空間，我們問問律師吧。

sentences.en: My interpretation is that sales dropped because of the weather.
sentences.zh: 我的解讀是，銷售下滑是因為天氣。

sentences.en: Without the teacher's intervention, the argument would have gotten worse.
sentences.zh: 沒有老師的介入，爭吵會變得更嚴重。

sentences.en: Did the patient need any medical intervention?
sentences.zh: 病人需要任何醫療介入嗎？

sentences.en: Early intervention can help children with reading problems.
sentences.zh: 及早介入能幫助有閱讀困難的孩子。

sentences.en: Is outside intervention really necessary in this dispute?
sentences.zh: 在這場爭議中，真的有必要由外人介入嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks to his quick intervention, nobody got hurt.
sentences.zh: 多虧他及時介入，沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: Intervention by a neutral mediator helped both sides reach a deal.
sentences.zh: 中立調解人的介入，幫助雙方達成協議。

sentences.en: The interviewer asked me about my last job.
sentences.zh: 面試官問了我上一份工作的事。

sentences.en: Was the interviewer friendly, or did she seem tough?
sentences.zh: 面試官友善嗎，還是看起來很嚴格？

sentences.en: How should I dress to impress the interviewer?
sentences.zh: 我該怎麼穿，才能給面試官好印象？

sentences.en: The interviewer on the radio show asked great questions.
sentences.zh: 廣播節目的訪問者問了很棒的問題。

sentences.en: Always thank the interviewer for her time.
sentences.zh: 一定要謝謝面試官撥出時間。

sentences.en: The survey interviewer knocked on our door at noon.
sentences.zh: 問卷訪員中午來敲我們家的門。

gloss_note: be intrigued by 對…很感興趣

sentences.en: The new idea intrigued the investors right away.
sentences.zh: 這個新點子馬上引起了投資人的興趣。

sentences.en: What about the proposal intrigues you the most?
sentences.zh: 這項提案哪一點最讓你感興趣？

sentences.en: Does the title of the book intrigue you?
sentences.zh: 這本書的書名會引起你的興趣嗎？

sentences.en: I'm intrigued by your offer. Can we talk more?
sentences.zh: 您的提議引起了我的興趣，我們能多談談嗎？

sentences.en: Strange sounds from the basement always intrigue my kids.
sentences.zh: 地下室傳來的怪聲總是讓我的孩子們好奇。

sentences.en: The mystery of the old house intrigued everyone in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 老房子的謎團引起了整個社區的好奇。

gloss_note: word order inversion 語序倒裝

sentences.en: Today we will study inversion in English questions.
sentences.zh: 今天我們要學英語問句中的倒裝。

sentences.en: Is this an inversion of the usual word order?
sentences.zh: 這是一般語序的倒置嗎？

sentences.en: The poem uses inversion to put the verb first.
sentences.zh: 這首詩用倒裝把動詞放在前面。

sentences.en: The movie's twist is a complete inversion of what we expected.
sentences.zh: 電影的轉折完全顛倒了我們原本的預期。

sentences.en: Why does inversion happen when a sentence begins with a negative word?
sentences.zh: 為什麼句子以否定詞開頭時會出現倒裝？

sentences.en: She showed us an inversion of the image, with black and white switched.
sentences.zh: 她給我們看那張圖像的倒置版，黑白互換。

gloss_note: invert the cake 把蛋糕倒扣

sentences.en: Invert the pan onto a plate to release the cake.
sentences.zh: 把烤盤倒扣在盤子上，讓蛋糕脫模。

sentences.en: Should I invert the cup before I put it in the dishwasher?
sentences.zh: 我把杯子放進洗碗機之前，要先倒過來嗎？

sentences.en: If you invert the triangle, the point faces down.
sentences.zh: 如果你把三角形倒過來，尖角就會朝下。

sentences.en: Why do we invert the second fraction when we divide?
sentences.zh: 做除法時，為什麼要把第二個分數倒過來？

sentences.en: The magician inverted the glass, but the water stayed inside.
sentences.zh: 魔術師把杯子倒過來，水卻還留在裡面。

sentences.en: Gently invert the bottle a few times to mix the dressing.
sentences.zh: 輕輕把瓶子倒轉幾次，讓醬汁混合均勻。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. TheDaveRoss assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The investigator asked everyone in the office a few questions.
sentences.zh: 調查員問了辦公室裡每個人幾個問題。

sentences.en: Who is the lead investigator on this case?
sentences.zh: 這個案子的主要調查員是誰？

sentences.en: Did the insurance investigator visit your house yet?
sentences.zh: 保險公司的調查員已經去過你家了嗎？

sentences.en: Investigators are still looking into what caused the fire.
sentences.zh: 調查人員仍在調查火災的起因。

sentences.en: She works as an investigator for the state labor office.
sentences.zh: 她在州勞工局擔任調查員。

sentences.en: The investigator in the movie always wears a long coat.
sentences.zh: 那部電影裡的偵探總是穿著長大衣。

sentences.en: The irony is that the fire station itself caught fire.
sentences.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局本身竟然起火了。

sentences.en: Do you see the irony in a bakery that's out of bread?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有看出，麵包店竟然沒麵包的諷刺？

sentences.en: There is a little irony in buying a gym membership and never going.
sentences.zh: 辦了健身房會員卻從不去，這有點諷刺。

sentences.en: My teacher said the story is full of irony.
sentences.zh: 老師說這個故事充滿了諷刺。

sentences.en: Can you explain the irony in the title of this novel?
sentences.zh: 你能解釋這本小說書名裡的諷刺意味嗎？

sentences.en: He said "Great weather!" in the rain, and the irony made us laugh.
sentences.zh: 他在雨中說「天氣真好！」，那份諷刺讓我們都笑了。

sentences.en: Farmers in dry areas depend on irrigation.
sentences.zh: 乾旱地區的農民仰賴灌溉。

sentences.en: How does drip irrigation save water?
sentences.zh: 滴灌如何節省用水？

sentences.en: The new irrigation system watered the whole field in two hours.
sentences.zh: 新的灌溉系統兩小時就澆完了整片田。

sentences.en: Is irrigation the reason this valley is so green?
sentences.zh: 這座山谷這麼翠綠，是因為灌溉嗎？

sentences.en: Ancient people built canals for irrigation thousands of years ago.
sentences.zh: 古人在數千年前就挖運河來灌溉。

sentences.en: We set up an irrigation timer for the backyard garden.
sentences.zh: 我們為後院的菜園裝了灌溉定時器。

sentences.en: My roommate studies journalism at a state university.
sentences.zh: 我的室友在州立大學讀新聞系。

sentences.en: Is journalism still a good career today?
sentences.zh: 新聞業在今天仍是好職業嗎？

sentences.en: Good journalism checks the facts before it publishes a story.
sentences.zh: 好的新聞工作會在刊登報導前先查證事實。

sentences.en: What made you choose a career in journalism?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼選擇從事新聞業？

sentences.en: She won a prize for her work in local journalism.
sentences.zh: 她因在地方新聞工作的表現而獲獎。

sentences.en: Online news has changed journalism a lot.
sentences.zh: 網路新聞大大改變了新聞業。

gloss_note: a jug of milk 一大罐牛奶

sentences.en: Can you pick up a jug of milk on the way home?
sentences.zh: 你回家路上可以順便買一大罐牛奶嗎？

sentences.en: We keep a water jug in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 我們冰箱裡放了一壺水。

sentences.en: Would you pass me the jug of orange juice?
sentences.zh: 可以把那壺柳橙汁遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: He filled the jug at the kitchen sink.
sentences.zh: 他在廚房水槽把水壺裝滿了水。

sentences.en: Is that jug big enough for the whole team?
sentences.zh: 那個水壺夠整支球隊喝嗎？

sentences.en: Grandma kept an old glass jug on the porch.
sentences.zh: 奶奶在門廊上放了一個舊的玻璃罐。

sentences.en: I got a notice to serve on a jury next month.
sentences.zh: 我收到通知，下個月要擔任陪審團成員。

sentences.en: The jury took three days to reach a decision.
sentences.zh: 陪審團花了三天才作出裁決。

sentences.en: Do you think the jury will believe his story?
sentences.zh: 你覺得陪審團會相信他的說法嗎？

sentences.en: Have you ever been called for jury duty?
sentences.zh: 你有被通知去擔任過陪審員嗎？

sentences.en: The jury was made up of twelve ordinary citizens.
sentences.zh: 陪審團由十二位一般市民組成。

sentences.en: The lawyer spoke slowly so the jury could follow.
sentences.zh: 律師說得很慢，好讓陪審團聽得懂。

gloss_note: justify the cost 說明花費合理

sentences.en: How can you justify spending so much on one dinner?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼能說花這麼多錢吃一頓晚餐是合理的？

sentences.en: Nothing can justify that kind of behavior.
sentences.zh: 沒有任何理由能讓那種行為說得過去。

sentences.en: I don't think the results justify the cost.
sentences.zh: 我不認為這些成果能證明這筆花費是合理的。

sentences.en: Can you justify the price increase to our customers?
sentences.zh: 你能向客戶說明漲價的正當理由嗎？

sentences.en: He tried to justify being late by blaming the traffic.
sentences.zh: 他把遲到怪到塞車頭上，想替自己找理由。

sentences.en: Do we have enough data to justify a new store?
sentences.zh: 我們有足夠的資料來證明開新店是合理的嗎？

sentences.en: Juvenile court handles cases for people under eighteen.
sentences.zh: 少年法庭處理未滿十八歲者的案件。

sentences.en: Is this book for juvenile readers or adults?
sentences.zh: 這本書是給青少年讀者，還是給成人的？

sentences.en: Juvenile crime rates dropped in our county last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我們郡的青少年犯罪率下降了。

sentences.en: Do juveniles need a parent with them in court?
sentences.zh: 青少年上法庭需要家長陪同嗎？

sentences.en: The library has a large section of juvenile fiction.
sentences.zh: 圖書館有一大區青少年小說。

sentences.en: The judge said juvenile records are usually kept private.
sentences.zh: 法官說青少年的前科紀錄通常不公開。

gloss_note: kidnap for ransom 綁架勒贖

sentences.en: The movie starts when criminals kidnap a rich man's daughter.
sentences.zh: 電影從歹徒綁架富翁的女兒開始。

sentences.en: Who kidnapped the little girl in the detective novel?
sentences.zh: 偵探小說裡是誰綁架了那個小女孩？

sentences.en: Why would someone kidnap a pet dog and ask for money?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人會綁架寵物狗還要錢？

sentences.en: Police believe the man was kidnapped on his way home.
sentences.zh: 警方認為那名男子在回家途中被綁架。

sentences.en: The story tells how pirates once tried to kidnap a young prince.
sentences.zh: 故事講述海盜曾企圖綁架一位年輕王子。

sentences.en: In the game, you must rescue a kidnapped princess.
sentences.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，你必須救出被綁架的公主。

gloss_note: killer app 殺手級應用程式

sentences.en: What's the killer feature of your new software?
sentences.zh: 你們新軟體的殺手級功能是什麼？

sentences.en: We need a killer app to win over customers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一款殺手級應用程式來爭取顧客。

sentences.en: Her killer presentation impressed the whole board.
sentences.zh: 她那場超強的簡報讓整個董事會印象深刻。

sentences.en: Does this phone have a killer camera?
sentences.zh: 這支手機有超強的相機嗎？

sentences.en: The startup's killer idea made it famous overnight.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司的超強點子讓它一夜爆紅。

sentences.en: She has a killer resume, so she'll get an interview.
sentences.zh: 她的履歷超強，所以一定能拿到面試機會。

sentences.en: Mom makes the best lasagna I've ever had.
sentences.zh: 媽媽做的千層麵是我吃過最好吃的。

sentences.en: Can I get the lasagna with a side salad?
sentences.zh: 我可以點千層麵，附一份沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: Is the lasagna vegetarian, or does it have meat?
sentences.zh: 這份千層麵是素的，還是有肉？

sentences.en: The lasagna needs another twenty minutes in the oven.
sentences.zh: 千層麵還需要在烤箱裡再烤二十分鐘。

sentences.en: We brought lasagna to the new neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我們帶了千層麵給新搬來的鄰居。

sentences.en: Leftover lasagna tastes even better the next day.
sentences.zh: 吃剩的千層麵隔天更好吃。

sentences.en: Our office just bought a new laser printer.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室剛買了一台新的雷射印表機。

sentences.en: Do you know how a laser works?
sentences.zh: 你知道雷射是怎麼運作的嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors can use a laser to fix some eye problems.
sentences.zh: 醫師可以用雷射矯正某些眼睛的問題。

sentences.en: Never shine a laser into anyone's eyes.
sentences.zh: 絕對不要把雷射照向任何人的眼睛。

sentences.en: The speaker used a red laser to point at the slide.
sentences.zh: 講者用紅色雷射光指著投影片。

sentences.en: Does your clinic use a laser for hair removal?
sentences.zh: 你們診所有用雷射去除體毛嗎？

sentences.en: The movie shows criminals trying to launder money through a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 電影演出罪犯試圖透過餐廳洗錢。

sentences.en: How do banks stop people from laundering money?
sentences.zh: 銀行如何防止人們洗錢？

sentences.en: The newspaper said the company helped launder millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 報紙說這家公司協助洗了數百萬美元的錢。

sentences.en: Could small shops be used to launder money?
sentences.zh: 小商店有可能被用來洗錢嗎？

sentences.en: In the novel, a lawyer launders cash for a powerful family.
sentences.zh: 小說裡，一名律師替一個有權勢的家族洗錢。

sentences.en: Employees are trained to spot attempts to launder money.
sentences.zh: 員工受過訓練，要能發現洗錢的企圖。

sentences.en: Lawmakers will vote on the new budget next week.
sentences.zh: 議員們下週將就新預算投票。

sentences.en: Which lawmaker introduced the bill about bike lanes?
sentences.zh: 是哪位議員提出了自行車道的法案？

sentences.en: A local lawmaker visited our class on Friday.
sentences.zh: 一位本地議員週五來我們班拜訪。

sentences.en: Lawmakers in our state want to lower the speed limit near schools.
sentences.zh: 我們州的議員想降低學校附近的速限。

sentences.en: How many lawmakers are there in the state senate?
sentences.zh: 州參議院有多少位議員？

sentences.en: The lawmaker explained the bill in simple terms.
sentences.zh: 那位議員用簡單的話解釋了這項法案。

sentences.en: Put a layer of cheese on top of the noodles.
sentences.zh: 在麵條上鋪一層起司。

sentences.en: It's cold out, so wear a few layers.
sentences.zh: 外面很冷，所以多穿幾層衣服。

sentences.en: The ozone layer protects us from harmful rays from the sun.
sentences.zh: 臭氧層保護我們免受太陽有害射線的傷害。

sentences.en: How many layers does this chocolate cake have?
sentences.zh: 這個巧克力蛋糕有幾層？

sentences.en: A thin layer of dust covered the old piano.
sentences.zh: 一層薄薄的灰塵覆蓋著那架舊鋼琴。

sentences.en: Is there another layer of security I need to pass?
sentences.zh: 我還要通過另一層安全檢查嗎？

gloss_note: play in a league 參加聯賽

sentences.en: Our company has a softball team in the local league.
sentences.zh: 我們公司在本地聯賽有一支壘球隊。

sentences.en: Which team is leading the league right now?
sentences.zh: 現在是哪一隊在聯賽中領先？

sentences.en: My son joined a youth soccer league this fall.
sentences.zh: 我兒子今年秋天加入了青少年足球聯盟。

sentences.en: Did your team make it into the league playoffs?
sentences.zh: 你們隊進了聯賽的季後賽嗎？

sentences.en: The league announced a new schedule for next season.
sentences.zh: 聯盟公布了下個球季的新賽程。

sentences.en: She's the best player in the whole league.
sentences.zh: 她是整個聯盟裡最好的球員。

gloss_note: a legendary figure 傳奇人物

sentences.en: He's a legendary basketball coach in this town.
sentences.zh: 他是這座城鎮裡傳奇的籃球教練。

sentences.en: Is this the legendary restaurant everyone talks about?
sentences.zh: 這就是大家都在討論的那家傳奇餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: The singer's legendary voice filled the whole stadium.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手傳奇般的嗓音響徹整座體育場。

sentences.en: Have you heard the legendary story of the lost treasure?
sentences.zh: 你聽過失落寶藏的傳奇故事嗎？

sentences.en: Our boss is legendary for answering emails at midnight.
sentences.zh: 老闆半夜回覆電子郵件的事蹟堪稱傳奇。

sentences.en: That legendary game is still talked about today.
sentences.zh: 那場傳奇比賽至今仍被人們談論。

sentences.en: New legislation on data privacy takes effect next year.
sentences.zh: 有關資料隱私的新法規將於明年生效。
