sentences.en: Is there any legislation about working from home?
sentences.zh: 有沒有關於居家工作的法規？

sentences.en: Lawmakers are working on legislation to protect small farms.
sentences.zh: 議員們正在擬定保護小型農場的立法。

sentences.en: Does this legislation apply to small businesses?
sentences.zh: 這項法規適用於小型企業嗎？

sentences.en: The legislation passed after months of debate.
sentences.zh: 這項立法在數個月的辯論後通過了。

sentences.en: Our lawyer keeps up with new legislation on safety rules.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師隨時關注有關安全規定的新法規。

sentences.en: The auditor checked the legitimacy of every payment.
sentences.zh: 稽核員查核了每筆付款的合法性。

sentences.en: How can we prove the legitimacy of this supplier?
sentences.zh: 我們怎麼證明這家供應商的合法性？

sentences.en: Investors want proof of the company's legitimacy before they invest.
sentences.zh: 投資人投資前，想看到公司合法性的證明。

sentences.en: Does the contract's legitimacy depend on both signatures?
sentences.zh: 這份合約的合法性取決於雙方簽名嗎？

sentences.en: Some people doubted the legitimacy of the online store.
sentences.zh: 有些人質疑這家網路商店的合法性。

sentences.en: A license gives the clinic legitimacy in the eyes of patients.
sentences.zh: 執照讓診所在病患眼中具有正當性。

sentences.en: A lever helps you lift a heavy rock with little effort.
sentences.zh: 槓桿能讓你用很小的力氣抬起沉重的石頭。

sentences.en: Which lever do I pull to raise the seat?
sentences.zh: 我要拉哪一根操縱桿才能把座椅升高？

sentences.en: Do you know how a lever makes work easier?
sentences.zh: 你知道槓桿如何讓工作變輕鬆嗎？

sentences.en: Push the lever down to start the machine.
sentences.zh: 把操縱桿往下壓就能啟動機器。

sentences.en: The old coffee machine has a lever on the side.
sentences.zh: 那台老咖啡機側面有一根拉桿。

sentences.en: In physics class, we built a lever from a ruler and a pencil.
sentences.zh: 物理課上，我們用尺和鉛筆做了一個槓桿。

sentences.en: The company accepted liability for the damage.
sentences.zh: 公司承認對這項損害負有法律責任。

sentences.en: Who has liability if the package gets lost?
sentences.zh: 如果包裹遺失，誰要負法律責任？

sentences.en: Does the contract limit our liability?
sentences.zh: 這份合約有限制我們的責任嗎？

sentences.en: The store has insurance to cover its liability.
sentences.zh: 這家店有保險來承擔它的責任。

sentences.en: Our biggest liability this year is the loan for the new building.
sentences.zh: 今年我們最大的負債是新大樓的貸款。

sentences.en: Is a company's debt considered a liability on the balance sheet?
sentences.zh: 公司的債務在資產負債表上算負債嗎？

gloss_note: liberalize trade 放寬貿易管制

sentences.en: The country decided to liberalize its trade rules.
sentences.zh: 這個國家決定放寬貿易規定。

sentences.en: Why did the government liberalize the energy market?
sentences.zh: 政府為什麼要讓能源市場自由化？

sentences.en: Experts say liberalizing the market could lower prices.
sentences.zh: 專家說讓市場自由化可能會壓低價格。

sentences.en: Will they liberalize the rules for foreign investors?
sentences.zh: 他們會放寬外國投資人的規定嗎？

sentences.en: The new law will liberalize rules for opening a small business.
sentences.zh: 新法將放寬開設小型企業的規定。

sentences.en: Some economists want to liberalize the airline industry further.
sentences.zh: 一些經濟學家希望進一步讓航空業自由化。

sentences.en: Do you have a lighter? I need to light the candles.
sentences.zh: 你有打火機嗎？我要點蠟燭。

sentences.en: I always keep a lighter in my camping bag.
sentences.zh: 我的露營包裡總是放著一個打火機。

sentences.en: Can you hand me the lighter for the grill?
sentences.zh: 你可以把烤肉爐的打火機遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: Where did I leave my lighter?
sentences.zh: 我把打火機放哪了？

sentences.en: The kitchen lighter ran out of gas.
sentences.zh: 廚房的打火機沒瓦斯了。

sentences.en: Airport security found a lighter in my backpack.
sentences.zh: 機場安檢在我的背包裡發現了一個打火機。

sentences.en: Please don't talk so loudly in the library.
sentences.zh: 請不要在圖書館裡這麼大聲說話。

sentences.en: The baby cried loudly all through the flight.
sentences.zh: 那個嬰兒在整趟航程中一直大聲哭鬧。

sentences.en: Why is your neighbor playing music so loudly?
sentences.zh: 你鄰居為什麼把音樂放得這麼大聲？

sentences.en: I can't hear you. Can you speak more loudly?
sentences.zh: 我聽不到你說話，你可以說大聲一點嗎？

sentences.en: The crowd cheered loudly when the team scored.
sentences.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾大聲歡呼。

sentences.en: He knocked loudly on the hotel room door.
sentences.zh: 他大聲敲著飯店房間的門。

sentences.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance until noon.
sentences.zh: 電梯在中午前因維修而停用。

sentences.en: How often does this car need maintenance?
sentences.zh: 這輛車多久需要保養一次？

sentences.en: Regular maintenance can save you a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 定期保養可以幫你省下很多錢。

sentences.en: Our landlord handles all the maintenance in the building.
sentences.zh: 房東負責大樓裡所有的維修工作。

sentences.en: Did you call maintenance about the leaking sink?
sentences.zh: 你有通知維修人員水槽漏水的事嗎？

sentences.en: My bike needs some maintenance before the weekend ride.
sentences.zh: 我的腳踏車在週末騎乘前需要保養一下。

gloss_note: whale 鯨魚、bat 蝙蝠都是哺乳動物

sentences.en: A whale is a mammal, not a fish.
sentences.zh: 鯨魚是哺乳動物，不是魚。

sentences.en: Is a bat a bird or a mammal?
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠是鳥還是哺乳動物？

sentences.en: Which mammal is the largest on Earth?
sentences.zh: 地球上最大的哺乳動物是哪一種？

sentences.en: Mother mammals feed their babies milk.
sentences.zh: 哺乳動物媽媽都會用乳汁餵養寶寶。

sentences.en: We saw a small mammal run across the trail.
sentences.zh: 我們看到一隻小型哺乳動物跑過步道。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to name three mammals.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們說出三種哺乳動物。

gloss_note: 美式拼法；room to maneuver 迴旋空間

sentences.en: The company made a clever maneuver to avoid higher taxes.
sentences.zh: 公司採取了一個聰明的策略來避開較高的稅。

sentences.en: Can we maneuver this proposal past the legal team?
sentences.zh: 我們能想辦法讓這份提案順利通過法務部門嗎？

sentences.en: She tried to maneuver the discussion toward a better price.
sentences.zh: 她設法把討論引導到更好的價格上。

sentences.en: Our manager pulled off a smart maneuver in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理在會議中使出了很聰明的一招。

sentences.en: Do we have any room to maneuver on the budget?
sentences.zh: 預算方面我們還有調整的空間嗎？

sentences.en: It took careful maneuvering to keep the deal alive.
sentences.zh: 要讓這筆交易不破局，需要小心地周旋。

sentences.en: Stress can manifest itself as headaches.
sentences.zh: 壓力可能會以頭痛的形式表現出來。

sentences.en: His disappointment was manifest to everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 房間裡的每個人都看得出他很失望。

sentences.en: Did the symptoms manifest right after the trip?
sentences.zh: 症狀是旅行後馬上出現的嗎？

sentences.en: Her talent began to manifest at age five.
sentences.zh: 她的才華在五歲時開始顯現。

sentences.en: It was manifest that nobody had read the instructions.
sentences.zh: 很明顯，沒有人讀過說明。

sentences.en: How does fear manifest in young children?
sentences.zh: 恐懼在小孩身上會如何表現出來？

sentences.en: They live in a huge mansion on top of the hill.
sentences.zh: 他們住在山丘頂上的一棟大豪宅裡。

sentences.en: Would you want to live in a mansion?
sentences.zh: 你會想住在豪宅裡嗎？

sentences.en: The mansion has ten bedrooms and a big pool.
sentences.zh: 這棟豪宅有十間臥室和一座大游泳池。

sentences.en: How much would a mansion like that cost?
sentences.zh: 像那樣的豪宅要花多少錢？

sentences.en: We toured an old mansion on our school trip.
sentences.zh: 我們校外教學時參觀了一棟老豪宅。

sentences.en: Mom said our small house is no mansion, but it's home.
sentences.zh: 媽媽說我們的小房子不是豪宅，但這裡是我們的家。

sentences.en: I'll have the spaghetti with marinara, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點義大利麵搭番茄紅醬，謝謝。

sentences.en: Can I get extra marinara for dipping?
sentences.zh: 可以多給我一些番茄紅醬來沾嗎？

sentences.en: The cheese sticks come with a side of marinara.
sentences.zh: 炸起司條附一小份番茄紅醬。

sentences.en: Is the marinara made fresh every day?
sentences.zh: 這個番茄紅醬是每天現做的嗎？

sentences.en: My dad makes his own marinara on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸星期天都會自己熬番茄紅醬。

sentences.en: Dip the garlic bread in the warm marinara.
sentences.zh: 把蒜香麵包沾上溫熱的番茄紅醬。

sentences.en: I want to study marine biology in college.
sentences.zh: 我想在大學主修海洋生物學。

sentences.en: Is this marine park open on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這座海洋公園週末有開嗎？

sentences.en: Pollution is harming marine life along the coast.
sentences.zh: 汙染正危害沿岸的海洋生物。

sentences.en: Which marine animals can we see at the aquarium?
sentences.zh: 我們在水族館可以看到哪些海洋動物？

sentences.en: Sea turtles are marine reptiles that lay eggs on beaches.
sentences.zh: 海龜是在沙灘上產卵的海生爬蟲類。

sentences.en: Our class visited a marine research center last week.
sentences.zh: 我們班上週參觀了一座海洋研究中心。

gloss_note: marketable product 有銷路的產品

sentences.en: Is this new product marketable in the US?
sentences.zh: 這項新產品在美國有銷路嗎？

sentences.en: We need a more marketable design to attract buyers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要更有銷路的設計來吸引買家。

sentences.en: The team believes the idea is highly marketable.
sentences.zh: 團隊認為這個點子非常有市場。

sentences.en: What makes a snack marketable to teenagers?
sentences.zh: 什麼因素會讓零食在青少年之間有銷路？

sentences.en: Our prototype costs too much to be marketable yet.
sentences.zh: 我們的原型成本太高，目前還沒有銷路。

sentences.en: A catchy name makes the product more marketable.
sentences.zh: 好記的名字能讓產品更有銷路。

sentences.en: Bone marrow produces new blood cells every day.
sentences.zh: 骨髓每天都會製造新的血球。

sentences.en: Where in the body is marrow found?
sentences.zh: 骨髓位於身體的哪個部位？

sentences.en: The lecture explained how a bone marrow transplant works.
sentences.zh: 這堂課講解了骨髓移植的運作方式。

sentences.en: Can marrow cells turn into other types of cells?
sentences.zh: 骨髓細胞可以變成其他類型的細胞嗎？

sentences.en: Marrow inside the long bones makes red blood cells.
sentences.zh: 長骨內的骨髓會製造紅血球。

sentences.en: A recent study looked at how exercise affects bone marrow health.
sentences.zh: 一項最新研究探討運動如何影響骨髓健康。

sentences.en: He has a deep, masculine voice.
sentences.zh: 他的聲音低沉，很有男人味。

sentences.en: Is this cologne too masculine for a gift?
sentences.zh: 這款古龍水當禮物會不會太陽剛了？

sentences.en: The store has a masculine style, with dark wood and leather.
sentences.zh: 這家店風格陽剛，用了深色木頭和皮革。

sentences.en: Names like Jack and Tom sound masculine to most people.
sentences.zh: 像傑克和湯姆這樣的名字，大多數人聽起來都是男生的名字。

sentences.en: What does masculine mean to teenagers today?
sentences.zh: 對現在的青少年來說，「陽剛」是什麼意思？

sentences.en: Her short haircut gave her a more masculine look.
sentences.zh: 她的短髮讓她看起來更陽剛。

sentences.en: A massive tree fell across the road last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有一棵巨大的樹倒在馬路上。

sentences.en: Did you see the massive crowd at the concert?
sentences.zh: 你有看到演唱會那麼龐大的人潮嗎？

sentences.en: The company announced massive layoffs this morning.
sentences.zh: 公司今天早上宣布大規模裁員。

sentences.en: Why is that truck so massive?
sentences.zh: 那輛卡車為什麼這麼大？

sentences.en: We got a massive discount on the new sofa.
sentences.zh: 我們買新沙發拿到了超大的折扣。

sentences.en: The new stadium is a massive project that will take years.
sentences.zh: 這座新球場是個要花好幾年的大型工程。

sentences.en: This painting is considered a masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫被視為傑作。

sentences.en: Is that movie really a masterpiece, or just popular?
sentences.zh: 那部電影真的是傑作，還是只是很紅？

sentences.en: The chef called his new dish a masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 主廚稱他的新菜是一件傑作。

sentences.en: Which of his books do you think is his masterpiece?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他哪一本書是他的代表傑作？

sentences.en: She spent ten years painting her masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 她花了十年畫她的傑作。

sentences.en: Wow, your birthday cake is a masterpiece!
sentences.zh: 哇，你的生日蛋糕簡直是傑作！

sentences.en: We need to buy a new mattress.
sentences.zh: 我們得買一張新床墊。

sentences.en: Is this mattress too soft for your back?
sentences.zh: 這張床墊對你的背來說會不會太軟？

sentences.en: That store is having a big sale on mattresses.
sentences.zh: 那家店的床墊正在大特價。

sentences.en: How long does a good mattress usually last?
sentences.zh: 一張好的床墊通常可以用多久？

sentences.en: I slept on a thin mattress on the floor at camp.
sentences.zh: 在營地時，我睡在地板上的一張薄床墊。

sentences.en: The hotel bed had a really comfortable mattress.
sentences.zh: 飯店的床墊睡起來非常舒服。

sentences.en: The lock has a simple mechanism inside.
sentences.zh: 這個鎖的內部機械裝置很簡單。

sentences.en: How does the locking mechanism work?
sentences.zh: 這個鎖定機制是怎麼運作的？

sentences.en: The body has a natural mechanism to cool itself.
sentences.zh: 人體有天然的降溫機制。

sentences.en: Can you fix the broken mechanism in this clock?
sentences.zh: 你能修好這個時鐘壞掉的機械裝置嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists are still studying the mechanism behind sleep.
sentences.zh: 科學家仍在研究睡眠背後的機制。

sentences.en: Our school has a mechanism for students to report problems.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有讓學生反映問題的機制。

sentences.en: Let's try the new Mediterranean restaurant downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們去試試市區那家新開的地中海餐廳吧。

sentences.en: Do you like Mediterranean food?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡地中海料理嗎？

sentences.en: Our lunch special is a Mediterranean chicken wrap.
sentences.zh: 我們的午餐特餐是地中海風味的雞肉捲餅。

sentences.en: What's in the Mediterranean salad?
sentences.zh: 地中海沙拉裡有什麼？

sentences.en: My doctor suggested a Mediterranean diet to lower my cholesterol.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生建議我採用地中海飲食來降低膽固醇。

sentences.en: Can I get the Mediterranean platter with extra hummus?
sentences.zh: 我可以點地中海拼盤並多加鷹嘴豆泥嗎？

sentences.en: Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature.
sentences.zh: 汞是唯一在室溫下呈液態的金屬。

sentences.en: Old thermometers used mercury to measure temperature.
sentences.zh: 老式溫度計用水銀來測量溫度。

sentences.en: Why is mercury harmful to human health?
sentences.zh: 為什麼汞對人體健康有害？

sentences.en: Some large fish contain high levels of mercury.
sentences.zh: 有些大型魚類含有高濃度的汞。

sentences.en: Is there any mercury in these light bulbs?
sentences.zh: 這些燈泡裡有汞嗎？

sentences.en: Factories must limit the mercury they release into rivers.
sentences.zh: 工廠必須限制排入河川的汞量。

sentences.en: More than six million people live in the metropolitan area.
sentences.zh: 超過六百萬人住在這個都會區。

sentences.en: Is public transportation good in the metropolitan area?
sentences.zh: 這個都會區的大眾運輸方便嗎？

sentences.en: The metropolitan population has grown quickly.
sentences.zh: 這個都會區的人口成長得很快。

sentences.en: Housing costs are rising in most large metropolitan areas.
sentences.zh: 大多數大型都會區的房價都在上漲。

sentences.en: How far is the airport from the metropolitan center?
sentences.zh: 機場離都會中心有多遠？

sentences.en: She moved from a small town to the Chicago metropolitan area.
sentences.zh: 她從小鎮搬到了芝加哥都會區。

gloss_note: in the midst of 正在……當中

sentences.en: We're in the midst of a big move.
sentences.zh: 我們正忙著搬家。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm in the midst of a meeting.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我正在開會。

sentences.en: Are you in the midst of cooking dinner?
sentences.zh: 你正在做晚餐嗎？

sentences.en: The town was in the midst of a heat wave.
sentences.zh: 小鎮正處於熱浪之中。

sentences.en: A few tall trees stood in the midst of the field.
sentences.zh: 田野中間矗立著幾棵高大的樹。

sentences.en: Why did he quit in the midst of the project?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼在計畫進行到一半時離職？

sentences.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
sentences.zh: 許多鳥類會南遷過冬。

sentences.en: When do the whales migrate along the coast?
sentences.zh: 鯨魚什麼時候會沿著海岸遷徙？

sentences.en: Millions of workers migrate to cities each year.
sentences.zh: 每年有數百萬名工人移居到城市。

sentences.en: Why do monarch butterflies migrate thousands of miles?
sentences.zh: 帝王斑蝶為什麼要遷徙數千英里？

sentences.en: Some families migrate to find better jobs.
sentences.zh: 有些家庭為了找更好的工作而遷居。

sentences.en: Researchers track how fish migrate between rivers and the ocean.
sentences.zh: 研究人員追蹤魚類如何在河川與海洋之間遷徙。

gloss_note: reach a milestone 達到里程碑

sentences.en: Finishing high school is a big milestone.
sentences.zh: 高中畢業是一個重要的里程碑。

sentences.en: We reached an important milestone in the project today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在計畫中達到了一個重要的里程碑。

sentences.en: What's the next milestone for your team?
sentences.zh: 你們團隊的下一個里程碑是什麼？

sentences.en: Learning to drive was a milestone for me.
sentences.zh: 學會開車對我來說是個里程碑。

sentences.en: Did we hit the milestone we promised the client?
sentences.zh: 我們有達到對客戶承諾的里程碑嗎？

sentences.en: The company celebrated a milestone of one million customers.
sentences.zh: 公司慶祝客戶數達到一百萬人的里程碑。

sentences.en: The screw is only three millimeters wide.
sentences.zh: 這顆螺絲只有三毫米寬。

sentences.en: How many millimeters are in a centimeter?
sentences.zh: 一公分等於幾毫米？

sentences.en: The insect is about five millimeters long.
sentences.zh: 這隻昆蟲大約五毫米長。

sentences.en: Can you cut the board down by one millimeter?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這塊板子再削掉一毫米嗎？

sentences.en: This ruler shows every millimeter clearly.
sentences.zh: 這把尺把每一毫米都標示得很清楚。

sentences.en: The crack in the glass is less than a millimeter wide.
sentences.zh: 玻璃上的裂縫寬度不到一毫米。

sentences.en: He collects miniature cars from around the world.
sentences.zh: 他收集來自世界各地的迷你模型車。

sentences.en: Is this a miniature version of the real building?
sentences.zh: 這是那棟真實建築的縮小模型嗎？

sentences.en: My niece has a dollhouse with miniature furniture.
sentences.zh: 我姪女有一間附迷你小傢俱的娃娃屋。

sentences.en: Can you show me the miniature in the glass case?
sentences.zh: 你能給我看玻璃櫃裡的那個縮小模型嗎？

sentences.en: The park has a miniature train for kids.
sentences.zh: 公園裡有給小朋友坐的迷你火車。

sentences.en: The shop sells miniature bottles of olive oil as gifts.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售迷你瓶裝橄欖油當作禮品。

sentences.en: Please don't misidentify the product when you label the boxes.
sentences.zh: 貼箱子標籤時，請不要認錯產品。

sentences.en: Did the scanner misidentify our item again?
sentences.zh: 掃描器又把我們的商品認錯了嗎？

sentences.en: It's easy to misidentify mushrooms in the wild.
sentences.zh: 在野外很容易認錯蘑菇。

sentences.en: The software sometimes misidentifies faces in dark photos.
sentences.zh: 軟體有時會把暗處照片裡的臉認錯。

sentences.en: Why did the receptionist misidentify me as a delivery driver?
sentences.zh: 櫃檯人員為什麼把我誤認成送貨司機？

sentences.en: Our team misidentified the cause of the delay at first.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊一開始誤判了延誤的原因。

sentences.en: The missionary taught English at a small village school.
sentences.zh: 那位傳教士在一所小村莊學校教英文。

sentences.en: Her aunt worked as a missionary and helped build a clinic.
sentences.zh: 她的阿姨當傳教士，協助蓋了一間診所。

sentences.en: Did the missionary stay in the village for long?
sentences.zh: 那位傳教士在村子裡待了很久嗎？

sentences.en: We read about a missionary who helped build the first hospital there.
sentences.zh: 我們讀到一位協助在當地蓋了第一家醫院的傳教士。

sentences.en: What was life like for a missionary a hundred years ago?
sentences.zh: 一百年前傳教士的生活是什麼樣子？

sentences.en: The museum has a letter from a missionary dated 1890.
sentences.zh: 博物館收藏了一封1890年傳教士寫的信。

gloss_note: mitigate risk 降低風險；正式用語

sentences.en: We need a plan to mitigate the risk.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一個計畫來減輕風險。

sentences.en: How can we mitigate the impact of the delay?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何減輕延誤造成的影響？

sentences.en: Extra staff will help mitigate the effects of the holiday rush.
sentences.zh: 增加人手有助於減輕節日旺季帶來的影響。

sentences.en: Insurance can mitigate the cost of unexpected repairs.
sentences.zh: 保險可以減輕意外維修的費用負擔。

sentences.en: What steps did you take to mitigate the problem?
sentences.zh: 你採取了哪些步驟來緩和這個問題？

sentences.en: The manager tried to mitigate the damage with a quick apology.
sentences.zh: 經理試圖以迅速道歉來減輕傷害。

gloss_note: 抱怨義美式常說 moan and groan

sentences.en: The patient let out a soft moan.
sentences.zh: 病人發出輕輕的呻吟聲。

sentences.en: Stop moaning about the homework and just start.
sentences.zh: 別再抱怨功課了，直接開始寫吧。

sentences.en: Why is everyone moaning and groaning about the Monday meeting?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家都在對星期一的會議唉聲嘆氣？

sentences.en: I heard a low moan from the next room.
sentences.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來低低的呻吟聲。

sentences.en: He moaned loudly when he saw the pile of dishes.
sentences.zh: 他一看到那堆碗盤就哀嚎了一聲。

sentences.en: Do you always moan and groan before a big test?
sentences.zh: 你每次大考前都要唉聲嘆氣地抱怨嗎？

sentences.en: We took a mock exam in class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在課堂上考了一次模擬考。

sentences.en: Can you help me practice for a mock interview?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我練習模擬面試嗎？

sentences.en: Don't mock him just because he made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 別因為他犯了錯就嘲笑他。

sentences.en: Why do some kids mock their classmates?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些孩子會嘲笑同學？

sentences.en: The school held a mock trial for the law club.
sentences.zh: 學校為法律社舉辦了一場模擬法庭。

sentences.en: My brother likes to mock my singing in the car.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟喜歡在車上取笑我唱歌。

gloss_note: mode of transportation 交通方式

sentences.en: Please put your phone in silent mode.
sentences.zh: 請把你的手機調成靜音模式。

sentences.en: What mode of transportation do you take to school?
sentences.zh: 你搭什麼交通工具上學？

sentences.en: My laptop switches to power-saving mode automatically.
sentences.zh: 我的筆電會自動切換成省電模式。

sentences.en: Is your phone still in airplane mode?
sentences.zh: 你的手機還在飛航模式嗎？

sentences.en: After finals, I went into vacation mode.
sentences.zh: 期末考之後，我進入了放假模式。

sentences.en: Texting is the main mode of communication among my friends.
sentences.zh: 傳訊息是我朋友之間主要的溝通方式。

gloss_note: modify an order 修改訂單

sentences.en: Can I modify my order after I pay?
sentences.zh: 付款後我還可以修改訂單嗎？

sentences.en: We modified the recipe to use less sugar.
sentences.zh: 我們修改了食譜，改用比較少的糖。

sentences.en: The teacher modified the test for students who need extra time.
sentences.zh: 老師為需要額外時間的學生調整了考試。

sentences.en: Please don't modify this file without asking me.
sentences.zh: 沒問過我，請不要修改這個檔案。

sentences.en: How did you modify the engine to run faster?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼改裝引擎讓它跑得更快的？

sentences.en: The company may modify its return policy next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月可能會修改退貨政策。

sentences.en: The factory makes plastic toys with a steel mold.
sentences.zh: 工廠用鋼製模具來製造塑膠玩具。

sentences.en: How long does it take to make a new mold?
sentences.zh: 製作一副新模具要花多久時間？

sentences.en: The machine molds hot plastic into bottles.
sentences.zh: 這台機器把熱塑膠塑形成瓶子。

sentences.en: We need to replace the old mold before next month's order.
sentences.zh: 在下個月的訂單之前，我們得更換舊模具。

sentences.en: Did the supplier send the new mold yet?
sentences.zh: 供應商寄來新模具了嗎？

sentences.en: Good managers help mold young employees into strong leaders.
sentences.zh: 好主管會幫助塑造年輕員工成為出色的領導者。

gloss_note: 鼴鼠在美國常在草坪挖地道

sentences.en: Moles dig tunnels under the ground to find insects.
sentences.zh: 鼴鼠會在地底挖地道找昆蟲吃。

sentences.en: Something keeps digging holes in our lawn. Could it be a mole?
sentences.zh: 有東西一直在我們的草坪上挖洞，會是鼴鼠嗎？

sentences.en: A mole has tiny eyes and can barely see.
sentences.zh: 鼴鼠的眼睛很小，幾乎看不見。

sentences.en: Did you know a mole spends almost its whole life underground?
sentences.zh: 你知道鼴鼠幾乎一輩子都待在地底下嗎？

sentences.en: The article explains how moles help keep the soil healthy.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章說明鼴鼠如何幫助維持土壤健康。

sentences.en: My neighbor called a pest company to get rid of the moles.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居請了除蟲公司來趕走鼴鼠。

sentences.en: A monopolist can set prices as high as it wants.
sentences.zh: 壟斷者想把價格訂多高都可以。

sentences.en: Is the company really a monopolist in this market?
sentences.zh: 這家公司在這個市場上真的是壟斷者嗎？

sentences.en: The monopolist ignored complaints because buyers had no choice.
sentences.zh: 那家獨占企業忽視客訴，因為消費者沒有其他選擇。

sentences.en: Regulators accused the monopolist of blocking smaller rivals.
sentences.zh: 主管機關指控這家獨占企業阻擋規模較小的對手。

sentences.en: Why does a monopolist charge more than a competitive firm?
sentences.zh: 為什麼壟斷者收的價格比競爭廠商高？

sentences.en: As the only seller in town, the water company is a monopolist.
sentences.zh: 身為鎮上唯一的供應商，這家自來水公司是個獨占業者。

gloss_note: pay off a mortgage 還清房貸

sentences.en: We pay our mortgage on the first of every month.
sentences.zh: 我們每個月一號繳房貸。

sentences.en: What's the interest rate on your mortgage?
sentences.zh: 你的房貸利率是多少？

sentences.en: My parents finally paid off their mortgage.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽終於還清了房貸。

sentences.en: Did the bank approve your mortgage application?
sentences.zh: 銀行核准你的房貸申請了嗎？

sentences.en: A thirty-year mortgage is common in the US.
sentences.zh: 三十年期房貸在美國很常見。

sentences.en: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
sentences.zh: 他們貸了一筆房貸來買第一間房子。

sentences.en: The old mosque is a famous landmark in the city.
sentences.zh: 這座古老的清真寺是城裡的著名地標。

sentences.en: Is the mosque open to visitors on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這座清真寺週末開放參觀嗎？

sentences.en: The tour guide showed us the mosque's beautiful tile work.
sentences.zh: 導遊帶我們欣賞清真寺美麗的磁磚工藝。

sentences.en: The city is building a new library near the mosque.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在清真寺附近蓋一座新圖書館。

sentences.en: How old is the mosque in the center of town?
sentences.zh: 市中心那座清真寺有多久的歷史？

sentences.en: Architecture students visit the mosque to study its dome.
sentences.zh: 建築系學生來參觀清真寺，研究它的圓頂。

sentences.en: We plan to mount the TV on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我們打算把電視裝在牆上。

sentences.en: Can you help me mount this shelf above the desk?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這個架子裝在書桌上方嗎？

sentences.en: How do I mount the camera on a tripod?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼把相機裝到三腳架上？

sentences.en: The workers will mount the sign above the store entrance tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 工人明天會把招牌裝在店門口上方。

sentences.en: She mounted her bike and rode off.
sentences.zh: 她跨上腳踏車騎走了。

sentences.en: The singer mounted the stage to loud cheers.
sentences.zh: 歌手登上舞台，現場歡聲雷動。

sentences.en: Please don't mumble; I can't hear you.
sentences.zh: 請不要含糊不清地說話，我聽不清楚。

sentences.en: What did you just mumble under your breath?
sentences.zh: 你剛剛小聲嘟囔了什麼？

sentences.en: He mumbled an apology and left the room.
sentences.zh: 他含糊地道了歉就離開房間。

sentences.en: Why does my brother mumble when he's nervous?
sentences.zh: 我哥哥緊張的時候為什麼會含糊不清地說話？

sentences.en: She mumbled something about being late.
sentences.zh: 她嘟囔了一些遲到的事。

sentences.en: The old man mumbles to himself while he walks.
sentences.zh: 那位老先生走路時會喃喃自語。

sentences.en: He's tall and muscular from years of swimming.
sentences.zh: 他游了多年的泳，又高又壯、肌肉發達。

sentences.en: How did she get so muscular in six months?
sentences.zh: 她怎麼在六個月內練出這麼結實的肌肉？

sentences.en: Muscular dog breeds need lots of daily exercise.
sentences.zh: 肌肉發達的犬種每天都需要大量運動。

sentences.en: Muscular pain is common after a hard workout.
sentences.zh: 劇烈運動後常會出現肌肉疼痛。

sentences.en: Do you want a muscular look or a lean one?
sentences.zh: 你想要肌肉發達的外型，還是精瘦的？

sentences.en: The coach has muscular arms and a big smile.
sentences.zh: 教練有一雙結實的手臂和燦爛的笑容。

sentences.en: I was naive to believe the stranger's story.
sentences.zh: 我太天真了，竟然相信那個陌生人的話。

sentences.en: Don't be naive; nobody gives away free phones.
sentences.zh: 別天真了，沒有人會免費送手機。

sentences.en: Is it naive to think we can finish by Friday?
sentences.zh: 以為我們週五前能完成，是不是太天真了？

sentences.en: The young intern was a little naive about office politics.
sentences.zh: 那位年輕的實習生對職場人際關係有點涉世未深。

sentences.en: Why are kids so naive about money?
sentences.zh: 為什麼小孩對金錢這麼天真？

sentences.en: That was a naive question, but I'm glad you asked.
sentences.zh: 那是個很天真的問題，但我很高興你問了。

sentences.en: The narrative is told from a child's point of view.
sentences.zh: 這個故事是從孩子的視角來敘述的。

sentences.en: What's the main narrative of this novel?
sentences.zh: 這本小說的主要敘事是什麼？

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short narrative about summer.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於夏天的短篇敘述文。

sentences.en: The news report offered a very different narrative of the event.
sentences.zh: 這則新聞報導對這起事件有截然不同的敘述。

sentences.en: I love the narrative in this video game.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡這款電玩遊戲的敘事。

sentences.en: Is the narrative in this book hard to follow?
sentences.zh: 這本書的敘述很難看懂嗎？

sentences.en: The government decided to nationalize the railway.
sentences.zh: 政府決定將鐵路國有化。

sentences.en: Why did the country nationalize its oil industry?
sentences.zh: 這個國家為什麼要把石油產業收歸國有？

sentences.en: Our textbook explains what it means to nationalize an industry.
sentences.zh: 我們的課本解釋了把一個產業國有化是什麼意思。

sentences.en: Can a government legally nationalize a private company?
sentences.zh: 政府可以合法地將私人公司國有化嗎？

sentences.en: The news said they plan to nationalize the airline.
sentences.zh: 新聞說他們打算把那家航空公司國有化。

sentences.en: After the war, the country moved to nationalize its steel mills.
sentences.zh: 戰後，該國著手把鋼鐵廠收歸國有。

sentences.en: Is the price on this sofa negotiable?
sentences.zh: 這張沙發的價格可以議價嗎？

sentences.en: The salary is negotiable depending on experience.
sentences.zh: 薪水可依經驗協商。

sentences.en: My start date is negotiable if you need me earlier.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要我早一點上班，我的到職日可以協商。

sentences.en: Are the delivery terms negotiable, or are they fixed?
sentences.zh: 交貨條件可以協商，還是已經固定了？

sentences.en: The rent is not negotiable, but the lease length is.
sentences.zh: 房租沒得談，但租期可以。

sentences.en: Everything in the contract is negotiable except the deadline.
sentences.zh: 合約中除了期限以外，所有內容都可以協商。

sentences.en: The two sides are still in negotiation.
sentences.zh: 雙方仍在談判中。

sentences.en: How long will the negotiation take?
sentences.zh: 這場談判會花多久時間？

sentences.en: Salary negotiation can feel scary at first.
sentences.zh: 薪資談判一開始可能會讓人覺得很可怕。

sentences.en: We reached an agreement after hours of negotiation.
sentences.zh: 經過好幾個小時的協商，我們達成了協議。

sentences.en: Do you have any tips for contract negotiations?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有任何合約談判的訣竅？

sentences.en: The negotiation ended when both sides finally compromised.
sentences.zh: 雙方終於讓步，談判就此結束。

sentences.en: She is a skilled negotiator who rarely loses a deal.
sentences.zh: 她是個談判高手，很少談不成生意。

sentences.en: Who will be our lead negotiator in the meeting?
sentences.zh: 會議中誰會擔任我們的首席談判代表？

sentences.en: A good negotiator listens more than he talks.
sentences.zh: 好的談判者聽得比說得多。

sentences.en: Our company hired a negotiator to work out the contract terms.
sentences.zh: 我們公司請了一位談判專家來談定合約條件。

sentences.en: Are you a tough negotiator when you buy a used car?
sentences.zh: 你買二手車的時候是個強硬的談判者嗎？

sentences.en: The union sent a negotiator to talk with management.
sentences.zh: 工會派了一名談判代表去和管理階層談。

sentences.en: As a newcomer, I'm still learning how things work here.
sentences.zh: 身為新人，我還在學習這裡是怎麼運作的。

sentences.en: Are you a newcomer to this neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你是這個社區的新住戶嗎？

sentences.en: We hold a lunch to welcome each newcomer to the team.
sentences.zh: 我們會辦午餐歡迎每位加入團隊的新人。

sentences.en: The newcomer quickly became the star of the sales team.
sentences.zh: 這位新人很快就成為業務團隊的明星。

sentences.en: Can you show the newcomer where the break room is?
sentences.zh: 你可以告訴那位新人休息室在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: The newcomers got a tour of the office on Monday.
sentences.zh: 新人在星期一參觀了辦公室。

sentences.en: The new system is working nicely so far.
sentences.zh: 新系統到目前為止運作得很順利。

sentences.en: If you ask nicely, he might help you.
sentences.zh: 如果你客氣地請求，他也許會幫你。

sentences.en: The report is nicely organized and easy to follow.
sentences.zh: 這份報告整理得很好，很容易讀懂。

sentences.en: The plan worked out nicely, and we finished early.
sentences.zh: 計畫進行得很順利，我們提早完成了。

sentences.en: My boss asked me nicely, so how could I say no?
sentences.zh: 老闆很客氣地拜託我，我怎麼好意思拒絕？

sentences.en: These shoes fit nicely, but do you have them in black?
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋穿起來很合腳，不過有黑色的嗎？

gloss_note: accept a nomination 接受提名

sentences.en: Who received the nomination for best actor?
sentences.zh: 誰獲得了最佳男演員的提名？

sentences.en: Her nomination for team leader surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 她被提名為組長，讓所有人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: We are accepting nominations for employee of the year.
sentences.zh: 我們正在接受年度優秀員工的提名。

sentences.en: Thank you for the nomination; I'm honored.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的提名，我深感榮幸。

sentences.en: Did you submit a nomination before the deadline?
sentences.zh: 你有在截止日前提交提名嗎？

sentences.en: The film earned five nominations at the awards show.
sentences.zh: 這部電影在頒獎典禮上獲得五項提名。

sentences.en: Each nominee will give a short speech tonight.
sentences.zh: 每位被提名人今晚都會發表簡短演說。

sentences.en: Who is the youngest nominee this year?
sentences.zh: 今年最年輕的被提名人是誰？

sentences.en: She was the only nominee from our school.
sentences.zh: 她是我們學校唯一的被提名人。

sentences.en: Are you a nominee for the science award?
sentences.zh: 你是科學獎的被提名人嗎？

sentences.en: The nominees walked down the red carpet.
sentences.zh: 被提名者走上了紅毯。

sentences.en: Every nominee received a small gift from the sponsors.
sentences.zh: 每位被提名人都收到贊助商送的一份小禮物。

sentences.en: I'd like a nonfat latte, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯脫脂拿鐵，謝謝。

sentences.en: Do you have nonfat milk for the coffee?
sentences.zh: 你們有脫脂牛奶可以加咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: She buys nonfat yogurt every week.
sentences.zh: 她每週都買脫脂優格。

sentences.en: Can I get my smoothie made with nonfat yogurt?
sentences.zh: 我的冰沙可以用脫脂優格做嗎？

sentences.en: Is the nonfat dressing as good as the regular kind?
sentences.zh: 無脂沙拉醬跟一般的一樣好吃嗎？

sentences.en: This cake uses nonfat milk instead of cream.
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕用脫脂牛奶取代鮮奶油。

sentences.en: She works for a nonprofit group that feeds homeless families.
sentences.zh: 她任職於一個為無家可歸的家庭提供餐食的非營利團體。

sentences.en: Is your hospital a nonprofit organization or a private company?
sentences.zh: 你們醫院是非營利組織還是民營公司？

sentences.en: Our nonprofit library depends on donations from local families.
sentences.zh: 我們這間非營利圖書館靠當地家庭的捐款維持運作。

sentences.en: Did you volunteer at the nonprofit clinic last summer?
sentences.zh: 你去年夏天有去那間非營利診所當志工嗎？

sentences.en: The nonprofit board meets on the first Monday of every month.
sentences.zh: 這個非營利機構的董事會每個月第一個週一開會。

sentences.en: He left a bank job to start a nonprofit school.
sentences.zh: 他辭掉銀行的工作，創辦了一所非營利學校。

gloss_note: notable achievement 顯著成就；偏正式

sentences.en: Sales showed a notable increase in the second quarter.
sentences.zh: 第二季的銷售額有顯著成長。

sentences.en: Was there anything notable in today's meeting?
sentences.zh: 今天的會議有什麼值得注意的事嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant is notable for its fresh homemade noodles.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以新鮮的手工麵條而聞名。

sentences.en: She made a notable contribution to the team's success.
sentences.zh: 她對團隊的成功有顯著的貢獻。

sentences.en: Which notable changes did the new manager introduce?
sentences.zh: 新經理帶來了哪些重大的改變？

sentences.en: A notable exception is our Denver office, which lost money.
sentences.zh: 一個值得注意的例外是丹佛辦公室，它虧損了。

gloss_note: barely noticeable 幾乎看不出來

sentences.en: There is a noticeable difference in price between the two stores.
sentences.zh: 這兩家店的價格有明顯的差異。

sentences.en: Is the scratch on the car noticeable from far away?
sentences.zh: 車上的刮痕從遠處看得出來嗎？

sentences.en: Her improvement in math was noticeable after only a month.
sentences.zh: 才過一個月，她的數學進步就很明顯。

sentences.en: The stain on my shirt is barely noticeable.
sentences.zh: 我襯衫上的污漬幾乎看不出來。

sentences.en: Do you find the noise from the street noticeable at night?
sentences.zh: 你覺得晚上街上的噪音很明顯嗎？

sentences.en: He walked with a noticeable limp after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，他走路明顯有點跛。

gloss_note: the notion of 對…的觀念

sentences.en: The notion of working from home appeals to many people.
sentences.zh: 在家工作的想法吸引了許多人。

sentences.en: Where did you get the notion that I was leaving?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼會以為我要走了？

sentences.en: Many students reject the notion that math is boring.
sentences.zh: 許多學生不認同數學很無聊這種想法。

sentences.en: Our teacher explained the notion of supply and demand.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了供需的觀念。

sentences.en: Is the notion of a four-day workweek realistic?
sentences.zh: 一週工作四天的想法實際嗎？

sentences.en: She laughed at the notion of buying a boat.
sentences.zh: 她聽到要買船的想法就笑了。

gloss_note: a complete novice 完全的新手

sentences.en: I'm a novice at cooking, so please be patient.
sentences.zh: 我是烹飪新手，請多包涵。

sentences.en: Is this software easy enough for a novice to use?
sentences.zh: 這套軟體簡單到新手也能使用嗎？

sentences.en: The class is designed for novices with no experience.
sentences.zh: 這門課是為毫無經驗的初學者設計的。

sentences.en: Even a novice can fix this problem in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 連新手也能在五分鐘內解決這個問題。

sentences.en: Are you a novice or an expert at chess?
sentences.zh: 你下棋是新手還是高手？

sentences.en: The novice climber slipped, but her guide caught her.
sentences.zh: 那位新手登山客滑了一跤，但嚮導抓住了她。

gloss_note: nowhere to go 無處可去

sentences.en: There was nowhere to park near the stadium.
sentences.zh: 體育場附近沒有地方可以停車。

sentences.en: My keys were nowhere to be found. Have you seen them?
sentences.zh: 我的鑰匙到處都找不到。你有看到嗎？

sentences.en: She had nowhere else to go, so we let her stay.
sentences.zh: 她沒有別的地方可去，所以我們讓她住下來。

sentences.en: Is there really nowhere in this town to get good coffee?
sentences.zh: 這個鎮上真的找不到一個能喝到好咖啡的地方嗎？

sentences.en: The road led nowhere, so we turned around.
sentences.zh: 這條路哪裡也通不到，所以我們掉頭了。

sentences.en: Nowhere in the contract does it mention overtime pay.
sentences.zh: 合約裡完全沒有提到加班費。

sentences.en: Good nutrition helps children grow and do well in school.
sentences.zh: 良好的營養有助於孩子成長，在學校也表現得更好。

sentences.en: Where can I find the nutrition facts on this package?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以找到這個包裝上的營養成分？

sentences.en: She studies nutrition at a university in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 她在俄亥俄州的一所大學讀營養學。

sentences.en: Does fast food provide enough nutrition for growing teenagers?
sentences.zh: 速食能提供青少年成長所需的足夠營養嗎？

sentences.en: The school lunch program focuses on nutrition, not just taste.
sentences.zh: 學校的營養午餐計畫重視營養，而不只是口味。

sentences.en: Poor nutrition can make you feel tired all day.
sentences.zh: 營養不良會讓你整天都覺得很累。

gloss_note: obituary notice 訃告；報紙上的訃聞版

sentences.en: I read my neighbor's obituary in the local newspaper this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我在地方報紙上看到鄰居的訃聞。

sentences.en: Who wrote the obituary for your grandfather?
sentences.zh: 你祖父的訃聞是誰寫的？

sentences.en: The family posted an obituary on the funeral home's website.
sentences.zh: 家屬把訃聞貼在殯儀館的網站上。

sentences.en: Her obituary described her as a kind teacher and a great cook.
sentences.zh: 她的訃聞形容她是一位親切的老師，也是廚藝很棒的人。

sentences.en: Did the obituary mention when the service will be held?
sentences.zh: 訃聞裡有提到告別式的時間嗎？

sentences.en: He cut out the obituary and kept it in a drawer.
sentences.zh: 他把訃聞剪下來，收在抽屜裡。

gloss_note: under no obligation 沒有義務

sentences.en: Parents have an obligation to keep their children safe.
sentences.zh: 父母有責任保護孩子的安全。

sentences.en: Do I have any obligation to attend the party?
sentences.zh: 我有義務一定要去參加派對嗎？

sentences.en: You are under no obligation to buy anything today.
sentences.zh: 你今天沒有義務一定要買任何東西。

sentences.en: The company met its legal obligation to pay overtime.
sentences.zh: 公司履行了支付加班費的法律義務。

sentences.en: Does the contract create an obligation for both sides?
sentences.zh: 這份合約是否對雙方都構成義務？

sentences.en: She felt a strong obligation to help her old friend.
sentences.zh: 她覺得自己有責任幫助老朋友。

sentences.en: The previous occupant left the apartment very clean.
sentences.zh: 前一位住戶把公寓打掃得很乾淨。

sentences.en: Every occupant of the building must carry a key card.
sentences.zh: 大樓的每位住戶都必須隨身帶門禁卡。

sentences.en: Were all the occupants of the car wearing seat belts?
sentences.zh: 車上所有的乘員都有繫安全帶嗎？

sentences.en: The only occupant of that office is out today.
sentences.zh: 那間辦公室只有一個人使用，而他今天不在。

sentences.en: Who is the current occupant of room 305?
sentences.zh: 目前住在305號房的是誰？

sentences.en: Airbags protect the occupants of a car in a crash.
sentences.zh: 安全氣囊在撞車時保護車內的乘員。

sentences.en: He spoke openly about his mistakes at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在會議上坦白談到自己的錯誤。

sentences.en: Can we talk openly about the budget problems?
sentences.zh: 我們可以坦白談談預算問題嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor openly admitted that the plan had failed.
sentences.zh: 市長公開承認這項計畫失敗了。

sentences.en: They openly disagreed during the call, didn't they?
sentences.zh: 他們在電話中公開表示意見不合，不是嗎？

sentences.en: Employees should feel free to share ideas openly.
sentences.zh: 員工應該能放心地坦率分享想法。

sentences.en: Is it wise to criticize your boss openly?
sentences.zh: 公開批評老闆明智嗎？

sentences.en: Our team will face a tough opponent on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們隊週六要面對一個強勁的對手。

sentences.en: Who was your opponent in the final match?
sentences.zh: 你在決賽中的對手是誰？

sentences.en: She shook hands with her opponent after the match.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，她和對手握了手。

sentences.en: Did the candidate beat her opponent in the school election?
sentences.zh: 那位候選人在學校選舉中打敗對手了嗎？

sentences.en: He is a strong opponent of the new parking rules.
sentences.zh: 他強烈反對新的停車規定。

sentences.en: A smart chess player studies his opponent's habits.
sentences.zh: 聰明的棋手會研究對手的習慣。

sentences.en: There was strong opposition to the new building plan.
sentences.zh: 這項新建案計畫遭到強烈反對。

sentences.en: Did the staff voice any opposition to the schedule change?
sentences.zh: 員工對時程更動有表達任何反對意見嗎？

sentences.en: Despite the opposition, the manager approved the project.
sentences.zh: 儘管有人反對，經理還是核准了這項計畫。

sentences.en: Local residents' opposition delayed the road work for months.
sentences.zh: 當地居民的反對讓道路工程延後了好幾個月。

sentences.en: Is there much opposition to a four-day workweek in your office?
sentences.zh: 你們辦公室對一週工作四天有很多反對聲音嗎？

sentences.en: Our defense held the opposition to just three points.
sentences.zh: 我們的防守把對手壓制到只得三分。

gloss_note: optimum level 最佳水準；偏正式

sentences.en: Early morning is the optimum time to water the plants.
sentences.zh: 清晨是替植物澆水的最佳時間。

sentences.en: What is the optimum temperature for storing wine?
sentences.zh: 儲存葡萄酒的最佳溫度是幾度？

sentences.en: The software runs at optimum speed on a new computer.
sentences.zh: 這個軟體在新電腦上以最佳速度運作。

sentences.en: Is this the optimum price for our new product?
sentences.zh: 這是我們新產品最理想的價格嗎？

sentences.en: Sleep helps your brain work at its optimum level.
sentences.zh: 睡眠能幫助大腦以最佳狀態運作。

sentences.en: The factory reached optimum output after the repairs.
sentences.zh: 工廠在維修後達到了最佳產量。

sentences.en: We picked apples at an orchard near our house.
sentences.zh: 我們在家附近的果園摘蘋果。

sentences.en: Does the orchard sell fresh peaches in summer?
sentences.zh: 這座果園夏天有賣新鮮的桃子嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather planted an orchard of pear trees years ago.
sentences.zh: 我祖父多年前種了一片梨樹果園。

sentences.en: The orchard was full of white flowers in April.
sentences.zh: 四月時，果園開滿了白花。

sentences.en: How many trees are in the orchard?
sentences.zh: 這座果園裡有幾棵樹？

sentences.en: Farmers protected the orchard from the frost last night.
sentences.zh: 農夫昨晚保護果園不受霜害。

sentences.en: The judges praised the originality of her design.
sentences.zh: 評審稱讚她設計的獨創性。

sentences.en: Does this essay show any originality?
sentences.zh: 這篇文章有任何原創性嗎？

sentences.en: His paintings lack originality and look like copies.
sentences.zh: 他的畫缺乏原創性，看起來像是仿作。

sentences.en: Originality matters more than perfect grammar in this contest.
sentences.zh: 在這場比賽中，原創性比完美的文法更重要。

sentences.en: How can students show originality in a science project?
sentences.zh: 學生要怎麼在科學專題中展現獨創性？

sentences.en: Our boss values originality and encourages new ideas.
sentences.zh: 我們老闆重視原創性，也鼓勵提出新想法。

sentences.en: Many popular desserts originate from small family kitchens.
sentences.zh: 許多受歡迎的甜點源自小家庭的廚房。

sentences.en: Where did this tradition originate?
sentences.zh: 這個傳統是從哪裡起源的？

sentences.en: The rumor originated in the sales department.
sentences.zh: 這個謠言是從業務部傳出來的。

sentences.en: Did the fire originate in the kitchen or the garage?
sentences.zh: 火是從廚房還是車庫燒起來的？

sentences.en: Most of our coffee originates from farms in Colombia.
sentences.zh: 我們的咖啡大多來自哥倫比亞的農場。

sentences.en: The idea originated during a lunch meeting last spring.
sentences.zh: 這個點子是去年春天在一次午餐會議中產生的。

sentences.en: Add one ounce of butter to the pan.
sentences.zh: 在鍋子裡加入一盎司的奶油。

sentences.en: How many ounces are in this bag of coffee?
sentences.zh: 這袋咖啡有幾盎司？

sentences.en: The package weighs exactly twelve ounces.
sentences.zh: 這個包裹剛好重十二盎司。

sentences.en: Can you give me four ounces of sliced turkey, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我四盎司的火雞肉片嗎？

sentences.en: A small cup holds about eight ounces of coffee.
sentences.zh: 一個小杯子大約能裝八盎司的咖啡。

sentences.en: The baby weighed seven pounds and two ounces at birth.
sentences.zh: 寶寶出生時重七磅兩盎司。

gloss_note: oust the CEO 撤換執行長

sentences.en: The board voted to oust the CEO after the loss.
sentences.zh: 董事會在虧損後投票撤換了執行長。

sentences.en: Can shareholders oust a manager they don't trust?
sentences.zh: 股東能罷免他們不信任的經理嗎？

sentences.en: She was ousted as chairwoman after the scandal.
sentences.zh: 醜聞爆發後，她被撤換掉董事長的職位。

sentences.en: Will the new directors try to oust the founder?
sentences.zh: 新任董事會會試圖罷免創辦人嗎？

sentences.en: Investors hope to oust the entire management team.
sentences.zh: 投資人希望撤換整個管理團隊。

sentences.en: Rumors say the board plans to oust him this week.
sentences.zh: 傳聞董事會打算在本週撤換他。

gloss_note: outbreak of flu 流感爆發

sentences.en: Health officials are investigating a food poisoning outbreak at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 衛生官員正在調查那家餐廳爆發的食物中毒事件。

sentences.en: The flu outbreak closed three schools this week.
sentences.zh: 流感爆發讓三所學校這週停課。

sentences.en: How did the outbreak start in the first place?
sentences.zh: 疫情當初是怎麼爆發的？

sentences.en: Doctors say the outbreak is now under control.
sentences.zh: 醫生說疫情現在已經受到控制。

sentences.en: Was there an outbreak of measles in your area?
sentences.zh: 你們那一帶有爆發麻疹疫情嗎？

sentences.en: The company sent staff home at the first sign of an outbreak.
sentences.zh: 一出現疫情的跡象，公司就讓員工回家了。

sentences.en: The outgoing CEO will train her replacement next month.
sentences.zh: 即將卸任的執行長下個月會訓練她的接班人。

sentences.en: Please put the outgoing mail in the tray by the door.
sentences.zh: 請把要寄出的郵件放在門邊的托盤裡。

sentences.en: Is the outgoing manager still available for questions?
sentences.zh: 即將卸任的經理還能回答問題嗎？

sentences.en: Outgoing calls from this phone are limited to local numbers.
sentences.zh: 這支電話的外撥只能打市內電話。

sentences.en: Who will replace the outgoing president of the club?
sentences.zh: 誰會接替即將卸任的社長？

sentences.en: Do outgoing emails go through a spam filter first?
sentences.zh: 寄出的電子郵件會先經過垃圾郵件過濾嗎？

gloss_note: initial outlay 初期支出；偏正式

sentences.en: The initial outlay for the new equipment was quite high.
sentences.zh: 新設備的初期支出相當高。

sentences.en: What is the total outlay for this project?
sentences.zh: 這項計畫的總支出是多少？

sentences.en: A small outlay now could save us money later.
sentences.zh: 現在的一小筆支出，日後能幫我們省錢。

sentences.en: The shop recovered its outlay within six months.
sentences.zh: 這家店在六個月內就回收了當初的支出。

sentences.en: Is the outlay worth it for such a small gain?
sentences.zh: 為了這麼小的收益，這筆支出值得嗎？

sentences.en: Her only outlay was the bus fare to the interview.
sentences.zh: 她唯一的花費是去面試的公車車資。

sentences.en: The factory doubled its output after buying new machines.
sentences.zh: 買了新機器之後，工廠的產量增加了一倍。

sentences.en: How can we increase our output without hiring more people?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在不多請人的情況下提高產出？

sentences.en: Daily output dropped because of the power failure.
sentences.zh: 因為停電，每日的產量下降了。

sentences.en: What is the weekly output of your bakery?
sentences.zh: 你們麵包店每週的產量是多少？

sentences.en: Her output at work has improved since she changed her schedule.
sentences.zh: 自從調整作息後，她的工作產出變好了。

sentences.en: Farm output was lower this year due to heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 今年因為大雨，農作物的產量比較少。

sentences.en: The new fee caused outrage among customers.
sentences.zh: 新的收費引起顧客的憤怒。

sentences.en: Did the news of the layoffs spark outrage in the office?
sentences.zh: 裁員的消息有在辦公室引起憤慨嗎？

sentences.en: She expressed her outrage in a long email to the manager.
sentences.zh: 她寫了一封長長的電子郵件給經理，表達她的憤慨。

sentences.en: There was public outrage after the park was closed.
sentences.zh: 公園關閉後，引起了民眾的憤慨。

sentences.en: Why is there so much outrage over a simple mistake?
sentences.zh: 為什麼一個小錯誤會引起這麼大的憤怒？

sentences.en: The mayor's remark was met with outrage online.
sentences.zh: 市長的發言在網路上引來一片憤慨。

gloss_note: benefits outweigh costs 利大於弊

sentences.en: The benefits of the plan outweigh the costs.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫的好處勝過成本。

sentences.en: Do the risks outweigh the possible rewards?
sentences.zh: 風險是否大過可能的收益？

sentences.en: In my opinion, the advantages clearly outweigh the disadvantages.
sentences.zh: 我認為優點明顯勝過缺點。

sentences.en: Does the salary outweigh the long commute for you?
sentences.zh: 對你來說，薪水比漫長的通勤時間更重要嗎？

sentences.en: Her love of teaching outweighs the low pay.
sentences.zh: 她對教學的熱愛比低薪更重要。

sentences.en: The pleasure of traveling outweighed the tiredness.
sentences.zh: 旅行的樂趣勝過了疲憊。

sentences.en: Did the trip go well overall?
sentences.zh: 整體來說，這趟旅行順利嗎？

sentences.en: The overall cost of the repair was lower than expected.
sentences.zh: 維修的整體費用比預期的低。

sentences.en: What is your overall impression of the new office?
sentences.zh: 你對新辦公室的整體印象如何？

sentences.en: Overall, customers were happy with the new menu.
sentences.zh: 整體來說，顧客對新菜單很滿意。

sentences.en: Her overall score on the test was ninety-two.
sentences.zh: 她這次考試的總成績是92分。

sentences.en: The overall quality of the food was excellent.
sentences.zh: 食物的整體品質非常出色。

gloss_note: overcharge sb for sth 向某人多收費

sentences.en: I think the taxi driver overcharged us for the ride.
sentences.zh: 我覺得計程車司機多收了我們的車資。

sentences.en: Did the hotel overcharge you for the room service?
sentences.zh: 飯店有多收你客房服務的費用嗎？

sentences.en: The shop overcharged me by ten dollars.
sentences.zh: 這家店多收了我十美元。

sentences.en: Why would they overcharge customers who pay in cash?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼要對付現的顧客多收錢？

sentences.en: Please check the bill; we don't want to be overcharged.
sentences.zh: 請核對帳單，我們不想被多收錢。

sentences.en: The garage was caught overcharging people for simple repairs.
sentences.zh: 這家修車廠被發現對簡單的維修多收費用。

gloss_note: overhaul a system 全面改革系統

sentences.en: The mechanic will overhaul the engine this weekend.
sentences.zh: 技師這個週末會徹底檢修引擎。

sentences.en: We need to overhaul our whole customer service system.
sentences.zh: 我們需要全面改革整個客服系統。

sentences.en: Did the airline complete the overhaul of its planes?
sentences.zh: 航空公司完成飛機的徹底檢修了嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans a major overhaul of its bus system.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算全面改革公車系統。

sentences.en: How long will it take to overhaul the old machine?
sentences.zh: 徹底檢修這台舊機器要花多久時間？

sentences.en: The new manager overhauled our hiring process in one month.
sentences.zh: 新經理在一個月內全面改革了我們的招募流程。

gloss_note: lack of oversight 缺乏監督

sentences.en: The project lacked proper oversight from senior managers.
sentences.zh: 這項計畫缺乏高階主管的適當監督。

sentences.en: Who has oversight of the budget this year?
sentences.zh: 今年由誰負責監督預算？

sentences.en: A new committee will provide oversight of the spending.
sentences.zh: 一個新委員會將負責監督這些支出。

sentences.en: Is there enough oversight of the food safety program?
sentences.zh: 食品安全計畫的監管足夠嗎？

sentences.en: Government oversight of banks became stricter after the crisis.
sentences.zh: 金融危機後，政府對銀行的監管變得更嚴格。

sentences.en: The new branch will operate under the oversight of the head office.
sentences.zh: 新分行將在總公司的監督下營運。

gloss_note: overstate the risk 誇大風險

sentences.en: I don't want to overstate the problem, but it's serious.
sentences.zh: 我不想誇大問題，但這件事很嚴重。

sentences.en: Do you think the report overstates the risks?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這份報告誇大了風險嗎？

sentences.en: Some ads overstate what their products can do.
sentences.zh: 有些廣告誇大了產品的功能。

sentences.en: He tends to overstate his role in the project.
sentences.zh: 他常常誇大自己在專案中的角色。

sentences.en: Why would the company overstate its profits?
sentences.zh: 公司為什麼要誇大它的獲利？

sentences.en: The article overstated the number of people at the event.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章誇大了活動的參加人數。

gloss_note: 開車超車美式多說 pass

sentences.en: Online shopping could overtake in-store sales within five years.
sentences.zh: 網路購物可能在五年內超越實體店面的銷售額。

sentences.en: Our sales may overtake last year's record by December.
sentences.zh: 我們的銷售額到十二月可能會超越去年的紀錄。

sentences.en: Did the cyclist overtake the leader before the finish line?
sentences.zh: 那位自行車選手在終點線前超越領先者了嗎？

sentences.en: She overtook the other runners in the last lap.
sentences.zh: 她在最後一圈超越了其他跑者。

sentences.en: Has our competitor overtaken us in the market yet?
sentences.zh: 我們的競爭對手在市場上已經超越我們了嗎？

sentences.en: Solar power may soon overtake coal as the main energy source.
sentences.zh: 太陽能可能很快就會超越煤炭，成為主要的能源。

gloss_note: overturn a ruling 推翻裁決

sentences.en: The court voted to overturn the earlier decision.
sentences.zh: 法院投票推翻了先前的判決。

sentences.en: Can the board overturn the manager's decision?
sentences.zh: 董事會能推翻經理的決定嗎？

sentences.en: A strong wave overturned the small fishing boat.
sentences.zh: 一個大浪打翻了那艘小漁船。

sentences.en: The truck overturned on the highway during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間，卡車在公路上翻覆了。

sentences.en: Will the judge overturn the ruling on appeal?
sentences.zh: 法官會在上訴時推翻這項裁定嗎？

sentences.en: Strong winds overturned several tables in the garden.
sentences.zh: 強風吹翻了花園裡好幾張桌子。

sentences.en: Iron will oxidize if you leave it outside in the rain.
sentences.zh: 鐵如果放在外面淋雨就會氧化。

sentences.en: Why do sliced apples oxidize and turn brown?
sentences.zh: 為什麼切開的蘋果會氧化變褐？

sentences.en: Lemon juice slows down how fast fruit oxidizes.
sentences.zh: 檸檬汁能減緩水果氧化的速度。

sentences.en: Copper oxidized slowly and turned the roof green.
sentences.zh: 銅慢慢氧化，讓屋頂變成了綠色。

sentences.en: Does silver oxidize faster in humid air?
sentences.zh: 銀在潮濕的空氣中氧化得比較快嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher showed how metal oxidizes in our chemistry lab.
sentences.zh: 老師在化學實驗課上示範金屬如何氧化。

sentences.en: I'd like a dozen raw oysters to start, please.
sentences.zh: 我想先點一打生蠔。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried grilled oysters with garlic?
sentences.zh: 你吃過蒜香烤生蠔嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh oysters are best in the cooler months.
sentences.zh: 新鮮生蠔在比較涼的月份最好吃。

sentences.en: The chef opened each oyster with a small knife.
sentences.zh: 主廚用一把小刀撬開每一顆生蠔。

sentences.en: Are the oysters on the menu local?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的生蠔是本地產的嗎？

sentences.en: She felt sick after eating a bad oyster.
sentences.zh: 她吃到壞掉的生蠔之後覺得不舒服。

gloss_note: It's a paradox that... 矛盾的是…

sentences.en: It's a paradox that the richest town has the most debt.
sentences.zh: 最富有的鎮卻負債最多，這真是矛盾。

sentences.en: Isn't it a paradox to save money by spending more?
sentences.zh: 靠多花錢來省錢，不是很矛盾嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher explained the paradox in the short story.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了這篇短篇故事裡的矛盾之處。

sentences.en: Here is a paradox: the more choices we have, the less happy we feel.
sentences.zh: 這裡有個矛盾：選擇越多，我們反而越不快樂。

sentences.en: What is the paradox in his statement?
sentences.zh: 他的說法裡有什麼矛盾？

sentences.en: Scientists were puzzled by the strange paradox in the data.
sentences.zh: 科學家對資料中奇怪的矛盾現象感到困惑。

sentences.en: The two roads run parallel to the river.
sentences.zh: 這兩條路與河流平行。

sentences.en: Are these two lines parallel to each other?
sentences.zh: 這兩條線互相平行嗎？

sentences.en: The bridge has parallel lanes for bikes and cars.
sentences.zh: 這座橋有平行的車道，供腳踏車和汽車使用。

sentences.en: Can you see any parallel between these two events?
sentences.zh: 你看得出這兩件事有任何相似之處嗎？

sentences.en: Parallel parking is the hardest part of the driving test.
sentences.zh: 平行停車是駕照考試中最難的部分。

sentences.en: The movie draws a parallel between two very different families.
sentences.zh: 這部電影點出兩個截然不同的家庭之間的相似之處。

sentences.en: The documentary explains how paramilitary groups formed in the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片說明準軍事團體如何在1920年代形成。

sentences.en: Was the paramilitary police force created after the war?
sentences.zh: 這支準軍事警察部隊是戰後成立的嗎？

sentences.en: The history textbook describes a paramilitary organization of that era.
sentences.zh: 歷史課本描述了那個年代的一個準軍事組織。

sentences.en: In the movie, paramilitary forces guard the city gates.
sentences.zh: 電影中，準軍事部隊守衛著城門。

sentences.en: News reports said a paramilitary unit helped after the flood.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導說，一支準軍事部隊在洪水後協助救災。

sentences.en: Did the article say the paramilitary group was part of the police?
sentences.zh: 文章有說這個準軍事團體隸屬於警方嗎？

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: Put the extra details in parentheses.
sentences.zh: 把額外的細節放在括號裡。

sentences.en: Did you close the parenthesis at the end of the sentence?
sentences.zh: 你有在句尾把括號關起來嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher circled the missing parenthesis in my math answer.
sentences.zh: 老師把我數學答案裡漏掉的括號圈了起來。

sentences.en: Why is the date written in parentheses?
sentences.zh: 為什麼日期寫在括號裡？

sentences.en: Each opening parenthesis needs a matching closing one.
sentences.zh: 每個左括號都需要一個對應的右括號。

sentences.en: Use parentheses to show the part you want to calculate first.
sentences.zh: 用括號標出你想先計算的部分。

gloss_note: grated parmesan 磨碎的帕瑪森起司

sentences.en: Would you like some parmesan on your pasta?
sentences.zh: 你的義大利麵要加一些帕瑪森起司嗎？

sentences.en: She grated fresh parmesan over the salad.
sentences.zh: 她把新鮮的帕瑪森起司刨在沙拉上。

sentences.en: Can I get extra parmesan on the side, please?
sentences.zh: 可以另外附上多一點帕瑪森起司嗎？

sentences.en: This soup tastes better with a little parmesan.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯加一點帕瑪森起司更好喝。

sentences.en: Parmesan keeps for months in the refrigerator if wrapped well.
sentences.zh: 帕瑪森起司包好的話，放冰箱可以保存好幾個月。

sentences.en: I forgot to buy parmesan at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我忘了在超市買帕瑪森起司。

sentences.en: Each participant will receive a free T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 每位參加者都會拿到一件免費的T恤。

sentences.en: How many participants signed up for the workshop?
sentences.zh: 有多少人報名參加這場工作坊？

sentences.en: The survey asked participants about their daily habits.
sentences.zh: 這項調查詢問參與者的日常習慣。

sentences.en: Was she an active participant in the group discussion?
sentences.zh: 她在小組討論中很積極參與嗎？

sentences.en: Participants must arrive fifteen minutes before the race starts.
sentences.zh: 參加者必須在比賽開始前十五分鐘抵達。

sentences.en: The oldest participant in the marathon was eighty years old.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松中年紀最大的參加者已經八十歲了。

sentences.en: The delay was partly my fault.
sentences.zh: 這次延誤有一部分是我的錯。

sentences.en: The meeting was canceled partly because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 會議取消有一部分是因為暴風雨。

sentences.en: Is the roof partly made of glass?
sentences.zh: 屋頂有一部分是玻璃做的嗎？

sentences.en: She was partly right, but she missed one point.
sentences.zh: 她說對了一部分，但漏掉了一點。

sentences.en: Prices went up partly because of higher shipping costs.
sentences.zh: 價格上漲有一部分是因為運費提高。

sentences.en: Are you partly responsible for the mistake, or was it all him?
sentences.zh: 你對這個錯誤也要負一部分責任，還是全是他的錯？

sentences.en: She is passionate about teaching young children.
sentences.zh: 她對教導幼兒充滿熱情。

sentences.en: Are you passionate about your current job?
sentences.zh: 你對現在的工作充滿熱情嗎？

sentences.en: He gave a passionate speech at the team meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在團隊會議上發表了熱情洋溢的演說。

sentences.en: My dad is a passionate gardener.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是個熱愛園藝的人。

sentences.en: Why are you so passionate about recycling?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對回收這麼有熱情？

sentences.en: The chef is passionate about using local ingredients.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚熱愛使用當地的食材。

sentences.en: I'd like a coffee and a fresh pastry, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一杯咖啡和一個新鮮的糕點。

sentences.en: Are these pastries baked fresh every morning?
sentences.zh: 這些點心是每天早上現烤的嗎？

sentences.en: She baked a flaky pastry filled with apples.
sentences.zh: 她烤了一個內餡是蘋果的酥皮點心。

sentences.en: Pastries sell out fast at our cafe on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 週日我們咖啡館的點心很快就賣完了。

sentences.en: Which pastry do you recommend from the display case?
sentences.zh: 展示櫃裡的點心，你推薦哪一種？

sentences.en: He brought a box of pastries to the morning meeting.
sentences.zh: 他帶了一盒糕點到早上的會議。

sentences.en: I sewed a patch on the knee of his jeans.
sentences.zh: 我在他牛仔褲的膝蓋處縫了一塊補丁。

sentences.en: There's a patch of mold on the bathroom ceiling.
sentences.zh: 浴室天花板上有一塊黴斑。

sentences.en: Is there a patch of grass big enough for a picnic?
sentences.zh: 有沒有一塊夠大的草地可以野餐？

sentences.en: Be careful, there's a patch of ice by the door.
sentences.zh: 小心，門口有一小片結冰。

sentences.en: Did you put a patch over the hole in the tent?
sentences.zh: 你有在帳篷的破洞上貼補丁嗎？

sentences.en: My garden has a sunny patch where tomatoes grow best.
sentences.zh: 我的花園有一小塊向陽的地方，番茄長得最好。

gloss_note: 語氣強烈帶輕蔑，對人使用要小心

sentences.en: Our team's defense was pathetic in the second half.
sentences.zh: 我們隊下半場的防守差勁透了。

sentences.en: That was a pathetic excuse for being late.
sentences.zh: 那是個爛透了的遲到藉口。

sentences.en: Isn't it pathetic that nobody checked the report?
sentences.zh: 居然沒有人檢查報告，不是很可悲嗎？

sentences.en: I felt pathetic after losing to a ten-year-old.
sentences.zh: 輸給十歲的小孩，讓我覺得自己很可悲。

sentences.en: Why is the internet connection in this hotel so pathetic?
sentences.zh: 這家飯店的網路為什麼這麼爛？

sentences.en: The movie's ending was so pathetic that we laughed.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的結局爛到讓我們笑了出來。
