sentences.en: Security guards patrol the parking lot every hour.
sentences.zh: 保全每小時巡邏一次停車場。

sentences.en: Does a police car patrol this neighborhood at night?
sentences.zh: 晚上有警車在這附近巡邏嗎？

sentences.en: The night patrol found a broken window in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 夜間巡邏人員發現倉庫有一扇窗戶破了。

sentences.en: Rangers patrol the park to keep visitors safe.
sentences.zh: 護管員在園區巡邏，確保遊客安全。

sentences.en: How often do guards patrol the office building?
sentences.zh: 警衛多久巡邏一次辦公大樓？

sentences.en: On patrol last night, the officers saw nothing unusual.
sentences.zh: 昨晚巡邏時，警員沒看到任何異狀。

sentences.en: The news said a peacekeeping force will arrive next week.
sentences.zh: 新聞說維和部隊下週會抵達。

sentences.en: Did your grandfather serve in a peacekeeping mission?
sentences.zh: 你祖父參加過維和任務嗎？

sentences.en: The class discussed peacekeeping efforts after the long conflict.
sentences.zh: 課堂上討論了漫長衝突結束後的維和行動。

sentences.en: Peacekeeping troops helped deliver food to the villages.
sentences.zh: 維和部隊協助把食物送到各個村莊。

sentences.en: How successful was the peacekeeping operation in that region?
sentences.zh: 那個地區的維和行動成效如何？

sentences.en: The peacekeeping budget was the main topic in the report.
sentences.zh: 維和經費是這份報告的主要議題。

sentences.en: Press the brake pedal gently when you slow down.
sentences.zh: 減速時要輕輕踩煞車踏板。

sentences.en: Can you reach the pedals on this bike?
sentences.zh: 你搆得到這輛腳踏車的踏板嗎？

sentences.en: She pedaled hard up the hill.
sentences.zh: 她用力踩著踏板爬上山坡。

sentences.en: My foot slipped off the pedal.
sentences.zh: 我的腳從踏板上滑掉了。

sentences.en: How fast do you pedal when you ride to work?
sentences.zh: 你騎車上班時踩得多快？

sentences.en: He had to pedal against the wind all the way home.
sentences.zh: 他回家一路上都得頂著風踩踏板。

gloss_note: peg A to B 把A釘住B

sentences.en: The country decided to peg its currency to the dollar.
sentences.zh: 該國決定把貨幣釘住美元。

sentences.en: Our contract pegs salary raises to inflation.
sentences.zh: 我們的合約把加薪幅度與通貨膨脹掛鉤。

sentences.en: Why did the government peg the exchange rate?
sentences.zh: 政府為什麼要固定匯率？

sentences.en: Can we peg the price of fuel at three dollars?
sentences.zh: 我們能把燃料價格固定在三美元嗎？

sentences.en: The bank pegs its loan rate to the prime rate.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行的貸款利率與基本放款利率掛鉤。

sentences.en: Is your rent pegged to the cost of living?
sentences.zh: 你的房租和生活費用掛鉤嗎？

sentences.en: Your request is still pending approval.
sentences.zh: 你的申請還在等待核准。

sentences.en: Are there any pending orders from last week?
sentences.zh: 上週還有沒處理的訂單嗎？

sentences.en: The decision is still pending; the board meets next week.
sentences.zh: 這項決定還沒定案，董事會下週開會。

sentences.en: Why is my payment still pending?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的款項還在處理中？

sentences.en: Several lawsuits are pending against the company.
sentences.zh: 這家公司還有好幾件訴訟尚未了結。

sentences.en: We have two pending projects that need your review.
sentences.zh: 我們有兩個待處理的專案需要你審閱。

gloss_note: penetrate the market 打入市場

sentences.en: Rain began to penetrate the old roof.
sentences.zh: 雨水開始滲進那個舊屋頂。

sentences.en: Can our products penetrate the Asian market?
sentences.zh: 我們的產品打得進亞洲市場嗎？

sentences.en: The sharp nail could penetrate the thick board.
sentences.zh: 這根尖釘子能穿透厚木板。

sentences.en: Sunlight cannot penetrate deep into the ocean.
sentences.zh: 陽光無法穿透到深海。

sentences.en: How did the startup penetrate the market so quickly?
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司怎麼這麼快就打入市場？

sentences.en: We hope to penetrate the local market next year.
sentences.zh: 我們希望明年能打入當地市場。

sentences.en: My grandfather lives on a small pension.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺靠一小筆退休金過活。

sentences.en: Does the company offer a pension plan?
sentences.zh: 公司有提供退休金計畫嗎？

sentences.en: She will receive her pension at age sixty-five.
sentences.zh: 她六十五歲就能開始領退休金。

sentences.en: Many workers worry their pension won't be enough.
sentences.zh: 許多勞工擔心退休金不夠用。

sentences.en: How much do you pay into your pension each month?
sentences.zh: 你每個月提撥多少錢到退休金？

sentences.en: The city raised the pension for retired teachers.
sentences.zh: 市政府調高了退休教師的退休金。

gloss_note: 美式較常說 retiree（退休人士）

sentences.en: The museum gives a discount to every pensioner.
sentences.zh: 博物館給每位退休人士折扣。

sentences.en: Is the pensioner next door feeling better?
sentences.zh: 隔壁那位退休的長輩好一點了嗎？

sentences.en: The town sent a small gift to each pensioner.
sentences.zh: 鎮上送了一份小禮物給每位退休人士。

sentences.en: The average pensioner spends little on travel.
sentences.zh: 一般退休人士在旅遊上花得不多。

sentences.en: Are you a pensioner, or do you still work?
sentences.zh: 你已經退休了，還是還在工作？

sentences.en: My neighbor is a pensioner who loves gardening.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居已經退休，很愛種花草。

gloss_note: perceive A as B 把A視為B

sentences.en: Customers perceive this brand as high quality.
sentences.zh: 顧客認為這個品牌品質很好。

sentences.en: How do you perceive the risks of this project?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼看這項計畫的風險？

sentences.en: Dogs can perceive sounds that humans cannot hear.
sentences.zh: 狗能察覺到人類聽不見的聲音。

sentences.en: Did you perceive any change in his attitude?
sentences.zh: 你有察覺到他的態度有什麼改變嗎？

sentences.en: Many people perceive the new rule as unfair.
sentences.zh: 許多人認為這項新規定不公平。

sentences.en: I perceived a faint smell of smoke in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 我察覺到走廊有一絲煙味。

sentences.en: Public perception of the company has improved lately.
sentences.zh: 大眾對這家公司的觀感最近有所改善。

sentences.en: How can we change customers' perception of our service?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼改變顧客對服務的看法？

sentences.en: My perception of city life changed after I moved.
sentences.zh: 搬家之後，我對都市生活的看法改變了。

sentences.en: Is this perception of risk based on facts?
sentences.zh: 這種對風險的看法有事實根據嗎？

sentences.en: First impressions shape perception more than we think.
sentences.zh: 第一印象對觀感的影響比我們想的還大。

sentences.en: There's a perception that online stores are cheaper.
sentences.zh: 一般人覺得網路商店比較便宜。

sentences.en: The store closed permanently last month.
sentences.zh: 那家店上個月永久歇業了。

sentences.en: The file was permanently deleted. Can we recover it?
sentences.zh: 檔案被永久刪除了。我們還救得回來嗎？

sentences.en: He is moving here permanently. Did you hear?
sentences.zh: 他要永久搬來這裡了，你聽說了嗎？

sentences.en: The injury could permanently damage his knee.
sentences.zh: 這個傷可能會對他的膝蓋造成永久的損傷。

sentences.en: This road is permanently closed to traffic.
sentences.zh: 這條路永久禁止車輛通行。

sentences.en: She is leaving the company permanently. Who will take her place?
sentences.zh: 她要永久離開公司了。誰會接她的位置？

sentences.en: The baby's perpetual crying kept us awake all night.
sentences.zh: 寶寶不停地哭，害我們整晚沒睡。

sentences.en: Why is the printer in perpetual need of repair?
sentences.zh: 為什麼印表機老是需要維修？

sentences.en: The village lives under perpetual threat of floods.
sentences.zh: 這個村子長期處在洪水的威脅之下。

sentences.en: Is a perpetual motion machine really possible?
sentences.zh: 永動機真的有可能存在嗎？

sentences.en: The company's perpetual losses worried the investors.
sentences.zh: 公司不斷的虧損讓投資人很擔心。

sentences.en: His perpetual complaints about work tired everyone out.
sentences.zh: 他對工作沒完沒了的抱怨讓大家都累了。

sentences.en: She has a persistent cough that won't go away.
sentences.zh: 她一直咳嗽，怎麼都好不了。

sentences.en: Be persistent, and the client may say yes.
sentences.zh: 要堅持下去，客戶說不定就會答應。

sentences.en: Is the persistent noise coming from upstairs again?
sentences.zh: 那個一直響的噪音又是從樓上傳來的嗎？

sentences.en: His persistent efforts finally paid off.
sentences.zh: 他不懈的努力終於有了回報。

sentences.en: He calls every day. Why is that salesman so persistent?
sentences.zh: 他每天都打來。那個業務員為什麼這麼鍥而不捨？

sentences.en: Persistent rain has delayed the road work.
sentences.zh: 持續的降雨延誤了道路工程。

gloss_note: personalize a gift 客製化禮物

sentences.en: Can you personalize the mug with my name?
sentences.zh: 你可以在這個馬克杯上客製我的名字嗎？

sentences.en: We personalize every email for each customer.
sentences.zh: 我們替每位客戶客製化每一封電子郵件。

sentences.en: This app lets you personalize your home screen.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式可以讓你個人化主畫面。

sentences.en: Why not personalize the invitation with a photo?
sentences.zh: 何不放張照片，讓邀請函更有個人特色？

sentences.en: Many websites personalize ads based on what you buy.
sentences.zh: 很多網站會依據你買過的東西，把廣告個人化。

sentences.en: I'll personalize the report for each department.
sentences.zh: 我會替每個部門客製化這份報告。

gloss_note: personnel 指人員；人事部現多說 HR

sentences.en: All personnel must wear badges inside the building.
sentences.zh: 大樓內所有人員都必須佩戴識別證。

sentences.en: Please send the form to the personnel office.
sentences.zh: 請把表格送到人事室。

sentences.en: How many personnel work on the night shift?
sentences.zh: 夜班有多少人員在上班？

sentences.en: Hospital personnel were praised for their quick response.
sentences.zh: 醫院人員因反應迅速而受到讚揚。

sentences.en: Is this area open to authorized personnel only?
sentences.zh: 這個區域只限授權人員進入嗎？

sentences.en: Our personnel are trained to handle emergencies.
sentences.zh: 我們的員工都受過處理緊急狀況的訓練。

gloss_note: from my perspective 就我看來

sentences.en: Let me give you a different perspective.
sentences.zh: 讓我給你另一個角度的看法。

sentences.en: From a customer's perspective, the website is confusing.
sentences.zh: 從顧客的角度來看，這個網站很難懂。

sentences.en: Can you see the issue from her perspective?
sentences.zh: 你能從她的角度來看這件事嗎？

sentences.en: Traveling gave me a new perspective on life.
sentences.zh: 旅行讓我對人生有了新的看法。

sentences.en: What is your perspective on the new schedule?
sentences.zh: 你對新的時程表有什麼看法？

sentences.en: The author writes from a child's perspective.
sentences.zh: 作者是以孩子的觀點來寫的。

gloss_note: 墨西哥、菲律賓等國的貨幣

sentences.en: How many pesos do I get for one dollar?
sentences.zh: 一美元可以換多少披索？

sentences.en: The peso fell sharply against the dollar today.
sentences.zh: 披索今天對美元大幅貶值。

sentences.en: A cup of coffee costs about fifty pesos here.
sentences.zh: 這裡一杯咖啡大約要五十披索。

sentences.en: Do you take pesos, or only dollars?
sentences.zh: 你們收披索，還是只收美元？

sentences.en: I exchanged my pesos at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我在機場把披索換掉了。

sentences.en: The peso is the currency in several countries.
sentences.zh: 披索是好幾個國家使用的貨幣。

sentences.en: There is growing pessimism about the economy.
sentences.zh: 大家對經濟越來越悲觀。

sentences.en: Why is there so much pessimism on the team?
sentences.zh: 為什麼團隊裡的氣氛這麼悲觀？

sentences.en: Her pessimism made the trip harder for everyone.
sentences.zh: 她的悲觀讓這趟旅行對大家都更難熬。

sentences.en: Do you think his pessimism is justified?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他的悲觀有道理嗎？

sentences.en: Pessimism spread after the company lost its biggest client.
sentences.zh: 公司失去最大客戶後，悲觀的氣氛蔓延開來。

sentences.en: Despite the bad news, he refused to give in to pessimism.
sentences.zh: 儘管有壞消息，他仍不肯向悲觀低頭。

sentences.en: Organic farms avoid using chemical pesticides.
sentences.zh: 有機農場避免使用化學農藥。

sentences.en: Is there any pesticide left on these apples?
sentences.zh: 這些蘋果上還有殘留農藥嗎？

sentences.en: Too much pesticide can harm bees and birds.
sentences.zh: 過量的農藥會傷害蜜蜂和鳥類。

sentences.en: Wash vegetables well to remove pesticide residue.
sentences.zh: 蔬菜要洗乾淨，才能去除殘留的農藥。

sentences.en: Should the government limit the use of pesticides?
sentences.zh: 政府應該限制農藥的使用嗎？

sentences.en: The farmer sprayed pesticide on the corn field.
sentences.zh: 農夫在玉米田裡噴灑了殺蟲劑。

sentences.en: Let's not argue over petty details.
sentences.zh: 我們別為了瑣碎的細節爭論了。

sentences.en: Do we keep any petty cash in the office?
sentences.zh: 辦公室有留零用金嗎？

sentences.en: He gets petty about splitting the bill.
sentences.zh: 一說到分攤帳單，他就變得斤斤計較。

sentences.en: Isn't it petty to complain about a small delay?
sentences.zh: 為了一點小延誤就抱怨，不是太小家子氣了嗎？

sentences.en: I'll pay for the taxi from petty cash.
sentences.zh: 計程車費我會用零用金支付。

sentences.en: The two neighbors had a petty quarrel about a fence.
sentences.zh: 兩位鄰居為了圍籬起了點瑣碎的爭執。

sentences.en: The first phase of the project ends in June.
sentences.zh: 計畫的第一階段在六月結束。

sentences.en: Which phase are we in right now?
sentences.zh: 我們現在是在哪個階段？

sentences.en: Toddlers go through a phase of saying no.
sentences.zh: 幼兒都會經歷一個什麼都說不要的時期。

sentences.en: Is the second phase of testing finished yet?
sentences.zh: 第二階段的測試完成了嗎？

sentences.en: Construction will be done in three phases.
sentences.zh: 工程將分三個階段完成。

sentences.en: Don't worry, it's just a phase.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，這只是一個階段。

sentences.en: The singer gave a phenomenal performance last night.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手昨晚的演出精彩絕倫。

sentences.en: Sales growth this quarter was phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 本季的銷售成長相當驚人。

sentences.en: Did you see her phenomenal goal in the final?
sentences.zh: 你有看到她在決賽那顆驚人的進球嗎？

sentences.en: The chef's talent is truly phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚的才華真是非凡。

sentences.en: How did the team make such phenomenal progress?
sentences.zh: 這個團隊是怎麼有這麼驚人的進步？

sentences.en: The view from the mountain was phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 山上的景色美得令人驚嘆。

sentences.en: She has a photographic memory for faces.
sentences.zh: 她對臉孔有過目不忘的本事。

sentences.en: Do you need photographic equipment for the class?
sentences.zh: 這門課需要攝影器材嗎？

sentences.en: The museum shows photographic prints from the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出1920年代的老照片。

sentences.en: Is a photographic memory something you can train?
sentences.zh: 過目不忘是可以訓練出來的嗎？

sentences.en: He studies photographic techniques at art school.
sentences.zh: 他在藝術學校學習攝影技巧。

sentences.en: The report included photographic evidence of the damage.
sentences.zh: 報告附上了災損的照片證據。

sentences.en: We walked to the end of the pier.
sentences.zh: 我們走到碼頭的盡頭。

sentences.en: Is the ferry leaving from this pier?
sentences.zh: 渡輪是從這個碼頭出發嗎？

sentences.en: Fishermen sat along the pier at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 日出時，漁夫們坐在碼頭邊。

sentences.en: Many people go fishing off the pier on weekends.
sentences.zh: 很多人週末會到碼頭釣魚。

sentences.en: The storm damaged the old wooden pier.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨損壞了那座舊木造碼頭。

sentences.en: Can we meet you at the pier at noon?
sentences.zh: 我們中午可以在碼頭跟你碰面嗎？

gloss_note: a pillar of society 社會的支柱

sentences.en: Four stone pillars hold up the roof.
sentences.zh: 四根石柱撐起了屋頂。

sentences.en: Honesty is a pillar of any good team.
sentences.zh: 誠實是任何好團隊的支柱。

sentences.en: Can you see the clock behind that pillar?
sentences.zh: 你看得到那根柱子後面的時鐘嗎？

sentences.en: Teachers are pillars of the local community.
sentences.zh: 老師是地方社區的支柱。

sentences.en: Why is this pillar in the middle of the room?
sentences.zh: 這根柱子為什麼會在房間正中央？

sentences.en: Family is the main pillar of her life.
sentences.zh: 家人是她生活中最重要的支柱。

sentences.en: In the movie, the pirate hides his gold on an island.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，海盜把他的金子藏在一座島上。

sentences.en: Did pirates really bury treasure on islands?
sentences.zh: 海盜真的會把寶藏埋在島上嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher told us about a pirate from the 1700s.
sentences.zh: 老師跟我們講了一位1700年代的海盜。

sentences.en: Does your son want to dress as a pirate?
sentences.zh: 你兒子想扮成海盜嗎？

sentences.en: Pirates sailed these waters hundreds of years ago.
sentences.zh: 幾百年前，海盜曾在這片海域航行。

sentences.en: The little boy waved his toy sword like a pirate.
sentences.zh: 小男孩像海盜一樣揮舞著他的玩具劍。

sentences.en: The pitcher threw a fastball to start the game.
sentences.zh: 投手投出一記速球為比賽揭開序幕。

sentences.en: Who is the starting pitcher tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚的先發投手是誰？

sentences.en: Our pitcher struck out ten batters yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們的投手昨天三振了十名打者。

sentences.en: Is your son a pitcher or a catcher?
sentences.zh: 你兒子是投手還是捕手？

sentences.en: The pitcher was tired after seven innings.
sentences.zh: 投了七局之後，投手已經累了。

sentences.en: She trained for years to become a pitcher.
sentences.zh: 她為了成為投手訓練了好幾年。

gloss_note: a plague of 一大堆（討厭的東西）

sentences.en: A plague swept through the city in the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 中世紀時，一場瘟疫橫掃了整座城市。

sentences.en: Did the plague really kill millions of people?
sentences.zh: 瘟疫真的奪走了數百萬人的性命嗎？

sentences.en: Traffic jams are a daily plague for commuters.
sentences.zh: 塞車是通勤族每天的禍害。

sentences.en: Why are mosquitoes such a plague in summer?
sentences.zh: 為什麼夏天的蚊子這麼惱人？

sentences.en: Late payments are a plague for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 延遲付款是小型企業的禍害。

sentences.en: Old stories describe a plague that emptied whole villages.
sentences.zh: 古老的故事描述一場瘟疫讓整個村莊人去樓空。

sentences.en: She plainly needs help. Should we call someone?
sentences.zh: 她顯然需要幫忙。我們要不要找人來？

sentences.en: He told the client plainly that the price was final.
sentences.zh: 他直接告訴客戶，價格不能再談了。

sentences.en: The sign plainly says no parking after six.
sentences.zh: 標示寫得很清楚：六點後禁止停車。

sentences.en: I'll say it plainly: we can't finish by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我就直說吧：我們週五完成不了。

sentences.en: The mistake was plainly my fault. Can I fix it?
sentences.zh: 這個錯顯然是我造成的。我可以來補救嗎？

sentences.en: He plainly wasn't listening. Why did you keep talking?
sentences.zh: 他顯然沒在聽。你為什麼還繼續講？

sentences.en: The geography teacher showed us pictures of a coffee plantation.
sentences.zh: 地理老師讓我們看了咖啡園的照片。

sentences.en: Workers on the tea plantation start before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 茶園的工人天亮前就開工了。

sentences.en: Was the plantation large enough to employ hundreds of people?
sentences.zh: 這座大農場大到能僱用數百人嗎？

sentences.en: Rubber plantations cover much of the region.
sentences.zh: 橡膠園遍布這個地區的大部分地方。

sentences.en: Do you want to visit a banana plantation?
sentences.zh: 你想去參觀香蕉園嗎？

sentences.en: The old plantation is now a museum.
sentences.zh: 那座舊農場現在是博物館。

sentences.en: The family made a plea for help on the news.
sentences.zh: 這家人在新聞上呼籲大家伸出援手。

sentences.en: Did you hear his plea for a second chance?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到他請求再給一次機會嗎？

sentences.en: Her plea for more time was rejected.
sentences.zh: 她要求多給一點時間的請求被駁回了。

sentences.en: The manager ignored our plea for a day off.
sentences.zh: 經理沒理會我們請一天假的請求。

sentences.en: Why did nobody answer the child's plea?
sentences.zh: 為什麼沒有人回應那個孩子的哀求？

sentences.en: The shelter issued a plea for blankets and food.
sentences.zh: 收容所發出呼籲，希望募集毛毯和食物。

gloss_note: plead with sb 向某人懇求

sentences.en: The little girl pleaded with her dad for a puppy.
sentences.zh: 小女孩央求爸爸買一隻小狗給她。

sentences.en: Do I have to plead with you every time?
sentences.zh: 難道每次都要我求你嗎？

sentences.en: He pleaded for more time to finish the report.
sentences.zh: 他懇求多給一點時間完成報告。

sentences.en: Would you plead with the boss to change his mind?
sentences.zh: 你會去求老闆改變心意嗎？

sentences.en: Villagers pleaded for help after the flood.
sentences.zh: 洪水過後，村民們哀求救援。

sentences.en: She pleaded with him not to leave.
sentences.zh: 她哀求他不要走。

sentences.en: Her description of the sunset was almost poetic.
sentences.zh: 她對夕陽的描述充滿詩意。

sentences.en: Is there a poetic meaning behind this song?
sentences.zh: 這首歌背後有什麼詩意的涵義嗎？

sentences.en: He has a poetic way of saying simple things.
sentences.zh: 他說簡單的事情時，總帶著一股詩意。

sentences.en: The class studied poetic forms such as the sonnet.
sentences.zh: 班上學習了十四行詩這類詩歌的形式。

sentences.en: Don't you think the ending is poetic?
sentences.zh: 你不覺得這個結局很有詩意嗎？

sentences.en: It felt poetic to watch the snow fall quietly.
sentences.zh: 看著雪靜靜落下，感覺很有詩意。

gloss_note: poke at the fire 撥弄火堆

sentences.en: Don't poke the cake with dirty fingers.
sentences.zh: 別用髒手指戳蛋糕。

sentences.en: She poked me in the arm to wake me up.
sentences.zh: 她戳我的手臂把我叫醒。

sentences.en: Why do you keep poking the sleeping cat?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼一直戳那隻睡著的貓？

sentences.en: He gave the soft dough a gentle poke.
sentences.zh: 他輕輕戳了一下柔軟的麵團。

sentences.en: Can you poke a hole in the lid?
sentences.zh: 你可以在蓋子上戳個洞嗎？

sentences.en: I poked the potato with a fork to check it.
sentences.zh: 我用叉子戳馬鈴薯，看熟了沒。

sentences.en: Every policyholder will receive a letter this week.
sentences.zh: 每位保戶本週都會收到一封信。

sentences.en: Can a policyholder change coverage online?
sentences.zh: 保戶可以在線上更改保障內容嗎？

sentences.en: The policyholder filed a claim after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，保戶提出了理賠申請。

sentences.en: Are policyholders required to pay in advance?
sentences.zh: 保戶需要預先繳費嗎？

sentences.en: The insurer refunded money to thousands of policyholders.
sentences.zh: 保險公司退款給數千名保戶。

sentences.en: As a policyholder, you can call us anytime.
sentences.zh: 身為保戶，您隨時都可以打電話給我們。

sentences.en: Policymakers met to discuss the new housing plan.
sentences.zh: 政策制定者開會討論新的住宅計畫。

sentences.en: What do policymakers need to know about this issue?
sentences.zh: 政策制定者需要了解這個議題的哪些面向？

sentences.en: Researchers sent the report to local policymakers.
sentences.zh: 研究人員把報告送給了地方的政策制定者。

sentences.en: Would you like to become a policymaker one day?
sentences.zh: 你有一天會想成為政策制定者嗎？

sentences.en: Good policymakers listen to the people they serve.
sentences.zh: 優秀的政策制定者會傾聽他們服務對象的聲音。

sentences.en: The company hired a former policymaker as an advisor.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請了一位前政策制定者擔任顧問。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: We like to sit on the porch after dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們喜歡晚餐後坐在門廊上。

sentences.en: Is the package on the front porch?
sentences.zh: 包裹放在前廊嗎？

sentences.en: The delivery driver left a box on the porch.
sentences.zh: 送貨司機把一個箱子留在門廊上。

sentences.en: A rocking chair stood on the old porch.
sentences.zh: 舊門廊上放著一張搖椅。

sentences.en: Can you turn on the porch light, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把門廊的燈打開嗎？

sentences.en: Rain pounded the porch roof all night.
sentences.zh: 雨整夜猛打著門廊的屋頂。

sentences.en: The film's portrayal of farm life felt very real.
sentences.zh: 這部電影對農場生活的刻畫非常真實。

sentences.en: Do you think the portrayal of the hero is fair?
sentences.zh: 你覺得對這位英雄的描繪公允嗎？

sentences.en: Critics praised her portrayal of a nervous teacher.
sentences.zh: 評論家稱讚她對一位緊張老師的詮釋。

sentences.en: The book's portrayal of the 1800s is quite accurate.
sentences.zh: 這本書對1800年代的描繪相當準確。

sentences.en: How accurate is this portrayal of office work?
sentences.zh: 這樣描繪上班生活有多貼近事實？

sentences.en: The news report gave a negative portrayal of the town.
sentences.zh: 那則新聞報導對這個小鎮的描繪很負面。

sentences.en: My roommate is a postgraduate in the chemistry department.
sentences.zh: 我的室友是化學系的研究生。

sentences.en: How many postgraduates study at your university?
sentences.zh: 你們大學有多少研究生？

sentences.en: Postgraduates often work as teaching assistants.
sentences.zh: 研究生常擔任助教。

sentences.en: The postgraduate presented her research at the conference.
sentences.zh: 那位研究生在研討會上發表了她的研究。

sentences.en: Is this room reserved for postgraduates only?
sentences.zh: 這間教室只留給研究生使用嗎？

sentences.en: He became a postgraduate right after finishing college.
sentences.zh: 他一讀完大學就成了研究生。

sentences.en: Bananas are rich in potassium.
sentences.zh: 香蕉富含鉀。

sentences.en: Do you get enough potassium in your diet?
sentences.zh: 你的飲食有攝取到足夠的鉀嗎？

sentences.en: Potassium helps your muscles and nerves work properly.
sentences.zh: 鉀能幫助肌肉和神經正常運作。

sentences.en: The label says one serving has 400 milligrams of potassium.
sentences.zh: 標示寫著一份含有400毫克的鉀。

sentences.en: Which foods contain the most potassium?
sentences.zh: 哪些食物含鉀量最高？

sentences.en: Too little potassium can cause leg cramps.
sentences.zh: 鉀攝取太少可能造成腿部抽筋。

gloss_note: as a precaution 以防萬一

sentences.en: Wear a helmet as a precaution.
sentences.zh: 戴上安全帽以防萬一。

sentences.en: We took extra precautions during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間，我們格外做了防範。

sentences.en: What precautions should we take before the trip?
sentences.zh: 出發旅行前，我們該做哪些預防措施？

sentences.en: As a precaution, the school closed early.
sentences.zh: 為了預防萬一，學校提早放學。

sentences.en: Did you take any precautions against the flu?
sentences.zh: 你有做任何預防流感的措施嗎？

sentences.en: Safety precautions are listed on the first page.
sentences.zh: 安全預防措施列在第一頁。

sentences.en: This decision sets a precedent for future cases.
sentences.zh: 這項決定為日後的案件開了先例。

sentences.en: Is there a precedent for this kind of contract?
sentences.zh: 這種合約有先例可循嗎？

sentences.en: We have no precedent for handling a complaint like this.
sentences.zh: 我們沒有處理這類客訴的先例。

sentences.en: The court followed a precedent from ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 法院依循了十年前的先例。

sentences.en: Will this change create a dangerous precedent?
sentences.zh: 這個改變會不會開出危險的先例？

sentences.en: Can you find a precedent in our old files?
sentences.zh: 你能在我們的舊檔案裡找到先例嗎？

gloss_note: precipitate a crisis 引發危機

sentences.en: The shortage precipitated a crisis in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 物資短缺使這家醫院突然陷入危機。

sentences.en: Could one small mistake precipitate such a disaster?
sentences.zh: 一個小失誤有可能引發這麼大的災難嗎？

sentences.en: The scandal precipitated the manager's resignation.
sentences.zh: 這起醜聞促使經理辭職。

sentences.en: Heavy debt may precipitate the company's collapse.
sentences.zh: 沉重的債務可能加速公司的倒閉。

sentences.en: What precipitated the sudden drop in sales?
sentences.zh: 是什麼原因造成銷售突然下滑？

sentences.en: A sharp rise in oil prices precipitated the recession.
sentences.zh: 油價飆漲促成了這場經濟衰退。

sentences.en: Annual precipitation here is about forty inches.
sentences.zh: 這裡的年降水量約為四十英寸。

sentences.en: Will there be any precipitation this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末會下雨或下雪嗎？

sentences.en: Precipitation includes rain, snow, and hail.
sentences.zh: 降水包括雨、雪和冰雹。

sentences.en: The region gets little precipitation in winter.
sentences.zh: 這個地區冬天降水很少。

sentences.en: How much precipitation fell during the storm?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間降下了多少雨量？

sentences.en: Heavy precipitation caused flooding in several towns.
sentences.zh: 大量降水造成好幾個城鎮淹水。

sentences.en: The machine cuts metal with great precision.
sentences.zh: 這台機器切割金屬的精準度很高。

sentences.en: Does this job require a lot of precision?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要很高的精確度嗎？

sentences.en: She described the plan with remarkable precision.
sentences.zh: 她非常精確地說明了這個計畫。

sentences.en: The surgeon's precision impressed everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 外科醫師的精準讓在場所有人都印象深刻。

sentences.en: How can we improve the precision of our forecasts?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼提高預測的準確度？

sentences.en: Precision matters when you measure ingredients for baking.
sentences.zh: 烘焙時量材料的精確度很重要。

sentences.en: The lion is a top predator in Africa.
sentences.zh: 獅子是非洲的頂級掠食者。

sentences.en: What predators hunt rabbits in this area?
sentences.zh: 這一帶有哪些掠食動物會獵捕兔子？

sentences.en: Without predators, deer populations can grow too fast.
sentences.zh: 沒有掠食者，鹿群的數量可能會成長得太快。

sentences.en: Birds build nests high up to avoid predators.
sentences.zh: 鳥類把巢築在高處以躲避掠食者。

sentences.en: Is the shark the ocean's biggest predator?
sentences.zh: 鯊魚是海洋中最大的掠食者嗎？

sentences.en: The documentary showed a predator stalking its prey.
sentences.zh: 紀錄片拍到一隻掠食者正悄悄跟蹤獵物。

gloss_note: a good predictor of 是…的良好指標

sentences.en: Past sales are a good predictor of future demand.
sentences.zh: 過去的銷售量是預測未來需求的良好指標。

sentences.en: Is income the best predictor of spending habits?
sentences.zh: 收入是預測消費習慣的最佳指標嗎？

sentences.en: Test scores alone are a poor predictor of success.
sentences.zh: 光看考試成績並不能準確預測一個人的成就。

sentences.en: What is the strongest predictor of customer loyalty?
sentences.zh: 預測顧客忠誠度最強的指標是什麼？

sentences.en: The study found age to be a reliable predictor.
sentences.zh: 研究發現年齡是個可靠的預測因素。

sentences.en: Economists watch several predictors of economic growth.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家會觀察幾項預測經濟成長的指標。

sentences.en: Prejudice against older workers is still common.
sentences.zh: 對年長員工的偏見仍然很常見。

sentences.en: Do you think hiring managers have hidden prejudice?
sentences.zh: 你覺得招募主管心裡有隱藏的偏見嗎？

sentences.en: He worked hard to overcome prejudice at school.
sentences.zh: 他努力克服在學校所遭遇的偏見。

sentences.en: Education can reduce prejudice among young people.
sentences.zh: 教育可以減少年輕人之間的偏見。

sentences.en: Is there any prejudice in the way we choose employees?
sentences.zh: 我們挑選員工的方式有任何偏見嗎？

sentences.en: The film shows how prejudice can hurt a small town.
sentences.zh: 這部電影呈現偏見如何傷害一個小鎮。

sentences.en: It's premature to celebrate before the final result.
sentences.zh: 在最終結果出來前就慶祝還太早了。

sentences.en: Was the decision to cancel premature?
sentences.zh: 取消的決定是否太草率了？

sentences.en: I think the announcement is premature.
sentences.zh: 我認為這項宣布還言之過早。

sentences.en: A premature judgment can hurt the whole team.
sentences.zh: 草率的判斷可能會傷害整個團隊。

sentences.en: Isn't it premature to buy tickets already?
sentences.zh: 現在就買票不是太早了嗎？

sentences.en: The premature launch caused many problems for the company.
sentences.zh: 過早上市給公司帶來了許多問題。

sentences.en: This is the city's premier hotel for business travelers.
sentences.zh: 這是本市商務旅客的首選高級飯店。

sentences.en: She works at a premier research lab.
sentences.zh: 她在一家頂尖的研究實驗室工作。

sentences.en: Is this the premier event of the year?
sentences.zh: 這是今年最重要的盛會嗎？

sentences.en: The company is a premier supplier of car parts.
sentences.zh: 這家公司是頂尖的汽車零件供應商。

sentences.en: Which school is the premier choice for music?
sentences.zh: 哪一所學校是學音樂的首選？

sentences.en: The shop is a premier destination for bike lovers.
sentences.zh: 這家店是單車愛好者的首選去處。

gloss_note: on the premise that 以…為前提

sentences.en: The argument is built on a false premise.
sentences.zh: 這個論點建立在錯誤的前提上。

sentences.en: What is the main premise of your proposal?
sentences.zh: 你這份提案的主要前提是什麼？

sentences.en: The whole plan rests on one simple premise.
sentences.zh: 整個計畫都建立在一個簡單的前提上。

sentences.en: Do you agree with the premise of the book?
sentences.zh: 你同意這本書的前提嗎？

sentences.en: The show's premise is simple: two strangers swap homes.
sentences.zh: 這個節目的前提很簡單：兩個陌生人交換住家。

sentences.en: Let's start with the premise that customers want speed.
sentences.zh: 我們就從顧客想要速度這個前提開始吧。

sentences.en: The hotel requires a prepayment of one night's stay.
sentences.zh: 飯店要求預付一晚的住宿費用。

sentences.en: Is prepayment necessary for online orders?
sentences.zh: 網路訂單需要預付款嗎？

sentences.en: A prepayment of fifty dollars secures your seat.
sentences.zh: 預付五十美元就能保留你的座位。

sentences.en: Please send the prepayment before the shipment leaves.
sentences.zh: 請在貨物出發前匯出預付款。

sentences.en: Can I get a refund on my prepayment?
sentences.zh: 我的預付款可以退款嗎？

sentences.en: Prepayment lowers the risk for small suppliers.
sentences.zh: 預付款能降低小型供應商的風險。

sentences.en: The presidential election is held every four years.
sentences.zh: 總統大選每四年舉行一次。

sentences.en: Did you read the article about the presidential library?
sentences.zh: 你有讀過那篇關於總統圖書館的文章嗎？

sentences.en: Traffic was terrible downtown because of the presidential visit.
sentences.zh: 因為總統來訪，市中心的交通糟透了。

sentences.en: In history class, we read a famous presidential speech.
sentences.zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀了一篇著名的總統演說。

sentences.en: Which presidential museum should we visit this summer?
sentences.zh: 今年夏天我們該去參觀哪一座總統博物館？

sentences.en: She wrote her book report on a presidential biography.
sentences.zh: 她的讀書報告寫的是一本總統傳記。

gloss_note: a prestigious award 備受推崇的獎項

sentences.en: Our company won a prestigious award this year.
sentences.zh: 我們公司今年獲得了一個很有分量的獎項。

sentences.en: Did your manager graduate from a prestigious university?
sentences.zh: 你的經理是從一所名校畢業的嗎？

sentences.en: He got an internship at a prestigious bank.
sentences.zh: 他在一家很有名的銀行找到了實習機會。

sentences.en: Is this a prestigious firm to work for?
sentences.zh: 這是一家值得去上班的知名公司嗎？

sentences.en: It's a prestigious event, so please dress formally.
sentences.zh: 這是個很重要的盛會，所以請穿正式一點。

sentences.en: The magazine named it the most prestigious design contest in Asia.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌稱它為亞洲最負盛名的設計競賽。

gloss_note: 語氣比 probably 更像推測

sentences.en: He's presumably still in a meeting. Should I call later?
sentences.zh: 他大概還在開會。我晚點再打給他好嗎？

sentences.en: It's presumably closed by now. Should we call first?
sentences.zh: 現在大概已經打烊了。我們要先打電話確認嗎？

sentences.en: You've presumably heard the news already. Am I right?
sentences.zh: 你想必已經聽說那個消息了。我說得對嗎？

sentences.en: The package will presumably arrive on Monday.
sentences.zh: 那個包裹大概星期一會到。

sentences.en: Presumably, the test will cover chapters one through five.
sentences.zh: 考試想必會涵蓋第一到第五章。

sentences.en: The road is presumably icy, so drive slowly.
sentences.zh: 路面大概結冰了，所以開慢一點。

gloss_note: 多為不可數；bird of prey 猛禽

sentences.en: The owl waited quietly for its prey.
sentences.zh: 貓頭鷹靜靜地等著牠的獵物。

sentences.en: What kind of prey does a snow leopard hunt?
sentences.zh: 雪豹會獵捕哪一種獵物？

sentences.en: A hawk circled above, searching for prey.
sentences.zh: 一隻老鷹在上空盤旋，尋找獵物。

sentences.en: Fish are the main prey of this bird.
sentences.zh: 魚是這種鳥的主要獵物。

sentences.en: Why do some animals hunt their prey only at night?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些動物只在夜間獵捕獵物？

sentences.en: The lion chased its prey across the open field.
sentences.zh: 獅子追著牠的獵物跑過空曠的原野。

gloss_note: prior notice 事先通知；prior to 之前

sentences.en: Do you have prior experience in sales?
sentences.zh: 你有過銷售的相關經驗嗎？

sentences.en: Please give us prior notice if you can't come.
sentences.zh: 如果你不能來，請事先通知我們。

sentences.en: I have a prior commitment on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我星期五下午已經有約了。

sentences.en: Did you get prior approval from your manager?
sentences.zh: 你有事先取得經理的同意嗎？

sentences.en: Prior knowledge of math helps in this class.
sentences.zh: 先具備一些數學知識，對這門課有幫助。

sentences.en: The store requires prior notice for large orders.
sentences.zh: 這家店要求大量訂單要提前通知。

gloss_note: proclaim A (as) B 宣布 A 為 B；較正式

sentences.en: The mayor proclaimed Friday a day of celebration.
sentences.zh: 市長宣布星期五為慶祝日。

sentences.en: The banner proclaims the grand opening of the store.
sentences.zh: 布條宣告這家店即將盛大開幕。

sentences.en: Did the company proclaim its new goals at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 公司有在會議上公開宣布新目標嗎？

sentences.en: He proudly proclaimed that he had finished first.
sentences.zh: 他得意地宣布自己拿了第一名。

sentences.en: The sign proclaims the best pizza in town. Is it true?
sentences.zh: 那塊招牌宣稱這是全鎮最好吃的披薩。是真的嗎？

sentences.en: The newspaper proclaimed the team's victory on the front page.
sentences.zh: 報紙在頭版大幅宣告了該隊的勝利。

gloss_note: prod sb into doing 催促某人去做

sentences.en: I have to prod him to finish the report.
sentences.zh: 我得催他把報告寫完。

sentences.en: Could you prod the vendor about our late order?
sentences.zh: 你可以去催一下供應商我們延遲的訂單嗎？

sentences.en: A little prodding might get the team moving.
sentences.zh: 稍微催一下，也許能讓團隊動起來。

sentences.en: Falling sales prodded the firm to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 銷售下滑迫使公司削減成本。

sentences.en: Does anyone need to prod the client for payment?
sentences.zh: 有人需要去催客戶付款嗎？

sentences.en: The sale prodded customers into buying early.
sentences.zh: 這次特價促使顧客提早購買。

sentences.en: Please handle every complaint professionally.
sentences.zh: 請專業地處理每一件客訴。

sentences.en: She dressed professionally for the job interview.
sentences.zh: 她為了面試穿得很專業。

sentences.en: Did he answer the client's email professionally?
sentences.zh: 他有以專業的方式回覆客戶的電子郵件嗎？

sentences.en: Professionally, this job is a big step for me.
sentences.zh: 就職涯而言，這份工作對我是一大步。

sentences.en: How can we speak more professionally on the phone?
sentences.zh: 我們講電話時要怎麼說得更專業？

sentences.en: The room was professionally cleaned before the guests arrived.
sentences.zh: 客人到達前，房間已由專業人員清潔過。

gloss_note: update your profile 更新個人資料

sentences.en: Please update your profile on the website.
sentences.zh: 請在網站上更新你的個人資料。

sentences.en: Did you see her profile picture?
sentences.zh: 你看過她的個人檔案照片嗎？

sentences.en: His profile says he enjoys hiking and photography.
sentences.zh: 他的簡介上寫著他喜歡健行和攝影。

sentences.en: The magazine published a profile of a local chef.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌刊登了一篇當地主廚的人物簡介。

sentences.en: Where can I edit my profile settings?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡修改個人檔案設定？

sentences.en: I read the speaker's profile before the talk.
sentences.zh: 演講前我先讀了講者的簡介。

gloss_note: the proliferation of 某事物的激增

sentences.en: The proliferation of cheap phones changed how we shop.
sentences.zh: 便宜手機的快速普及改變了我們購物的方式。

sentences.en: Is the proliferation of online stores hurting small shops?
sentences.zh: 網路商店的激增是否傷害了小商店？

sentences.en: The report warns about the proliferation of fake reviews.
sentences.zh: 報告警告假評論正在激增。

sentences.en: What caused the proliferation of coffee shops downtown?
sentences.zh: 是什麼造成市中心咖啡店暴增？

sentences.en: There has been a proliferation of new brands this year.
sentences.zh: 今年新品牌大量冒出。

sentences.en: Managers worry about the proliferation of spreadsheets in our department.
sentences.zh: 主管擔心我們部門的試算表越來越多。

gloss_note: prolong the process 拖長流程

sentences.en: Let's not prolong the meeting any longer.
sentences.zh: 我們別再拖長這場會議了。

sentences.en: Will adding another step prolong the process?
sentences.zh: 多加一個步驟會讓流程變長嗎？

sentences.en: Bad weather prolonged our trip by two days.
sentences.zh: 天氣不好讓我們的旅程多拖了兩天。

sentences.en: Proper care can prolong the life of your shoes.
sentences.zh: 妥善保養可以延長鞋子的壽命。

sentences.en: Why did she prolong the call so much?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼把通話拖得那麼久？

sentences.en: Don't prolong the argument; just say you're sorry.
sentences.zh: 別再拖長爭吵了，說聲抱歉就好。

sentences.en: I'm prone to headaches when I skip lunch.
sentences.zh: 我不吃午餐就容易頭痛。

sentences.en: Is this area prone to flooding in the spring?
sentences.zh: 這個地區春天容易淹水嗎？

sentences.en: Old pipes are prone to leaking.
sentences.zh: 老舊的水管很容易漏水。

sentences.en: He is prone to making careless mistakes when tired.
sentences.zh: 他累的時候很容易犯粗心的錯。

sentences.en: Are young children more prone to colds?
sentences.zh: 小孩子比較容易感冒嗎？

sentences.en: Software that is rarely updated is prone to errors.
sentences.zh: 很少更新的軟體容易出錯。

gloss_note: prop up 撐住；prop the door open

sentences.en: Could you prop the door open for the delivery?
sentences.zh: 你可以把門撐開讓貨物送進來嗎？

sentences.en: Prop the sign against the wall near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 把招牌靠在入口旁邊的牆上。

sentences.en: He propped his laptop on a stack of books.
sentences.zh: 他把筆記型電腦墊在一疊書上。

sentences.en: Investors propped up the struggling company with extra cash.
sentences.zh: 投資人用額外的資金撐住了這家吃緊的公司。

sentences.en: Can you prop this poster up on the table?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這張海報立在桌上嗎？

sentences.en: Why is that ladder propped against the shelf?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那把梯子靠在架子上？

gloss_note: 常帶貶意，指刻意影響觀感的資訊

sentences.en: Our history class studied posters used as wartime propaganda.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史課研究了戰時當作文宣的海報。

sentences.en: The museum has an exhibit about old propaganda films.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一個關於老式宣傳影片的展覽。

sentences.en: Is this ad real information or just propaganda?
sentences.zh: 這則廣告是真實資訊，還是只是文宣？

sentences.en: How did propaganda spread before the internet?
sentences.zh: 在有網路以前，文宣是怎麼傳開的？

sentences.en: The documentary explains how propaganda shapes public opinion.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片說明文宣如何影響大眾的看法。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to spot the propaganda in the poster.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們找出海報中的文宣手法。

gloss_note: a prophet of doom 老是唱衰的人

sentences.en: No one is a perfect prophet when it comes to the stock market.
sentences.zh: 說到股市，沒有人能完美預測。

sentences.en: In myth class, we read about a Greek prophet.
sentences.zh: 在神話課上，我們讀到一位希臘的預言家。

sentences.en: He's a prophet of doom who always expects the worst.
sentences.zh: 他老是唱衰，總是預期最糟的情況。

sentences.en: Can anyone be a true prophet of future trends?
sentences.zh: 有人真的能預言未來趨勢嗎？

sentences.en: The old movie shows a prophet who predicts a storm.
sentences.zh: 那部老電影演的是一位預言暴風雨的預言家。

sentences.en: Do you think economists make good prophets?
sentences.zh: 你覺得經濟學家是好的預言家嗎？

gloss_note: a large proportion of 很大一部分

sentences.en: What proportion of students walk to school?
sentences.zh: 有多大比例的學生走路上學？

sentences.en: A large proportion of our sales come from online orders.
sentences.zh: 我們很大一部分銷售額來自網路訂單。

sentences.en: The proportion of sugar to flour is two to one.
sentences.zh: 糖和麵粉的比例是二比一。

sentences.en: Keep the proportions right when you resize the picture.
sentences.zh: 調整圖片大小時，要保持比例正確。

sentences.en: Only a small proportion of the staff works from home.
sentences.zh: 只有一小部分員工在家工作。

sentences.en: Does the recipe give the proportion of water to rice?
sentences.zh: 食譜有寫水和米的比例嗎？

sentences.en: Your bonus is proportional to your sales results.
sentences.zh: 你的獎金和你的業績成正比。

sentences.en: Is the shipping fee proportional to the weight?
sentences.zh: 運費是和重量成比例的嗎？

sentences.en: Pay should be proportional to the hours worked.
sentences.zh: 薪水應該和工作時數成比例。

sentences.en: The cost is directly proportional to the size of the order.
sentences.zh: 成本和訂單大小成正比。

sentences.en: Are the drawings proportional to the real building?
sentences.zh: 這些圖和實際的建築物比例一致嗎？

sentences.en: We need a proportional increase in staff for the larger store.
sentences.zh: 店面變大，人手也需要等比例增加。

sentences.en: She runs her bakery as a sole proprietorship.
sentences.zh: 她以獨資的方式經營她的烘焙店。

sentences.en: Is a sole proprietorship easy to set up?
sentences.zh: 獨資企業容易成立嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle's shop is a proprietorship, not a corporation.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔的店是獨資經營，不是公司。

sentences.en: What taxes does a proprietorship pay?
sentences.zh: 獨資企業要繳哪些稅？

sentences.en: He turned his sole proprietorship into a larger company.
sentences.zh: 他把自己的獨資企業發展成一家較大的公司。

sentences.en: The owner of a proprietorship is responsible for all debts.
sentences.zh: 獨資企業的老闆要為所有債務負責。

sentences.en: The job prospects for nurses look very good.
sentences.zh: 護理師的就業前景看起來很好。

sentences.en: I'm excited about the prospect of traveling to Italy.
sentences.zh: 一想到能去義大利旅行，我就很興奮。

sentences.en: What are the prospects for this industry next year?
sentences.zh: 這個產業明年的前景如何？

sentences.en: There's little prospect of rain this week.
sentences.zh: 這個星期不太可能下雨。

sentences.en: Did the bad news hurt your prospects of getting promoted?
sentences.zh: 那個壞消息有影響你升遷的機會嗎？

sentences.en: Graduates in this field have good career prospects.
sentences.zh: 這個領域的畢業生職涯前景不錯。

gloss_note: build a prototype 製作原型

sentences.en: The engineers built a prototype of the new phone.
sentences.zh: 工程師做出了新手機的原型。

sentences.en: Can we test the prototype this Friday?
sentences.zh: 我們這個星期五可以測試原型機嗎？

sentences.en: The first prototype was too heavy to carry.
sentences.zh: 第一個原型太重了，沒辦法提著走。

sentences.en: How long did it take to finish the prototype?
sentences.zh: 完成這個原型花了多久時間？

sentences.en: Our team presented a working prototype to investors.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊向投資人展示了可運作的原型。

sentences.en: Customers will try a prototype at the trade show.
sentences.zh: 顧客會在展覽會上試用原型機。

gloss_note: 加拿大等國的一級行政區

sentences.en: Canada has ten provinces and three territories.
sentences.zh: 加拿大有十個省和三個地區。

sentences.en: Which province is famous for its maple syrup?
sentences.zh: 哪一個省以楓糖漿聞名？

sentences.en: We took a train through a rural province last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我們搭火車穿過一個鄉村省分。

sentences.en: The province plans to build a new bridge next year.
sentences.zh: 這個省計畫明年蓋一座新橋。

sentences.en: My cousin lives in a small province in the south.
sentences.zh: 我有個表親住在南部的一個小省分。

sentences.en: Does your country have provinces or states?
sentences.zh: 你的國家分成省還是州？

gloss_note: a provision in a contract 合約條款

sentences.en: The provision of free lunch made the staff happy.
sentences.zh: 提供免費午餐讓員工很開心。

sentences.en: Is there a provision for overtime pay in my contract?
sentences.zh: 我的合約裡有加班費的條款嗎？

sentences.en: The contract has a provision about late payments.
sentences.zh: 合約中有一條關於逾期付款的規定。

sentences.en: The city is responsible for the provision of clean water.
sentences.zh: 市政府負責供應乾淨的水。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of the provision of office supplies?
sentences.zh: 誰負責供應辦公用品？

sentences.en: The new law includes a provision on recycling.
sentences.zh: 這項新法律包含一條關於資源回收的規定。

gloss_note: a prudent decision 審慎的決定

sentences.en: It's prudent to save some money every month.
sentences.zh: 每個月存一點錢是明智的。

sentences.en: Is it prudent to spend so much on ads?
sentences.zh: 花這麼多錢打廣告明智嗎？

sentences.en: The manager made a prudent decision about the budget.
sentences.zh: 經理對預算做了謹慎的決定。

sentences.en: A prudent investor never puts all his money in one place.
sentences.zh: 謹慎的投資人不會把全部的錢放在同一個地方。

sentences.en: Would it be prudent to wait until next quarter?
sentences.zh: 等到下一季再做會比較穩當嗎？

sentences.en: Be prudent when you sign a long contract.
sentences.zh: 簽長期合約時要小心謹慎。

gloss_note: publicize an event 宣傳活動

sentences.en: We need to publicize the event on social media.
sentences.zh: 我們需要在社群媒體上宣傳這個活動。

sentences.en: How will the store publicize its grand opening?
sentences.zh: 這家店要怎麼宣傳它的開幕？

sentences.en: The company publicized its new product with videos.
sentences.zh: 公司用影片宣傳它的新產品。

sentences.en: Please publicize the new schedule on the company website.
sentences.zh: 請把新的時間表公布在公司網站上。

sentences.en: Did the school publicize the winners' names?
sentences.zh: 學校有公布得獎者的名字嗎？

sentences.en: The team publicized the concert with colorful posters.
sentences.zh: 團隊用彩色海報宣傳這場演唱會。

gloss_note: 班機或客輪上負責客艙事務的人員

sentences.en: The purser welcomed passengers at the airplane door.
sentences.zh: 座艙長在機艙門口迎接乘客。

sentences.en: Could you ask the purser to come to our seats?
sentences.zh: 可以請座艙長到我們的座位來一下嗎？

sentences.en: The purser announced that the flight would be delayed.
sentences.zh: 座艙長宣布班機將會延誤。

sentences.en: Where is the purser during boarding?
sentences.zh: 登機時座艙長在哪裡？

sentences.en: A purser on a ship handles passenger tickets and money.
sentences.zh: 客輪上的事務長負責處理乘客的船票和款項。

sentences.en: Our flight's purser was friendly and helpful.
sentences.zh: 我們這班飛機的座艙長親切又樂於幫忙。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: We took photos in front of the pyramid in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 我們在埃及的金字塔前拍了照。

sentences.en: Have you ever visited a pyramid in Egypt?
sentences.zh: 你去過埃及的金字塔嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher drew a food pyramid on the board.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個食物金字塔。

sentences.en: How were the pyramids built so long ago?
sentences.zh: 金字塔在那麼久以前是怎麼蓋起來的？

sentences.en: The museum has a small glass pyramid at its entrance.
sentences.zh: 博物館的入口處有一座小型玻璃金字塔。

sentences.en: Stack the cups in a pyramid for the party.
sentences.zh: 為了派對，把杯子疊成金字塔形。

sentences.en: Do you qualify for the student discount?
sentences.zh: 你符合學生折扣的資格嗎？

sentences.en: You need two years of experience to qualify.
sentences.zh: 你需要兩年的經驗才符合資格。

sentences.en: She qualified for the final by winning the race.
sentences.zh: 她贏得比賽，取得了決賽資格。

sentences.en: Does this ticket qualify me for a free upgrade?
sentences.zh: 這張票能讓我免費升等嗎？

sentences.en: Our team didn't qualify for the tournament this year.
sentences.zh: 我們的隊伍今年沒有取得錦標賽的資格。

sentences.en: A college degree qualifies you for many jobs.
sentences.zh: 大學學歷讓你符合許多工作的資格。

gloss_note: high quality 高品質；也可當形容詞

sentences.en: This restaurant uses only high-quality ingredients.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳只用優質的食材。

sentences.en: The quality of the soup really surprised me.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯的品質真的讓我很驚喜。

sentences.en: Is the quality of the fish good here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的魚品質好嗎？

sentences.en: We care more about food quality than about price.
sentences.zh: 我們比較在乎食物品質，而不是價格。

sentences.en: How can you tell the quality of fresh bread?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼判斷新鮮麵包的品質？

sentences.en: Quality olive oil makes a big difference in this dish.
sentences.zh: 優質的橄欖油能讓這道菜差很多。

gloss_note: a quest for 對…的追求

sentences.en: His quest for the perfect pizza took him across the country.
sentences.zh: 他為了找到完美的披薩，走遍了全國。

sentences.en: Her quest for knowledge never ended.
sentences.zh: 她對知識的追求從未停止。

sentences.en: Is this movie about a quest to find lost treasure?
sentences.zh: 這部電影是講尋找失落寶藏的冒險嗎？

sentences.en: The hero begins a long quest in the first chapter.
sentences.zh: 主角在第一章就展開了漫長的探索旅程。

sentences.en: Are you still on your quest to learn Spanish?
sentences.zh: 你還在努力學西班牙文嗎？

sentences.en: Scientists continue their quest for clean energy sources.
sentences.zh: 科學家持續探索潔淨的能源。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: Her voice began to quiver as she spoke.
sentences.zh: 她說話時聲音開始發抖。

sentences.en: Is the puppy quivering because it's cold?
sentences.zh: 小狗是因為冷才在發抖嗎？

sentences.en: The leaves quivered in the cool evening wind.
sentences.zh: 樹葉在涼爽的晚風中微微顫動。

sentences.en: His hands quivered before he opened the exam results.
sentences.zh: 他在打開成績單之前，手微微發抖。

sentences.en: The little boy's lip quivered, and he started to cry.
sentences.zh: 小男孩的嘴唇顫抖著，然後哭了起來。

sentences.en: Did you see the cup quiver when the truck passed?
sentences.zh: 卡車經過時，你有看到杯子在晃嗎？

gloss_note: 常見於新聞、歷史課與社會議題討論

sentences.en: In social studies, we learned about the history of racism.
sentences.zh: 在社會課上，我們學到了種族歧視的歷史。

sentences.en: The film shows a family facing racism in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描寫一個家庭在1960年代面對種族歧視。

sentences.en: What can schools do to teach students about racism?
sentences.zh: 學校可以怎麼教學生認識種族歧視？

sentences.en: The article explains the causes of racism in simple words.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章用簡單的話說明種族歧視的成因。

sentences.en: Did the workshop at work cover racism and fairness?
sentences.zh: 公司的工作坊有談到種族歧視與公平嗎？

sentences.en: Many groups offer training that explains racism and respect.
sentences.zh: 許多團體提供講解種族歧視與尊重的訓練課程。

sentences.en: The company made a radical change to its menu.
sentences.zh: 公司對菜單做了徹底的改變。

sentences.en: Is such a radical idea realistic for a small team?
sentences.zh: 這麼大膽徹底的點子，對小團隊來說實際嗎？

sentences.en: The new software brought radical changes to our workflow.
sentences.zh: 新軟體為我們的工作流程帶來根本的改變。

sentences.en: Her radical haircut surprised everyone at the party.
sentences.zh: 她大刀闊斧的新髮型讓派對上的每個人都嚇了一跳。

sentences.en: Scientists proposed a radical new way to store energy.
sentences.zh: 科學家提出了一種徹底創新的儲能方式。

sentences.en: Would a radical redesign help the website?
sentences.zh: 徹底改版對網站有幫助嗎？

sentences.en: The boy wore a ragged jacket with holes in it.
sentences.zh: 那個男孩穿著一件破了洞的舊外套。

sentences.en: Is your old backpack too ragged to use?
sentences.zh: 你那個舊背包是不是破爛到不能用了？

sentences.en: The dog's ragged blanket was still its favorite.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗的破舊毯子仍然是牠的最愛。

sentences.en: She threw away the ragged towels and bought new ones.
sentences.zh: 她把破爛的毛巾丟掉，買了新的。

sentences.en: The book's ragged cover showed how often it was read.
sentences.zh: 這本書破舊的封面顯示它被翻過很多次。

sentences.en: Do you want to keep these ragged jeans?
sentences.zh: 你要留著這幾件破爛的牛仔褲嗎？

gloss_note: by rail 搭火車；handrail 扶手

sentences.en: Hold the rail when you go down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 下樓梯時要扶著欄杆。

sentences.en: Is it faster to travel by rail or by car?
sentences.zh: 搭火車比較快，還是開車比較快？

sentences.en: A rail line connects the city to the airport.
sentences.zh: 一條鐵路線把市區和機場連起來。

sentences.en: Don't lean on the rail; it's loose.
sentences.zh: 別靠在欄杆上，它鬆了。

sentences.en: Is there a rail link between the airport and downtown?
sentences.zh: 機場和市中心之間有鐵路連線嗎？

sentences.en: The new rail project will shorten the trip by an hour.
sentences.zh: 新的鐵路工程會讓行程縮短一個小時。

sentences.en: We picked a random number between one and ten.
sentences.zh: 我們隨機選了一個一到十之間的數字。

sentences.en: Can you pick a random card from the deck?
sentences.zh: 你可以從這疊牌中隨便抽一張嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher called on a random student.
sentences.zh: 老師隨機點了一位學生。

sentences.en: Is the winner chosen by a random drawing?
sentences.zh: 得獎者是用隨機抽籤選出來的嗎？

sentences.en: The survey asked random people at the mall.
sentences.zh: 這份調查隨機詢問了購物中心裡的人。

sentences.en: Please enter a random password with letters and numbers.
sentences.zh: 請輸入一組由字母和數字組成的隨機密碼。

gloss_note: 需經正式表決或簽署，較正式

sentences.en: The board must ratify the contract before it begins.
sentences.zh: 董事會必須在合約開始前批准它。

sentences.en: Did the members ratify the new agreement?
sentences.zh: 成員們有批准新協議嗎？

sentences.en: Workers voted to ratify the new work schedule.
sentences.zh: 員工投票通過了新的排班制度。

sentences.en: The committee will ratify the budget on Monday.
sentences.zh: 委員會將在星期一批准這份預算。

sentences.en: When will the shareholders ratify the merger plan?
sentences.zh: 股東什麼時候會批准合併計畫？

sentences.en: The club ratified its new rules at the annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 社團在年會上正式通過了新規則。

gloss_note: in a ratio of 2 to 1 以二比一的比例

sentences.en: The ratio of boys to girls in the class is about one to one.
sentences.zh: 這個班的男女比例大約是一比一。

sentences.en: What is the ratio of water to rice in this recipe?
sentences.zh: 這份食譜中水和米的比例是多少？

sentences.en: Our company has a high ratio of women managers.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的女性主管比例很高。

sentences.en: Do you know the student-teacher ratio at this school?
sentences.zh: 你知道這間學校的師生比嗎？

sentences.en: Mix the paint in a ratio of two to one.
sentences.zh: 把油漆以二比一的比例混合。

sentences.en: The report shows a rising ratio of debt to income.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示負債占收入的比率正在上升。

gloss_note: a daily ration 每日配給量

sentences.en: Hikers ration their water on long trips.
sentences.zh: 健行的人在長途旅程中會限量使用飲水。

sentences.en: The store had to ration fresh milk after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，商店必須限量供應鮮奶。

sentences.en: How much food does each person get as a daily ration?
sentences.zh: 每個人每天的配給量有多少食物？

sentences.en: Why does the cafeteria ration sugar packets?
sentences.zh: 為什麼自助餐廳要限量供應糖包？

sentences.en: Each camper received a ration of bread and cheese.
sentences.zh: 每位露營的人都領到一份麵包和起司的配給。

sentences.en: We must ration our spending until the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 我們必須節制開支，撐到年底。

sentences.en: The windows rattle whenever a truck drives by.
sentences.zh: 每次有卡車開過，窗戶就嘎嘎作響。

sentences.en: Do you hear something rattling in the trunk?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到後車廂裡有東西在嘎嘎響嗎？

sentences.en: The old car rattled all the way up the hill.
sentences.zh: 那輛老車一路嘎嘎作響地開上山坡。

sentences.en: Don't let the tough question rattle you.
sentences.zh: 別讓那個刁鑽的問題把你弄慌了。

sentences.en: Why is the cabinet door rattling again?
sentences.zh: 為什麼櫃子的門又在嘎嘎響了？

sentences.en: The loud noise rattled the nervous speaker.
sentences.zh: 巨大的聲響讓緊張的講者更慌了。

sentences.en: A reactive approach waits for problems to appear.
sentences.zh: 被動因應的做法是等問題出現才處理。

sentences.en: Is our company too reactive, instead of planning ahead?
sentences.zh: 我們公司是不是太被動，而不是事先規劃？

sentences.en: Sodium is a highly reactive metal.
sentences.zh: 鈉是一種反應性很強的金屬。

sentences.en: Reactive management solves issues only after they happen.
sentences.zh: 被動式管理要等問題發生後才解決。

sentences.en: How reactive is this chemical when mixed with water?
sentences.zh: 這種化學物質與水混合時反應性有多強？

sentences.en: She prefers being proactive rather than reactive at work.
sentences.zh: 她在工作上喜歡主動出擊，而不是被動因應。

gloss_note: realism in art 藝術上的寫實主義

sentences.en: The painting is famous for its realism.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫以寫實風格聞名。

sentences.en: Is realism more important than hope when we plan?
sentences.zh: 做計畫時，務實比抱持希望更重要嗎？

sentences.en: The movie's realism makes the story easy to believe.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的寫實感讓故事很容易讓人相信。

sentences.en: Her realism helped the team set achievable goals.
sentences.zh: 她的務實態度幫助團隊訂出做得到的目標。

sentences.en: Do you prefer realism or fantasy in novels?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡寫實的小說還是奇幻小說？

sentences.en: In art class, we studied realism in painting.
sentences.zh: 在美術課上，我們研究了繪畫中的寫實主義。

gloss_note: realizable goals 可達成的目標

sentences.en: Is this goal realizable within six months?
sentences.zh: 這個目標在六個月內做得到嗎？

sentences.en: Our plan is realizable if we keep costs low.
sentences.zh: 只要壓低成本，我們的計畫就做得到。

sentences.en: These are small, realizable goals for the first quarter.
sentences.zh: 這些是第一季小而可達成的目標。

sentences.en: Are those savings realizable this year?
sentences.zh: 那些節省的金額今年能實現嗎？

sentences.en: A realizable target keeps the team motivated.
sentences.zh: 可達成的目標能讓團隊保持幹勁。

sentences.en: The manager wants realizable ideas, not big dreams.
sentences.zh: 經理要的是做得到的點子，而不是遠大的夢想。

gloss_note: come to the realization 領悟到

sentences.en: The realization of this project took almost three years.
sentences.zh: 這個專案的實現花了將近三年。

sentences.en: She came to the realization that she needed more help.
sentences.zh: 她領悟到自己需要更多協助。

sentences.en: Was there a moment of realization during the meeting?
sentences.zh: 會議中有哪個時刻讓你突然領悟嗎？

sentences.en: The realization of our plan depends on the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們計畫能否實現，取決於預算。

sentences.en: Did the realization that he was wrong surprise you?
sentences.zh: 他意識到自己錯了，這讓你驚訝嗎？

sentences.en: A sudden realization made her stop and reread the contract.
sentences.zh: 她突然恍然大悟，停下來重讀合約。

gloss_note: reap the benefits 享受成果

sentences.en: Our company is reaping the benefits of early planning.
sentences.zh: 我們公司正在享受提早規劃的成果。

sentences.en: Farmers reap the wheat in late summer.
sentences.zh: 農夫在夏末收割小麥。

sentences.en: Will we reap any rewards from this long project?
sentences.zh: 這個漫長的專案會讓我們有任何回報嗎？

sentences.en: You reap what you sow, as the saying goes.
sentences.zh: 俗話說，種什麼因，得什麼果。

sentences.en: How soon can the firm reap profits from the new store?
sentences.zh: 這家公司多久能從新店賺到利潤？

sentences.en: Customers reaped big savings during the sale.
sentences.zh: 顧客在特價期間省下了不少錢。

gloss_note: rear seat 後座；at the rear 在後方

sentences.en: Please sit in the rear seat and buckle up.
sentences.zh: 請坐在後座並繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: Is there a rear exit in this building?
sentences.zh: 這棟建築有後門出口嗎？

sentences.en: The rear door of the bus was stuck.
sentences.zh: 公車的後門卡住了。

sentences.en: Park in the rear lot to leave room in front.
sentences.zh: 把車停在後面的停車場，前面才有空位。

sentences.en: Is the rear light on your bike working?
sentences.zh: 你腳踏車的後燈還亮嗎？

sentences.en: We sat at the rear of the theater.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在戲院的後方。

sentences.en: The soup was reasonably priced, and it tasted great.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯價格合理，味道又很棒。

sentences.en: The menu is reasonably priced, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 這份菜單的價格還算合理，對吧？

sentences.en: The chef cooked the steak reasonably well.
sentences.zh: 主廚把牛排煎得相當不錯。

sentences.en: The restaurant is reasonably quiet at lunch. Want a table?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳中午相當安靜。要不要找個位子？

sentences.en: The pasta was reasonably good, but a bit salty.
sentences.zh: 這份義大利麵還算不錯，只是有點鹹。

sentences.en: The portions are reasonably big. Want to share one?
sentences.zh: 份量相當大。要不要分一份來吃？

gloss_note: a rebellion against 對…的反抗

sentences.en: Our history class studied a famous rebellion in the 1700s.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史課研究了1700年代一場著名的叛亂。

sentences.en: Teenagers sometimes show a little rebellion at home.
sentences.zh: 青少年有時會在家裡表現出一點反抗。

sentences.en: Why did the rebellion fail in the movie?
sentences.zh: 電影裡的那場叛亂為什麼失敗了？

sentences.en: The novel tells the story of a rebellion against a cruel king.
sentences.zh: 這本小說講的是反抗殘暴國王的故事。

sentences.en: Did you learn about the rebellion in history class?
sentences.zh: 你在歷史課上學過那場叛亂嗎？

sentences.en: Her small rebellion was wearing red shoes to the formal party.
sentences.zh: 她的小小叛逆，就是穿紅鞋去參加正式的派對。

sentences.en: Sales rebounded strongly in the spring.
sentences.zh: 春天時銷售強勁回升。

sentences.en: Do you think the economy will rebound next year?
sentences.zh: 你覺得經濟明年會回升嗎？

sentences.en: The ball hit the wall and rebounded to me.
sentences.zh: 球打到牆壁後彈回到我這邊。

sentences.en: Tourism is expected to rebound this summer.
sentences.zh: 預期今年夏天觀光業會回升。

sentences.en: How quickly can a small shop rebound from a slow season?
sentences.zh: 小商店從淡季中能多快恢復？

sentences.en: The company's profits rebounded after it cut costs.
sentences.zh: 公司削減成本後，獲利出現反彈。

sentences.en: Can you recite this poem from memory?
sentences.zh: 你能把這首詩背出來嗎？

sentences.en: Each student had to recite a poem in class.
sentences.zh: 每位學生都得在課堂上朗誦一首詩。

sentences.en: He recited the speech without looking at his notes.
sentences.zh: 他沒看筆記就把演講稿背了出來。

sentences.en: The little girl recited her phone number to the officer.
sentences.zh: 小女孩向警察背出了她的電話號碼。

sentences.en: Did you recite the dialogue before the audition?
sentences.zh: 試鏡前你有先背台詞嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher asked me to recite the multiplication table.
sentences.zh: 老師要我背誦乘法表。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a good dentist near here?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦這附近一位不錯的牙醫嗎？

sentences.en: My teacher recommended this book to the whole class.
sentences.zh: 老師向全班推薦了這本書。

sentences.en: What do you recommend for a first-time visitor?
sentences.zh: 對第一次來的遊客，你有什麼推薦的？

sentences.en: I highly recommend taking the early train.
sentences.zh: 我強烈建議搭早班火車。

sentences.en: The doctor recommends getting more sleep every night.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議每晚多睡一點。

sentences.en: She recommended me for the job, and I got it.
sentences.zh: 她推薦我應徵這份工作，而我錄取了。

sentences.en: Do you have any restaurant recommendations for tonight?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有今晚的餐廳推薦？

sentences.en: Thanks for the recommendation. The soup was amazing.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的推薦，那碗湯太棒了。

sentences.en: Our server gave us a great dessert recommendation.
sentences.zh: 服務生給了我們一個很棒的甜點推薦。

sentences.en: Can I get your recommendation on which laptop to buy?
sentences.zh: 關於該買哪台筆電，我可以聽聽你的建議嗎？

sentences.en: I followed my doctor's recommendation and started walking every day.
sentences.zh: 我聽從醫生的建議，開始每天走路。

sentences.en: The committee made one recommendation: hire more teachers.
sentences.zh: 委員會提出一項建議：多聘請幾位老師。

gloss_note: 常見於災後或工程：reconstruction costs

sentences.en: Reconstruction of the warehouse will take about six months.
sentences.zh: 倉庫的重建大約需要六個月。

sentences.en: How much will the reconstruction cost after the flood?
sentences.zh: 水災過後，重建要花多少錢？

sentences.en: The insurance company covers part of the reconstruction costs.
sentences.zh: 保險公司負擔部分重建費用。

sentences.en: Is the bridge reconstruction still on schedule?
sentences.zh: 橋梁的改建工程還照進度走嗎？

sentences.en: The city approved funding for downtown reconstruction last week.
sentences.zh: 市政府上週通過了市中心重建的經費。

sentences.en: Our boss is overseeing the reconstruction of the old factory.
sentences.zh: 我們老闆正在監督舊工廠的改建。

gloss_note: recruit sb for sth 為某事招募某人

sentences.en: Our company is trying to recruit more engineers.
sentences.zh: 我們公司正努力招募更多工程師。

sentences.en: How do you recruit volunteers for the school event?
sentences.zh: 你們怎麼為學校活動招募志工？

sentences.en: The team recruited two new players this season.
sentences.zh: 球隊本季招募了兩名新球員。

sentences.en: Have they recruited anyone for the front desk yet?
sentences.zh: 他們已經招到櫃台人員了嗎？

sentences.en: The new recruit starts training on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 這位新進人員週一早上開始受訓。

sentences.en: The club needs to recruit new members soon.
sentences.zh: 社團得盡快招募新成員。

gloss_note: 常指重新粉刷、換家具與擺設

sentences.en: The hotel will redecorate all the guest rooms this winter.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店今年冬天會重新裝潢所有客房。

sentences.en: Are you going to redecorate the office before the move?
sentences.zh: 搬遷前你們要重新裝潢辦公室嗎？

sentences.en: We redecorated the lobby to make it feel warmer.
sentences.zh: 我們重新裝潢了大廳，讓它感覺更溫馨。

sentences.en: How long will it take to redecorate the conference room?
sentences.zh: 重新裝潢會議室要花多久時間？

sentences.en: She wants to redecorate the living room in light colors.
sentences.zh: 她想用淺色系重新布置客廳。

sentences.en: The restaurant closed for a week to redecorate.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳休業一週來重新裝潢。

gloss_note: redesign a website 網站改版

sentences.en: We need to redesign the product packaging this quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們這一季得重新設計產品包裝。

sentences.en: Did the team redesign the website before the launch?
sentences.zh: 團隊在上線前重新設計網站了嗎？

sentences.en: The redesign made our app much easier to use.
sentences.zh: 改版之後，我們的應用程式好用多了。

sentences.en: Why did they redesign the logo again?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼又重新設計商標？

sentences.en: The company redesigned its checkout process to reduce errors.
sentences.zh: 公司重新設計了結帳流程，以減少錯誤。

sentences.en: A full redesign of the store layout is planned.
sentences.zh: 店面的配置預計全面重新設計。

gloss_note: 美式指多餘或備援；英式常指裁員

sentences.en: The server has redundancy, so one failure won't stop us.
sentences.zh: 伺服器有備援，所以單一故障不會讓我們停擺。

sentences.en: Is there any redundancy in these two reports?
sentences.zh: 這兩份報告有重複多餘的地方嗎？

sentences.en: We built redundancy into the system for safety.
sentences.zh: 我們為了安全，在系統中建立了備援。

sentences.en: Can we cut the redundancy in this contract?
sentences.zh: 我們能刪掉合約裡多餘的部分嗎？

sentences.en: Redundancy in the supply chain protects us during shortages.
sentences.zh: 供應鏈中的備援能在缺貨時保護我們。

sentences.en: Please remove the redundancy from your email; it's too long.
sentences.zh: 請刪掉電子郵件裡的贅述，內容太長了。

gloss_note: 常指房貸或債務轉貸、換較低利率

sentences.en: We plan to refinance our mortgage at a lower rate.
sentences.zh: 我們打算用較低的利率重新辦理房貸。

sentences.en: Should we refinance before interest rates go up again?
sentences.zh: 我們該在利率再次上升前重新貸款嗎？

sentences.en: The company refinanced its debt to lower monthly payments.
sentences.zh: 公司把債務重新融資，以降低每月還款額。

sentences.en: Can I refinance my car loan with another bank?
sentences.zh: 我可以改到別家銀行辦理車貸轉貸嗎？

sentences.en: She refinanced the house and saved about two hundred dollars monthly.
sentences.zh: 她把房子重新貸款，每個月省下約兩百美元。

sentences.en: The firm needs to refinance its loans by December.
sentences.zh: 公司得在12月前辦理再融資。

sentences.en: The oil refinery hired fifty new workers this year.
sentences.zh: 這家煉油廠今年新聘了五十名員工。

sentences.en: Is the refinery near the port still running?
sentences.zh: 港口附近的煉油廠還在運轉嗎？

sentences.en: Her father worked at a sugar refinery for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 她的父親在精糖廠工作了三十年。

sentences.en: How much oil does this refinery process each day?
sentences.zh: 這座煉油廠每天處理多少原油？

sentences.en: The refinery shut down for two weeks of maintenance.
sentences.zh: 這座煉油廠停工兩週進行維修保養。

sentences.en: Our truck delivers fuel from the refinery to gas stations.
sentences.zh: 我們的卡車把燃料從煉油廠運到加油站。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Usmaan
Recorder: Middle river exports

sentences.en: The new CEO is known as a reformer in the industry.
sentences.zh: 這位新執行長在業界以改革者聞名。

sentences.en: Was she the reformer who fixed the hiring process?
sentences.zh: 她就是改善了聘僱流程的那位改革者嗎？

sentences.en: Reformers in the company want clearer pay rules.
sentences.zh: 公司內的改革者希望薪資規定更明確。

sentences.en: Our history class studied a reformer of the school system.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史課研究了一位學校制度的改革者。

sentences.en: Do you think the board will listen to the reformers?
sentences.zh: 你覺得董事會會聽取改革者的意見嗎？

sentences.en: He saw himself as a reformer, not a critic.
sentences.zh: 他把自己視為改革者，而不是批評者。

gloss_note: 形容態度或做法傾向漸進改革

sentences.en: The company adopted a reformist approach to its pay system.
sentences.zh: 公司對薪資制度採取了改革派的做法。

sentences.en: Is the board's new plan really reformist, or just cosmetic?
sentences.zh: 董事會的新計畫真的有改革精神，還只是做做表面功夫？

sentences.en: A reformist group inside the firm pushed for open meetings.
sentences.zh: 公司內的改革派團體推動公開會議。

sentences.en: The article described him as a reformist manager.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章形容他是個改革派的經理。

sentences.en: Did the reformists in your department get their way?
sentences.zh: 你們部門的改革派人士如願以償了嗎？

sentences.en: Reformist leaders in the industry support stricter safety rules.
sentences.zh: 業界的改革派領袖支持更嚴格的安全規範。

gloss_note: refresh the page 重新整理網頁

sentences.en: Try to refresh the page if the file won't load.
sentences.zh: 如果檔案載入不了，試著重新整理頁面。

sentences.en: Did you refresh the browser before checking the report?
sentences.zh: 你查看報告前有重新整理瀏覽器嗎？

sentences.en: A short walk can refresh your mind between meetings.
sentences.zh: 在會議之間散個短步，能讓頭腦清醒一下。

sentences.en: A cold drink will refresh you after the long meeting.
sentences.zh: 一杯冷飲能讓你在冗長的會議後恢復精神。

sentences.en: Why does the screen refresh every few seconds?
sentences.zh: 為什麼螢幕每隔幾秒就重新整理一次？

sentences.en: We felt refreshed after the short break.
sentences.zh: 短暫休息後，我們覺得精神煥發。

sentences.en: Campers found refuge in their car during the snowstorm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雪期間，露營的人躲進車裡避難。

sentences.en: Hikers took refuge in a cabin when the storm hit.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來襲時，登山客躲進一間小木屋避難。

sentences.en: Where can we take refuge from this heavy rain?
sentences.zh: 我們可以到哪裡躲這場大雨？

sentences.en: The shelter offered refuge to families after the flood.
sentences.zh: 水災後，收容所為家庭提供庇護。

sentences.en: Is the old church still a refuge for travelers?
sentences.zh: 那座老教堂還是旅人的避難所嗎？

sentences.en: The cave served as a refuge for villagers long ago.
sentences.zh: 很久以前，這個洞穴是村民的避難所。

sentences.en: The company hopes to regain its lost market share.
sentences.zh: 公司希望奪回失去的市占率。

sentences.en: How can we regain our customers' trust after the mistake?
sentences.zh: 出錯之後，我們要如何重新贏得客戶的信任？

sentences.en: She slowly regained her strength after the surgery.
sentences.zh: 手術後，她慢慢恢復了體力。

sentences.en: Did the stock regain its value by the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 這檔股票在當天收盤前有回升到原本的價值嗎？

sentences.en: The team regained control of the project in April.
sentences.zh: 團隊在4月重新掌握了這個專案。

sentences.en: Sales finally regained momentum this quarter.
sentences.zh: 這一季的銷售終於重拾動能。

sentences.en: The meeting starts at nine regardless of the weather.
sentences.zh: 不管天氣如何，會議都在九點開始。

sentences.en: It's expensive, but I'll buy it regardless. Is that crazy?
sentences.zh: 這很貴，但我還是會買。這樣很瘋狂嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone gets a free ticket, regardless of age. Isn't that great?
sentences.zh: 不論年齡，每個人都有免費門票。這不是很棒嗎？

sentences.en: Prices went up, but people kept buying regardless.
sentences.zh: 價格上漲了，但人們還是照買不誤。

sentences.en: We're going regardless of the rain. Do you want to come?
sentences.zh: 下雨我們也照去。你要一起來嗎？

sentences.en: She finished the race regardless of her sore knee.
sentences.zh: 儘管膝蓋痠痛，她還是跑完了比賽。

sentences.en: Rehabilitation after the knee surgery took about three months.
sentences.zh: 膝蓋手術後的復健花了大約三個月。

sentences.en: How long does stroke rehabilitation usually last?
sentences.zh: 中風復健通常要持續多久？

sentences.en: The hospital opened a new rehabilitation center for athletes.
sentences.zh: 醫院為運動員開設了一間新的復健中心。

sentences.en: Physical rehabilitation helped him walk again.
sentences.zh: 物理復健幫助他重新走路。

sentences.en: Is rehabilitation covered by your health insurance?
sentences.zh: 你的健康保險有給付復健嗎？

sentences.en: Studies show early rehabilitation improves recovery in older patients.
sentences.zh: 研究顯示，及早復健能改善年長病患的康復情形。

gloss_note: dress rehearsal 彩排（著裝排練）

sentences.en: We have a rehearsal for the school play after class.
sentences.zh: 下課後我們要為學校話劇排練。

sentences.en: What time is tomorrow's dress rehearsal?
sentences.zh: 明天的彩排是幾點？

sentences.en: The band's rehearsal ran late last night.
sentences.zh: 樂團昨晚的排練拖得很晚。

sentences.en: Did you go to the wedding rehearsal on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你週五有去婚禮彩排嗎？

sentences.en: Every rehearsal makes the speech sound smoother.
sentences.zh: 每排練一次，演講就更流暢一些。

sentences.en: After one more rehearsal, we'll be ready for the presentation.
sentences.zh: 再排練一次，我們就能準備好上台簡報了。

gloss_note: rein in costs 控制成本

sentences.en: We need to rein in spending this quarter.
sentences.zh: 這一季我們得控制開銷。

sentences.en: Can the company rein in its travel costs?
sentences.zh: 公司能控制差旅費用嗎？

sentences.en: The manager reined in the budget after last year's overspending.
sentences.zh: 去年超支之後，經理壓低了預算。

sentences.en: How can we rein in rising supplier prices?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何抑制不斷上漲的供應商價格？

sentences.en: She tried to rein in her excitement during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會時，她試著壓抑自己的興奮之情。

sentences.en: The new policy should rein in unnecessary expenses.
sentences.zh: 新政策應該能抑制不必要的支出。

gloss_note: 常用複數 reinforcements 表增援人力

sentences.en: The bridge needs structural reinforcement before winter.
sentences.zh: 這座橋在冬天前需要做結構補強。

sentences.en: We asked headquarters for reinforcements during the holiday rush.
sentences.zh: 節慶旺季期間，我們向總公司要求增援人手。

sentences.en: Positive reinforcement helps new employees learn faster.
sentences.zh: 正向的鼓勵強化能幫助新進員工學得更快。

sentences.en: Does the policy need more reinforcement from managers?
sentences.zh: 這項政策需要經理們多加強推動嗎？

sentences.en: The store called in reinforcements when the line got too long.
sentences.zh: 排隊人潮太長時，店裡調來了支援人手。

sentences.en: Can you send reinforcements to the front desk?
sentences.zh: 你可以派人手支援櫃台嗎？

gloss_note: reinvestment of profits 盈餘再投資

sentences.en: Reinvestment of profits will help us grow faster.
sentences.zh: 把利潤再投資，能幫助我們更快成長。

sentences.en: Is the reinvestment plan approved by the board?
sentences.zh: 董事會核准這項再投資計畫了嗎？

sentences.en: We chose reinvestment over paying bigger dividends.
sentences.zh: 我們選擇再投資，而不是發放更高的股息。

sentences.en: How much of our earnings goes into reinvestment?
sentences.zh: 我們的盈餘有多少用在再投資上？

sentences.en: The fund encourages reinvestment of dividends.
sentences.zh: 這檔基金鼓勵股息再投資。

sentences.en: Reinvestment in new equipment kept the factory competitive.
sentences.zh: 對新設備的再投資讓工廠保持競爭力。

gloss_note: relational database 關聯式資料庫

sentences.en: We store customer data in a relational database.
sentences.zh: 我們把客戶資料存放在關聯式資料庫裡。

sentences.en: Is this a relational database or a spreadsheet?
sentences.zh: 這是關聯式資料庫，還是試算表？

sentences.en: Her relational skills make her great with clients.
sentences.zh: 她的人際相處能力讓她和客戶合作得很好。

sentences.en: The consultant took a relational approach to selling.
sentences.zh: 這位顧問用重視人際關係的方式做銷售。

sentences.en: Do you know how relational databases link different tables?
sentences.zh: 你知道關聯式資料庫如何連結不同的表格嗎？

sentences.en: Good managers build relational trust with their teams.
sentences.zh: 好的主管會和團隊建立起人際間的信任。

gloss_note: a relaxed atmosphere 輕鬆的氣氛

sentences.en: The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, perfect for families.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳氣氛輕鬆，很適合全家光顧。

sentences.en: Is the dress code relaxed at that café?
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡館的服裝規定隨性嗎？

sentences.en: We had a relaxed dinner on the patio.
sentences.zh: 我們在露台上享用了一頓輕鬆的晚餐。

sentences.en: The chef is friendly and relaxed with every customer.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚對每位客人都親切又隨和。

sentences.en: Do you prefer a relaxed brunch or a fancy dinner?
sentences.zh: 你比較想要輕鬆的早午餐，還是講究的晚餐？

sentences.en: The relaxed service made us feel right at home.
sentences.zh: 輕鬆隨性的服務讓我們有賓至如歸的感覺。

sentences.en: I don't see the relevance of this question.
sentences.zh: 我看不出這個問題有什麼關聯。

sentences.en: What is the relevance of this data to our sales?
sentences.zh: 這份資料和我們的銷售有什麼關聯？

sentences.en: Check the relevance of each slide before the presentation.
sentences.zh: 簡報前，先檢查每張投影片是否切題。

sentences.en: The report lacks relevance to our current goals.
sentences.zh: 這份報告和我們目前的目標缺乏關聯。

sentences.en: Does this article have any relevance to our project?
sentences.zh: 這篇文章和我們的專案有任何關聯嗎？

sentences.en: Customer feedback has direct relevance to our next product.
sentences.zh: 客戶意見與我們的下一項產品直接相關。

gloss_note: reluctance to + V 不願意做…

sentences.en: He showed some reluctance to sign the contract.
sentences.zh: 他對簽署合約表現出些許猶豫。

sentences.en: Why the reluctance to share the numbers?
sentences.zh: 為什麼不太願意公開這些數字？

sentences.en: Her reluctance to travel surprised her boss.
sentences.zh: 她不願出差，讓她的老闆很意外。

sentences.en: I noticed some reluctance among investors to take the risk.
sentences.zh: 我注意到投資人有些不願冒這個風險。

sentences.en: Is there any reluctance to try the new software?
sentences.zh: 大家對試用新軟體有任何猶豫嗎？

sentences.en: Despite his reluctance, he agreed to lead the project.
sentences.zh: 儘管不太情願，他還是同意領導這個專案。

sentences.en: The company invests heavily in renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 這家公司大量投資再生能源。

sentences.en: Is this contract renewable after one year?
sentences.zh: 這份合約一年後可以續約嗎？

sentences.en: Our license is renewable every two years.
sentences.zh: 我們的執照每兩年可以更新一次。

sentences.en: How much renewable energy does your factory use?
sentences.zh: 你們工廠使用多少再生能源？

sentences.en: Is the subscription renewable online?
sentences.zh: 這項訂閱可以在網路上續訂嗎？

sentences.en: Solar power is a renewable source of electricity.
sentences.zh: 太陽能是一種可再生的電力來源。

sentences.en: The reorganization will combine two departments into one.
sentences.zh: 這次重組會把兩個部門合併成一個。

sentences.en: When does the reorganization take effect?
sentences.zh: 這次改組什麼時候生效？

sentences.en: Employees were nervous about the company's reorganization.
sentences.zh: 員工對公司的重組感到緊張。

sentences.en: Did the reorganization change your job duties?
sentences.zh: 這次改組有改變你的工作職責嗎？

sentences.en: Our manager explained the reorganization at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們經理在會上說明了這次重組。

sentences.en: A big reorganization of the sales team starts in June.
sentences.zh: 銷售團隊的大規模重組將於6月展開。

gloss_note: 語氣稍正式，常見於新聞

sentences.en: The company reportedly cut two hundred jobs. Did you hear about it?
sentences.zh: 據報導，這家公司裁了兩百個職位。你聽說了嗎？

sentences.en: The CEO is reportedly planning to step down next year.
sentences.zh: 據報導，執行長打算明年卸任。

sentences.en: The store reportedly lost millions last quarter.
sentences.zh: 據報導，這家店上一季虧損了數百萬美元。

sentences.en: The deal is reportedly worth five billion dollars. Is that true?
sentences.zh: 據報導這筆交易價值五十億美元。這是真的嗎？

sentences.en: The factory has reportedly reopened after repairs.
sentences.zh: 據報導，工廠修復後已經重新開工。

sentences.en: The merger was reportedly approved yesterday. Is that right?
sentences.zh: 據報導，合併案昨天獲得核准。是這樣嗎？

gloss_note: reprint a brochure 重印簡介

sentences.en: We need to reprint the brochures before the trade show.
sentences.zh: 展覽前，我們得重印簡介手冊。

sentences.en: Can you reprint this page? The ink came out too light.
sentences.zh: 你可以重印這一頁嗎？墨水印得太淡了。

sentences.en: The publisher decided to reprint the manual.
sentences.zh: 出版社決定重印這本手冊。

sentences.en: How many copies should we reprint?
sentences.zh: 我們該再印幾份？

sentences.en: The book sold out, so a reprint is coming.
sentences.zh: 這本書賣完了，所以即將再版。

sentences.en: Is the reprint of the catalog ready yet?
sentences.zh: 型錄的再版印好了嗎？

gloss_note: 美國語境多指 Republican Party

sentences.en: The county has a Republican mayor and a Democratic sheriff.
sentences.zh: 這個郡有一位共和黨籍市長和一位民主黨籍警長。

sentences.en: Is the new state senator a Republican or an independent?
sentences.zh: 新上任的州參議員是共和黨員還是無黨籍？

sentences.en: A Republican candidate spoke in our school's civics class.
sentences.zh: 一位共和黨候選人到我們學校的公民課演講。

sentences.en: The news said a Republican group will meet downtown.
sentences.zh: 新聞說，一個共和黨團體將在市中心開會。

sentences.en: Do you know which Republican lawmakers attended the hearing?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪些共和黨籍議員出席了聽證會嗎？

sentences.en: Her grandfather was a Republican county clerk for years.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父當過多年的共和黨籍郡書記官。

sentences.en: The resale value of this car is surprisingly high.
sentences.zh: 這輛車的轉售價值高得驚人。

sentences.en: Can I check the resale price on this jacket?
sentences.zh: 我可以查一下這件外套的轉售價格嗎？

sentences.en: Many people buy sneakers only for resale.
sentences.zh: 很多人買球鞋只是為了轉售。

sentences.en: Is resale allowed under the distributor's contract?
sentences.zh: 經銷商的合約允許轉售嗎？

sentences.en: Resale shops are popular among students on a budget.
sentences.zh: 二手商店很受預算有限的學生歡迎。

sentences.en: How much would the van be worth at resale?
sentences.zh: 這輛廂型車轉售的話值多少錢？

gloss_note: bear a resemblance to 與…相像

sentences.en: There is a strong resemblance between the two brothers.
sentences.zh: 這對兄弟長得非常相像。

sentences.en: Do you see any resemblance between her and her mother?
sentences.zh: 你覺得她和她媽媽有任何相像之處嗎？

sentences.en: The painting bears a close resemblance to my hometown.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫和我的家鄉非常相似。

sentences.en: The resemblance was so clear that everyone noticed.
sentences.zh: 兩者的相似處太明顯，每個人都注意到了。

sentences.en: Is there any resemblance between these two designs?
sentences.zh: 這兩個設計有任何相似之處嗎？

sentences.en: He has a slight resemblance to my old teacher.
sentences.zh: 他和我以前的老師有點像。

gloss_note: drinking water reservoir 飲用水水庫

sentences.en: The city gets its drinking water from a large reservoir.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的飲用水來自一座大水庫。

sentences.en: How deep is the reservoir behind the dam?
sentences.zh: 水壩後面的水庫有多深？

sentences.en: Water levels in the reservoir dropped during the dry summer.
sentences.zh: 乾燥的夏季裡，水庫的水位下降了。

sentences.en: We went fishing at the reservoir last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末去水庫釣魚。

sentences.en: Is the reservoir open to hikers on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這座水庫週末開放給登山客嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy rain finally filled the reservoir again.
sentences.zh: 一場大雨終於又把水庫灌滿了。

gloss_note: proof of residence 居住證明

sentences.en: Please write your current residence on this form.
sentences.zh: 請在這張表格上填寫你目前的住處。

sentences.en: Is this address your primary residence?
sentences.zh: 這個地址是你的主要住所嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor's official residence is open to visitors in spring.
sentences.zh: 市長的官邸春天會開放給民眾參觀。

sentences.en: Can you send proof of residence with your application?
sentences.zh: 你可以隨申請書附上居住證明嗎？

sentences.en: She took up residence in Boston after college.
sentences.zh: 她大學畢業後搬到波士頓定居。

sentences.en: The hotel became his temporary residence during the move.
sentences.zh: 搬家期間，這家飯店成了他的臨時住所。

sentences.en: Local residents were invited to the town meeting.
sentences.zh: 當地居民受邀參加鎮民大會。

sentences.en: Are you a resident of this neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你是這一區的居民嗎？

sentences.en: Only residents may park on this street.
sentences.zh: 只有住戶可以在這條街上停車。

sentences.en: The apartment manager sent a note to all residents.
sentences.zh: 公寓管理員寄了一張通知給所有住戶。

sentences.en: Do residents need a permit to park here?
sentences.zh: 住戶要有許可證才能在這裡停車嗎？

sentences.en: She has been a resident of Seattle for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她已經是西雅圖居民十年了。

sentences.en: I missed the first part. Could you restate your question?
sentences.zh: 我漏聽了前半段。你可以重述一次問題嗎？

sentences.en: The company had to restate its earnings from last year.
sentences.zh: 公司得重編去年的財報。

sentences.en: Let me restate the main goal for everyone.
sentences.zh: 讓我為大家重述一次主要目標。

sentences.en: Did the firm restate its financial results again?
sentences.zh: 那家公司又重編財務報表了嗎？

sentences.en: She restated her offer in a follow-up email.
sentences.zh: 她在後續的電子郵件裡重申了自己的報價。

sentences.en: The auditors asked us to restate the quarterly figures.
sentences.zh: 查帳人員要求我們重編季度數字。

sentences.en: We must restrain spending until sales improve.
sentences.zh: 在銷售好轉之前，我們得抑制支出。

sentences.en: How can the company restrain rising labor costs?
sentences.zh: 公司要如何抑制不斷上升的人事成本？

sentences.en: He tried to restrain his anger during the negotiation.
sentences.zh: 談判期間，他試著克制自己的怒氣。
