sentences.en: The new rule will restrain price increases.
sentences.zh: 這項新規定會抑制價格上漲。

sentences.en: Did the manager restrain herself from replying right away?
sentences.zh: 那位經理有忍住不立刻回覆嗎？

sentences.en: Higher interest rates helped restrain inflation last year.
sentences.zh: 利率升高協助抑制了去年的通貨膨脹。

sentences.en: The contract has some restrictive terms for suppliers.
sentences.zh: 這份合約對供應商有一些限制性條款。

sentences.en: Is the return policy too restrictive for customers?
sentences.zh: 退貨政策對顧客來說是不是太嚴格了？

sentences.en: Restrictive rules slow down our product launches.
sentences.zh: 嚴格的規定拖慢了我們推出產品的速度。

sentences.en: The visa rules are more restrictive than before.
sentences.zh: 簽證規定比以前更嚴格了。

sentences.en: Do you find the dress code restrictive?
sentences.zh: 你覺得服裝規定太受限嗎？

sentences.en: Restrictive budget rules limited our marketing plans.
sentences.zh: 嚴格的預算規定限制了我們的行銷計畫。

gloss_note: retail price 零售價；wholesale 批發

sentences.en: She works in retail during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 她在節慶旺季從事零售工作。

sentences.en: The retail price is twenty dollars.
sentences.zh: 零售價是二十美元。

sentences.en: Is this store open to retail customers?
sentences.zh: 這家店有對一般零售客人開放嗎？

sentences.en: Retail sales rose sharply in December.
sentences.zh: 12月的零售銷售急遽上升。

sentences.en: Do you sell at retail or only wholesale?
sentences.zh: 你們是零售，還是只做批發？

sentences.en: Many retail stores in the mall stay open late on weekends.
sentences.zh: 購物中心裡許多零售店週末營業到很晚。

sentences.en: The asset revaluation raised the value of our land.
sentences.zh: 資產重估讓我們土地的價值提高了。

sentences.en: Is a revaluation of our inventory needed this year?
sentences.zh: 今年需要重新評估我們的存貨嗎？

sentences.en: An accountant is handling the property revaluation.
sentences.zh: 一位會計師正在處理房產重估。

sentences.en: The revaluation of the currency made imports cheaper.
sentences.zh: 幣值重估讓進口商品變便宜了。

sentences.en: Did the revaluation change our tax bill?
sentences.zh: 這次重估有改變我們的稅單嗎？

sentences.en: A revaluation of the building is scheduled for May.
sentences.zh: 大樓的重新估價預定在5月進行。

sentences.en: Our revenue grew ten percent last quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們上一季的營收成長了百分之十。

sentences.en: How much revenue does the shop make each month?
sentences.zh: 這家店每個月有多少營收？

sentences.en: The city's tax revenue dropped after the factory closed.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉後，市府的稅收減少了。

sentences.en: Ticket sales are the main source of revenue.
sentences.zh: 票房是主要的收入來源。

sentences.en: Did the new product increase your revenue?
sentences.zh: 新產品有增加你們的營收嗎？

sentences.en: Annual revenue reached fifty million dollars this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的年營收達到五千萬美元。

sentences.en: The company's sudden reversal surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 公司突然大轉彎，讓每個人都很意外。

sentences.en: Do you think the reversal in the housing market will last?
sentences.zh: 你覺得房市的反轉會持續下去嗎？

sentences.en: A reversal in sales trends gave us hope.
sentences.zh: 銷售趨勢的逆轉給了我們希望。

sentences.en: Why did management announce a policy reversal?
sentences.zh: 管理階層為什麼宣布政策大轉彎？

sentences.en: The board's reversal of the decision shocked employees.
sentences.zh: 董事會推翻原決定，讓員工大吃一驚。

sentences.en: We saw a reversal of the earlier trend this spring.
sentences.zh: 今年春天，我們看到先前趨勢出現逆轉。

gloss_note: reverse the order 顛倒順序

sentences.en: Can you reverse the order of these names?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這些名字的順序顛倒過來嗎？

sentences.en: The reverse side of the card has a phone number.
sentences.zh: 卡片的背面有一組電話號碼。

sentences.en: He reversed his decision after talking with his wife.
sentences.zh: 和太太談過之後，他改變了原本的決定。

sentences.en: Did the new rule reverse the earlier policy?
sentences.zh: 新規定有推翻先前的政策嗎？

sentences.en: The results were the reverse of what we expected.
sentences.zh: 結果和我們預期的恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Please reverse the steps if the machine stops.
sentences.zh: 如果機器停了，請把步驟反向操作一遍。

sentences.en: The company hopes for a revival in sales this year.
sentences.zh: 公司希望今年的銷售能夠復甦。

sentences.en: Is the economy showing signs of revival?
sentences.zh: 經濟有出現復甦的跡象嗎？

sentences.en: The downtown revival brought new shops and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 市中心的復興帶來了新的商店和餐廳。

sentences.en: What caused the revival of that old brand?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓那個老品牌再度復興？

sentences.en: A revival of interest in vinyl records surprised the store owner.
sentences.zh: 黑膠唱片重新受到歡迎，讓店老闆很驚訝。

sentences.en: Many people hope for a quick revival after the long recession.
sentences.zh: 許多人期盼長期衰退後能快速復甦。

sentences.en: This software could revolutionize the way we work.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體可能會徹底改變我們的工作方式。

sentences.en: Will the new device revolutionize online shopping?
sentences.zh: 這款新裝置會徹底改變網路購物嗎？

sentences.en: The company wants to revolutionize customer service.
sentences.zh: 這家公司想徹底革新客戶服務。

sentences.en: Smartphones have revolutionized how we pay for things.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機徹底改變了我們付款的方式。

sentences.en: Did the new machine revolutionize your production line?
sentences.zh: 新機器有徹底改變你們的生產線嗎？

sentences.en: Electric cars may revolutionize the auto industry.
sentences.zh: 電動車可能會革新汽車產業。

sentences.en: He bruised a rib when he fell off his bike.
sentences.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，肋骨挫傷了。

sentences.en: Do you want ribs or chicken for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你晚餐想吃肋排還是雞肉？

sentences.en: We ordered a full rack of pork ribs.
sentences.zh: 我們點了一整份豬肋排。

sentences.en: Is the barbecue sauce on the ribs spicy?
sentences.zh: 肋排上的烤肉醬會辣嗎？

sentences.en: My dad grills ribs every Fourth of July.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每年7月4日都會烤肋排。

sentences.en: Does your rib still hurt after the soccer game?
sentences.zh: 足球賽後你的肋骨還會痛嗎？

gloss_note: along the ridge 沿著稜線

sentences.en: We hiked along the ridge at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我們在日出時沿著稜線健行。

sentences.en: How far is it to the top of the ridge?
sentences.zh: 到山脊頂端還有多遠？

sentences.en: The ridge blocks the wind from the valley.
sentences.zh: 山脊擋住了從山谷吹來的風。

sentences.en: Clouds covered the ridge all morning.
sentences.zh: 雲霧整個早上都籠罩著山脊。

sentences.en: Is the trail along the ridge safe in winter?
sentences.zh: 冬天走山脊上的步道安全嗎？

sentences.en: A narrow ridge separates the two valleys.
sentences.zh: 一道狹窄的山脊隔開了兩座山谷。

sentences.en: That price is ridiculous for such a small room.
sentences.zh: 這麼小的房間卻開這種價錢，太離譜了。

sentences.en: Don't be ridiculous. Of course I'll help you.
sentences.zh: 別傻了，我當然會幫你。

sentences.en: Isn't it ridiculous how long we waited?
sentences.zh: 我們等了這麼久，不是很離譜嗎？

sentences.en: The movie was so ridiculous that we laughed all night.
sentences.zh: 這部電影荒謬到讓我們笑了一整晚。

sentences.en: Why are the ticket prices so ridiculous?
sentences.zh: 為什麼票價這麼離譜？

sentences.en: It sounds ridiculous, but it actually works.
sentences.zh: 聽起來很荒謬，但其實真的有效。

sentences.en: The museum displays a rifle from the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一把1800年代的步槍。

sentences.en: A hunter cleaned his rifle before the season opened.
sentences.zh: 獵人在狩獵季開始前擦拭了他的步槍。

sentences.en: Is that antique rifle really over a century old?
sentences.zh: 那把古董步槍真的有超過一百年了嗎？

sentences.en: How heavy is a typical hunting rifle?
sentences.zh: 一般的獵槍有多重？

sentences.en: The history teacher showed us a photo of an old rifle.
sentences.zh: 歷史老師給我們看了一張老步槍的照片。

sentences.en: Hunters are required to store each rifle safely.
sentences.zh: 獵人必須安全存放每一把步槍。

sentences.en: Our manager was rightly concerned about the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們的經理擔心預算是理所當然的。

sentences.en: She rightly pointed out the error. Did you notice it?
sentences.zh: 她正確地指出了那個錯誤。你有注意到嗎？

sentences.en: Customers are rightly upset when orders arrive late. Wouldn't you be?
sentences.zh: 訂單晚到，客人會不高興是理所當然的。換作是你不也會嗎？

sentences.en: He was rightly praised for finishing the project early.
sentences.zh: 他提早完成專案而受到稱讚，這是應該的。

sentences.en: The company rightly decided to delay the launch. Did the board agree?
sentences.zh: 公司決定延後上市是對的。董事會同意嗎？

sentences.en: I think you rightly refused that offer.
sentences.zh: 我覺得你拒絕那個報價是對的。

sentences.en: The company's rules are too rigid for new employees.
sentences.zh: 公司的規定對新進員工來說太死板了。

sentences.en: Why is the schedule so rigid this week?
sentences.zh: 這週的時程為什麼這麼死板？

sentences.en: His rigid thinking makes it hard to try new ideas.
sentences.zh: 他死板的想法讓他很難嘗試新點子。

sentences.en: Do you think a rigid schedule helps kids learn?
sentences.zh: 你覺得死板的時間表對孩子學習有幫助嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher isn't rigid about deadlines when someone is sick.
sentences.zh: 有人生病時，我們老師不會死板地卡截止日期。

sentences.en: He stood rigid with fear when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 燈熄滅時，他嚇得全身僵硬。

gloss_note: rigorous testing 嚴格測試；偏正式

sentences.en: Every new product goes through rigorous testing before launch.
sentences.zh: 每項新產品上市前都要經過嚴格的測試。

sentences.en: Is the review process rigorous enough for this contract?
sentences.zh: 這份合約的審核流程夠嚴謹嗎？

sentences.en: She follows a rigorous training schedule before every marathon.
sentences.zh: 她每次馬拉松前都遵循嚴格的訓練時程。

sentences.en: How rigorous was the interview for the manager position?
sentences.zh: 經理職缺的面試有多嚴格？

sentences.en: Our professor expects rigorous research and careful writing.
sentences.zh: 我們教授要求嚴謹的研究和細心的寫作。

sentences.en: The auditors did a rigorous check of last year's accounts.
sentences.zh: 稽核人員對去年的帳目做了嚴謹的檢查。

gloss_note: rim of a glass 杯緣；眼鏡框

sentences.en: There's a small chip on the rim of this glass.
sentences.zh: 這個玻璃杯的杯緣有個小缺口。

sentences.en: Could I get salt on the rim of my glass?
sentences.zh: 可以在我的杯緣沾點鹽嗎？

sentences.en: He wears glasses with thin black rims.
sentences.zh: 他戴的是黑色細框眼鏡。

sentences.en: Did the ball bounce off the rim or go in?
sentences.zh: 球是彈出籃框還是進去了？

sentences.en: She filled the cup right up to the rim.
sentences.zh: 她把杯子倒滿到杯緣。

sentences.en: The tour guide pointed to the rim of the canyon.
sentences.zh: 導遊指向峽谷的邊緣。

gloss_note: rip open 撕開；rip a hole 撕出破洞

sentences.en: Be careful not to rip the paper.
sentences.zh: 小心別把紙撕破。

sentences.en: I ripped my jeans when I climbed the fence.
sentences.zh: 我爬圍欄時把牛仔褲扯破了。

sentences.en: Did the dog rip the package open again?
sentences.zh: 狗又把包裹撕開了嗎？

sentences.en: Kids love to rip open presents on their birthdays.
sentences.zh: 小孩都愛在生日當天撕開禮物包裝。

sentences.en: Can you rip a page out of that notebook?
sentences.zh: 你可以從那本筆記本撕下一頁嗎？

sentences.en: The strong wind ripped the tent in half.
sentences.zh: 強風把帳篷撕成兩半。

sentences.en: Our biggest rival just lowered its prices again.
sentences.zh: 我們最大的對手又降價了。

sentences.en: Who is your main rival in this market?
sentences.zh: 你在這個市場上的主要對手是誰？

sentences.en: He has been my rival since high school.
sentences.zh: 他從高中起就是我的對手。

sentences.en: Did your rival offer the client a better price?
sentences.zh: 你的對手有給客戶更好的價格嗎？

sentences.en: The two rivals will meet again in the final tonight.
sentences.zh: 兩位對手今晚將在決賽再度交手。

sentences.en: She beat her old rival and won the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 她擊敗老對手，贏得金牌。

sentences.en: I'd like the roasted chicken with mashed potatoes, please.
sentences.zh: 我想點烤雞配馬鈴薯泥。

sentences.en: Do you want roasted vegetables or a salad?
sentences.zh: 你想要烤蔬菜還是沙拉？

sentences.en: We bought roasted coffee beans from a local shop.
sentences.zh: 我們從一家在地店家買了烘焙過的咖啡豆。

sentences.en: The kitchen smelled like roasted garlic all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 整個下午廚房都瀰漫著烤大蒜的香味。

sentences.en: Is the roasted turkey ready to come out of the oven?
sentences.zh: 烤火雞可以從烤箱拿出來了嗎？

sentences.en: She served roasted bell peppers with fresh bread.
sentences.zh: 她端上烤彩椒配新鮮麵包。

gloss_note: fishing rod 釣竿；curtain rod 窗簾桿

sentences.en: He bought a new fishing rod for the trip.
sentences.zh: 他為這趟旅行買了一支新釣竿。

sentences.en: Can you help me hang the curtain rod?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我裝窗簾桿嗎？

sentences.en: The metal rod holds up the shower curtain.
sentences.zh: 這根金屬桿撐著浴簾。

sentences.en: Did you remember to pack your rod?
sentences.zh: 你有記得帶你的釣竿嗎？

sentences.en: The workers put a steel rod inside the concrete.
sentences.zh: 工人在水泥裡放了一根鋼棒。

sentences.en: We need a longer rod to hang clothes in this closet.
sentences.zh: 這個衣櫃需要一根更長的桿子來掛衣服。

sentences.en: Our team routinely checks the inventory every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊每週一早上都會例行盤點庫存。

sentences.en: Banks routinely ask for two forms of ID. Did you bring yours?
sentences.zh: 銀行通常會要求兩種身分證件。你有帶嗎？

sentences.en: She routinely worked late whenever a deadline was close.
sentences.zh: 每次截止日期接近時，她經常加班到很晚。

sentences.en: Do the buses routinely run late in the winter?
sentences.zh: 冬天公車常常誤點嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors routinely recommend a yearly checkup for adults.
sentences.zh: 醫生通常建議成人每年做一次健康檢查。

sentences.en: We routinely back up all files on the server. Is that enough?
sentences.zh: 我們定期備份伺服器上的所有檔案。這樣夠嗎？

gloss_note: pay royalties 付權利金；常用複數

sentences.en: The author earns a royalty on every book sold.
sentences.zh: 作者每賣出一本書就能拿到版稅。

sentences.en: How much do we pay in royalties each year?
sentences.zh: 我們每年要付多少權利金？

sentences.en: The band receives royalties whenever a radio station plays its song.
sentences.zh: 每當電台播放這支樂團的歌曲，他們就能收到版稅。

sentences.en: Did the company agree to pay a royalty for the software?
sentences.zh: 公司同意為這套軟體支付權利金嗎？

sentences.en: Her first royalties check arrived in the mail today.
sentences.zh: 她的第一張版稅支票今天寄到了。

sentences.en: The restaurant chain charges franchise owners a five percent royalty.
sentences.zh: 這家連鎖餐廳向加盟店老闆收取百分之五的權利金。

gloss_note: 常指不容打擾的事，如 sacred time

sentences.en: Family dinner time is sacred in our house.
sentences.zh: 在我們家，家人的晚餐時間是神聖不可侵犯的。

sentences.en: Is your Sunday morning sacred, or can I call?
sentences.zh: 你的週日早晨是不容打擾的嗎，還是我可以打給你？

sentences.en: She treats her morning run as sacred time.
sentences.zh: 她把晨跑視為神聖不容打擾的時間。

sentences.en: Locals consider the old lake a sacred place.
sentences.zh: 當地人把這座古老的湖視為神聖之地。

sentences.en: Why do you guard your weekends as if they were sacred?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把週末守得像神聖不可侵犯一樣？

sentences.en: The teacher said that a student's privacy is sacred.
sentences.zh: 老師說學生的隱私是不容侵犯的。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Xnux assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The rider put the saddle on the horse.
sentences.zh: 騎士把馬鞍放到馬背上。

sentences.en: Is this saddle too heavy for a young horse?
sentences.zh: 這個馬鞍對年輕的馬來說是不是太重了？

sentences.en: My grandfather made that leather saddle by hand.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺親手做了那個皮製馬鞍。

sentences.en: Where do we keep the extra saddles?
sentences.zh: 備用的馬鞍我們放在哪裡？

sentences.en: The cowboy climbed into the saddle and rode away.
sentences.zh: 牛仔爬上馬鞍，騎馬離開了。

sentences.en: A good saddle keeps both the rider and horse comfortable.
sentences.zh: 好的馬鞍能讓騎士和馬都覺得舒服。

sentences.en: Sadly, the store closed last month. Did you hear?
sentences.zh: 可惜那家店上個月關門了。你聽說了嗎？

sentences.en: Sadly, our flight was canceled because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 遺憾的是，我們的班機因暴風雨取消了。

sentences.en: Sadly, I can't come to the party tonight. Are you still going?
sentences.zh: 可惜我今晚不能去派對。你還是會去嗎？

sentences.en: Sadly, the team lost by only one point.
sentences.zh: 可惜球隊只輸了一分。

sentences.en: We tried our best, but sadly, the deal fell through.
sentences.zh: 我們盡了全力，但遺憾的是這筆交易告吹了。

sentences.en: Sadly, my grandmother's old recipe was lost years ago.
sentences.zh: 可惜我奶奶的老食譜多年前就遺失了。

gloss_note: You're a saint. 你真是大好人

sentences.en: You're a saint for driving me to the airport!
sentences.zh: 你真是大好人，還載我去機場！

sentences.en: Thanks for covering my shift. You're a saint.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你幫我代班。你真是大好人。

sentences.en: My neighbor is a saint to put up with our noisy kids.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居真是大好人，願意忍受我們吵鬧的孩子。

sentences.en: Who was the saint that the town was named after?
sentences.zh: 這座城鎮是以哪位聖人命名的？

sentences.en: He must be a saint to work with such rude customers.
sentences.zh: 他簡直是聖人，才能和那麼無禮的客人共事。

sentences.en: Would you call a person who helps everyone a saint?
sentences.zh: 你會把一個幫助所有人的人稱為聖人嗎？

sentences.en: Could I get a salami sandwich on rye?
sentences.zh: 我可以點一份黑麥麵包的義大利臘腸三明治嗎？

sentences.en: The pizza comes with salami and extra cheese.
sentences.zh: 這份披薩附有義大利臘腸和加量起司。

sentences.en: Do you want salami or turkey in your sandwich?
sentences.zh: 你的三明治要放義大利臘腸還是火雞肉？

sentences.en: I sliced the salami and put it on a plate.
sentences.zh: 我把義大利臘腸切片，放到盤子上。

sentences.en: My dad always buys salami from the deli counter.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸總是在熟食櫃台買義大利臘腸。

sentences.en: Is this salami too spicy for the kids?
sentences.zh: 這種義大利臘腸對孩子來說會不會太辣？

gloss_note: grilled salmon 烤鮭魚；單複數同形

sentences.en: I'll have the grilled salmon with rice, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點烤鮭魚配飯。

sentences.en: Is the salmon fresh or frozen today?
sentences.zh: 今天的鮭魚是新鮮的還是冷凍的？

sentences.en: Wild salmon swim up the river to lay eggs.
sentences.zh: 野生鮭魚會逆流游上河川產卵。

sentences.en: We had smoked salmon on bagels this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們今天早上吃了煙燻鮭魚貝果。

sentences.en: Did you add lemon to the salmon?
sentences.zh: 你有在鮭魚上加檸檬嗎？

sentences.en: The fisherman caught a huge salmon yesterday.
sentences.zh: 漁夫昨天釣到一條超大的鮭魚。

gloss_note: hair salon 美髮院；nail salon 美甲店

sentences.en: I have an appointment at the hair salon at three.
sentences.zh: 我三點在美髮院有預約。

sentences.en: Does this salon do nails as well?
sentences.zh: 這家美容院也做指甲嗎？

sentences.en: She works at a salon downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心的一家美髮院工作。

sentences.en: How long did you wait at the salon yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天在美髮院等了多久？

sentences.en: My mom opened her own salon last year.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽去年開了自己的美髮院。

sentences.en: The salon offers a discount for first-time customers.
sentences.zh: 這家美容院提供新客戶折扣。

gloss_note: 常搭配 chips 玉米脆片

sentences.en: Could we get extra salsa with the chips?
sentences.zh: 我們可以多要一些莎莎醬配玉米脆片嗎？

sentences.en: I made fresh salsa with tomatoes and onions.
sentences.zh: 我用番茄和洋蔥做了新鮮的莎莎醬。

sentences.en: Is the salsa mild, medium, or hot?
sentences.zh: 這個莎莎醬是微辣、中辣還是大辣？

sentences.en: My roommate puts salsa on everything, even eggs.
sentences.zh: 我室友什麼都加莎莎醬，連蛋也不例外。

sentences.en: She brought a big bowl of salsa to the party.
sentences.zh: 她帶了一大碗莎莎醬去派對。

sentences.en: This salsa goes well with grilled chicken.
sentences.zh: 這種莎莎醬跟烤雞很搭。

gloss_note: salvage the deal 挽救交易

sentences.en: Can we still salvage the deal with that client?
sentences.zh: 我們還能挽救跟那位客戶的交易嗎？

sentences.en: The team worked all night to salvage the project.
sentences.zh: 團隊通宵工作，要搶救這個專案。

sentences.en: She tried to salvage her presentation after the projector failed.
sentences.zh: 投影機故障後，她努力挽救她的簡報。

sentences.en: Is there any way to salvage this report?
sentences.zh: 有任何辦法能挽救這份報告嗎？

sentences.en: Workers managed to salvage some furniture from the flooded store.
sentences.zh: 員工設法從淹水的店裡搶救出一些家具。

sentences.en: He hopes to salvage his grade with a good final exam.
sentences.zh: 他希望靠期末考考好來挽救成績。

gloss_note: 常用複數 sandals，一雙 a pair of

sentences.en: I need a new pair of sandals for vacation.
sentences.zh: 我需要一雙新涼鞋度假穿。

sentences.en: Do these sandals come in a size nine?
sentences.zh: 這些涼鞋有九號的嗎？

sentences.en: She lost one sandal on the beach.
sentences.zh: 她在海灘上弄丟了一隻涼鞋。

sentences.en: Why are you wearing sandals in the snow?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼在雪地裡穿涼鞋？

sentences.en: Leather sandals are comfortable in hot weather.
sentences.zh: 皮涼鞋在大熱天很舒服。

sentences.en: My feet hurt because my sandals are too tight.
sentences.zh: 我的腳會痛，因為涼鞋太緊了。

gloss_note: time saver 省時；money saver 省錢

sentences.en: This software is a real time saver.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體真的很省時間。

sentences.en: Is a slow cooker really a money saver?
sentences.zh: 慢燉鍋真的能省錢嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother is a careful saver.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶是個精打細算的儲蓄者。

sentences.en: Are you a saver or a spender?
sentences.zh: 你是愛存錢的人還是愛花錢的人？

sentences.en: These coupons are a great money saver for families.
sentences.zh: 這些優惠券對家庭來說是很棒的省錢工具。

sentences.en: Banks offer higher rates to long-term savers.
sentences.zh: 銀行提供較高的利率給長期儲蓄者。

gloss_note: scan a file 掃描檔案

sentences.en: Could you scan this contract and email it to me?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這份合約掃描後用電子郵件寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: The cashier will scan each item at the register.
sentences.zh: 收銀員會在櫃台掃描每件商品。

sentences.en: I just scanned the report for any mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我剛瀏覽過報告，看有沒有錯誤。

sentences.en: Did you scan the menu before we sat down?
sentences.zh: 我們入座前你有先瀏覽菜單嗎？

sentences.en: Please scan the barcode on your ticket.
sentences.zh: 請掃描你票券上的條碼。

sentences.en: He scanned the headlines while drinking his coffee.
sentences.zh: 他邊喝咖啡邊瀏覽新聞標題。

gloss_note: leave a scar 留下疤痕

sentences.en: He has a small scar on his chin.
sentences.zh: 他的下巴上有一道小疤痕。

sentences.en: Will this cut leave a scar?
sentences.zh: 這個傷口會留下疤嗎？

sentences.en: She got the scar when she fell off her bike.
sentences.zh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來時留下了這道疤。

sentences.en: How did you get that scar on your arm?
sentences.zh: 你手臂上那道疤是怎麼來的？

sentences.en: The doctor said the scar would fade over time.
sentences.zh: 醫生說疤痕會隨時間變淡。

sentences.en: The old tree still has a scar from the storm.
sentences.zh: 那棵老樹上仍留有暴風雨造成的疤痕。

gloss_note: a light scent 淡淡的香味

sentences.en: I love the scent of fresh bread in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡早晨新鮮麵包的香味。

sentences.en: What is that scent in your candle?
sentences.zh: 你那支蠟燭是什麼香味？

sentences.en: This soap has a light lemon scent.
sentences.zh: 這塊肥皂有淡淡的檸檬香味。

sentences.en: Do you like the pine scent in this room?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡這個房間裡的松木香味嗎？

sentences.en: The dog followed the scent across the field.
sentences.zh: 狗循著氣味穿過田野。

sentences.en: A sweet scent of flowers filled the hallway last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚走廊裡飄滿了甜甜的花香。

gloss_note: 美式常帶負面意味，如詭計、騙局

sentences.en: Their scheme to cheat customers was discovered last week.
sentences.zh: 他們欺騙顧客的計謀上週被發現了。

sentences.en: What's your scheme for getting out of work early?
sentences.zh: 你有什麼提早下班的計謀？

sentences.en: In the movie, the thieves carry out a daring scheme.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，小偷們執行了一項大膽的計畫。

sentences.en: He came up with a clever scheme to win the bet.
sentences.zh: 他想出一個聰明的計謀來贏得賭注。

sentences.en: Did she tell you about her scheme to surprise Dad?
sentences.zh: 她有告訴你她要給爸爸驚喜的計畫嗎？

sentences.en: That scheme sounds too good to be true. Who told you?
sentences.zh: 那個計畫聽起來好得不像真的。是誰告訴你的？

gloss_note: beyond the scope of 超出…的範圍

sentences.en: The scope of this project is much bigger than we thought.
sentences.zh: 這個專案的範圍比我們想的大得多。

sentences.en: Is that task within the scope of your job?
sentences.zh: 那項任務在你的工作範圍內嗎？

sentences.en: The study has a very narrow scope.
sentences.zh: 這項研究的範圍很窄。

sentences.en: Can we limit the scope of the meeting to budget issues?
sentences.zh: 我們能把會議範圍限縮在預算議題嗎？

sentences.en: That question is beyond the scope of today's lesson.
sentences.zh: 那個問題超出了今天課程的範圍。

sentences.en: The new law will widen the scope of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 新法律將擴大調查的範圍。

sentences.en: Please fill out the scorecard after each interview.
sentences.zh: 請在每場面試後填寫評分表。

sentences.en: How did our team do on the quarterly scorecard?
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在季度績效評分表上表現如何？

sentences.en: The golfer handed his scorecard to a tournament official.
sentences.zh: 高爾夫球手把計分卡交給賽事工作人員。

sentences.en: Do you review your supplier scorecard every month?
sentences.zh: 你每個月都會檢視供應商的績效評分表嗎？

sentences.en: The scorecard shows that sales improved in every region.
sentences.zh: 績效評分表顯示每個地區的銷售都進步了。

sentences.en: The kids made a scorecard for the family game night.
sentences.zh: 孩子們為家庭遊戲之夜做了一張計分卡。

sentences.en: Fans scrambled for the best seats when the doors opened.
sentences.zh: 門一打開，粉絲們就爭搶最好的座位。

sentences.en: I had to scramble to finish the report before noon.
sentences.zh: 我得匆忙趕在中午前完成報告。

sentences.en: Why are we always scrambling at the last minute?
sentences.zh: 我們為什麼總是在最後一刻手忙腳亂？

sentences.en: Passengers scrambled to find their gate after the delay.
sentences.zh: 延誤之後，乘客們匆忙去找登機門。

sentences.en: Did you scramble to get tickets like everyone else?
sentences.zh: 你也像大家一樣搶著買票嗎？

sentences.en: Shoppers scramble for the best deals every holiday weekend.
sentences.zh: 每逢假日週末，購物者都會爭搶最划算的商品。

gloss_note: read from a script 照稿念

sentences.en: The actor memorized his whole script in two days.
sentences.zh: 演員兩天內就背完了整份劇本。

sentences.en: Did you write the script for the presentation?
sentences.zh: 你寫了簡報的講稿嗎？

sentences.en: She read from a script during the video call.
sentences.zh: 她在視訊通話時照著講稿念。

sentences.en: Can I see the script before we start filming?
sentences.zh: 開拍前我可以先看看劇本嗎？

sentences.en: The speaker stuck to the script all evening.
sentences.zh: 講者整個晚上都照著講稿走。

sentences.en: My favorite movie has a funny script.
sentences.zh: 我最喜歡的電影有個有趣的劇本。

gloss_note: 常指古老的宗教經典，偏正式

sentences.en: The museum has a display of ancient scripture.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出了古老的經文。

sentences.en: Which language was this scripture originally written in?
sentences.zh: 這部經典最初是用哪種語言寫成的？

sentences.en: Our history teacher explained how scripture was copied by hand.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史老師解釋了經文如何以手抄方式流傳。

sentences.en: Did the scholars find any scripture in the cave?
sentences.zh: 學者們在洞穴裡有發現任何經文嗎？

sentences.en: The library keeps a rare copy of the ancient scriptures.
sentences.zh: 圖書館收藏了這些古代經典的一份珍貴抄本。

sentences.en: Scholars study scripture to understand how people lived long ago.
sentences.zh: 學者研究經典，以了解古人的生活方式。

sentences.en: The museum displays an ancient scroll from the tenth century.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一卷十世紀的古老卷軸。

sentences.en: Is this painting on a scroll or on paper?
sentences.zh: 這幅畫是畫在卷軸上還是紙上？

sentences.en: She carefully unrolled the scroll on the table.
sentences.zh: 她小心地把卷軸攤在桌上。

sentences.en: Did the students see the scroll at the exhibit?
sentences.zh: 學生們在展覽上看到那卷卷軸了嗎？

sentences.en: A scroll hung on the wall of the tea house.
sentences.zh: 茶館的牆上掛著一幅卷軸。

sentences.en: The archaeologists found a sealed scroll in a clay jar.
sentences.zh: 考古學家在陶罐裡找到一卷封好的卷軸。

gloss_note: 生物學用語；名詞 secretion 分泌物

sentences.en: The stomach secretes acid to break down food.
sentences.zh: 胃會分泌酸液來分解食物。

sentences.en: Do you know which organ secretes insulin? I forgot.
sentences.zh: 你知道哪個器官會分泌胰島素嗎？我忘了。

sentences.en: Why does my nose secrete so much mucus when I have a cold?
sentences.zh: 感冒時我的鼻子為什麼會分泌那麼多黏液？

sentences.en: My teacher said bees secrete wax to build their hives.
sentences.zh: 我的老師說蜜蜂會分泌蠟來築巢。

sentences.en: Do frogs secrete a slimy liquid to protect their skin?
sentences.zh: 青蛙會分泌黏滑的液體來保護皮膚嗎？

sentences.en: The lab report showed that the cells secreted extra protein.
sentences.zh: 實驗報告顯示這些細胞分泌了額外的蛋白質。

sentences.en: She works in the public sector.
sentences.zh: 她在公部門工作。

sentences.en: Which sector is hiring the most right now?
sentences.zh: 現在哪個產業徵人徵得最多？

sentences.en: The tech sector grew faster than expected last year.
sentences.zh: 科技產業去年的成長比預期快。

sentences.en: Is the banking sector recovering from the crisis?
sentences.zh: 銀行業從危機中復甦了嗎？

sentences.en: Our company serves customers in the health care sector.
sentences.zh: 我們公司服務醫療保健產業的客戶。

sentences.en: Many people in the retail sector work on weekends.
sentences.zh: 零售業有許多人週末也要上班。

gloss_note: 常修飾形容詞，如 seemingly simple

sentences.en: He was seemingly calm, but his hands were shaking.
sentences.zh: 他看似冷靜，但雙手在發抖。

sentences.en: The seemingly simple task took us three hours.
sentences.zh: 這項看似簡單的工作花了我們三個小時。

sentences.en: The store was seemingly empty when we arrived. Where was everyone?
sentences.zh: 我們到的時候，店裡看似空無一人。大家都去哪了？

sentences.en: Seemingly out of nowhere, the power went out.
sentences.zh: 電突然斷了，看似毫無來由。

sentences.en: She seemingly forgot about our meeting. Should I call her?
sentences.zh: 她好像忘了我們的會議。我要打電話給她嗎？

sentences.en: The seemingly endless line at the airport moved quickly.
sentences.zh: 機場裡看似沒完沒了的隊伍移動得很快。

gloss_note: a segment of the market 市場的一部分

sentences.en: The news show had a funny segment about pets.
sentences.zh: 新聞節目有個關於寵物的有趣片段。

sentences.en: Which segment of customers spends the most?
sentences.zh: 哪一部分的顧客花最多錢？

sentences.en: The last segment of the road was closed for repairs.
sentences.zh: 這條路的最後一段因維修而封閉。

sentences.en: Can you cut that segment out of the video?
sentences.zh: 你可以把影片裡那一段剪掉嗎？

sentences.en: Each segment of the tour lasts about an hour.
sentences.zh: 這趟行程的每一段大約持續一小時。

sentences.en: The report is divided into three main segments.
sentences.zh: 這份報告分成三個主要部分。

sentences.en: Market segmentation helps us target the right customers.
sentences.zh: 市場區隔幫助我們鎖定對的顧客。

sentences.en: Do we have any segmentation data for last quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們有上一季的客群區隔資料嗎？

sentences.en: The team presented a new customer segmentation model.
sentences.zh: 團隊提出了一個新的顧客區隔模型。

sentences.en: How does segmentation change our advertising plan?
sentences.zh: 區隔會如何改變我們的廣告計畫？

sentences.en: Good segmentation lets a small business compete with larger companies.
sentences.zh: 良好的區隔能讓小型企業和大公司競爭。

sentences.en: The professor explained image segmentation in today's lecture.
sentences.zh: 教授在今天的課上講解了影像分割。

sentences.en: I felt a burning sensation in my throat.
sentences.zh: 我覺得喉嚨有灼熱感。

sentences.en: Do you ever lose the sensation in your fingers when it's cold?
sentences.zh: 天冷時你的手指會不會失去知覺？

sentences.en: The patient had no sensation in his left foot.
sentences.zh: 病人的左腳沒有知覺。

sentences.en: Have you ever had that sinking sensation in your stomach?
sentences.zh: 你有過那種胃往下沉的感覺嗎？

sentences.en: Cold water on the skin creates a sharp sensation.
sentences.zh: 冷水碰到皮膚會產生刺痛的感覺。

sentences.en: She enjoyed the sensation of warm sand under her feet.
sentences.zh: 她很享受腳下溫暖沙子的觸感。

sentences.en: The sensor turns on the light when you walk in.
sentences.zh: 你走進來時，感應器會把燈打開。

sentences.en: Is the motion sensor broken again?
sentences.zh: 動作感應器又壞了嗎？

sentences.en: A temperature sensor tells us when the room is too hot.
sentences.zh: 溫度感測器會告訴我們房間何時太熱。

sentences.en: Where did they put the light sensor for the garden lamps?
sentences.zh: 他們把花園燈的光線感應器裝在哪裡？

sentences.en: The parking sensor beeped loudly as I backed up.
sentences.zh: 我倒車時，停車感應器大聲嗶嗶響。

sentences.en: The factory added sensors to every machine last month.
sentences.zh: 工廠上個月在每台機器上加裝了感測器。

sentences.en: This old watch has sentimental value for me.
sentences.zh: 這支舊手錶對我來說有情感上的價值。

sentences.en: Are you feeling sentimental about leaving the old apartment?
sentences.zh: 要離開舊公寓，你是不是有點多愁善感？

sentences.en: My grandmother gets sentimental whenever she sees old photos.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶一看到老照片就會多愁善感。

sentences.en: Why do people get so sentimental at graduation?
sentences.zh: 人們為什麼在畢業典禮上這麼多愁善感？

sentences.en: I kept the ticket for sentimental reasons.
sentences.zh: 基於情感因素，我留下了那張票。

sentences.en: He is too sentimental to throw away his old toys.
sentences.zh: 他太多愁善感，捨不得丟掉舊玩具。

sentences.en: The news report quoted a separatist from the region.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導引述了該地區一名分離主義者的話。

sentences.en: Who was the separatist mentioned in today's history lesson?
sentences.zh: 今天歷史課提到的分離主義者是誰？

sentences.en: My professor interviewed a former separatist for his book.
sentences.zh: 我的教授為他的書訪問了一位前分離主義者。

sentences.en: Did the separatists and the government agree to talk?
sentences.zh: 分離主義者和政府同意談判了嗎？

sentences.en: In the documentary, a separatist explains why he changed his mind.
sentences.zh: 紀錄片裡，一名分離主義者解釋他為何改變了心意。

sentences.en: The museum has letters written by a separatist in 1920.
sentences.zh: 博物館收藏了一位分離主義者在1920年寫的信。

sentences.en: Put these steps in the correct sequence.
sentences.zh: 請把這些步驟照正確的順序排好。

sentences.en: Can you check the sequence of numbers on this form?
sentences.zh: 你可以檢查表格上的數字順序嗎？

sentences.en: A strange sequence of events led to the delay.
sentences.zh: 一連串奇怪的事件導致了延誤。

sentences.en: What is the next number in this sequence?
sentences.zh: 這一連串數字的下一個是什麼？

sentences.en: She typed the password in the wrong sequence.
sentences.zh: 她輸入密碼的順序錯了。

sentences.en: Did the sequence of the questions confuse you?
sentences.zh: 問題的順序讓你搞混了嗎？

sentences.en: The serial number is on the back of the laptop.
sentences.zh: 序號在筆電的背面。

sentences.en: Could you read me the serial number over the phone?
sentences.zh: 你可以在電話裡把序號唸給我聽嗎？

sentences.en: He is a serial entrepreneur who has started four companies.
sentences.zh: 他是連續創業者，已經創辦過四家公司。

sentences.en: Is the serial number printed on the receipt?
sentences.zh: 序號有印在收據上嗎？

sentences.en: Each bill has its own serial number.
sentences.zh: 每張鈔票都有各自的序號。

sentences.en: The police matched the serial number to a stolen phone.
sentences.zh: 警方把序號和一支失竊的手機比對相符。

gloss_note: a series of 一系列；單複數同形

sentences.en: Have you seen the new series everyone is talking about?
sentences.zh: 你看過大家都在聊的那部新影集嗎？

sentences.en: The company released a series of short videos.
sentences.zh: 公司發布了一系列短片。

sentences.en: We watched a whole series in one weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們一個週末就看完了整部影集。

sentences.en: A series of storms hit the coast last week.
sentences.zh: 上週有一連串的暴風雨侵襲海岸。

sentences.en: Is this book part of a series?
sentences.zh: 這本書是某個系列的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: She is writing a series of articles on healthy eating.
sentences.zh: 她正在寫一系列關於健康飲食的文章。

gloss_note: 美式說法；英式多說 waiter/waitress

sentences.en: Our server was friendly and very fast.
sentences.zh: 我們的服務生很親切，速度也很快。

sentences.en: Can you ask the server for more water?
sentences.zh: 你可以向服務生多要一些水嗎？

sentences.en: The server brought our food in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 服務生十分鐘就把我們的餐點端來了。

sentences.en: Did you leave a tip for the server?
sentences.zh: 你有給服務生小費嗎？

sentences.en: I worked as a server to pay for college.
sentences.zh: 我當服務生來付大學的學費。

sentences.en: Our server recommended the soup of the day.
sentences.zh: 我們的服務生推薦了今日例湯。

sentences.en: Our training session starts at nine tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我們的培訓課明天九點開始。

sentences.en: How long was the study session last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的讀書時間有多久？

sentences.en: I booked a photo session for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 我幫全家人預約了一段拍照時間。

sentences.en: Questions came up at the end of the session.
sentences.zh: 課程結束時出現了一些問題。

sentences.en: Is there still a seat in the afternoon session?
sentences.zh: 下午場還有座位嗎？

sentences.en: The players had a short practice session before the game.
sentences.zh: 球員們在比賽前做了一小段練習。

gloss_note: office setup 辦公室配置；也可寫 set-up

sentences.en: I love your home office setup.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡你家裡辦公室的配置。

sentences.en: Can you help me with the setup of this printer?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我設定這台印表機嗎？

sentences.en: The setup took less than ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 設定只花了不到十分鐘。

sentences.en: Is this the right setup for the video call?
sentences.zh: 這樣的配置適合視訊通話嗎？

sentences.en: The IT team finished the new setup over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 資訊組在週末完成了新的配置。

sentences.en: Our conference room has a simple setup with one screen.
sentences.zh: 我們的會議室配置簡單，只有一個螢幕。

sentences.en: The storm severely damaged several houses.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨嚴重損毀了好幾棟房子。

sentences.en: Was anyone severely hurt in the accident?
sentences.zh: 有人在事故中受重傷嗎？

sentences.en: Sales were severely hit by the new competitor.
sentences.zh: 銷售受到新競爭者的嚴重打擊。

sentences.en: I severely underestimated how long the drive would take.
sentences.zh: 我嚴重低估了開車要花的時間。

sentences.en: Did the delay severely affect your trip?
sentences.zh: 延誤嚴重影響了你的旅程嗎？

sentences.en: Our team is severely short of staff this month.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊這個月人手嚴重不足。

sentences.en: The city is repairing the main sewer on Oak Street.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在維修橡樹街的主要下水道。

sentences.en: Don't throw trash into the sewer.
sentences.zh: 不要把垃圾丟進下水道。

sentences.en: Did a bad smell come from the sewer outside?
sentences.zh: 外面的下水道有傳出臭味嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy rain filled the sewer and flooded the street.
sentences.zh: 大雨灌滿了下水道，淹沒了街道。

sentences.en: Who is in charge of cleaning the sewer lines?
sentences.zh: 誰負責清理下水道管線？

sentences.en: Our building is connected to the city sewer.
sentences.zh: 我們的大樓接上了市政下水道。

sentences.en: Every shareholder will receive a copy of the annual report.
sentences.zh: 每位股東都會收到一份年度報告。

sentences.en: Did the shareholders approve the new budget?
sentences.zh: 股東們核准新預算了嗎？

sentences.en: She became a shareholder after buying stock last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年買了股票後成為股東。

sentences.en: How many shareholders attended the meeting today?
sentences.zh: 今天有多少位股東出席會議？

sentences.en: A shareholder asked a tough question about profits.
sentences.zh: 一位股東針對利潤提出了一個棘手的問題。

sentences.en: We must keep our shareholders informed.
sentences.zh: 我們必須讓股東隨時了解情況。

sentences.en: The glass shattered when it hit the kitchen floor.
sentences.zh: 玻璃掉到廚房地板上就碎了。

sentences.en: Did you hear something shatter in the living room?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有聽到客廳有東西碎掉的聲音？

sentences.en: Be careful, or you'll shatter that old vase.
sentences.zh: 小心點，不然你會把那個舊花瓶打碎。

sentences.en: A baseball shattered our neighbor's window last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一顆棒球打碎了鄰居家的窗戶。

sentences.en: Why do some glasses shatter when you pour hot water in?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些玻璃杯一倒入熱水就會破掉？

sentences.en: The ice shattered into tiny pieces on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 冰塊在人行道上碎成了小碎片。

gloss_note: sheer luck 純粹運氣；強調程度

sentences.en: He passed the test through sheer hard work.
sentences.zh: 他完全是靠努力才通過考試。

sentences.en: The sheer size of the new mall surprised me.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心的龐大規模讓我很驚訝。

sentences.en: Was it sheer luck that you found a parking spot?
sentences.zh: 你找到停車位純粹是運氣嗎？

sentences.en: She quit the class out of sheer boredom.
sentences.zh: 她純粹因為無聊而退掉了那門課。

sentences.en: The sheer number of emails today is unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 今天電子郵件的數量之多，真是令人難以置信。

sentences.en: Is it sheer coincidence that we both chose the same shirt?
sentences.zh: 我們兩個挑了同一件襯衫，純粹是巧合嗎？

sentences.en: The county sheriff spoke at our school assembly today.
sentences.zh: 郡警長今天在我們學校的集會上演講。

sentences.en: In the movie, the sheriff rides into town alone.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，警長獨自騎馬進了小鎮。

sentences.en: Who is running for sheriff in our county this year?
sentences.zh: 今年我們郡有誰要參選警長？

sentences.en: My uncle worked as a deputy sheriff for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔當了二十年的副警長。

sentences.en: Did the sheriff say when the road would reopen?
sentences.zh: 警長有說道路什麼時候會重新開放嗎？

sentences.en: The sheriff's office posted a warning about icy roads.
sentences.zh: 警長辦公室發布了路面結冰的警告。

gloss_note: shiver with cold 冷得發抖

sentences.en: I shivered in the cold wind at the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 我在公車站的寒風中直發抖。

sentences.en: Why do you shiver every time the air conditioner turns on?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每次冷氣一開你就會發抖？

sentences.en: The puppy gave a little shiver and curled up.
sentences.zh: 小狗微微打了個顫，然後蜷縮起來。

sentences.en: The kids were still shivering after swimming in the cold lake.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在冷湖裡游完泳後還一直發抖。

sentences.en: Are you shivering because the room is too cold?
sentences.zh: 你在發抖是因為房間太冷嗎？

sentences.en: Grab a jacket so you don't shiver at the game.
sentences.zh: 帶件外套，免得你看比賽時冷得發抖。

sentences.en: My grandmother bakes shortbread every Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年聖誕節都會烤奶油酥餅。

sentences.en: Would you like some shortbread with your tea?
sentences.zh: 你要不要來點奶油酥餅配茶？

sentences.en: This shortbread is so buttery that it melts in your mouth.
sentences.zh: 這種奶油酥餅奶油味十足，入口即化。

sentences.en: Can you pick up a box of shortbread at the grocery store?
sentences.zh: 你可以去雜貨店買一盒奶油酥餅嗎？

sentences.en: The shortbread is cooling on the counter right now.
sentences.zh: 奶油酥餅現在正放在流理台上放涼。

sentences.en: I only need flour, sugar, and butter to make shortbread.
sentences.zh: 只要麵粉、糖和奶油就能做出奶油酥餅。

sentences.en: The company is facing a budget shortfall this quarter.
sentences.zh: 公司這一季面臨預算缺口。

sentences.en: How will we cover the shortfall in sales?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼填補銷售上的缺口？

sentences.en: A shortfall of two hundred dollars delayed the purchase.
sentences.zh: 兩百美元的缺口讓採購延後了。

sentences.en: Did the report explain the shortfall in this month's revenue?
sentences.zh: 報告有說明本月營收短缺的原因嗎？

sentences.en: The city had a shortfall of nurses during the winter.
sentences.zh: 這座城市在冬天出現了護理師人力短缺。

sentences.en: We need to make up the shortfall before the end of June.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在六月底前補足缺口。

sentences.en: Someone shoved me in the crowded subway car.
sentences.zh: 有人在擁擠的地鐵車廂裡推了我一下。

sentences.en: Please don't shove your way to the front.
sentences.zh: 請不要用推擠的方式擠到前面。

sentences.en: He shoved his keys into his pocket and left.
sentences.zh: 他把鑰匙塞進口袋就離開了。

sentences.en: Why did you shove all your clothes into one drawer?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把所有衣服都塞進同一個抽屜？

sentences.en: Can you shove that box under the bed for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把那個箱子推到床底下嗎？

sentences.en: Give the door a shove if it gets stuck.
sentences.zh: 門如果卡住了，就用力推一下。

sentences.en: She just shrugged and said she didn't mind.
sentences.zh: 她只是聳聳肩，說她不介意。

sentences.en: What does it mean when he shrugs like that?
sentences.zh: 他那樣聳肩是什麼意思？

sentences.en: I asked him about the plan, but he only gave a shrug.
sentences.zh: 我問他計畫的事，他只是聳了聳肩。

sentences.en: Why do you always shrug when I ask a question?
sentences.zh: 每次我問問題，你為什麼都在聳肩？

sentences.en: The coach shrugged when the reporter asked about the loss.
sentences.zh: 記者問到這場敗仗時，教練聳了聳肩。

sentences.en: With a little shrug, he handed me the keys.
sentences.zh: 他輕輕聳了一下肩，把鑰匙遞給我。

gloss_note: 常用複數 siblings；不分性別

sentences.en: Do you have any siblings, or are you an only child?
sentences.zh: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎，還是你是獨生子女？

sentences.en: All three of my siblings live in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我的三個兄弟姊妹都住在德州。

sentences.en: Sibling rivalry can make family dinners pretty noisy.
sentences.zh: 手足之間的競爭有時會讓家庭晚餐變得很吵。

sentences.en: Which sibling do you call the most?
sentences.zh: 你最常打電話給哪一位兄弟姊妹？

sentences.en: She shares a bedroom with two of her siblings.
sentences.zh: 她和兩個兄弟姊妹共用一間臥室。

sentences.en: The study looked at how siblings affect each other's habits.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討兄弟姊妹如何影響彼此的習慣。

sentences.en: The history teacher described the siege of an ancient castle.
sentences.zh: 歷史老師描述了一座古堡遭到圍攻的經過。

sentences.en: How long did the siege of the city last?
sentences.zh: 這座城市被圍攻了多久？

sentences.en: The castle survived a siege that lasted nearly six months.
sentences.zh: 這座城堡撐過了將近六個月的圍攻。

sentences.en: Our museum has a model showing the siege of a fort.
sentences.zh: 我們的博物館有一個展示堡壘遭圍攻的模型。

sentences.en: Did the townspeople have enough food during the siege?
sentences.zh: 圍攻期間，鎮上的居民有足夠的食物嗎？

sentences.en: The old documentary explains how armies prepared for a siege.
sentences.zh: 這部老紀錄片說明了軍隊如何為圍攻做準備。

sentences.en: A green light on the printer signifies that it's ready.
sentences.zh: 印表機上的綠燈表示它已經就緒了。

sentences.en: What does a red flag on the map signify?
sentences.zh: 地圖上的紅旗代表什麼意思？

sentences.en: In many cultures, the color red signifies good luck.
sentences.zh: 在許多文化中，紅色象徵好運。

sentences.en: Does your signature signify that you agree to the terms?
sentences.zh: 你的簽名表示你同意這些條款嗎？

sentences.en: The sudden drop in orders may signify a bigger problem.
sentences.zh: 訂單突然減少可能表示有更大的問題。

sentences.en: A nod from the manager signified approval.
sentences.zh: 經理點頭表示同意。

sentences.en: I love the simplicity of this phone's design.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡這支手機設計上的簡單。

sentences.en: The simplicity of the recipe makes it perfect for beginners.
sentences.zh: 這道食譜做法簡單，非常適合初學者。

sentences.en: Why do customers value simplicity so much?
sentences.zh: 為什麼顧客這麼重視簡單？

sentences.en: The cabin's simplicity was part of its charm.
sentences.zh: 那間小屋的簡樸是它魅力的一部分。

sentences.en: Do you prefer the simplicity of paper forms?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡紙本表格的簡單方便嗎？

sentences.en: She lives a life of simplicity in a small town.
sentences.zh: 她在小鎮過著簡樸的生活。

sentences.en: My son got a new skateboard for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 我兒子生日收到一塊新滑板。

sentences.en: Do you ride a skateboard to school?
sentences.zh: 你是玩滑板去上學的嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't leave your skateboard in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 請不要把你的滑板放在走廊上。

sentences.en: He carried his skateboard under his arm into the store.
sentences.zh: 他把滑板夾在腋下走進店裡。

sentences.en: Where can I buy a good skateboard around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近哪裡可以買到好的滑板？

sentences.en: The skateboard rolled down the hill without him.
sentences.zh: 滑板自己滾下了山坡，上面沒有人。

sentences.en: The museum has a dinosaur skeleton in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館大廳裡有一具恐龍骨架。

sentences.en: How many bones are in the human skeleton?
sentences.zh: 人體骨骼裡有多少塊骨頭？

sentences.en: Students labeled each bone on the plastic skeleton in biology class.
sentences.zh: 學生在生物課上為塑膠骨骼模型的每塊骨頭標上名稱。

sentences.en: Scientists announced a nearly complete skeleton found in the desert.
sentences.zh: 科學家宣布在沙漠中發現了一具幾乎完整的骨架。

sentences.en: Did you see the whale skeleton hanging from the ceiling?
sentences.zh: 你有看到掛在天花板上的鯨魚骨架嗎？

sentences.en: The skeleton protects our organs and supports the body.
sentences.zh: 骨骼保護我們的器官並支撐身體。

sentences.en: I'm a bit of a skeptic about that new software.
sentences.zh: 我對那套新軟體有點存疑。

sentences.en: Our manager is a skeptic who always wants proof.
sentences.zh: 我們經理是個懷疑派，凡事都要證據。

sentences.en: Are you still a skeptic after seeing the results?
sentences.zh: 看過結果之後，你還是持懷疑態度嗎？

sentences.en: Even the biggest skeptic in the room was impressed.
sentences.zh: 連在場最懷疑的人都印象深刻。

sentences.en: Why is Tom such a skeptic about online reviews?
sentences.zh: 湯姆為什麼對網路評論這麼懷疑？

sentences.en: As a skeptic, she asked for more data before voting.
sentences.zh: 身為懷疑者，她在投票前要求更多數據。

sentences.en: The museum displays the skull of a giant prehistoric bear.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館展出一隻史前巨熊的頭骨。

sentences.en: A helmet protects your skull if you fall off a bike.
sentences.zh: 騎腳踏車摔倒時，安全帽能保護你的頭骨。

sentences.en: How thick is the human skull?
sentences.zh: 人類的頭骨有多厚？

sentences.en: Students studied a plastic skull in anatomy class.
sentences.zh: 學生在解剖課上觀察一個塑膠頭骨模型。

sentences.en: Did the scientists find a skull at the dig site?
sentences.zh: 科學家在挖掘現場找到頭骨了嗎？

sentences.en: The skull is made up of many bones joined together.
sentences.zh: 頭骨是由許多相連的骨頭組成的。

sentences.en: The workers poured a concrete slab for the new garage.
sentences.zh: 工人為新車庫澆灌了一塊水泥厚板。

sentences.en: He cut a thick slab of cheese for the sandwich.
sentences.zh: 他切了一大塊厚厚的起司來做三明治。

sentences.en: Would you like a slab of chocolate cake?
sentences.zh: 你要不要來一大塊巧克力蛋糕？

sentences.en: A heavy stone slab covered the old well.
sentences.zh: 一塊厚重的石板蓋住了那口老井。

sentences.en: How thick should the concrete slab be for the patio?
sentences.zh: 露台的水泥厚板應該要多厚？

sentences.en: The butcher cut a slab of beef for us.
sentences.zh: 肉販為我們切了一大塊牛肉。

gloss_note: slam the door 用力甩門

sentences.en: Please don't slam the door when you leave.
sentences.zh: 離開時請不要用力甩門。

sentences.en: The wind slammed the window shut.
sentences.zh: 風把窗戶砰地一聲吹上了。

sentences.en: Why did you slam the laptop closed like that?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼那樣用力把筆電蓋上？

sentences.en: She slammed her bag on the desk and sat down.
sentences.zh: 她把包包重重摔在桌上，然後坐下來。

sentences.en: Did you hear that car door slam?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到那個車門砰地關上的聲音嗎？

sentences.en: The slam of the door woke everyone up.
sentences.zh: 關門的砰然巨響把大家都吵醒了。

gloss_note: a slap on the back 拍背

sentences.en: He slapped me on the back and said congratulations.
sentences.zh: 他拍拍我的背，對我說恭喜。

sentences.en: Did he really slap the table that loudly during the meeting?
sentences.zh: 會議中他真的那麼大聲地拍桌子嗎？

sentences.en: The coach gave the player a friendly slap on the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 教練友善地拍了拍球員的肩膀。

sentences.en: Why does the water slap against the dock all night?
sentences.zh: 為什麼水整晚都拍打著碼頭？

sentences.en: He slapped the table and laughed at the joke.
sentences.zh: 他一邊笑那個笑話，一邊拍著桌子。

sentences.en: The kids slap their knees along with the music.
sentences.zh: 孩子們跟著音樂拍打自己的膝蓋。

sentences.en: Do you have a free slot on Thursday afternoon?
sentences.zh: 你週四下午有空檔嗎？

sentences.en: We booked the last time slot for the presentation.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了簡報的最後一個時段。

sentences.en: Which slot works better for you, nine or ten?
sentences.zh: 九點和十點，哪個時段對你比較方便？

sentences.en: The show moved to a later slot on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 這個節目換到週五晚上較晚的時段。

sentences.en: I can fit you into the two o'clock slot.
sentences.zh: 我可以把你排進兩點的時段。

sentences.en: All the morning slots at the clinic are full.
sentences.zh: 診所早上的時段都滿了。

gloss_note: smash into pieces 砸成碎片

sentences.en: The kids smashed a flower pot while playing.
sentences.zh: 孩子們玩耍時打碎了一個花盆。

sentences.en: Be careful with the boxes, or you'll smash the glasses inside.
sentences.zh: 小心那些箱子，不然你會把裡面的玻璃杯打碎。

sentences.en: Who smashed the cookie jar in the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 是誰把廚房的餅乾罐打破了？

sentences.en: A truck smashed through the fence last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一輛卡車撞破了圍欄。

sentences.en: Did you smash your phone screen again?
sentences.zh: 你又把手機螢幕摔破了嗎？

sentences.en: He smashed the ice with a hammer for the drinks.
sentences.zh: 他用槌子把冰塊敲碎來做飲料。

sentences.en: Heavy smog covered the city this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上濃濃的霧霾籠罩了整座城市。

sentences.en: Is there a lot of smog in your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你的家鄉有很多霧霾嗎？

sentences.en: Smog makes it hard to see the mountains.
sentences.zh: 霧霾讓人很難看到遠方的山。

sentences.en: The school canceled outdoor sports because of the smog.
sentences.zh: 學校因為霧霾而取消了戶外運動。

sentences.en: Why does smog get worse in the summer?
sentences.zh: 為什麼霧霾在夏天會更嚴重？

sentences.en: Cars and factories both add to the smog in big cities.
sentences.zh: 汽車和工廠都讓大城市的霧霾問題更嚴重。

gloss_note: smuggle sth in/out 偷帶進／出

sentences.en: The news said police stopped men trying to smuggle rare birds.
sentences.zh: 新聞說警方攔下了企圖走私稀有鳥類的人。

sentences.en: My little brother tried to smuggle candy into the movie theater.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟想偷帶糖果進電影院。

sentences.en: Did you smuggle your dog into the hotel room?
sentences.zh: 你是不是把狗偷偷帶進了飯店房間？

sentences.en: Customs officers caught him trying to smuggle fruit into the country.
sentences.zh: 海關人員抓到他企圖把水果夾帶入境。

sentences.en: Why would anyone smuggle antiques out of a country?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人要把古董走私出境？

sentences.en: In history class, we learned how merchants smuggled goods past tax collectors.
sentences.zh: 歷史課上，我們學到商人如何把貨物走私過稅吏的關卡。

sentences.en: He tried to sneak out of the meeting early.
sentences.zh: 他想提早偷偷溜出會議。

sentences.en: Did you sneak a cookie from the jar?
sentences.zh: 你是不是偷拿了一片餅乾？

sentences.en: The cat snuck into the kitchen while we ate.
sentences.zh: 貓趁我們吃飯時偷偷溜進了廚房。

sentences.en: Can you sneak me some leftovers from the party?
sentences.zh: 你可以偷偷帶一些派對的剩菜給我嗎？

sentences.en: I sneaked a quick look at my phone during class.
sentences.zh: 我上課時偷偷看了一下手機。

sentences.en: Don't sneak up on me like that.
sentences.zh: 別那樣從背後偷偷靠近我。

gloss_note: 別人打噴嚏時常回一句 Bless you.

sentences.en: I always sneeze when I walk past a cat.
sentences.zh: 我每次走過貓旁邊都會打噴嚏。

sentences.en: Did you just sneeze, or was that the heater?
sentences.zh: 你剛剛是打了噴嚏，還是那是暖氣的聲音？

sentences.en: Please cover your mouth when you sneeze.
sentences.zh: 打噴嚏時請摀住嘴巴。

sentences.en: Why do I sneeze when I look at bright light?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我看到強光就會打噴嚏？

sentences.en: His loud sneeze echoed through the quiet library.
sentences.zh: 他響亮的噴嚏聲在安靜的圖書館裡迴盪。

sentences.en: Spring pollen makes me sneeze all morning.
sentences.zh: 春天的花粉讓我一整個早上都在打噴嚏。

gloss_note: sniff the milk 聞聞牛奶壞了沒

sentences.en: The dog sniffed my shoes at the door.
sentences.zh: 狗在門口聞了聞我的鞋子。

sentences.en: Sniff the milk to see if it's still good.
sentences.zh: 聞聞看牛奶還能不能喝。

sentences.en: Why does your dog sniff every tree on the walk?
sentences.zh: 為什麼你的狗散步時每棵樹都要聞一聞？

sentences.en: She sniffed the soup and added a little salt.
sentences.zh: 她聞了聞湯，然後加了一點鹽。

sentences.en: Could you sniff this and tell me if it smells burnt?
sentences.zh: 你可以聞聞這個，告訴我有沒有燒焦味嗎？

sentences.en: He took a quick sniff of the fresh bread.
sentences.zh: 他湊近聞了一下剛出爐的麵包。

gloss_note: soak in water 泡在水裡

sentences.en: Soak the beans in water overnight.
sentences.zh: 把豆子泡水一整晚。

sentences.en: I got soaked waiting for the bus in the rain.
sentences.zh: 我在雨中等公車，全身都濕透了。

sentences.en: Should I soak these stained shirts before washing them?
sentences.zh: 我洗這些有污漬的襯衫之前，要先浸泡嗎？

sentences.en: How long do you soak your feet in hot water?
sentences.zh: 你的腳通常泡熱水泡多久？

sentences.en: The rain soaked through my jacket.
sentences.zh: 雨水把我的外套浸透了。

sentences.en: My shoes were soaking wet after the hike.
sentences.zh: 健行結束後，我的鞋子濕透了。

gloss_note: sob 比 cry 更帶抽噎聲

sentences.en: The little girl began to sob when she lost her balloon.
sentences.zh: 小女孩弄丟氣球後開始啜泣。

sentences.en: I could hear someone sobbing in the next room.
sentences.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間有人在啜泣。

sentences.en: Why is she sobbing in the hallway?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼在走廊上啜泣？

sentences.en: He tried not to sob during the sad movie.
sentences.zh: 他看那部悲傷的電影時，努力不讓自己啜泣。

sentences.en: Did you hear the sob in her voice?
sentences.zh: 你有聽出她聲音裡的啜泣嗎？

sentences.en: Between sobs, he told us what happened.
sentences.zh: 他一邊啜泣，一邊告訴我們發生了什麼事。

gloss_note: 指沒喝酒的清醒，或態度嚴肅

sentences.en: I'll drive home tonight because I'm staying sober.
sentences.zh: 今晚我會開車回家，因為我會保持清醒。

sentences.en: Who is the designated driver that has to stay sober tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚必須保持清醒的指定駕駛是誰？

sentences.en: The report gave a sober view of next year's sales.
sentences.zh: 報告對明年的銷售提出了冷靜嚴肅的看法。

sentences.en: The mood in the room turned sober after the news.
sentences.zh: 聽到消息後，房間裡的氣氛變得嚴肅。

sentences.en: Can we take a sober look at the numbers first?
sentences.zh: 我們可以先冷靜地看一下這些數字嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher spoke in a sober voice about the exam results.
sentences.zh: 老師用嚴肅的語氣談到考試結果。

gloss_note: socialize with sb 與某人交際

sentences.en: I like to socialize with coworkers after work.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡下班後和同事社交。

sentences.en: Do you socialize much with your neighbors?
sentences.zh: 你和鄰居常往來嗎？

sentences.en: Dogs need to socialize with other dogs when they are young.
sentences.zh: 小狗在年幼時需要和其他狗互動交際。

sentences.en: New students socialize during the first week of orientation.
sentences.zh: 新生在迎新的第一週彼此交際。

sentences.en: How can I socialize more when I work from home?
sentences.zh: 我在家工作時，要怎麼樣才能多一點社交？

sentences.en: Studies show that people who socialize regularly feel less lonely.
sentences.zh: 研究顯示，經常社交的人比較不孤單。

gloss_note: soften the blow 緩和衝擊

sentences.en: Leave the butter out so it can soften.
sentences.zh: 把奶油放在室溫下讓它軟化。

sentences.en: Warm lighting can soften the look of a small room.
sentences.zh: 暖色燈光能讓小房間看起來更柔和。

sentences.en: How do I soften brown sugar that has turned hard?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼讓變硬的黑糖軟化？

sentences.en: She tried to soften the bad news with a smile.
sentences.zh: 她試著用微笑讓壞消息不那麼刺耳。

sentences.en: Did the rain soften the ground enough to plant?
sentences.zh: 雨水有沒有讓土壤軟到可以種植？

sentences.en: His voice softened when he talked about his kids.
sentences.zh: 他談到孩子時，聲音變得柔和了。

gloss_note: go solo 獨自行動；也可作副詞

sentences.en: She is planning a solo trip to Canada this summer.
sentences.zh: 她計畫今年夏天去加拿大獨自旅行。

sentences.en: Have you ever traveled solo?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有獨自旅行過？

sentences.en: I like to go to the movies solo.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡自己一個人去看電影。

sentences.en: Is it safe to hike solo in this area?
sentences.zh: 在這個地區一個人健行安全嗎？

sentences.en: The pilot completed his first solo flight yesterday.
sentences.zh: 飛行員昨天完成了他的第一次單獨飛行。

sentences.en: I prefer solo workouts to group classes.
sentences.zh: 比起團體課程，我比較喜歡一個人運動。

gloss_note: soluble in water 可溶於水

sentences.en: Sugar is soluble in water.
sentences.zh: 糖可溶於水。

sentences.en: Is this instant coffee soluble in cold milk?
sentences.zh: 這種即溶咖啡可溶於冷牛奶嗎？

sentences.en: Oil is not soluble in water, so it floats.
sentences.zh: 油不溶於水，所以會浮在水面上。

sentences.en: The teacher showed us which salts are soluble.
sentences.zh: 老師向我們示範了哪些鹽類是可溶的。

sentences.en: Are all fertilizers soluble in water?
sentences.zh: 所有的肥料都可溶於水嗎？

sentences.en: Soluble fiber can help lower cholesterol.
sentences.zh: 水溶性纖維有助於降低膽固醇。

gloss_note: solute 溶於 solvent 溶劑

sentences.en: In salt water, the salt is the solute.
sentences.zh: 在鹽水中，鹽是溶質。

sentences.en: Which part of the mixture is the solute?
sentences.zh: 這個混合物的哪一部分是溶質？

sentences.en: The solute dissolves in the solvent to form a solution.
sentences.zh: 溶質溶於溶劑而形成溶液。

sentences.en: How much solute can the water hold at this temperature?
sentences.zh: 在這個溫度下，水能容納多少溶質？

sentences.en: Our chemistry teacher asked us to weigh the solute first.
sentences.zh: 化學老師要我們先稱溶質的重量。

sentences.en: A higher temperature lets more solute dissolve in the liquid.
sentences.zh: 溫度較高時，液體能溶解更多溶質。

gloss_note: solvent 溶解 solute 溶質

sentences.en: Water is the most common solvent in nature.
sentences.zh: 水是自然界中最常見的溶劑。

sentences.en: Do not use a strong solvent on the plastic.
sentences.zh: 不要在塑膠上使用強力溶劑。

sentences.en: Which solvent works best for removing sticky labels?
sentences.zh: 哪一種溶劑最適合去除黏黏的標籤？

sentences.en: The salt dissolved completely in the solvent.
sentences.zh: 鹽完全溶解在溶劑中。

sentences.en: Is alcohol a good solvent for this stain?
sentences.zh: 酒精是處理這個污漬的好溶劑嗎？

sentences.en: Open the window when you use a cleaning solvent.
sentences.zh: 使用清潔溶劑時請打開窗戶。

sentences.en: Let's go someplace quiet for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們去某個安靜的地方吃午餐吧。

sentences.en: I left my keys someplace, but I can't remember where.
sentences.zh: 我把鑰匙放在某個地方了，但想不起來在哪。

sentences.en: We should eat someplace nice for your birthday.
sentences.zh: 你生日那天，我們應該找個不錯的地方吃飯。

sentences.en: Is there someplace near here to get coffee?
sentences.zh: 這附近有地方可以買咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: I need to put these boxes someplace dry. Any ideas?
sentences.zh: 我需要把這些箱子放在乾燥的地方。有什麼想法嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want to meet someplace downtown after work?
sentences.zh: 下班後你想在市中心某個地方碰面嗎？

gloss_note: 指複雜精密，或品味高雅

sentences.en: This machine uses a very sophisticated cooling system.
sentences.zh: 這台機器使用非常精密的冷卻系統。

sentences.en: The restaurant serves sophisticated dishes in a casual setting.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳在輕鬆的環境中供應精緻講究的菜餚。

sentences.en: Is this phone too sophisticated for my grandfather?
sentences.zh: 這支手機對我爺爺來說是不是太複雜精密了？

sentences.en: She has sophisticated taste in wine and cheese.
sentences.zh: 她對葡萄酒和起司的品味很講究。

sentences.en: Do you think the new software is sophisticated enough for our needs?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這套新軟體夠精密，能滿足我們的需求嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel lobby looks modern and sophisticated.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店的大廳看起來既現代又精緻高雅。

gloss_note: 美國高中或大學的二年級

sentences.en: I was a sophomore when I joined the chess club.
sentences.zh: 我讀二年級時加入了西洋棋社。

sentences.en: Are you a sophomore or a junior this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年是二年級還是三年級？

sentences.en: Every sophomore has to take a health class.
sentences.zh: 每位二年級生都得修一門健康課。

sentences.en: She's a sophomore studying biology at a state university.
sentences.zh: 她是州立大學主修生物的二年級生。

sentences.en: How many sophomores signed up for the field trip?
sentences.zh: 有多少二年級生報名了校外教學？

sentences.en: The sophomore class is selling cookies to raise money.
sentences.zh: 二年級的同學正在賣餅乾籌錢。

gloss_note: a source of 的來源；source 作動詞為進貨

sentences.en: Beans are a good source of protein.
sentences.zh: 豆類是蛋白質的良好來源。

sentences.en: We source our vegetables from local farms.
sentences.zh: 我們的蔬菜取自當地農場。

sentences.en: Where do you source your seafood?
sentences.zh: 你們的海鮮是從哪裡進貨的？

sentences.en: Milk is a major source of calcium for kids.
sentences.zh: 牛奶是孩子鈣質的主要來源。

sentences.en: What is the main source of fiber in your diet?
sentences.zh: 你飲食中纖維的主要來源是什麼？

sentences.en: The chef sources fresh herbs from a small garden nearby.
sentences.zh: 主廚的新鮮香草取自附近的一座小菜園。

gloss_note: Southern food 美國南方菜（常大寫）

sentences.en: I love Southern food, especially the sweet iced tea.
sentences.zh: 我愛南方菜，尤其是甜冰茶。

sentences.en: Do you know any good Southern restaurants around here?
sentences.zh: 你知道這附近有什麼不錯的南方菜餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: Southern Italy is famous for its tomatoes and olive oil.
sentences.zh: 義大利南部以番茄和橄欖油聞名。

sentences.en: My aunt makes Southern biscuits every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨每個星期天早上都會做南方式的比司吉。

sentences.en: Is this recipe from the southern part of the country?
sentences.zh: 這份食譜是來自這個國家的南部嗎？

sentences.en: The southern coast is warmer, so fruit grows well there.
sentences.zh: 南部海岸比較暖和，所以水果長得很好。

sentences.en: The news report explained what national sovereignty means.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導說明了國家主權的意思。

sentences.en: How does our textbook define sovereignty?
sentences.zh: 我們的課本如何定義主權？

sentences.en: My roommate is writing a paper on sovereignty.
sentences.zh: 我室友正在寫一篇關於主權的報告。

sentences.en: Can you explain sovereignty to me in simple words?
sentences.zh: 你可以用簡單的話跟我解釋主權嗎？

sentences.en: My teacher says sovereignty is about who makes the rules in a country.
sentences.zh: 老師說主權就是誰有權在一個國家裡訂規則。

sentences.en: The museum exhibit shows how the idea of sovereignty developed.
sentences.zh: 博物館展覽展示了主權概念是如何發展的。

sentences.en: Farmers sow wheat in the fall in some regions.
sentences.zh: 在某些地區，農民在秋天播種小麥。

sentences.en: We sowed the lettuce seeds last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末播下了萵苣種子。

sentences.en: When should I sow tomato seeds indoors?
sentences.zh: 我應該什麼時候在室內播番茄種子？

sentences.en: Dad is sowing grass seed in the front yard.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正在前院播草籽。

sentences.en: Did you sow the carrots before the rain came?
sentences.zh: 下雨之前你有把紅蘿蔔播下去嗎？

sentences.en: It's best to sow the seeds about an inch deep.
sentences.zh: 種子最好播在大約一英吋深的地方。

gloss_note: sparkle in the sun 在陽光下閃耀

sentences.en: The lake sparkled in the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 湖面在晨光中閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: Her new ring sparkles under the lights.
sentences.zh: 她的新戒指在燈光下閃閃發光。

sentences.en: Why do the stars sparkle at night?
sentences.zh: 為什麼星星在夜裡會閃爍？

sentences.en: I polished the glasses until they sparkled.
sentences.zh: 我把玻璃杯擦到閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: Did you see the sparkle in her eyes?
sentences.zh: 你有看到她眼中閃耀的光彩嗎？

sentences.en: The snow gave the whole street a bright sparkle.
sentences.zh: 雪讓整條街閃著明亮的光。

gloss_note: a heart specialist 心臟專科醫師

sentences.en: My doctor sent me to a heart specialist.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生把我轉介給一位心臟專科醫師。

sentences.en: We need a specialist to fix this network problem.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一位專家來解決這個網路問題。

sentences.en: Is there a specialist in tax law at your firm?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有稅法專家嗎？

sentences.en: He became a specialist in old computers.
sentences.zh: 他成了老式電腦的專家。

sentences.en: How long do I have to wait to see the specialist?
sentences.zh: 我要等多久才能看到那位專科醫師？

sentences.en: The specialist explained the test results in simple words.
sentences.zh: 專科醫師用簡單的話解釋了檢查結果。

gloss_note: area of specialization 專長領域

sentences.en: What is your area of specialization?
sentences.zh: 你的專長領域是什麼？

sentences.en: Her specialization is supply chain management.
sentences.zh: 她的專長領域是供應鏈管理。

sentences.en: Specialization helps a small firm stand out from bigger ones.
sentences.zh: 專精某個領域能幫助小公司在大公司之中脫穎而出。

sentences.en: Does your degree have a specialization in finance?
sentences.zh: 你的學位有財務方面的專長領域嗎？

sentences.en: He chose a specialization in tax law after college.
sentences.zh: 他大學畢業後選擇了稅法作為專長領域。

sentences.en: A narrow specialization can make it harder to change jobs.
sentences.zh: 過窄的專業領域可能讓換工作更困難。

sentences.en: Our shop specializes in used bicycles.
sentences.zh: 我們店專賣二手腳踏車。

sentences.en: What does your company specialize in?
sentences.zh: 你們公司專門做什麼？

sentences.en: She wants to specialize in children's medicine.
sentences.zh: 她想專攻兒童醫學。

sentences.en: Many restaurants here specialize in seafood.
sentences.zh: 這裡有很多餐廳專賣海鮮。

sentences.en: Do you plan to specialize in one subject in college?
sentences.zh: 你打算在大學專攻某一個科目嗎？

sentences.en: I specialized in marketing before I changed careers.
sentences.zh: 我轉換跑道之前是專攻行銷的。

sentences.en: Please specify your size when you place the order.
sentences.zh: 下單時請註明你的尺寸。

sentences.en: Did the contract specify a delivery date?
sentences.zh: 合約有明確規定交貨日期嗎？

sentences.en: You can specify how you want your steak cooked.
sentences.zh: 你可以指定你的牛排要幾分熟。

sentences.en: The recipe doesn't specify what kind of flour to use.
sentences.zh: 食譜沒有明確說明要用哪一種麵粉。

sentences.en: Could you specify which day works best for you?
sentences.zh: 你可以明確說出哪一天對你最方便嗎？

sentences.en: The manual specifies how often to change the filter.
sentences.zh: 說明書規定了濾網要多久更換一次。

gloss_note: a spectacular view 壯觀的景色

sentences.en: The view from the hotel balcony was spectacular.
sentences.zh: 飯店陽台上的景色非常壯觀。

sentences.en: Did you see the spectacular fireworks last night?
sentences.zh: 你有看到昨晚精彩的煙火嗎？

sentences.en: Our sales results this quarter were spectacular.
sentences.zh: 我們這一季的銷售成績非常出色。

sentences.en: The team gave a spectacular presentation to the clients.
sentences.zh: 團隊向客戶做了一場精彩的簡報。

sentences.en: I heard the concert was spectacular. How was it?
sentences.zh: 我聽說那場演唱會很精彩。你覺得怎麼樣？

sentences.en: The canyon is a spectacular sight at sunset.
sentences.zh: 峽谷在日落時的景色非常壯觀。

gloss_note: 指現場看比賽、活動的人

sentences.en: The stadium held over fifty thousand spectators last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚球場容納了五萬多名觀眾。

sentences.en: Were there many spectators at the game on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 週六的比賽有很多觀眾嗎？

sentences.en: As a spectator, I just clapped and cheered from the stands.
sentences.zh: 我只是個觀眾，在看台上拍手加油。

sentences.en: Spectators are not allowed on the field during practice.
sentences.zh: 練習期間，觀眾不可進入場地。

sentences.en: Do you prefer being a player or a spectator?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡當球員，還是當觀眾？

sentences.en: My dad was a quiet spectator at every one of my games.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每場比賽都安靜地在旁邊觀看。

sentences.en: Reporters began to speculate about why the CEO resigned.
sentences.zh: 記者開始猜測執行長為什麼辭職。

sentences.en: I don't want to speculate until we have the facts.
sentences.zh: 在掌握事實之前，我不想隨便臆測。

sentences.en: Can you speculate on what caused the delay?
sentences.zh: 你能推測延誤的原因是什麼嗎？

sentences.en: People online keep speculating about the singer's next album.
sentences.zh: 網友不斷猜測這位歌手的下一張專輯。

sentences.en: Scientists speculated that the ice melted much earlier than expected.
sentences.zh: 科學家推測冰比預期更早就融化了。

sentences.en: Why do experts speculate that prices will drop next year?
sentences.zh: 為什麼專家推測明年物價會下跌？

gloss_note: 常指短線買賣股票、房地產的人

sentences.en: Speculators drove up housing prices in the area last year.
sentences.zh: 去年投機客把這一帶的房價炒高了。

sentences.en: Was he an investor or just a speculator?
sentences.zh: 他是投資人，還是只是個投機客？

sentences.en: The speculator sold all his shares before the market fell.
sentences.zh: 這位投機者在股市下跌前賣光了所有股票。

sentences.en: Why do speculators move in whenever a new rail line is announced?
sentences.zh: 為什麼一宣布新鐵路，投機客就跟著湧入？

sentences.en: My uncle was a land speculator in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在1980年代是土地投機客。

sentences.en: Do you think speculators are to blame for the sudden price jump?
sentences.zh: 你覺得價格暴漲該怪投機客嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor said my spine is perfectly healthy.
sentences.zh: 醫生說我的脊椎完全正常。

sentences.en: Keep your spine straight when you sit at your desk.
sentences.zh: 坐在書桌前要把脊椎挺直。

sentences.en: Does your back hurt near your spine?
sentences.zh: 你的背是靠近脊椎的地方會痛嗎？

sentences.en: A cold shiver ran down my spine during the movie.
sentences.zh: 看電影時，我背脊一陣發涼。

sentences.en: How long has she had pain in her lower spine?
sentences.zh: 她下背部的脊椎痛多久了？

sentences.en: He injured his spine in a skiing accident.
sentences.zh: 他在滑雪意外中傷到了脊椎。

gloss_note: 名詞：電線、繩索、膠片的接合處

sentences.en: The electrician checked the splice where the two wires met.
sentences.zh: 電工檢查了兩條電線相接的接合處。

sentences.en: Can you see the splice in the rope?
sentences.zh: 你看得到繩子上的接合處嗎？

sentences.en: The splice in the old film strip is barely visible.
sentences.zh: 舊膠片上的剪接處幾乎看不出來。

sentences.en: Wrap tape around the splice to keep it dry.
sentences.zh: 在接頭處纏上膠帶，避免受潮。

sentences.en: A weak splice in the cable caused the power outage.
sentences.zh: 電纜上一處不牢的接頭造成了停電。

sentences.en: Do you notice the splice between the two takes?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到兩個鏡頭之間的剪接處嗎？

sentences.en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the counter.
sentences.zh: 用濕海綿把檯面擦一擦。

sentences.en: Did you buy a new sponge for the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 你有買新的廚房海綿嗎？

sentences.en: The sponge soaked up all the spilled juice.
sentences.zh: 海綿把灑出來的果汁全吸乾了。

sentences.en: Could you hand me the sponge by the sink?
sentences.zh: 可以把水槽旁的海綿遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: This sponge is too old and smells bad.
sentences.zh: 這塊海綿太舊了，而且有味道。

sentences.en: My daughter loves squeezing a wet sponge in the bathtub.
sentences.zh: 我女兒喜歡在浴缸裡擠濕海綿。

gloss_note: sponsor an event 贊助活動

sentences.en: A local bank agreed to sponsor our school's soccer team.
sentences.zh: 當地一家銀行同意贊助我們學校的足球隊。

sentences.en: Who is the main sponsor of this year's marathon?
sentences.zh: 今年馬拉松的主要贊助商是誰？

sentences.en: The sponsors will put their logos on the banner.
sentences.zh: 贊助商會把他們的標誌放在布條上。

sentences.en: Would your company sponsor our charity dinner?
sentences.zh: 貴公司願意贊助我們的慈善晚宴嗎？

sentences.en: She finally found a sponsor for her art show.
sentences.zh: 她終於為自己的藝術展找到了贊助者。

sentences.en: We are sponsoring the science fair for the third year.
sentences.zh: 我們已經是第三年贊助這場科展了。

sentences.en: The soccer squad practices every morning before school.
sentences.zh: 足球隊每天早上上課前都會練習。

sentences.en: Who made the varsity squad this year?
sentences.zh: 今年誰入選了校隊？

sentences.en: A rescue squad arrived within ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 救援小隊十分鐘內就趕到了。

sentences.en: Are you on the cheer squad?
sentences.zh: 你是啦啦隊的成員嗎？

sentences.en: Our product squad is working on the new app.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品小組正在開發新的應用程式。

sentences.en: The coach announced a twenty-player squad for the tournament.
sentences.zh: 教練公布了參加錦標賽的二十人名單。

sentences.en: Don't squash the bread when you pack the bags.
sentences.zh: 裝袋子的時候別把麵包壓扁了。

sentences.en: Can we squash one more person into the back seat?
sentences.zh: 後座還能再擠一個人進去嗎？

sentences.en: My sandwich got squashed at the bottom of my backpack.
sentences.zh: 我的三明治被壓扁在背包最底下。

sentences.en: Why did you squash all the boxes into the trunk?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把所有箱子都塞進後車廂？

sentences.en: Five of us squashed into a tiny elevator.
sentences.zh: 我們五個人擠進了一部小電梯。

sentences.en: He squashed the empty can with his foot.
sentences.zh: 他用腳把空罐子踩扁。

sentences.en: He squatted down to tie his little brother's shoes.
sentences.zh: 他蹲下來幫弟弟綁鞋帶。

sentences.en: Can you squat all the way to the floor?
sentences.zh: 你能一路蹲到地板上嗎？

sentences.en: The children squatted by the pond to watch the frogs.
sentences.zh: 孩子們蹲在池塘邊看青蛙。

sentences.en: Squat down so the kids can see you.
sentences.zh: 蹲下來，這樣孩子們才看得到你。

sentences.en: Why is the little boy squatting under the table?
sentences.zh: 那個小男孩為什麼蹲在桌子底下？

sentences.en: When I squat, my knees hurt.
sentences.zh: 我一蹲下去，膝蓋就會痛。

sentences.en: Everyone wants job stability these days.
sentences.zh: 現在大家都想要穩定的工作。

sentences.en: How can we improve the stability of this table?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓這張桌子更穩？

sentences.en: The company's financial stability reassured investors.
sentences.zh: 公司財務穩健，讓投資人放心。

sentences.en: The new law should bring stability to the region.
sentences.zh: 這項新法應該會為該地區帶來穩定。

sentences.en: Is political stability important when you choose where to invest?
sentences.zh: 選擇投資地點時，政局穩定重要嗎？

sentences.en: A wide base gives the tower more stability.
sentences.zh: 寬大的底座讓塔更穩固。

sentences.en: There's a coffee stain on my white shirt.
sentences.zh: 我的白襯衫上有一塊咖啡漬。

sentences.en: Will this stain come out in the wash?
sentences.zh: 這塊汙漬洗得掉嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, red wine can stain the carpet.
sentences.zh: 小心，紅酒會弄髒地毯。

sentences.en: How did you get that grass stain on your jeans?
sentences.zh: 你牛仔褲上的草漬是怎麼弄的？

sentences.en: Juice stained my sleeve during lunch, and I didn't notice.
sentences.zh: 午餐時果汁弄髒了我的袖子，我都沒發現。

sentences.en: She scrubbed the stain for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 她把那塊汙漬刷了十分鐘。

gloss_note: at stake 攸關；a stake in 有利害關係

sentences.en: Our jobs are at stake if this deal fails.
sentences.zh: 如果這筆交易失敗，我們的工作就不保了。

sentences.en: Do you have a stake in the new restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你在這家新餐廳有投資股份嗎？

sentences.en: She sold her stake in the company last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天賣掉了公司的持股。

sentences.en: What's at stake in tomorrow's meeting?
sentences.zh: 明天的會議攸關什麼？

sentences.en: Neighbors have a big stake in how the park is used.
sentences.zh: 公園怎麼使用，和鄰居的利益息息相關。

sentences.en: The investor bought a ten percent stake in the startup.
sentences.zh: 這位投資人買下了新創公司百分之十的股份。

sentences.en: The loud thunder startled the baby.
sentences.zh: 響亮的雷聲嚇了寶寶一跳。

sentences.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意嚇你。

sentences.en: Did the sudden noise startle you too?
sentences.zh: 那陣突然的聲響也嚇到你了嗎？

sentences.en: Deer startle easily when they hear footsteps.
sentences.zh: 鹿一聽到腳步聲就很容易受驚。

sentences.en: She was startled by the phone ringing at midnight.
sentences.zh: 半夜電話鈴響，把她嚇了一跳。

sentences.en: Why does the cat startle every time the door opens?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每次門一開，貓就會嚇一跳？

sentences.en: Grandma's beef stew is perfect on a cold night.
sentences.zh: 奶奶的燉牛肉最適合在寒冷的夜晚吃。

sentences.en: How long should I stew this beef?
sentences.zh: 這塊牛肉要燉多久？

sentences.en: I stewed apples with cinnamon for dessert.
sentences.zh: 我用肉桂燉了蘋果當甜點。

sentences.en: Would you like some stew with your bread?
sentences.zh: 你要不要配麵包來點燉菜？

sentences.en: The stew needs another hour on low heat.
sentences.zh: 這鍋燉菜還需要再用小火燉一個小時。

sentences.en: Let the pork stew slowly until it falls apart.
sentences.zh: 讓豬肉慢慢燉到軟爛。

sentences.en: Games can stimulate children's interest in math.
sentences.zh: 遊戲可以激發孩子對數學的興趣。

sentences.en: The government hopes to stimulate the economy with lower taxes.
sentences.zh: 政府希望用減稅來刺激經濟。

sentences.en: Does coffee stimulate your brain in the morning?
sentences.zh: 咖啡會在早上讓你的腦袋清醒嗎？

sentences.en: Good questions stimulate class discussion.
sentences.zh: 好問題能激發課堂討論。

sentences.en: Bright toys stimulated the baby's curiosity.
sentences.zh: 色彩鮮豔的玩具激發了寶寶的好奇心。

sentences.en: How can we stimulate sales during the slow season?
sentences.zh: 淡季時我們要怎麼刺激買氣？

sentences.en: Your gym bag stinks! Please open the window.
sentences.zh: 你的運動包好臭！請把窗戶打開。

sentences.en: What's that awful stink coming from the fridge?
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡傳出來的那股噁心臭味是什麼？

sentences.en: The garbage began to stink after two days.
sentences.zh: 垃圾放了兩天就開始發臭。

sentences.en: Does the basement still stink after the flood?
sentences.zh: 淹水之後，地下室還是很臭嗎？

sentences.en: The stink of rotten eggs filled the lab.
sentences.zh: 臭蛋的味道瀰漫整間實驗室。

sentences.en: The old fish stank, and we opened every window.
sentences.zh: 那條放太久的魚很臭，我們把所有窗戶都打開了。

sentences.en: The analyst built a stochastic model to predict price changes.
sentences.zh: 分析師建立了隨機模型來預測價格變化。

sentences.en: Is the stock market really a stochastic process?
sentences.zh: 股市真的是隨機過程嗎？

sentences.en: Stochastic models help banks measure uncertain risks.
sentences.zh: 隨機模型能幫銀行衡量不確定的風險。

sentences.en: Why did you choose a stochastic approach for this forecast?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼選用隨機方法來做這次預測？

sentences.en: Our team ran a stochastic simulation of next year's cash flow.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊對明年的現金流做了隨機模擬。

sentences.en: These daily price swings seem stochastic, don't they?
sentences.zh: 這些每天的價格波動看起來是隨機的，不是嗎？

gloss_note: in stock 有現貨；out of stock 缺貨

sentences.en: Sorry, that size is out of stock.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，那個尺寸缺貨了。

sentences.en: Do you have this jacket in stock?
sentences.zh: 這件外套有現貨嗎？

sentences.en: We need to check our stock before the sale.
sentences.zh: 特賣前我們得先清點庫存。

sentences.en: The store keeps a large stock of winter coats.
sentences.zh: 這家店備有大量的冬季外套庫存。

sentences.en: How much stock is left in the warehouse?
sentences.zh: 倉庫裡還剩多少庫存？

sentences.en: Fresh stock arrives every Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 新貨每週二早上會到。

sentences.en: Our apartment has very little storage space.
sentences.zh: 我們的公寓幾乎沒有收納空間。

sentences.en: Is there enough storage on your phone for these photos?
sentences.zh: 你的手機有足夠空間存這些照片嗎？

sentences.en: We put the Christmas decorations in storage.
sentences.zh: 我們把聖誕裝飾收進儲藏室了。

sentences.en: The warehouse offers cheap cold storage for fruit.
sentences.zh: 這間倉庫提供便宜的水果冷藏服務。

sentences.en: Where's the storage room for office supplies?
sentences.zh: 辦公用品的儲藏室在哪裡？

sentences.en: Cloud storage lets me open my files anywhere.
sentences.zh: 有了雲端儲存，我在哪裡都能開啟檔案。

sentences.en: Please straighten your tie before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前請把領帶拉直。

sentences.en: Can you straighten up your room before dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐前你可以先把房間整理好嗎？

sentences.en: She straightened her back and took a deep breath.
sentences.zh: 她挺直背脊，深吸了一口氣。

sentences.en: Did the plumber straighten the bent pipe?
sentences.zh: 水管工有把彎掉的水管弄直嗎？

sentences.en: He straightened the pictures on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他把牆上的畫框扶正。

sentences.en: Let's straighten up the house before guests arrive.
sentences.zh: 客人來之前我們先把家裡整理一下吧。

gloss_note: strain a muscle 拉傷肌肉

sentences.en: I strained my back moving the couch.
sentences.zh: 我搬沙發時拉傷了背。

sentences.en: Did you strain your wrist playing tennis?
sentences.zh: 你打網球時手腕拉傷了嗎？

sentences.en: The extra work put a lot of strain on the team.
sentences.zh: 額外的工作讓團隊承受很大的壓力。

sentences.en: Raising three kids puts a strain on their budget.
sentences.zh: 養三個孩子讓他們的預算吃緊。

sentences.en: Stretch first so you don't strain a muscle.
sentences.zh: 先伸展一下，才不會拉傷肌肉。

sentences.en: How much strain can this old bridge take?
sentences.zh: 這座老橋能承受多大的負荷？

sentences.en: The strap on my bag just broke.
sentences.zh: 我包包的帶子剛剛斷了。

sentences.en: Can you strap the box to the back of the bike?
sentences.zh: 你可以把箱子綁在腳踏車後面嗎？

sentences.en: She strapped her son into the car seat.
sentences.zh: 她把兒子固定在汽車安全座椅上。

sentences.en: Is this strap long enough for your shoulder?
sentences.zh: 這條帶子夠長，可以背在你肩上嗎？

sentences.en: I'll strap the tent to my backpack.
sentences.zh: 我會把帳篷綁在背包上。

sentences.en: Pull the strap tight so the helmet stays on.
sentences.zh: 把帶子拉緊，安全帽才不會掉。

sentences.en: Engineers found structural damage in the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 工程師發現這座舊橋有結構損壞。

sentences.en: Is this wall structural, or can we remove it?
sentences.zh: 這面牆是承重結構，還是可以拆掉？

sentences.en: The company announced structural changes to its sales team.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布調整業務團隊的組織結構。

sentences.en: Did the inspector find any structural problems?
sentences.zh: 檢查員有發現任何結構上的問題嗎？

sentences.en: Structural reforms may take years to show results.
sentences.zh: 結構性改革可能要好幾年才會見效。

sentences.en: Please don't cut that beam; it's structural.
sentences.zh: 請不要切那根樑，它是結構用的。

sentences.en: I stumbled on the stairs and dropped my coffee.
sentences.zh: 我在樓梯上絆了一下，把咖啡打翻了。

sentences.en: Did you stumble over the cord again?
sentences.zh: 你又被電線絆到了嗎？

sentences.en: The runner stumbled near the finish line.
sentences.zh: 那名跑者在終點線附近踉蹌了一下。

sentences.en: A small stumble cost her the race.
sentences.zh: 一次小小的踉蹌讓她輸掉了比賽。

sentences.en: Why do I always stumble on this icy sidewalk?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我在這條結冰的人行道上老是絆倒？

sentences.en: Watch your step, or you'll stumble in the dark.
sentences.zh: 小心腳下，不然你會在黑暗中跌跌撞撞。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: This sturdy table can hold all of our books.
sentences.zh: 這張堅固的桌子可以放下我們所有的書。

sentences.en: Is the ladder sturdy enough for me to climb?
sentences.zh: 這把梯子夠結實讓我爬嗎？

sentences.en: She bought sturdy boots for the long hike.
sentences.zh: 她為了長程健行買了一雙結實的靴子。

sentences.en: The bridge looks old, but it's quite sturdy.
sentences.zh: 這座橋看起來很舊，但相當堅固。

sentences.en: Where can I find a sturdy box for these books?
sentences.zh: 我去哪裡可以找到裝這些書的結實紙箱？

sentences.en: The little boy has sturdy legs and loves to run.
sentences.zh: 那個小男孩的腿很結實，愛到處跑。

gloss_note: submit a report 提交報告

sentences.en: Please submit your report by noon on Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五中午前提交你的報告。

sentences.en: Did you submit the form online?
sentences.zh: 你有在網路上繳交表格嗎？

sentences.en: I submitted my application last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚已經送出申請了。

sentences.en: When do I need to submit my expense report?
sentences.zh: 我的費用報告什麼時候要交？

sentences.en: Our team will submit the proposal tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊明天早上會提交提案。

sentences.en: Students must submit their essays before the class ends.
sentences.zh: 學生必須在下課前交出作文。

sentences.en: Please read subsection two before you sign the contract.
sentences.zh: 簽約之前請先讀第二小節。

sentences.en: Which subsection covers late payment fees?
sentences.zh: 哪一個小節規範了逾期付款的費用？

sentences.en: The lawyer pointed to a subsection about refunds.
sentences.zh: 律師指著一個關於退款的小節。

sentences.en: Each subsection of the report has its own summary.
sentences.zh: 報告的每個小節都有各自的摘要。

sentences.en: Is this rule listed under a different subsection?
sentences.zh: 這條規定是列在別的小節底下嗎？

sentences.en: I added a new subsection to the safety policy.
sentences.zh: 我在安全政策裡新增了一個小節。

sentences.en: Subsequent reports showed that the first story was wrong.
sentences.zh: 後來的報導顯示第一則消息是錯的。

sentences.en: What happened in the subsequent meeting?
sentences.zh: 後來的那場會議發生了什麼事？

sentences.en: The first test was easy, but subsequent ones were harder.
sentences.zh: 第一次測驗很簡單，但後面幾次就難多了。

sentences.en: Please email me any subsequent questions.
sentences.zh: 之後如果還有問題，請寄電子郵件給我。

sentences.en: Did the subsequent changes improve sales?
sentences.zh: 後續的調整有讓銷售變好嗎？

sentences.en: Subsequent visits to the clinic went much smoother.
sentences.zh: 之後幾次去診所都順利多了。
