sentences.en: She earned a substantial amount of money last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年賺了一大筆錢。

sentences.en: Is there a substantial difference between the two phones?
sentences.zh: 這兩支手機有很大的差別嗎？

sentences.en: The city made substantial progress on the new library.
sentences.zh: 市政府在新圖書館的工程上有可觀的進展。

sentences.en: We saw a substantial increase in online orders.
sentences.zh: 我們的網路訂單大幅增加。

sentences.en: Do you expect substantial changes in the next version?
sentences.zh: 你預期下一個版本會有大幅度的改變嗎？

sentences.en: He left a substantial tip for the waiter.
sentences.zh: 他給了服務生一筆可觀的小費。

gloss_note: substitute A for B 用A代替B

sentences.en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
sentences.zh: 這道食譜裡，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

sentences.en: Is there a good substitute for butter?
sentences.zh: 有沒有什麼東西可以代替奶油？

sentences.en: Nothing can substitute for real experience.
sentences.zh: 沒有什麼可以取代實際的經驗。

sentences.en: Can I substitute brown rice for white rice?
sentences.zh: 我可以把白飯換成糙米飯嗎？

sentences.en: Our team needs someone to substitute for Maria next week.
sentences.zh: 下週我們團隊需要有人代替瑪麗亞。

sentences.en: This cheap cheese is a poor substitute for the real thing.
sentences.zh: 這種便宜的起司根本比不上真正的起司。

sentences.en: They moved to a quiet suburban neighborhood last year.
sentences.zh: 他們去年搬到一個安靜的郊區社區。

sentences.en: Is the suburban mall busier than the one downtown?
sentences.zh: 郊區的購物中心比市中心那間更擠嗎？

sentences.en: Our suburban school has a great soccer field.
sentences.zh: 我們郊區的學校有一座很棒的足球場。

sentences.en: Suburban families often need two cars.
sentences.zh: 郊區的家庭常常需要兩輛車。

sentences.en: Do you like suburban life, or do you miss the city?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡郊區的生活，還是懷念城市？

sentences.en: She grew up in a suburban town near a big city.
sentences.zh: 她在大城市附近的郊區小鎮長大。

sentences.en: The board is working on a CEO succession plan.
sentences.zh: 董事會正在擬定執行長的接班計畫。

sentences.en: Has the company announced a succession plan yet?
sentences.zh: 公司已經公布接班計畫了嗎？

sentences.en: Careful succession planning keeps a family business strong.
sentences.zh: 審慎規畫接班，能讓家族企業保持穩健。

sentences.en: The founder's retirement raised questions about succession.
sentences.zh: 創辦人退休引發了關於接班的疑問。

sentences.en: Why is succession such a big issue for small family firms?
sentences.zh: 為什麼接班對小型家族企業是這麼大的問題？

sentences.en: My manager asked me to help with succession planning.
sentences.zh: 我的主管請我協助規畫接班事宜。

gloss_note: three successive years 連續三年

sentences.en: The team lost four successive games.
sentences.zh: 這支球隊連輸了四場比賽。

sentences.en: Sales have grown for five successive quarters.
sentences.zh: 銷售額已連續五季成長。

sentences.en: Why did it rain on three successive weekends?
sentences.zh: 為什麼連續三個週末都在下雨？

sentences.en: She got a raise in two successive years.
sentences.zh: 她連續兩年都加薪了。

sentences.en: Has the stock fallen for six successive days?
sentences.zh: 這檔股票是不是已經連跌六天了？

sentences.en: Our company posted record profits for the third successive year.
sentences.zh: 我們公司連續第三年創下獲利新高。

gloss_note: a superb meal 絕佳的一餐

sentences.en: The chef prepared a superb dinner for us.
sentences.zh: 主廚為我們準備了一頓絕佳的晚餐。

sentences.en: Everyone said your presentation was superb.
sentences.zh: 大家都說你的簡報棒極了。

sentences.en: Was the hotel service really that superb?
sentences.zh: 那間飯店的服務真的有那麼好嗎？

sentences.en: She gave a superb performance in the school play.
sentences.zh: 她在學校的話劇中演出精湛。

sentences.en: The view from our room was simply superb.
sentences.zh: 從我們房間看出去的景色簡直太棒了。

sentences.en: How did you get such superb seats?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼搶到這麼棒的座位的？

sentences.en: Some people think thirteen is unlucky, but that's just superstition.
sentences.zh: 有些人覺得十三是不吉利的數字，但那只是迷信。

sentences.en: Do you believe in any superstitions?
sentences.zh: 你相信任何迷信的說法嗎？

sentences.en: It's a superstition that a broken mirror brings bad luck.
sentences.zh: 打破鏡子會帶來厄運，這是一種迷信。

sentences.en: My grandmother has a superstition about whistling at night.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶有個迷信，說晚上不能吹口哨。

sentences.en: Is it just superstition, or does knocking on wood really help?
sentences.zh: 那只是迷信，還是敲木頭真的有用？

sentences.en: Many athletes follow a superstition before big games.
sentences.zh: 許多運動員在重要比賽前會遵守某種迷信習慣。

sentences.en: She was promoted to a supervisory position last month.
sentences.zh: 她上個月升任了管理職。

sentences.en: Does this job include supervisory duties?
sentences.zh: 這份工作包含管理職責嗎？

sentences.en: A supervisory board reviews the company's major decisions.
sentences.zh: 監督委員會會審查公司的重大決策。

sentences.en: I'd like a supervisory role, but I lack experience.
sentences.zh: 我想擔任管理職，但缺乏經驗。

sentences.en: Who handles supervisory tasks when the manager is away?
sentences.zh: 經理不在的時候，誰負責管理工作？

sentences.en: The supervisory staff meets every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 管理人員每週一早上開會。

sentences.en: Surveillance cameras cover every entrance of the building.
sentences.zh: 監視器涵蓋了大樓的每個出入口。

sentences.en: Is the parking lot under surveillance at night?
sentences.zh: 停車場晚上有受到監控嗎？

sentences.en: Police used surveillance video to identify the driver.
sentences.zh: 警方用監視器影片辨認出駕駛。

sentences.en: The store increased surveillance after several thefts.
sentences.zh: 發生幾起竊案後，這家店加強了監控。

sentences.en: Why do airports need so much surveillance?
sentences.zh: 為什麼機場需要這麼多監控？

sentences.en: Our company posted a notice about video surveillance.
sentences.zh: 我們公司貼出了關於影像監控的公告。

sentences.en: The airline suspended all flights because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 航空公司因暴風雨暫停了所有航班。

sentences.en: Why did the school suspend him for a week?
sentences.zh: 學校為什麼讓他停學一週？

sentences.en: The company will suspend its hiring until spring.
sentences.zh: 公司將暫停招募，直到春天。

sentences.en: Can I suspend my gym membership for a month?
sentences.zh: 我可以把健身房會員資格暫停一個月嗎？

sentences.en: Two players were suspended for fighting during the game.
sentences.zh: 兩名球員因比賽中打架而被禁賽。

sentences.en: Did the city suspend bus service during the snow?
sentences.zh: 下雪期間，市政府有暫停公車服務嗎？

sentences.en: Can the company sustain this rate of growth?
sentences.zh: 公司能維持這樣的成長速度嗎？

sentences.en: She couldn't sustain her energy through the whole race.
sentences.zh: 她沒辦法在整場比賽中維持體力。

sentences.en: A balanced diet helps sustain your energy all day.
sentences.zh: 均衡飲食有助於一整天維持精力。

sentences.en: How long can the team sustain this pace?
sentences.zh: 這個團隊能維持這種步調多久？

sentences.en: Farmers need rain to sustain their crops.
sentences.zh: 農夫需要雨水來讓作物持續生長。

sentences.en: It's hard to sustain interest in a long, boring lecture.
sentences.zh: 在冗長乏味的課堂上，很難一直保持興趣。

sentences.en: Our company released a new sustainability report this year.
sentences.zh: 我們公司今年發布了新的永續報告。

sentences.en: Is sustainability a priority for your team?
sentences.zh: 永續發展是你們團隊的優先事項嗎？

sentences.en: Sustainability matters when we choose suppliers.
sentences.zh: 我們挑選供應商時，永續性很重要。

sentences.en: She runs the sustainability team at a local retailer.
sentences.zh: 她帶領當地一家零售商的永續發展團隊。

sentences.en: How can small businesses improve sustainability on a budget?
sentences.zh: 小型企業要怎麼在預算有限下提升永續性？

sentences.en: Customers now care about the sustainability of what they buy.
sentences.zh: 顧客現在很在意所買商品的永續性。

sentences.en: The team responded swiftly, didn't they?
sentences.zh: 團隊反應很迅速，不是嗎？

sentences.en: The manager acted swiftly to fix the error.
sentences.zh: 經理迅速採取行動修正錯誤。

sentences.en: News of the merger spread swiftly through the office.
sentences.zh: 合併的消息在辦公室裡迅速傳開。

sentences.en: She swiftly closed her laptop and left the room.
sentences.zh: 她迅速闔上筆電，離開了房間。

sentences.en: Did the airline handle the complaint swiftly?
sentences.zh: 航空公司有迅速處理這項客訴嗎？

sentences.en: We should move swiftly on this order, shouldn't we?
sentences.zh: 這筆訂單我們該趕快處理，不是嗎？

gloss_note: switch A for B 把A換成B

sentences.en: Can I switch the fries for a salad?
sentences.zh: 我可以把薯條換成沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: She switched her order to the chicken sandwich.
sentences.zh: 她把餐點改成了雞肉三明治。

sentences.en: Could we switch to a table by the window?
sentences.zh: 我們可以換到靠窗的位子嗎？

sentences.en: I switched from soda to water at dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐時我把汽水換成了水。

sentences.en: Do you mind if I switch my steak for the fish?
sentences.zh: 我把牛排換成魚，可以嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter switched our plates by mistake.
sentences.zh: 服務生不小心把我們的盤子弄反了。

sentences.en: The professor handed out the syllabus on the first day.
sentences.zh: 教授在第一天發了課程大綱。

sentences.en: Is the final exam listed in the syllabus?
sentences.zh: 期末考有列在課程大綱裡嗎？

sentences.en: According to the syllabus, the paper is due in March.
sentences.zh: 依照課程大綱，報告三月要交。

sentences.en: Where can I download the syllabus for this course?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以下載這門課的大綱？

sentences.en: The syllabus covers modern history from 1900 to 2000.
sentences.zh: 課程大綱涵蓋了1900年到2000年的近代史。

sentences.en: Did you read the syllabus before you signed up?
sentences.zh: 你報名之前有看課程大綱嗎？

sentences.en: A sore throat is often the first symptom of a cold.
sentences.zh: 喉嚨痛通常是感冒的第一個症狀。

sentences.en: Do you have any other symptoms besides the cough?
sentences.zh: 除了咳嗽，你還有其他症狀嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor asked me to describe my symptoms.
sentences.zh: 醫生請我描述我的症狀。

sentences.en: Her symptoms disappeared after a few days.
sentences.zh: 她的症狀幾天後就消失了。

sentences.en: What symptom made you call the clinic?
sentences.zh: 是什麼症狀讓你打電話給診所？

sentences.en: Fever is a common symptom of the flu.
sentences.zh: 發燒是流感常見的症狀。

sentences.en: A syndicate of banks lent the company two billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 一個銀行團借給這家公司二十億美元。

sentences.en: Which syndicate is behind the new stadium project?
sentences.zh: 是哪個財團在支持新球場的計畫？

sentences.en: A media syndicate sells the columnist's articles to many papers.
sentences.zh: 一家聯合媒體機構把這位專欄作家的文章賣給許多報社。

sentences.en: The investors formed a syndicate to buy the hotel.
sentences.zh: 投資人組成了一個財團來買下這間飯店。

sentences.en: Is that syndicate still looking for a new partner?
sentences.zh: 那個財團還在找新的夥伴嗎？

sentences.en: The syndicate agreed to share the risk equally.
sentences.zh: 這個聯合組織同意平均分擔風險。

sentences.en: The merger should create real synergy between the two teams.
sentences.zh: 這次合併應該能在兩個團隊間創造真正的綜效。

sentences.en: Do you see any synergy between marketing and sales?
sentences.zh: 你覺得行銷和業務之間有任何綜效嗎？

sentences.en: There was great synergy in our team's brainstorming session.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊的腦力激盪會議產生了很好的協同效應。

sentences.en: The companies hope to find synergy in their supply chains.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司希望在供應鏈上找到綜效。

sentences.en: How do we get the most synergy out of this partnership?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼從這次合作中發揮最大的綜效？

sentences.en: Without synergy, the two departments just repeat each other's work.
sentences.zh: 沒有綜效的話，這兩個部門只會重複彼此的工作。

sentences.en: This jacket is made of synthetic fabric.
sentences.zh: 這件外套是合成纖維做的。

sentences.en: Is the sweater natural wool or synthetic?
sentences.zh: 這件毛衣是天然羊毛還是合成的？

sentences.en: Synthetic rubber is cheaper than natural rubber.
sentences.zh: 合成橡膠比天然橡膠便宜。

sentences.en: Scientists created a synthetic version of the drug.
sentences.zh: 科學家製造出這種藥物的合成版本。

sentences.en: Does the synthetic leather feel like the real thing?
sentences.zh: 這種人造皮摸起來像真皮嗎？

sentences.en: Our factory switched to synthetic materials to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 我們工廠改用合成材料來降低成本。

gloss_note: tackle a problem 處理問題

sentences.en: We need to tackle this problem before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我們得在期限前解決這個問題。

sentences.en: How should we tackle the budget issue?
sentences.zh: 我們該怎麼處理預算問題？

sentences.en: She tackled the pile of emails first thing.
sentences.zh: 她一早就先著手處理那一大堆電子郵件。

sentences.en: Which project do you want to tackle next?
sentences.zh: 你接下來想著手處理哪個專案？

sentences.en: The city is tackling traffic with a new plan.
sentences.zh: 市政府正以新計畫來處理交通問題。

sentences.en: Let's tackle the dishes together after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們一起來洗碗吧。

gloss_note: tactical move 策略性的一步

sentences.en: Moving the launch to May was a smart tactical decision.
sentences.zh: 把上市時間挪到五月，是個聰明的策略決定。

sentences.en: Is this a tactical move or part of the long-term plan?
sentences.zh: 這是策略性的一步，還是長期計畫的一部分？

sentences.en: The coach made a tactical change at halftime.
sentences.zh: 教練在中場休息時做了戰術調整。

sentences.en: We need a tactical approach to win back those customers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要有策略的做法，才能把那些客戶爭取回來。

sentences.en: Did the team discuss any tactical options during the meeting?
sentences.zh: 團隊在會議中有討論任何策略上的選項嗎？

sentences.en: Her tactical thinking helped us beat the competition.
sentences.zh: 她的策略思考幫助我們擊敗了競爭對手。

gloss_note: 常說 get tangled up 纏住

sentences.en: My headphone cords always tangle in my bag.
sentences.zh: 我的耳機線放在包包裡總是會纏在一起。

sentences.en: Why do these necklaces tangle every time I travel?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每次旅行這些項鍊都會纏在一起？

sentences.en: Can you help me get this tangle out of my hair?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把頭髮上這團打結弄開嗎？

sentences.en: The kitten got tangled up in the yarn.
sentences.zh: 小貓被毛線纏住了。

sentences.en: There was a huge tangle of wires behind the desk.
sentences.zh: 書桌後面有一大團糾結的電線。

sentences.en: Her long hair tangles easily in the wind.
sentences.zh: 她的長髮在風中很容易打結。

gloss_note: 比 bar 老派，常見於小鎮

sentences.en: We stopped at a small tavern for burgers and fries.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家小酒館停下來吃漢堡和薯條。

sentences.en: Is there a tavern near the hotel that serves dinner?
sentences.zh: 飯店附近有供應晚餐的酒館嗎？

sentences.en: The old tavern on Main Street has been there since 1920.
sentences.zh: 主街上那間老酒館從1920年就在那裡了。

sentences.en: Does the tavern take reservations for large groups?
sentences.zh: 這間酒館大團體可以訂位嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle owns a tavern with live music on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔開了一間酒館，週五有現場音樂。

sentences.en: The tavern was so crowded that we waited outside.
sentences.zh: 那間酒館太擠，我們只好在外面等。

gloss_note: sales tax 銷售稅，標價通常未含

sentences.en: Is tax included in the price on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的價格有含稅嗎？

sentences.en: The total is $24 before tax and tip.
sentences.zh: 未加稅金和小費前，總共是24美元。

sentences.en: Sales tax here is about eight percent.
sentences.zh: 這裡的銷售稅大約是百分之八。

sentences.en: How much tax did they charge on that sandwich?
sentences.zh: 他們對那個三明治收了多少稅？

sentences.en: The price on the tag doesn't include tax.
sentences.zh: 標價不含稅。

sentences.en: Our server said the tax is already on the bill.
sentences.zh: 我們的服務生說稅已經算在帳單上了。

gloss_note: 常放句首，後面常接 but

sentences.en: Technically, we're still open until nine on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 嚴格來說，我們週日還是營業到九點。

sentences.en: She works part-time, so technically she isn't staff, right?
sentences.zh: 她是兼職，所以嚴格來說不算正職員工，對吧？

sentences.en: You can technically return it within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 嚴格來說，你可以在三十天內退貨。

sentences.en: We technically finished the project, but it needs testing.
sentences.zh: 嚴格來說我們完成了這個專案，但還需要測試。

sentences.en: It's technically legal to park here, but would you risk it?
sentences.zh: 在這裡停車嚴格來說是合法的，但你敢冒這個險嗎？

sentences.en: Technically speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
sentences.zh: 嚴格來說，番茄是水果。

gloss_note: 可搭 email template 郵件範本

sentences.en: Can you send me the template for the monthly report?
sentences.zh: 你可以把月報的範本寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: Use this template for all your client emails.
sentences.zh: 所有給客戶的電子郵件都用這個範本。

sentences.en: I downloaded a free resume template from the website.
sentences.zh: 我從網站下載了一個免費的履歷範本。

sentences.en: Do we have a template for meeting notes?
sentences.zh: 我們有會議記錄的範本嗎？

sentences.en: She saved the invoice as a template for next time.
sentences.zh: 她把請款單存成範本，下次可以用。

sentences.en: The template keeps every slide looking the same.
sentences.zh: 這個範本讓每張投影片看起來都一致。

sentences.en: I couldn't resist the temptation to eat another cookie.
sentences.zh: 我抵擋不了再吃一片餅乾的誘惑。

sentences.en: Is it hard to avoid temptation when sweets are everywhere?
sentences.zh: 甜點到處都是的時候，很難抵抗誘惑嗎？

sentences.en: Her phone is a constant temptation during study time.
sentences.zh: 讀書時，她的手機一直是個誘惑。

sentences.en: Do you ever give in to temptation and shop online late at night?
sentences.zh: 你會不會敵不過誘惑，半夜上網購物？

sentences.en: Temptation was everywhere in the candy store.
sentences.zh: 糖果店裡到處都是誘惑。

sentences.en: He kept his phone in the car to avoid the temptation.
sentences.zh: 他把手機放在車上，避開那個誘惑。

gloss_note: 正式用語；大學的終身職另有意思

sentences.en: During her tenure, the company's sales doubled.
sentences.zh: 在她任內，公司的業績成長了一倍。

sentences.en: How long was his tenure as department head?
sentences.zh: 他擔任部門主管的任期有多久？

sentences.en: My tenure at this company will end next June.
sentences.zh: 我在這間公司的任期到明年六月結束。

sentences.en: Did the board extend the CEO's tenure for two more years?
sentences.zh: 董事會把執行長的任期又延長了兩年嗎？

sentences.en: Staff with long tenure receive extra vacation days.
sentences.zh: 在職時間長的員工有額外的休假天數。

sentences.en: The mayor's tenure was marked by steady growth.
sentences.zh: 市長任內的特色是穩定成長。

gloss_note: 常用 terribly sorry 非常抱歉

sentences.en: I'm terribly sorry for the delay.
sentences.zh: 非常抱歉延誤了。

sentences.en: Are you terribly busy this afternoon, or can we talk?
sentences.zh: 你今天下午是不是非常忙，還是我們可以聊一下？

sentences.en: He was terribly embarrassed by the mistake.
sentences.zh: 他對那個錯誤感到非常尷尬。

sentences.en: Is it terribly urgent, or can it wait until Monday?
sentences.zh: 這事非常緊急嗎，還是可以等到週一？

sentences.en: She wasn't terribly surprised by the news.
sentences.zh: 她對這個消息並不是非常驚訝。

sentences.en: Is something terribly wrong with the printer?
sentences.zh: 印表機是不是出了什麼大問題？

gloss_note: 受詞常是人；被動 be terrified

sentences.en: Thunder used to terrify my little brother.
sentences.zh: 打雷以前會把我弟弟嚇壞。

sentences.en: Does public speaking terrify you as much as it does me?
sentences.zh: 公開演講會讓你像我一樣害怕嗎？

sentences.en: The scary movie terrified the kids.
sentences.zh: 那部恐怖片把孩子們嚇壞了。

sentences.en: Heights terrify her, so she never takes the glass elevator.
sentences.zh: 她怕高，所以從不搭玻璃電梯。

sentences.en: Why does the idea of flying terrify so many people?
sentences.zh: 為什麼搭飛機的想法會讓這麼多人害怕？

sentences.en: I was terrified when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 燈熄滅的時候，我嚇壞了。

gloss_note: testify in court 出庭作證

sentences.en: The witness will testify in court tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 證人明天早上會在法庭作證。

sentences.en: Will you be asked to testify at the hearing?
sentences.zh: 你會被要求在聽證會上作證嗎？

sentences.en: She testified that she saw the car leave at noon.
sentences.zh: 她作證說她看到那輛車中午離開。

sentences.en: Did the manager testify before the committee last week?
sentences.zh: 經理上週有在委員會面前作證嗎？

sentences.en: In the movie, a young clerk must testify against his boss.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一名年輕店員必須出庭指證他的老闆。

sentences.en: Experts testified for two hours about the bridge design.
sentences.zh: 專家們就橋梁設計作證了兩個小時。

sentences.en: Her testimony helped the jury understand what happened.
sentences.zh: 她的證詞幫助陪審團了解事情的經過。

sentences.en: Was his testimony consistent with the video?
sentences.zh: 他的證詞和影片內容一致嗎？

sentences.en: The witness gave her testimony in a calm voice.
sentences.zh: 證人用平靜的聲音提出證詞。

sentences.en: How long did the expert's testimony last?
sentences.zh: 專家的證詞持續了多久？

sentences.en: The judge asked him to repeat his testimony.
sentences.zh: 法官要他重述一次證詞。

sentences.en: Written testimony must be submitted before the hearing.
sentences.zh: 書面證詞必須在聽證會前提交。

sentences.en: I love the creamy texture of this soup.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這碗湯滑順的口感。

sentences.en: Is the fabric soft, or does it have a rough texture?
sentences.zh: 這布料是柔軟的，還是質地粗糙？

sentences.en: The cake has a light, fluffy texture.
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕的口感輕盈蓬鬆。

sentences.en: Do you like the texture of this sweater?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡這件毛衣的質感嗎？

sentences.en: The mushrooms have a chewy texture that kids dislike.
sentences.zh: 這些香菇有嚼勁的口感，孩子不喜歡。

sentences.en: The soil's texture changes after a heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 大雨過後，土壤的質地會改變。

sentences.en: She is studying theology at a small college.
sentences.zh: 她在一所小型學院讀神學。

sentences.en: Does your school offer any courses in theology?
sentences.zh: 你們學校有開神學相關的課嗎？

sentences.en: My professor wrote a book on the history of theology.
sentences.zh: 我的教授寫了一本關於神學史的書。

sentences.en: Theology is one of the oldest subjects taught at universities.
sentences.zh: 神學是大學裡最古老的科目之一。

sentences.en: Why did he switch from theology to philosophy?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼從神學轉去讀哲學？

sentences.en: The library has a whole floor of theology books.
sentences.zh: 圖書館有整整一層樓的神學書籍。

sentences.en: This class focuses on theoretical physics, not experiments.
sentences.zh: 這堂課著重在理論物理，而不是實驗。

sentences.en: Is the risk only theoretical, or could it really happen?
sentences.zh: 這風險只是理論上的，還是真的可能發生？

sentences.en: In theoretical terms, the plan should work.
sentences.zh: 從理論上來說，這個計畫應該行得通。

sentences.en: Her theoretical knowledge is strong, but she lacks experience.
sentences.zh: 她的理論知識很扎實，但缺乏經驗。

sentences.en: Do we have a theoretical model to explain these results?
sentences.zh: 我們有理論模型可以解釋這些結果嗎？

sentences.en: That's a theoretical possibility, but it's very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 那在理論上有可能，但可能性很低。

gloss_note: 常見 physical therapist 物理治療師

sentences.en: My physical therapist showed me some new exercises.
sentences.zh: 我的物理治療師教了我一些新的運動。

sentences.en: Do you know a good therapist near downtown?
sentences.zh: 你知道市中心附近有不錯的治療師嗎？

sentences.en: The therapist told him to rest his knee for a week.
sentences.zh: 治療師要他讓膝蓋休息一週。

sentences.en: Is your therapist covered by your insurance plan?
sentences.zh: 你的治療師有包含在你的保險方案裡嗎？

sentences.en: She trained for six years to become a speech therapist.
sentences.zh: 她訓練了六年，成為語言治療師。

sentences.en: The therapist keeps a calm, friendly tone with every patient.
sentences.zh: 治療師對每位病人都保持平靜友善的語氣。

sentences.en: He goes to physical therapy twice a week.
sentences.zh: 他每週去做兩次物理治療。

sentences.en: How long will the therapy last?
sentences.zh: 這個療程會持續多久？

sentences.en: Therapy helped her handle stress at work.
sentences.zh: 治療幫助她應付工作壓力。

sentences.en: Does your insurance cover therapy for back pain?
sentences.zh: 你的保險有給付背痛的治療嗎？

sentences.en: Music therapy is used in some hospitals.
sentences.zh: 有些醫院會採用音樂治療。

sentences.en: The new therapy reduced his pain within weeks.
sentences.zh: 新的療法在幾週內就減輕了他的疼痛。

sentences.en: He retired in 2010 and moved away thereafter, right?
sentences.zh: 他2010年退休，之後就搬走了，對吧？

sentences.en: The store opened in May, and sales grew steadily thereafter.
sentences.zh: 商店五月開幕，此後業績穩定成長。

sentences.en: She joined the firm in 2015 and was promoted soon thereafter.
sentences.zh: 她2015年進公司，不久之後就升職了。

sentences.en: Rent is due on May 1 and on the first of every month thereafter, right?
sentences.zh: 房租五月一日要繳，之後每個月一號也要繳，對嗎？

sentences.en: The rain stopped at noon, and the sun came out shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 中午雨停了，不久後太陽就出來了。

sentences.en: The class ended at noon, and thereafter we ate lunch together.
sentences.zh: 下課時間是中午，之後我們一起吃了午餐。

sentences.en: I pulled a muscle in my thigh while running.
sentences.zh: 我跑步時拉傷了大腿肌肉。

sentences.en: Do you prefer chicken thighs or chicken breasts?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡雞腿肉還是雞胸肉？

sentences.en: My thigh still hurts from yesterday's long hike.
sentences.zh: 我的大腿因為昨天的長程健行還在痛。

sentences.en: Does squatting make your thighs sore the next day?
sentences.zh: 深蹲會讓你隔天大腿痠痛嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor checked the bruise on his thigh.
sentences.zh: 醫生檢查了他大腿上的瘀青。

sentences.en: Season the chicken thighs with salt before baking.
sentences.zh: 烤之前先用鹽幫雞腿肉調味。

sentences.en: Skiing down a big hill is a real thrill.
sentences.zh: 從大山坡滑雪而下真的很刺激。

sentences.en: The news thrilled everyone on the team.
sentences.zh: 這個消息讓全隊的人都很興奮。

sentences.en: Did you feel the thrill when the crowd cheered?
sentences.zh: 觀眾歡呼的時候，你有感受到那股興奮嗎？

sentences.en: She still gets a thrill from seeing her name in print.
sentences.zh: 她看到自己的名字印出來，還是會很興奮。

sentences.en: Does a roller coaster thrill you or scare you?
sentences.zh: 雲霄飛車會讓你興奮還是害怕？

sentences.en: I'm thrilled that you can come to the party.
sentences.zh: 你能來參加派對，我好開心。

sentences.en: Let's watch a thriller on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 我們週五晚上來看部驚悚片吧。

sentences.en: Have you read the new thriller by that author?
sentences.zh: 你讀過那位作者的新驚悚小說嗎？

sentences.en: This thriller kept me awake until two in the morning.
sentences.zh: 這本驚悚小說讓我熬夜到凌晨兩點。

sentences.en: Is the movie a comedy or a thriller?
sentences.zh: 這部電影是喜劇還是驚悚片？

sentences.en: The thriller has a surprising ending.
sentences.zh: 這部驚悚片有個出人意料的結局。

sentences.en: My mom loves reading a good thriller on the plane.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽喜歡在飛機上看一本好看的驚悚小說。

sentences.en: The young prince took the throne after his father died.
sentences.zh: 年輕的王子在父親去世後登上王位。

sentences.en: Who sat on the throne after the queen?
sentences.zh: 女王之後是誰坐上王位？

sentences.en: The museum has an old throne made of wood and gold.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一張用木頭和黃金打造的古老王座。

sentences.en: In the play, the king refuses to give up his throne.
sentences.zh: 劇中，國王拒絕讓出他的王位。

sentences.en: Did the princess have a right to the throne?
sentences.zh: 公主有繼承王位的權利嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists lined up to take photos beside the royal throne.
sentences.zh: 觀光客排隊在王座旁拍照。

sentences.en: He thrust his hands into his pockets and waited.
sentences.zh: 他把雙手塞進口袋裡等著。

sentences.en: She thrust the keys into my hand and ran.
sentences.zh: 她把鑰匙塞進我手裡就跑了。

sentences.en: Why did the toddler thrust his toy toward me?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那個小朋友把玩具往我這邊猛推？

sentences.en: Why did you thrust your hand into the box without looking?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼不先看一眼就把手猛地伸進箱子裡？

sentences.en: The reporter thrust a microphone toward the mayor.
sentences.zh: 記者把麥克風猛地遞向市長。

sentences.en: With one thrust, he pushed the heavy door open.
sentences.zh: 他用力一推，把沉重的門推開了。

sentences.en: A thunderstorm delayed our flight by two hours.
sentences.zh: 一場雷雨讓我們的班機延誤了兩小時。

sentences.en: Is a thunderstorm expected during the conference?
sentences.zh: 會議期間預計會下雷雨嗎？

sentences.en: The thunderstorm knocked out power in our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 這場雷雨讓我們社區停電了。

sentences.en: Do you think the thunderstorm will stop before we leave?
sentences.zh: 你覺得雷雨會在我們出發前停嗎？

sentences.en: I watched the thunderstorm from my hotel window.
sentences.zh: 我從飯店窗戶看著那場雷雨。

sentences.en: Thunderstorms often hit Florida on summer afternoons.
sentences.zh: 夏天午後，佛羅里達常有雷雨。

sentences.en: I can hear the clock tick in the quiet room.
sentences.zh: 我在安靜的房間裡聽得到時鐘滴答作響。

sentences.en: Does that old watch still tick?
sentences.zh: 那隻老手錶還會滴答作響嗎？

sentences.en: The tick of the clock kept me awake.
sentences.zh: 時鐘的滴答聲讓我睡不著。

sentences.en: Why does the kitchen timer tick so loudly?
sentences.zh: 為什麼廚房計時器的滴答聲那麼大？

sentences.en: Every tick of the clock made him more nervous.
sentences.zh: 時鐘每一次滴答聲都讓他更緊張。

sentences.en: The meeting dragged on while the clock ticked away.
sentences.zh: 會議一直拖著，時鐘也滴答地走著。

sentences.en: We chose white tile for the bathroom floor.
sentences.zh: 我們選了白色磁磚鋪浴室地板。

sentences.en: Can you tile a kitchen floor by yourself?
sentences.zh: 你自己能鋪廚房地板的磁磚嗎？

sentences.en: A cracked tile near the shower needs replacing.
sentences.zh: 淋浴間旁有一塊裂掉的磁磚需要更換。

sentences.en: How much will it cost to tile the whole entryway?
sentences.zh: 把整個玄關鋪上磁磚要多少錢？

sentences.en: My dad tiled our kitchen wall last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我爸上週末幫我們家廚房的牆壁貼了磁磚。

sentences.en: These tiles are cold under bare feet in winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天赤腳踩這些磁磚很冰。

sentences.en: Grease the muffin tin before pouring in the batter.
sentences.zh: 倒入麵糊前，先在馬芬烤盤上抹油。

sentences.en: Do you have a spare muffin tin I could borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有多的馬芬烤盤可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: Rain sounded loud on the old tin roof.
sentences.zh: 雨打在老舊的鐵皮屋頂上，聲音很大。

sentences.en: Bronze is made by mixing copper with tin.
sentences.zh: 青銅是把銅和錫混合製成的。

sentences.en: Wrap the leftovers in tin foil before putting them away.
sentences.zh: 把剩菜用錫箔紙包好再收起來。

sentences.en: Is tin harder or softer than copper?
sentences.zh: 錫比銅硬還是軟？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: The runner carried the torch into the stadium.
sentences.zh: 跑者把火炬帶進了體育場。

sentences.en: Who will light the torch at the opening ceremony?
sentences.zh: 開幕典禮上誰要點燃火炬？

sentences.en: Guards in the movie held torches in the dark hall.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，守衛在黑暗的大廳裡舉著火把。

sentences.en: Why does the torch travel from city to city before the games?
sentences.zh: 為什麼比賽前火炬要一座城市接一座城市傳遞？

sentences.en: A flickering torch lit the old stone tunnel.
sentences.zh: 搖曳的火把照亮了古老的石造隧道。

sentences.en: The festival ends when they put out the torch.
sentences.zh: 他們熄滅火炬時，慶典就結束了。

gloss_note: 作動詞時指長時間讓人痛苦

sentences.en: The long wait was pure torment for the fans.
sentences.zh: 漫長的等待對球迷來說簡直是折磨。

sentences.en: Does the noise from the street torment you at night?
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音晚上會折磨你嗎？

sentences.en: Waiting for the test results tormented her all week.
sentences.zh: 等待檢查結果讓她整個星期都很痛苦。

sentences.en: Why does he torment his little sister with silly jokes?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼老用無聊的笑話折磨他妹妹？

sentences.en: The heat was a torment for the hikers.
sentences.zh: 酷熱對健行者來說是種折磨。

sentences.en: In the novel, guilt torments the main character for years.
sentences.zh: 小說裡，罪惡感折磨了主角好多年。

sentences.en: Our school will host the chess tournament next month.
sentences.zh: 我們學校下個月將舉辦西洋棋錦標賽。

sentences.en: Are you signing up for the tennis tournament?
sentences.zh: 你要報名網球錦標賽嗎？

sentences.en: She won the golf tournament by two strokes.
sentences.zh: 她以兩桿之差贏得高爾夫錦標賽。

sentences.en: How many teams are in the tournament this year?
sentences.zh: 今年錦標賽有幾支隊伍？

sentences.en: The tournament was moved indoors because of rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，比賽改到室內舉行。

sentences.en: My son plays in a youth soccer tournament each spring.
sentences.zh: 我兒子每年春天參加青少年足球錦標賽。

gloss_note: 搭 toxic to；toxic waste 有毒廢棄物

sentences.en: Keep these cleaning products away from kids because they're toxic.
sentences.zh: 這些清潔用品有毒，要放在孩子拿不到的地方。

sentences.en: Is this paint toxic to pets?
sentences.zh: 這種油漆對寵物有毒嗎？

sentences.en: The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste.
sentences.zh: 工廠因傾倒有毒廢棄物而被罰款。

sentences.en: Are these mushrooms toxic, or can we eat them?
sentences.zh: 這些菇有毒，還是可以吃？

sentences.en: Some common houseplants are toxic to cats.
sentences.zh: 有些常見的室內植物對貓有毒。

sentences.en: Toxic fumes forced the workers to leave the building.
sentences.zh: 有毒的煙霧迫使工人離開大樓。

gloss_note: a traitor to 背叛…的人；語氣很重

sentences.en: In the movie, one of the knights turns out to be a traitor.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，其中一名騎士其實是叛徒。

sentences.en: Who was the traitor in the story we read?
sentences.zh: 我們讀的那個故事裡，誰是叛徒？

sentences.en: The general was called a traitor after he sold the secret plans.
sentences.zh: 那位將軍把機密計畫賣掉後，被稱為叛徒。

sentences.en: Did the villagers really think he was a traitor?
sentences.zh: 村民真的認為他是叛徒嗎？

sentences.en: History books describe him as a traitor to his country.
sentences.zh: 歷史書把他描述成背叛國家的叛徒。

sentences.en: She felt like a traitor for telling her friend's secret.
sentences.zh: 她覺得自己像個叛徒，因為說出了朋友的祕密。

gloss_note: 金融用語，常見 first tranche

sentences.en: The bank released the first tranche of the loan today.
sentences.zh: 銀行今天撥出了貸款的第一期款項。

sentences.en: When will the second tranche be paid?
sentences.zh: 第二期款項什麼時候會撥款？

sentences.en: Investors bought the final tranche of bonds in an hour.
sentences.zh: 投資人一個小時內就買下了最後一批債券。

sentences.en: Is each tranche tied to a project milestone?
sentences.zh: 每一期款項都跟專案里程碑掛鉤嗎？

sentences.en: The company sold a tranche of shares to raise cash.
sentences.zh: 公司出售了一批股份來籌措現金。

sentences.en: Funding will arrive in three tranches over the year.
sentences.zh: 資金會在一年內分三期撥付。

gloss_note: transcribe an interview 整理逐字稿

sentences.en: Can you transcribe this interview by Friday?
sentences.zh: 你可以在週五前把這段訪談轉成文字稿嗎？

sentences.en: She transcribed every word of the lecture.
sentences.zh: 她把講課的每個字都謄寫下來。

sentences.en: The software can transcribe a meeting in real time.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體可以即時把會議轉成文字。

sentences.en: Who will transcribe the recordings from the study?
sentences.zh: 誰要把這項研究的錄音轉成文字？

sentences.en: Students must transcribe the audio before they analyze it.
sentences.zh: 學生必須先把錄音轉成文字，再進行分析。

sentences.en: He transcribed his grandmother's old letters by hand.
sentences.zh: 他用手抄寫了祖母的舊信件。

sentences.en: The move to remote work was a big transition.
sentences.zh: 改成遠距上班是個很大的轉變。

sentences.en: How was your transition from high school to college?
sentences.zh: 你從高中到大學的轉變還順利嗎？

sentences.en: We're managing the transition to the new system.
sentences.zh: 我們正在處理轉換到新系統的過渡工作。

sentences.en: Is the transition to a new manager going smoothly?
sentences.zh: 換新主管的過渡期順利嗎？

sentences.en: The company went through a smooth transition last year.
sentences.zh: 去年公司順利度過了轉型期。

sentences.en: Moving to a new town is a hard transition for kids.
sentences.zh: 搬到新城鎮對孩子來說是個不容易的轉變。

gloss_note: 兩義：材質透明／作風公開

sentences.en: The glass is so clean it looks almost transparent.
sentences.zh: 這玻璃太乾淨，看起來幾乎是透明的。

sentences.en: Is the company's pricing transparent to customers?
sentences.zh: 公司的定價對客戶來說公開透明嗎？

sentences.en: Use a transparent container so you can see what's inside.
sentences.zh: 用透明的容器，這樣你就能看到裡面裝什麼。

sentences.en: We want a transparent process for choosing vendors.
sentences.zh: 我們希望挑選廠商的過程公開透明。

sentences.en: Why isn't the school's budget more transparent?
sentences.zh: 為什麼學校的預算不更公開透明一點？

sentences.en: The manager was transparent about the budget cuts.
sentences.zh: 主管對預算刪減的事坦白公開。

sentences.en: He is waiting for a kidney transplant.
sentences.zh: 他正在等待腎臟移植。

sentences.en: How long is recovery after a heart transplant?
sentences.zh: 心臟移植手術後要多久才能恢復？

sentences.en: The transplant took eight hours, but it went well.
sentences.zh: 這場移植手術花了八小時，但很順利。

sentences.en: Is a liver transplant covered by her insurance?
sentences.zh: 她的保險有給付肝臟移植嗎？

sentences.en: The hospital performs hundreds of transplants every year.
sentences.zh: 這家醫院每年進行數百例移植手術。

sentences.en: A bone marrow transplant saved the boy's life.
sentences.zh: 骨髓移植救了那個男孩的命。

sentences.en: The students paid tribute to their retiring teacher.
sentences.zh: 學生們向即將退休的老師致敬。

sentences.en: Will there be a tribute to the founder at the dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚宴上會有向創辦人致敬的環節嗎？

sentences.en: Thousands of fans left flowers as a tribute to the singer.
sentences.zh: 數千名粉絲獻上花束悼念那位歌手。

sentences.en: How did the team pay tribute to its coach?
sentences.zh: 球隊是怎麼向教練致敬的？

sentences.en: The concert was a tribute to classic rock music.
sentences.zh: 這場演唱會是向經典搖滾致敬。

sentences.en: She wrote a short tribute for her grandfather's memorial.
sentences.zh: 她為祖父的追思會寫了一篇簡短的悼詞。

gloss_note: trigger an alarm 觸發警報

sentences.en: Dust can trigger my allergies in the spring.
sentences.zh: 春天的灰塵會引發我的過敏。

sentences.en: What was the trigger for the sudden price drop?
sentences.zh: 價格突然下跌的導火線是什麼？

sentences.en: The motion sensor triggered the alarm at night.
sentences.zh: 動作感應器在夜裡觸發了警報。

sentences.en: Does coffee trigger headaches for you?
sentences.zh: 咖啡會讓你頭痛嗎？

sentences.en: A small mistake triggered a long argument.
sentences.zh: 一個小錯誤引發了一場冗長的爭執。

sentences.en: Heavy rain triggered flooding in several towns.
sentences.zh: 豪雨在幾個城鎮引發了淹水。

gloss_note: win a trophy 贏得獎盃

sentences.en: Our team brought home the trophy this year.
sentences.zh: 我們隊今年把獎盃帶回家了。

sentences.en: Where should we display the trophy?
sentences.zh: 我們該把獎盃擺在哪裡？

sentences.en: He polishes his tennis trophy every weekend.
sentences.zh: 他每個週末都擦亮他的網球獎盃。

sentences.en: Did she receive a trophy for finishing first?
sentences.zh: 她拿第一名有得到獎盃嗎？

sentences.en: The trophy sits on the shelf above my desk.
sentences.zh: 獎盃就放在我書桌上方的架子上。

sentences.en: The mayor handed the trophy to the winning captain.
sentences.zh: 市長把獎盃交給獲勝的隊長。

gloss_note: 罐頭鮪魚美式叫 canned tuna

sentences.en: I'll have a tuna sandwich and a small salad.
sentences.zh: 我要一份鮪魚三明治和一份小沙拉。

sentences.en: Is the tuna in this roll fresh or canned?
sentences.zh: 這個壽司捲裡的鮪魚是新鮮的還是罐頭的？

sentences.en: Grilled tuna with lemon is my favorite dinner.
sentences.zh: 檸檬烤鮪魚是我最愛的晚餐。

sentences.en: Do you want tuna salad or egg salad on your bread?
sentences.zh: 你的麵包要夾鮪魚沙拉還是蛋沙拉？

sentences.en: Tuna steaks are on sale at the market today.
sentences.zh: 超市今天鮪魚排特價。

sentences.en: My dad packs a tuna melt for lunch every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我爸每週二都帶鮪魚起司三明治當午餐。

sentences.en: The company was in turmoil after the CEO resigned.
sentences.zh: 執行長辭職後，公司陷入一片混亂。

sentences.en: Is the market still in turmoil after yesterday's news?
sentences.zh: 昨天的消息公布後，市場還在動盪嗎？

sentences.en: Her mind was in turmoil after the argument.
sentences.zh: 吵完架後，她的心裡一片混亂。

sentences.en: How can we stay calm during this turmoil?
sentences.zh: 在這場動盪中，我們要怎麼保持冷靜？

sentences.en: The merger caused months of turmoil for employees.
sentences.zh: 這次合併讓員工動盪不安了好幾個月。

sentences.en: Economic turmoil forced many small shops to close.
sentences.zh: 經濟動盪迫使許多小店關門。

gloss_note: uncover the truth 揭露真相

sentences.en: Reporters uncovered a problem in the city's budget.
sentences.zh: 記者發現了市政預算中的一個問題。

sentences.en: Did the audit uncover any mistakes in the accounts?
sentences.zh: 這次查帳有發現帳目有誤嗎？

sentences.en: I hope this survey will uncover what customers really want.
sentences.zh: 我希望這份調查能找出客戶真正想要什麼。

sentences.en: Workers uncovered an old coin while digging in the garden.
sentences.zh: 工人在花園裡挖土時發現了一枚舊硬幣。

sentences.en: Can we uncover the cause of the delay by Friday?
sentences.zh: 我們能在週五前查出延誤的原因嗎？

sentences.en: The detective uncovered a clue hidden in the letter.
sentences.zh: 偵探發現了藏在信裡的線索。

gloss_note: underestimate the cost 低估成本

sentences.en: Don't underestimate how long the paperwork will take.
sentences.zh: 別低估文書作業要花多少時間。

sentences.en: Did we underestimate the demand for this product?
sentences.zh: 我們是不是低估了這項產品的需求？

sentences.en: Many people underestimate the cost of owning a car.
sentences.zh: 很多人低估了養車的花費。

sentences.en: Do you think I underestimated our competitors?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我低估了我們的競爭對手嗎？

sentences.en: She underestimated the traffic and arrived late.
sentences.zh: 她低估了車流，結果遲到了。

sentences.en: Early reports underestimated the damage from the storm.
sentences.zh: 早期的報導低估了風暴造成的損失。

gloss_note: 受詞常是手術、檢查、整修

sentences.en: My grandfather will undergo surgery next Monday.
sentences.zh: 我祖父下週一要接受手術。

sentences.en: Will the building undergo repairs this summer?
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓今年夏天會整修嗎？

sentences.en: All new workers must undergo safety training.
sentences.zh: 所有新進員工都必須接受安全訓練。

sentences.en: Did the hotel undergo a major renovation last year?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店去年有大整修嗎？

sentences.en: She underwent several tests before the doctor made a diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 她在醫生做出診斷前接受了好幾項檢查。

sentences.en: The old library is undergoing a complete makeover.
sentences.zh: 老圖書館正在進行全面翻新。

sentences.en: She is an undergraduate majoring in biology.
sentences.zh: 她是主修生物的大學部學生。

sentences.en: Are you an undergraduate or a graduate student?
sentences.zh: 你是大學部學生還是研究生？

sentences.en: Undergraduates can borrow up to ten books at once.
sentences.zh: 大學部學生一次最多可以借十本書。

sentences.en: How many undergraduates live on campus this year?
sentences.zh: 今年有多少大學部學生住在校園裡？

sentences.en: I worked in a lab as an undergraduate.
sentences.zh: 我讀大學部的時候在實驗室工作過。

sentences.en: The undergraduate program accepts new students every fall.
sentences.zh: 大學部課程每年秋季招收新生。

sentences.en: The mall has an underground parking garage.
sentences.zh: 這間購物中心有地下停車場。

sentences.en: Is the parking lot underground or on the street?
sentences.zh: 停車場是在地下還是在路邊？

sentences.en: Workers buried the cables underground to protect them.
sentences.zh: 工人把電纜埋在地下加以保護。

sentences.en: Do you know if the storage room is underground?
sentences.zh: 你知道儲藏室是不是在地下嗎？

sentences.en: The city plans an underground water tank to prevent floods.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫蓋地下蓄水槽來防洪。

sentences.en: Many plants send their roots deep underground.
sentences.zh: 許多植物把根伸到很深的地下。

gloss_note: 多用於抽象的基礎，較正式

sentences.en: Strong customer trust underpins our whole business.
sentences.zh: 穩固的客戶信任是我們整個事業的基礎。

sentences.en: What assumptions underpin this sales forecast?
sentences.zh: 這份銷售預測是根據哪些假設？

sentences.en: Solid data should underpin every decision we make.
sentences.zh: 我們每個決策都應該以可靠的數據為基礎。

sentences.en: Do these figures underpin her argument for a price increase?
sentences.zh: 這些數字能支持她主張漲價的論點嗎？

sentences.en: New steel beams underpin the floor of the old warehouse.
sentences.zh: 新的鋼梁支撐著舊倉庫的地板。

sentences.en: Trust and honesty underpin every good partnership.
sentences.zh: 信任與誠實是每段良好合作關係的基礎。

gloss_note: undertake a task 承擔任務；較正式

sentences.en: Who will undertake the repair work this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末誰要負責進行維修工作？

sentences.en: Our team agreed to undertake the survey next month.
sentences.zh: 我們的團隊同意下個月進行這項調查。

sentences.en: Are you ready to undertake such a big project?
sentences.zh: 你準備好承擔這麼大的專案了嗎？

sentences.en: She undertook the task of training new workers.
sentences.zh: 她負責訓練新進員工的工作。

sentences.en: The city will undertake a study of the bus system.
sentences.zh: 市政府將對公車系統進行一項研究。

sentences.en: I can't undertake any more work this week.
sentences.zh: 我這個星期無法再承擔更多工作了。

sentences.en: Many investors undervalue this small company.
sentences.zh: 許多投資人低估了這家小公司。

sentences.en: Did the bank undervalue our house?
sentences.zh: 銀行是不是低估了我們的房子？

sentences.en: Don't undervalue your skills when you negotiate your salary.
sentences.zh: 談薪水時，別低估自己的能力。

sentences.en: Is the stock undervalued right now?
sentences.zh: 這支股票現在被低估了嗎？

sentences.en: Managers sometimes undervalue the work of new staff.
sentences.zh: 主管有時會低估新進員工的工作價值。

sentences.en: The shop owner undervalued the old watch and sold it cheap.
sentences.zh: 店老闆低估了那支舊手錶的價值，把它賤價賣掉了。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: The meeting is already underway.
sentences.zh: 會議已經開始進行了。

sentences.en: Is the renovation underway yet?
sentences.zh: 整修工程已經開始進行了嗎？

sentences.en: Work on the new store is well underway.
sentences.zh: 新店的工程正進行得很順利。

sentences.en: When did the investigation get underway?
sentences.zh: 調查是什麼時候開始進行的？

sentences.en: Plans for the sales event are underway.
sentences.zh: 促銷活動的籌備工作正在進行中。

sentences.en: Boarding is underway at gate twelve.
sentences.zh: 十二號登機門正在登機。

gloss_note: 負責評估風險、決定是否承保

sentences.en: The underwriter reviewed my application this morning.
sentences.zh: 核保人今天早上審查了我的申請。

sentences.en: Will the underwriter approve our home insurance policy?
sentences.zh: 核保人會批准我們的房屋保險單嗎？

sentences.en: An underwriter decides how risky a driver is.
sentences.zh: 核保人會判斷一位駕駛人的風險有多高。

sentences.en: Has the underwriter asked for more documents?
sentences.zh: 核保人要求更多文件了嗎？

sentences.en: The underwriter raised the cost of the policy after two accidents.
sentences.zh: 發生兩次事故後，核保人提高了保單的費用。

sentences.en: Our underwriter works closely with the sales team.
sentences.zh: 我們的核保人和業務團隊密切合作。

gloss_note: undo the last step 復原上一步

sentences.en: How do I undo the last change?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼復原上一個變更？

sentences.en: Click this icon to undo your last edit.
sentences.zh: 點一下這個圖示就能復原你最後一次編輯。

sentences.en: Can you undo the knot in my shoelace?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我解開鞋帶上的結嗎？

sentences.en: She undid her seat belt and stepped out of the car.
sentences.zh: 她解開安全帶，下了車。

sentences.en: The tailor undid the seam and made the jacket larger.
sentences.zh: 裁縫師拆開縫線，把外套放大了。

sentences.en: He undid the top button of his shirt.
sentences.zh: 他解開了襯衫最上面的扣子。

gloss_note: 修飾整句或形容詞，語氣肯定

sentences.en: Her new movie is undoubtedly her best. Have you seen it?
sentences.zh: 她的新電影無疑是她最好的作品。你看過了嗎？

sentences.en: She is undoubtedly the best speaker on our team.
sentences.zh: 她無疑是我們團隊中最會演講的人。

sentences.en: That was undoubtedly a hard test. Did you finish on time?
sentences.zh: 那無疑是一場很難的考試。你有在時間內寫完嗎？

sentences.en: Undoubtedly, the new menu will attract more customers.
sentences.zh: 毫無疑問，新菜單會吸引更多顧客。

sentences.en: You are undoubtedly tired after the long flight. Want some tea?
sentences.zh: 長途飛行之後你無疑很累了。要喝點茶嗎？

sentences.en: Prices will undoubtedly rise again next year.
sentences.zh: 明年物價無疑會再度上漲。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate fell again last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月失業率再度下降。

sentences.en: Is unemployment a big problem in your town?
sentences.zh: 失業在你們鎮上是個大問題嗎？

sentences.en: He has been receiving unemployment benefits since March.
sentences.zh: 他從三月起就一直在領失業救濟金。

sentences.en: How did you manage during your unemployment?
sentences.zh: 你失業期間是怎麼撐過來的？

sentences.en: High unemployment makes young people worry about the future.
sentences.zh: 高失業率讓年輕人擔心未來。

sentences.en: After a year of unemployment, she finally found a job.
sentences.zh: 失業一年之後，她終於找到了工作。

sentences.en: Our flight was unexpectedly canceled. Are you still coming?
sentences.zh: 我們的班機意外被取消了。你還會來嗎？

sentences.en: Sales rose unexpectedly in the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 第三季的銷售額出乎意料地成長。

sentences.en: Why did the manager leave so unexpectedly?
sentences.zh: 經理為什麼走得這麼突然？

sentences.en: My uncle unexpectedly showed up at the door.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔出乎意料地出現在門口。

sentences.en: The test was unexpectedly easy. Did you think so too?
sentences.zh: 這次考試意外地簡單。你也這麼覺得嗎？

sentences.en: The store unexpectedly closed early because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 這家店因為暴風雨而出乎意料地提早打烊。

sentences.en: The contract includes terms unfavorable to small suppliers.
sentences.zh: 這份合約包含對小型供應商不利的條款。

sentences.en: Would you accept such unfavorable terms?
sentences.zh: 你會接受這麼不利的條件嗎？

sentences.en: Unfavorable weather delayed the delivery.
sentences.zh: 不利的天氣延誤了送貨。

sentences.en: Why did the company get such unfavorable reviews?
sentences.zh: 這家公司為什麼會得到這麼負面的評價？

sentences.en: The exchange rate is unfavorable for us right now.
sentences.zh: 目前的匯率對我們不利。

sentences.en: Customers gave an unfavorable response to the new price.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新價格的反應不佳。

gloss_note: events unfold 事情逐漸展開

sentences.en: Please unfold the map on the table.
sentences.zh: 請把地圖攤開在桌上。

sentences.en: How will the story unfold in the next episode?
sentences.zh: 這個故事在下一集會怎麼發展？

sentences.en: Reporters watched the events unfold on the street.
sentences.zh: 記者看著事件在街上逐漸展開。

sentences.en: Did the plan unfold the way you expected?
sentences.zh: 計畫有照你預期的方式進展嗎？

sentences.en: The plot unfolds slowly in the first few chapters.
sentences.zh: 情節在前幾章慢慢展開。

sentences.en: The waiter unfolded my napkin and handed it to me.
sentences.zh: 服務生把我的餐巾攤開，遞給了我。

sentences.en: His handwriting is almost unintelligible.
sentences.zh: 他的字跡幾乎讓人看不懂。

sentences.en: Why was the announcement so unintelligible?
sentences.zh: 這則廣播為什麼這麼讓人聽不懂？

sentences.en: The phone line was bad, and her words were unintelligible.
sentences.zh: 電話訊號很差，她說的話難以理解。

sentences.en: Is the legal language in this contract unintelligible to most people?
sentences.zh: 這份合約的法律用語對多數人來說難以理解嗎？

sentences.en: The little girl's speech was still unintelligible to strangers.
sentences.zh: 這個小女孩說的話對陌生人來說仍然難以理解。

sentences.en: The static made the radio message unintelligible.
sentences.zh: 雜訊讓那則無線電訊息難以理解。

gloss_note: unlock a phone 解鎖手機

sentences.en: Can you unlock the front door for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把前門的鎖打開嗎？

sentences.en: I forgot the code to unlock my cell phone.
sentences.zh: 我忘了解鎖手機的密碼。

sentences.en: The hotel clerk will unlock your room soon.
sentences.zh: 飯店櫃台人員很快就會幫你打開房門。

sentences.en: Did you unlock the gate before you left?
sentences.zh: 你離開前有把大門的鎖打開嗎？

sentences.en: She used a small key to unlock the cabinet.
sentences.zh: 她用一把小鑰匙打開了櫃子的鎖。

sentences.en: The guard unlocked the office door at seven.
sentences.zh: 警衛在七點打開了辦公室的門鎖。

sentences.en: Please pay the unpaid balance by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前付清未付的餘額。

sentences.en: Is this invoice still unpaid?
sentences.zh: 這張請款單還沒付款嗎？

sentences.en: She did unpaid work for a charity last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天她為一個慈善團體做無薪的工作。

sentences.en: Why are these bills still unpaid?
sentences.zh: 這些帳單為什麼還沒付？

sentences.en: Unpaid leave is not allowed during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 旺季期間不允許請無薪假。

sentences.en: Some students take unpaid internships to gain experience.
sentences.zh: 有些學生為了累積經驗而參加無薪實習。

gloss_note: an unpleasant smell 難聞的氣味

sentences.en: The meeting ended on an unpleasant note.
sentences.zh: 會議在不愉快的氣氛中結束。

sentences.en: Is there an unpleasant smell in this room?
sentences.zh: 這個房間裡有難聞的味道嗎？

sentences.en: The customer was rude and very unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客既無禮又很令人不愉快。

sentences.en: Did you find the long trip unpleasant?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那趟長途旅行不愉快嗎？

sentences.en: It was an unpleasant surprise to see the high bill.
sentences.zh: 看到那麼高的帳單，真是個令人不快的意外。

sentences.en: The weather was cold, wet, and unpleasant all week.
sentences.zh: 整個星期天氣又冷又濕，令人很不舒服。

sentences.en: Is the market always this unpredictable?
sentences.zh: 市場總是這麼難以預測嗎？

sentences.en: Mountain weather can be unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 山區的天氣可能變化莫測。

sentences.en: Our boss is unpredictable, so we always plan ahead.
sentences.zh: 我們的老闆難以捉摸，所以我們總是提早規劃。

sentences.en: Why are gas prices so unpredictable this year?
sentences.zh: 今年的油價為什麼這麼難以預測？

sentences.en: Unpredictable demand makes it hard to order enough stock.
sentences.zh: 難以預測的需求讓人很難訂到足夠的庫存。

sentences.en: Do you like his unpredictable sense of humor?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡他那種難以捉摸的幽默感嗎？

sentences.en: These two problems seem completely unrelated.
sentences.zh: 這兩個問題看起來完全不相關。

sentences.en: Is your question unrelated to today's topic?
sentences.zh: 你的問題和今天的主題無關嗎？

sentences.en: His late arrival was unrelated to the traffic.
sentences.zh: 他遲到和交通狀況無關。

sentences.en: Please keep unrelated files out of this folder.
sentences.zh: 請不要把無關的檔案放進這個資料夾。

sentences.en: Are the two accidents unrelated?
sentences.zh: 這兩起事故彼此無關嗎？

sentences.en: The study found the illness was unrelated to diet.
sentences.zh: 研究發現這種疾病與飲食無關。

sentences.en: An unsecured loan does not require any collateral.
sentences.zh: 無擔保貸款不需要任何抵押品。

sentences.en: Is this credit card debt unsecured?
sentences.zh: 這筆信用卡債務是無擔保的嗎？

sentences.en: The bank charges higher interest on unsecured loans.
sentences.zh: 銀行對無擔保貸款收取較高的利息。

sentences.en: Can a small business get an unsecured loan easily?
sentences.zh: 小型企業能輕易取得無擔保貸款嗎？

sentences.en: Most unsecured creditors lose money when a firm fails.
sentences.zh: 公司倒閉時，大多數無擔保債權人都會賠錢。

sentences.en: She paid off the unsecured debt before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 她在年底前還清了無擔保債務。

sentences.en: Can I return this unused item for a refund?
sentences.zh: 我可以把這件未使用的商品退貨退款嗎？

sentences.en: She kept the unused tickets in a drawer.
sentences.zh: 她把沒用過的票放在抽屜裡。

sentences.en: Is there any unused space in the warehouse?
sentences.zh: 倉庫裡還有任何閒置的空間嗎？

sentences.en: Unused vacation days do not carry over to next year.
sentences.zh: 未使用的休假天數不能保留到明年。

sentences.en: The unused rooms on the second floor were locked.
sentences.zh: 二樓閒置的房間都上了鎖。

sentences.en: Do you have any unused coupons I could borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有還沒用過的優惠券可以借我？

sentences.en: The client is unwilling to pay more.
sentences.zh: 客戶不願意多付錢。

sentences.en: Are you unwilling to work on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你不願意週末上班嗎？

sentences.en: Many workers were unwilling to move to the new office.
sentences.zh: 許多員工不願意搬到新辦公室。

sentences.en: He seemed unwilling to talk about the accident.
sentences.zh: 他似乎不願意談那起意外。

sentences.en: Why is the supplier unwilling to lower the price?
sentences.zh: 供應商為什麼不願意降價？

sentences.en: She was unwilling to sign the form without reading it.
sentences.zh: 她不願意在沒讀過的情況下簽那份表格。

gloss_note: update me on 向我說明最新進度

sentences.en: Can you update me on the project?
sentences.zh: 你可以向我說明專案的最新進度嗎？

sentences.en: I need to update my phone's software today.
sentences.zh: 我今天得更新手機的軟體。

sentences.en: Please send me a quick update by email.
sentences.zh: 請用電子郵件寄給我一份簡短的最新消息。

sentences.en: Did the system update finish during the night?
sentences.zh: 系統更新有在夜裡完成嗎？

sentences.en: We will update the website every Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們每週一都會更新網站。

sentences.en: The news update says the storm is coming.
sentences.zh: 最新新聞快報說暴風雨要來了。

gloss_note: uplift one's spirits 振奮精神

sentences.en: A good song can uplift your mood.
sentences.zh: 一首好歌能提振你的心情。

sentences.en: Can a short walk really uplift your spirits?
sentences.zh: 短短散個步真的能振奮你的精神嗎？

sentences.en: The coach's speech uplifted the whole team.
sentences.zh: 教練的演講鼓舞了整個團隊。

sentences.en: The new program aims to uplift low-income families.
sentences.zh: 這項新計畫旨在提升低收入家庭的生活。

sentences.en: The good news uplifted everyone in the office.
sentences.zh: 這個好消息鼓舞了辦公室裡的每個人。

sentences.en: Do these classes uplift the spirits of older adults?
sentences.zh: 這些課程能鼓舞年長者的精神嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse asked for a urine sample.
sentences.zh: 護理師請我提供尿液檢體。

sentences.en: Is a urine test part of the checkup?
sentences.zh: 驗尿是健康檢查的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: Dark urine can be a sign that you need water.
sentences.zh: 深色的尿液可能表示你需要補充水分。

sentences.en: Please put your urine sample in the cup.
sentences.zh: 請把你的尿液檢體放進杯子裡。

sentences.en: The lab will test your urine for infection.
sentences.zh: 檢驗室會檢驗你的尿液有沒有感染。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get the urine results?
sentences.zh: 尿液檢驗結果要多久才會出來？

sentences.en: The utilization of office space has improved.
sentences.zh: 辦公空間的使用率已經提高了。

sentences.en: Is our machine utilization too low this month?
sentences.zh: 我們這個月的機器使用率是不是太低了？

sentences.en: Better utilization of staff time will save money.
sentences.zh: 更有效地利用員工的時間可以省錢。

sentences.en: What is the current utilization rate of the warehouse?
sentences.zh: 倉庫目前的使用率是多少？

sentences.en: The report shows poor utilization of the new software.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示新軟體的使用率很低。

sentences.en: Higher utilization of solar power cuts energy costs.
sentences.zh: 提高太陽能的利用可以降低能源成本。

gloss_note: a vague answer 含糊的回答

sentences.en: His answer was too vague to help us.
sentences.zh: 他的回答太含糊，幫不上我們的忙。

sentences.en: Why are the instructions so vague?
sentences.zh: 這些說明為什麼這麼含糊？

sentences.en: I have only a vague memory of that trip.
sentences.zh: 我對那趟旅行只有模糊的記憶。

sentences.en: Your plan sounds vague. Can you explain it more?
sentences.zh: 你的計畫聽起來很含糊。你可以多解釋一下嗎？

sentences.en: The contract was vague about the payment date.
sentences.zh: 合約對付款日期的說明很含糊。

sentences.en: Is the report's main point still vague to you?
sentences.zh: 報告的重點對你來說仍然很模糊嗎？

sentences.en: Let x be the variable in this equation.
sentences.zh: 設 x 為這個方程式中的變數。

sentences.en: Is speed the only variable in the test?
sentences.zh: 速度是這項測試中唯一的變數嗎？

sentences.en: The weather here is highly variable in spring.
sentences.zh: 這裡春天的天氣變化很大。

sentences.en: Is the quality of the fruit variable from week to week?
sentences.zh: 水果的品質每週都不一樣嗎？

sentences.en: The scientist changed only one variable at a time.
sentences.zh: 科學家一次只改變一個變數。

sentences.en: Many variables affect how fast a plant grows.
sentences.zh: 許多變數會影響植物生長的速度。

gloss_note: variation in prices 價格變動

sentences.en: There is little variation in daily temperature here.
sentences.zh: 這裡每天的溫度變化很小。

sentences.en: Is this recipe a variation on the classic one?
sentences.zh: 這份食譜是經典食譜的變化款嗎？

sentences.en: The report shows a big variation in prices.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示價格有很大的變動。

sentences.en: Why is there so much variation in test scores?
sentences.zh: 為什麼考試成績的差異這麼大？

sentences.en: She played a piano variation on that old song.
sentences.zh: 她彈了那首老歌的鋼琴變奏版。

sentences.en: Seasonal variation affects how many tourists visit.
sentences.zh: 季節性的變動會影響到訪的遊客人數。

sentences.en: Their new venture lost money in its first year.
sentences.zh: 他們的新事業第一年就賠錢。

sentences.en: Is this venture too risky for a small company?
sentences.zh: 這個新事業對小公司來說太冒險了嗎？

sentences.en: We ventured into the forest after lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們午餐後冒險走進了森林。

sentences.en: She started a coffee venture with two friends.
sentences.zh: 她和兩個朋友開創了一個咖啡新事業。

sentences.en: Would you venture out in such a heavy storm?
sentences.zh: 這麼大的暴風雨，你敢冒險出門嗎？

sentences.en: The company's first venture overseas was a success.
sentences.zh: 公司首次在海外開展的新事業成功了。

sentences.en: Which version of the software are you using?
sentences.zh: 你在用哪個版本的軟體？

sentences.en: Please send me the final version of the report.
sentences.zh: 請把報告的最終版本寄給我。

sentences.en: Can I see the English version of the menu?
sentences.zh: 我可以看一下菜單的英文版嗎？

sentences.en: His version of the story was very different.
sentences.zh: 他對這件事的說法很不一樣。

sentences.en: The new version of the app runs much faster.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式的新版本跑得快多了。

sentences.en: The movie is a new version of an old classic.
sentences.zh: 這部電影是一部老經典的新版本。

sentences.en: My grandfather is a proud veteran of the army.
sentences.zh: 我祖父是一位引以為傲的退伍軍人。

sentences.en: Is your neighbor a veteran?
sentences.zh: 你的鄰居是退伍軍人嗎？

sentences.en: Many veterans receive help to find new jobs.
sentences.zh: 許多退伍軍人會得到協助來找新工作。

sentences.en: She is a veteran teacher with twenty years of experience.
sentences.zh: 她是一位有二十年經驗的資深老師。

sentences.en: The company hired a veteran to lead the security team.
sentences.zh: 公司僱用了一位退伍軍人來帶領保全團隊。

sentences.en: Do veterans get discounts at this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 退伍軍人在這家餐廳有折扣嗎？

gloss_note: a vicious dog 兇惡的狗

sentences.en: The sign warns that the dog is vicious.
sentences.zh: 標示牌警告說這隻狗很兇惡。

sentences.en: Why did he make such a vicious comment?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼要說這麼惡毒的話？

sentences.en: The vicious rumor hurt her reputation.
sentences.zh: 那則惡毒的謠言傷害了她的名聲。

sentences.en: Was the online attack against her vicious?
sentences.zh: 網路上對她的攻擊很惡毒嗎？

sentences.en: Her vicious temper scared her coworkers.
sentences.zh: 她兇惡的脾氣嚇到了同事。

sentences.en: The two lawyers had a vicious argument in court.
sentences.zh: 兩位律師在法庭上吵得十分兇狠。

sentences.en: Try to see it from my viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 試著從我的角度來看這件事。

sentences.en: Can you share your viewpoint on this plan?
sentences.zh: 你能就這項計畫分享你的看法嗎？

sentences.en: Each writer has a different viewpoint on city life.
sentences.zh: 每位作者對都市生活都有不同的觀點。

sentences.en: From a customer's viewpoint, the price is too high.
sentences.zh: 從顧客的角度來看，價格太高了。

sentences.en: Did his viewpoint change after he traveled abroad?
sentences.zh: 他出國旅行之後，觀點有改變嗎？

sentences.en: The article offers a fresh viewpoint on health.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章對健康提出了嶄新的觀點。

sentences.en: She is very vocal about her ideas in meetings.
sentences.zh: 她在會議上對自己的想法很直言不諱。

sentences.en: Why are the neighbors so vocal about the parking rules?
sentences.zh: 鄰居為什麼對停車規定這麼直言不諱？

sentences.en: Is your boss vocal about problems on the team?
sentences.zh: 你的老闆會直言團隊裡的問題嗎？

sentences.en: The singer rested her vocal cords before the show.
sentences.zh: 歌手在演出前讓她的聲帶休息。

sentences.en: Is her vocal range wider than yours?
sentences.zh: 她的音域比你的更寬嗎？

sentences.en: Several vocal customers asked the store for a refund.
sentences.zh: 好幾位直言不諱的顧客要求商店退款。

gloss_note: null and void 作廢無效

sentences.en: Please void this check and write me a new one.
sentences.zh: 請把這張支票作廢，再開一張新的給我。

sentences.en: The contract is void if either side fails to sign.
sentences.zh: 任何一方沒簽名，合約就無效。

sentences.en: Can you void this order and start over?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這筆訂單作廢，重新開始嗎？

sentences.en: Opening the case will void your warranty.
sentences.zh: 打開外殼會使你的保固失效。

sentences.en: Is the coupon void after the expiration date?
sentences.zh: 優惠券過了到期日就無效了嗎？

sentences.en: The judge ruled that the old agreement was void.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定那份舊協議無效。

sentences.en: The volcano erupted early this morning.
sentences.zh: 火山今天一早噴發了。

sentences.en: Is that volcano still active?
sentences.zh: 那座火山還是活火山嗎？

sentences.en: We hiked to the top of a small volcano.
sentences.zh: 我們健行到一座小火山的山頂。

sentences.en: How often does this volcano erupt?
sentences.zh: 這座火山多久噴發一次？

sentences.en: Ash from the volcano covered the nearby town.
sentences.zh: 火山灰覆蓋了附近的小鎮。

sentences.en: My son built a model volcano for science class.
sentences.zh: 我兒子為自然課做了一個火山模型。

gloss_note: of one's own volition 出於自願

sentences.en: She left the company of her own volition.
sentences.zh: 她出於自己的意願離開了公司。

sentences.en: Did he sign the paper of his own volition?
sentences.zh: 他是出於自願簽下那份文件的嗎？

sentences.en: Philosophers debate how much volition humans really have.
sentences.zh: 哲學家爭論人類到底有多少自由意志。

sentences.en: The students joined the project of their own volition.
sentences.zh: 學生們是出於自己的意願參加這個專案的。

sentences.en: Did she make the decision of her own volition or under pressure?
sentences.zh: 她做這個決定是出於自願，還是迫於壓力？

sentences.en: Nobody forced me; I came of my own volition.
sentences.zh: 沒人逼我，是我自己願意來的。

sentences.en: The baby vomited after drinking too much milk.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒喝太多牛奶後吐了。

sentences.en: Did you vomit last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有吐嗎？

sentences.en: Feeling sick, he rushed to the bathroom to vomit.
sentences.zh: 他覺得不舒服，衝進浴室去吐。

sentences.en: Call the doctor if you vomit more than twice.
sentences.zh: 如果你吐超過兩次，請打電話給醫生。

sentences.en: Many people vomit on boats because they get seasick.
sentences.zh: 許多人因為暈船而在船上嘔吐。

sentences.en: Does the flu make you want to vomit?
sentences.zh: 流感會讓你想吐嗎？

gloss_note: vow to + 動詞 發誓要

sentences.en: He vowed to finish the marathon this year.
sentences.zh: 他發誓今年要跑完馬拉松。

sentences.en: Did you really vow to quit sugar?
sentences.zh: 你真的發誓要戒糖嗎？

sentences.en: The manager vowed to fix the problem quickly.
sentences.zh: 經理發誓會盡快解決這個問題。

sentences.en: The couple exchanged vows in a small garden.
sentences.zh: 這對新人在一座小花園裡交換了誓言。

sentences.en: Will she keep her vow to call every week?
sentences.zh: 她會信守每週打電話的誓言嗎？

sentences.en: The town leaders vowed to repair the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 鎮上的領導人發誓要修復那座舊橋。

gloss_note: waive a fee 免收費用

sentences.en: Can you waive the late fee this time?
sentences.zh: 這次可以免收逾期費嗎？

sentences.en: The bank agreed to waive the monthly charge.
sentences.zh: 銀行同意免除月費。

sentences.en: The school will waive the fee for new students.
sentences.zh: 學校會免除新生的費用。

sentences.en: Did the hotel waive the cancellation fee?
sentences.zh: 飯店有免收取消費嗎？

sentences.en: You can waive your right to a refund by signing.
sentences.zh: 簽名之後，你就放棄了退款的權利。

sentences.en: The airline waived the baggage fee for families.
sentences.zh: 航空公司對家庭旅客免收行李費。

sentences.en: My aunt works in the children's ward.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在兒童病房工作。

sentences.en: Which ward is Mr. Lee in?
sentences.zh: 李先生在哪個病房？

sentences.en: Visitors must check in before entering the ward.
sentences.zh: 訪客進入病房前必須先登記。

sentences.en: The nurse walked through the ward every hour.
sentences.zh: 護理師每小時都會巡視一次病房。

sentences.en: Is the surgery ward on the third floor?
sentences.zh: 外科病房在三樓嗎？

sentences.en: The hospital opened a new ward for flu patients.
sentences.zh: 醫院為流感病患開設了一間新病房。

gloss_note: a brave warrior 勇敢的戰士

sentences.en: The museum has a statue of an ancient warrior.
sentences.zh: 博物館裡有一座古代戰士的雕像。

sentences.en: Did you like the warrior in that movie?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡那部電影裡的戰士嗎？

sentences.en: Each warrior carried a wooden shield.
sentences.zh: 每位戰士都帶著一面木盾。

sentences.en: Our son wants to be a warrior in the game.
sentences.zh: 我們的兒子想在遊戲裡當戰士。

sentences.en: The tribe honored its bravest warrior with a feast.
sentences.zh: 部落用一場盛宴表揚最勇敢的戰士。

sentences.en: How did a warrior train in ancient times?
sentences.zh: 古代的戰士是如何訓練的？

sentences.en: Be wary of emails from unknown senders.
sentences.zh: 要提防來路不明的寄件者寄來的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Why is she so wary of strangers?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼這麼提防陌生人？

sentences.en: Investors are wary of the new company.
sentences.zh: 投資人對這家新公司抱持戒心。

sentences.en: I'm wary of buying a used car online.
sentences.zh: 我對在網路上買二手車很謹慎。

sentences.en: Are you wary about signing this contract?
sentences.zh: 你對簽這份合約有所顧慮嗎？

sentences.en: The deer kept a wary eye on us.
sentences.zh: 那隻鹿一直提防地盯著我們。

gloss_note: a watershed moment 重大轉折

sentences.en: The new law was a watershed for the industry.
sentences.zh: 新法律是這個產業的轉捩點。

sentences.en: Was that meeting a watershed for the company?
sentences.zh: 那場會議是公司的轉捩點嗎？

sentences.en: Graduation was a watershed in her life.
sentences.zh: 畢業是她人生的轉捩點。

sentences.en: The discovery marked a watershed in medicine.
sentences.zh: 這項發現標誌著醫學的轉捩點。

sentences.en: Do you see this year as a watershed moment?
sentences.zh: 你覺得今年是個重要的轉捩點嗎？

sentences.en: The invention of the phone was a watershed in communication.
sentences.zh: 電話的發明是通訊史上的轉捩點。

sentences.en: Is the museum accessible by wheelchair?
sentences.zh: 這座博物館輪椅可以進去嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather uses a wheelchair outdoors.
sentences.zh: 我祖父在戶外會使用輪椅。

sentences.en: The airline will bring a wheelchair to the gate.
sentences.zh: 航空公司會把輪椅送到登機門。

sentences.en: Could you hold the door for the man in the wheelchair?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫坐輪椅的那位先生扶一下門嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel has ramps for every wheelchair user.
sentences.zh: 飯店為每位輪椅使用者都設有斜坡道。

sentences.en: He pushed her wheelchair down the hall.
sentences.zh: 他推著她的輪椅走過走廊。

gloss_note: 作主詞時單複數動詞皆可

sentences.en: Do you know his whereabouts today?
sentences.zh: 你知道他今天的行蹤嗎？

sentences.en: The whereabouts of the missing keys are unknown.
sentences.zh: 遺失的鑰匙下落不明。

sentences.en: Police asked the public for information on his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 警方向民眾徵求有關他下落的資訊。

sentences.en: We still don't know the whereabouts of the package.
sentences.zh: 我們仍然不知道那個包裹的下落。

sentences.en: Can you tell me the whereabouts of the manager?
sentences.zh: 你能告訴我經理的行蹤嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep me informed of your whereabouts during the trip.
sentences.zh: 旅途中請隨時讓我知道你的行蹤。

sentences.en: Stop whining about the homework and start it.
sentences.zh: 別再為了功課發牢騷，快開始寫吧。

sentences.en: Why does he always whine about the weather?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼總是對天氣發牢騷？

sentences.en: The puppy began to whine at the door.
sentences.zh: 小狗開始在門口哀鳴。

sentences.en: Do your kids whine when they are tired?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子累的時候會發牢騷嗎？

sentences.en: Nobody likes a coworker who whines all day.
sentences.zh: 沒有人喜歡整天發牢騷的同事。

sentences.en: The dog whined until we opened the gate.
sentences.zh: 狗一直哀鳴，直到我們打開大門。

gloss_note: buy from a wholesaler 向批發商進貨

sentences.en: We buy our vegetables from a local wholesaler.
sentences.zh: 我們向當地的批發商採購蔬菜。

sentences.en: Is the wholesaler offering a discount on large orders?
sentences.zh: 批發商對大量訂單有提供折扣嗎？

sentences.en: The wholesaler delivers to our store every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 批發商每週二送貨到我們店裡。

sentences.en: A wholesaler sells goods in large quantities to retail stores.
sentences.zh: 批發商把商品大量賣給零售店。

sentences.en: Our wholesaler raised prices again this month.
sentences.zh: 我們的批發商這個月又漲價了。

sentences.en: Can we find a cheaper wholesaler for these cups?
sentences.zh: 我們能為這些杯子找到更便宜的批發商嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a blonde wig to the costume party.
sentences.zh: 她戴著金色假髮去參加變裝派對。

sentences.en: Does this wig look natural?
sentences.zh: 這頂假髮看起來自然嗎？

sentences.en: The actor put on a wig for the role.
sentences.zh: 演員為了這個角色戴上了假髮。

sentences.en: My aunt bought a wig after her hair got thin.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨頭髮變稀疏後買了一頂假髮。

sentences.en: Can you help me pin my wig in place?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把假髮固定好嗎？

sentences.en: The judge in the old film wore a white wig.
sentences.zh: 那部老電影裡的法官戴著白色假髮。

gloss_note: in the wilderness 在荒野中

sentences.en: We camped in the wilderness for three days.
sentences.zh: 我們在荒野露營了三天。

sentences.en: Is it safe to hike in this wilderness alone?
sentences.zh: 一個人在這片荒野健行安全嗎？

sentences.en: Wilderness covers most of the northern part of the state.
sentences.zh: 荒野占了這個州北部的大部分地區。

sentences.en: A guide led us through the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 一位嚮導帶領我們穿越荒野。

sentences.en: Would you survive alone in the wilderness for a week?
sentences.zh: 你能在荒野中獨自存活一個星期嗎？

sentences.en: Laws protect the wilderness from new roads.
sentences.zh: 法律保護荒野不被開闢新道路。

sentences.en: A small rock cracked my windshield on the highway.
sentences.zh: 一顆小石頭在高速公路上打裂了我的擋風玻璃。

sentences.en: Can you clean the windshield before we leave?
sentences.zh: 出發前你可以把擋風玻璃擦乾淨嗎？

sentences.en: Rain covered the windshield, so I slowed down.
sentences.zh: 雨水布滿了擋風玻璃，所以我放慢了車速。

sentences.en: Is the windshield covered with ice this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上擋風玻璃上結了冰嗎？

sentences.en: The mechanic replaced the broken windshield today.
sentences.zh: 技師今天換了破掉的擋風玻璃。

sentences.en: Please put the parking permit on the windshield.
sentences.zh: 請把停車許可證放在擋風玻璃上。

sentences.en: Why did the roses wither so quickly this week?
sentences.zh: 這星期玫瑰為什麼這麼快就枯萎了？

sentences.en: The plants will wither if you forget to water them.
sentences.zh: 如果你忘了澆水，這些植物會枯萎。

sentences.en: Will the leaves wither before the first frost arrives?
sentences.zh: 葉子會在第一場霜來臨前就凋謝嗎？

sentences.en: The flowers withered in the hot car.
sentences.zh: 那些花在炎熱的車裡凋謝了。

sentences.en: Farmers watched the corn wither during the long dry summer.
sentences.zh: 農夫看著玉米在漫長乾燥的夏天裡枯萎。

sentences.en: My basil always seems to wither by the window.
sentences.zh: 我的羅勒擺在窗邊好像總是會枯萎。

gloss_note: a witty remark 機智的妙語

sentences.en: Her speech was witty and made everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 她的演講風趣幽默，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: Is your new coworker always this witty?
sentences.zh: 你的新同事總是這麼機智風趣嗎？

sentences.en: He wrote a witty reply to the angry email.
sentences.zh: 他給那封憤怒的電子郵件寫了一則機智的回覆。

sentences.en: Did you read the witty comments under that video?
sentences.zh: 你看了那支影片底下那些風趣的留言嗎？

sentences.en: The witty host kept the dinner party lively.
sentences.zh: 風趣的主持人讓晚宴一直很熱鬧。

sentences.en: My grandfather is witty, even when he is tired.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺即使累了還是很風趣。

gloss_note: financial woes 財務困境（常用複數）

sentences.en: The company's financial woes got worse last quarter.
sentences.zh: 公司的財務困境在上一季更加惡化。

sentences.en: Can the new manager solve our staffing woes?
sentences.zh: 新經理能解決我們人手不足的困境嗎？

sentences.en: She told me all her woes over lunch.
sentences.zh: 她午餐時把所有煩惱都告訴了我。

sentences.en: What caused the shipping woes at the warehouse?
sentences.zh: 是什麼造成倉庫的出貨困境？

sentences.en: Rising rent added to the small shop's woes.
sentences.zh: 租金上漲讓這家小店的困境雪上加霜。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to hear my money woes again.
sentences.zh: 沒有人想再聽我的金錢煩惱了。

sentences.en: Are these mushrooms picked from the woodland?
sentences.zh: 這些蘑菇是從林地採來的嗎？

sentences.en: We hiked through the woodland before lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐前我們在樹林裡健行。

sentences.en: The restaurant gets its herbs from a nearby woodland.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的香草來自附近的林地。

sentences.en: Do deer live in this woodland?
sentences.zh: 這片樹林裡有鹿嗎？

sentences.en: Woodland covers about a third of the county.
sentences.zh: 林地約占這個郡三分之一的面積。

sentences.en: The picnic table sits at the edge of the woodland.
sentences.zh: 野餐桌就在林地的邊緣。

sentences.en: Please add a new worksheet for the March budget.
sentences.zh: 請為三月預算新增一個工作表。

sentences.en: Which worksheet has the final sales numbers?
sentences.zh: 哪一個工作表有最終的銷售數字？

sentences.en: I'll email you the worksheet with the cost estimates.
sentences.zh: 我會把有成本估算的工作表用電子郵件寄給你。

sentences.en: The worksheet shows our monthly expenses in detail.
sentences.zh: 這份工作表詳細列出了我們每月的支出。

sentences.en: Did you lock the worksheet before sharing it?
sentences.zh: 你分享之前有把工作表鎖定嗎？

sentences.en: Her worksheet tracks every order from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 她的工作表追蹤每一筆訂單從頭到尾的進度。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: Will the traffic worsen after the road closes?
sentences.zh: 道路封閉後交通會變得更糟嗎？

sentences.en: Our cash problems could worsen if sales keep dropping.
sentences.zh: 如果銷售持續下滑，我們的資金問題可能會惡化。

sentences.en: His cough began to worsen overnight.
sentences.zh: 他的咳嗽在一夜之間開始惡化。

sentences.en: Did the storm worsen the delays at the airport?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨讓機場的延誤更嚴重了嗎？

sentences.en: Experts say the shortage may worsen next year.
sentences.zh: 專家說這項短缺明年可能會惡化。

sentences.en: Let's fix it before the problem worsens.
sentences.zh: 我們在問題惡化前把它修好吧。

sentences.en: Many kids worship their favorite soccer player.
sentences.zh: 許多孩子崇拜自己最喜歡的足球選手。

sentences.en: Why do fans worship that singer so much?
sentences.zh: 為什麼粉絲這麼崇拜那位歌手？

sentences.en: Hero worship can make people overlook flaws.
sentences.zh: 英雄崇拜可能讓人忽略缺點。

sentences.en: Did you worship your older brother when you were small?
sentences.zh: 你小時候崇拜你哥哥嗎？

sentences.en: She worships her grandmother and wants to be just like her.
sentences.zh: 她敬仰她的祖母，想變得跟她一模一樣。

sentences.en: The students worship their coach after the big win.
sentences.zh: 大勝之後，學生們都崇拜他們的教練。

gloss_note: a worthwhile effort 值得的努力

sentences.en: Is the extra training really worthwhile?
sentences.zh: 這額外的訓練真的值得嗎？

sentences.en: The long drive was worthwhile because the view was amazing.
sentences.zh: 這趟長途開車很值得，因為風景太棒了。

sentences.en: It's worthwhile to compare prices before you buy.
sentences.zh: 買東西前比價是值得的。

sentences.en: She said the course was a worthwhile investment.
sentences.zh: 她說這門課是一項值得的投資。

sentences.en: Would a bigger office be worthwhile for a small team?
sentences.zh: 對一個小團隊來說，更大的辦公室值得嗎？

sentences.en: Volunteering at the school felt worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 在學校當志工讓人覺得很值得。

sentences.en: Is this old laptop worthy of repair?
sentences.zh: 這台舊筆電值得修理嗎？

sentences.en: She is a worthy winner of the award.
sentences.zh: 她是當之無愧的得獎者。

sentences.en: This idea is worthy of more discussion.
sentences.zh: 這個想法值得多討論一下。

sentences.en: Do you think he is worthy of the promotion?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他配得上這次升遷嗎？

sentences.en: They were a worthy opponent in the finals.
sentences.zh: 他們是決賽中值得敬重的對手。

sentences.en: Raising money for the library is a worthy cause.
sentences.zh: 為圖書館募款是一件值得投入的事。

sentences.en: The couple bought a small yacht last spring.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻去年春天買了一艘小遊艇。

sentences.en: Can we rent a yacht for the wedding party?
sentences.zh: 我們可以為婚禮派對租一艘遊艇嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle spends every summer weekend on his yacht.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔每個夏天的週末都待在他的遊艇上。

sentences.en: Do you know how much a new yacht costs?
sentences.zh: 你知道一艘新遊艇要多少錢嗎？

sentences.en: A white yacht floated quietly in the harbor.
sentences.zh: 一艘白色遊艇靜靜地漂浮在港口。

sentences.en: The captain showed us around the yacht.
sentences.zh: 船長帶我們參觀了這艘遊艇。

sentences.en: Bread needs yeast to rise properly.
sentences.zh: 麵包需要酵母才能正常發酵膨脹。

sentences.en: Did you add the yeast to warm water?
sentences.zh: 你有把酵母加進溫水裡嗎？

sentences.en: Yeast eats sugar and releases gas.
sentences.zh: 酵母會吃掉糖並釋放出氣體。

sentences.en: How long should the yeast mixture sit before baking?
sentences.zh: 酵母混合液在烘烤前應該靜置多久？

sentences.en: Old yeast won't make the dough rise.
sentences.zh: 放太久的酵母無法讓麵團膨脹。

sentences.en: Scientists use yeast to study how cells grow.
sentences.zh: 科學家用酵母來研究細胞如何生長。

gloss_note: 多用於狗，因痛或受驚而叫

sentences.en: The puppy gave a yelp when I stepped on its tail.
sentences.zh: 我踩到小狗的尾巴時，牠發出一聲短促的尖叫。

sentences.en: Did you hear a dog yelp outside the restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到餐廳外面有狗在哀叫嗎？

sentences.en: She let out a yelp when hot soup splashed her hand.
sentences.zh: 熱湯濺到她的手時，她短促地叫了一聲。

sentences.en: Did the cat yelp when the door closed?
sentences.zh: 門關上的時候，貓有尖叫嗎？

sentences.en: We heard a sharp yelp from the backyard.
sentences.zh: 我們聽到後院傳來一聲尖銳的哀叫。

sentences.en: The dog began to yelp at the loud fireworks.
sentences.zh: 狗被響亮的煙火嚇得開始哀叫。

sentences.en: Will this land yield enough corn this year?
sentences.zh: 這塊地今年能產出足夠的玉米嗎？

sentences.en: The new seeds gave us a much higher yield.
sentences.zh: 新種子讓我們的產量高出許多。

sentences.en: Savings accounts yield very little interest now.
sentences.zh: 現在儲蓄帳戶幾乎產生不了什麼利息。

sentences.en: What is the average yield per acre on this farm?
sentences.zh: 這座農場每英畝的平均產量是多少？

sentences.en: The pear trees in our yard yield fruit every fall.
sentences.zh: 我們院子裡的梨樹每年秋天都會結果。

sentences.en: Heavy rain reduced this year's wheat yield.
sentences.zh: 大雨使今年的小麥產量減少。

sentences.en: How do you abbreviate a long street name on a form?
sentences.zh: 你在表格上會怎麼縮寫很長的街名？

sentences.en: Can I abbreviate this title to fit the box?
sentences.zh: 我可以把這個標題縮寫，好讓它放進方框裡嗎？

sentences.en: We abbreviate the long report title in emails.
sentences.zh: 我們在電子郵件裡會把報告的長標題縮寫。

sentences.en: People often abbreviate words in text messages.
sentences.zh: 人們常在簡訊裡縮寫單字。

sentences.en: The teacher told us not to abbreviate in essays.
sentences.zh: 老師叫我們寫作文時不要縮寫。

sentences.en: On addresses, we abbreviate state names to two letters.
sentences.zh: 在地址上，我們會把州名縮寫成兩個字母。

gloss_note: abide by the rules 遵守規定

sentences.en: All guests must abide by the hotel rules.
sentences.zh: 所有住客都必須遵守飯店規定。

sentences.en: Will both sides abide by the agreement?
sentences.zh: 雙方會遵守這份協議嗎？

sentences.en: Drivers should abide by the speed limit.
sentences.zh: 駕駛人應該遵守速限。

sentences.en: Do you always abide by the dress code at work?
sentences.zh: 你在公司都會遵守服裝規定嗎？

sentences.en: She promised to abide by the judge's decision.
sentences.zh: 她承諾服從法官的裁決。

sentences.en: Our team abides by a few simple rules.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊遵守幾條簡單的規則。

gloss_note: 澳洲、加拿大常用；美國多說 Indigenous

sentences.en: The museum has a large aboriginal art collection.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有大量原住民藝術的收藏。

sentences.en: Is that aboriginal language still taught in schools?
sentences.zh: 那種原住民語言現在學校還有教嗎？

sentences.en: She wrote a paper on aboriginal music.
sentences.zh: 她寫了一篇關於原住民音樂的論文。

sentences.en: Aboriginal communities held a festival last weekend.
sentences.zh: 原住民社區上週末舉辦了一場慶典。

sentences.en: Did you see the aboriginal dance at the festival?
sentences.zh: 你有看到慶典上的原住民舞蹈嗎？

sentences.en: The guide explained aboriginal stories about the river.
sentences.zh: 導覽員解說了關於這條河的原住民故事。

sentences.en: Fresh fruit abounds at the summer market.
sentences.zh: 夏季市集上有大量新鮮水果。

sentences.en: Do rumors abound whenever a company changes owners?
sentences.zh: 每當公司換老闆，傳言就會四處流傳嗎？

sentences.en: Opportunities abound for people who speak two languages.
sentences.zh: 會說兩種語言的人有很多機會。

sentences.en: Fish abound in this clear lake.
sentences.zh: 這座清澈的湖裡魚很多。

sentences.en: Do good restaurants abound in your neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你們社區裡好餐廳很多嗎？

sentences.en: Mistakes abound in the first draft of the report.
sentences.zh: 報告的初稿中到處都是錯誤。

gloss_note: a pure abstraction 純粹抽象的東西

sentences.en: Is freedom just an abstraction to young children?
sentences.zh: 對年幼的孩子來說，自由只是個抽象概念嗎？

sentences.en: Math becomes more about abstraction in high school.
sentences.zh: 高中的數學更偏重抽象思考。

sentences.en: Love is an abstraction that is hard to define.
sentences.zh: 愛是一個很難定義的抽象概念。

sentences.en: Can you explain this abstraction with a simple example?
sentences.zh: 你可以用簡單的例子解釋這個抽象概念嗎？

sentences.en: The painter moved away from reality toward abstraction.
sentences.zh: 這位畫家從寫實走向抽象。

sentences.en: A budget feels like an abstraction until you spend it.
sentences.zh: 預算在你花錢之前，感覺只是個抽象的概念。

sentences.en: The farm has an abundance of fresh vegetables.
sentences.zh: 這座農場有大量新鮮蔬菜。

sentences.en: Is there an abundance of parking near the stadium?
sentences.zh: 球場附近有很多停車位嗎？

sentences.en: Wildflowers grow in abundance on the hillside.
sentences.zh: 山坡上野花盛開，數量繁多。

sentences.en: We have an abundance of ideas but little time.
sentences.zh: 我們點子很多，但時間很少。

sentences.en: Did the wet spring bring an abundance of berries?
sentences.zh: 潮濕的春天帶來大量莓果了嗎？

sentences.en: She was surprised by the abundance of food at the party.
sentences.zh: 她對派對上豐盛的食物感到驚訝。

sentences.en: She studied cooking at a small academy downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區一所小學院學烹飪。

sentences.en: Is the music academy still accepting students?
sentences.zh: 這所音樂學院還在招生嗎？

sentences.en: The art academy offers evening classes for adults.
sentences.zh: 這所藝術學院為成年人開設夜間課程。

sentences.en: The police academy trains new officers for months.
sentences.zh: 警察學院對新進警員進行為期數個月的訓練。

sentences.en: Did you graduate from the same academy as your father?
sentences.zh: 你和你爸爸畢業於同一所學院嗎？

sentences.en: The academy will hold an open house on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 這所學院週六會舉辦開放參觀日。

sentences.en: The new film won critical acclaim this fall.
sentences.zh: 這部新電影今年秋天贏得影評界的讚譽。

sentences.en: Was the author's first book widely acclaimed?
sentences.zh: 這位作家的第一本書廣受讚譽嗎？

sentences.en: Her design earned acclaim from clients across the country.
sentences.zh: 她的設計贏得全國客戶的讚譽。

sentences.en: Did the team's new product receive any acclaim?
sentences.zh: 這個團隊的新產品有受到任何讚譽嗎？

sentences.en: The play was acclaimed as the best show of the year.
sentences.zh: 這齣戲被盛讚為年度最佳演出。

sentences.en: The director deserves acclaim for his bold new film.
sentences.zh: 這位導演的大膽新片值得讚譽。

sentences.en: Many people get acne during their teens.
sentences.zh: 許多人在十幾歲時會長青春痘。

sentences.en: Does chocolate really cause acne?
sentences.zh: 巧克力真的會讓人長痘痘嗎？

sentences.en: She uses a gentle soap to fight acne.
sentences.zh: 她用溫和的肥皂來對付痘痘。

sentences.en: My brother's acne cleared up after a few months.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟的痘痘幾個月後就消了。

sentences.en: Should I see a doctor about my acne?
sentences.zh: 我的痘痘該去看醫生嗎？

sentences.en: Stress and poor sleep can make acne worse.
sentences.zh: 壓力和睡眠不足會讓痘痘更嚴重。

sentences.en: Phone addiction is a growing problem among teens.
sentences.zh: 手機成癮是青少年之間日益嚴重的問題。

sentences.en: Do you think video games can cause addiction?
sentences.zh: 你覺得電玩會造成上癮嗎？

sentences.en: His addiction to sugar makes dieting hard.
sentences.zh: 他對糖上癮，讓節食很困難。
