sentences.en: How can I break my addiction to coffee?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼戒掉咖啡癮？

sentences.en: Online shopping addiction left her with huge bills.
sentences.zh: 網購成癮讓她背了一大筆帳單。

sentences.en: Her addiction to social media eats up hours each day.
sentences.zh: 她沉迷社群媒體，每天都耗掉好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Who will administrate the new training program?
sentences.zh: 誰來管理這項新的培訓計畫？

sentences.en: She administrates the school's online system.
sentences.zh: 她負責管理學校的網路系統。

sentences.en: Can one person administrate the whole warehouse?
sentences.zh: 一個人能管理整座倉庫嗎？

sentences.en: The office manager will administrate the budget.
sentences.zh: 辦公室經理會管理這筆預算。

sentences.en: It takes time to administrate a large hospital.
sentences.zh: 管理一家大型醫院需要時間。

sentences.en: He was hired to administrate the city's parks.
sentences.zh: 他被聘來管理這座城市的公園。

gloss_note: fleet admiral 海軍五星上將

sentences.en: The admiral gave orders to the whole fleet.
sentences.zh: 海軍上將向整支艦隊下達命令。

sentences.en: Who played the admiral in that old sea movie?
sentences.zh: 那部老海戰電影裡，誰演海軍上將？

sentences.en: My grandfather dreamed of becoming an admiral.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺曾夢想成為海軍上將。

sentences.en: The admiral visited the ship before it sailed.
sentences.zh: 海軍上將在船啟航前視察了這艘船。

sentences.en: Is an admiral higher in rank than a captain?
sentences.zh: 海軍上將的軍階比上校高嗎？

sentences.en: A statue of the admiral stands in the harbor.
sentences.zh: 這位海軍上將的雕像矗立在港口。

sentences.en: Adolescence can be a confusing time for many kids.
sentences.zh: 青春期對許多孩子來說可能是個令人困惑的時期。

sentences.en: What changes happen to the body during adolescence?
sentences.zh: 青春期時身體會有什麼變化？

sentences.en: She spent her adolescence in a small coastal town.
sentences.zh: 她的青少年時期是在海邊小鎮度過的。

sentences.en: Does adolescence last longer than it used to?
sentences.zh: 青春期持續的時間比以前更長嗎？

sentences.en: He was quiet and shy throughout his adolescence.
sentences.zh: 他整個青少年時期都安靜又害羞。

sentences.en: Many parents find adolescence hard to handle.
sentences.zh: 許多父母覺得青春期很難應付。

sentences.en: Do I need an advance reservation for six people?
sentences.zh: 六個人的話，我需要預先訂位嗎？

sentences.en: Please give us advance notice for large catering orders.
sentences.zh: 大型外燴訂單請事先通知我們。

sentences.en: The restaurant asks for an advance deposit for large groups.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳要求大型團體預先付訂金。

sentences.en: Is an advance order required for the birthday cake?
sentences.zh: 生日蛋糕需要預先訂購嗎？

sentences.en: Advance booking is required for the chef's tasting menu.
sentences.zh: 主廚的品嚐套餐需要事先預約。

sentences.en: Advance tickets for the food festival sell quickly.
sentences.zh: 美食節的預售票賣得很快。

gloss_note: an affectionate hug 親暱的擁抱

sentences.en: Our dog is very affectionate with children.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗對孩子很親暱。

sentences.en: Is your cat always this affectionate?
sentences.zh: 你的貓總是這麼親暱嗎？

sentences.en: She gave her grandmother an affectionate hug.
sentences.zh: 她給了奶奶一個親暱的擁抱。

sentences.en: He is shy but very affectionate with his family.
sentences.zh: 他很害羞，但對家人非常親暱。

sentences.en: Why are some cats so affectionate and others so cold?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些貓這麼親暱，有些卻那麼冷淡？

sentences.en: The couple exchanged affectionate glances across the table.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻隔著桌子互相投以深情的目光。

sentences.en: Can I get agave syrup instead of sugar in my tea?
sentences.zh: 我的茶可以加龍舌蘭糖漿而不加糖嗎？

sentences.en: This cafe sweetens its lemonade with agave.
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店用龍舌蘭糖漿為檸檬汁增加甜味。

sentences.en: Agave grows well in dry, sunny places.
sentences.zh: 龍舌蘭在乾燥、陽光充足的地方生長良好。

sentences.en: Is agave sweeter than honey?
sentences.zh: 龍舌蘭糖漿比蜂蜜甜嗎？

sentences.en: She poured agave over the warm pancakes.
sentences.zh: 她把龍舌蘭糖漿倒在熱騰騰的鬆餅上。

sentences.en: The recipe calls for two tablespoons of agave.
sentences.zh: 食譜需要兩大匙龍舌蘭糖漿。

sentences.en: Store the cookies in an airtight container.
sentences.zh: 請把餅乾存放在密封容器裡。

sentences.en: Is this lid really airtight?
sentences.zh: 這個蓋子真的完全密封嗎？

sentences.en: Our contract is airtight, so we won't lose.
sentences.zh: 我們的合約滴水不漏，所以我們不會輸。

sentences.en: Did the team find an airtight plan for the launch?
sentences.zh: 團隊為新品上市找到無懈可擊的計畫了嗎？

sentences.en: The jar must be airtight to keep the jam fresh.
sentences.zh: 罐子必須密封，果醬才能保持新鮮。

sentences.en: He gave an airtight explanation for the delay.
sentences.zh: 他對延誤做出了無懈可擊的解釋。

gloss_note: clear the airway 清理呼吸道

sentences.en: The nurse checked that his airway was clear.
sentences.zh: 護理師確認他的呼吸道是暢通的。

sentences.en: Can dust irritate the airway?
sentences.zh: 灰塵會刺激呼吸道嗎？

sentences.en: A small piece of food blocked the baby's airway.
sentences.zh: 一小塊食物卡住了寶寶的呼吸道。

sentences.en: Why does cold air make my airway feel tight?
sentences.zh: 為什麼冷空氣會讓我的呼吸道覺得緊緊的？

sentences.en: Heavy smoke can damage the airway over time.
sentences.zh: 濃煙長期下來會傷害呼吸道。

sentences.en: Doctors use a tube to keep the airway open.
sentences.zh: 醫生用一根管子保持呼吸道暢通。

sentences.en: Harsh comments can alienate your coworkers.
sentences.zh: 刻薄的評論會讓同事疏遠你。

sentences.en: Will this new rule alienate our best customers?
sentences.zh: 這項新規定會讓我們最好的客戶反感嗎？

sentences.en: He didn't mean to alienate his friends.
sentences.zh: 他無意讓朋友們疏遠他。

sentences.en: Do long work hours alienate parents from their kids?
sentences.zh: 長時間工作會讓父母和孩子變得疏遠嗎？

sentences.en: The ad may alienate older shoppers.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告可能會讓年長的顧客反感。

sentences.en: The constant teasing alienated him from his classmates.
sentences.zh: 不斷被取笑讓他和同學之間產生隔閡。

gloss_note: allege that… 聲稱…（新聞用語）

sentences.en: Police allege that the thief entered through a window.
sentences.zh: 警方指稱竊賊是從窗戶進入的。

sentences.en: Did anyone allege that the report was wrong?
sentences.zh: 有人聲稱這份報告有誤嗎？

sentences.en: She alleges that her boss ignored her emails.
sentences.zh: 她聲稱她的老闆不理會她的電子郵件。

sentences.en: What do the critics allege about the new company policy?
sentences.zh: 批評者對公司的新政策有什麼指控？

sentences.en: The article alleges the store charged too much.
sentences.zh: 這篇文章指稱這家店收費過高。

sentences.en: Some customers allege that the app deleted their files.
sentences.zh: 一些顧客聲稱應用程式刪掉了他們的檔案。

sentences.en: An alligator slept on the bank of the river.
sentences.zh: 一隻短吻鱷在河岸上睡覺。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a real alligator?
sentences.zh: 你看過真正的短吻鱷嗎？

sentences.en: The zoo keeps a large alligator in a pond.
sentences.zh: 動物園在池塘裡養了一隻大短吻鱷。

sentences.en: Alligators can swim much faster than people.
sentences.zh: 短吻鱷游泳比人快得多。

sentences.en: Do alligators live in cold climates?
sentences.zh: 短吻鱷會住在寒冷的氣候裡嗎？

sentences.en: Our guide warned us to stay away from the alligator.
sentences.zh: 導遊警告我們要遠離那隻短吻鱷。

sentences.en: I love the cozy ambiance of this restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這家餐廳溫馨的氣氛。

sentences.en: Does the cafe have a quiet ambiance at night?
sentences.zh: 這家咖啡店晚上氣氛安靜嗎？

sentences.en: Soft lights create a warm ambiance.
sentences.zh: 柔和的燈光營造出溫暖的氣氛。

sentences.en: The food was good, but the ambiance was too noisy.
sentences.zh: 食物不錯，但氣氛太吵了。

sentences.en: Did you choose this place for its romantic ambiance?
sentences.zh: 你選這個地方是因為它浪漫的氣氛嗎？

sentences.en: Live music adds a lot to the ambiance here.
sentences.zh: 現場音樂為這裡的氣氛加分不少。

gloss_note: remove ambiguity 消除含糊之處

sentences.en: The contract's ambiguity caused a long argument.
sentences.zh: 合約的含糊不清引發了一場長時間的爭論。

sentences.en: Is there any ambiguity in these instructions?
sentences.zh: 這些說明有任何含糊之處嗎？

sentences.en: She asked for clarity to remove the ambiguity.
sentences.zh: 她要求說明清楚，以消除含糊之處。

sentences.en: Poetry often uses ambiguity on purpose.
sentences.zh: 詩常常刻意使用歧義。

sentences.en: Why does this question have so much ambiguity?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個問題這麼含糊不清？

sentences.en: The ambiguity in his answer worried the interviewer.
sentences.zh: 他回答中的含糊讓面試官擔心。

gloss_note: amplify the sound 放大聲音

sentences.en: Can this speaker amplify my voice in a big room?
sentences.zh: 這個喇叭能在大房間裡放大我的聲音嗎？

sentences.en: Social media can amplify small rumors.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體會放大小謠言。

sentences.en: The microphone will amplify every sound on stage.
sentences.zh: 麥克風會放大舞台上的每個聲音。

sentences.en: Did the empty hall amplify the noise?
sentences.zh: 空蕩蕩的大廳讓噪音變大了嗎？

sentences.en: We need to amplify our message to reach more customers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要加強我們傳達的訊息，才能接觸更多顧客。

sentences.en: Stress can amplify small problems at work.
sentences.zh: 壓力會把工作上的小問題放大。

sentences.en: The sailors dropped the anchor near the shore.
sentences.zh: 水手們在岸邊附近拋下了錨。

sentences.en: Can we anchor the boat here for the night?
sentences.zh: 我們今晚可以把船停泊在這裡嗎？

sentences.en: This heavy anchor keeps the ship from drifting.
sentences.zh: 這個沉重的錨讓船不會漂走。

sentences.en: Did you anchor the tent with rocks?
sentences.zh: 你有用石頭固定帳篷嗎？

sentences.en: We will anchor the shelf to the wall.
sentences.zh: 我們會把架子固定在牆上。

sentences.en: A rusty anchor lay on the dock.
sentences.zh: 一個生鏽的錨躺在碼頭上。

sentences.en: We decided to start the project anew.
sentences.zh: 我們決定重新開始這個專案。

sentences.en: She wrote the proposal anew after the feedback.
sentences.zh: 她根據意見回饋重新寫了提案。

sentences.en: He wants to build the website anew. Is that realistic?
sentences.zh: 他想重新建置這個網站。這可行嗎？

sentences.en: They painted the lobby anew. Have you seen it?
sentences.zh: 他們把大廳重新粉刷過了。你看過了嗎？

sentences.en: The data was lost, so we had to count the stock anew.
sentences.zh: 資料遺失了，所以我們得重新清點庫存。

sentences.en: After the merger, the company set goals anew.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，公司重新設定了目標。

gloss_note: animate a drawing 讓圖畫動起來

sentences.en: Good music can animate a quiet party.
sentences.zh: 好音樂能讓安靜的派對活絡起來。

sentences.en: Our team will animate the logo for the website.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊會把網站標誌製成動畫。

sentences.en: Can you animate these drawings on a computer?
sentences.zh: 你能用電腦把這些圖畫製成動畫嗎？

sentences.en: Her stories animate even the dullest meetings.
sentences.zh: 她的故事連最無聊的會議也能變得生動。

sentences.en: How long does it take to animate one minute of film?
sentences.zh: 把一分鐘的影片製成動畫要花多久？

sentences.en: The teacher used pictures to animate the lesson.
sentences.zh: 老師用圖片讓課程變得生動。

sentences.en: The loud construction was a daily annoyance.
sentences.zh: 嘈雜的施工每天都讓人心煩。

sentences.en: She sighed in annoyance when the printer jammed.
sentences.zh: 印表機卡紙時，她惱怒地嘆了口氣。

sentences.en: Is slow internet your biggest annoyance at work?
sentences.zh: 網路很慢是你在工作上最大的困擾嗎？

sentences.en: To my annoyance, the store was already closed.
sentences.zh: 讓我惱火的是，這家店已經關門了。

sentences.en: What is your biggest annoyance when you travel?
sentences.zh: 旅行時最讓你煩的事是什麼？

sentences.en: He tried to hide his annoyance during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他試著在會議中隱藏自己的惱怒。

sentences.en: The band played the national anthem before the parade.
sentences.zh: 遊行開始前，樂隊演奏了國歌。

sentences.en: Who sang the anthem before the game?
sentences.zh: 比賽前是誰唱國歌？

sentences.en: That song became the anthem of our summer.
sentences.zh: 那首歌成了我們那年夏天的代表曲。

sentences.en: Is this song really the anthem of your generation?
sentences.zh: 這首歌真的是你們這一代的代表曲嗎？

sentences.en: The new movie has a powerful anthem at the end.
sentences.zh: 這部新電影結尾有一首震撼人心的主題曲。

sentences.en: Fans sang the team anthem together in the rain.
sentences.zh: 球迷在雨中一起高唱隊歌。

sentences.en: The kids waited for the cake with great anticipation.
sentences.zh: 孩子們滿心期待地等著蛋糕。

sentences.en: Is there much anticipation for the new phone?
sentences.zh: 大家對新手機很期待嗎？

sentences.en: In anticipation of the storm, we bought extra water.
sentences.zh: 預期暴風雨要來，我們多買了一些水。

sentences.en: The stores hired more workers in anticipation of crowds.
sentences.zh: 商店預期會有大批人潮，所以多僱了人。

sentences.en: Her voice shook with anticipation before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前，她的聲音因期待而發抖。

sentences.en: How can we build anticipation before the launch?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在新品上市前營造期待感？

gloss_note: antonym 反義詞；synonym 同義詞

sentences.en: What is the antonym of easy?
sentences.zh: 「容易」的反義詞是什麼？

sentences.en: Cold is the antonym of hot.
sentences.zh: 冷是熱的反義詞。

sentences.en: Can you give me an antonym for happy?
sentences.zh: 你能給我「快樂」的反義詞嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to find an antonym for each word.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們為每個單字找出一個反義詞。

sentences.en: A good dictionary often lists an antonym next to each entry.
sentences.zh: 好的字典常在每個詞條旁列出反義詞。

sentences.en: I forgot the antonym, so I looked it up online.
sentences.zh: 我忘了那個反義詞，所以上網查了。

gloss_note: apparently 美式口語常指「聽說」

sentences.en: Apparently the cafe closed early today. Did you know that?
sentences.zh: 看來咖啡店今天提早打烊了。你知道嗎？

sentences.en: Apparently the soup is spicy. Should I order something else?
sentences.zh: 看來這道湯很辣。我該點別的嗎？

sentences.en: She apparently forgot to bring the cake.
sentences.zh: 她看來是忘了帶蛋糕。

sentences.en: Apparently, they ran out of fresh bread by noon.
sentences.zh: 據說他們中午前就把新鮮麵包賣完了。

sentences.en: The chef apparently learned to cook from his grandmother.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚據說是跟他的祖母學做菜的。

sentences.en: He apparently didn't like the dessert. Do you know why?
sentences.zh: 他看來不喜歡那道甜點。你知道為什麼嗎？

sentences.en: The audience began to applaud after the last song.
sentences.zh: 最後一首歌結束後，觀眾開始鼓掌。

sentences.en: Everyone stood to applaud the winning team.
sentences.zh: 大家起立為獲勝的球隊鼓掌。

sentences.en: Did the crowd applaud when she finished her speech?
sentences.zh: 她演講結束時群眾有鼓掌嗎？

sentences.en: I applaud your effort to finish the work early.
sentences.zh: 我很讚賞你想提早完成工作的努力。

sentences.en: Parents applauded the school's new reading program.
sentences.zh: 家長們稱讚學校的新閱讀計畫。

sentences.en: Why do we applaud at the end of a play?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們在戲劇結束時要鼓掌？

sentences.en: I felt apprehensive before my first big presentation.
sentences.zh: 在第一次重要簡報之前，我覺得很憂慮。

sentences.en: Are you apprehensive about the new manager?
sentences.zh: 你對新經理感到擔心嗎？

sentences.en: The staff was apprehensive about the upcoming merger.
sentences.zh: 員工對即將到來的合併感到憂慮。

sentences.en: She looked apprehensive as the plane took off.
sentences.zh: 飛機起飛時，她看起來很擔心。

sentences.en: Why are the customers so apprehensive about the new system?
sentences.zh: 顧客為什麼對新系統這麼擔心？

sentences.en: He gave us an apprehensive smile at the door.
sentences.zh: 他在門口對我們露出憂慮的微笑。

sentences.en: The ball flew in a high arc over the fence.
sentences.zh: 球以高高的弧線飛過圍籬。

sentences.en: Can you draw an arc with a compass?
sentences.zh: 你能用圓規畫一條弧線嗎？

sentences.en: The bridge forms a graceful arc across the river.
sentences.zh: 這座橋在河面上形成優美的弧形。

sentences.en: Does the chart show an arc or a straight line?
sentences.zh: 這張圖表呈現的是弧線還是直線？

sentences.en: The lights on the ceiling form an arc.
sentences.zh: 天花板上的燈排成一個弧形。

sentences.en: A rainbow made an arc across the sky.
sentences.zh: 彩虹在天空中劃出一道弧線。

sentences.en: My daughter is learning basic arithmetic in second grade.
sentences.zh: 我女兒二年級正在學基本算術。

sentences.en: Can you do this arithmetic in your head?
sentences.zh: 你可以用心算算出這個嗎？

sentences.en: Did the cashier make an arithmetic mistake on the bill?
sentences.zh: 收銀員是不是把帳單算錯了？

sentences.en: The teacher gave us ten arithmetic problems for homework.
sentences.zh: 老師出了十題算術題當回家作業。

sentences.en: Simple arithmetic shows we're short about two hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 簡單算一下就知道我們還差大約兩百美元。

sentences.en: He was quick at arithmetic even as a little boy.
sentences.zh: 他從小算術就算得很快。

sentences.en: Could we change the seating arrangement for our party?
sentences.zh: 我們的聚會可以換一下座位安排嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter set the fruit in a pretty arrangement on the platter.
sentences.zh: 服務生把水果擺成漂亮的造型放在大盤上。

sentences.en: We made all the arrangements for the banquet last week.
sentences.zh: 宴席的一切安排我們上週就處理好了。

sentences.en: Does this table arrangement leave enough room for everyone?
sentences.zh: 這樣的桌位安排夠每個人坐嗎？

sentences.en: The chef's arrangement of the sushi on the plate was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 主廚把壽司在盤中擺得非常漂亮。

sentences.en: What arrangement did you make with the caterer for Saturday?
sentences.zh: 你和外燴業者為週六談好什麼安排了？

sentences.en: Have you ever tried a steamed artichoke with butter sauce?
sentences.zh: 你吃過蒸朝鮮薊配奶油醬嗎？

sentences.en: I bought two artichokes at the farmers market today.
sentences.zh: 我今天在農夫市集買了兩顆朝鮮薊。

sentences.en: This spinach and artichoke dip is my favorite appetizer.
sentences.zh: 這道菠菜朝鮮薊沾醬是我最愛的開胃菜。

sentences.en: Do you want artichoke hearts on your pizza?
sentences.zh: 你的披薩要加朝鮮薊心嗎？

sentences.en: You pull off each leaf of the artichoke and dip it.
sentences.zh: 你把朝鮮薊的葉片一片片剝下來沾醬吃。

sentences.en: My grandmother grew artichoke plants in her backyard.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶以前在後院種朝鮮薊。

sentences.en: Could I get the salad with arugula instead of lettuce?
sentences.zh: 沙拉可以用芝麻葉代替生菜嗎？

sentences.en: Arugula has a slightly spicy, peppery flavor.
sentences.zh: 芝麻葉帶有微微辛辣的胡椒味。

sentences.en: I put fresh arugula and parmesan on the pizza.
sentences.zh: 我在披薩上放了新鮮芝麻葉和帕瑪森起司。

sentences.en: Is this arugula organic, or from a regular farm?
sentences.zh: 這芝麻葉是有機的，還是一般農場種的？

sentences.en: She tossed the arugula with lemon juice and olive oil.
sentences.zh: 她用檸檬汁和橄欖油拌芝麻葉。

sentences.en: The server recommended the arugula salad with grilled chicken.
sentences.zh: 服務生推薦了烤雞芝麻葉沙拉。

gloss_note: 較正式；ascend the stairs 登上階梯

sentences.en: The balloon began to ascend slowly above the field.
sentences.zh: 熱氣球開始在田野上方緩緩上升。

sentences.en: We watched the hikers ascend the steep trail.
sentences.zh: 我們看著登山客爬上陡峭的山徑。

sentences.en: Does this road ascend all the way to the top of the hill?
sentences.zh: 這條路會一路往上通到山頂嗎？

sentences.en: The plane will ascend to thirty thousand feet soon.
sentences.zh: 飛機很快就會爬升到三萬英尺的高度。

sentences.en: Did you see the smoke ascend into the sky?
sentences.zh: 你有看到煙往天空升起嗎？

sentences.en: Visitors ascend the stone steps to reach the old tower.
sentences.zh: 遊客要登上石階才能到達古老的塔樓。

sentences.en: Many students aspire to attend a good university.
sentences.zh: 許多學生立志要上好大學。

sentences.en: Do you aspire to become a manager someday?
sentences.zh: 你有志成為經理嗎？

sentences.en: She has aspired to be a doctor since she was ten.
sentences.zh: 她從十歲起就立志成為醫生。

sentences.en: What do you aspire to do after you graduate?
sentences.zh: 你畢業後立志要做什麼？

sentences.en: He aspires to open his own bakery in the city.
sentences.zh: 他渴望在城裡開一間自己的烘焙坊。

sentences.en: Young athletes who aspire to win medals train every day.
sentences.zh: 渴望贏得獎牌的年輕運動員每天都在訓練。

sentences.en: The movie is about a plot to assassinate a king.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一起暗殺國王的陰謀。

sentences.en: Historians still debate who tried to assassinate the emperor.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論是誰企圖暗殺皇帝。

sentences.en: Why did the rebels want to assassinate the governor?
sentences.zh: 反抗軍為什麼想暗殺那位總督？

sentences.en: Officials said the plan to assassinate the prince failed.
sentences.zh: 官員表示暗殺王子的計畫失敗了。

sentences.en: Did the spy in the film really assassinate the general?
sentences.zh: 電影裡的間諜真的暗殺了那位將軍嗎？

sentences.en: Ancient rulers often feared that someone would assassinate them.
sentences.zh: 古代統治者常擔心有人會暗殺自己。

sentences.en: My son has asthma, so he carries an inhaler.
sentences.zh: 我兒子有氣喘，所以隨身帶著吸入器。

sentences.en: Does dust make your asthma worse?
sentences.zh: 灰塵會讓你的氣喘更嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: She had a mild asthma attack during gym class.
sentences.zh: 她在體育課時輕微氣喘發作。

sentences.en: Cold air can trigger asthma in some people.
sentences.zh: 冷空氣可能誘發某些人的氣喘。

sentences.en: Is there any history of asthma in your family?
sentences.zh: 你的家族裡有人有氣喘病史嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors say pollution may raise the risk of asthma in children.
sentences.zh: 醫師表示汙染可能提高孩童罹患氣喘的風險。

gloss_note: go astray 走偏；lead astray 帶壞

sentences.en: Your package must have gone astray. Should we resend it?
sentences.zh: 您的包裹一定是送錯地方了。要我們重寄一次嗎？

sentences.en: Bad friends can lead a young person astray.
sentences.zh: 壞朋友可能把年輕人帶上歧途。

sentences.en: My directions must have led us astray, sorry. Should we turn back?
sentences.zh: 我的指示一定是帶錯路了，抱歉。要不要掉頭？

sentences.en: He feared the new crowd would lead his brother astray.
sentences.zh: 他擔心那群新朋友會把弟弟帶壞。

sentences.en: Do you worry that social media will lead your kids astray?
sentences.zh: 你會擔心社群媒體把孩子帶壞嗎？

sentences.en: A few sheep wandered astray during the storm last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚暴風雨時有幾隻羊走散，跑錯了地方。

sentences.en: My nephew wants to be an astronaut when he grows up.
sentences.zh: 我姪子長大後想當太空人。

sentences.en: Did the astronaut really spend six months in space?
sentences.zh: 那位太空人真的在太空待了六個月嗎？

sentences.en: Astronauts train for years before their first mission.
sentences.zh: 太空人在第一次任務前要訓練好幾年。

sentences.en: How do astronauts eat and sleep without gravity?
sentences.zh: 太空人在沒有重力的情況下怎麼吃飯睡覺？

sentences.en: The astronaut waved to the crowd before boarding the shuttle.
sentences.zh: 太空人在登上太空梭前向群眾揮手。

sentences.en: We met a retired astronaut at the science museum.
sentences.zh: 我們在科學博物館遇到一位退休的太空人。

sentences.en: The astronomer spotted a new comet last night.
sentences.zh: 那位天文學家昨晚發現了一顆新彗星。

sentences.en: Is your uncle an astronomer or an astronaut?
sentences.zh: 你叔叔是天文學家還是太空人？

sentences.en: Astronomers use huge telescopes to study distant stars.
sentences.zh: 天文學家用巨大的望遠鏡研究遙遠的恆星。

sentences.en: My roommate wants to become an astronomer someday.
sentences.zh: 我室友將來想當天文學家。

sentences.en: What does an astronomer do during the day?
sentences.zh: 天文學家白天都在做什麼？

sentences.en: A famous astronomer gave a talk at our school.
sentences.zh: 一位知名的天文學家到我們學校演講。

sentences.en: I'm taking an astronomy class at the community college.
sentences.zh: 我在社區大學修一門天文學課。

sentences.en: Is astronomy harder than physics for you?
sentences.zh: 對你來說，天文學比物理難嗎？

sentences.en: He has loved astronomy since his dad gave him a telescope.
sentences.zh: 自從爸爸送他望遠鏡後，他就愛上了天文學。

sentences.en: Our astronomy club meets every Friday night to watch the stars.
sentences.zh: 我們的天文社每週五晚上聚會看星星。

sentences.en: Astronomy helps us understand how the universe began.
sentences.zh: 天文學幫助我們了解宇宙是如何誕生的。

sentences.en: Do you have any good books on astronomy?
sentences.zh: 你有什麼不錯的天文學書嗎？

gloss_note: 正式字；attainment of goals 達成目標

sentences.en: The attainment of this goal will take several years.
sentences.zh: 要達成這個目標需要好幾年的時間。

sentences.en: Does your company reward the attainment of sales targets?
sentences.zh: 貴公司會獎勵達成銷售目標的人嗎？

sentences.en: She was proud of her attainment in mathematics.
sentences.zh: 她對自己在數學上的成就感到驕傲。

sentences.en: The attainment of fluency in a new language takes patience.
sentences.zh: 要精通一門新語言需要耐心。

sentences.en: The coach praised the team for the attainment of its season goals.
sentences.zh: 教練稱讚球隊達成了本季的目標。

sentences.en: How important is the attainment of a degree to you?
sentences.zh: 取得學位對你有多重要？

gloss_note: attempt to + V；比 try 正式

sentences.en: I'll attempt a new cake recipe this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我要嘗試一份新的蛋糕食譜。

sentences.en: Did you attempt the spicy noodle challenge at that restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你有去挑戰那家餐廳的辣麵嗎？

sentences.en: My first attempt at making bread was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 我第一次嘗試做麵包就搞砸了。

sentences.en: She attempted to flip the pancake without a spatula.
sentences.zh: 她試著不用鍋鏟就把鬆餅翻面。

sentences.en: Should I attempt homemade pasta for the dinner party?
sentences.zh: 晚餐派對我要不要試著自己做義大利麵？

sentences.en: His attempt to eat five tacos in ten minutes failed.
sentences.zh: 他想在十分鐘內吃完五個塔可餅的嘗試失敗了。

gloss_note: audition for a role 試鏡某角色

sentences.en: When is the audition for the new commercial?
sentences.zh: 新廣告的試鏡是什麼時候？

sentences.en: She will audition for the lead role next Monday.
sentences.zh: 她下週一要去試鏡主角。

sentences.en: Over fifty actors came to audition for the musical.
sentences.zh: 有五十多位演員來試演這齣音樂劇。

sentences.en: Did the director like your audition?
sentences.zh: 導演喜歡你的試鏡表現嗎？

sentences.en: I need to prepare a song for my audition tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我得為明天的試鏡準備一首歌。

sentences.en: Can I audition for the part over a video call?
sentences.zh: 我可以用視訊通話來試鏡這個角色嗎？

sentences.en: He works for a large automotive parts company.
sentences.zh: 他在一家大型汽車零件公司工作。

sentences.en: Is the automotive industry hiring engineers this year?
sentences.zh: 汽車業今年有在徵工程師嗎？

sentences.en: We're launching a new automotive safety system next spring.
sentences.zh: 我們明年春天要推出新的汽車安全系統。

sentences.en: The automotive trade show opens downtown tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 汽車產業展明天在市區開幕。

sentences.en: Which automotive supplier gave us the lowest price?
sentences.zh: 哪家汽車供應商給我們的價格最低？

sentences.en: Our automotive repair shop offers free oil checks.
sentences.zh: 我們的汽車維修廠提供免費機油檢查。

gloss_note: avert a crisis 避免危機；較正式

sentences.en: Quick action helped avert a major traffic accident.
sentences.zh: 迅速的行動避免了一場重大車禍。

sentences.en: Can anything still avert a strike at the factory?
sentences.zh: 還有什麼辦法能避免工廠罷工嗎？

sentences.en: We signed the deal to avert a legal fight.
sentences.zh: 我們簽下協議以避免一場法律糾紛。

sentences.en: How can we avert delays during the holiday rush?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼避免節日旺季的延誤？

sentences.en: A last-minute call managed to avert disaster.
sentences.zh: 最後一刻的來電成功避免了災難。

sentences.en: Regular checkups can avert serious health problems later.
sentences.zh: 定期檢查能預防日後的嚴重健康問題。

sentences.en: Is this avocado ripe enough to eat today?
sentences.zh: 這顆酪梨熟到今天可以吃了嗎？

sentences.en: I love avocado toast with a fried egg on top.
sentences.zh: 我愛吃上面放荷包蛋的酪梨吐司。

sentences.en: Could you add avocado to my burrito, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你在我的墨西哥捲餅裡加酪梨嗎？

sentences.en: Mash two avocados with lime juice and a little salt.
sentences.zh: 把兩顆酪梨和萊姆汁加一點鹽一起壓成泥。

sentences.en: The avocados at this store are cheap this week.
sentences.zh: 這家店的酪梨這週很便宜。

sentences.en: My roommate puts avocado in every smoothie he makes.
sentences.zh: 我室友做的每杯果昔都放酪梨。

gloss_note: awhile 不接 for；for a while 要分開寫

sentences.en: Let's sit here awhile and rest our feet.
sentences.zh: 我們在這裡坐一會兒，讓腳休息一下吧。

sentences.en: I'll wait here awhile, okay? Take your time.
sentences.zh: 我在這裡等一會兒，好嗎？你慢慢來。

sentences.en: Can you stay awhile and help me finish dinner?
sentences.zh: 你可以多待一會兒幫我做完晚餐嗎？

sentences.en: She stood awhile at the window, thinking about the news.
sentences.zh: 她在窗邊站了一會兒，思考著那個消息。

sentences.en: The soup needs to cool awhile before you serve it.
sentences.zh: 湯需要放涼一會兒再端上桌。

sentences.en: Why don't you rest awhile before the meeting?
sentences.zh: 開會前你要不要先休息一會兒？

sentences.en: She earned a bachelor's degree in biology last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天拿到生物學學士學位。

sentences.en: Do you need a bachelor's degree to apply for this job?
sentences.zh: 申請這份工作需要學士學位嗎？

sentences.en: My dad finished his bachelor's at a state university.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸在一所州立大學拿到學士學位。

sentences.en: What did you study for your bachelor's?
sentences.zh: 你的學士學位唸的是什麼科系？

sentences.en: A bachelor's takes four years at most American colleges.
sentences.zh: 在大多數美國大學，拿學士學位要花四年。

sentences.en: He went back to school to complete his bachelor's degree.
sentences.zh: 他回學校完成學士學位。

gloss_note: the backbone of ... 某事物的支柱

sentences.en: Small businesses are the backbone of our local economy.
sentences.zh: 小型企業是我們地方經濟的支柱。

sentences.en: The doctor checked my backbone for any injury.
sentences.zh: 醫師檢查了我的脊椎有沒有受傷。

sentences.en: Is Maria the backbone of your team?
sentences.zh: 瑪麗亞是你們團隊的支柱嗎？

sentences.en: Does sitting all day hurt your backbone?
sentences.zh: 整天坐著會傷到你的脊椎嗎？

sentences.en: Volunteers are the backbone of this community center.
sentences.zh: 志工是這個社區活動中心的支柱。

sentences.en: Fish and snakes have a backbone, but insects do not.
sentences.zh: 魚和蛇有脊椎，但昆蟲沒有。

sentences.en: Can I get a toasted bagel with cream cheese?
sentences.zh: 我可以點一個烤過的貝果加奶油乳酪嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a dozen bagels for the office meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們為辦公室的會議買了一打貝果。

sentences.en: Do you prefer a sesame bagel or a plain one?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡芝麻貝果還是原味的？

sentences.en: This bagel is still warm from the oven.
sentences.zh: 這個貝果剛出爐還是熱的。

sentences.en: I grab a bagel and coffee on my way to work.
sentences.zh: 我上班途中會買個貝果和咖啡。

sentences.en: The shop on the corner makes the best bagels in town.
sentences.zh: 轉角那家店做的貝果是全城最好吃的。

sentences.en: The awards dinner will be held in the hotel ballroom.
sentences.zh: 頒獎晚宴將在飯店宴會廳舉行。

sentences.en: Is the ballroom big enough for three hundred guests?
sentences.zh: 這間宴會廳容得下三百位賓客嗎？

sentences.en: Please set up the stage in the main ballroom by noon.
sentences.zh: 請在中午前把主宴會廳的舞台布置好。

sentences.en: Which ballroom is the conference reception in?
sentences.zh: 會議的歡迎酒會在哪一間宴會廳？

sentences.en: The ballroom has a stunning crystal chandelier overhead.
sentences.zh: 宴會廳頭頂掛著一盞美麗的水晶吊燈。

sentences.en: We reserved the ballroom for our company's holiday party.
sentences.zh: 我們預訂了宴會廳來辦公司的節慶派對。

sentences.en: The film shows a barbarian army attacking a walled city.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描寫野蠻人大軍攻打一座有城牆的城市。

sentences.en: Why did the Romans call outsiders barbarians?
sentences.zh: 為什麼羅馬人把外人稱為野蠻人？

sentences.en: In the story, a barbarian warrior crosses the frozen river.
sentences.zh: 故事中，一名野蠻人戰士越過了結冰的河。

sentences.en: Did the old empire fear the barbarian tribes?
sentences.zh: 那個古老的帝國是否害怕野蠻人部落？

sentences.en: Our history teacher explained where the word barbarian came from.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史老師解釋了「野蠻人」這個詞的由來。

sentences.en: My son dressed as a barbarian for the Halloween party.
sentences.zh: 我兒子在萬聖節派對上扮成野蠻人。

gloss_note: 發音同 base；bass guitar 貝斯

sentences.en: He plays bass in a small jazz band.
sentences.zh: 他在一支小型爵士樂團彈貝斯。

sentences.en: Can you turn down the bass a little?
sentences.zh: 你可以把低音調小一點嗎？

sentences.en: The speaker has deep bass that shakes the whole room.
sentences.zh: 這個喇叭的低音很渾厚，震得整個房間都在晃。

sentences.en: Do you sing bass or tenor in the choir?
sentences.zh: 你在合唱團唱低音還是男高音？

sentences.en: I'm learning to play the bass guitar this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年在學彈電貝斯。

sentences.en: The bass in this song makes me want to dance.
sentences.zh: 這首歌的貝斯讓我想跳舞。

sentences.en: Mix the pancake batter until there are no lumps.
sentences.zh: 把鬆餅麵糊攪到沒有結塊。

sentences.en: Is the batter thick enough for frying chicken?
sentences.zh: 這個麵糊夠濃稠，可以拿來炸雞嗎？

sentences.en: She dipped each shrimp in batter before frying it.
sentences.zh: 她把每隻蝦裹上麵糊再下鍋炸。

sentences.en: Pour the batter into the pan and wait for bubbles.
sentences.zh: 把麵糊倒進鍋裡，等它冒泡。

sentences.en: Should I let the waffle batter rest overnight?
sentences.zh: 格子鬆餅的麵糊要不要放一晚？

sentences.en: The cake batter smells like vanilla and butter.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕麵糊聞起來有香草和奶油的味道。

gloss_note: beautify the city 美化市容

sentences.en: The city wants to beautify the park before summer.
sentences.zh: 市政府想在夏天前美化公園。

sentences.en: Volunteers helped beautify the neighborhood with flowers and paint.
sentences.zh: 志工們用花和油漆幫忙美化社區。

sentences.en: How can we beautify our small balcony cheaply?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼用低成本美化小陽台？

sentences.en: Do you think new trees will beautify this street?
sentences.zh: 你覺得新種的樹會讓這條街更美嗎？

sentences.en: The school plans to beautify its entrance this fall.
sentences.zh: 學校打算在今年秋天美化入口。

sentences.en: She used plants to beautify the empty office corner.
sentences.zh: 她用植物美化辦公室空蕩蕩的角落。

gloss_note: after the beep 嗶聲之後

sentences.en: The microwave gave three loud beeps when it finished.
sentences.zh: 微波爐完成時發出三聲響亮的嗶聲。

sentences.en: Why does my phone beep every five minutes?
sentences.zh: 我的手機為什麼每五分鐘就嗶一聲？

sentences.en: Please leave your message after the beep.
sentences.zh: 請在嗶聲後留言。

sentences.en: The smoke alarm began to beep in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 煙霧警報器在半夜開始嗶嗶響。

sentences.en: Did you hear that beep from the oven?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到烤箱那聲嗶嗎？

sentences.en: The cashier scanned my card, and the machine beeped.
sentences.zh: 收銀員刷了我的卡，機器嗶了一聲。

sentences.en: This salad has roasted beets and goat cheese.
sentences.zh: 這道沙拉有烤甜菜根和山羊起司。

sentences.en: Do you like the taste of beet juice?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡甜菜根汁的味道嗎？

sentences.en: Beets turn everything they touch a deep red color.
sentences.zh: 甜菜根碰到什麼東西都會把它染成深紅色。

sentences.en: I peeled the beet and cut it into thin slices.
sentences.zh: 我把甜菜根削皮，切成薄片。

sentences.en: Could I substitute beet for carrot in this soup?
sentences.zh: 這道湯可以用甜菜根代替紅蘿蔔嗎？

sentences.en: We bought fresh beets from a farm stand.
sentences.zh: 我們在農家攤位買了新鮮的甜菜根。

gloss_note: pork belly；salmon belly 鮭魚腹肉

sentences.en: We ordered the crispy pork belly as an appetizer.
sentences.zh: 我們點了酥脆的五花肉當開胃菜。

sentences.en: Is the salmon belly sushi worth the extra price?
sentences.zh: 鮭魚腹肉壽司值得多付那些錢嗎？

sentences.en: The chef slow-cooks the pork belly for six hours.
sentences.zh: 主廚把五花肉慢燉了六個小時。

sentences.en: Can I get the tuna belly instead of regular tuna?
sentences.zh: 我可以點鮪魚腹肉，不要一般的鮪魚嗎？

sentences.en: This bacon comes from the belly of the pig.
sentences.zh: 這種培根取自豬的腹肉。

sentences.en: Pork belly is great sliced thin and grilled with garlic.
sentences.zh: 五花肉切成薄片，用大蒜一起烤很好吃。

sentences.en: Firefighters spent hours fighting the blaze downtown.
sentences.zh: 消防員花了好幾個小時撲滅市區的大火。

sentences.en: How did the blaze start in the old warehouse?
sentences.zh: 那間舊倉庫的大火是怎麼燒起來的？

sentences.en: The campfire grew into a bright blaze in minutes.
sentences.zh: 營火幾分鐘內就燒成了明亮的火焰。

sentences.en: The chef grilled the steak over a roaring blaze.
sentences.zh: 主廚用熊熊烈火烤那塊牛排。

sentences.en: Did anyone get hurt in the blaze last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的那場大火有人受傷嗎？

sentences.en: We sat watching the blaze in the fireplace all evening.
sentences.zh: 整個晚上我們坐著看壁爐裡的火焰。

gloss_note: bleach one's hair 把頭髮漂白

sentences.en: Add a little bleach to the white laundry.
sentences.zh: 在白色衣物裡加一點漂白水。

sentences.en: Do not mix bleach with other cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 不要把漂白水和其他清潔用品混在一起。

sentences.en: She decided to bleach her hair before the concert.
sentences.zh: 她決定在演唱會前把頭髮漂白。

sentences.en: Will bleach get this stain out of the shirt?
sentences.zh: 漂白水能把襯衫上的汙漬洗掉嗎？

sentences.en: The sun can bleach the color out of curtains.
sentences.zh: 太陽會把窗簾的顏色曬到褪掉。

sentences.en: Is it safe to clean the sink with bleach?
sentences.zh: 用漂白水清潔水槽安全嗎？

gloss_note: blond 通用；blonde 多指女性

sentences.en: My little brother has blond hair and blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟有一頭金髮和藍眼睛。

sentences.en: Is the man with the blond beard your new boss?
sentences.zh: 留著金色鬍子的那個男人是你的新老闆嗎？

sentences.en: She dyed her dark hair blond last weekend.
sentences.zh: 她上週末把深色頭髮染成了金色。

sentences.en: The actor was tall, blond, and very polite.
sentences.zh: 那位演員個子高、一頭金髮，而且很有禮貌。

sentences.en: Do you know the blond woman by the window?
sentences.zh: 你認識窗邊那位金髮女士嗎？

sentences.en: His hair was almost blond as a child, then it darkened.
sentences.zh: 他小時候頭髮幾乎是金色的，後來顏色變深了。

gloss_note: blot with a paper towel 用紙巾吸乾

sentences.en: Blot the spill with a paper towel; don't rub it.
sentences.zh: 用紙巾輕輕吸乾灑出來的東西，不要用力擦。

sentences.en: Could you blot the grease off the pizza with a napkin?
sentences.zh: 你可以用餐巾紙把披薩上的油吸乾嗎？

sentences.en: She blotted her lips with a napkin after dinner.
sentences.zh: 她晚餐後用餐巾輕輕按了按嘴唇。

sentences.en: Did you blot the carpet before the stain set?
sentences.zh: 汙漬滲進去之前，你有先把地毯吸乾嗎？

sentences.en: There was an ink blot on the corner of the page.
sentences.zh: 頁面的一角有一塊墨漬。

sentences.en: What should I use to blot this coffee spill?
sentences.zh: 我該用什麼來吸乾這灘咖啡？

sentences.en: I'd like a blueberry muffin and a small coffee.
sentences.zh: 我想要一個藍莓馬芬和一杯小杯咖啡。

sentences.en: Are these blueberries sweet enough for pancakes?
sentences.zh: 這些藍莓夠甜，可以放進鬆餅嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother makes blueberry jam every summer.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年夏天都會做藍莓果醬。

sentences.en: We picked a whole basket of blueberries at the farm.
sentences.zh: 我們在農場摘了滿滿一籃藍莓。

sentences.en: Blueberry pie is the dessert I always order here.
sentences.zh: 藍莓派是我在這裡每次必點的甜點。

sentences.en: Do you want blueberry or strawberry yogurt?
sentences.zh: 你要藍莓還是草莓優格？

sentences.en: The sushi bar serves fresh bluefin tuna on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 這家壽司吧每週五供應新鮮的黑鮪魚。

sentences.en: Why is bluefin tuna so expensive at restaurants?
sentences.zh: 為什麼黑鮪魚在餐廳這麼貴？

sentences.en: Bluefin is prized for its rich, fatty flavor.
sentences.zh: 黑鮪魚以濃郁的油脂風味備受珍視。

sentences.en: Could we get an order of bluefin sashimi?
sentences.zh: 我們可以點一份黑鮪魚生魚片嗎？

sentences.en: The fishermen caught a huge bluefin off the coast.
sentences.zh: 漁夫在外海捕到一條巨大的黑鮪魚。

sentences.en: I ate bluefin sushi for the first time last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚第一次吃黑鮪魚壽司。

gloss_note: a blunt answer 直截了當的回答

sentences.en: My boss is blunt, but she's always fair.
sentences.zh: 我老闆說話很直接，但她一向很公平。

sentences.en: Can I be blunt with you for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你直話直說一下嗎？

sentences.en: His blunt comments hurt some people's feelings.
sentences.zh: 他直率的言論傷到了一些人的感受。

sentences.en: To be blunt, this plan will not work.
sentences.zh: 說白了，這個計畫行不通。

sentences.en: Why are you so blunt about everything?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對什麼事都這麼直接？

sentences.en: The doctor gave a blunt answer about the risks.
sentences.zh: 醫師對風險給了直截了當的回答。

sentences.en: We ate fries on the boardwalk while the sun set.
sentences.zh: 日落時我們在海濱棧道上吃薯條。

sentences.en: Is there a good seafood stand on the boardwalk?
sentences.zh: 海濱棧道上有沒有不錯的海鮮攤？

sentences.en: The boardwalk is full of ice cream and pizza stands.
sentences.zh: 棧道上有一排排冰淇淋和披薩攤。

sentences.en: Let's walk down the boardwalk and find some tacos.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著棧道走下去，找點塔可餅吃吧。

sentences.en: Did you try the fried dough on the boardwalk?
sentences.zh: 你有吃過棧道上的炸麵團嗎？

sentences.en: Many restaurants along the boardwalk open early for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 棧道沿線許多餐廳很早就開門供應早餐。

sentences.en: The restaurant has a bocce court behind the patio.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳露台後面有一座地滾球場。

sentences.en: Do you want to play bocce while we wait for dinner?
sentences.zh: 等晚餐的時候，你想玩地滾球嗎？

sentences.en: We played bocce at the winery after our pasta lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們吃完義大利麵午餐後，在酒莊玩了地滾球。

sentences.en: Bocce is an easy game that everyone can enjoy.
sentences.zh: 地滾球是人人都能玩得開心的簡單遊戲。

sentences.en: Is the bar's bocce league starting this month?
sentences.zh: 這家酒吧的地滾球聯賽這個月開始嗎？

sentences.en: Our family brought lemonade and sandwiches for a bocce picnic.
sentences.zh: 我們全家帶了檸檬水和三明治，去辦一場地滾球野餐。

sentences.en: Could we have a booster for our five-year-old?
sentences.zh: 可以給我們五歲的孩子一張增高座椅嗎？

sentences.en: The host brought a booster to our table.
sentences.zh: 帶位人員拿了一張增高座椅到我們桌邊。

sentences.en: Does the restaurant have a booster for my toddler?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有給我家學步幼兒用的增高座椅嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter is too small to reach the table without a booster.
sentences.zh: 我女兒個子太小，沒有增高座椅就搆不到桌子。

sentences.en: Please put the booster on that chair for him.
sentences.zh: 請把增高座椅放在那張椅子上給他坐。

sentences.en: We always ask for a booster when we eat out.
sentences.zh: 我們外出用餐時總會要一張增高座椅。

sentences.en: The best tacos are in a small town near the border.
sentences.zh: 最好吃的塔可餅就在靠近國界的一個小鎮。

sentences.en: Do you need a passport to cross the border?
sentences.zh: 過國界需要護照嗎？

sentences.en: We stopped for lunch at a roadside stand before the border.
sentences.zh: 我們在抵達邊界前，停在路邊攤吃午餐。

sentences.en: This border town is famous for its street food.
sentences.zh: 這個邊境小鎮以街頭小吃聞名。

sentences.en: Cooks on both sides of the border make this stew.
sentences.zh: 國界兩側的廚師都會做這道燉菜。

sentences.en: How long is the line at the border today?
sentences.zh: 今天邊界那邊的隊伍有多長？

gloss_note: 較文雅；hold to one's bosom 抱在懷裡

sentences.en: She held the sleeping baby close to her bosom.
sentences.zh: 她把熟睡的嬰兒緊緊抱在懷裡。

sentences.en: The puppy snuggled into his bosom and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 小狗依偎在他懷裡睡著了。

sentences.en: Did Grandma hold the new puppy to her bosom?
sentences.zh: 奶奶有把新來的小狗抱在懷裡嗎？

sentences.en: He pressed the old letter to his bosom and smiled.
sentences.zh: 他把那封舊信按在胸前，微笑了起來。

sentences.en: The mother hugged her son to her bosom at the airport.
sentences.zh: 母親在機場把兒子緊緊摟在懷裡。

sentences.en: Why does she always hold her old diary to her bosom?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼總是把那本舊日記抱在胸前？

sentences.en: Our hotel is right on the main boulevard.
sentences.zh: 我們的飯店就在主要大街上。

sentences.en: Palm trees line both sides of the boulevard.
sentences.zh: 棕櫚樹沿著大道兩側排列。

sentences.en: Is there a good coffee shop on that boulevard?
sentences.zh: 那條大道上有不錯的咖啡店嗎？

sentences.en: We took a long walk down the boulevard after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們沿著林蔭大道散步了很久。

sentences.en: The parade will move slowly along the boulevard on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 遊行週六將沿著大道緩緩前進。

sentences.en: Which exit do I take to get onto the boulevard?
sentences.zh: 我要走哪個出口才能上那條大道？

sentences.en: My coworker takes a boxing class twice a week.
sentences.zh: 我同事每週上兩次拳擊課。

sentences.en: Do you want to watch the boxing match tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想看拳擊賽嗎？

sentences.en: Boxing is a great workout for your whole body.
sentences.zh: 拳擊是很棒的全身運動。

sentences.en: Our gym offers boxing lessons for beginners.
sentences.zh: 我們健身房有開給初學者的拳擊課。

sentences.en: Is boxing popular among high school students here?
sentences.zh: 拳擊在這裡的高中生之間受歡迎嗎？

sentences.en: He wore red boxing gloves and trained for hours.
sentences.zh: 他戴著紅色拳擊手套練了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: I need to buy a new sports bra for running.
sentences.zh: 我需要買一件新的運動內衣來跑步。

sentences.en: Can I return this bra if it doesn't fit?
sentences.zh: 如果尺寸不合，這件內衣可以退貨嗎？

sentences.en: Wash your bra by hand to keep its shape.
sentences.zh: 內衣用手洗才能維持形狀。

sentences.en: The store has a sale on bras this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這家店這個週末有內衣特賣。

sentences.en: Which size of bra should I try first?
sentences.zh: 我應該先試穿哪個尺寸的內衣？

sentences.en: She packed a sports bra and shorts in her gym bag.
sentences.zh: 她在健身包裡放了運動內衣和短褲。

gloss_note: knee brace 護膝；braces 牙套

sentences.en: He wore a knee brace after the soccer injury.
sentences.zh: 他在足球受傷後戴著護膝。

sentences.en: Did the doctor tell you to wear a back brace?
sentences.zh: 醫師有叫你戴護腰嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter will get braces on her teeth next month.
sentences.zh: 我女兒下個月要戴牙齒矯正器。

sentences.en: The brace on her wrist helps with the pain.
sentences.zh: 她手腕上的護具能緩解疼痛。

sentences.en: Do braces hurt during the first few days?
sentences.zh: 戴牙套的前幾天會痛嗎？

sentences.en: He took off the ankle brace to take a shower.
sentences.zh: 他拿下護踝去洗澡。

sentences.en: We celebrated her birthday at a Brazilian steakhouse.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家巴西烤肉店慶祝她的生日。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried Brazilian cheese bread?
sentences.zh: 你吃過巴西起司麵包嗎？

sentences.en: Brazilian coffee is smooth and slightly sweet.
sentences.zh: 巴西咖啡口感滑順，帶點甜味。

sentences.en: Is this Brazilian restaurant open for lunch?
sentences.zh: 這家巴西餐廳午餐時間有營業嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor cooks a delicious Brazilian bean stew every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居每個星期天都會煮一鍋好吃的巴西豆燉菜。

sentences.en: A Brazilian chef led our cooking class on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 一位巴西主廚週六帶我們上烹飪課。

gloss_note: breadth of knowledge 知識廣度

sentences.en: The library has an amazing breadth of books for kids.
sentences.zh: 這間圖書館的童書種類非常廣泛。

sentences.en: Her breadth of knowledge impressed the whole class.
sentences.zh: 她知識的廣度讓全班都印象深刻。

sentences.en: Does this course cover the full breadth of the subject?
sentences.zh: 這門課涵蓋了這個主題的完整範圍嗎？

sentences.en: The river is two miles in breadth at this point.
sentences.zh: 河流在這一段寬兩英里。

sentences.en: Does the candidate have the breadth of experience we need?
sentences.zh: 這位應徵者有我們需要的廣泛經驗嗎？

sentences.en: The report shows the breadth of public support for the plan.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示民眾對這項計畫的支持相當廣泛。

sentences.en: He was sad for weeks after the breakup.
sentences.zh: 分手後他難過了好幾個星期。

sentences.en: How did you get over your last breakup?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼走出上一次分手的？

sentences.en: Their breakup surprised everyone in our group of friends.
sentences.zh: 他們分手的事讓朋友圈裡的每個人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Is the breakup the reason she moved to Chicago?
sentences.zh: 分手是她搬去芝加哥的原因嗎？

sentences.en: She wrote a song about her breakup last winter.
sentences.zh: 她去年冬天寫了一首關於分手的歌。

sentences.en: A bad breakup can make it hard to focus at work.
sentences.zh: 一次不愉快的分手可能讓人很難專心工作。

sentences.en: We toured a local brewery on Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們週六下午參觀了一家當地的啤酒廠。

sentences.en: Does the brewery offer tours on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這家啤酒廠週末有提供導覽嗎？

sentences.en: The brewery next to my office has a great patio.
sentences.zh: 我辦公室隔壁的那家精釀酒廠有個很棒的露天座位區。

sentences.en: How long has your brewery been in business?
sentences.zh: 你們的酒廠開業多久了？

sentences.en: A new brewery opened downtown last spring.
sentences.zh: 去年春天，市中心開了一家新的啤酒廠。

sentences.en: The brewery sells its beer in cans and kegs.
sentences.zh: 這家酒廠用罐裝和桶裝兩種方式賣啤酒。

sentences.en: Brewing a good cup of coffee takes patience.
sentences.zh: 要沖出一杯好咖啡需要耐心。

sentences.en: The brewing process for this beer takes three weeks.
sentences.zh: 這款啤酒的釀造過程要花三個星期。

sentences.en: What water temperature do you use for brewing green tea?
sentences.zh: 你沖泡綠茶都用幾度的水？

sentences.en: My uncle took up home brewing after he retired.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔退休後開始在家自己釀啤酒。

sentences.en: The smell of brewing coffee filled the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 沖煮咖啡的香氣瀰漫了整間廚房。

sentences.en: Is cold brewing really better for making iced coffee?
sentences.zh: 做冰咖啡時，冷泡真的比較好嗎？

gloss_note: on the brink of 瀕臨……

sentences.en: The company was on the brink of bankruptcy last year.
sentences.zh: 那家公司去年瀕臨破產。

sentences.en: Are we on the brink of a breakthrough in this project?
sentences.zh: 我們這個專案是不是快要有突破了？

sentences.en: Scientists say the species is on the brink of extinction.
sentences.zh: 科學家說這個物種瀕臨絕種。

sentences.en: Why do you wait until we're on the brink of disaster to ask for help?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要等到我們快出大事了才開口求助？

sentences.en: He stood at the brink of the cliff and looked down.
sentences.zh: 他站在懸崖邊緣往下看。

sentences.en: The team stood on the brink of winning the title.
sentences.zh: 這支球隊即將奪得冠軍。

gloss_note: 常慢烤或燻製，美式烤肉常見

sentences.en: The restaurant smokes its brisket for twelve hours.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳把牛胸肉燻上十二個小時。

sentences.en: Can I get the brisket sandwich with coleslaw?
sentences.zh: 我可以點牛胸肉三明治配涼拌高麗菜絲嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want the brisket sliced thin or thick?
sentences.zh: 你的牛胸肉要切薄片還是厚片？

sentences.en: My dad cooked a brisket for the family reunion.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸為家族聚會煮了一塊牛胸肉。

sentences.en: Brisket gets tender after hours of slow cooking.
sentences.zh: 牛胸肉經過幾個小時慢煮就會變得軟嫩。

sentences.en: We ordered brisket tacos at the food truck.
sentences.zh: 我們在餐車點了牛胸肉塔可餅。

gloss_note: 美式指烤箱上火烤，英式稱 grill

sentences.en: Broil the salmon for about six minutes.
sentences.zh: 把鮭魚炙烤大約六分鐘。

sentences.en: Should I broil the chicken or bake it?
sentences.zh: 我該把雞肉炙烤還是烘烤？

sentences.en: I like to broil cheese on top of toast.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡把起司放在吐司上炙烤。

sentences.en: How long do you usually broil a thick steak?
sentences.zh: 你通常把厚牛排炙烤多久？

sentences.en: We broil vegetables when we're short on time.
sentences.zh: 我們趕時間的時候就用烤箱上火烤蔬菜。

sentences.en: Don't walk away while you broil the garlic bread.
sentences.zh: 烤蒜香麵包的時候別走開。

sentences.en: A small brook runs behind our campsite.
sentences.zh: 我們的營地後面有一條小溪流過。

sentences.en: Can you hear the brook from the cabin?
sentences.zh: 你在小木屋裡聽得到小溪的流水聲嗎？

sentences.en: The children built a tiny bridge over the brook.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在小溪上搭了一座小橋。

sentences.en: Trout swim in the cold brook near the trail.
sentences.zh: 鱒魚在步道旁冰涼的小溪裡游動。

sentences.en: Is that brook safe to drink from?
sentences.zh: 那條小溪的水可以直接喝嗎？

sentences.en: The brook froze solid during the January cold wave.
sentences.zh: 一月寒流來襲時，小溪整個結凍了。

sentences.en: This light chicken broth is perfect for a cold day.
sentences.zh: 這碗清淡的雞湯很適合冷天喝。

sentences.en: Could I get extra broth in my noodle soup?
sentences.zh: 我的湯麵可以多加一點湯嗎？

sentences.en: Simmer the bones in water to make beef broth.
sentences.zh: 把骨頭放進水裡慢燉，就能熬出牛高湯。

sentences.en: Do you use vegetable broth or water for the rice?
sentences.zh: 你煮飯是用蔬菜高湯還是水？

sentences.en: The ramen shop's broth takes two days to prepare.
sentences.zh: 這家拉麵店的湯頭要花兩天準備。

sentences.en: Add a cup of broth to the pot.
sentences.zh: 在鍋子裡加一杯高湯。

sentences.en: The players formed a close brotherhood over the years.
sentences.zh: 這些球員多年來建立起深厚的兄弟情誼。

sentences.en: Does your team feel like a brotherhood?
sentences.zh: 你們的團隊有像兄弟一樣的情誼嗎？

sentences.en: Their brotherhood lasted long after they left school.
sentences.zh: 他們的兄弟情誼在畢業後維持了很久。

sentences.en: What does brotherhood mean to you?
sentences.zh: 兄弟情誼對你來說代表什麼？

sentences.en: The film is about friendship and brotherhood in wartime.
sentences.zh: 這部電影談的是戰爭時期的友誼與兄弟情誼。

sentences.en: Many firefighters say the brotherhood is the best part of the job.
sentences.zh: 許多消防員說兄弟情誼是這份工作最棒的地方。

sentences.en: This bulky suitcase won't fit in the overhead bin.
sentences.zh: 這個笨重的行李箱放不進頭頂的行李櫃。

sentences.en: Is that sweater too bulky to pack in my bag?
sentences.zh: 那件毛衣是不是太蓬鬆，塞不進我的包包？

sentences.en: The old television was bulky and heavy.
sentences.zh: 那台舊電視又大又笨重。

sentences.en: We need a truck to move the bulky furniture.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一輛卡車來搬運那些體積龐大的家具。

sentences.en: Do you charge extra for bulky packages?
sentences.zh: 體積大的包裹要加收費用嗎？

sentences.en: Her bulky backpack kept bumping into people on the train.
sentences.zh: 她那個鼓鼓的大背包在火車上一直撞到人。

sentences.en: We tried Burmese food for the first time yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們昨天第一次嘗試緬甸菜。

sentences.en: Have you ever eaten a Burmese tea leaf salad?
sentences.zh: 你吃過緬甸茶葉沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: The Burmese restaurant on Main Street is always crowded.
sentences.zh: 主街上的那家緬甸餐廳總是客滿。

sentences.en: Is this curry Burmese or Thai?
sentences.zh: 這道咖哩是緬甸風味還是泰式的？

sentences.en: My neighbor makes Burmese noodles from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居會從頭手工做緬甸麵。

sentences.en: The Burmese chef showed us how to make the soup.
sentences.zh: 那位緬甸籍主廚示範了這道湯怎麼做。
