gloss_note: 反義詞 indispensable 不可或缺

sentences.en: No one on the team is dispensable.
sentences.zh: 團隊裡沒有人是可有可無的。

sentences.en: Is this feature dispensable, or do users need it?
sentences.zh: 這個功能是可有可無的，還是使用者需要它？

sentences.en: When money is tight, dispensable items go first.
sentences.zh: 錢緊的時候，可有可無的東西最先砍掉。

sentences.en: The manager said extra meetings were dispensable.
sentences.zh: 經理說額外的會議是可有可無的。

sentences.en: We're running out of time. Are these decorations dispensable?
sentences.zh: 我們時間快不夠了。這些裝飾可以省掉嗎？

sentences.en: He felt dispensable after the company hired three new people.
sentences.zh: 公司又找了三個新人之後，他覺得自己可有可無。

sentences.en: This machine dispenses hot and cold water.
sentences.zh: 這台機器供應冷熱水。

sentences.en: Does the vending machine dispense change?
sentences.zh: 這台販賣機會找零嗎？

sentences.en: The pharmacist dispensed my prescription this morning.
sentences.zh: 藥師今天早上幫我配好了處方藥。

sentences.en: Volunteers will dispense free water at the finish line.
sentences.zh: 志工會在終點線分發免費的水。

sentences.en: Which pharmacy can dispense this prescription?
sentences.zh: 哪家藥局可以配這張處方箋的藥？

sentences.en: The soap pump doesn't dispense any soap.
sentences.zh: 這個洗手乳按壓瓶擠不出洗手乳。

sentences.en: Reading is a nice diversion after a long day.
sentences.zh: 忙了一整天後，閱讀是不錯的消遣。

sentences.en: The kids needed a diversion during the long drive.
sentences.zh: 長途開車時，孩子們需要找點事情來打發時間。

sentences.en: Is gardening a good diversion from work stress?
sentences.zh: 園藝是擺脫工作壓力的好消遣嗎？

sentences.en: The magician created a diversion while his assistant switched the cards.
sentences.zh: 魔術師製造了分散注意力的動作，同時助手換掉了紙牌。

sentences.en: Do you need a diversion after studying all day?
sentences.zh: 讀了一整天書後，你需要找點消遣嗎？

sentences.en: A funny video was a welcome diversion during the boring training.
sentences.zh: 一支搞笑影片是無聊培訓中受歡迎的調劑。

gloss_note: 美式拼法；英式常拼 doughnut

sentences.en: I grabbed a donut and a coffee before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我開會前拿了一個甜甜圈和一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: Who brought the donuts this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上是誰帶了甜甜圈來？

sentences.en: Do you want a glazed donut or a chocolate one?
sentences.zh: 你想要糖霜甜甜圈，還是巧克力口味的？

sentences.en: The donut shop on the corner opens at five.
sentences.zh: 轉角那家甜甜圈店五點開門。

sentences.en: She ate two donuts and then felt a little sick.
sentences.zh: 她吃了兩個甜甜圈，然後覺得有點不舒服。

sentences.en: Please leave a few donuts for the night shift.
sentences.zh: 請留幾個甜甜圈給夜班的同事。

gloss_note: 公寓大樓、飯店門口的服務人員

sentences.en: The doorman helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
sentences.zh: 門房幫我們把箱子搬上樓。

sentences.en: Did the doorman sign for your package?
sentences.zh: 門房有幫你簽收包裹嗎？

sentences.en: Our doorman knows every resident by name.
sentences.zh: 我們的門房記得每位住戶的名字。

sentences.en: Could you ask the doorman to call us a taxi?
sentences.zh: 你可以請門房幫我們叫輛計程車嗎？

sentences.en: I left the spare key with the doorman.
sentences.zh: 我把備用鑰匙留給門房了。

sentences.en: The doorman opened the door and wished us a good evening.
sentences.zh: 門房為我們開門，並祝我們有個愉快的夜晚。

gloss_note: 口語簡稱；正式說法是 dormitory

sentences.en: My dorm room is small, but it's cheap.
sentences.zh: 我的宿舍房間很小，但很便宜。

sentences.en: Do you live in the dorm or off campus?
sentences.zh: 你住宿舍還是住校外？

sentences.en: The dorm has a laundry room on every floor.
sentences.zh: 宿舍每層樓都有洗衣間。

sentences.en: Which dorm are you in this semester?
sentences.zh: 你這學期住哪一棟宿舍？

sentences.en: My roommate and I decorated our dorm together.
sentences.zh: 我室友和我一起布置了我們的宿舍。

sentences.en: Freshmen are required to live in the dorms.
sentences.zh: 新生必須住宿舍。

gloss_note: 較正式；口語常簡稱 dorm

sentences.en: The dormitory is only a five-minute walk from class.
sentences.zh: 宿舍離教室只要走五分鐘。

sentences.en: Is the dormitory open during winter break?
sentences.zh: 宿舍在寒假期間有開放嗎？

sentences.en: Each dormitory room has two beds and two desks.
sentences.zh: 每間宿舍房間都有兩張床和兩張書桌。

sentences.en: How much does a dormitory room cost per semester?
sentences.zh: 宿舍房間每學期要多少錢？

sentences.en: The university plans to build a new dormitory next year.
sentences.zh: 這所大學計畫明年蓋一棟新宿舍。

sentences.en: She was homesick during her first week in the dormitory.
sentences.zh: 她住進宿舍的第一週很想家。

sentences.en: I started to doze off during the long meeting.
sentences.zh: 開那場冗長的會議時，我開始打瞌睡。

sentences.en: Grandpa likes to doze in his chair after lunch.
sentences.zh: 爺爺午餐後喜歡在椅子上打個盹。

sentences.en: Did you doze off on the couch again?
sentences.zh: 你又在沙發上睡著了嗎？

sentences.en: Try not to doze off while you're driving.
sentences.zh: 開車時千萬別打瞌睡。

sentences.en: I only had a short doze on the plane.
sentences.zh: 我在飛機上只小睡了一下。

sentences.en: Are you dozing, or are you listening to me?
sentences.zh: 你是在打瞌睡，還是有在聽我說話？

sentences.en: The company had to take drastic measures to save money.
sentences.zh: 公司必須採取激烈的措施來省錢。

sentences.en: Is a drastic change really necessary?
sentences.zh: 真的有必要做出這麼劇烈的改變嗎？

sentences.en: There was a drastic drop in sales last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月的銷售額出現了劇烈的下滑。

sentences.en: Don't do anything drastic before we talk.
sentences.zh: 在我們談過之前，別做任何激烈的事。

sentences.en: Do we need such drastic cuts to the budget?
sentences.zh: 我們需要這麼大幅度地削減預算嗎？

sentences.en: The storm caused a drastic change in the weather.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨使天氣出現劇烈的變化。

sentences.en: Prices went up drastically. Did you notice?
sentences.zh: 物價大幅上漲了。你有注意到嗎？

sentences.en: Our sales dropped drastically after the new competitor opened.
sentences.zh: 新的競爭對手開幕後，我們的銷售額大幅下滑。

sentences.en: We had to change the plan drastically.
sentences.zh: 我們不得不大幅更動計畫。

sentences.en: Has the schedule changed drastically since last week?
sentences.zh: 行程表從上週起有大幅變動嗎？

sentences.en: The new software drastically reduces the time we spend on reports.
sentences.zh: 這套新軟體大幅縮短了我們寫報告的時間。

sentences.en: Wait times have drastically improved since we hired more staff.
sentences.zh: 自從多請了人手，等候時間已大幅改善。

sentences.en: I'm dubious about the deal because the price is so low.
sentences.zh: 價格這麼低，我對這筆交易半信半疑。

sentences.en: Are you still dubious about the new plan?
sentences.zh: 你對新計畫還是半信半疑嗎？

sentences.en: That website looks dubious to me.
sentences.zh: 那個網站在我看來很可疑。

sentences.en: Her dubious excuse didn't convince anyone.
sentences.zh: 她那個可疑的藉口沒有說服任何人。

sentences.en: Why are you so dubious about his story?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對他的說法這麼存疑？

sentences.en: The mechanic sounded dubious when I described the noise.
sentences.zh: 我描述那個聲音時，技師聽起來半信半疑。

gloss_note: 美南 chicken and dumplings 是家常菜

sentences.en: Let's order two plates of pork dumplings.
sentences.zh: 我們點兩盤豬肉餃子吧。

sentences.en: Do you want your dumplings steamed or fried?
sentences.zh: 你的餃子要蒸的還是煎的？

sentences.en: My grandma makes dumplings from scratch every Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年農曆新年都會從頭自己包餃子。

sentences.en: Are the dumplings on the menu made in-house?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的餃子是店裡自己做的嗎？

sentences.en: The dumplings come with a spicy dipping sauce.
sentences.zh: 餃子附一份辣味的沾醬。

sentences.en: Chicken and dumplings is a classic comfort food in the South.
sentences.zh: 雞肉麵疙瘩是美國南方的經典療癒美食。

sentences.en: We got to the campsite just before dusk.
sentences.zh: 我們在黃昏前一刻才抵達營地。

sentences.en: The streetlights come on at dusk.
sentences.zh: 路燈在黃昏時亮起。

sentences.en: Do you walk your dog at dawn or at dusk?
sentences.zh: 你都是清晨還是黃昏遛狗？

sentences.en: Dusk fell quickly, and the temperature dropped.
sentences.zh: 暮色很快降臨，氣溫也隨之下降。

sentences.en: Can we finish the hike before dusk?
sentences.zh: 我們能在黃昏前完成健行嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant patio looks beautiful at dusk.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的露台在黃昏時很美。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortybot assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: 童話、奇幻故事中的角色

sentences.en: In the story, a dwarf guards a cave full of gold.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一個矮人守著一座裝滿黃金的洞穴。

sentences.en: Which dwarf in the movie is your favorite?
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡你最喜歡哪個矮人？

sentences.en: My daughter dressed up as a dwarf for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我女兒萬聖節扮成矮人。

sentences.en: The book describes a dwarf who forges magic swords.
sentences.zh: 這本書描寫一位打造魔法劍的矮人。

sentences.en: Did the dwarf in the fantasy novel find his treasure?
sentences.zh: 那本奇幻小說裡的矮人找到他的寶藏了嗎？

sentences.en: The dwarfs sang as they marched to the mine.
sentences.zh: 矮人們一邊唱歌，一邊走向礦坑。

sentences.en: Try not to dwell on your mistakes.
sentences.zh: 別一直想著你的錯誤。

sentences.en: Why do you always dwell on the past?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼總是老想著過去？

sentences.en: I don't want to dwell on it, but I'm still upset.
sentences.zh: 我不想老想著這件事，可是我還是很難過。

sentences.en: Let's not dwell on the bad review.
sentences.zh: 我們別對那則負評耿耿於懷了。

sentences.en: Do you ever dwell on things you said at work?
sentences.zh: 你會不會老想著自己在工作上說過的話？

sentences.en: She tends to dwell on small problems when she can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 她睡不著的時候，常會一直想著一些小問題。

gloss_note: 書面用語；口語多說 home、house

sentences.en: The city inspects every dwelling before a family can move in.
sentences.zh: 市政府會先檢查每間住宅，家庭才能搬進去。

sentences.en: The city plans to build affordable dwellings near the station.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在車站附近興建平價住宅。

sentences.en: Is this dwelling suitable for a family of five?
sentences.zh: 這棟住宅適合五口之家居住嗎？

sentences.en: Ancient dwellings carved into the cliff attract many visitors.
sentences.zh: 鑿刻在懸崖上的古代住所吸引了許多遊客。

sentences.en: What kind of dwelling did early settlers build?
sentences.zh: 早期的拓荒者蓋的是什麼樣的住所？

sentences.en: How many dwellings will the new apartment complex include?
sentences.zh: 這個新的公寓大樓社區會有多少戶住宅？

sentences.en: This restaurant serves Eastern European comfort food.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應東歐的家常料理。

sentences.en: There's a great noodle place in the eastern part of town.
sentences.zh: 城東那一區有一家很棒的麵店。

sentences.en: Is the eastern side of the dining room quieter?
sentences.zh: 餐廳東側比較安靜嗎？

sentences.en: Do you know any good bakeries in eastern Ohio?
sentences.zh: 你知道俄亥俄州東部有什麼不錯的麵包店嗎？

sentences.en: We sat on the eastern patio to catch the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在東側露台曬早晨的太陽。

sentences.en: Her family recipe comes from a village in eastern Poland.
sentences.zh: 她家的食譜來自波蘭東部的一座村莊。

gloss_note: 形容人古怪但通常不帶惡意

sentences.en: My uncle is a bit eccentric, but we love him.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔有點古怪，不過我們都很愛他。

sentences.en: The owner is an eccentric who collects antique clocks.
sentences.zh: 老闆是個怪人，愛收集古董鐘。

sentences.en: Do you think her eccentric habits will bother the team?
sentences.zh: 你覺得她那些古怪的習慣會讓團隊困擾嗎？

sentences.en: He's known as the eccentric of the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他是這附近出了名的怪人。

sentences.en: What's the most eccentric thing you've ever bought?
sentences.zh: 你買過最古怪的東西是什麼？

sentences.en: She wore an eccentric hat to the office party.
sentences.zh: 她戴了一頂很古怪的帽子去參加公司派對。

gloss_note: eclectic menu 多元風格的菜單

sentences.en: The restaurant has an eclectic menu with dishes from around the world.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的菜單兼容並蓄，有世界各地的料理。

sentences.en: Is your taste in music as eclectic as mine?
sentences.zh: 你的音樂品味也像我一樣多元嗎？

sentences.en: The cafe has an eclectic mix of old chairs and bright art.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館混搭了老舊椅子和色彩鮮明的藝術品。

sentences.en: Her cooking is eclectic, mixing Thai, Mexican, and Italian flavors.
sentences.zh: 她的料理風格多元，融合了泰式、墨西哥和義式風味。

sentences.en: What would you recommend from such an eclectic wine list?
sentences.zh: 這麼多元的酒單，你會推薦哪一款？

sentences.en: My roommate has eclectic taste in movies.
sentences.zh: 我室友對電影的口味很多元。

sentences.en: Did you see the solar eclipse yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天有看到日蝕嗎？

sentences.en: We drove three hours to watch the eclipse.
sentences.zh: 我們開了三個小時的車去看日蝕。

sentences.en: A lunar eclipse will be visible tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚可以看到月蝕。

sentences.en: Never look at an eclipse without special glasses.
sentences.zh: 沒戴特殊眼鏡絕對不要直視日蝕。

sentences.en: When is the next total eclipse in our area?
sentences.zh: 我們這一帶下一次日全蝕是什麼時候？

sentences.en: The kids made a model of an eclipse for science class.
sentences.zh: 孩子們為科學課做了一個日蝕的模型。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: 反義字 inedible 不能吃的

sentences.en: Are these wild mushrooms edible?
sentences.zh: 這些野生蘑菇可以吃嗎？

sentences.en: The flowers on the cake are edible.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕上的花是可以吃的。

sentences.en: That burnt toast is barely edible.
sentences.zh: 那片烤焦的吐司勉強能吃。

sentences.en: Is this glitter on the dessert edible?
sentences.zh: 甜點上的這種亮片可以食用嗎？

sentences.en: The campers found edible berries along the trail.
sentences.zh: 露營的人在步道旁找到了可食用的莓果。

sentences.en: Is this leftover pizza still edible after two days?
sentences.zh: 這片剩下的披薩放了兩天還能吃嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have the eggplant parmesan, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點帕瑪森茄子，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Do you grow eggplant in your garden?
sentences.zh: 你的菜園有種茄子嗎？

sentences.en: Slice the eggplant and roast it with olive oil.
sentences.zh: 把茄子切片，淋上橄欖油烤。

sentences.en: Is there any eggplant in the stir-fry?
sentences.zh: 這道炒菜裡有茄子嗎？

sentences.en: My kids don't like eggplant because of the texture.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子不喜歡茄子，因為口感的關係。

sentences.en: She grilled eggplant and peppers for the barbecue.
sentences.zh: 她為烤肉聚會烤了茄子和甜椒。

sentences.en: You can sign the contract electronically.
sentences.zh: 你可以用電子方式簽署合約。

sentences.en: Did you submit your tax forms electronically?
sentences.zh: 你的報稅表是用電子方式提交的嗎？

sentences.en: We prefer to receive invoices electronically.
sentences.zh: 我們偏好以電子方式收取請款單。

sentences.en: Can I pay my bill electronically?
sentences.zh: 我可以用電子方式繳費嗎？

sentences.en: The documents were sent electronically this morning.
sentences.zh: 文件今天早上已用電子方式寄出。

sentences.en: All applications must be filed electronically by Friday.
sentences.zh: 所有申請都必須在週五前以電子方式提交。

gloss_note: 指從本國移出者；移入者為 immigrant

sentences.en: My grandfather was an emigrant from Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我祖父是從愛爾蘭移居國外的人。

sentences.en: Where did the emigrants in this old photo come from?
sentences.zh: 這張老照片裡的移民是從哪裡來的？

sentences.en: The museum tells the stories of Italian emigrants from a century ago.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館講述一百年前義大利移民離鄉的故事。

sentences.en: Many emigrants send money home to their families.
sentences.zh: 許多移民會把錢寄回家給家人。

sentences.en: Were your parents emigrants from Vietnam?
sentences.zh: 你的父母是從越南移民出來的嗎？

sentences.en: Some emigrants miss the food from their home country.
sentences.zh: 有些移民會想念家鄉的食物。

gloss_note: emigrate from 國家 / to 國家

sentences.en: My aunt decided to emigrate from Korea in 1990.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在1990年決定從韓國移居國外。

sentences.en: Why did your family emigrate to the United States?
sentences.zh: 你們家為什麼移居美國？

sentences.en: Many people emigrate to find better jobs.
sentences.zh: 許多人移居國外是為了找更好的工作。

sentences.en: Are you thinking of emigrating to Canada?
sentences.zh: 你在考慮移居加拿大嗎？

sentences.en: She emigrated from Brazil when she was ten.
sentences.zh: 她十歲時從巴西移居國外。

sentences.en: He plans to emigrate once he finishes graduate school.
sentences.zh: 他打算研究所畢業後就移居國外。

gloss_note: 指出境；入境移民為 immigration

sentences.en: The island saw a rise in emigration last year.
sentences.zh: 這座島去年移居國外的人數增加了。

sentences.en: What are the main causes of emigration?
sentences.zh: 移居國外的主要原因是什麼？

sentences.en: My grandparents' emigration changed our family's life.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母移居國外，改變了我們家的生活。

sentences.en: Is emigration common in your home country?
sentences.zh: 在你的母國，移居國外很常見嗎？

sentences.en: The report says emigration is slowing down.
sentences.zh: 報告指出移居國外的人數正在減緩。

sentences.en: Her emigration to Australia took almost a year to plan.
sentences.zh: 她移居澳洲這件事花了將近一年規劃。

gloss_note: 墨西哥菜，捲餅淋上辣醬並焗烤

sentences.en: I'll have the chicken enchilada with extra cheese.
sentences.zh: 我要雞肉墨西哥辣醬捲餅，起司多一點。

sentences.en: Do you want red or green sauce on your enchilada?
sentences.zh: 你的墨西哥辣醬捲餅要淋紅醬還是綠醬？

sentences.en: The enchiladas here come with rice and beans.
sentences.zh: 這裡的墨西哥辣醬捲餅附飯和豆子。

sentences.en: Is the cheese enchilada spicy?
sentences.zh: 起司口味的墨西哥辣醬捲餅會辣嗎？

sentences.en: My mom makes enchiladas every Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽每個週日晚上都做墨西哥辣醬捲餅。

sentences.en: We split an enchilada plate and a bowl of soup.
sentences.zh: 我們分著吃一份墨西哥辣醬捲餅套餐和一碗湯。

gloss_note: 美式拼法（英式 endeavour）；較正式

sentences.en: We will endeavor to answer every message within a day.
sentences.zh: 我們會努力在一天內回覆每一則訊息。

sentences.en: Is this a new endeavor for your company?
sentences.zh: 這對貴公司來說是一項新的嘗試嗎？

sentences.en: Starting a business is a risky endeavor.
sentences.zh: 創業是一項有風險的嘗試。

sentences.en: Good luck with all your future endeavors!
sentences.zh: 祝你未來的一切努力都順利！

sentences.en: What's your next endeavor after you retire?
sentences.zh: 你退休後下一個想投入的事是什麼？

sentences.en: Her endeavors to learn Spanish finally paid off.
sentences.zh: 她學西班牙文的努力終於有了回報。

sentences.en: Marathon running takes a lot of endurance.
sentences.zh: 跑馬拉松需要很強的耐力。

sentences.en: Do you have the endurance for a long hike?
sentences.zh: 你有足夠的耐力走長程健行嗎？

sentences.en: I'm building my endurance by swimming every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上游泳來增強耐力。

sentences.en: How much endurance do you need for this job?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要多少耐力？

sentences.en: Her endurance impressed the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她的耐力讓整個團隊印象深刻。

sentences.en: Working double shifts tested his endurance.
sentences.zh: 連續上兩班考驗著他的耐力。

gloss_note: enduring popularity 歷久不衰的人氣

sentences.en: Fried chicken enjoys enduring popularity across the country.
sentences.zh: 炸雞在全美各地的人氣歷久不衰。

sentences.en: This is an enduring family recipe passed down from my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 這是祖母傳下來、歷久不衰的家傳食譜。

sentences.en: What explains the enduring appeal of the burger?
sentences.zh: 漢堡歷久不衰的魅力是什麼原因？

sentences.en: Is ramen's enduring popularity due to its price?
sentences.zh: 拉麵歷久不衰的人氣是因為價格嗎？

sentences.en: The diner has been an enduring favorite in town for decades.
sentences.zh: 這家小餐館幾十年來一直是鎮上歷久不衰的最愛。

sentences.en: Apple pie remains an enduring symbol of American home cooking.
sentences.zh: 蘋果派仍是美式家常菜歷久不衰的象徵。

gloss_note: enhance the flavor 提升風味

sentences.en: A little lemon juice will enhance the flavor.
sentences.zh: 加一點檸檬汁就能提升風味。

sentences.en: How can we enhance the customer experience?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何提升顧客體驗？

sentences.en: This software is designed to enhance team productivity.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體是為了提升團隊生產力而設計的。

sentences.en: Does the new lighting enhance the look of the room?
sentences.zh: 新的燈光有讓房間的外觀更出色嗎？

sentences.en: Regular exercise can enhance your memory.
sentences.zh: 規律運動可以增強你的記憶力。

sentences.en: We added more photos to enhance our website's appearance.
sentences.zh: 我們多放了幾張照片，讓網站的外觀更出色。

gloss_note: Can you enlighten me? 能讓我了解嗎？

sentences.en: Can you enlighten me about how this works?
sentences.zh: 你能讓我了解一下這是怎麼運作的嗎？

sentences.en: Could someone enlighten me on why the meeting was canceled?
sentences.zh: 有人能讓我了解會議為什麼被取消嗎？

sentences.en: The speaker tried to enlighten us about healthy eating.
sentences.zh: 講者試著啟發我們對健康飲食的認識。

sentences.en: Let me enlighten you about how taxes work here.
sentences.zh: 讓我來為你說明這裡的稅是怎麼運作的。

sentences.en: That documentary really enlightened me about ocean pollution.
sentences.zh: 那部紀錄片真的啟發了我對海洋汙染的認識。

sentences.en: Would you enlighten us on the new policy?
sentences.zh: 你願意為我們說明一下新政策嗎？

gloss_note: 指獲得新的理解或見解

sentences.en: The workshop brought real enlightenment about how to budget.
sentences.zh: 這場工作坊讓我對如何做預算有了真正的領悟。

sentences.en: Did the class bring you any enlightenment?
sentences.zh: 這堂課有帶給你任何啟發嗎？

sentences.en: Reading her essay was a moment of enlightenment for me.
sentences.zh: 讀她的文章是我茅塞頓開的一刻。

sentences.en: What kind of enlightenment do you hope to get from this trip?
sentences.zh: 你希望從這趟旅行得到什麼樣的領悟？

sentences.en: The talk offered little enlightenment, only a lot of slides.
sentences.zh: 這場演講沒帶來什麼啟發，只有一大堆投影片。

sentences.en: Good teachers bring enlightenment by asking good questions.
sentences.zh: 好老師透過提出好問題帶來啟發。

gloss_note: enrichment program 課後充實課程

sentences.en: My son joined an after-school enrichment program.
sentences.zh: 我兒子參加了課後充實課程。

sentences.en: Do the enrichment classes cost extra?
sentences.zh: 充實課程要另外收費嗎？

sentences.en: The library offers enrichment activities every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 圖書館每週六都有增進學習的活動。

sentences.en: Which enrichment class is your daughter taking this semester?
sentences.zh: 你女兒這學期上哪一門充實課程？

sentences.en: Travel is a great source of personal enrichment.
sentences.zh: 旅行是充實自我的絕佳方式。

sentences.en: The school added art and music enrichment for all students.
sentences.zh: 學校為所有學生增設了藝術和音樂的充實課程。

sentences.en: The enrollment for fall classes opens next Monday.
sentences.zh: 秋季課程的註冊從下週一開始。

sentences.en: Did you finish your enrollment online?
sentences.zh: 你有在網路上完成註冊嗎？

sentences.en: Our school's enrollment has grown by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的入學人數增加了百分之十。

sentences.en: Is there an enrollment fee for the yoga class?
sentences.zh: 瑜伽課要收註冊費嗎？

sentences.en: Falling enrollment forced the college to cut some programs.
sentences.zh: 入學人數下降，迫使這所大學砍掉一些課程。

sentences.en: Please bring your ID to complete your enrollment.
sentences.zh: 請帶身分證件來完成註冊。

gloss_note: 指讓數量、程度變得一致

sentences.en: The new rule aims to equalize pay between teams.
sentences.zh: 新規定旨在使各團隊的薪資趨於平均。

sentences.en: How can we equalize the workload among the staff?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓員工之間的工作量平均？

sentences.en: Open the door to equalize the temperature in both rooms.
sentences.zh: 把門打開，讓兩個房間的溫度一致。

sentences.en: Swallow a few times to equalize the pressure in your ears.
sentences.zh: 吞幾次口水，讓耳朵內外的壓力平衡。

sentences.en: Did the new tax equalize prices across the state?
sentences.zh: 新的稅制有讓全州的價格趨於一致嗎？

sentences.en: Using the same measuring cup helps equalize each portion.
sentences.zh: 用同一個量杯有助於讓每一份一樣多。

gloss_note: hold sb in high esteem 非常敬重某人

sentences.en: Everyone at the office holds her in high esteem.
sentences.zh: 辦公室裡的每個人都十分敬重她。

sentences.en: Do you hold your teacher in high esteem?
sentences.zh: 你很敬重你的老師嗎？

sentences.en: He earned the esteem of his coworkers over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年下來，他贏得了同事的敬重。

sentences.en: The chef is held in great esteem by the local community.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚深受當地社區的敬重。

sentences.en: Do you think he has lost the esteem of the team?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他失去團隊的敬重了嗎？

sentences.en: Years of honest work earned him the esteem of his neighbors.
sentences.zh: 多年來誠實工作，讓他贏得了鄰居的敬重。

gloss_note: an eternity 形容等了很久

sentences.en: It felt like an eternity waiting for the results.
sentences.zh: 等結果的時候，感覺像等了一輩子那麼久。

sentences.en: Did you wait an eternity at the airport?
sentences.zh: 你在機場等了好久嗎？

sentences.en: Why does the last hour of work feel like an eternity?
sentences.zh: 為什麼上班的最後一小時感覺像一輩子那麼久？

sentences.en: They promised to love each other for eternity.
sentences.zh: 他們承諾永遠相愛。

sentences.en: The poem describes the sea as a symbol of eternity.
sentences.zh: 這首詩把大海描寫成永恆的象徵。

sentences.en: It took him an eternity to find his keys.
sentences.zh: 他找鑰匙找了好久。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried Ethiopian food?
sentences.zh: 你吃過衣索比亞菜嗎？

sentences.en: We had dinner at a small Ethiopian restaurant downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們在市中心一家小小的衣索比亞餐廳吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Ethiopian coffee has a bright, fruity flavor.
sentences.zh: 衣索比亞咖啡有明亮的果香風味。

sentences.en: At the Ethiopian place, you eat with your hands instead of a fork.
sentences.zh: 在那家衣索比亞餐廳，你是用手而不是用叉子吃。

sentences.en: Is the Ethiopian stew spicy?
sentences.zh: 這道衣索比亞燉菜辣嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighbor is an Ethiopian chef who loves cooking for guests.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居是衣索比亞籍的主廚，很愛為客人下廚。

sentences.en: This bakery makes European-style bread.
sentences.zh: 這家麵包店做歐式麵包。

sentences.en: Do you prefer European chocolate or American chocolate?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡歐洲的巧克力還是美國的巧克力？

sentences.en: The menu features a variety of European cheeses.
sentences.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的歐洲起司。

sentences.en: Have you tried the European breakfast buffet at the hotel?
sentences.zh: 你試過飯店的歐式早餐自助餐了嗎？

sentences.en: She studied European cooking in Paris for two years.
sentences.zh: 她在巴黎學了兩年歐洲料理。

sentences.en: People in many European countries eat dinner later than Americans.
sentences.zh: 許多歐洲國家的人晚餐吃得比美國人晚。

sentences.en: Pine trees are evergreen, so they stay green all winter.
sentences.zh: 松樹是常綠的，所以整個冬天都保持綠色。

sentences.en: We put lights on the evergreen in the front yard.
sentences.zh: 我們在前院的常青樹上掛了燈。

sentences.en: Is this plant evergreen, or does it lose its leaves?
sentences.zh: 這種植物是常綠的，還是會落葉？

sentences.en: Our backyard has several evergreens that block the wind.
sentences.zh: 我們後院有幾棵常青樹擋風。

sentences.en: Which evergreen should we plant along the fence?
sentences.zh: 我們該在圍籬邊種哪一種常青樹？

sentences.en: The park is full of evergreen trees even in January.
sentences.zh: 公園裡即使在一月也滿是常綠樹。

sentences.en: The smell of fresh bread evokes memories of my grandmother's kitchen.
sentences.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味喚起我對祖母廚房的回憶。

sentences.en: Does this song evoke any memories for you?
sentences.zh: 這首歌有喚起你什麼回憶嗎？

sentences.en: The ad was designed to evoke strong emotions.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告是設計來引發強烈情感的。

sentences.en: What feelings does the painting evoke in you?
sentences.zh: 這幅畫在你心中引起什麼樣的感受？

sentences.en: Her speech evoked a lot of laughter in the room.
sentences.zh: 她的演講在會場引起不少笑聲。

sentences.en: Old photos can evoke memories you thought you'd forgotten.
sentences.zh: 老照片可以喚起你以為早已忘記的回憶。

gloss_note: 較正式；日常也說 test taker

sentences.en: Each examinee must show an ID before entering the room.
sentences.zh: 每位考生進場前都必須出示身分證件。

sentences.en: How many examinees are taking the test today?
sentences.zh: 今天有多少考生參加考試？

sentences.en: All examinees must turn off their cell phones.
sentences.zh: 所有考生都必須關掉手機。

sentences.en: Is every examinee seated yet?
sentences.zh: 每位考生都坐好了嗎？

sentences.en: One examinee finished the exam early and left.
sentences.zh: 有一位考生提早寫完考卷離開了。

sentences.en: The teacher handed each examinee a pencil and an answer sheet.
sentences.zh: 老師發給每位考生一枝鉛筆和一張答案卡。

sentences.en: The examiner asked me three questions about my hobbies.
sentences.zh: 主考官問了我三個關於興趣的問題。

sentences.en: Was the examiner at your driving test strict?
sentences.zh: 你駕照考試的考官嚴格嗎？

sentences.en: A bank examiner will review our company's accounts on Monday.
sentences.zh: 銀行檢查員週一會來查核我們公司的帳目。

sentences.en: Do you know who the examiner for the oral exam will be?
sentences.zh: 你知道口試的主考官會是誰嗎？

sentences.en: She smiled at the examiner and began her speech.
sentences.zh: 她對主考官微笑，然後開始演講。

sentences.en: The examiner took off points for spelling mistakes.
sentences.zh: 考官因為拼字錯誤而扣分。

sentences.en: She excels at math and loves solving puzzles.
sentences.zh: 她數學很強，也很愛解謎題。

sentences.en: Do you think you'll excel in your new role?
sentences.zh: 你覺得你在新職務上能表現優異嗎？

sentences.en: I want to excel at my job this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我想在工作上表現優異。

sentences.en: Which subject does your son excel in?
sentences.zh: 你兒子擅長哪一科？

sentences.en: Our team excelled during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在忙碌的假期旺季表現優異。

sentences.en: He really excels at making people feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 他真的很擅長讓人有賓至如歸的感覺。

gloss_note: an excerpt from 某作品的節錄

sentences.en: Please read the excerpt on page twelve.
sentences.zh: 請讀第十二頁的節錄段落。

sentences.en: Our teacher gave us an excerpt from a famous novel.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們一段名著小說的節錄。

sentences.en: Can you send me an excerpt of the contract?
sentences.zh: 你可以寄給我合約的節錄內容嗎？

sentences.en: The magazine printed an excerpt from her new book.
sentences.zh: 雜誌刊登了她新書的節錄。

sentences.en: Which excerpt did you choose for your presentation?
sentences.zh: 你的簡報選了哪一段節錄？

sentences.en: I only read a short excerpt, so I can't judge the whole book.
sentences.zh: 我只讀了一小段節錄，所以沒辦法評斷整本書。

sentences.en: You'll pay a fee for excess baggage at the airport.
sentences.zh: 你在機場要為超重行李付費。

sentences.en: Is there an excess charge for the extra bag?
sentences.zh: 多帶的那個袋子要收超額費用嗎？

sentences.en: Please remove the excess fat before cooking the chicken.
sentences.zh: 煮雞肉之前，請先把多餘的油脂去掉。

sentences.en: We have an excess of inventory this quarter.
sentences.zh: 我們這一季的庫存過剩。

sentences.en: Do you have any excess cash to put into savings?
sentences.zh: 你有多餘的現金可以存起來嗎？

sentences.en: The excess water from the storm flooded the street.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨帶來的過量雨水淹沒了街道。

sentences.en: The company cut its expenditure on travel this year.
sentences.zh: 公司今年削減了差旅支出。

sentences.en: Is the expenditure for this project in the budget?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫的經費有編在預算裡嗎？

sentences.en: Total expenditure for the quarter was higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 這一季的總支出比預期的高。

sentences.en: How do we track expenditure on office supplies?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何追蹤辦公用品的支出？

sentences.en: The government announced a large expenditure on new highways.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布將在新的高速公路上投入一大筆經費。

sentences.en: Our monthly expenditure on groceries has gone up.
sentences.zh: 我們每月在雜貨上的支出增加了。

sentences.en: The explorer spent years mapping the rainforest.
sentences.zh: 這位探險家花了好幾年繪製雨林的地圖。

sentences.en: Who was the first explorer to reach the South Pole?
sentences.zh: 第一位抵達南極的探險家是誰？

sentences.en: My son wants to be an explorer when he grows up.
sentences.zh: 我兒子長大後想當探險家。

sentences.en: Are you an explorer or a planner when you travel?
sentences.zh: 旅行時你是愛探索的人，還是愛規劃的人？

sentences.en: The hotel offers tours for young explorers.
sentences.zh: 飯店為小小探險家提供導覽行程。

sentences.en: Early explorers often relied on the stars to find their way.
sentences.zh: 早期的探險家常靠星星找路。

sentences.en: The dentist had to extract one of my teeth.
sentences.zh: 牙醫必須拔掉我的一顆牙。

sentences.en: Can you extract the data from this report?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這份報告裡的資料提取出來嗎？

sentences.en: This machine can extract juice from fruit quickly.
sentences.zh: 這台機器能快速從水果中提取果汁。

sentences.en: How do I extract files from a zipped folder?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼從壓縮資料夾裡取出檔案？

sentences.en: Workers extract salt from seawater here.
sentences.zh: 工人在這裡從海水中提取鹽。

sentences.en: Did the engineer extract the information from the old system?
sentences.zh: 工程師有從舊系統中提取資訊嗎？

sentences.en: Colleges look at your extracurricular activities.
sentences.zh: 大學會參考你的課外活動。

sentences.en: What extracurricular activities does your school offer?
sentences.zh: 你們學校有哪些課外活動？

sentences.en: She's busy with extracurricular activities after school every day.
sentences.zh: 她每天放學後都忙著參加課外活動。

sentences.en: Do your kids have any extracurricular activities this fall?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子這個秋天有參加什麼課外活動嗎？

sentences.en: Joining an extracurricular club helped him make friends.
sentences.zh: 參加課外社團幫助他交到朋友。

sentences.en: The school cut its extracurricular programs to save money.
sentences.zh: 學校為了省錢而砍掉課外活動計畫。

sentences.en: They threw an extravagant dinner party for their anniversary.
sentences.zh: 他們為紀念日辦了一場奢華的晚宴。

sentences.en: Is that extravagant dessert really worth thirty dollars?
sentences.zh: 那份奢華的甜點真的值三十美元嗎？

sentences.en: I think a six-course meal is too extravagant for a weeknight.
sentences.zh: 我覺得六道菜的餐點對平日晚上來說太鋪張了。

sentences.en: The hotel buffet was extravagant, with a chocolate fountain.
sentences.zh: 飯店的自助餐很奢華，還有巧克力噴泉。

sentences.en: Do we really need such an extravagant cake?
sentences.zh: 我們真的需要這麼鋪張的蛋糕嗎？

sentences.en: He ordered an extravagant seafood platter just for himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己一個人點了一大盤奢華的海鮮拼盤。

gloss_note: 常用複數 eyelashes；睫毛膏 mascara

sentences.en: Her eyelashes are so long that they touch her glasses.
sentences.zh: 她的睫毛長到會碰到眼鏡。

sentences.en: Is there an eyelash on my cheek? It feels itchy.
sentences.zh: 我臉頰上是不是有根睫毛？感覺癢癢的。

sentences.en: Which mascara makes your eyelashes look longer?
sentences.zh: 哪一種睫毛膏能讓你的睫毛看起來更長？

sentences.en: An eyelash got into my eye. Can you see it?
sentences.zh: 有根睫毛跑進我的眼睛了。你看得到嗎？

sentences.en: My little niece counted every eyelash on her doll.
sentences.zh: 我的小姪女數了她娃娃的每一根睫毛。

sentences.en: The salon offers eyelash extensions for forty dollars.
sentences.zh: 這家美容院提供接睫毛服務，要價四十美元。

gloss_note: 眼瞼為較正式說法；upper/lower eyelid

sentences.en: My left eyelid has been twitching all morning.
sentences.zh: 我的左眼皮整個早上都在跳。

sentences.en: Why is my eyelid so swollen today?
sentences.zh: 我的眼皮今天怎麼腫成這樣？

sentences.en: Can you see the small bump on my eyelid?
sentences.zh: 你看得到我眼皮上的小腫塊嗎？

sentences.en: The baby's eyelids slowly closed as she fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 寶寶睡著時，眼皮慢慢闔上了。

sentences.en: The doctor gently lifted the patient's upper eyelid.
sentences.zh: 醫生輕輕掀起病人的上眼瞼。

sentences.en: I was so tired that my eyelids felt heavy.
sentences.zh: 我累到眼皮都覺得很沉重。

gloss_note: 不可數；good/poor eyesight 視力好／差

sentences.en: Does your eyesight get worse when you stay up late?
sentences.zh: 你熬夜的時候，視力會變差嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather's eyesight is still sharp at eighty.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺八十歲了，視力還是很好。

sentences.en: Reading in the dark can hurt your eyesight.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中看書會傷害視力。

sentences.en: Have you had your eyesight checked this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年檢查過視力嗎？

sentences.en: Pilots must pass a strict eyesight test before they fly.
sentences.zh: 飛行員在飛行前必須通過嚴格的視力檢查。

sentences.en: Carrots are said to be good for your eyesight.
sentences.zh: 據說胡蘿蔔對視力有益。

gloss_note: 常有動物角色並帶出寓意 moral

sentences.en: Our teacher read us a fable about a tortoise and a hare.
sentences.zh: 老師唸了一則關於烏龜和兔子的寓言給我們聽。

sentences.en: Do you remember the fable of the boy who cried wolf?
sentences.zh: 你還記得那個喊「狼來了」的男孩的寓言嗎？

sentences.en: Every fable ends with a lesson about life.
sentences.zh: 每則寓言的結尾都有一個人生的道理。

sentences.en: Can you tell me the moral of this fable?
sentences.zh: 你能告訴我這則寓言的寓意嗎？

sentences.en: My son wrote his own fable for English class.
sentences.zh: 我兒子替英文課寫了一則自己的寓言。

sentences.en: Many old fables use talking animals to teach children.
sentences.zh: 許多古老的寓言用會說話的動物來教導孩子。

gloss_note: factual report/error 事實性報告／錯誤

sentences.en: Please make sure the report is factual and complete.
sentences.zh: 請確定這份報告內容符合事實而且完整。

sentences.en: Is this article factual, or just someone's opinion?
sentences.zh: 這篇文章是根據事實的，還是只是某人的意見？

sentences.en: I found a factual error on page three.
sentences.zh: 我在第三頁發現一個事實錯誤。

sentences.en: Could you double-check that every claim in the report is factual?
sentences.zh: 你可以再確認一下報告裡的每項說法都符合事實嗎？

sentences.en: The manager asked for a factual summary of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理要求提供一份根據事實的會議摘要。

sentences.en: Our press release must stay factual and avoid any exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 我們的新聞稿必須忠於事實，避免任何誇大。

gloss_note: 美國日常用華氏；攝氏為 Celsius

sentences.en: It was ninety degrees Fahrenheit in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 停車場裡是華氏九十度。

sentences.en: What's the temperature outside in Fahrenheit?
sentences.zh: 外面的氣溫是華氏幾度？

sentences.en: Set the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 把烤箱設定在華氏350度。

sentences.en: Water freezes at thirty-two degrees Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 水在華氏32度結冰。

sentences.en: Do you know how to convert Celsius to Fahrenheit?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼把攝氏換算成華氏嗎？

sentences.en: My cell phone says it's fifty degrees Fahrenheit today.
sentences.zh: 我的手機顯示今天是華氏50度。

gloss_note: 書面；也指聲音、腳步不穩

sentences.en: Her confidence began to falter after the second loss.
sentences.zh: 輸了第二場之後，她的信心開始動搖了。

sentences.en: Did your resolve falter when the job got hard?
sentences.zh: 工作變難的時候，你的決心有動搖嗎？

sentences.en: Why did our sales falter during the winter months?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們的銷售在冬季那幾個月變弱了？

sentences.en: Don't falter now; you're almost at the finish line.
sentences.zh: 現在別動搖，你就快到終點了。

sentences.en: Her voice faltered for a moment before she went on.
sentences.zh: 她的聲音顫了一下，然後繼續說下去。

sentences.en: The economy began to falter late last year.
sentences.zh: 去年年底，經濟開始走弱。

sentences.en: We stayed at a cozy farmhouse bed and breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我們住在一間舒適的農舍民宿。

sentences.en: Would you like the farmhouse breakfast with eggs and sausage?
sentences.zh: 你想點附蛋和香腸的農舍早餐嗎？

sentences.en: We bought fresh eggs from a farmhouse down the road.
sentences.zh: 我們向路邊的一間農舍買了新鮮雞蛋。

sentences.en: Is that new farmhouse-style restaurant any good?
sentences.zh: 那家新開的農舍風餐廳好吃嗎？

sentences.en: My grandparents live in an old farmhouse near the lake.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母住在湖邊的一間老農舍裡。

sentences.en: Everything we ate in the farmhouse kitchen was homemade.
sentences.zh: 我們在農舍廚房吃的每樣東西都是自製的。

gloss_note: fascination with sth 對某事著迷

sentences.en: My daughter has a fascination with space.
sentences.zh: 我女兒對太空很著迷。

sentences.en: What is your fascination with old movies?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對老電影這麼著迷？

sentences.en: The kids watched the magician with great fascination.
sentences.zh: 孩子們著迷地看著魔術師表演。

sentences.en: Did his fascination with cars start as a kid?
sentences.zh: 他對汽車的著迷是從小時候開始的嗎？

sentences.en: The old castle has a certain fascination for tourists.
sentences.zh: 這座古堡對觀光客有某種魅力。

sentences.en: Her fascination with birds led her to become a scientist.
sentences.zh: 她因為迷上鳥類而成為科學家。

gloss_note: feeble excuse/attempt 無力的藉口／嘗試

sentences.en: The old dog was too feeble to climb the stairs.
sentences.zh: 那隻老狗虛弱得爬不上樓梯。

sentences.en: Isn't that a pretty feeble excuse for being late?
sentences.zh: 那不是個很無力的遲到藉口嗎？

sentences.en: Her voice was so feeble that I could barely hear her.
sentences.zh: 她的聲音虛弱到我幾乎聽不見。

sentences.en: Why was his reply so feeble?
sentences.zh: 他的回答為什麼這麼無力？

sentences.en: After the flu, my grandma felt feeble for weeks.
sentences.zh: 得了流感之後，我奶奶虛弱了好幾個星期。

sentences.en: The team made a feeble attempt to defend the goal.
sentences.zh: 球隊做了一次無力的防守嘗試。

gloss_note: 文法上可指陰性；反義 masculine

sentences.en: She prefers a soft, feminine style of clothing.
sentences.zh: 她偏好柔和、有女人味的服裝風格。

sentences.en: Do you think this color looks too feminine?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個顏色看起來太女性化嗎？

sentences.en: Her room has a very feminine look, with pink walls.
sentences.zh: 她的房間很有女人味，牆壁是粉紅色的。

sentences.en: The designer wanted the dress to look elegant and feminine.
sentences.zh: 設計師希望這件洋裝看起來優雅而有女人味。

sentences.en: Which of these two bags looks more feminine to you?
sentences.zh: 這兩個包包，你覺得哪一個比較有女人味？

sentences.en: The hotel lobby has a light and feminine design.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店大廳的設計輕盈又有女人味。

sentences.en: Farmers spread fertilizer on the fields every spring.
sentences.zh: 農夫每年春天都會把肥料撒在田裡。

sentences.en: Which fertilizer works best for tomato plants?
sentences.zh: 哪一種肥料最適合番茄植物？

sentences.en: Do I need to buy more fertilizer for the lawn?
sentences.zh: 我需要再買更多草坪用的肥料嗎？

sentences.en: Too much fertilizer can burn the roots.
sentences.zh: 肥料太多會燒傷根部。

sentences.en: The hardware store has a sale on garden fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 五金行的園藝肥料正在特價。

sentences.en: Chemical fertilizer can pollute rivers and lakes if used carelessly.
sentences.zh: 化學肥料若使用不當，可能污染河川和湖泊。

sentences.en: The restaurant is serving a festive menu this month.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳這個月供應節慶菜單。

sentences.en: Would you like to try our festive dessert?
sentences.zh: 你想試試我們的節慶甜點嗎？

sentences.en: The whole street looked festive with lights and flags.
sentences.zh: 整條街掛滿燈飾和旗子，充滿節慶氣氛。

sentences.en: Is there a festive drink on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜單上有節慶飲料嗎？

sentences.en: Her red sweater made her feel festive.
sentences.zh: 她那件紅毛衣讓她覺得喜氣洋洋。

sentences.en: We set the table with festive napkins and candles.
sentences.zh: 我們用喜氣的餐巾和蠟燭佈置餐桌。

sentences.en: I'll have the fettuccine Alfredo, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點阿弗列多白醬寬扁麵，謝謝。

sentences.en: Does the fettuccine come with chicken or shrimp?
sentences.zh: 這道寬扁麵是配雞肉還是蝦子？

sentences.en: Fresh fettuccine cooks in only three minutes.
sentences.zh: 新鮮的寬扁麵只要煮三分鐘。

sentences.en: My husband made fettuccine with mushrooms and cream.
sentences.zh: 我先生做了加蘑菇和鮮奶油的寬扁麵。

sentences.en: Can I get the fettuccine with a side salad?
sentences.zh: 我可以點寬扁麵再附一份生菜沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: Rich cream sauce goes well with fettuccine.
sentences.zh: 濃郁的奶油醬很適合配寬扁麵。

gloss_note: 女性為 fiancee（多一個 e）

sentences.en: My fiancé and I are getting married in June.
sentences.zh: 我未婚夫和我六月要結婚。

sentences.en: Have you met my fiancé yet?
sentences.zh: 你見過我的未婚夫了嗎？

sentences.en: She introduced her fiancé to everyone at the office party.
sentences.zh: 她在公司派對上把未婚夫介紹給大家。

sentences.en: Is your fiancé coming to the dinner on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你的未婚夫週五會來吃晚餐嗎？

sentences.en: Her fiancé proposed to her at the beach.
sentences.zh: 她的未婚夫在海邊向她求婚。

sentences.en: My fiancé works as a nurse at the hospital downtown.
sentences.zh: 我的未婚夫在市區的醫院當護理師。

gloss_note: 美式拼法 filet；filet mignon 菲力牛排

sentences.en: I'd like the filet mignon, medium rare, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一份菲力牛排，三分熟，謝謝。

sentences.en: Does the salmon filet come with rice or potatoes?
sentences.zh: 這份鮭魚排附飯還是馬鈴薯？

sentences.en: The waiter recommended the grilled fish filet.
sentences.zh: 服務生推薦了烤魚排。

sentences.en: How much is the filet on the dinner menu?
sentences.zh: 晚餐菜單上的菲力牛排多少錢？

sentences.en: She ordered a small filet with mashed potatoes.
sentences.zh: 她點了一份小份菲力，附馬鈴薯泥。

sentences.en: First, sprinkle some salt and pepper on the cod filet.
sentences.zh: 首先，在鱈魚排上撒些鹽和胡椒。

gloss_note: 常用複數；農曆新年、節慶時施放

sentences.en: Kids set off a firecracker outside our apartment last night.
sentences.zh: 孩子們昨晚在我們公寓外面放了一支鞭炮。

sentences.en: Did you hear the firecracker go off?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到鞭炮炸開的聲音嗎？

sentences.en: We heard firecrackers all night during Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 農曆新年期間，我們整晚都聽得到鞭炮聲。

sentences.en: It is illegal to sell firecrackers in some cities.
sentences.zh: 在某些城市販售鞭炮是違法的。

sentences.en: Is it safe to let kids light a firecracker?
sentences.zh: 讓小孩點鞭炮安全嗎？

sentences.en: My dog hides under the bed when a firecracker goes off.
sentences.zh: 鞭炮一響，我家的狗就躲到床底下。

sentences.en: The company keeps its files in a fireproof cabinet.
sentences.zh: 公司把檔案放在防火櫃裡。

sentences.en: Is this safe really fireproof?
sentences.zh: 這個保險箱真的防火嗎？

sentences.en: The new building has fireproof walls and doors.
sentences.zh: 這棟新大樓有防火的牆壁和門。

sentences.en: Are the curtains in this hotel room fireproof?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店客房的窗簾防火嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a fireproof box for our passports.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一個防火盒來放護照。

sentences.en: The firefighter's coat is made of fireproof material.
sentences.zh: 消防員的外套是用防火材料製成的。

sentences.en: The fishery along this coast employs thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 這段海岸的漁業僱用了數千人。

sentences.en: Is the local fishery still doing well this year?
sentences.zh: 當地的漁業今年還好嗎？

sentences.en: Overfishing has hurt the fishery badly.
sentences.zh: 過度捕撈使漁業大受打擊。

sentences.en: How big is the fishery near your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你家鄉附近的漁場有多大？

sentences.en: The government set new rules to protect the fishery.
sentences.zh: 政府訂定了新規定來保護漁業。

sentences.en: My uncle works at a fishery off the east coast.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在東海岸外的一座漁場工作。

sentences.en: The landlord will replace the old light fixtures next week.
sentences.zh: 房東下週會更換舊的燈具。

sentences.en: Does the rent include the bathroom fixtures?
sentences.zh: 租金有包含衛浴設備嗎？

sentences.en: The shop is buying display fixtures for the new location.
sentences.zh: 這家店正在為新店面添購陳列設備。

sentences.en: Do the kitchen fixtures belong to the tenant or the landlord?
sentences.zh: 廚房的固定設備是屬於房客還是房東？

sentences.en: Please turn off the power before you touch the fixture.
sentences.zh: 碰燈具之前，請先關掉電源。

sentences.en: The plumber replaced the old fixture in the shower.
sentences.zh: 水電工換掉了淋浴間的舊衛浴設備。

gloss_note: paint flakes off 油漆剝落

sentences.en: Paint began to flake off the old fence.
sentences.zh: 舊圍籬上的油漆開始剝落。

sentences.en: Does the fish flake easily when you press it with a fork?
sentences.zh: 用叉子壓魚肉，魚肉會輕易一片片剝開嗎？

sentences.en: I sprinkled chocolate flakes on top of the cake.
sentences.zh: 我在蛋糕上撒了巧克力薄片。

sentences.en: Why is my skin starting to flake?
sentences.zh: 我的皮膚為什麼開始脫皮？

sentences.en: Cook the salmon until it starts to flake.
sentences.zh: 把鮭魚煮到肉開始一片片剝開。

sentences.en: Do you want some red pepper flakes on your pizza?
sentences.zh: 你的披薩要加一些辣椒片嗎？

sentences.en: I flunked my chemistry test last week.
sentences.zh: 我上週化學考試不及格了。

sentences.en: Did you flunk the driving test again?
sentences.zh: 你的駕照考試又不及格了嗎？

sentences.en: He is afraid he will flunk math this semester.
sentences.zh: 他擔心這學期數學會被當掉。

sentences.en: Will I flunk the class if I miss one more quiz?
sentences.zh: 如果我再缺考一次小考，這門課會被當嗎？

sentences.en: Half the students flunked the final exam.
sentences.zh: 一半的學生期末考不及格。

sentences.en: My brother nearly flunked English in high school.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟高中時英文差點被當。

gloss_note: 書面、文學用語；日常多說 enemy

sentences.en: The hero finally faced his greatest foe.
sentences.zh: 英雄終於面對他最大的敵人。

sentences.en: Was the old king a friend or a foe?
sentences.zh: 那位老國王是朋友還是敵人？

sentences.en: The two teams have been foes for years.
sentences.zh: 這兩支球隊多年來一直是對手。

sentences.en: Who is the main foe in this story?
sentences.zh: 這個故事裡的主要敵人是誰？

sentences.en: Our cat and the neighbor's dog are old foes.
sentences.zh: 我們家的貓和鄰居的狗是老冤家。

sentences.en: The knight swore to defeat every foe in his path.
sentences.zh: 騎士發誓要擊敗路上的每一個敵人。

gloss_note: 不可數；folk tale 為單篇民間故事

sentences.en: Our class is studying Taiwanese folklore this month.
sentences.zh: 我們班這個月在研讀台灣的民間傳說。

sentences.en: According to local folklore, a dragon lives in this lake.
sentences.zh: 根據當地的民間傳說，有條龍住在這座湖裡。

sentences.en: Do you know any folklore about this mountain?
sentences.zh: 你知道任何關於這座山的民間傳說嗎？

sentences.en: Is that story real, or just old folklore?
sentences.zh: 那個故事是真的，還是只是古老的民間傳說？

sentences.en: My grandmother knows a lot of folklore from her village.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶知道許多她村子裡的民間傳說。

sentences.en: The museum has an exhibit on folklore and festivals.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一個關於民俗與節慶的展覽。

sentences.en: Let's order the cheese fondue for the table.
sentences.zh: 我們點一份起司火鍋給全桌吧。

sentences.en: Does the fondue come with bread and vegetables?
sentences.zh: 這份起司火鍋附麵包和蔬菜嗎？

sentences.en: The chocolate fondue was the best part of the dinner.
sentences.zh: 巧克力鍋是這頓晚餐最棒的部分。

sentences.en: Be careful, the fondue pot is very hot.
sentences.zh: 小心，這個起司鍋很燙。

sentences.en: Have you ever eaten fondue at a restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你有在餐廳吃過起司火鍋嗎？

sentences.en: We dipped fresh strawberries into the warm chocolate fondue.
sentences.zh: 我們把新鮮草莓沾進溫熱的巧克力鍋裡。

gloss_note: 不可數、集合名詞；shoes/boots 的總稱

sentences.en: Our dress code requires safe footwear on the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 我們的服裝規定要求在工廠作業區穿安全鞋。

sentences.en: Which department sells women's footwear?
sentences.zh: 哪個部門賣女鞋？

sentences.en: Do I have to wear special footwear on the job site?
sentences.zh: 在工地我一定要穿特別的鞋子嗎？

sentences.en: The store has a big sale on winter footwear.
sentences.zh: 這家店的冬季鞋款正在大特價。

sentences.en: Please keep your footwear by the front door.
sentences.zh: 請把鞋子放在前門旁邊。

sentences.en: The company makes comfortable footwear for nurses.
sentences.zh: 這家公司生產給護理師穿的舒適鞋類。

gloss_zh: 難以對付的；令人敬畏的

sentences.en: Our biggest rival is a formidable opponent.
sentences.zh: 我們最大的對手是個難以對付的勁敵。

sentences.en: Is this task as formidable as it sounds?
sentences.zh: 這項任務真的像聽起來那麼艱鉅嗎？

sentences.en: Climbing the mountain in one day was a formidable task.
sentences.zh: 一天內爬完這座山是一項艱鉅的任務。

sentences.en: She is a formidable lawyer who rarely loses a case.
sentences.zh: 她是位令人敬畏的律師，很少輸掉官司。

sentences.en: Did you see the formidable wall around the old fortress?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那座古堡壘周圍令人望而生畏的牆嗎？

sentences.en: Do you think we can beat such a formidable team?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們打得贏這麼難對付的球隊嗎？

sentences.en: He promised never to forsake his family.
sentences.zh: 他承諾絕不拋棄家人。

sentences.en: Would you forsake your career to travel the world?
sentences.zh: 你會為了環遊世界而放棄事業嗎？

sentences.en: The old village was forsaken by its residents long ago.
sentences.zh: 這座古老的村莊很久以前就被居民拋棄了。

sentences.en: Did the hero forsake his friends in the story?
sentences.zh: 故事裡的英雄有拋棄他的朋友嗎？

sentences.en: She would never forsake her principles for money.
sentences.zh: 她絕不會為了錢而放棄自己的原則。

sentences.en: The sailors refused to forsake their sinking ship.
sentences.zh: 水手們拒絕拋棄他們那艘正在下沉的船。

gloss_note: fortified with vitamins 營養強化

sentences.en: The soldiers worked to fortify the city walls.
sentences.zh: 士兵們努力加強城牆的防禦。

sentences.en: Is this cereal fortified with vitamins and iron?
sentences.zh: 這種麥片有添加維他命和鐵質來強化營養嗎？

sentences.en: Do you think we should fortify the door with another lock?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們該再加一道鎖來加強這扇門嗎？

sentences.en: A good breakfast will fortify you for a long day.
sentences.zh: 吃頓豐盛的早餐，能讓你有體力面對漫長的一天。

sentences.en: The company plans to fortify its security this year.
sentences.zh: 公司打算今年加強保全。

sentences.en: Workers fortified the old bridge with steel beams.
sentences.zh: 工人用鋼樑加固了這座老橋。

gloss_note: 書面；美國日常多說 poultry

sentences.en: Farmers raise fowl such as chickens and ducks.
sentences.zh: 農夫飼養雞和鴨之類的家禽。

sentences.en: Are geese and turkeys considered fowl?
sentences.zh: 鵝和火雞算是家禽嗎？

sentences.en: The farm sells fresh eggs and fowl.
sentences.zh: 這座農場賣新鮮的蛋和家禽。

sentences.en: The farm show has a contest for the best fowl.
sentences.zh: 農業展有個最佳家禽的比賽。

sentences.en: Is it safe to keep fowl near the house?
sentences.zh: 把家禽養在房子附近安全嗎？

sentences.en: The recipe works with any kind of fowl.
sentences.zh: 這道食譜適用於任何種類的家禽。

gloss_note: 也可指香水（fragrance counter 香水專櫃）

sentences.en: I love the fragrance of fresh coffee in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡早晨新鮮咖啡的香氣。

sentences.en: Which fragrance do you want for your birthday?
sentences.zh: 你生日想要哪一款香水？

sentences.en: The roses filled the room with a sweet fragrance.
sentences.zh: 玫瑰讓整個房間充滿甜美的香氣。

sentences.en: Does this soap have a strong fragrance?
sentences.zh: 這塊肥皂的香味很重嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a light fragrance to the interview.
sentences.zh: 她面試時噴了淡淡的香水。

sentences.en: The fragrance of baking bread came from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 烘焙麵包的香味從廚房飄來。

sentences.en: The garden is full of fragrant flowers.
sentences.zh: 花園裡開滿了芳香的花。

sentences.en: Is this tea fragrant enough for you?
sentences.zh: 這茶對你來說夠香嗎？

sentences.en: The fragrant soup on the stove made everyone hungry.
sentences.zh: 爐子上香噴噴的湯讓大家都餓了。

sentences.en: Do fragrant candles help you relax?
sentences.zh: 香氛蠟燭能幫助你放鬆嗎？

sentences.en: The cook added fragrant herbs to the rice.
sentences.zh: 廚師在飯裡加了芳香的香草。

sentences.en: A fragrant breeze came through the open window.
sentences.zh: 一陣芳香的微風從敞開的窗戶吹進來。

gloss_note: frantic search/call 慌亂地尋找／打電話

sentences.en: I was frantic when I couldn't find my passport.
sentences.zh: 我找不到護照時慌了手腳。

sentences.en: Why are you so frantic this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上怎麼這麼慌張？

sentences.en: She made a frantic call to the airline.
sentences.zh: 她驚慌地打電話給航空公司。

sentences.en: The office was frantic before the big deadline.
sentences.zh: 在重要的截止日前，辦公室裡一片慌亂。

sentences.en: Were the parents frantic when the child got lost in the mall?
sentences.zh: 孩子在購物中心走失時，父母是不是慌亂不已？

sentences.en: The frantic crowd rushed toward the exit.
sentences.zh: 慌亂的群眾衝向出口。

sentences.en: I'd like a large vanilla frappe, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯大杯香草冰沙咖啡，謝謝。

sentences.en: Can I get the mocha frappe with oat milk?
sentences.zh: 摩卡冰沙咖啡可以換成燕麥奶嗎？

sentences.en: It's so hot today that I want a cold frappe.
sentences.zh: 今天好熱，我想喝一杯冰涼的冰沙咖啡。

sentences.en: In New England, a frappe is a thick milkshake.
sentences.zh: 在新英格蘭地區，frappe 指的是濃稠的奶昔。

sentences.en: Would you like whipped cream on your frappe?
sentences.zh: 你的冰沙咖啡要加鮮奶油嗎？

sentences.en: My friend makes a great frappe with her blender.
sentences.zh: 我朋友用果汁機做出很棒的冰沙咖啡。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 美西常用；美東多說 highway

sentences.en: The freeway was packed with cars this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上高速公路上擠滿了車。

sentences.en: Which freeway should we take to the airport?
sentences.zh: 我們去機場該走哪條高速公路？

sentences.en: Traffic on the freeway was backed up for miles.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上的車流大排長龍，塞了好幾英里。

sentences.en: Is there a gas station near the next freeway exit?
sentences.zh: 下一個高速公路出口附近有加油站嗎？

sentences.en: I drive on the freeway to work every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天開車走高速公路上班。

sentences.en: Construction will close the freeway this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末施工會封閉這段高速公路。

sentences.en: Trout is a freshwater fish.
sentences.zh: 鱒魚是淡水魚。

sentences.en: Is this fish freshwater or saltwater?
sentences.zh: 這種魚是淡水魚還是海水魚？

sentences.en: The restaurant serves freshwater shrimp from a local farm.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應來自當地養殖場的淡水蝦。

sentences.en: Do you like the taste of freshwater fish?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡淡水魚的味道嗎？

sentences.en: We caught freshwater bass at the lake and grilled it.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖裡釣到淡水鱸魚，然後拿去烤。

sentences.en: Grilled freshwater eel is popular in many Asian restaurants.
sentences.zh: 烤淡水鰻在許多亞洲餐廳很受歡迎。

gloss_zh: 多餘的裝飾；非必要附加
gloss_note: 多用 no frills；no-frills 指簡單實在

sentences.en: The motel offers no frills, just a clean bed.
sentences.zh: 這間汽車旅館沒有多餘的裝飾，只有一張乾淨的床。

sentences.en: Do you prefer a diner with no frills or a fancy restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡沒有多餘裝飾的小餐館，還是高級餐廳？

sentences.en: The menu has no frills, but the food is great.
sentences.zh: 這份菜單很簡單樸實，但食物很棒。

sentences.en: Does the cheap hotel have any frills, like free breakfast?
sentences.zh: 這間便宜的飯店有沒有免費早餐之類的附加服務？

sentences.en: I like a plain cake with no frills.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡不加任何多餘裝飾的樸素蛋糕。

sentences.en: The airline cut all the frills to keep ticket prices low.
sentences.zh: 這家航空公司取消了所有不必要的附加服務，好讓票價保持低廉。

sentences.en: Paint fumes made me feel dizzy.
sentences.zh: 油漆散發的氣體讓我覺得頭暈。

sentences.en: Open the window so the fumes can escape.
sentences.zh: 打開窗戶，讓有害氣體散出去。

sentences.en: Do these cleaning products give off strong fumes?
sentences.zh: 這些清潔用品會散發強烈的氣體嗎？

sentences.en: Exhaust fumes from the trucks fill the street.
sentences.zh: 卡車的廢氣瀰漫整條街。

sentences.en: Is it safe to breathe the fumes from this glue?
sentences.zh: 吸入這種膠水散發的氣體安全嗎？

sentences.en: Workers must wear masks to avoid breathing toxic fumes.
sentences.zh: 工人必須戴口罩，以免吸入有毒氣體。

gloss_note: in fury 憤怒地；較 anger 強烈

sentences.en: She threw the letter down in fury.
sentences.zh: 她憤怒地把信摔在地上。

sentences.en: His face turned red with fury.
sentences.zh: 他氣得滿臉通紅。

sentences.en: Did you see the fury in his eyes?
sentences.zh: 你有看到他眼中的怒火嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the news cause such public fury?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那則新聞引發這麼大的民憤？

sentences.en: The customer shouted at the clerk in fury.
sentences.zh: 顧客憤怒地對店員大吼。

sentences.en: Were you surprised by her sudden fury at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你對她在會議上突然的暴怒感到意外嗎？

gloss_note: blown fuse 保險絲燒斷；fuse box 保險絲盒

sentences.en: A blown fuse cut the power in our kitchen.
sentences.zh: 保險絲燒斷了，我們廚房斷電了。

sentences.en: Do you know where the fuse box is?
sentences.zh: 你知道保險絲盒在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: The electrician replaced the fuse in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 電工五分鐘就換好了保險絲。

sentences.en: Did the fuse blow when you turned on the heater?
sentences.zh: 你打開暖氣機時，保險絲有燒斷嗎？

sentences.en: The fireworks crew lit the long fuse and stepped back.
sentences.zh: 煙火工作人員點燃長長的導火線後退開。

sentences.en: Cut the power before you check the fuse.
sentences.zh: 檢查保險絲之前，先把電源切斷。

gloss_note: make a fuss；fuss over sb 過度關心

sentences.en: Please don't make a fuss over a small mistake.
sentences.zh: 請不要為了一個小錯誤大驚小怪。

sentences.en: Why is everyone making such a fuss about the new phone?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家都為了那支新手機大驚小怪？

sentences.en: My mom always fusses over me when I'm sick.
sentences.zh: 我生病時，媽媽總是緊張兮兮地照顧我。

sentences.en: What's all the fuss about?
sentences.zh: 這樣大驚小怪是為了什麼？

sentences.en: Don't fuss about the small details; just send the file.
sentences.zh: 別為了小細節小題大作了，把檔案寄出去就好。

sentences.en: He never makes a fuss when the flight is delayed.
sentences.zh: 航班延誤時，他從來不大驚小怪。

gloss_note: 指馬的最快步伐；gallop 比 trot 快

sentences.en: The horse began to gallop across the field.
sentences.zh: 那匹馬開始在田野上飛奔。

sentences.en: Can you hear the horses gallop down the road?
sentences.zh: 你聽得到馬在路上疾馳的聲音嗎？

sentences.en: The cowboy let his horse gallop along the river.
sentences.zh: 牛仔讓他的馬沿著河邊疾馳。

sentences.en: Did you ever learn how to gallop on a horse?
sentences.zh: 你學過怎麼騎馬疾馳嗎？

sentences.en: We heard the gallop of horses getting closer.
sentences.zh: 我們聽到馬匹疾馳的聲音越來越近。

sentences.en: The racehorse broke into a gallop at the start.
sentences.zh: 賽馬一起跑就飛奔起來。

sentences.en: My dad loves old gangster movies from the 1940s.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸愛看1940年代的老黑幫電影。

sentences.en: Is that actor playing a gangster in the new movie?
sentences.zh: 那位演員在新電影裡演黑幫分子嗎？

sentences.en: The news says police arrested a gangster downtown last night.
sentences.zh: 新聞說警方昨晚在市區逮捕了一名幫派分子。

sentences.en: Which gangster film should we watch tonight?
sentences.zh: 我們今晚該看哪一部黑幫電影？

sentences.en: The museum has an exhibit about gangsters in the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一個關於1920年代黑幫的展覽。

sentences.en: The book tells the life story of a famous gangster.
sentences.zh: 這本書講述一位知名黑幫分子的人生故事。

gloss_note: 中性用語；舊義「快樂的」已過時

sentences.en: My roommate is gay, and we're good friends.
sentences.zh: 我的室友是同性戀，我們是好朋友。

sentences.en: Our school has a club for gay students and their friends.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有個給同性戀學生和他們朋友的社團。

sentences.en: Did you watch the movie about two gay teenagers?
sentences.zh: 你看過那部講兩個同性戀少年的電影嗎？

sentences.en: One character in the show is a gay father.
sentences.zh: 這齣影集有個角色是同性戀爸爸。

sentences.en: My aunt is gay, and she lives with her partner.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨是同性戀，她和她的伴侶住在一起。

sentences.en: Did you know the main character in that book is gay?
sentences.zh: 你知道那本書的主角是同性戀嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數；常說 geometry class 幾何課

sentences.en: I have a geometry quiz tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天有幾何學小考。

sentences.en: Is geometry harder than algebra for you?
sentences.zh: 對你來說，幾何學比代數更難嗎？

sentences.en: My sister is helping me with my geometry homework.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹正在幫我寫幾何學作業。

sentences.en: Do you remember the geometry formulas from high school?
sentences.zh: 你還記得高中的幾何學公式嗎？

sentences.en: Architects use geometry to design strong buildings.
sentences.zh: 建築師運用幾何學來設計堅固的建築。

sentences.en: Ancient Greeks made great discoveries in geometry.
sentences.zh: 古希臘人在幾何學上有重大發現。

sentences.en: We planned a romantic getaway to the coast.
sentences.zh: 我們計畫去海邊來一趟浪漫的小旅行。

sentences.en: Our company is offering a weekend getaway as a prize.
sentences.zh: 公司提供週末度假行程當作獎品。

sentences.en: Do you need a quick getaway after this busy week?
sentences.zh: 忙碌的這一週過後，你需要來趟短途度假嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a good getaway spot near the city?
sentences.zh: 市區附近有沒有適合短期度假的好去處？

sentences.en: This cabin is a perfect getaway for a weekend.
sentences.zh: 這間小木屋是週末度假的絕佳去處。

sentences.en: The hotel advertises a cheap getaway package for couples.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店推出給情侶的優惠度假套裝行程。

gloss_note: 美國口語；也指女性之間的好友

sentences.en: I took my girlfriend to a new Italian restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我帶女朋友去了一家新開的義大利餐廳。

sentences.en: My girlfriend ordered the salmon, and I had steak.
sentences.zh: 我女朋友點了鮭魚，我點了牛排。

sentences.en: Can we get a table for two? It's my girlfriend's birthday.
sentences.zh: 我們可以安排一張雙人桌嗎？今天是我女朋友的生日。

sentences.en: Does your girlfriend like spicy food?
sentences.zh: 你女朋友喜歡吃辣嗎？

sentences.en: Where does your girlfriend want to eat tonight?
sentences.zh: 你女朋友今晚想去哪裡吃飯？

sentences.en: My girlfriend and I cook dinner together every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我和女朋友每個星期天一起煮晚餐。

sentences.en: The glacier is melting faster every year.
sentences.zh: 冰河每年融化得更快。

sentences.en: Did you see the glacier on your trip to Alaska?
sentences.zh: 你去阿拉斯加旅行時有看到冰河嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists can hike on the glacier with a guide.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以在嚮導帶領下在冰河上健行。

sentences.en: How thick is the glacier near the top of the mountain?
sentences.zh: 山頂附近的冰河有多厚？

sentences.en: Scientists study the glacier to learn about the climate.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究冰河以了解氣候。

sentences.en: The glacier slowly carved a deep valley over time.
sentences.zh: 冰河經過漫長的時間，慢慢刻出一道深谷。

gloss_note: a glamorous life 光鮮亮麗的生活

sentences.en: She looked glamorous in her long red dress.
sentences.zh: 她穿著紅色長洋裝，看起來光彩迷人。

sentences.en: Is working at a fashion magazine really that glamorous?
sentences.zh: 在時尚雜誌工作真的有那麼光鮮亮麗嗎？

sentences.en: My aunt lived a glamorous life in Paris.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨以前在巴黎過著光鮮亮麗的生活。

sentences.en: The actress wore a glamorous gown to the awards night.
sentences.zh: 那位女演員穿著一件迷人的禮服出席頒獎典禮。

sentences.en: Do you think a glamorous wedding is worth the cost?
sentences.zh: 你覺得辦一場華麗的婚禮值得花那筆錢嗎？

sentences.en: Her job sounds glamorous, but it's mostly long flights.
sentences.zh: 她的工作聽起來很光鮮，其實大多是長途飛行。

sentences.en: The glamour of the big city attracted him.
sentences.zh: 大城市的魅力吸引了他。

sentences.en: Behind the glamour, the job is hard work.
sentences.zh: 光鮮亮麗的背後，這份工作其實很辛苦。

sentences.en: Does the glamour of the stage ever wear off?
sentences.zh: 舞台的光彩會不會有消退的一天？

sentences.en: Some sparkly lights added a touch of glamour to the room.
sentences.zh: 一些閃亮的燈飾為房間增添了幾分魅力。

sentences.en: Why do so many kids dream of the glamour of fame?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那麼多孩子嚮往名氣帶來的光鮮亮麗？

sentences.en: These old photos show the glamour of that era.
sentences.zh: 這些老照片呈現出那個年代的風采。

sentences.en: There was a gleam of excitement in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她的眼中閃爍著興奮的光芒。

sentences.en: The floor gleamed after we cleaned it.
sentences.zh: 我們清理過後，地板閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: Can you see the gleam of that light across the lake?
sentences.zh: 你看得到湖對岸那道閃光嗎？

sentences.en: Why do his shoes always gleam like new?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他的鞋子總是亮得像新的一樣？

sentences.en: The car's hood gleamed in the afternoon sun.
sentences.zh: 車子的引擎蓋在午後的陽光下閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: I saw a gleam of light under the door.
sentences.zh: 我看到門縫下有一道微光。

sentences.en: The skaters glide across the ice with ease.
sentences.zh: 溜冰的人輕鬆地滑過冰面。

sentences.en: Have you ever watched an eagle glide over a valley?
sentences.zh: 你看過老鷹在山谷上空滑翔嗎？

sentences.en: The boat glided quietly across the lake.
sentences.zh: 小船悄悄滑過湖面。

sentences.en: Does the new drawer glide smoothly when you open it?
sentences.zh: 這個新抽屜拉開時滑順嗎？

sentences.en: The dancer glided across the stage in a white dress.
sentences.zh: 舞者穿著白色洋裝滑過舞台。

sentences.en: The pilot let the small plane glide down to the runway.
sentences.zh: 飛行員讓小飛機滑翔降落到跑道上。

sentences.en: My daughter spilled glitter all over the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 我女兒把亮粉灑得整張廚房餐桌都是。

sentences.en: Her new earrings glitter under the lights.
sentences.zh: 她的新耳環在燈光下閃閃發光。

sentences.en: Do we have any glitter for the school art project?
sentences.zh: 我們有亮粉可以做學校的美勞作業嗎？

sentences.en: Why does the snow glitter so much this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上的雪為什麼這麼閃亮？

sentences.en: The kids covered their cards with glitter and glue.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在卡片上塗滿了亮粉和膠水。

sentences.en: The city lights glittered on the water at night.
sentences.zh: 夜晚，城市的燈光在水面上閃閃發光。

sentences.en: We sat in the gloom, waiting for the power to come back.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在昏暗中，等電力恢復。

sentences.en: A feeling of gloom filled the room after the bad news.
sentences.zh: 聽到壞消息後，房間裡瀰漫著憂鬱的氣氛。

sentences.en: Why is there so much gloom in the office today?
sentences.zh: 今天辦公室裡為什麼這麼沉悶？

sentences.en: Can a bright lamp chase away the winter gloom?
sentences.zh: 一盞明亮的燈能驅散冬天的陰鬱嗎？

sentences.en: The gloom of the cave made us nervous.
sentences.zh: 洞穴裡的陰暗讓我們很緊張。

sentences.en: He tried to hide his gloom with a smile.
sentences.zh: 他試著用微笑掩飾自己的憂鬱。

sentences.en: Our goalkeeper stopped three shots in the first half.
sentences.zh: 我們的守門員在上半場擋下了三次射門。

sentences.en: Who is the goalkeeper on your soccer team?
sentences.zh: 你們足球隊的守門員是誰？

sentences.en: The goalkeeper jumped to the left and caught the ball.
sentences.zh: 守門員向左撲出，接住了球。

sentences.en: Does a goalkeeper have to wear special gloves?
sentences.zh: 守門員一定要戴特殊手套嗎？

sentences.en: My brother wants to be a goalkeeper in high school.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟想在高中當守門員。

sentences.en: The goalkeeper was tired after the long game.
sentences.zh: 打完那場漫長的比賽，守門員累壞了。

sentences.en: The gorilla sat quietly and ate leaves.
sentences.zh: 那隻大猩猩安靜地坐著吃樹葉。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a gorilla at the zoo?
sentences.zh: 你在動物園看過大猩猩嗎？

sentences.en: A baby gorilla held on to its mother's back.
sentences.zh: 小猩猩緊緊抓著媽媽的背。

sentences.en: How much does a male gorilla weigh?
sentences.zh: 一隻雄性大猩猩有多重？

sentences.en: The documentary showed a gorilla family in the forest.
sentences.zh: 紀錄片呈現了森林裡的一個大猩猩家庭。

sentences.en: My son played a gorilla in the school play.
sentences.zh: 我兒子在學校的話劇裡演一隻大猩猩。

sentences.en: Our school choir sang a gospel song at the concert.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的合唱團在音樂會上唱了一首福音歌曲。

sentences.en: Do you like gospel music or jazz better?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡福音音樂還是爵士樂？

sentences.en: The gospel choir had amazing voices.
sentences.zh: 那個福音合唱團的歌聲好得驚人。

sentences.en: Is there a gospel choir I can join in this town?
sentences.zh: 這個鎮上有我可以加入的福音合唱團嗎？

sentences.en: My music teacher played a gospel recording in class.
sentences.zh: 我的音樂老師在課堂上播放了一段福音音樂的錄音。

sentences.en: She learned to sing from old gospel records.
sentences.zh: 她是聽老的福音唱片學會唱歌的。

sentences.en: I usually have half a grapefruit for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我早餐通常吃半顆葡萄柚。

sentences.en: Is this grapefruit juice too bitter for you?
sentences.zh: 這杯葡萄柚汁對你來說太苦嗎？

sentences.en: She cut the grapefruit into small slices.
sentences.zh: 她把葡萄柚切成小片。

sentences.en: Could you buy two grapefruits at the market?
sentences.zh: 你可以在市場買兩顆葡萄柚嗎？

sentences.en: This grapefruit tastes sour but also a little sweet.
sentences.zh: 這顆葡萄柚嚐起來酸酸的，又帶點甜。

sentences.en: Did you add grapefruit to the fruit salad?
sentences.zh: 你有把葡萄柚加進水果沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: Cows graze on the hill behind our house.
sentences.zh: 牛群在我們家後面的山坡上吃草。

sentences.en: Do the sheep graze here all year?
sentences.zh: 這裡的羊整年都在這裡吃草嗎？

sentences.en: Farmers let their cattle graze in the open field.
sentences.zh: 農夫讓牛群在空曠的田野上吃草。

sentences.en: The horses grazed quietly by the river.
sentences.zh: 馬兒安靜地在河邊吃草。

sentences.en: Where do the deer graze at night?
sentences.zh: 鹿晚上都在哪裡吃草？

sentences.en: The ranch needs more land for the cattle to graze.
sentences.zh: 這座牧場需要更多土地讓牛群放牧。

sentences.en: Wipe the grease off the stove with a paper towel.
sentences.zh: 用紙巾把爐子上的油汙擦掉。

sentences.en: Why is there so much grease on this pizza?
sentences.zh: 這個披薩上為什麼有這麼多油？

sentences.en: Grease the pan before you pour in the batter.
sentences.zh: 倒入麵糊之前，先在鍋子上抹油。

sentences.en: The cooks scraped the grease off the kitchen wall.
sentences.zh: 廚師們把廚房牆上的油汙刮掉。

sentences.en: Does dish soap remove grease from plates well?
sentences.zh: 洗碗精能把盤子上的油汙洗乾淨嗎？

sentences.en: He greased the bike chain before the ride.
sentences.zh: 他在騎車前幫鏈條上了油。

sentences.en: The students groaned when the teacher gave extra homework.
sentences.zh: 老師多出作業時，學生們都哀嚎起來。

sentences.en: Why did everyone groan at his joke?
sentences.zh: 大家為什麼聽了他的笑話都哀嚎？

sentences.en: We heard a loud groan from the next room.
sentences.zh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來一聲大聲的呻吟。

sentences.en: Did you hear Dad groan when he saw the bill?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到爸爸看到帳單時發出的哀嚎嗎？

sentences.en: She let out a groan after the long climb.
sentences.zh: 爬完那段長長的山路後，她發出一聲呻吟。

sentences.en: The crowd gave a groan when the team missed the shot.
sentences.zh: 球隊投失那一球時，群眾發出一陣哀嘆。

sentences.en: The dog began to growl at the stranger.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗開始對陌生人低吼。

sentences.en: Did you hear that growl behind the bushes?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到灌木叢後面那聲低吼嗎？

sentences.en: My stomach growled during the quiet meeting.
sentences.zh: 安靜的會議中，我的肚子咕嚕咕嚕叫。

sentences.en: Why does your stomach always growl before lunch?
sentences.zh: 為什麼你的肚子總是在午餐前咕嚕叫？

sentences.en: A low growl came from the tiger's cage.
sentences.zh: 老虎的籠子裡傳來一聲低吼。

sentences.en: The cat growled when I tried to pick it up.
sentences.zh: 我想抱起那隻貓時，牠發出低吼。

sentences.en: Customers grumble when the line moves too slowly.
sentences.zh: 隊伍前進得太慢時，顧客都會抱怨。

sentences.en: Why do you always grumble about the weather?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是在抱怨天氣？

sentences.en: He grumbled about the long meeting all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 他整個下午都在抱怨那場冗長的會議。

sentences.en: My brother grumbled but still washed the dishes.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥雖然發了牢騷，還是把碗洗了。

sentences.en: Are the neighbors still grumbling about the noise?
sentences.zh: 鄰居還在為那些噪音發牢騷嗎？

sentences.en: I won't grumble if the bus is a little late today.
sentences.zh: 如果今天公車晚一點來，我不會抱怨的。

sentences.en: A gull stole a french fry from my tray.
sentences.zh: 一隻海鷗從我的托盤上偷走了一根薯條。

sentences.en: Do you see the gulls over the pier?
sentences.zh: 你有看到碼頭上空的海鷗嗎？

sentences.en: The gulls followed the fishing boat all morning.
sentences.zh: 整個早上，海鷗都跟著那艘漁船。

sentences.en: Why are so many gulls in the parking lot?
sentences.zh: 停車場裡為什麼有這麼多海鷗？

sentences.en: A single gull stood on the roof of the beach house.
sentences.zh: 一隻海鷗獨自站在海邊小屋的屋頂上。

sentences.en: We heard the cry of a gull at dawn.
sentences.zh: 我們在黎明時聽到海鷗的叫聲。

sentences.en: The school gymnasium is open until nine tonight.
sentences.zh: 學校的體育館今晚開到九點。

sentences.en: Is the gymnasium big enough for the whole class?
sentences.zh: 這個體育館夠整個班級使用嗎？

sentences.en: Our company rented a gymnasium for the staff sports day.
sentences.zh: 我們公司租了一間體育館來辦員工運動日。

sentences.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the gymnasium.
sentences.zh: 畢業典禮將在體育館舉行。

sentences.en: Do both gymnasiums have a locker room?
sentences.zh: 兩間體育館都有更衣室嗎？

sentences.en: The volleyball team practices in the gymnasium after class.
sentences.zh: 排球隊放學後在體育館練習。

sentences.en: A hacker stole customer data from the company's website.
sentences.zh: 一名駭客從這家公司的網站竊取了客戶資料。

sentences.en: How did the hacker get into our network?
sentences.zh: 那個駭客是怎麼入侵我們網路的？

sentences.en: The bank says a hacker tried to get into my account.
sentences.zh: 銀行說有駭客想闖進我的帳戶。

sentences.en: The company hired a hacker to test its security.
sentences.zh: 這家公司僱了一名駭客來測試自己的資安。

sentences.en: Can a strong password stop a hacker?
sentences.zh: 強度高的密碼擋得住駭客嗎？

sentences.en: The report says a hacker shut down the city's website for a day.
sentences.zh: 報告指出，有駭客讓市政網站停擺了一天。

gloss_note: 作動詞：It hailed. 下了冰雹

sentences.en: Hail hit the roof of our car during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨中，冰雹打在我們的車頂上。

sentences.en: Is it going to hail this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 今天下午會下冰雹嗎？

sentences.en: The hail was as big as golf balls.
sentences.zh: 那些冰雹大得像高爾夫球。

sentences.en: Did the hail damage your garden last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的冰雹有毀掉你的花園嗎？

sentences.en: It hailed for ten minutes, and then the sun came out.
sentences.zh: 下了十分鐘的冰雹，然後太陽就出來了。

sentences.en: The forecast warns of heavy rain and hail tonight.
sentences.zh: 氣象預報警告今晚會有大雨和冰雹。

sentences.en: Heavy snow hampered traffic all across the city.
sentences.zh: 大雪妨礙了全市的交通。

sentences.en: Will the bad weather hamper our travel plans?
sentences.zh: 壞天氣會妨礙我們的旅行計畫嗎？

sentences.en: A lack of money can hamper a small business.
sentences.zh: 缺乏資金可能會阻礙一家小公司的發展。

sentences.en: Loud noise from the street hampered our phone call.
sentences.zh: 街上的大噪音妨礙了我們講電話。

sentences.en: Does this old software hamper your team's progress?
sentences.zh: 這套舊軟體有拖慢你們團隊的進度嗎？

sentences.en: A broken leg hampered his training for months.
sentences.zh: 一條骨折的腿妨礙了他好幾個月的訓練。

gloss_note: 指身心障礙已過時，美國改說 disability

sentences.en: Lack of experience is a big handicap in this job market.
sentences.zh: 缺乏經驗在這個就業市場是很大的不利條件。

sentences.en: Is being short a handicap in basketball?
sentences.zh: 個子矮在籃球場上是不利條件嗎？

sentences.en: Not speaking the language was a handicap for us abroad.
sentences.zh: 不會當地的語言，讓我們在國外吃了不少虧。

sentences.en: Would a late start be a handicap for our team?
sentences.zh: 晚開始對我們這一隊會是個不利條件嗎？

sentences.en: She overcame the handicap of a poor start and won.
sentences.zh: 她克服了起步不佳的不利條件而獲勝。

sentences.en: The bad weather was a handicap for the runners.
sentences.zh: 壞天氣對跑者們來說是個不利因素。

sentences.en: The market sells handicrafts made by local artists.
sentences.zh: 這個市集販售當地藝術家做的手工藝品。

sentences.en: Do you teach handicraft at your school?
sentences.zh: 你們學校有教手工藝嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother's handicraft is famous in the village.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶的手工藝在村子裡很有名。

sentences.en: These handicrafts make nice gifts for tourists.
sentences.zh: 這些手工藝品很適合當作送給遊客的禮物。

sentences.en: Where can I find good handicrafts in this town?
sentences.zh: 在這個鎮上哪裡可以找到好的手工藝品？

sentences.en: Is the handicraft class open to adults on weekends?
sentences.zh: 週末的手工藝課開放給成人參加嗎？

sentences.en: Reporters kept harassing the family with phone calls.
sentences.zh: 記者不斷打電話騷擾那一家人。

sentences.en: Please don't harass the staff over small mistakes.
sentences.zh: 請不要為了小錯誤一直找員工麻煩。

sentences.en: Why do these salespeople harass us every night?
sentences.zh: 這些推銷員為什麼每天晚上都來煩我們？

sentences.en: The company has a rule against harassing coworkers.
sentences.zh: 公司有禁止騷擾同事的規定。

sentences.en: The older boys harassed him on the bus every day.
sentences.zh: 那些大男生每天都在公車上找他麻煩。

sentences.en: Can I report someone who harasses me by email?
sentences.zh: 我可以舉報用電子郵件騷擾我的人嗎？

sentences.en: The company offers training on workplace harassment.
sentences.zh: 公司提供職場騷擾防治的訓練。

sentences.en: Can I report phone harassment to the police?
sentences.zh: 我可以向警方舉報電話騷擾嗎？

sentences.en: She filed a complaint about online harassment.
sentences.zh: 她針對網路騷擾提出了申訴。

sentences.en: Does your school have a policy against harassment?
sentences.zh: 你們學校有禁止騷擾的規定嗎？

sentences.en: Repeated calls from sales agents can feel like harassment.
sentences.zh: 推銷員一再來電，可能讓人覺得是騷擾。

sentences.en: Harassment of any kind is not allowed here.
sentences.zh: 這裡不允許任何形式的騷擾。

sentences.en: The glue will harden in about ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 這種膠大約十分鐘後會變硬。

sentences.en: How long does the concrete take to harden?
sentences.zh: 水泥要多久才會變硬？

sentences.en: Let the clay harden overnight before you paint it.
sentences.zh: 讓黏土放一晚變硬，再上色。

sentences.en: The bad news only hardened his determination to win.
sentences.zh: 那個壞消息只讓他更堅定要贏的決心。

sentences.en: Does butter harden quickly in the fridge?
sentences.zh: 奶油放在冰箱裡會很快變硬嗎？

sentences.en: The mud hardened into a rough surface under the sun.
sentences.zh: 泥巴在太陽下曬成了粗糙的硬地面。

sentences.en: She is the most hardworking person on our team.
sentences.zh: 她是我們團隊裡最勤奮的人。

sentences.en: Are your new employees as hardworking as they seem?
sentences.zh: 你們的新員工真的像看起來那麼努力嗎？

sentences.en: My parents were hardworking people who ran a small shop.
sentences.zh: 我父母都很勤奮，經營著一家小店。

sentences.en: We want to hire a hardworking assistant.
sentences.zh: 我們想僱用一位肯努力的助理。

sentences.en: Do you know any hardworking students who need a part-time job?
sentences.zh: 你認識哪些需要打工的認真學生嗎？

sentences.en: The hardworking farmers got up before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 勤奮的農夫們在日出前就起床了。

sentences.en: My grandfather plays the harmonica every evening.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺每天傍晚都吹口琴。

sentences.en: Can you teach me to play the harmonica?
sentences.zh: 你可以教我吹口琴嗎？

sentences.en: He keeps a small harmonica in his jacket pocket.
sentences.zh: 他的外套口袋裡放著一支小口琴。

sentences.en: The harmonica sounded sweet around the campfire.
sentences.zh: 營火旁的口琴聲聽起來很悅耳。

sentences.en: How much does a good harmonica cost?
sentences.zh: 一支好的口琴要多少錢？

sentences.en: She bought a harmonica at a yard sale.
sentences.zh: 她在一場庭院拍賣會上買了一支口琴。

sentences.en: Many cities hope to harness solar energy.
sentences.zh: 許多城市希望能利用太陽能。

sentences.en: Can we harness the power of the ocean waves?
sentences.zh: 我們能利用海浪的力量嗎？

sentences.en: The farm harnesses wind power to get cheap electricity.
sentences.zh: 這座農場利用風力來取得便宜的電力。

sentences.en: How can teachers harness students' curiosity in class?
sentences.zh: 老師要怎麼在課堂上善用學生的好奇心？

sentences.en: The small town harnessed the river to produce power.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮利用河水來發電。

sentences.en: We should harness our team's skills to finish earlier.
sentences.zh: 我們應該善用團隊的專長，早點完成。

gloss_note: corned beef hash 鹹牛肉雜燴

sentences.en: I ordered corned beef hash with two eggs.
sentences.zh: 我點了鹹牛肉雜燴配兩顆蛋。

sentences.en: Does the diner serve hash on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這家餐館週末有供應煎雜燴嗎？

sentences.en: Dad makes hash from leftover roast beef and potatoes.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用吃剩的烤牛肉和馬鈴薯做煎雜燴。

sentences.en: The hash was crispy on the outside and soft inside.
sentences.zh: 這份雜燴外酥內軟。

sentences.en: Could I get the hash instead of toast?
sentences.zh: 我可以點雜燴來代替吐司嗎？

sentences.en: She cooked a big skillet of hash for brunch.
sentences.zh: 她煎了一大鍋雜燴當早午餐。

sentences.en: People say a friendly ghost haunts the old library.
sentences.zh: 人們說，有一隻和善的鬼魂在那間舊圖書館出沒。

sentences.en: Does a ghost really haunt this house?
sentences.zh: 這間房子真的有鬼魂出沒嗎？

sentences.en: The memory of that mistake still haunts him.
sentences.zh: 那個錯誤的回憶仍然縈繞在他心頭。

sentences.en: Would you stay overnight in a haunted hotel?
sentences.zh: 你敢在鬧鬼的旅館過夜嗎？

sentences.en: That sad song haunts me whenever I hear it.
sentences.zh: 每次聽到那首悲傷的歌，它都會縈繞在我心頭。

sentences.en: A funny ghost haunts the school kitchen in the story.
sentences.zh: 故事裡有一隻搞笑的鬼魂在學校廚房出沒。

gloss_note: 常用複數：a pair of headphones

sentences.en: I forgot my headphones at the office.
sentences.zh: 我把耳機忘在辦公室了。

sentences.en: Do these headphones work with my phone?
sentences.zh: 這副耳機可以用在我的手機上嗎？

sentences.en: She wore headphones to block out the noise.
sentences.zh: 她戴著耳機來隔絕噪音。

sentences.en: Please wear headphones if you want to watch videos here.
sentences.zh: 如果要在這裡看影片，請戴耳機。

sentences.en: My new headphones have great sound quality.
sentences.zh: 我的新耳機音質很棒。

sentences.en: Where did you buy those headphones?
sentences.zh: 你那副耳機是在哪裡買的？

gloss_note: healthful 指事物有益；healthy 指人健康

sentences.en: Salads and fruit make a healthful lunch.
sentences.zh: 沙拉和水果是有益健康的午餐。

sentences.en: Is brown rice more healthful than white rice?
sentences.zh: 糙米比白米更有益健康嗎？

sentences.en: The cafeteria now offers more healthful choices.
sentences.zh: 自助餐廳現在提供更多有益健康的選擇。

sentences.en: The new menu focuses on healthful ingredients.
sentences.zh: 新菜單主打有益健康的食材。

sentences.en: What is the most healthful snack for kids?
sentences.zh: 對小孩來說，最有益健康的點心是什麼？

sentences.en: A healthful diet and enough sleep keep you strong.

sentences.zh: 你想來一碗豐盛的蔬菜湯嗎？

sentences.zh: 他在門口熱情地和我握了手。

sentences.en: This hearty stew will keep you warm in winter.
sentences.zh: 這鍋豐盛的燉菜能讓你在冬天暖呼呼的。

sentences.en: Did you get a hearty welcome from your new coworkers?
sentences.zh: 你的新同事們有熱誠地歡迎你嗎？

sentences.zh: 這家小餐館以份量十足聞名。

sentences.zh: 吵鬧的音樂加強了電影裡的緊張感。

sentences.zh: 一點鹽能提升這道湯的風味嗎？

sentences.zh: 暴風雨的消息加深了我們的擔憂。

sentences.zh: 機場這個週末將加強安全措施。

sentences.en: Will the new rules heighten safety at the pool?
sentences.zh: 新規定會提高游泳池的安全嗎？

sentences.en: A good teacher can heighten students' interest in science.
sentences.zh: 好老師能提高學生對科學的興趣。

sentences.en: Seasons are reversed in the Southern Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 南半球的季節是相反的。

sentences.en: Which hemisphere has summer in December?
sentences.zh: 十二月時哪個半球是夏天？

sentences.en: The Earth is divided into the northern and southern hemispheres.
sentences.zh: 地球分成北半球和南半球。

sentences.en: Is Taiwan in the Northern Hemisphere?
sentences.zh: 台灣位在北半球嗎？

sentences.en: Each hemisphere of the brain handles different tasks.
sentences.zh: 大腦的每個半球負責不同的工作。

sentences.en: Some birds in the Northern Hemisphere fly south in winter.
sentences.zh: 北半球有些鳥類會在冬天飛往南方。

sentences.zh: 信上寫著「我特此辭職」，這樣夠了嗎？

sentences.zh: 表格上寫「本人特此同意」，我要在這裡簽名嗎？

sentences.zh: 茲邀請您參加我們公司的年度晚宴。

sentences.en: The contract says the lease is hereby extended by one year.
sentences.zh: 合約寫明租約特此延長一年。

sentences.en: The company hereby announces a new return policy.
sentences.zh: 本公司特此公布新的退貨政策。

sentences.en: Check the line that says "hereby approved" before you sign.
sentences.zh: 簽名之前，先確認寫著「特此核准」的那一行。

sentences.en: The firefighter made a heroic rescue.
sentences.zh: 那名消防員完成了一次英勇的救援。

sentences.en: Do you think his heroic act deserves a medal?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他的英勇行為值得得到一枚獎章嗎？

sentences.en: The movie tells a heroic story of a small town.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講述一個小鎮的英雄故事。

sentences.en: A heroic nurse stayed to help every patient.
sentences.zh: 一位英勇的護理師留下來幫助每一位病患。

sentences.en: Why do kids love heroic characters in cartoons?
sentences.zh: 為什麼小孩子喜歡卡通裡的英雄角色？

sentences.en: The coach praised the team's heroic comeback in the final game.
sentences.zh: 教練稱讚球隊在決賽中英勇的逆轉。

sentences.zh: 我們在一家鐵板燒餐廳慶祝我的生日。

sentences.en: Does the hibachi chef cook at your table?
sentences.zh: 鐵板燒的廚師會在你們的桌邊料理嗎？

sentences.en: The hibachi shrimp and fried rice were delicious.
sentences.zh: 鐵板燒的蝦子和炒飯都很好吃。

sentences.en: Let's get hibachi for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚晚餐去吃鐵板燒吧。

sentences.en: The kids loved watching the hibachi chef flip shrimp.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很愛看鐵板燒廚師翻蝦子。

sentences.en: Is the hibachi lunch special cheaper than dinner?
sentences.zh: 鐵板燒的午間特餐比晚餐便宜嗎？

sentences.en: Could we get a highchair for our baby?
sentences.zh: 可以給我們的寶寶一張高腳餐椅嗎？

sentences.zh: 服務生把一張高腳餐椅搬到我們桌邊。

sentences.en: My son threw peas from his highchair.
sentences.zh: 我兒子從他的高腳餐椅上丟豌豆。

sentences.en: Does this restaurant have a highchair for toddlers?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有給幼兒用的高腳餐椅嗎？

sentences.en: The highchair has a tray that comes off easily.
sentences.zh: 這張高腳餐椅的托盤很容易拆下來。

sentences.en: Our daughter is too big for her highchair now.
sentences.zh: 我們的女兒現在長太大，坐不下她的高腳餐椅了。

sentences.zh: 這部電影在講一群想劫持火車的歹徒。

sentences.zh: 警方攔下了企圖劫持貨運卡車的男子。

sentences.en: Does the hero stop the men who hijack the plane?
sentences.zh: 主角有阻止劫持飛機的那些人嗎？
