sentences.zh: 新聞報導說有名男子劫持了一輛公車，但很快就投降了。

sentences.zh: 小偷是怎麼劫持那輛裝滿筆電的卡車的？

gloss_note: Himalayan salt 喜馬拉雅山玫瑰鹽

sentences.en: I bought a jar of Himalayan salt at the store.
sentences.zh: 我在店裡買了一罐喜馬拉雅山玫瑰鹽。

sentences.en: Is Himalayan salt really better than regular salt?
sentences.zh: 喜馬拉雅山玫瑰鹽真的比一般的鹽好嗎？

sentences.en: The Himalayan mountains are covered in snow all year.
sentences.zh: 喜馬拉雅山脈終年被白雪覆蓋。

sentences.en: We ate dumplings in a small Himalayan village.
sentences.zh: 我們在喜馬拉雅山的一個小村莊吃了餃子。

sentences.en: Do you cook with Himalayan salt at home?
sentences.zh: 你在家煮菜會用喜馬拉雅山玫瑰鹽嗎？

sentences.en: She sprinkled Himalayan salt on the grilled steak.
sentences.zh: 她在烤好的牛排上撒了喜馬拉雅山玫瑰鹽。

sentences.en: The hipster café near campus serves oat milk lattes.
sentences.zh: 學校附近的文青咖啡館有賣燕麥奶拿鐵。

sentences.en: Is your sister a hipster who loves vintage stores?
sentences.zh: 你姊姊是那種愛逛古著店的文青嗎？

sentences.en: My cousin is a hipster who only drinks craft beer.
sentences.zh: 我表哥是個只喝精釀啤酒的文青。

sentences.en: Hipsters line up outside the bakery every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 每個週日早上，文青們都在麵包店外排隊。

sentences.en: Do you think this bakery is full of hipsters?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這家麵包店是不是到處都是文青？

sentences.en: The old warehouse became a hangout for hipsters, with food trucks outside.
sentences.zh: 那間舊倉庫成了文青的聚集地，外面還有餐車。

sentences.zh: 演唱會結束後，我的聲音都啞了。

sentences.en: Why are you so hoarse today?
sentences.zh: 你今天的聲音怎麼這麼沙啞？

sentences.en: She was hoarse from cheering at the game.
sentences.zh: 她因為在比賽中大聲加油，聲音都啞了。

sentences.en: Hot tea with honey helps a hoarse throat.
sentences.zh: 加蜂蜜的熱茶對沙啞的喉嚨有幫助。

sentences.en: The teacher sounded hoarse by the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 到了一天結束時，老師的聲音聽起來很沙啞。

sentences.en: Are you hoarse because of a cold?
sentences.zh: 你聲音沙啞是因為感冒嗎？

sentences.zh: 這一家人在一座小農場養肉豬。

sentences.zh: 他們為鎮上的節慶烤了一整隻豬。

sentences.en: How many hogs does your uncle have?
sentences.zh: 你叔叔養了幾頭豬？

sentences.zh: 我們的培根是直接向養豬場買的。

sentences.zh: 你星期六會來參加烤全豬聚會嗎？

sentences.zh: 一頭肉豬可以重達300磅以上。

sentences.zh: 我帶了自己做的餅乾到公司派對。

sentences.zh: 這個醬料是自己做的，還是罐裝的？

sentences.zh: 這家咖啡館以自製的派聞名。

sentences.zh: 你們店裡有賣自製的果醬嗎？

sentences.zh: 奶奶煮的家常湯總是讓我覺得舒服多了。

sentences.en: Our homemade bread is baked fresh every morning.

sentences.zh: 這間小餐廳感覺溫暖又有家的氣息。

sentences.en: Why does her kitchen feel so homey?
sentences.zh: 為什麼她的廚房感覺這麼溫馨？

sentences.zh: 這家咖啡館有柔軟的椅子，氣氛很溫馨。

sentences.zh: 我想找個溫馨的地方吃週日早午餐。

sentences.zh: 新鮮的麵包和輕柔的音樂讓這家店感覺很溫馨。

sentences.zh: 那所大學頒給她一個榮譽學位。

sentences.en: He was named honorary chairman of the club.
sentences.zh: 他被推舉為俱樂部的名譽主席。

sentences.en: Why did they make the old coach an honorary member?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼讓那位老教練當榮譽會員？

sentences.zh: 榮譽會員需要繳費嗎？

sentences.zh: 她因三十年的服務而獲頒榮譽獎。

sentences.zh: 市長贈送來訪的主廚一把榮譽市鑰。

sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居非常好客。

sentences.zh: 那戶好客的人家邀請我們留下來吃晚餐。

sentences.zh: 謝謝你們在我們拜訪期間這麼熱情招待。

sentences.en: My aunt is so hospitable that guests never leave hungry.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨非常好客，客人從來不會餓著肚子離開。

sentences.zh: 這間旅店的老闆一向都這麼熱情好客嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你們熱情的款待。

sentences.zh: 許多學生想在餐旅業發展。

sentences.zh: 好客是你們文化中很重要的一部分嗎？

sentences.zh: 這間旅店以親切的款待聞名。

sentences.zh: 主人是怎麼款待客人的？

sentences.zh: 當地那一家人的熱情款待讓我們很感動。

sentences.zh: 他在事故後住院了三天。

sentences.zh: 你爺爺上週為什麼住院？

sentences.zh: 她必須住院一晚觀察。

sentences.en: Will they hospitalize him, or can he go home?
sentences.zh: 他們會讓他住院，還是他可以回家？

sentences.zh: 報導指出，兩名駕駛在公路車禍後住院。

sentences.zh: 我們訂了火車站附近一間便宜的青年旅館。

sentences.en: Is there a hostel in this town with private rooms?
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮有附獨立房間的青年旅館嗎？

sentences.en: The hostel offers a free breakfast every morning.
sentences.zh: 這間青年旅館每天早上提供免費早餐。

sentences.en: She met many travelers while staying at a hostel.
sentences.zh: 她住青年旅館時認識了許多旅客。

sentences.en: Did you stay in a hostel during your trip to Europe?
sentences.zh: 你去歐洲旅行時住過青年旅館嗎？

sentences.zh: 青年旅館很受省錢旅行的學生歡迎。

sentences.en: A helicopter hovered above the parking lot for several minutes.
sentences.zh: 一架直升機在停車場上空盤旋了好幾分鐘。

sentences.en: Why is that man hovering near the door?
sentences.zh: 那個男人為什麼在門口附近徘徊？

sentences.en: A hummingbird hovered next to the red flowers.
sentences.zh: 一隻蜂鳥在紅花旁盤旋。

sentences.zh: 每次截止日接近，我老闆就在我桌子附近晃來晃去。

sentences.en: Do you see the seagulls hovering over the pier?
sentences.zh: 你看到碼頭上空盤旋的海鷗了嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter hovered nearby, waiting for us to order.
sentences.zh: 服務生在附近徘徊，等著我們點餐。

sentences.en: That restaurant serves huge portions for a fair price.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳份量很大，價格也公道。

sentences.en: Wow, this burger is huge! Can we share it?
sentences.zh: 哇，這個漢堡好大！我們可以分著吃嗎？

sentences.en: She ordered a huge salad with grilled chicken.
sentences.zh: 她點了一大份有烤雞肉的沙拉。

sentences.en: The bakery is famous for its huge cinnamon rolls.
sentences.zh: 這家烘焙坊以超大的肉桂捲聞名。

sentences.en: Our team made a huge mistake in the report.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在報告中犯了一個大錯。

sentences.en: Is the new stadium really that huge?
sentences.zh: 新體育場真的有那麼大嗎？

sentences.zh: 他想在全班面前羞辱我。

sentences.en: I felt humiliated when my phone rang during the speech.
sentences.zh: 演講時我的手機響了，我覺得好丟臉。

sentences.en: Why would anyone humiliate a coworker in a meeting?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人要在會議上讓同事難堪？

sentences.en: The coach never humiliates his players, even after a loss.
sentences.zh: 教練即使輸球也從不羞辱他的球員。

sentences.en: Do you think the joke humiliated him?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那個玩笑讓他很丟臉嗎？

sentences.en: The singer was humiliated when she forgot the lyrics on stage.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手在台上忘了歌詞，覺得非常丟臉。

gloss_note: have a hunch 有種預感

sentences.en: I have a hunch that she will say yes.
sentences.zh: 我有種預感她會答應。

sentences.en: Do you have a hunch about who sent the gift?
sentences.zh: 你對於誰送了這份禮物有什麼直覺嗎？

sentences.en: His hunch was right, and the shop was closed.
sentences.zh: 他的直覺是對的，那家店關門了。

sentences.en: Call it a hunch, but I think it will rain.
sentences.zh: 說是直覺也行，但我覺得會下雨。

sentences.en: Why did you follow your hunch instead of the data?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼憑直覺，而不是依據資料？

sentences.en: The detective acted on a hunch and checked the old warehouse.
sentences.zh: 偵探憑直覺行動，去查了那間舊倉庫。

sentences.zh: 他真是個偽君子，從不遵守自己訂的規矩。

sentences.en: Don't be a hypocrite. Do what you tell others to do.

sentences.zh: 教練因為違反自己訂的規定，被批評是偽君子。

sentences.zh: 沒有人喜歡批評別人遲到的偽君子。

sentences.zh: 船緩緩轉向以避開冰山。

sentences.zh: 你知道冰山大部分都在水面下嗎？

sentences.zh: 科學家看著一座巨大的冰山從冰河上分離。

sentences.en: We saw a blue iceberg from the tour boat.
sentences.zh: 我們從遊覽船上看到一座藍色的冰山。

sentences.zh: 照片裡那座冰山有多大？

sentences.zh: 這部電影一開始是一艘船靠近一座漂浮的冰山。

sentences.zh: 一盞燈照亮了小房間。

sentences.zh: 煙火照亮了港口上方的夜空。

sentences.zh: 這個例子能幫忙闡明主要概念嗎？

sentences.en: Could you use your phone to illuminate the stairs?
sentences.zh: 你可以用手機把樓梯照亮嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher used a story to illuminate the lesson.
sentences.zh: 老師用一個故事來闡明這堂課的內容。

sentences.en: Candles illuminated the restaurant and made it feel warm.
sentences.zh: 蠟燭照亮了餐廳，讓人覺得很溫暖。

sentences.en: The old legend tells of an immortal king.
sentences.zh: 古老傳說講述一位永生的國王。

sentences.en: Do you think anyone could really be immortal?
sentences.zh: 你覺得有人真的能永生嗎？

sentences.en: That immortal song still plays at every wedding.
sentences.zh: 那首不朽的歌曲在每場婚禮上仍會播放。

sentences.en: The old poet's immortal lines are painted on the library wall.
sentences.zh: 那位老詩人不朽的詩句被畫在圖書館的牆上。

sentences.en: Her immortal words inspired students for generations.
sentences.zh: 她不朽的話語啟發了好幾代學生。

sentences.en: Would you want to be immortal if you could?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的話，你會想長生不老嗎？

sentences.en: The customer grew impatient while waiting for the manager.
sentences.zh: 顧客等經理等得不耐煩了。

sentences.en: Why are you so impatient to see the results?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼急著想看結果？

sentences.en: Please don't be impatient; the system is still updating.
sentences.zh: 請別不耐煩，系統還在更新。

sentences.en: He sounded impatient on the phone this morning.
sentences.zh: 他今天早上講電話時聽起來很不耐煩。

sentences.en: Are you getting impatient with the slow software?
sentences.zh: 你是不是對這個很慢的軟體越來越沒耐心了？

sentences.en: Impatient travelers crowded the gate before boarding began.
sentences.zh: 心急的旅客在開始登機前就擠到登機門前。

sentences.en: The museum has many treasures from the imperial palace.
sentences.zh: 博物館有許多來自皇宮的珍寶。

sentences.en: The imperial army marched across the desert.
sentences.zh: 帝國的軍隊穿越了沙漠。

sentences.en: Was the imperial robe really made of silk?
sentences.zh: 那件皇袍真的是絲綢做的嗎？

sentences.en: We learned about the imperial family in history class.
sentences.zh: 我們在歷史課上學到皇室家族。

sentences.en: Imperial guards protected the palace day and night.
sentences.zh: 禁衛軍日夜守衛著皇宮。

sentences.en: Why did the imperial court move to a new city?
sentences.zh: 為什麼帝國的朝廷要遷到新城市？

sentences.en: The king ordered the guards to imprison the thief.
sentences.zh: 國王命令衛兵把小偷關起來。

sentences.en: In the film, the hero is imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit.
sentences.zh: 在電影裡，主角因為一項他沒犯的罪而被關。

sentences.en: Why did the queen imprison her own brother?
sentences.zh: 為什麼女王要監禁自己的弟弟？

sentences.en: The news said the thief was imprisoned for two years after the trial.
sentences.zh: 新聞說那名小偷審判後被判關兩年。

sentences.en: The pirates imprisoned the sailors in a small cabin.
sentences.zh: 海盜把水手關在一間小艙房裡。

sentences.en: Can a person be imprisoned without a trial?
sentences.zh: 一個人可以不經審判就被關押嗎？

sentences.en: The judge gave him two years of imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 法官判他兩年徒刑。

sentences.en: Life imprisonment is the harshest punishment in many countries.
sentences.zh: 無期徒刑是許多國家最重的刑罰。

sentences.en: How long was his imprisonment in the story?
sentences.zh: 故事裡他被監禁了多久？

sentences.en: The prisoner wrote a diary during his imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 那名囚犯在監禁期間寫日記。

sentences.en: Does the law allow imprisonment for small crimes?
sentences.zh: 法律允許因為輕微的犯罪而判處監禁嗎？

sentences.en: Her imprisonment in the tower lasted seven years in the fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 在童話故事裡，她被監禁在塔中長達七年。

sentences.en: Please answer the incoming call before the meeting starts.
sentences.zh: 請在會議開始前接聽來電。

sentences.en: The incoming manager will start work on Monday.
sentences.zh: 新上任的經理週一開始上班。

sentences.en: Is the incoming email from our client?
sentences.zh: 這封新收到的電子郵件是客戶寄來的嗎？

sentences.en: A hundred incoming students will join the school this fall.
sentences.zh: 今年秋天會有一百名新生入學。

sentences.en: Who will welcome the incoming president of the club?
sentences.zh: 誰會歡迎新上任的社團社長？

sentences.en: After six, incoming calls go to the front desk.
sentences.zh: 六點過後，來電會轉到櫃檯。

sentences.en: She was indignant about the rude email from the landlord.
sentences.zh: 她對房東那封無禮的電子郵件感到憤慨。

sentences.en: Why are the customers so indignant about the new fee?
sentences.zh: 顧客為什麼對新的費用這麼憤慨？

sentences.en: He gave an indignant reply and left the room.
sentences.zh: 他憤慨地回了一句，然後離開了房間。

sentences.en: The fans were indignant at the referee's decision.
sentences.zh: 球迷對裁判的判罰感到憤慨。

sentences.en: Don't look so indignant; I only asked a question.
sentences.zh: 別一臉憤慨的樣子，我只是問了個問題。

sentences.en: Were you indignant when they refused to refund you?
sentences.zh: 他們拒絕退錢給你時，你有沒有很氣憤？

sentences.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on the small town.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨對這個小鎮造成了嚴重的損害。

sentences.en: I don't want to inflict my bad mood on everyone.
sentences.zh: 我不想讓大家承受我的壞心情。

sentences.en: Why did the movie inflict such a sad ending on us?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這部電影要讓我們承受這麼難過的結局？

sentences.en: The flood inflicted heavy losses on local farmers.
sentences.zh: 洪水使當地農民遭受重大損失。

sentences.en: Can one player inflict that much damage on a team?
sentences.zh: 一個球員能對整支球隊造成那麼大的傷害嗎？

sentences.en: He inflicted a long speech on the tired guests.
sentences.zh: 他讓疲憊的客人們硬聽了一場冗長的演講。

gloss_note: 及物動詞，後面不加 in

sentences.en: Many species of birds inhabit this wetland.
sentences.zh: 許多種鳥類棲息在這片濕地。

sentences.en: Do you know who first inhabited this valley?
sentences.zh: 你知道最早住在這座山谷的是誰嗎？

sentences.en: Penguins inhabit the cold coast of the southern ocean.
sentences.zh: 企鵝棲息在南方海洋寒冷的海岸。

sentences.en: About two million people inhabit the city.
sentences.zh: 大約兩百萬人居住在這座城市。

sentences.en: Do any wild animals still inhabit this forest?
sentences.zh: 這片森林裡還有野生動物棲息嗎？

sentences.en: Few people inhabited the island a hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 一百年前，島上幾乎沒有人居住。

sentences.en: The town has only about five hundred inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮只有大約五百位居民。

sentences.en: Every inhabitant received a letter from the city.
sentences.zh: 每位居民都收到了市政府寄來的信。

sentences.en: Are the inhabitants of this village friendly?
sentences.zh: 這個村子的居民友善嗎？

sentences.en: Bats are common inhabitants of the old cave.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠是這個古老洞穴裡常見的棲息者。

sentences.en: How many inhabitants live in your neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你們社區住了多少居民？

sentences.en: The island's inhabitants fish for a living.
sentences.zh: 島上的居民靠捕魚維生。

gloss_note: a sense of injustice 不公平感

sentences.en: She felt a deep sense of injustice after the decision.
sentences.zh: 做出那個決定後，她深深覺得不公平。

sentences.en: Is it an injustice that some students get no help?
sentences.zh: 有些學生得不到協助，這是不是不公平？

sentences.en: Why did the kids call the new rule an injustice?
sentences.zh: 孩子們為什麼說新規定不公平？

sentences.en: He spoke out against injustice at his workplace.
sentences.zh: 他在職場上公開反對不公平的事。

sentences.en: What a terrible injustice that the winner was disqualified!
sentences.zh: 優勝者被取消資格，這實在太不公平了！

sentences.en: The novel is about a boy who fights injustice at school.
sentences.zh: 這本小說是關於一個在學校對抗不公平的男孩。

sentences.en: The road turns inland after the small harbor.
sentences.zh: 這條路過了小港口後轉向內陸。

sentences.en: Inland areas are usually hotter in summer.
sentences.zh: 內陸地區夏天通常比較熱。

sentences.en: We drove inland to avoid the crowded beach.
sentences.zh: 我們往內陸開，避開擁擠的海灘。

sentences.en: Is the inland lake safe for swimming?
sentences.zh: 這座內陸湖適合游泳嗎？

sentences.en: How far inland did the storm travel?
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨深入內陸多遠？

sentences.en: Farmers in the inland valley grow mostly oranges.
sentences.zh: 內陸山谷的農民大多種柳橙。

sentences.en: There are innumerable stars in the desert sky.
sentences.zh: 沙漠的夜空有無數顆星星。

sentences.en: I've told you innumerable times to lock the door.
sentences.zh: 我已經告訴過你無數次要鎖門了。

sentences.en: Why are there innumerable bugs near the lake tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚湖邊為什麼有數不清的蟲子？

sentences.en: The library holds innumerable books on every subject.
sentences.zh: 圖書館藏有各種主題的無數本書。

sentences.en: Innumerable fans waited outside the concert hall.
sentences.zh: 無數粉絲在音樂廳外等候。

sentences.en: Have you noticed the innumerable tiny shells on this beach?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到這片海灘上無數的小貝殼嗎？

sentences.en: Her insistence on quality impressed the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她對品質的堅持讓整個團隊印象深刻。

sentences.en: At his insistence, we waited another hour.
sentences.zh: 在他的堅持下，我們又多等了一小時。

sentences.en: What is the reason for your insistence on paying?
sentences.zh: 你堅持要付錢的原因是什麼？

sentences.en: The manager's insistence that we arrive early annoyed everyone.
sentences.zh: 經理堅持要我們提早到，讓大家都很不高興。

sentences.en: Despite her insistence, the clerk would not give a refund.
sentences.zh: 儘管她堅持，店員還是不肯退款。

sentences.en: Is your insistence on a window seat really necessary?
sentences.zh: 你堅持要靠窗的座位真的有必要嗎？

sentences.en: Her instinctive reaction was to catch the falling cup.
sentences.zh: 她的本能反應是去接住掉下來的杯子。

sentences.en: Babies have an instinctive need to be held.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒天生就有被抱著的本能需求。

sentences.en: Was your decision instinctive, or did you plan it?
sentences.zh: 你的決定是憑直覺，還是事先計畫好的？

sentences.en: Birds show an instinctive fear of large shadows.
sentences.zh: 鳥類對巨大的影子有本能的恐懼。

sentences.en: He made an instinctive turn to avoid the bicycle.
sentences.zh: 他本能地轉向，閃開那輛腳踏車。

sentences.en: Is it instinctive to smile when you meet someone?
sentences.zh: 見到人就微笑是一種本能嗎？

sentences.en: Follow the cooking instructions on the package.
sentences.zh: 請照包裝上的烹調說明做。

sentences.en: The recipe's instructions say to bake it for twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 食譜的步驟說要烤二十分鐘。

sentences.en: Did you read the instructions on the noodle box?
sentences.zh: 你有看麵條盒子上的說明嗎？

sentences.en: I gave the waiter special instructions for my allergy.
sentences.zh: 我針對我的過敏情況，給了服務生特別的交代。

sentences.en: The manager gave clear instructions to the new staff.
sentences.zh: 經理給了新進員工明確的指示。

sentences.en: Who wrote these confusing instructions for the coffee machine?
sentences.zh: 誰寫了這份咖啡機難懂的使用說明？

sentences.en: Doctors advise a lower daily intake of salt.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議降低每日的鹽攝取量。

sentences.en: How much daily sugar intake is healthy for kids?
sentences.zh: 小孩每天攝取多少糖才算健康？

sentences.en: She tracks her water intake with a small app.
sentences.zh: 她用一個小應用程式記錄喝水量。

sentences.en: Reducing your caffeine intake may help you sleep better.
sentences.zh: 減少咖啡因攝取量，可能讓你睡得更好。

sentences.en: Is your calorie intake enough for an active teenager?
sentences.zh: 對活潑好動的青少年來說，你的熱量攝取量夠嗎？

sentences.en: A sudden intake of breath showed that she was surprised.
sentences.zh: 突然倒抽一口氣，顯示她很驚訝。

sentences.en: The professor is known for her sharp intellect.
sentences.zh: 那位教授以她敏銳的才智聞名。

sentences.en: Does a strong intellect always lead to success?
sentences.zh: 過人的智力一定會帶來成功嗎？

sentences.en: He used his intellect to solve the puzzle quickly.
sentences.zh: 他運用才智很快解開了謎題。

sentences.en: Reading helps develop a child's intellect.
sentences.zh: 閱讀有助於培養孩子的智力。

sentences.en: The movie's hero has more intellect than strength.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的主角才智勝過體力。

sentences.en: Isn't it rude to doubt someone's intellect?
sentences.zh: 質疑別人的智力不是很沒禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: The students listened intently to the guest speaker.
sentences.zh: 學生們專注地聽客座講者演講。

sentences.en: Why was he listening so intently?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼聽得那麼專注？

sentences.en: She stared intently at the screen during the presentation.
sentences.zh: 簡報時，她目不轉睛地盯著螢幕。

sentences.en: He watched the clock intently. Is something wrong?
sentences.zh: 他目不轉睛地看著時鐘。有什麼不對勁嗎？

sentences.en: The manager read the contract intently before signing.
sentences.zh: 經理簽約前專注地讀著合約。

sentences.en: The cat watched the bird intently from the window.
sentences.zh: 貓從窗邊目不轉睛地看著那隻鳥。

sentences.en: We hired an interpreter for the meeting with the visitors.
sentences.zh: 我們為了和訪客開會請了一位口譯員。

sentences.en: Does the hospital provide an interpreter for patients?
sentences.zh: 醫院有為病患提供口譯員嗎？

sentences.en: The interpreter whispered to the guest while the manager spoke.
sentences.zh: 經理說話時，口譯員在客人耳邊輕聲翻譯。

sentences.en: My friend works as a Spanish interpreter at conferences.
sentences.zh: 我朋友是會議的西班牙語口譯員。

sentences.en: Can you ask the interpreter to repeat that sentence?
sentences.zh: 你可以請口譯員重複那句話嗎？

sentences.en: The company needs a Japanese interpreter for next week's trip.
sentences.zh: 公司下週的行程需要一位日語口譯員。

sentences.en: Turn left at the next intersection.
sentences.zh: 在下個路口左轉。

sentences.en: There was an accident at the intersection this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上路口發生了一起車禍。

sentences.en: Which intersection has the new traffic light?
sentences.zh: 哪個路口裝了新的紅綠燈？

sentences.en: The bank is at the intersection of Main Street and Fifth Avenue.
sentences.zh: 銀行在主街和第五大道的交叉口。

sentences.en: Wait for the green light before crossing the intersection.
sentences.zh: 過路口前要等綠燈。

sentences.en: Is the bus stop near the intersection?
sentences.zh: 公車站牌在路口附近嗎？

sentences.en: The small café has a cozy sense of intimacy.
sentences.zh: 這家小咖啡館有種溫馨又親切的感覺。

sentences.en: Long talks over dinner built intimacy between the sisters.
sentences.zh: 晚餐時的長談拉近了姊妹之間的親密感。

sentences.en: Does sharing secrets create intimacy between friends?
sentences.zh: 分享祕密會讓朋友之間更親近嗎？

sentences.en: The intimacy of the family dinner made her feel at home.
sentences.zh: 家庭晚餐的親切氣氛讓她有回到家的感覺。

sentences.en: Do you miss the intimacy of a small class?
sentences.zh: 你懷念小班上課那種親近感嗎？

sentences.en: Friends often show their intimacy through small jokes.
sentences.zh: 朋友常常透過小玩笑展現彼此的親密。

sentences.en: The big, quiet office can intimidate new employees.
sentences.zh: 又大又安靜的辦公室可能會讓新員工感到膽怯。

sentences.en: I felt intimidated by the long list of rules.
sentences.zh: 那一長串規定讓我覺得有點怯步。

sentences.en: Don't let the loud crowd intimidate you.
sentences.zh: 別讓吵鬧的人群嚇到你。

sentences.en: Why does the final exam intimidate so many students?
sentences.zh: 為什麼期末考會讓這麼多學生害怕？

sentences.en: Did the huge dog intimidate you at first?
sentences.zh: 那隻大狗一開始有嚇到你嗎？

sentences.en: The bully tried to intimidate the younger kids at school.
sentences.zh: 那個霸凌者想在學校恐嚇年紀較小的孩子。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to intrude, but may I ask a question?
sentences.zh: 抱歉打擾一下，我可以問個問題嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't intrude on our private meeting.
sentences.zh: 請不要打擾我們的私人會議。

sentences.en: Reporters should not intrude into people's private lives.
sentences.zh: 記者不該侵入別人的私生活。

sentences.en: Why would anyone intrude on a quiet family dinner?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人要打擾安靜的家庭晚餐？

sentences.en: The noise from the street kept intruding on my work.
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音一直打擾我工作。

sentences.en: I didn't mean to intrude on your conversation.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要打斷你們的談話。

sentences.en: In the movie, an intruder breaks into the old mansion.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一名闖入者闖進了老宅邸。

sentences.en: The alarm went off when the intruder opened the window.
sentences.zh: 闖入者打開窗戶時警報響了。

sentences.en: Did the camera catch the intruder on video?
sentences.zh: 攝影機有把闖入者錄下來嗎？

sentences.en: Police arrested an intruder who entered the school at night.
sentences.zh: 警方逮捕了一名夜間闖入學校的入侵者。

sentences.en: The dog barked loudly at the intruder.
sentences.zh: 狗對著闖入者大聲吠叫。

sentences.en: How did the intruder get past the front gate?
sentences.zh: 闖入者是怎麼通過大門的？

sentences.en: He invariably arrives late. Have you noticed?
sentences.zh: 他總是遲到。你有注意到嗎？

sentences.en: She invariably orders the same soup. Why is that?
sentences.zh: 她總是點同一種湯。為什麼呢？

sentences.en: Traffic is invariably heavy on Friday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 週五下午的車流總是很多。

sentences.en: Winter flights from this airport are invariably delayed.
sentences.zh: 這座機場冬天的班機總是延誤。

sentences.en: The teacher invariably starts class with a short quiz.
sentences.zh: 老師上課總是以一個小測驗開場。

sentences.en: My roommate invariably forgets his keys. Does yours?
sentences.zh: 我室友總是忘記帶鑰匙。你的室友也這樣嗎？

sentences.en: The chef is famous for her inventive dessert menu.
sentences.zh: 那位主廚以她富有創意的甜點菜單聞名。

sentences.en: Have you tried the inventive tacos at the new restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你吃過新餐廳那些有創意的塔可餅嗎？

sentences.en: Her inventive use of spices surprised every guest.
sentences.zh: 她別出心裁地使用香料，讓每位客人都很驚喜。

sentences.en: The students came up with an inventive science project.
sentences.zh: 學生們想出了一個很有創意的科學專題。

sentences.en: Is the cook inventive enough to change the recipe?
sentences.zh: 這位廚師有創意到能改良食譜嗎？

sentences.en: He is an inventive worker who always finds new ways to save time.
sentences.zh: 他是個很有創意的員工，總是想出節省時間的新方法。

sentences.en: It is ironic that the plumber's own sink leaks.
sentences.zh: 真諷刺，水電工自己家的水槽居然漏水。

sentences.en: Isn't it ironic that the dentist has bad teeth?
sentences.zh: 牙醫自己牙齒不好，不是很諷刺嗎？

sentences.en: She gave an ironic smile when he said he was on time.
sentences.zh: 他說自己準時時，她露出了帶著諷刺的微笑。

sentences.en: The ironic part is that I found my keys right after buying new ones.
sentences.zh: 諷刺的是，我一買了新鑰匙，就找到我的鑰匙了。

sentences.en: It was ironic that the traffic expert got stuck in traffic.
sentences.zh: 交通專家居然塞在車陣裡，真是諷刺。

sentences.en: Do you find it ironic that the lifeguard can't swim?
sentences.zh: 救生員竟然不會游泳，你不覺得諷刺嗎？

sentences.en: I get irritable when I don't sleep enough.
sentences.zh: 我睡不夠的時候會很煩躁。

sentences.en: The baby was irritable after a long car ride.
sentences.zh: 寶寶在長途車程後很煩躁。

sentences.en: Why is my boss so irritable this morning?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我老闆今天早上這麼易怒？

sentences.en: Hunger can make people tired and irritable.
sentences.zh: 飢餓會讓人疲倦又易怒。

sentences.en: Are you feeling irritable because of the heat?
sentences.zh: 你是因為天氣熱而覺得煩躁嗎？

sentences.en: The irritable customer complained about the long wait.
sentences.zh: 那位易怒的顧客抱怨等太久。

gloss_note: 與 aisle 同音；多用於地名、詩文

sentences.en: They spent the summer on a small isle near the coast.
sentences.zh: 他們在海岸附近的一座小島度過夏天。

sentences.en: The story takes place on a quiet isle far from the city.
sentences.zh: 故事發生在遠離城市的一座寧靜小島。

sentences.en: Which isle did the old sailors talk about?
sentences.zh: 老水手們談到的是哪座島？

sentences.en: A thick fog covered the isle all morning.
sentences.zh: 濃霧整個早上都籠罩著小島。

sentences.en: The ferry to the isle runs twice a day.
sentences.zh: 往小島的渡輪一天兩班。

sentences.en: Do you know the poem about a lonely isle?
sentences.zh: 你知道那首關於孤島的詩嗎？

sentences.en: My arm began to itch after the mosquito bite.
sentences.zh: 被蚊子叮了之後，我的手臂開始發癢。

sentences.en: Do you have an itch that won't go away?
sentences.zh: 你有哪裡一直癢個不停嗎？

sentences.en: This wool sweater makes my neck itch.
sentences.zh: 這件羊毛衣讓我脖子發癢。

sentences.en: Try not to scratch that itch on your hand.
sentences.zh: 盡量不要去抓你手上那個癢處。

sentences.en: Why does my back itch every time I sit down?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我每次坐下背就發癢？

sentences.en: She felt an itch on her nose during the photo.
sentences.zh: 拍照時，她鼻子突然有點癢。

sentences.en: Green ivy covers the old brick wall.
sentences.zh: 綠色的常春藤爬滿了老磚牆。

sentences.en: Ivy grows well in shady places.
sentences.zh: 常春藤在陰涼處長得很好。

sentences.en: Can ivy damage the wall of a house?
sentences.zh: 常春藤會損壞房子的牆嗎？

sentences.en: She planted ivy along the fence last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天沿著圍籬種了常春藤。

sentences.en: Do you water the ivy in your office every week?
sentences.zh: 你辦公室的常春藤每週都澆水嗎？

sentences.en: The library was almost hidden behind thick ivy.
sentences.zh: 圖書館幾乎被濃密的常春藤遮住了。

sentences.en: She wears a jade bracelet on her left wrist.
sentences.zh: 她左手腕戴著一只玉鐲。

sentences.en: Is this necklace made of real jade?
sentences.zh: 這條項鍊是真的玉做的嗎？

sentences.en: My mother gave me a small jade pendant.
sentences.zh: 媽媽給了我一個小玉墜。

sentences.en: Jade is often green, but it can also be white.
sentences.zh: 玉通常是綠色的，但也可以是白色的。

sentences.en: How can you tell whether jade is real?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼分辨玉是不是真的？

sentences.en: The museum displays an ancient jade cup.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示了一只古代的玉杯。

gloss_note: 學校、大樓的維護清潔人員

sentences.en: The janitor unlocked the gym for the basketball team.
sentences.zh: 工友為籃球隊打開了體育館的門。

sentences.en: Please tell the janitor that the sink is leaking.
sentences.zh: 請告訴工友水槽漏水了。

sentences.en: Our school janitor knows every student by name.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的工友認得每個學生的名字。

sentences.en: Where can I find the janitor in this building?
sentences.zh: 我在這棟大樓哪裡可以找到清潔工？

sentences.en: The janitor mops the hallway before classes start.
sentences.zh: 工友在上課前拖走廊的地。

sentences.en: Did the janitor lock the back door last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚工友有把後門鎖上嗎？

sentences.en: I love the sweet smell of jasmine in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡花園裡茉莉花的香甜味道。

sentences.en: Could I have a cup of hot jasmine tea?
sentences.zh: 我可以來一杯熱的茉莉花茶嗎？

sentences.en: This restaurant serves chicken with jasmine rice.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應搭配茉莉香米的雞肉。

sentences.en: Jasmine has small white flowers that bloom in spring.
sentences.zh: 茉莉有小小的白花，在春天開放。

sentences.en: Do you prefer jasmine tea or green tea?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡茉莉花茶還是綠茶？

sentences.en: She put fresh jasmine in a small glass vase.
sentences.zh: 她把新鮮的茉莉花放進小玻璃花瓶。

gloss_note: 美式口語；a cup of java

sentences.en: I need a cup of java before this meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會前我需要來杯咖啡。

sentences.en: I just made a pot. Want some fresh java?
sentences.zh: 我剛煮了一壺。要不要來點新鮮的咖啡？

sentences.en: The diner serves hot java all day long.
sentences.zh: 這家餐館整天供應熱咖啡。

sentences.en: How many cups of java do you drink each day?
sentences.zh: 你每天喝幾杯咖啡？

sentences.en: He grabbed a cup of java and a bagel on his way to work.
sentences.zh: 他在上班途中買了杯咖啡和一個貝果。

sentences.en: Nothing wakes me up like strong java in the morning.
sentences.zh: 沒有什麼比早上一杯濃咖啡更能讓我清醒。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: The keys jingle in my pocket when I walk.
sentences.zh: 我走路時，鑰匙在口袋裡叮噹作響。

sentences.en: The children shook their bracelets and made a happy jingle.
sentences.zh: 孩子們搖著手鐲，發出歡快的叮噹聲。

sentences.en: Why do your coins jingle every time you run?
sentences.zh: 你每次跑步，硬幣為什麼都會叮噹響？

sentences.en: A soft jingle told us someone had opened the door.
sentences.zh: 一陣輕輕的叮噹聲告訴我們有人開了門。

sentences.en: Did you hear the jingle of the bell on the door?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到門上鈴鐺的叮噹聲嗎？

sentences.en: The tiny bells on the baby's toy jingled.
sentences.zh: 寶寶玩具上的小鈴鐺叮噹作響。

gloss_note: 賽馬的騎師，通常體型嬌小

sentences.en: The jockey wore a bright blue and yellow shirt.
sentences.zh: 那位騎師穿著鮮豔的藍黃相間上衣。

sentences.en: A good jockey must be light and strong.
sentences.zh: 優秀的騎師必須體重輕而且有力。

sentences.en: Did the jockey thank the horse after the race?
sentences.zh: 比賽後騎師有感謝那匹馬嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor used to be a jockey when he was young.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居年輕時當過騎師。

sentences.en: The young jockey smiled as he led the horse around.
sentences.zh: 年輕的騎師一邊牽著馬繞場，一邊微笑。

sentences.en: How does a jockey stay balanced at high speed?
sentences.zh: 騎師要怎麼在高速下保持平衡？

sentences.en: Our jolly neighbor waves to everyone on the street.
sentences.zh: 我們快活的鄰居向街上每個人揮手。

sentences.en: The party was jolly, with music and laughter.
sentences.zh: 派對很歡樂，有音樂也有笑聲。

sentences.en: Why is the old waiter always so jolly?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那位年長的服務生總是這麼快活？

sentences.en: She told a story in a jolly voice that made everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 她用愉快的語氣講了個故事，逗得大家都笑了。

sentences.en: The jolly bus driver sang along with the radio.
sentences.zh: 那位快活的公車司機跟著收音機一起唱歌。

sentences.en: Are you in a jolly mood today?
sentences.zh: 你今天心情很愉快嗎？

sentences.en: The wedding was a joyous occasion for both families.
sentences.zh: 婚禮對兩家人來說都是個歡樂的場合。

sentences.en: Why does the whole town feel so joyous today?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今天整個小鎮都感覺這麼歡樂？

sentences.en: Her joyous laughter filled the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 她歡樂的笑聲充滿了廚房。

sentences.en: Did you hear the joyous news about Tom's new baby?
sentences.zh: 你聽說湯姆家新生寶寶的喜訊了嗎？

sentences.en: The children sang a joyous song at the school concert.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在學校音樂會上唱了一首歡樂的歌。

sentences.en: Graduation day is always a joyous time for students.
sentences.zh: 畢業日對學生來說總是充滿喜悅的時刻。

sentences.en: Stay on Route 9 until you reach the junction with Interstate 80.
sentences.zh: 沿著9號公路開，一直到和80號州際公路的交會處。

sentences.en: Is there a gas station near the junction?
sentences.zh: 路口附近有加油站嗎？

sentences.en: The two highways meet at a busy junction north of town.
sentences.zh: 兩條公路在城北一處繁忙的交會處相接。

sentences.en: Is the rest stop before or after the highway junction?
sentences.zh: 休息站在公路交會處之前還是之後？

sentences.en: A truck broke down at the junction, so traffic is backed up.
sentences.zh: 一輛卡車在路口拋錨，所以車子大排長龍。

sentences.en: Our motel is just past the junction of Highway 9 and Route 12.
sentences.zh: 我們的汽車旅館就在9號公路和12號公路交會處再過去一點。

sentences.en: I'd like the kale salad with grilled chicken, please.
sentences.zh: 我想點羽衣甘藍沙拉配烤雞，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Do you want kale or spinach in your smoothie?
sentences.zh: 你的果昔想放羽衣甘藍還是菠菜？

sentences.en: Kale chips are crunchy and easy to make at home.
sentences.zh: 羽衣甘藍脆片又脆又容易在家做。

sentences.en: Could you add some kale to the soup?
sentences.zh: 你可以在湯裡加一些羽衣甘藍嗎？

sentences.en: The farmers market had fresh kale for two dollars a bunch.
sentences.zh: 農夫市集的新鮮羽衣甘藍一把兩美元。

sentences.en: My kids will not touch kale, no matter how I cook it.
sentences.zh: 不管我怎麼煮，我的孩子就是不碰羽衣甘藍。

sentences.en: We ordered a lamb kebab and a side of rice.
sentences.zh: 我們點了一份羊肉串和一份白飯。

sentences.en: Would you like chicken or beef kebabs?
sentences.zh: 你想要雞肉串還是牛肉串？

sentences.en: Dad is grilling vegetable kebabs in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正在後院烤蔬菜串。

sentences.en: How long should I grill the kebab on each side?
sentences.zh: 烤肉串每面應該烤多久？

sentences.en: The kebab stand near the park sells out by noon.
sentences.zh: 公園附近的烤肉串攤中午前就賣完了。

sentences.en: Soak the wooden sticks first so the kebabs don't burn.
sentences.zh: 先把木籤泡水，烤肉串才不會燒焦。

gloss_note: next of kin 最近親屬；單用 kin 較老派

sentences.en: Please list your next of kin on this form.
sentences.zh: 請在這張表格上填寫你的最近親屬。

sentences.en: Who should we call as your next of kin?
sentences.zh: 我們該聯絡誰當你的最近親屬？

sentences.en: The airline contacted the passengers' next of kin right away.
sentences.zh: 航空公司立刻聯絡了乘客的最近親屬。

sentences.en: Do you have any kin living in the United States?
sentences.zh: 你有任何親人住在美國嗎？

sentences.en: He left the farm to his kin when he retired.
sentences.zh: 他退休時把農場留給了家人。

sentences.en: All of her kin came to the family reunion last summer.
sentences.zh: 她所有的親戚去年夏天都來參加了家族聚會。

sentences.en: Dry leaves help kindle a campfire quickly.
sentences.zh: 乾樹葉有助於很快點燃營火。

sentences.en: Can you kindle the fire while I set up the tent?
sentences.zh: 我搭帳篷的時候，你可以把火生起來嗎？

sentences.en: The museum visit kindled her interest in science.
sentences.zh: 那次參觀博物館激起了她對科學的興趣。

sentences.en: How can teachers kindle a love of reading in kids?
sentences.zh: 老師要怎麼激起孩子對閱讀的熱愛？

sentences.en: A good book can kindle your imagination.
sentences.zh: 一本好書能激發你的想像力。

sentences.en: Her kind words kindled hope in the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她親切的話語在整個團隊心中點燃了希望。

gloss_note: kosher restaurant 猶太潔食餐廳

sentences.en: This deli sells kosher hot dogs and pickles.
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店賣符合猶太教規的熱狗和醃黃瓜。

sentences.en: Excuse me, is this restaurant kosher?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，這間餐廳符合猶太教規嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighbor only buys kosher meat from the market on Elm Street.
sentences.zh: 我們鄰居只在榆樹街的市場買符合猶太教規的肉。

sentences.en: Do you have any kosher options on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜單上有符合猶太教規的選項嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel kitchen prepares a separate kosher meal on request.
sentences.zh: 飯店廚房可依要求另外準備符合猶太教規的餐點。

sentences.en: A kosher bakery just opened near the mall.
sentences.zh: 購物中心附近剛開了一家符合猶太教規的麵包店。

gloss_note: 美式少用，偏英式或老派說法

sentences.en: When Grandpa was a young lad, he worked on a farm.
sentences.zh: 爺爺還是個小夥子的時候，在農場工作過。

sentences.en: He's a bright lad, and he'll go far.
sentences.zh: 他是個聰明的小夥子，將來一定會有成就。

sentences.en: Who's that young lad standing at the door?
sentences.zh: 站在門口的那個年輕小夥子是誰？

sentences.en: "Come here, lad," the old fisherman said with a smile.
sentences.zh: 「過來吧，孩子。」老漁夫笑著說。

sentences.en: Is the lad old enough to drive the tractor?
sentences.zh: 這個少年夠大了可以開拖拉機嗎？

sentences.en: The story is about a poor lad who becomes a hero.
sentences.zh: 這個故事講的是一個窮小子變成英雄的經過。

sentences.en: My landlady lives downstairs and keeps the hallway clean.
sentences.zh: 我的女房東住在樓下，並且把走廊保持得很乾淨。

sentences.en: Did you call your landlady about the leaking faucet?
sentences.zh: 你有打電話跟女房東說水龍頭漏水的事嗎？

sentences.en: Our landlady raised the rent by fifty dollars this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我們的女房東把房租漲了五十美元。

sentences.en: The landlady showed us the apartment on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 女房東星期六早上帶我們看了這間公寓。

sentences.en: Can you ask the landlady when she'll fix the heater?
sentences.zh: 你可以問女房東什麼時候會修暖氣嗎？

sentences.en: Our landlady bakes cookies for every tenant during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 我們的女房東在節慶期間會烤餅乾送給每位房客。

sentences.en: A landslide blocked the mountain road after the heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 大雨過後，一場山崩封住了山路。

sentences.en: Is the hiking trail safe after yesterday's landslide?
sentences.zh: 昨天的山崩之後，這條登山步道安全嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy rain can cause a landslide on steep hillsides.
sentences.zh: 大雨可能在陡峭的山坡上引發土石流。

sentences.en: The road crew is clearing the landslide near the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 道路工程隊正在清除隧道附近山崩的土石。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the landslide that closed the highway?
sentences.zh: 你有聽說那場讓公路封閉的山崩嗎？

sentences.en: Our bus was delayed because of a small landslide.
sentences.zh: 我們的公車因為一場小規模山崩而誤點。

gloss_note: 多用 lashes；false lashes 假睫毛

sentences.en: This mascara makes my lashes look longer.
sentences.zh: 這支睫毛膏讓我的睫毛看起來更長。

sentences.en: Can the salon curl and tint my lashes?
sentences.zh: 這家美容院可以幫我夾翹並染睫毛嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want to try false lashes for the party?
sentences.zh: 你想在派對上試試假睫毛嗎？

sentences.en: She has long, dark lashes like her mother.
sentences.zh: 她有一雙像媽媽一樣又長又黑的睫毛。

sentences.en: Can you help me? One of my lashes fell into my eye.
sentences.zh: 你能幫我嗎？我有一根睫毛掉進眼睛裡了。

sentences.en: Be careful not to pull out your lashes when you remove makeup.
sentences.zh: 卸妝時小心別扯掉睫毛。

gloss_note: Latin food 拉丁美洲料理

sentences.en: We found a Latin restaurant that serves great grilled steak.
sentences.zh: 我們找到一家烤牛排很棒的拉丁美洲餐廳。

sentences.en: Have you tried Latin food before?
sentences.zh: 你以前吃過拉丁美洲料理嗎？

sentences.en: The café plays lively Latin music on weekends.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館週末會播放熱鬧的拉丁美洲音樂。

sentences.en: Does this Latin bakery sell fresh empanadas?
sentences.zh: 這家拉丁美洲麵包店有賣現做的肉餡餅嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor cooks Latin dishes with black beans and rice.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居會煮配黑豆和米飯的拉丁美洲菜。

sentences.en: The Latin grocery store sells spices you can't find elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 那家拉丁美洲雜貨店賣在別處買不到的香料。

sentences.en: The city is located at 25 degrees north latitude.
sentences.zh: 這座城市位於北緯二十五度。

sentences.en: What is the latitude of this island?
sentences.zh: 這座島的緯度是多少？

sentences.en: Places near the equator have a low latitude.
sentences.zh: 靠近赤道的地方緯度低。

sentences.en: Can you find our latitude on this map?
sentences.zh: 你能在這張地圖上找到我們所在的緯度嗎？

sentences.en: The pilot checked the plane's latitude and longitude.
sentences.zh: 飛行員確認了飛機的緯度和經度。

sentences.en: Temperatures change a lot as you move to a higher latitude.
sentences.zh: 隨著往更高的緯度移動，氣溫變化很大。

sentences.en: The company threw a lavish party for its fifth anniversary.
sentences.zh: 公司為五週年舉辦了一場奢華的派對。

sentences.en: Did you see the lavish buffet at the wedding?
sentences.zh: 你有看到婚禮上那桌豐盛的自助餐嗎？

sentences.en: She prepared a lavish dinner for her guests.
sentences.zh: 她為客人準備了一頓豐盛的晚餐。

sentences.en: Is it worth paying for such a lavish hotel suite?
sentences.zh: 花錢住這麼奢華的飯店套房值得嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant is known for its lavish desserts.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳以豐盛的甜點聞名。

sentences.en: They lived in a lavish house with a pool.
sentences.zh: 他們住在一棟有泳池的豪華大宅。

gloss_note: in layman's terms 用白話說

sentences.en: Can you explain this in layman's terms?
sentences.zh: 你能用白話解釋一下這個嗎？

sentences.en: I'm just a layman, so please keep it simple.
sentences.zh: 我只是個外行人，所以請說簡單一點。

sentences.en: The doctor explained the results in terms a layman could follow.
sentences.zh: 醫生用外行人也聽得懂的方式解釋了結果。

sentences.en: Is this manual written for a layman or an engineer?
sentences.zh: 這份手冊是寫給外行人還是工程師看的？

sentences.en: As a layman, I found the legal contract hard to read.
sentences.zh: 身為外行人，我覺得這份法律合約很難讀。

sentences.en: The report summarizes the research for the average layman.
sentences.zh: 這份報告為一般外行人總結了這項研究。

other_senses: 解雇（動詞片語 lay off）

sentences.en: The company announced a layoff of two hundred workers.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布裁員兩百名員工。

sentences.en: Are there going to be more layoffs this year?
sentences.zh: 今年還會有更多裁員嗎？

sentences.en: After the layoff, he spent months looking for a new job.
sentences.zh: 遭到資遣後，他花了好幾個月找新工作。

sentences.en: How did your team handle the layoff news?
sentences.zh: 你的團隊是怎麼面對裁員消息的？

sentences.en: Slow sales led to a layoff at the factory.
sentences.zh: 銷售不振導致工廠裁員。

sentences.en: My manager says the layoff won't affect our department.
sentences.zh: 我的主管說這次裁員不會影響我們部門。

sentences.en: A state legislator visited our school to talk about how laws are made.
sentences.zh: 一位州議員來我們學校，談法律是如何制定的。

sentences.en: The legislator introduced a bill about road safety.
sentences.zh: 這位議員提出了一項關於道路安全的法案。

sentences.en: Which legislator represents our district?
sentences.zh: 哪位議員代表我們這一區？

sentences.en: Have you ever written a letter to a legislator?
sentences.zh: 你有寫過信給議員嗎？

sentences.en: Local legislators met on Tuesday to discuss the budget.
sentences.zh: 地方議員週二開會討論預算。

sentences.en: The legislator answered questions from students after the speech.
sentences.zh: 演講結束後，這位議員回答了學生們的提問。

gloss_note: 亦可作名詞；中性用語，常說女同志

sentences.en: A lesbian couple moved in next door last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月有一對女同志伴侶搬到我們隔壁。

sentences.en: The community center hosts a lesbian book club every month.
sentences.zh: 社區中心每個月都有一個女同志讀書會。

sentences.en: Did you watch the documentary about lesbian families in small towns?
sentences.zh: 你有看過那部關於小鎮女同志家庭的紀錄片嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a lesbian support group at your school?
sentences.zh: 你們學校有女同志支持團體嗎？

sentences.en: The bookstore has a shelf of novels by lesbian authors.
sentences.zh: 這家書店有一個書架放著女同志作家的小說。

sentences.en: The library added more books with lesbian characters this year.
sentences.zh: 圖書館今年增加了更多有女同志角色的書。

sentences.en: This medicine should lessen the pain in your knee.
sentences.zh: 這種藥應該能減輕你膝蓋的疼痛。

sentences.en: How can we lessen the risk of food poisoning?
sentences.zh: 我們要如何降低食物中毒的風險？

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet can lessen the chance of serious injury.
sentences.zh: 戴安全帽可以降低受重傷的機會。

sentences.en: Will a new schedule lessen your stress at work?
sentences.zh: 新的時程表會減輕你工作上的壓力嗎？

sentences.en: Planting trees helps lessen the noise from the highway.
sentences.zh: 種樹有助於減少公路傳來的噪音。

sentences.en: A cold towel might lessen the swelling.
sentences.zh: 冷毛巾也許能減輕腫脹。

sentences.en: A rattlesnake bite can be lethal if untreated.
sentences.zh: 響尾蛇咬傷若未經治療可能致命。

sentences.en: Keep these chemicals away from kids because they can be lethal.
sentences.zh: 把這些化學藥劑放遠離孩子，因為它們可能致命。

sentences.en: Is this plant lethal to dogs?
sentences.zh: 這種植物對狗會致命嗎？

sentences.en: The news said the heat wave could be lethal for older people.
sentences.zh: 新聞說這波熱浪可能對年長者致命。

sentences.en: In the movie, the hero faces a lethal robot.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，英雄要面對一個致命的機器人。

sentences.en: Is carbon monoxide really that lethal?
sentences.zh: 一氧化碳真的那麼致命嗎？

gloss_note: on company letterhead 用公司信紙

sentences.en: Please print the offer letter on company letterhead.
sentences.zh: 請把錄取通知信印在公司信紙上。

sentences.en: Do we have any letterhead left in the supply closet?
sentences.zh: 備品櫃裡還有抬頭信紙嗎？

sentences.en: The new letterhead includes our updated address and logo.
sentences.zh: 新的信頭包含我們更新後的地址與標誌。

sentences.en: Can you design a simple letterhead for our small business?
sentences.zh: 你可以為我們的小公司設計一個簡單的信頭嗎？

sentences.en: The bank's reply came on official letterhead.
sentences.zh: 銀行的回覆是印在正式的抬頭信紙上寄來的。

sentences.en: Use the letterhead only for formal letters to clients.
sentences.zh: 抬頭信紙只能用在寫給客戶的正式信件。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: The army liberated the town at the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 軍隊在戰爭結束時解放了這座城鎮。

sentences.en: Working from home can liberate you from a long commute.
sentences.zh: 在家工作能讓你擺脫漫長的通勤。

sentences.en: Does owning less stuff liberate you from worry?
sentences.zh: 擁有的東西少，會讓你擺脫煩惱嗎？

sentences.en: The new software will liberate staff from boring paperwork.
sentences.zh: 新軟體將讓員工擺脫無聊的文書作業。

sentences.en: Why did the book say music could liberate the mind?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那本書說音樂能解放心靈？

sentences.en: The farmer decided to liberate the birds from their small cages.
sentences.zh: 農夫決定把鳥從小籠子裡解放出來。

sentences.en: We learned about the liberation of the city in history class.
sentences.zh: 我們在歷史課上學到那座城市的解放。

sentences.en: The liberation of the prisoners made headlines worldwide.
sentences.zh: 囚犯獲得解放的消息登上了全球頭條。

sentences.en: Is there a museum about the country's liberation?
sentences.zh: 有沒有關於這個國家解放歷程的博物館？

sentences.en: Many people celebrated the liberation with parades.
sentences.zh: 許多人以遊行來慶祝解放。

sentences.en: How long did the liberation of the region take?
sentences.zh: 這個地區的解放花了多久時間？

sentences.en: She felt a sense of liberation after quitting her stressful job.
sentences.zh: 辭掉壓力大的工作後，她有一種獲得解放的感覺。

sentences.en: The police lieutenant briefed the officers before the shift.
sentences.zh: 警察副隊長在輪班前向警員們做了簡報。

sentences.en: Is Lieutenant Davis in his office?
sentences.zh: 戴維斯副隊長在辦公室嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle served as a lieutenant in the army.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔曾在陸軍當過中尉。

sentences.en: A young lieutenant led the small group across the river.
sentences.zh: 一位年輕的中尉帶領小隊渡過了河。

sentences.en: Who is the lieutenant in charge of this case?
sentences.zh: 負責這個案件的副隊長是哪一位？

sentences.en: The lieutenant told reporters that the road would reopen soon.
sentences.zh: 副隊長告訴記者，這條路很快就會重新開放。

sentences.en: Mia and I have been lifelong friends since kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 米亞和我從幼稚園起就是一輩子的朋友。

sentences.en: Do you think learning is a lifelong habit?
sentences.zh: 你認為學習是一輩子的習慣嗎？

sentences.en: He has a lifelong fear of deep water.
sentences.zh: 他一輩子都怕深水。

sentences.en: Teaching was her lifelong dream.
sentences.zh: 當老師是她一輩子的夢想。

sentences.en: Is a lifelong career with one company still common?
sentences.zh: 一輩子待在同一家公司的職涯還常見嗎？

sentences.en: My grandparents made lifelong memories on that farm.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母在那座農場留下了一輩子的回憶。

gloss_note: lighten the load 減輕負擔

sentences.en: Can you help me lighten the load in this backpack?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我減輕這個背包的重量嗎？

sentences.en: A little humor can lighten the mood in a meeting.
sentences.zh: 一點幽默能讓會議的氣氛輕鬆一些。

sentences.en: Painting the walls white will lighten the room.
sentences.zh: 把牆壁漆成白色會讓房間變亮。

sentences.en: How does the company plan to lighten our workload?
sentences.zh: 公司打算怎麼減輕我們的工作量？

sentences.en: The sun came out and lightened the sky.
sentences.zh: 太陽出來了，天空也跟著變亮。

sentences.en: Hiring an assistant would lighten my burden a lot.
sentences.zh: 請個助理會大大減輕我的負擔。

sentences.en: I need a lightweight laptop for business trips.
sentences.zh: 我需要一台輕便的筆電出差用。

sentences.en: Is this suitcase lightweight enough for carry-on?
sentences.zh: 這個行李箱夠輕，可以當隨身行李嗎？

sentences.en: The tent is lightweight and easy to carry.
sentences.zh: 這頂帳篷很輕，攜帶方便。

sentences.en: Which lightweight jacket would you pack for the trip?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅行你會帶哪件輕便外套？

sentences.en: Our new tablet is thin and lightweight.
sentences.zh: 我們的新平板又薄又輕。

sentences.en: She bought a lightweight stroller for air travel.
sentences.zh: 她買了一台輕便的嬰兒推車，方便搭飛機。

sentences.en: The restaurant has a limited menu, but everything is fresh.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳菜單選項有限，但每樣都很新鮮。

sentences.en: Seating is limited, so please arrive early.
sentences.zh: 座位有限，所以請提早到。

sentences.en: Is this dessert only available for a limited time?
sentences.zh: 這道甜點只在限定期間供應嗎？

sentences.en: We have limited space in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們廚房的空間有限。

sentences.en: Do you offer any limited-edition flavors this month?
sentences.zh: 你們這個月有任何限量口味嗎？

sentences.en: The chef made a limited number of pies today.
sentences.zh: 主廚今天只做了限量的幾個派。

gloss_note: walk with a limp 走路跛

sentences.en: The dog started to limp after the long walk.
sentences.zh: 長途散步後，那隻狗開始一拐一拐地走。

sentences.en: Why are you limping? Did you hurt your ankle?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼一拐一拐的？是扭到腳踝了嗎？

sentences.en: He limped off the field after twisting his knee.
sentences.zh: 他扭傷膝蓋後，一拐一拐地走下球場。

sentences.en: My grandfather has walked with a limp since his fall.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺自從跌倒後，走路就有點跛。

sentences.en: Can you limp to the car if I carry your bag?
sentences.zh: 我幫你拿包包，你能一拐一拐地走到車子那邊嗎？

sentences.en: The hiker limped back to camp with a sore foot.
sentences.zh: 那位健行者腳痛，一拐一拐地走回營地。

sentences.en: The ocean liner left the port at sunset.
sentences.zh: 那艘遠洋客輪在日落時駛離港口。

sentences.en: Have you ever traveled on a luxury liner?
sentences.zh: 你曾搭過豪華客輪旅行嗎？

sentences.en: Our cruise ship is a huge liner with five restaurants.
sentences.zh: 我們的郵輪是一艘有五間餐廳的巨型客輪。

sentences.en: A giant liner appeared on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 一艘巨大的客輪出現在地平線上。

sentences.en: How many passengers can this liner carry?
sentences.zh: 這艘客輪可以載多少乘客？

sentences.en: My grandparents crossed the ocean on a liner in 1962.
sentences.zh: 1962年，我的祖父母搭客輪橫渡了大洋。

gloss_note: linger over coffee 邊喝咖啡邊聊

sentences.en: The smell of garlic lingered in the kitchen all evening.
sentences.zh: 大蒜的味道整晚在廚房裡久久不散。

sentences.en: Why don't we linger over coffee after dinner?
sentences.zh: 我們何不晚餐後邊喝咖啡邊多坐一會兒？

sentences.en: Some guests lingered at the door after the party.
sentences.zh: 派對結束後，有些客人還在門口逗留。

sentences.en: Does the perfume linger on your clothes all day?
sentences.zh: 那款香水會一整天留在你的衣服上嗎？

sentences.en: I'd love to linger here, but I have a meeting at two.
sentences.zh: 我很想在這裡多待一會兒，但我兩點有個會議。

sentences.en: The taste of that spicy soup lingered on my tongue.
sentences.zh: 那碗辣湯的味道留在我舌尖久久不散。

gloss_note: 常搭配海鮮或蒜香醬汁

sentences.en: I'll have the linguine with clams, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點蛤蠣扁細麵，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Does the linguine come with a side salad?
sentences.zh: 扁細麵有附配菜沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: Linguine goes well with a light garlic sauce.
sentences.zh: 扁細麵很適合搭配清爽的蒜味醬汁。

sentences.en: How long should I boil the linguine?
sentences.zh: 扁細麵應該煮多久？

sentences.en: My brother cooked shrimp linguine for dinner last night.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥昨晚煮了鮮蝦扁細麵當晚餐。

sentences.en: The restaurant's linguine is served with fresh basil.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的扁細麵搭配新鮮羅勒。

sentences.en: This coat has a warm fleece lining.
sentences.zh: 這件外套有溫暖的刷毛襯裡。

sentences.en: The lining of my bag is torn.
sentences.zh: 我的包包內襯破了。

sentences.en: Can you sew the lining back into my jacket?
sentences.zh: 你可以把我外套的襯裡縫回去嗎？

sentences.en: Does the raincoat have a waterproof lining?
sentences.zh: 這件雨衣有防水內層嗎？

sentences.en: The silk lining feels smooth against your skin.
sentences.zh: 絲質襯裡貼著皮膚摸起來很滑順。

sentences.en: There's a hidden pocket inside the lining of this purse.
sentences.zh: 這個包包的襯裡裡面有一個隱藏口袋。

sentences.en: The library offers free literacy classes for adults.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為成人提供免費的讀寫課程。

sentences.en: Is financial literacy taught at your school?
sentences.zh: 你們學校有教理財素養嗎？

sentences.en: Reading with kids every night builds early literacy.
sentences.zh: 每晚陪孩子閱讀能培養早期讀寫能力。

sentences.en: The country's literacy rate has risen over the past decade.
sentences.zh: 這個國家的識字率在過去十年間上升了。

sentences.en: How can parents improve their child's digital literacy?
sentences.zh: 家長要怎麼提升孩子的數位素養？

sentences.en: Basic computer literacy is required for this job.
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要具備基本的電腦素養。

sentences.en: A literal translation of this phrase makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 這個片語逐字翻譯起來毫無意義。

sentences.en: Is that the literal meaning or a joke?
sentences.zh: 那是字面上的意思，還是在開玩笑？

sentences.en: Don't take his words in the literal sense.
sentences.zh: 別從字面上去理解他的話。

sentences.en: What is the literal translation of this menu item?
sentences.zh: 這個菜單品項逐字翻譯是什麼？

sentences.en: My teacher asked for a literal reading of the poem first.
sentences.zh: 我的老師先要我們從字面上解讀這首詩。

sentences.en: Don't be so literal; she was only joking.
sentences.zh: 別那麼照字面理解，她只是在開玩笑。

sentences.en: Almost everyone in this country is literate.
sentences.zh: 這個國家幾乎人人識字。

sentences.en: Are you computer literate enough to fix this problem?
sentences.zh: 你的電腦知識夠修好這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: Is your grandmother literate in English?
sentences.zh: 你奶奶看得懂、寫得出英文嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher helped older students become literate.
sentences.zh: 老師幫助年紀較大的學生學會識字。

sentences.en: How can we make people more financially literate?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓大家更懂理財？

sentences.en: She is literate in three languages.
sentences.zh: 她能讀寫三種語言。

sentences.en: The farmer keeps livestock like cows, pigs, and sheep.
sentences.zh: 農夫養了牛、豬和羊之類的家畜。

sentences.en: How much feed does the livestock need each day?
sentences.zh: 這些牲畜每天需要多少飼料？

sentences.en: Heavy snow put the livestock at risk this winter.
sentences.zh: 今年冬天的大雪讓牲畜處境危險。

sentences.en: A fence keeps the livestock out of the road.
sentences.zh: 柵欄把牲畜擋在馬路外。

sentences.en: Do you raise any livestock on your land?
sentences.zh: 你的土地上有養任何家畜嗎？

sentences.en: The county fair had livestock from local farms on display.
sentences.zh: 郡裡的農業博覽會展出了當地農場的牲畜。

sentences.en: A small lizard ran across the wall.
sentences.zh: 一隻小蜥蜴跑過牆壁。

sentences.en: Is the lizard in your yard dangerous?
sentences.zh: 你院子裡的那隻蜥蜴危險嗎？

sentences.en: My son keeps a pet lizard in his room.
sentences.zh: 我兒子在房間裡養了一隻寵物蜥蜴。

sentences.en: The lizard lay still on a warm rock.
sentences.zh: 蜥蜴一動也不動地趴在溫暖的岩石上。

sentences.en: Did you see that lizard change color?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那隻蜥蜴變色嗎？

sentences.en: Some lizards can drop their tails to escape.
sentences.zh: 有些蜥蜴能斷尾逃生。

sentences.en: We stayed at a ski lodge in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我們住在山上的一間滑雪山莊。

sentences.en: Does the lodge serve breakfast?
sentences.zh: 山莊有供應早餐嗎？

sentences.en: The fishing lodge sits right beside the lake.
sentences.zh: 這間釣魚小屋就位在湖邊。

sentences.en: Can we book a room at the mountain lodge for March?
sentences.zh: 我們能預訂三月山莊的房間嗎？

sentences.en: After skiing, everyone gathered by the fire in the lodge.
sentences.zh: 滑雪後，大家聚在山莊裡的爐火邊。

sentences.en: The old lodge was turned into a small hotel.
sentences.zh: 這間老山莊被改建成了一間小旅館。

sentences.en: She has lofty goals for her career.
sentences.zh: 她對自己的職涯有遠大的目標。

sentences.en: Is it realistic to set such lofty goals?
sentences.zh: 設定這麼遠大的目標實際嗎？

sentences.en: The speech was full of lofty ideas about helping others.
sentences.zh: 這場演講充滿了關於幫助他人的崇高理念。

sentences.en: What lofty plans do you have for the new year?
sentences.zh: 你對新的一年有什麼遠大的計畫？

sentences.en: Their lofty vision for the company inspired the staff.
sentences.zh: 他們對公司的遠大願景鼓舞了員工。

sentences.en: The coach set a lofty target for the team this season.
sentences.zh: 教練為球隊本季訂下了遠大的目標。

gloss_note: 美式口語，帶懷念孤寂感

sentences.en: I felt lonesome after my best friend moved away.
sentences.zh: 好朋友搬走後，我覺得很寂寞。

sentences.en: Does your grandfather get lonesome living alone?
sentences.zh: 你爺爺一個人住會覺得孤單嗎？

sentences.en: The lonesome cowboy sang by the campfire.
sentences.zh: 孤單的牛仔在營火旁唱歌。

sentences.en: It's a lonesome drive across the desert at night.
sentences.zh: 夜裡開車穿越沙漠是一趟孤單的旅程。

sentences.en: Why do you look so lonesome sitting there?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼獨自坐在那裡，看起來這麼寂寞？

sentences.en: The old dog grew lonesome when the kids left for college.
sentences.zh: 孩子們離家上大學後，老狗變得孤單。

sentences.en: Eating well can add to your longevity.
sentences.zh: 吃得健康有助於長壽。

sentences.en: What's the secret to her longevity?
sentences.zh: 她長壽的祕訣是什麼？

sentences.en: The study looked at diet and longevity in older adults.
sentences.zh: 這項研究探討了老年人的飲食與長壽的關係。

sentences.en: Good care ensures the longevity of leather shoes.
sentences.zh: 妥善保養能讓皮鞋經久耐用。

sentences.en: Is a long warranty a sign of the product's longevity?
sentences.zh: 保固期長，就代表產品耐用嗎？

sentences.en: Some tortoises are famous for their longevity.
sentences.zh: 有些烏龜以長壽聞名。

sentences.en: Longitude lines run from the North Pole to the South Pole.
sentences.zh: 經線從北極延伸到南極。

sentences.en: Can you read the longitude on this map?
sentences.zh: 你能讀出這張地圖上的經度嗎？

sentences.en: The captain wrote down the ship's longitude every hour.
sentences.zh: 船長每小時記下一次船隻所在的經度。

sentences.en: Which longitude does this island sit on?
sentences.zh: 這座島位在哪一條經線上？

sentences.en: Time zones are based on longitude.
sentences.zh: 時區是依經度劃分的。

sentences.en: Your phone can show your longitude on the map.
sentences.zh: 你的手機可以在地圖上顯示你所在的經度。

sentences.en: I put lotion on my hands after washing dishes.
sentences.zh: 洗完碗後，我會在手上擦乳液。

sentences.en: Do you have a lotion for dry skin?
sentences.zh: 你們有適合乾燥肌膚的乳液嗎？

sentences.en: This lotion smells like vanilla.
sentences.zh: 這罐乳液聞起來有香草味。

sentences.en: Could you hand me the body lotion?
sentences.zh: 可以把身體乳液遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: The pharmacist recommended a lotion without perfume.
sentences.zh: 藥師推薦了一款無香料的乳液。

sentences.en: My skin feels tight when I skip lotion in winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天沒擦乳液，我的皮膚就會覺得緊繃。

sentences.en: My uncle won the lottery last year.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔去年中了樂透。

sentences.en: Do you buy a lottery ticket every week?
sentences.zh: 你每週都買彩券嗎？

sentences.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
sentences.zh: 如果你中了樂透，你會怎麼做？

sentences.en: The lottery jackpot is over two hundred million dollars.
sentences.zh: 樂透頭獎金額超過兩億美元。

sentences.en: She bought a lottery ticket at the gas station.
sentences.zh: 她在加油站買了一張彩券。

sentences.en: The odds of winning the lottery are very small.
sentences.zh: 中樂透的機率非常小。

gloss_note: lotus root 蓮藕；lotus seeds 蓮子

sentences.en: A pink lotus bloomed in the pond.
sentences.zh: 一朵粉紅色的蓮花在池塘裡綻放。

sentences.en: Do you like soup with lotus root?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡加蓮藕的湯嗎？

sentences.en: Lotus seeds are often used in sweet soups.
sentences.zh: 蓮子常用在甜湯裡。

sentences.en: The lotus leaves floated on the water like green plates.
sentences.zh: 蓮葉像綠色盤子般漂在水面上。

sentences.en: Can you slice the lotus root thinly for the stir-fry?
sentences.zh: 你可以把蓮藕切成薄片來炒嗎？

sentences.en: We took photos of lotus flowers at the park.
sentences.zh: 我們在公園拍了蓮花的照片。

gloss_note: over the loudspeaker 透過廣播

sentences.en: The announcement came over the loudspeaker.
sentences.zh: 廣播從擴音器傳了出來。

sentences.en: Can you hear the loudspeaker from back there?
sentences.zh: 你在後面聽得到擴音器嗎？

sentences.en: The coach shouted through a loudspeaker at practice.
sentences.zh: 教練在練習時用擴音器喊話。

sentences.en: The store announced over the loudspeaker that it was closing.
sentences.zh: 商店透過擴音器廣播說要打烊了。

sentences.en: The principal's voice boomed from the loudspeaker in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 校長的聲音從走廊的擴音器響起。

sentences.en: Is there a loudspeaker in the gym for the game?
sentences.zh: 體育館裡有為比賽準備擴音器嗎？

gloss_note: sing a lullaby 唱搖籃曲

sentences.en: She sang a lullaby to help the baby sleep.
sentences.zh: 她唱了一首搖籃曲哄寶寶入睡。

sentences.en: Do you remember the lullaby your mom used to sing?
sentences.zh: 你還記得你媽媽以前唱的搖籃曲嗎？

sentences.en: This soft lullaby always calms my daughter.
sentences.zh: 這首輕柔的搖籃曲總能讓我女兒平靜下來。

sentences.en: Dad hummed a lullaby while rocking the crib.
sentences.zh: 爸爸一邊搖著嬰兒床，一邊哼著搖籃曲。

sentences.en: Can you play a lullaby on the piano?
sentences.zh: 你可以用鋼琴彈一首搖籃曲嗎？

sentences.en: The movie ends with a gentle lullaby.
sentences.zh: 這部電影以一首溫柔的搖籃曲作結。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: Lunar New Year 農曆新年

sentences.en: Our family gathers for dinner on Lunar New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 我們全家在農曆除夕聚餐。

sentences.en: When is the Lunar New Year this year?
sentences.zh: 今年的農曆新年是什麼時候？

sentences.en: The lunar calendar follows the moon's cycles.
sentences.zh: 農曆是依照月亮的週期來計算的。

sentences.en: Scientists studied rocks from the lunar surface.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究了月球表面的岩石。

sentences.en: Do you know the date of the next lunar eclipse?
sentences.zh: 你知道下一次月蝕的日期嗎？

sentences.en: Grandma still uses the lunar calendar for birthdays.
sentences.zh: 奶奶生日仍然看農曆。

gloss_note: lush lawn／forest 茂盛的草地／森林

sentences.en: The park looks lush after all that spring rain.
sentences.zh: 下了那麼多春雨，公園看起來一片青翠茂盛。

sentences.en: Is your lawn always this lush in the summer?
sentences.zh: 你家的草坪夏天都這麼翠綠茂盛嗎？

sentences.en: We hiked through a lush green valley yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們昨天健行穿過一片青翠的山谷。

sentences.en: Why is the garden next door so lush?
sentences.zh: 為什麼隔壁的花園這麼繁茂？

sentences.en: The tour guide pointed out the lush rainforest below.
sentences.zh: 導遊指著下方茂密的雨林。

sentences.en: Frequent rain keeps these hills lush throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 頻繁的降雨讓這些山丘全年綠意盎然。

gloss_note: macaroni and cheese 起司通心粉

sentences.en: I'm making macaroni and cheese for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚要煮起司通心粉當晚餐。

sentences.en: Do you want extra cheese on your macaroni?
sentences.zh: 你的通心粉要不要多加一點起司？

sentences.en: The kids always ask for macaroni at lunch.
sentences.zh: 孩子們午餐總是要吃通心粉。

sentences.en: How long should I boil the macaroni?
sentences.zh: 這通心粉我該煮多久？

sentences.en: This macaroni salad is perfect for the picnic.
sentences.zh: 這道通心粉沙拉很適合帶去野餐。

sentences.en: The school cafeteria served macaroni with tomato sauce today.
sentences.zh: 學校餐廳今天供應番茄醬汁通心粉。

gloss_note: 口語多說 ma'am；madam 較正式

sentences.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about my recent order.
sentences.zh: 敬啟者：我寫信是想詢問我最近的訂單。

sentences.en: Can I help you find something, madam?
sentences.zh: 女士，需要我幫您找什麼嗎？

sentences.en: Madam, your table is ready now.
sentences.zh: 女士，您的位子準備好了。

sentences.en: Would you like to see the dessert menu, madam?
sentences.zh: 女士，您要看一下甜點菜單嗎？

sentences.en: Excuse me, madam, you dropped your scarf.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，女士，您的圍巾掉了。

sentences.en: At the club meeting, everyone called her Madam Chair.
sentences.zh: 在社團會議上，大家都稱她為主席女士。

other_senses: 誇大（把事情說得更嚴重）

sentences.en: This lens can magnify small print up to ten times.
sentences.zh: 這個鏡片可以把小字放大十倍。

sentences.en: Could you magnify the map so I can read it?
sentences.zh: 你可以把地圖放大讓我看清楚嗎？

sentences.en: The microscope will magnify the cells for our class.
sentences.zh: 顯微鏡會把細胞放大給我們全班看。

sentences.en: Do you have a magnifying glass I could borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有放大鏡可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: He used his phone to magnify the tiny street sign.
sentences.zh: 他用手機把小小的路標放大。

sentences.en: The bathroom mirror magnifies your face quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 浴室的鏡子會把你的臉放大不少。

gloss_note: maiden name 娘家姓（婚前的姓）

sentences.en: The new cruise ship will begin its maiden voyage next week.
sentences.zh: 這艘新郵輪下週就要展開首航。

sentences.en: What was your mother's maiden name?
sentences.zh: 你母親婚前的姓氏是什麼？

sentences.en: Her maiden name was Carter before she got married.
sentences.zh: 她結婚前的姓是卡特。

sentences.en: Did you watch the plane's maiden flight on TV?
sentences.zh: 你有看電視上那架飛機的首次飛行嗎？

sentences.en: Did she keep her maiden name after the wedding?
sentences.zh: 她婚後有保留娘家姓嗎？

sentences.en: The train made its maiden run on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 這班火車在週一早上首度行駛。

sentences.en: We stood in front of the majestic mountain at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我們在日出時站在雄偉的高山前。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen such a majestic waterfall?
sentences.zh: 你見過這麼壯麗的瀑布嗎？

sentences.en: The old castle looks majestic against the evening sky.
sentences.zh: 那座古堡在傍晚的天空襯托下顯得雄偉。

sentences.en: Look at that majestic eagle flying over the lake!
sentences.zh: 看那隻雄偉的老鷹飛過湖面！

sentences.en: Isn't the view from the hotel balcony majestic?
sentences.zh: 飯店陽台的景色不是很壯麗嗎？

sentences.en: The majestic redwood trees towered above the hikers.
sentences.zh: 雄偉的紅杉高高聳立在健行者上方。

gloss_note: Your Majesty 陛下，用於童話、電影、歷史

sentences.en: The guide described the majesty of the ancient mountains.
sentences.zh: 導遊描述了這些古老山脈的雄偉。

sentences.en: Your Majesty, shall I let the guests in?
sentences.zh: 陛下，要我請賓客進來嗎？

sentences.en: In the movie, the knight bowed and said, "Your Majesty."
sentences.zh: 電影裡，騎士鞠躬說：「陛下。」

sentences.en: Did you feel the majesty of the canyon at sunset?
sentences.zh: 你有在日落時感受到峽谷的雄偉嗎？

sentences.en: In the story, the servant asked, "More tea, Your Majesty?"
sentences.zh: 故事裡，僕人問：「陛下，還要再來點茶嗎？」

sentences.en: Visitors are always amazed by the majesty of the falls.
sentences.zh: 遊客總是對瀑布的雄偉感到驚嘆。

gloss_note: Malaysian food 馬來西亞料理

sentences.en: We found a great Malaysian restaurant near my office.
sentences.zh: 我們在公司附近找到一家很棒的馬來西亞餐廳。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried Malaysian noodle soup?
sentences.zh: 你吃過馬來西亞的湯麵嗎？

sentences.en: Her grandmother cooks the best Malaysian chicken satay.
sentences.zh: 她奶奶煮的馬來西亞雞肉沙嗲最好吃。

sentences.en: Is the Malaysian coconut rice on the menu today?
sentences.zh: 今天的菜單上有馬來西亞椰漿飯嗎？

sentences.en: My coworker brought Malaysian snacks to the office party.
sentences.zh: 我同事帶了馬來西亞零食來辦公室派對。

sentences.en: The Malaysian food festival is happening downtown this weekend.
sentences.zh: 馬來西亞美食節這個週末在市中心舉行。

gloss_note: 常說 mandarin orange；大寫是華語

sentences.en: I peeled a mandarin and shared it with my sister.
sentences.zh: 我剝了一顆橘子和妹妹分著吃。

sentences.en: Do you want a mandarin or an apple?
sentences.zh: 你想吃橘子還是蘋果？

sentences.en: The salad has mandarin segments and crunchy almonds.
sentences.zh: 這道沙拉有橘子瓣和脆脆的杏仁。

sentences.en: Are these mandarins sweet enough for the kids?
sentences.zh: 這些橘子夠甜，適合給孩子吃嗎？

sentences.en: Mom packs a mandarin in my lunch box every day.
sentences.zh: 媽媽每天都在我的便當盒裡放一顆橘子。

sentences.en: Canned mandarin slices go well with plain yogurt.
sentences.zh: 罐頭橘子瓣很適合搭配原味優格。

gloss_note: maple leaf 楓葉；maple syrup 楓糖漿

sentences.en: Maple leaves turn bright red in the fall.
sentences.zh: 楓葉在秋天會轉成鮮紅色。

sentences.en: Would you like maple syrup on your pancakes?
sentences.zh: 你的鬆餅要淋楓糖漿嗎？

sentences.en: We planted a young maple tree in the front yard.
sentences.zh: 我們在前院種了一棵小楓樹。

sentences.en: Is this bottle of maple syrup made locally?
sentences.zh: 這瓶楓糖漿是本地製造的嗎？

sentences.en: The kids jumped into a pile of maple leaves.
sentences.zh: 孩子們跳進一堆楓葉裡。

sentences.en: A huge maple shades our backyard every summer afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一棵大楓樹在每個夏日午後為我們的後院遮蔭。

gloss_note: frozen margarita 冰沙式瑪格麗特

sentences.en: I'll have a margarita with no salt, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯瑪格麗特，杯口不要鹽，謝謝。

sentences.en: Does your restaurant make a frozen margarita?
sentences.zh: 你們餐廳有賣冰沙式瑪格麗特嗎？

sentences.en: She ordered a lime margarita to go with her tacos.
sentences.zh: 她點了一杯萊姆瑪格麗特來配墨西哥捲餅。

sentences.en: Which is better, the strawberry margarita or the classic one?
sentences.zh: 草莓瑪格麗特和經典款，哪一種比較好喝？

sentences.en: My husband and I split a margarita at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我先生和我晚餐時分著喝一杯瑪格麗特。

sentences.en: The waiter brought a margarita in a salt-rimmed glass.
sentences.zh: 服務生端來一杯杯口沾著鹽的瑪格麗特。

sentences.en: My son takes a martial arts class every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我兒子每週六都上武術課。

sentences.en: Which martial art did you study as a kid?
sentences.zh: 你小時候學過哪一種武術？

sentences.en: She earned a black belt in a martial art last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年在一種武術中拿到了黑帶。

sentences.en: Is there a martial arts studio near the mall?
sentences.zh: 購物中心附近有武術教室嗎？

sentences.en: The movie's martial arts scenes were amazing to watch.
sentences.zh: 那部電影的武打場面精采極了。

sentences.en: Martial arts training can improve balance and focus.
sentences.zh: 武術訓練可以改善平衡感和專注力。

other_senses: 奇蹟；令人驚奇的事物（名詞）

sentences.en: Tourists stop to marvel at the giant canyon.
sentences.zh: 遊客停下腳步，對巨大的峽谷讚嘆不已。

sentences.en: Did you marvel at the fireworks last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有被煙火驚豔到嗎？

sentences.en: I still marvel at how fast kids learn.
sentences.zh: 我至今仍對孩子學得這麼快感到驚嘆。

sentences.en: We marveled at the size of the old tree.
sentences.zh: 我們對那棵老樹的粗大感到驚嘆。

sentences.en: Why does everyone marvel at this simple magic trick?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家都對這個簡單的魔術驚嘆不已？

sentences.en: Visitors marvel at the detail in each hand-painted vase.
sentences.zh: 參觀者對每個手繪花瓶的細緻讚嘆不已。

sentences.en: Her mastery of French impressed the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她精通法文，讓整個團隊印象深刻。

sentences.en: Does the job require mastery of spreadsheet software?
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要精通試算表軟體嗎？

sentences.en: It takes years of practice to reach mastery of the piano.
sentences.zh: 要精通鋼琴需要多年的練習。

sentences.en: Mastery of basic math will help you in every class.
sentences.zh: 熟練基礎數學會對你的每一門課都有幫助。

sentences.en: How did he gain such mastery of the guitar?
sentences.zh: 他是怎麼練到精通吉他的？

sentences.en: The chef showed real mastery of knife skills.
sentences.zh: 那位主廚展現了精湛的刀工。

sentences.en: Could you put less mayonnaise on my sandwich?
sentences.zh: 你可以在我的三明治上少放一點美乃滋嗎？

sentences.en: We're out of mayonnaise, so I need to go to the store.
sentences.zh: 我們的美乃滋用完了，所以我得去一趟商店。

sentences.en: Do you like mayonnaise on your French fries?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡在薯條上沾美乃滋嗎？

sentences.en: She mixed mayonnaise with tuna for the sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 她把美乃滋和鮪魚拌在一起做三明治。

sentences.en: Is this potato salad made with homemade mayonnaise?
sentences.zh: 這道馬鈴薯沙拉是用自製美乃滋做的嗎？

sentences.en: Keep the mayonnaise in the refrigerator after you open it.
sentences.zh: 美乃滋開封後要放在冰箱裡。

sentences.en: We toured a medieval town in Europe last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們去年夏天參觀了歐洲的一座中世紀小鎮。

sentences.en: Do you like medieval stories about knights and dragons?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡有騎士和龍的中世紀故事嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has a great medieval armor exhibit.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有很棒的中世紀盔甲展。

sentences.en: Was this bridge built in medieval times?
sentences.zh: 這座橋是中世紀時蓋的嗎？

sentences.en: My history class is studying medieval trade routes.
sentences.zh: 我的歷史課正在研究中世紀的貿易路線。

sentences.en: The restaurant is decorated like a medieval hall.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳佈置得像中世紀的大廳。

sentences.en: I meditate for ten minutes every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都會冥想十分鐘。

sentences.en: Do you meditate before big presentations?
sentences.zh: 你在重要簡報前會先冥想嗎？

sentences.en: Our yoga teacher showed us how to meditate by breathing slowly.
sentences.zh: 瑜珈老師教我們用緩慢呼吸的方式靜坐。

sentences.en: Can you meditate on a crowded bus?
sentences.zh: 你能在擁擠的公車上冥想嗎？

sentences.en: She likes to meditate in the quiet garden after work.
sentences.zh: 她下班後喜歡在安靜的花園裡冥想。

sentences.en: Doctors say that meditating can help lower stress.
sentences.zh: 醫生說冥想有助於降低壓力。

sentences.en: A short meditation helps me relax after work.
sentences.zh: 一段短短的冥想幫助我在下班後放鬆。

sentences.en: Is there a meditation class at the community center?
sentences.zh: 社區中心有冥想課嗎？

sentences.en: He downloaded a meditation app to help him sleep.
sentences.zh: 他下載了一個冥想應用程式幫助入睡。

sentences.en: Do you do guided meditation in the evening?
sentences.zh: 你晚上會做引導式冥想嗎？

sentences.en: The gym has a quiet room for meditation.
sentences.zh: 健身房有一間安靜的冥想室。

sentences.en: Daily meditation may reduce stress, according to the study.
sentences.zh: 根據這項研究，每天冥想或許能減輕壓力。

gloss_note: 名詞也可，指淡淡的憂愁

sentences.en: The rainy weather put me in a melancholy mood.
sentences.zh: 下雨的天氣讓我心情有些憂鬱。

sentences.en: Why does this old song sound so melancholy?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這首老歌聽起來這麼感傷？

sentences.en: She gave a melancholy smile as she packed her things.
sentences.zh: 她一邊收拾東西，一邊露出感傷的微笑。

sentences.en: Do you ever feel melancholy when summer ends?
sentences.zh: 夏天結束時，你會覺得有些感傷嗎？

sentences.en: The melancholy melody played softly in the empty cafe.
sentences.zh: 憂傷的旋律在空蕩蕩的咖啡館裡輕輕播放。

sentences.en: He felt a quiet melancholy after his friends moved away.
sentences.zh: 朋友搬走後，他心中有一股淡淡的憂愁。

gloss_note: 形容咖啡、酒、起司的味道

sentences.en: This coffee has a smooth, mellow flavor.
sentences.zh: 這咖啡的味道滑順溫和。

sentences.en: Is the cheddar mellow or sharp?
sentences.zh: 這個切達起司味道溫和還是濃烈？

sentences.en: I prefer a mellow red wine with my steak.
sentences.zh: 我配牛排比較喜歡順口的紅酒。

sentences.en: The soup tastes mellow after simmering for hours.
sentences.zh: 這鍋湯燉煮好幾個小時後，味道變得醇厚順口。

sentences.en: Do you have a coffee that's more mellow?
sentences.zh: 你們有比較順口的咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: The aged cheese has a rich, mellow taste.
sentences.zh: 這種熟成起司有濃郁又溫和的風味。

sentences.en: I admire her never-give-up mentality.
sentences.zh: 我很欣賞她絕不放棄的心態。

sentences.en: What kind of mentality do you need to run a marathon?
sentences.zh: 跑馬拉松需要什麼樣的心態？

sentences.en: The coach talked about having a winning mentality.
sentences.zh: 教練談到要有求勝的心態。

sentences.en: Do you think a herd mentality makes people buy more?
sentences.zh: 你覺得從眾心態會讓人買得更多嗎？

sentences.en: Her positive mentality helped the whole office stay calm.
sentences.zh: 她的正向心態幫助整個辦公室保持冷靜。

sentences.en: Changing a lazy mentality takes time and effort.
sentences.zh: 改變懶散的心態需要時間和努力。

sentences.en: My daughter wants to be a mermaid for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我女兒萬聖節想扮成美人魚。

sentences.en: Have you read that picture book about a mermaid?
sentences.zh: 你讀過那本關於美人魚的繪本嗎？

sentences.en: The mermaid in the story lived at the bottom of the sea.
sentences.zh: 故事裡的美人魚住在海底。

sentences.en: Do you think mermaids are real?
sentences.zh: 你覺得美人魚是真的嗎？

sentences.en: She drew a mermaid with long green hair.
sentences.zh: 她畫了一隻有著綠色長髮的美人魚。

sentences.en: The aquarium has a mermaid show on weekends.
sentences.zh: 水族館週末有美人魚表演。

sentences.en: My parrot can mimic the sound of the phone.
sentences.zh: 我的鸚鵡會模仿電話鈴聲。

sentences.en: Can you mimic your boss's voice?
sentences.zh: 你會模仿你老闆的聲音嗎？

sentences.en: Little kids often mimic what adults do.
sentences.zh: 小孩常常模仿大人的行為。

sentences.en: Why do babies mimic the faces we make?
sentences.zh: 為什麼嬰兒會模仿我們做的表情？

sentences.en: The robot is designed to mimic human movements.
sentences.zh: 這個機器人是設計來模仿人類動作的。

sentences.en: She mimicked the teacher's walk, and everyone laughed.
sentences.zh: 她模仿老師走路的樣子，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: Feel free to mingle with the other guests.
sentences.zh: 你可以隨意和其他賓客交談走動。

sentences.en: Do you like to mingle at networking events?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡在人脈交流活動上與人交際嗎？

sentences.en: We'll have snacks and time to mingle after the talk.
sentences.zh: 演講結束後會有點心，也有時間讓大家交流。

sentences.en: Shall we go mingle with the other parents?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要去和其他家長聊聊？

sentences.en: The smell of coffee mingled with the smell of fresh bread.
sentences.zh: 咖啡香和剛出爐麵包的香味交融在一起。

sentences.en: Colors mingle together when you stir the paint.
sentences.zh: 攪拌顏料時，顏色會混在一起。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Naomi Persephone Amethyst
Recorder: NaomiAmethyst

sentences.en: She made a miraculous recovery after the surgery.
sentences.zh: 她在手術後奇蹟般地康復了。

sentences.en: Was it really a miraculous escape, or just luck?
sentences.zh: 那真的是奇蹟般的脫險，還是只是運氣好？

sentences.en: The team's miraculous comeback surprised every fan.
sentences.zh: 這支球隊神奇的逆轉讓每位球迷都很驚訝。

sentences.en: This miraculous cleaner removed the stain in seconds.
sentences.zh: 這款神奇的清潔劑幾秒就去掉了污漬。

sentences.en: Isn't it miraculous that nobody was hurt in the accident?
sentences.zh: 那場意外沒有人受傷，不是很神奇嗎？

sentences.en: The new medicine had miraculous results for patients.
sentences.zh: 這種新藥對病人有神奇的效果。

sentences.en: Put the miscellaneous items in that box.
sentences.zh: 把雜物放進那個箱子裡。

sentences.en: How much did you spend on miscellaneous expenses?
sentences.zh: 你在雜項開銷上花了多少錢？

sentences.en: The budget includes a small fund for miscellaneous costs.
sentences.zh: 預算中包含一小筆雜支經費。

sentences.en: Is there a drawer for miscellaneous cables?
sentences.zh: 有沒有抽屜可以放各種雜線？

sentences.en: She sells miscellaneous goods at the weekend market.
sentences.zh: 她在週末市集賣各式各樣的雜貨。

sentences.en: Please list any miscellaneous fees on the report.
sentences.zh: 請把任何雜項費用列在報告上。

sentences.en: My mischievous puppy hid my left shoe again.
sentences.zh: 我調皮的小狗又把我的一隻鞋藏起來了。

sentences.en: Why is your little brother smiling in such a mischievous way?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟為什麼笑得那麼調皮？

sentences.en: The twins were mischievous and loved playing tricks.
sentences.zh: 那對雙胞胎很淘氣，愛惡作劇。

sentences.en: Is your cat always this mischievous?
sentences.zh: 你的貓總是這麼調皮嗎？

sentences.en: He gave me a mischievous grin before he jumped out.
sentences.zh: 他跳出來之前，對我露出了淘氣的笑容。

sentences.en: A mischievous student hid the teacher's chalk.
sentences.zh: 一個調皮的學生把老師的粉筆藏起來了。

sentences.en: The mayor asked residents to mobilize after the storm.
sentences.zh: 市長在風暴後呼籲居民動員起來。

sentences.en: Can we mobilize enough volunteers by Saturday?
sentences.zh: 我們能在週六前動員到足夠的志工嗎？

sentences.en: Neighbors mobilized quickly to clean up the flooded street.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們迅速動員起來清理淹水的街道。

sentences.en: How fast can the city mobilize emergency crews?
sentences.zh: 市政府能多快調動緊急救援人員？

sentences.en: Our club will mobilize its members for the food drive.
sentences.zh: 我們社團會動員成員參加食物募集活動。

sentences.en: The company mobilized extra staff to meet the deadline.
sentences.zh: 公司調動了額外人手來趕上截止期限。

gloss_note: 數據機接網路，路由器分送訊號

sentences.en: Our internet is down, so I'll restart the modem.
sentences.zh: 我們的網路斷了，所以我要重新啟動數據機。

sentences.en: Do I need a new modem for faster speeds?
sentences.zh: 我需要換新的數據機才能更快嗎？

sentences.en: The technician came to replace the old modem.
sentences.zh: 技術人員來更換舊的數據機。

sentences.en: Is the modem plugged in properly?
sentences.zh: 數據機有插好嗎？

sentences.en: Plug the modem into the wall, then connect the router.
sentences.zh: 先把數據機插上牆上的插座，再接路由器。

sentences.en: My modem lights keep blinking red.
sentences.zh: 我的數據機燈號一直閃紅燈。

sentences.en: The restaurant is moderately priced and always busy.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳價格適中，而且總是客滿。

sentences.en: Is the curry moderately spicy or very hot?
sentences.zh: 這咖哩是中辣還是很辣？

sentences.en: The menu is moderately priced, so should we try it?
sentences.zh: 菜單價格還算中等，我們要不要試試看？

sentences.en: This sauce is moderately sweet, so kids will like it.
sentences.zh: 這個醬汁甜度適中，小孩會喜歡。

sentences.en: Eat moderately, and you can still enjoy dessert.
sentences.zh: 吃得適度一點，你還是可以享用甜點。

sentences.en: Our dinner was moderately expensive, but it was worth it.
sentences.zh: 我們的晚餐算是中等價位，但很值得。

sentences.en: The city announced the modernization of its old train station.
sentences.zh: 市政府宣布要將老舊的火車站現代化。

sentences.en: Does the budget cover the modernization of our computers?
sentences.zh: 預算有包含我們電腦設備的更新嗎？

sentences.en: Rapid modernization has changed life in many small towns.
sentences.zh: 快速的現代化改變了許多小鎮的生活。

sentences.en: How long will the modernization of the factory take?
sentences.zh: 工廠的現代化改造要花多久時間？

sentences.en: The school needs modernization to meet new safety rules.
sentences.zh: 這所學校需要翻新現代化，才能符合新的安全規定。

sentences.en: Her essay discusses modernization and its effects on family life.
sentences.zh: 她的文章探討現代化及其對家庭生活的影響。

sentences.en: We need to modernize our old filing system.
sentences.zh: 我們需要把舊的檔案管理系統現代化。

sentences.en: Are they going to modernize the kitchen this year?
sentences.zh: 他們今年會把廚房翻新嗎？

sentences.en: The owners decided to modernize the hotel lobby.
sentences.zh: 業主決定翻新飯店大廳。

sentences.en: Can this software help us modernize our workflow?
sentences.zh: 這套軟體能幫我們把工作流程現代化嗎？

sentences.en: The library modernized its catalog last spring.
sentences.zh: 圖書館去年春天更新了館藏目錄系統。

sentences.en: Why does it cost so much to modernize an old house?
sentences.zh: 為什麼翻新老房子這麼花錢？

sentences.en: In the fairy tale, the monarch ruled a small kingdom.
sentences.zh: 在童話故事裡，那位君主統治著一個小王國。

sentences.en: Was the monarch kind to the people in the story?
sentences.zh: 故事裡的君主對人民好嗎？

sentences.en: Our history teacher explained how a monarch once ruled the land.
sentences.zh: 我們的歷史老師解釋了君主過去如何統治這片土地。

sentences.en: The young monarch in the movie loved to read.
sentences.zh: 電影裡年輕的君主很愛讀書。

sentences.en: What did a monarch do in the Middle Ages?
sentences.zh: 中世紀的君主都做些什麼？

sentences.en: The old monarch gave a speech from the castle balcony.
sentences.zh: 年邁的君主在城堡陽台上發表談話。

gloss_note: break the monotony 打破單調

sentences.en: I needed a trip to break the monotony of daily life.
sentences.zh: 我需要一趟旅行來打破日常生活的單調。

sentences.en: How do you deal with the monotony of a desk job?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼面對坐辦公桌工作的乏味？

sentences.en: Music helps me escape the monotony of long drives.
sentences.zh: 音樂讓我擺脫長途開車的枯燥。

sentences.en: The monotony of the lecture put half the class to sleep.
sentences.zh: 那場演講太單調，讓半個班級都睡著了。

sentences.en: Do you ever get tired of the monotony at work?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有厭倦過工作上的一成不變？

sentences.en: Adding color to the room will break the monotony.
sentences.zh: 在房間加點顏色可以打破單調感。

sentences.en: A monstrous truck blocked the narrow road.
sentences.zh: 一輛龐然大物般的卡車擋住了窄路。

sentences.en: Did you see the monstrous waves at the beach?
sentences.zh: 你有看到海灘上那些駭人的巨浪嗎？

sentences.en: The movie's monstrous robot was bigger than a building.
sentences.zh: 那部電影裡巨大的機器人比一棟大樓還高。

sentences.en: That's a monstrous amount of homework for one night!
sentences.zh: 一個晚上要寫這麼大量的作業也太誇張了！

sentences.en: Is the new stadium really that monstrous in size?
sentences.zh: 新的體育場真的有那麼龐大嗎？

sentences.en: The kids drew a monstrous dinosaur with huge teeth.
sentences.zh: 孩子們畫了一隻有大牙齒的巨大恐龍。

gloss_zh: 喜怒無常的；心情不好的

sentences.en: My teenage brother gets moody when he's tired.
sentences.zh: 我的青少年弟弟一累就會心情不好。

sentences.en: Why is your boss so moody today?
sentences.zh: 你老闆今天為什麼心情這麼差？

sentences.en: She's been moody all week because of the exams.
sentences.zh: 她因為考試，整個星期都心情不好。

sentences.en: Don't be moody; come eat dinner with us.
sentences.zh: 別鬧情緒了，來和我們一起吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Is the baby moody because she missed her nap?
sentences.zh: 寶寶是因為沒睡午覺才鬧脾氣嗎？

sentences.en: He's a moody person, so give him some space.
sentences.zh: 他這個人情緒起伏很大，給他一點空間吧。

sentences.en: In the myth, the hero was a mortal, not a god.
sentences.zh: 在神話中，那位英雄是凡人，不是神。

sentences.en: Are you saying that every living thing is mortal?
sentences.zh: 你是說所有生物都終有一死嗎？

sentences.en: The fairy fell in love with a mortal boy.
sentences.zh: 那位仙女愛上了一個凡人男孩。

sentences.en: Unlike the dragon, we are mere mortals.
sentences.zh: 不像那條龍，我們只是凡人。

sentences.en: Does the story say the king was mortal?
sentences.zh: 故事裡有說國王是凡人嗎？

sentences.en: The wizard warned that even a great hero is mortal.
sentences.zh: 巫師警告說，就連偉大的英雄也終有一死。

sentences.en: She balances motherhood and a busy career.
sentences.zh: 她同時兼顧為人母的角色和忙碌的事業。

sentences.en: How has motherhood changed your daily routine?
sentences.zh: 當了媽媽之後，你的日常作息有什麼改變？

sentences.en: The author wrote a book about the joys of motherhood.
sentences.zh: 這位作家寫了一本關於為人母喜悅的書。

sentences.en: Motherhood taught me to be more patient.
sentences.zh: 當了媽媽讓我學會更有耐心。

sentences.en: Do you think motherhood is harder than people say?
sentences.zh: 你覺得當媽媽比大家說的還辛苦嗎？

sentences.en: Many women say motherhood changed their goals in life.
sentences.zh: 許多女性說，為人母改變了她們的人生目標。

sentences.en: My motto is "Never stop learning."
