sentences.zh: 我的座右銘是「學無止境」。

sentences.en: What's your team's motto this year?
sentences.zh: 你們團隊今年的口號是什麼？

sentences.en: The school motto is written above the front door.
sentences.zh: 校訓寫在前門上方。

sentences.en: Do you have a personal motto?
sentences.zh: 你有自己的座右銘嗎？

sentences.en: Their company motto is "Customers come first."
sentences.zh: 他們公司的格言是「顧客至上」。

sentences.en: He printed his favorite motto on a poster.
sentences.zh: 他把自己最愛的格言印在海報上。

sentences.en: The pitcher walked slowly to the mound.
sentences.zh: 投手慢慢走向投手丘。

sentences.en: A mound of laundry was waiting on the bed.
sentences.zh: 床上堆著一大堆待洗的衣服。

sentences.en: The kids built a mound of sand at the beach.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在海灘上堆了一座沙堆。

sentences.en: Why is there a mound of dirt in our yard?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們的院子裡有一堆土？

sentences.en: Is that a mound of snow or a parked car?
sentences.zh: 那是一堆雪還是一輛停著的車？

sentences.en: The squirrel hid nuts under a small mound of leaves.
sentences.zh: 松鼠把堅果藏在一小堆落葉下面。

gloss_note: mourn the loss of 哀悼…的逝世

sentences.en: The whole town came together to mourn the beloved teacher.
sentences.zh: 全鎮的人聚在一起哀悼那位深受愛戴的老師。

sentences.en: Do people in your culture mourn in a special way?
sentences.zh: 你們的文化裡，人們有特別的哀悼方式嗎？

sentences.en: Fans gathered outside the theater to mourn the singer.
sentences.zh: 歌迷聚集在劇院外悼念那位歌手。

sentences.en: We mourned the loss of our kind old neighbor.
sentences.zh: 我們哀悼那位親切的老鄰居離世。

sentences.en: Is it okay to mourn a pet for months?
sentences.zh: 為一隻寵物哀悼好幾個月，這樣可以嗎？

sentences.en: The city held a quiet evening ceremony to mourn the flood victims.
sentences.zh: 市政府舉辦了一場安靜的晚間追思儀式，悼念洪水的罹難者。

sentences.en: The violin played a mournful tune.
sentences.zh: 小提琴拉出了一段哀傷的曲調。

sentences.en: Why did the dog make such a mournful sound?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那隻狗發出這麼哀傷的聲音？

sentences.en: She gave a mournful look at the empty chair.
sentences.zh: 她哀傷地看著那張空椅子。

sentences.en: Is that mournful song from an old movie?
sentences.zh: 那首哀傷的歌是出自一部老電影嗎？

sentences.en: A mournful silence filled the room after the news.
sentences.zh: 聽到消息後，房間裡充滿了悲傷的沉默。

sentences.en: The wind made a mournful noise in the trees.
sentences.zh: 風在樹林間發出悲涼的聲響。

sentences.en: I need to mow the lawn before it rains.
sentences.zh: 我得在下雨前把草坪割一割。

sentences.en: Who's going to mow the grass this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末誰要來割草？

sentences.en: My dad mows the yard every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每個週六早上都會割院子的草。

sentences.en: Can you mow the front yard first?
sentences.zh: 你可以先割前院的草嗎？

sentences.en: We hire a teenager to mow our lawn in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天我們請一個青少年來幫我們割草。

sentences.en: It's too wet to mow today.
sentences.zh: 今天地太濕，沒辦法割草。

sentences.en: Our lawn mower won't start this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們的割草機今天早上發不動。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your mower for an hour?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你借割草機用一個小時嗎？

sentences.en: He bought a new electric mower at the hardware store.
sentences.zh: 他在五金行買了一台新的電動割草機。

sentences.en: Is the mower out of gas again?
sentences.zh: 割草機又沒油了嗎？

sentences.en: The mower is loud, so wear ear protection.
sentences.zh: 割草機很吵，所以要戴耳塞保護聽力。

sentences.en: She pushed the mower slowly across the front yard.
sentences.zh: 她推著割草機慢慢走過前院。

sentences.en: I'll have a blueberry muffin and a coffee, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一個藍莓瑪芬和一杯咖啡，謝謝。

sentences.en: Do you want a muffin with your tea?
sentences.zh: 你的茶要配瑪芬嗎？

sentences.en: Mom baked a batch of banana muffins this morning.
sentences.zh: 媽媽今天早上烤了一批香蕉瑪芬。

sentences.en: Is this muffin made with whole wheat flour?
sentences.zh: 這個瑪芬是用全麥麵粉做的嗎？

sentences.en: The cafe sells fresh muffins until noon.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館到中午都有賣現做的瑪芬。

sentences.en: I ate a warm muffin on my way to work.
sentences.zh: 我在上班途中吃了一個熱呼呼的瑪芬。

gloss_note: 常指激發創作的人或事物

sentences.en: My dog is the muse for all my paintings.
sentences.zh: 我的狗是我所有畫作的靈感來源。

sentences.en: Who was the muse behind your latest song?
sentences.zh: 你最新那首歌的靈感來自誰？

sentences.en: The writer said the ocean was her muse.
sentences.zh: 那位作家說大海是她的靈感來源。

sentences.en: Is nature your muse when you write?
sentences.zh: 你寫作的時候，大自然是你的靈感來源嗎？

sentences.en: For this artist, the city at night is a constant muse.
sentences.zh: 對這位藝術家來說，夜晚的城市是源源不絕的靈感。

sentences.en: Every great designer needs a muse.
sentences.zh: 每位出色的設計師都需要一個靈感來源。

sentences.en: He shaved off his mustache last week.
sentences.zh: 他上星期把小鬍子剃掉了。

sentences.en: Do you think my mustache looks funny?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我的小鬍子看起來很好笑嗎？

sentences.en: The old man had a thick gray mustache.
sentences.zh: 那位老先生留著濃密的灰色八字鬍。

sentences.en: My grandfather twirls his mustache when he's thinking.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺思考的時候會捻他的鬍子。

sentences.en: Why did you grow a mustache?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼留起了小鬍子？

sentences.en: The cartoon character has a big curly mustache.
sentences.zh: 那個卡通角色有一撮大大的捲翹鬍子。

gloss_note: you're on mute 你還在靜音

sentences.en: Please mute your microphone while you're not speaking.
sentences.zh: 你沒在說話時，請把麥克風設成靜音。

sentences.en: Can you mute the TV for a second?
sentences.zh: 你可以把電視關靜音一下嗎？

sentences.en: Oh no, you're on mute!
sentences.zh: 糟了，你還在靜音狀態！

sentences.en: I always mute my phone during meetings.
sentences.zh: 我開會時一定會把手機調成靜音。

sentences.en: Do you mute the ads when they come on?
sentences.zh: 廣告出現的時候，你會關靜音嗎？

sentences.en: She muted the video so the baby could sleep.
sentences.zh: 她把影片設成靜音，讓寶寶可以睡覺。

sentences.en: Could we get an order of garlic naan?
sentences.zh: 我們可以點一份大蒜烤餅嗎？

sentences.en: The naan came out warm and soft.
sentences.zh: 烤餅端上來時又熱又軟。

sentences.en: I like to dip naan in the curry sauce.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡拿烤餅沾咖哩醬吃。

sentences.en: Do you know how to make naan at home?
sentences.zh: 你知道在家怎麼做烤餅嗎？

sentences.en: Rice or naan, which would you like with your meal?
sentences.zh: 你的餐點要配飯還是烤餅？

sentences.en: The chef bakes fresh naan in a clay oven.
sentences.zh: 主廚用陶製烤爐現烤烤餅。

sentences.en: Let's share a plate of nachos before dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐前我們分一盤起司玉米片吧。

sentences.en: Do the nachos come with extra cheese?
sentences.zh: 這份起司玉米片有多加起司嗎？

sentences.en: Jake ordered nachos with beans and salsa.
sentences.zh: 傑克點了配豆子和莎莎醬的起司玉米片。

sentences.en: Are nachos your favorite game day snack?
sentences.zh: 起司玉米片是你最愛的球賽日點心嗎？

sentences.en: She topped the nachos with hot peppers and sour cream.
sentences.zh: 她在起司玉米片上放了辣椒和酸奶油。

sentences.en: These nachos are too salty for me.
sentences.zh: 這份起司玉米片對我來說太鹹了。

gloss_note: nag sb to do 一直唸某人去做

sentences.en: My mom nags me to wear a jacket.
sentences.zh: 我媽一直唸我要穿外套。

sentences.en: Please stop nagging me about the dishes.
sentences.zh: 別再為了碗盤的事一直唸我了。

sentences.en: Why does my boss keep nagging us about reports?
sentences.zh: 為什麼老闆老是為了報告的事一直催我們？

sentences.en: I hate to nag, but the rent is due today.
sentences.zh: 我不想一直催，但房租今天到期了。

sentences.en: Do I really have to nag you every morning?
sentences.zh: 難道我每天早上都得唸你嗎？

sentences.en: The little boy nagged his dad for a new toy.
sentences.zh: 小男孩纏著爸爸吵著要新玩具。

gloss_note: narrate a story 講述故事

sentences.en: Who will narrate the documentary?
sentences.zh: 誰要為這部紀錄片擔任旁白？

sentences.en: Grandpa likes to narrate stories about his childhood.
sentences.zh: 爺爺喜歡講述他童年的故事。

sentences.en: Can you narrate what happened step by step?
sentences.zh: 你可以一步一步把事情經過說一遍嗎？

sentences.en: The author chose to narrate the story in the first person.
sentences.zh: 作者選擇用第一人稱來敘述這個故事。

sentences.en: Students must narrate the events in the picture.
sentences.zh: 學生必須敘述圖片中發生的事。

sentences.en: Would you narrate this photo slideshow for the guests?
sentences.zh: 你可以為來賓講解這組照片投影片嗎？

sentences.en: The narrator of the story is a young girl.
sentences.zh: 這個故事的敘述者是個年輕女孩。

sentences.en: Who is the narrator in this novel?
sentences.zh: 這本小說的敘事者是誰？

sentences.en: The film's narrator has a calm, friendly voice.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的旁白聲音沉穩又親切。

sentences.en: Did the studio hire a new narrator for the series?
sentences.zh: 製作公司為這個系列聘了新的旁白嗎？

sentences.en: A good narrator keeps the audience interested.
sentences.zh: 好的敘述者能讓觀眾保持興趣。

sentences.en: The narrator tells the story from the dog's point of view.
sentences.zh: 敘述者從狗的角度來說這個故事。

gloss_note: navigate a city 在城市裡找路

sentences.en: Can you navigate with a paper map?
sentences.zh: 你會用紙本地圖找路嗎？

sentences.en: My phone helps me navigate unfamiliar cities.
sentences.zh: 手機幫我在陌生的城市裡找路。

sentences.en: It's hard to navigate this huge airport.
sentences.zh: 在這座大機場裡找路很困難。

sentences.en: Sailors once used stars to navigate across the ocean.
sentences.zh: 水手過去靠星星在海上導航。

sentences.en: Could you navigate while I drive?
sentences.zh: 我開車時你可以幫忙看路嗎？

sentences.en: Do new employees know how to navigate the building?
sentences.zh: 新進員工知道怎麼在這棟大樓裡找路嗎？

sentences.en: The navigation system says to turn left ahead.
sentences.zh: 導航系統說前面要左轉。

sentences.en: Does your car have a built-in navigation system?
sentences.zh: 你的車有內建導航系統嗎？

sentences.en: Good navigation is important on a long sea trip.
sentences.zh: 在漫長的海上航程中，好的航行技術很重要。

sentences.en: Our navigation app showed a faster route.
sentences.zh: 我們的導航應用程式顯示了一條比較快的路線。

sentences.en: The pilot checked the navigation equipment before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 機師在起飛前檢查了導航設備。

sentences.en: Did the navigation system send you down the wrong street again?
sentences.zh: 導航系統又把你帶到錯的街上了嗎？

gloss_note: Neapolitan ice cream 三色冰淇淋

sentences.en: Do you serve Neapolitan pizza here?
sentences.zh: 你們這裡有賣拿坡里披薩嗎？

sentences.en: The Neapolitan crust is thin in the middle and puffy at the edge.
sentences.zh: 拿坡里披薩的餅皮中間薄、邊緣蓬鬆。

sentences.en: We split a Neapolitan pizza after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，我們分食了一個拿坡里披薩。

sentences.en: Is the Neapolitan sauce made with fresh tomatoes?
sentences.zh: 拿坡里醬是用新鮮番茄做的嗎？

sentences.en: The chef learned the Neapolitan way of making dough.
sentences.zh: 主廚學會了拿坡里式的揉麵方法。

sentences.en: Would you like chocolate or Neapolitan ice cream?
sentences.zh: 你想吃巧克力冰淇淋，還是拿坡里三色冰淇淋？

sentences.en: I'm nearsighted, so I need glasses to drive.
sentences.zh: 我近視，所以開車需要戴眼鏡。

sentences.en: Is your daughter nearsighted like you?
sentences.zh: 你女兒跟你一樣近視嗎？

sentences.en: The eye doctor said I'm slightly nearsighted.
sentences.zh: 眼科醫師說我有輕微近視。

sentences.en: Many nearsighted people squint at road signs.
sentences.zh: 許多近視的人會瞇著眼看路標。

sentences.en: Did you get these glasses because you're nearsighted?
sentences.zh: 你戴這副眼鏡是因為近視嗎？

sentences.en: My brother is so nearsighted that he can't read the board.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟近視到看不清楚黑板。

gloss_note: 美國硬幣：penny 一分、nickel 五分

sentences.en: Do you have a nickel for the parking meter?
sentences.zh: 你有五分錢硬幣可以投停車計時器嗎？

sentences.en: A nickel is worth five cents.
sentences.zh: 一枚五分錢硬幣值五分錢。

sentences.en: I found a nickel under the couch.
sentences.zh: 我在沙發底下找到一枚五分錢硬幣。

sentences.en: Can I get two nickels for this dime?
sentences.zh: 這枚十分錢硬幣可以換兩個五分錢硬幣嗎？

sentences.en: The vending machine only takes quarters, not nickels.
sentences.zh: 這台自動販賣機只收二十五分錢硬幣，不收五分錢硬幣。

sentences.en: Grandpa still keeps a lucky nickel in his wallet.
sentences.zh: 爺爺的皮夾裡還留著一枚幸運的五分錢硬幣。

sentences.en: I normally skip breakfast. Do you?
sentences.zh: 我通常不吃早餐。你呢？

sentences.en: We normally order takeout on Fridays. What about you?
sentences.zh: 我們星期五通常會叫外賣。你們呢？

sentences.en: The restaurant normally closes at ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳通常十點打烊。

sentences.en: The oven isn't heating normally, so the cake is still raw.
sentences.zh: 烤箱沒有正常加熱，所以蛋糕還沒熟。

sentences.en: Our chef normally uses fresh herbs, not dried ones.
sentences.zh: 我們的主廚通常用新鮮香草，而不是乾燥的。

sentences.en: How much does a meal like this normally cost?
sentences.zh: 這樣的一餐通常要多少錢？

sentences.en: Air flows in through your nostrils when you breathe.
sentences.zh: 你呼吸時，空氣會從鼻孔進入。

sentences.en: The smell of fresh bread filled my nostrils.
sentences.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味撲鼻而來。

sentences.en: Why is my left nostril blocked again?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的左鼻孔又塞住了？

sentences.en: The doctor put a drop of medicine in each nostril.
sentences.zh: 醫師在每個鼻孔裡滴了一滴藥。

sentences.en: Can you move your nostrils without moving your nose?
sentences.zh: 你可以不動鼻子只動鼻孔嗎？

sentences.en: The cold wind stung the inside of my nostrils.
sentences.zh: 冷風刺痛了我的鼻孔內側。

gloss_zh: 惡名昭彰的；臭名在外的

sentences.en: The city is notorious for its heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 這座城市因交通壅塞而出了名。

sentences.en: Is that restaurant still notorious for slow service?
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳還是以服務緩慢出名嗎？

sentences.en: He was a notorious thief in the old movie.
sentences.zh: 他是那部老電影裡惡名昭彰的小偷。

sentences.en: That road is notorious for car accidents in the rain.
sentences.zh: 那條路在雨天出了名地容易發生車禍。

sentences.en: Why is this website notorious for fake reviews?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個網站以假評論聞名？

sentences.en: My neighbor's dog is notorious for barking at night.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居的狗因為夜裡吠叫而出了名。

gloss_note: nourish the body 滋養身體

sentences.en: Fresh vegetables nourish the body.
sentences.zh: 新鮮蔬菜能滋養身體。

sentences.en: Do these vitamins really nourish your skin?
sentences.zh: 這些維他命真的能滋養你的肌膚嗎？

sentences.en: A parent's job is to nourish and protect children.
sentences.zh: 父母的責任是養育並保護孩子。

sentences.en: Rain and sunlight nourish the plants in our garden.
sentences.zh: 雨水和陽光滋養著我們花園裡的植物。

sentences.en: Good books can nourish the mind as well.
sentences.zh: 好書同樣能滋養心靈。

sentences.en: Do you think fast food can really nourish a growing kid?
sentences.zh: 你覺得速食真的能讓成長中的孩子獲得足夠營養嗎？

sentences.en: Babies get all their nourishment from milk.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒的所有營養都來自奶水。

sentences.en: Is a bowl of soup enough nourishment for dinner?
sentences.zh: 一碗湯夠當晚餐的營養嗎？

sentences.en: Plants take nourishment from the soil.
sentences.zh: 植物從土壤中吸收養分。

sentences.en: The hospital gives patients simple but healthy nourishment.
sentences.zh: 醫院提供病患簡單但健康的營養餐點。

sentences.en: Where do these birds find nourishment in winter?
sentences.zh: 這些鳥在冬天去哪裡找食物吃？

sentences.en: The kids need more than snacks for proper nourishment.
sentences.zh: 孩子們需要的不只是零食，才能攝取足夠的營養。

sentences.en: Good teachers nurture a love of reading.
sentences.zh: 好老師會培養孩子對閱讀的熱愛。

sentences.en: How do you nurture young talent in your team?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼在團隊裡培育年輕人才？

sentences.en: She nurtured three children while working full time.
sentences.zh: 她一邊全職工作，一邊養育三個孩子。

sentences.en: Our company aims to nurture future leaders.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的目標是培育未來的領導人才。

sentences.en: Can a small garden nurture a sense of patience?
sentences.zh: 小花園能培養耐心嗎？

sentences.en: The coach worked hard to nurture the team's confidence.
sentences.zh: 教練努力培養球隊的信心。

gloss_note: an oasis of calm 鬧中取靜處

sentences.en: The travelers finally reached an oasis in the desert.
sentences.zh: 旅人終於抵達沙漠中的一片綠洲。

sentences.en: Palm trees and fresh water make an oasis.
sentences.zh: 棕櫚樹和清水構成了一片綠洲。

sentences.en: Our backyard is a quiet oasis after a long day.
sentences.zh: 忙了一天後，我們的後院是個清幽的休憩之處。

sentences.en: Is there an oasis anywhere near this desert road?
sentences.zh: 這條沙漠公路附近有綠洲嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel pool was a cool oasis in the summer heat.
sentences.zh: 飯店的泳池是炎夏裡的一處清涼綠洲。

sentences.en: Can a tiny park be an oasis in a busy city?
sentences.zh: 小小的公園能成為繁忙都市裡的一片綠洲嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want oats or cereal for breakfast?
sentences.zh: 你早餐想吃燕麥還是穀片？

sentences.en: Oats are full of fiber and keep you full.
sentences.zh: 燕麥富含纖維，吃了很有飽足感。

sentences.en: I add oats to my cookie dough.
sentences.zh: 我會在餅乾麵團裡加燕麥。

sentences.en: Are these oat cookies made with real raisins?
sentences.zh: 這些燕麥餅乾是用真的葡萄乾做的嗎？

sentences.en: The farmer grows oats on the hill behind his barn.
sentences.zh: 農夫在穀倉後面的山坡上種燕麥。

sentences.en: We soak the oats overnight before cooking them.
sentences.zh: 我們煮之前會把燕麥泡一整晚。

sentences.en: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 證人宣誓會說實話。

sentences.en: Did you take an oath when you became a citizen?
sentences.zh: 你成為公民時有宣誓嗎？

sentences.en: He broke his oath and lost everyone's trust.
sentences.zh: 他違背誓言，失去所有人的信任。

sentences.en: Doctors take an oath to help their patients.
sentences.zh: 醫師宣誓要幫助病患。

sentences.en: Why did the knight break his oath to the king?
sentences.zh: 騎士為什麼違背對國王的誓言？

sentences.en: She kept her oath to her father and finished school.
sentences.zh: 她信守對父親的誓言，完成了學業。

sentences.en: I eat a bowl of oatmeal every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都吃一碗燕麥粥。

sentences.en: Would you like brown sugar on your oatmeal?
sentences.zh: 你的燕麥粥要加黑糖嗎？

sentences.en: Add some oatmeal and nuts to the yogurt.
sentences.zh: 在優格裡加點燕麥片和堅果。

sentences.en: Is oatmeal really better for you than sugary cereal?
sentences.zh: 燕麥粥真的比含糖穀片更健康嗎？

sentences.en: The diner serves oatmeal with fresh berries.
sentences.zh: 這家簡餐店的燕麥粥配了新鮮莓果。

sentences.en: The oatmeal got thick, so I added more milk.
sentences.zh: 燕麥粥變得太稠，所以我多加了些牛奶。

gloss_note: be obligated to do 有義務做

sentences.en: Employees are obligated to report safety problems.
sentences.zh: 員工有義務通報安全問題。

sentences.en: Are we obligated to attend the training session?
sentences.zh: 我們有義務參加這場訓練課程嗎？

sentences.en: The contract obligates both sides to give thirty days' notice.
sentences.zh: 合約規定雙方都有義務提前三十天通知。

sentences.en: I felt obligated to help after she lent me money.
sentences.zh: 她借了我錢之後，我覺得有義務幫忙。

sentences.en: Is the store obligated to refund a damaged item?
sentences.zh: 商店有義務為受損商品退款嗎？

sentences.en: This agreement does not obligate you to buy anything.
sentences.zh: 這份協議不會要求你一定要購買任何東西。

sentences.en: Don't obsess over one small mistake.
sentences.zh: 別為了一個小錯誤鑽牛角尖。

sentences.en: Why do you obsess about what people think?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼在意別人怎麼想？

sentences.en: My roommate is obsessed with baking shows.
sentences.zh: 我室友迷上了烘焙節目。

sentences.en: Some students obsess over grades and forget to rest.
sentences.zh: 有些學生過度在意成績而忘了休息。

sentences.en: Do you obsess over your cell phone battery level?
sentences.zh: 你會一直盯著手機電量嗎？

sentences.en: Tom started to obsess about his health after turning forty.
sentences.zh: 湯姆滿四十歲後開始過度在意自己的健康。

sentences.en: My grandfather is too obstinate to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺太固執，不肯去看醫生。

sentences.en: Why are you so obstinate about this small detail?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對這個小細節這麼固執？

sentences.en: The obstinate child refused to eat any vegetables.
sentences.zh: 那個固執的孩子拒絕吃任何蔬菜。

sentences.en: An obstinate manager can slow down the whole team.
sentences.zh: 固執的主管會拖慢整個團隊。

sentences.en: Is he always this obstinate when he disagrees?
sentences.zh: 他意見不同時總是這麼固執嗎？

sentences.en: The obstinate donkey would not move an inch.
sentences.zh: 那頭固執的驢子一步也不肯動。

sentences.en: Have you ever eaten grilled octopus?
sentences.zh: 你吃過烤章魚嗎？

sentences.en: An octopus has eight arms and three hearts.
sentences.zh: 章魚有八條腕足和三顆心臟。

sentences.en: The octopus changed color to hide on the rocks.
sentences.zh: 章魚變換顏色，躲在岩石上。

sentences.en: We saw a huge octopus at the aquarium.
sentences.zh: 我們在水族館看到一隻巨大的章魚。

sentences.en: Is the octopus salad on the menu spicy?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的章魚沙拉會辣嗎？

sentences.en: The chef boiled the octopus until it was tender.
sentences.zh: 主廚把章魚煮到軟嫩。

gloss_note: 美式拼法 odor（英式 odour）

sentences.en: There's a strange odor coming from the fridge.
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡傳來一股怪味。

sentences.en: How can I get rid of the odor in my shoes?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼除掉鞋子裡的異味？

sentences.en: This soap has no odor at all.
sentences.zh: 這塊肥皂完全沒有味道。

sentences.en: The hotel room had a smoky odor.
sentences.zh: 那間飯店房間有股菸味。

sentences.en: Does baking soda really remove odors?
sentences.zh: 小蘇打真的能去除異味嗎？

sentences.en: Dogs can pick up an odor from far away.
sentences.zh: 狗能從很遠的地方聞到氣味。

sentences.en: The king oppressed his people with heavy taxes.
sentences.zh: 國王用沉重的稅賦壓迫人民。

sentences.en: Why did the ruler oppress the farmers so cruelly?
sentences.zh: 統治者為什麼如此殘酷地壓迫農民？

sentences.en: The movie shows how a cruel lord oppresses a small village.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描述殘酷的領主如何壓迫一個小村莊。

sentences.en: No one should oppress others because of their background.
sentences.zh: 沒有人應該因為別人的出身而壓迫他們。

sentences.en: Did the old law oppress workers in the factories?
sentences.zh: 那條舊法律壓迫了工廠裡的工人嗎？

sentences.en: The workers felt oppressed by long hours and low pay.
sentences.zh: 工人們被長工時和低薪壓得喘不過氣。

gloss_note: 不可數；escape oppression 逃離壓迫

sentences.en: The novel tells a story about fighting oppression.
sentences.zh: 這部小說講述對抗壓迫的故事。

sentences.en: People left the country to escape oppression.
sentences.zh: 人們離開這個國家以逃離壓迫。

sentences.en: Did the villagers live under years of oppression?
sentences.zh: 村民們是否生活在多年的壓迫之下？

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to write about oppression in history.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於歷史上壓迫的報告。

sentences.en: Can art help people cope with oppression?
sentences.zh: 藝術能幫助人們面對壓迫嗎？

sentences.en: The film shows a family's life under oppression.
sentences.zh: 這部電影呈現一個家庭在壓迫下的生活。

gloss_note: go through an ordeal 熬過煎熬

sentences.en: Getting through the storm was a terrible ordeal.
sentences.zh: 熬過那場暴風雨是一段可怕的煎熬。

sentences.en: Was the long flight an ordeal for the baby?
sentences.zh: 這趟長途飛行對寶寶來說是種折磨嗎？

sentences.en: The hikers survived a three-day ordeal in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 登山客在山裡熬過了三天的艱難考驗。

sentences.en: Taking the driving test was an ordeal for me.
sentences.zh: 考駕照對我來說是一場煎熬。

sentences.en: How did she get through such an ordeal?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼熬過這麼艱難的考驗的？

sentences.en: Moving to a new school was a real ordeal for Emma.
sentences.zh: 搬到新學校對艾瑪來說真是一大考驗。

gloss_note: in an orderly manner 有秩序地

sentences.en: She keeps her desk neat and orderly.
sentences.zh: 她把書桌整理得整齊有序。

sentences.en: The students left the room in an orderly line.
sentences.zh: 學生們排成整齊的隊伍離開教室。

sentences.en: Is the warehouse always this orderly?
sentences.zh: 倉庫總是這麼井然有序嗎？

sentences.en: Please stay orderly during the fire drill.
sentences.zh: 防火演習時請保持秩序。

sentences.en: How did the crowd stay so orderly after the game?
sentences.zh: 球賽結束後，群眾怎麼能這麼井然有序？

sentences.en: The orderly kitchen makes cooking much easier.
sentences.zh: 整齊有序的廚房讓做菜輕鬆許多。

sentences.en: We hung a glass ornament on the Christmas tree.
sentences.zh: 我們在聖誕樹上掛了一個玻璃裝飾品。

sentences.en: Do you want to buy a new ornament this year?
sentences.zh: 今年你想買新的裝飾品嗎？

sentences.en: This silver ornament belonged to my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 這個銀製裝飾品是我奶奶留下來的。

sentences.en: The kids made paper ornaments in art class.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在美術課做了紙裝飾品。

sentences.en: Where did you put the box of ornaments?
sentences.zh: 你把那箱裝飾品放哪了？

sentences.en: The shop sells ornaments from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售來自世界各地的裝飾品。

sentences.en: The old orphanage was turned into a library.
sentences.zh: 那間舊孤兒院被改建成圖書館。

sentences.en: Volunteers visit the orphanage every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 志工每個星期六都會去孤兒院。

sentences.en: Did the movie take place in an orphanage?
sentences.zh: 這部電影是以孤兒院為背景嗎？

sentences.en: She grew up in an orphanage but became a teacher.
sentences.zh: 她在孤兒院長大，後來成為老師。

sentences.en: Our class collected toys for the local orphanage.
sentences.zh: 我們班為當地的孤兒院募集玩具。

sentences.en: How many children live in this orphanage?
sentences.zh: 這間孤兒院裡住了多少孩子？

sentences.en: The doctor prefers orthodox methods over new ones.
sentences.zh: 這位醫師偏好傳統的療法，而不是新方法。

sentences.en: Is this an orthodox way to solve the problem?
sentences.zh: 這是解決問題的正統方法嗎？

sentences.en: Her teaching style is far from orthodox.
sentences.zh: 她的教學風格一點也不傳統。

sentences.en: Our boss rejected the orthodox approach to marketing.
sentences.zh: 老闆否決了傳統的行銷做法。

sentences.en: Our professor taught the orthodox view of how the economy works.
sentences.zh: 教授講授的是關於經濟如何運作的正統觀點。

sentences.en: Why do some artists avoid orthodox styles?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些藝術家避開傳統的風格？

sentences.en: A power outage shut down the whole office.
sentences.zh: 一場停電讓整間辦公室停擺。

sentences.en: When will the internet outage be fixed?
sentences.zh: 網路中斷什麼時候會修好？

sentences.en: The storm caused a long outage in our area.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨使我們這一區停電了很久。

sentences.en: Did you get an email about the system outage?
sentences.zh: 你有收到系統中斷的電子郵件嗎？

sentences.en: We lost an hour of work during the outage.
sentences.zh: 停電期間我們損失了一小時的工作時間。

sentences.en: The company apologized for yesterday's outage.
sentences.zh: 公司為昨天的服務中斷道歉。

gloss_note: 常稱 the Outback，指澳洲內陸

sentences.en: We drove through the Australian outback for three days.
sentences.zh: 我們開車穿越澳洲內陸荒野三天。

sentences.en: Have you ever camped in the outback?
sentences.zh: 你曾在內陸荒野露營過嗎？

sentences.en: The documentary shows animals living in the outback.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片介紹住在澳洲內陸荒野的動物。

sentences.en: Summers in the outback are hot and very dry.
sentences.zh: 內陸荒野的夏天炎熱又非常乾燥。

sentences.en: Is it safe to travel alone in the outback?
sentences.zh: 一個人在內陸荒野旅行安全嗎？

sentences.en: My friend Tom grew up on a sheep farm in the outback.
sentences.zh: 我朋友湯姆在內陸荒野的一座牧羊場長大。

sentences.en: Our company outing is next Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的員工旅遊在下週五。

sentences.en: Are you coming on the class outing tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天會參加班級郊遊嗎？

sentences.en: We planned a family outing to the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們計畫了一趟全家去湖邊的出遊。

sentences.en: The rain ruined our outing to the beach.
sentences.zh: 這場雨毀了我們的海邊出遊。

sentences.en: Where should we go for a weekend outing?
sentences.zh: 週末我們該去哪裡走走？

sentences.en: The senior center offers a bus outing once a month.
sentences.zh: 長者中心每個月安排一次巴士出遊。

sentences.en: The city plans to outlaw plastic bags next year.
sentences.zh: 市府計畫明年明令禁用塑膠袋。

sentences.en: Should lawmakers outlaw texting while driving?
sentences.zh: 立法者應該明令禁止開車時傳訊息嗎？

sentences.en: The outlaw rode away on his horse before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 亡命之徒在日出前騎馬逃走了。

sentences.en: Many old Western movies feature a famous outlaw.
sentences.zh: 許多老西部片都有個知名的亡命之徒。

sentences.en: Did the state outlaw smoking in restaurants?
sentences.zh: 州政府是否明令禁止在餐廳吸菸？

sentences.en: In the story, the sheriff chases an outlaw across the desert.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，警長穿越沙漠追捕一名亡命之徒。

gloss_note: outnumber sb 人數多於某人

sentences.en: Girls outnumber boys in my chemistry class.
sentences.zh: 我的化學課上女生人數比男生多。

sentences.en: Do cars now outnumber bikes on this street?
sentences.zh: 現在這條街上汽車比腳踏車多嗎？

sentences.en: The tourists outnumber the locals in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天遊客的人數比當地人多。

sentences.en: Our customers outnumbered the staff three to one.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧客人數是員工的三倍。

sentences.en: Do the positive reviews outnumber the negative ones?
sentences.zh: 好評比差評多嗎？

sentences.en: Our team was outnumbered, so we lost the match.
sentences.zh: 我們隊的人數比對手少，所以輸了比賽。

gloss_note: new outpost 新分店（美國餐飲報導）

sentences.en: The famous bakery just opened a new outpost downtown.
sentences.zh: 這家知名烘焙坊剛在市中心開了新分店。

sentences.en: Will the bakery open another outpost near the airport?
sentences.zh: 這家烘焙坊會在機場附近再開一家分店嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant's second outpost opens next month.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的第二家分店下個月開幕。

sentences.en: A tiny outpost of the pizza shop appeared by the station.
sentences.zh: 車站旁出現了這家披薩店的小分店。

sentences.en: Soldiers built an outpost on the hill.
sentences.zh: 士兵們在山丘上建了一座前哨據點。

sentences.en: Did the owner choose the mall for her next outpost?
sentences.zh: 老闆選了購物中心做她的下一家分店嗎？

sentences.en: The price of this coffee is outrageous.
sentences.zh: 這杯咖啡的價格太離譜了。

sentences.en: Why are the hotel fees so outrageous?
sentences.zh: 為什麼飯店費用這麼離譜？

sentences.en: His outrageous behavior shocked the whole class.
sentences.zh: 他離譜的行為嚇到了全班。

sentences.en: That's an outrageous excuse for being late.
sentences.zh: 那是個遲到的離譜藉口。

sentences.en: Isn't it outrageous that the flight was canceled again?
sentences.zh: 班機又被取消，這不是很令人憤慨嗎？

sentences.en: The news report called the new rule outrageous.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導稱這項新規定令人憤慨。

sentences.en: I told you at the outset that it would be hard.
sentences.zh: 我一開始就告訴過你這會很難。

sentences.en: Let's set clear goals at the outset of the project.
sentences.zh: 讓我們在專案一開始就訂好明確的目標。

sentences.en: Did you know about the extra fees from the outset?
sentences.zh: 你一開始就知道有額外費用嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher explained the rules at the outset.
sentences.zh: 老師一開始就說明了規則。

sentences.en: From the outset, the team worked well together.
sentences.zh: 從一開始，這個團隊就合作得很好。

sentences.en: Why didn't you mention the problem at the outset?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼一開始沒提到這個問題？

gloss_note: 常用複數：on the outskirts of

sentences.en: We live on the outskirts of the city.
sentences.zh: 我們住在城市的郊區。

sentences.en: Is the airport on the outskirts of town?
sentences.zh: 機場在市郊嗎？

sentences.en: The new factory will be built on the outskirts.
sentences.zh: 新工廠會蓋在郊區。

sentences.en: Rent is much cheaper on the outskirts than downtown.
sentences.zh: 郊區的房租比市中心便宜多了。

sentences.en: Do many workers commute from the outskirts every day?
sentences.zh: 很多員工每天從郊區通勤嗎？

sentences.en: We found a quiet cafe on the outskirts of the village.
sentences.zh: 我們在村莊外圍找到一間安靜的咖啡店。

sentences.en: Her calm outward appearance hid her fear.
sentences.zh: 她平靜的外表掩藏了她的恐懼。

sentences.en: Is there any outward sign of damage on the box?
sentences.zh: 箱子外表有任何受損的跡象嗎？

sentences.en: He showed no outward sign of being nervous.
sentences.zh: 他沒有顯露出任何緊張的跡象。

sentences.en: The new model has few outward changes from last year's.
sentences.zh: 新款的外觀和去年那款相比幾乎沒什麼改變。

sentences.en: Do you notice any outward change in the patient?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到病人外表有什麼變化嗎？

sentences.en: Judging people by their outward looks alone is unfair.
sentences.zh: 光憑外表來評斷一個人是不公平的。

sentences.en: The train was overcrowded during the morning rush.
sentences.zh: 早上尖峰時段列車擠得水洩不通。

sentences.en: Don't overcrowd the pan, or the food won't brown.
sentences.zh: 別把鍋子塞太滿，不然食物不會上色。

sentences.en: Is the waiting room overcrowded again today?
sentences.zh: 今天候診室又擠滿人了嗎？

sentences.en: Selling too many tickets can overcrowd the hall.
sentences.zh: 票賣太多會讓會場過度擁擠。

sentences.en: The hotel was overcrowded because of the big convention.
sentences.zh: 因為舉辦大型會議，飯店人滿為患。

sentences.en: How can we keep the store from getting overcrowded on sale days?
sentences.zh: 特價日我們要怎麼避免商店擠爆？

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: Don't overdo it. 別太勉強

sentences.en: Did you overdo it at the gym yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天在健身房是不是練過頭了？

sentences.en: I think I overdid the salt in this soup.
sentences.zh: 我想我這鍋湯鹽放過頭了。

sentences.en: Why did they overdo the decorations for such a small party?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這麼小的派對，他們卻裝飾得這麼誇張？

sentences.en: The actor tends to overdo every emotional scene.
sentences.zh: 那位演員每場情緒戲都容易演過頭。

sentences.en: Be careful not to overdo the cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 小心不要用太多清潔用品。

sentences.en: Take it easy and don't overdo it, Dad.
sentences.zh: 爸，慢慢來，別太勉強。

sentences.en: The bathtub is about to overflow!
sentences.zh: 浴缸快要溢出來了！

sentences.en: Did the river overflow after the heavy rain?
sentences.zh: 豪雨過後河水有溢出來嗎？

sentences.en: The trash can began to overflow with paper cups.
sentences.zh: 垃圾桶裡的紙杯滿了出來。

sentences.en: Don't fill the glass so full that it will overflow.
sentences.zh: 杯子別倒太滿，會溢出來的。

sentences.en: The crowd overflowed into the street outside the hall.
sentences.zh: 人群滿到了會場外的街上。

sentences.en: Why does the sink always overflow when I wash dishes?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我洗碗時水槽總是會滿出來？

gloss_note: overhear sb 無意間聽到某人說話

sentences.en: I overheard two people talking about the sale.
sentences.zh: 我無意中聽到兩個人在聊特價的事。

sentences.en: Did you overhear what they said in the meeting room?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有無意間聽到他們在會議室說了什麼？

sentences.en: I didn't mean to overhear your phone call.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要偷聽你講電話的。

sentences.en: Kids can overhear more than parents expect.
sentences.zh: 孩子聽到的比父母預期的還多。

sentences.en: She overheard her name and turned around.
sentences.zh: 她無意中聽見有人叫她的名字，便轉過身。

sentences.en: Can customers overhear the staff in the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 客人聽得到廚房裡員工說的話嗎？

gloss_note: overpay for sth 為某物多花錢

sentences.en: I think we overpaid for the repairs.
sentences.zh: 我覺得我們修理費付太多了。

sentences.en: Did the company overpay you last month?
sentences.zh: 公司上個月是不是多付了你薪水？

sentences.en: Compare prices so you don't overpay for tickets.
sentences.zh: 先比價，才不會多花冤枉錢買票。

sentences.en: The power company will refund anything you overpay on your bill.
sentences.zh: 你帳單上多付的任何金額，電力公司都會退還。

sentences.en: How do I know I'm not overpaying for this hotel room?
sentences.zh: 我怎麼知道這間飯店房間的價格沒有付太多？

sentences.en: They overpaid the supplier by mistake, so accounting asked for the money back.
sentences.zh: 他們誤付供應商太多錢，會計部門要求把錢追回來。

sentences.en: Don't overwork yourself, or you'll get sick.
sentences.zh: 別累壞自己，否則你會生病。

sentences.en: Many nurses suffer from overwork these days.
sentences.zh: 現在許多護理師深受過勞所苦。

sentences.en: Is the team overworked because of the new deadline?
sentences.zh: 因為新的截止日，團隊是不是被操過頭了？

sentences.en: Years of overwork led to his health problems.
sentences.zh: 長年過勞導致他出現健康問題。

sentences.en: Why do you overwork yourself on weekends?
sentences.zh: 為什麼你連週末都把自己操得這麼累？

sentences.en: My boss doesn't want to overwork the new staff.
sentences.zh: 我老闆不想讓新進員工工作過度。

sentences.en: The ozone layer protects us from strong sunlight.
sentences.zh: 臭氧層保護我們免受強烈陽光的傷害。

sentences.en: What happens when the ozone layer gets thinner?
sentences.zh: 臭氧層變薄會發生什麼事？

sentences.en: Scientists found a hole in the ozone layer.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現臭氧層有個破洞。

sentences.en: Can we do anything to help protect the ozone layer?
sentences.zh: 我們能做些什麼來保護臭氧層嗎？

sentences.en: Ground-level ozone can make the air unhealthy to breathe.
sentences.zh: 地表臭氧會讓空氣變得不利於呼吸。

sentences.en: Our teacher showed a chart of ozone levels over time.
sentences.zh: 老師展示了一張臭氧濃度隨時間變化的圖表。

gloss_note: paddle a canoe 划獨木舟

sentences.en: Can you hand me that paddle before we leave the dock?
sentences.zh: 你可以在我們離開碼頭前把那支槳遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: We paddle across the lake every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 我們每個週日早上都划船過湖。

sentences.en: Do you know how to paddle a canoe?
sentences.zh: 你會划獨木舟嗎？

sentences.en: She dropped her paddle into the water and laughed.
sentences.zh: 她把槳掉進水裡，然後笑了起來。

sentences.en: You just paddle slowly and enjoy the quiet river.
sentences.zh: 你只要慢慢地划，好好享受寧靜的河面就好。

sentences.en: Are the paddles at the rental shop made of wood?
sentences.zh: 租借店裡的槳是木頭做的嗎？

gloss_note: hand out a pamphlet 發小冊子

sentences.en: Please take a pamphlet on your way out.
sentences.zh: 離開時請順手拿一本小冊子。

sentences.en: Did you read the pamphlet about the new health insurance plan?
sentences.zh: 你看過那本新健康保險方案的小冊子了嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel left a pamphlet of local tours in my room.
sentences.zh: 飯店在我房間裡放了一本當地旅遊的小冊子。

sentences.en: Could you print two hundred pamphlets for the trade show?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫商展印兩百本小冊子嗎？

sentences.en: This pamphlet explains how to recycle old batteries.
sentences.zh: 這本小冊子說明如何回收舊電池。

sentences.en: Our team designed a short pamphlet for new customers.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊替新客戶設計了一本簡短的小冊子。

gloss_note: law firm paralegal 律師事務所助理

sentences.en: Emily works as a paralegal at a small law firm.
sentences.zh: 艾蜜莉在一家小型律師事務所擔任法務助理。

sentences.en: Could you ask the paralegal to send me the contract?
sentences.zh: 你可以請法務助理把合約寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: A paralegal helps lawyers prepare documents and research cases.
sentences.zh: 法務助理協助律師準備文件並研究案件。

sentences.en: Is Anna a paralegal or a licensed lawyer?
sentences.zh: 安娜是法務助理，還是有執照的律師？

sentences.en: The paralegal checked every page before the client meeting.
sentences.zh: 客戶會議前，法務助理把每一頁都檢查過了。

sentences.en: He studied for two years to become a paralegal.
sentences.zh: 他讀了兩年書，才成為法務助理。

gloss_note: paralyzed by fear 嚇得動彈不得

sentences.en: A heavy snowstorm can paralyze the whole city's traffic.
sentences.zh: 一場大暴風雪就能讓整座城市的交通癱瘓。

sentences.en: Did the storm paralyze the bus system this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上暴風雨讓公車系統癱瘓了嗎？

sentences.en: Fear can paralyze you right before a big speech.
sentences.zh: 在重要演講前，恐懼可能讓你動彈不得。

sentences.en: Why does stage fright paralyze some people?
sentences.zh: 為什麼怯場會讓有些人動彈不得？

sentences.en: A computer virus paralyzed the airline's website for hours.
sentences.zh: 一種電腦病毒讓航空公司的網站癱瘓了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: She stood paralyzed with fear when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 燈一熄滅，她就嚇得動彈不得。

sentences.en: We ordered croissants at a small Parisian café.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家小小的巴黎式咖啡館點了可頌。

sentences.en: Is this bistro known for its Parisian style of cooking?
sentences.zh: 這家小餐館以巴黎風格的料理聞名嗎？

sentences.en: The chef learned Parisian baking techniques in France.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚在法國學到了巴黎式的烘焙技巧。

sentences.en: Would you like the Parisian ham sandwich or the salad?
sentences.zh: 你想點巴黎火腿三明治，還是沙拉？

sentences.en: She dreams of a Parisian vacation with museums and fresh bread.
sentences.zh: 她夢想來一趟有博物館和新鮮麵包的巴黎假期。

sentences.en: The bakery's window looks very Parisian in the morning light.
sentences.zh: 晨光下，這家麵包店的櫥窗看起來很有巴黎風情。

gloss_note: ice cream parlor 冰淇淋店

sentences.en: Let's stop at the ice cream parlor after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們去冰淇淋店吧。

sentences.en: Does the pizza parlor on Fifth Street deliver after ten?
sentences.zh: 第五街那家披薩店十點後還送餐嗎？

sentences.en: Grandpa took us to a frozen yogurt parlor for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 爺爺帶我們去優格冰店慶祝我的生日。

sentences.en: I got a part-time job at the ice cream parlor.
sentences.zh: 我在那家冰淇淋店找到了一份兼職工作。

sentences.en: The parlor was packed with kids after the soccer game.
sentences.zh: 足球賽後，那家店裡擠滿了孩子。

sentences.en: What new flavors did the parlor add this summer?
sentences.zh: 那家店今年夏天新增了哪些口味？

sentences.en: Reading is my favorite pastime on rainy days.
sentences.zh: 下雨天，閱讀是我最愛的消遣。

sentences.en: Is fishing still a popular pastime in your town?
sentences.zh: 釣魚在你們鎮上還是很受歡迎的消遣嗎？

sentences.en: Baseball is often called America's national pastime.
sentences.zh: 棒球常被稱為美國的國民消遣。

sentences.en: What's your favorite pastime when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 不工作的時候，你最愛的消遣是什麼？

sentences.en: Gardening became a relaxing pastime for my grandfather.
sentences.zh: 園藝成了我爺爺放鬆身心的消遣。

sentences.en: Playing board games is a cheap pastime for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 玩桌遊是全家人都能享受的平價消遣。

gloss_note: pastrami on rye 裸麥五香牛肉三明治

sentences.en: I'll have a pastrami sandwich on rye, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一份裸麥麵包的五香燻牛肉三明治，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Does the pastrami come with pickles on the side?
sentences.zh: 這份五香燻牛肉會附醃黃瓜嗎？

sentences.en: The deli slices its pastrami thin and piles it high.
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店把五香燻牛肉切得很薄，再堆得高高的。

sentences.en: How long do you smoke the pastrami before serving it?
sentences.zh: 你們的五香燻牛肉上桌前要燻多久？

sentences.en: My dad packs pastrami and mustard in his lunch box.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸的便當裡常放五香燻牛肉和芥末醬。

sentences.en: Hot pastrami smells wonderful when it's fresh from the steamer.
sentences.zh: 剛從蒸鍋拿出來的熱五香燻牛肉聞起來好香。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: a true patriot 真正的愛國者

sentences.en: The museum has a statue honoring a famous patriot.
sentences.zh: 博物館裡有一座紀念知名愛國志士的雕像。

sentences.en: Was he a patriot who loved his country deeply?
sentences.zh: 他是個深愛自己國家的愛國者嗎？

sentences.en: On the Fourth of July, Grandpa waves a flag like a true patriot.
sentences.zh: 美國獨立紀念日那天，爺爺像個真正的愛國者一樣揮舞著旗子。

sentences.en: The movie tells the story of a young patriot during the war.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講述一位年輕愛國者在戰時的故事。

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to write about a patriot we admire.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫一位我們欽佩的愛國者。

sentences.en: Can you name a patriot from your country's history?
sentences.zh: 你說得出你們國家歷史上的一位愛國志士嗎？

sentences.en: The crowd sang a patriotic song at the parade.
sentences.zh: 群眾在遊行中唱了一首愛國歌曲。

sentences.en: Do you feel patriotic on national holidays?
sentences.zh: 你在國定假日會覺得特別有愛國情懷嗎？

sentences.en: The kids made patriotic posters for Independence Day.
sentences.zh: 孩子們為獨立紀念日做了愛國海報。

sentences.en: Is that old patriotic movie still worth watching?
sentences.zh: 那部老愛國電影還值得一看嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor flies a flag every day because he feels patriotic.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居每天都掛著國旗，因為他很有愛國情操。

sentences.en: The town hall held a patriotic concert last weekend.
sentences.zh: 市政廳上週末舉辦了一場愛國音樂會。

gloss_note: proud as a peacock 得意洋洋

sentences.en: The peacock spread its colorful tail for the visitors.
sentences.zh: 孔雀對遊客展開了牠色彩繽紛的尾羽。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a peacock up close?
sentences.zh: 你曾經近距離看過孔雀嗎？

sentences.en: A peacock strutted across the lawn at the park.
sentences.zh: 一隻孔雀在公園的草地上昂首闊步。

sentences.en: Why does the male peacock have such long feathers?
sentences.zh: 為什麼雄孔雀有那麼長的羽毛？

sentences.en: My little brother was as proud as a peacock after his win.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟贏了之後，得意得像隻孔雀。

sentences.en: We heard a loud peacock call outside our cabin.
sentences.zh: 我們在小木屋外聽到孔雀響亮的叫聲。

sentences.en: I found a smooth pebble on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我在海灘上撿到一顆光滑的小石子。

sentences.en: Is there a pebble in your shoe?
sentences.zh: 你的鞋子裡有小石子嗎？

sentences.en: The children skipped a pebble across the quiet pond.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把一顆小石子在平靜的池塘上打水漂。

sentences.en: Dad covered the garden path with white pebbles.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在花園小徑上鋪了白色的小石子。

sentences.en: Do these pebbles come with the aquarium kit?
sentences.zh: 這些小石子是水族箱組合附贈的嗎？

sentences.en: The stream was clear, with pebbles shining at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 溪水很清澈，水底的小石子閃閃發亮。

gloss_note: take a peek at 瞄一眼

sentences.en: Don't peek until I say you can open your eyes.
sentences.zh: 我說可以睜開眼睛之前，不准偷看。

sentences.en: Can I take a peek at your notes?
sentences.zh: 我可以瞄一眼你的筆記嗎？

sentences.en: She peeked through the curtains to see who was outside.
sentences.zh: 她從窗簾縫偷看外面是誰。

sentences.en: Did you peek at your birthday present early?
sentences.zh: 你有提早偷看你的生日禮物嗎？

sentences.en: The kitten peeked out from under the sofa.
sentences.zh: 小貓從沙發底下探出頭來偷看。

sentences.en: Let me have a quick peek at the new design.
sentences.zh: 讓我先快速瞄一眼新的設計。

gloss_note: penalize for lateness 遲到處罰

sentences.en: The contract will penalize us for late delivery.
sentences.zh: 合約規定我們延遲交貨會被罰款。

sentences.en: Does the company penalize employees who arrive late?
sentences.zh: 公司會處罰遲到的員工嗎？

sentences.en: The school may penalize students who copy others' work.
sentences.zh: 學校可能會處罰抄襲別人作業的學生。

sentences.en: Is it fair to penalize customers for returning items?
sentences.zh: 因為客人退貨就向他們收罰款，公平嗎？

sentences.en: Airlines penalize passengers who change tickets at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 航空公司會對臨時更改機票的乘客收取罰款。

sentences.en: Our supplier was penalized for missing the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我們的供應商因為錯過期限而被處罰。

sentences.en: Florida is a long peninsula in the southeastern United States.
sentences.zh: 佛羅里達是美國東南部一個狹長的半島。

sentences.en: Is Italy a peninsula or an island?
sentences.zh: 義大利是半島還是島嶼？

sentences.en: We drove around the peninsula and stopped at a lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 我們開車環繞半島，還在一座燈塔停了一下。

sentences.en: Water surrounds the peninsula on three sides.
sentences.zh: 這座半島三面環水。

sentences.en: Which peninsula has the best beaches in this state?
sentences.zh: 這個州哪一個半島的海灘最棒？

sentences.en: Our geography teacher drew a peninsula on the board.
sentences.zh: 我們的地理老師在黑板上畫了一個半島。

sentences.en: Could I get a cup of peppermint tea, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一杯薄荷茶嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter handed us peppermints with the check.
sentences.zh: 服務生隨帳單附上了薄荷糖。

sentences.en: Do you want peppermint ice cream or chocolate?
sentences.zh: 你要薄荷冰淇淋還是巧克力？

sentences.en: Mom bakes peppermint cookies every December.
sentences.zh: 媽媽每年十二月都會烤薄荷餅乾。

sentences.en: Peppermint helps settle my stomach after a heavy meal.
sentences.zh: 吃得很飽之後，薄荷能讓我的胃舒服些。

sentences.en: Is there any peppermint in this hot chocolate?
sentences.zh: 這杯熱可可裡有加薄荷嗎？

sentences.en: A small bird perched on the fence outside my window.
sentences.zh: 一隻小鳥停在我窗外的籬笆上。

sentences.en: Why do pigeons perch on the statue every morning?
sentences.zh: 為什麼鴿子每天早上都停在那座雕像上？

sentences.en: She perched on the edge of the desk during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會時，她坐在桌子邊緣。

sentences.en: Do you mind if I perch on this stool?
sentences.zh: 你介意我坐在這張高腳凳上嗎？

sentences.en: The cabin is perched high on a hill above the lake.
sentences.zh: 那間小木屋坐落在湖上方的山丘高處。

sentences.en: Owls often perch quietly in tall trees at night.
sentences.zh: 貓頭鷹晚上常靜靜地棲息在高大的樹上。

gloss_note: at your peril 自負風險

sentences.en: Hikers ignore the weather at their own peril.
sentences.zh: 登山客無視天氣就得自負風險。

sentences.en: Are the rescue teams aware of the peril in the mountains?
sentences.zh: 救難隊知道山區裡的危險嗎？

sentences.en: The captain warned the crew about the peril ahead.
sentences.zh: 船長警告船員前方有危險。

sentences.en: The movie shows a family in great peril on a stormy sea.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描述一家人在暴風雨的海上身陷險境。

sentences.en: Do tourists understand the peril of swimming in strong currents?
sentences.zh: 遊客了解在強流中游泳的危險嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher said ignoring safety rules puts everyone in peril.
sentences.zh: 老師說無視安全規定會讓每個人陷入危險。

gloss_note: perish the thought 千萬別這麼想

sentences.en: Many ancient civilizations perished long before modern times.
sentences.zh: 許多古文明早在現代之前就已消亡。

sentences.en: Did the dinosaurs perish because of a giant asteroid?
sentences.zh: 恐龍是因為巨大的小行星而滅絕的嗎？

sentences.en: Without water, these plants will perish in the summer heat.
sentences.zh: 沒有水的話，這些植物會在夏天的高溫下枯死。

sentences.en: The explorers feared they would perish in the desert without water.
sentences.zh: 探險家擔心自己會在沒有水的沙漠中喪命。

sentences.en: Will the old customs perish as young people move away?
sentences.zh: 年輕人搬走後，舊習俗會消失嗎？

sentences.en: Why did so many early settlers perish in the first winter?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這麼多早期移民在第一個冬天喪生？

sentences.en: Is it permissible to bring my own snacks into the movie theater?
sentences.zh: 可以把自己的零食帶進電影院嗎？

sentences.en: Eating at your desk is permissible, but keep it clean.
sentences.zh: 在座位上吃東西是允許的，但要保持整潔。

sentences.en: Phones are not permissible during the final exam.
sentences.zh: 期末考期間不准使用手機。

sentences.en: Is a small delay permissible under the contract?
sentences.zh: 合約允許小幅度的延誤嗎？

sentences.en: The rules say a certain amount of noise is permissible.
sentences.zh: 規定上說一定程度的噪音是可以接受的。

sentences.en: Missing class is permissible only with a doctor's note.
sentences.zh: 只有附上醫師證明，缺課才會被允許。

sentences.en: If you persevere, you will pass the driving test.
sentences.zh: 只要你堅持下去，就會通過駕照考試。

sentences.en: How did she persevere through such a long illness?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼撐過那麼長的病痛的？

sentences.en: Athletes must persevere even when training gets difficult.
sentences.zh: 就算訓練變得困難，運動員也必須堅持下去。

sentences.en: Will our team persevere after losing three games in a row?
sentences.zh: 我們隊連輸三場後還能堅持下去嗎？

sentences.en: He persevered with his studies while working nights.
sentences.zh: 他一邊上夜班，一邊堅持完成學業。

sentences.en: Despite many rejections, the author persevered and published her book.
sentences.zh: 儘管被拒絕很多次，這位作家仍堅持不懈，最後出版了她的書。

sentences.en: We tried a Persian restaurant near the university last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚試了大學附近的一家波斯餐廳。

sentences.en: Do you like Persian rice with a crispy bottom?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡底部酥脆的波斯米飯嗎？

sentences.en: The Persian stew was full of herbs and tender lamb.
sentences.zh: 那道波斯燉菜裡有滿滿的香草和軟嫩的羊肉。

sentences.en: Is Persian tea usually served with sugar cubes?
sentences.zh: 波斯茶通常搭配方糖嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighbor cooks Persian dishes for every holiday.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居每逢節日都會做波斯菜。

sentences.en: The bakery sells Persian flatbread fresh from the oven.
sentences.zh: 這家麵包店賣剛出爐的波斯扁麵包。

gloss_note: Persistence pays off. 堅持有回報

sentences.en: Her persistence finally paid off when she got the job.
sentences.zh: 她的堅持終於有了回報，得到了這份工作。

sentences.en: Do you think persistence matters more than talent?
sentences.zh: 你覺得毅力比天分更重要嗎？

sentences.en: Persistence is the key to learning a new language.
sentences.zh: 堅持是學會一種新語言的關鍵。

sentences.en: The salesman's persistence won us over in the end.
sentences.zh: 業務員的鍥而不捨最後說服了我們。

sentences.en: How much persistence does it take to run a marathon?
sentences.zh: 跑一場馬拉松需要多大的毅力？

sentences.en: The coach praised the team's persistence during the long season.
sentences.zh: 教練稱讚球隊在漫長球季中的毅力。

gloss_note: Peruvian ceviche 秘魯檸汁生魚

sentences.en: Peruvian ceviche is made with fresh fish and lime juice.
sentences.zh: 秘魯檸汁生魚是用新鮮魚肉和檸檬汁做成的。

sentences.en: Have you ever eaten at a Peruvian restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你曾經在秘魯餐廳吃過飯嗎？

sentences.en: The Peruvian chicken here comes with green sauce.
sentences.zh: 這裡的秘魯烤雞附有綠色醬汁。

sentences.en: Does this Peruvian coffee taste smoother than the Brazilian one?
sentences.zh: 這款秘魯咖啡喝起來比巴西那款更順口嗎？

sentences.en: We roasted Peruvian purple potatoes for dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們晚餐烤了秘魯紫馬鈴薯。

sentences.en: She bought Peruvian quinoa at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 她在農夫市集買了秘魯藜麥。

gloss_note: pesto pasta 青醬義大利麵

sentences.en: I'd like the pasta with pesto, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點青醬義大利麵，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Does the pesto contain nuts?
sentences.zh: 這青醬含堅果嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh basil, garlic, and olive oil make a simple pesto.
sentences.zh: 新鮮羅勒、大蒜和橄欖油就能做出簡單的青醬。

sentences.en: Could you spread some pesto on my sandwich?
sentences.zh: 你可以在我的三明治上抹一點青醬嗎？

sentences.en: My dad stirs pesto into the soup for extra flavor.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸會在湯裡拌入青醬來增添風味。

sentences.en: The chef blends pesto fresh every morning.
sentences.zh: 主廚每天早上現打青醬。

sentences.en: Petroleum is used to make gasoline and plastic.
sentences.zh: 石油可以用來製造汽油和塑膠。

sentences.en: Which country produces the most petroleum?
sentences.zh: 哪個國家的石油產量最大？

sentences.en: The company imports crude petroleum from overseas.
sentences.zh: 這家公司從海外進口原油。

sentences.en: Do petroleum prices affect the cost of airline tickets?
sentences.zh: 石油價格會影響機票的價格嗎？

sentences.en: Engineers study how to find petroleum deep underground.
sentences.zh: 工程師研究如何找到地底深處的石油。

sentences.en: Scientists want to reduce our dependence on petroleum.
sentences.zh: 科學家希望減少我們對石油的依賴。

gloss_note: a bowl of pho 一碗越南河粉

sentences.en: I'll have a large bowl of beef pho.
sentences.zh: 我要一大碗牛肉河粉。

sentences.en: Does the pho come with fresh herbs on the side?
sentences.zh: 這碗河粉會附新鮮香草嗎？

sentences.en: Pho is perfect when you have a cold.
sentences.zh: 感冒的時候來碗河粉最適合了。

sentences.en: How long does the pho broth simmer?
sentences.zh: 河粉的湯頭要熬多久？

sentences.en: We usually get pho on rainy days.
sentences.zh: 下雨天我們通常會吃河粉。

sentences.en: She added lime and chili to her pho.
sentences.zh: 她在河粉裡加了檸檬和辣椒。

Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: concert pianist 音樂會鋼琴家

sentences.en: The pianist played a quiet song while we ate dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們用餐時，鋼琴手彈著輕柔的曲子。

sentences.en: Is your neighbor a professional pianist?
sentences.zh: 你的鄰居是專業的鋼琴家嗎？

sentences.en: Our school hired a pianist for the spring concert.
sentences.zh: 我們學校請了一位鋼琴家來演出春季音樂會。

sentences.en: Many people say he is the best pianist in town.
sentences.zh: 很多人說他是鎮上最棒的鋼琴家。

sentences.en: Does the choir need a pianist for rehearsal on Friday?
sentences.zh: 合唱團週五排練需要鋼琴伴奏嗎？

sentences.en: She practiced for years to become a concert pianist.
sentences.zh: 她練了好多年，才成為音樂會鋼琴家。

gloss_note: Beware of pickpockets. 小心扒手

sentences.en: Watch out for pickpockets in crowded train stations.
sentences.zh: 在擁擠的火車站要小心扒手。

sentences.en: Did a pickpocket take your wallet on the bus?
sentences.zh: 有扒手在公車上偷了你的皮夾嗎？

sentences.en: The guidebook warns tourists about pickpockets near popular sights.
sentences.zh: 旅遊書提醒遊客在熱門景點附近要提防扒手。

sentences.en: How can I protect my bag from a pickpocket?
sentences.zh: 我該怎麼保護我的包包不被扒手偷走？

sentences.en: A pickpocket was caught on camera at the market.
sentences.zh: 一名扒手在市場被監視器拍到。

sentences.en: The detective in the movie once worked as a pickpocket.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的偵探以前當過扒手。

sentences.en: My son is a picky eater and hates vegetables.
sentences.zh: 我兒子很挑食，討厭吃蔬菜。

sentences.en: Are you always this picky about what you order?
sentences.zh: 你點餐都這麼挑嗎？

sentences.en: Don't be so picky; the soup tastes great.
sentences.zh: 別這麼挑嘴，這碗湯很好喝。

sentences.en: Why is the chef so picky about fresh ingredients?
sentences.zh: 為什麼主廚對食材的新鮮度這麼挑剔？

sentences.en: He's picky about his steak and wants it medium rare.
sentences.zh: 他對牛排很挑，一定要三分熟。

sentences.en: Picky customers often send dishes back to the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 挑剔的客人常把菜退回廚房。

sentences.en: The restaurant serves grilled pike with lemon butter.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應檸檬奶油烤狗魚。

sentences.en: Is pike a freshwater fish or a saltwater fish?
sentences.zh: 狗魚是淡水魚還是海水魚？

sentences.en: Dad caught a huge pike at the lake yesterday.
sentences.zh: 爸爸昨天在湖邊釣到一條大狗魚。

sentences.en: Pike has firm white meat with many small bones.
sentences.zh: 狗魚的肉質結實呈白色，小骨很多。

sentences.en: Would you like your pike fried or baked?
sentences.zh: 你的狗魚要炸的還是烤的？

sentences.en: The fishmonger said the pike was caught this morning.
sentences.zh: 魚販說這條狗魚是今天早上捕的。

gloss_note: the Pilgrims 搭五月花號來美的清教徒

sentences.en: Thousands of pilgrims walk this old road every year.
sentences.zh: 每年有數千名朝聖者走這條古老的道路。

sentences.en: Do you know why the Pilgrims celebrated the first Thanksgiving?
sentences.zh: 你知道清教徒移民為什麼要慶祝第一個感恩節嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter wore a pilgrim costume in the school play.
sentences.zh: 我女兒在學校話劇裡穿了清教徒移民的服裝。

sentences.en: Each pilgrim carried a small bag and a walking stick.
sentences.zh: 每位朝聖者都帶著一個小包和一根手杖。

sentences.en: Are those travelers pilgrims or ordinary tourists?
sentences.zh: 那些旅人是朝聖者，還是一般的觀光客？

sentences.en: In history class, we studied how the Pilgrims built their first village.
sentences.zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到清教徒移民如何建立他們的第一座村莊。

sentences.en: I woke up with a big pimple on my chin.
sentences.zh: 我醒來發現下巴長了一顆大痘痘。

sentences.en: Should I put medicine on this pimple?
sentences.zh: 我該在這顆痘痘上擦藥嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't pop that pimple with dirty hands.
sentences.zh: 拜託不要用髒手去擠那顆痘痘。

sentences.en: Teenagers often get a pimple before school pictures.
sentences.zh: 青少年常常在拍學校照片前冒出痘痘。

sentences.en: Does chocolate really cause pimples?
sentences.zh: 巧克力真的會讓人長痘痘嗎？

sentences.en: The pharmacist recommended a gentle cream for her pimples.
sentences.zh: 藥師推薦她用溫和的乳霜處理痘痘。

gloss_note: a pinch of salt 一小撮鹽

sentences.en: Add a pinch of salt to the sauce.
sentences.zh: 在醬汁裡加一小撮鹽。

sentences.en: Please don't pinch the baby's cheeks at the party.
sentences.zh: 拜託不要在派對上捏寶寶的臉頰。

sentences.en: Did you pinch yourself to see if you were dreaming?
sentences.zh: 你有捏自己一下，看看是不是在做夢嗎？

sentences.en: The recipe calls for a pinch of cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 這份食譜要加一小撮肉桂。

sentences.en: Can you pinch the dough to seal the edges?
sentences.zh: 你可以把麵糰的邊緣捏緊封起來嗎？

sentences.en: He pinched my arm to wake me up during class.
sentences.zh: 上課時，他捏我的手臂把我叫醒。

sentences.en: I'll have a glass of pinot noir with the salmon.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯黑皮諾搭配鮭魚。

sentences.en: Does the restaurant carry a good pinot by the glass?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有提供不錯的皮諾單杯酒嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter recommended a light pinot for our chicken dinner.
sentences.zh: 服務生為我們的雞肉晚餐推薦了一款清爽的皮諾。

sentences.en: Which pinot goes best with mushroom pasta?
sentences.zh: 哪一款皮諾最適合搭配蘑菇義大利麵？

sentences.en: She read the label and saw the pinot was from Oregon.
sentences.zh: 她看了標籤，發現這款皮諾來自奧勒岡州。

sentences.en: This pinot has a soft, fruity flavor.
sentences.zh: 這款皮諾口感柔和，帶有果香。

sentences.en: We shared a seafood platter as an appetizer.
sentences.zh: 我們一起分享了一份海鮮拼盤當開胃菜。

sentences.en: Could you bring a larger platter for the turkey?
sentences.zh: 你可以拿一個更大的盤子來裝火雞嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter set a cheese platter in the center of the table.
sentences.zh: 服務生把乳酪拼盤放在桌子中央。

sentences.en: Is the sampler platter big enough for four people?
sentences.zh: 這份綜合拼盤夠四個人吃嗎？

sentences.en: She arranged the fruit on a silver platter.
sentences.zh: 她把水果擺在一個銀色的大盤子上。

sentences.en: Do you want to order the fried chicken platter?
sentences.zh: 你要點炸雞拼盤嗎？

sentences.en: The playwright attended the opening night of her new play.
sentences.zh: 劇作家出席了她新戲的首演。

sentences.en: Did the playwright write this play in just one month?
sentences.zh: 這位劇作家只花了一個月就寫完這齣戲嗎？

sentences.en: A young playwright won the school writing award.
sentences.zh: 一位年輕的劇作家贏得了學校的寫作獎。

sentences.en: Which playwright wrote the play we saw last weekend?
sentences.zh: 我們上週末看的那齣戲是哪位劇作家寫的？

sentences.en: The playwright answered questions from the audience after the show.
sentences.zh: 演出結束後，劇作家回答了觀眾的提問。

sentences.en: He dreams of becoming a playwright someday.
sentences.zh: 他夢想有一天成為劇作家。

sentences.en: A farmer uses a plow to turn over the soil.
sentences.zh: 農夫用犁來翻土。

sentences.en: The city sent a plow to clear our street after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雪後，市政府派了一輛除雪車來清理我們這條街。

sentences.en: Did the crew plow the parking lot before the store opened?
sentences.zh: 工作人員在店開門前有把停車場的雪剷掉嗎？

sentences.en: We hired someone to plow our driveway this winter.
sentences.zh: 今年冬天我們請人來剷車道上的雪。

sentences.en: Farmers plow their fields before they plant seeds in spring.
sentences.zh: 農夫春天播種前會先犁田。

sentences.en: How early do the trucks plow the roads here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的卡車多早會出來剷路上的雪？

sentences.en: Tom stayed home for a week because of pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 湯姆因為肺炎在家休養了一週。

sentences.en: Can a bad cold turn into pneumonia?
sentences.zh: 嚴重的感冒會變成肺炎嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor listened to my chest and suspected pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 醫師幫我聽診，懷疑是肺炎。

sentences.en: Is there a vaccine that protects against pneumonia?
sentences.zh: 有可以預防肺炎的疫苗嗎？

sentences.en: Pneumonia can be serious for small children and older adults.
sentences.zh: 肺炎對幼童和年長者可能很嚴重。

sentences.en: She recovered from pneumonia after taking antibiotics for ten days.
sentences.zh: 她吃了十天的抗生素後，肺炎就康復了。

sentences.en: She paused to ponder the question before answering.
sentences.zh: 她停下來仔細思考這個問題，然後才回答。

sentences.en: Do you ponder big questions when you can't sleep at night?
sentences.zh: 你睡不著的時候會思考一些大哉問嗎？

sentences.en: I need time to ponder my next career move.
sentences.zh: 我需要時間好好思考我下一步的職涯。

sentences.en: Do you ever ponder what life would be like on Mars?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有想過在火星上生活會是什麼樣子？

sentences.en: He sat by the window and pondered his choices.
sentences.zh: 他坐在窗邊，反覆思考自己的選擇。

sentences.en: The committee will ponder the proposal over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 委員會會在週末仔細考慮這項提案。

sentences.en: My daughter wants a pony for her birthday.
sentences.zh: 我女兒生日想要一匹小馬。

sentences.en: Can children ride the pony at the fair?
sentences.zh: 小朋友可以在園遊會上騎小馬嗎？

sentences.en: The pony trotted slowly around the small ring.
sentences.zh: 小馬在小圍場裡慢慢地小跑步。

sentences.en: How tall is a full-grown pony?
sentences.zh: 一匹成年小馬有多高？

sentences.en: We fed carrots to the pony at the petting zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們在動物園的可愛動物區餵小馬吃紅蘿蔔。

sentences.en: A pony is smaller than a regular horse.
sentences.zh: 小馬比一般的馬還要矮小。

sentences.en: Millions of people populate the coastal cities.
sentences.zh: 數百萬人居住在沿海城市。

sentences.en: Which animals populate the forests of this region?
sentences.zh: 這個地區的森林裡棲息著哪些動物？

sentences.en: This area is densely populated, so housing is expensive.
sentences.zh: 這個地區人口稠密，所以房價很高。

sentences.en: Is the island populated, or is it empty?
sentences.zh: 這座島上有人居住，還是無人島？

sentences.en: Early settlers slowly populated the western plains.
sentences.zh: 早期移民逐漸在西部平原定居。

sentences.en: Colorful fish populate the coral reef near our hotel.
sentences.zh: 色彩繽紛的魚類棲息在我們飯店附近的珊瑚礁。

gloss_note: 美式飯店多說 bellhop；porter 多指車站搬運工

sentences.en: The porter carried our suitcases to the train.
sentences.zh: 搬運工把我們的行李箱扛到火車上。

sentences.en: Should I tip the porter for helping with luggage?
sentences.zh: 我該給行李員小費謝謝他幫忙搬行李嗎？

sentences.en: A porter met us at the train station.
sentences.zh: 一位搬運工在火車站接應我們。

sentences.en: Could you ask a porter to bring a cart for our bags?
sentences.zh: 你可以請搬運工推一台推車來裝我們的行李嗎？

sentences.en: He worked as a porter at the airport during college.
sentences.zh: 他大學時在機場當搬運工。

sentences.en: The porter was friendly and helped us with every suitcase.
sentences.zh: 那位行李員很親切，每一只行李箱都幫我們提。

sentences.en: Good posture can prevent back pain at your desk.
sentences.zh: 良好的姿勢可以避免坐在書桌前背痛。

sentences.en: Why does my teacher keep telling me to fix my posture?
sentences.zh: 老師為什麼一直叫我矯正姿勢？

sentences.en: Her posture improved after months of yoga.
sentences.zh: 練了幾個月瑜伽後，她的體態改善了。

sentences.en: Do you check your posture while working on a computer?
sentences.zh: 你用電腦工作時會注意自己的姿勢嗎？

sentences.en: Sit with good posture during the long flight.
sentences.zh: 長途飛行時要保持良好的坐姿。

sentences.en: The dancer's straight posture impressed the judges.
sentences.zh: 舞者挺直的體態讓評審印象深刻。

sentences.en: This herbal tea is more potent than it looks.
sentences.zh: 這杯花草茶比看起來更有勁。

sentences.en: Is the new cleaner potent enough to remove old stains?
sentences.zh: 這款新的清潔劑夠強效，能去除陳年污漬嗎？

sentences.en: That hot sauce is potent, so use just a drop.
sentences.zh: 那種辣醬很夠勁，只要加一滴就好。

sentences.en: A potent argument convinced the whole board.
sentences.zh: 一個很有力的論點說服了整個董事會。

sentences.en: Laughter is a potent cure for stress.
sentences.zh: 笑是消除壓力的強效良方。

sentences.en: Can a single speech be potent enough to change minds?
sentences.zh: 一場演講能強而有力到改變人心嗎？

sentences.en: Cook poultry until the inside is no longer pink.
sentences.zh: 家禽肉要煮到裡面不再呈粉紅色。

sentences.en: Does this farm raise poultry or only cattle?
sentences.zh: 這個農場養的是家禽，還是只有牛？

sentences.en: Chicken and turkey are the most common poultry in America.
sentences.zh: 雞和火雞是美國最常見的家禽。

sentences.en: Wash your hands after touching raw poultry.
sentences.zh: 摸過生的禽肉後要洗手。

sentences.en: How much poultry do Americans eat each year?
sentences.zh: 美國人每年吃多少禽肉？

sentences.en: The grocery store has a separate section for fresh poultry.
sentences.zh: 這家超市有一個專賣新鮮禽肉的區域。

gloss_note: practice what you preach 言行一致

sentences.en: You should practice what you preach.
sentences.zh: 你應該言行一致。

sentences.en: Please don't preach to me about saving money.
sentences.zh: 拜託不要對我說教該怎麼省錢。

sentences.en: Why do some coaches preach teamwork but never listen?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些教練嘴上宣導團隊合作，卻從不聽別人說話？

sentences.en: My manager preaches the value of honest feedback.
sentences.zh: 我的主管一直宣導誠實回饋的價值。

sentences.en: Do doctors always follow the habits they preach?
sentences.zh: 醫師總是會做到自己宣導的習慣嗎？

sentences.en: Parents often preach good manners at the dinner table.
sentences.zh: 父母常在餐桌上說教，要我們有禮貌。

sentences.en: The museum displays prehistoric tools made of stone.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示著石頭做的史前工具。

sentences.en: Did prehistoric people really live in caves?
sentences.zh: 史前人類真的住在洞穴裡嗎？

sentences.en: Kids love the prehistoric animals in that movie.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很喜歡那部電影裡的史前動物。

sentences.en: Scientists found prehistoric footprints near the river.
sentences.zh: 科學家在河邊發現了史前的腳印。

sentences.en: How old is that prehistoric painting on the cave wall?
sentences.zh: 洞穴牆上那幅史前壁畫有多古老？

sentences.en: Dinosaurs are prehistoric creatures that lived millions of years ago.
sentences.zh: 恐龍是數百萬年前生存的史前生物。
