sentences.en: The movie's premiere is next Friday night.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的首映在下週五晚上。

sentences.en: Are you going to the premiere tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚要去首映會嗎？

sentences.en: Her new play had its premiere in October.
sentences.zh: 她的新劇在十月首演。

sentences.en: How did you get tickets to the premiere?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼弄到首映票的？

sentences.en: We watched the stars arrive at the premiere on TV.
sentences.zh: 我們在電視上看明星抵達首映會。

sentences.en: The orchestra's premiere of the new symphony sold out in two hours.
sentences.zh: 樂團新交響曲的首演門票在兩小時內就售完了。

sentences.en: The mayor will preside over the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 市長將主持這場典禮。

sentences.en: Who is going to preside over tomorrow's meeting?
sentences.zh: 明天的會議由誰主持？

sentences.en: Our principal presides over every graduation.
sentences.zh: 我們校長都會主持每一場畢業典禮。

sentences.en: Could you preside over the class election this week?
sentences.zh: 這週的班級選舉可以請你主持嗎？

sentences.en: The judge calmly presided over the hearing.
sentences.zh: 法官沉著地主持了這場庭訊。

sentences.en: She was chosen to preside over the town meeting.
sentences.zh: 她被選為主持鎮民大會的人。

gloss_note: gain/lose prestige 贏得／失去聲望

sentences.en: The award brings great prestige to our school.
sentences.zh: 這個獎為我們學校帶來極大的聲望。

sentences.en: Does this university have a lot of prestige?
sentences.zh: 這所大學很有名望嗎？

sentences.en: He took the job for the prestige, not the money.
sentences.zh: 他接下這份工作是為了名望，不是為了錢。

sentences.en: Why do people still care about a brand's prestige?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家還是那麼在意品牌的名望？

sentences.en: Her family lost its prestige after the scandal.
sentences.zh: 醜聞之後，她的家族失去了名望。

sentences.en: Winning the contest gave the small town some prestige.
sentences.zh: 贏得比賽讓這個小鎮有了些名氣。

sentences.en: Regular checkups are a form of preventive care.
sentences.zh: 定期健檢是預防保健的一種。

sentences.en: Is preventive maintenance included in the service plan?
sentences.zh: 服務方案有包含預防性保養嗎？

sentences.en: The city took preventive measures before the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，市政府採取了預防措施。

sentences.en: Do you think preventive medicine gets enough funding?
sentences.zh: 你覺得預防醫學得到足夠的經費嗎？

sentences.en: Our dentist stresses preventive care, like flossing.
sentences.zh: 我們的牙醫很強調像用牙線這類預防性的保健。

sentences.en: Taking preventive steps now will save money later.
sentences.zh: 現在採取預防措施，之後能省下不少錢。

sentences.en: That old photo of my grandma is priceless to me.
sentences.zh: 那張我奶奶的老照片對我來說是無價之寶。

sentences.en: The museum protects its priceless paintings with tight security.
sentences.zh: 博物館用嚴密的保全保護它珍貴的畫作。

sentences.en: Is this vase really priceless, or just expensive?
sentences.zh: 這個花瓶真的是無價之寶，還只是很貴而已？

sentences.en: Good friends are priceless, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 好朋友是無價的，不是嗎？

sentences.en: The thieves took several priceless jewels from the display.
sentences.zh: 小偷拿走了展示櫃裡好幾顆珍貴的寶石。

sentences.en: Time with your kids is priceless.
sentences.zh: 和孩子相處的時光是無價的。

sentences.en: A long procession of students walked into the gym.
sentences.zh: 一長列學生走進了體育館。

sentences.en: Did you see the procession on Main Street?
sentences.zh: 你有看到大街上的遊行隊伍嗎？

sentences.en: The wedding procession started at noon.
sentences.zh: 婚禮的隊伍中午就出發了。

sentences.en: Why is the funeral procession moving so slowly?
sentences.zh: 為什麼送葬的隊伍走得這麼慢？

sentences.en: Kids in costumes formed a procession down the hall.
sentences.zh: 穿著戲服的孩子們在走廊上排成一列行進。

sentences.en: The royal procession passed through the old city gate.
sentences.zh: 皇家隊伍穿過了古老的城門。

gloss_note: a prohibition on/against 對…的禁令

sentences.en: The school announced a prohibition on phones during exams.
sentences.zh: 學校宣布考試期間禁止使用手機。

sentences.en: Is there a prohibition against pets in your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你住的公寓有禁止養寵物的規定嗎？

sentences.en: The prohibition of fireworks starts next week.
sentences.zh: 煙火禁令從下週開始。

sentences.en: Why did the city lift its prohibition on street food?
sentences.zh: 為什麼市政府解除了對街頭小吃的禁令？

sentences.en: The prohibition on parking applies after six p.m.
sentences.zh: 晚上六點後禁止停車的規定就生效了。

sentences.en: Our lease includes a prohibition on loud music after ten.
sentences.zh: 我們的租約規定晚上十點後禁止大聲播放音樂。

gloss_note: propel A forward 推著A前進

sentences.en: Strong winds propelled the sailboat across the bay.
sentences.zh: 強風推著帆船橫越海灣。

sentences.en: What propels a rocket into space?
sentences.zh: 是什麼把火箭推進太空的？

sentences.en: Her hard work propelled her to the top of the class.
sentences.zh: 她的努力把她推上了全班第一名。

sentences.en: The engine propels the boat at a steady speed.
sentences.zh: 引擎以穩定的速度推動這艘船。

sentences.en: Can a small motor propel this kayak?
sentences.zh: 小馬達推得動這艘獨木舟嗎？

sentences.en: One viral video propelled the band to fame.
sentences.zh: 一支爆紅的影片讓這個樂團一炮而紅。

sentences.en: I'll have the pizza with prosciutto and arugula.
sentences.zh: 我要點生火腿和芝麻葉的披薩。

sentences.en: Does the sandwich come with prosciutto or turkey?
sentences.zh: 這個三明治是夾生火腿還是火雞肉？

sentences.en: She wrapped thin slices of prosciutto around the melon.
sentences.zh: 她用薄薄的生火腿片把哈密瓜包起來。

sentences.en: Could I get extra prosciutto on my salad?
sentences.zh: 我的沙拉可以多加一點生火腿嗎？

sentences.en: Prosciutto tastes salty, so go easy on the cheese.
sentences.zh: 生火腿本身就很鹹，起司放少一點。

sentences.en: The deli sells prosciutto by the pound.
sentences.zh: 這家熟食店的生火腿是按磅賣的。

sentences.en: I like her prose better than her poetry.
sentences.zh: 比起她的詩，我更喜歡她的散文。

sentences.en: Is this passage written in prose or verse?
sentences.zh: 這段文字是用散文還是韻文寫的？

sentences.en: The author's prose is clear and simple.
sentences.zh: 這位作者的散文清楚又簡單。

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short piece of prose.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇短篇散文。

sentences.en: Why is his prose so hard to follow?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他的散文這麼難讀懂？

sentences.en: The novel is famous for its elegant prose.
sentences.zh: 這本小說以優美的文筆聞名。

gloss_note: an old proverb 一句古老的諺語

sentences.en: There's an old proverb about not counting your chickens.
sentences.zh: 有句古老的諺語說，蛋還沒孵出來別先數雞。

sentences.en: Do you know a proverb that means the same thing?
sentences.zh: 你知道有哪句諺語是同樣的意思嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather always quotes a proverb at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺吃晚餐時總愛引用一句諺語。

sentences.en: What does this proverb mean in plain English?
sentences.zh: 這句諺語用白話來說是什麼意思？

sentences.en: The proverb says that haste makes waste.
sentences.zh: 這句諺語說的是欲速則不達。

sentences.en: We learned a new proverb in English class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在英文課學了一句新的諺語。

sentences.en: This is only a provisional schedule for now.
sentences.zh: 這只是目前暫定的時間表。

sentences.en: Is the provisional license valid for six months?
sentences.zh: 這張臨時執照的有效期是六個月嗎？

sentences.en: The provisional budget still needs final approval next week.
sentences.zh: 這份暫定預算下週還需要最後核准。

sentences.en: The team set up a provisional office in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 團隊在大廳設了一間臨時辦公室。

sentences.en: Are these provisional results, or are they final?
sentences.zh: 這些是暫時的結果，還是最終結果？

sentences.en: A provisional plan is better than no plan.
sentences.zh: 暫定的計畫總比沒有計畫好。

gloss_note: a psychiatry ward 精神科病房

sentences.en: She is studying psychiatry at medical school.
sentences.zh: 她在醫學院修精神醫學。

sentences.en: He works in the psychiatry department at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他在醫院的精神科工作。

sentences.en: Did you know psychiatry is a branch of medicine?
sentences.zh: 你知道精神醫學是醫學的一個分支嗎？

sentences.en: Advances in psychiatry have changed how we treat anxiety.
sentences.zh: 精神醫學的進步改變了我們治療焦慮的方式。

sentences.en: Why did you decide to go into psychiatry?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼決定走精神科這條路？

sentences.en: A friend of mine is doing her residency in child psychiatry.
sentences.zh: 我有個朋友正在兒童精神科做住院醫師訓練。

gloss_note: a psychic detective 通靈偵探

sentences.en: The movie is about a psychic girl with strange powers.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一個有特殊超能力的通靈女孩。

sentences.en: How did you know that? Are you psychic?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼會知道？你有超能力嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother pretended to be psychic at the party.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟在派對上假裝自己有超能力。

sentences.en: He joked that he was psychic and knew the quiz answers.
sentences.zh: 他開玩笑說自己有超能力，知道小考答案。

sentences.en: Do you think some people are really psychic?
sentences.zh: 你覺得有些人真的有通靈能力嗎？

sentences.en: In the story, the psychic detective sees the future.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，那位通靈偵探看得到未來。

gloss_note: be in psychotherapy 正在接受心理治療

sentences.en: Psychotherapy can help people manage stress and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 心理治療能幫助人們處理壓力與焦慮。

sentences.en: Has psychotherapy helped you feel better?
sentences.zh: 心理治療有讓你感覺好一點嗎？

sentences.en: She has a psychotherapy session every Tuesday after work.
sentences.zh: 她每週二下班後都有一次心理治療。

sentences.en: Does insurance cover psychotherapy in this state?
sentences.zh: 這個州的保險有給付心理治療嗎？

sentences.en: The clinic offers group psychotherapy for teens.
sentences.zh: 這間診所提供青少年的團體心理治療。

sentences.en: He began psychotherapy after a very hard year.
sentences.zh: 在非常艱難的一年之後，他開始接受心理治療。

gloss_note: a puff of steam 一縷蒸氣

sentences.en: A puff of steam rose from the pot.
sentences.zh: 一縷蒸氣從鍋子裡冒了出來。

sentences.en: He puffed out his cheeks and sighed.
sentences.zh: 他鼓起臉頰，嘆了口氣。

sentences.en: Why is that old train puffing so loudly?
sentences.zh: 那輛老火車為什麼噴氣噴得這麼大聲？

sentences.en: The kids huffed and puffed up the steep hill.
sentences.zh: 孩子們氣喘吁吁地爬上陡坡。

sentences.en: Did you see the puff of smoke from the chimney?
sentences.zh: 你有看到煙囪冒出的那陣煙嗎？

sentences.en: She blew out the candles with one puff.
sentences.zh: 她一口氣就把蠟燭吹熄了。

sentences.en: This filter can purify tap water in minutes.
sentences.zh: 這個濾水器幾分鐘就能淨化自來水。

sentences.en: Does the machine purify the air in the whole room?
sentences.zh: 這台機器能淨化整個房間的空氣嗎？

sentences.en: Some plants help purify indoor air.
sentences.zh: 有些植物有助於淨化室內空氣。

sentences.en: How do you purify water when you go camping?
sentences.zh: 你去露營時是怎麼過濾水的？

sentences.en: The treatment plant purifies river water before it reaches homes.
sentences.zh: 淨水廠會先淨化河水，才送到各家各戶。

sentences.en: We bought a pitcher to purify our drinking water.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一個濾水壺來過濾飲用水。

sentences.en: The company advertises the purity of its bottled water.
sentences.zh: 這家公司宣傳它瓶裝水的純淨度。

sentences.en: How do they test the purity of the gold?
sentences.zh: 他們怎麼檢測黃金的純度？

sentences.en: Lab workers measure the purity of each sample.
sentences.zh: 實驗室人員會測量每個樣本的純度。

sentences.en: Is the purity of this salt really 99 percent?
sentences.zh: 這種鹽的純度真的有百分之九十九嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone admired the purity of the lake's water.
sentences.zh: 大家都讚嘆那座湖水的純淨。

sentences.en: Her voice has a beautiful purity.
sentences.zh: 她的聲音有一種美好的純淨感。

sentences.en: We had lunch at a quaint little café downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們在市區一家別緻的小咖啡館吃了午餐。

sentences.en: Is there a quaint bakery near your hotel?
sentences.zh: 你住的飯店附近有沒有古色古香的麵包店？

sentences.en: The town is quaint, with cobblestone streets and flower boxes.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮很古樸，有鵝卵石街道和花箱。

sentences.en: It's a quaint place. Want to try their pie?
sentences.zh: 這家店很別緻。要不要試試他們的派？

sentences.en: Do you like the quaint decor in this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡這家餐廳古色古香的裝潢嗎？

sentences.en: They stayed at a quaint inn with a cozy dining room.
sentences.zh: 他們住在一間有溫馨餐廳的別緻小旅館。

gloss_note: n. 是 earthquake 的口語縮寫

sentences.en: The quake woke everyone up around three in the morning.
sentences.zh: 凌晨三點左右，地震把大家都震醒了。

sentences.en: Did you feel the quake this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上有感覺到地震嗎？

sentences.en: The windows rattled during the small quake.
sentences.zh: 小地震時，窗戶喀喀作響。

sentences.en: His voice began to quake as he spoke.
sentences.zh: 他說話時，聲音開始顫抖。

sentences.en: Why did the dog quake during the thunderstorm?
sentences.zh: 為什麼打雷時那隻狗一直發抖？

sentences.en: Scientists study each quake to learn about the fault.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究每一次地震，來了解那條斷層。

gloss_note: the right qualifications 合適的資格

sentences.en: What qualifications do I need for this job?
sentences.zh: 我需要具備什麼資格才能做這份工作？

sentences.en: She has the right qualifications for the position.
sentences.zh: 她具備這個職位所需的資格。

sentences.en: Is a college degree the only qualification you require?
sentences.zh: 大學學歷是你們要求的唯一資格嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have any teaching qualifications?
sentences.zh: 你有任何教學資格嗎？

sentences.en: Experience matters more than formal qualifications here.
sentences.zh: 在這裡，經驗比正式資格更重要。

sentences.en: His main qualification is ten years of sales experience.
sentences.zh: 他最主要的資格是十年的業務經驗。

sentences.en: I'll have a chicken quesadilla and a glass of water.
sentences.zh: 我要一份雞肉墨西哥起司餅和一杯水。

sentences.en: Can I get the quesadilla without onions?
sentences.zh: 墨西哥起司餅可以不要放洋蔥嗎？

sentences.en: The kids ate a cheese quesadilla for lunch.
sentences.zh: 孩子們午餐吃了起司墨西哥餅。

sentences.en: Does the quesadilla come with sour cream?
sentences.zh: 墨西哥起司餅有附酸奶油嗎？

sentences.en: She cut the quesadilla into four triangles.
sentences.zh: 她把墨西哥起司餅切成四個三角形。

sentences.en: A quesadilla is quick to make on a busy night.
sentences.zh: 在忙碌的晚上，做墨西哥起司餅很快。

gloss_note: a radiant smile 燦爛的笑容

sentences.en: The bride looked radiant in her white dress.
sentences.zh: 新娘穿著白紗，看起來容光煥發。

sentences.en: You look radiant today. Did something happen?
sentences.zh: 你今天看起來容光煥發。有什麼好事嗎？

sentences.en: The radiant sun lit up the whole valley.
sentences.zh: 燦爛的陽光照亮了整座山谷。

sentences.en: Why is she so radiant after her vacation?
sentences.zh: 她度假回來為什麼這麼容光煥發？

sentences.en: He gave us a radiant smile.
sentences.zh: 他對我們露出燦爛的笑容。

sentences.en: Her radiant face showed how happy she was.
sentences.zh: 她容光煥發的臉龐顯示出她有多快樂。

sentences.en: The heater radiates heat across the whole room.
sentences.zh: 暖氣機把熱度散發到整個房間。

sentences.en: Does the fireplace radiate enough warmth for the cabin?
sentences.zh: 這個壁爐散發的暖意夠小木屋用嗎？

sentences.en: She radiates confidence whenever she walks in.
sentences.zh: 她每次走進來都散發著自信。

sentences.en: The sun radiated warmth onto the beach.
sentences.zh: 太陽把暖意灑在海灘上。

sentences.en: How does he radiate such calm in a crisis?
sentences.zh: 他是怎麼在危機中散發出這麼沉穩的氣質？

sentences.en: Heat radiates from the stove while I cook.
sentences.zh: 我煮飯時，爐子會散發熱氣。

sentences.en: Radioactive materials must be stored in special containers.
sentences.zh: 放射性物質必須存放在特殊容器裡。

sentences.en: Is it safe to be near radioactive waste?
sentences.zh: 靠近放射性廢料安全嗎？

sentences.en: The science museum has a display on radioactive elements.
sentences.zh: 科學博物館有放射性元素的展覽。

sentences.en: Scientists use radioactive elements to date ancient fossils.
sentences.zh: 科學家用放射性元素來測定古代化石的年代。

sentences.en: Why are some elements radioactive and others not?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些元素有放射性，有些卻沒有？

sentences.en: The lab keeps radioactive samples behind thick walls.
sentences.zh: 實驗室把放射性樣本存放在厚牆後面。

gloss_note: 美國超市多指小紅蘿蔔

sentences.en: I added sliced radish to the salad.
sentences.zh: 我在沙拉裡加了切片的小紅蘿蔔。

sentences.en: Is a radish a root vegetable?
sentences.zh: 小紅蘿蔔是根莖類蔬菜嗎？

sentences.en: The radish adds a nice crunch to the tacos.
sentences.zh: 小紅蘿蔔讓塔可多了清脆的口感。

sentences.en: Could you buy a bunch of radishes at the store?
sentences.zh: 你能去商店買一把小紅蘿蔔嗎？

sentences.en: Her garden grows carrots, lettuce, and radishes.
sentences.zh: 她的菜園種了紅蘿蔔、萵苣和小紅蘿蔔。

sentences.en: Do you like the peppery taste of radish?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡小紅蘿蔔那種辛辣的味道嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother listens to rap on his way to school.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟上學途中都聽饒舌音樂。

sentences.en: Do you like rap or pop better?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡饒舌還是流行歌？

sentences.en: She wrote a rap about our class trip.
sentences.zh: 她寫了一首關於我們校外教學的饒舌歌。

sentences.en: Rap music has grown a lot in the past thirty years.
sentences.zh: 饒舌音樂在過去三十年成長了很多。

sentences.en: Can you recommend some good rap for the gym?
sentences.zh: 你能推薦一些適合健身時聽的饒舌歌嗎？

sentences.en: The school talent show ended with a funny rap.
sentences.zh: 校園才藝表演以一首搞笑的饒舌作結。

sentences.en: I got a rash on my arm after hiking.
sentences.zh: 我健行完，手臂上起了疹子。

sentences.en: Does the rash itch or hurt?
sentences.zh: 這個疹子會癢還是會痛？

sentences.en: The baby has a mild rash on his cheeks.
sentences.zh: 寶寶的臉頰上有輕微的疹子。

sentences.en: Should I see a doctor about this rash?
sentences.zh: 這個疹子我該去看醫生嗎？

sentences.en: The rash went away after a few days.
sentences.zh: 疹子過了幾天就消了。

sentences.en: My skin broke out in a rash after I tried the new soap.
sentences.zh: 我用了新的肥皂後，皮膚起了疹子。

sentences.en: I'd like a raspberry muffin and a coffee.
sentences.zh: 我想要一個覆盆子瑪芬和一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: Is the sauce made from raspberry or strawberry?
sentences.zh: 這個醬是用覆盆子還是草莓做的？

sentences.en: She topped the cake with fresh raspberries.
sentences.zh: 她在蛋糕上放了新鮮的覆盆子。

sentences.en: Do you want raspberry jam on your toast?
sentences.zh: 你的吐司要抹覆盆子果醬嗎？

sentences.en: These raspberries are sweet but a bit sour.
sentences.zh: 這些覆盆子甜甜的，又帶點酸。

sentences.en: My favorite smoothie flavor is raspberry.
sentences.zh: 我最愛的冰沙口味是覆盆子。

gloss_note: cheese ravioli 起司義大利餃

sentences.en: Tonight we're having cheese ravioli with tomato sauce.
sentences.zh: 今晚我們吃起司義大利餃配番茄醬。

sentences.en: Is the ravioli made fresh here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的義大利餃是現做的嗎？

sentences.en: She filled each ravioli with spinach and ricotta.
sentences.zh: 她在每個義大利餃裡包了菠菜和瑞可塔起司。

sentences.en: Can I get the ravioli with extra sauce?
sentences.zh: 義大利餃可以多加一點醬嗎？

sentences.en: Homemade ravioli takes time, but it's worth it.
sentences.zh: 自製義大利餃很花時間，但很值得。

sentences.en: The waiter recommended the mushroom ravioli.
sentences.zh: 服務生推薦了蘑菇義大利餃。

sentences.en: Driving that fast in the rain is reckless.
sentences.zh: 在雨中開那麼快太魯莽了。

sentences.en: Why would he make such a reckless decision?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼會做出這麼魯莽的決定？

sentences.en: Her reckless spending left her with no savings.
sentences.zh: 她不顧後果亂花錢，結果一點積蓄也沒有。

sentences.en: Do you think it's reckless to quit without another job?
sentences.zh: 你覺得沒有下一份工作就辭職是不是太魯莽了？

sentences.en: The coach warned the players against reckless tackles.
sentences.zh: 教練警告球員不要做魯莽的擒抱。

sentences.en: He was fined for reckless driving last month.
sentences.zh: 他上個月因為魯莽駕駛被罰款。

sentences.en: I reckon it'll rain before dinner.
sentences.zh: 我猜晚餐前會下雨。

sentences.en: What do you reckon we should do?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們該怎麼辦？

sentences.en: Do you reckon they'll be here on time?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他們會準時到嗎？

sentences.en: I reckon he's right about the price.
sentences.zh: 我認為他說的價格是對的。

sentences.en: She reckons the store closes at nine.
sentences.zh: 她猜那家店九點關門。

sentences.en: How long do you reckon the drive will take?
sentences.zh: 你猜開車要多久？

gloss_note: reconsider an offer 重新考慮提案

sentences.en: Would you reconsider our offer before Friday?
sentences.zh: 可以請您在週五前重新考慮我們的提案嗎？

sentences.en: I hope the board will reconsider its decision.
sentences.zh: 我希望董事會能重新考慮這個決定。

sentences.en: Please reconsider the schedule, since it's too tight.
sentences.zh: 時間表太緊了，請重新考慮一下。

sentences.en: Should we reconsider the budget for next quarter?
sentences.zh: 我們是不是該重新考慮下一季的預算？

sentences.en: After talking with her, he reconsidered the job offer.
sentences.zh: 和她談過之後，他重新考慮了這份工作邀約。

sentences.en: The customer asked us to reconsider the price.
sentences.zh: 客戶要求我們重新考慮價格。

sentences.en: We went snorkeling near the coral reef.
sentences.zh: 我們在珊瑚礁附近去浮潛。

sentences.en: Is the reef healthy, or is it dying?
sentences.zh: 這片珊瑚礁健康嗎，還是正在死去？

sentences.en: Colorful fish live around the reef.
sentences.zh: 色彩繽紛的魚住在礁岩周圍。

sentences.en: The boat got stuck on a reef near the island.
sentences.zh: 船卡在島附近的一處礁石上。

sentences.en: Why are coral reefs important to the ocean?
sentences.zh: 為什麼珊瑚礁對海洋很重要？

sentences.en: Tourists must not touch the reef.
sentences.zh: 遊客不可以碰觸珊瑚礁。

sentences.en: The design needs only a few small refinements.
sentences.zh: 這個設計只需要一些小小的修正。

sentences.en: Did the engineers make any refinements to the software?
sentences.zh: 工程師有對軟體做任何改進嗎？

sentences.en: Each refinement made the recipe a little better.
sentences.zh: 每一次的修正都讓這份食譜更好了一點。

sentences.en: What refinements would you suggest for this draft?
sentences.zh: 你會建議這份草稿做哪些細部修改？

sentences.en: After some refinement, the app was ready to launch.
sentences.zh: 經過一些細部調整，這個應用程式就準備好上線了。

sentences.en: The new model has several refinements over the old one.
sentences.zh: 新款比舊款多了幾項改良。

gloss_note: reflective vest/tape 反光背心／膠帶

sentences.en: Wear a reflective vest when you bike at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上騎腳踏車要穿反光背心。

sentences.en: Does your jacket have reflective tape on it?
sentences.zh: 你的外套上有反光條嗎？

sentences.en: The road signs are reflective, so drivers can see them.
sentences.zh: 路標是反光的，所以駕駛看得到。

sentences.en: Reflective stickers on the bag make it safer to walk.
sentences.zh: 包包上的反光貼紙讓走夜路更安全。

sentences.en: Where can I buy a reflective collar for my dog?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以買到給狗用的反光項圈？

sentences.en: Workers on the highway wear reflective gear.
sentences.zh: 公路上的工人穿著反光裝備。

gloss_note: refried beans 墨西哥炸豆泥

sentences.en: The burrito comes with rice and refried beans.
sentences.zh: 這份墨西哥捲餅附米飯和炸豆泥。

sentences.en: Can I get refried beans instead of black beans?
sentences.zh: 我可以用炸豆泥換掉黑豆嗎？

sentences.en: Refried beans taste great with melted cheese.
sentences.zh: 炸豆泥配融化的起司很好吃。

sentences.en: She spooned refried beans onto each tortilla.
sentences.zh: 她把炸豆泥舀到每一張薄餅上。

sentences.en: Are the refried beans made with lard?
sentences.zh: 這些炸豆泥是用豬油做的嗎？

sentences.en: We ordered chips, salsa, and a side of refried beans.
sentences.zh: 我們點了玉米片、莎莎醬和一份炸豆泥配菜。

gloss_note: refute a claim 駁斥說法

sentences.en: The scientist tried to refute the old theory.
sentences.zh: 那位科學家試圖駁斥舊理論。

sentences.en: Can anyone refute his argument?
sentences.zh: 有人能反駁他的論點嗎？

sentences.en: She refuted the rumor with clear evidence.
sentences.zh: 她用明確的證據駁斥了那個謠言。

sentences.en: The company refuted the claims in the report.
sentences.zh: 公司駁斥了報告中的說法。

sentences.en: How would you refute that point in a debate?
sentences.zh: 在辯論中你會怎麼反駁那一點？

sentences.en: No one could refute her calm explanation.
sentences.zh: 沒有人能反駁她冷靜的說明。

gloss_note: rehabilitate a patient 幫病人復健

sentences.en: The clinic helps patients rehabilitate after knee surgery.
sentences.zh: 這間診所協助病人在膝蓋手術後復健。

sentences.en: How long will it take to rehabilitate your shoulder?
sentences.zh: 你的肩膀要多久才能復健好？

sentences.en: It took months to rehabilitate her back after the fall.
sentences.zh: 她跌倒後，背部花了好幾個月才復健好。

sentences.en: She worked hard to rehabilitate her injured leg.
sentences.zh: 她很努力讓受傷的腿恢復。

sentences.en: Does this program rehabilitate wild animals before release?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫會在野放前讓野生動物恢復健康嗎？

sentences.en: The therapist rehabilitated his injured wrist in six weeks.
sentences.zh: 治療師在六週內讓他受傷的手腕恢復了。

gloss_note: during her reign 在她統治期間

sentences.en: The queen's reign lasted over fifty years.
sentences.zh: 女王的統治長達五十多年。

sentences.en: Who reigned in this country in the 1700s?
sentences.zh: 1700年代是誰統治這個國家？

sentences.en: The team has reigned as champions for three years.
sentences.zh: 這支球隊已經稱霸三年了。

sentences.en: Did the king's reign bring peace to the land?
sentences.zh: 國王的統治有為這片土地帶來和平嗎？

sentences.en: The old tower was built during his reign.
sentences.zh: 那座古塔是在他統治期間蓋的。

sentences.en: Her reign as chess champion ended last night.
sentences.zh: 她的西洋棋冠軍寶座昨晚結束了。

sentences.en: The whole town rejoiced when the team won.
sentences.zh: 球隊獲勝時，全鎮都歡欣鼓舞。

sentences.en: Did the fans rejoice after the final whistle?
sentences.zh: 終場哨聲響起後，球迷們有沒有歡呼慶祝？

sentences.en: Families rejoiced at the news of the safe return.
sentences.zh: 聽到平安歸來的消息，家人們欣喜不已。

sentences.en: She rejoiced to hear that her son had passed the exam.
sentences.zh: 聽到兒子考試通過了，她非常欣喜。

sentences.en: Let's rejoice together. We finally finished the project!
sentences.zh: 我們一起慶祝吧。這個專案終於完成了！

sentences.en: Why does everyone rejoice when school lets out for summer?
sentences.zh: 為什麼學校放暑假時大家都那麼歡欣？

sentences.en: The soup is relatively cheap, and it's delicious.
sentences.zh: 這道湯相對便宜，而且很好喝。

sentences.en: Prices are relatively low here, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 這裡的價格比較低，不是嗎？

sentences.en: It's relatively quiet at lunch. Want to sit outside?
sentences.zh: 午餐時間相對安靜。要不要坐外面？

sentences.en: The pasta is relatively quick to cook.
sentences.zh: 義大利麵煮起來相對快。

sentences.en: That dish is relatively light, so I can order dessert.
sentences.zh: 那道菜比較清淡，所以我還可以點甜點。

sentences.en: Is the service here relatively fast on weekdays?
sentences.zh: 這裡平日的服務速度比較快嗎？

gloss_note: relay a message 轉達訊息

sentences.en: Could you relay this message to the manager?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把這則訊息轉達給經理嗎？

sentences.en: I'll relay your request to the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我會把您的要求轉達給廚房。

sentences.en: She relayed the news to her parents over the phone.
sentences.zh: 她在電話裡把消息轉告了父母。

sentences.en: Can you relay the customer's question to our team?
sentences.zh: 你可以把客戶的問題轉達給我們團隊嗎？

sentences.en: The assistant relayed the instructions to everyone.
sentences.zh: 助理把指示傳達給每個人。

sentences.en: Please relay my thanks to everyone who helped.
sentences.zh: 請把我的感謝轉達給每一位幫忙的人。

gloss_note: relentless effort 不屈不撓的努力

sentences.en: The relentless rain lasted all weekend.
sentences.zh: 那場不停的雨下了整個週末。

sentences.en: Why is the heat so relentless this summer?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今年夏天的酷熱沒完沒了？

sentences.en: Her relentless effort finally paid off.
sentences.zh: 她不屈不撓的努力終於有了回報。

sentences.en: Are you ready for the relentless pace of this job?
sentences.zh: 你準備好面對這份工作永不停歇的步調了嗎？

sentences.en: The coach was relentless in training.
sentences.zh: 教練在訓練時毫不鬆懈。

sentences.en: He faced relentless questions from the reporters.
sentences.zh: 他面對記者連珠炮般的提問。

sentences.en: Many small towns are reliant on tourism.
sentences.zh: 許多小鎮都依賴觀光業。

sentences.en: Are you still reliant on your parents for money?
sentences.zh: 你的生活費還要靠父母嗎？

sentences.en: The company is too reliant on one customer.
sentences.zh: 這家公司太依賴單一客戶了。

sentences.en: I don't want to be reliant on my car.
sentences.zh: 我不想依賴自己的車。

sentences.en: Is the restaurant reliant on weekend crowds?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳是不是得靠週末的人潮？

sentences.en: Farmers are reliant on good weather.
sentences.zh: 農夫要靠好天氣。

gloss_note: a relic of the past 過去的遺物

sentences.en: This old radio is a relic from the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 這台舊收音機是1960年代的遺物。

sentences.en: The museum displays relics from an ancient city.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一座古城的遺物。

sentences.en: Is that flip phone a relic, or do you still use it?
sentences.zh: 那支掀蓋手機是古董，還是你還在用？

sentences.en: My dad's old typewriter is a relic of his school days.
sentences.zh: 我爸的舊打字機是他學生時代的遺物。

sentences.en: Archaeologists found a relic buried near the river.
sentences.zh: 考古學家在河邊發現一件埋藏的遺物。

sentences.en: Does your town have any historic relics?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上有任何歷史遺跡嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want relish on your hot dog?
sentences.zh: 你的熱狗要加甜酸醬嗎？

sentences.en: I like mustard and relish on my hot dog.
sentences.zh: 我的熱狗喜歡加芥末醬和甜酸醬。

sentences.en: Could I get extra relish on the side?
sentences.zh: 可以另外多給我一點甜酸醬嗎？

sentences.en: The relish is sweet and a little sour.
sentences.zh: 這個甜酸醬甜甜的又帶點酸。

sentences.en: She made a jar of relish with chopped pickles.
sentences.zh: 她用切碎的醃黃瓜做了一罐甜酸醬。

sentences.en: He spooned relish over the grilled sausage.
sentences.zh: 他把甜酸醬舀到烤香腸上。

sentences.en: The company is paying for my relocation to Texas.
sentences.zh: 公司出錢讓我調職搬到德州。

sentences.en: When does the office relocation take place?
sentences.zh: 辦公室什麼時候搬遷？

sentences.en: Relocation can be stressful for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 搬遷對全家人來說都可能很有壓力。

sentences.en: Is the relocation package enough to cover moving costs?
sentences.zh: 這份搬遷補助夠付搬家費用嗎？

sentences.en: Her relocation to the Seattle branch starts in March.
sentences.zh: 她調到西雅圖分公司的時間是三月。

sentences.en: Have you decided about the relocation yet?
sentences.zh: 你對調職的事決定了嗎？

sentences.en: This song is reminiscent of my high school days.
sentences.zh: 這首歌讓我想起高中時光。

sentences.en: The smell is reminiscent of my grandma's kitchen.
sentences.zh: 這味道讓我想起奶奶的廚房。

sentences.en: Is her style reminiscent of any famous painter?
sentences.zh: 她的風格有沒有讓人想起哪位名畫家？

sentences.en: His voice is reminiscent of an old radio host.
sentences.zh: 他的聲音讓人想起老牌電台主持人。

sentences.en: The little café is reminiscent of a Paris street.
sentences.zh: 這家小咖啡館讓人想起巴黎的街道。

sentences.en: Isn't this melody reminiscent of an old movie theme?
sentences.zh: 這段旋律是不是讓人想起某部老電影的主題曲？

gloss_note: remove the seeds 去籽；請店家拿掉配料

sentences.en: Could you remove the onions from my burger, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把我漢堡裡的洋蔥拿掉嗎？

sentences.en: Remove the seeds before you chop the pepper.
sentences.zh: 切辣椒之前先把籽去掉。

sentences.en: Do I need to remove the skin from the chicken?
sentences.zh: 我需要把雞皮去掉嗎？

sentences.en: She used a spoon to remove the foam from the soup.
sentences.zh: 她用湯匙把湯上的浮沫撈掉。

sentences.en: He forgot to remove the bay leaf from the stew.
sentences.zh: 他忘了把燉菜裡的月桂葉拿出來。

sentences.en: Can the chef remove the nuts from this dessert?
sentences.zh: 這道甜點可以請主廚把堅果去掉嗎？

sentences.en: The town is renowned for its fresh seafood.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮以新鮮海產聞名。

sentences.en: Is your professor renowned for her research on bees?
sentences.zh: 你的教授是以研究蜜蜂而聞名的嗎？

sentences.en: A renowned architect designed our new library.
sentences.zh: 一位著名的建築師設計了我們的新圖書館。

sentences.en: Which restaurant in this area is the most renowned?
sentences.zh: 這一區哪家餐廳最有名？

sentences.en: He became renowned after his first novel came out.
sentences.zh: 他的第一本小說出版後就聲名大噪。

sentences.en: The school is renowned worldwide for its music program.
sentences.zh: 這所學校的音樂課程享譽全球。

sentences.en: We should reorder napkins before we run out.
sentences.zh: 我們該在用完之前再訂一些餐巾紙。

sentences.en: We need to reorder flour before the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們週末前得再訂麵粉。

sentences.en: Did you reorder the paper cups for the café?
sentences.zh: 你有幫咖啡店再訂紙杯嗎？

sentences.en: Should we reorder more coffee beans this week?
sentences.zh: 我們這週要不要再訂一些咖啡豆？

sentences.en: Customers often reorder this soup in winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天客人常常會再點這道湯。

sentences.en: She plans to reorder the hot sauce online tonight.
sentences.zh: 她打算今晚上網再訂辣醬。

sentences.en: A snake is a reptile, not an insect.
sentences.zh: 蛇是爬蟲類，不是昆蟲。

sentences.en: Is a turtle a reptile or an amphibian?
sentences.zh: 烏龜是爬蟲類還是兩棲類？

sentences.en: Our class visited the reptile house at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們班去動物園的爬蟲館參觀。

sentences.en: Do you want a pet reptile like a lizard?
sentences.zh: 你想養像蜥蜴這樣的爬蟲類寵物嗎？

sentences.en: Most reptile eggs hatch in warm sand.
sentences.zh: 大多數爬蟲類的蛋在溫暖的沙裡孵化。

sentences.en: My little brother is curious about every reptile he sees.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟對他看到的每一種爬蟲類都很好奇。

sentences.en: I resent being treated like a child.
sentences.zh: 我很不滿被當成小孩對待。

sentences.en: Do you resent your coworker for getting the promotion?
sentences.zh: 你會因為同事得到升遷而心生不滿嗎？

sentences.en: She resented the extra work her boss gave her.
sentences.zh: 她對老闆多派給她的工作感到不滿。

sentences.en: Why would he resent your success?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼要怨恨你的成功？

sentences.en: Many workers resent the new schedule.
sentences.zh: 很多員工對新班表很不滿。

sentences.en: They resented each other for years after the argument.
sentences.zh: 吵架之後他們好多年都彼此怨恨。

sentences.en: She felt deep resentment toward her old boss.
sentences.zh: 她對前老闆懷有很深的怨恨。

sentences.en: Does the extra work cause resentment among the staff?
sentences.zh: 多出來的工作會讓員工之間產生不滿嗎？

sentences.en: His resentment grew every time he was ignored.
sentences.zh: 每次被忽視，他的怨氣就更深。

sentences.en: How can we avoid resentment in a big family?
sentences.zh: 在大家庭裡要怎麼避免心生怨懟？

sentences.en: There was a lot of resentment about the new rules.
sentences.zh: 大家對新規定有很多不滿。

sentences.en: He spoke without any resentment about the loss.
sentences.zh: 他談起那次失利時毫無怨恨。

gloss_note: reside in 居住於（正式，口語用 live）

sentences.en: Do you currently reside in California?
sentences.zh: 你目前住在加州嗎？

sentences.en: Most of our members reside in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分會員都住在市中心。

sentences.en: She has resided in the same apartment for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她在同一間公寓已經住了十年。

sentences.en: Where does the president of the club reside?
sentences.zh: 社團社長住在哪裡？

sentences.en: Please write the address where you reside.
sentences.zh: 請寫下你的居住地址。

sentences.en: The family resided in a small town before moving.
sentences.zh: 搬家前，那家人住在一個小鎮。

gloss_note: a restatement of 對…的重新說明

sentences.en: This memo is just a restatement of our earlier goals.
sentences.zh: 這份備忘錄只是我們先前目標的重述。

sentences.en: Could you give me a quick restatement of the policy?
sentences.zh: 你可以簡單重述一下這項政策嗎？

sentences.en: Is this a restatement of the old plan, or something new?
sentences.zh: 這是舊計畫的重述，還是新的東西？

sentences.en: Her email was a clear restatement of the contract terms.
sentences.zh: 她的電子郵件清楚重述了合約條款。

sentences.en: The manager asked for a restatement of the main goals.
sentences.zh: 經理要求重新說明主要目標。

sentences.en: After the meeting, he posted a restatement of the deadlines.
sentences.zh: 會後他貼出了截止日期的重新說明。

gloss_note: restoration of power 恢復供電

sentences.en: The restoration of the old theater took two years.
sentences.zh: 這座老戲院的修復花了兩年。

sentences.en: How long will the restoration of the bridge take?
sentences.zh: 這座橋的修復要多久？

sentences.en: The city expects the restoration of power by tonight.
sentences.zh: 市府預計今晚前恢復供電。

sentences.en: Do you think the museum needs more money for restoration?
sentences.zh: 你覺得博物館需要更多經費來做修復嗎？

sentences.en: Her grandfather spends weekends on classic car restoration.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父週末都投入老爺車的修復工作。

sentences.en: The restoration of trust between the two teams took time.
sentences.zh: 兩隊之間信任的恢復需要時間。

sentences.en: "That's not fair!" she retorted.
sentences.zh: 「這不公平！」她回嘴說。

sentences.en: Did she retort, or did she just walk away?
sentences.zh: 她有回嘴嗎，還是直接走開了？

sentences.en: Her quick retort made everyone in the class laugh.
sentences.zh: 她迅速的反駁讓全班都笑了。

sentences.en: Did you hear his retort at the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到他在會議上的回嘴嗎？

sentences.en: "You started it," his friend retorted.
sentences.zh: 「是你先開始的。」他的朋友反駁道。

sentences.en: I wanted to retort, but I stayed quiet.
sentences.zh: 我很想回嘴，但還是保持沉默。

gloss_note: come as a revelation 令人大開眼界

sentences.en: That documentary was a revelation to me.
sentences.zh: 那部紀錄片讓我大開眼界。

sentences.en: Was the revelation about the missing painting a surprise?
sentences.zh: 那件關於失蹤畫作的揭露讓你意外嗎？

sentences.en: The news story's final revelation shocked the whole town.
sentences.zh: 報導最後揭露的內容震驚了整個小鎮。

sentences.en: What was the biggest revelation of your trip?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅行中你最大的新發現是什麼？

sentences.en: Her revelation that she can sing surprised us all.
sentences.zh: 她透露自己會唱歌，讓我們大家都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Learning to cook at home was a revelation for him.
sentences.zh: 在家學煮飯對他來說是個重大發現。

gloss_note: a revolt against 對…的反抗

sentences.en: Our history teacher explained why the farmers started a revolt.
sentences.zh: 歷史老師解釋了農民為什麼發動叛亂。

sentences.en: The movie shows a revolt against a cruel king.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描繪了對殘暴國王的反抗。

sentences.en: Did the revolt in that story succeed in the end?
sentences.zh: 那個故事裡的叛亂最後成功了嗎？

sentences.en: Workers might revolt if the boss cuts their pay again.
sentences.zh: 如果老闆再砍薪水，員工可能會群起反抗。

sentences.en: Why did the soldiers revolt in the film?
sentences.zh: 電影裡的士兵為什麼會叛變？

sentences.en: The students revolted against the strict new dress code.
sentences.zh: 學生們反抗嚴格的新服裝規定。

gloss_note: revolve around 繞著…轉；以…為中心

sentences.en: The Earth takes a year to revolve around the sun.
sentences.zh: 地球繞太陽一圈要一年。

sentences.en: Does your whole life revolve around work?
sentences.zh: 你的生活是不是完全繞著工作轉？

sentences.en: The plot of the movie revolves around a lost dog.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的劇情圍繞著一隻走失的狗。

sentences.en: Our conversation revolved around vacation plans.
sentences.zh: 我們的談話都圍繞著度假計畫。

sentences.en: What does the story revolve around?
sentences.zh: 這個故事是圍繞著什麼展開的？

sentences.en: The small planet revolves around a bright star.
sentences.zh: 這顆小行星繞著一顆明亮的恆星運轉。

gloss_note: ricotta cheese；常用於千層麵、甜點

sentences.en: This lasagna is made with fresh ricotta.
sentences.zh: 這份千層麵用的是新鮮瑞可塔起司。

sentences.en: Can I get ricotta on my pancakes?
sentences.zh: 我的鬆餅可以加瑞可塔起司嗎？

sentences.en: Mix the ricotta with spinach and garlic.
sentences.zh: 把瑞可塔起司和菠菜、大蒜拌在一起。

sentences.en: Do you prefer ricotta or cream cheese in cheesecake?
sentences.zh: 做起司蛋糕，你比較喜歡用瑞可塔起司還是奶油起司？

sentences.en: The bakery sells a ricotta pie every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 這家烘焙坊每週日都賣瑞可塔起司派。

sentences.en: She spread ricotta on toast and added honey.
sentences.zh: 她在吐司上抹瑞可塔起司，再淋上蜂蜜。

gloss_note: bus rider 公車乘客；bike rider 騎車的人

sentences.en: Bus riders should have exact change ready.
sentences.zh: 公車乘客應該事先準備好零錢。

sentences.en: Is every rider required to wear a helmet?
sentences.zh: 每位騎乘者都必須戴安全帽嗎？

sentences.en: The new schedule should help daily riders get to work on time.
sentences.zh: 新的時刻表應該能幫助每天搭車的人準時上班。

sentences.en: How many riders use this subway line each morning?
sentences.zh: 每天早上有多少乘客搭這條地鐵線？

sentences.en: A bike rider stopped to let us cross the street.
sentences.zh: 一位騎腳踏車的人停下來讓我們過馬路。

sentences.en: Our company shuttle can carry twelve riders at once.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的接駁車一次可載十二位乘客。

gloss_note: ripple effect 連鎖／波及效應

sentences.en: A small stone made ripples across the pond.
sentences.zh: 一顆小石頭在池塘上激起了漣漪。

sentences.en: Will the price increase have a ripple effect on other stores?
sentences.zh: 這次漲價會波及其他商店嗎？

sentences.en: The news rippled through the office within minutes.
sentences.zh: 這個消息幾分鐘內就在辦公室傳開了。

sentences.en: Do you see the ripples when the wind blows?
sentences.zh: 風吹過時，你有看到漣漪嗎？

sentences.en: The factory closing sent ripples through the whole town.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉對整個小鎮造成了波及。

sentences.en: A tiny wave rippled across the surface of my coffee.
sentences.zh: 一道小小的波紋掠過我的咖啡表面。

sentences.en: The rivalry between the two schools is famous.
sentences.zh: 這兩所學校之間的較勁很有名。

sentences.en: Is there any rivalry between you and your coworker?
sentences.zh: 你和你的同事之間有在較勁嗎？

sentences.en: Their friendly rivalry makes the team work harder.
sentences.zh: 他們之間良性的競爭讓團隊更努力。

sentences.en: Fans filled the stadium for the old rivalry game.
sentences.zh: 球迷擠滿球場觀看這場宿敵對決。

sentences.en: How did the rivalry between the two companies start?
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司的競爭是怎麼開始的？

sentences.en: There was some sibling rivalry at dinner last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚吃晚餐時，手足之間有點較勁。

gloss_note: 美式路邊小館，常有現場音樂

sentences.en: We stopped at a roadhouse for steak and fries.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家路邊餐館停下來吃牛排和薯條。

sentences.en: Is the roadhouse on Route 9 still open?
sentences.zh: 九號公路旁那家路邊餐館還有營業嗎？

sentences.en: The roadhouse has live music on Friday nights.
sentences.zh: 這家路邊餐館週五晚上有現場音樂。

sentences.en: Which roadhouse serves the best ribs around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近哪家路邊餐館的肋排最好吃？

sentences.en: My dad used to work at a roadhouse in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸以前在德州的一家路邊餐館工作。

sentences.en: The old roadhouse is famous for its big burgers.
sentences.zh: 那家老路邊餐館以大漢堡聞名。

sentences.en: We roamed the streets of the old town all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們整個下午都在老城區的街上閒逛。

sentences.en: Do you like to roam around the mall on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末喜歡在購物中心閒逛嗎？

sentences.en: Wild horses roam freely across these plains.
sentences.zh: 野馬在這片平原上自由漫遊。

sentences.en: Kids should not roam the halls during class.
sentences.zh: 上課時孩子們不該在走廊閒晃。

sentences.en: Does your dog roam the neighborhood at night?
sentences.zh: 你家的狗晚上會在附近到處亂跑嗎？

sentences.en: Cattle roam the hills near our cabin.
sentences.zh: 牛群在我們小木屋附近的山丘上漫步。

sentences.en: We hiked along the rugged coastline all morning.
sentences.zh: 我們整個早上沿著崎嶇的海岸線健行。

sentences.en: Is the trail to the lake very rugged?
sentences.zh: 通往湖邊的步道很崎嶇嗎？

sentences.en: He had a rugged face and a warm smile.
sentences.zh: 他有一張粗獷的臉和溫暖的笑容。

sentences.en: The rugged hills made the drive slow.
sentences.zh: 崎嶇的丘陵讓開車的速度變慢了。

sentences.en: Would you rather stay in a rugged cabin or a hotel?
sentences.zh: 你比較想住粗獷風的小木屋還是飯店？

sentences.en: The rugged mountains are a popular spot for photographers.
sentences.zh: 崎嶇的群山是攝影師愛去的地點。

gloss_note: rustic bread 鄉村麵包；鄉村風裝潢

sentences.en: The bakery sells rustic bread with a thick crust.
sentences.zh: 這家烘焙坊賣外皮厚實的鄉村麵包。

sentences.en: Do you like the rustic decor in this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡這家餐廳的鄉村風裝潢嗎？

sentences.en: We had dinner in a rustic farmhouse near the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊一間質樸的農舍吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Can I get the rustic tomato soup with bread?
sentences.zh: 我可以點鄉村風番茄湯配麵包嗎？

sentences.en: The chef makes a rustic apple tart with no frills.
sentences.zh: 主廚做了一款沒有花俏裝飾的質樸蘋果塔。

sentences.en: Her kitchen has rustic wooden tables and shelves.
sentences.zh: 她的廚房有質樸的木桌和木架。

sentences.en: The movie's villain is a ruthless businessman.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的反派是個冷酷無情的商人。

sentences.en: Is it ruthless to fire someone by email?
sentences.zh: 用電子郵件開除人是不是太無情了？

sentences.en: In the nature documentary, the lion looked ruthless.
sentences.zh: 在自然紀錄片裡，那隻獅子看起來冷酷無情。

sentences.en: Our rival was ruthless in the final minutes of the game.
sentences.zh: 對手在比賽最後幾分鐘毫不留情。

sentences.en: Why are some bosses so ruthless about deadlines?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些老闆對截止日期這麼冷酷？

sentences.en: Business can be ruthless when two big stores compete.
sentences.zh: 兩家大型商店競爭時，商場可能很無情。

gloss_note: 西部片常見的老式酒館

sentences.en: The cowboy pushed open the swinging doors of the saloon.
sentences.zh: 牛仔推開了酒館的彈簧門。

sentences.en: Is that old saloon in the movie a real place?
sentences.zh: 電影裡那間老酒館是真實存在的嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists love the saloon in this old mining town.
sentences.zh: 遊客很愛這個老礦鎮裡的酒館。

sentences.en: The saloon was decorated like a scene from a western.
sentences.zh: 這間酒館布置得像西部片裡的場景。

sentences.en: What is the story behind this saloon's piano?
sentences.zh: 這間酒館的鋼琴背後有什麼故事？

sentences.en: We had burgers at a saloon with a wooden floor.
sentences.zh: 我們在一間木地板的酒館吃漢堡。

gloss_note: salted butter 有鹽奶油；鹹焦糖

sentences.en: Do you use salted or unsalted butter for baking?
sentences.zh: 你烘焙時用有鹽還是無鹽奶油？

sentences.en: I'll have the salted caramel ice cream, please.
sentences.zh: 請給我鹹焦糖冰淇淋。

sentences.en: A bag of salted peanuts costs two dollars.
sentences.zh: 一包鹽味花生兩美元。

sentences.en: These salted crackers go well with soup.
sentences.zh: 這些鹹餅乾很適合配湯。

sentences.en: Is the salted fish too strong for kids?
sentences.zh: 這道鹹魚對小孩來說會不會太重口味？

sentences.en: She put a pat of salted butter on the corn.
sentences.zh: 她在玉米上放了一小塊有鹽奶油。

gloss_note: salute the flag 向國旗敬禮

sentences.en: The soldier gave a sharp salute to the officer.
sentences.zh: 士兵向長官敬了一個俐落的禮。

sentences.en: Do students salute the teacher in some countries?
sentences.zh: 在有些國家，學生會向老師敬禮嗎？

sentences.en: We raised our glasses to salute the winners.
sentences.zh: 我們舉杯向得獎者致敬。

sentences.en: The crowd stood to salute the retiring coach.
sentences.zh: 群眾起立向即將退休的教練致敬。

sentences.en: Should I salute when the flag passes by?
sentences.zh: 國旗經過時我應該敬禮嗎？

sentences.en: This film is a salute to nurses everywhere.
sentences.zh: 這部電影是向各地護理師致敬的作品。

sentences.en: Good sanitation keeps the whole neighborhood healthy.
sentences.zh: 良好的環境衛生讓整個社區保持健康。

sentences.en: Does this village have clean water and sanitation?
sentences.zh: 這個村莊有乾淨的水和衛生設施嗎？

sentences.en: The city hired more sanitation workers last year.
sentences.zh: 去年市政府多聘了一些清潔人員。

sentences.en: Sanitation is the first thing inspectors check in a kitchen.
sentences.zh: 衛生檢查員在廚房最先檢查的就是環境衛生。

sentences.en: How can schools improve sanitation in the restrooms?
sentences.zh: 學校要怎麼改善廁所的衛生？

sentences.en: A sanitation truck comes down our street every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 每週二垃圾車都會開過我們這條街。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: I'd like my hot dog with mustard and sauerkraut.
sentences.zh: 我的熱狗要加黃芥末和德國酸菜。

sentences.en: Does this sandwich come with sauerkraut?
sentences.zh: 這個三明治有附德國酸菜嗎？

sentences.en: Sauerkraut is just cabbage that has been fermented.
sentences.zh: 德國酸菜其實就是發酵過的高麗菜。

sentences.en: My grandmother makes sauerkraut in a big jar.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶用大玻璃罐自己醃德國酸菜。

sentences.en: Why does sauerkraut taste so sour?
sentences.zh: 德國酸菜為什麼這麼酸？

sentences.en: The sausages were served with warm sauerkraut and potatoes.
sentences.zh: 香腸搭配溫熱的德國酸菜和馬鈴薯上桌。

sentences.en: The tiger in the documentary looked wild and savage.
sentences.zh: 紀錄片裡的老虎看起來野性又凶猛。

sentences.en: Is that dog really as savage as people say?
sentences.zh: 那隻狗真的像大家說的那麼凶猛嗎？

sentences.en: The critic wrote a savage review of the movie.
sentences.zh: 影評人對這部電影寫了一篇猛烈的批評。

sentences.en: Why was the coach's speech so savage after the loss?
sentences.zh: 輸球後，教練的訓話為什麼那麼猛烈？

sentences.en: In the movie, the bear gave a savage roar.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，那頭熊發出凶猛的吼叫。

sentences.en: In the old story, a savage beast lived in the forest.
sentences.zh: 在古老的故事裡，森林裡住著一頭凶猛的野獸。

sentences.en: The chef cooked the scallops in garlic butter.
sentences.zh: 主廚用蒜味奶油煎了干貝。

sentences.en: Can I add scallops to my pasta?
sentences.zh: 我的義大利麵可以加干貝嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh scallops are sweet and a little salty.
sentences.zh: 新鮮干貝甜甜的，帶點鹹味。

sentences.en: Are the scallops on the menu wild or farmed?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的干貝是野生的還是養殖的？

sentences.en: We found a pretty scallop shell on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海灘上撿到一個漂亮的扇貝殼。

sentences.en: My wife ordered the scallop salad as an appetizer.
sentences.zh: 我太太點了干貝沙拉當開胃菜。

gloss_note: scenic route 風景優美的路線

sentences.en: Let's take the scenic route along the river.
sentences.zh: 我們走沿著河邊那條風景優美的路吧。

sentences.en: Is there a scenic spot near your hotel?
sentences.zh: 你的飯店附近有風景優美的地方嗎？

sentences.en: The scenic view from the balcony was amazing.
sentences.zh: 從陽台看出去的風景美極了。

sentences.en: We took a scenic train ride through the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我們搭了一趟穿越群山的景觀列車。

sentences.en: Which scenic trail do you recommend for beginners?
sentences.zh: 你推薦哪一條風景優美的步道給初學者？

sentences.en: This scenic town gets thousands of visitors each fall.
sentences.zh: 這個風景如畫的小鎮每年秋天都吸引上千名遊客。

gloss_note: 美式多為烘焙坊點心，常見藍莓口味；英式配奶油果醬

sentences.en: I'll have a blueberry scone and a coffee.
sentences.zh: 我要一個藍莓司康和一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: Do you sell scones in the morning only?
sentences.zh: 你們司康只有早上賣嗎？

sentences.en: She baked a pan of warm scones for brunch.
sentences.zh: 她為早午餐烤了一盤熱騰騰的司康。

sentences.en: Why is this scone so dry?
sentences.zh: 這個司康怎麼這麼乾？

sentences.en: Jam and butter taste great on a fresh scone.
sentences.zh: 果醬和奶油抹在新鮮司康上超好吃。

sentences.en: The café's cheese scone sells out by nine.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡店的起司司康九點前就賣完了。

gloss_note: treat with scorn 以輕蔑態度對待

sentences.en: He looked at the old car with scorn.
sentences.zh: 他輕蔑地看著那輛舊車。

sentences.en: Why do some people pour scorn on new ideas?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人老愛鄙視新點子？

sentences.en: She scorned the idea of cheating on the test.
sentences.zh: 她對考試作弊的想法嗤之以鼻。

sentences.en: Do you scorn people who don't like sports?
sentences.zh: 你會瞧不起不愛運動的人嗎？

sentences.en: The critics treated the film with scorn.
sentences.zh: 影評人對這部電影不屑一顧。

sentences.en: His words were full of scorn.
sentences.zh: 他的話滿是輕蔑。

sentences.en: The restaurant serves Scottish salmon with lemon.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應搭配檸檬的蘇格蘭鮭魚。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried Scottish shortbread?
sentences.zh: 你吃過蘇格蘭奶油酥餅嗎？

sentences.en: This Scottish oatmeal is creamy and a little nutty.
sentences.zh: 這款蘇格蘭燕麥粥綿滑又帶點堅果香。

sentences.en: Is the soup on the menu a Scottish recipe?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的湯是蘇格蘭食譜嗎？

sentences.en: Our host cooked a Scottish breakfast with eggs and sausage.
sentences.zh: 主人煮了一份有蛋和香腸的蘇格蘭早餐。

sentences.en: Which Scottish dessert would you recommend?
sentences.zh: 你會推薦哪一道蘇格蘭甜點？

gloss_note: scrape off 刮掉；膝蓋擦傷

sentences.en: Scrape the burnt bits off the bottom of the pan.
sentences.zh: 把鍋底燒焦的部分刮掉。

sentences.en: I scraped my knee when I fell off my bike.
sentences.zh: 我從腳踏車上摔下來時擦傷了膝蓋。

sentences.en: Do you have a tool to scrape the ice off the windshield?
sentences.zh: 你有工具可以刮掉擋風玻璃上的冰嗎？

sentences.en: It's only a scrape, so you don't need stitches.
sentences.zh: 只是擦傷而已，不用縫針。

sentences.en: Why did you scrape the paint off the door?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把門上的油漆刮掉？

sentences.en: The cat scraped its claws against the sofa.
sentences.zh: 貓用爪子刮著沙發。

gloss_note: flat-head 一字起子；十字起子

sentences.en: Hand me the screwdriver from the toolbox, please.
sentences.zh: 請把工具箱裡的螺絲起子遞給我。

sentences.en: Do you have a small screwdriver for my glasses?
sentences.zh: 你有小螺絲起子可以修我的眼鏡嗎？

sentences.en: I need a screwdriver to open the battery cover.
sentences.zh: 我需要螺絲起子才能打開電池蓋。

sentences.en: Which screwdriver fits this cabinet hinge?
sentences.zh: 哪一支螺絲起子適合這個櫥櫃的鉸鏈？

sentences.en: He tightened the loose handle with a screwdriver.
sentences.zh: 他用螺絲起子把鬆掉的把手鎖緊。

sentences.en: Where did I leave my screwdriver this time?
sentences.zh: 這次我又把螺絲起子放哪了？

gloss_note: sculptor 常用石頭、黏土創作

sentences.en: The sculptor carved a horse from a block of marble.
sentences.zh: 雕刻家用一塊大理石雕出一匹馬。

sentences.en: Is your neighbor a sculptor or a painter?
sentences.zh: 你的鄰居是雕刻家還是畫家？

sentences.en: A famous sculptor will visit our art class today.
sentences.zh: 一位著名的雕刻家今天會來我們的美術課。

sentences.en: Which sculptor made the statue in the park?
sentences.zh: 公園裡那座雕像是哪位雕塑家做的？

sentences.en: She dreamed of becoming a sculptor as a child.
sentences.zh: 她小時候夢想成為雕塑家。

sentences.en: The sculptor spent three years finishing the fountain.
sentences.zh: 雕塑家花了三年完成這座噴泉。

sentences.en: A seagull stole a fry from my tray.
sentences.zh: 一隻海鷗從我的餐盤裡偷走了一根薯條。

sentences.en: Do seagulls live near lakes too?
sentences.zh: 海鷗也住在湖邊嗎？

sentences.en: The seagull circled above the fishing boat.
sentences.zh: 海鷗在漁船上空盤旋。

sentences.en: Why is that seagull following us?
sentences.zh: 那隻海鷗為什麼一直跟著我們？

sentences.en: Don't feed the seagulls on the pier.
sentences.zh: 不要在碼頭餵海鷗。

sentences.en: We watched a seagull land on the roof of the café.
sentences.zh: 我們看著一隻海鷗停在咖啡店的屋頂上。

gloss_note: sear the steak 煎牛排表面

sentences.en: Sear the steak for two minutes on each side.
sentences.zh: 牛排每面用大火煎兩分鐘。

sentences.en: How long should I sear the tuna?
sentences.zh: 鮪魚要用大火煎多久？

sentences.en: The chef seared the pork until it was brown.
sentences.zh: 主廚把豬肉大火煎到表面上色。

sentences.en: Do you sear the meat before it goes in the oven?
sentences.zh: 你會先把肉煎封再放進烤箱嗎？

sentences.en: Heat the pan first so you can sear the chicken properly.
sentences.zh: 先把鍋子燒熱，才能好好把雞肉表面煎封。

sentences.en: I always sear mushrooms in a very hot pan.
sentences.zh: 我總是用很燙的鍋子把蘑菇煎出焦香。

sentences.en: Add a little more seasoning to the soup.
sentences.zh: 在湯裡再多加一點調味料。

sentences.en: What seasoning do you put on your popcorn?
sentences.zh: 你的爆米花都撒什麼調味料？

sentences.en: This seasoning has garlic, pepper, and dried herbs.
sentences.zh: 這款調味料含有大蒜、胡椒和乾燥香草。

sentences.en: Does the chicken need more seasoning?
sentences.zh: 這雞肉需要再多調味嗎？

sentences.en: Taco seasoning makes the beef taste much better.
sentences.zh: 塔可調味粉讓牛肉好吃很多。

sentences.en: I forgot to buy seasoning at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我忘了在雜貨店買調味料。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 四門轎車；租車常見車型

sentences.en: I'd like to rent a sedan for three days.
sentences.zh: 我想租一輛轎車三天。

sentences.en: Is a sedan big enough for five people?
sentences.zh: 轎車夠坐五個人嗎？

sentences.en: The rental company has one sedan left.
sentences.zh: 租車公司只剩一輛轎車了。

sentences.en: Their new sedan gets great gas mileage.
sentences.zh: 他們的新轎車很省油。

sentences.en: Do you want a sedan or a pickup truck?
sentences.zh: 你要轎車還是小貨卡？

sentences.en: A silver sedan was parked outside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 一輛銀色轎車停在飯店外面。

sentences.en: The lake looked serene in the early morning.
sentences.zh: 清晨的湖面看起來寧靜平和。

sentences.en: Is there a more serene spot to read around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有沒有更安靜的地方可以看書？

sentences.en: She had a serene smile on her face.
sentences.zh: 她臉上帶著安詳的微笑。

sentences.en: How can you stay so serene before a big exam?
sentences.zh: 大考前你怎麼能這麼平靜安詳？

sentences.en: The garden was serene after the rain stopped.
sentences.zh: 雨停之後，花園一片寧靜。

sentences.en: Our hotel room has a serene view of the hills.
sentences.zh: 我們的飯店房間可以看到寧靜的山景。

sentences.en: The sergeant told the new recruits to line up.
sentences.zh: 中士要新兵排成一列。

sentences.en: Is the sergeant in the movie played by a famous actor?
sentences.zh: 電影裡那位中士是由有名的演員飾演的嗎？

sentences.en: A police sergeant spoke to our class about safety.
sentences.zh: 一位警察小隊長來我們班上談安全。

sentences.en: Who is the sergeant in charge of this shift?
sentences.zh: 這個班次由哪位小隊長負責？

sentences.en: My grandfather retired as an army sergeant.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺以陸軍中士的身分退役。

sentences.en: The sergeant shouted orders across the field.
sentences.zh: 中士在操場上大聲下達命令。

gloss_note: give a sermon 講道；長篇說教

sentences.en: The pastor gave a short sermon on kindness.
sentences.zh: 牧師做了一場關於善意的簡短講道。

sentences.en: Please don't give me another sermon about homework.
sentences.zh: 拜託別再對我長篇說教功課的事了。

sentences.en: Was the sermon at the wedding too long?
sentences.zh: 婚禮上的講道是不是太長了？

sentences.en: My dad gave me a sermon about saving money.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸對我長篇說教了一番，要我存錢。

sentences.en: Did you listen to the whole sermon?
sentences.zh: 你有把整場講道聽完嗎？

sentences.en: Her speech sounded more like a sermon than a lesson.
sentences.zh: 她的演說聽起來比較像說教，不像上課。

gloss_note: sesame seeds 芝麻；sesame oil 麻油

sentences.en: Sprinkle sesame seeds on the noodles before serving.
sentences.zh: 上菜前在麵上撒些芝麻。

sentences.en: Is there sesame in this sauce? I'm allergic.
sentences.zh: 這個醬料裡有芝麻嗎？我會過敏。

sentences.en: The bagel is topped with sesame and salt.
sentences.zh: 這個貝果上面撒了芝麻和鹽。

sentences.en: Do you want sesame or plain bread for your sandwich?
sentences.zh: 你的三明治要芝麻麵包還是原味麵包？

sentences.en: A drop of sesame oil gives the soup a nutty smell.
sentences.zh: 幾滴芝麻油讓湯有股堅果香。

sentences.en: Should I put sesame oil in the dressing?
sentences.zh: 我該在醬汁裡加芝麻油嗎？

audio.artist:
Speaker: The Editor's Apprentice
Recorder: The Editor's Apprentice

gloss_note: suffer a setback 遭遇挫折

sentences.en: The injury was a big setback for the team.
sentences.zh: 這次受傷對球隊是個大挫折。

sentences.en: Did the delay cause a major setback for the project?
sentences.zh: 這次延誤對計畫造成重大阻礙了嗎？

sentences.en: Don't let one setback stop you from trying again.
sentences.zh: 別讓一次挫折阻止你再試一次。

sentences.en: We faced a setback when the supplier closed.
sentences.zh: 供應商歇業時，我們遇上了挫折。

sentences.en: What was your biggest setback this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年最大的挫折是什麼？

sentences.en: Her recovery had a small setback last week.
sentences.zh: 她的康復上週遇到了一點小挫折。

sentences.en: The hotel room was clean but a little shabby.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間很乾淨，但有點破舊。

sentences.en: Why does the sofa look so shabby?
sentences.zh: 這張沙發怎麼看起來這麼破舊？

sentences.en: He wore a shabby coat to the job interview.
sentences.zh: 他穿著一件寒酸的外套去面試。

sentences.en: Is it rude to give such a shabby gift?
sentences.zh: 送這麼寒酸的禮物是不是很失禮？

sentences.en: The old shop on the corner looks shabby but sells great pie.
sentences.zh: 轉角的老店看起來破舊，派卻很好吃。

sentences.en: They hung a shabby curtain over the window.
sentences.zh: 他們在窗戶上掛了一片破舊的窗簾。

sentences.en: We ate fresh crab at a shack on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海灘邊的小吃店吃了新鮮螃蟹。

sentences.en: Is that shack on the pier open all year?
sentences.zh: 碼頭邊那間小吃店全年都有營業嗎？

sentences.en: The best fish tacos come from a little taco shack.
sentences.zh: 最好吃的魚肉塔可來自一間小小的塔可店。

sentences.en: His grandfather built a wooden shack by the river.
sentences.zh: 他爺爺在河邊蓋了一間木造簡陋小屋。

sentences.en: Which shack has the best clam chowder?
sentences.zh: 哪間小吃店的蛤蜊巧達濃湯最好喝？

sentences.en: A tiny shack stood at the end of the dirt road.
sentences.zh: 土路的盡頭有一間小小的簡陋小屋。

sentences.en: Can you sharpen this pencil for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我削這支鉛筆嗎？

sentences.en: He sharpens his knives before every dinner service.
sentences.zh: 他每次晚餐營業前都會磨刀。

sentences.en: These old scissors need to be sharpened.
sentences.zh: 這把舊剪刀需要磨一磨了。

sentences.en: How often should you sharpen kitchen knives?
sentences.zh: 廚房刀具應該多久磨一次？

sentences.en: This class will sharpen your writing skills.
sentences.zh: 這門課會磨練你的寫作技巧。

sentences.en: Do you practice daily to sharpen your skills?
sentences.zh: 你每天都練習來磨練自己的技能嗎？

sentences.en: Is my electric shaver still in the bathroom drawer?
sentences.zh: 我的電動刮鬍刀還在浴室的抽屜裡嗎？

sentences.en: My dad got a new shaver for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 我爸生日時收到一支新的刮鬍刀。

sentences.en: This shaver works well on sensitive skin.
sentences.zh: 這支刮鬍刀用在敏感肌膚上很好用。

sentences.en: Do you know where I can charge my shaver?
sentences.zh: 你知道我可以在哪裡幫刮鬍刀充電嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel bathroom has an outlet just for a shaver.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店的浴室有一個刮鬍刀專用的插座。

sentences.en: I forgot to pack my shaver for the business trip.
sentences.zh: 我出差時忘了帶刮鬍刀。

gloss_note: overcome a shortcoming 克服缺點

sentences.en: Everyone has shortcomings, and mine is being late.
sentences.zh: 每個人都有缺點，而我的缺點就是會遲到。

sentences.en: What is the biggest shortcoming of this plan?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫最大的缺點是什麼？

sentences.en: Her only shortcoming is that she talks too fast.
sentences.zh: 她唯一的缺點就是講話太快。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about a shortcoming you have overcome?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我說說你克服過的一項缺點嗎？

sentences.en: The report points out several shortcomings in the old system.
sentences.zh: 報告指出舊系統有好幾項缺點。

sentences.en: He knows his shortcomings and works hard to improve.
sentences.zh: 他清楚自己的缺點，並且努力改進。

sentences.en: Cutting the training budget was a shortsighted decision.
sentences.zh: 削減培訓預算是個短視的決定。

sentences.en: Isn't it shortsighted to ignore long-term costs?
sentences.zh: 忽略長期成本不是很短視嗎？

sentences.en: Don't be shortsighted; think about next year too.
sentences.zh: 別目光短淺，也要想想明年。

sentences.en: Why would the council make such a shortsighted choice?
sentences.zh: 市議會為什麼會做出這麼短視的選擇？

sentences.en: Some people think saving money on repairs is shortsighted.
sentences.zh: 有些人認為在維修上省錢是短視的做法。

sentences.en: The coach called the trade shortsighted.
sentences.zh: 教練說這筆交易很短視。

gloss_note: shred paper 碎紙；撕碎紙張

sentences.en: Please shred these old documents before you go home.
sentences.zh: 下班回家前，請把這些舊文件碎紙處理掉。

sentences.en: Did the puppy shred your homework again?
sentences.zh: 小狗又把你的作業撕爛了嗎？

sentences.en: The wind left shreds of paper all over the yard.
sentences.zh: 風把碎紙片吹得滿院子都是。

sentences.en: Can you help me shred these old receipts?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這些舊收據用碎紙機絞碎嗎？

sentences.en: He tore the letter to shreds and threw it away.
sentences.zh: 他把信撕成碎片，然後丟掉了。

sentences.en: The cat shredded the new curtains in one afternoon.
sentences.zh: 貓一個下午就把新窗簾撕爛了。

gloss_note: shriek with laughter 尖聲大笑

sentences.en: Did you hear that shriek from the next room?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到隔壁房間傳來的那聲尖叫嗎？

sentences.en: The children shrieked with joy at the water park.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在水上樂園開心地尖叫。

sentences.en: Why did she shriek when she saw the spider?
sentences.zh: 她看到蜘蛛為什麼尖叫？

sentences.en: A shriek came from the haunted house at the fair.
sentences.zh: 園遊會的鬼屋裡傳出一聲尖叫。

sentences.en: Don't shriek; the baby is finally asleep.
sentences.zh: 別尖叫，寶寶好不容易睡著了。

sentences.en: The audience shrieked as the movie monster appeared.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的怪物出現時，觀眾都尖叫起來。

gloss_note: trim a shrub 修剪灌木

sentences.en: We planted a few shrubs along the front fence.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著前院的籬笆種了幾株灌木。

sentences.en: Could you trim the shrub next to the garage?
sentences.zh: 你可以修剪車庫旁邊那叢灌木嗎？

sentences.en: Which shrub grows best in the shade?
sentences.zh: 哪種灌木在陰涼處長得最好？

sentences.en: A small bird hid in the shrub by the window.
sentences.zh: 一隻小鳥躲在窗邊的灌木叢裡。

sentences.en: Shrubs are shorter than trees and have many stems.
sentences.zh: 灌木比樹矮，而且有許多枝幹。

sentences.en: The garden center has a sale on flowering shrubs.
sentences.zh: 園藝中心的開花灌木正在特價。

sentences.en: Can you shuffle the cards before we start?
sentences.zh: 開始前你可以先洗牌嗎？

sentences.en: Who shuffled the deck this time?
sentences.zh: 這次是誰洗牌的？

sentences.en: Shuffle the cards well so nobody can guess.
sentences.zh: 把牌洗均勻，這樣就沒人猜得到了。

sentences.en: My grandpa taught me how to shuffle cards like a pro.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺教我怎麼像高手一樣洗牌。

sentences.en: Do I need to shuffle again, or is that enough?
sentences.zh: 我需要再洗一次牌，還是這樣就夠了？

sentences.en: She shuffled the deck and dealt five cards to each player.
sentences.zh: 她洗好牌，發給每位玩家五張牌。

sentences.en: Please close the shutters; the afternoon sun is too bright.
sentences.zh: 請把百葉窗關上，下午的太陽太刺眼了。

sentences.en: Could you open the shutters in the living room?
sentences.zh: 你可以把客廳的百葉窗打開嗎？

sentences.en: The shutters on the old farmhouse are painted green.
sentences.zh: 那棟老農舍的百葉窗漆成綠色。

sentences.en: Press the shutter button halfway to focus first.
sentences.zh: 先半按快門鈕對焦。

sentences.en: Why is the shutter so slow on this camera?
sentences.zh: 這台相機的快門為什麼這麼慢？

sentences.en: Did you hear the shutter click when I took that photo?
sentences.zh: 我拍那張照片時，你有聽到快門聲嗎？

gloss_note: Sicilian pizza 西西里披薩（方形厚底）

sentences.en: We ordered a Sicilian pizza with thick, square slices.
sentences.zh: 我們點了一個切成厚實方塊的西西里披薩。

sentences.en: Do you want a Sicilian-style pizza or a thin crust?
sentences.zh: 你要西西里風味的披薩，還是薄皮披薩？

sentences.en: This Sicilian eggplant dish is my favorite on the menu.
sentences.zh: 這道西西里茄子料理是菜單上我最愛的一道。

sentences.en: Is the Sicilian lemon cake sold by the slice?
sentences.zh: 西西里檸檬蛋糕有單片賣嗎？

sentences.en: The chef makes a Sicilian tomato sauce with fresh basil.
sentences.zh: 主廚用新鮮羅勒做西西里風味的番茄醬。

sentences.en: The restaurant is known for its Sicilian seafood pasta.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以西西里風味的海鮮義大利麵聞名。

sentences.en: Two simultaneous meetings made my schedule a mess.
sentences.zh: 兩場同時舉行的會議把我的行程弄得一團亂。

sentences.en: Are the two events simultaneous, or does one start first?
sentences.zh: 這兩個活動是同時進行的，還是其中一個先開始？

sentences.en: She works as a simultaneous interpreter at conferences.
sentences.zh: 她在研討會上擔任同步口譯員。

sentences.en: The concert was also aired as a simultaneous radio broadcast.
sentences.zh: 這場演唱會也同步透過廣播播出。

sentences.en: Can the system handle simultaneous requests from many users?
sentences.zh: 系統能處理許多使用者同時送出的要求嗎？

sentences.en: The simultaneous release of both movies surprised fans.
sentences.zh: 兩部電影同步上映讓影迷很驚訝。

sentences.en: What does this slang word mean?
sentences.zh: 這個俚語是什麼意思？

sentences.en: My teacher doesn't like it when we use slang in essays.
sentences.zh: 老師不喜歡我們在作文裡用俚語。

sentences.en: Teenagers invent new slang all the time.
sentences.zh: 青少年總是在創造新的俚語。

sentences.en: Is that slang, or can I use it in a formal email?
sentences.zh: 那是俚語嗎？還是我可以用在正式的電子郵件裡？

sentences.en: I picked up some American slang from my coworkers.
sentences.zh: 我從同事那裡學到一些美式俚語。

sentences.en: The dictionary lists many slang terms from the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 這本字典收錄了許多1990年代的俚語。

sentences.en: The farm sends its older cattle to slaughter each fall.
sentences.zh: 農場每年秋天都把年老的牛隻送去屠宰。

sentences.en: Is it legal to slaughter animals at home?
sentences.zh: 在家自行屠宰動物合法嗎？

sentences.en: Inspectors visit the slaughterhouse every month.
sentences.zh: 檢查員每個月都會去屠宰場。

sentences.en: The news report condemned the slaughter of civilians.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導譴責對平民的屠殺。

sentences.en: Why did the country ban the slaughter of whales?
sentences.zh: 這個國家為什麼禁止屠殺鯨魚？

sentences.en: The family slaughtered a pig for the New Year feast.
sentences.zh: 這家人宰了一頭豬，準備過年的大餐。

gloss_note: slew/slain 為過去式與過去分詞

sentences.en: The hero slew the dragon and saved the village.
sentences.zh: 英雄殺死了那條龍，拯救了村莊。

sentences.en: In the legend, a young knight must slay a sea monster.
sentences.zh: 傳說中，一名年輕騎士必須斬殺海怪。

sentences.en: Did the prince really slay the giant in the story?
sentences.zh: 故事裡，王子真的殺死了那個巨人嗎？

sentences.en: Which hero slays the beast in this old tale?
sentences.zh: 這個古老的故事裡，是哪位英雄殺死了野獸？

sentences.en: The poem tells how the king was slain in battle.
sentences.zh: 這首詩講述國王如何在戰場上被殺。

sentences.en: How did the brave tailor slay the giant in the fairy tale?
sentences.zh: 在童話故事裡，勇敢的裁縫是怎麼殺死巨人的？

sentences.en: Your report is sloppy; there are typos on every page.
sentences.zh: 你的報告太草率了，每一頁都有錯字。

sentences.en: Why is your handwriting so sloppy today?
sentences.zh: 你今天的字為什麼這麼潦草？

sentences.en: Don't be sloppy when you check the numbers.
sentences.zh: 核對數字的時候別馬虎。

sentences.en: He looks sloppy in that wrinkled shirt.
sentences.zh: 他穿那件皺巴巴的襯衫看起來很邋遢。

sentences.en: Would a sloppy job like this pass the inspection?
sentences.zh: 這樣馬虎的工作能通過檢查嗎？

sentences.en: The coach was angry about the team's sloppy play.
sentences.zh: 教練對球隊馬虎的表現很生氣。

sentences.en: The documentary explores life in a large city slum.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片探討大城市貧民窟裡的生活。

sentences.en: Many families in the slum lack clean running water.
sentences.zh: 貧民窟裡有許多家庭缺乏乾淨的自來水。

sentences.en: Did the city build new housing to replace the slum?
sentences.zh: 市政府有蓋新住宅來取代那片貧民窟嗎？

sentences.en: The volunteers teach reading classes in a slum neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 志工在貧民窟的社區裡教閱讀課。

sentences.en: How can a government improve conditions in a slum?
sentences.zh: 政府要怎麼改善貧民窟的環境？

sentences.en: The old novel is set in a crowded slum.
sentences.zh: 這本舊小說以一個擁擠的貧民窟為背景。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: a sly smile 狡黠的微笑

sentences.en: The fox in the story is sly and clever.
sentences.zh: 故事裡的狐狸既狡猾又聰明。

sentences.en: She gave me a sly smile and said nothing.
sentences.zh: 她對我露出狡黠的微笑，什麼也沒說。

sentences.en: Is your cat always this sly when it wants food?
sentences.zh: 你的貓想吃東西的時候都這麼狡猾嗎？

sentences.en: Don't trust a sly salesman who hides the fees.
sentences.zh: 別相信那種把費用藏起來的狡猾業務員。

sentences.en: What sly trick did he use to win the game?
sentences.zh: 他用了什麼狡猾的招數贏了比賽？

sentences.en: The sly merchant sold the same cheap watch to three people.
sentences.zh: 那個狡猾的商人把同一只便宜手錶賣給三個人。

sentences.en: Does this smartphone come with a charger?
sentences.zh: 這支智慧型手機有附充電器嗎？

sentences.en: I use my smartphone to check my calendar.
sentences.zh: 我用智慧型手機查看行事曆。

sentences.en: The store is running a sale on smartphones this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這家店這個週末智慧型手機特價。

sentences.en: Can I pay with my smartphone at this register?
sentences.zh: 我可以在這個收銀台用智慧型手機付款嗎？

sentences.en: Please silence your smartphone during the presentation.
sentences.zh: 簡報期間，請把你的智慧型手機轉成靜音。

sentences.en: My smartphone battery dies by the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我的智慧型手機電池到下午就沒電了。

sentences.en: Can I get a strawberry smoothie, please?
sentences.zh: 我可以點一杯草莓果昔嗎？

sentences.en: This smoothie has banana, spinach, and yogurt in it.
sentences.zh: 這杯果昔裡有香蕉、菠菜和優格。

sentences.en: Do you want a small or large smoothie?
sentences.zh: 你要小杯還是大杯的果昔？

sentences.en: I make a smoothie for breakfast every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上都做一杯果昔當早餐。

sentences.en: The coffee shop on the corner sells a great mango smoothie.
sentences.zh: 街角那家咖啡店的芒果果昔很好喝。

sentences.en: Add some ice to the blender to make the smoothie thicker.
sentences.zh: 在果汁機裡加點冰塊，果昔會更濃稠。

sentences.en: These sneakers are comfortable enough to walk in all day.
sentences.zh: 這雙球鞋舒服到可以穿著走一整天。

sentences.en: Do you have these sneakers in a size nine?
sentences.zh: 這雙球鞋有九號的嗎？

sentences.en: I need new sneakers for gym class.
sentences.zh: 我需要買雙新球鞋來上體育課。

sentences.en: Where did you buy your white sneakers?
sentences.zh: 你的白色球鞋是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: Employees can wear sneakers to work on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 員工星期五可以穿球鞋上班。

sentences.en: One of my sneakers came untied, so I stopped to tie it.
sentences.zh: 我有一隻球鞋的鞋帶鬆了，所以停下來綁好。

sentences.en: My roommate snores so loudly that I can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我室友打呼打得太大聲，害我睡不著。

sentences.en: Do I snore when I sleep on my back?
sentences.zh: 我仰睡的時候會打呼嗎？

sentences.en: He started to snore ten minutes after the movie began.
sentences.zh: 電影開始十分鐘後，他就打起呼來。

sentences.en: Is there anything that helps people stop snoring?
sentences.zh: 有什麼方法可以幫助人不再打呼嗎？

sentences.en: I could hear his snore through the thin wall.
sentences.zh: 隔著薄薄的牆，我都聽得到他的鼾聲。

sentences.en: The dog's loud snore made everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 狗大聲的鼾聲逗得大家哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: This snug corner booth is perfect on a cold day.
sentences.zh: 在寒冷的日子裡，這個舒適溫暖的角落卡座再適合不過了。

sentences.en: The café is small and snug, with a warm fireplace.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡店小小的，溫暖又舒適，還有一個暖烘烘的壁爐。

sentences.en: Is this sweater too snug around the shoulders?
sentences.zh: 這件毛衣的肩膀部分是不是太貼身了？

sentences.en: We stayed snug in the cabin while it snowed outside.
sentences.zh: 外面下著雪，我們待在小木屋裡暖呼呼的。

sentences.en: Do you want a snug seat by the window or a big table?
sentences.zh: 你想坐靠窗的舒適小座位，還是大桌？

sentences.en: The jeans fit a little snug, but I like them.
sentences.zh: 這條牛仔褲穿起來有點貼身，但我很喜歡。

gloss_note: a sociable person 好相處的人

sentences.en: My neighbor is sociable and knows everyone on our street.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居很好交際，我們這條街上每個人他都認識。

sentences.en: Are you sociable, or do you prefer staying home?
sentences.zh: 你是愛交際的人，還是比較喜歡待在家？

sentences.en: She isn't very sociable at big parties.
sentences.zh: 她在大型派對上不太合群。

sentences.en: Our new coworker is friendly and sociable.
sentences.zh: 我們的新同事很友善，也很好相處。

sentences.en: Why is your dog so sociable with strangers?
sentences.zh: 你的狗為什麼這麼愛跟陌生人打交道？

sentences.en: A sociable host makes every guest feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 擅長交際的主人會讓每位客人都覺得受歡迎。

sentences.en: Today our history teacher introduced the idea of socialism.
sentences.zh: 今天歷史老師介紹了社會主義的概念。

sentences.en: How did socialism spread in Europe in the 1800s?
sentences.zh: 社會主義在1800年代是怎麼在歐洲傳開的？

sentences.en: Socialism is an economic idea that stresses shared ownership.
sentences.zh: 社會主義是一種強調共同所有權的經濟思想。

sentences.en: Can you explain the difference between socialism and capitalism?
sentences.zh: 你能解釋社會主義和資本主義的差別嗎？

sentences.en: Our textbook has a chapter on the history of socialism.
sentences.zh: 我們的課本有一章在談社會主義的歷史。

sentences.en: Students wrote essays about socialism for social studies class.
sentences.zh: 學生們為社會課寫了關於社會主義的報告。

gloss_note: major in sociology 主修社會學

sentences.en: She is majoring in sociology at a state university.
sentences.zh: 她在州立大學主修社會學。

sentences.en: What does sociology tell us about family life?
sentences.zh: 社會學告訴了我們哪些關於家庭生活的事？

sentences.en: I'm taking an intro sociology class this fall.
sentences.zh: 我這學期要修一門社會學概論。

sentences.en: Does your sociology professor give a lot of reading?
sentences.zh: 你的社會學教授會指定很多閱讀嗎？

sentences.en: Sociology studies how groups of people behave in society.
sentences.zh: 社會學研究人群在社會中的行為。

sentences.en: He wrote a sociology paper on social media habits.
sentences.zh: 他寫了一篇關於社群媒體使用習慣的社會學報告。

gloss_note: a solemn promise 鄭重的承諾

sentences.en: Everyone stood in solemn silence during the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 典禮進行時，大家肅穆地靜靜站著。

sentences.en: Why does he look so solemn today?
sentences.zh: 他今天看起來為什麼這麼嚴肅？

sentences.en: The principal gave a solemn speech at the memorial.
sentences.zh: 校長在追思會上發表了莊嚴的談話。

sentences.en: Did you hear the solemn music at the end of the film?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到電影結尾那段莊嚴的音樂嗎？

sentences.en: She made a solemn promise to visit every week.
sentences.zh: 她鄭重承諾每個星期都會來探望。

sentences.en: The judge's solemn tone told us it was serious.
sentences.zh: 法官嚴肅的語氣讓我們知道事態嚴重。

sentences.en: The neighbors showed solidarity after the storm by helping each other.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，鄰居們互相幫忙，展現了團結。

sentences.en: How can a team build solidarity among its members?
sentences.zh: 球隊要怎麼凝聚成員之間的團結精神？

sentences.en: Students wore blue shirts to show solidarity with their classmate.
sentences.zh: 學生們穿上藍色上衣，表示與同學站在一起。

sentences.en: Is solidarity more important than winning in sports?
sentences.zh: 在運動中，團結比贏得比賽更重要嗎？

sentences.en: The speech called for solidarity between old and new residents.
sentences.zh: 這場演說呼籲新舊居民團結一致。

sentences.en: Our class felt a strong sense of solidarity at graduation.
sentences.zh: 畢業典禮上，我們班感受到強烈的團結感。

gloss_note: a solitary life 孤單的生活

sentences.en: The old man leads a solitary life in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 老先生在山裡過著孤單的生活。

sentences.en: A solitary tree stood in the middle of the field.
sentences.zh: 一棵孤零零的樹立在田野中央。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy solitary walks in the evening?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡在傍晚獨自散步嗎？

sentences.en: Why does she prefer solitary hobbies like reading?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼偏愛閱讀這類獨自進行的嗜好？

sentences.en: I spotted a solitary bird on the roof.
sentences.zh: 我看見屋頂上有一隻孤零零的鳥。

sentences.en: Fishing can be a solitary activity, but I like it.
sentences.zh: 釣魚可以是一項獨自進行的活動，但我很喜歡。

sentences.en: After a busy week, I need some solitude.
sentences.zh: 忙了一整個星期後，我需要一點獨處的時間。

sentences.en: Do you find peace in solitude, or do you feel lonely?
sentences.zh: 你在獨處時會覺得平靜，還是會覺得寂寞？

sentences.en: She walked along the beach and enjoyed the solitude.
sentences.zh: 她沿著海灘散步，享受這份獨處。

sentences.en: The cabin by the lake offers complete solitude.
sentences.zh: 湖邊的小木屋能讓人完全獨處。

sentences.en: Can you work well in solitude?
sentences.zh: 你一個人的時候也能把工作做好嗎？

sentences.en: He lived in solitude for years after retiring.
sentences.zh: 他退休後獨自生活了好幾年。

gloss_note: soothe a sore throat 舒緩喉痛

sentences.en: Warm tea can soothe a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 熱茶可以舒緩喉嚨痛。

sentences.en: How do you soothe a crying baby at night?
sentences.zh: 晚上寶寶哭的時候，你都怎麼安撫他？

sentences.en: The soft music helped soothe my nerves before the test.
sentences.zh: 輕柔的音樂幫我在考試前舒緩了緊張的情緒。

sentences.en: She tried to soothe the angry customer with a smile.
sentences.zh: 她試著用微笑安撫那位生氣的客人。

sentences.en: Does this lotion soothe dry skin?
sentences.zh: 這款乳液能舒緩乾燥的皮膚嗎？

sentences.en: The sound of rain soothes me when I can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 睡不著的時候，雨聲能讓我平靜下來。

gloss_note: a sorrowful look 哀傷的神情

sentences.en: She gave me a sorrowful look as she said goodbye.
sentences.zh: 她道別時，給了我一個哀傷的眼神。

sentences.en: Why is the song so sorrowful?
sentences.zh: 這首歌為什麼這麼悲傷？

sentences.en: The sorrowful news spread quickly through our small town.
sentences.zh: 這個悲傷的消息很快就傳遍了我們的小鎮。

sentences.en: Did the sorrowful ending make you cry?
sentences.zh: 那個悲傷的結局讓你哭了嗎？

sentences.en: He wrote a sorrowful letter to his old friend.
sentences.zh: 他寫了一封哀傷的信給老朋友。

sentences.en: The room was quiet and sorrowful after the funeral.
sentences.zh: 葬禮結束後，房間裡安靜又哀傷。

sentences.en: I'll have the chicken souvlaki with rice, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點雞肉希臘烤肉串配飯。

sentences.en: Does the souvlaki come with a side salad?
sentences.zh: 希臘烤肉串有附配菜沙拉嗎？

sentences.en: We shared a pork souvlaki platter at the Greek restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我們在希臘餐廳分食了一份豬肉烤肉串拼盤。

sentences.en: What kind of sauce goes with souvlaki?
sentences.zh: 希臘烤肉串搭配什麼醬汁？

sentences.en: The food truck sells souvlaki wrapped in warm pita.
sentences.zh: 那台餐車賣用溫熱皮塔餅包起來的希臘烤肉串。

sentences.en: Grilled souvlaki smells wonderful at the summer food fair.
sentences.zh: 夏日美食市集上，烤希臘肉串的香味好誘人。

gloss_note: launch a spacecraft 發射太空船

sentences.en: The spacecraft will land on Mars next year.
sentences.zh: 這艘太空船明年將登陸火星。

sentences.en: How long did the spacecraft stay in orbit?
sentences.zh: 這艘太空船在軌道上待了多久？

sentences.en: Engineers tested the spacecraft before the launch.
sentences.zh: 工程師在發射前測試了這艘太空船。

sentences.en: Is that spacecraft carrying people or only equipment?
sentences.zh: 那艘太空船載的是人，還是只有設備？

sentences.en: The museum has a model of a real spacecraft.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一個真實太空船的模型。

sentences.en: Our class watched the spacecraft launch live.
sentences.zh: 我們班收看了太空船發射的直播。

sentences.en: In the movie, a spaceship lands in the desert.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一艘太空船降落在沙漠中。

sentences.en: My son drew a spaceship with six big windows.
sentences.zh: 我兒子畫了一艘有六個大窗戶的太空船。

sentences.en: Would you ride a spaceship to the moon?
sentences.zh: 你會搭太空船去月球嗎？

sentences.en: What powers the spaceship in this science fiction novel?
sentences.zh: 這本科幻小說裡的太空船是靠什麼驅動的？

sentences.en: The toy spaceship lights up and makes sounds.
sentences.zh: 這個玩具太空船會發亮，還會發出聲音。

sentences.en: The captain turned the spaceship toward a blue planet.
sentences.zh: 船長把太空船轉向一顆藍色的星球。
