gloss_note: a flock of sparrows 一群麻雀

sentences.en: A sparrow landed on our balcony railing this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有一隻麻雀停在我們的陽台欄杆上。

sentences.en: Do you see that sparrow under the table?
sentences.zh: 你有看到桌子底下那隻麻雀嗎？

sentences.en: Sparrows often eat crumbs outside the coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 麻雀常在咖啡店外面啄食麵包屑。

sentences.en: How many sparrows are in that tree?
sentences.zh: 那棵樹上有幾隻麻雀？

sentences.en: The little sparrow built a nest in our garage.
sentences.zh: 那隻小麻雀在我們的車庫裡築了巢。

sentences.en: A flock of sparrows flew away when the dog barked.
sentences.zh: 狗一叫，一群麻雀就飛走了。

gloss_note: a natural spectacle 自然奇觀

sentences.en: The fireworks over the lake were quite a spectacle.
sentences.zh: 湖上的煙火真是壯觀。

sentences.en: Did you see the spectacle at the stadium last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有看到體育場裡的那場盛大場面嗎？

sentences.en: The northern lights are a stunning natural spectacle.
sentences.zh: 北極光是令人驚嘆的自然奇觀。

sentences.en: The opening ceremony was a real spectacle.
sentences.zh: 開幕典禮真是壯觀。

sentences.en: Is the spectacle of a total eclipse worth traveling for?
sentences.zh: 日全食的奇景值得特地跑一趟去看嗎？

sentences.en: Tourists gathered to watch the spectacle of the parade.
sentences.zh: 遊客聚在一起觀看遊行的盛大場面。

sentences.en: We climbed a spiral staircase to the top of the tower.
sentences.zh: 我們爬上螺旋梯，來到塔頂。

sentences.en: Do you have a spiral notebook I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有線圈筆記本可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: The smoke began to spiral up into the sky.
sentences.zh: 煙開始盤旋著往天空升去。

sentences.en: The bird spiraled down toward the field.
sentences.zh: 那隻鳥盤旋著往田野飛降。

sentences.en: Why does the water spiral as it goes down the drain?
sentences.zh: 水流進排水孔時，為什麼會呈螺旋狀旋轉？

sentences.en: The seashell has a beautiful spiral pattern.
sentences.zh: 這個貝殼有漂亮的螺旋紋路。

gloss_note: in all its splendor 極其壯麗

sentences.en: Tourists gathered to see the splendor of the old palace.
sentences.zh: 遊客聚集起來欣賞古老宮殿的壯麗。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen the splendor of a sunset over the ocean?
sentences.zh: 你有看過海上日落的壯麗景色嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel lobby impressed us with its splendor.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的氣派讓我們印象深刻。

sentences.en: The trees were in all their splendor this October.
sentences.zh: 十月的樹木展現出最輝煌的樣子。

sentences.en: What gives this old theater its splendor?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓這間老劇院如此富麗堂皇？

sentences.en: The film captures the splendor of ancient Rome.
sentences.zh: 這部電影呈現了古羅馬的輝煌。

sentences.en: The company's spokeswoman will speak to reporters at noon.
sentences.zh: 公司的女發言人中午會向記者說明。

sentences.en: Who is the spokeswoman for the city hospital?
sentences.zh: 市立醫院的女發言人是誰？

sentences.en: A spokeswoman said the store will reopen on Monday.
sentences.zh: 一位女發言人表示，這家店星期一會重新開幕。

sentences.en: Did the spokeswoman answer your question about the delay?
sentences.zh: 那位女發言人有回答你關於延誤的問題嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a spokeswoman for a local school district.
sentences.zh: 她擔任當地學區的女發言人。

sentences.en: The team's spokeswoman announced the new coach today.
sentences.zh: 球隊的女發言人今天宣布了新教練。

sentences.en: He is a true sportsman who never cheats.
sentences.zh: 他是個真正的運動家，從不作弊。

sentences.en: The town honored the local sportsman who won a gold medal.
sentences.zh: 小鎮表揚了那位贏得金牌的在地運動員。

sentences.en: Is he a good sportsman, win or lose?
sentences.zh: 不論輸贏，他都是個有風度的運動員嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather was a famous sportsman in his day.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺年輕時是知名的運動員。

sentences.en: Which sportsman would you like to meet?
sentences.zh: 你最想見哪一位運動員？

sentences.en: A good sportsman shakes hands after the game.
sentences.zh: 好的運動員會在賽後握手。

gloss_note: show good sportsmanship 展現風度

sentences.en: The coach praised the team for its good sportsmanship.
sentences.zh: 教練稱讚球隊有良好的運動家精神。

sentences.en: Is shaking hands after the game part of sportsmanship?
sentences.zh: 賽後握手也是運動家精神的一部分嗎？

sentences.en: Show some sportsmanship, even if you lose.
sentences.zh: 即使輸了，也要展現運動家精神。

sentences.en: He won an award for sportsmanship at the tournament.
sentences.zh: 他在錦標賽上獲得了運動家精神獎。

sentences.en: How do you teach kids sportsmanship?
sentences.zh: 你都怎麼教孩子運動家精神？

sentences.en: Sportsmanship matters more than the final score.
sentences.zh: 運動家精神比最後的比數更重要。

gloss_note: 男性為 sportsman，中性用 athlete

sentences.en: She is the most famous sportswoman in our town.
sentences.zh: 她是我們鎮上最有名的女運動員。

sentences.en: The young sportswoman trains every morning before school.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的女運動員每天上學前都會訓練。

sentences.en: Which sportswoman won the gold medal in swimming at the school meet?
sentences.zh: 哪位女運動員在校運會上拿下游泳金牌？

sentences.en: Is she a professional sportswoman or a student?
sentences.zh: 她是職業女運動員，還是學生？

sentences.en: My aunt was a talented sportswoman in college.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨大學時是個很有天分的女運動員。

sentences.en: The sportswoman thanked her coach after the race.
sentences.zh: 賽後，這位女運動員感謝了她的教練。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: in the spotlight 備受矚目

sentences.en: The singer stood alone in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 歌手獨自站在聚光燈下。

sentences.en: Do you like being in the spotlight?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡成為眾人的焦點嗎？

sentences.en: The news report put the spotlight on rising rent prices.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導把焦點放在不斷上漲的房租上。

sentences.en: The theater crew adjusted the spotlight before the show.
sentences.zh: 劇場工作人員在演出前調整了聚光燈。

sentences.en: Why does he always try to steal the spotlight?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼老是想搶鋒頭？

sentences.en: Our coach doesn't want the spotlight; he praises the team.
sentences.zh: 我們教練不愛出風頭，他總是稱讚球隊。

sentences.en: The tired runner staggered across the finish line.
sentences.zh: 筋疲力盡的跑者搖搖晃晃地衝過終點線。

sentences.en: Why did he stagger off the boat after the long trip?
sentences.zh: 長途航行後，他下船時為什麼走得搖搖晃晃的？

sentences.en: I staggered home with five heavy bags of groceries.
sentences.zh: 我扛著五大袋雜貨，搖搖晃晃地走回家。

sentences.en: The old man began to stagger on the icy sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 老先生在結冰的人行道上走得搖搖晃晃。

sentences.en: Can you carry that box, or will you stagger under its weight?
sentences.zh: 你搬得動那個箱子嗎？還是會被壓得搖搖晃晃？

sentences.en: The hikers staggered into camp at sunset, exhausted.
sentences.zh: 健行者們在日落時筋疲力盡、跌跌撞撞地走進營地。

gloss_note: 美式多說 appetizer，英式 starter

sentences.en: Do you want to share a starter before the main course?
sentences.zh: 主菜前，你想分一份前菜嗎？

sentences.en: The starter was a small salad with goat cheese.
sentences.zh: 前菜是一份加了山羊起司的小沙拉。

sentences.en: What starters do you recommend?
sentences.zh: 你推薦哪些前菜？

sentences.en: I'll have the soup as a starter, please.
sentences.zh: 我前菜想點湯。

sentences.en: Our starters came quickly, but the main dishes took forever.
sentences.zh: 前菜很快就上了，但主菜等了好久。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers three starters under eight dollars.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有三道不到八美元的前菜。

sentences.en: Millions of people still suffer from starvation.
sentences.zh: 仍有數百萬人飽受飢餓之苦。

sentences.en: What causes starvation during a long drought?
sentences.zh: 長期乾旱期間，是什麼導致人們挨餓？

sentences.en: The charity works to end child starvation.
sentences.zh: 這個慈善團體致力於消除孩童的飢餓問題。

sentences.en: Many animals face starvation in a harsh winter.
sentences.zh: 在嚴冬中，許多動物面臨挨餓的處境。

sentences.en: Is starvation still a problem in the world today?
sentences.zh: 飢餓在今日的世界上仍是個問題嗎？

sentences.en: The settlers nearly died of starvation that winter.
sentences.zh: 那年冬天，拓荒者差點就餓死了。

gloss_note: 口語 I'm starving. 我餓扁了

sentences.en: I'm starving; can we order now?
sentences.zh: 我餓壞了，我們可以現在點餐了嗎？

sentences.en: Are you starving, or can you wait ten minutes?
sentences.zh: 你餓壞了嗎？還是可以再等十分鐘？

sentences.en: The kids were starving after soccer practice.
sentences.zh: 孩子們練完足球後餓壞了。

sentences.en: We were starving by the time the food arrived.
sentences.zh: 菜上桌的時候，我們已經餓壞了。

sentences.en: Why are you starving? Didn't you eat lunch?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼餓成這樣？沒吃午餐嗎？

sentences.en: He was starving, so he ordered two burgers.
sentences.zh: 他餓壞了，所以點了兩個漢堡。

gloss_note: 指受敬重的資深政治領袖

sentences.en: He is remembered as a wise statesman.
sentences.zh: 人們記得他是一位睿智的政治家。

sentences.en: Which statesman is on this old coin?
sentences.zh: 這枚舊硬幣上是哪位政治家？

sentences.en: The history book describes him as a respected statesman.
sentences.zh: 歷史課本形容他是一位受人敬重的政治家。

sentences.en: Was he a statesman or just a politician?
sentences.zh: 他是政治家，還是只是個政客？

sentences.en: The retired statesman now teaches at a university.
sentences.zh: 這位退休的政治家現在在大學任教。

sentences.en: A statesman thinks about the country's future, not just the next election.
sentences.zh: 政治家想的是國家的未來，而不只是下一次選舉。

gloss_note: stationary bike 固定式健身車

sentences.en: The car was stationary at the red light.
sentences.zh: 那輛車在紅燈前停著不動。

sentences.en: I ride a stationary bike at home when it rains.
sentences.zh: 下雨的時候，我在家騎固定式健身車。

sentences.en: Please remain stationary until the ride comes to a stop.
sentences.zh: 在遊樂設施完全停止之前，請保持不動。

sentences.en: Was the object stationary, or was it moving slowly?
sentences.zh: 那個物體是靜止的，還是在慢慢移動？

sentences.en: Why are the cars stationary on the highway?
sentences.zh: 高速公路上的車子為什麼停著不動？

sentences.en: A stationary object stays still unless a force moves it.
sentences.zh: 靜止的物體除非受到外力，否則會保持不動。

gloss_note: small in stature 身材矮小

sentences.en: He is a man of short stature but great strength.
sentences.zh: 他身材矮小，但力氣很大。

sentences.en: The player's stature grew after the championship.
sentences.zh: 拿下冠軍後，那位球員的聲望大增。

sentences.en: Does the doctor deserve his high stature in the community?
sentences.zh: 這位醫生配得上他在社區裡的崇高聲望嗎？

sentences.en: She is small in stature, but she leads the team well.
sentences.zh: 她身材嬌小，卻把團隊帶得很好。

sentences.en: Does a person's stature affect how others see them?
sentences.zh: 一個人的身材會影響別人怎麼看他嗎？

sentences.en: A writer of her stature rarely gives interviews.
sentences.zh: 像她這樣有聲望的作家很少接受訪問。

sentences.en: Does he treat his stepchild like his own child?
sentences.zh: 他對待繼子女像對待親生孩子一樣嗎？

sentences.en: My stepchild just started high school this fall.
sentences.zh: 我的繼子女今年秋天剛上高中。

sentences.en: She became a stepchild when her mom remarried.
sentences.zh: 她媽媽再婚後，她就成了繼女。

sentences.en: How does your stepchild like the new house?
sentences.zh: 你的繼子女覺得新家怎麼樣？

sentences.en: Being a stepchild was hard for her at first.
sentences.zh: 剛開始，當繼女對她來說不容易。

sentences.en: A stepchild needs time to trust a new parent.
sentences.zh: 繼子女需要時間才能信任新的家長。

sentences.en: My stepfather taught me how to drive.
sentences.zh: 我的繼父教我開車。

sentences.en: Is your stepfather coming to the graduation ceremony?
sentences.zh: 你的繼父會來參加畢業典禮嗎？

sentences.en: Her stepfather works as a high school teacher.
sentences.zh: 她的繼父是高中老師。

sentences.en: He calls his stepfather every Sunday evening.
sentences.zh: 他每個週日晚上都會打電話給繼父。

sentences.en: Did your stepfather cook dinner for everyone last night?
sentences.zh: 你的繼父昨晚煮晚餐給大家吃了嗎？

sentences.en: My stepfather and I fixed the old fence together.
sentences.zh: 我和繼父一起修好了那道舊籬笆。

sentences.en: Her stepmother makes the best apple pie.
sentences.zh: 她繼母做的蘋果派最好吃。

sentences.en: Do you get along well with your stepmother?
sentences.zh: 你和繼母相處得好嗎？

sentences.en: My stepmother drove me to school this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上繼母開車送我去學校。

sentences.en: In the story, the stepmother is not really evil.
sentences.zh: 在這個故事裡，繼母其實並不壞。

sentences.en: When did your stepmother move to Texas?
sentences.zh: 你的繼母是什麼時候搬到德州的？

sentences.en: His stepmother helped him write his college essay.
sentences.zh: 他的繼母幫他寫大學申請的作文。

sentences.en: Babies need a lot of stimulation to learn and grow.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒需要大量的刺激才能學習和成長。

sentences.en: Does your job give you enough mental stimulation?
sentences.zh: 你的工作給你足夠的腦力刺激嗎？

sentences.en: Puzzles provide good stimulation for older adults.
sentences.zh: 拼圖對年長者來說是很好的腦力刺激。

sentences.en: The dog gets bored without enough stimulation.
sentences.zh: 狗如果沒有足夠的刺激，就會覺得無聊。

sentences.en: What kind of stimulation helps kids focus in class?
sentences.zh: 哪一種刺激能幫助孩子在課堂上專心？

sentences.en: The report says music gives the brain strong stimulation.
sentences.zh: 報告指出，音樂能給大腦很強的刺激。

sentences.en: My stockbroker called me about the new shares.
sentences.zh: 我的股票經紀人打電話來，跟我談新股的事。

sentences.en: Does your stockbroker charge a monthly fee?
sentences.zh: 你的股票經紀人會收月費嗎？

sentences.en: She worked as a stockbroker for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她當了十年的股票經紀人。

sentences.en: The stockbroker advised us to wait until spring.
sentences.zh: 股票經紀人建議我們等到春天再說。

sentences.en: How did you find a reliable stockbroker?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼找到可靠的股票經紀人的？

sentences.en: A stockbroker buys and sells shares for clients.
sentences.zh: 股票經紀人替客戶買賣股票。

sentences.en: The extra chairs are in the storeroom.
sentences.zh: 多的椅子在儲藏室裡。

sentences.en: Can you check the storeroom for more paper?
sentences.zh: 你可以去儲藏室看看還有沒有紙嗎？

sentences.en: Our store keeps the extra stock in the storeroom.
sentences.zh: 我們店裡把多的存貨放在庫房裡。

sentences.en: Who has the key to the storeroom?
sentences.zh: 誰有儲藏室的鑰匙？

sentences.en: The storeroom is full, so we need new shelves.
sentences.zh: 庫房滿了，所以我們需要新的架子。

sentences.en: He went to the storeroom to get a box of pens.
sentences.zh: 他去儲藏室拿了一盒筆。

gloss_note: 常用複數 straits；the Strait of ...

sentences.en: Ships must pass through the narrow strait one at a time.
sentences.zh: 船隻必須一艘接一艘通過這個狹窄的海峽。

sentences.en: Which strait connects the two seas on this map?
sentences.zh: 這張地圖上，哪個海峽連接這兩片海？

sentences.en: The Strait of Gibraltar lies between Europe and Africa.
sentences.zh: 直布羅陀海峽位於歐洲與非洲之間。

sentences.en: The captain steered carefully through the strait.
sentences.zh: 船長小心地駕船穿過海峽。

sentences.en: Is the strait wide enough for large cargo ships?
sentences.zh: 這個海峽夠寬，能讓大型貨輪通行嗎？

sentences.en: Our geography teacher asked us to mark the strait on the map.
sentences.zh: 地理老師要我們在地圖上標出這個海峽。

sentences.en: Too many rules can strangle a small business.
sentences.zh: 太多規定可能會扼殺小型企業。

sentences.en: Will the new tax strangle local farms?
sentences.zh: 這項新稅會扼殺本地的農場嗎？

sentences.en: The vines began to strangle the young tree.
sentences.zh: 藤蔓開始勒住那棵小樹。

sentences.en: Red tape can strangle new ideas before they grow.
sentences.zh: 繁文縟節可能會在新點子成長之前就把它扼殺。

sentences.en: Doesn't heavy traffic strangle business downtown?
sentences.zh: 市中心嚴重塞車，不是會扼殺生意嗎？

sentences.en: Her scarf was so tight it seemed to strangle her.
sentences.zh: 她的圍巾緊到好像要勒住她的脖子。

sentences.en: We found a stray cat near our apartment building.
sentences.zh: 我們在公寓大樓附近發現一隻流浪貓。

sentences.en: Did you take in that stray dog?
sentences.zh: 你收留了那隻流浪狗嗎？

sentences.en: The shelter cares for stray animals until they find homes.
sentences.zh: 收容所會照顧流浪動物，直到牠們找到家。

sentences.en: A stray puppy followed me home from school.
sentences.zh: 一隻走失的小狗從學校一路跟我回家。

sentences.en: Have you seen a stray dog with a red collar?
sentences.zh: 你有看到一隻戴著紅項圈的走失狗嗎？

sentences.en: The city is trying to reduce the number of stray cats.
sentences.zh: 市政府正努力減少流浪貓的數量。

gloss_note: stride into a room 大步走進

sentences.en: He will stride across the stage to get his diploma.
sentences.zh: 他會大步走過舞台去領畢業證書。

sentences.en: Why does he always stride into the meeting late?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他總是遲到，還大步走進會議室？

sentences.en: The runner's long stride helped her win the race.
sentences.zh: 這位跑者的大跨步幫助她贏得了比賽。

sentences.en: With long strides, he crossed the street in seconds.
sentences.zh: 他邁開大步，幾秒就穿過了馬路。

sentences.en: Can you match my stride, or should I slow down?
sentences.zh: 你跟得上我的步伐嗎？還是我該放慢一點？

sentences.en: We watched the tall man stride down the hallway.
sentences.zh: 我們看著那個高個子男人大步走過走廊。

gloss_note: take a stroll 去散個步

sentences.en: Let's take a stroll along the river after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們沿著河邊散散步吧。

sentences.en: Do you want to stroll through the market with me?
sentences.zh: 你想跟我一起去市場逛逛嗎？

sentences.en: Couples strolled in the park on Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 週日下午，情侶們在公園裡散步。

sentences.en: How about a quick stroll before the meeting starts?
sentences.zh: 會議開始前去散個步怎麼樣？

sentences.en: We strolled around the mall while waiting for the movie.
sentences.zh: 等電影開演時，我們在購物中心閒逛。

sentences.en: The old man enjoys a slow stroll every morning.
sentences.zh: 那位老先生每天早上都喜歡悠閒地散步。

sentences.en: The news stunned everyone in the office.
sentences.zh: 這個消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都愣住了。

sentences.en: Were you stunned when you heard the price?
sentences.zh: 聽到價格的時候，你是不是傻眼了？

sentences.en: Her sudden resignation stunned the whole team.
sentences.zh: 她突然辭職，讓整個團隊都震驚不已。

sentences.en: The beauty of the mountain stunned us.
sentences.zh: 這座山的美景讓我們驚嘆不已。

sentences.en: Why did the test results stun so many students?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這次的考試成績讓這麼多學生震驚？

sentences.en: The movie's ending stunned the audience into silence.
sentences.zh: 電影的結局讓觀眾震驚得鴉雀無聲。

gloss_note: stutter with nerves 緊張到結巴

sentences.en: He used to stutter when he spoke in public.
sentences.zh: 他以前在公開場合說話會結巴。

sentences.en: Does she stutter when she gets nervous?
sentences.zh: 她一緊張就會結巴嗎？

sentences.en: Don't laugh at kids who stutter.
sentences.zh: 不要嘲笑會口吃的孩子。

sentences.en: Speech therapy helped him overcome his stutter.
sentences.zh: 語言治療幫助他克服了口吃。

sentences.en: I stuttered a little during my first job interview.
sentences.zh: 我第一次面試的時候有點結巴。

sentences.en: Why did the actor stutter on the very first line?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那位演員在第一句台詞就結巴了？

gloss_note: a stylish coat 時髦的外套

sentences.en: That is a really stylish jacket!
sentences.zh: 那件外套真時髦！

sentences.en: Where did you buy such a stylish bag?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡買到這麼有型的包包？

sentences.en: The new café is small but very stylish.
sentences.zh: 這家新開的咖啡廳雖然小，但很時髦。

sentences.en: My grandmother is always stylish, even at home.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶就算在家也總是穿得很時髦。

sentences.en: Is this hotel lobby stylish enough for photos?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店大廳夠時髦，適合拍照嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a stylish hat to the wedding.
sentences.zh: 她戴了一頂時髦的帽子去參加婚禮。

sentences.en: It's so hot in here that I feel like I'll suffocate.
sentences.zh: 這裡熱得我悶到快透不過氣了。

sentences.en: Open the window, or we'll all suffocate!
sentences.zh: 把窗戶打開，不然我們都要悶死了！

sentences.en: Do you ever feel suffocated in a crowded elevator?
sentences.zh: 在擠滿人的電梯裡，你會不會覺得悶得透不過氣？

sentences.en: Don't wear that wool sweater; it'll be suffocating in this heat.
sentences.zh: 別穿那件毛衣，這種天氣會悶死人。

sentences.en: Why is this small room so suffocating?
sentences.zh: 這間小房間為什麼這麼悶？

sentences.en: The fire safety class taught us how smoke can suffocate people.
sentences.zh: 防火安全課教我們濃煙如何讓人窒息。

gloss_note: summon sb to... 叫某人去…

sentences.en: The principal summoned me to her office after class.
sentences.zh: 下課後，校長把我叫去她的辦公室。

sentences.en: Why did the boss summon the whole team this morning?
sentences.zh: 老闆今天早上為什麼把整個團隊都叫了過去？

sentences.en: She was summoned to court as a witness.
sentences.zh: 她被傳喚到法院當證人。

sentences.en: The king summoned his advisers to the castle.
sentences.zh: 國王召見他的顧問到城堡來。

sentences.en: Did the coach summon you to his office after practice?
sentences.zh: 練習結束後，教練把你叫去他的辦公室了嗎？

sentences.en: A bell summoned the students back to class.
sentences.zh: 一陣鐘聲把學生們叫回了教室。

sentences.en: Don't forget to put on sunscreen before you go out.
sentences.zh: 出門前別忘了擦防曬乳。

sentences.en: Do you sell sunscreen for sensitive skin?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣敏感肌用的防曬乳嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel gift shop keeps the sunscreen near the front.
sentences.zh: 飯店的禮品店把防曬乳放在前面。

sentences.en: Which sunscreen works best at the beach?
sentences.zh: 在海邊用哪一種防曬乳效果最好？

sentences.en: Sunscreen is on sale this week: buy one, get one free.
sentences.zh: 防曬乳本週特價，買一送一。

sentences.en: I packed sunscreen and a hat for the business trip to Florida.
sentences.zh: 我帶了防曬乳和帽子去佛羅里達出差。

Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: His knowledge of the topic is rather superficial.
sentences.zh: 他對這個主題的了解相當膚淺。

sentences.en: Is she only interested in superficial things like looks?
sentences.zh: 她是不是只在意外表這類膚淺的事？

sentences.en: We only had a superficial look at the problem.
sentences.zh: 我們只是粗略地看了一下這個問題。

sentences.en: The report is too superficial to help the team.
sentences.zh: 這份報告太粗淺，對團隊沒有幫助。

sentences.en: Why do you think the movie felt so superficial?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼覺得這部電影這麼膚淺？

sentences.en: Don't make superficial judgments based on first impressions.
sentences.zh: 不要光憑第一印象就做出膚淺的判斷。

sentences.en: Our building superintendent fixed the leaky sink today.
sentences.zh: 我們大樓的管理員今天修好了漏水的水槽。

sentences.en: Can you call the superintendent about the broken heater?
sentences.zh: 你可以打電話給管理員，說暖氣壞了嗎？

sentences.en: The superintendent lives on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 管理員住在一樓。

sentences.en: Who is the superintendent of this apartment building?
sentences.zh: 這棟公寓大樓的管理員是誰？

sentences.en: I asked the superintendent for an extra key.
sentences.zh: 我向管理員多要了一把鑰匙。

sentences.en: The superintendent said the elevator will be fixed by Friday.
sentences.zh: 管理員說電梯週五前會修好。

sentences.en: The team's superiority was clear from the first minute.
sentences.zh: 從第一分鐘起，這支球隊的優勢就很明顯。

sentences.en: Is there any proof of this product's superiority over its rivals?
sentences.zh: 有證據證明這項產品勝過競爭對手嗎？

sentences.en: He spoke with an air of superiority.
sentences.zh: 他說話時帶著一種優越感。

sentences.en: Why do some people feel a sense of superiority at work?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些人在工作上會有優越感？

sentences.en: The company's superiority in quality won many customers.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在品質上的優勢贏得了許多客戶。

sentences.en: Her superiority in math was obvious to everyone in class.
sentences.zh: 她在數學上的優勢，班上每個人都看得出來。

sentences.en: My grandmother is very superstitious about the number four.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶對數字四非常迷信。

sentences.en: Are you superstitious about Friday the 13th?
sentences.zh: 你會忌諱13號星期五嗎？

sentences.en: He's superstitious, so he always wears the same socks to games.
sentences.zh: 他很迷信，所以比賽時總是穿同一雙襪子。

sentences.en: Some sailors were once superstitious about leaving port on a Friday.
sentences.zh: 有些水手從前很迷信，不在星期五出港。

sentences.en: Why are athletes so superstitious before big games?
sentences.zh: 為什麼運動員在大賽前都這麼迷信？

sentences.en: I'm not superstitious, but I still avoid walking under ladders.
sentences.zh: 我不迷信，但還是會避開走在梯子底下。

gloss_note: vitamin supplement 維他命補充品

sentences.en: Do you take a vitamin supplement every day?
sentences.zh: 你每天都吃維他命補充品嗎？

sentences.en: Many people supplement their diet with vitamins.
sentences.zh: 很多人用維他命來補充飲食所需。

sentences.en: The doctor said I don't need any supplements.
sentences.zh: 醫生說我不需要吃任何補充品。

sentences.en: Can I supplement my class notes with this book?
sentences.zh: 我可以用這本書來補充上課筆記嗎？

sentences.en: The store has a whole aisle of protein supplements.
sentences.zh: 這家店有整整一排走道都是蛋白質補充品。

sentences.en: She works weekends to supplement her salary.
sentences.zh: 她週末打工來補充薪水的不足。

sentences.en: We're running low on supplies, so I'll order more.
sentences.zh: 我們的供應品快用完了，我來多訂一些。

sentences.en: Who supplies the fresh fish for this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的新鮮魚貨是誰供應的？

sentences.en: The kitchen has a steady supply of fresh herbs.
sentences.zh: 廚房有穩定供應的新鮮香草。

sentences.en: Do you have enough supplies for the party on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 你有足夠的用品來辦週六的派對嗎？

sentences.en: A local farm will supply all our vegetables this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，我們所有的蔬菜都由當地農場供應。

sentences.en: The supply of eggs was low at the store.
sentences.zh: 商店裡的雞蛋供應量很少。

sentences.en: What is your surname, please?
sentences.zh: 請問你的姓氏是什麼？

sentences.en: Her surname is hard to spell.
sentences.zh: 她的姓氏很難拼。

sentences.en: Please write your surname in capital letters.
sentences.zh: 請用大寫字母寫下你的姓氏。

sentences.en: Do you have the same surname as your sister?
sentences.zh: 你和你姊妹同姓嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher called each student by their surname.
sentences.zh: 老師都用姓氏來叫每位學生。

sentences.en: In many countries, the surname comes last.
sentences.zh: 在許多國家，姓氏放在名字後面。

sentences.en: Sales this year have surpassed our goal.
sentences.zh: 今年的銷售額已經超越我們的目標。

sentences.en: Did the final results surpass your expectations?
sentences.zh: 最後的結果有超出你的預期嗎？

sentences.en: She hopes to surpass her best time in the race.
sentences.zh: 她希望在比賽中超越自己的最佳成績。

sentences.en: The new restaurant surpasses the old one in every way.
sentences.zh: 這家新餐廳在各方面都勝過舊的那家。

sentences.en: Will online shopping soon surpass store sales?
sentences.zh: 網路購物很快就會超越實體店面的銷售嗎？

sentences.en: His skills have surpassed those of his teacher.
sentences.zh: 他的技術已經超越了他的老師。

gloss_note: the surrounding area 周邊地區

sentences.en: The surrounding area has many good restaurants.
sentences.zh: 這附近有很多不錯的餐廳。

sentences.en: Are there any cafés on the surrounding streets?
sentences.zh: 周圍的街上有咖啡廳嗎？

sentences.en: The surrounding hills make the view from the dining room beautiful.
sentences.zh: 四周的山丘讓餐廳裡的景色很美。

sentences.en: Guests come from the surrounding towns every weekend.
sentences.zh: 每個週末，附近城鎮的客人都會來這裡。

sentences.en: How noisy are the surrounding restaurants at night?
sentences.zh: 附近的餐廳晚上有多吵？

sentences.en: The chef uses herbs grown in the surrounding fields.
sentences.zh: 主廚使用附近田裡種的香草。

gloss_note: keep sb in suspense 吊人胃口

sentences.en: Please don't keep me in suspense. Did I pass?
sentences.zh: 別吊我胃口了，我過了嗎？

sentences.en: The movie is full of suspense until the last scene.
sentences.zh: 這部電影一直到最後一幕都充滿懸疑。

sentences.en: I can't stand the suspense of waiting for the test results.
sentences.zh: 等考試成績的那份懸念，我真的受不了。

sentences.en: Do you like books with a lot of suspense?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡充滿懸疑的書嗎？

sentences.en: The suspense grew as the judges opened the envelope.
sentences.zh: 評審打開信封時，懸念越來越濃。

sentences.en: How does the writer build suspense in the first chapter?
sentences.zh: 作者是怎麼在第一章營造懸疑感的？

sentences.en: The suspension of train service surprised many commuters.
sentences.zh: 火車暫停營運，讓許多通勤的人很意外。

sentences.en: Is there any news about the suspension of flights?
sentences.zh: 有航班暫停的消息嗎？

sentences.en: The company announced a suspension of all new hiring.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布暫停所有新的招聘。

sentences.en: How long will the suspension of the project last?
sentences.zh: 這個專案要暫停多久？

sentences.en: A power failure caused a suspension of work at the factory.
sentences.zh: 停電導致工廠暫停作業。

sentences.en: The city ordered a suspension of construction near the river.
sentences.zh: 市政府下令暫停河邊的施工。

gloss_note: be swamped with 忙得不可開交

sentences.en: Frogs live in the swamp behind our school.
sentences.zh: 青蛙住在我們學校後面的沼澤裡。

sentences.en: Alligators are common in the swamps of Florida.
sentences.zh: 在佛羅里達的沼澤地，鱷魚很常見。

sentences.en: Heavy rain swamped the streets downtown.
sentences.zh: 大雨淹沒了市中心的街道。

sentences.en: I'm swamped with work today. Can we talk later?
sentences.zh: 我今天工作多到忙不過來，我們晚點再聊好嗎？

sentences.en: Why is the field behind the house turning into a swamp?
sentences.zh: 為什麼房子後面的那塊地變成沼澤了？

sentences.en: The boat slowly crossed the swamp at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 船在日出時緩緩穿越沼澤。

gloss_note: a swarm of bees 一群蜜蜂

sentences.en: A swarm of bees landed on the old tree.
sentences.zh: 一群蜜蜂停在那棵老樹上。

sentences.en: Did you see the swarm of mosquitoes by the lake?
sentences.zh: 你有看到湖邊那一大群蚊子嗎？

sentences.en: Fans swarmed around the singer as she left.
sentences.zh: 歌手離開時，粉絲蜂擁而上。

sentences.en: Tourists swarm the old town every summer.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，遊客都會湧進老城區。

sentences.en: Why do ants swarm over the cake so quickly?
sentences.zh: 為什麼螞蟻這麼快就爬滿了蛋糕？

sentences.en: A swarm of shoppers rushed in when the store opened.
sentences.zh: 商店一開門，一大群顧客就衝了進去。

gloss_note: sweeten to taste 依喜好加糖

sentences.en: I usually sweeten my tea with a little honey.
sentences.zh: 我通常會加一點蜂蜜讓茶變甜。

sentences.en: Do you sweeten your coffee, or drink it black?
sentences.zh: 你的咖啡會加糖，還是喝黑咖啡？

sentences.en: The chef will sweeten the sauce with a bit of sugar.
sentences.zh: 主廚會加一點糖讓醬汁變甜。

sentences.en: You can sweeten the oatmeal with fresh fruit.
sentences.zh: 你可以用新鮮水果替燕麥粥增添甜味。

sentences.en: How much sugar should I add to sweeten the lemonade?
sentences.zh: 我該加多少糖，才能讓檸檬水變甜？

sentences.en: Ripe bananas sweeten the pancakes without extra sugar.
sentences.zh: 熟透的香蕉不用另外加糖，也能讓鬆餅變甜。

sentences.en: Do you have a sweetener for my coffee?
sentences.zh: 你們有給我咖啡用的代糖嗎？

sentences.en: Honey is a natural sweetener.
sentences.zh: 蜂蜜是天然的甜味劑。

sentences.en: The waiter brought some sugar and a sweetener.
sentences.zh: 服務生拿來了一些糖和代糖。

sentences.en: This soda uses an artificial sweetener instead of sugar.
sentences.zh: 這種汽水用人工甜味劑取代糖。

sentences.en: Which sweetener is best for baking?
sentences.zh: 哪一種甜味劑最適合烘焙？

sentences.en: She added a packet of sweetener to her iced tea.
sentences.zh: 她在冰紅茶裡加了一包代糖。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: A symbolizes B A 象徵 B

sentences.en: The white dove symbolizes peace.
sentences.zh: 白鴿象徵和平。

sentences.en: What does the red rose symbolize in this story?
sentences.zh: 這個故事裡的紅玫瑰象徵什麼？

sentences.en: Green lights symbolize permission to go.
sentences.zh: 綠燈象徵可以通行。

sentences.en: The ring symbolizes their love for each other.
sentences.zh: 這枚戒指象徵他們對彼此的愛。

sentences.en: Does the broken clock symbolize the passing of time?
sentences.zh: 那個壞掉的鐘是在象徵時間的流逝嗎？

sentences.en: In many cultures, red symbolizes good luck.
sentences.zh: 在許多文化裡，紅色象徵好運。

sentences.en: The building has perfect symmetry from the front.
sentences.zh: 這棟建築從正面看完全對稱。

sentences.en: Butterfly wings show beautiful symmetry.
sentences.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀呈現出美麗的對稱。

sentences.en: Can you see the symmetry in this snowflake?
sentences.zh: 你看得出這片雪花的對稱嗎？

sentences.en: Our art teacher explained symmetry with a paper fold.
sentences.zh: 美術老師用摺紙來說明什麼是對稱。

sentences.en: Why do people find symmetry so pleasing to look at?
sentences.zh: 為什麼人們覺得對稱的東西看起來特別賞心悅目？

sentences.en: The garden was designed with careful symmetry.
sentences.zh: 這座花園設計得很講究對稱。

sentences.en: I sympathize with you. That sounds really hard.
sentences.zh: 我很同情你，聽起來真的很辛苦。

sentences.en: Do you sympathize with his situation?
sentences.zh: 你同情他的處境嗎？

sentences.en: Many viewers sympathized with the lead character.
sentences.zh: 許多觀眾都同情劇中的主角。

sentences.en: I can't help but sympathize with the customer.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住同情那位顧客。

sentences.en: How can I sympathize if you won't tell me what happened?
sentences.zh: 你不告訴我發生了什麼事，我要怎麼體諒你？

sentences.en: She sympathized with her friend after the bad news.
sentences.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她很同情她的朋友。

sentences.en: We went to hear the symphony on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 我們週六晚上去聽了交響樂。

sentences.en: Have you ever played in a symphony orchestra?
sentences.zh: 你曾經在交響樂團演奏過嗎？

sentences.en: The symphony lasted almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 這首交響曲演奏了將近一小時。

sentences.en: My dad listens to a symphony while he cooks.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸做飯時會聽交響樂。

sentences.en: Which symphony did the orchestra play last night?
sentences.zh: 樂團昨晚演奏了哪一首交響曲？

sentences.en: The composer finished his first symphony at the age of twenty.
sentences.zh: 這位作曲家二十歲時完成了他的第一首交響曲。

sentences.en: Can you think of a synonym for this word?
sentences.zh: 你想得出這個字的同義字嗎？

sentences.en: A thesaurus lists a synonym for almost every word.
sentences.zh: 同義詞典幾乎替每個字都列出了同義字。

sentences.en: Use a synonym so you don't repeat the same word.
sentences.zh: 用個同義字，才不會重複同一個字。

sentences.en: Our teacher asked us to find a synonym for each word.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們為每個字找一個同義字。

sentences.en: Is there a synonym that sounds more polite?
sentences.zh: 有沒有聽起來更有禮貌的同義字？

sentences.en: Writers often choose a synonym to make a sentence sound better.
sentences.zh: 作家常選用同義字，讓句子讀起來更順。

sentences.en: Please spread a clean tablecloth on every table.
sentences.zh: 請在每張桌子上鋪一條乾淨的桌布。

sentences.en: Do we have a larger tablecloth for the banquet?
sentences.zh: 我們有比較大的桌布可以辦宴會用嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter spilled water on the tablecloth.
sentences.zh: 服務生把水灑在桌布上。

sentences.en: The tablecloth needs to be washed before the next event.
sentences.zh: 下一場活動前，這條桌布需要洗一洗。

sentences.en: Where did you buy this beautiful tablecloth?
sentences.zh: 這條漂亮的桌布你是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: The hotel changes the tablecloth after every meal.
sentences.zh: 飯店每餐過後都會換桌布。

sentences.en: I tan easily, so I always wear sunscreen.
sentences.zh: 我很容易曬黑，所以總是擦防曬乳。

sentences.en: You have a nice tan! Did you go to the beach?
sentences.zh: 你曬成漂亮的古銅色！你去海邊了嗎？

sentences.en: She came back from vacation with a deep tan.
sentences.zh: 她度假回來，曬得一身古銅色。

sentences.en: Do you tan or burn when you stay in the sun?
sentences.zh: 你在太陽底下是會曬黑，還是曬傷？

sentences.en: My skin never seems to tan, no matter what I do.
sentences.zh: 不管我怎麼做，我的皮膚好像都曬不黑。

sentences.en: Many people go to the beach to get a tan.
sentences.zh: 很多人去海邊就是想把皮膚曬黑。

sentences.en: I'd like the tandoori chicken with rice, please.
sentences.zh: 我想點坦都里烤雞配飯，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Is the tandoori chicken spicy?
sentences.zh: 坦都里烤雞辣嗎？

sentences.en: The tandoori dishes here come out hot and smoky.
sentences.zh: 這裡的坦都里料理上桌時熱騰騰的，還帶著煙燻香。

sentences.en: Tandoori meat is cooked in a very hot clay oven.
sentences.zh: 坦都里烤肉是用非常熱的陶製烤爐烤出來的。

sentences.en: We shared tandoori shrimp and warm flatbread at dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐我們一起吃了坦都里烤蝦和熱烤餅。

sentences.en: What goes well with tandoori fish?
sentences.zh: 什麼東西跟坦都里烤魚很搭？

sentences.en: The brewery has a taproom with a large patio.
sentences.zh: 這家啤酒廠有個附大露臺的飲酒區。

sentences.en: Is the taproom open for lunch on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 這間飲酒區週日中午有營業嗎？

sentences.en: We met some friends at the taproom after work.
sentences.zh: 下班後，我們在酒吧跟幾個朋友碰面。

sentences.en: The taproom serves pretzels and burgers with its beer.
sentences.zh: 這間酒吧除了啤酒，也供應椒鹽脆餅和漢堡。

sentences.en: Can kids come into the taproom before six?
sentences.zh: 六點以前小孩可以進這間酒吧嗎？

sentences.en: The taproom is a popular spot on Friday nights.
sentences.zh: 週五晚上，這間酒吧是熱門的去處。

sentences.en: Filling out these forms is a tedious job.
sentences.zh: 填這些表格是件乏味的差事。

sentences.en: Why is the meeting so long and tedious?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這場會議又長又乏味？

sentences.en: Washing all the dishes by hand was tedious.
sentences.zh: 用手洗完所有碗盤又煩又枯燥。

sentences.en: Did you find the lecture tedious?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這堂課很乏味嗎？

sentences.en: The trip was tedious because of the long delays.
sentences.zh: 因為一再延誤，這趟旅程又長又乏味。

sentences.en: Checking every number by hand can be tedious work.
sentences.zh: 逐一用手核對每個數字，可能是件枯燥的工作。

sentences.en: She works in the telecommunications industry.
sentences.zh: 她在電信業工作。

sentences.en: Is telecommunications a good field for new graduates?
sentences.zh: 電信是適合新鮮人的領域嗎？

sentences.en: Telecommunications has changed how we stay in touch.
sentences.zh: 電信科技改變了我們保持聯絡的方式。

sentences.en: My uncle studied telecommunications in college.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔大學念的是電信。

sentences.en: Did the storm damage the town's telecommunications network?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨有損壞鎮上的電信網路嗎？

sentences.en: Modern telecommunications lets us video chat across the world.
sentences.zh: 現代電信讓我們能和世界各地的人視訊聊天。

gloss_note: set the tempo 掌控步調

sentences.en: The band slowed the tempo for the last song.
sentences.zh: 樂團把最後一首歌的速度放慢了。

sentences.en: Can you play this piece at a faster tempo?
sentences.zh: 你可以用比較快的速度演奏這首曲子嗎？

sentences.en: The tempo of life is slower in small towns.
sentences.zh: 小鎮的生活步調比較慢。

sentences.en: Our teacher tapped the tempo on the desk.
sentences.zh: 老師在桌上敲出節拍。

sentences.en: What tempo do you like to run to?
sentences.zh: 你跑步喜歡配什麼樣的節奏？

sentences.en: The new manager wants to keep a steady tempo at work.
sentences.zh: 新經理希望工作能維持穩定的步調。

gloss_note: a tentative plan 暫定計畫

sentences.en: We have a tentative meeting on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我們暫定週二開會。

sentences.en: Is the schedule tentative, or is it final?
sentences.zh: 這份時間表是暫定的，還是已經確定了？

sentences.en: They reached a tentative agreement last night.
sentences.zh: 他們昨晚達成了暫定協議。

sentences.en: Her tentative smile showed she was still shy.
sentences.zh: 她那帶著試探的微笑，顯示她還有些害羞。

sentences.en: Can we make a tentative plan for the trip?
sentences.zh: 我們可以先為這趟旅行擬個暫定計畫嗎？

sentences.en: He took a tentative step onto the thin ice.
sentences.zh: 他試探性地往薄冰上踏出一步。

gloss_note: 限成年人；常調成雞尾酒

sentences.en: The bartender mixed a margarita with tequila and lime.
sentences.zh: 酒保用龍舌蘭酒和萊姆調了一杯瑪格麗特。

sentences.en: Is this sauce made with tequila?
sentences.zh: 這個醬汁有加龍舌蘭酒嗎？

sentences.en: Tequila is made from the blue agave plant.
sentences.zh: 龍舌蘭酒是用藍色龍舌蘭植物釀成的。

sentences.en: Customers twenty-one and older can order tequila with their tacos.
sentences.zh: 年滿21歲的客人可以點龍舌蘭酒配塔可餅。

sentences.en: Do you serve shots of tequila at this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳有供應小杯的龍舌蘭酒嗎？

sentences.en: The chef flavors the shrimp with a splash of tequila.
sentences.zh: 主廚用一點龍舌蘭酒替蝦子調味。

sentences.en: I'll have the chicken teriyaki bowl, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一份照燒雞肉飯，麻煩你。

sentences.en: Does the teriyaki sauce contain peanuts?
sentences.zh: 照燒醬裡有花生嗎？

sentences.en: My mom makes teriyaki salmon on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽每個星期五都會做照燒鮭魚。

sentences.en: Teriyaki sauce is sweet and salty at the same time.
sentences.zh: 照燒醬同時帶有甜味和鹹味。

sentences.en: Which is better, the teriyaki or the curry?
sentences.zh: 照燒和咖哩，哪個比較好吃？

sentences.en: The lunch special comes with teriyaki beef and rice.
sentences.zh: 午間特餐附有照燒牛肉和白飯。

gloss_note: dine on the terrace 在露臺用餐

sentences.en: We had coffee on the terrace this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我們在露臺喝了咖啡。

sentences.en: Can we get a table on the terrace?
sentences.zh: 我們可以坐露臺的位子嗎？

sentences.en: Rice grows on terraces on the steep hillside.
sentences.zh: 稻米種在陡峭山坡的梯田上。

sentences.en: Their apartment has a large terrace with a city view.
sentences.zh: 他們的公寓有一個可以看到市景的大露臺。

sentences.en: Why are terraces built on mountain farms?
sentences.zh: 為什麼山區的農場要建梯田？

sentences.en: The hotel terrace is open until ten at night.
sentences.zh: 飯店的露臺開放到晚上十點。

sentences.en: Can you check my temperature with the thermometer?
sentences.zh: 你可以用體溫計幫我量一下體溫嗎？

sentences.en: The thermometer outside shows 95 degrees today.
sentences.zh: 外面的溫度計顯示今天是華氏95度。

sentences.en: Did the nurse put a thermometer under your tongue?
sentences.zh: 護理師有把體溫計放在你的舌頭下面嗎？

sentences.en: Our science class used a thermometer to measure the water.
sentences.zh: 我們的自然課用溫度計來量水溫。

sentences.en: She shook the thermometer before taking her son's temperature.
sentences.zh: 她先甩了甩體溫計，再幫兒子量體溫。

sentences.en: Put a thermometer in the oven to check the actual temperature.
sentences.zh: 在烤箱裡放一支溫度計，確認實際的溫度。

gloss_note: chicken tikka 雞肉提卡；印度菜

sentences.en: I'll have the chicken tikka with rice, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點雞肉提卡配飯，謝謝。

sentences.en: Is the tikka cooked in a clay oven?
sentences.zh: 這道提卡是用陶製烤爐烤的嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want to share the lamb tikka as an appetizer?
sentences.zh: 你想一起分著吃羊肉提卡當開胃菜嗎？

sentences.en: The tikka was spicy, so I ordered extra yogurt sauce.
sentences.zh: 提卡很辣，所以我多點了優格醬。

sentences.en: Our neighbor marinated the tikka in yogurt and spices overnight.
sentences.zh: 鄰居把提卡用優格和香料醃了一整晚。

sentences.en: This restaurant is known for its tender chicken tikka.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以軟嫩的雞肉提卡聞名。

sentences.en: Tilt your head back a little, please.
sentences.zh: 請把頭稍微往後仰。

sentences.en: The picture on the wall seems to tilt to the left.
sentences.zh: 牆上那幅畫好像往左傾斜。

sentences.en: Why does this table tilt whenever I put my laptop on it?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我一把筆電放上去，這張桌子就會傾斜？

sentences.en: Did you notice the tilt of the tower in the photo?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到照片裡那座塔的傾斜嗎？

sentences.en: Don't tilt the glass too far, or the juice will spill.
sentences.zh: 杯子別傾斜得太厲害，不然果汁會灑出來。

sentences.en: The pilot had to tilt the plane slightly to turn.
sentences.zh: 飛行員得把飛機稍微傾斜才能轉彎。

sentences.en: Can you send me the project timeline by noon?
sentences.zh: 你可以在中午前把專案時程表寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: What is the timeline for the new store opening?
sentences.zh: 新店開幕的時程是怎麼安排的？

sentences.en: We need a more realistic timeline for this task.
sentences.zh: 這項工作我們需要一個更實際的時程。

sentences.en: The manager explained the timeline to the whole team.
sentences.zh: 經理向整個團隊說明了時程。

sentences.en: Is the timeline on the website up to date?
sentences.zh: 網站上的時程表是最新的嗎？

sentences.en: The delay in shipping pushed back our whole timeline.
sentences.zh: 出貨延誤讓我們整個時程都往後延了。

sentences.en: I tiptoed into the room so I wouldn't wake the baby.
sentences.zh: 我躡手躡腳走進房間，免得吵醒寶寶。

sentences.en: Why are you tiptoeing around the house at midnight?
sentences.zh: 你半夜為什麼在家裡躡手躡腳地走？

sentences.zh: 她得踮起腳尖才搆得到最上層的架子。

sentences.en: The boss is on the phone. Can you tiptoe past the office?
sentences.zh: 老闆正在講電話。你可以輕手輕腳地走過辦公室嗎？

sentences.en: The kids tiptoed down the stairs to see their presents.
sentences.zh: 孩子們躡手躡腳地下樓去看禮物。

sentences.en: The cat tiptoes across the kitchen counter every morning.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓每天早上都輕手輕腳地走過廚房檯面。

gloss_note: tiresome habit 惹人厭的習慣

sentences.en: Waiting in line for an hour was really tiresome.
sentences.zh: 排隊等了一個小時，真的很令人厭煩。

sentences.en: Do you find his long speeches tiresome too?
sentences.zh: 你也覺得他的長篇演說很乏味嗎？

sentences.en: It's tiresome to explain the same rule every day.
sentences.zh: 每天解釋同樣的規定真是令人厭煩。

sentences.en: Is filling out these forms always so tiresome?
sentences.zh: 填這些表格總是這麼煩人嗎？

sentences.en: The movie was tiresome, and I almost fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 那部電影很乏味，我差點睡著。

sentences.en: He has a tiresome habit of interrupting people.
sentences.zh: 他有個惹人厭的習慣，就是愛打斷別人說話。

sentences.en: Did you pack all your toiletries for the trip?
sentences.zh: 你旅行的盥洗用品都帶齊了嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel provides free toiletries like soap and shampoo.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供肥皂和洗髮精之類的免費盥洗用品。

sentences.en: Toiletries must be in small bottles in your carry-on bag.
sentences.zh: 盥洗用品必須裝在小瓶子裡，放進隨身行李。

sentences.en: Where can I find toiletries in this store?
sentences.zh: 這家店的盥洗用品在哪裡？

sentences.en: The store has a sale on toiletries this week.
sentences.zh: 這家店這星期盥洗用品特價。

sentences.zh: 她把盥洗用品放在一個藍色的小袋子裡。

gloss_note: a token of thanks 一點心意

sentences.en: You need a token to play this arcade game.
sentences.zh: 你需要一枚代幣才能玩這台遊戲機。

sentences.en: Do you have any tokens left for the laundromat?
sentences.zh: 你還有自助洗衣店用的代幣嗎？

sentences.en: Can I get more tokens for the kids' games?
sentences.zh: 我可以多換一些代幣給孩子們玩遊戲嗎？

sentences.en: Please accept this gift as a token of our thanks.
sentences.zh: 請收下這份禮物，作為我們的一點謝意。

sentences.en: The small flower was a token of her love.
sentences.zh: 那朵小花是她愛意的象徵。

sentences.en: The ring is a token of their promise to each other.
sentences.zh: 這枚戒指象徵著他們對彼此的承諾。

sentences.en: A tornado hit the small town last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一場龍捲風襲擊了這個小鎮。

sentences.en: Do you know what to do during a tornado warning?
sentences.zh: 你知道龍捲風警報期間該怎麼做嗎？

sentences.en: We watched a movie about a huge tornado.
sentences.zh: 我們看了一部關於巨大龍捲風的電影。

sentences.en: The tornado destroyed several houses near the highway.
sentences.zh: 那場龍捲風摧毀了公路附近的好幾棟房子。

sentences.en: Why do tornadoes happen more often in spring?
sentences.zh: 為什麼龍捲風在春天比較常發生？

sentences.en: Our school has a tornado drill every fall.
sentences.zh: 我們學校每年秋天都會演練龍捲風避難。

gloss_note: a torrent of rain 傾盆大雨

sentences.zh: 一股混濁的急流從山坡上衝了下來。

sentences.en: The rain came down in a torrent all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 整個下午大雨傾盆而下。

sentences.en: Can we cross the river when it turns into a torrent?
sentences.zh: 河水變成急流時，我們還能過河嗎？

sentences.en: The streets turned into torrents during the heavy storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間，街道變成了一條條急流。

sentences.en: Did you get caught in the torrent of rain on your way home?
sentences.zh: 你回家的路上有被那場傾盆大雨淋到嗎？

sentences.en: Rain poured in torrents, and the game was canceled.
sentences.zh: 大雨傾盆而下，比賽被取消了。

sentences.zh: 你想要玉米還是麵粉的墨西哥薄餅？

sentences.en: The server brought warm tortillas to our table.
sentences.zh: 服務生把溫熱的墨西哥薄餅端到我們桌上。

sentences.en: Can I get the tacos on a soft tortilla?
sentences.zh: 我可以點軟墨西哥薄餅的塔可嗎？

sentences.en: She wrapped the beans and cheese in a tortilla.
sentences.zh: 她把豆子和起司包進墨西哥薄餅裡。

sentences.en: Is this tortilla made fresh every morning?
sentences.zh: 這張墨西哥薄餅是每天早上現做的嗎？

sentences.en: We fried the tortilla until it turned crispy.
sentences.zh: 我們把墨西哥薄餅煎到變得酥脆。

sentences.zh: 請把你的成績單寄給招生辦公室。

sentences.en: How can I request an official transcript from my college?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼向我的大學申請正式成績單？

sentences.en: The transcript shows that she got an A in math.
sentences.zh: 成績單顯示她的數學拿了A。

sentences.en: Do you have a transcript of the interview?
sentences.zh: 你有那場訪談的逐字稿嗎？

sentences.en: I read the transcript of the speech online.
sentences.zh: 我在網路上讀了那場演說的逐字稿。

sentences.en: Can you check the transcript for any mistakes?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫忙檢查逐字稿有沒有錯誤嗎？

sentences.en: We trekked through the forest for six hours.
sentences.zh: 我們在森林裡跋涉了六個小時。

sentences.en: It's a long trek from the parking lot to the beach.
sentences.zh: 從停車場走到海灘要走很長一段路。

sentences.en: Do you want to trek through the hills this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末你想去山區長途健行嗎？

sentences.en: After the long trek, we were too tired to cook.
sentences.zh: 長途跋涉之後，我們累得沒力氣煮飯。

sentences.en: Did the hikers trek across the desert in one day?
sentences.zh: 登山客有在一天之內徒步穿越沙漠嗎？

sentences.en: The trek to the village took us two days.
sentences.zh: 前往那個村莊的跋涉花了我們兩天。

gloss_note: a trendy place 時髦的地方

sentences.en: Is that new restaurant as trendy as people say?
sentences.zh: 那家新餐廳真如大家說的那麼時髦嗎？

sentences.en: We went to a trendy cafe downtown for brunch.
sentences.zh: 我們去市區一家時髦的咖啡店吃早午餐。

sentences.en: The menu is trendy, but the prices are fair.
sentences.zh: 菜單很時髦，價格卻很公道。

sentences.en: Do you know any trendy places for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你知道有哪些適合吃晚餐的時髦餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: Trendy food trucks line the street every Friday.
sentences.zh: 每個星期五，時髦的餐車都會沿著街道排開。

sentences.en: My friend likes trendy dishes she sees online.
sentences.zh: 我朋友喜歡她在網路上看到的流行料理。

sentences.en: Don't worry about that. It's just a trifle.
sentences.zh: 別擔心那件事，只是件小事。

sentences.en: Why do you argue over such trifles?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要為這種瑣事爭吵？

sentences.en: They fought over a trifle and stopped talking.
sentences.zh: 他們為了一件小事吵架，然後就不說話了。

sentences.en: Is it worth losing sleep over a trifle?
sentences.zh: 為了一件小事失眠值得嗎？

sentences.en: The mistake was a trifle, and nobody noticed.
sentences.zh: 那個錯誤只是小事一樁，沒有人注意到。

sentences.en: She spends too much time on trifles at work.
sentences.zh: 她在工作上花太多時間處理瑣事。

sentences.zh: 這個國家的債務將近兩兆美元。

sentences.zh: 你知道一兆裡面有幾個零嗎？

sentences.zh: 一兆等於一千個十億。

sentences.zh: 科學家說人體有數兆個細胞。

sentences.zh: 你真的有辦法想像一兆美元有多少嗎？

sentences.zh: 那家公司現在的價值超過一兆美元。

sentences.zh: 熱帶地區全年都很溫暖。

sentences.zh: 你有沒有去熱帶地區度過假？

sentences.zh: 許多色彩鮮豔的鳥類棲息在熱帶地區。

sentences.zh: 北回歸線通過台灣南部。

sentences.zh: 這些植物在熱帶以外的地方也長得好嗎？

sentences.zh: 夏季時，熱帶地區常下大雨。

sentences.zh: 我爸爸在湖邊釣到一條大鱒魚。

sentences.zh: 你想用檸檬來烤這條鱒魚嗎？

sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應新鮮鱒魚配馬鈴薯。

sentences.zh: 在這條河裡釣鱒魚合法嗎？

sentences.zh: 鱒魚需要冰涼乾淨的水才能存活。

sentences.zh: 我們用營火烤了這條鱒魚。

sentences.zh: 你要不要在義大利麵上加一些黑松露？

sentences.en: The truffle oil makes this dish smell amazing.
sentences.zh: 松露油讓這道菜聞起來香極了。

sentences.en: Why are truffles so expensive?
sentences.zh: 松露為什麼這麼貴？

sentences.en: The chef shaved fresh truffle over the soup.
sentences.zh: 主廚把新鮮松露削片灑在湯上。

sentences.en: Have you tried the truffle fries at that restaurant?
sentences.zh: 你吃過那家餐廳的松露薯條嗎？

sentences.en: Dogs are trained to find truffles in the forest.
sentences.zh: 狗經過訓練，能在森林裡找到松露。

gloss_note: tuck in one's shirt 把衣服塞進去

sentences.en: Tuck your shirt in before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前先把襯衫塞進褲子裡。

sentences.en: Can you tuck the blanket around the baby?
sentences.zh: 你可以把毯子掖在寶寶身邊嗎？

sentences.en: She tucked the letter into her bag.
sentences.zh: 她把信塞進了包包裡。

sentences.en: Why did he tuck the money under his pillow?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼把錢塞在枕頭底下？

sentences.en: He tucked his phone into his back pocket.
sentences.zh: 他把手機塞進後面的口袋。

sentences.en: Please tuck the cables behind the desk.
sentences.zh: 請把電線塞到桌子後面。

sentences.en: We walked along the beach at twilight.
sentences.zh: 黃昏時，我們沿著海灘散步。

sentences.en: Is it safe to hike in the twilight?
sentences.zh: 在暮色中健行安全嗎？

sentences.en: The sky turned purple in the twilight.
sentences.zh: 暮色中，天空變成了紫色。

sentences.en: What time does twilight start in winter?
sentences.zh: 冬天的黃昏是幾點開始的？

sentences.en: The birds were still singing in the twilight.
sentences.zh: 鳥兒在暮色中仍然唱著歌。

sentences.en: Did you see the first star appear at twilight?
sentences.zh: 你有看到黃昏時第一顆星星出現嗎？

gloss_note: twinkle like stars 像星星般閃爍

sentences.en: The stars twinkle brightly over the desert.
sentences.zh: 星星在沙漠上空明亮地閃爍著。

sentences.en: Can you see the lights twinkle on the hill?
sentences.zh: 你看得到山丘上的燈光在閃爍嗎？

sentences.en: Her eyes twinkled when she saw the cake.
sentences.zh: 她看到蛋糕時，眼睛閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: The lights on the Christmas tree twinkle every night.
sentences.zh: 聖誕樹上的燈每天晚上都閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: Why do stars seem to twinkle at night?
sentences.zh: 為什麼星星在夜裡看起來會閃爍？

sentences.en: There was a twinkle in his eye as he told the joke.
sentences.zh: 他說笑話時，眼裡閃著光芒。

gloss_note: a unanimous vote 全體一致的投票

sentences.en: The committee's vote was unanimous.
sentences.zh: 委員會的投票結果是全體一致。

sentences.en: Was the team's decision unanimous?
sentences.zh: 團隊的決定是一致通過的嗎？

sentences.en: We reached a unanimous agreement after a long meeting.
sentences.zh: 開了很久的會之後，我們達成了一致的共識。

sentences.en: The jury gave a unanimous verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪審團做出了一致的裁決。

sentences.en: Are the members unanimous about the new plan?
sentences.zh: 成員們對新計畫的看法一致嗎？

sentences.en: The fans were unanimous: the movie was great.
sentences.zh: 影迷們意見一致：這部電影很棒。

gloss_note: unauthorized access 未經授權的存取

sentences.en: Unauthorized people may not enter this area.
sentences.zh: 未經授權的人員不得進入這個區域。

sentences.en: Did you see an unauthorized charge on your card?
sentences.zh: 你有看到信用卡上出現未經授權的扣款嗎？

sentences.en: The company blocked unauthorized access to its files.
sentences.zh: 公司封鎖了對檔案的未經授權存取。

sentences.en: Is it okay to share unauthorized copies of the software?
sentences.zh: 分享未經授權的軟體複本可以嗎？

sentences.en: The manager found an unauthorized visitor in the office.
sentences.zh: 經理在辦公室裡發現一名未經許可的訪客。

sentences.en: Please report any unauthorized use of the printer.
sentences.zh: 請回報任何未經授權使用印表機的情況。

sentences.en: She gave her kids unconditional love.
sentences.zh: 她給了孩子們無條件的愛。

sentences.en: Is the store's money-back guarantee unconditional?
sentences.zh: 這家店的退款保證是無條件的嗎？

sentences.en: The fans offered unconditional support after the loss.
sentences.zh: 球迷在輸球之後仍給予無條件的支持。

sentences.en: Do you believe in unconditional trust between friends?
sentences.zh: 你相信朋友之間有無條件的信任嗎？

sentences.en: The customer wanted an unconditional refund.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客想要無條件退款。

sentences.en: A dog's love is often called unconditional.
sentences.zh: 狗的愛常被形容為無條件的。

sentences.en: The unification of Germany happened in 1871.
sentences.zh: 德國在1871年完成統一。

sentences.en: When did the unification of Italy happen?
sentences.zh: 義大利是在什麼時候統一的？

sentences.en: The unification of the two computer systems will save us money.
sentences.zh: 兩套電腦系統整合之後，能幫我們省錢。

sentences.en: Did unification bring peace to the region?
sentences.zh: 統一有為這個地區帶來和平嗎？

sentences.en: The book describes the unification of several small kingdoms into one country.
sentences.zh: 這本書描述了幾個小王國統一成一個國家的過程。

sentences.en: Many people cried with joy on the day of unification.
sentences.zh: 統一那天，許多人喜極而泣。

gloss_note: unplug the charger 拔掉充電器

sentences.en: Please unplug the printer before you clean it.
sentences.zh: 清潔印表機之前，請先拔掉插頭。

sentences.en: Did you unplug the coffee maker before leaving?
sentences.zh: 你離開前有拔掉咖啡機的插頭嗎？

sentences.en: Unplug the laptop when the battery is full.
sentences.zh: 電池充飽之後，把筆電的插頭拔掉。

sentences.en: Why did someone unplug the refrigerator?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有人把冰箱的插頭拔掉了？

sentences.en: I unplugged the lamp and carried it to the other room.
sentences.zh: 我拔掉檯燈的插頭，把它拿到另一個房間。

sentences.en: You should unplug the charger when you aren't using it.
sentences.zh: 不用充電器的時候，你應該把它拔掉。

gloss_note: unreliable source 不可靠的來源

sentences.en: My old car is unreliable in cold weather.
sentences.zh: 我那輛舊車在寒冷的天氣裡不太可靠。

sentences.en: Is the Wi-Fi in this office always so unreliable?
sentences.zh: 這間辦公室的無線網路總是這麼不穩嗎？

sentences.en: The supplier was unreliable, so we changed companies.
sentences.zh: 那家供應商不可靠，所以我們換了公司。

sentences.en: Do you think this website is unreliable?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這個網站不可靠嗎？

sentences.en: Unreliable information can cause big problems for a business.
sentences.zh: 不可靠的資訊可能給公司帶來大麻煩。

sentences.en: The bus schedule is unreliable on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末的公車時刻表不太準。

gloss_note: an unsuccessful attempt 失敗的嘗試

sentences.en: My first attempt at baking bread was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 我第一次嘗試烤麵包失敗了。

sentences.en: Was the new restaurant unsuccessful because of its location?
sentences.zh: 那家新餐廳經營不成功是因為地點嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant's unsuccessful menu change cost it many customers.
sentences.zh: 餐廳換菜單失敗，流失了很多客人。

sentences.en: Why were all my attempts at pie crust unsuccessful?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我做派皮每次都失敗？

sentences.en: After two unsuccessful tries, he finally made a perfect cake.
sentences.zh: 試了兩次都失敗後，他終於做出了完美的蛋糕。

sentences.en: Their unsuccessful bakery closed after only one year.
sentences.zh: 他們那家經營不善的麵包店只開了一年就關了。

sentences.en: Please keep your seat upright during takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛時，請讓你的座椅保持直立。

sentences.en: Can you sit upright and stop leaning on the desk?
sentences.zh: 你可以坐直，別再趴在桌上嗎？

sentences.en: Can the baby sit upright without help yet?
sentences.zh: 寶寶不用人扶，已經能坐直了嗎？

sentences.en: He stood upright and shook the manager's hand.
sentences.zh: 他站直身體，和經理握了手。

sentences.en: An upright piano takes up less space than a grand piano.
sentences.zh: 直立式鋼琴比三角鋼琴佔的空間小。

sentences.en: The doctor told me to sit upright while eating.
sentences.zh: 醫生叫我吃東西時要坐直。

gloss_note: an uprising against 反抗…的起義

sentences.en: The history class studied an uprising against the king.
sentences.zh: 歷史課探討了一場反抗國王的起義。

sentences.en: What caused the uprising in the old city?
sentences.zh: 是什麼引發了那座古城的起義？

sentences.en: The movie is about a farmers' uprising.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是農民起義。

sentences.en: Did the uprising last for several years?
sentences.zh: 這場起義持續了好幾年嗎？

sentences.en: The uprising ended when the army arrived.
sentences.zh: 軍隊抵達後，起義就結束了。

sentences.en: Our teacher explained why the uprising began in spring.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了這場起義為什麼在春天開始。

gloss_note: 市中心外圍的住宅區；紐約指北邊

sentences.en: We took the subway uptown to find a good steakhouse.
sentences.zh: 我們搭地鐵到上城區，去找一家好吃的牛排館。

sentences.en: Is there a good Italian place uptown?
sentences.zh: 上城區有好吃的義大利餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: She works downtown but lives uptown.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心上班，卻住在上城區。

sentences.en: The uptown bakery opens at six every morning.
sentences.zh: 上城區那家麵包店每天早上六點開門。

sentences.en: Do you want to eat at an uptown cafe tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想去上城區的咖啡館吃飯嗎？

sentences.en: My favorite uptown diner has the best pancakes.
sentences.zh: 我最愛的上城區小餐館有最好吃的鬆餅。
