Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: a sense of urgency 迫切感

sentences.en: Please treat this order with urgency.
sentences.zh: 請緊急處理這張訂單。

sentences.en: I don't understand the urgency of this request.
sentences.zh: 我不明白這項要求為什麼這麼急。

sentences.en: Is there any urgency to finish the report today?
sentences.zh: 今天有必要趕著完成報告嗎？

sentences.en: She felt a sense of urgency when the alarm rang.
sentences.zh: 警報響起時，她感到一股迫切感。

sentences.en: Why did the manager stress the urgency of the problem?
sentences.zh: 為什麼經理一再強調這個問題的急迫性？

sentences.en: There's no urgency, so send the file next week.
sentences.zh: 不急，檔案下週再寄就好。

gloss_note: usher sb to a seat 帶某人入座

sentences.en: A waiter ushered us to a table by the window.
sentences.zh: 服務生帶我們到窗邊的桌位。

sentences.en: Could you usher the guests into the meeting room?
sentences.zh: 你可以引導客人進會議室嗎？

sentences.en: The usher helped us find our seats at the theater.
sentences.zh: 帶位員幫我們找到劇院裡的座位。

sentences.en: Did the usher check your tickets at the door?
sentences.zh: 帶位員有在門口檢查你的票嗎？

sentences.en: The receptionist ushered him into the manager's office.
sentences.zh: 櫃檯人員引領他走進經理的辦公室。

sentences.en: My friend works as an usher at a concert hall.
sentences.zh: 我朋友在音樂廳擔任帶位員。

sentences.en: We need a few more kitchen utensils.
sentences.zh: 我們還需要幾件廚房用具。

sentences.en: Which utensil is best for stirring soup?
sentences.zh: 哪種器具最適合用來攪拌湯？

sentences.en: Please wash the utensils after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後請把餐具洗乾淨。

sentences.en: Could I get a clean set of utensils, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你給我一副乾淨的餐具嗎？

sentences.en: Do you eat with utensils or with your hands?
sentences.zh: 你是用餐具吃還是用手吃？

sentences.en: The drawer is full of cooking utensils.
sentences.zh: 抽屜裡塞滿了烹飪用具。

sentences.en: The movie was an utter waste of time.
sentences.zh: 這部電影完全是浪費時間。

sentences.en: I felt utter confusion when I read the notice.
sentences.zh: 我讀到那張通知時完全摸不著頭緒。

sentences.en: Is it utter nonsense, or is there some truth in it?
sentences.zh: 這完全是胡說八道，還是有幾分真實？

sentences.en: There was utter silence in the room after the news.
sentences.zh: 聽到消息後，房間裡一片寂靜。

sentences.en: He looked at the broken car in utter shock.
sentences.zh: 他完全震驚地看著那輛壞掉的車。

sentences.en: Did you feel utter joy when you won?
sentences.zh: 你贏的時候是不是感到無比喜悅？

gloss_note: validate a ticket 驗證票券

sentences.en: Please validate your ticket before boarding the train.
sentences.zh: 上火車之前，請先驗證你的車票。

sentences.en: Can the hotel validate my parking ticket?
sentences.zh: 飯店可以幫我的停車券蓋章驗證嗎？

sentences.en: We need to validate the data before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會之前，我們需要先驗證這些資料。

sentences.en: The system will validate your password automatically.
sentences.zh: 系統會自動驗證你的密碼。

sentences.en: How do you validate an email address on this form?
sentences.zh: 這張表單要怎麼驗證電子郵件地址？

sentences.en: The cashier had to validate my coupon before the discount worked.
sentences.zh: 收銀員得先確認我的優待券有效，折扣才能生效。

gloss_note: out of vanity 出於虛榮

sentences.en: His vanity made it hard for him to accept advice.
sentences.zh: 他的虛榮讓他很難接受別人的建議。

sentences.en: Is it vanity to check the mirror every five minutes?
sentences.zh: 每五分鐘照一次鏡子是虛榮嗎？

sentences.en: She bought the car out of pure vanity.
sentences.zh: 她買那輛車純粹是出於虛榮。

sentences.en: Do you think social media feeds people's vanity?
sentences.zh: 你覺得社群媒體會助長人們的虛榮心嗎？

sentences.en: Vanity is a weakness that many people share.
sentences.zh: 虛榮是許多人共有的弱點。

sentences.en: The singer's vanity annoyed everyone in the band.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手的虛榮讓樂團裡的每個人都很反感。

sentences.en: Water vapor rises from the hot soup.
sentences.zh: 熱湯冒出水蒸氣。

sentences.en: Is water vapor really invisible?
sentences.zh: 水蒸氣真的是看不見的嗎？

sentences.en: Vapor from the shower fogged the cold bathroom mirror.
sentences.zh: 淋浴的水氣讓冰冷的浴室鏡子起了霧。

sentences.en: Clouds form when water vapor cools into tiny drops.
sentences.zh: 水蒸氣冷卻成小水滴後就形成了雲。

sentences.en: Is the vapor from this humidifier safe for the baby?
sentences.zh: 這台加濕器噴出的水氣對寶寶安全嗎？

sentences.en: The kettle let out vapor as it boiled.
sentences.zh: 水壺煮沸時冒出了蒸氣。

sentences.en: Is the veal on the menu served with mushrooms?
sentences.zh: 菜單上的小牛肉有配蘑菇嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have the veal with potatoes, please.
sentences.zh: 我要點小牛肉配馬鈴薯，謝謝。

sentences.en: The veal was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 那份小牛肉嫩得入口即化。

sentences.en: Veal comes from young calves.
sentences.zh: 小牛肉來自年幼的小牛。

sentences.en: Do you prefer veal or chicken for this recipe?
sentences.zh: 這道食譜你比較想用小牛肉還是雞肉？

sentences.en: My grandmother cooks veal with lemon sauce on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每個星期天都會做檸檬醬小牛肉。

gloss_note: a veil of mist 一層薄霧

sentences.en: The bride wore a long white veil.
sentences.zh: 新娘戴著一條長長的白色面紗。

sentences.en: A veil of mist covered the lake this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上一層薄霧籠罩著湖面。

sentences.en: Does the veil come with the wedding dress?
sentences.zh: 面紗有附在婚紗裡一起賣嗎？

sentences.en: Thick clouds veiled the top of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 厚厚的雲層遮住了山頂。

sentences.en: Why did she lift her veil during the ceremony?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼在典禮上掀起面紗？

sentences.en: A thin veil of dust covered the old table.
sentences.zh: 一層薄薄的灰塵蓋在那張舊桌子上。

sentences.en: She bought a red velvet dress for the party.
sentences.zh: 她為派對買了一件紅色天鵝絨洋裝。

sentences.en: Is this velvet sofa easy to clean?
sentences.zh: 這張天鵝絨沙發容易清理嗎？

sentences.en: The theater has heavy velvet curtains.
sentences.zh: 這間劇院掛著厚重的天鵝絨布幕。

sentences.en: The cat's fur felt soft like velvet.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓的毛摸起來像天鵝絨一樣柔軟。

sentences.en: Do you like the velvet pillows in the living room?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡客廳裡那些天鵝絨抱枕嗎？

sentences.en: He wore a black velvet jacket to the dinner.
sentences.zh: 他穿著一件黑色天鵝絨外套去參加晚宴。

gloss_note: a versatile tool 多功能工具

sentences.en: This versatile pan can fry, bake, and steam food.
sentences.zh: 這個多用途的鍋子可以煎、烤和蒸食物。

sentences.en: Is a black jacket versatile enough for work and parties?
sentences.zh: 一件黑外套夠百搭，可以工作和派對都穿嗎？

sentences.en: She is a versatile player who can play any position.
sentences.zh: 她是個多才多藝的球員，什麼位置都能打。

sentences.en: Do you need a versatile tool for your garage?
sentences.zh: 你的車庫需要一把多功能工具嗎？

sentences.en: Rice is a versatile food that goes with many dishes.
sentences.zh: 米飯用途很廣，可以搭配很多菜。

sentences.en: We hired him because he is smart and versatile.
sentences.zh: 我們僱用他，因為他既聰明又多才多藝。

sentences.en: Did you take the puppy to the vet yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天有帶小狗去看獸醫嗎？

sentences.en: Our vet says the cat needs a checkup every year.
sentences.zh: 我們的獸醫說這隻貓每年都要做一次健康檢查。

sentences.en: Is there a good vet near your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你公寓附近有好的獸醫嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter wants to become a vet after college.
sentences.zh: 我女兒大學畢業後想當獸醫。

sentences.en: The vet gave the dog a shot and some medicine.
sentences.zh: 獸醫幫狗打了一針，還開了藥。

sentences.en: The vet visited the farm to check the cows.
sentences.zh: 獸醫到農場去檢查那些乳牛。

sentences.en: The veterinarian examined our rabbit carefully.
sentences.zh: 獸醫仔細檢查了我們的兔子。

sentences.en: Is your neighbor a veterinarian?
sentences.zh: 你的鄰居是獸醫嗎？

sentences.en: Why did you decide to become a veterinarian?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼決定當獸醫？

sentences.en: A veterinarian told us to keep the dog indoors today.
sentences.zh: 獸醫要我們今天把狗留在室內。

sentences.en: Please call the veterinarian if the cat stops eating.
sentences.zh: 如果貓不吃東西，請打電話給獸醫。

sentences.en: The veterinarian works late at the animal clinic on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 這位獸醫每週五都在動物診所工作到很晚。

gloss_note: 口語；the vibe of a place 場所的氛圍

sentences.en: I love the cozy vibe of this little café.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡這家小咖啡館溫馨的氛圍。

sentences.en: Does the restaurant have a relaxed vibe on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳週末的氣氛輕鬆嗎？

sentences.en: The patio has a fun vibe, especially at night.
sentences.zh: 這個露台的氛圍很有趣，尤其是在晚上。

sentences.en: What kind of vibe are you looking for on your birthday?
sentences.zh: 你生日想找什麼樣的氛圍？

sentences.en: The soft lights give the dining room a warm vibe.
sentences.zh: 柔和的燈光讓用餐區多了一份溫暖的感覺。

sentences.en: Did you like the vibe at that new noodle place?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡那家新開的麵店給人的感覺嗎？

gloss_note: 手機的 vibrate 模式＝震動模式

sentences.en: Please set your cell phone to vibrate during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開會時請把你的手機調成震動。

sentences.en: Does the whole floor vibrate when the train passes?
sentences.zh: 火車經過時，整層樓都會震動嗎？

sentences.en: The windows vibrate whenever a big truck drives by.
sentences.zh: 每次有大卡車經過，窗戶都會震動。

sentences.en: Why does my phone vibrate when nobody is calling?
sentences.zh: 為什麼沒有人打來，我的手機還是會震動？

sentences.en: Guitar strings vibrate and make sound.
sentences.zh: 吉他的弦震動後就會發出聲音。

sentences.en: The old washing machine began to vibrate during the spin cycle.
sentences.zh: 那台老舊的洗衣機在脫水時開始震動。

gloss_note: feel a vibration 感到震動

sentences.en: Did you feel the vibration from the earthquake?
sentences.zh: 你有感覺到地震的震動嗎？

sentences.en: The vibration of the engine made my hands numb.
sentences.zh: 引擎的震動讓我的雙手發麻。

sentences.en: Can a strong vibration break a glass?
sentences.zh: 強烈的震動能震破玻璃杯嗎？

sentences.en: Sound is caused by the vibration of the air.
sentences.zh: 聲音是由空氣的震動所產生的。

sentences.en: I turned off the ringer, but I still felt the vibration.
sentences.zh: 我把鈴聲關掉了，但還是感覺得到震動。

sentences.en: Is that vibration coming from the dryer?
sentences.zh: 那個震動是烘衣機傳來的嗎？

gloss_note: a vice 惡習；反義為 virtue（美德）

sentences.en: Gambling is a vice that can ruin a family.
sentences.zh: 賭博是會毀掉一個家庭的惡習。

sentences.en: Is chocolate your only vice?
sentences.zh: 巧克力是你唯一的壞習慣嗎？

sentences.en: Her one vice is staying up too late.
sentences.zh: 她唯一的缺點就是太晚睡。

sentences.en: Do you think video games are a vice or just fun?
sentences.zh: 你覺得電玩是種惡習，還是單純好玩？

sentences.en: Honesty is a virtue, and lying is a vice.
sentences.zh: 誠實是美德，說謊則是惡習。

sentences.en: What is your biggest vice when you feel stressed?
sentences.zh: 你壓力大的時候，最大的壞習慣是什麼？

sentences.en: Who will be the victor in tomorrow's final game?
sentences.zh: 誰會是明天決賽的贏家？

sentences.en: The victor received a gold medal and a small trophy.
sentences.zh: 優勝者得到一面金牌和一座小獎盃。

sentences.en: After three hours, the victor of the chess match shook hands with his rival.
sentences.zh: 三個小時後，這場西洋棋賽的勝利者和對手握了手。

sentences.en: Were you the victor in last year's spelling contest?
sentences.zh: 你是去年拼字比賽的優勝者嗎？

sentences.en: The victor gave a short speech after the race.
sentences.zh: 勝利者在賽後發表了簡短的談話。

sentences.en: In the end, the victor was a nine-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 最後的優勝者是一位九歲的小女孩。

gloss_note: hold a videoconference 召開視訊會議

sentences.en: Can we set up a videoconference with the Tokyo office?
sentences.zh: 我們可以和東京分公司安排一場視訊會議嗎？

sentences.en: The videoconference starts at ten, so please log in early.
sentences.zh: 視訊會議十點開始，所以請提早登入。

sentences.en: Did the videoconference go well with the new client?
sentences.zh: 和新客戶的視訊會議順利嗎？

sentences.en: We held a videoconference because our boss was traveling.
sentences.zh: 因為老闆出差，我們開了視訊會議。

sentences.en: Our internet dropped during the videoconference.
sentences.zh: 視訊會議進行到一半，我們的網路斷線了。

sentences.en: I'll send you the link for tomorrow's videoconference.
sentences.zh: 我會把明天視訊會議的連結寄給你。

gloss_note: 指越南菜時多當形容詞：Vietnamese food

sentences.en: Do you know a good Vietnamese restaurant nearby?
sentences.zh: 你知道附近有好吃的越南餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: I ordered a bowl of Vietnamese noodle soup with beef.
sentences.zh: 我點了一碗牛肉越南湯麵。

sentences.en: Is Vietnamese coffee stronger than regular coffee?
sentences.zh: 越南咖啡比一般咖啡濃嗎？

sentences.en: Vietnamese spring rolls are served with fresh herbs and sauce.
sentences.zh: 越南春捲會搭配新鮮香草和醬料一起上桌。

sentences.en: Our neighbor is Vietnamese, and she often cooks for us.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居是越南人，她常常煮東西給我們吃。

sentences.en: Which Vietnamese dish would you recommend for a first-timer?
sentences.zh: 你會推薦第一次吃的人點哪一道越南菜？

sentences.en: She jumped into the project with great vigor.
sentences.zh: 她充滿幹勁地投入了這個計畫。

sentences.en: Do you still have the vigor you had in college?
sentences.zh: 你還有大學時那種活力嗎？

sentences.en: A good breakfast gives me the vigor to work all morning.
sentences.zh: 一頓好的早餐讓我整個早上都有精力工作。

sentences.en: Grandpa walks every day to maintain his vigor.
sentences.zh: 爺爺每天走路來維持精力。

sentences.en: Where do you get the vigor to run every morning?
sentences.zh: 你每天早上跑步的精力是從哪來的？

sentences.en: The young coach brought new vigor to the team.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的教練替球隊注入了新的活力。

sentences.en: Vigorous exercise is good for your heart.
sentences.zh: 劇烈運動對心臟有益。

sentences.en: Is a vigorous workout too much for beginners?
sentences.zh: 對初學者來說，劇烈的健身運動會太吃力嗎？

sentences.en: My grandfather is still vigorous at eighty.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺到了八十歲仍然精力充沛。

sentences.en: The doctor told him to avoid vigorous activity for a week.
sentences.zh: 醫生要他一個星期內避免劇烈活動。

sentences.en: The kids played a vigorous game of soccer after school.
sentences.zh: 孩子們放學後踢了一場很激烈的足球。

sentences.en: Are you ready for a vigorous hike this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你準備好這個週末來場劇烈的健行了嗎？

sentences.en: They rented a villa near the beach for the summer.
sentences.zh: 他們為了夏天在海邊租了一棟別墅。

sentences.en: Does the villa come with a private pool?
sentences.zh: 這棟別墅附有私人泳池嗎？

sentences.en: The villa has four bedrooms and a big garden.
sentences.zh: 這棟別墅有四間臥室和一座大花園。

sentences.en: How much does it cost to stay in a villa for a week?
sentences.zh: 住一個星期的別墅要花多少錢？

sentences.en: A wealthy family built this villa in 1950.
sentences.zh: 一個富有的家族在1950年蓋了這棟別墅。

sentences.en: We had dinner on the villa's terrace.
sentences.zh: 我們在別墅的露台上吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Who plays the villain in that new movie?
sentences.zh: 那部新電影裡誰演反派？

sentences.en: The villain in the story is secretly the king's advisor.
sentences.zh: 故事裡的壞人其實是國王的顧問。

sentences.en: Kids often cheer for the hero and boo the villain.
sentences.zh: 孩子們常會為英雄加油，對壞人發出噓聲。

sentences.en: Was the villain really evil, or just misunderstood?
sentences.zh: 那個反派真的很壞，還是只是被誤會了？

sentences.en: The detective in the movie finally caught the villain who robbed the bank.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的偵探終於抓到了搶銀行的壞人。

sentences.en: Every good movie needs a strong villain.
sentences.zh: 每部好電影都需要一個強大的反派。

sentences.en: A green vine covered the whole garden wall.
sentences.zh: 一條綠色的藤蔓爬滿了整面花園牆。

sentences.en: Do tomatoes grow on a vine?
sentences.zh: 番茄是長在藤蔓上的嗎？

sentences.en: Grapes grow on a vine and ripen in late summer.
sentences.zh: 葡萄長在藤上，在夏末成熟。

sentences.en: The vine climbed the fence all the way to the roof.
sentences.zh: 那條藤蔓沿著圍籬一路爬到屋頂。

sentences.en: Pumpkins grow on long vines across the field.
sentences.zh: 南瓜長在田裡蔓延的長藤上。

sentences.en: Why is the vine growing so fast this year?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今年這條藤蔓長得這麼快？

gloss_note: visit a vineyard 參觀葡萄園

sentences.en: We toured a vineyard during our trip to California.
sentences.zh: 我們到加州旅行時參觀了一座葡萄園。

sentences.en: Does the vineyard sell its own grape juice?
sentences.zh: 這座葡萄園有賣自己做的葡萄汁嗎？

sentences.en: Workers pick grapes in the vineyard every September.
sentences.zh: 工人每年九月都會在葡萄園裡採葡萄。

sentences.en: Her family owns a small vineyard in the hills.
sentences.zh: 她的家人在山丘上擁有一座小葡萄園。

sentences.en: Would you like to visit a vineyard this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末想去參觀葡萄園嗎？

sentences.en: The vineyard is famous for its sunny hillside.
sentences.zh: 這座葡萄園以陽光充足的山坡聞名。

gloss_note: violin 小提琴 + -ist 演奏者

sentences.en: Who is the violinist in tonight's concert?
sentences.zh: 今晚音樂會的小提琴手是誰？

sentences.en: My father is a violinist in the city orchestra.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是市立交響樂團的小提琴手。

sentences.en: The young violinist practices three hours every day.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的小提琴手每天練習三個小時。

sentences.en: Has the violinist played in many countries?
sentences.zh: 這位小提琴手在很多國家演出過嗎？

sentences.en: The violinist bowed, and the crowd stood up to clap.
sentences.zh: 小提琴手鞠了躬，觀眾起立鼓掌。

sentences.en: Would you like to become a violinist someday?
sentences.zh: 你將來想成為小提琴手嗎？

gloss_note: full of vitality 充滿活力

sentences.en: Regular exercise gives you more vitality.
sentences.zh: 規律運動能讓你更有活力。

sentences.en: Do you have the vitality to work all night?
sentences.zh: 你有精力工作一整晚嗎？

sentences.en: The old town has lost its vitality since the factory closed.
sentences.zh: 自從工廠關閉後，這座老城鎮就失去了活力。

sentences.en: The little girl is full of vitality.
sentences.zh: 那個小女孩充滿活力。

sentences.en: Grandma's vitality surprises everyone in the family.
sentences.zh: 奶奶的活力讓家裡每個人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: How can we keep up our vitality during exam week?
sentences.zh: 考試週期間，我們要怎麼維持活力？

gloss_note: 強調使命感；不同於一般 job

sentences.en: Teaching is more than a job; it's her vocation.
sentences.zh: 教書對她來說不只是工作，而是天職。

sentences.en: Did you find your true vocation after college?
sentences.zh: 你大學畢業後找到真正的天職了嗎？

sentences.en: He chose nursing as his vocation after helping his mother.
sentences.zh: 他在照顧過母親之後，選擇以護理為天職。

sentences.en: What made you choose music as a vocation?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓你選擇音樂作為終身職業？

sentences.en: Many people never discover their real vocation.
sentences.zh: 很多人始終沒發現自己真正的天職。

sentences.en: My uncle has loved his vocation as a farmer for forty years.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔熱愛務農這份天職，已經四十年了。

sentences.en: Vocational schools teach students practical job skills.
sentences.zh: 職業學校教學生實用的工作技能。

sentences.en: Is a vocational school a good choice for you?
sentences.zh: 職業學校對你來說是個好選擇嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor is taking a vocational course in car repair.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居正在上汽車維修的職業課程。

sentences.en: The vocational program includes a three-month internship.
sentences.zh: 這個職業訓練課程包含三個月的實習。

sentences.en: Does the government offer vocational training for adults?
sentences.zh: 政府有提供成年人職業訓練嗎？

sentences.en: She earned a culinary certificate at a vocational school.
sentences.zh: 她在職業學校拿到了烹飪證書。

sentences.en: The puppy wags its tail whenever I come home.
sentences.zh: 每次我回到家，小狗都會搖尾巴。

sentences.en: Why does a dog wag its tail when it is happy?
sentences.zh: 狗開心的時候為什麼會搖尾巴？

sentences.en: Our dog wagged his tail and ran to the door.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗搖著尾巴跑向門口。

sentences.en: Does your dog wag its tail when it's nervous?
sentences.zh: 你的狗緊張時會搖尾巴嗎？

sentences.en: She wagged her finger at the kids and told them to stop.
sentences.zh: 她對孩子們搖了搖手指，叫他們停下來。

sentences.en: The dog's tail was wagging so hard that it hit the table.
sentences.zh: 狗的尾巴搖得太用力，撞到了桌子。

gloss_note: walnut 為堅果，也指其木材

sentences.en: Some people say walnuts are good for your brain.
sentences.zh: 有人說核桃對大腦很好。

sentences.en: Can you crack this walnut for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這顆核桃敲開嗎？

sentences.en: I added chopped walnuts to the banana bread.
sentences.zh: 我在香蕉麵包裡加了切碎的核桃。

sentences.en: Does this salad have walnuts in it?
sentences.zh: 這份沙拉裡有核桃嗎？

sentences.en: A squirrel carried a walnut up the tree.
sentences.zh: 一隻松鼠叼著一顆核桃爬上樹。

sentences.en: Grandma keeps a bowl of walnuts on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 奶奶在廚房桌上放了一碗核桃。

sentences.en: I need to update my wardrobe before the new job starts.
sentences.zh: 新工作開始前，我得添購一些新衣服。

sentences.en: Is most of your wardrobe black or gray?
sentences.zh: 你的衣服大部分是黑色還是灰色的？

sentences.en: The old wooden wardrobe in the bedroom was my grandmother's.
sentences.zh: 臥室裡那個老木衣櫃是我奶奶的。

sentences.en: Is there room in the wardrobe for my winter coats?
sentences.zh: 這個衣櫃還有空間放我的冬天外套嗎？

sentences.en: She bought a few new pieces to freshen up her wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 她買了幾件新衣服來替衣著換換新意。

sentences.en: Her wardrobe is full of bright summer dresses.
sentences.zh: 她的衣服大多是鮮豔的夏季洋裝。

gloss_note: 壽司常見的綠色辛辣佐料

sentences.en: Could I get extra wasabi with my sushi?
sentences.zh: 我的壽司可以多給我一點哇沙米嗎？

sentences.en: Wasabi burns your nose more than your tongue.
sentences.zh: 哇沙米辣的是鼻子，而不是舌頭。

sentences.en: Do you mix wasabi into your soy sauce?
sentences.zh: 你會把哇沙米拌進醬油裡嗎？

sentences.en: The wasabi was so strong that my eyes watered.
sentences.zh: 那個哇沙米太嗆了，我的眼淚都流出來了。

sentences.en: Is real wasabi really that expensive?
sentences.zh: 真正的山葵真的那麼貴嗎？

sentences.en: She added a dab of wasabi to her sushi roll.
sentences.zh: 她在壽司捲上加了一小點哇沙米。

sentences.en: Is this jacket waterproof or just water resistant?
sentences.zh: 這件外套是防水的，還是只有防潑水？

sentences.en: I bought a waterproof case for my cell phone.
sentences.zh: 我幫手機買了一個防水保護殼。

sentences.en: Are your hiking boots waterproof?
sentences.zh: 你的登山靴防水嗎？

sentences.en: We need to waterproof the basement before the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 雨季來臨前，我們得替地下室做防水。

sentences.en: The tent is waterproof, so we stayed dry all night.
sentences.zh: 這頂帳篷防水，所以我們整晚都沒淋濕。

sentences.en: Can you waterproof leather shoes at home?
sentences.zh: 皮鞋可以在家自己做防水處理嗎？

sentences.en: After the long flight, the weary travelers fell asleep fast.
sentences.zh: 經過長途飛行，疲憊的旅客很快就睡著了。

sentences.en: Are you weary of eating the same lunch every day?
sentences.zh: 你是不是厭倦了每天吃一樣的午餐？

sentences.en: He gave me a weary smile and sat down.
sentences.zh: 他對我露出疲倦的微笑，然後坐了下來。

sentences.en: I grew weary of waiting in line at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我在機場排隊排到厭煩了。

sentences.en: Why do you look so weary this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上看起來怎麼這麼累？

sentences.en: The weary nurse finally went home after a double shift.
sentences.zh: 這位疲憊的護理師輪完雙班後終於回家了。

gloss_note: a wedge of lemon 一塊檸檬角

sentences.en: Could I get a lemon wedge with my iced tea?
sentences.zh: 我的冰茶可以附一片檸檬角嗎？

sentences.en: She cut the cheese into thick wedges.
sentences.zh: 她把起司切成厚厚的楔形塊。

sentences.en: Would you like a wedge of lime in your drink?
sentences.zh: 你的飲料要加一塊萊姆角嗎？

sentences.en: He squeezed a wedge of lemon over the fish.
sentences.zh: 他把一塊檸檬角擠在魚上面。

sentences.en: Do you want a wedge of cheese with your crackers?
sentences.zh: 你要不要來一塊起司配餅乾？

sentences.en: The salad came with two tomato wedges on the side.
sentences.zh: 這份沙拉旁邊附了兩塊番茄角。

gloss_zh: 親切的；令人感到歡迎的
gloss_note: a welcoming atmosphere 親切的氛圍

sentences.en: The staff at this diner are always warm and welcoming.
sentences.zh: 這家餐館的店員總是熱情又親切。

sentences.en: Is the new bakery welcoming to first-time customers?
sentences.zh: 這家新麵包店對初次上門的客人親切嗎？

sentences.en: The owner gave us a welcoming smile at the door.
sentences.zh: 老闆在門口對我們露出親切的微笑。

sentences.en: I like this café because it feels so welcoming.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這家咖啡館，因為它讓人覺得很親切。

sentences.en: What makes a restaurant feel welcoming to you?
sentences.zh: 什麼會讓你覺得一家餐廳很親切？

sentences.en: The welcoming waiter brought us free tea while we waited.
sentences.zh: 親切的服務生在我們等位時送了免費的茶。

gloss_note: wellness program 員工保健計畫

sentences.en: Our company offers a wellness program for all employees.
sentences.zh: 我們公司為所有員工提供保健計畫。

sentences.en: Does the insurance plan cover wellness checkups?
sentences.zh: 這個保險方案涵蓋保健檢查嗎？

sentences.en: Staff wellness is one of our top priorities this year.
sentences.zh: 員工的身心健康是我們今年的首要任務之一。

sentences.en: She gave a short talk on workplace wellness at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她在會議上做了一場關於職場身心健康的簡短演講。

sentences.en: How can we support employee wellness during busy season?
sentences.zh: 旺季期間，我們該如何支持員工的身心健康？

sentences.en: The break room has a poster about mental wellness.
sentences.zh: 休息室裡有一張關於心理健康的海報。

sentences.en: The ferry leaves from the wharf at eight.
sentences.zh: 渡輪八點從碼頭出發。

sentences.en: Is there a seafood restaurant near the wharf?
sentences.zh: 碼頭附近有海鮮餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: Fishermen unloaded their catch at the wharf.
sentences.zh: 漁夫在碼頭卸下他們捕到的魚。

sentences.en: We walked along the wharf and watched the boats.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著碼頭散步，看著船隻。

sentences.en: How far is the wharf from the hotel?
sentences.zh: 碼頭離飯店有多遠？

sentences.en: Workers carried boxes from the ship to the wharf.
sentences.zh: 工人把箱子從船上搬到碼頭。

gloss_note: 美、愛爾蘭拼 whiskey；蘇格蘭拼 whisky

sentences.en: The bar has whiskey from many different countries.
sentences.zh: 這間酒吧有來自許多不同國家的威士忌。

sentences.en: Do you know how whiskey is made?
sentences.zh: 你知道威士忌是怎麼做出來的嗎？

sentences.en: He never has more than one glass of whiskey.
sentences.zh: 他喝威士忌從不超過一杯。

sentences.en: The guide explained how whiskey is aged in oak barrels.
sentences.zh: 導覽員解說了威士忌如何在橡木桶中熟成。

sentences.en: Does this sauce recipe call for whiskey?
sentences.zh: 這份醬料食譜需要用到威士忌嗎？

sentences.en: Whiskey sales rose last year, the report said.
sentences.zh: 報告指出，去年威士忌的銷量增加了。

sentences.en: Mom packs a wholesome lunch for me every day.
sentences.zh: 媽媽每天幫我準備健康的午餐。

sentences.en: Is this cereal really wholesome, or just full of sugar?
sentences.zh: 這款麥片真的健康嗎，還是只是滿滿的糖？

sentences.en: The movie is wholesome fun for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 這部電影是適合全家觀賞的健全娛樂。

sentences.en: We want our kids to grow up in a wholesome environment.
sentences.zh: 我們希望孩子在健全的環境中長大。

sentences.en: Do you eat wholesome meals during exam week?
sentences.zh: 考試週期間你有吃健康的餐點嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh fruit and vegetables make a wholesome snack.
sentences.zh: 新鮮水果和蔬菜是健康的點心。

sentences.en: The widow lives alone in a small house near the park.
sentences.zh: 那位寡婦獨自住在公園附近的小房子裡。

sentences.en: My neighbor became a widow last year, so we visit her often.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居去年成了寡婦，所以我們常去看她。

sentences.en: Is the old woman next door a widow?
sentences.zh: 隔壁那位老太太是寡婦嗎？

sentences.en: The charity gave food to every widow in the village.
sentences.zh: 慈善團體把食物送給村裡的每一位寡婦。

sentences.en: Can a widow receive her husband's pension?
sentences.zh: 寡婦可以領取丈夫的退休金嗎？

sentences.en: The movie is about a young widow who opens a bakery.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是一位年輕寡婦開麵包店的故事。

sentences.en: My grandfather has been a widower for ten years.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺已經當了十年的鰥夫。

sentences.en: Is the man in the blue coat a widower?
sentences.zh: 穿藍色外套的那位男士是鰥夫嗎？

sentences.en: The widower raised three children by himself.
sentences.zh: 這位鰥夫獨自把三個孩子養大。

sentences.en: After his wife passed away, the widower moved in with his son.
sentences.zh: 妻子過世後，這位鰥夫搬去和兒子同住。

sentences.en: Did the widower sell the house after his wife died?
sentences.zh: 妻子過世後，那位鰥夫把房子賣了嗎？

sentences.en: The widower brought flowers to the grave every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 這位鰥夫每個星期天都帶花到墓前。

sentences.en: I'd like a bowl of wonton soup, please.
sentences.zh: 麻煩給我一碗餛飩湯。

sentences.en: Are the wontons filled with pork or shrimp?
sentences.zh: 這些餛飩是包豬肉還是蝦子？

sentences.en: My grandmother makes wontons from scratch every winter.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年冬天都會自己包餛飩。

sentences.en: Does the set lunch come with wonton soup?
sentences.zh: 午間套餐有附餛飩湯嗎？

sentences.en: The wontons floated to the top when they were done.
sentences.zh: 餛飩煮熟後就浮到了水面上。

sentences.en: The wonton wrappers are thin, so be careful.
sentences.zh: 餛飩皮很薄，要小心一點。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: A woodpecker was tapping on the old tree.
sentences.zh: 一隻啄木鳥正在老樹上啄著。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a woodpecker in your yard?
sentences.zh: 你在自家院子裡看過啄木鳥嗎？

sentences.en: The woodpecker uses its strong beak to find insects.
sentences.zh: 啄木鳥用堅硬的喙找昆蟲吃。

sentences.en: How does a woodpecker avoid getting a headache?
sentences.zh: 啄木鳥是怎麼避免頭痛的？

sentences.en: Listen! There's a woodpecker somewhere nearby.
sentences.zh: 聽！附近有一隻啄木鳥。

sentences.en: The woodpecker flew away when we got close to the tree.
sentences.zh: 我們走近那棵樹時，啄木鳥就飛走了。

sentences.en: Is this sweater made of pure wool?
sentences.zh: 這件毛衣是純羊毛做的嗎？

sentences.en: Wool keeps you warm even when it gets wet.
sentences.zh: 羊毛即使弄濕了也能保暖。

sentences.en: The store sells wool coats at half price this week.
sentences.zh: 這家店本週的毛料外套都半價。

sentences.en: Do you have this scarf in a softer wool?
sentences.zh: 這條圍巾有更柔軟的毛料款嗎？

sentences.en: Please wash wool items by hand to avoid shrinking.
sentences.zh: 羊毛衣物請用手洗，以免縮水。

sentences.en: Our supplier ships raw wool to factories overseas.
sentences.zh: 我們的供應商把原毛運到海外的工廠。

gloss_note: wrestle with 還有「奮力對付」之意

sentences.en: My dad and I used to wrestle on the living room floor.
sentences.zh: 我和爸爸以前常在客廳地板上摔角玩。

sentences.en: Did you wrestle in high school?
sentences.zh: 你高中時打過摔角嗎？

sentences.en: The two boys wrestled for the ball until the teacher stopped them.
sentences.zh: 兩個男孩為了搶球扭打，直到老師出面制止。

sentences.en: Do you want to wrestle for the last slice of pizza?
sentences.zh: 你想用摔角來決定誰拿最後一片披薩嗎？

sentences.en: He wrestled the thief to the ground.
sentences.zh: 他把小偷摔倒在地。

sentences.en: The puppies wrestle in the yard all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 小狗們整個下午都在院子裡扭打嬉鬧。

gloss_note: wrinkle-free 免燙；衣服皺褶也叫 wrinkle

sentences.en: This fabric doesn't wrinkle, even after a long flight.
sentences.zh: 這種布料即使搭了長途飛機也不會起皺。

sentences.en: Do you have an iron to remove the wrinkles from my shirt?
sentences.zh: 你有熨斗可以幫我燙平襯衫上的皺褶嗎？

sentences.en: Grandpa has deep wrinkles around his eyes from smiling.
sentences.zh: 爺爺因為愛笑，眼角有很深的皺紋。

sentences.en: Please don't wrinkle my dress when you pack it.
sentences.zh: 你打包我的洋裝時，請不要把它弄皺。

sentences.en: Does this cotton shirt wrinkle easily in the dryer?
sentences.zh: 這件棉質襯衫放進烘衣機容易起皺嗎？

sentences.en: She smoothed the wrinkles out of the tablecloth.
sentences.zh: 她把桌巾上的皺褶撫平。

sentences.en: My father gave me his old wristwatch.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸把他的舊手錶送給了我。

sentences.en: Does the store repair a broken wristwatch?
sentences.zh: 這家店可以修壞掉的手錶嗎？

sentences.en: The leather strap makes this wristwatch look very elegant.
sentences.zh: 皮製錶帶讓這支手錶看起來很優雅。

sentences.en: Is this wristwatch on sale this week?
sentences.zh: 這支手錶本週有特價嗎？

sentences.en: He glanced at his wristwatch and hurried out of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他瞄了一眼手錶，匆匆離開了會議。

sentences.en: The customer returned the wristwatch because the battery died.
sentences.zh: 顧客因為電池沒電而退回了這支手錶。

sentences.en: Many people yearn for a quiet life by the sea.
sentences.zh: 很多人嚮往在海邊過著平靜的生活。

sentences.en: Do you ever yearn for your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有想念過家鄉？

sentences.en: She yearned to travel abroad after high school.
sentences.zh: 她高中畢業後渴望出國旅行。

sentences.en: Does he still yearn for his old job?
sentences.zh: 他還在懷念原來的工作嗎？

sentences.en: The lonely boy yearned for a real friend.
sentences.zh: 那個孤單的男孩渴望有一個真正的朋友。

sentences.en: After a week of rain, we all yearned for sunshine.
sentences.zh: 下了一個星期的雨後，我們都渴望看到陽光。

sentences.en: I eat a cup of yogurt for breakfast every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天早餐都吃一杯優格。

sentences.en: Is this yogurt sweetened, or is it plain?
sentences.zh: 這個優格有加糖，還是原味的？

sentences.en: Mix yogurt with fresh fruit for a quick snack.
sentences.zh: 把優格和新鮮水果拌在一起，就是快速的點心。

sentences.en: Do you want honey on your yogurt?
sentences.zh: 你的優格要加蜂蜜嗎？

sentences.en: The yogurt in the fridge expires tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡的優格明天到期。

sentences.en: Yogurt is made from milk and helpful bacteria.
sentences.zh: 優格是用牛奶和有益的細菌做成的。

gloss_note: zoom in 放大；zoom out 縮小

sentences.en: Can you zoom in on that picture?
sentences.zh: 你可以把那張照片放大嗎？

sentences.en: The camera can zoom in on a bird far away.
sentences.zh: 這台相機可以把遠處的鳥拉近。

sentences.en: Please zoom in so everyone can read the map.
sentences.zh: 請放大畫面，讓大家都看得清楚地圖。

sentences.en: How far can this lens zoom?
sentences.zh: 這個鏡頭可以拉近到多遠？

sentences.en: The camera zoomed in on the winner's happy face.
sentences.zh: 鏡頭拉近到優勝者開心的臉上。

sentences.en: This camera has a strong zoom for shooting wild animals.
sentences.zh: 這台相機有強大的變焦功能，適合拍野生動物。

gloss_note: be able to 能夠，比 can 稍正式

sentences.en: Are you able to work on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 你星期六可以上班嗎？

sentences.en: She wasn't able to finish her homework last night.
sentences.zh: 她昨晚沒辦法把功課寫完。

sentences.en: Sorry, I won't be able to make it tonight.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我今晚沒辦法到場。

sentences.en: My neighbor's son is studying abroad this year.
sentences.zh: 鄰居的兒子今年在國外讀書。

sentences.en: Have you ever traveled abroad by yourself?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有自己一個人出國旅行過？

sentences.en: Many people go abroad during summer vacation.
sentences.zh: 很多人暑假會出國。

gloss_note: Act your age. 別幼稚了

sentences.en: Why are you acting so strange today?
sentences.zh: 你今天怎麼表現得這麼奇怪？

sentences.en: We need to act fast before the sale ends.
sentences.zh: 我們得在特價結束前趕快行動。

sentences.en: Come on, act your age!
sentences.zh: 好了啦，別幼稚了！

sentences.en: Her quick action kept the soup from burning.
sentences.zh: 她動作很快，湯才沒有燒焦。

sentences.en: Actions speak louder than words, my dad always says.
sentences.zh: 我爸總說，行動勝於言語。

sentences.en: Is the city taking action on the noise?
sentences.zh: 市政府有針對噪音採取行動嗎？

gloss_note: 近年也常用 actor 泛稱男女演員

sentences.en: My neighbor is a stage actor in town.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居是本地的舞台劇演員。

sentences.en: Who's your favorite actor in this movie?
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡你最喜歡哪位演員？

sentences.en: He wants to become an actor someday.
sentences.zh: 他希望有一天能成為演員。

gloss_note: 近年也常用 actor 泛稱女演員

sentences.en: The actress forgot her lines during the school play.
sentences.zh: 那位女演員在校內演出時忘詞了。

sentences.en: Did you see that actress on the talk show?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那位女演員上脫口秀節目嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter dreams of becoming an actress.
sentences.zh: 我女兒夢想成為女演員。

gloss_note: 口語常用來糾正或補充說明

sentences.en: I actually like cooking more than eating out.
sentences.zh: 其實我比較喜歡自己煮，不愛外食。

sentences.en: Do you actually know how to swim?
sentences.zh: 你真的會游泳嗎？

sentences.en: Actually, I'm not that hungry right now.
sentences.zh: 其實我現在沒那麼餓。

gloss_note: I'm afraid... 委婉說壞消息

sentences.en: Are you afraid of dogs?
sentences.zh: 你怕狗嗎？

sentences.en: I'm afraid we're out of milk.
sentences.zh: 恐怕我們的牛奶沒了。

sentences.en: Don't be afraid to ask questions in class.
sentences.zh: 別怕在課堂上發問。

sentences.en: Do you want to hang out this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 你今天下午想出來玩嗎？

sentences.en: The kids play at the park every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 孩子們每天下午都在公園玩。

sentences.en: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我明天下午要看牙醫。

gloss_note: at the age of 在…歲時

sentences.en: What's the age limit for this ride?
sentences.zh: 這個遊樂設施有年齡限制嗎？

sentences.en: My son started school at the age of five.
sentences.zh: 我兒子五歲就開始上學了。

sentences.en: She's about my age, so we get along.
sentences.zh: 她年紀跟我差不多，所以我們很合得來。

sentences.en: I moved here three years ago.
sentences.zh: 我三年前搬來這裡。

sentences.en: How long ago did you start working here?
sentences.zh: 你多久以前開始在這裡工作的？

sentences.en: My phone died a few minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 我的手機幾分鐘前沒電了。

gloss_note: agree with sb 同意某人的看法

sentences.en: I totally agree with you on that.
sentences.zh: 這點我完全同意你。

sentences.en: Do you agree with the coach?
sentences.zh: 你同意教練的看法嗎？

sentences.en: We finally agreed on a time to meet.
sentences.zh: 我們終於談好了見面的時間。

gloss_note: Go ahead. 請便；ahead of time 提前

sentences.en: Go ahead, I'll wait in the car.
sentences.zh: 你先去吧，我在車上等。

sentences.en: There's a long line ahead of us.
sentences.zh: 我們前面排了很長的隊。

sentences.en: Can we order ahead of time?
sentences.zh: 我們可以提前訂餐嗎？

sentences.en: Let's go outside and get some fresh air.
sentences.zh: 我們去外面呼吸點新鮮空氣吧。

sentences.en: Is the air quality bad today?
sentences.zh: 今天空氣品質差嗎？

sentences.en: Can you put some air in my tire?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我的輪胎打點氣嗎？

gloss_note: 美式拼法 airplane，英式 aeroplane

sentences.en: Please put your phone on airplane mode.
sentences.zh: 請把你的手機調成飛航模式。

sentences.en: Have you ever been on an airplane?
sentences.zh: 你搭過飛機嗎？

sentences.en: My son loves watching airplanes take off.
sentences.zh: 我兒子很愛看飛機起飛。

gloss_note: pick sb up 去機場接人

sentences.en: Can you pick me up at the airport?
sentences.zh: 你可以來機場接我嗎？

sentences.en: We got to the airport two hours early.
sentences.zh: 我們提早兩小時到機場。

sentences.en: The airport shuttle leaves every thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 機場接駁車每三十分鐘一班。

sentences.en: Dogs aren't allowed in this restaurant.
sentences.zh: 這間餐廳不准帶狗進來。

sentences.en: Does your school allow phones in class?
sentences.zh: 你們學校允許在課堂上用手機嗎？

sentences.en: My mom doesn't allow candy before dinner.
sentences.zh: 我媽不讓我們在晚餐前吃糖果。

sentences.en: Dinner is almost ready, so wash your hands.
sentences.zh: 晚餐快好了，去洗手吧。

sentences.en: I almost forgot my lunch at home!
sentences.zh: 我差點把午餐忘在家裡！

sentences.en: Are we almost there yet?
sentences.zh: 我們快到了嗎？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Stephanie~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: already 放句中；yet 多用於問句、否定句句尾

sentences.en: I already finished my homework.
sentences.zh: 我已經把功課寫完了。

sentences.en: Have you already eaten lunch?
sentences.zh: 你已經吃過午餐了嗎？

sentences.en: It's already dark, so let's head home.
sentences.zh: 天已經黑了，我們回家吧。

gloss_note: 放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後

sentences.en: I also need to buy some eggs.
sentences.zh: 我還需要買一些蛋。

sentences.en: Are you also going to the party?
sentences.zh: 你也要去那個派對嗎？

sentences.en: She's smart and also very funny.
sentences.zh: 她很聰明，而且也很風趣。

gloss_note: You're always late! 抱怨的語氣

sentences.en: My dad always makes pancakes on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我爸每個星期天都會做鬆餅。

sentences.en: Why are you always late for work?
sentences.zh: 你上班怎麼老是遲到？

sentences.en: The bus is always crowded in the morning.
sentences.zh: 早上的公車總是很擠。

sentences.en: Many Americans watch football on Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 很多美國人感恩節會看美式足球。

sentences.en: Is that an American flag on your porch?
sentences.zh: 你家門廊上那是美國國旗嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor is American, and she speaks Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居是美國人，她會說西班牙文。

gloss_note: from a different angle 換個角度

sentences.en: Try taking the photo from a different angle.
sentences.zh: 試試看從不同的角度拍這張照片。

sentences.en: Is this angle bigger than ninety degrees?
sentences.zh: 這個角大於九十度嗎？

sentences.en: Let's look at this problem from another angle.
sentences.zh: 我們換個角度看這個問題吧。

sentences.en: Are you still angry at me?
sentences.zh: 你還在生我的氣嗎？

sentences.en: My boss gets angry when we're late.
sentences.zh: 我們遲到的話，老闆會生氣。

sentences.en: I was angry about the parking ticket.
sentences.zh: 我對那張停車罰單很生氣。

sentences.en: What's your favorite animal at the zoo?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡動物園裡的哪種動物？

sentences.en: My daughter collects stuffed animals.
sentences.zh: 我女兒喜歡收集填充玩偶。

sentences.en: Please don't feed the animals in the park.
sentences.zh: 請不要在公園裡餵動物。

sentences.en: Can you answer the phone for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我接電話嗎？

sentences.en: I don't know the answer to this question.
sentences.zh: 我不知道這題的答案。

sentences.en: She never answers my texts right away.
sentences.zh: 她從來不馬上回我訊息。

gloss_note: get rid of ants 除掉螞蟻

sentences.en: There are ants in the kitchen again!
sentences.zh: 廚房裡又有螞蟻了！

sentences.en: Do you know how to get rid of ants?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼除掉螞蟻嗎？

sentences.en: An ant is carrying a crumb across the table.
sentences.zh: 一隻螞蟻正扛著麵包屑爬過桌子。

sentences.en: We live in a small apartment downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們住在市區的一間小公寓。

sentences.en: How much is the rent for this apartment?
sentences.zh: 這間公寓的租金多少？

sentences.en: Our apartment building has a laundry room.
sentences.zh: 我們的公寓大樓裡有洗衣間。

sentences.en: A deer suddenly appeared on the road.
sentences.zh: 一隻鹿突然出現在路上。

sentences.en: He appears to be asleep.
sentences.zh: 他看起來好像睡著了。

sentences.en: Did a message appear on your screen?
sentences.zh: 你的螢幕上有跳出訊息嗎？

sentences.en: We picked apples at a farm last fall.
sentences.zh: 我們去年秋天在農場採了蘋果。

sentences.en: Can you slice this apple for the kids?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫孩子們把這顆蘋果切片嗎？

sentences.en: She packs an apple in her lunch.
sentences.zh: 她的午餐裡都會放一顆蘋果。

sentences.en: Taxes are due on April fifteenth.
sentences.zh: 報稅期限是四月十五日。

sentences.en: Does your school have spring break in April?
sentences.zh: 你們學校四月有春假嗎？

sentences.en: It rains a lot here in April.
sentences.zh: 這裡四月常下雨。

gloss_note: in this area 在這一帶

sentences.en: Is there a good pizza place in this area?
sentences.zh: 這一帶有好吃的披薩店嗎？

sentences.en: Parents wait in the waiting area.
sentences.zh: 家長都在等候區等待。

sentences.en: We live in a quiet area near school.
sentences.zh: 我們住在學校附近一個安靜的地區。

gloss_note: break an arm 手臂骨折

sentences.en: My arm hurts after the tennis game.
sentences.zh: 打完網球後我的手臂好痛。

sentences.en: Can you hold the baby in your other arm?
sentences.zh: 你可以用另一隻手臂抱寶寶嗎？

sentences.en: He broke his arm skateboarding last summer.
sentences.zh: 他去年夏天玩滑板時摔斷了手臂。

sentences.en: Let's meet around six at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我們六點左右在餐廳碰面吧。

sentences.en: Can you show me around the campus?
sentences.zh: 你可以帶我在校園裡四處逛逛嗎？

sentences.en: The kids are running around in the yard.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在院子裡跑來跑去。

gloss_note: arrive at 小地點；arrive in 大城市

sentences.en: What time does your flight arrive?
sentences.zh: 你的班機幾點抵達？

sentences.en: We arrived at the clinic ten minutes early.
sentences.zh: 我們提早十分鐘到診所。

sentences.en: My package should arrive by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我的包裹星期五前應該會送到。

sentences.en: I have art class right after lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐後我馬上有美術課。

sentences.en: Do you like modern art?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡現代藝術嗎？

sentences.en: Her art is hanging on the fridge.
sentences.zh: 她的畫作貼在冰箱上。

sentences.en: Don't be shy; just ask for help.
sentences.zh: 別害羞，直接開口求助就好。

sentences.en: Can I ask you a quick question?
sentences.zh: 我可以問你一個簡單的問題嗎？

sentences.en: She asked me to pick up the kids.
sentences.zh: 她請我去接孩子。

gloss_note: 用於人或動物攻擊；球賽進攻美式說 offense

sentences.en: Did the dog attack the mail carrier again?
sentences.zh: 那隻狗又攻擊郵差了嗎？

sentences.en: Bees can attack if you get too close.
sentences.zh: 靠太近的話，蜜蜂可能會攻擊你。

sentences.en: My cat likes to attack my shoelaces.
sentences.zh: 我的貓很愛撲咬我的鞋帶。

sentences.en: It's really hot and humid here in August.
sentences.zh: 這裡八月又熱又悶。

sentences.en: Our school starts in late August.
sentences.zh: 我們學校在八月底開學。

sentences.en: Are you going on vacation in August?
sentences.zh: 你八月要去度假嗎？

gloss_note: aunt 泛指姑姑、阿姨、舅媽、嬸嬸

sentences.en: My aunt makes the best apple pie.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨做的蘋果派最好吃。

sentences.en: Are you visiting your aunt this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末要去看你阿姨嗎？

sentences.en: My aunt and uncle live next door.
sentences.zh: 我的阿姨和姨丈住在隔壁。

sentences.en: Autumn leaves turn red and orange here.
sentences.zh: 這裡的秋天樹葉會變紅變橘。

sentences.en: Do you prefer autumn or spring?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡秋天還是春天？

sentences.en: We always rake the yard in autumn.
sentences.zh: 我們每年秋天都會耙院子裡的落葉。

gloss_note: far away 很遠；go away 走開

sentences.en: Is the grocery store far away?
sentences.zh: 那間雜貨店很遠嗎？

sentences.en: Go away; I'm trying to study!
sentences.zh: 走開啦，我在念書！

sentences.en: I'll be away from my desk until noon.
sentences.zh: 我中午前都不會在座位上。

sentences.en: Our neighbors just had a baby girl.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居剛生了一個女寶寶。

sentences.en: Is the baby sleeping in the next room?
sentences.zh: 寶寶是在隔壁房間睡覺嗎？

sentences.en: Be quiet, or you'll wake the baby.
sentences.zh: 小聲點，不然會吵醒寶寶。

gloss_note: be back 回來；back pain 背痛

sentences.en: I'll be back in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 我十分鐘後回來。

sentences.en: My back hurts from sitting all day.
sentences.zh: 我坐了一整天，背好痛。

sentences.en: Did you call the dentist back yet?
sentences.zh: 你回電給牙醫了嗎？

gloss_note: feel bad 覺得抱歉或難過

sentences.en: The weather is really bad today.
sentences.zh: 今天天氣真的很糟。

sentences.en: Is it bad to eat late at night?
sentences.zh: 晚上很晚吃東西不好嗎？

sentences.en: Not bad, but the fries were cold.
sentences.zh: 還不錯啦，只是薯條冷掉了。

sentences.en: We play badminton in the gym every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我們每週二在體育館打羽毛球。

sentences.en: Do you want to play badminton after school?
sentences.zh: 你放學後想打羽毛球嗎？

sentences.en: Bring your badminton racket to the park.
sentences.zh: 把你的羽毛球拍帶到公園來。

gloss_note: Paper or plastic? 紙袋還是塑膠袋？

sentences.en: Do you need a bag for that?
sentences.zh: 你需要袋子裝那個嗎？

sentences.en: I left my bag on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我把包包忘在公車上了。

sentences.en: Can you carry this heavy bag for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我拿這個很重的袋子嗎？

sentences.en: I'm baking cookies for the school bake sale.
sentences.zh: 我正在烤餅乾，要拿去學校的烘焙義賣。

sentences.en: Can you bake a cake for my birthday?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我烤個生日蛋糕嗎？

sentences.en: Bake the chicken for forty minutes.
sentences.zh: 把雞肉烤四十分鐘。

gloss_note: stop by the bakery 順路去麵包店

sentences.en: The bakery on Main Street opens at six.
sentences.zh: 大街上那家麵包店六點開門。

sentences.en: Can you stop by the bakery on your way home?
sentences.zh: 你回家路上可以順道去一下麵包店嗎？

sentences.en: I always buy fresh bread at the bakery.
sentences.zh: 我總是在麵包店買新鮮的麵包。

gloss_note: 一樓的戶外平台多叫 patio

sentences.en: We eat breakfast on the balcony when it's warm.
sentences.zh: 天氣暖和時，我們會在陽台吃早餐。

sentences.en: Does your apartment have a balcony?
sentences.zh: 你的公寓有陽台嗎？

sentences.en: My cat likes to sit on the balcony.
sentences.zh: 我的貓喜歡坐在陽台上。

gloss_note: a bunch of bananas 一串香蕉

sentences.en: Do we have any bananas left?
sentences.zh: 我們還有香蕉嗎？

sentences.en: I eat a banana before every morning run.
sentences.zh: 我每次晨跑前都會吃一根香蕉。

sentences.en: These bananas are still green; wait a few days.
sentences.zh: 這些香蕉還是綠的，再等幾天吧。

sentences.en: My son plays the drums in the school band.
sentences.zh: 我兒子在學校樂隊打鼓。

sentences.en: Is that band playing at the park tonight?
sentences.zh: 那個樂團今晚會在公園表演嗎？

sentences.en: She joined a rock band in high school.
sentences.zh: 她高中時加入了一個搖滾樂團。

sentences.en: I need to stop by the bank after work.
sentences.zh: 我下班後要順道去一下銀行。

sentences.en: Do you have an account at this bank?
sentences.zh: 你在這家銀行有帳戶嗎？

sentences.en: The bank closes at five on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 這家銀行星期五五點關門。

sentences.en: Let's go to a baseball game this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們這個週末去看棒球賽吧。

sentences.en: Does your son play baseball in the summer?
sentences.zh: 你兒子夏天打棒球嗎？

sentences.en: My dad wears a baseball cap everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我爸去哪裡都戴棒球帽。

sentences.en: Put the apples in the basket, please.
sentences.zh: 請把蘋果放進籃子裡。

sentences.en: Do you have a basket for the laundry?
sentences.zh: 你有洗衣籃嗎？

sentences.en: Grab a basket if you're only buying a few things.
sentences.zh: 如果只買幾樣東西，就拿個籃子吧。

sentences.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
sentences.zh: 我們放學後在公園打籃球。

sentences.en: Who's your favorite basketball player?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪位籃球選手？

sentences.en: My son's basketball practice ends at six.
sentences.zh: 我兒子的籃球練習六點結束。

sentences.en: Hold the bat with both hands.
sentences.zh: 用雙手握住球棒。

sentences.en: A bat flew into our garage last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有隻蝙蝠飛進了我們的車庫。

sentences.en: Did you bring your bat to practice?
sentences.zh: 你有把球棒帶來練習嗎？

sentences.en: I take a bath before bed every night.
sentences.zh: 我每天睡前都會泡澡。

sentences.en: Can you give the baby a bath?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫寶寶洗澡嗎？

sentences.en: The bath water is too hot.
sentences.zh: 泡澡的水太燙了。

sentences.en: Excuse me, where's the bathroom?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，請問洗手間在哪裡？

sentences.en: I need to clean the bathroom today.
sentences.zh: 我今天得打掃浴室。

sentences.en: The bathroom sink is leaking again.
sentences.zh: 浴室的水槽又漏水了。

gloss_note: go to the beach 去海邊

sentences.en: Let's go to the beach this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們這個週末去海邊吧。

sentences.en: Is the beach crowded in July?
sentences.zh: 七月的海灘會很擠嗎？

sentences.en: We walked along the beach at sunset.
sentences.zh: 我們在日落時沿著海灘散步。

sentences.en: Can you add green beans to the salad?
sentences.zh: 你可以在沙拉裡加些四季豆嗎？

sentences.en: We eat rice and beans every week.
sentences.zh: 我們每週都吃豆子拌飯。

sentences.en: I'll have a bowl of bean soup.
sentences.zh: 我要一碗豆子湯。

sentences.en: Don't leave food out; a bear might come.
sentences.zh: 別把食物放在外面，可能會引來熊。

sentences.en: Did you see a bear on the hiking trail?
sentences.zh: 你在健行步道上有看到熊嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter sleeps with a teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 我女兒抱著泰迪熊睡覺。

gloss_note: It's a beautiful day. 天氣真好

sentences.en: It's a beautiful day for a picnic.
sentences.zh: 今天很適合野餐，天氣真好。

sentences.en: Your garden looks so beautiful this spring.
sentences.zh: 你的花園今年春天看起來好漂亮。

sentences.en: Isn't the sunset beautiful tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚的夕陽不是很美嗎？

sentences.en: What do you want to become when you grow up?
sentences.zh: 你長大後想成為什麼樣的人？

sentences.en: The weather becomes cooler after October.
sentences.zh: 十月過後天氣會變涼。

sentences.en: My neighbors have become good friends of ours.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居已經成了我們的好朋友。

gloss_note: go to bed 上床睡覺

sentences.en: It's late; go to bed now.
sentences.zh: 很晚了，現在去睡覺吧。

sentences.en: Did you make your bed this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上有鋪床嗎？

sentences.en: I usually get into bed around eleven.
sentences.zh: 我通常十一點左右上床。

sentences.en: Our apartment has two bedrooms.
sentences.zh: 我們的公寓有兩間臥室。

sentences.en: Is your bedroom clean yet?
sentences.zh: 你的房間打掃好了嗎？

sentences.en: Her bedroom window faces the park.
sentences.zh: 她臥室的窗戶面向公園。

sentences.en: A bee landed on my juice cup.
sentences.zh: 一隻蜜蜂停在我的果汁杯上。

sentences.en: Are you allergic to bee stings?
sentences.zh: 你會對蜜蜂螫傷過敏嗎？

sentences.en: Bees help flowers grow in the garden.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂幫助花園裡的花生長。

sentences.en: Can you pick up some ground beef today?
sentences.zh: 你今天可以順便買些牛絞肉嗎？

sentences.en: We're having beef stew tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚吃燉牛肉。

sentences.en: Is this beef cooked all the way through?
sentences.zh: 這塊牛肉煮熟了嗎？

gloss_note: begin 比 start 稍正式

sentences.en: What time does the movie begin?
sentences.zh: 這部電影幾點開演？

sentences.en: Class begins at eight, so don't be late.
sentences.zh: 八點開始上課，所以不要遲到。

sentences.en: I began learning guitar last year.
sentences.zh: 我去年開始學吉他。

gloss_note: Believe it or not. 信不信由你

sentences.en: I can't believe we won!
sentences.zh: 我不敢相信我們贏了！

sentences.en: Do you believe what he said?
sentences.zh: 你相信他說的話嗎？

sentences.en: Believe it or not, I've never seen snow.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，我從沒看過雪。

gloss_note: school bell 學校的上下課鈴

sentences.en: The school bell rings at three o'clock.
sentences.zh: 學校的下課鐘在三點響。

sentences.en: Did someone just ring the bell?
sentences.zh: 剛剛是不是有人按了鈴？

sentences.en: My cat has a bell on her collar.
sentences.zh: 我的貓項圈上掛著一個鈴鐺。

gloss_note: belong to 屬於；belong in 應放在

sentences.en: Does this jacket belong to you?
sentences.zh: 這件外套是你的嗎？

sentences.en: The dishes belong in the top cabinet.
sentences.zh: 這些盤子應該放在上面的櫃子裡。

sentences.en: I finally feel like I belong here.
sentences.zh: 我終於覺得自己屬於這裡。

sentences.en: It was ten degrees below zero this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上是零下十度。

sentences.en: Please sign your name on the line below.
sentences.zh: 請在下面那條線上簽名。

sentences.en: Do you hear music from the apartment below?
sentences.zh: 你聽得到樓下公寓傳來的音樂嗎？

sentences.en: Buckle your seat belt before we leave.
sentences.zh: 出發前先繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: I need a new belt for these pants.
sentences.zh: 我需要一條新皮帶搭這件褲子。

sentences.en: Do I need to take off my belt here?
sentences.zh: 我在這裡需要脫掉皮帶嗎？

sentences.en: Let's sit on that bench by the pond.
sentences.zh: 我們去坐池塘邊那張長椅吧。

sentences.en: Someone left a backpack on the bench.
sentences.zh: 有人把背包留在長椅上。

sentences.en: Is anyone sitting on this bench right now?
sentences.zh: 現在有人坐這張長椅嗎？

gloss_note: ride a bicycle；口語多說 bike

sentences.en: She rides her bicycle to school every day.
sentences.zh: 她每天騎腳踏車上學。

sentences.en: Do you know how to fix a bicycle tire?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼修腳踏車輪胎嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighbor gave us his old bicycle.
sentences.zh: 鄰居把他的舊腳踏車送給我們。

gloss_note: no big deal 沒什麼大不了

sentences.en: That's a really big pizza for two people.
sentences.zh: 那個披薩對兩個人來說真的很大。

sentences.en: Don't worry, it's no big deal.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，沒什麼大不了。

sentences.en: Do you have any big plans this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末有什麼重要的計畫嗎？

gloss_note: 美式口語常說 bike；ride a bike

sentences.en: I ride my bike to work when it's sunny.
sentences.zh: 天氣好的時候我騎腳踏車上班。

sentences.en: Can I park my bike here?
sentences.zh: 我可以把腳踏車停在這裡嗎？

sentences.en: We went on a long bike ride yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們昨天騎了很久的腳踏車。

sentences.en: A little bird landed on our porch.
sentences.zh: 一隻小鳥停在我們的門廊上。

sentences.en: What kind of bird is that on the fence?
sentences.zh: 圍籬上那是什麼鳥？

sentences.en: My son loves watching birds at the park.
sentences.zh: 我兒子喜歡在公園看鳥。

sentences.en: Happy birthday! Did you make a wish?
sentences.zh: 生日快樂！你許願了嗎？

sentences.en: We're having a birthday party on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們星期六要辦生日派對。

sentences.en: My birthday falls on a Monday this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我的生日剛好是星期一。

gloss_note: grab a bite 隨便吃點東西

sentences.en: Does your dog bite strangers?
sentences.zh: 你的狗會咬陌生人嗎？

sentences.en: Let's grab a quick bite before the movie.
sentences.zh: 看電影前我們先簡單吃點東西吧。

sentences.en: Try not to bite your nails.
sentences.zh: 盡量別咬指甲。

sentences.en: I'll have a black coffee, please.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯黑咖啡，謝謝。

sentences.en: She wore a black dress to the party.
sentences.zh: 她穿一件黑色洋裝去參加派對。

sentences.en: Do you have these shoes in black?
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋有黑色的嗎？

gloss_note: 美式常說 chalkboard；現多用 whiteboard

sentences.en: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
sentences.zh: 老師把日期寫在黑板上。

sentences.en: Can everyone see the blackboard from there?
sentences.zh: 你們從那裡都看得到黑板嗎？

sentences.en: Please erase the blackboard before you leave.
sentences.zh: 離開前請把黑板擦乾淨。

gloss_note: fill in the blank 填空

sentences.en: Why did you leave this line blank?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把這一行留空白？

sentences.en: Fill in the blank with the right word.
sentences.zh: 請用正確的字填空。

sentences.en: My mind went blank during the test.
sentences.zh: 考試時我腦中一片空白。

gloss_note: wrap up in a blanket 裹著毯子

sentences.en: It's cold, so I need another blanket.
sentences.zh: 天氣很冷，所以我需要再一條毯子。

sentences.en: Can you grab a blanket for the picnic?
sentences.zh: 你可以帶一條毯子去野餐嗎？

sentences.en: The baby fell asleep under a soft blanket.
sentences.zh: 寶寶在柔軟的毯子下睡著了。

gloss_note: blind spot 開車的視線死角

sentences.en: Dad is blind in one eye.
sentences.zh: 爸爸有一隻眼睛看不見。

sentences.en: Guide dogs help people who are blind.
sentences.zh: 導盲犬能幫助失明的人。

sentences.en: Has your grandpa been blind since birth?
sentences.zh: 你爺爺是天生就看不見嗎？

gloss_note: two blocks away 隔兩條街

sentences.en: The grocery store is two blocks away.
sentences.zh: 雜貨店在兩個街區外。

sentences.en: Excuse me, is that truck blocking my driveway?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，那輛卡車擋住我家車道了嗎？

sentences.en: We walked around the block after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們繞著街區散步。

gloss_note: blow out 吹熄；blow your nose 擤鼻涕

sentences.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles.
sentences.zh: 許個願，然後吹熄蠟燭。

sentences.en: The wind is blowing really hard today.
sentences.zh: 今天風吹得很大。

sentences.en: Do you need a tissue to blow your nose?
sentences.zh: 你需要面紙擤鼻涕嗎？

sentences.en: I love your new blue backpack.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡你新的藍色背包。

sentences.en: Why do you look so blue today?
sentences.zh: 你今天怎麼看起來這麼憂鬱？

sentences.en: The ocean looks so blue from here.
sentences.zh: 從這裡看海好藍。

gloss_note: take a boat ride 搭船遊覽

sentences.en: We rented a boat at the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊租了一艘船。

sentences.en: Do you get seasick on a boat?
sentences.zh: 你搭船會暈船嗎？

sentences.en: The boat leaves the dock at noon.
sentences.zh: 船在中午離開碼頭。

sentences.en: Stretch your whole body before you run.
sentences.zh: 跑步前先伸展全身。

sentences.en: Exercise is good for your body and mind.
sentences.zh: 運動對身心都有益。

sentences.en: Does your body feel sore after the gym?
sentences.zh: 去健身房後你身體會痠痛嗎？

sentences.en: Boil the water first, then add the pasta.
sentences.zh: 先把水煮沸，再放入義大利麵。

sentences.en: How long should I boil these eggs?
sentences.zh: 這些蛋我該煮多久？

sentences.en: The soup is boiling over on the stove!
sentences.zh: 湯在爐子上滾出來了！

sentences.en: I'm reading a good book right now.
sentences.zh: 我現在正在讀一本好書。

sentences.en: Can we book a table for six?
sentences.zh: 我們可以訂六個人的位子嗎？

sentences.en: I booked a doctor's appointment for Monday.
sentences.zh: 我預約了星期一看醫生。

sentences.en: There's a small bookstore near my school.
sentences.zh: 我學校附近有一間小書店。

sentences.en: Do you want to stop by the bookstore?
sentences.zh: 你想順道去書店嗎？

sentences.en: She works part-time at the campus bookstore.
sentences.zh: 她在校園書店打工。

sentences.en: I'm so bored. Can we go outside?
sentences.zh: 我好無聊。我們可以去外面嗎？

sentences.en: He gets bored easily in long meetings.
sentences.zh: 他開長會時很容易覺得無聊。

sentences.en: Are you bored with this game already?
sentences.zh: 你已經玩膩這個遊戲了嗎？

gloss_note: bored 是人無聊，boring 是事物無聊

sentences.en: The movie was long and really boring.
sentences.zh: 那部電影又長又無聊。

sentences.en: Is your job boring or exciting?
sentences.zh: 你的工作無聊還是刺激？

sentences.en: Cleaning the garage is boring but necessary.
sentences.zh: 打掃車庫很無聊但有必要。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your pen for a second?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的筆一下嗎？

sentences.en: She borrowed a ladder from the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 她向鄰居借了一座梯子。

sentences.en: You can borrow up to five books.
sentences.zh: 你最多可以借五本書。

sentences.en: My boss is letting me leave early today.
sentences.zh: 我老闆今天讓我提早下班。

sentences.en: Did you tell your boss about the problem?
sentences.zh: 你有把這個問題告訴老闆嗎？

sentences.en: Our boss ordered pizza for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 老闆幫全組訂了披薩。

gloss_note: a bottle of water 一瓶水

sentences.en: Can I have a bottle of water?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一瓶水嗎？

sentences.en: Don't forget to recycle the empty bottles.
sentences.zh: 別忘了回收空瓶子。

sentences.en: He fills his water bottle every morning.
sentences.zh: 他每天早上都把水壺裝滿水。

gloss_note: at the bottom of 在…的底部

sentences.en: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
sentences.zh: 鑰匙在我包包的底部。

sentences.en: Please sign at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 請在頁面底部簽名。

sentences.en: Is there any juice left at the bottom of the bottle?
sentences.zh: 瓶底還有剩一點果汁嗎？

gloss_note: take a bow 鞠躬謝幕；蝴蝶結的 bow 發音不同

sentences.en: The singers bow to the audience at the end.
sentences.zh: 歌手們在最後向觀眾鞠躬。

sentences.en: Did the kids bow after the school play?
sentences.zh: 孩子們在學校話劇演完後有鞠躬嗎？

sentences.en: He took a bow after his piano solo.
sentences.zh: 他鋼琴獨奏完後鞠躬謝幕。

gloss_note: a bowl of soup 一碗湯

sentences.en: I'd like a bowl of tomato soup.
sentences.zh: 我想要一碗番茄湯。

sentences.en: Put the fruit in the big bowl.
sentences.zh: 把水果放進那個大碗裡。

sentences.en: Can you wash this bowl for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我洗這個碗嗎？

gloss_note: a box of cookies 一盒餅乾

sentences.en: I need a box for these old toys.
sentences.zh: 我需要一個箱子裝這些舊玩具。

sentences.en: Could you carry this heavy box upstairs?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這個重箱子搬上樓嗎？

sentences.en: She bought a box of cookies at the store.
sentences.zh: 她在店裡買了一盒餅乾。

gloss_note: Oh boy! 表示無奈或驚訝

sentences.en: Their little boy just started kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 他們的小男孩剛上幼稚園。

sentences.en: Which boy broke the window?
sentences.zh: 哪個男孩打破了窗戶？

sentences.en: The boys are playing soccer in the park.
sentences.zh: 男孩們正在公園踢足球。

gloss_note: brave enough to 有膽量去…

sentences.en: The firefighter was brave enough to go inside.
sentences.zh: 那位消防員很勇敢，敢走進裡面。

sentences.en: Be brave, sweetie. The shot is quick.
sentences.zh: 勇敢點，寶貝。打針很快就好。

sentences.en: Are you brave enough to try that ride?
sentences.zh: 你有膽量玩那個遊樂設施嗎？

gloss_note: a loaf of bread 一條麵包

sentences.en: We need to buy a loaf of bread.
sentences.zh: 我們得買一條麵包。

sentences.en: Would you like some bread with your soup?
sentences.zh: 你的湯要不要配點麵包？

sentences.en: I'll make a sandwich with whole wheat bread.
sentences.zh: 我要用全麥麵包做三明治。

gloss_note: take a break 休息一下

sentences.en: Let's take a ten-minute break.
sentences.zh: 我們休息十分鐘吧。

sentences.en: Be careful not to break the glass.
sentences.zh: 小心別打破玻璃杯。

sentences.en: Will this plate break if I drop it?
sentences.zh: 如果我把這個盤子掉在地上，它會破嗎？

sentences.en: I usually skip breakfast on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 我平日通常不吃早餐。

sentences.en: What did you have for breakfast today?
sentences.zh: 你今天早餐吃了什麼？

sentences.en: Dad makes pancakes for breakfast on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 爸爸星期天早餐會做鬆餅。

sentences.en: We drive across the bridge every morning.
sentences.zh: 我們每天早上開車過橋。

sentences.en: Is the bridge closed for repairs?
sentences.zh: 這座橋因為維修封閉了嗎？

sentences.en: Kids were fishing off the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在舊橋上釣魚。

sentences.en: Wow, the sun is so bright today!
sentences.zh: 哇，今天太陽好亮！

sentences.en: She wore a bright yellow jacket.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件亮黃色外套。

sentences.en: Is this room bright enough to read?
sentences.zh: 這個房間夠亮可以看書嗎？

gloss_note: bring 帶到說話者這邊，take 帶去別處

sentences.en: Please bring a jacket; it gets cold.
sentences.zh: 請帶一件外套，天氣會變冷。

sentences.en: Can I bring a friend to the party?
sentences.zh: 我可以帶朋友去派對嗎？

sentences.en: Our waiter brought us extra napkins.
sentences.zh: 服務生多拿了一些餐巾紙給我們。

gloss_note: 美式不分長幼，要加 older/younger

sentences.en: My older brother lives in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥住在德州。

sentences.en: Is your younger brother in third grade?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟讀三年級嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother hates eating broccoli.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟討厭吃花椰菜。

sentences.en: She has long brown hair and green eyes.
sentences.zh: 她有一頭棕色長髮和綠色眼睛。

sentences.en: Do you have this couch in brown?
sentences.zh: 你們有這款沙發的棕色嗎？

sentences.en: The leaves turn brown in the fall.
sentences.zh: 樹葉在秋天會變成褐色。

sentences.en: Did you brush your teeth this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上刷牙了嗎？

sentences.en: Can you brush the snow off the car?
sentences.zh: 你可以把車上的雪刷掉嗎？

sentences.en: He brushes his hair before school.
sentences.zh: 他上學前會梳頭髮。

gloss_note: bug spray 防蚊液；stomach bug 腸胃炎

sentences.en: Put on bug spray before we hike.
sentences.zh: 健行前先噴防蚊液。

sentences.en: Is that a bug or a leaf?
sentences.zh: 那是蟲還是葉子？

sentences.en: Half my class caught a stomach bug.
sentences.zh: 我們班一半的人得了腸胃炎。

sentences.en: They're building a new library downtown.
sentences.zh: 他們正在市區蓋一座新圖書館。

sentences.en: Do you want to build a snowman?
sentences.zh: 你想堆雪人嗎？

sentences.en: Dad built a treehouse for the kids.
sentences.zh: 爸爸幫孩子們蓋了一間樹屋。

sentences.en: Would you like a toasted bun?
sentences.zh: 你要烤過的小圓麵包嗎？

sentences.en: She put her hair up in a bun.
sentences.zh: 她把頭髮盤成丸子頭。

sentences.en: These cinnamon buns smell amazing.
sentences.zh: 這些肉桂捲聞起來好香。

sentences.en: I'll have a burger with no onions.
sentences.zh: 我要一個漢堡，不加洋蔥。

sentences.en: Do you want fries with your burger?
sentences.zh: 你的漢堡要配薯條嗎？

sentences.en: Dad is grilling burgers in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正在後院烤漢堡。

gloss_note: I burn easily 我容易曬傷

sentences.en: Don't burn the toast again!
sentences.zh: 別又把吐司烤焦了！

sentences.en: I burned my tongue on the hot coffee.
sentences.zh: 我被熱咖啡燙到舌頭了。

sentences.en: Do you burn easily in the sun?
sentences.zh: 你在太陽下容易曬傷嗎？

sentences.en: I take the bus to work every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天搭公車上班。

sentences.en: Does this bus stop at the library?
sentences.zh: 這班公車會停圖書館嗎？

sentences.en: The school bus picks up kids at seven.
sentences.zh: 校車七點接小孩。

sentences.en: Her parents run a small business.
sentences.zh: 她的父母經營一家小生意。

sentences.en: How's business at the restaurant these days?
sentences.zh: 餐廳最近生意怎麼樣？

sentences.en: Business is slow during the winter months.
sentences.zh: 冬天那幾個月生意很清淡。

sentences.en: My uncle is a successful businessman.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是個成功的商人。

sentences.en: The businessman left his briefcase on the train.
sentences.zh: 那位商人把公事包忘在火車上了。

sentences.en: Do you know that businessman in the lobby?
sentences.zh: 你認識大廳裡那位商人嗎？

sentences.en: I'm busy right now. Can I call you back?
sentences.zh: 我現在很忙，可以晚點回電給你嗎？

sentences.en: Downtown gets really busy on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 市中心週六真的很繁忙。

sentences.en: She was busy cooking when I arrived.
sentences.zh: 我到的時候她正忙著煮飯。

gloss_note: peanut butter 花生醬；不可數

sentences.en: Can you pass the butter, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把奶油遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: I spread butter on my toast.
sentences.zh: 我在吐司上抹奶油。

sentences.en: Mom melted some butter in a pan.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在平底鍋裡融化了一些奶油。

gloss_note: butterflies in my stomach 緊張

sentences.en: A butterfly landed on my hand.
sentences.zh: 一隻蝴蝶停在我手上。

sentences.en: Look at those butterflies in the garden!
sentences.zh: 看花園裡那些蝴蝶！

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a blue butterfly?
sentences.zh: 你看過藍色的蝴蝶嗎？

sentences.en: Press the red button to start.
sentences.zh: 按紅色按鈕開始。

sentences.en: I lost a button on my shirt.
sentences.zh: 我的襯衫掉了一顆鈕扣。

sentences.en: Which button turns off the oven?
sentences.zh: 哪個按鈕可以關掉烤箱？

gloss_note: buy 常見：buy lunch 請吃午餐

sentences.en: Where did you buy that cute jacket?
sentences.zh: 你那件可愛的外套是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: I'm buying groceries after work today.
sentences.zh: 我今天下班後要去買菜。

sentences.en: Let me buy you lunch today.
sentences.zh: 今天午餐我請你。

gloss_note: a piece of cake 一塊蛋糕

sentences.en: Mom baked a chocolate cake for dessert.
sentences.zh: 媽媽烤了一個巧克力蛋糕當點心。

sentences.en: Would you like a piece of cake?
sentences.zh: 你想吃一塊蛋糕嗎？

sentences.en: The cake needs another ten minutes in the oven.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕還要在烤箱裡再烤十分鐘。

gloss_note: give me a call 打電話給我

sentences.en: Call me when you get home.
sentences.zh: 到家時打個電話給我。

sentences.en: I'll call the plumber tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 我明天早上會打電話給水電工。

sentences.en: What do you call this vegetable in English?
sentences.zh: 這種蔬菜英文叫什麼？

sentences.en: Did you bring your camera on the trip?
sentences.zh: 你旅行有帶相機嗎？

sentences.en: The camera on my cell phone is broken.
sentences.zh: 我手機的相機壞了。

sentences.en: There's a security camera above the door.
sentences.zh: 門上方有一台監視器。

sentences.en: We like to camp by the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們喜歡在湖邊露營。

sentences.en: My daughter goes to summer camp in July.
sentences.zh: 我女兒七月去參加夏令營。

sentences.en: Are you going camping this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末要去露營嗎？

sentences.en: She lit a candle during dinner.
sentences.zh: 她在晚餐時點了一根蠟燭。

sentences.en: This candle smells like fresh vanilla.
sentences.zh: 這根蠟燭聞起來像新鮮的香草。

sentences.en: Do we have candles for the power outage?
sentences.zh: 我們有蠟燭可以應付停電嗎？

sentences.en: The kids got lots of candy on Halloween.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在萬聖節拿到很多糖果。

sentences.en: Is there any candy left in the jar?
sentences.zh: 罐子裡還有糖果嗎？

sentences.en: She hid a candy bar in her backpack.
sentences.zh: 她在背包裡藏了一條巧克力棒。

sentences.en: Dad always wears a baseball cap outside.
sentences.zh: 爸爸出門總是戴棒球帽。

sentences.en: Please put the cap back on the bottle.
sentences.zh: 請把瓶蓋蓋回瓶子上。

sentences.en: Where did I leave my cap?
sentences.zh: 我把帽子放哪了？

gloss_note: get in the car 上車

sentences.en: Let's take my car to the mall.
sentences.zh: 我們開我的車去購物中心吧。

sentences.en: Can you help me wash the car?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我洗車嗎？

sentences.en: Her car broke down on the highway.
sentences.zh: 她的車在公路上拋錨了。

sentences.en: We signed a card for our teacher.
sentences.zh: 我們為老師在卡片上簽了名。

sentences.en: Will you pay in cash or by card?
sentences.zh: 你要付現還是刷卡？

sentences.en: Grandma sent me a card with some money.
sentences.zh: 奶奶寄給我一張附了錢的卡片。

gloss_note: take care of 照顧；Take care! 保重

sentences.en: Who will take care of your dog?
sentences.zh: 誰會照顧你的狗？

sentences.en: I really don't care which movie we see.
sentences.zh: 我真的不在乎我們看哪部電影。

sentences.en: Take care, and text me when you arrive.
sentences.zh: 好好照顧自己，到了傳訊息給我。

gloss_note: be careful with 小心對待

sentences.en: Be careful, the floor is wet.
sentences.zh: 小心，地板是濕的。

sentences.en: Is he a careful driver on the highway?
sentences.zh: 他在公路上開車小心嗎？

sentences.en: She is careful about what she eats.
sentences.zh: 她很注意自己吃的東西。

gloss_note: mail carrier 郵差；也指電信業者

sentences.en: The mail carrier comes around noon.
sentences.zh: 郵差大約中午會來。

sentences.en: Which cell phone carrier do you use?
sentences.zh: 你用哪一家電信業者？

sentences.en: I might switch carriers because the signal is weak.
sentences.zh: 我可能會換電信業者，因為訊號很差。

sentences.en: Can you carry these bags to the car?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這些袋子拿到車上嗎？

sentences.en: I always carry my wallet and keys.
sentences.zh: 我總是隨身帶著錢包和鑰匙。

sentences.en: She carried the sleeping baby upstairs.
sentences.zh: 她抱著熟睡的寶寶上樓。

sentences.en: I need a new case for my phone.
sentences.zh: 我需要一個新的手機殼。

sentences.en: Where's the case for my glasses?
sentences.zh: 我的眼鏡盒在哪裡？

sentences.en: She keeps her guitar in a hard case.
sentences.zh: 她把吉他放在硬盒裡。

sentences.en: We visited an old castle on our trip.
sentences.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了一座古老的城堡。

sentences.en: Did you build a sand castle at the beach?
sentences.zh: 你有在海灘上堆沙堡嗎？

sentences.en: That castle on the hill looks amazing at night.
sentences.zh: 山丘上的那座城堡在夜晚看起來美極了。

sentences.en: Our cat sleeps on the couch all day.
sentences.zh: 我們家的貓整天都睡在沙發上。

sentences.en: Are you a cat person or a dog person?
sentences.zh: 你是貓派還是狗派？

sentences.en: My neighbor feeds the stray cats every morning.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居每天早上都會餵流浪貓。

gloss_note: catch the bus 趕上公車

sentences.en: Can you catch the ball with one hand?
sentences.zh: 你可以單手接住這顆球嗎？

sentences.en: We need to catch an early flight tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我們明天得趕搭一班早班飛機。

sentences.en: Dad tossed me the keys, and I managed to catch them.
sentences.zh: 爸爸把鑰匙丟給我，我剛好接住了。

sentences.en: We celebrate my mom's birthday every year.
sentences.zh: 我們每年都會幫我媽媽慶生。

sentences.en: How do you usually celebrate the Fourth of July?
sentences.zh: 你們通常怎麼慶祝七月四日國慶日？

sentences.en: Let's celebrate with ice cream after the game!
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，我們去吃冰淇淋慶祝吧！

gloss_note: 美式說 cell phone，不說 mobile

sentences.en: My cellphone battery is almost dead.
sentences.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

sentences.en: Where did you put your cellphone?
sentences.zh: 你把手機放到哪裡去了？

sentences.en: Please turn off your cellphone during the movie.
sentences.zh: 看電影時請把手機關掉。

gloss_note: a penny 是 one cent 的口語

sentences.en: These apples cost ninety-nine cents each.
sentences.zh: 這些蘋果一顆九十九美分。

sentences.en: Do you have fifty cents for the vending machine?
sentences.zh: 你有五十美分可以投販賣機嗎？

sentences.en: I don't have a single cent on me.
sentences.zh: 我身上一毛錢都沒帶。

sentences.en: Put the vase in the center of the table.
sentences.zh: 把花瓶放在桌子正中央。

sentences.en: Is there a shopping center near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有購物中心嗎？

sentences.en: The community center offers free yoga classes.
sentences.zh: 社區活動中心提供免費的瑜珈課。

gloss_note: 美國日常多用 inch，少用公分

sentences.en: This table is about ninety centimeters wide.
sentences.zh: 這張桌子大約寬九十公分。

sentences.en: How many centimeters are in one inch?
sentences.zh: 一英寸等於多少公分？

sentences.en: The baby grew two centimeters last month.
sentences.zh: 寶寶上個月長高了兩公分。

gloss_note: pull up a chair 拉張椅子坐

sentences.en: Please pull up a chair and join us.
sentences.zh: 請拉張椅子過來一起坐吧。

sentences.en: Whose jacket is hanging on this chair?
sentences.zh: 掛在這張椅子上的是誰的外套？

sentences.en: The waiter brought a high chair for the baby.
sentences.zh: 服務生為寶寶拿來了一張兒童高腳椅。

gloss_note: a piece of chalk 一支粉筆

sentences.en: The teacher wrote the answer with white chalk.
sentences.zh: 老師用白粉筆寫下了答案。

sentences.en: The kids are drawing on the sidewalk with chalk.
sentences.zh: 孩子們正用粉筆在人行道上畫畫。

sentences.en: Is there any chalk left in the classroom?
sentences.zh: 教室裡還有粉筆嗎？

gloss_note: take a chance 冒險一試

sentences.en: You should take a chance and apply for it.
sentences.zh: 你應該放手一試，去申請看看。

sentences.en: Is there a chance of rain tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天有可能下雨嗎？

sentences.en: I finally got a chance to try surfing.
sentences.zh: 我終於有機會嘗試衝浪了。

gloss_note: Keep the change. 不用找了

sentences.en: You can keep the change, thanks.
sentences.zh: 零錢不用找了，謝謝。

sentences.en: Do you have change for a twenty-dollar bill?
sentences.zh: 你有可以換開二十元鈔票的零錢嗎？

sentences.en: Our teacher changed the test date again.
sentences.zh: 我們老師又更改了考試日期。

sentences.en: Gas is much cheaper here than downtown.
sentences.zh: 這裡的油價比市中心便宜多了。

sentences.en: Where can I find a cheap flight to Chicago?
sentences.zh: 我去哪裡能找到飛芝加哥的便宜機票？

sentences.en: This shirt was cheap, but it looks great.
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫很便宜，但看起來很棒。

gloss_note: cheat on a test 考試作弊

sentences.en: The teacher caught him cheating on the quiz.
sentences.zh: 老師抓到他在小考時作弊。

sentences.en: Do you think it's wrong to cheat at cards?
sentences.zh: 你覺得玩牌作弊是不對的嗎？

sentences.en: He cheats whenever we play video games.
sentences.zh: 我們玩電動時他每次都作弊。

sentences.en: Please check your answers before you hand them in.
sentences.zh: 交卷之前請先檢查你的答案。

sentences.en: Can we get the check, please?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩幫我們結帳嗎？

sentences.en: I'll check the weather before we leave.
sentences.zh: 出發前我會先查一下天氣。

sentences.en: The crowd began to cheer loudly.
sentences.zh: 群眾開始大聲歡呼。

sentences.en: Will you come cheer for me at the game?
sentences.zh: 你會來比賽現場幫我加油嗎？

sentences.en: My parents always cheer me on at my games.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽總是到我的比賽現場為我加油。

sentences.en: Can I get extra cheese on my burger?
sentences.zh: 我的漢堡可以多加起司嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone, say cheese for the camera!
sentences.zh: 大家看鏡頭，笑一個！

sentences.en: We had grilled cheese sandwiches for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們午餐吃了烤起司三明治。

sentences.en: We're having fried chicken for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚的晚餐吃炸雞。

sentences.en: Would you like chicken or fish?
sentences.zh: 您要雞肉還是魚肉？

sentences.en: My grandpa raises chickens on his farm.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺在他的農場養雞。

gloss_note: 複數 children；口語常說 kid

sentences.en: Every child gets a free ticket at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 每位兒童在動物園都能拿到一張免費門票。

sentences.en: How old is your youngest child?
sentences.zh: 你最小的孩子幾歲了？

sentences.en: She was a very shy child back then.
sentences.zh: 她小時候是個很害羞的孩子。

sentences.en: Do you speak Chinese at home?
sentences.zh: 你們在家說中文嗎？

sentences.en: We ordered Chinese takeout for dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們晚餐叫了中式外帶餐。

sentences.en: My Chinese teacher gives us a quiz every week.
sentences.zh: 我的中文老師每週都會考我們一次小考。

sentences.en: Would you like some hot chocolate?
sentences.zh: 你要不要來杯熱可可？

sentences.en: I'm craving chocolate right now.
sentences.zh: 我現在超想吃巧克力。

sentences.en: She gave me a box of chocolates.
sentences.zh: 她送了我一盒巧克力。

gloss_note: have no choice 別無選擇

sentences.en: I had no choice but to wait.
sentences.zh: 我別無選擇，只能等。

sentences.en: Which is your first choice for college?
sentences.zh: 你的大學第一志願是哪一間？

sentences.en: The menu has plenty of healthy choices.
sentences.zh: 這份菜單有很多健康的選擇。
