sentences.en: Can we meet at your place tonight?
sentences.zh: 我們今晚可以在你家碰面嗎？

sentences.en: I can't find a place to sit.
sentences.zh: 我找不到地方坐。

gloss_note: Any plans tonight? 今晚有事嗎

sentences.en: Do you have any plans for Saturday night?
sentences.zh: 你週六晚上有什麼安排嗎？

sentences.en: We plan to visit my aunt next month.
sentences.zh: 我們打算下個月去看阿姨。

sentences.en: The plan changed because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，計畫改了。

gloss_note: 美式 plane 或 airplane 皆可

sentences.en: Our plane lands at six in the evening.
sentences.zh: 我們的飛機傍晚六點降落。

sentences.en: Did you get a window seat on the plane?
sentences.zh: 你在飛機上有分到靠窗的位子嗎？

sentences.en: I always fall asleep on the plane.
sentences.zh: 我在飛機上總是會睡著。

gloss_note: the planet 常指我們的地球

sentences.en: Earth is the third planet from the sun.
sentences.zh: 地球是離太陽第三近的行星。

sentences.en: How many planets are in our solar system?
sentences.zh: 太陽系裡有幾顆行星？

sentences.en: We should take care of our planet.
sentences.zh: 我們應該愛護我們的地球。

sentences.en: I forgot to water the plants again.
sentences.zh: 我又忘了澆花。

sentences.en: Can we plant tomatoes in the backyard?
sentences.zh: 我們可以在後院種番茄嗎？

sentences.en: This plant needs a lot of sunlight.
sentences.zh: 這株植物需要大量陽光。

sentences.en: Please put the plates on the table.
sentences.zh: 請把盤子放到桌上。

sentences.en: Finish everything on your plate, please.
sentences.zh: 請把盤子裡的東西吃完。

sentences.en: Could I get a clean plate, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一個乾淨的盤子嗎？

sentences.en: Can Jake come out and play?
sentences.zh: 傑克可以出來玩嗎？

sentences.en: We play soccer after school on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 我們每週五放學後會踢足球。

sentences.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩。

gloss_note: team player 重視團隊合作的人

sentences.en: He's the best player on our team.
sentences.zh: 他是我們隊上最強的球員。

sentences.en: How many players can join this game?
sentences.zh: 這個遊戲最多可以有幾位玩家加入？

sentences.en: The players are warming up on the field.
sentences.zh: 球員們正在場上熱身。

gloss_note: 學校或公園的兒童遊樂區，有溜滑梯、鞦韆

sentences.en: The kids run to the playground after school.
sentences.zh: 放學後孩子們跑去遊樂場。

sentences.en: Is the playground open on Sunday morning?
sentences.zh: 遊樂場週日早上有開嗎？

sentences.en: She fell off the swing at the playground.
sentences.zh: 她在遊樂場從鞦韆上摔了下來。

gloss_note: Yes, please. 好的，麻煩你；放句首或句尾

sentences.en: Could you close the window, please?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩你把窗戶關上嗎？

sentences.en: Would you like more rice? Yes, please.
sentences.zh: 還要再來點飯嗎？好的，麻煩你。

sentences.en: You can't please everyone, so just relax.
sentences.zh: 你不可能討好每個人，放輕鬆點。

sentences.en: Thank you for helping! It was my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你幫忙！別客氣，我很樂意。

sentences.en: It was a pleasure to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高興認識你。

sentences.en: Do you read books for pleasure or school?
sentences.zh: 你讀書是為了興趣還是為了功課？

sentences.en: I left my keys in my coat pocket.
sentences.zh: 我把鑰匙忘在外套口袋裡了。

sentences.en: Do these pants have deep pockets?
sentences.zh: 這條褲子的口袋深嗎？

sentences.en: My phone is in my back pocket.
sentences.zh: 我的手機在後口袋裡。

gloss_note: make a point 提出論點；point at 指著

sentences.en: You make a good point about the cost.
sentences.zh: 你說到成本這一點很有道理。

sentences.en: Wait, what was the main point again?
sentences.zh: 等等，重點是什麼來著？

sentences.en: Please don't point at people; it's rude.
sentences.zh: 請不要指著人，這樣很沒禮貌。

gloss_note: call the police 報警；police 當複數用

sentences.en: Someone called the police about the noise.
sentences.zh: 有人因為噪音報了警。

sentences.en: The police are talking to our neighbor.
sentences.zh: 警察正在跟我們的鄰居談話。

sentences.en: Should we call the police about this?
sentences.zh: 我們該為這件事報警嗎？

gloss_note: be polite to 對…有禮貌；反義 rude

sentences.en: It's polite to say thank you.
sentences.zh: 說聲謝謝是有禮貌的表現。

sentences.en: Be polite to the guests, please.
sentences.zh: 請對客人有禮貌一點。

sentences.en: Is it polite to ask about someone's age?
sentences.zh: 問別人年紀有禮貌嗎？

gloss_note: duck pond 有鴨子的池塘

sentences.en: We fed the ducks at the pond.
sentences.zh: 我們在池塘邊餵鴨子。

sentences.en: Is the pond frozen yet?
sentences.zh: 池塘結冰了嗎？

sentences.en: There's a small pond behind our school.
sentences.zh: 我們學校後面有一座小池塘。

gloss_note: swimming pool 游泳池；pool 也指撞球

sentences.en: Let's go to the pool this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們今天下午去游泳池吧。

sentences.en: Is the pool open on weekends?
sentences.zh: 游泳池週末有開嗎？

sentences.en: Our apartment has a pool on the roof.
sentences.zh: 我們公寓大樓頂樓有游泳池。

gloss_note: in poor health 健康不佳

sentences.en: Many poor families need help in winter.
sentences.zh: 許多貧困家庭在冬天需要幫助。

sentences.en: The food was good, but the service was poor.
sentences.zh: 食物不錯，但服務很差。

sentences.en: Why is the signal so poor in here?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這裡的訊號這麼差？

gloss_note: soda pop 汽水；美國中西部常說 pop 指汽水

sentences.en: Do you like pop music or country?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡流行樂還是鄉村音樂？

sentences.en: Can I get a pop with my burger?
sentences.zh: 我的漢堡可以配一杯汽水嗎？

sentences.en: She sings pop songs in the shower.
sentences.zh: 她在淋浴時唱流行歌。

gloss_note: 不可數：a bag of popcorn 一袋爆米花

sentences.en: Let's get popcorn before the movie starts.
sentences.zh: 電影開演前我們去買爆米花吧。

sentences.en: Do you want butter on your popcorn?
sentences.zh: 你的爆米花要加奶油嗎？

sentences.en: The kids ate a whole bag of popcorn.
sentences.zh: 孩子們吃掉了整整一袋爆米花。

gloss_note: popular with students 受學生歡迎

sentences.en: This restaurant is really popular with students.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳很受學生歡迎。

sentences.en: Is soccer popular in your hometown?
sentences.zh: 足球在你的家鄉受歡迎嗎？

sentences.en: She was the most popular girl at school.
sentences.zh: 她是學校裡最受歡迎的女生。

gloss_note: pork chop 豬排；pig 是豬、pork 是豬肉

sentences.en: We're having pork chops for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我們晚餐吃豬排。

sentences.en: Do you eat pork or just chicken?
sentences.zh: 你吃豬肉還是只吃雞肉？

sentences.en: Slow-cooked pork tastes great on a sandwich.
sentences.zh: 慢燉的豬肉夾進三明治裡很好吃。

gloss_note: as soon as possible 儘快

sentences.en: Please call me back as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 請儘快回電給我。

sentences.en: Is it possible to get a refund?
sentences.zh: 有可能退款嗎？

sentences.en: It's possible that the bus is late.
sentences.zh: 公車有可能誤點了。

gloss_note: post a photo 發照片；美式郵寄用 mail

sentences.en: Did you see her post about the concert?
sentences.zh: 你有看到她那則關於演唱會的貼文嗎？

sentences.en: I'll post the photos online tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚會把照片貼到網路上。

sentences.en: He posts funny videos every single day.
sentences.zh: 他每天都會張貼搞笑影片。

gloss_note: send a postcard 寄明信片

sentences.en: My aunt sent us a postcard from Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 阿姨從夏威夷寄了一張明信片給我們。

sentences.en: Do you have a stamp for this postcard?
sentences.zh: 你有可以貼這張明信片的郵票嗎？

sentences.en: I bought a postcard at the museum shop.
sentences.zh: 我在博物館的紀念品店買了一張明信片。

gloss_note: pot 是深鍋，pan 是平底鍋

sentences.en: Put a pot of water on the stove.
sentences.zh: 在爐子上放一鍋水。

sentences.en: Is there more coffee in the pot?
sentences.zh: 壺裡還有咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, that pot is very hot!
sentences.zh: 小心，那個鍋子很燙！

gloss_note: 約0.45公斤，縮寫 lb；$2 a pound 一磅兩美元

sentences.en: I've lost five pounds since last month.
sentences.zh: 我從上個月到現在瘦了五磅。

sentences.en: How much are the apples per pound?
sentences.zh: 蘋果一磅多少錢？

sentences.en: The baby weighed seven pounds at birth.
sentences.zh: 寶寶出生時重七磅。

sentences.en: The power went out during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨時停電了。

sentences.en: Did the power come back on yet?
sentences.zh: 電來了嗎？

sentences.en: That machine has a lot of power.
sentences.zh: 那台機器的力量很大。

sentences.en: I have soccer practice after school today.
sentences.zh: 我今天放學後要練足球。

sentences.en: How often do you practice the guitar?
sentences.zh: 你多久練一次吉他？

sentences.en: Practice makes perfect, so keep trying.
sentences.zh: 熟能生巧，所以繼續努力吧。

gloss_note: pray for 為…祈禱；praying 也表殷切盼望

sentences.en: We're praying for good weather this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們祈禱這個週末天氣好。

sentences.en: Let's pray the traffic isn't too bad.
sentences.zh: 祈禱路上不要太塞吧。

sentences.en: Do you pray before big exams?
sentences.zh: 重要考試前你會祈禱嗎？

gloss_note: prepare for a test 準備考試

sentences.en: I need to prepare for my math test.
sentences.zh: 我得準備數學考試。

sentences.en: Who is preparing dinner tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚誰要準備晚餐？

sentences.en: Dad prepared breakfast before we woke up.
sentences.zh: 我們起床前爸爸就準備好早餐了。

sentences.en: What present did you get for Mom?
sentences.zh: 你幫媽媽買了什麼禮物？

sentences.en: I wrapped the present with blue paper.
sentences.zh: 我用藍色包裝紙包好了禮物。

sentences.en: Is everyone present? I'm taking attendance.
sentences.zh: 大家都到了嗎？我在點名。

sentences.en: What a pretty dress you're wearing!
sentences.zh: 你穿的洋裝好漂亮！

sentences.en: The soup is pretty good, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 這湯還滿好喝的，不是嗎？

sentences.en: It's pretty cold outside, so wear a jacket.
sentences.zh: 外面滿冷的，穿件外套吧。

sentences.en: What's the price of this jacket?
sentences.zh: 這件夾克多少錢？

sentences.en: Gas prices went up again this week.
sentences.zh: 這週油價又漲了。

sentences.en: I think the price is a little high.
sentences.zh: 我覺得價格有點高。

gloss_note: win first prize 得第一名

sentences.en: She won first prize in the spelling contest.
sentences.zh: 她在拼字比賽中得了第一名。

sentences.en: What is the prize for the winner?
sentences.zh: 優勝者的獎品是什麼？

sentences.en: Each kid gets a small prize at the fair.
sentences.zh: 園遊會上每個孩子都能得到一份小獎品。

gloss_note: Probably not. 大概不會（簡短回答）

sentences.en: We'll probably get there around noon.
sentences.zh: 我們大概中午左右會到。

sentences.en: You're probably tired from work, right?
sentences.zh: 你下班大概很累了吧？

sentences.en: I'll probably just stay home and watch movies.
sentences.zh: 我大概就待在家看電影吧。

gloss_note: No problem. 沒問題／不客氣

sentences.en: No problem, I can pick you up.
sentences.zh: 沒問題，我可以去接你。

sentences.en: What seems to be the problem?
sentences.zh: 請問是什麼問題？

sentences.en: I'm having a problem with my phone.
sentences.zh: 我的手機出了點問題。

gloss_note: 電視節目口語多說 show

sentences.en: What's your favorite TV program?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡的電視節目是什麼？

sentences.en: This program keeps crashing on my laptop.
sentences.zh: 這個程式一直在我的筆電上當機。

sentences.en: The cooking program starts at eight tonight.
sentences.zh: 那個烹飪節目今晚八點開始。

sentences.en: I'm so proud of you!
sentences.zh: 我以你為榮！

sentences.en: Are your parents proud of your grades?
sentences.zh: 你爸媽對你的成績感到驕傲嗎？

sentences.en: She felt proud when her son graduated.
sentences.zh: 兒子畢業時，她感到很驕傲。

gloss_note: public school 在美國指公立學校

sentences.en: Is there a public restroom nearby?
sentences.zh: 附近有公共廁所嗎？

sentences.en: My kids go to a public school.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子們念公立學校。

sentences.en: The public library closes at eight tonight.
sentences.zh: 公共圖書館今晚八點關門。

sentences.en: Just pull the door. It's not locked.
sentences.zh: 用拉的就好，門沒有鎖。

sentences.en: Why did that car pull over?
sentences.zh: 那輛車為什麼靠邊停了？

sentences.en: Pull the cord to turn on the light.
sentences.zh: 拉一下繩子就能開燈。

gloss_note: pumpkin pie 南瓜派，感恩節常見

sentences.en: We carved a pumpkin for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我們為萬聖節雕了一顆南瓜。

sentences.en: Do you want pumpkin pie or apple pie?
sentences.zh: 你想吃南瓜派還是蘋果派？

sentences.en: Pumpkin spice lattes come out every fall.
sentences.zh: 南瓜香料拿鐵每年秋天都會推出。

gloss_note: adopt a puppy 領養小狗

sentences.en: Our neighbors just got a puppy.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居剛養了一隻小狗。

sentences.en: Can we keep the puppy, Mom?
sentences.zh: 媽，我們可以養這隻小狗嗎？

sentences.en: The puppy chewed up my new shoes.
sentences.zh: 小狗把我的新鞋咬壞了。

gloss_note: a purple shirt 紫色襯衫

sentences.en: She wore a purple dress to prom.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件紫色洋裝去畢業舞會。

sentences.en: Is your favorite color purple?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡的顏色是紫色嗎？

sentences.en: The sky turned purple at sunset.
sentences.zh: 日落時天空變成了紫色。

gloss_note: push the button 按按鈕；門上 Push 是推

sentences.en: Push the button to call the elevator.
sentences.zh: 按一下按鈕叫電梯。

sentences.en: Don't push! Wait your turn in line.
sentences.zh: 不要推！排隊等輪到你。

sentences.en: Can you help me push this cart?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我推這台推車嗎？

gloss_note: put on 穿上；put away 收好

sentences.en: Put on your jacket. It's cold out.
sentences.zh: 把外套穿上，外面很冷。

sentences.en: Where did you put my keys?
sentences.zh: 你把我的鑰匙放哪了？

sentences.en: Please put the groceries away.
sentences.zh: 請把買回來的東西收好。

gloss_zh: 四分之一；二十五分硬幣
gloss_note: 洗衣機、停車計時器常要投 quarters

sentences.en: Do you have a quarter for the meter?
sentences.zh: 你有二十五分硬幣可以投停車計時器嗎？

sentences.en: Cut the pizza into quarters, please.
sentences.zh: 請把披薩切成四等份。

sentences.en: A quarter of our class rides the school bus.
sentences.zh: 我們班有四分之一的人搭校車。

gloss_note: queen bed 美式床尺寸之一

sentences.en: The queen waved at the crowd from her balcony.
sentences.zh: 女王從陽台向群眾揮手。

sentences.en: Who played the queen in the school play?
sentences.zh: 學校話劇裡誰演女王？

sentences.en: She moved her queen and won the chess game.
sentences.zh: 她移動了皇后，贏了那盤西洋棋。

sentences.en: Can I ask you a question?
sentences.zh: 我可以問你一個問題嗎？

sentences.en: Raise your hand if you have a question.
sentences.zh: 有問題的人請舉手。

sentences.en: That's a good question. Let me check.
sentences.zh: 這個問題問得好，我查一下。

gloss_note: a quick bite 隨便吃點東西

sentences.en: Let's grab a quick bite before the movie.
sentences.zh: 電影開始前我們先隨便吃點東西吧。

sentences.en: Can I make a quick call?
sentences.zh: 我可以打個電話嗎？很快就好。

sentences.en: Take a quick look at this email.
sentences.zh: 你快看一下這封電子郵件。

sentences.en: Please be quiet. The baby is sleeping.
sentences.zh: 請小聲點，寶寶在睡覺。

sentences.en: Why is the house so quiet today?
sentences.zh: 今天家裡怎麼這麼安靜？

sentences.en: We live on a quiet street.
sentences.zh: 我們住在一條很安靜的街上。

gloss_note: 美式口語更常說 pretty；quite a few 不少

sentences.en: It's quite cold outside this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上外面相當冷。

sentences.en: Have you been waiting quite a while?
sentences.zh: 你已經等了好一陣子了嗎？

sentences.en: We've had quite a few snow days.
sentences.zh: 我們已經停課在家好幾次了。

sentences.en: We have a pop quiz in math today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天數學有隨堂小考。

sentences.en: How did you do on the quiz?
sentences.zh: 你小考考得怎麼樣？

sentences.en: I took a fun quiz on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我在手機上做了一個好玩的測驗。

sentences.en: Look! A rabbit is eating our carrots.
sentences.zh: 看！有隻兔子在吃我們的紅蘿蔔。

sentences.en: Do you have a pet rabbit?
sentences.zh: 你有養寵物兔嗎？

sentences.en: The rabbit hopped across the yard.
sentences.zh: 兔子跳過了院子。

gloss_note: run a race 參加賽跑

sentences.en: Who won the race at school today?
sentences.zh: 今天學校的賽跑誰贏了？

sentences.en: I'm running a five-mile race this Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我這個星期六要跑一場五英里的比賽。

sentences.en: Do you want to race to the car?
sentences.zh: 你要不要跟我比賽跑到車子那裡？

gloss_note: on the radio 在廣播裡

sentences.en: Turn up the radio. I love this song!
sentences.zh: 把收音機音量調大，我超愛這首歌！

sentences.en: I heard it on the radio this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上在廣播裡聽到的。

sentences.en: Does your car have a radio?
sentences.zh: 你的車有收音機嗎？

gloss_note: take a rain check 改天再約（口語）

sentences.en: It's going to rain all weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末會一直下雨。

sentences.en: We got a lot of rain last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚下了好大的雨。

sentences.en: Do you think it will rain tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你覺得明天會下雨嗎？

sentences.en: Look at that beautiful rainbow over the hills!
sentences.zh: 你看山上那道美麗的彩虹！

sentences.en: Did you see the rainbow after the storm?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨後你有看到彩虹嗎？

sentences.zh: 那家店又漲價了。

sentences.zh: 你隨時都可以傳訊息聯絡我。

sentences.en: I read that book twice last year.
sentences.zh: 那本書我去年讀了兩遍。

sentences.en: Can you read me the menu?
sentences.zh: 你可以唸菜單給我聽嗎？

gloss_note: Ready? 準備好了嗎；get ready 準備

sentences.zh: 您準備好要點餐了嗎？

sentences.zh: 晚餐十分鐘後就好了。

sentences.zh: 準備一下，公車快到了。

sentences.zh: 謝謝，我真的很感謝你的幫忙。

sentences.zh: 其實不太想，我有點累。

sentences.zh: 不知道為什麼，我的手機充不了電。

sentences.zh: 延誤的原因是什麼？

sentences.zh: 沒有什麼好擔心的。

sentences.zh: 你的新車是紅色還是橘色？

sentences.zh: 我大部分的親戚都住在台灣。

sentences.zh: 我不記得以前見過他。

sentences.zh: 老師要我們把每個字再唸一次。

sentences.en: Did the reporter interview the coach?

sentences.en: We ate at a Thai restaurant yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們昨天在一家泰式餐廳吃飯。

sentences.zh: 我可以借用一下洗手間嗎？

sentences.en: The gas station restroom was really clean.
sentences.zh: 那間加油站的洗手間真的很乾淨。

sentences.zh: 我要點炒飯。

sentences.zh: 這個巧克力蛋糕對你來說會不會太膩？

sentences.zh: 他靠賣二手車致富。

sentences.zh: 那條河就在我們家後面流過。

sentences.zh: 這台機器人可以撿起小箱子。

sentences.zh: 那家街角商店有賣新鮮麵包。

gloss_note: 英式說 jumper；ugly sweater 醜毛衣

sentences.en: Take a sweater. It gets cold at night.
sentences.zh: 帶件毛衣吧，晚上會變冷。

sentences.en: I got this sweater on sale for twenty dollars.
sentences.zh: 這件毛衣我是特價時用二十美元買的。

sentences.en: Is that a new sweater?
sentences.zh: 那是新毛衣嗎？

gloss_note: That's so sweet! 你人真好

sentences.en: That's so sweet of you to remember!
sentences.zh: 你還記得，真貼心！

sentences.en: Is the tea sweet or unsweetened?
sentences.zh: 這茶是甜的還是無糖的？

sentences.en: I have a sweet tooth, so I love dessert.
sentences.zh: 我愛吃甜食，所以超愛甜點。

sentences.en: Can you swim across the pool?
sentences.zh: 你能游過這個泳池嗎？

sentences.en: We go swimming at the lake every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們每年夏天都會去湖裡游泳。

sentences.en: My daughter is learning to swim this summer.
sentences.zh: 我女兒這個夏天正在學游泳。

sentences.en: The kids are playing on the swings.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在盪鞦韆。

sentences.en: Can you push me on the swing?
sentences.zh: 你可以推我盪鞦韆嗎？

sentences.en: He swung the bat and hit the ball.
sentences.zh: 他揮棒擊中了球。

sentences.en: Could we get a table for four?
sentences.zh: 可以給我們一張四人桌嗎？

sentences.en: Can you set the table for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫忙擺好晚餐的餐具嗎？

sentences.en: Your keys are on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 你的鑰匙在廚房的餐桌上。

sentences.en: Look at that dog wagging its tail!
sentences.zh: 看那隻狗在搖尾巴！

sentences.en: Does your cat have a long tail?
sentences.zh: 你的貓尾巴很長嗎？

sentences.en: The squirrel has a big fluffy tail.
sentences.zh: 那隻松鼠有條蓬鬆的大尾巴。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get there?
sentences.zh: 到那裡要花多久？

sentences.en: Take an umbrella. It might rain.
sentences.zh: 帶把傘吧，可能會下雨。

sentences.en: I like to take my laptop to the coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡把筆電帶去咖啡店。

gloss_note: We need to talk. 我們得談談

sentences.en: We need to talk after dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們晚餐後得談一談。

sentences.en: Who were you talking to on the phone?
sentences.zh: 你剛剛在跟誰講電話？

sentences.en: He talks a lot when he's nervous.
sentences.zh: 他一緊張話就變多。

gloss_note: How tall…? 問身高；不用 high 形容人

sentences.en: How tall is your little brother now?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟現在多高了？

sentences.en: She is almost as tall as her mom.
sentences.zh: 她幾乎跟她媽媽一樣高了。

sentences.en: There are tall trees all along our street.
sentences.zh: 我們整條街都是高大的樹。

gloss_note: duct tape 銀色萬用膠帶

sentences.en: Do you have any tape? I need to wrap this.
sentences.zh: 你有膠帶嗎？我要包這個。

sentences.en: He fixed the broken box with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他用銀色膠帶修好了壞掉的箱子。

sentences.en: Where did you put the packing tape?
sentences.zh: 你把封箱膠帶放哪了？

gloss_note: tastes like 嚐起來像；taste good 好吃

sentences.en: It tastes better with a little butter.
sentences.zh: 加一點奶油嚐起來更好吃。

sentences.en: Do you like the taste of cilantro?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡香菜的味道嗎？

sentences.en: These cookies taste like my grandma's.
sentences.zh: 這些餅乾吃起來就像我奶奶做的。

gloss_note: 美式口語也說 cab；hail a taxi 招計程車

sentences.en: Let's take a taxi to the airport.
sentences.zh: 我們搭計程車去機場吧。

sentences.en: How much is a taxi from here to downtown?
sentences.zh: 從這裡搭計程車到市區要多少錢？

sentences.en: A taxi pulled up right in front of us.
sentences.zh: 一輛計程車剛好停在我們面前。

gloss_note: iced tea 冰茶；sweet tea 南方甜茶

sentences.en: Would you like some tea?
sentences.zh: 你要喝點茶嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have an iced tea with lemon.
sentences.zh: 我要一杯加檸檬的冰茶。

sentences.en: My grandma drinks green tea every morning.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每天早上都喝綠茶。

gloss_note: teach 人 + 科目：teach me English

sentences.en: My mom teaches third grade at a public school.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽在公立學校教三年級。

sentences.en: Can you teach me how to swim?
sentences.zh: 你可以教我游泳嗎？

sentences.en: He is teaching himself to play guitar online.
sentences.zh: 他在網路上自學彈吉他。

gloss_note: 直接稱呼說 Ms. Lee，不說 Teacher

sentences.en: Our teacher gave us no homework today.
sentences.zh: 老師今天沒出作業給我們。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite teacher this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年最喜歡哪位老師？

sentences.en: I need to talk to my kid's teacher.
sentences.zh: 我得跟孩子的老師談一談。

gloss_note: on a team 在隊上；Go team! 加油

sentences.en: Which team are you rooting for tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚支持哪一隊？

sentences.en: She's the captain of the girls' soccer team.
sentences.zh: 她是女子足球隊的隊長。

sentences.en: We really make a great team.
sentences.zh: 我們真是絕佳拍檔。

sentences.en: My teenager never wants to talk at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我家的青少年吃晚飯時都不想講話。

sentences.en: Do teenagers really need eight hours of sleep?
sentences.zh: 青少年真的需要睡八小時嗎？

sentences.en: She was a shy teenager, but not anymore.
sentences.zh: 她以前是個害羞的青少年，現在可不一樣了。

gloss_note: 口語多說 phone；telephone 較正式

sentences.en: Someone left a telephone number on my desk.
sentences.zh: 有人在我桌上留了一組電話號碼。

sentences.en: The telephone rang just as we sat down.
sentences.zh: 我們才剛坐下，電話就響了。

sentences.en: Is there a telephone in the lobby I can use?
sentences.zh: 大廳有我可以用的電話嗎？

gloss_note: 口語說 TV；watch TV 看電視

sentences.en: Turn off the television and come eat.
sentences.zh: 把電視關掉，過來吃飯。

sentences.en: We just bought a new television online.
sentences.zh: 我們剛在網路上買了一台新電視。

sentences.en: Dad, what is on television tonight?
sentences.zh: 爸，今晚電視演什麼？

gloss_note: tell the truth 說實話；過去式 told

sentences.en: Please tell me the truth this time.
sentences.zh: 這次請跟我說實話。

sentences.en: Did anyone tell you about the meeting?
sentences.zh: 有人跟你說開會的事了嗎？

sentences.en: She's telling everyone about her new job.
sentences.zh: 她到處跟人講她的新工作。

sentences.en: We visited a Buddhist temple in Chinatown.
sentences.zh: 我們參觀了中國城裡的一座佛寺。

sentences.en: Is there a temple near your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你家鄉附近有廟嗎？

sentences.en: Please take off your shoes before entering the temple.
sentences.zh: 進廟之前請脫鞋。

sentences.en: Do you want to play tennis on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 你週六想打網球嗎？

sentences.en: My dad plays tennis every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每週日早上都打網球。

sentences.en: The tennis court is closed for repairs.
sentences.zh: 網球場因整修而關閉。

gloss_note: feel terrible 覺得很糟／很內疚

sentences.en: I feel terrible about missing your party.
sentences.zh: 沒能參加你的派對，我覺得很過意不去。

sentences.en: The traffic this morning was terrible.
sentences.zh: 今天早上塞車塞得很糟。

sentences.en: Was the movie as terrible as everyone said?
sentences.zh: 那部電影真的像大家說的那麼爛嗎？

gloss_note: take a test 考試；blood test 抽血檢查

sentences.en: I have a math test first thing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天一早就有數學考試。

sentences.en: Did you pass your driving test?
sentences.zh: 你駕照考試通過了嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor ordered a blood test for me.
sentences.zh: 醫生幫我安排了抽血檢查。

gloss_note: Thanks a lot 多謝；Thank God 謝天謝地

sentences.en: I'd like to thank everyone for coming tonight.
sentences.zh: 我想謝謝今晚到場的每一位。

sentences.en: Did you thank your aunt for the gift?
sentences.zh: 你有為了禮物向阿姨道謝嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks a lot for picking me up.
sentences.zh: 多謝你來接我。

gloss_note: 美式拼法；看電影說 movie theater

sentences.en: Let's meet outside the movie theater at six.
sentences.zh: 我們六點在電影院外面碰面吧。

sentences.en: We saw a play at the local theater.
sentences.zh: 我們在當地的劇院看了一齣戲。

sentences.en: Is there a theater near your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你公寓附近有戲院嗎？

gloss_note: a thick coat 厚外套；thick fog 濃霧

sentences.en: It's cold, so wear a thick coat.
sentences.zh: 天氣冷，穿件厚外套吧。

sentences.en: Is the soup too thick for you?
sentences.zh: 這碗湯對你來說會太濃稠嗎？

sentences.en: The fog was so thick we could barely drive.
sentences.zh: 霧濃到我們幾乎沒辦法開車。

gloss_note: thin 中性；skinny 可能帶貶意

sentences.en: These walls are so thin I hear everything.
sentences.zh: 這些牆好薄，我什麼都聽得到。

sentences.en: Do you like thin crust or thick?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡薄脆餅皮還是厚餅皮？

sentences.en: She's gotten thinner since she started running.
sentences.zh: 她開始跑步之後變瘦了。

sentences.en: The first thing I do is make coffee.
sentences.zh: 我做的第一件事就是泡咖啡。

sentences.en: Can you grab a few things from the store?
sentences.zh: 你可以去店裡買幾樣東西回來嗎？

sentences.en: The thing is, I forgot my wallet.
sentences.zh: 問題是，我忘了帶錢包。

gloss_note: I think so 我想是；我想想看

sentences.en: I think it's going to rain later.
sentences.zh: 我覺得待會兒會下雨。

sentences.en: Do you think we should leave now?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們該現在出發嗎？

sentences.en: Let me think about it and get back to you.
sentences.zh: 我考慮一下再回覆你。

sentences.en: I'm so thirsty after that long run.
sentences.zh: 跑了那麼久，我渴死了。

sentences.en: There is water in the fridge. Are you thirsty?
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡有水，你渴嗎？

sentences.en: The kids get thirsty fast at the pool.
sentences.zh: 小孩在泳池邊很容易口渴。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Neoglitch assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: two thousand 不加 s；thousands of

sentences.en: The repair cost almost two thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 這次維修花了將近兩千美元。

sentences.en: Thousands of people go to the fair each year.
sentences.zh: 每年有成千上萬的人去逛園遊會。

sentences.en: Can you lend me a thousand until Friday?
sentences.zh: 你能借我一千塊到週五嗎？

gloss_note: sore throat 喉嚨痛；清喉嚨

sentences.en: I have a sore throat this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上喉嚨痛。

sentences.en: He cleared his throat before he spoke.
sentences.zh: 他開口前先清了清喉嚨。

sentences.en: Does your throat hurt when you swallow?
sentences.zh: 你吞嚥的時候喉嚨會痛嗎？

gloss_note: throw away 丟掉；throw to 丟給

sentences.en: Throw the ball to your brother, please.
sentences.zh: 請把球丟給你弟弟。

sentences.en: Are you going to throw that away?
sentences.zh: 你要把那個丟掉嗎？

sentences.en: She's throwing out old clothes this weekend.
sentences.zh: 她這個週末要把舊衣服丟掉。

gloss_note: 口語可省略 on：See you Thursday

sentences.en: Let's get lunch on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我們週四一起吃午餐吧。

sentences.en: Is the library open on Thursday evenings?
sentences.zh: 圖書館週四晚上有開嗎？

sentences.en: Trash pickup is every Thursday morning here.
sentences.zh: 這裡每週四早上收垃圾。

sentences.en: I got a parking ticket downtown today.
sentences.zh: 我今天在市中心被開了停車罰單。

sentences.en: Where can I buy tickets for the game?
sentences.zh: 我在哪裡可以買到球賽的票？

sentences.en: Don't forget your plane ticket tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天別忘了帶機票。

gloss_note: tidy up 整理收拾；美式更常說 clean up

sentences.en: Please tidy up your room before dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐前請把房間整理好。

sentences.en: Her desk is always neat and tidy.
sentences.zh: 她的桌子總是整整齊齊。

sentences.en: Why is your room never tidy?
sentences.zh: 你的房間怎麼老是不整齊？

gloss_note: wear a tie 打領帶；tie shoes 綁鞋帶

sentences.en: Dad wears a tie to work every day.
sentences.zh: 爸爸每天都打領帶上班。

sentences.en: Can you help me tie my shoes?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我綁鞋帶嗎？

sentences.en: He tied the rope around the tree.
sentences.zh: 他把繩子綁在樹上。

gloss_note: 美國許多學校球隊就叫 Tigers

sentences.en: The tiger at the zoo was asleep.
sentences.zh: 動物園裡的老虎在睡覺。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a real tiger?
sentences.zh: 你看過真的老虎嗎？

sentences.en: My son wants a tiger costume for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我兒子萬聖節想要一套老虎裝。

gloss_note: What time is it?；on time 準時

sentences.en: What time do you get off work?
sentences.zh: 你幾點下班？

sentences.en: I don't have time to cook tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚沒時間煮飯。

sentences.en: We had a great time at your place.
sentences.zh: 我們在你家玩得很開心。

gloss_note: leave a tip 留小費；一般約 15–20%

sentences.en: Did you leave a tip for the waiter?
sentences.zh: 你有給服務生小費嗎？

sentences.en: Twenty percent is a normal tip here.
sentences.zh: 在這裡，小費一般是兩成。

sentences.en: Thanks for the tip about parking!
sentences.zh: 謝謝你提供的停車小訣竅！

gloss_note: tired of 對…膩了；tired out 累壞了

sentences.en: I'm too tired to cook tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚累得沒力氣做飯。

sentences.en: Aren't you tired of eating pizza?
sentences.zh: 你吃披薩都不膩嗎？

sentences.en: The baby was tired after the long drive.
sentences.zh: 長途開車之後，寶寶累了。

gloss_note: wheat toast；raise a toast 舉杯

sentences.en: I'll have two eggs and wheat toast.
sentences.zh: 我要兩顆蛋跟全麥吐司。

sentences.en: Would you like your toast buttered?
sentences.zh: 你的吐司要塗奶油嗎？

sentences.en: Let's raise a toast to the happy couple.
sentences.zh: 讓我們舉杯祝福這對新人。

gloss_note: today 前不加 on：I'm busy today

sentences.en: Are you free for lunch today?
sentences.zh: 你今天午餐有空嗎？

sentences.en: Today is my mom's birthday.
sentences.zh: 今天是我媽媽的生日。

sentences.en: It's supposed to snow later today.
sentences.zh: 今天稍晚應該會下雪。

gloss_note: stub your toe 腳趾撞到；big toe 大拇趾

sentences.en: I stubbed my toe on the door.
sentences.zh: 我的腳趾撞到門了。

sentences.en: Does your big toe still hurt?
sentences.zh: 你的大腳趾還會痛嗎？

sentences.en: The baby grabbed her toes and giggled.
sentences.zh: 寶寶抓著自己的腳趾咯咯笑。

sentences.en: Let's get together this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末聚一聚吧。

sentences.en: Do you two live together?
sentences.zh: 你們兩個住在一起嗎？

sentences.en: We cooked dinner together last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚一起做了晚餐。

gloss_note: 複數 tomatoes；tomato sauce 番茄醬汁

sentences.en: Could I get extra tomato on my burger?
sentences.zh: 我的漢堡可以多加點番茄嗎？

sentences.en: We grow tomatoes in our backyard.
sentences.zh: 我們在後院種番茄。

sentences.en: This tomato soup is really good.
sentences.zh: 這碗番茄湯真好喝。

sentences.en: I'll call you tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 我明天早上打電話給你。

sentences.en: What are you doing tomorrow night?
sentences.zh: 你明天晚上要做什麼？

sentences.en: Tomorrow is a big day for us.
sentences.zh: 明天對我們來說是重要的日子。

sentences.en: Mom, what is for dinner tonight?
sentences.zh: 媽，今晚吃什麼？

sentences.en: I'm staying home tonight to rest.
sentences.zh: 我今晚要待在家休息。

sentences.en: Tonight's game starts at seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 今晚的比賽七點開始。

gloss_note: power tools 電動工具；toolbox 工具箱

sentences.en: Where do you keep your tools?
sentences.zh: 你的工具都放在哪裡？

sentences.en: Dad needs a special tool for this job.
sentences.zh: 爸爸做這件事需要一種專用工具。

sentences.en: Can I borrow a few tools from you?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你借幾樣工具嗎？

gloss_note: 複數是 teeth；刷牙 brush your teeth

sentences.en: My son lost his first tooth yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我兒子昨天掉了第一顆牙。

sentences.en: I think I have a bad tooth.
sentences.zh: 我覺得我有一顆牙壞了。

sentences.en: Does your tooth still hurt after the filling?
sentences.zh: 補牙之後你那顆牙還會痛嗎？

gloss_note: at the top of 在…頂端

sentences.en: Put the box on the top shelf.
sentences.zh: 把箱子放在最上層的架子上。

sentences.en: Is she at the top of her class?
sentences.zh: 她是班上最頂尖的學生嗎？

sentences.en: We hiked to the top before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我們在日出前健行到了山頂。

sentences.en: Can we change the topic?
sentences.zh: 我們可以換個話題嗎？

sentences.en: What topic did you pick for your essay?
sentences.zh: 你的作文選了什麼主題？

sentences.en: Money is a touchy topic for them.
sentences.zh: 錢對他們來說是個敏感話題。

gloss_note: in total 總共；comes to 共計

sentences.en: What's the total for these groceries?
sentences.zh: 這些雜貨總共多少錢？

sentences.en: The total comes to twenty dollars.
sentences.zh: 總共是二十美元。

sentences.en: We had a total of ten guests.
sentences.zh: 我們總共有十位客人。

gloss_note: keep in touch 保持聯絡

sentences.en: Don't touch the stove. It's hot.
sentences.zh: 別碰爐子，很燙。

sentences.en: Let's keep in touch after graduation.
sentences.zh: 畢業後我們保持聯絡吧。

sentences.en: How can I get in touch with the manager?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼聯絡經理？

gloss_note: bath towel 浴巾；paper towel 紙巾

sentences.en: Grab a clean towel from the closet.
sentences.zh: 從櫃子裡拿條乾淨的毛巾。

sentences.en: Did you hang up your wet towel?
sentences.zh: 你有把濕毛巾掛起來嗎？

sentences.en: She wrapped a towel around her hair.
sentences.zh: 她用毛巾包住頭髮。

gloss_note: go into town 進城；out of town

sentences.en: I grew up in a small town.
sentences.zh: 我在小鎮長大。

sentences.en: We're going into town to grab lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們要進城去吃午餐。

sentences.en: Is your boss still out of town?
sentences.zh: 你老闆還在外地嗎？

gloss_note: 美式說 stuffed animal 填充玩偶

sentences.en: The kids left their toys everywhere.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把玩具丟得到處都是。

sentences.en: What toy does your daughter want for her birthday?
sentences.zh: 你女兒生日想要什麼玩具？

sentences.en: He's playing with his toy trucks.
sentences.zh: 他在玩他的玩具卡車。

sentences.en: Sorry I'm late, I got stuck in traffic.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我遲到了，我被塞在車陣裡。

sentences.en: Is there a lot of traffic on the freeway?
sentences.zh: 高速公路上車多嗎？

sentences.en: Traffic is always bad on Friday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 週五下午的車流總是很糟。

gloss_note: take the train 搭火車；train 也可作動詞

sentences.en: I take the train to work.
sentences.zh: 我搭火車上班。

sentences.en: Where do I catch the train to Boston?
sentences.zh: 我要在哪裡搭到波士頓的火車？

sentences.en: We're training our puppy to sit.
sentences.zh: 我們在訓練小狗坐下。

sentences.en: Can you take out the trash tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚可以把垃圾拿出去倒嗎？

sentences.en: Don't leave your trash on the floor.
sentences.zh: 別把你的垃圾留在地板上。

sentences.en: The trash truck comes every Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 垃圾車每週二早上都會來。

gloss_note: My treat 我請客；treat A like B

sentences.en: Dinner is my treat tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚晚餐我請客。

sentences.en: How does your manager treat new employees?
sentences.zh: 你的主管怎麼對待新進員工？

sentences.en: He always treats his dog like family.
sentences.zh: 他總是把他的狗當成家人看待。

gloss_note: plant a tree 種樹；family tree 家譜

sentences.en: Our dog loves to dig under that tree.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗最愛在那棵樹下挖洞。

sentences.en: Did the storm knock down any trees?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨有把樹吹倒嗎？

sentences.en: We planted a young tree in the yard.
sentences.zh: 我們在院子裡種了一棵小樹。

gloss_note: magic trick 魔術；Trick or treat!

sentences.en: My dog knows a few cool tricks.
sentences.zh: 我的狗會幾招很酷的把戲。

sentences.en: Is there a trick to opening this jar?
sentences.zh: 打開這個罐子有什麼訣竅嗎？

sentences.en: That magic trick fooled everyone at the party.
sentences.zh: 那個魔術騙過了派對上所有人。

gloss_note: take a trip 去旅行；road trip 公路旅行

sentences.en: We're taking a trip to Hawaii in July.
sentences.zh: 我們七月要去夏威夷旅行。

sentences.en: How was your trip to Chicago?
sentences.zh: 你的芝加哥之旅怎麼樣？

sentences.en: Have a safe trip, and call me!
sentences.zh: 旅途平安，記得打給我！

sentences.en: I'm having trouble logging in to my account.
sentences.zh: 我登入帳號有點困難。

sentences.en: Will I get in trouble for being late?
sentences.zh: 我遲到會惹上麻煩嗎？

sentences.en: Sorry for all the trouble, and thanks again.
sentences.zh: 抱歉造成這麼多麻煩，再次感謝。

gloss_note: 美式 truck；pickup truck 是常見私家車

sentences.en: A delivery truck is blocking our driveway.
sentences.zh: 一輛送貨卡車擋住了我們的車道。

sentences.en: Does your uncle still drive that old truck?
sentences.zh: 你叔叔還在開那台舊卡車嗎？

sentences.en: He bought a pickup truck last month.
sentences.zh: 他上個月買了一台小貨卡。

gloss_note: That's true／So true 說得沒錯

sentences.en: Is it true that you're moving?
sentences.zh: 你要搬家是真的嗎？

sentences.en: That's true, but it's still too expensive.
sentences.zh: 是沒錯，但還是太貴了。

sentences.en: The story is based on true events.
sentences.zh: 這個故事是根據真實事件改編的。

gloss_note: try on 試穿；Give it a try

sentences.en: Do you want to try my pasta?
sentences.zh: 你想嘗嘗我煮的義大利麵嗎？

sentences.en: I tried calling you, but you didn't answer.
sentences.zh: 我試著打給你，但你沒接。

sentences.en: We're trying to save money this year.
sentences.zh: 我們今年想努力存錢。

sentences.en: My dentist appointment is next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我下週二要看牙。

sentences.en: Do you work on Tuesdays?
sentences.zh: 你週二要上班嗎？

sentences.en: The store was closed last Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 那家店上週二沒開。

gloss_note: turn left 左轉；your turn 輪到你

sentences.en: Turn left at the next light.
sentences.zh: 在下一個紅綠燈左轉。

sentences.en: Whose turn is it to do dishes?
sentences.zh: 輪到誰洗碗了？

sentences.en: He turned around and waved at us.
sentences.zh: 他轉過身來向我們揮手。

sentences.en: We saw a sea turtle at the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海灘看到一隻海龜。

sentences.en: Does your son still have his pet turtle?
sentences.zh: 你兒子還養著他的寵物烏龜嗎？

sentences.en: The turtle moved slowly across the path.
sentences.zh: 那隻烏龜慢慢爬過小徑。

gloss_note: watch TV 看電視；on TV 電視上

sentences.en: Mom, can I watch TV after dinner?
sentences.zh: 媽，晚餐後我可以看電視嗎？

sentences.en: Turn down the TV, the baby's sleeping.
sentences.zh: 把電視音量調小，寶寶在睡覺。

sentences.en: There's nothing good on TV tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚電視上沒什麼好看的。

gloss_note: twice a week 一週兩次

sentences.en: I go to the gym twice a week.
sentences.zh: 我一週去兩次健身房。

sentences.en: Have you been here twice already?
sentences.zh: 你已經來過這裡兩次了嗎？

sentences.en: He rang the doorbell twice, but nobody answered.
sentences.zh: 他按了兩次門鈴，但沒人應門。

sentences.en: What type of music do you like?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡哪種音樂？

sentences.en: She's the type who never complains.
sentences.zh: 她就是那種從不抱怨的人。

sentences.en: Can you type this email for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我打這封電子郵件嗎？

gloss_note: 美洲說 hurricane；西太平洋才叫 typhoon

sentences.en: A typhoon is heading toward southern Japan.
sentences.zh: 有個颱風正朝日本南部逼近。

sentences.en: Was your family safe during the typhoon?
sentences.zh: 颱風期間你家人都平安嗎？

sentences.en: School was canceled because of the typhoon.
sentences.zh: 因為颱風，學校停課了。

gloss_note: ugly 語氣直接，當面形容人較失禮

sentences.en: That's an ugly sweater, but I love it.
sentences.zh: 那件毛衣很醜，但我就是喜歡。

sentences.en: Is that lamp ugly, or is it just me?
sentences.zh: 那盞燈很醜，還是只有我這麼覺得？

sentences.en: We painted over the ugly wallpaper last week.
sentences.zh: 上週我們把那醜醜的壁紙漆掉了。

gloss_note: grab an umbrella 帶把傘；英式 brolly

sentences.en: Don't forget your umbrella, it's pouring out there.
sentences.zh: 別忘了帶傘，外面下傾盆大雨。

sentences.en: Can I share your umbrella on the way to the bus stop?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你共撐一把傘走去公車站嗎？

sentences.en: I left my umbrella on the train.
sentences.zh: 我把傘忘在火車上了。

gloss_note: 叔伯舅姑丈姨丈都叫 uncle

sentences.en: My uncle owns a small hardware store.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔開了一家小小的五金行。

sentences.en: Is Uncle Mike coming for Thanksgiving?
sentences.zh: 麥克舅舅會來過感恩節嗎？

sentences.en: We stayed at my uncle's house last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我們住在舅舅家。

gloss_note: 口語常說 I get it／Got it

sentences.en: Sorry, I don't understand the question.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不懂這個問題。

sentences.en: Do you understand what the sign says?
sentences.zh: 你看得懂這個標誌寫什麼嗎？

sentences.en: I understand you're busy, but this is urgent.
sentences.zh: 我知道你很忙，但這件事很緊急。

gloss_note: unhappy with 對…不滿；口語常說 upset

sentences.en: She seems unhappy at her new job.
sentences.zh: 她在新工作上似乎不開心。

sentences.en: Are you unhappy with the service here?
sentences.zh: 你對這裡的服務不滿意嗎？

sentences.en: The kids were unhappy about the rain.
sentences.zh: 孩子們因為下雨而不開心。

gloss_note: 美國公立學校多半沒有校服

sentences.en: Do you have to wear a uniform at work?
sentences.zh: 你上班需要穿制服嗎？

sentences.en: The police officer wore a dark blue uniform.
sentences.zh: 那位警察穿著深藍色的制服。

sentences.en: Her school uniform is already too small.
sentences.zh: 她的校服已經太小了。

gloss_note: upload a file 上傳檔案；反義 download

sentences.en: Please upload your photos to the shared folder.
sentences.zh: 請把你的照片上傳到共用資料夾。

sentences.en: How long does it take to upload this video?
sentences.zh: 上傳這支影片要花多久？

sentences.en: I uploaded the report an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 我一小時前就上傳了報告。

gloss_note: use up 用完；Can I use…? 是借用

sentences.en: Can I use your phone charger for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以借用一下你的手機充電器嗎？

sentences.en: We used up all the milk this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們今天早上把牛奶都用完了。

sentences.en: She uses a calculator for her math homework.
sentences.zh: 她用計算機寫數學作業。

gloss_note: be useful for 對…有用；口語也說 handy

sentences.en: This map app is really useful for finding parking.
sentences.zh: 這個地圖應用程式對找停車位真的很有用。

sentences.en: Was the advice from your teacher useful?
sentences.zh: 你老師給的建議有用嗎？

sentences.en: A flashlight is useful during a power outage.
sentences.zh: 停電的時候手電筒很有用。

gloss_note: 放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後

sentences.en: I usually take the bus to school.
sentences.zh: 我平常搭公車上學。

sentences.en: What time do you usually eat dinner?
sentences.zh: 你通常幾點吃晚餐？

sentences.en: It's usually pretty quiet around here on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 這附近星期天通常很安靜。

gloss_note: 美式說 vacation，英式多說 holiday

sentences.en: We're taking a vacation to Hawaii next summer.
sentences.zh: 我們明年夏天要去夏威夷度假。

sentences.en: How many vacation days do you get each year?
sentences.zh: 你一年有幾天休假？

sentences.en: She's on vacation until next Monday.
sentences.zh: 她休假到下週一。

gloss_note: eat your vegetables 多吃蔬菜；常用複數

sentences.en: Eat your vegetables before you have dessert.
sentences.zh: 先把蔬菜吃完再吃甜點。

sentences.en: Which vegetable do you like the most?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪一種蔬菜？

sentences.en: We buy fresh vegetables at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我們在農夫市集買新鮮蔬菜。

sentences.en: Did you see the funny video I sent you?
sentences.zh: 你有看我傳給你的那支搞笑影片嗎？

sentences.en: I watched a cooking video on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我用手機看了一支料理影片。

sentences.en: I recorded a short video of our dog.
sentences.zh: 我錄了一段我們家狗的短影片。

gloss_note: play the violin 拉小提琴（樂器前加 the）

sentences.en: My daughter plays the violin in the school orchestra.
sentences.zh: 我女兒在學校管弦樂團拉小提琴。

sentences.en: How long have you been taking violin lessons?
sentences.zh: 你學小提琴多久了？

sentences.en: He carried his violin case onto the bus.
sentences.zh: 他把小提琴盒帶上了公車。

gloss_note: visit 後直接接人或地點，不加 to

sentences.en: We're visiting my grandparents this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我們要去看我的祖父母。

sentences.en: Do you want to visit the museum today?
sentences.zh: 你今天想去參觀博物館嗎？

sentences.en: My friend Dan visits us every summer.
sentences.zh: 我朋友丹每年夏天都會來看我們。

sentences.en: Visitor parking is behind the main building.
sentences.zh: 訪客停車位在主建築後面。

sentences.en: Do we have any visitors coming this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末有訪客要來嗎？

sentences.en: The park gets thousands of visitors every summer.
sentences.zh: 這座公園每年夏天都有上千名遊客。

gloss_note: keep your voice down 小聲點

sentences.en: Please keep your voice down; the baby's sleeping.
sentences.zh: 請小聲一點，寶寶在睡覺。

sentences.en: I lost my voice after the concert.
sentences.zh: 演唱會結束後我的聲音都啞了。

sentences.en: Whose voice is that on the radio?
sentences.zh: 廣播裡那是誰的聲音？

gloss_note: wait for 等…；Wait a minute! 等一下

sentences.en: Wait a minute, I forgot my keys.
sentences.zh: 等一下，我忘了帶鑰匙。

sentences.en: How long did you wait for the bus?
sentences.zh: 你等公車等了多久？

sentences.en: We're waiting for the doctor to call back.
sentences.zh: 我們在等醫生回電。

gloss_note: 叫服務生常說 Excuse me；也可通稱 server

sentences.en: Our waiter was really friendly and fast.
sentences.zh: 我們的服務生人很親切，動作也很快。

sentences.en: Can you ask the waiter for more water?
sentences.zh: 你可以請服務生再給我們一些水嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter brought us the check right away.
sentences.zh: 服務生馬上把帳單拿來給我們。

gloss_note: 美國現多說 server，不分性別

sentences.en: The waitress asked if we wanted dessert.
sentences.zh: 女服務生問我們要不要點甜點。

sentences.en: My sister works as a waitress on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊週末在餐廳當服務生。

sentences.en: Excuse me, are you our waitress tonight?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，你是我們今晚的服務生嗎？

gloss_note: wake up 醒來；wake me up 叫我起床

sentences.en: What time do you wake up on weekdays?
sentences.zh: 你平日幾點起床？

sentences.en: Please don't wake the baby; she just fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 別吵醒寶寶，她剛睡著。

sentences.en: My alarm wakes me up at six every morning.
sentences.zh: 我的鬧鐘每天早上六點把我叫醒。

gloss_note: walk the dog 遛狗；go for a walk

sentences.en: He walks to the bus stop every morning.
sentences.zh: 他每天早上走路到公車站。

sentences.en: Can you walk the dog before dinner?
sentences.zh: 你可以在晚餐前去遛狗嗎？

sentences.en: Let's go for a walk after lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們午餐後去散個步吧。

sentences.en: Let's hang this picture on the living room wall.
sentences.zh: 我們把這幅畫掛在客廳的牆上吧。

sentences.en: Who painted the walls blue?
sentences.zh: 誰把牆壁漆成藍色的？

sentences.en: There's a spider on the wall!
sentences.zh: 牆上有一隻蜘蛛！

gloss_note: 美式 purse 指女用手提包，不是錢包

sentences.en: I left my wallet in the car.
sentences.zh: 我把皮夾忘在車上了。

sentences.en: Do you have your wallet with you?
sentences.zh: 你有帶皮夾嗎？

sentences.en: Her wallet fell out of her pocket.
sentences.zh: 她的皮夾從口袋裡掉了出來。

gloss_note: want to + 原形動詞；要不要

sentences.en: Do you want to grab lunch together?
sentences.zh: 你要不要一起去吃午餐？

sentences.en: I want a new phone for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 我生日想要一支新手機。

sentences.en: He wants to be a doctor someday.
sentences.zh: 他以後想當醫生。

sentences.en: It's warm outside, so we ate on the patio.
sentences.zh: 外面很暖和，所以我們在露台吃飯。

sentences.en: Would you like a cup of warm milk?
sentences.zh: 你要不要來杯溫牛奶？

sentences.en: Wear a warm jacket; it's freezing out there.
sentences.zh: 穿件保暖的外套，外面冷死了。

sentences.en: Don't forget to wash your hands before dinner.
sentences.zh: 吃晚餐前別忘了洗手。

sentences.en: Who's washing the dishes tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚誰要洗碗？

sentences.en: I washed my car this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上洗了車。

gloss_note: 去電影院看多說 see a movie

sentences.en: Do you want to watch a movie tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想看電影嗎？

sentences.en: We watch TV together after dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們晚餐後一起看電視。

sentences.en: My watch is five minutes fast.
sentences.zh: 我的手錶快了五分鐘。

gloss_note: a glass of water 一杯水

sentences.en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一杯水嗎？

sentences.en: Make sure you drink enough water every day.
sentences.zh: 每天要記得喝足夠的水。

sentences.en: The water in the pool is too cold.
sentences.zh: 泳池的水太冷了。

gloss_note: a slice of watermelon 一片西瓜

sentences.en: Watermelon is perfect on a hot summer day.
sentences.zh: 大熱天吃西瓜最棒了。

sentences.en: Would you like a slice of watermelon?
sentences.zh: 你要不要吃片西瓜？

sentences.en: We brought a big watermelon to the picnic.
sentences.zh: 我們帶了一顆大西瓜去野餐。

gloss_note: wave goodbye 揮手道別；wave at 對…揮手

sentences.en: The kids waved goodbye from the school bus.
sentences.zh: 孩子們從校車上揮手說再見。

sentences.en: Why is that man waving at us?
sentences.zh: 那個男人為什麼對我們揮手？

sentences.en: The waves were huge at the beach today.
sentences.zh: 今天海邊的浪好大。

gloss_note: on the way 在途中；by the way 順帶一提

sentences.en: What's the best way to get downtown?
sentences.zh: 去市中心最好怎麼走？

sentences.en: I'll grab some milk on the way home.
sentences.zh: 我回家路上會順便買點牛奶。

sentences.en: That's not the right way to cut onions.
sentences.zh: 切洋蔥不是這樣切的。

gloss_note: weak coffee 淡咖啡；feel weak 覺得沒力

sentences.en: I felt weak after being sick all week.
sentences.zh: 我病了一整個星期，覺得渾身無力。

sentences.en: Is the signal weak in your room?
sentences.zh: 你房間的訊號很弱嗎？

sentences.en: This coffee is too weak for me.
sentences.zh: 這杯咖啡對我來說太淡了。

gloss_note: wear 是穿戴的狀態；put on 是穿上的動作

sentences.en: What are you going to wear to the party?
sentences.zh: 你打算穿什麼去派對？

sentences.en: He always wears a baseball cap.
sentences.zh: 他總是戴著棒球帽。

sentences.en: You should wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 騎腳踏車時應該戴安全帽。

gloss_note: How's the weather? 天氣如何；不可數名詞

sentences.en: How's the weather in Seattle this week?
sentences.zh: 西雅圖這星期的天氣怎麼樣？

sentences.en: The weather is supposed to be nice tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天天氣應該會不錯。

sentences.en: We canceled the picnic because of bad weather.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣不好，我們取消了野餐。

gloss_note: 唸成 WENZ-day；on Wednesday 在星期三

sentences.en: Our team meeting is on Wednesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們的小組會議在星期三下午。

sentences.en: Are you free this Wednesday evening?
sentences.zh: 你這個星期三晚上有空嗎？

sentences.en: I have piano lessons every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我每個星期三都要上鋼琴課。

gloss_note: last week 上週；next week 下週

sentences.en: I'll call you sometime next week.
sentences.zh: 我下週找個時間打給你。

sentences.en: How many hours do you work per week?
sentences.zh: 你一週工作幾個小時？

sentences.en: It rained almost every day last week.
sentences.zh: 上週幾乎天天下雨。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: What are you doing this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末你要做什麼？

sentences.en: We usually clean the house on the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們通常週末打掃家裡。

sentences.en: Have a great weekend, everyone!
sentences.zh: 大家週末愉快！

sentences.en: Welcome to our home! Please come in.
sentences.zh: 歡迎來我們家！請進。

sentences.en: "Thanks for helping!" "You're welcome, anytime."
sentences.zh: 「謝謝你幫忙！」「不客氣，隨時都可以。」

sentences.en: Did your new neighbors welcome you with a gift?
sentences.zh: 你的新鄰居有送禮歡迎你嗎？

gloss_note: get well soon 早日康復

sentences.en: She speaks English really well.
sentences.zh: 她的英文說得真好。

sentences.en: I don't feel well, so I'm staying home.
sentences.zh: 我身體不舒服，所以待在家裡。

sentences.en: Did you sleep well last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚睡得好嗎？

gloss_note: the West Coast 西岸；out west 往西部

sentences.en: The sun sets in the west.
sentences.zh: 太陽從西邊落下。

sentences.en: Is the airport west of downtown?
sentences.zh: 機場在市中心的西邊嗎？

sentences.en: We drove west for about six hours.
sentences.zh: 我們往西開了大約六個小時。

gloss_note: soaking wet 濕透了；Wet Paint 油漆未乾

sentences.en: My shoes got soaking wet in the rain.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋子被雨淋得濕透了。

sentences.en: Careful, the floor is still wet.
sentences.zh: 小心，地板還是濕的。

sentences.en: Why is your hair wet?
sentences.zh: 你的頭髮為什麼是濕的？

gloss_note: white rice 白飯；white lie 善意的謊言

sentences.en: I need a white shirt for the interview.
sentences.zh: 我面試需要一件白襯衫。

sentences.en: Do you want white rice or brown rice?
sentences.zh: 你要白飯還是糙米飯？

sentences.en: The kitchen walls are painted white.
sentences.zh: 廚房的牆壁漆成了白色。

gloss_note: two feet wide 兩英尺寬

sentences.en: The road is wide enough for two trucks.
sentences.zh: 這條路寬到可以並排開兩輛卡車。

sentences.en: How wide is this couch?
sentences.zh: 這張沙發有多寬？

sentences.en: The parking spaces here aren't very wide.
sentences.zh: 這裡的停車格不太寬。

gloss_note: 口語常說 my wife；複數是 wives

sentences.en: My wife is picking up the kids today.
sentences.zh: 今天是我太太去接孩子。

sentences.en: Have you met his wife yet?
sentences.zh: 你見過他太太了嗎？

sentences.en: He cooks dinner for his wife every Friday.
sentences.zh: 他每週五都會煮晚餐給太太吃。

gloss_note: win a game 贏比賽；win a prize 得獎

sentences.en: Do you think our team can win tonight?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們隊今晚能贏嗎？

sentences.en: She wins every time we play cards.
sentences.zh: 我們每次玩牌都是她贏。

sentences.en: Our team is winning by ten points!
sentences.zh: 我們隊領先十分！

gloss_note: a strong wind 強風；wind chill 風寒

sentences.en: The wind knocked over our trash cans.
sentences.zh: 風把我們的垃圾桶吹倒了。

sentences.en: There's a cold wind coming from the north.
sentences.zh: 有一陣冷風從北邊吹來。

sentences.en: Is the wind always this strong here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的風都這麼大嗎？

sentences.en: Could you open the window a little?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把窗戶開一點嗎？

sentences.en: I always ask for a window seat on planes.
sentences.zh: 搭飛機時我都會要靠窗的座位。

sentences.en: Our living room window faces the street.
sentences.zh: 我們客廳的窗戶面向街道。

gloss_note: It's windy out. 外面風很大

sentences.en: It's too windy to fly a kite today.
sentences.zh: 今天風太大，不能放風箏。

sentences.en: Is it always this windy in Chicago?
sentences.zh: 芝加哥的風都這麼大嗎？

sentences.en: Last Saturday was cold and windy.
sentences.zh: 上星期六又冷、風又大。

sentences.en: It gets really cold here in the winter.
sentences.zh: 這裡冬天會變得很冷。

sentences.en: Do you go skiing every winter?
sentences.zh: 你每年冬天都去滑雪嗎？

sentences.en: We're flying home for winter break.
sentences.zh: 我們要搭飛機回家過寒假。

gloss_note: a wise decision 明智的決定

sentences.en: Moving closer to work was a wise decision.
sentences.zh: 搬到離公司近一點是明智的決定。

sentences.en: My grandfather is a very wise man.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是個很有智慧的人。

sentences.en: Is it wise to drive in this storm?
sentences.zh: 在這種暴風雨中開車明智嗎？

gloss_note: I wish I could… 但願我能…

sentences.en: I wish I could join you tonight.
sentences.zh: 真希望我今晚能跟你們一起去。

sentences.en: We wish you all the best in your new job.
sentences.zh: 我們祝你新工作一切順利。

sentences.en: Did you make a wish on your birthday?
sentences.zh: 你生日那天有許願嗎？

sentences.en: That woman over there is our new neighbor.
sentences.zh: 那邊那位女士是我們的新鄰居。

sentences.en: Who is the woman talking to the manager?
sentences.zh: 正在跟經理講話的那位女士是誰？

sentences.en: Two women were waiting in line ahead of me.
sentences.zh: 有兩位女士排在我前面。

gloss_note: 口語感嘆：That's wonderful! 太好了

sentences.en: We had a wonderful time at your party.
sentences.zh: 我們在你的派對上玩得很開心。

sentences.en: You got the job? That's wonderful news!
sentences.zh: 你得到那份工作了？真是好消息！

sentences.en: Wasn't the concert absolutely wonderful?
sentences.zh: 那場演唱會是不是棒極了？

gloss_note: Can I have a word? 能借一步說話嗎

sentences.en: How do you spell that word?
sentences.zh: 那個字怎麼拼？

sentences.en: I looked up that word in the dictionary.
sentences.zh: 我在字典裡查了那個字。

sentences.en: Can I have a word with you?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你說句話嗎？

gloss_note: go to work 去上班；It works! 管用

sentences.en: I work from home on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 我星期五在家上班。

sentences.en: What time do you get off work?
sentences.zh: 你幾點下班？

sentences.en: The printer isn't working again.
sentences.zh: 印表機又壞了。

gloss_note: do a workbook page 寫習作本一頁

sentences.en: Open your workbook to page twelve.
sentences.zh: 請把習作本翻到第十二頁。

sentences.en: Did you finish the workbook pages for tonight?
sentences.zh: 你寫完今晚的習作本了嗎？

sentences.en: I left my math workbook at school.
sentences.zh: 我把數學習作本忘在學校了。

sentences.en: She's a hard worker, and everyone likes her.
sentences.zh: 她工作很努力，大家都喜歡她。

sentences.en: The construction workers start before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 施工人員天亮前就開工了。

sentences.en: How many workers does your company have?
sentences.zh: 你們公司有多少員工？

gloss_note: around the world 世界各地

sentences.en: I want to travel around the world someday.
sentences.zh: 我想有一天環遊世界。

sentences.en: What's the biggest city in the world?
sentences.zh: 世界上最大的城市是哪一個？

sentences.en: My friends live all over the world.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友遍布世界各地。

gloss_note: Don't worry about it. 別擔心／沒關係

sentences.en: Don't worry about it; it's no big deal.
sentences.zh: 別放在心上，沒什麼大不了。

sentences.en: Are you worried about the test tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你在擔心明天的考試嗎？

sentences.en: My mom worries when I drive at night.
sentences.zh: 我晚上開車時，我媽會擔心。

gloss_note: write down 寫下來；write to 寫信給

sentences.en: Can you write down your phone number for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以把電話號碼寫下來給我嗎？

sentences.en: She writes in her journal every night.
sentences.zh: 她每天晚上都寫日記。

sentences.en: I'm writing a thank-you note to my teacher.
sentences.zh: 我正在寫一張感謝卡給我的老師。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite writer?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡的作家是誰？

sentences.en: My aunt is a writer for a magazine.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨是雜誌的撰稿人。

sentences.en: The writer signed copies of her new book.
sentences.zh: 那位作家為她的新書簽名。

sentences.en: You look upset. What's wrong?
sentences.zh: 你看起來不太開心，怎麼了？

sentences.en: Sorry, you have the wrong number.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，你打錯電話了。

sentences.en: I took the wrong exit on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 我在高速公路上下錯了出口。

gloss_note: front yard 前院；yard sale 庭院二手拍賣

sentences.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
sentences.zh: 孩子們正在院子裡玩。

sentences.en: We're having a yard sale this Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們這個星期六要辦庭院二手拍賣。

sentences.en: Do you mow your yard every week?
sentences.zh: 你每個星期都會割院子的草嗎？

gloss_note: school year 學年；X years old X 歲

sentences.en: I've lived in California for three years.
sentences.zh: 我在加州住了三年。

sentences.en: Which year did you graduate from high school?
sentences.zh: 你是哪一年高中畢業的？

sentences.en: My daughter is six years old.
sentences.zh: 我女兒六歲。

gloss_note: yellow light 黃燈；美國校車是黃色的

sentences.en: The school bus is bright yellow.
sentences.zh: 校車是亮黃色的。

sentences.en: Should I wear the yellow shirt or the blue one?
sentences.zh: 我該穿黃色那件還是藍色那件？

sentences.en: Slow down when the light turns yellow.
sentences.zh: 黃燈亮的時候要減速。

sentences.en: I saw your brother at the store yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天在商店看到你哥哥。

sentences.en: What did you have for lunch yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天午餐吃了什麼？

sentences.en: Yesterday was the hottest day of the year.
sentences.zh: 昨天是今年最熱的一天。

gloss_note: 疑問句／否定句用；Not yet. 還沒

sentences.en: Have you finished your homework yet?
sentences.zh: 你功課寫完了嗎？

sentences.en: I haven't called my landlord yet.
sentences.zh: 我還沒打給我的房東。

sentences.en: The mail hasn't come yet.
sentences.zh: 郵件還沒送來。

gloss_note: young kids 年紀小的孩子

sentences.en: She's too young to drive a car.
sentences.zh: 她年紀太小，還不能開車。

sentences.en: Do you have any young kids at home?
sentences.zh: 你家裡有年紀小的孩子嗎？

sentences.en: I met my wife when we were young.
sentences.zh: 我跟太太是年輕時認識的。

gloss_note: 兒語／口語，比 delicious 隨興

sentences.en: Mmm, this soup smells so yummy!
sentences.zh: 嗯，這碗湯聞起來好好吃！

sentences.en: These cookies are so yummy!
sentences.zh: 這些餅乾好好吃！

sentences.en: Was the chocolate cake as yummy as it looks?
sentences.zh: 那塊巧克力蛋糕有看起來那麼好吃嗎？

gloss_note: 美式的斑馬線叫 crosswalk，不叫 zebra

sentences.en: We saw a zebra at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻斑馬。

sentences.en: Why does a zebra have black and white stripes?
sentences.zh: 斑馬為什麼有黑白條紋？

sentences.en: No two zebras have the same stripes.
sentences.zh: 沒有兩隻斑馬的條紋是一樣的。
