gloss_note: go to the zoo 去動物園

sentences.en: We take the kids to the zoo every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們每年夏天都帶孩子去動物園。

sentences.en: Is the zoo open on Mondays?
sentences.zh: 動物園星期一有開嗎？

sentences.en: The zoo has a new baby elephant.
sentences.zh: 動物園來了一隻新的小象。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Neoglitch assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: absent from school 沒來上課

sentences.en: Tyler was absent from class on Monday.
sentences.zh: 泰勒星期一沒來上課。

sentences.en: Why have you been absent so often?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼常缺席？

sentences.en: Please call the school if your child is absent.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子沒去上學，請打電話給學校。

gloss_note: accept credit cards 收信用卡

sentences.en: Do you accept credit cards here?
sentences.zh: 你們這裡收信用卡嗎？

sentences.en: She accepted the job offer yesterday.
sentences.zh: 她昨天接受了那份工作邀約。

sentences.en: I can't accept this gift; it's too much.
sentences.zh: 我不能收這份禮物，太貴重了。

sentences.en: This store sells phone accessories like cases and chargers.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣手機殼和充電器之類的手機配件。

sentences.en: Which accessories go best with this dress?
sentences.zh: 哪些配件跟這件洋裝最搭？

sentences.en: She loves buying cute accessories for her bag.
sentences.zh: 她很愛買可愛的配件來裝飾包包。

sentences.en: There was a bad accident on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上發生了嚴重車禍。

sentences.en: I spilled coffee on your desk by accident.
sentences.zh: 我不小心把咖啡灑在你的桌上了。

sentences.en: Was anyone hurt in the accident?
sentences.zh: 有人在這場意外中受傷嗎？

sentences.en: My grandma stays active by walking every day.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每天走路來保持活動力。

sentences.en: Are your kids active in any sports?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子有參加任何運動嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighborhood group is very active online.
sentences.zh: 我們的社區群組在網路上很活躍。

sentences.en: What kind of activities does your school offer?
sentences.zh: 你們學校提供哪些活動？

sentences.en: Swimming is my favorite summer activity.
sentences.zh: 游泳是我最愛的夏季活動。

sentences.en: We planned a fun activity for the kids.
sentences.zh: 我們為孩子們規劃了一個好玩的活動。

gloss_note: add up 加總；add A to B 把A加到B

sentences.en: Add two eggs and stir well.
sentences.zh: 加兩顆蛋，然後攪拌均勻。

sentences.en: Can you add me to the group chat?
sentences.zh: 你可以把我加進群組聊天室嗎？

sentences.en: He added that he'd be home late.
sentences.zh: 他補充說他會晚點回家。

gloss_note: What's your address? 也指演說

sentences.en: What's your new email address?
sentences.zh: 你的新電子郵件地址是什麼？

sentences.en: Please write your home address on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上寫下你的住家地址。

sentences.en: I still don't have his new address.
sentences.zh: 我還沒有他的新地址。

gloss_note: admire sb for sth 佩服某人的某點

sentences.en: I really admire your courage.
sentences.zh: 我真的很佩服你的勇氣。

sentences.en: Which teacher do you admire the most?
sentences.zh: 你最佩服哪位老師？

sentences.en: We stopped to admire the view.
sentences.zh: 我們停下來欣賞風景。

gloss_note: adult ticket 成人票；也可當形容詞

sentences.en: Two adult tickets for the noon show, please.
sentences.zh: 請給我兩張中午場的成人票。

sentences.en: Does every child need an adult with them?
sentences.zh: 每個小孩都需要大人陪同嗎？

sentences.en: Kids get in free, but adults pay ten dollars.
sentences.zh: 小孩免費入場，大人要付十美元。

gloss_note: 口語多說 ad，電視廣告叫 commercial

sentences.en: I saw your advertisement online yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天在網路上看到你們的廣告。

sentences.en: Why is there an advertisement every five minutes?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每五分鐘就有一支廣告？

sentences.en: The advertisement says the sale ends Sunday.
sentences.zh: 廣告上說特賣到週日結束。

gloss_note: 不可數；a piece of advice 一則建議

sentences.en: Can I ask you for some advice?
sentences.zh: 我可以向你請教一些建議嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks for your advice. It really helped.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的建議，真的幫了大忙。

sentences.en: Let me give you a piece of advice.
sentences.zh: 讓我給你一個忠告。

gloss_note: advise sb to do 勸某人做某事

sentences.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議我休息一週。

sentences.en: What do you advise us to do?
sentences.zh: 你建議我們怎麼做？

sentences.en: I'd advise you to leave early because of traffic.
sentences.zh: 我建議你早點出門，因為會塞車。

gloss_note: 動詞用 affect，名詞「影響」多用 effect

sentences.en: Does coffee affect your sleep?
sentences.zh: 咖啡會影響你的睡眠嗎？

sentences.en: The rain didn't affect our plans.
sentences.zh: 下雨沒有影響我們的計畫。

sentences.en: Lack of sleep really affects my work.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足真的會影響我的工作。

gloss_note: aim at 瞄準；aim to do 打算做

sentences.en: What's your aim for this school year?
sentences.zh: 你這學年的目標是什麼？

sentences.en: He aimed at the target and threw.
sentences.zh: 他瞄準靶心後丟了出去。

sentences.en: Our aim is to finish before dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是在晚餐前完成。

gloss_note: 單數 airline；Which airline? 哪家航空

sentences.en: Which airlines fly directly to Chicago?
sentences.zh: 哪些航空公司有直飛芝加哥？

sentences.en: Some airlines charge extra for checked bags.
sentences.zh: 有些航空公司託運行李要加收費用。

sentences.en: I always compare airlines before I book.
sentences.zh: 我訂票前總會比較各家航空公司。

gloss_note: set an alarm 設鬧鐘；fire alarm 火警

sentences.en: I set my alarm for six thirty.
sentences.zh: 我把鬧鐘設在六點半。

sentences.en: Did the smoke alarm just go off?
sentences.zh: 煙霧警報器剛剛是不是響了？

sentences.en: The fire alarm went off during lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐時間火警警報響了。

gloss_note: photo album 相簿；新專輯 new album

sentences.en: Have you heard her new album yet?
sentences.zh: 你聽過她的新專輯了嗎？

sentences.en: We looked through the old photo album.
sentences.zh: 我們翻看了舊相簿。

sentences.en: I made an album of our trip photos.
sentences.zh: 我把旅行照片做成了一本相簿。

sentences.en: You and your brother look so alike!
sentences.zh: 你和你哥哥長得好像！

sentences.en: Are all these phones alike?
sentences.zh: 這些手機都一樣嗎？

sentences.en: We think alike, so we get along.
sentences.zh: 我們想法很像，所以處得來。

gloss_note: alive and well 平安健康

sentences.en: Is the plant still alive?
sentences.zh: 那盆植物還活著嗎？

sentences.en: I'm just glad you're alive and well.
sentences.zh: 我只是很高興你平安無事。

sentences.en: The streets come alive on Friday nights.
sentences.zh: 街道在週五晚上變得熱鬧起來。

sentences.en: Do you live here alone?
sentences.zh: 你一個人住在這裡嗎？

sentences.en: Please leave me alone for a minute.
sentences.zh: 請讓我自己靜一分鐘。

sentences.en: She doesn't like walking home alone at night.
sentences.zh: 她不喜歡晚上一個人走路回家。

gloss_note: read aloud 朗讀；口語常說 out loud

sentences.en: Can you read this part aloud?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這段唸出來嗎？

sentences.en: Say it aloud so everyone can hear.
sentences.zh: 大聲說出來，讓大家都聽得到。

sentences.en: I was just thinking aloud, sorry.
sentences.zh: 我只是自言自語地想，抱歉。

sentences.en: Can your son sing the alphabet song?
sentences.zh: 你兒子會唱字母歌嗎？

sentences.en: The English alphabet has twenty-six letters.
sentences.zh: 英文字母共有二十六個。

sentences.en: My name starts with the first letter of the alphabet.
sentences.zh: 我的名字以字母表的第一個字母開頭。

gloss_note: 注意與 all together（大家一起）不同

sentences.en: That comes to forty dollars altogether.
sentences.zh: 總共是四十美元。

sentences.en: I stopped drinking soda altogether.
sentences.zh: 我完全不喝汽水了。

sentences.en: How many people are coming altogether?
sentences.zh: 總共有多少人會來？

gloss_note: call an ambulance 叫救護車；美國打 911

sentences.en: Someone call an ambulance, please!
sentences.zh: 誰快叫救護車！

sentences.en: The ambulance got here in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 救護車五分鐘就到了。

sentences.en: Did you see the ambulance outside our building?
sentences.zh: 你有看到我們大樓外面的救護車嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數用 amount，可數用 number

sentences.en: That's a huge amount of homework.
sentences.zh: 那是一大堆作業。

sentences.en: What's the total amount on the bill?
sentences.zh: 帳單的總金額是多少？

sentences.en: I only have a small amount of cash.
sentences.zh: 我身上只有一點現金。

gloss_note: 口語可形容老舊東西，如 an ancient laptop

sentences.en: Have you ever seen ancient Egyptian art?
sentences.zh: 你看過古埃及藝術嗎？

sentences.en: Our computer is ancient. It's so slow.
sentences.zh: 我們的電腦老掉牙了，慢死了。

sentences.en: We visited some ancient ruins on vacation.
sentences.zh: 我們度假時參觀了一些古代遺跡。

gloss_note: You're an angel! 你人真好！

sentences.en: Thanks for the ride. You're an angel!
sentences.zh: 謝謝你載我，你真是大好人！

sentences.en: Our baby is an angel when she sleeps.
sentences.zh: 寶寶睡著時就像個小天使。

sentences.en: Did you see the angel on the Christmas tree?
sentences.zh: 你有看到聖誕樹上的天使嗎？

gloss_note: in anger 氣得；形容詞是 angry

sentences.en: He couldn't hide his anger.
sentences.zh: 他藏不住怒氣。

sentences.en: She slammed the door in anger.
sentences.zh: 她氣得用力甩上門。

sentences.en: How do you deal with anger at work?
sentences.zh: 你在工作上怎麼處理怒氣？

gloss_note: twist/sprain your ankle 扭傷腳踝

sentences.en: I twisted my ankle playing soccer.
sentences.zh: 我踢足球時扭到了腳踝。

sentences.en: Does your ankle still hurt?
sentences.zh: 你的腳踝還會痛嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor wrapped my ankle in a bandage.
sentences.zh: 醫生用繃帶把我的腳踝包起來。

sentences.en: Do you want to go anywhere today?
sentences.zh: 你今天想去哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: I can't find my keys anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我到處都找不到我的鑰匙。

sentences.en: You can sit anywhere you like.
sentences.zh: 你想坐哪裡都可以。

gloss_note: apologize to sb for sth 為某事道歉

sentences.en: I apologize for being late.
sentences.zh: 我為遲到道歉。

sentences.en: Did he apologize to you yet?
sentences.zh: 他向你道歉了嗎？

sentences.en: The store apologized and gave me a refund.
sentences.zh: 店家向我道歉並退了款。

gloss_note: I appreciate it. 感謝；受詞是事或情，不是人

sentences.en: I really appreciate your help.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激你的幫忙。

sentences.en: Thanks for the ride. I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你載我，我很感激。

sentences.en: Do you appreciate how hard she works?
sentences.zh: 你有體會到她工作有多努力嗎？

gloss_note: argue with sb about sth 與某人爭論

sentences.en: Please don't argue with your sister.
sentences.zh: 請不要跟你姊姊吵架。

sentences.en: What are they arguing about now?
sentences.zh: 他們現在又在吵什麼？

sentences.en: My parents never argue in front of us.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽從不在我們面前吵架。

sentences.en: Dad fell asleep in his favorite armchair.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在他最愛的扶手椅上睡著了。

sentences.en: Can you move the armchair closer to the window?
sentences.zh: 你可以把扶手椅搬到靠窗一點嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a used armchair at a yard sale.
sentences.zh: 我們在庭院拍賣買了一張二手扶手椅。

gloss_note: join the army 從軍；美國另有海軍、空軍

sentences.en: My uncle served in the army for ten years.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在陸軍服役了十年。

sentences.en: Did you watch that movie about the army?
sentences.zh: 你看過那部軍隊電影嗎？

sentences.en: The army helped deliver food after the storm.
sentences.zh: 風暴過後，陸軍協助運送食物。

gloss_note: arrange a meeting 安排會面

sentences.en: Can you arrange a ride for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我安排交通嗎？

sentences.en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
sentences.zh: 她把花插在花瓶裡擺好。

sentences.en: Let's arrange a time to talk.
sentences.zh: 我們約個時間談談吧。

gloss_note: street artist 街頭藝人；也可指歌手

sentences.en: My sister wants to be an artist.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹想當藝術家。

sentences.en: Do you know the artist who painted this?
sentences.zh: 你知道這幅畫的畫家是誰嗎？

sentences.en: A street artist drew our portraits.
sentences.zh: 一位街頭藝人幫我們畫了肖像。

gloss_note: 美國常說 Asian American 亞裔美國人

sentences.en: There's a great Asian market near here.
sentences.zh: 這附近有一家很棒的亞洲超市。

sentences.en: Do you cook Asian food at home?
sentences.zh: 你在家煮亞洲菜嗎？

sentences.en: He's Asian American and grew up in Texas.
sentences.zh: 他是亞裔美國人，在德州長大。

gloss_note: fall asleep 睡著；fast asleep 熟睡

sentences.en: The baby fell asleep in the car.
sentences.zh: 寶寶在車上睡著了。

sentences.en: Is your brother still asleep?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟還在睡嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone was fast asleep by ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 到十點時大家都已熟睡。

gloss_note: teaching assistant 助教，常簡稱 TA

sentences.en: My assistant will call you back.
sentences.zh: 我的助理會回電給你。

sentences.en: Who's the teaching assistant for this class?
sentences.zh: 這堂課的助教是誰？

sentences.en: She works as a dental assistant downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區當牙醫助理。

gloss_note: I assume so. 我想是吧；別隨便 assume

sentences.en: I assume you already had dinner.
sentences.zh: 我想你已經吃過晚餐了。

sentences.en: Don't assume he knows the way.
sentences.zh: 別以為他認得路。

sentences.en: Why would you assume I'm angry?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼以為我在生氣？

sentences.en: Please pay attention in class.
sentences.zh: 上課請專心。

sentences.en: Can I have your attention, everyone?
sentences.zh: 大家請注意一下好嗎？

sentences.en: The new puppy needs lots of attention.
sentences.zh: 新來的小狗需要很多關注。

gloss_note: Are you available? 你有空嗎？

sentences.en: Is this shirt available in medium?
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫有中號嗎？

sentences.en: I'm available on Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我週二下午有空。

sentences.en: The doctor is not available until Monday.
sentences.zh: 醫生要到週一才有空。

sentences.en: I try to avoid driving at rush hour.
sentences.zh: 我盡量避免在尖峰時間開車。

sentences.en: How can we avoid the traffic?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼避開塞車？

sentences.en: He crossed the street to avoid the dog.
sentences.zh: 他過馬路去躲那隻狗。

gloss_note: 美國學生上學都背 backpack

sentences.en: Did you pack your lunch in your backpack?
sentences.zh: 你有把午餐放進背包嗎？

sentences.en: What's in your backpack? It looks heavy.
sentences.zh: 你背包裡裝什麼？看起來好重。

sentences.en: My backpack broke on the way to school.
sentences.zh: 我的背包在上學途中壞掉了。

gloss_note: 美式 backward 與 backwards 都可用

sentences.en: Please take a step backward.
sentences.zh: 請往後退一步。

sentences.en: Can you count backward from ten?
sentences.zh: 你能從十倒數嗎？

sentences.en: He put his cap on backward.
sentences.zh: 他把帽子戴反了。

sentences.en: Throw the ball to your brother.
sentences.zh: 把球丟給你弟弟。

sentences.en: Whose ball is this in the yard?
sentences.zh: 院子裡這顆球是誰的？

sentences.en: He kicked the ball over the fence.
sentences.zh: 他把球踢過了圍籬。

gloss_note: blow up a balloon 吹氣球

sentences.en: Can you help me blow up these balloons?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我吹這些氣球嗎？

sentences.en: The balloon popped and the baby cried.
sentences.zh: 氣球爆了，寶寶就哭了。

sentences.en: We tied a balloon to the mailbox.
sentences.zh: 我們把氣球綁在信箱上。

gloss_note: have a barbecue 辦烤肉；常縮寫 BBQ

sentences.en: We're having a barbecue on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們週六要辦烤肉。

sentences.en: Do you want to bring anything to the barbecue?
sentences.zh: 你要帶點什麼去烤肉聚會嗎？

sentences.en: Dad is grilling hot dogs at the barbecue.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在烤肉聚會上烤熱狗。

sentences.en: I need to see my barber this week.
sentences.zh: 我這週得去找我的理髮師。

sentences.en: Is there a good barber near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有好的理髮師嗎？

sentences.en: The barber asked how short I wanted it.
sentences.zh: 理髮師問我想剪多短。

gloss_note: bark at sb 對某人吠；bark 也是樹皮

sentences.en: Our neighbor's dog barks all night.
sentences.zh: 鄰居的狗整晚叫個不停。

sentences.en: Why does your dog bark at the mail carrier?
sentences.zh: 你家的狗為什麼對郵差叫？

sentences.en: The puppy started to bark at the door.
sentences.zh: 小狗開始對著門吠。

gloss_note: 棒球 first base 一壘

sentences.en: The lamp has a heavy wooden base.
sentences.zh: 這盞燈有個厚重的木製底座。

sentences.en: Who's standing on third base?
sentences.zh: 誰站在三壘？

sentences.en: Careful, the base of that shelf is loose.
sentences.zh: 小心，那個架子的底座鬆了。

gloss_note: 美國家庭常把 basement 當洗衣間或娛樂室

sentences.en: The washer and dryer are in the basement.
sentences.zh: 洗衣機和烘衣機在地下室。

sentences.en: Can you bring the boxes up from the basement?
sentences.zh: 你可以把箱子從地下室搬上來嗎？

sentences.en: We turned our basement into a game room.
sentences.zh: 我們把地下室改成了遊戲間。

sentences.en: She teaches basic Spanish at the library.
sentences.zh: 她在圖書館教基礎西班牙文。

sentences.en: Do you know the basic rules of chess?
sentences.zh: 你知道西洋棋的基本規則嗎？

sentences.en: Food and water are basic needs.
sentences.zh: 食物和水是基本需求。

gloss_note: 日常多說 take a bath；bathe 常指幫嬰兒洗

sentences.en: I bathe the baby every night.
sentences.zh: 我每天晚上幫寶寶洗澡。

sentences.en: How often should you bathe a dog?
sentences.zh: 你多久該幫狗洗一次澡？

sentences.en: Who bathes the kids at your house?
sentences.zh: 你們家是誰幫孩子洗澡？

gloss_note: grow a beard 留鬍子；唇上的叫 mustache

sentences.en: Dad is growing a beard this winter.
sentences.zh: 爸爸今年冬天在留鬍子。

sentences.en: Are you going to shave your beard?
sentences.zh: 你要把鬍子刮掉嗎？

sentences.en: He has a long gray beard.
sentences.zh: 他留著一把灰色長鬍子。

gloss_note: beat the eggs 打蛋；beat 過去式同形

sentences.en: Our team beat them by ten points.
sentences.zh: 我們隊以十分之差打敗了他們。

sentences.en: Beat the eggs until they're smooth.
sentences.zh: 把蛋打到滑順為止。

sentences.en: Think you can beat me at chess?
sentences.zh: 你以為你下棋贏得了我嗎？

gloss_note: Isn't she a beauty? 常用來稱讚車子

sentences.en: Many tourists come for the beauty of the mountains.
sentences.zh: 許多遊客是為了山的美景而來。

sentences.en: Check out my new truck. Isn't she a beauty?
sentences.zh: 看看我的新卡車，是不是很漂亮？

sentences.en: Beauty is only skin deep.
sentences.zh: 美貌只是表面的。

gloss_note: 美國須年滿21歲才能買酒，常被查證件

sentences.en: My dad has a cold beer during the game.
sentences.zh: 我爸看球賽時會喝一瓶冰啤酒。

sentences.en: Can I see your ID for the beer?
sentences.zh: 買啤酒的話，我可以看一下你的證件嗎？

sentences.en: This restaurant sells beer and wine.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳有賣啤酒和葡萄酒。

sentences.en: This class is perfect for beginners.
sentences.zh: 這堂課很適合初學者。

sentences.en: I'm a total beginner at tennis.
sentences.zh: 我打網球完全是新手。

sentences.en: Is there a beginner group for yoga?
sentences.zh: 有瑜伽的初學者班嗎？

gloss_note: at the beginning of 在…之初

sentences.en: I missed the beginning of the movie.
sentences.zh: 我錯過了電影的開頭。

sentences.en: Are you free at the beginning of May?
sentences.zh: 你五月初有空嗎？

sentences.en: At the beginning, everything felt strange.
sentences.zh: 一開始，什麼都覺得陌生。

sentences.en: Please behave yourself at Grandma's house.
sentences.zh: 在奶奶家請守規矩。

sentences.en: Did the kids behave at school today?
sentences.zh: 孩子們今天在學校乖嗎？

sentences.en: He behaves differently when his friends are around.
sentences.zh: 他朋友在場時行為就不一樣。

gloss_note: 句首 Besides, 表示「再說」

sentences.en: Besides, it's too late to go out.
sentences.zh: 再說，現在太晚了，不能出去。

sentences.en: Who's coming besides you and Mike?
sentences.zh: 除了你和麥可，還有誰要來？

sentences.en: Besides English, I also speak Chinese.
sentences.zh: 除了英文，我也會說中文。

gloss_note: 餐廳帳單美式也說 check

sentences.en: The electric bill came in the mail.
sentences.zh: 電費帳單寄來了。

sentences.en: Can I pay the bill with a card?
sentences.zh: 我可以用卡付帳單嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have a ten-dollar bill?
sentences.zh: 你有十元鈔票嗎？

gloss_note: 高中 biology 是必修科目

sentences.en: I have a biology test tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天有生物考試。

sentences.en: Is biology harder than chemistry?
sentences.zh: 生物比化學難嗎？

sentences.en: My sister wants to study marine biology.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊想念海洋生物學。

sentences.en: This coffee tastes too bitter for me.
sentences.zh: 這咖啡對我來說太苦了。

sentences.en: It was bitter cold at the football game.
sentences.zh: 美式足球賽現場冷得刺骨。

sentences.en: Does dark chocolate taste bitter to you?
sentences.zh: 黑巧克力你吃起來會苦嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, the blade is very sharp.
sentences.zh: 小心，刀片很鋒利。

sentences.en: I need a new blade for my razor.
sentences.zh: 我的刮鬍刀需要換新刀片。

sentences.en: Did you change the blade on the blender?
sentences.zh: 你有換果汁機的刀片嗎？

gloss_note: blame sb for sth 把某事怪到某人身上

sentences.en: Don't blame me. I didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 別怪我，那不是我做的。

sentences.en: Why do they always blame the kids?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼老是怪小孩？

sentences.en: She blamed the traffic for being late.
sentences.zh: 她把遲到怪到塞車頭上。

gloss_note: 別人打噴嚏時說 Bless you!

sentences.en: Bless you! Do you have a cold?
sentences.zh: 祝你健康！你感冒了嗎？

sentences.en: She sneezed, so I said bless you.
sentences.zh: 她打了噴嚏，我就對她說「祝你健康」。

sentences.en: We're blessed to have such good neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我們很幸運有這麼好的鄰居。

gloss_note: donate blood 捐血；blood test 驗血

sentences.en: I donate blood every few months.
sentences.zh: 我每隔幾個月就會捐血。

sentences.en: The nurse took a little blood for the test.
sentences.zh: 護理師抽了一點血做檢驗。

sentences.en: Do you know your blood type?
sentences.zh: 你知道自己的血型嗎？

gloss_note: 一般襯衫 shirt；blouse 專指女裝

sentences.en: I love your new blouse!
sentences.zh: 我好喜歡你的新襯衫！

sentences.en: Where did you buy that blue blouse?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡買到那件藍色襯衫的？

sentences.en: She ironed her blouse before the interview.
sentences.zh: 她面試前把襯衫燙好了。

sentences.en: Please write the answer on the board.
sentences.zh: 請把答案寫在黑板上。

sentences.en: Flight twelve will begin boarding soon.
sentences.zh: 十二號班機即將開始登機。

sentences.en: Do you have a cutting board I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有砧板可以借我嗎？

gloss_note: 口語 bomb 指表演、考試搞砸或票房慘敗

sentences.en: Workers found an old bomb during construction.
sentences.zh: 工人在施工時發現一枚舊炸彈。

sentences.en: I totally bombed my math test.
sentences.zh: 我數學考試完全考砸了。

sentences.en: Did that new comedy bomb last weekend?
sentences.zh: 那部新喜劇上週末票房是不是慘敗？

sentences.en: I think I broke a bone in my foot.
sentences.zh: 我想我腳上有根骨頭斷了。

sentences.en: The dog buried a bone in the yard.
sentences.zh: 狗把一根骨頭埋在院子裡。

sentences.en: Is the soup made with chicken bones?
sentences.zh: 這湯是用雞骨頭煮的嗎？

gloss_note: bookshelf 書架；bookcase 是整座書櫃

sentences.en: We need a bigger bookcase for these books.
sentences.zh: 我們需要更大的書櫃來放這些書。

sentences.en: Can you help me put together this bookcase?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我組裝這個書櫃嗎？

sentences.en: The cat sleeps on top of the bookcase.
sentences.zh: 貓睡在書櫃頂上。

gloss_note: Sorry to bother you 不好意思打擾

sentences.en: Sorry to bother you, but is this seat taken?
sentences.zh: 不好意思打擾一下，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

sentences.en: Don't bother cooking tonight; we'll just order pizza.
sentences.zh: 今晚不用麻煩煮了，我們叫披薩就好。

sentences.en: Does the loud music bother your neighbors?
sentences.zh: 這麼大聲的音樂會吵到你的鄰居嗎？

sentences.en: We go bowling every Friday night after work.
sentences.zh: 我們每週五晚上下班後都去打保齡球。

sentences.en: Do you want to go bowling this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末你想去打保齡球嗎？

sentences.en: My dad's bowling ball is too heavy for me.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸的保齡球對我來說太重了。

gloss_note: bank branch 銀行分行；美式也說分店

sentences.en: A big branch fell on our car last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚一根大樹枝掉在我們的車上。

sentences.en: Is there a branch of this bank near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有這家銀行的分行嗎？

sentences.en: The kids are climbing out on the branches.
sentences.zh: 孩子們正爬到樹枝上。

gloss_note: a brick wall 磚牆；red brick 紅磚

sentences.en: Their house is made of red brick.
sentences.zh: 他們的房子是用紅磚蓋的。

sentences.en: Can you carry these bricks to the backyard?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這些磚塊搬到後院嗎？

sentences.en: He ran into a brick wall in the dark.
sentences.zh: 他在黑暗中撞上了一道磚牆。

sentences.en: He has broad shoulders from swimming every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天游泳，所以肩膀很寬。

sentences.en: The store carries a broad range of cereals.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣的麥片種類很廣。

sentences.en: Why does he have such a broad smile today?
sentences.zh: 他今天為什麼笑得那麼開心？

sentences.en: The game will be broadcast live tonight.
sentences.zh: 這場比賽今晚會現場轉播。

sentences.en: Which station will broadcast the concert?
sentences.zh: 哪一台會轉播這場演唱會？

sentences.en: They broadcast the speech on several channels.
sentences.zh: 他們在好幾個頻道播出這場演講。

gloss_note: weekend brunch 週末早午餐，美國很流行

sentences.en: Let's meet for brunch on Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 我們星期天早上約吃早午餐吧。

sentences.en: Where did you have brunch with your cousins?
sentences.zh: 你和表兄弟姊妹在哪裡吃早午餐的？

sentences.en: This restaurant serves brunch until two o'clock.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應早午餐到兩點。

gloss_note: bucket list 人生願望清單

sentences.en: Fill the bucket with warm water, please.
sentences.zh: 請在水桶裡裝滿溫水。

sentences.en: Where did you put the mop and bucket?
sentences.zh: 你把拖把和水桶放在哪裡了？

sentences.en: The kids built a sandcastle with a bucket.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用水桶堆了一座沙堡。

gloss_note: all-you-can-eat buffet 吃到飽自助餐

sentences.en: We went to a lunch buffet after church.
sentences.zh: 我們做完禮拜後去吃了午餐自助餐。

sentences.en: Is the dessert buffet included in the price?
sentences.zh: 甜點自助區有包含在價錢裡嗎？

sentences.en: My family loves the Sunday brunch buffet.
sentences.zh: 我們全家都愛週日的早午餐自助餐。

sentences.en: There's a new building across from our school.
sentences.zh: 我們學校對面蓋了一棟新大樓。

sentences.en: Which floor of the building do you live on?
sentences.zh: 你住在這棟大樓的幾樓？

sentences.en: The building is closed on Sundays and holidays.
sentences.zh: 這棟建築物星期日和假日不開放。

gloss_note: bundle of 一捆；bundle up 穿暖一點

sentences.en: She tied the old letters in a bundle.
sentences.zh: 她把舊信件綁成一捆。

sentences.en: Can you carry this bundle of newspapers outside?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這捆報紙拿到外面嗎？

sentences.en: He bought a bundle of firewood for camping.
sentences.zh: 他買了一捆柴火要去露營。

gloss_note: burst into tears 突然哭出來

sentences.en: The balloon burst right in her face.
sentences.zh: 氣球就在她臉前爆開了。

sentences.en: A pipe burst in our basement last winter.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天我們地下室的水管爆裂了。

sentences.en: Why did she burst into tears just now?
sentences.zh: 她剛剛為什麼突然哭了起來？

sentences.en: I need one head of cabbage for the soup.
sentences.zh: 我需要一顆高麗菜來煮湯。

sentences.en: Do you like cabbage in your tacos?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡在墨西哥捲餅裡放高麗菜嗎？

sentences.en: My grandma is cutting cabbage in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶正在廚房切高麗菜。

sentences.en: I need a longer cable for my laptop.
sentences.zh: 我的筆記型電腦需要一條更長的線。

sentences.en: Do you still pay for cable every month?
sentences.zh: 你每個月還在付有線電視費嗎？

sentences.en: Don't trip over the cable on the floor.
sentences.zh: 小心別被地上的電線絆倒。

sentences.en: We eat lunch in the school cafeteria every day.
sentences.zh: 我們每天都在學校餐廳吃午餐。

sentences.en: What's for lunch in the cafeteria today?
sentences.zh: 今天餐廳的午餐是什麼？

sentences.en: The cafeteria at my job closes at two.
sentences.zh: 我工作的地方的員工餐廳兩點關門。

gloss_note: bird cage 鳥籠；in a cage 關在籠子裡

sentences.en: Our hamster is sleeping in his cage.
sentences.zh: 我們的倉鼠正在牠的籠子裡睡覺。

sentences.en: Did you close the cage door this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上有把籠子門關好嗎？

sentences.en: The parrot flew out of its cage again.
sentences.zh: 那隻鸚鵡又從籠子裡飛出來了。

gloss_note: check my calendar 查我的行程

sentences.en: Let me check my calendar and get back to you.
sentences.zh: 我看一下行事曆，再回覆你。

sentences.en: Is there a calendar on the kitchen wall?
sentences.zh: 廚房牆上有日曆嗎？

sentences.en: She marked the party on her calendar.
sentences.zh: 她把派對標在行事曆上了。

gloss_note: calm down 冷靜下來；stay calm 保持冷靜

sentences.en: Stay calm and take a deep breath.
sentences.zh: 保持冷靜，深呼吸。

sentences.en: The lake was calm and quiet this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上湖面平靜又安靜。

sentences.en: How can you stay so calm before a test?
sentences.zh: 考試前你怎麼能這麼冷靜？

sentences.en: We go camping in the mountains every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們每年夏天都去山上露營。

sentences.en: Have you ever been camping in the rain?
sentences.zh: 你有在雨中露營過嗎？

sentences.en: Don't forget the flashlight for our camping trip.
sentences.zh: 別忘了帶手電筒去露營。

gloss_note: on campus 在校內；campus tour 校園導覽

sentences.en: Freshmen usually live on campus in their first year.
sentences.zh: 大一新生通常第一年住在校內。

sentences.en: Is there a coffee shop on campus?
sentences.zh: 校園裡有咖啡店嗎？

sentences.en: The campus looks beautiful in the fall.
sentences.zh: 校園在秋天看起來很美。

gloss_note: 美式 canceled 只有一個 l

sentences.en: I need to cancel my appointment for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我需要取消明天的預約。

sentences.en: Did they cancel the game because of rain?
sentences.zh: 他們因為下雨取消比賽了嗎？

sentences.en: She canceled her gym membership last week.
sentences.zh: 她上星期取消了健身房會員資格。

sentences.en: Her grandfather beat cancer two years ago.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父兩年前戰勝了癌症。

sentences.en: Does too much sun cause skin cancer?
sentences.zh: 曬太多太陽會造成皮膚癌嗎？

sentences.en: They raised money for cancer research.
sentences.zh: 他們為癌症研究募款。

sentences.en: Who is the captain of your soccer team?
sentences.zh: 你們足球隊的隊長是誰？

sentences.en: The captain told us to buckle our seat belts.
sentences.zh: 機長要我們繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: Our captain scored two goals in the game.
sentences.zh: 我們隊長在比賽中進了兩球。

sentences.en: I made a careless mistake on the test.
sentences.zh: 我在考試時犯了一個粗心的錯誤。

sentences.en: Don't be so careless with your phone.
sentences.zh: 別對你的手機這麼不小心。

sentences.en: Was it careless of me to leave the door open?
sentences.zh: 我讓門開著是不是太粗心了？

gloss_note: wall-to-wall carpet 鋪滿整個房間的地毯

sentences.en: We just cleaned the carpet in the living room.
sentences.zh: 我們剛清潔了客廳的地毯。

sentences.en: Do you prefer carpet or wood floors?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡地毯還是木地板？

sentences.en: My cat keeps scratching the new carpet.
sentences.zh: 我的貓一直抓新地毯。

gloss_note: baby carrots 迷你胡蘿蔔，美國常當點心

sentences.en: Cut two carrots for the soup, please.
sentences.zh: 請切兩根紅蘿蔔來煮湯。

sentences.en: Do you want some carrot sticks with ranch?
sentences.zh: 你要不要來點紅蘿蔔條沾沙拉醬？

sentences.en: My little brother hates eating carrots.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟討厭吃紅蘿蔔。

sentences.en: The kids watch cartoons after school every day.
sentences.zh: 孩子們每天放學後都看卡通。

sentences.en: What's your favorite cartoon character?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡的卡通角色是誰？

sentences.en: This cartoon is funny for both kids and adults.
sentences.zh: 這部卡通大人小孩看了都覺得好笑。

gloss_note: pay in cash 付現；cash only 只收現金

sentences.en: Sorry, this place takes cash only.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，這家店只收現金。

sentences.en: Do you have any cash on you?
sentences.zh: 你身上有現金嗎？

sentences.en: I paid for the pizza in cash.
sentences.zh: 我用現金付了披薩的錢。

sentences.en: Nobody knows the cause of the fire yet.
sentences.zh: 還沒有人知道火災的原因。

sentences.en: Will this medicine cause any side effects?
sentences.zh: 這個藥會造成任何副作用嗎？

sentences.en: Heavy rain can cause traffic jams.
sentences.zh: 大雨可能造成塞車。

gloss_note: 室內是 ceiling，屋頂是 roof

sentences.en: There is a big water stain on the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 天花板上有一大片水漬。

sentences.en: Can you turn on the ceiling fan?
sentences.zh: 你可以把吊扇打開嗎？

sentences.en: The kids stuck stars on their bedroom ceiling.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把星星貼在臥室的天花板上。

sentences.en: Our apartment has central air and heat.
sentences.zh: 我們的公寓有中央空調和暖氣。

sentences.en: Is the hotel in a central location?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店位在市中心嗎？

sentences.en: The central part of the state gets hot in summer.
sentences.zh: 這個州的中部地區夏天很熱。

sentences.en: This house is more than a century old.
sentences.zh: 這棟房子已經有一百多年了。

sentences.en: Which century did the Industrial Revolution start in?
sentences.zh: 工業革命是在哪個世紀開始的？

sentences.en: Cars changed a lot in the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 汽車在二十世紀改變了很多。

gloss_note: a bowl of cereal 一碗麥片

sentences.en: I usually have cereal with milk for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我早餐通常吃加牛奶的麥片。

sentences.en: Did you finish all the cereal again?
sentences.zh: 你又把麥片全部吃完了嗎？

sentences.en: She poured a bowl of cereal for her son.
sentences.zh: 她幫兒子倒了一碗麥片。

sentences.en: I'm certain I locked the front door.
sentences.zh: 我確定我有鎖前門。

sentences.en: Are you certain this is the right address?
sentences.zh: 你確定這是正確的地址嗎？

sentences.en: Certain stores close early on holidays.
sentences.zh: 某些店家在假日會提早打烊。

sentences.en: Can you change the channel, please?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我換個頻道嗎？

sentences.en: This channel shows basketball games all night.
sentences.zh: 這個頻道整晚都播籃球比賽。

sentences.en: Which channel is the news on?
sentences.zh: 新聞是在哪個頻道？

sentences.en: Who is your favorite character in the movie?
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡你最喜歡哪個角色？

sentences.en: The main character is a shy teenager.
sentences.zh: 主角是一個害羞的青少年。

sentences.en: She has a strong character and never gives up.
sentences.zh: 她個性堅強，從不放棄。

gloss_note: charge a phone 幫手機充電

sentences.en: How much do they charge for parking here?
sentences.zh: 他們在這裡停車怎麼收費？

sentences.en: Can I charge my phone at your desk?
sentences.zh: 我可以在你的桌子這裡幫手機充電嗎？

sentences.en: The shop doesn't charge for gift wrapping.
sentences.zh: 這家店不收包裝禮物的費用。

sentences.en: Look at the chart on page ten.
sentences.zh: 看一下第十頁的圖表。

sentences.en: Can you make a chart of our sales?
sentences.zh: 你可以做一張我們銷售額的圖表嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse marked my height on the growth chart.
sentences.zh: 護理師把我的身高標在成長曲線圖上。

sentences.en: The dog loves to chase squirrels in the yard.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗愛在院子裡追松鼠。

sentences.en: Why are the kids chasing each other?
sentences.zh: 孩子們為什麼互相追來追去？

sentences.en: The police chased the car for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 警察追了那輛車十分鐘。

gloss_note: 美國高中文化中常見的 cheerleader 隊伍

sentences.en: My daughter is a cheerleader at her high school.
sentences.zh: 我女兒是她高中的啦啦隊員。

sentences.en: Did the cheerleaders perform at halftime?
sentences.zh: 啦啦隊有在中場表演嗎？

sentences.en: She practices with the cheerleaders after class.
sentences.zh: 她下課後和啦啦隊一起練習。

gloss_note: chemistry class 化學課；也指人與人之間的默契

sentences.en: I have a chemistry test on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我星期五有化學考試。

sentences.en: Is chemistry harder than biology for you?
sentences.zh: 對你來說化學比生物難嗎？

sentences.en: She teaches high school chemistry downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區教高中化學。

sentences.en: My grandfather plays chess in the park.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺在公園下西洋棋。

sentences.en: Do you want to play chess after dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐後你想下西洋棋嗎？

sentences.en: He joined the chess club in middle school.
sentences.zh: 他在國中時加入了西洋棋社。

sentences.en: I spent my childhood on a small farm.
sentences.zh: 我的童年是在一座小農場度過的。

sentences.en: What was your favorite childhood game?
sentences.zh: 你小時候最愛玩的遊戲是什麼？

sentences.en: She still talks to her childhood friends.
sentences.zh: 她還會和兒時玩伴聊天。

gloss_note: 語氣帶貶意，像在說人幼稚

sentences.en: Don't be so childish; just say sorry.
sentences.zh: 別這麼幼稚，說聲抱歉就好了。

sentences.en: Why is he acting so childish today?
sentences.zh: 他今天為什麼表現得這麼幼稚？

sentences.en: Throwing a fit in public is childish.
sentences.zh: 在公共場合鬧脾氣很幼稚。

gloss_note: 正面語氣，如 childlike wonder 孩子般的好奇

sentences.en: She has a childlike love of snow.
sentences.zh: 她對雪有一種孩子般的喜愛。

sentences.en: Grandpa still has a childlike sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 爺爺還保有孩子般的幽默感。

sentences.en: Doesn't his childlike smile make you happy too?
sentences.zh: 他天真的笑容是不是也讓你很開心？

gloss_note: chin up 打起精神；double chin 雙下巴

sentences.en: He rested his chin on his hand.
sentences.zh: 他用手托著下巴。

sentences.en: The baby has milk on her chin.
sentences.zh: 寶寶的下巴上沾到了牛奶。

sentences.en: Did you cut your chin while shaving?
sentences.zh: 你刮鬍子時割傷下巴了嗎？

gloss_note: 形容嬰兒或臉頰可愛，形容大人較失禮

sentences.en: The baby has chubby little cheeks.
sentences.zh: 那個寶寶有圓嘟嘟的小臉頰。

sentences.en: Isn't her chubby puppy adorable?
sentences.zh: 她那隻圓滾滾的小狗是不是很可愛？

sentences.en: I was a chubby kid in elementary school.
sentences.zh: 我小學時是個圓滾滾的小孩。

sentences.en: My mom plays classical music while cooking.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽煮飯時會放古典音樂。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy classical music or rock?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡古典音樂還是搖滾樂？

sentences.en: He studied classical piano for ten years.
sentences.zh: 他學了十年古典鋼琴。

sentences.en: That was a clever way to save money.
sentences.zh: 那是個省錢的聰明辦法。

sentences.en: Our dog is clever enough to open doors.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗聰明到會開門。

sentences.en: Who came up with such a clever idea?
sentences.zh: 是誰想出這麼巧妙的點子？

sentences.en: The climate here is dry and sunny.
sentences.zh: 這裡的氣候又乾燥又晴朗。

sentences.en: How does climate change affect farmers?
sentences.zh: 氣候變遷如何影響農夫？

sentences.en: We moved to a warmer climate last year.
sentences.zh: 我們去年搬到氣候比較溫暖的地方。

sentences.en: Hang your coat in the hall closet.
sentences.zh: 把你的外套掛在走廊的衣櫥裡。

sentences.en: Is there enough closet space in this apartment?
sentences.zh: 這間公寓的衣櫥空間夠嗎？

sentences.en: She cleaned out her closet before the move.
sentences.zh: 她搬家前把衣櫥清空整理了。

gloss_note: 不可數；a piece of clothing 一件衣物

sentences.en: This store sells clothing for kids and adults.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣大人和小孩的衣物。

sentences.en: Please bring warm clothing for the hike.
sentences.zh: 健行請帶保暖的衣物。

sentences.en: Where can I donate old clothing around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近哪裡可以捐舊衣物？

gloss_note: head coach 總教練；美式 coach 也指經濟艙

sentences.en: Our coach makes us run every morning.
sentences.zh: 我們的教練要我們每天早上跑步。

sentences.en: Does your coach let you play every game?
sentences.zh: 你的教練會讓你每場比賽都上場嗎？

sentences.en: The coach called a timeout in the last minute.
sentences.zh: 教練在最後一分鐘喊了暫停。

sentences.en: We drove along the coast all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們整個下午沿著海岸開車。

sentences.en: Do you live on the East Coast?
sentences.zh: 你住在東岸嗎？

sentences.en: Their cousins live near the coast in California.
sentences.zh: 他們的表親住在加州的海邊附近。

sentences.en: I saw a cockroach in the kitchen last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚在廚房看到一隻蟑螂。

sentences.en: Does this old building have cockroaches?
sentences.zh: 這棟舊大樓有蟑螂嗎？

sentences.en: The landlord called someone to kill the cockroaches.
sentences.zh: 房東請人來除蟑螂。

gloss_note: flip a coin 擲硬幣決定

sentences.en: Let's flip a coin to decide.
sentences.zh: 我們擲硬幣來決定吧。

sentences.en: Do you have a coin for the vending machine?
sentences.zh: 你有投販賣機用的硬幣嗎？

sentences.en: My grandpa collects old coins from many countries.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺收集許多國家的舊硬幣。

gloss_note: 美國日常多說 soda 或 pop，cola 較像品類名

sentences.en: Can I get a cherry cola with extra ice?
sentences.zh: 我可以點一杯多加冰塊的櫻桃可樂嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want cola or root beer with your burger?
sentences.zh: 你的漢堡要配可樂還是沙士？

sentences.en: He spilled cola all over the table.
sentences.zh: 他把可樂灑得整張桌子都是。

gloss_note: 美式 college 泛指大學

sentences.en: She wants to go to college in California.
sentences.zh: 她想去加州上大學。

sentences.en: Which college did you go to?
sentences.zh: 你是念哪一所大學的？

sentences.en: College costs a lot of money these days.
sentences.zh: 現在上大學要花很多錢。

gloss_note: a colorful dress 色彩鮮豔的洋裝

sentences.en: The kids drew colorful pictures for their teacher.
sentences.zh: 孩子們畫了色彩繽紛的圖送給老師。

sentences.en: Isn't the farmers market colorful this time of year?
sentences.zh: 這個時節的農夫市集不是很繽紛嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a colorful scarf to the party.
sentences.zh: 她戴了一條色彩鮮豔的圍巾去派對。

sentences.en: The dog follows every command you give it.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗會聽從你下的每個指令。

sentences.en: Can you say that voice command again?
sentences.zh: 你可以再說一次那個語音指令嗎？

sentences.en: Type this command to restart the computer.
sentences.zh: 輸入這個指令來重新啟動電腦。

sentences.en: Thanks for your comment on my video.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你在我的影片下留言。

sentences.en: Did anyone comment on my new haircut?
sentences.zh: 有人對我的新髮型發表意見嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor had no comment on the story.
sentences.zh: 市長對這則報導不予置評。

sentences.en: My dad works for a small software company.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸在一家小型軟體公司上班。

sentences.en: Which company did you apply to?
sentences.zh: 你應徵了哪一家公司？

sentences.en: Thanks for keeping me company at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你在醫院陪我。

sentences.en: Let's compare prices before we buy anything.
sentences.zh: 我們買東西之前先比價吧。

sentences.en: How does this phone compare to your old one?
sentences.zh: 這支手機跟你的舊手機比起來如何？

sentences.en: Don't compare yourself with other people.
sentences.zh: 別拿自己跟別人比較。

sentences.en: He always complains about the weather.
sentences.zh: 他總是在抱怨天氣。

sentences.en: Did anyone complain about the noise last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚有人抱怨噪音嗎？

sentences.en: I'm going to complain to the manager.
sentences.zh: 我要去向經理投訴。

gloss_note: complete a form 填寫表格

sentences.en: Please complete this form before you leave.
sentences.zh: 請在離開前填完這份表格。

sentences.en: Did you complete your homework last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚寫完功課了嗎？

sentences.en: I bought a complete set of dishes yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天買了一整套餐盤。

sentences.en: My biggest concern is the cost of rent.
sentences.zh: 我最擔心的是房租的花費。

sentences.en: Do you have any concerns about the plan?
sentences.zh: 你對這個計畫有任何疑慮嗎？

sentences.en: Her low grades really concern her parents.
sentences.zh: 她的成績不好，讓她父母很擔心。

sentences.en: We're out of shampoo and conditioner again.
sentences.zh: 我們的洗髮精和潤髮乳又用完了。

sentences.en: Do you put conditioner on every day?
sentences.zh: 你每天都用潤髮乳嗎？

sentences.en: This conditioner makes my hair soft and shiny.
sentences.zh: 這瓶潤髮乳讓我的頭髮柔順有光澤。

sentences.en: I feel confident about tomorrow's job interview.
sentences.zh: 我對明天的面試很有信心。

sentences.en: Are you confident enough to speak in front of everyone?
sentences.zh: 你有自信在大家面前說話嗎？

sentences.en: She looks confident on the basketball court.
sentences.zh: 她在籃球場上看起來很有自信。

gloss_note: confuse A with B 把A和B搞混

sentences.en: Don't confuse me with my twin brother.
sentences.zh: 別把我跟我的雙胞胎兄弟搞混了。

sentences.en: Do these directions confuse you too?
sentences.zh: 這些指示也讓你覺得很困惑嗎？

sentences.en: The long menu confused my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 那份很長的菜單讓我奶奶很困惑。

sentences.en: We're considering a trip to Hawaii this summer.
sentences.zh: 我們正在考慮今年夏天去夏威夷玩。

sentences.en: Would you consider moving to a bigger city?
sentences.zh: 你會考慮搬到大一點的城市嗎？

sentences.en: Please consider my offer before you decide.
sentences.zh: 在你決定之前，請考慮一下我的提議。

gloss_note: It's considerate of you 你真體貼

sentences.en: It's very considerate of you to call first.
sentences.zh: 你先打電話來真是體貼。

sentences.en: Is he always this considerate to the staff?
sentences.zh: 他對員工一直都這麼體貼嗎？

sentences.en: A considerate neighbor keeps the music down.
sentences.zh: 體貼的鄰居會把音樂關小聲。

gloss_note: get in contact with 與…取得聯絡

sentences.en: Please contact me if anything changes.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何變動，請聯絡我。

sentences.en: Did you get in contact with the landlord?
sentences.zh: 你有聯絡上房東嗎？

sentences.en: Wash your hands after contact with raw chicken.
sentences.zh: 碰過生雞肉之後要洗手。

sentences.en: Do you want to continue watching this show?
sentences.zh: 你想繼續看這個節目嗎？

sentences.en: The rain continued all night.
sentences.zh: 雨整晚下個不停。

sentences.en: Continue straight for two blocks, then turn right.
sentences.zh: 直走兩個街區，然後右轉。

sentences.en: Did you read the contract before signing it?
sentences.zh: 你簽約前有看過合約嗎？

sentences.en: I signed a one-year contract with my phone company.
sentences.zh: 我跟電信公司簽了一年的合約。

sentences.en: My contract at work ends in June.
sentences.zh: 我工作的合約六月到期。

gloss_note: 美式遙控器多說 remote；lose control 失控

sentences.en: Can you control the lights with your phone?
sentences.zh: 你可以用手機控制燈嗎？

sentences.en: Everything is under control, so don't worry.
sentences.zh: 一切都在掌握中，別擔心。

sentences.en: He lost control of his bike on the hill.
sentences.zh: 他在下坡時控制不住腳踏車。

sentences.en: I love the convenience of online grocery shopping.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡網路買菜的便利。

sentences.en: Is there a convenience store near your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你住的公寓附近有便利商店嗎？

sentences.en: For your convenience, we offer free parking.
sentences.zh: 為了方便您，我們提供免費停車。

sentences.en: Can we have a quick conversation after class?
sentences.zh: 下課後我們可以簡短談一下嗎？

sentences.en: I overheard their conversation on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我在公車上無意間聽到他們的對話。

sentences.en: The conversation got awkward after the argument.
sentences.zh: 吵完架之後，談話變得很尷尬。

gloss_note: do the cooking 負責煮飯

sentences.en: Who does the cooking at your house?
sentences.zh: 你們家是誰負責煮飯？

sentences.en: I really miss my mom's home cooking.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想念媽媽煮的家常菜。

sentences.en: Cooking dinner takes me about an hour.
sentences.zh: 煮晚餐大概要花我一個小時。

gloss_note: corn on the cob 玉米棒

sentences.en: Do you like corn on the cob?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡吃玉米棒嗎？

sentences.en: We bought fresh corn at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我們在農夫市集買了新鮮玉米。

sentences.en: Farmers here plant corn in the spring.
sentences.zh: 這裡的農夫在春天種玉米。

sentences.en: Is this shirt one hundred percent cotton?
sentences.zh: 這件襯衫是百分之百純棉的嗎？

sentences.en: I used a cotton ball to clean the cut.
sentences.zh: 我用棉球清理傷口。

sentences.en: Cotton socks feel great in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天穿棉襪感覺很舒服。

gloss_note: cough up 咳出；a bad cough 重咳

sentences.en: I've had a bad cough all week.
sentences.zh: 我已經咳了一整個星期，咳得很厲害。

sentences.en: Why is he coughing so much?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼咳得這麼厲害？

sentences.en: Cover your mouth when you cough.
sentences.zh: 咳嗽的時候要遮住嘴巴。

gloss_note: a couple of 幾個，口語常省略 of

sentences.en: That young couple just moved in next door.
sentences.zh: 那對年輕夫妻剛搬到隔壁。

sentences.en: Can you wait a couple of minutes?
sentences.zh: 你可以等個幾分鐘嗎？

sentences.en: I'll be back in a couple days.
sentences.zh: 我過幾天就會回來。

gloss_note: have the courage to V 有勇氣做

sentences.en: It took courage to speak up in class.
sentences.zh: 在課堂上發言需要勇氣。

sentences.en: Do you have the courage to try it?
sentences.zh: 你有勇氣試試看嗎？

sentences.en: She finally found the courage to ask for a raise.
sentences.zh: 她終於鼓起勇氣要求加薪。

sentences.en: Let's shoot hoops on the basketball court after school.
sentences.zh: 放學後我們去籃球場投籃吧。

sentences.en: The case will go to court next month.
sentences.zh: 這個案子下個月會上法院。

sentences.en: Is the tennis court open today?
sentences.zh: 網球場今天有開放嗎？

sentences.en: He wore a cowboy hat to the party.
sentences.zh: 他戴著牛仔帽去參加派對。

sentences.en: Did you watch that old cowboy movie?
sentences.zh: 你有看那部老牛仔電影嗎？

sentences.en: My grandpa dreamed of being a cowboy.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺夢想當牛仔。

sentences.en: We ate steamed crab at a seafood restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳吃了清蒸螃蟹。

sentences.en: Do you want crab cakes or shrimp?
sentences.zh: 你想點蟹肉餅還是蝦子？

sentences.en: A crab walked sideways across the sand.
sentences.zh: 一隻螃蟹橫著走過沙灘。

gloss_note: a box of crayons 一盒蠟筆

sentences.en: My daughter drew a house with a red crayon.
sentences.zh: 我女兒用紅色蠟筆畫了一間房子。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your blue crayon?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你借藍色蠟筆嗎？

sentences.en: Crayons melt if you leave them in the car.
sentences.zh: 蠟筆放在車上會融化。

gloss_note: create an account 建立帳號

sentences.en: Please create an account to continue.
sentences.zh: 請先建立帳號才能繼續。

sentences.en: Did you create this poster yourself?
sentences.zh: 這張海報是你自己做的嗎？

sentences.en: The kids created a fort out of blankets.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用毯子蓋了一座堡壘。

sentences.en: Do you take credit cards?
sentences.zh: 你們收信用卡嗎？

sentences.en: She deserves credit for organizing the party.
sentences.zh: 辦這場派對她功不可沒。

sentences.en: My credit score is pretty good.
sentences.zh: 我的信用分數還不錯。

gloss_note: crime show 犯罪影集；a crime 一樁罪行

sentences.en: Crime is low in our quiet neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我們這個安靜的社區犯罪率很低。

sentences.en: Did you watch that crime show last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有看那部犯罪影集嗎？

sentences.en: The police are investigating a crime downtown.
sentences.zh: 警方正在調查市中心的一樁案件。

gloss_note: a big crowd 一大群人

sentences.en: A big crowd gathered at the park.
sentences.zh: 一大群人聚集在公園。

sentences.en: Why is there such a crowd at the door?
sentences.zh: 為什麼門口擠了這麼多人？

sentences.en: The crowd cheered when the band came out.
sentences.zh: 樂團一出場，群眾就歡呼起來。

sentences.en: The subway was crowded this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上地鐵很擠。

sentences.en: Is the mall crowded on weekends?
sentences.zh: 週末的購物中心人很多嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant was too crowded, so we left.
sentences.zh: 餐廳太擠了，所以我們就離開了。

sentences.en: That was a cruel thing to say.
sentences.zh: 那句話說得太刻薄了。

sentences.en: Is it cruel to keep a bird in a cage?
sentences.zh: 把鳥關在籠子裡算殘忍嗎？

sentences.en: Kids can be cruel at that age.
sentences.zh: 孩子在那個年紀有時會很刻薄。

sentences.en: I felt culture shock when I first moved here.
sentences.zh: 我剛搬來這裡時有文化衝擊。

sentences.en: Do you enjoy learning about other cultures?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡了解其他文化嗎？

sentences.en: Every culture has its own holidays.
sentences.zh: 每種文化都有自己的節日。

gloss_note: cure a cold 治好感冒

sentences.en: There is no cure for the common cold.
sentences.zh: 一般感冒沒有根治的方法。

sentences.en: Can hot soup cure a cold?
sentences.zh: 熱湯能治好感冒嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors hope to find a cure soon.
sentences.zh: 醫生希望能早日找到療法。

sentences.en: I'm curious about how you learned Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你是怎麼學會西班牙文的。

sentences.en: Aren't you curious what's inside the box?
sentences.zh: 你不好奇盒子裡裝了什麼嗎？

sentences.en: Kids are curious, so they ask lots of questions.
sentences.zh: 孩子很好奇，所以會問很多問題。

sentences.en: What is your current address?
sentences.zh: 你現在的地址是什麼？

sentences.en: My current job is only part-time.
sentences.zh: 我目前的工作只是兼職。

sentences.en: She reads about current events every morning.
sentences.zh: 她每天早上都會看時事新聞。

sentences.en: Please close the curtains, the sun is bright.
sentences.zh: 請把窗簾拉上，太陽很刺眼。

sentences.en: Can you open the curtain a little?
sentences.zh: 你可以把窗簾拉開一點嗎？

sentences.en: The curtain rose and the play began.
sentences.zh: 布幕升起，戲就開演了。

sentences.en: Slow down, there's a sharp curve ahead.
sentences.zh: 慢一點，前面有個急彎。

sentences.en: Why does this road have so many curves?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這條路有這麼多彎？

sentences.en: She drew a smooth curve with her pencil.
sentences.zh: 她用鉛筆畫了一條平滑的曲線。

sentences.en: It's a custom to tip your server here.
sentences.zh: 在這裡給服務生小費是一種習慣。

sentences.en: Is it a custom to bring a gift?
sentences.zh: 帶禮物去是一種習俗嗎？

sentences.en: Every country has different customs.
sentences.zh: 每個國家都有不同的習俗。

sentences.en: The customer wants to return this jacket.
sentences.zh: 這位顧客想退這件外套。

sentences.en: Are you a regular customer here?
sentences.zh: 你是這裡的常客嗎？

sentences.en: Call customer service if the package is late.
sentences.zh: 如果包裹晚到，就打電話給客服。

sentences.en: What's your daily routine like?
sentences.zh: 你平常的作息是怎樣的？

sentences.en: I take a daily walk after dinner.
sentences.zh: 我每天晚餐後都會散步。

sentences.en: Check the daily special on the board.
sentences.zh: 看一下板子上的每日特餐。

sentences.en: The storm caused a lot of damage.
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨造成了很大的損害。

sentences.en: Did the fall damage your phone?
sentences.zh: 那一跌有把你的手機摔壞嗎？

sentences.en: Check for water damage before you buy the house.
sentences.zh: 買房子前要先檢查有沒有水損。

sentences.en: Stay back! You're in danger of falling.
sentences.zh: 退後！你有跌下去的危險。

sentences.en: Are pandas still in danger?
sentences.zh: 貓熊還處在危險之中嗎？

sentences.en: Fast drivers are a danger to everyone.
sentences.zh: 開快車的人對所有人都是危險。

sentences.en: We left for the lake at dawn.
sentences.zh: 我們黎明時就出發去湖邊了。

sentences.en: Do you wake up before dawn?
sentences.zh: 你會在天亮前就醒來嗎？

sentences.en: The birds start singing at dawn.
sentences.zh: 鳥兒黎明時就開始唱歌。

gloss_note: hard of hearing 指部分聽力受損

sentences.en: My grandfather is partly deaf in one ear.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺有一隻耳朵聽不太到。

sentences.en: Is there a sign language class for deaf kids?
sentences.zh: 有給失聰孩子的手語課嗎？

sentences.en: Some deaf people use sign language every day.
sentences.zh: 有些失聰的人每天都用手語。

sentences.en: The class had a debate about homework.
sentences.zh: 全班針對作業的事辯論了一番。

sentences.en: Are you joining the debate team?
sentences.zh: 你要加入辯論社嗎？

sentences.en: We debated where to eat for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我們為了要去哪吃爭論了一個小時。

sentences.en: It's a big decision, so take your time.
sentences.zh: 這是個重大決定，慢慢想吧。

sentences.en: Have you made a decision yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經做決定了嗎？

sentences.en: I'm happy with my decision to move here.
sentences.zh: 我對搬來這裡的決定很滿意。

sentences.en: Do you want to decorate the cake?
sentences.zh: 你想來裝飾蛋糕嗎？

sentences.en: We decorated the gym for the dance.
sentences.zh: 我們為舞會布置了體育館。

sentences.en: I decorate my desk with small photos.
sentences.zh: 我用小照片裝飾我的書桌。

gloss_note: 反義 increase；a decrease in 減少

sentences.en: Gas prices decreased a little this week.
sentences.zh: 這星期汽油價格小幅下降。

sentences.en: Did your stress decrease after the vacation?
sentences.zh: 度假之後你的壓力有減輕嗎？

sentences.en: We saw a big decrease in traffic today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天看到車流量大幅減少。

gloss_note: 單複數同形：one deer, two deer

sentences.en: We saw a deer on the road.
sentences.zh: 我們在路上看到一隻鹿。

sentences.en: Are there many deer in your neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你家附近有很多鹿嗎？

sentences.en: The deer ran into the woods.
sentences.zh: 那隻鹿跑進了樹林裡。

gloss_note: 美國氣溫用華氏，90度約攝氏32度

sentences.en: It's only forty degrees outside tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚外面只有華氏四十度。

sentences.en: Do you have a college degree?
sentences.zh: 你有大學學位嗎？

sentences.en: He earned a degree in nursing.
sentences.zh: 他拿到了護理學位。

sentences.en: The mail carrier delivers our mail at noon.
sentences.zh: 郵差中午會送信過來。

sentences.en: Do you deliver to this address?
sentences.zh: 你們送得到這個地址嗎？

sentences.en: They delivered the sofa this morning.
sentences.zh: 他們今天早上把沙發送來了。

sentences.en: It depends on the weather.
sentences.zh: 那要看天氣而定。

sentences.en: Can I depend on you to be on time?
sentences.zh: 我可以指望你準時到嗎？

sentences.en: Plants depend on water and sunlight.
sentences.zh: 植物需要水和陽光才能生長。

gloss_note: describe A to B 向B描述A

sentences.en: Can you describe the man you saw?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下你看到的那個男人嗎？

sentences.en: She described the trip to us.
sentences.zh: 她向我們描述了那趟旅行。

sentences.en: Please describe the pain to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 請向醫生描述一下哪裡痛。

gloss_note: 別和 dessert 甜點搞混

sentences.en: It almost never rains in the desert.
sentences.zh: 沙漠裡幾乎不下雨。

sentences.en: We drove across the desert at night.
sentences.zh: 我們在夜裡開車穿越沙漠。

sentences.en: Is it hot in the desert all year?
sentences.zh: 沙漠一整年都很熱嗎？

sentences.en: I like the design of this phone case.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這個手機殼的設計。

sentences.en: Who designed your wedding dress?
sentences.zh: 你的婚紗是誰設計的？

sentences.en: She wants to design video games someday.
sentences.zh: 她以後想設計電玩遊戲。

gloss_note: desire to V 渴望；口語多說 want

sentences.en: She has a strong desire to travel.
sentences.zh: 她非常渴望出去旅行。

sentences.en: Do you have any desire to run a marathon?
sentences.zh: 你有想跑馬拉松的念頭嗎？

sentences.en: I have no desire to argue with you.
sentences.zh: 我一點也不想跟你吵。

gloss_note: dessert 有兩個 s；desert 是沙漠

sentences.en: What's for dessert tonight, Mom?
sentences.zh: 媽，今晚的甜點是什麼？

sentences.en: I always save room for dessert.
sentences.zh: 我總是會留肚子給甜點。

sentences.en: We ordered one dessert and two forks.
sentences.zh: 我們點了一份甜點，加兩支叉子。

sentences.en: Can you detect any difference in taste?
sentences.zh: 你嚐得出味道有什麼不同嗎？

sentences.en: This alarm can detect smoke very quickly.
sentences.zh: 這個警報器能很快偵測到煙。

sentences.en: I detected a strange smell in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我在廚房聞到一股怪味。

gloss_note: develop a habit 養成習慣

sentences.en: How can I develop better study habits?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼養成更好的讀書習慣？

sentences.en: Her interest in art developed slowly over time.
sentences.zh: 她對藝術的興趣是慢慢培養出來的。

sentences.en: A small town developed near the river.
sentences.zh: 河邊發展出了一個小鎮。

sentences.en: Dial 911 if there is an emergency.
sentences.zh: 遇到緊急狀況就撥打911。

sentences.en: What number should I dial for the front desk?
sentences.zh: 我要撥幾號找櫃檯？

sentences.en: He turned the dial to lower the heat.
sentences.zh: 他轉動旋鈕把火關小。

sentences.en: Is that ring a real diamond?
sentences.zh: 那枚戒指是真的鑽石嗎？

sentences.en: The kids are playing on the baseball diamond.
sentences.zh: 孩子們正在棒球場上打球。

sentences.en: He proposed with a diamond ring.
sentences.zh: 他用鑽戒求了婚。

gloss_note: keep a diary 寫日記；美式也說 journal

sentences.en: Do you keep a diary?
sentences.zh: 你有在寫日記嗎？

sentences.en: She wrote about her day in her diary.
sentences.zh: 她在日記裡寫下這一天的事。

sentences.en: My little sister hides her diary under the bed.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹把日記藏在床底下。

sentences.en: Are you on a special diet?
sentences.zh: 你有在特別注意飲食嗎？

sentences.en: A balanced diet includes lots of vegetables.
sentences.zh: 均衡的飲食包含大量蔬菜。

sentences.en: My doctor suggested a change in my diet.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生建議我調整飲食。

sentences.en: Can you tell the difference between them?
sentences.zh: 你分得出它們有什麼不同嗎？

sentences.en: It makes no difference to me.
sentences.zh: 對我來說都一樣。

sentences.en: There's a big difference in price.
sentences.zh: 價格差很多。

sentences.en: I have difficulty hearing in noisy places.
sentences.zh: 在吵雜的地方我很難聽清楚。

sentences.en: Did you have any difficulty finding the place?
sentences.zh: 你找這個地方有遇到困難嗎？

sentences.en: She finished the test without difficulty.
sentences.zh: 她毫不費力就考完了。

sentences.en: Mia is a diligent student.
sentences.zh: 米雅是個用功的學生。

sentences.en: Is he diligent about doing his homework?
sentences.zh: 他有認真寫功課嗎？

sentences.en: Diligent workers often get promoted.
sentences.zh: 勤奮的員工常常會獲得升遷。

sentences.en: Which dinosaur is your favorite?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪一種恐龍？

sentences.en: My nephew absolutely loves dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 我姪子超級愛恐龍。

sentences.en: The museum has a huge dinosaur skeleton.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一副巨大的恐龍骨架。

sentences.en: Her father works as a diplomat overseas.
sentences.zh: 她爸爸在海外擔任外交官。

sentences.en: Is your aunt a diplomat?
sentences.zh: 你阿姨是外交官嗎？

sentences.en: The diplomats met to talk about trade.
sentences.zh: 外交官們碰面討論貿易的事。

sentences.en: Is there a direct flight to Seattle?
sentences.zh: 有直飛西雅圖的班機嗎？

sentences.en: Be direct and tell him how you feel.
sentences.zh: 直接告訴他你的感受吧。

sentences.en: The direct route is much faster.
sentences.zh: 走直達的路線快多了。

sentences.en: Can you give me directions to the mall?
sentences.zh: 你可以告訴我怎麼去購物中心嗎？

sentences.en: Which direction is the beach?
sentences.zh: 海灘在哪個方向？

sentences.en: We walked in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 我們走錯方向了。

sentences.en: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
sentences.zh: 太陽消失在雲層後面。

sentences.en: Did the stain disappear after you washed it?
sentences.zh: 你洗過之後污漬消失了嗎？

sentences.en: My socks always disappear in the dryer.
sentences.zh: 我的襪子總是在烘衣機裡不見。

gloss_note: discover 常指首次發現或偶然發現

sentences.en: I discovered a great little cafe near work.
sentences.zh: 我發現公司附近有間很棒的小咖啡店。

sentences.en: How did you discover this band?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼發現這個樂團的？

sentences.en: Scientists discovered a new type of frog.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現了一種新的青蛙。

gloss_note: discuss 後面直接接受詞，不加 about

sentences.en: Let's discuss this after lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們午餐後再討論這件事吧。

sentences.en: What did you discuss in your meeting?
sentences.zh: 你們開會討論了什麼？

sentences.en: We need to discuss the budget.
sentences.zh: 我們得討論一下預算。

gloss_note: have a discussion 進行討論

sentences.en: We had a good discussion in class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在課堂上討論得很熱烈。

sentences.en: Is this topic open for discussion?
sentences.zh: 這個主題可以拿來討論嗎？

sentences.en: After a long discussion, we picked a movie.
sentences.zh: 討論了很久後，我們選好了電影。

sentences.en: It's dishonest to copy someone else's work.
sentences.zh: 抄別人的作業是不誠實的。

sentences.en: Why were you dishonest about your age?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼謊報年齡？

sentences.en: The dishonest seller never sent the package.
sentences.zh: 那個不老實的賣家根本沒寄包裹。

gloss_note: walking distance 走路可到的距離

sentences.en: The school is within walking distance.
sentences.zh: 學校走路就到得了。

sentences.en: What's the distance from here to Boston?
sentences.zh: 從這裡到波士頓有多遠？

sentences.en: I could see a mountain in the distance.
sentences.zh: 我看得到遠方有一座山。

sentences.en: We could hear distant thunder.
sentences.zh: 我們聽得到遠處的雷聲。

sentences.en: Is she a distant cousin of yours?
sentences.zh: 她是你的遠房表親嗎？

sentences.en: Her voice sounded distant on the phone.
sentences.zh: 電話裡她的聲音聽起來很疏遠。

gloss_note: divide A into B 把A分成B

sentences.en: Divide the pizza into eight slices.
sentences.zh: 把披薩分成八片。

sentences.en: What is twenty divided by four?
sentences.zh: 二十除以四是多少？

sentences.en: Let's divide the chores evenly.
sentences.zh: 我們把家事平均分一分吧。

sentences.en: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast.
sentences.zh: 我太快站起來就會頭暈。

sentences.en: Do you feel dizzy after the ride?
sentences.zh: 搭完那個遊樂設施你會頭暈嗎？

sentences.en: The spinning ride made me dizzy.
sentences.zh: 那個旋轉遊樂設施讓我頭暈。

gloss_note: dodge a question 迴避問題

sentences.en: He tried to dodge the question again.
sentences.zh: 他又想迴避這個問題。

sentences.en: Did you see him dodging puddles on the sidewalk?
sentences.zh: 你有看到他在人行道上閃躲水坑嗎？

sentences.en: She dodged the ball in gym class.
sentences.zh: 她在體育課上閃過了那顆球。

sentences.en: We saw a dolphin jump near the boat.
sentences.zh: 我們看到一隻海豚在船邊躍出水面。

sentences.en: Do dolphins really sleep with one eye open?
sentences.zh: 海豚睡覺時真的會睜著一隻眼嗎？

sentences.en: My little sister loves the dolphin show at the aquarium.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹超愛水族館的海豚表演。

gloss_note: 驢叫聲是 hee-haw；常見於農場

sentences.en: The farmer's donkey carries heavy bags up the hill.
sentences.zh: 農夫的驢子把沉重的袋子馱上山坡。

sentences.en: Why is that donkey standing in the middle of the road?
sentences.zh: 那頭驢子為什麼站在馬路中間？

sentences.en: Kids can ride a donkey at the petting zoo.
sentences.zh: 小朋友可以在動物互動園區騎驢子。

sentences.en: Can I get a double shot of espresso?
sentences.zh: 我可以點雙份濃縮咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: The price of eggs has doubled since last year.
sentences.zh: 雞蛋的價格比去年漲了一倍。

sentences.en: Please double the recipe because many guests are coming.
sentences.zh: 來的客人很多，請把食譜的份量加倍。

gloss_note: no doubt 無疑；I doubt it. 我不認為

sentences.en: I doubt he'll show up on time.
sentences.zh: 我懷疑他會準時出現。

sentences.en: There's no doubt she's the best player here.
sentences.zh: 毫無疑問，她是這裡最強的球員。

sentences.en: Do you have any doubts about the plan?
sentences.zh: 你對這個計畫有任何疑慮嗎？

gloss_note: 美式也拼 donut；一打 a dozen

sentences.en: Do you want a doughnut with your coffee?
sentences.zh: 你要不要配咖啡吃個甜甜圈？

sentences.en: Dad stopped by the bakery and bought a dozen doughnuts.
sentences.zh: 爸爸順道去烘焙坊，買了一打甜甜圈。

sentences.en: Someone ate the last doughnut in the break room.
sentences.zh: 有人把休息室裡最後一個甜甜圈吃掉了。

sentences.en: Dinner is ready, so come downstairs!
sentences.zh: 晚餐好了，快下樓來！

sentences.en: Our downstairs neighbors complain about the noise.
sentences.zh: 我們樓下的鄰居抱怨噪音太吵。

sentences.en: Did I leave my phone downstairs?
sentences.zh: 我是不是把手機留在樓下了？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortybot assumed (based on copyright claims).

sentences.en: Let's take the bus downtown after lunch.
sentences.zh: 午餐後我們搭公車去市中心吧。

sentences.en: Parking downtown is expensive on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末在市中心停車很貴。

sentences.en: Do you work downtown or near your house?
sentences.zh: 你在市中心上班，還是在家附近上班？

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

sentences.en: Our team joined the dragon boat race last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們隊上個夏天參加了龍舟比賽。

sentences.en: In the movie, the dragon breathes fire at the knight.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，那條龍對著騎士噴火。

sentences.en: Were you born in the Year of the Dragon?
sentences.zh: 你是龍年出生的嗎？

gloss_note: TV drama 電視劇；drama club 戲劇社

sentences.en: What's that new drama everyone is talking about?
sentences.zh: 大家都在聊的那部新影集是什麼？

sentences.en: My mom watches a Korean drama every night.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽每天晚上都看韓劇。

sentences.en: I joined the drama club to meet new friends.
sentences.zh: 我加入戲劇社是為了認識新朋友。

sentences.en: Put your clean socks in the top dresser drawer.
sentences.zh: 把乾淨的襪子放進五斗櫃最上面的抽屜。

sentences.en: Are my keys on the dresser?
sentences.zh: 我的鑰匙是不是在五斗櫃上？

sentences.en: We bought a used dresser at a garage sale.
sentences.zh: 我們在車庫拍賣買了一個二手五斗櫃。

gloss_note: 美式藥局兼賣日用品；也叫 pharmacy

sentences.en: I need to stop by the drugstore for cough medicine.
sentences.zh: 我得順路去藥妝店買咳嗽藥。

sentences.en: Is there a drugstore near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有藥妝店嗎？

sentences.en: She works part-time at the drugstore on Main Street.
sentences.zh: 她在大街上的藥妝店兼差。

sentences.en: Please move the wet clothes into the dryer.
sentences.zh: 請把溼衣服移到烘衣機裡。

sentences.en: My dryer broke, so I hung the towels outside.
sentences.zh: 我的烘衣機壞了，所以我把毛巾晾在外面。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your hair dryer for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的吹風機用一下嗎？

gloss_note: 口語；對人說 dumb 可能冒犯，說事情較安全

sentences.en: That was a dumb mistake, but I fixed it.
sentences.zh: 那是個很蠢的錯誤，不過我已經改好了。

sentences.en: Is it a dumb question if I ask again?
sentences.zh: 如果我再問一次，會是個蠢問題嗎？

sentences.en: I felt dumb when I forgot her name.
sentences.zh: 我忘了她的名字，覺得自己好蠢。

gloss_note: 美式也泛稱包餡麵食；煎餃叫 potsticker

sentences.en: My grandma makes pork dumplings every Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶每年農曆新年都包豬肉水餃。

sentences.en: Do you want steamed dumplings or fried rice?
sentences.zh: 你想吃蒸餃還是炒飯？

sentences.en: He dipped the dumpling in soy sauce.
sentences.zh: 他把水餃沾了醬油。

gloss_note: on duty 值班；off duty 下班

sentences.en: The nurse is on duty until midnight.
sentences.zh: 那位護士要值班到午夜。

sentences.en: Whose duty is it to walk the dog?
sentences.zh: 遛狗是誰的責任？

sentences.en: My dad has jury duty next week.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸下週要去當陪審員。

gloss_note: bald eagle 白頭海鵰，美國象徵

sentences.en: The bald eagle is a symbol of America.
sentences.zh: 白頭海鵰是美國的象徵。

sentences.en: Did you see that eagle flying over the lake?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那隻在湖面上飛的老鷹嗎？

sentences.en: Our school team is called the Eagles.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的隊伍叫作老鷹隊。

gloss_note: earn money 賺錢；earn a living 謀生

sentences.en: How much do you earn at your part-time job?
sentences.zh: 你的兼職工作賺多少錢？

sentences.en: She earns extra money by walking neighbors' dogs.
sentences.zh: 她靠幫鄰居遛狗賺外快。

sentences.en: He earned the coach's respect with hard work.
sentences.zh: 他靠努力贏得了教練的尊重。

gloss_note: 常成對；a pair of earrings 一副耳環

sentences.en: These earrings go perfectly with your dress.
sentences.zh: 這副耳環跟你的洋裝超搭。

sentences.en: Where did you buy those earrings?
sentences.zh: 你那副耳環是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: I lost one of my earrings at the gym.
sentences.zh: 我在健身房弄丟了一只耳環。

gloss_note: with ease 輕鬆地；put at ease 使放心

sentences.en: She solved the puzzle with ease.
sentences.zh: 她輕輕鬆鬆就解開了這個謎題。

sentences.en: This medicine should ease the pain in your back.
sentences.zh: 這種藥應該能減輕你背部的疼痛。

sentences.en: Does the doctor always put patients at ease?
sentences.zh: 醫生總是能讓病人放鬆下來嗎？

gloss_note: on the edge of 在……邊緣

sentences.en: Please don't run near the edge of the pool.
sentences.zh: 請不要在泳池邊緣跑來跑去。

sentences.en: Is the edge of this knife sharp?
sentences.zh: 這把刀的刀刃利嗎？

sentences.en: Our house is on the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 我們家在鎮上邊緣的位置。

sentences.en: Did you put much effort into this essay?
sentences.zh: 你有在這篇作文上花很多心力嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks for all your effort on this project.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你為這個專案付出的所有努力。

sentences.en: Nice effort! You almost made the shot.
sentences.zh: 很努力喔！你差一點就投進了。

gloss_note: 常用複數 elders；形容年紀大美式多說 older

sentences.en: You should always respect your elders.
sentences.zh: 你應該永遠尊敬長輩。

sentences.en: Is it rude to call your elders by their first names?
sentences.zh: 直接叫長輩的名字會不禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: Our town has a lunch program for elders.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上有給長者的午餐計畫。

gloss_note: elect 人 as 職位；口語多說 vote for

sentences.en: We elect a new class president every fall.
sentences.zh: 我們每年秋天選出新的班長。

sentences.en: Who did your town elect as mayor?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上選了誰當市長？

sentences.en: She was elected to the school board last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年當選了學區的教育委員。

sentences.en: My neighbor just bought an electric car.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居剛買了一輛電動車。

sentences.en: Did you pay the electric bill yet?
sentences.zh: 你繳電費了嗎？

sentences.en: The electric heater keeps my room warm.
sentences.zh: 電暖器讓我的房間很暖和。

gloss_note: 常用被動 be embarrassed 覺得糗

sentences.en: Please don't embarrass me in front of my friends.
sentences.zh: 拜託別在我朋友面前讓我難堪。

sentences.en: I was so embarrassed when I tripped.
sentences.zh: 我絆倒的時候真是糗斃了。

sentences.en: Did my loud laugh embarrass you at the theater?
sentences.zh: 我在戲院大聲笑，有讓你覺得尷尬嗎？

sentences.en: He never shows his emotions at work.
sentences.zh: 他在工作時從不表露情緒。

sentences.en: Her voice shook with emotion.
sentences.zh: 她的聲音因情緒激動而顫抖。

sentences.en: Is it okay to cry when emotions run high?
sentences.zh: 情緒激動的時候哭出來沒關係嗎？

gloss_note: 後面直接接名詞，不加 on；同 stress

sentences.en: My coach always emphasizes teamwork.
sentences.zh: 我的教練總是強調團隊合作。

sentences.en: Did the teacher emphasize this part for the test?
sentences.zh: 老師有特別強調這部分會考嗎？

sentences.en: I want to emphasize that the store closes at nine.
sentences.zh: 我要強調，這家店九點就打烊。

gloss_note: 多用被動 be employed；口語常說 hire

sentences.en: The factory employs about two hundred people.
sentences.zh: 那間工廠僱用了大約兩百人。

sentences.en: Is your sister employed at the hospital?
sentences.zh: 你姊姊是受僱在那間醫院工作嗎？

sentences.en: He was employed as a delivery driver last year.
sentences.zh: 他去年受僱當外送司機。

sentences.en: Why is the fridge empty already?
sentences.zh: 冰箱怎麼已經空了？

sentences.en: Could you empty the trash before you leave?
sentences.zh: 你出門前可以把垃圾倒一倒嗎？

sentences.en: Uh-oh, the gas tank is almost empty.
sentences.zh: 糟了，油箱快空了。

gloss_note: 電玩、電影、歷史中常見；也可指大敵

sentences.en: In the game, you must defeat every enemy.
sentences.zh: 在這個遊戲裡，你得打敗每一個敵人。

sentences.en: Who is the enemy in that movie?
sentences.zh: 那部電影裡的敵人是誰？

sentences.en: Sugar is the enemy of healthy teeth.
sentences.zh: 糖是健康牙齒的大敵。

gloss_note: an energetic kid 活潑好動的孩子

sentences.en: My puppy is very energetic in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我的小狗早上精力超旺盛。

sentences.en: How are you so energetic before seven a.m.?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼七點前就這麼有精神？

sentences.en: We need an energetic coach for the kids' team.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一位充滿活力的教練來帶孩子們的球隊。

gloss_note: save energy 節能；no energy 沒力氣

sentences.en: I have no energy after a long day.
sentences.zh: 忙了一整天後，我一點力氣也沒有。

sentences.en: Turn off the lights to save energy.
sentences.zh: 關燈來節省能源。

sentences.en: Do you have enough energy to play soccer?
sentences.zh: 你還有力氣去踢足球嗎？

gloss_note: start the engine 發動引擎

sentences.en: Turn off the engine while we wait here.
sentences.zh: 我們在這裡等的時候請把引擎熄火。

sentences.en: The check engine light just came on!
sentences.zh: 引擎故障燈剛剛亮了！

sentences.en: Can you check the engine before our road trip?
sentences.zh: 公路旅行前你可以檢查一下引擎嗎？

sentences.en: Meet me at the main entrance at noon.
sentences.zh: 中午在正門口跟我碰面。

sentences.en: Where's the entrance to the parking garage?
sentences.zh: 停車場的入口在哪裡？

sentences.en: There is a small entrance fee at the museum.
sentences.zh: 博物館要收一點入場費。

sentences.en: Recycling helps protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 做資源回收有助於保護環境。

sentences.en: Do you like the work environment at your new job?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡新工作的工作環境嗎？

sentences.en: Kids learn better in a quiet environment.
sentences.zh: 孩子在安靜的環境中學得更好。

sentences.en: I envy people who can sleep on planes.
sentences.zh: 我好羨慕能在飛機上睡著的人。

sentences.en: She was green with envy when she saw my new bike.
sentences.zh: 她看到我的新腳踏車時眼紅得不得了。

sentences.en: Do you feel envy when friends post vacation photos?
sentences.zh: 朋友貼出度假照片時，你會感到羨慕嗎？

gloss_note: equal rights 平等權利；equal to 等於

sentences.en: Cut the pizza into equal pieces, please.
sentences.zh: 請把披薩切成大小相同的幾塊。

sentences.en: Do boys and girls get equal time on the court?
sentences.zh: 男生和女生在球場上的時間一樣多嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone should have an equal chance to try out.
sentences.zh: 每個人都應該有同等的機會參加選拔。

sentences.en: I love fall, especially the pumpkin pie.
sentences.zh: 我愛秋天，尤其是南瓜派。

sentences.en: It's cold here, especially at night.
sentences.zh: 這裡很冷，尤其是晚上。

sentences.en: Do you like pizza, especially with extra cheese?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡披薩嗎，尤其是加量起司的？

sentences.en: Our school is holding a big event on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們學校週五要舉辦一場大型活動。

sentences.en: Are you going to the neighborhood event tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天要去社區活動嗎？

sentences.en: The charity event raised money for the animal shelter.
sentences.zh: 這場慈善活動為動物收容所籌了款。

gloss_note: Everywhere I go... 不論我去哪都……

sentences.en: I looked everywhere, but I can't find my keys.
sentences.zh: 我到處找過了，還是找不到鑰匙。

sentences.en: There are bikes everywhere on campus.
sentences.zh: 校園裡到處都是腳踏車。

sentences.en: Does your dog follow you everywhere?
sentences.zh: 你的狗是不是你走到哪都跟著？

sentences.en: The evil queen locks the princess in a tower.
sentences.zh: 邪惡的皇后把公主鎖在塔裡。

sentences.en: Why is the villain always so evil in cartoons?
sentences.zh: 為什麼卡通裡的壞蛋總是那麼邪惡？

sentences.en: My little brother gave me an evil smile.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟對我露出邪惡的笑容。

gloss_note: take an exam 參加考試

sentences.en: I have a math exam on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我星期一有數學考試。

sentences.en: Did you study for the history exam?
sentences.zh: 你有準備歷史考試嗎？

sentences.en: She passed her final exam with flying colors.
sentences.zh: 她期末考考得非常出色。

sentences.en: Loud music always seems to excite the dog.
sentences.zh: 大聲的音樂似乎總會讓狗興奮起來。

sentences.en: I'm so excited about the field trip tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我對明天的校外教學超興奮。

sentences.en: Does the idea of a road trip excite you?
sentences.zh: 公路旅行這個點子讓你興奮嗎？

sentences.en: Does that old shoe store still exist?
sentences.zh: 那間老鞋店還在嗎？

sentences.en: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
sentences.zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前就存在了。

sentences.en: That problem doesn't exist anymore, so don't worry.
sentences.zh: 那個問題已經不存在了，別擔心。

sentences.en: Take the next exit for the gas station.
sentences.zh: 下個出口下去就有加油站。

sentences.en: Where is the nearest emergency exit?
sentences.zh: 最近的緊急出口在哪裡？

sentences.en: Please exit the bus through the rear door.
sentences.zh: 請從後門下車。

gloss_note: express lane 快速結帳通道（限少量商品）

sentences.en: It's hard to express how thankful I am.
sentences.zh: 我很難表達我有多感激。

sentences.en: Can I use the express lane with nine items?
sentences.zh: 我拿九樣東西可以走快速結帳通道嗎？

sentences.en: Children should learn to express their feelings with words.
sentences.zh: 孩子應該學會用言語表達自己的感受。

sentences.en: Can I get extra napkins, please?
sentences.zh: 可以多給我一些餐巾紙嗎？

sentences.en: My teacher gave us extra credit for the poster.
sentences.zh: 老師因為海報給了我們額外加分。

sentences.en: We need one extra chair for my uncle.
sentences.zh: 我們還需要多一張椅子給我叔叔。

sentences.en: That's not fair, you got two turns!
sentences.zh: 這不公平，你玩了兩次！

sentences.en: Is thirty dollars a fair price for this jacket?
sentences.zh: 這件外套賣三十美元算合理嗎？

sentences.en: The referee is always fair to both teams.
sentences.zh: 裁判對兩隊總是很公平。

sentences.en: Is this statement true or false?
sentences.zh: 這個敘述是對還是錯？

sentences.en: It was a false alarm, so everyone relaxed.
sentences.zh: 原來是虛驚一場，大家都放鬆了。

sentences.en: He gave a false name at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 他在櫃檯報了假名字。

sentences.en: We went to a fancy restaurant for our anniversary.
sentences.zh: 我們去一家高級餐廳慶祝週年紀念。

sentences.en: Do I need fancy shoes for the wedding?
sentences.zh: 我參加婚禮需要穿講究的鞋子嗎？

sentences.en: I don't need a fancy phone, just a simple one.
sentences.zh: 我不需要花俏的手機，簡單的就好。

sentences.en: You did a fantastic job on the presentation.
sentences.zh: 你的簡報做得太棒了。

sentences.en: The pizza was fantastic, and the service was fast.
sentences.zh: 披薩好吃極了，上菜又快。

sentences.en: Isn't this weather absolutely fantastic today?
sentences.zh: 今天的天氣是不是好得沒話說？

gloss_note: 反義 old-fashioned；口語也說 trendy

sentences.en: Those boots look very fashionable on you.
sentences.zh: 那雙靴子你穿起來很時髦。

sentences.en: Is this jacket still fashionable these days?
sentences.zh: 這件外套現在還流行嗎？

sentences.en: Baggy jeans are fashionable again this year.
sentences.zh: 寬鬆牛仔褲今年又流行了。

sentences.en: Please turn off the faucet when you brush your teeth.
sentences.zh: 刷牙的時候請把水龍頭關掉。

sentences.en: The kitchen faucet is leaking again.
sentences.zh: 廚房的水龍頭又在漏水了。

sentences.en: Can you fix the bathroom faucet this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末可以修一下浴室的水龍頭嗎？

gloss_note: It's my fault. 是我的錯

sentences.en: Sorry, it's my fault. I missed the turn.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，是我的錯，我錯過了轉彎處。

sentences.en: It's not your fault the bus was late.
sentences.zh: 公車晚到不是你的錯。

sentences.en: Whose fault is it that the milk spilled?
sentences.zh: 牛奶灑出來是誰的錯？

sentences.en: Do you have a fear of heights?
sentences.zh: 你會懼高嗎？

sentences.en: She jumped off the diving board without fear.
sentences.zh: 她毫無懼色地從跳水板上跳了下去。

sentences.en: Don't fear the dentist; it's not that bad.
sentences.zh: 別怕牙醫，沒那麼糟。

gloss_note: late fee 逾期費；entrance fee 入場費

sentences.en: Is there a fee to park here?
sentences.zh: 在這裡停車要收費嗎？

sentences.en: The bank charged me a late fee.
sentences.zh: 銀行向我收了逾期費。

sentences.en: The gym has no sign-up fee this month.
sentences.zh: 健身房這個月不收入會費。

gloss_note: 表格用 male/female；稱人較常說 woman

sentences.en: Please check male or female on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上勾選男性或女性。

sentences.en: Is the cat you adopted male or female?
sentences.zh: 你領養的那隻貓是公的還是母的？

sentences.en: About half of the students in my class are female.
sentences.zh: 我們班大約一半的學生是女生。

gloss_note: white picket fence 白色尖木籬

sentences.en: Our neighbor painted the fence white last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們鄰居上週末把圍欄漆成白色。

sentences.en: Can the dog jump over that fence?
sentences.zh: 那隻狗跳得過那道圍欄嗎？

sentences.en: We built a wooden fence around the backyard.
sentences.zh: 我們在後院周圍蓋了一道木頭圍欄。

gloss_note: 日常多說 movie；film 指影展、拍攝、底片

sentences.en: Is it okay to film the concert on my phone?
sentences.zh: 我可以用手機拍下這場演唱會嗎？

sentences.en: My sister wants to study film in college.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊想在大學主修電影。

sentences.en: The film festival in our town starts Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上的影展週五開始。

gloss_note: final exam 期末考；finals 期末考週

sentences.en: The final bus leaves at ten thirty.
sentences.zh: 最後一班公車十點半開。

sentences.en: Are you ready for your finals next week?
sentences.zh: 你為下週的期末考準備好了嗎？

sentences.en: This is the final question on the quiz.
sentences.zh: 這是小考的最後一題。

sentences.en: Let's go fishing at the lake this Saturday.
sentences.zh: 這個星期六我們去湖邊釣魚吧。

sentences.en: My grandpa took me fishing when I was six.
sentences.zh: 爺爺在我六歲時帶我去釣魚。

sentences.en: Did you bring your fishing rod?
sentences.zh: 你有帶釣竿嗎？

sentences.en: Does this jacket fit you?
sentences.zh: 這件外套你穿合身嗎？

sentences.en: I'm trying to stay fit by walking every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天走路，努力保持健康。

sentences.en: These boots don't fit my feet anymore.
sentences.zh: 這雙靴子我的腳穿不下了。

sentences.en: The kids raise the flag at camp every morning.
sentences.zh: 孩子們每天早上在營地升旗。

sentences.en: Whose flag is that on the ship?
sentences.zh: 那艘船上的旗子是哪一國的？

sentences.en: My neighbors hang a flag outside on holidays.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居在假日會在外面掛旗子。

sentences.en: The power went out. Do you have a flashlight?
sentences.zh: 停電了，你有手電筒嗎？

sentences.en: I used my phone as a flashlight in the dark.
sentences.zh: 我在黑暗中用手機當手電筒。

sentences.en: Dad keeps a flashlight in the kitchen drawer.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在廚房抽屜裡放了一支手電筒。

gloss_note: a flat tire 爆胎；美式 flat 不指公寓

sentences.en: I got a flat tire on the way to work.
sentences.zh: 我上班途中輪胎爆了。

sentences.en: Is the ground flat enough for our tent?
sentences.zh: 這塊地夠平，可以搭我們的帳篷嗎？

sentences.en: Lay the dough flat on the baking sheet.
sentences.zh: 把麵糰平放在烤盤上。

sentences.en: My flight leaves at six tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 我的班機明天早上六點起飛。

sentences.en: Was your flight delayed because of the storm?
sentences.zh: 你的班機因為暴風雨延誤了嗎？

sentences.en: We booked a direct flight to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了直飛洛杉磯的班機。

sentences.en: We're out of flour, so no pancakes today.
sentences.zh: 我們的麵粉用完了，今天沒有鬆餅吃了。

sentences.en: Mix two cups of flour with the sugar.
sentences.zh: 把兩杯麵粉跟糖拌在一起。

sentences.en: Do I need all-purpose flour for this recipe?
sentences.zh: 這份食譜需要用中筋麵粉嗎？

gloss_note: get the flu；flu shot 疫苗

sentences.en: Half of my class has the flu this week.
sentences.zh: 這週我們班有一半的人得了流感。

sentences.en: Did you get your flu shot yet?
sentences.zh: 你打過流感疫苗了嗎？

sentences.en: I stayed home because I thought I had the flu.
sentences.zh: 我以為自己得了流感，所以待在家裡。

gloss_note: play the flute 吹長笛；樂器前加 the

sentences.en: My daughter plays the flute in the school band.
sentences.zh: 我女兒在學校樂隊吹長笛。

sentences.en: How long have you played the flute?
sentences.zh: 你吹長笛吹多久了？

sentences.en: The flute sounds so sweet in this song.
sentences.zh: 長笛在這首歌裡聽起來好悅耳。

gloss_note: focus on 專注於；out of focus 失焦

sentences.en: I can't focus with the TV on.
sentences.zh: 電視開著，我沒辦法專心。

sentences.en: Can you focus on the road, please?
sentences.zh: 請你專心看路好嗎？

sentences.en: The photo is out of focus.
sentences.zh: 這張照片失焦了。

gloss_note: dense fog 濃霧；the fog lifts 霧散了

sentences.en: Is there always this much fog in the morning?
sentences.zh: 這裡早上總是有這麼多霧嗎？

sentences.en: Thick fog made my drive to work really slow.
sentences.zh: 濃霧讓我開車上班慢了很多。

sentences.en: The fog should burn off by noon.
sentences.zh: 霧大概中午前就會散去。

gloss_note: foggy day 起霧的天；眼鏡起霧也說 fog up

sentences.en: It's too foggy to see the road.
sentences.zh: 霧太大了，看不清楚路。

sentences.en: Was it foggy when you left this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上出門時有霧嗎？

sentences.en: My glasses get foggy when I wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 我戴口罩時眼鏡會起霧。

gloss_note: feel foolish 覺得自己很蠢

sentences.en: Don't do anything foolish tonight, okay?
sentences.zh: 今晚別做傻事，好嗎？

sentences.en: I felt foolish when I forgot his name.
sentences.zh: 我忘了他的名字，覺得自己好蠢。

sentences.en: Isn't it foolish to skip breakfast before a test?
sentences.zh: 考試前不吃早餐不是很傻嗎？

gloss_note: 美國的 football 是橄欖球式；足球說 soccer

sentences.en: Do you watch football on Sunday afternoons?
sentences.zh: 你週日下午會看美式足球嗎？

sentences.en: My brother plays football for the high school team.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟是高中美式足球隊的球員。

sentences.en: We always eat chicken wings during the football game.
sentences.zh: 看美式足球賽時，我們都會吃雞翅。

sentences.en: We went hiking in the forest last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末去森林健行。

sentences.en: Is it safe to camp in this forest?
sentences.zh: 在這片森林露營安全嗎？

sentences.en: A forest fire closed the road yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天森林大火讓這條路封閉了。

gloss_note: forgive and forget 既往不咎

sentences.en: Can you forgive me for forgetting your birthday?
sentences.zh: 你可以原諒我忘了你的生日嗎？

sentences.en: Please forgive the mess; we just moved in.
sentences.zh: 請見諒家裡很亂，我們才剛搬進來。

sentences.en: She has forgiven him, but she won't forget.
sentences.zh: 她已經原諒他了，但她不會忘記。

gloss_note: fill out a form 填表格

sentences.en: Please fill out this form first.
sentences.zh: 請先填寫這張表格。

sentences.en: Where should I turn in this form?
sentences.zh: 這張表格我要交到哪裡？

sentences.en: The nurse handed me two forms to sign.
sentences.zh: 護理師給了我兩份表格要簽名。

gloss_note: formal dress 正式服裝；反義 casual

sentences.en: Is a tie too formal for the dinner?
sentences.zh: 這場晚餐打領帶會太正式嗎？

sentences.en: We don't have to be formal; just call me Tom.
sentences.zh: 我們不必那麼正式，叫我湯姆就好。

sentences.en: She wrote a formal complaint to the landlord.
sentences.zh: 她寫了一封正式的投訴信給房東。

gloss_note: forward an email 轉寄電子郵件

sentences.en: Can you forward me that email from Monday?
sentences.zh: 你可以把週一那封郵件轉寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: I'll forward the receipt to you tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚會把收據轉寄給你。

sentences.en: Mom keeps forwarding me silly chain messages.
sentences.zh: 媽媽一直轉寄無聊的連鎖訊息給我。

sentences.en: To be frank, I didn't like the movie.
sentences.zh: 老實說，我不喜歡那部電影。
