sentences.en: She was very frank with me about money.
sentences.zh: 她對我很坦白地談了錢的事。

sentences.en: Can I be frank with you for a second?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟你坦白說幾句嗎？

gloss_note: freedom of speech 言論自由

sentences.en: Do you have the freedom to set your schedule?
sentences.zh: 你可以自己安排時間嗎？

sentences.en: Getting my license gave me a lot of freedom.
sentences.zh: 拿到駕照讓我自由多了。

sentences.en: Kids love the freedom of summer vacation.
sentences.zh: 孩子們愛暑假的那份自由。

gloss_note: freezer burn 冷凍燒（食物受凍變質）

sentences.en: Is there any ice cream left in the freezer?
sentences.zh: 冷凍庫裡還有冰淇淋嗎？

sentences.en: Please put the leftovers in the freezer.
sentences.zh: 請把剩菜放進冷凍庫。

sentences.en: Our big freezer in the garage is full.
sentences.zh: 我們車庫裡的大冷凍櫃塞滿了。

sentences.en: It's freezing outside, so wear a coat.
sentences.zh: 外面冷死了，所以要穿外套。

sentences.en: Is it freezing in here, or is it just me?
sentences.zh: 這裡很冷，還是只有我覺得冷？

sentences.en: I'm freezing! Can you turn the heat up?
sentences.zh: 我冷死了！你可以把暖氣開大一點嗎？

gloss_note: a close friendship 親密的友誼

sentences.en: Their friendship started in kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 他們的友誼從幼稚園就開始了。

sentences.en: How did your friendship with Emma start?
sentences.zh: 你和艾瑪的友誼是怎麼開始的？

sentences.en: Thanks for your friendship during a hard year.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你在艱難的一年裡的友誼。

sentences.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you!
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意要嚇你的！

sentences.en: Does the dark still frighten your little sister?
sentences.zh: 你妹妹現在還是怕黑嗎？

sentences.en: Thunder always frightens our dog.
sentences.zh: 打雷總是會嚇到我們的狗。

sentences.en: Do you want to throw a frisbee at the park?
sentences.zh: 你想去公園丟飛盤嗎？

sentences.en: Our dog loves catching a frisbee.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗最愛接飛盤。

sentences.en: We played frisbee on the beach all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們整個下午都在海灘上玩飛盤。

gloss_note: 不可數：a piece of furniture 一件家具

sentences.en: We bought some used furniture at a yard sale.
sentences.zh: 我們在庭院拍賣買了一些二手家具。

sentences.en: Can you help me move the furniture?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我搬家具嗎？

sentences.en: Their new apartment has almost no furniture yet.
sentences.zh: 他們的新公寓幾乎還沒有家具。

sentences.en: I gained a few pounds over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 我過節期間胖了幾磅。

sentences.en: Will this part-time job help me gain experience?
sentences.zh: 這份兼職能幫我累積經驗嗎？

sentences.en: Did the baby gain any weight at the checkup?
sentences.zh: 寶寶在健康檢查時有增加體重嗎？

gloss_note: garage sale 車庫拍賣（賣舊物）

sentences.en: Please park your truck in the garage.
sentences.zh: 請把你的卡車停進車庫。

sentences.en: Is the garage door still open?
sentences.zh: 車庫門還開著嗎？

sentences.en: We're having a garage sale this Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們這個星期六要辦車庫拍賣。

sentences.en: Please gather around, everyone; dinner's ready.
sentences.zh: 大家請圍過來，晚餐好了。

sentences.en: Can you gather your toys before bedtime?
sentences.zh: 睡覺前你可以把玩具收一收嗎？

sentences.en: Neighbors gathered outside to watch the fireworks.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們聚在外面看煙火。

sentences.en: In general, I wake up around six.
sentences.zh: 我一般大約六點起床。

sentences.en: Do you have a general idea of the cost?
sentences.zh: 你大概知道費用是多少嗎？

sentences.en: General admission tickets are ten dollars each.
sentences.zh: 普通票一張十美元。

gloss_note: a generous tip 豐厚的小費

sentences.en: That's so generous of you, thank you!
sentences.zh: 你真是太大方了，謝謝！

sentences.en: We left a generous tip for our waiter.
sentences.zh: 我們給了服務生豐厚的小費。

sentences.en: Is your boss generous with vacation days?
sentences.zh: 你老闆在休假天數上大方嗎？

gloss_note: a stroke of genius 神來之筆

sentences.en: You're a genius! That fixed my phone.
sentences.zh: 你真是天才！我的手機被你修好了。

sentences.en: Is your little brother really a math genius?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟真的是數學天才嗎？

sentences.en: Using a magnet was a stroke of genius.
sentences.zh: 用磁鐵真是神來之筆。

sentences.en: Be gentle with the puppy, kids.
sentences.zh: 孩子們，對小狗要溫柔一點。

sentences.en: Is this soap gentle on sensitive skin?
sentences.zh: 這款肥皂對敏感肌膚溫和嗎？

sentences.en: Our dog is huge, but he's very gentle.
sentences.zh: 我們的狗很大隻，但是很溫和。

gloss_note: Ladies and gentlemen 各位先生女士

sentences.en: He held the door for me; what a gentleman!
sentences.zh: 他幫我撐著門，真是紳士！

sentences.en: Is the gentleman at table four ready for the check?
sentences.zh: 四號桌的先生準備好結帳了嗎？

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats now.
sentences.zh: 各位先生女士，請現在就座。

sentences.en: Mountains and rivers are geographical features.
sentences.zh: 山和河流都是地理特徵。

sentences.en: Which geographical area does this map show?
sentences.zh: 這張地圖顯示的是哪個地理區域？

sentences.en: We studied the geographical regions of Texas in class.
sentences.zh: 我們在課堂上學了德州的地理區域。

sentences.en: Do you have a geography quiz tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天有地理小考嗎？

sentences.en: I'm bad at geography. Where exactly is Chile?
sentences.zh: 我地理很差，智利到底在哪裡？

sentences.en: Our geography teacher brought a giant world map.
sentences.zh: 我們的地理老師帶來一張超大的世界地圖。

gloss_note: a nice gesture 貼心的舉動

sentences.en: Thanks for the flowers; what a sweet gesture!
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的花，真是貼心的舉動！

sentences.en: Do you know what this hand gesture means?
sentences.zh: 你知道這個手勢是什麼意思嗎？

sentences.en: She made a gesture for me to sit down.
sentences.zh: 她比手勢示意我坐下。

gloss_note: set a goal 設定目標

sentences.en: What's your goal for this semester?
sentences.zh: 你這學期的目標是什麼？

sentences.en: Our team scored the winning goal in overtime.
sentences.zh: 我們隊在延長賽踢進了致勝的一球。

sentences.en: My goal this year is to save more money.
sentences.zh: 我今年的目標是多存一點錢。

gloss_note: gold medal 金牌；gold 也可當形容詞

sentences.en: Is that ring made of real gold?
sentences.zh: 那枚戒指是真金做的嗎？

sentences.en: She won a gold medal in swimming.
sentences.zh: 她在游泳比賽中拿到金牌。

sentences.en: Our school colors are blue and gold.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的代表色是藍色和金色。

sentences.en: Is the toast golden brown yet?
sentences.zh: 吐司烤到金黃色了嗎？

sentences.en: The leaves in our yard turn golden in October.
sentences.zh: 我們院子裡的樹葉在十月會變成金黃色。

sentences.en: Summer break is a golden opportunity to learn guitar.
sentences.zh: 暑假是學吉他的絕佳機會。

gloss_note: play golf 打高爾夫；golf course 球場

sentences.en: Dad plays golf every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 爸爸每個週六早上都會打高爾夫球。

sentences.en: Do you want to play golf this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末想打高爾夫球嗎？

sentences.en: Grandpa hit his golf ball into the lake.
sentences.zh: 爺爺把他的高爾夫球打進湖裡了。

sentences.en: Thank goodness the store was still open!
sentences.zh: 謝天謝地，那家店還開著！

sentences.en: My goodness, you've grown so tall!
sentences.zh: 天哪，你長得好高！

sentences.en: For goodness' sake, can you hurry up?
sentences.zh: 拜託，你可以快一點嗎？

gloss_note: work for the government 在政府工作

sentences.en: Does your aunt work for the government?
sentences.zh: 你阿姨在政府機關工作嗎？

sentences.en: Government offices are closed on Monday.
sentences.zh: 政府機關星期一休息。

sentences.en: The city government is fixing our street.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在修我們這條街。

gloss_note: granddaughter 可指兒子或女兒的女兒

sentences.en: Is that little girl your granddaughter?
sentences.zh: 那個小女孩是你的孫女嗎？

sentences.en: My granddaughter starts kindergarten this fall.
sentences.zh: 我的孫女今年秋天要上幼稚園。

sentences.en: Grandma baked cookies with her granddaughter yesterday.
sentences.zh: 奶奶昨天和孫女一起烤了餅乾。

sentences.en: Our grandson visits us every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們的孫子每年夏天都會來看我們。

sentences.en: Did you pick up your grandson from school?
sentences.zh: 你有去學校接你孫子嗎？

sentences.en: Grandpa taught his grandson how to fish.
sentences.zh: 爺爺教他的孫子怎麼釣魚。

gloss_note: Don't be greedy. 不要貪心

sentences.en: Don't be greedy; leave some cake for me.
sentences.zh: 不要太貪心，留一些蛋糕給我。

sentences.en: Why are you being so greedy with the fries?
sentences.zh: 薯條你怎麼都不分別人吃，這麼貪心？

sentences.en: A greedy raccoon got into our trash again.
sentences.zh: 一隻貪吃的浣熊又翻了我們的垃圾。

gloss_note: greet with a smile 微笑迎接

sentences.en: I'll greet the guests at the door.
sentences.zh: 我會在門口迎接客人。

sentences.en: The cashier greeted me with a big smile.
sentences.zh: 收銀員笑容滿面地跟我打招呼。

sentences.en: How do Americans usually greet each other?
sentences.zh: 美國人通常怎麼互相打招呼？

sentences.en: The security guard checked my ID.
sentences.zh: 保全檢查了我的證件。

sentences.en: Is there a guard at the front desk?
sentences.zh: 櫃檯有警衛嗎？

sentences.en: A guard walks around the parking lot at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上有警衛在停車場巡邏。

gloss_note: guest room 客房；houseguest 留宿的客人

sentences.en: We're having guests over for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚請客人來家裡吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Where should the guests park their cars?
sentences.zh: 客人要把車停在哪裡？

sentences.en: Grandma is staying in our guest room this week.
sentences.zh: 奶奶這週住在我們的客房。

gloss_note: tour guide 導遊；user guide 使用指南

sentences.en: Our tour guide was funny and friendly.
sentences.zh: 我們的導遊風趣又親切。

sentences.en: Do we need a guide for this hike?
sentences.zh: 這趟健行我們需要請嚮導嗎？

sentences.en: The user guide in the box explains everything.
sentences.zh: 盒子裡的使用指南什麼都有說明。

gloss_note: glue gun 熱熔膠槍；water gun 水槍

sentences.en: Do you know where the glue gun is?
sentences.zh: 你知道熱熔膠槍在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: The kids are playing with water guns outside.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在外面玩水槍。

sentences.en: Dad fixed the screen with a staple gun.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用釘槍修好了紗窗。

sentences.en: I need a haircut before my interview.
sentences.zh: 我面試前得去剪頭髮。

sentences.en: Where do you usually get your haircut?
sentences.zh: 你平常都在哪裡剪頭髮？

sentences.en: Hey, nice haircut! Is it new?
sentences.zh: 嘿，髮型不錯！是新剪的嗎？

sentences.en: The restroom is down the hall, on the left.
sentences.zh: 洗手間沿著走廊走，在左手邊。

sentences.en: Kids, please don't run in the hall!
sentences.zh: 孩子們，請不要在走廊上跑！

sentences.en: Do you have a hall pass?
sentences.zh: 你有走廊通行證嗎？

gloss_note: hammer and nails 鐵鎚和釘子

sentences.en: Can I borrow your hammer for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的鐵鎚用一下嗎？

sentences.en: Ouch! I hit my thumb with the hammer!
sentences.zh: 哎唷！我用鐵鎚敲到大拇指了！

sentences.en: We keep a hammer and nails in the garage.
sentences.zh: 我們在車庫放了鐵鎚和釘子。

gloss_note: 美式日常多說 tissue（面紙）

sentences.en: Grandpa always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。

sentences.en: Do you have a handkerchief or a tissue?
sentences.zh: 你有手帕或面紙嗎？

sentences.en: She dried her tears with a handkerchief.
sentences.zh: 她用手帕擦乾眼淚。

gloss_note: I can handle it. 我可以搞定

sentences.en: Don't worry, I can handle it.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，我可以搞定。

sentences.en: Can you handle school and a part-time job?
sentences.zh: 你應付得來上學又打工嗎？

sentences.en: Let me handle the bill tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚的帳單讓我來處理。

sentences.en: Please put your coat on a hanger.
sentences.zh: 請把你的外套掛在衣架上。

sentences.en: Do we have any extra hangers?
sentences.zh: 我們還有多的衣架嗎？

sentences.en: Each shirt in the closet is on its own hanger.
sentences.zh: 衣櫃裡每件襯衫都各自掛在一個衣架上。

gloss_note: hardly ever 幾乎從不；本身已含否定

sentences.en: Sorry, I can hardly hear you right now.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我現在幾乎聽不到你說話。

sentences.en: There's hardly any milk left in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡幾乎沒有牛奶了。

sentences.en: Why do you hardly ever text me back?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼幾乎從來不回我訊息？

sentences.en: Can you turn on the heater? I'm cold.
sentences.zh: 你可以開暖氣嗎？我覺得冷。

sentences.en: The heater in my car stopped working.
sentences.zh: 我車上的暖氣壞了。

sentences.en: Is it safe to leave the space heater on?
sentences.zh: 電暖器一直開著安全嗎？

sentences.en: A helicopter flew over our house this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有一架直升機飛過我們家上空。

sentences.en: Have you ever been in a helicopter?
sentences.zh: 你有搭過直升機嗎？

sentences.en: The kids waved at the helicopter above the park.
sentences.zh: 孩子們對著公園上空的直升機揮手。

sentences.en: My mom is my hero; she does it all.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽是我心目中的英雄，她什麼都包辦。

sentences.en: Who was your hero when you were little?
sentences.zh: 你小時候的偶像是誰？

sentences.en: The firefighter who saved the cat is a hero.
sentences.zh: 救了那隻貓的消防員是個英雄。

gloss_note: 加州常說 freeway；rest stop 休息站

sentences.en: Is there a toll on this highway?
sentences.zh: 這條公路要收過路費嗎？

sentences.en: Traffic on the highway was terrible this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上公路上塞車很嚴重。

sentences.en: We pulled over at a rest stop off the highway.
sentences.zh: 我們在公路旁的休息站停了下來。

gloss_note: hands on hips 雙手叉腰

sentences.en: Did you hurt your hip at practice?
sentences.zh: 你練習時弄傷髖部了嗎？

sentences.en: Put your hands on your hips and bend.
sentences.zh: 雙手叉腰，然後彎下去。

sentences.en: Grandma had surgery on her hip last year.
sentences.zh: 奶奶去年髖部動過手術。

sentences.en: We saw a big hippo at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻大河馬。

sentences.en: Can a hippo really run faster than a person?
sentences.zh: 河馬真的跑得比人還快嗎？

sentences.en: My little sister has a stuffed hippo.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹有一隻河馬玩偶。

gloss_note: 美式租車說 rent，hire 指僱人

sentences.en: The grocery store is hiring part-time cashiers.
sentences.zh: 那家超市正在徵兼職收銀員。

sentences.en: Did the bakery hire you after the interview?
sentences.zh: 面試之後，麵包店有錄用你嗎？

sentences.en: We need to hire a plumber for the sink.
sentences.zh: 我們得請水電工來修水槽。

gloss_note: a hole in my sock 襪子破洞

sentences.en: I have a hole in my sock again.
sentences.zh: 我的襪子又破了個洞。

sentences.en: Can you dig a hole for the new plant?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫新植物挖個洞嗎？

sentences.en: The dog dug a huge hole in our yard.
sentences.zh: 狗在我們院子裡挖了一個大洞。

sentences.en: I felt homesick during my first month here.
sentences.zh: 我剛來這裡的第一個月很想家。

sentences.en: Do you ever get homesick for Taiwan?
sentences.zh: 你會想念台灣嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother gets homesick at summer camp.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟在夏令營會想家。

sentences.en: Isn't honesty the best policy?
sentences.zh: 誠實不是最好的做法嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks, I really appreciate your honesty.
sentences.zh: 謝謝，我真的很感謝你的坦誠。

sentences.en: In all honesty, I didn't love that movie.
sentences.zh: 老實說，我不太喜歡那部電影。

gloss_note: hop in 上車；hop on 跳上（車）
other_senses: 輕鬆搭上（hop on a bus）

sentences.en: The kids hop over puddles on the way to school.
sentences.zh: 孩子們上學途中會跳過水坑。

sentences.en: The little bunny hopped across the yard.
sentences.zh: 小兔子蹦蹦跳跳地穿過院子。

sentences.en: Can you hop on one foot?
sentences.zh: 你可以單腳跳嗎？

gloss_note: a horrible day 糟糕的一天

sentences.en: The traffic this morning was absolutely horrible.
sentences.zh: 今天早上的車流真的糟透了。

sentences.en: Why does this milk smell so horrible?
sentences.zh: 這牛奶為什麼聞起來這麼噁心？

sentences.en: I had a horrible day at work.
sentences.zh: 我今天上班糟透了。

gloss_note: talk show host 談話節目主持人

sentences.en: Thanks for dinner! You're a wonderful host.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的晚餐！你真是個好主人。

sentences.en: Who is the host of that game show?
sentences.zh: 那個益智節目的主持人是誰？

sentences.en: The host welcomed everyone at the door.
sentences.zh: 主人在門口歡迎每一個人。

gloss_note: do the housework 做家事（不可數）

sentences.en: Who does most of the housework in your family?
sentences.zh: 你們家大部分的家事是誰做的？

sentences.en: I finish all my housework on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 我星期六早上會把所有家事做完。

sentences.en: Housework takes up half of my Sunday.
sentences.zh: 家事佔了我一半的週日時間。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: give someone a hug 給某人一個擁抱

sentences.en: Come here and give me a big hug!
sentences.zh: 過來給我一個大擁抱！

sentences.en: She hugged her grandma at the airport.
sentences.zh: 她在機場擁抱了奶奶。

sentences.en: Do you hug your friends when you say goodbye?
sentences.zh: 你和朋友道別時會擁抱嗎？

gloss_note: I'm only human. 我只是凡人（會犯錯）

sentences.en: Everyone makes mistakes. We're only human.
sentences.zh: 每個人都會犯錯，我們只是凡人。

sentences.en: Is this a recording, or a real human?
sentences.zh: 這是錄音，還是真人？

sentences.en: Dogs can hear sounds that humans can't.
sentences.zh: 狗能聽到人類聽不到的聲音。

sentences.en: Welcome to my humble apartment, everyone!
sentences.zh: 歡迎大家來到我的寒舍！

sentences.en: The winner stayed humble after the big game.
sentences.zh: 贏家在大賽後依然很謙虛。

sentences.en: Is it hard to stay humble when you're famous?
sentences.zh: 出名之後還要保持謙虛很難嗎？

gloss_note: hot and humid 又熱又濕

sentences.en: Is it always this humid in July?
sentences.zh: 七月總是這麼潮濕嗎？

sentences.en: The air feels hot and humid today.
sentences.zh: 今天的空氣感覺又熱又濕。

sentences.en: My skin feels sticky on humid days.
sentences.zh: 天氣潮濕的日子，我的皮膚會黏黏的。

sentences.en: She has a great sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 她很有幽默感。

sentences.en: Do you like that kind of humor?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡那種幽默嗎？

sentences.en: Humor helps me get through a long week.
sentences.zh: 幽默感讓我撐過漫長的一週。

gloss_note: humorous 較書面，口語常說 funny

sentences.en: Her toast at the wedding was humorous.
sentences.zh: 她在婚禮上的祝酒詞很幽默。

sentences.en: Is this a humorous book or a serious one?
sentences.zh: 這是一本幽默的書還是嚴肅的書？

sentences.en: Dad told a humorous story at dinner.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在晚餐時講了一個好笑的故事。

sentences.en: Is it real hunger, or are you just bored?
sentences.zh: 你是真的餓，還是只是無聊？

sentences.en: Skipping breakfast gives me hunger pains by ten.
sentences.zh: 不吃早餐的話，我到十點就會餓得難受。

sentences.en: Our school collects food to help fight hunger.
sentences.zh: 我們學校募集食物來幫助對抗飢餓。

gloss_note: bargain hunter 愛找便宜貨的人

sentences.en: My uncle is a deer hunter.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是個獵鹿人。

sentences.en: Are there hunters in the woods this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末樹林裡有獵人嗎？

sentences.en: She's a bargain hunter who loves garage sales.
sentences.zh: 她很愛撿便宜，最喜歡逛車庫拍賣。

gloss_note: ignore a text 已讀不回

sentences.en: Why are you ignoring my texts?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼不回我的訊息？

sentences.en: Just ignore the noise and keep studying.
sentences.zh: 別理那些噪音，繼續念書吧。

sentences.en: My neighbor ignored me at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居在超市對我視而不見。

gloss_note: 美式口語多說 sick；ill 較正式

sentences.en: She was too ill to go to school.
sentences.zh: 她病得沒辦法去上學。

sentences.en: Are you feeling ill, or just tired?
sentences.zh: 你是身體不舒服，還是只是累了？

sentences.en: He fell ill right after the picnic.
sentences.zh: 他野餐一結束就生病了。

gloss_note: Can you imagine...? 你能想像嗎

sentences.en: Can you imagine living without a phone?
sentences.zh: 你能想像沒有手機的生活嗎？

sentences.en: I imagine the store will be crowded today.
sentences.zh: 我猜今天店裡會很擠。

sentences.en: Imagine my surprise when he walked in!
sentences.zh: 你想想看，他走進來時我有多驚訝！

gloss_note: 反義 polite；rude 語氣更重

sentences.en: It's impolite to talk with food in your mouth.
sentences.zh: 嘴裡有食物時講話很不禮貌。

sentences.en: Is it impolite to ask her age?
sentences.zh: 問她的年齡不禮貌嗎？

sentences.en: My little brother was impolite to the waiter.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟對服務生很沒禮貌。

sentences.en: The doctor explained the importance of getting enough sleep.
sentences.zh: 醫生說明了睡眠充足的重要性。

sentences.en: Do you understand the importance of this test?
sentences.zh: 你了解這次考試的重要性嗎？

sentences.en: Being on time is of great importance at my job.
sentences.zh: 準時對我的工作非常重要。

gloss_note: It's impossible to + V 不可能做到

sentences.en: It's impossible to find parking downtown today.
sentences.zh: 今天市中心根本找不到停車位。

sentences.en: Is it impossible to get a table tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚真的訂不到位子嗎？

sentences.en: The math homework looked impossible at first.
sentences.zh: 數學作業一開始看起來根本不可能寫完。

gloss_note: improve my English 增進英文

sentences.en: My English is improving every month.
sentences.zh: 我的英文每個月都在進步。

sentences.en: How can I improve my writing?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼讓我的寫作變好？

sentences.en: I hope the weather improves by Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我希望天氣到週六會好轉。

gloss_note: Is tax included? 有含稅嗎

sentences.en: Does the price include tax?
sentences.zh: 這個價錢有含稅嗎？

sentences.en: Breakfast is included with your hotel room.
sentences.zh: 您的房價有附早餐。

sentences.en: The tour includes lunch and a free hat.
sentences.zh: 這個行程包含午餐和一頂免費的帽子。

gloss_note: income tax 所得稅；low income 低收入

sentences.en: My part-time job is my only income.
sentences.zh: 我的打工是我唯一的收入。

sentences.en: Do you pay income tax in your state?
sentences.zh: 你們那一州要繳所得稅嗎？

sentences.en: Her family lives on a low income.
sentences.zh: 她家靠微薄的收入過活。

gloss_note: a big increase 大幅增加

sentences.en: Rent in this area increased again this year.
sentences.zh: 這一區的房租今年又漲了。

sentences.en: Did the store increase its prices?
sentences.zh: 那家店有漲價嗎？

sentences.en: We saw a big increase in traffic.
sentences.zh: 我們發現車流量大增。

gloss_note: an independent bookstore 獨立書店

sentences.en: My daughter is very independent for her age.
sentences.zh: 以她的年紀來說，我女兒非常獨立。

sentences.en: Are you ready to be independent after college?
sentences.zh: 大學畢業後你準備好要自立了嗎？

sentences.en: She runs an independent bookstore downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心經營一家獨立書店。

gloss_note: 多用於書面；口語常說 show

sentences.en: The sign indicates where the exits are.
sentences.zh: 這個告示牌標示出出口的位置。

sentences.en: What does that red light indicate?
sentences.zh: 那個紅燈代表什麼？

sentences.en: She nodded to indicate she was ready.
sentences.zh: 她點點頭表示她準備好了。

sentences.en: TV can be a bad influence on kids.
sentences.zh: 電視可能對小孩有不好的影響。

sentences.en: Who has the biggest influence on you?
sentences.zh: 誰對你的影響最大？

sentences.en: My friends influenced me to start running.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友影響我開始跑步。

sentences.en: Can I get your contact information?
sentences.zh: 可以給我你的聯絡資料嗎？

sentences.en: Please check the website for more information.
sentences.zh: 更多資訊請上網站查看。

sentences.en: Thanks for the information; it helped a lot.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你提供的資訊，幫了我大忙。

gloss_note: run out of ink 墨水用完

sentences.en: My pen is running out of ink.
sentences.zh: 我的筆快沒墨水了。

sentences.en: Do we have any black ink for the printer?
sentences.zh: 我們有印表機用的黑色墨水嗎？

sentences.en: Ink got all over my shirt.
sentences.zh: 墨水沾得我整件襯衫都是。

sentences.en: He insisted on paying for lunch.
sentences.zh: 他堅持要付午餐錢。

sentences.en: Why do you always insist on driving?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是堅持要開車？

sentences.en: I insist you take my seat.
sentences.zh: 我堅持讓位給你坐。

gloss_note: inspire sb to V 激勵某人去做

sentences.en: What inspired you to start baking?
sentences.zh: 是什麼啟發你開始烤東西的？

sentences.en: Her story inspired me to keep going.
sentences.zh: 她的故事鼓勵我繼續努力。

sentences.en: Great teachers inspire students to try harder.
sentences.zh: 好老師會激勵學生更努力。

sentences.en: I usually just drink instant coffee at home.
sentences.zh: 我在家通常只喝即溶咖啡。

sentences.en: Is instant oatmeal really that healthy?
sentences.zh: 即食燕麥片真的那麼健康嗎？

sentences.en: She sent a text and got an instant reply.
sentences.zh: 她傳了訊息，馬上就收到回覆。

gloss_note: play an instrument 演奏樂器

sentences.en: Do you play an instrument?
sentences.zh: 你會演奏樂器嗎？

sentences.en: Her favorite instrument is the violin.
sentences.zh: 她最喜歡的樂器是小提琴。

sentences.en: The pilot checked every instrument before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 機長在起飛前檢查了每一項儀器。

gloss_note: 日常說 smart 更口語

sentences.en: My niece is very intelligent for a six-year-old.
sentences.zh: 以六歲的孩子來說，我姪女非常聰明。

sentences.en: Is that dog really as intelligent as people say?
sentences.zh: 那隻狗真的像大家說的那麼聰明嗎？

sentences.en: He asked an intelligent question in class.
sentences.zh: 他在課堂上問了一個很有見地的問題。

sentences.en: Our school has many international students.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有很多國際學生。

sentences.en: Which gate is for international flights?
sentences.zh: 哪一個登機門是國際航班的？

sentences.en: We make international calls to Taiwan every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我們每個週日都會打國際電話回台灣。

gloss_note: Sorry to interrupt 抱歉打擾一下

sentences.en: Sorry to interrupt, but dinner is ready.
sentences.zh: 不好意思打擾一下，晚餐好了。

sentences.en: My phone rang and interrupted our movie.
sentences.zh: 我的手機響了，打斷了我們看電影。

sentences.en: Why do you keep interrupting me?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼一直打斷我？

gloss_note: introduce A to B 把A介紹給B

sentences.en: Let me introduce you to my neighbor.
sentences.zh: 讓我把你介紹給我的鄰居。

sentences.en: Did Mom introduce you to her coworkers?
sentences.zh: 媽媽有把你介紹給她的同事嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher introduced the new student to everyone.
sentences.zh: 老師向大家介紹新同學。

sentences.en: Who invented the telephone first?
sentences.zh: 電話最早是誰發明的？

sentences.en: Kids love to invent their own games.
sentences.zh: 小孩很愛自己發明遊戲。

sentences.en: He invented an excuse to leave early.
sentences.zh: 他編了個藉口提早離開。

gloss_note: decline an invitation 婉拒邀請

sentences.en: Thanks for the invitation to your party!
sentences.zh: 謝謝你邀請我參加派對！

sentences.en: Did you get an invitation to Emma's wedding?
sentences.zh: 你有收到艾瑪婚禮的邀請函嗎？

sentences.en: I sent invitations for Lily's birthday party.
sentences.zh: 我寄出了莉莉生日派對的邀請函。

sentences.en: Do we have an iron in the house?
sentences.zh: 我們家有熨斗嗎？

sentences.en: I need to iron my shirt before the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試前我得把襯衫燙一燙。

sentences.en: Be careful, the iron is still hot.
sentences.zh: 小心，熨斗還很燙。

gloss_note: traffic jam 塞車；果醬美國也說 jelly

sentences.en: We got stuck in a traffic jam on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 我們在高速公路上塞車了。

sentences.en: Do you want strawberry jam on your toast?
sentences.zh: 你的吐司要抹草莓醬嗎？

sentences.en: Mom makes strawberry jam every summer.
sentences.zh: 媽媽每年夏天都會做草莓果醬。

sentences.en: Does your friend speak Japanese?
sentences.zh: 你的朋友會說日語嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbors are Japanese, and they're very friendly.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居是日本人，他們非常友善。

sentences.en: We ate at a Japanese restaurant last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚去吃了一家日本餐廳。

gloss_note: live jazz 現場爵士演奏

sentences.en: My grandpa listens to jazz every morning.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺每天早上都聽爵士樂。

sentences.en: Do you like jazz music?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡爵士樂嗎？

sentences.en: There's live jazz at the coffee shop tonight.
sentences.zh: 咖啡店今晚有爵士樂現場演奏。

gloss_note: I'm so jealous! 好羨慕喔

sentences.en: Are you jealous of his new truck?
sentences.zh: 你是不是嫉妒他的新卡車？

sentences.en: I'm so jealous that you're going to Hawaii!
sentences.zh: 你要去夏威夷，我好羨慕喔！

sentences.en: My little sister gets jealous when I'm on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我在講電話時，妹妹會吃醋。

sentences.en: My aunt is a journalist for the local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨是當地報社的記者。

sentences.en: Do you want to be a journalist someday?
sentences.zh: 你以後想當記者嗎？

sentences.en: A journalist interviewed the coach after the game.
sentences.zh: 賽後有一位記者訪問了教練。

gloss_note: judge a book by its cover 以貌取人

sentences.en: The judge listened to both sides carefully.
sentences.zh: 法官仔細聽了雙方的說法。

sentences.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
sentences.zh: 不要以貌取人。

sentences.en: Who is judging the pie contest this year?
sentences.zh: 今年的派比賽是誰擔任評審？

sentences.en: We saw a kangaroo at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻袋鼠。

sentences.en: Is it true that a kangaroo carries its baby?
sentences.zh: 袋鼠真的會帶著寶寶嗎？

sentences.en: Kangaroos can hop really fast.
sentences.zh: 袋鼠跳得真的很快。

gloss_note: 美式也拼 catsup；薯條沾 ketchup

sentences.zh: 可以再給我一點番茄醬嗎？

sentences.zh: 我吃薯條一定要沾番茄醬。

sentences.en: Mom, we're out of ketchup again.
sentences.zh: 媽，我們的番茄醬又用完了。

sentences.zh: 一英里大約是 1.6 公里。

sentences.zh: 從台北到台南有幾公里？

sentences.en: My cousin runs five kilometers every morning.
sentences.zh: 我表哥每天早上跑五公里。

gloss_note: 美國 kindergarten 約五歲，屬小學

sentences.en: My son starts kindergarten this fall.
sentences.zh: 我兒子今年秋天要上幼稚園。

sentences.en: What time does kindergarten let out?
sentences.zh: 幼稚園幾點放學？

sentences.en: Ms. Lee is a kindergarten teacher at my school.
sentences.zh: 李老師是我們學校的幼稚園老師。

gloss_note: 童話常見：a faraway kingdom 遙遠的王國

sentences.en: Once upon a time, a kingdom stood by the sea.
sentences.zh: 很久很久以前，海邊有一個王國。

sentences.en: Who rules the kingdom in this fairy tale?
sentences.zh: 這個童話故事裡是誰統治這個王國？

sentences.en: The kids built a castle in their pretend kingdom.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在假想的王國裡蓋了一座城堡。

gloss_note: kitten 是幼貓；幼犬叫 puppy

sentences.en: We just adopted a kitten from the shelter.
sentences.zh: 我們剛從收容所領養了一隻小貓。

sentences.en: Can we get a kitten, Mom?
sentences.zh: 媽媽，我們可以養小貓嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor's kitten keeps climbing our fence.
sentences.zh: 鄰居的小貓一直爬我們家的圍籬。

gloss_note: koala 不是熊，但常叫 koala bear

sentences.en: Koalas sleep up to twenty hours a day.
sentences.zh: 無尾熊一天最多睡二十個小時。

sentences.en: Did you see the koala at the zoo?
sentences.zh: 你有看到動物園裡的無尾熊嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter sleeps with a stuffed koala.
sentences.zh: 我女兒抱著無尾熊玩偶睡覺。

gloss_note: Korean 可指韓國人或韓語

sentences.en: Do you want Korean barbecue for dinner tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃韓式烤肉嗎？

sentences.en: My roommate is learning Korean on her phone.
sentences.zh: 我的室友正在用手機學韓語。

sentences.en: Our new neighbors are Korean and very kind.
sentences.zh: 我們的新鄰居是韓國人，人非常好。

gloss_note: a lack of sleep 睡眠不足

sentences.en: Lack of sleep makes me cranky.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足讓我脾氣很差。

sentences.en: The park lacks a good place to sit.
sentences.zh: 這座公園缺少好坐的地方。

sentences.en: Why is there such a lack of parking here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的停車位為什麼這麼少？

gloss_note: Ladies and gentlemen 各位來賓

sentences.en: Who is the lady in the blue coat?
sentences.zh: 那位穿藍色外套的女士是誰？

sentences.en: The old lady next door waves every morning.
sentences.zh: 隔壁的老太太每天早上都會揮手打招呼。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our show tonight.
sentences.zh: 各位來賓，歡迎來看我們今晚的表演。

sentences.en: Do you like lamb chops?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡吃羊排嗎？

sentences.en: The lamb followed its mother across the field.
sentences.zh: 小羊跟著媽媽走過田野。

sentences.en: Dad is grilling lamb for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 爸爸今晚要烤羊肉當晚餐。

sentences.en: We lit a lantern on our camping trip.
sentences.zh: 我們露營時點了一盞提燈。

sentences.en: Can you hand me the lantern, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把提燈遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: Kids carried paper lanterns at the festival.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在節慶活動中提著紙燈籠。

sentences.en: Is it against the law to park here?
sentences.zh: 把車停在這裡違法嗎？

sentences.en: My cousin is studying law at college.
sentences.zh: 我表哥在大學念法律。

sentences.en: A new law says kids need car seats.
sentences.zh: 新法規定小孩要坐安全座椅。

sentences.en: Do you rake leaves in your yard every fall?
sentences.zh: 你每年秋天都會耙院子裡的落葉嗎？

sentences.en: A leaf fell right into my coffee.
sentences.zh: 一片葉子剛好掉進我的咖啡裡。

sentences.en: The leaves turn red and orange in October.
sentences.zh: 樹葉在十月會變成紅色和橘色。

sentences.en: I lost a contact lens at the pool.
sentences.zh: 我在游泳池弄丟了一片隱形眼鏡。

sentences.en: Did you wipe the lens on your camera?
sentences.zh: 你有擦過相機的鏡頭嗎？

sentences.en: These new glasses have thin lenses.
sentences.zh: 這副新眼鏡的鏡片很薄。

gloss_note: head of lettuce 一顆生菜

sentences.en: Do you want lettuce on your burger?
sentences.zh: 你的漢堡要加生菜嗎？

sentences.en: Can you grab a head of lettuce at the store?
sentences.zh: 你可以去店裡買一顆生菜嗎？

sentences.en: The lettuce in this salad tastes so fresh.
sentences.zh: 這份沙拉裡的生菜吃起來好新鮮。

gloss_note: lick the spoon 舔湯匙（刮乾淨）

sentences.en: The puppy licked my face when I got home.
sentences.zh: 我一回到家，小狗就舔我的臉。

sentences.en: Do you lick the spoon after baking cookies?
sentences.zh: 你烤完餅乾後會舔湯匙嗎？

sentences.en: Don't lick your fingers at the table.
sentences.zh: 吃飯時不要舔手指。

sentences.en: Put the lid back on the jar, please.
sentences.zh: 請把罐子的蓋子蓋回去。

sentences.en: Where is the lid for this pot?
sentences.zh: 這個鍋子的蓋子在哪裡？

sentences.en: The lid fell off my coffee cup.
sentences.zh: 我咖啡杯的蓋子掉了。

gloss_note: 美式較常說 give sb a ride，lift 也聽得到

sentences.en: I can't lift this box by myself.
sentences.zh: 這個箱子我自己抬不動。

sentences.en: Do you need a lift to the airport?
sentences.zh: 你需要我載你去機場嗎？

sentences.en: Mike gave me a lift home after work.
sentences.zh: 麥克下班後載我回家。

gloss_note: thunder and lightning 雷電交加

sentences.en: We watched lightning flash from our porch.
sentences.zh: 我們從門廊看著閃電劃過天空。

sentences.en: Did you see that lightning?
sentences.zh: 你有看到剛剛那道閃電嗎？

sentences.en: Stay off the lake when there's lightning.
sentences.zh: 打雷閃電時不要待在湖上。

sentences.en: It's likely to rain this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨。

sentences.en: Is she likely to come to the party?
sentences.zh: 她有可能會來參加派對嗎？

sentences.en: She'll most likely call you back tonight.
sentences.zh: 她今晚很可能會回電給你。

sentences.en: The speed limit here is twenty-five miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 這裡的速限是每小時二十五英里。

sentences.en: Is there a limit on how many I can buy?
sentences.zh: 有限制我能買幾個嗎？

sentences.en: Mom limits our screen time to one hour.
sentences.zh: 媽媽限制我們使用螢幕的時間不能超過一小時。

sentences.en: Text me the link, and I'll sign up.
sentences.zh: 把連結傳給我，我就去報名。

sentences.en: Does this link go to the right page?
sentences.zh: 這個連結會連到正確的頁面嗎？

sentences.en: The link in your email is broken.
sentences.zh: 你信裡的連結壞掉了。

sentences.en: Ice turns into liquid when it melts.
sentences.zh: 冰融化時會變成液體。

sentences.en: Do you prefer liquid soap or bar soap?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡洗手乳還是肥皂塊？

sentences.en: Pour the liquid into a measuring cup.
sentences.zh: 把液體倒進量杯裡。

gloss_note: 美國多用加侖；汽水常見 two-liter

sentences.en: Can you buy a two-liter bottle of soda?
sentences.zh: 你可以買一瓶兩公升的汽水嗎？

sentences.en: How many liters of water should I drink?
sentences.zh: 我應該喝幾公升的水？

sentences.en: The recipe calls for one liter of milk.
sentences.zh: 這份食譜需要一公升牛奶。

gloss_note: a loaf of bread 一條吐司；複數 loaves

sentences.en: Can you pick up a loaf of bread?
sentences.zh: 你可以順便買一條吐司嗎？

sentences.en: Grandma bakes a fresh loaf every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 奶奶每個週日都會烤一條新鮮的麵包。

sentences.en: We finished the whole loaf of banana bread.
sentences.zh: 我們把整條香蕉麵包都吃完了。

sentences.en: I buy my vegetables at the local farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我在當地的農夫市集買蔬菜。

sentences.en: Is there a good local pizza place nearby?
sentences.zh: 附近有不錯的在地披薩店嗎？

sentences.en: The local news says it will snow tonight.
sentences.zh: 當地新聞說今晚會下雪。

sentences.en: Did you lock the front door?
sentences.zh: 你有鎖前門嗎？

sentences.en: I locked my keys in the car!
sentences.zh: 我把鑰匙鎖在車子裡了！

sentences.en: The lock on this door is stuck.
sentences.zh: 這扇門的鎖卡住了。

sentences.en: What's your locker number at school?
sentences.zh: 你在學校的置物櫃是幾號？

sentences.en: I left my jacket in my gym locker.
sentences.zh: 我把外套忘在體育館的置物櫃裡了。

sentences.en: Dan forgot the combination to his locker again.
sentences.zh: 丹又忘了他置物櫃的密碼。

sentences.en: Don't be a sore loser; it's just a game.
sentences.zh: 別輸不起，這只是個遊戲。

sentences.en: Who was the loser in last night's game?
sentences.zh: 昨晚比賽的輸家是誰？

sentences.en: My little brother hates being the loser.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟最討厭當輸家。

gloss_note: subscribe to a magazine 訂閱雜誌

sentences.en: I read an old magazine at the doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 我在診所看了一本舊雜誌。

sentences.en: Do you subscribe to any magazines?
sentences.zh: 你有訂閱任何雜誌嗎？

sentences.en: There's a cooking magazine on the coffee table.
sentences.zh: 咖啡桌上有一本料理雜誌。

gloss_note: hire a magician 請魔術師表演

sentences.en: We hired a magician for Ben's birthday party.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一位魔術師來參加班的生日派對。

sentences.en: Is the magician going to pull a rabbit out of a hat?
sentences.zh: 魔術師會從帽子裡變出一隻兔子嗎？

sentences.en: The magician pulled a coin from my ear.
sentences.zh: 魔術師從我的耳朵變出一枚硬幣。

gloss_note: What's your major? 你主修什麼？

sentences.en: What did you choose as your major?
sentences.zh: 你選了什麼當主修？

sentences.en: We live close to a major highway.
sentences.zh: 我們家離一條主要公路很近。

sentences.en: My sister is a biology major.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊主修生物。

gloss_note: male or female 男或女（表格）

sentences.en: Is your new puppy male or female?
sentences.zh: 你的新小狗是公的還是母的？

sentences.en: Please check male or female on the form.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上勾選男或女。

sentences.en: A male peacock has bright, colorful feathers.
sentences.zh: 雄孔雀有鮮豔多彩的羽毛。

gloss_note: go to the mall 去逛購物中心

sentences.en: Let's meet at the mall after school.
sentences.zh: 放學後我們在購物中心碰面吧。

sentences.en: Is the mall open on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 購物中心星期天有開嗎？

sentences.en: I got a part-time job at the mall.
sentences.zh: 我在購物中心找到一份打工。

gloss_note: speak to the manager 找經理

sentences.en: Can I speak to your manager, please?
sentences.zh: 請問我可以和你們的經理談談嗎？

sentences.en: My manager said I can leave early today.
sentences.zh: 我的主管說我今天可以提早下班。

sentences.en: The store manager is hiring two new cashiers.
sentences.zh: 店經理正在徵兩位新的收銀員。

sentences.en: This mango is so sweet and juicy!
sentences.zh: 這顆芒果好甜、好多汁！

sentences.en: Do you want mango in your smoothie?
sentences.zh: 你的冰沙要加芒果嗎？

sentences.en: Mom is cutting up a ripe mango.
sentences.zh: 媽媽正在切一顆熟透的芒果。

sentences.en: Where are your manners, young man?
sentences.zh: 年輕人，你的禮貌到哪去了？

sentences.en: She always speaks in a calm manner.
sentences.zh: 她說話的方式總是很冷靜。

sentences.en: Please mind your manners at grandma's house.
sentences.zh: 在奶奶家要注意禮貌。

gloss_note: 口語多說 get married (to sb)

sentences.en: Jake wants to marry his girlfriend next year.
sentences.zh: 傑克明年想娶他的女朋友。

sentences.en: My sister married her high school sweetheart in June.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊六月嫁給了她的高中戀人。

sentences.en: Did your grandparents marry when they were very young?
sentences.zh: 你的祖父母結婚時很年輕嗎？

sentences.en: We had a marvelous time at the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊玩得好開心。

sentences.en: Your mom made a marvelous apple pie!
sentences.zh: 你媽媽做的蘋果派太棒了！

sentences.en: Isn't this weather marvelous today?
sentences.zh: 今天的天氣不是很棒嗎？

gloss_note: a mass of 一大堆／一大片

sentences.en: A mass of people waited outside the movie theater.
sentences.zh: 一大群人在電影院外面等著。

sentences.en: Why is there a mass of wet leaves on the porch?
sentences.zh: 門廊上為什麼有一大堆濕葉子？

sentences.en: A mass of dark clouds is moving in.
sentences.zh: 一大片烏雲正在逼近。

gloss_note: master a skill 精通某項技能

sentences.en: It takes years to master the piano.
sentences.zh: 要花好幾年才能精通鋼琴。

sentences.en: Grandpa is a real master at making dumplings.
sentences.zh: 爺爺包水餃真是一把罩。

sentences.en: Have you mastered your times tables yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經把乘法表背熟了嗎？

gloss_note: yoga mat 瑜伽墊；doormat 門口地墊

sentences.en: Please wipe your feet on the mat.
sentences.zh: 請在地墊上擦一下腳。

sentences.en: Bring a yoga mat to class tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天上課請帶瑜伽墊。

sentences.en: Where did you put the place mats?
sentences.zh: 你把餐墊放到哪裡去了？

gloss_note: 美式球賽多說 game；網球、拳擊仍說 match

sentences.en: Do these curtains match the couch?
sentences.zh: 這些窗簾跟沙發搭嗎？

sentences.en: Dad lit the candles with a match.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用火柴點了蠟燭。

sentences.en: I can't find a match for this sock.
sentences.zh: 我找不到這隻襪子的另一隻。

gloss_note: a maximum of + 數量 最多…

sentences.en: What's the maximum number of people this elevator holds?
sentences.zh: 這部電梯最多能載幾個人？

sentences.en: The maximum speed here is thirty-five miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 這裡的最高速度是每小時三十五英里。

sentences.en: I can borrow a maximum of five books.
sentences.zh: 我最多可以借五本書。

gloss_note: 問字義多說 What does it mean?

sentences.en: What's the meaning of this word?
sentences.zh: 這個字是什麼意思？

sentences.en: Your gift has a lot of meaning to me.
sentences.zh: 你的禮物對我意義重大。

sentences.en: The teacher explained the meaning of the poem.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了這首詩的意思。

gloss_note: measure out 量出所需分量

sentences.en: Can you measure the window for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我量一下這扇窗戶嗎？

sentences.en: Measure two cups of flour into the bowl.
sentences.zh: 把兩杯麵粉量進碗裡。

sentences.en: The nurse will measure your height first.
sentences.zh: 護理師會先量你的身高。

sentences.en: My mechanic says the brakes need work.
sentences.zh: 我的修車師傅說煞車需要處理。

sentences.en: Is there a good mechanic near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有好的修車師傅嗎？

sentences.en: Uncle Tom works as a mechanic downtown.
sentences.zh: 湯姆叔叔在市區當技師。

sentences.en: I have a terrible memory for names.
sentences.zh: 我記人名的能力很差。

sentences.en: This photo brings back so many memories.
sentences.zh: 這張照片勾起好多回憶。

sentences.en: What's your favorite memory from summer camp?
sentences.zh: 你對夏令營最喜歡的回憶是什麼？

sentences.en: Did you get my message about dinner?
sentences.zh: 你有收到我傳的晚餐訊息嗎？

sentences.en: She left a message on my phone.
sentences.zh: 她在我的手機裡留了言。

sentences.en: I'll send you a message when I get home.
sentences.zh: 我到家再傳訊息給你。

sentences.en: Don't put anything metal in the microwave.
sentences.zh: 不要把任何金屬製品放進微波爐。

sentences.en: Is this bike frame made of metal?
sentences.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是金屬做的嗎？

sentences.en: The metal slide gets hot in summer.
sentences.zh: 金屬溜滑梯夏天會很燙。

sentences.en: The pool is about two meters deep.
sentences.zh: 這游泳池大約兩公尺深。

sentences.en: I need coins for the parking meter.
sentences.zh: 我需要零錢投停車計費器。

sentences.en: Did the taxi driver turn on the meter?
sentences.zh: 計程車司機有打表嗎？

gloss_note: method of payment 付款方式

sentences.en: What's your method for memorizing new words?
sentences.zh: 你背新單字用什麼方法？

sentences.en: Grandma has her own method for baking bread.
sentences.zh: 奶奶有她自己烤麵包的方法。

sentences.en: This method saves a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 這個方法省下很多時間。

sentences.en: Just microwave the soup for two minutes.
sentences.zh: 把湯用微波爐加熱兩分鐘就好。

sentences.en: Who left fish in the microwave again?
sentences.zh: 又是誰把魚留在微波爐裡？

sentences.en: The microwave beeped, so dinner was ready.
sentences.zh: 微波爐嗶了一聲，晚餐好了。

sentences.en: We stayed up until midnight on New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 跨年夜我們熬夜到午夜十二點。

sentences.en: Why are you still awake at midnight?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼半夜十二點還沒睡？

sentences.en: Dad got home after midnight last night.
sentences.zh: 爸爸昨晚過了午夜才到家。

gloss_note: minor injury 輕傷；a minor 未成年人

sentences.en: It's only a minor cut, so don't worry.
sentences.zh: 只是輕微的割傷，別擔心。

sentences.en: Is this a minor change or a big one?
sentences.zh: 這是小改動還是大改動？

sentences.en: Luckily, the car had only minor damage.
sentences.zh: 幸好車子只有輕微的損壞。

sentences.en: Check the rearview mirror before you back up.
sentences.zh: 倒車前先看一下後視鏡。

sentences.en: Who hung this mirror in the hallway?
sentences.zh: 誰把這面鏡子掛在走廊上的？

sentences.en: She practiced her speech in front of the mirror.
sentences.zh: 她在鏡子前練習演講。

gloss_note: cake mix 蛋糕粉；mix up 搞混

sentences.en: Mix the eggs and sugar in a big bowl.
sentences.zh: 把雞蛋和糖在大碗裡拌勻。

sentences.en: Do oil and water mix?
sentences.zh: 油和水會混在一起嗎？

sentences.en: Dad mixed some juice and soda for the kids.
sentences.zh: 爸爸幫孩子們把果汁和汽水調在一起。

gloss_note: latest model 最新款；model car 模型車

sentences.en: He builds model airplanes in his spare time.
sentences.zh: 他閒暇時組裝模型飛機。

sentences.en: Is this the newest model of the phone?
sentences.zh: 這是這支手機的最新款嗎？

sentences.en: What model is your car?
sentences.zh: 你的車是什麼車款？

sentences.en: The little boy checked under his bed for monsters.
sentences.zh: 小男孩檢查了床底下有沒有怪物。

sentences.en: Did you see the green monster in that movie?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那部電影裡的綠色怪物嗎？

sentences.en: She dressed up as a friendly monster for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 她萬聖節扮成一隻友善的怪物。

gloss_note: 複數 mosquitoes；bug spray 防蚊液

sentences.en: A mosquito bit me three times last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有隻蚊子叮了我三下。

sentences.en: Do you have any bug spray for mosquitoes?
sentences.zh: 你有防蚊液嗎？

sentences.en: Close the screen door so mosquitoes stay out.
sentences.zh: 把紗門關好，蚊子才不會進來。

sentences.en: Watch the replay in slow motion.
sentences.zh: 用慢動作看一下重播。

sentences.en: Do you get motion sickness on the bus?
sentences.zh: 你搭公車會暈車嗎？

sentences.en: Stir the sauce with a slow circular motion.
sentences.zh: 用緩慢的畫圈動作攪拌醬汁。

gloss_note: movement 指一次動作或動靜

sentences.en: I saw a little movement behind the curtain.
sentences.zh: 我看見窗簾後面有點動靜。

sentences.en: Does this movement hurt your shoulder?
sentences.zh: 這個動作會讓你的肩膀痛嗎？

sentences.en: The camera picks up any movement at night.
sentences.zh: 攝影機在夜間會偵測到任何動靜。

sentences.en: My dad is a musician in a local band.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是本地樂團的樂手。

sentences.en: A street musician played guitar near the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 一位街頭藝人在公車站附近彈吉他。

sentences.en: Do you want to be a musician someday?
sentences.zh: 你以後想當音樂家嗎？

gloss_note: paper napkin 紙餐巾；英式說 serviette

sentences.en: Could I get some extra napkins, please?
sentences.zh: 可以多給我一些餐巾紙嗎？

sentences.en: She put the napkin on her lap.
sentences.zh: 她把餐巾放在腿上。

sentences.en: Dad grabbed a napkin and wiped his hands.
sentences.zh: 爸爸拿了張餐巾紙擦手。

gloss_note: narrow street 窄街；反義 wide

sentences.en: This road is too narrow for two trucks.
sentences.zh: 這條路太窄，容不下兩輛卡車。

sentences.en: Is this narrow street a one-way road?
sentences.zh: 這條窄街是單行道嗎？

sentences.en: My feet are narrow, so these shoes slip off.
sentences.zh: 我的腳很窄，所以這雙鞋會掉。

gloss_note: across the nation 全國各地

sentences.en: Pizza is a favorite food across the nation.
sentences.zh: 披薩是全國各地都愛吃的食物。

sentences.en: Which nation hosted the soccer tournament this year?
sentences.zh: 今年哪個國家主辦了足球賽？

sentences.en: Our class studied the nations of South America.
sentences.zh: 我們班研究了南美洲的各個國家。

sentences.en: Is this juice made from all natural ingredients?
sentences.zh: 這果汁是用全天然原料做的嗎？

sentences.en: It's natural to feel nervous before a test.
sentences.zh: 考試前會緊張是很自然的。

sentences.en: I'd rather use natural light than lamps.
sentences.zh: 我寧願用自然光，也不想開燈。

gloss_note: 形容小孩或寵物，不指成人

sentences.en: Stop being naughty and eat your carrots.
sentences.zh: 別調皮了，快把胡蘿蔔吃掉。

sentences.en: Was the puppy naughty while we were out?
sentences.zh: 我們出門時小狗有調皮嗎？

sentences.en: Our son gets naughty when he's tired.
sentences.zh: 我們的兒子累了就會變調皮。

sentences.en: I nearly forgot my keys this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上差點忘了帶鑰匙。

sentences.en: Is the pizza nearly ready?
sentences.zh: 披薩快好了嗎？

sentences.en: It's nearly noon, and the kids are still asleep.
sentences.zh: 快中午了，孩子們還在睡。

sentences.en: Is it necessary to bring a gift?
sentences.zh: 一定要帶禮物嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor said surgery isn't necessary.
sentences.zh: 醫生說不需要開刀。

sentences.en: Thanks, but a tip isn't necessary here.
sentences.zh: 謝謝，但這裡不一定要給小費。

sentences.en: Mom wears a gold necklace every day.
sentences.zh: 媽媽每天都戴一條金項鍊。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that cute necklace?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡買到那條可愛的項鍊？

sentences.en: My necklace broke while I was running.
sentences.zh: 我跑步的時候項鍊斷了。

sentences.en: Can you thread this needle for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這根針穿線嗎？

sentences.en: Grandma fixed my coat with a needle and thread.
sentences.zh: 奶奶用針線幫我縫好外套。

sentences.en: The nurse said the needle won't hurt much.
sentences.zh: 護理師說這根針不會很痛。

sentences.en: Try not to be so negative about everything.
sentences.zh: 試著不要對每件事都那麼負面。

sentences.en: Did the test come back negative?
sentences.zh: 檢驗結果是陰性嗎？

sentences.en: The movie got a negative review online.
sentences.zh: 這部電影在網路上得到負評。

sentences.en: Neither of my parents likes spicy food.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽兩個都不愛吃辣。

sentences.en: I can't swim, and neither can my roommate.
sentences.zh: 我不會游泳，我的室友也不會。

sentences.en: Why did neither of you answer my text?
sentences.zh: 你們兩個為什麼都沒回我的簡訊？

sentences.en: My nephew just turned five years old.
sentences.zh: 我的姪子剛滿五歲。

sentences.en: Are you picking up your nephew from school?
sentences.zh: 你要去學校接你的姪子嗎？

sentences.en: We bought our nephew a skateboard for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一個滑板送給姪子當生日禮物。

sentences.en: I'm nervous about my job interview tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我對明天的面試很緊張。

sentences.en: Are you nervous about flying alone?
sentences.zh: 你一個人搭飛機會緊張嗎？

sentences.en: Dad gets nervous when he drives in the snow.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在雪地開車會緊張。

sentences.en: A bird built a nest in our tree.
sentences.zh: 有隻鳥在我們的樹上築了巢。

sentences.en: There are three little eggs in the nest.
sentences.zh: 巢裡有三顆小小的蛋。

sentences.en: Did you see the nest under the roof?
sentences.zh: 你有看到屋簷下的鳥巢嗎？

sentences.en: My niece loves drawing pictures of horses.
sentences.zh: 我的姪女很愛畫馬。

sentences.en: Can you babysit your niece on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 星期六你可以幫忙照顧你的姪女嗎？

sentences.en: We took our niece to the zoo yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我們昨天帶姪女去動物園。

sentences.en: Just nod if you understand me.
sentences.zh: 如果你聽懂了就點頭。

sentences.en: He nodded at the neighbor and kept walking.
sentences.zh: 他向鄰居點頭致意，繼續往前走。

sentences.en: Why is the baby nodding along to the music?
sentences.zh: 寶寶為什麼跟著音樂點頭？

sentences.en: I'm reading a mystery novel on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我在公車上讀一本推理小說。

sentences.en: Have you finished that long novel yet?
sentences.zh: 那本長篇小說你看完了嗎？

sentences.en: My mom borrowed a novel from the library.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽從圖書館借了一本小說。

gloss_note: nut allergy 堅果過敏；peanut 花生

sentences.en: I'm allergic to nuts, so I can't eat this.
sentences.zh: 我對堅果過敏，所以不能吃這個。

sentences.en: Do these cookies have nuts in them?
sentences.zh: 這些餅乾裡有堅果嗎？

sentences.en: Squirrels bury nuts in our yard every fall.
sentences.zh: 松鼠每年秋天都在我們院子裡埋堅果。

gloss_note: obey the rules 遵守規則

sentences.en: Dogs need to obey simple commands.
sentences.zh: 狗需要服從簡單的口令。

sentences.en: Please obey the speed limit near the school.
sentences.zh: 學校附近請遵守速限。

sentences.en: Why won't the kids obey the rules?
sentences.zh: 孩子們為什麼不守規矩？

sentences.en: What is that strange object on the roof?
sentences.zh: 屋頂上那個奇怪的東西是什麼？

sentences.en: Keep sharp objects away from small kids.
sentences.zh: 讓尖銳的物品遠離小孩。

sentences.en: Heavy objects go on the bottom shelf.
sentences.zh: 重的東西放在最下層的架子。

sentences.en: We drove to the ocean for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們開車到海邊度週末。

sentences.en: How cold is the ocean in March?
sentences.zh: 三月的海水有多冷？

sentences.en: The kids love building sand castles by the ocean.
sentences.zh: 孩子們喜歡在海邊堆沙堡。

gloss_note: offer to help 主動幫忙

sentences.en: Can I offer you some coffee?
sentences.zh: 要不要來杯咖啡？

sentences.en: My neighbor offered to water our plants.
sentences.zh: 鄰居主動說要幫我們澆花。

sentences.en: The store is offering free delivery this week.
sentences.zh: 這家店本週提供免費送貨。

sentences.en: The recipe says you can omit the nuts.
sentences.zh: 食譜上說可以不放堅果。

sentences.en: Did I omit anyone from the guest list?
sentences.zh: 我有沒有漏掉名單上的任何人？

sentences.en: Don't omit your phone number on the form.
sentences.zh: 表格上別漏填你的電話號碼。

sentences.en: Cutting onions always makes me cry.
sentences.zh: 切洋蔥總是讓我流眼淚。

sentences.en: Do you want onion on your burger?
sentences.zh: 你的漢堡要加洋蔥嗎？

sentences.en: Mom added a chopped onion to the soup.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在湯裡加了一顆切碎的洋蔥。

sentences.en: My grandpa had an operation on his knee.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺的膝蓋動過手術。

sentences.en: How long does the operation usually take?
sentences.zh: 這種手術通常要多久？

sentences.en: Their small farm operation sells eggs every weekend.
sentences.zh: 他們的小型農場每個週末賣雞蛋。

sentences.en: In my opinion, this pizza is too salty.
sentences.zh: 依我看，這個披薩太鹹了。

sentences.en: Can I get your opinion on this dress?
sentences.zh: 我可以聽聽你對這件洋裝的意見嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone has a different opinion about the new school rule.
sentences.zh: 大家對新校規的看法都不一樣。

gloss_note: out of the ordinary 不尋常

sentences.en: It was just an ordinary day at work.
sentences.zh: 那只是工作上很平常的一天。

sentences.en: Is this an ordinary pencil or a special one?
sentences.zh: 這是普通鉛筆還是特別的？

sentences.en: We're just ordinary people who love camping.
sentences.zh: 我們只是熱愛露營的普通人。

gloss_note: preheat the oven 預熱烤箱

sentences.en: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
sentences.zh: 把烤箱預熱到華氏三百五十度。

sentences.en: Is the oven still hot?
sentences.zh: 烤箱還很燙嗎？

sentences.en: Dad took the cookies out of the oven.
sentences.zh: 爸爸把餅乾從烤箱裡拿出來。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: 美式指高架道路或跨越道路的橋

sentences.en: Traffic is backed up under the overpass.
sentences.zh: 高架橋下塞車了。

sentences.en: Is the overpass closed for repairs this week?
sentences.zh: 這座高架橋這週封閉維修嗎？

sentences.en: Turn right after the overpass, then go straight.
sentences.zh: 過了高架橋右轉，然後直走。

sentences.en: Mike is studying overseas this year.
sentences.zh: 麥克今年在國外念書。

sentences.en: Do you have family living overseas?
sentences.zh: 你有家人住在國外嗎？

sentences.en: Overseas calls can cost a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 國際電話可能很貴。

sentences.en: The owner of the corner store knows everyone.
sentences.zh: 轉角那家店的老闆認識每個人。

sentences.en: Are you the owner of this dog?
sentences.zh: 你是這隻狗的主人嗎？

sentences.en: Her parents are the owners of a small restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她爸媽是一家小餐廳的老闆。

gloss_note: as strong as an ox 力氣很大

sentences.en: Grandpa is as strong as an ox.
sentences.zh: 爺爺力氣大得像頭牛。

sentences.en: Is that big animal an ox or a cow?
sentences.zh: 那隻大動物是耕牛還是乳牛？

sentences.en: Farmers used oxen to pull carts long ago.
sentences.zh: 很久以前農夫用牛來拉車。

gloss_note: a pain in my back 背痛

sentences.en: I have a sharp pain in my back.
sentences.zh: 我的背有一陣劇痛。

sentences.en: Where do you feel the pain exactly?
sentences.zh: 你確切是哪裡痛？

sentences.en: Tell the nurse if the pain gets worse.
sentences.zh: 如果疼痛加劇，要告訴護理師。

sentences.en: My sore throat is really painful today.
sentences.zh: 我的喉嚨今天痛得厲害。

sentences.en: Is it painful when I press here?
sentences.zh: 我按這裡會痛嗎？

sentences.en: Falling off the bike was painful but not serious.
sentences.zh: 從腳踏車上摔下來很痛，但不嚴重。

sentences.en: Our neighbor is a painter who loves the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居是個愛海的畫家。

sentences.en: The painter will come to paint the kitchen tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 油漆工明天會來粉刷廚房。

sentences.en: Do you know a good painter for our house?
sentences.zh: 你知道有沒有好的油漆工可以來我們家嗎？

sentences.en: Put on your pajamas and brush your teeth.
sentences.zh: 換上睡衣，然後去刷牙。

sentences.en: Why are you still in your pajamas?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼還穿著睡衣？

sentences.en: I love staying home in my pajamas on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡星期天穿著睡衣待在家。

gloss_note: turn pale 臉色發白；pale blue 淡藍

sentences.en: Why do you look so pale today?
sentences.zh: 你今天怎麼臉色這麼蒼白？

sentences.en: She painted her room a pale blue.
sentences.zh: 她把房間漆成淡藍色。

sentences.en: He turned pale when he saw the check.
sentences.zh: 他看到帳單時臉色發白。

sentences.en: Heat some oil in a pan first.
sentences.zh: 先在平底鍋裡把油加熱。

sentences.en: Who left the dirty pan in the sink?
sentences.zh: 誰把髒鍋子留在水槽裡？

sentences.en: Dad flipped the pancakes in the pan.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在鍋裡把鬆餅翻面。

gloss_note: giant panda 大貓熊（台灣也說貓熊）

sentences.en: The panda at the zoo was eating bamboo.
sentences.zh: 動物園裡的熊貓正在吃竹子。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a real panda?
sentences.zh: 你看過真的熊貓嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter has a stuffed panda on her bed.
sentences.zh: 我女兒的床上有一隻熊貓玩偶。

gloss_note: Pardon? 請再說一次；Pardon me 不好意思

sentences.en: Pardon me, is this seat taken?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，這個位子有人坐嗎？

sentences.en: Pardon? I didn't catch your name.
sentences.zh: 你說什麼？我沒聽清楚你的名字。

sentences.en: Pardon the mess; we just moved in.
sentences.zh: 請見諒家裡有點亂，我們剛搬進來。

gloss_note: parking lot 停車場；英式 car park

sentences.en: Is there free parking near the park?
sentences.zh: 公園附近有免費停車位嗎？

sentences.en: Parking is hard to find downtown on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 週六市區很難找到停車位。

sentences.en: We ran late because we couldn't find parking.
sentences.zh: 我們因為找不到停車位而遲到。

sentences.en: Our neighbor has a parrot that says hello.
sentences.zh: 我們鄰居養了一隻會說「哈囉」的鸚鵡。

sentences.en: Can your parrot really talk?
sentences.zh: 你的鸚鵡真的會說話嗎？

sentences.en: The parrot at the pet store copied my laugh.
sentences.zh: 寵物店的鸚鵡學了我的笑聲。

sentences.en: Find a partner and practice the dialogue.
sentences.zh: 找個搭檔來練習對話。

sentences.en: My business partner is on vacation this week.
sentences.zh: 我的合夥人這週在休假。

sentences.en: Who is your partner for the science project?
sentences.zh: 科學專題你的搭檔是誰？

sentences.en: The bus driver waited for the last passenger.
sentences.zh: 公車司機等最後一位乘客上車。

sentences.en: How many passengers can this van hold?
sentences.zh: 這輛廂型車能載幾位乘客？

sentences.en: Every passenger must wear a seat belt.
sentences.zh: 每位乘客都必須繫安全帶。

gloss_note: file path 是電腦檔案路徑

sentences.en: Follow the path to the lake.
sentences.zh: 沿著這條小路走就會到湖邊。

sentences.en: Is this the right path to the parking lot?
sentences.zh: 這是通往停車場的路嗎？

sentences.en: Someone left muddy footprints on the garden path.
sentences.zh: 有人在花園小徑上留下泥巴腳印。

gloss_note: be patient with sb 對某人有耐心

sentences.en: Thanks for being so patient with me.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你對我這麼有耐心。

sentences.en: Be patient, the pizza will be here soon.
sentences.zh: 再耐心等一下，披薩很快就到。

sentences.en: Is the next patient ready to see the doctor?
sentences.zh: 下一位病人準備好看診了嗎？

sentences.en: I love the flower pattern on your dress.
sentences.zh: 我好喜歡你洋裝上的花朵圖案。

sentences.en: Do you see a pattern in these numbers?
sentences.zh: 你看得出這些數字有什麼規律嗎？

sentences.en: My sleep pattern is a mess this week.
sentences.zh: 我這週的睡眠作息一團亂。

sentences.en: Can you pause the movie for a second?
sentences.zh: 你可以把電影暫停一下嗎？

sentences.en: She paused at the door and smiled.
sentences.zh: 她在門口停了一下，笑了笑。

sentences.en: There was a long pause after my question.
sentences.zh: 我問完之後，沉默了好一會兒。

sentences.en: I just want some peace and quiet tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚只想要清靜一下。

sentences.en: Can we make peace and be friends again?
sentences.zh: 我們可以和好，再當朋友嗎？

sentences.en: He finally found peace after moving to the country.
sentences.zh: 他搬到鄉下後，終於找到內心的平靜。

gloss_note: a peaceful night 寧靜的夜晚

sentences.en: It was a peaceful Sunday morning at the park.
sentences.zh: 那是公園裡一個寧靜的週日早晨。

sentences.en: Is your neighborhood peaceful at night?
sentences.zh: 你們社區晚上安靜嗎？

sentences.en: The baby looked so peaceful in her sleep.
sentences.zh: 寶寶睡著的樣子好安詳。

sentences.en: Could you pass the salt and pepper?
sentences.zh: 可以把鹽和胡椒遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: I added chopped bell peppers to the tacos.
sentences.zh: 我在塔可餅裡加了切碎的甜椒。

sentences.en: Don't use too much pepper on the eggs.
sentences.zh: 蛋上不要灑太多胡椒。

gloss_note: a perfect fit 剛好合身

sentences.en: These shoes are a perfect fit.
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋剛剛好合腳。

sentences.en: Is this the perfect gift for Mom?
sentences.zh: 這會是送媽媽的完美禮物嗎？

sentences.en: Perfect, see you at six then!
sentences.zh: 太好了，那就六點見！

gloss_note: 美式句點叫 period，英式叫 full stop

sentences.en: You forgot the period at the end of the sentence.
sentences.zh: 你忘了在句尾加句點。

sentences.en: It was a hard period in my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我人生中很難熬的一段時期。

sentences.en: Can I borrow the car for a short period?
sentences.zh: 我可以借車用一小段時間嗎？

sentences.en: That's a very personal question.
sentences.zh: 那是很私人的問題。

sentences.en: Can I use my personal cell phone here?
sentences.zh: 我可以在這裡用我的私人手機嗎？

sentences.en: Please keep your personal items in the locker.
sentences.zh: 請把個人物品放在置物櫃裡。

gloss_note: 學科名，Physics is 搭單數動詞

sentences.en: I have a physics test on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我星期五有物理考試。

sentences.en: Is physics harder than chemistry?
sentences.zh: 物理比化學難嗎？

sentences.en: My brother is studying physics in college.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥在大學念物理。

gloss_note: city pigeon 指城市裡的野鴿

sentences.en: A pigeon landed on our balcony this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有一隻鴿子停在我們的陽台上。

sentences.en: Please don't feed the pigeons in the square.
sentences.zh: 請不要在廣場餵鴿子。

sentences.en: Is that pigeon following us?
sentences.zh: 那隻鴿子是在跟著我們嗎？

gloss_note: a pile of 一堆；pile up 堆積

sentences.en: Why is there a pile of mail by the door?
sentences.zh: 為什麼門邊有一堆信件？

sentences.en: Don't pile too many dishes in the sink.
sentences.zh: 別把太多碗盤堆在水槽裡。

sentences.en: Snow was piling up outside all night.
sentences.zh: 雪整晚都在外面堆積。

sentences.en: Can I have an extra pillow, please?
sentences.zh: 可以多給我一個枕頭嗎？

sentences.en: She hugged a pillow and watched TV.
sentences.zh: 她抱著枕頭看電視。

sentences.en: I like the throw pillows on your couch.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡你沙發上的抱枕。

gloss_note: pineapple on pizza 披薩加鳳梨

sentences.en: Do you like pineapple on pizza?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡披薩上放鳳梨嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a fresh pineapple at the market.
sentences.zh: 我們在市場買了一顆新鮮鳳梨。

sentences.en: Add some pineapple juice to the smoothie.
sentences.zh: 在果昔裡加點鳳梨汁。

sentences.en: I'll have a plain bagel with cream cheese.
sentences.zh: 我要一個原味貝果加奶油乳酪。

sentences.en: Do you have any plain white T-shirts?
sentences.zh: 你們有素面的白色T恤嗎？

sentences.en: Their house is plain but very cozy.
sentences.zh: 他們家很樸素，但很溫馨。

sentences.en: Which platform should we wait on?
sentences.zh: 我們該在哪個月台等？

sentences.en: The train leaves from platform four.
sentences.zh: 火車從四號月台出發。

sentences.en: He posts videos on that platform every week.
sentences.zh: 他每週都在那個平台上發影片。

gloss_note: Have a pleasant day 祝你有愉快的一天

sentences.en: I hope you have a pleasant weekend.
sentences.zh: 祝你週末愉快。

sentences.en: Is the weather pleasant there in April?
sentences.zh: 那裡四月天氣宜人嗎？

sentences.en: It was a pleasant surprise to see you.
sentences.zh: 見到你真是個驚喜。

gloss_note: Pleased to meet you 幸會

sentences.en: I'm pleased to meet you, Mrs. Lee.
sentences.zh: 很高興認識您，李太太。

sentences.en: Are you pleased with your new apartment?
sentences.zh: 你對新公寓滿意嗎？

sentences.en: My boss was pleased with the report.
sentences.zh: 老闆對這份報告很滿意。

sentences.en: She wrote a poem for her grandma.
sentences.zh: 她為奶奶寫了一首詩。

sentences.en: Can you read the poem out loud?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這首詩大聲唸出來嗎？

sentences.en: We memorized a short poem in class.
sentences.zh: 我們在課堂上背了一首短詩。

sentences.en: Keep the poison locked up, away from kids.
sentences.zh: 把毒藥鎖好，別讓小孩碰到。

sentences.en: Can that chemical poison the pets?
sentences.zh: 那種化學藥劑會讓寵物中毒嗎？

sentences.en: The label says this cleaner is poison.
sentences.zh: 標籤上說這種清潔劑有毒。

sentences.en: Cars pollute the air in big cities.
sentences.zh: 汽車讓大城市的空氣受到污染。

sentences.en: Don't pollute the river with trash.
sentences.zh: 別把垃圾丟進河裡污染河水。

sentences.en: Does this factory pollute the lake?
sentences.zh: 這間工廠會污染湖水嗎？

sentences.en: The air pollution here is really bad today.
sentences.zh: 這裡今天的空氣污染真的很嚴重。

sentences.en: Is there a lot of pollution near the highway?
sentences.zh: 高速公路附近的污染很嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: We joined a beach cleanup to reduce pollution.
sentences.zh: 我們參加淨灘活動來減少污染。

gloss_note: the city's population 城市人口

sentences.en: What's the population of your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你的家鄉有多少人口？

sentences.en: The city's population has grown fast.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的人口成長得很快。

sentences.en: Most of the population lives near the coast.
sentences.zh: 大部分人口住在海岸附近。

gloss_note: apply for a position 應徵職位

sentences.en: Are you applying for a position at the bank?
sentences.zh: 你要應徵銀行的職位嗎？

sentences.en: We have an open position in sales.
sentences.zh: 我們業務部門有個職缺。

sentences.en: Move the table to a better position.
sentences.zh: 把桌子移到更好的位置。

sentences.en: Try to stay positive, you'll do great.
sentences.zh: 保持樂觀，你會表現得很好。

sentences.en: Our teacher gave us positive feedback.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們正面的回饋。

sentences.en: Is she always this positive in the morning?
sentences.zh: 她早上總是這麼樂觀積極嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like a baked potato with my steak.
sentences.zh: 我的牛排想配一個烤馬鈴薯。

sentences.en: Can you peel the potatoes for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫忙削晚餐要用的馬鈴薯嗎？

sentences.en: Mashed potatoes are my favorite side dish.
sentences.zh: 馬鈴薯泥是我最愛的配菜。

sentences.en: Add a spoonful of cocoa powder to the milk.
sentences.zh: 在牛奶裡加一匙可可粉。

sentences.en: Do we have any baking powder left?
sentences.zh: 我們還有泡打粉嗎？

sentences.en: She put powder on the baby after the bath.
sentences.zh: 她在洗完澡後替寶寶撲上爽身粉。

gloss_note: praise sb for sth 因某事稱讚某人

sentences.en: The coach praised her for working hard.
sentences.zh: 教練稱讚她很努力。

sentences.en: Did the teacher praise your drawing?
sentences.zh: 老師有誇獎你的畫嗎？

sentences.en: He got a lot of praise for his speech.
sentences.zh: 他的演講獲得許多讚美。

sentences.en: Family time is precious to me.
sentences.zh: 和家人相處的時光對我來說很珍貴。

sentences.en: Don't waste your precious time on that game.
sentences.zh: 別把你寶貴的時間浪費在那個遊戲上。

sentences.en: Is that old watch precious to you?
sentences.zh: 那只舊手錶對你很珍貴嗎？

gloss_note: student body president 學生會長

sentences.en: Who was your class president in high school?
sentences.zh: 你高中時的班長是誰？

sentences.en: The president will give a speech tonight.
sentences.zh: 總統今晚會發表演說。

sentences.en: She's the president of our book club.
sentences.zh: 她是我們讀書會的會長。

sentences.en: I feel a lot of pressure at work lately.
sentences.zh: 我最近工作壓力很大。

sentences.en: Can you check the tire pressure for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我檢查一下胎壓嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse checked my blood pressure first.
sentences.zh: 護士先量了我的血壓。

gloss_note: 新教牧師多說 pastor 或 minister

sentences.en: The priest greeted everyone at the church door.
sentences.zh: 神父在教堂門口向大家問好。

sentences.en: Is that man in the black robe a priest?
sentences.zh: 那位穿黑袍的男士是神父嗎？

sentences.en: My neighbor used to be a priest.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居以前是神父。

gloss_note: 美式小學多說 elementary school

sentences.en: My primary goal this year is to save money.
sentences.zh: 我今年的主要目標是存錢。

sentences.en: What's the primary reason you moved here?
sentences.zh: 你搬來這裡的主要原因是什麼？

sentences.en: Rice is the primary food in many countries.
sentences.zh: 米是許多國家的主食。

gloss_note: Prince Charming 完美的白馬王子

sentences.en: The little prince lived in a big castle.
sentences.zh: 小王子住在一座大城堡裡。

sentences.en: She dressed up as a prince for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 她萬聖節打扮成王子。

sentences.en: Did the prince find her in the end?
sentences.zh: 王子最後有找到她嗎？

gloss_note: 也可當對小女孩的暱稱

sentences.en: My niece wants to be a princess for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我姪女萬聖節想扮公主。

sentences.en: The princess lived in a tall tower.
sentences.zh: 公主住在一座高塔裡。

sentences.en: Is this the princess from your favorite movie?
sentences.zh: 這是你最愛的電影裡的公主嗎？

gloss_note: 美式 principal 指中小學校長

sentences.en: The principal made an announcement this morning.
sentences.zh: 校長今天早上做了廣播。

sentences.en: Do I have to go to the principal's office?
sentences.zh: 我得去校長室嗎？

sentences.en: My principal worry is the weather.
sentences.zh: 我主要擔心的是天氣。

sentences.en: I never lie, on principle.
sentences.zh: 我基於原則，從不說謊。

sentences.en: In principle, that sounds like a good idea.
sentences.zh: 原則上，這聽起來是個好主意。

sentences.en: What's the basic principle behind this machine?
sentences.zh: 這台機器的基本原理是什麼？

sentences.en: Can you print this out for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這個印出來嗎？

sentences.en: I forgot to print my boarding pass.
sentences.zh: 我忘了列印登機證。

sentences.en: They print the menu on recycled paper.
sentences.zh: 他們把菜單印在再生紙上。

gloss_note: The printer is jammed 卡紙了

sentences.en: The printer is out of paper again.
sentences.zh: 印表機又沒紙了。

sentences.en: Why won't my laptop connect to the printer?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我的筆電連不上印表機？

sentences.en: We bought a new printer for the home office.
sentences.zh: 我們幫家裡的辦公室買了一台新印表機。

gloss_note: private room 單人房；in private 私下

sentences.en: Can we talk somewhere more private?
sentences.zh: 我們可以找個比較隱密的地方談嗎？

sentences.en: This is a private beach, sir.
sentences.zh: 這裡是私人海灘，先生。

sentences.en: She sent me a private message online.
sentences.zh: 她在網路上私訊了我。

gloss_note: produce section 是超市蔬果區

sentences.en: The produce section is on your left.
sentences.zh: 蔬果區在你的左手邊。

sentences.en: Does this farm produce organic vegetables?
sentences.zh: 這座農場生產有機蔬菜嗎？

sentences.en: We buy fresh produce at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我們在農夫市集買新鮮蔬果。

sentences.en: The factory's production slowed down after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，工廠的生產速度變慢了。

sentences.en: Is the new movie still in production?
sentences.zh: 這部新電影還在製作中嗎？

sentences.en: Mass production made phones much cheaper.
sentences.zh: 大量生產讓手機便宜許多。

sentences.en: Our professor canceled class today.
sentences.zh: 我們的教授今天停課。

sentences.en: Do you know which professor teaches biology?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪位教授教生物嗎？

sentences.en: I'm going to my professor's office hours today.
sentences.zh: 我今天要去教授的面談時間。

sentences.en: I'm making good progress on my homework.
sentences.zh: 我的作業進展得很順利。

sentences.en: How's the progress on the kitchen remodel?
sentences.zh: 廚房整修的進度如何？

sentences.en: My Spanish is progressing slowly but surely.
sentences.zh: 我的西班牙文進步得慢，但很穩。

sentences.en: We have a group project due Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們有個週五要交的小組專題。

sentences.en: What project are you working on now?
sentences.zh: 你現在在做什麼專案？

sentences.en: Dad started a big project in the garage.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在車庫開始了一項大工程。

gloss_note: keep／break a promise 守信／食言

sentences.en: I promise I'll call you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我保證明天打電話給你。

sentences.en: Don't make promises you can't keep.
sentences.zh: 別許下你做不到的承諾。

sentences.en: Did you promise the kids ice cream?
sentences.zh: 你答應孩子們要買冰淇淋嗎？

sentences.en: How do you pronounce your last name?
sentences.zh: 你的姓怎麼發音？

sentences.en: I can't pronounce this word at all.
sentences.zh: 我完全唸不出這個字。

sentences.en: The teacher pronounced each word slowly.
sentences.zh: 老師慢慢地唸出每一個字。

gloss_note: protect A from B 保護 A 免於 B

sentences.en: Wear a hat to protect your face from the sun.
sentences.zh: 戴頂帽子保護你的臉不被太陽曬傷。

sentences.en: Do these gloves protect your hands well?
sentences.zh: 這副手套能好好保護你的手嗎？

sentences.en: The fence protects the garden from deer.
sentences.zh: 圍籬保護花園不被鹿破壞。

gloss_note: provide A with B 提供 A 給 B

sentences.en: The hotel provides free breakfast every morning.
sentences.zh: 飯店每天早上提供免費早餐。

sentences.en: Could you provide your phone number, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你提供電話號碼嗎？

sentences.en: The company provided me with a laptop.
sentences.zh: 公司配了一台筆記型電腦給我。

sentences.en: Which pump is open at this gas station?
sentences.zh: 這間加油站哪台加油機有空？

sentences.en: I need to pump more air into this tire.
sentences.zh: 我得給這顆輪胎再打點氣。

sentences.en: The pump in the basement stopped working.
sentences.zh: 地下室的抽水幫浦壞了。

gloss_note: punish sb for sth 因某事處罰某人

sentences.en: Parents shouldn't punish kids for honest mistakes.
sentences.zh: 父母不該因為孩子無心的錯就處罰他們。

sentences.en: Did the teacher punish the whole class?
sentences.zh: 老師處罰了全班嗎？

sentences.en: He felt punished for telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 他覺得因為說實話而被罰。

sentences.en: Did you break it on purpose?
sentences.zh: 你是故意弄壞的嗎？

sentences.en: What's the purpose of this meeting?
sentences.zh: 這場會議的目的是什麼？

sentences.en: The main purpose of my trip is to visit family.
sentences.zh: 我這趟旅行的主要目的是探親。

sentences.en: I left my purse in the car.
sentences.zh: 我把手提包忘在車上了。

sentences.en: Can you hold my purse for a second?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我拿一下包包嗎？

sentences.en: She pulled her keys out of her purse.
sentences.zh: 她從包包裡拿出鑰匙。

sentences.en: We did a thousand-piece puzzle over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們週末拼了一幅千片拼圖。

sentences.en: Can you help me solve this puzzle?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我解開這個謎題嗎？

sentences.en: It's a puzzle why the car won't start.
sentences.zh: 車子為什麼發不動真是個謎。

gloss_note: quit＋-ing 戒掉某習慣；quit 三態同形

sentences.en: I'm thinking about quitting my job.
sentences.zh: 我在考慮辭掉工作。

sentences.en: My dad quit smoking last year.
sentences.zh: 我爸去年戒菸了。

sentences.en: Why did you quit the soccer team?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼退出足球隊？

sentences.en: The old railroad runs behind our house.
sentences.zh: 老鐵路從我們家後面經過。

sentences.en: Is this railroad still used by trains?
sentences.zh: 這條鐵路現在還有火車在跑嗎？

sentences.en: My grandpa worked on the railroad for forty years.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺在鐵路上工作了四十年。

sentences.en: Don't forget your raincoat; it's pouring outside.
sentences.zh: 別忘了帶雨衣，外面下大雨。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that yellow raincoat?
sentences.zh: 你那件黃色雨衣在哪買的？

sentences.en: I left my raincoat on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我把雨衣忘在公車上了。

gloss_note: rare 一分熟；medium rare 三分熟

sentences.en: It's rare to see snow here in April.
sentences.zh: 這裡四月很少下雪。

sentences.en: Do you like your steak rare?
sentences.zh: 你的牛排要一分熟嗎？

sentences.en: A rare bird landed in our backyard.
sentences.zh: 一隻罕見的鳥停在我們的後院。

sentences.en: I'd rather stay home tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚寧願待在家。

sentences.en: Would you rather have tea or coffee?
sentences.zh: 你想喝茶還是咖啡？

sentences.en: We left early rather than wait in line.
sentences.zh: 我們提早離開，不想排隊等。

sentences.en: I just realized I forgot my keys.
sentences.zh: 我剛發現我忘了帶鑰匙。

sentences.en: Do you realize what time it is?
sentences.zh: 你知道現在幾點了嗎？

sentences.en: She didn't realize the store was closed.
sentences.zh: 她沒發現店已經打烊了。

gloss_note: receive a call／text 接到電話／簡訊

sentences.en: Did you receive my message yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天有收到我的訊息嗎？

sentences.en: We received a package this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們今天早上收到一個包裹。

sentences.en: He received a text from his boss.
sentences.zh: 他收到老闆傳來的簡訊。

gloss_note: 名詞重音在前，動詞重音在後

sentences.en: Can I record this lecture on my phone?
sentences.zh: 我可以用手機錄這堂課嗎？

sentences.en: Keep a record of every payment.
sentences.zh: 把每一筆付款都記錄下來。

sentences.en: She broke the school record in the mile.
sentences.zh: 她打破了學校一英里的紀錄。

sentences.en: He's recovering from the flu at home.
sentences.zh: 他在家休養，正慢慢從流感中康復。

sentences.en: Did you recover your lost files?
sentences.zh: 你把弄丟的檔案找回來了嗎？

sentences.en: It takes time to recover after surgery.
sentences.zh: 手術後需要時間復原。

sentences.en: Draw a rectangle on the paper.
sentences.zh: 在紙上畫一個長方形。

sentences.en: Is a square a kind of rectangle?
sentences.zh: 正方形算是長方形的一種嗎？

sentences.en: The picture frame is a rectangle, not a square.
sentences.zh: 相框是長方形，不是正方形。

sentences.en: Please recycle your cans and bottles.
sentences.zh: 請回收你的罐子和瓶子。

sentences.en: Do you recycle plastic bags here?
sentences.zh: 這裡有回收塑膠袋嗎？

sentences.en: Our town recycles glass on Thursdays.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上每週四回收玻璃。

sentences.en: He refused to say sorry.
sentences.zh: 他拒絕道歉。

sentences.en: Why did you refuse their offer?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼拒絕他們的提議？

sentences.en: The car refuses to start in cold weather.
sentences.zh: 這輛車天一冷就不肯發動。

sentences.en: I regret not studying harder.
sentences.zh: 我後悔沒有更用功念書。

sentences.en: Do you have any regrets about moving here?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有後悔搬來這裡？

sentences.en: She regretted yelling at her brother.
sentences.zh: 她後悔對弟弟大吼。

sentences.en: I'll take the regular size, not the large.
sentences.zh: 我要一般大小的，不要大杯。

sentences.en: She's a regular customer at this diner.
sentences.zh: 她是這家小餐館的常客。

sentences.en: Do you exercise on a regular basis?
sentences.zh: 你有固定運動的習慣嗎？

gloss_note: reject an offer 拒絕提議

sentences.en: The bank rejected my loan application.
sentences.zh: 銀行駁回了我的貸款申請。

sentences.en: Why did you reject their job offer?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼拒絕他們的工作邀約？

sentences.en: The vending machine keeps rejecting my dollar bill.
sentences.zh: 販賣機一直不收我的一元鈔票。

gloss_note: remind me to＋原形；remind of 使想起

sentences.en: Can you remind me to buy milk?
sentences.zh: 你可以提醒我買牛奶嗎？

sentences.en: That song reminds me of high school.
sentences.zh: 那首歌讓我想起高中時光。

sentences.en: My phone reminded me about the dentist.
sentences.zh: 手機提醒我要去看牙醫。

gloss_note: for rent 出租；rent a car 租車

sentences.en: How much is the rent for this apartment?
sentences.zh: 這間公寓的租金多少？

sentences.en: We rent a small house near the school.
sentences.zh: 我們租了學校附近的一間小房子。

sentences.en: Let's rent a car for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們週末租輛車吧。

gloss_note: repair shop 修理廠；美式口語也常說 fix

sentences.en: Can you repair my bike this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末可以幫我修腳踏車嗎？

sentences.en: The car is in the shop for repairs.
sentences.zh: 那輛車正在修車廠維修。

sentences.en: My dad repaired the broken fence yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我爸昨天把壞掉的圍籬修好了。

sentences.en: I respect her for always telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 我很敬佩她，因為她總是說實話。

sentences.en: Kids should show respect to their teachers.
sentences.zh: 孩子應該尊敬自己的老師。

sentences.en: Do the players respect their new coach?
sentences.zh: 球員們尊敬他們的新教練嗎？

sentences.en: Who is responsible for cleaning the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 誰負責打掃廚房？

sentences.en: Jake is a very responsible babysitter.
sentences.zh: 傑克是個非常可靠的保母。

sentences.en: Mom thinks I'm responsible enough to stay home alone.
sentences.zh: 媽媽覺得我夠懂事，可以一個人待在家。

sentences.en: When do we get the test results?
sentences.zh: 我們什麼時候會拿到檢驗結果？

sentences.en: As a result, we missed the last bus.
sentences.zh: 結果我們錯過了最後一班公車。

sentences.en: Are you happy with the result?
sentences.zh: 你對這個結果滿意嗎？

sentences.en: We return to school after winter break.
sentences.zh: 寒假結束後我們就回學校上課。

sentences.en: I need to return these shoes to the store.
sentences.zh: 我得把這雙鞋拿回店裡退掉。

sentences.en: Did you return the library books yet?
sentences.zh: 你把圖書館的書還了嗎？

sentences.en: I read the reviews before booking the hotel.
sentences.zh: 訂飯店之前我先看了評價。

sentences.en: Let's review chapter five before the quiz.
sentences.zh: 小考前我們把第五章複習一下吧。

sentences.en: Did you review your notes last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有複習筆記嗎？

gloss_note: 美式說「複習」用 review，不用 revise

sentences.en: Please revise your essay and turn it in Monday.
sentences.zh: 請修改你的作文，星期一交上來。

sentences.en: Can you revise the schedule for next week?
sentences.zh: 你可以修改一下下週的時間表嗎？

sentences.en: He revised the recipe after the first try.
sentences.zh: 第一次試做之後，他修改了食譜。

gloss_note: rob a bank 搶銀行；被搶用 be robbed

sentences.en: Someone robbed the corner store last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有人搶了街角的商店。

sentences.en: Why would anyone rob a small gas station?
sentences.zh: 怎麼會有人去搶一間小加油站？

sentences.en: The thieves were caught robbing a jewelry store.
sentences.zh: 小偷在搶珠寶店時被逮到了。

gloss_note: play a role 扮演角色；role model 榜樣

sentences.en: Who got the main role in the school play?
sentences.zh: 學校話劇的主角是誰演的？

sentences.en: My older sister is a great role model.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊是很好的榜樣。

sentences.en: Sleep plays an important role in staying healthy.
sentences.zh: 睡眠對保持健康很重要。

gloss_note: on the roof 在屋頂上；roof rack 車頂架

sentences.en: The roof leaks every time it rains hard.
sentences.zh: 每次下大雨屋頂都會漏水。

sentences.en: Is it safe to climb on the roof?
sentences.zh: 爬上屋頂安全嗎？

sentences.en: We watched the fireworks from the roof of our building.
sentences.zh: 我們在大樓屋頂上看煙火。

sentences.en: Why do you keep rubbing your eyes?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼一直揉眼睛？

sentences.en: She rubbed lotion on her dry hands.
sentences.zh: 她把乳液抹在乾燥的雙手上。

sentences.en: Rub some salt on the steak before cooking.
sentences.zh: 下鍋前先在牛排上抹一點鹽。

sentences.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry.
sentences.zh: 這雙橡膠雨鞋能讓我的腳保持乾爽。

sentences.en: Do you have a rubber band I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有橡皮筋可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: Most car tires are made of rubber.
sentences.zh: 大多數車胎都是橡膠做的。

gloss_note: It's rude to... 這樣很沒禮貌

sentences.en: It's rude to talk with your mouth full.
sentences.zh: 嘴裡有食物時說話很沒禮貌。

sentences.en: Why was the waiter so rude to you?
sentences.zh: 那位服務生為什麼對你那麼無禮？

sentences.en: Sorry if I sounded rude on the phone.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我在電話裡聽起來可能不太客氣。

gloss_note: ruin the surprise 破壞驚喜

sentences.en: Stop talking, or you'll ruin the surprise.
sentences.zh: 別再說了，不然你會破壞驚喜。

sentences.en: The rain ruined our picnic yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天一場雨毀了我們的野餐。

sentences.en: Is the rain ruining your weekend plans?
sentences.zh: 這場雨有毀掉你的週末計畫嗎？

gloss_note: rush hour 尖峰時間；no rush 不急

sentences.en: Don't rush; we have plenty of time.
sentences.zh: 別急，我們時間很多。

sentences.en: We got stuck in rush hour traffic.
sentences.zh: 我們卡在尖峰時段的車陣裡。

sentences.en: Why is everyone rushing to the exit?
sentences.zh: 大家為什麼都急著往出口擠？

sentences.en: Always wear a helmet for your safety.
sentences.zh: 為了你的安全，一定要戴安全帽。

sentences.en: Is this toy tested for safety?
sentences.zh: 這個玩具通過安全檢驗了嗎？

sentences.en: Safety comes first when we go camping.
sentences.zh: 我們露營時安全最重要。

sentences.en: My uncle was a sailor for ten years.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔當了十年的水手。

sentences.en: The sailors waved from the deck of the ship.
sentences.zh: 水手們在船的甲板上揮手。

sentences.en: Do you want to be a sailor someday?
sentences.zh: 你以後想當水手嗎？

sentences.en: Can I try a free sample first?
sentences.zh: 我可以先試吃免費樣品嗎？

sentences.en: The store gave out samples of cheese.
sentences.zh: 那家店在發起司試吃品。

sentences.en: Let's sample a few desserts before we choose.
sentences.zh: 我們先試吃幾種甜點再決定吧。

gloss_note: sand castle 沙堡；sandy beach 沙灘

sentences.en: The kids built a castle in the sand.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在沙灘上堆了一座沙堡。

sentences.en: There's sand in my shoes again!
sentences.zh: 我的鞋子裡又有沙了！

sentences.en: Why is the sand so hot today?
sentences.zh: 今天的沙為什麼這麼燙？

sentences.en: Are you satisfied with your new cell phone?
sentences.zh: 你對新手機滿意嗎？

sentences.en: Nothing seems to satisfy him lately.
sentences.zh: 最近好像沒有什麼事能讓他滿意。

sentences.en: A snack will satisfy my hunger until dinner.
sentences.zh: 吃點心就能撐到晚餐。

gloss_note: hot sauce 辣醬；on the side 醬料另外放

sentences.en: Do you want more hot sauce on that?
sentences.zh: 你要在上面再多加一點辣醬嗎？

sentences.en: My mom makes pasta with homemade tomato sauce.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽用自己煮的番茄醬汁做義大利麵。

sentences.en: Please put the sauce on the side.
sentences.zh: 醬汁請另外放在旁邊。

sentences.en: She set the cup on a small saucer.
sentences.zh: 她把杯子放在一個小茶碟上。

sentences.en: Where do you keep the cups and saucers?
sentences.zh: 你們的杯子和茶碟收在哪裡？

sentences.en: Grandma uses her good saucers only for guests.
sentences.zh: 奶奶只在招待客人時才用她最好的茶碟。

gloss_note: wear a scarf 戴圍巾；複數 scarves

sentences.en: It's freezing; wear a scarf and gloves.
sentences.zh: 外面冷死了，戴上圍巾和手套。

sentences.en: Did I leave my scarf in your car?
sentences.zh: 我的圍巾是不是忘在你車上了？

sentences.en: Grandma knitted me a warm scarf for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 奶奶織了一條暖暖的圍巾送我當生日禮物。

sentences.en: That's my favorite scene in the whole movie.
sentences.zh: 那是整部電影我最喜歡的一幕。

sentences.en: The police arrived at the scene within minutes.
sentences.zh: 警察幾分鐘內就趕到了現場。

sentences.en: Did you cry during the last scene?
sentences.zh: 最後那一幕你有哭嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數；enjoy the scenery 欣賞風景

sentences.en: The scenery along the coast is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 沿海的風景很美。

sentences.en: We stopped to enjoy the scenery.
sentences.zh: 我們停下來欣賞風景。

sentences.en: Is the scenery on this trail worth the hike?
sentences.zh: 這條步道的風景值得走這一趟嗎？

sentences.en: My sister wants to be a scientist when she grows up.

sentences.zh: 我要怎麼一次選取所有照片？

sentences.zh: 我們昨天在水族館看到了一隻鯊魚。
