gloss_note: 藍牙喇叭；guest speaker 客座講者

sentences.en: Is your Bluetooth speaker waterproof?
sentences.zh: 你的藍牙喇叭防水嗎？

sentences.en: Our guest speaker today is a local firefighter.
sentences.zh: 我們今天的客座講者是本地的消防員。

sentences.en: The speaker at the front of the room crackled.
sentences.zh: 前面那個喇叭發出劈啪的雜音。

gloss_note: give a speech 發表演講

sentences.en: I have to give a speech in class tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天得在課堂上做一場演講。

sentences.en: Did you hear the principal's speech this morning?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到校長今天早上的演講嗎？

sentences.en: Her speech was funny, and everyone laughed.
sentences.zh: 她的演講很有趣，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: The speed limit on this road is 35.
sentences.zh: 這條路的速限是每小時35英里。

sentences.en: Is your internet speed fast enough for video calls?
sentences.zh: 你家的網路速度夠快，可以視訊通話嗎？

sentences.en: He rode his bike at full speed.
sentences.zh: 他全速騎著腳踏車。

sentences.en: Our school spirit is strong on game day.
sentences.zh: 比賽日當天，我們的校園向心力特別強。

sentences.en: Grandma was in good spirits after the visit.
sentences.zh: 探望完之後，奶奶心情很好。

sentences.en: Why is everyone in such high spirits today?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家今天都這麼興高采烈？

sentences.en: I found a great parking spot near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 我在入口附近找到一個很棒的停車位。

sentences.en: Is there a spot on my shirt?
sentences.zh: 我的襯衫上是不是有一塊污漬？

sentences.en: This is our favorite picnic spot by the lake.
sentences.zh: 這是我們最愛的湖邊野餐地點。

gloss_note: spread butter on bread 在麵包上抹奶油

sentences.en: Spread some peanut butter on my toast, please.
sentences.zh: 請幫我在吐司上抹些花生醬。

sentences.en: Can you spread the blanket out on the grass?
sentences.zh: 你可以把毯子攤開鋪在草地上嗎？

sentences.en: The news spread fast around our school.
sentences.zh: 這個消息在我們學校傳得很快。

sentences.en: Which state were you born in?
sentences.zh: 你是在哪一州出生的？

sentences.en: My aunt lives in a different state.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨住在別的州。

sentences.en: We camped at a state park last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們去年夏天在一座州立公園露營。

gloss_note: 指信紙信封類文具；勿與 stationary 混

sentences.en: I need new stationery to write Grandma a letter.
sentences.zh: 我需要新信紙來寫信給奶奶。

sentences.en: Does this store sell cute stationery?
sentences.zh: 這家店有賣可愛的文具嗎？

sentences.en: She wrote the thank-you note on pretty stationery.
sentences.zh: 她把感謝卡寫在漂亮的信紙上。

gloss_note: 過去式是 stole；被偷用 get stolen

sentences.en: Someone tried to steal my bike last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有人想偷我的腳踏車。

sentences.en: Did your little brother steal my cookie again?
sentences.zh: 你弟弟又偷吃我的餅乾了嗎？

sentences.en: In the movie, a clever cat steals the jewels.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一隻聰明的貓偷走了那些珠寶。

sentences.en: Steam rose from the hot bowl of soup.
sentences.zh: 熱湯的碗裡冒出陣陣蒸氣。

sentences.en: Should I steam the broccoli or roast it?
sentences.zh: 花椰菜要用蒸的還是烤的？

sentences.en: Careful! The steam from the kettle can burn you.
sentences.zh: 小心！水壺冒出的蒸氣會燙傷你。

gloss_note: watch your step 小心腳下

sentences.en: Watch your step. The stairs are wet.
sentences.zh: 小心腳下，樓梯是濕的。

sentences.en: Can you take one step back, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你往後退一步嗎？

sentences.en: We sat on the front step and ate ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在門口的台階上吃冰淇淋。

gloss_note: stingy with money 花錢很小氣

sentences.en: Don't be stingy. Share your candy with me!
sentences.zh: 別小氣嘛，分我一點糖果！

sentences.en: Are you being stingy with the popcorn again?
sentences.zh: 你又捨不得分爆米花了嗎？

sentences.en: He's too stingy to buy a new coat.
sentences.zh: 他小氣到捨不得買件新外套。

sentences.en: I have a stomachache. Can I go home?
sentences.zh: 我肚子痛，可以回家嗎？

sentences.en: Did you get a stomachache after eating that pizza?
sentences.zh: 你吃了那個披薩之後肚子痛嗎？

sentences.en: Too much candy gave her a stomachache.
sentences.zh: 糖果吃太多讓她肚子痛。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 大塊的石頭美式多說 rock

sentences.en: The kids skipped a stone across the lake.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在湖面上打水漂。

sentences.en: Can you feel a stone in your shoe?
sentences.zh: 你感覺得到鞋子裡有顆小石頭嗎？

sentences.en: The old castle wall is made of gray stone.
sentences.zh: 那座古堡的牆是用灰色石頭砌成的。

sentences.en: A big storm is coming tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚會有一場大暴風雨。

sentences.en: Did the storm knock out your power?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨有讓你們家停電嗎？

sentences.en: We watched the storm from the front porch.
sentences.zh: 我們在前廊看著暴風雨。

gloss_note: stormy weather 風雨交加的天氣

sentences.en: It was a dark and stormy night.
sentences.zh: 那是個漆黑又風雨交加的夜晚。

sentences.en: Is the weather going to stay stormy all week?
sentences.zh: 這週天氣會一直都這麼風雨交加嗎？

sentences.en: Stormy weather canceled our soccer game on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 週六的暴風雨讓我們的足球賽取消了。

sentences.en: Please turn off the stove before you leave.
sentences.zh: 出門前請把爐火關掉。

sentences.en: Is the stove still hot?
sentences.zh: 爐子還很燙嗎？

sentences.en: Mom is cooking soup on the stove.
sentences.zh: 媽媽正在爐子上煮湯。

gloss_note: 餐廳常問 Do you need a straw?

sentences.en: Can I have a straw, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一支吸管嗎？

sentences.en: She sipped her milkshake through a paper straw.
sentences.zh: 她用紙吸管啜飲著奶昔。

sentences.en: Many restaurants now use paper straws instead of plastic.
sentences.zh: 現在很多餐廳都改用紙吸管，不用塑膠的了。

gloss_note: stream a movie 串流播放電影

sentences.en: We crossed a small stream on our hike.
sentences.zh: 我們健行時越過了一條小溪。

sentences.en: Do you want to stream a movie tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚你想在網路上看部電影嗎？

sentences.en: The kids caught frogs in the stream.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在小溪裡抓青蛙。

sentences.en: The pitcher threw a strike right down the middle.
sentences.zh: 投手投出正中間的好球。

sentences.en: Was that pitch a ball or a strike?
sentences.zh: 剛剛那球是壞球還是好球？

sentences.en: Two strikes, and the crowd got really quiet.
sentences.zh: 兩好球了，觀眾席變得非常安靜。

gloss_note: not my style 不是我的菜

sentences.en: That jacket is totally my style.
sentences.zh: 那件外套完全是我的風格。

sentences.en: Which style do you like better, long or short?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡哪種款式，長的還是短的？

sentences.en: Her teaching style is relaxed and fun.
sentences.zh: 她的教學風格輕鬆又有趣。

gloss_note: 美式說 subway，英式說 underground

sentences.en: I take the subway to work every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天搭地鐵去上班。

sentences.en: Which subway line goes to the airport?
sentences.zh: 哪一條地鐵線有到機場？

sentences.en: The subway was packed, so we stood the whole way.
sentences.zh: 地鐵擠滿了人，所以我們一路站到底。

gloss_note: succeed in doing 成功做到

sentences.en: If you keep trying, you will succeed.
sentences.zh: 只要你持續努力，就會成功。

sentences.en: How did she succeed in starting a business?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼成功創業的？

sentences.en: We finally succeeded in fixing the old radio.
sentences.zh: 我們終於把那台舊收音機修好了。

sentences.en: The school bake sale was a huge success.
sentences.zh: 學校的烘焙義賣非常成功。

sentences.en: What is the secret to your success?
sentences.zh: 你成功的祕訣是什麼？

sentences.en: Practice is the key to success in sports.
sentences.zh: 練習是運動場上成功的關鍵。

gloss_note: all of a sudden 突然間

sentences.en: All of a sudden, the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 突然間，燈全都熄滅了。

sentences.en: Why the sudden change of plans?
sentences.zh: 怎麼突然改變計畫了？

sentences.en: The bus made a sudden stop, and I almost fell.
sentences.zh: 公車突然煞車，我差點跌倒。

gloss_note: 接 -ing 或 that 子句，不接 to

sentences.en: I suggest taking a different road home.
sentences.zh: 我建議回家時走另一條路。

sentences.en: What do you suggest for a first-time visitor?
sentences.zh: 對第一次來的遊客，你有什麼建議？

sentences.en: My teacher suggested that I read more.
sentences.zh: 我的老師建議我多閱讀。

gloss_note: suit and tie 西裝領帶；suit you 適合你

sentences.en: Dad wears a suit and tie to work.
sentences.zh: 爸爸穿西裝打領帶去上班。

sentences.en: Do I need a suit for the interview?
sentences.zh: 面試我需要穿西裝嗎？

sentences.en: That color really suits you.
sentences.zh: 那個顏色真的很適合你。

gloss_note: 口語 super good 超好吃，等於 very

sentences.en: That was a super fun party!
sentences.zh: 那場派對超好玩的！

sentences.en: Are you super hungry right now?
sentences.zh: 你現在是不是餓壞了？

sentences.en: The pizza was super good, and so cheap.
sentences.zh: 那個披薩超好吃，又超便宜。

gloss_note: 美國較常說 dinner，supper 較傳統

sentences.en: Mom, what's for supper tonight?
sentences.zh: 媽，今晚晚餐吃什麼？

sentences.en: Grandma serves supper at six every evening.
sentences.zh: 奶奶每天傍晚六點開飯。

sentences.en: We had a light supper after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，我們吃了簡單的晚餐。

sentences.en: My parents always support whatever I choose.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽總是支持我做的任何選擇。

sentences.en: Can you call tech support about my laptop?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我打電話給技術支援，問一下我筆電的問題嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks for coming to support our team!
sentences.zh: 謝謝你來幫我們的球隊加油！

gloss_note: survive a crash 在車禍中倖存

sentences.en: Plants can't survive without water and sunlight.
sentences.zh: 植物沒有水和陽光就無法存活。

sentences.en: Did your tomatoes survive the cold night?
sentences.zh: 你的番茄熬過那個寒冷的夜晚了嗎？

sentences.en: He barely survived his first week at the job.
sentences.zh: 他勉強撐過了這份工作的第一週。

sentences.en: It hurts when I swallow.
sentences.zh: 我吞東西的時候會痛。

sentences.en: Can you swallow this pill without water?
sentences.zh: 你可以不配水吞下這顆藥嗎？

sentences.en: Chew your food well before you swallow it.
sentences.zh: 吞下去之前，食物要好好嚼一嚼。

sentences.en: A white swan floated across the quiet pond.
sentences.zh: 一隻白天鵝滑過平靜的池塘。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a black swan?
sentences.zh: 你有看過黑天鵝嗎？

sentences.en: The kids watched the swans at the park.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在公園裡看天鵝。

sentences.en: Can you sweep the kitchen floor, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把廚房地板掃一掃嗎？

sentences.en: Dad is sweeping leaves off the porch.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正在掃前廊上的落葉。

sentences.en: I sweep the garage every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 我每個週六早上都會掃車庫。

sentences.en: Let's go swimming after lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們午餐後去游泳吧。

sentences.en: My doctor says swimming is good exercise.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生說游泳是很好的運動。

sentences.en: Are you taking swimming lessons this summer?
sentences.zh: 你今年夏天要去上游泳課嗎？

sentences.en: Don't forget your swimsuit and a towel.
sentences.zh: 別忘了帶泳衣和毛巾。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that swimsuit?
sentences.zh: 你那件泳衣是在哪裡買的？

sentences.en: My swimsuit is still wet from yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我的泳衣從昨天到現在還是濕的。

sentences.en: What does this symbol on the sign mean?
sentences.zh: 這個標誌上的符號是什麼意思？

sentences.en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
sentences.zh: 鴿子是和平的象徵。

sentences.en: The recycling symbol is on the bottom of the bottle.
sentences.zh: 瓶子底部有回收符號。

sentences.en: The computer system is down again.
sentences.zh: 電腦系統又當機了。

sentences.en: Does your car have a good sound system?
sentences.zh: 你的車有很好的音響系統嗎？

sentences.en: Our school has a new grading system.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有新的評分制度。

sentences.en: Is the tableware dishwasher safe?
sentences.zh: 這些餐具可以放洗碗機洗嗎？

sentences.en: Mom keeps her best tableware for Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 媽媽把她最好的餐具留到感恩節才用。

sentences.en: Please put the plastic tableware on the picnic table.
sentences.zh: 請把塑膠餐具放在野餐桌上。

gloss_note: Taiwanese food 台灣菜；也可指台語

sentences.en: I love Taiwanese food, especially the beef noodles.
sentences.zh: 我愛吃台灣菜，尤其是牛肉麵。

sentences.en: Wait, are your parents Taiwanese too?
sentences.zh: 等等，你爸媽也是台灣人嗎？

sentences.en: Her grandmother is Taiwanese and cooks amazing dumplings.
sentences.zh: 她奶奶是台灣人，包的水餃超好吃。

sentences.en: Our school talent show is next Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們學校的才藝表演在下週五。

sentences.en: Does your little sister have a talent for singing?
sentences.zh: 你妹妹有唱歌的天分嗎？

sentences.en: He has a real talent for fixing things.
sentences.zh: 他很有修理東西的天分。

sentences.en: My little sister is very talkative in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹早上話特別多。

sentences.en: Why are you so talkative today?
sentences.zh: 你今天怎麼話這麼多？

sentences.en: The talkative driver told us stories the whole ride.
sentences.zh: 那位愛聊天的司機一路上都在講故事給我們聽。

sentences.en: I packed a tangerine in your lunch.
sentences.zh: 我在你的午餐裡放了一顆橘子。

sentences.en: Do you want a tangerine or an apple?
sentences.zh: 你要橘子還是蘋果？

sentences.en: Peel the tangerine first, then eat it.
sentences.zh: 先把橘子剝皮，再吃。

gloss_note: gas tank 油箱；fish tank 魚缸

sentences.en: We need to fill the gas tank before the trip.
sentences.zh: 出發前我們得先把油箱加滿。

sentences.en: How much water does this tank hold?
sentences.zh: 這個水箱可以裝多少水？

sentences.en: The toilet tank is leaking again.
sentences.zh: 馬桶水箱又漏水了。

gloss_note: a pot of tea 一壺茶

sentences.en: Grandma pours tea from her old teapot.
sentences.zh: 奶奶用她的老茶壺倒茶。

sentences.en: Can you fill the teapot with hot water?
sentences.zh: 你可以在茶壺裡裝些熱水嗎？

sentences.en: The teapot broke when it fell off the shelf.
sentences.zh: 茶壺從架子上掉下來摔破了。

gloss_note: burst into tears 突然大哭

sentences.en: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
sentences.zh: 她聽到那個消息時突然哭了出來。

sentences.en: Why are there tears in your eyes?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼眼眶泛淚？

sentences.en: A single tear rolled down his cheek.
sentences.zh: 一滴眼淚滑過他的臉頰。

sentences.en: What's the temperature outside right now?
sentences.zh: 現在外面幾度？

sentences.en: Let me take your temperature. You feel warm.
sentences.zh: 我來量一下你的體溫，你摸起來好燙。

sentences.en: The temperature dropped fast after the sun went down.
sentences.zh: 太陽下山後，氣溫急速下降。

gloss_note: set up a tent 搭帳篷

sentences.en: We set up the tent near the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊搭起了帳篷。

sentences.en: Is the tent big enough for four people?
sentences.zh: 這頂帳篷夠四個人睡嗎？

sentences.en: It rained all night, but the tent stayed dry.
sentences.zh: 整晚都在下雨，但帳篷裡還是乾的。

gloss_note: in terms of 就…而言；long-term 長期

sentences.en: What's the right term for this tool?
sentences.zh: 這個工具的正確說法是什麼？

sentences.en: Please use the correct term in your report.
sentences.zh: 請在報告中使用正確的用語。

sentences.en: The doctor used a medical term I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 醫生用了一個我不懂的醫學術語。

sentences.en: That's a terrific idea! Let's do it.
sentences.zh: 這主意太棒了！我們就這麼做吧。

sentences.en: You did a terrific job on the project.
sentences.zh: 你的專題做得真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Isn't this weather terrific today?
sentences.zh: 今天這天氣不是好得沒話說嗎？

sentences.en: Open your textbook to page twenty, please.
sentences.zh: 請把課本翻到第二十頁。

sentences.en: I left my math textbook in my locker.
sentences.zh: 我把數學課本忘在置物櫃裡了。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your science textbook tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚我可以跟你借自然課本嗎？

gloss_note: 十一月第四個週四；吃火雞

sentences.en: We always eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 我們感恩節一定會吃火雞。

sentences.en: What are you doing for Thanksgiving?
sentences.zh: 你感恩節要怎麼過？

sentences.en: My cousins are flying in for Thanksgiving weekend.
sentences.zh: 我的表兄弟姊妹要搭飛機來過感恩節週末。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 書面語氣；口語多說 so

sentences.en: The roads were icy; therefore, school was canceled.
sentences.zh: 路面結冰，因此學校停課了。

sentences.en: Can you use therefore to connect these two sentences?
sentences.zh: 你能用「因此」把這兩個句子連起來嗎？

sentences.en: She practiced daily and therefore played very well.
sentences.zh: 她每天練習，因此表現得非常好。

sentences.en: A thief took the packages from our porch.
sentences.zh: 小偷把我們前廊的包裹拿走了。

sentences.en: Did the police catch the thief?
sentences.zh: 警察抓到那個小偷了嗎？

sentences.en: In the movie, the thief is actually a nice guy.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，那個小偷其實是個好人。

sentences.en: I hurt my thumb closing the car door.
sentences.zh: 我關車門時弄傷了拇指。

sentences.en: Give me a thumbs up if you're ready.
sentences.zh: 準備好了就比個讚給我。

sentences.en: Which thumb do you use to text?
sentences.zh: 你傳訊息時用哪隻拇指？

sentences.en: Did you hear that thunder last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有聽到那聲雷嗎？

sentences.en: The thunder was so loud that our dog hid.
sentences.zh: 雷聲大到我們家的狗都躲起來了。

sentences.en: We left the park when we heard thunder.
sentences.zh: 我們聽到打雷就離開了公園。

sentences.en: This apartment has a tiny kitchen.
sentences.zh: 這間公寓的廚房很小。

sentences.en: Can I have just a tiny piece of cake?
sentences.zh: 我可以只吃一小塊蛋糕嗎？

sentences.en: The baby has tiny hands and tiny feet.
sentences.zh: 那個寶寶的手腳都好小。

gloss_note: 美式拼 tire，英式拼 tyre

sentences.en: I think I have a flat tire.
sentences.zh: 我想我的輪胎沒氣了。

sentences.en: Can you check the air in the tires?
sentences.zh: 你可以檢查一下輪胎的氣壓嗎？

sentences.en: Dad is changing a flat tire on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正在路邊換掉沒氣的輪胎。

gloss_note: 常見搭配：the title of a book／song

sentences.en: What's the title of that movie?
sentences.zh: 那部電影叫什麼名字？

sentences.en: The book has a really funny title.
sentences.zh: 這本書的書名很好笑。

sentences.en: I forgot the song title, but I know the tune.
sentences.zh: 我忘了歌名，但記得旋律。

gloss_note: 不可數；a block of tofu 一塊豆腐

sentences.en: Do you want tofu or chicken in your stir-fry?
sentences.zh: 你的炒菜要放豆腐還是雞肉？

sentences.en: We had tofu soup for dinner last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚晚餐喝了豆腐湯。

sentences.en: Mom bought a block of tofu at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在超市買了一塊豆腐。

gloss_note: 指馬桶本身；公共場所說 restroom

sentences.en: The toilet is clogged again.
sentences.zh: 馬桶又塞住了。

sentences.en: Please flush the toilet after you use it.
sentences.zh: 用完馬桶請記得沖水。

sentences.en: Can you clean the toilet before the guests come?
sentences.zh: 客人來之前你能刷一下馬桶嗎？

gloss_note: stick out your tongue 伸出舌頭

sentences.en: Please stick out your tongue and say ah.
sentences.zh: 請把舌頭伸出來說「啊」。

sentences.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
sentences.zh: 我的舌頭被熱湯燙到了。

sentences.en: Did the candy turn your tongue blue?
sentences.zh: 那顆糖把你的舌頭染成藍色了嗎？

gloss_note: have a toothache 牙痛；可數名詞

sentences.en: I have a terrible toothache today.
sentences.zh: 我今天牙痛得很厲害。

sentences.en: Does your toothache still bother you?
sentences.zh: 你的牙還在痛嗎？

sentences.en: He stayed home from school with a toothache.
sentences.zh: 他因為牙痛沒去上學。

sentences.en: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 別忘了把牙刷放進行李。

sentences.en: Whose toothbrush is this on the sink?
sentences.zh: 洗手台上這支是誰的牙刷？

sentences.en: My dentist says to replace my toothbrush every three months.
sentences.zh: 牙醫說牙刷每三個月要換一支。

gloss_note: clock tower 鐘塔；water tower 水塔

sentences.en: We can see the tower from our window.
sentences.zh: 我們從窗戶就能看到那座塔。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to the top of a tower?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有爬上過塔頂？

sentences.en: The kids built a tower out of blocks.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用積木堆了一座塔。

gloss_note: no trace of 毫無蹤跡

sentences.en: There was no trace of the missing cat.
sentences.zh: 那隻走失的貓完全不見蹤影。

sentences.en: Can you trace where this package came from?
sentences.zh: 你查得出這個包裹是從哪寄來的嗎？

sentences.en: We traced the noise to a loose pipe.
sentences.zh: 我們查出噪音是來自一根鬆脫的水管。

gloss_note: trade A for B 用 A 換 B

sentences.en: Do you want to trade lunches with me today?
sentences.zh: 你今天要不要跟我換午餐？

sentences.en: He traded his old bike for a skateboard.
sentences.zh: 他把舊腳踏車換成了滑板。

sentences.en: The kids trade baseball cards at recess.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在下課時間交換棒球卡。

sentences.en: Eating turkey is a Thanksgiving tradition.
sentences.zh: 吃火雞是感恩節的傳統。

sentences.en: What's your family tradition on New Year's Eve?
sentences.zh: 你們家跨年夜有什麼傳統？

sentences.en: We keep the tradition of baking cookies every December.
sentences.zh: 我們每年十二月都會烤餅乾，一直沿襲這個傳統。

sentences.en: My grandma makes a traditional Taiwanese breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶會做傳統的台式早餐。

sentences.en: Is this a traditional wedding dress?
sentences.zh: 這是傳統的婚紗嗎？

sentences.en: They sell traditional snacks at that little shop.
sentences.zh: 那家小店賣傳統小吃。

sentences.en: Is there public transportation near your apartment?
sentences.zh: 你的公寓附近有大眾運輸嗎？

sentences.en: My car broke down, so I need transportation.
sentences.zh: 我的車壞了，所以需要交通工具。

sentences.en: Biking is my main transportation to work.
sentences.zh: 騎腳踏車是我上班主要的交通方式。

gloss_note: mousetrap 捕鼠器；be trapped 被困住

sentences.en: We set a trap for the mouse in the garage.
sentences.zh: 我們在車庫放了捕鼠器抓老鼠。

sentences.en: Were you trapped in the elevator for long?
sentences.zh: 你被困在電梯裡很久嗎？

sentences.en: Don't fall into the trap of buying too much.
sentences.zh: 別掉進買太多東西的陷阱。

gloss_note: 美式過去式 traveled；travel by train

sentences.en: We love to travel in the summer.
sentences.zh: 我們喜歡在夏天旅行。

sentences.en: Have you ever traveled alone?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有一個人旅行過？

sentences.en: My dad travels a lot for work.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸工作常常出差。

sentences.en: The kids had a treasure hunt in the yard.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩尋寶遊戲。

sentences.en: Did the pirates really bury treasure on this island?
sentences.zh: 海盜真的把寶藏埋在這座島上嗎？

sentences.en: This old photo is a family treasure.
sentences.zh: 這張老照片是我們家的傳家寶。

gloss_note: a right triangle 直角三角形

sentences.en: Can you draw a triangle on the board?
sentences.zh: 你可以在黑板上畫一個三角形嗎？

sentences.en: Mom cut my sandwich into two triangles.
sentences.zh: 媽媽把我的三明治切成兩個三角形。

sentences.en: That slice of pizza looks like a triangle.
sentences.zh: 那片披薩看起來像個三角形。

sentences.en: My brother plays the trumpet in the school band.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥在學校樂隊吹小號。

sentences.en: Can you hear the trumpet in this song?
sentences.zh: 你聽得到這首歌裡的小號嗎？

sentences.en: I practiced the trumpet for an hour yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天練了一小時的小號。

gloss_note: Trust me. 相信我；trust A with B

sentences.en: Trust me, you'll love this movie.
sentences.zh: 相信我，你會愛上這部電影。

sentences.en: Can I trust him with my keys?
sentences.zh: 我可以把鑰匙交給他保管嗎？

sentences.en: We trusted the doctor and followed her advice.
sentences.zh: 我們信任醫生，照著她的建議做。

sentences.en: Please tell me the truth.
sentences.zh: 請跟我說實話。

sentences.en: To tell the truth, I forgot your birthday.
sentences.zh: 老實說，我忘了你的生日。

sentences.en: Do you know the truth about what happened?
sentences.zh: 你知道事情的真相嗎？

gloss_note: bathtub 常簡稱 tub；a tub of 一桶

sentences.en: The baby is playing in the tub.
sentences.zh: 寶寶正在浴缸裡玩水。

sentences.en: Can you wash the tub after your bath?
sentences.zh: 你洗完澡後可以把浴缸刷一下嗎？

sentences.en: We bought a big tub of ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我們買了一大桶冰淇淋。

gloss_note: a tube of toothpaste 一條牙膏

sentences.en: Can you grab a tube of toothpaste at the store?
sentences.zh: 你可以去店裡順便買一條牙膏嗎？

sentences.en: Squeeze the tube from the bottom, not the middle.
sentences.zh: 軟管要從底部往上擠，不要從中間擠。

sentences.en: Our fish tank needs a new air tube.
sentences.zh: 我們的魚缸需要換一條新的打氣管。

gloss_note: go through a tunnel 穿過隧道

sentences.en: The car went through a long tunnel.
sentences.zh: 那輛車開過一條很長的隧道。

sentences.en: Is there a tunnel on the way to the airport?
sentences.zh: 去機場的路上有隧道嗎？

sentences.en: The kids dug a tunnel in the sand.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在沙灘上挖了一條地道。

sentences.en: Mom cooks a big turkey every Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 每年感恩節媽媽都會烤一隻大火雞。

sentences.en: Who wants more turkey and gravy?
sentences.zh: 誰還要再來點火雞肉和肉汁？

sentences.en: Leftover turkey makes a great sandwich the day after Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 感恩節隔天，吃剩的火雞肉最適合做三明治。

gloss_note: underline the answer 在答案下劃線

sentences.en: Please underline the main idea in the paragraph.
sentences.zh: 請在這段文字裡把主旨劃上底線。

sentences.en: Did you underline the new words in your book?
sentences.zh: 你有把課本裡的生字劃底線嗎？

sentences.en: She underlined the date so nobody would miss it.
sentences.zh: 她在日期下面劃線，免得大家漏看。

gloss_note: 指穿越公路或鐵路下方的通道

sentences.en: We walk through the underpass to get to school.
sentences.zh: 我們穿過地下道去上學。

sentences.en: Is there an underpass near the train station?
sentences.zh: 火車站附近有地下道嗎？

sentences.en: The underpass was dark, so Mom held my hand.
sentences.zh: 地下道很暗，所以媽媽牽著我的手。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 不可數；美式 pants 指長褲，不是內褲

sentences.en: Don't forget to pack extra underwear for the trip.
sentences.zh: 別忘了多帶幾件內褲出門旅行。

sentences.en: Where did you put my clean underwear?
sentences.zh: 你把我洗乾淨的內衣褲放哪了？

sentences.en: She folded the underwear and put it in the drawer.
sentences.zh: 她把內衣褲摺好，放進抽屜。

sentences.en: Every snowflake looks unique under a microscope.
sentences.zh: 在顯微鏡下，每片雪花看起來都獨一無二。

sentences.en: This shop sells unique gifts you can't find anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣的獨特禮物，別的地方買不到。

sentences.en: What makes your hometown so unique?
sentences.zh: 你的家鄉有什麼特別之處？

gloss_note: the universe 前面要加 the

sentences.en: Scientists say the universe is still growing.
sentences.zh: 科學家說宇宙還在擴張。

sentences.en: How big is the universe?
sentences.zh: 宇宙到底有多大？

sentences.en: My little brother loves books about the universe.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟很愛看有關宇宙的書。

gloss_note: 美式口語常說 college 泛指上大學

sentences.en: My older sister goes to a university in another state.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊在外州的一所大學念書。

sentences.en: Which university are you applying to?
sentences.zh: 你要申請哪一所大學？

sentences.en: Dad teaches at the university near our house.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在我們家附近的大學教書。

gloss_note: go upstairs 上樓；反義 downstairs

sentences.en: The bedrooms are all upstairs.
sentences.zh: 臥室都在樓上。

sentences.en: Can you come upstairs and help me?
sentences.zh: 你可以上樓來幫我嗎？

sentences.en: She ran upstairs to get her phone.
sentences.zh: 她跑上樓去拿手機。

sentences.en: As usual, the bus was late.
sentences.zh: 公車一如往常地誤點了。

sentences.en: Are you getting your usual coffee today?
sentences.zh: 你今天還是點平常那杯咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: I woke up earlier than usual this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上比平常早起。

gloss_note: Valentine's Day 是二月十四日

sentences.en: She gave every classmate a Valentine.
sentences.zh: 她送給每位同學一張情人節卡片。

sentences.en: Will you be my Valentine?
sentences.zh: 你願意當我的情人嗎？

sentences.en: He sent a Valentine to his grandmother.
sentences.zh: 他寄了一張情人節卡片給奶奶。

gloss_note: a green valley 綠色山谷

sentences.en: The farm sits in a green valley.
sentences.zh: 那座農場坐落在一片綠色山谷裡。

sentences.en: Is it cold in the valley at night?
sentences.zh: 山谷裡晚上會冷嗎？

sentences.en: We hiked down into the valley before sunset.
sentences.zh: 我們在日落前健行走進山谷。

sentences.en: Don't leave anything valuable in the car.
sentences.zh: 別把貴重物品留在車上。

sentences.en: Thanks, your advice was really valuable.
sentences.zh: 謝謝，你的建議真的很有價值。

sentences.en: Is this old coin valuable?
sentences.zh: 這枚舊硬幣值錢嗎？

gloss_note: good value 划算；value your time

sentences.en: This jacket is a great value for the price.
sentences.zh: 以這個價錢來說，這件外套很划算。

sentences.en: I value my sleep, so I go to bed early.
sentences.zh: 我很重視睡眠，所以很早就上床。

sentences.en: Does this old watch have any value?
sentences.zh: 這支舊手錶有任何價值嗎？

sentences.en: A street vendor sells hot dogs outside the stadium.
sentences.zh: 有個路邊小販在球場外賣熱狗。

sentences.en: Is that vendor selling fresh fruit?
sentences.zh: 那個攤商有在賣新鮮水果嗎？

sentences.en: Each vendor at the farmers market has a small booth.
sentences.zh: 農夫市集的每位攤商都有一個小攤位。

gloss_note: 美式 vest 是背心；英式 vest 指汗衫

sentences.en: It's cool today, so I'm wearing a vest.
sentences.zh: 今天有點涼，所以我穿了一件背心。

sentences.en: Where did you buy that puffy vest?
sentences.zh: 你那件羽絨背心在哪買的？

sentences.en: The worker wore a bright orange vest.
sentences.zh: 那位工人穿著亮橘色的背心。

sentences.en: Our team celebrated its first victory of the season.
sentences.zh: 我們球隊慶祝本季的第一場勝利。

sentences.en: Was that victory a surprise to you?
sentences.zh: 這場勝利讓你意外嗎？

sentences.en: Great job, everyone! This victory is for all of us.
sentences.zh: 大家做得好！這場勝利屬於我們每個人。

sentences.en: My grandpa grew up in a small village.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺在一個小村莊長大。

sentences.en: Is there a store in your village?
sentences.zh: 你們村子裡有商店嗎？

sentences.en: Everyone in the village came to the festival.
sentences.zh: 村裡每個人都來參加慶典。

sentences.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad.
sentences.zh: 在沙拉裡加一點醋。

sentences.en: Do we have any vinegar in the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 我們廚房裡還有醋嗎？

sentences.en: Mom cleans the windows with vinegar and water.
sentences.zh: 媽媽用醋和水擦窗戶。

gloss_note: build your vocabulary 增加字彙量

sentences.en: We have a vocabulary quiz on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們週五有字彙小考。

sentences.en: How can I improve my vocabulary?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼增加我的字彙量？

sentences.en: She learned many new vocabulary words from the movie.
sentences.zh: 她從那部電影學到很多新單字。

sentences.en: We play volleyball after school on Tuesdays.
sentences.zh: 我們每週二放學後打排球。

sentences.en: Do you want to join our volleyball team?
sentences.zh: 你想加入我們的排球隊嗎？

sentences.en: She hit the volleyball over the net.
sentences.zh: 她把排球打過了網。

gloss_note: vote for A 投給 A；take a vote 表決

sentences.en: Let's vote on where to eat tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們來投票決定今晚去哪吃吧。

sentences.en: Who gets your vote for class president?
sentences.zh: 你要把票投給誰當班長？

sentences.en: The club will vote for a new leader on Monday.
sentences.zh: 社團週一要投票選出新社長。

gloss_note: waist 是腰部，back 才是背

sentences.en: These pants are too tight around the waist.
sentences.zh: 這條褲子的腰圍太緊了。

sentences.en: The water came up to my waist.
sentences.zh: 水深到我的腰部。

sentences.en: What's your waist size in these pants?
sentences.zh: 這款褲子你的腰圍是多少？

sentences.en: Dad and I watched an old war movie on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我和爸爸週日看了一部老戰爭片。

sentences.en: Do you know why that war started?
sentences.zh: 你知道那場戰爭為什麼會爆發嗎？

sentences.en: My great-grandpa told us stories about the war.
sentences.zh: 我曾祖父跟我們講過那場戰爭的故事。

sentences.en: Don't waste water while you brush your teeth.
sentences.zh: 刷牙時不要浪費水。

sentences.en: Is it a waste of money to buy this?
sentences.zh: 買這個是不是浪費錢？

sentences.en: I wasted an hour looking for my keys.
sentences.zh: 我花了一個小時找鑰匙，白白浪費時間。

sentences.en: We hiked to two beautiful waterfalls last weekend.
sentences.zh: 上週末我們健行去看了兩座美麗的瀑布。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen waterfalls in person?
sentences.zh: 你有親眼看過瀑布嗎？

sentences.en: There is a small waterfall behind our campsite.
sentences.zh: 我們的營地後面有一座小瀑布。

sentences.en: We're going to my best friend's wedding on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們週六要去參加我最好朋友的婚禮。

sentences.en: Where will the wedding be held?
sentences.zh: 婚禮會在哪裡舉行？

sentences.en: Her wedding dress was white and simple.
sentences.zh: 她的婚紗是白色的，款式簡單。

gloss_note: on weekdays 在平日；反義 weekend

sentences.en: The store is open on weekdays from nine to five.
sentences.zh: 這家店平日從九點營業到五點。

sentences.en: Do you work out on weekdays or weekends?
sentences.zh: 你是平日還是週末運動？

sentences.en: Traffic is terrible on a weekday morning.
sentences.zh: 平日早上的車流很糟。

sentences.en: What's the weight limit for this bag?
sentences.zh: 這個袋子的重量上限是多少？

sentences.en: The nurse checked my weight and height.
sentences.zh: 護士量了我的體重和身高。

sentences.en: He lost some weight after he started running.
sentences.zh: 他開始跑步後瘦了一些。

sentences.en: We saw a whale during our boat trip.
sentences.zh: 我們坐船出遊時看到了一隻鯨魚。

sentences.en: How big is a blue whale?
sentences.zh: 藍鯨到底有多大？

sentences.en: A baby whale stays close to its mother.
sentences.zh: 小鯨魚會緊跟在媽媽身邊。

sentences.en: One wheel on my suitcase is broken.
sentences.zh: 我行李箱有一個輪子壞了。

sentences.en: Is the front wheel of your bike loose?
sentences.zh: 你腳踏車的前輪鬆了嗎？

sentences.en: The shopping cart has a squeaky wheel.
sentences.zh: 那台購物推車有個輪子會吱吱叫。

sentences.en: I watched movies the whole weekend.
sentences.zh: 我整個週末都在看電影。

sentences.en: Did you eat the whole pizza by yourself?
sentences.zh: 你一個人吃完了整個披薩嗎？

sentences.en: The whole class laughed at the joke.
sentences.zh: 全班都被那個笑話逗笑了。

sentences.en: Please don't feed the wild animals in the park.
sentences.zh: 請不要餵公園裡的野生動物。

sentences.en: Are these wild berries safe to eat?
sentences.zh: 這些野生莓果可以吃嗎？

sentences.en: Wild horses live in this part of the state.
sentences.zh: 這個州的這一帶有野馬棲息。

gloss_note: chicken wings 雞翅，美式常見點餐

sentences.en: The bird hurt its wing on the window.
sentences.zh: 那隻鳥的翅膀撞到窗戶受傷了。

sentences.en: Can we order a dozen wings for the game?
sentences.zh: 我們可以點十二塊雞翅來配比賽嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have the hot wings and a soda, please.
sentences.zh: 我要辣雞翅和一杯汽水，麻煩了。

sentences.en: Who was the winner of the spelling bee?
sentences.zh: 拼字比賽的冠軍是誰？

sentences.en: The winner gets a free movie ticket.
sentences.zh: 得獎的人可以拿到一張免費電影票。

sentences.en: Congratulations, you're the winner of our raffle!
sentences.zh: 恭喜，你是我們抽獎的得主！

gloss_note: 用 wok 炒菜、做炒飯

sentences.en: Heat the wok before you add the oil.
sentences.zh: 加油之前，先把炒鍋燒熱。

sentences.en: Do you have a wok, or only a frying pan?
sentences.zh: 你有炒鍋，還是只有平底鍋？

sentences.en: Dad cooks fried rice in his big wok.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用他的大炒鍋做炒飯。

gloss_note: 複數 wolves；lone wolf 孤狼

sentences.en: A wolf howled somewhere in the forest.
sentences.zh: 森林裡不知哪裡有隻狼在嚎叫。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a wolf at the zoo?
sentences.zh: 你有在動物園看過狼嗎？

sentences.en: The story is about a wolf and three pigs.
sentences.zh: 這個故事講的是一隻狼和三隻小豬。

sentences.en: This table is made of solid wood.
sentences.zh: 這張桌子是實木做的。

sentences.en: Dad bought some wood to build a shelf.
sentences.zh: 爸爸買了些木頭來做架子。

sentences.en: Is this floor real wood or fake?
sentences.zh: 這地板是真的木頭還是仿的？

gloss_note: The early bird gets the worm.

sentences.en: The early bird gets the worm.
sentences.zh: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。

sentences.en: Look at that worm on the sidewalk after the rain!
sentences.zh: 你看，雨後人行道上有一條蚯蚓！

sentences.en: Do fish really like worms as bait?
sentences.zh: 魚真的喜歡拿蟲當餌嗎？

gloss_note: 與 wind 過去式同形不同音；clean a wound

sentences.en: Clean the wound with soap and water.
sentences.zh: 用肥皂和水清洗傷口。

sentences.en: Does the wound still hurt?
sentences.zh: 傷口還會痛嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse covered the wound with a bandage.
sentences.zh: 護士用繃帶蓋住了傷口。

gloss_note: sprain your wrist 扭傷手腕

sentences.en: I hurt my wrist playing basketball.
sentences.zh: 我打籃球時弄傷了手腕。

sentences.en: Does your wrist hurt when you type?
sentences.zh: 你打字的時候手腕會痛嗎？

sentences.en: She wears a thin silver watch on her wrist.
sentences.zh: 她手腕上戴著一支細細的銀色手錶。

gloss_note: yell at 對…大吼；yell for help

sentences.en: Please don't yell at your little sister.
sentences.zh: 請不要對你妹妹大吼大叫。

sentences.en: Why is the coach yelling at them?
sentences.zh: 教練為什麼對他們大吼？

sentences.en: I yelled for help when I fell.
sentences.zh: 我跌倒時大聲喊救命。

gloss_note: youth soccer 青少年足球；in my youth

sentences.en: Our town has a youth soccer league.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上有青少年足球聯賽。

sentences.en: Dad played baseball a lot in his youth.
sentences.zh: 爸爸年輕時常打棒球。

sentences.en: Is there a youth center near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有青少年活動中心嗎？
